title: Trust the 5-star Reviews
text:
This place: the hotel, the rooms, the staff, the location, the prices....all top notch. I've already thought, if/when I get back to Paris, I'll likely stay here....

Paris is very expensive. This hotel does not skimp on quality, but the price was definitely one of the lowest I saw, short of a hostel or other undesired accommodation.

I started a review that I apparently lost.
The staff are very friendly and helpful.
There is a safe parking garage about 3-4 blocks away at The Bourse. It would be wise to book in advance for discounts. You can download a parking app to do it all electronically. I wish I knew that in advance.

There are a lot of useful establishments nearby (a carrefour (grocery store), a laundromat, a pharmacy as well as restaurants and a quick walk to the Palais Royal area with the Louvre, etc. I believe the Eiffel Tower is about a 45 minute walk along The Seine with it's views and lower level where folks exercise, have dance instructions at night, etc.)

I could spend a month in Paris exploring more that it has to offer, but alas I just had 5-1/2 days.

Enjoy!

title: Great experience overall
text:
My husband and I recently stayed at this hotel during our week in Paris and are very pleased with it. The staff were extremely helpful and accommodating. We had a "privilege room", which was quite spacious for 2 people and even had a designated dressing area/alcove and fridge. The drinks in the fridge were complimentary and replaced every day. Our room was cleaned well every day. We used their laundry service, which we were happy with and was reasonably priced. And even though they told us laundry given in the morning is usually returned the following day, our laundry (cleaned, pressed, and folded) was returned to us that afternoon on the same day. We were very impressed!

It rained occasionally during our trip (first week of September), and the hotel has plenty of umbrellas you can borrow. We took advantage of the buffet breakfasts in the lobby most mornings we were there, which were delicious! We stayed a week and there was enough variety that we didn't get tired of their breakfast options.

Our favorite part of the hotel was the free drinks (including a machine that makes most essential coffee beverages) and snacks (chips, nuts, breads, and pastries) that were available in the lobby all day. Our vacation involved a lot of walking, museums, sightseeing, etc. And it was such a welcome relief to take breaks at the hotel to relax, refuel and rehydrate, before going back out to see more! And the hotel is conveniently located that we could easily come back to it between stops on our daily itinerary. And another bonus is that there are multiple Astotel hotels all over Paris (17 locations I believe?), which we had access to if we wanted to use their restrooms, sit and rest, drinks/snacks in the lobby, etc. Which again, we found very helpful.

The only constructive criticism is that we found the sheets on our bed to be a little coarse. On a scale of 1 to 10, with 1 being the texture of sandpaper and 10 being very nice and soft bamboo sheets, we'd say the sheets on our bed were a 5 or 6. We didn't think it was that big a deal and didn't ask for them to be replaced. But it felt rough enough that we noticed it. 

Thank you for the wonderful stay at Hotel Malte Astotel. We highly recommend this hotel, and will definitely choose it again the next time we're in Paris.

title: Brilliant hotel with friendly staff - highly recommended
text:
I spend 3 nights at this hotel with my family and had a wonderful experience. First up, we were upgraded to a beautiful duplex room which was very spacious and clean. The room is well equipped, the staff is very friendly and supportive and the location of this hotel is simply perfect. It is walking distance from the Louvre and have ample cafes, restaurants and shopping all around. The hotel assisted with the airport transfers however even Uber is easily available and the train and bus stations are walking distance only.
The best and most important highlight of this hotel is that it is a part of a chain of hotels of Astotel Group located across Paris at key locations and as guests we have the luxury of using any of these hotels to freshen up and have coffee breaks between 2~2am. This is such a bonus for travelers especially with kids as it helps in taking a break during long days.
The breakfast was basic, not very wide spread…however it good and fresh, with usual eggs, bacons, fruits and baked goods. Maybe some fresh coffee would be advisable instead of having a coffee vending  machine.

The hotel also has a lounge area with free Wi-Fi and a work station to assist with any urgent needs. The have a small play area for toddlers as well.

Overall it was a please surprise for us at this hotel and will recommend this place for families as a nice, safe and warm stop in Paris. Thank you to the staff for all the love and support extended to us.

title: Great hotel, great service, great people!
text:
This was our first time visiting Paris. We are a family of 3 (2 adults and one 12yr old boy). After much research and discussions with others who have visited, we found and booked this hotel. 

Having a good experience was vital for a successful trip. We found the location of this hotel excellent.  Only 5 mins walk to the Louvre, and a wonderful 25-30 min walk to the Arc or the Eiffel tower. The walk allowed us to experience the streets of Paris.

The room (1 queen + 1 pullout chair/bed) was bigger than I expected. Quiet room with very little noise (if any). The bathroom had all the amenities include full tub and shower.  It even included a small beverage fridge that is restocked daily (at no additional cost).

The service was great for a family. The people spoke multiple langs including English, and were very helpful.  Helped us with bags, extra water when needed, and help with directions or just general questions. 

The family areas, including the open-bar (non-alcholic) after 2pm was perfect for us, for when we returned from our day sight-seeing, or just wanting a snack.

I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Paris, wanting to stay close to the Louvre area. I would stay again.

My disappointment was in the overall ambiance and atmosphere of the place. The front desk staff seemed distant and unwelcoming. The hotel was dark and dreary and showing its age. Little imperfections here and there in need of some TLC that have been ignored. These things count. No shampoo, or lotion etc in the rooms. No washcloths available for people who use them. All hotels should have Chromecast capabilities as we approach 2023 as well. As I said, this is a perfectly fine hotel, it just isn't a higher end hotel in my opinion. There's a certain je ne sais quoi you expect at 4 and 5 star hotels that you won't get here unfortunately. Decent spot, but vastly overrated.

title: Memorable stay
text:
We recently stayed at Novotel Paris Les Halles with my parents for 5 nights.  The location of the hotel is super convenient.  The Metro station is door steps away.  There are so many restaurants and bars nearby and it is right next to a Westfield shopping centre.  The Louvre and the Seine is only a few minutes’ walk.  The hotel has good facilities and breakfast is terrific. The staff are very friendly.  Everyone at the front desk is super nice, helpful and supportive.  My mother was injured during our trip to Europe and she was in wheelchair.  When we checked in, my mum didn’t come to the front desk.  Before going up to the room, Lada noticed my mum’s situation, she straight away found a different room which right next to the lift for my parents.  Lada enquired about my mum’s health every time she saw me, and helped my mum to call a doctor.  The host lady at breakfast (I forgot her name) was very caring and attentive.  She arranged a sitting close to the breakfast restaurant and help my father to deliver the food to my mum so she didn’t need to walk the stairs.

On the day we left, we need to catch the train to Amsterdam.  Due to Tour de France, there was no taxi.  With my mum in the wheelchair, and many luggage, we couldn’t travel through the metro by ourselves.  Careen and the other gentleman at Reception tried their best to help us.  Paolo also sent us to Gare du Nord.  On the way, he helped with our luggage, managed to prevent us being pocket lifted.  At the train station, he also helped us to liaise with the staff to arrange the accessible services for my mum.

All in all, we have a memorable stay at Novotel Paris Les Halles.  I can’t thank enough to everyone who helped us during our stay.   I highly recommend the hotel, and we will definitely stay again next time we are in Paris.

title: Great stay…amazing location!
text: I do kit is usually write reviews, but with this hotel stay I had to. We stayed here 3 nights as part of a multi-city UK/Fran e family trip with our 2 kids this past June. First off, the location of this hotel is absolutely perfect. It was our first time in Paris and the access to one of the main metro stations was key…it is right out front from the lobby doors. From this location we east went to  Montemarte and the Eiffel Tower area via metro. It is also within walking distance of St Germaine district and the Louvre. Do yourself a favor and get the breakfast buffet. It was very well appointed and had great food…we ate there every morning as it opens at 7:00. The rooms are super clean and quite spacious with the sofa bed up. By the way, the bed and even the sofa bed are very comfortable. The bathrooms are modern and overhead waterfall-type shower heads are a nice touch after a day of Paris sites. The staff was SUPER friendly and helpful with directions and even let us use their house phone to call the airlines as the airline lost a piece of luggage. They let me use the house phone for over 30 minutes…that would have cost me a fortune on my international cellular plan. The only drawback is that the bottled waters are not free, but no big deal. There is a nice little bar/restaurant right outside the lobby doors that is open late and we would get to-go drinks to take up to the room when we needed refreshments. If we ever go to Paris again, we will DEFINITELY stay here!  Great stay!!

title: Great Hotel, Perfect Location, Value for money
text:
We are from Thessaloniki, Greece and we chose the 45 sq. feet two bedroom suite for our visit to Paris.
The rooms are spacious, bright, with a huge corner window in the master bedroom that overlooks the gorgeous french roofs that stem Marguerit Sq. They are clean and well designed with a smart system of sliding doors that separate the master bedrooms’ way to the bathroom  from the secondary space and vice versa, a very convenient way to feel comfortable in your room, especially if you are sharing it with your nephew as I did. 
The bed was very comfortable, note that I have serious back pain issues and every morning I woke up feeling great. 
They change the towels every day and the pillowcases by demand. The suite has Molton Brown products for showering etc. 
The staff was very helpful and polite, especially in the dining area. You must try the hotels’ breakfast, its a value for money choice, everything is delicious and fresh. I think I’ve noticed five or six counters with different breakfast menus. Their baguettes, croissants and crepes are exceptional. 
On top of all, the best that this hotel has to offer is its location. The neighbourhood is full of small cafes, patisseries and multinational bars & restaurants. The atmosphere is happy and welcoming as you can walk on pebble stone paths without worrying about cars passing by. Although the hotel is in near everything, it is very quiet during the night. 
Rivoli Ave. where you can take a taxi to other parts of the city, is a 2 min walk. We payed about 15 - 20 euros for taxi transfer to Eiffel Tower, Or Basilique Sacr Coer in Montmartre, Le Ciel Montparnasse etc.
Pompidou Centre is a 5 min walk. The Louvre is a 12-15 min walk. The Seine is 7 min walk. Saint Chapelle is 15 min walk and you can walk another 15 min from there and reach Museum D’Orsey. So you actually have half the the things worth seeing in Paris in walking distance.
The hotels’ entrance is right in front of a metro line elevator, you can take the RER line from the airport and walk straight into Novotel Paris Les Halles. I wouldn’t recommend it though, because the train from the airport is extremely crowded, there’s no room for suitcases and the people are not willing to even move aside so as you can walk out of it. I would recommend you bought a taxi from and to the airport, its 60 euros worth spending. 
In the overall I was very glad I chose Novotel Paris Les Halles for our stay in Paris and I would recommend it to anyone who thinks that the hotel is not only for sleeping but it is part of your trip and a pivotal part of your journey. It’s a value for money experience.

title: Great funky hotel, great location
text:
There is so much going for this hotel, the most comfy bed in any hotel, breakfast, inclusive snacks and refreshments in the bar, free restocked soft drink mini bar in the room, great shower, sauna and gym, things for kids with awesome rocking horses. It is very clean hotel, with quirky decor and the staff are great. 

The hotel is in a great location, surrounded by reasonably priced bistros, supermarkets, metro stn, and in a generally lively but not too noisy area. Despite being elsewhere in Paris we came back to the vicinity of the hotel to eat in the evening a couple of times because of the lively but chilled feel of the neighbourhood and great places to eat.

Another great bonus is that you can make use of the complimentary snacks and refreshment facilities at the other Astotel-group hotels around Paris.

title: Perfect In Paris
text:
Hotel 34B is a perfect little hotel. I came to Paris with my friend for my first trip abroad by myself (without parents or guardians). The hotel was a very affordable price for us as University Students and the staff were very welcoming. The hotel is situated in what I would say is the perfect spot, it’s not right in the heart of all the action and the bustle of the city but it’s also not too far away for everything to be a taxi trip. It sits right in the perfect little zone, surrounded by quaint little Parisian bars and shops but with proximity to all the main sites and attractions. 

As a healthy, young University Student, I didn’t have time for all that taxi business and so I walked everywhere, Hotel 34B was perfect for this attitude. It is a 20 - 30 minute walk to the Louvre and Notre Dame as well as to the main train/metro station, Gare du Nord. The hotel also has a direct connection to one of the many main boulevards in Paris and so access to all the big stores and streets is easy. When it comes to the big hitters, the Eiffel Tower and Arc De Triumphe are around an hours walk away down the main boulevards, a walk I recommend partaking. 

Hotel 34B was a perfect little base camp near the heart of the city, clean, friendly and safe. Every night I knew, when I settled into that cosy single bed and watched Netflix from the exceptional WiFi provided, I knew that tomorrow would be a good day, all thanks to Hotel 34B 

10/10 would Paris again.

title: Perfect room, perfect location, perfect stay

As the title suggests, 34B is a wonderful little hotel at a very reasonable price. Room was incredibly comfortable, nice big bed and hotel itself is a great location to base yourself from for all the major sightseeing attractions in Paris and within walking distance of the Paris terminal for the Eurostar (20/25 min walk).

Highly recommended!

title: ALWAYS CHOOSE THEM

title: Exceptional service
text:
Excellent location, especially for the room rate. Hotel was conveniently located near two major metro lines.
Rooms were of European size and what I'd expect for the price.
What made the trip was the service from check in to check out the staff were wonderful, accommodating, and knowledgable. Offering recommendations for food, COVID tests, and local shops.
On our check out day we were stranded in Paris overnight due to a cancelled flight and the staff went above and beyond to assist us so that we were not left homeless for the night. 
Upon my return (and subsequent flight with the airlines) Fabrice went above and beyond to help me obtain a copy the the receipt from the taxi company they arranged for us to take to the airport (as I was no longer in Europe and do not speak French). I would highly recommend a stay here.

title: So thankful I found this place
text: Awesome hotel. Solo traveler. Rooms were cheap, clean, small but more than enough for what I needed. The AC actually worked here. The little glass divider to keep water in tub during shower should be longer but other than that, seriously best hotel I’ve stayed in in Paris. Get the breakfast too! title: Great base for a week's summer sightseeing in Paris
text: We spent a week in Paris in July 2022, staying at Hotel 34B. We had asked for, and got, a Courtyard room, which was wonderfully quiet, despite being in the centre of Paris. The triple glazed windows probably helped. The air conditioning was great, and responsive to small changes in desired temperature. The room was not large, but was well designed, with adequate space and a proper door between bedroom and bathroom. The staff were very helpful, especially in the buffet breakfast, where despite the high turnover of people passing through, there were invariably newly laid places and topped up food and juices. This is a seriously well-run hotel, in a good area for tourists. It is walking distance from the Louvre and the Pompidou, close to the metro, and well provided with lots of reasonable if not outstanding restaurants.

title: great place, great people!
text: I love this hotel, its staff are friendly and helpful, its a lovely quirky building with a great attention to detail, I use a wheelchair and the accessible rooms suit me fine, the public spaces are flexible and its a laid back place to enjoy the amenities, the breakfast is good value with plenty of variety.  I have stayed before and just re-booked for later in the year. its also a great area with good bars and bistros.

title: A good stay, would recommend.
text:
We were 2 adults and a 1 year old and enjoyed our stay. 
They provided us with a baby travel cot and the little one slept nicely in it. 
Breakfast was basic but good. We even got a travel pack when we checked out early to make the train to Nice.
Receptionists were of good help and in the mornings they were quite happy to help us heat up milk for the little one. 
Quite central and very easy and close access to the metro which we used to get everywhere we didn’t want to walk to. The metro was very easy to use even with a small travel stroller (Note: be prepared to carry the stroller up and down many stairs at the stations!).
The hotel had elevators, which was perfect! 
There is a play corner for children and some toys.
The AC was a life saver!

We stayed in room 226, second floor, corner room, superior. Not very big, but enough for the three of us and good space for a crib. It had a small but okay bathroom with a shower. We did notice stains and toothpaste marks under the shelves in the bathroom just by the sink and an easily removable stain on the floor. We did not mention this in the reception but I’m sure they would have reacted if we had. We were not bothered. 

Someone kind hearted (former guest perhaps) had left gaffa tape on the wall by the curtains which helped make the room darker so the little one would sleep better (maybe this should have been removed in between guests but we were happy to find it).

The common area/breakfast area was very cozy and nice to relax in, used by a lot of the guests in the afternoon/evening. 

Only downside was loud neighbors, with and without children. Loud talking and a woman crying around midnight from one room and loud parents singing very loud and loudly (!) trying to soothe a baby in the next room. also quite late in the evening  (the baby was not at fault I’d be crying too if someone tried to calm me with the noise the parents were making!…. Probably cultural though). 

So sound isolation could be better. 

All in all I would recommend!

title: Great place to stay
text:
This is great place to stay. Just a few Blocks from the metro and the neighborhood is very lively and safe. The rooms are very small but well appointed. A double room will only fit one international suitcase and 2 carryons at best. 
Breakfast was fantastic with many, many options. I would stay here again.

title: Safe for solo traveller
text:
Booked a room for three nights as a base and felt safe and comfortable. 
Room was clean and breakfast buffet well worth the €10. The hotel was a great base for seeing the sights. I wanted a place near gare du nord and walkable to Seine. The walk into the centre was passed lots of buzzing cafes and bars as well as Velib docking stations (bike hire). I often used this as an alternative to walking as the first 30mins is free. Would definitely return.

title: An absolute gem in a great location
text: Hotel 34B was so amazing that we stayed here twice in one trip. The rooms are adorable (the decor is a sort of French Austin Powers) with comfortable beds and, unlike lots of places in France, has great air conditioning. The people were all very nice, welcoming, and helpful. While it is in a busy area, the windows completely block out any noise from the street, so no concerns there. We paid a bit extra for the breakfast and found the selection to be great. There are also complimentary drinks available in the lobby all afternoon/evening and some activities to keep kids busy. We are often in France to visit family and this is the best hotel we have chosen by far. We will definitely use it as our base again in the future!

title: So pleasent , Perfect location
text:
A pleasant stay of two nights in a hotel that is always pleasant to return to after a day full of activities out side. 
The design of the hotel is charming, the colors and the selection of items always put a smile on your face. 
The room is lovely, although a little small for me, and it is completely individual. 
Clean, tidy, tastefully decorated, and most importantly a really comfortable bed and a proper air conditioner that always cooled the room. 
The shower is spacious and very comfortable. Two things that slightly bothered me, but did not affect the daily routine: 
1. The sink in the shower was clogged and it took time for the water to go down the drain. 
2. The glass doors of the shower did not close all the way, causing water to splash outside the shower area. 
The hotel staff, from the reception staff to the housekeeping staff, were admirably kind. The reception staff is always right to help with any question or request.
The breakfast is very nice, with a variety of ingredients, from breads, pastries, cheeses, sausages, eggs to side dishes. Personally, I was very lacking in vegetables such as cucumber and tomato, although the lack did not harm the overall experience.
Location in one word - perfection. 

I will absolutely return to the hotel, and if not to the hotel, I will try other hotels of the Astotel group around Paris in order to familiarize myself with other locations in Paris in the hope that they all maintain the same standard as 34B at the very least.

title: Cool vibres, hip, comfortable with great location to visit Paris
text: Stayed in paris for 3 nights and got a good deal on the room (better to book thru the hotel website). Cool vibres, hip but at the same time family friendly. Warm and efficient reception, easy check in/out. The room was spacious enough, fun decor with everything you would expect from a nice hotel. The best part was how quiet the rooms are, unbelievable in fact! Did not hear the water from other bathrooms, doors closing or even talking in the hallway. The not so good was the shower enclosure, the door more precisely, small and didn't open/slide smoothly, not a deal breaker just a pain. Did not use the breakfast option, too many great bakeries in paris to be eating hotel food! Great central locstion to visit paris, had a 5 day pass that gave me access to metro, bus and RER train to airport for 20 something dollars. Lots lots of great little restaurants, shops ect... I was super happy with my stay there and will book again in on my next trip to paris.

title: Business visit
text:

title: Cool hotel!

title: Great 3 night stay.

Corner room was a bit quirky as it was almost round which was different. Room was a good size with comfy bed and very clean as was the rest of the hotel, mini bar with free drinks was an excellent touch. Being ultra critical shower was on the small size but manageable. Breakfast was adequate with quite a lot of choice and the free snacks and coffee in lounge area were very acceptable after a day site seeing. We also called in at the Astotel Malte one afternoon to break up our walk back for free snacks there. That also looked a great Hotel. All staff very friendly and would definitely stay here again if in Paris

title: Business visit
text: The hotel is at the centre of the Paris city, full of amenities the staffs are friendly and helpful, the rooms are comfortable and will give you a feeling of a modern hotel, the visit will be purposeful while you stay at this hotel. The breakfast spread could be better moreover if you are here for a vacation its one the perfect place to stay, i come here twice a year for business purposes and overtime i stay at this hotel.

title: We spent 2 nights and were very impressed from the room and the service

title: Quirky deco, comfortable room, great breakfast, awesome staff
text:

Our bed was very comfortable--we slept well. Staff were helpful whenever we asked for information or help. The breakfast--what can I say, Whatever you want from eggs and sausage to breads and crepe, to cereals, to fruit and yogurts. 
I would definitely recommend this hotel to family and friends

title: Funky and Fun
text:

Towels were a little thin but the appreciated the bathtub and make up mirror with lots of shelving in the bathroom.  This actually was the first hotel that had tissues!
There are 2 USB ports by the beds but they didn't work - there were plug ins however.  
Mini bar was great to have with 2 waters, pop and OJ.  A desk and open closest were the other furnishings in the room.  2 english news channels were appreciated.
The breakfast was goo but basic.  Refreshments and snacks from 2 pm to 2 am were appreciated.  Very good coffee machine.  Loved the Madeline's and dried fruit available.
Good location for restaurants and 20 min walk to the Seine or Sacre Cour.  
We did not find the front desk staff overly friendly as others have indicated but they were efficient.

title: Excellent hotel
text: We stayed here for three nights and would definitely recommend this hotel.  Our air-conditioned room overlooked the courtyard and it was lovely and quiet.  34b is spotlessly clean with friendly and helpful staff. Breakfast plentiful and diverse. Complimentary coffee, juices and snacks. Minibar restocked daily with free soft drinks. We hope to return again.

text:
To me I will never change this hotel to another, the staff are most welcoming and helpful. It’s in a very prominent position , walking distance to many attractions such as Opera, La Fayette , Les Halles , theatre's and  Boulevard Haussmann is seconds away. The Louvre is merely 15 minutes walk away 

What makes it special is that as soon as you step out of the hotel you will find , cafeteria, bars, restaurants, mini markets …..  the metro is simply a corner  away . The area is very safe and one feels very at ease especially at night. 

Try it and you surely won’t be disappointed

title: Birthday break
text:
Great location.. comfortable clean room..great bed. Very helpful staff . Walking distance to a lot of sights loads of restaurants bars and cafes to relax in.
Had lovely weather everyday made it even better.
Will hopefully be back next year in the spring.

title: As good as it gets!
text: I stayed at this hotel for almost three weeks during a recent visit to France. 34B is wonderful! The hotel is beautifully decorated and spotlessly clean. Everyone from the manager to the cleaning staff is friendly and very helpful. The breakfasts were well-prepared, appropriately diverse, and plentiful. The staff at the front desk is eager to help in any way possible. In my travels, I have been privileged to stay at some of the world's top hotels--34B is as good as any of those and comes at a very reasonable price. Carine and company do a great job creating a friendly, welcoming environment. My next-to-the-last day in France, I needed a covid test in order to reenter the US. That day turned out to be a holiday--and most of the pharmacies in the area of the hotel were closed. The gentlemen at the front desk immediately began making calls and soon had found a pharmacy open and willing to do my test. They promptly handed me an address and helped me find the location on a map--problem solved. I wish I could take 34B with me everywhere I go!

title: Great location and helpful staff
text: Nice quiet air conditioned room overlooking the courtyard. Affordable with a nice selection at breakfast. Location is great, right near the passages and lively, but quiet. Staff were very courteous and helpful.

title: Fantastic for weekend break
text:
* great location with pubs cafés restaurants and bars nearby mix of French and itnl food
*Fun Stanley Kubrick ish decor in upstairs corridor and contemporary in all other spaces
*Free drinks in minibar and coffees from 2-2 
*Friendly staff who spoke English or tried ( thank u Kady!)
* Clean bedroom and bathroom and bedding 

Also : books to read, a large area downstairs suitable for meeting someone for a chat or to work around others , nice hot shower and all of this was reasonably priced via a website for last minute deals

It was my first time in Paris and the place made it perfect 0 stress about the hotel.A winner for me

title: What a wonderful find
text: Stayed here for 2 nights with 20 friends. When we arrived everything was ready for us. There was complementary coffee, juices and snacks and the rooms were great - and contained a small fridge with some bottled water which was a real bonus. It’s location is literally around the corner from a main metro station and close to all pubs and amenities. We would 100% stay here again. Many thanks to all who made us feel welcome.

title: A little gem in the heart of Paris
text: The hotel is a little gem in the heart of Paris.  It is in close proximity to all Paris major attractions.  The surrounding area has many lovely restaurants.  The hotel  staff are very helpful and professional.  Breakfast included adequate choices.

title: Good 3 Star Hotel with friendly staff and good breakfast
text:
We enjoyed our stay and had a warm welcome. Rooms were clean. I just do not like carpets in Hotels and hotel rooms. This one was clean though.
We will most likely stay here again on our next visit to Paris.

title: Great Stay
text: I was recommended this chain by a friend. What a great little hotel. The staff were fabulous.  Nothing was too much trouble, they assisted me with printing and scanning some documents.  Room very comfortable and quiet. Great location, easy walk to The Louvre and Galleries Lafayette.  Breakfast basic but good value.   I would definitely stay again .

title: Just lovely
text: We stayed her for a total of 3 nights split between two separate occasions. The staff was wonderful, the real fast was impressive, the community area was really well lit, open and inspiring to be in and the room was relatively spacious - especially from where we were previously. The environment feels very fun and is very family friendly yet also great for solo/young travelers. The location is awesome too - a comfortable walking distance to the louve, moulin rouge, nature dame and endless stores, restaurants and historical sites. Free coffee through the day along with snacks and fruit. We stayed at another Astotel site around the corner though this one was so much more comfortable, large, light, spacious and colorful. The gym was also impressive and the sauna was wonderful.

title: Excellent hotel; great value
text:
This is an excellent hotel in the middle of Paris. Staff are plentiful and helpful. Room was of decent size; plain and functional; excellent double glazing and good air conditioning made for a restful stay. 
If you want a clean, functional hotel to use as a base, it’s hard to see how you could beat this. We did not have breakfast here and there is no facility for other meals, but as you are in one of the world’s gastronomic capitals, it didn’t matter. We did not have kids with us, but noticed they had play areas for little ‘uns.

title: 5 day visit to Paris
text:
Great B&B hotel with quirky features. Very friendly and helpful staff. Excellent breakfast.
Good location near Grande Boulevard metro and loads of bars, cafes and restaurants in easy walking distance. 
Highly recommended.

title: Amazing Location
text: Amazing location, super close to the metro and walking distance to a lot of sights as well! Very comfortable and clean rooms & friendly staff!!! The free mini bar is an added bonus! Highly recommend!!

title: WOULD RECOMMEND
text:
Staff and Service

The highlight for our visit was the Assistant Director of the hotel. He was such a lovely person who helped us in our check in process while graciously looking out for us to ensure that we have a safe and enjoyable experience. The rest of the hotel staff were just as hospitable and welcoming as they were able to assist in our daily needs like room cleaning and breakfast service. Also, the hotel provides a complimentary in-room minibar which is restocked daily!

Location

Cafes and restaurants literally dot the surrounding area of 34B, some of which are hip, while some are traditional. The biggest locational advantage of this hotel is its proximity to two Metro stations (Grand Boulevards and Le Peletier)

Room and Amenities

The room we stayed in felt a bit dated but it’s very spacious and well-kept (big thanks to the tireless housekeepers). One amenity that deserves to be highlighted is its cavernous lounge area. It is located in the center of the hotel lobby which has a panoramic glass roof which provides dazzling sunlight during the day. 

Definitely would recommend!

title: Great location - Many design touches
text:
We had the duplex which was great for our 5 member family. Kids had their own room and there were W.C.s on both floors.
Breakfast had all the essentials and the room deco was great. Plus there was a kids corner for drawing with a couple toys.
It's the 2nd time we stay near la cité Bergère in Paris and I don't think we'll ever stay elsewhere. You can walk on foot from the Montmartre to the Louvre, la Bastille, the Notre-dame, while also being on proximity to the wonderful Marais. If you wish not to walk as much, there are several Metro lines on a very short distance.
Many nice bistros close to the hotel.

title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed here for 3 nights and would definitely recommend this hotel. It was very clean and the room was lovely and quiet .The breakfast was good, a self service buffet with lots to choose from.  A good place to have a base for getting around the city, with metro stations very close by. Lots of bars and restaurants very close by too.

title: A good hotel but quite rude service
text:
The hotel was pretty and The room was clean and nice. We got soft drinks in the minibar every day. 

At the check-in service was quite rude and one of the employees seemed to be rude to other employee. That was really uncomfortable to us and we felt bad.

title: Staying at 34B
text:
I was staying in Paris on business but had a couple of extra days down time also. So the hotel was ideally placed for visits to places of great interest. 
The hotel is a bright and friendly place. The rooms are good sized clean and quiet. The beds very comfortable. The staff are friendly and helpful. For those visiting Paris on a budget or with a young family it is ideal . However, I was a lone traveller and it suited me too. I have been three times now!

title: Great location and friendly helpful staff
text: The hotel is centrally located. Slightly on the expensive side but the room and the facilities provided were awesome. On the day of exit i got my breakfast complementary which made my day. Cheers. Happy staying here.

title: 100% perfect
text:
We stayed in the hotel 7  nights, and we are very satisfied about everything at the hotel. Nice and helpfull people in the reception, good service, free softdrinks in the room and in the lounge area. We had a corner room on the second floor, light and had a small balcony we used every day and enjoyed the city sound. When we closed the windows, it was totally quiet. Nice beds, and the cleaning perfect. 
As an ekstra plus they arranged flowers and chokolate in the room at our arrival on my request - thank you to the whole staff for making our stay in Paris celebrating our 50th aniversary perfect,, 👍☺️
We not hesitate to recommed the hotel, and will certainly stay here again if we come back to Paris !

title: Good location in art centric Montmartre
text: Good location in historic Montmartre. We had a room for 4 people, upstairs bedroom was large, private had a minibar stocked each day with water/juice for you to enjoy free of charge. Bedrooms were ample and bathrooms were modern. There was a kettle in the room.   Rooms were well appointed and beds comfortable. Breakfast included which was a buffet with fruit, pastries, breads, eggs, crepes, meats, coffee etc.

title: Paris vacation
text: We had the pleasure of staying at the Astohotel 34B  on Rue Berger in early May 2022. The location was great, close to everything. The hotel neighbor was delightful with lots of restaurants and shops on the same street. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The room was charming and a good size. Good value for the price.

title: Nice rooms, central location, reasonable price
text:
We had a nice and clean balcony room with day-light bathroom. Since we travelled in a group with friends, the lobby area was a convenient meeting point. Availability of free soft-drinks, coffee and snacks was highly welcome.
Recommended improvement: Access from the street to the lobby should be more secured.

title: Perfect for couples and solo trips.
text:
This hotel has been my place to go since 2016. We have stayed so many times that I have lost count. This was my first solo trip to Paris and I chose the same hotel we always choose as a couple.
Great service, great staff, tidy, very clean rooms and they even give you a few soft drinks in the minibar. The breakfast is very good too! Loads of fresh cheese, eggs, sausages, cereal and all the free coffee and hot drinks you can think of during the day.

title: Lovely hotel in a convenient location
text: Stayed here for 3 nights. Had a lovely bright balcony room. Staff all friendly and helpful. Breakfast good with lots of choice. The free soft drinks and snacks available all day was a good extra. The free mini bar with soft drinks in was also great. The hotel is located near 2 metro stations so travelling around Paris is easy. Good bars and restaurants in the area.

title: Nice stay for a city trip
text: The hotel is in a great location! Many cool restaurants and cafes around, walking distance to the Opera or the Seine. Nevertheless, it is not too noisy. Nice, cozy room. Free minibar with water etc. ! Very helpful :) the ceiling over the shower has probably molded but otherwise it was quite clean. For a few days in Paris definitely a good choice :)

title: Our favourite hotel in Paris!
text:
This was our 3rd stay at this hotel. We find the staff to be attentive and the rooms clean and comfortable with free soft drinks in your room. Breakfast is continental style with a wide choice of food including cereals, bread, meat and fruit. Restaurants and bars are plentiful in the local area and getting around is easy with the Metro less than 5 minutes away. A 20 minute stroll will get you to the River Seine or the Louvre to mention just a couple of sights!
If you choose this hotel you will also get access to free refreshments every afternoon and this applies to other Astotel Hotels across Paris.

title: Great stay at hotel
text:
This hotel has many very great values. 
Very good location for walking distance to main tourist places, like Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame etc. and to Metro stations.
Breakfast was good and Open bar was also helpful.

title: A true value for money 3 star hotel.
text: The hotel is in a vibrand area,full of restaurants and bars ,very close to 3 metro lines( 8, 9 & 7). We had a superior room, on the 3rd floor which was very clean and spacious for a Paris room. Staff was very friendly and helpfull. Breakfast was ok. The lobby is very cute with comfortable sofas and a library full of books to read.Hotel serves free soft drinks,coffee and snacks every afternoon until late at night .We had a great time , and we would definitely stay there next time we are in Paris !

title: Nice hotel, good location, poor maintenance
text:
A good choice for a 3 star hotel in Paris.
Very close to Grands Boulevards Metro station (lines 8 & 9). In a very nice area close to the Opera, with a lot of restaurants and brasseries.  
Very clean and spacious.
The shower was a bit problematic with a door jammed and a leaking hose, however it wasn't that bad for us to complain.
The free minibar was really nice (refilled every day).
Our room was on the second floor just above the street but it was really quiet without any noise from the street.

title: Fantastic few days in Paris.
text:
We were a party of 4 friends enjoying a visit to the beautiful  city of Paris. The hotel excelled all our expectations. It was fun and quirky( a bit like us )
The rooms were lovely , we had clean towels every day , the staff were nice and friendly too. 
We enjoyed the varied breakfast choices . 
The area around the hotel is alive with cafe’s , restaurants and bars and is also close to 2 metro stations to allow easy access into Paris. 
It was a lovely 3 days . 
I would definitely recommended this Hotel to anyone . Xx

title: Perfect location to discover Paris
text: We had a great time in the hotel. Very friendly staff and nice arrangement of birthday surprise in the room. Breakfast was a good selection of choices and beds were very comfortable! Thank you! We will come back :)

title: Ideal, central hotel for sightseeing in Paris
text:
Not sure what I expected when we booked this hotel but we were very pleasantly surprised. We flew into CDG airport - we got the RER train and actually walked from the Gare de Nord station, which took about 20 mins but after familiarising ourselves with the metro all week we got metro and RER back to the airport (2 changes) costing us about 11 euros each. 
Nicely situated in Montmarte area which is a nice area with plenty of amenities such as shops, restaurants, cafes etc and a few minutes walk to the nearest metro (Grand Boulevard). 
Nice reception area, very pleasant, helpful staff. Hotel had free soft drinks and snacks every afternoon (and could use these facilities in all their other sister hotels as well)
Rooms were compact but had everything you needed. Free soft drink mini bar/fridge, hairdryer, toiletries, clean towels every day. Slight gripe we had was no air conditioning (only able to use in summer!) and so rooms were very hot at night. Hotel hallways were a little bizarely but patrioticly decorated (you'll know what I mean when you see it!). 
We had breakfast which was not bad selection - croissants, breads, cold meats, sausages/mushrooms/scrambled egg/beans, fruit salad, yoghurts etc.
Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

title: Amazing hotel
text: I stayed here for a few days and had such a great experience. The place is well decorated and cozy, plus the breakfast had such great quality. It is also near a major avenue with lots of restaurants, small cafes, and all sorts of little stores.

title: Great hotel, minor problems
text:
We stayed at the family room. There was no connecting door, and we would love it if someone helped us carry our luggage (the room is at the sixth floor, and there's elevator only to the fifth floor)

Other than that, the staff were friendly

- Large clean room, very good location

title: Amazing hotel
text:
Convenient location, metro and bus stations nearby, walking distance from Opera Garnier.
Value for money, nice neighborhood.
The hotel was beautifully decorated with attention to detail. The breakfast was amazing, the staff helpful and kind. After numerous trips in Paris, I can surely say that this was the best hotel I've ever stayed in.
Ps. Plus, clients are offered free coffee and tea every afternoon with complimentary sweet treats, in all hotels of the Astotel chain, which is just perfect for a "pit stop".

title: Excellent service
text: Hotel Astoria is indeed a beautiful hotel with lovely rooms. Excellent breakfast but the staff are really friendly. Special mention to Tejpaul Singh who is extremely friendly and very welcoming. We enjoyed his friendly disposition. Well done Tej for making our stay an enjoyable experience

title: Highly recommend
text: We stayed here for 4 nights. We had a family suite which had two rooms behind one door. Perfect for the kids. Each room has an ensuite, air-conditioning (which was essential as we stayed during the heatwave 41°!!) There is also a free soft drinks mini bar which is replenished daily. There are free drinks snd snacks at reception. The breakfast was really lovely and the staff were attentive, especially Tej. I would most definitely recommend to others and we will return.

title: Great price/quality relation
text: Good location close to the city center. Great price/quality relation, I fell happy for what I paid. Breakfast is amazing and high quality. And I most say personal is very gentle, especially TEJ at the breakfast area, he is the best!! If I come back to Paris, I will stay again

title: Excellent, top quality
text:
First time in Paris, and glad we went with Hotel Astoria. Great location, clean room, friendly staff. Breakfast was included in our booking, and special thanks to Tej who was extremely friendly and welcoming, going above and beyond for his guests. 

10/10 and well deserved!

title: Excellent Service
text: A beautiful hotel, with beautiful rooms and a scrumptious breakfast! The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, especially Tejpal Singh. He had been so helpful the entire of breakfast that morning. The rooms are so cute with a decent amount of space as well.

title: Happy
text: First time in Paris and very happy with our accomodation choice. Great area- close to landmarks and metro. We had a cute little balcony and plenty of space. Of course Tej was a highlight too- incredibly helpful, funny and friendly.

title: Service and location Fantastic
text: From the front reception desk to Tej (who will take care of your every need) and the breakfast staff we were treated like old friends. We have never stayed in this arrondissment  before and it was perfect. Close to landmarks, shopping and tons of great restaurants. I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Best breakfast ever
text: Perfect location, excellent rooms but above all, the breakfast out of this world thanks to Tej. A polyglot, very accomodating, charming and sensible man who will ensure that you feel at ease and don't lack anything. I will say it : nothing would be the same without Tej. Thanks for everything and keep shining

title: nice interior design
text:
1. very nice interior design especially the cafe.
2. affordable room price
3. comfy room 
4. free flow snack and drink available and we can use the same room card to access the cafe in other 16 hotel in the network 
5. delicious breakfast

title: Amazing Hotel Service
text: TEJ went above and beyond every morning to ensure our breakfast was superb.  Anyone going in should definitely enjoy their breakfast with him!  The coffee/food was excellent but TEJ made sure no one started their day badly.

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: From the moment I arrived I felt right at home! Tej in the breakfast area was especially helpful and friendly. The rooms are decently spacious, the bathrooms lovely, and the lobby is welcoming. Definitely would stay again.

title: Absolutely amazing!!
text: Wonderful stay, the facilities were incredible and the rooms were luxurious and well-maintained. Food and mini-bar drinks were all complementary, which was lovely. Tej's service during the breakfast buffets was particularly brilliant - he was incredibly warm, friendly, and struck up a good conversation! He also helped us out whenever he could, and I really appreciated his kindness. Would 100% recommend.

title: Nice hotel and great service
text: Very confortable hotel and really good location. Great customer service specially from employees as TEJ , very cheerful, friendly and willing to help. Also they have a snacks station almost all day where you can get soft drinks and snacks for free.

title: Great hotel
text: The hotel was lovely, less than 1 minute walk from Rome metro station. The room is small but clean and comfortable with air conditioning. The bed was  very comfortable. A good size tv with a good selection of Uk channels. The fridge is stocked daily and free of charge with water and soft drinks and everyday in the hotel from 2 pm there are free soft drinks, water and snacks available and you can also access this at their other 12 hotels around Paris  by showing your room key.  The breakfast was very good, choice of cereal, breads, hot food, pastries, cold meat, cheese, juices , tea and coffee. The staff were very friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend this hotel fir a city break in Paris.

title: Back to Astoria
text: We went back to Astoria after 4 years and we really loved the experience again.  The new lady GM was very friendly and made us feel like at home.  The front of house team remains a credit in looking after the guests - Florence / Mahima / Oceane and Ahmed were always available for any help needed.  We truly felt like at home and will definitely book again on our next visit to Paris.

title: Great service
text: Hello! I visited with my friends for a birthday celebration here and I loved the morning staff there specially Tej. He was kind, energetic and very helpful. The breakfast was delicious. My friends and I loved his company and we will visit again for sure.

title: Great Service
text: We were here for a family vacation and it was very nice. While having our breakfast which was very delicious we met a staff member named Tej. He was very helpful and approachable that we enjoyed his company a lot and even had a great morning due to his nice and kind attitude.

title: BEST EXPERIENCE EVER!!!
text: We stayed for a week at the Astoria Hotel in Paris and everything was perfect! The staff was super friendly and the continental breakfast was delicious. The rooms were super clean and the bed was very comfortable. They even stocked your mini fridge everyday with 2 water bottles, 1 orange juice, 1 Sparkling water and a Coke. In the evenings, they had snacks and beverages available in the lobby. The best hotel we’ve been to hands down…..A big shout out to Florence who was the receptionist/concierge…..amazing lady! Thanks for the wonderful experience. We will be back!!!

title: First time in Paris
text: Comfy bedroom with everything needed. The mini bar and the refreshments after 2 p.m. were great. Varied breakfast and very nice and helpful staff serving it. Near the underground station and bus stops.

title: Hope to be back soon!
text:
Very nice boutique hotel with easy access to the train station. Reasonable rates as well. The hotel is situated in a safe area with nearby shops and cafes.

Excellent service from the hotel team, and the very friendly Tej.

Hope to be back soon!

title: Excellent service
text: Hi , My friend and i visited for vaccation nd stay here . I have wonderful experience . Every staff member is great but tej is very sweet guy with clients . Very high quality service . Property is very clean , and perfect to celebrate any ocassion. We have very great time there nd we will visit again .

title: Excellent Service
text: Hello! My family and I visited for a vacation and stayed here. It was an amazing experience. I loved the service we were offered. I encountered a worker there named Tej he was very friendly, helpful and approachable. He was very joyful even I the morning and I enjoyed his company. We will visit again for sure.

title: Perfect Service
text: Hello! My family and I stayed here for few days and we had a lot of fun. Their service was amazingly perfect. While having breakfast we meet a worker who's name is Tej. He was very helpful and amazing. He helped us throughout our requests and we enjoyed his company. We would love to visit again.

title: Perfect birthday
text:
I went to this place on my birthday and this is a highly recommended place to stay! The staff is very welcoming and even though I was alone, it felt like I was at home! 
Kudos to the staff and the managers!

title: Great service
text: Visited this hotel and i must say the service of the people working here were welcoming. Rooms are very comfortable. The view is nice . We met Tej whose very helpful and approachable. Will visit againnnn!

title: Very nice hotel and services must visit. Gud accommodation
text: Very nice hotel one should stay here very gud staff  and service is a one top notch. I will prefer this hotel only  next time when I will  visit next time also best property in the town just love their service

title: Great hotel
text: Visited this hotel and i must say the service of the receptionist were welcoming. Rooms are small but very comfortable. Clean and the view we had was nice. We had breakfast twice and we met Tej who was very sweet and very approachable. We asked for certain things and he was always upfont. We definitely will come back and expecting the same great service. Good job

title: Superb hotel
text: We stayed here for 2 days and had a good time. Hotel located in a quiet area and had good transport nearby. Receptionist were really nice especially maxima who was helpful. Special mention to the service of Tej at breakfast who was excellent and always joyful in the morning  that makes you laugh. Overall hotel was perfect for vacation with friends or even family. Definitely will come back

title: Great hotel
text: We stayed here as a family, with two rooms with doors that could be kept open behind one door. Everything was really good, with excellent attention to detail, e.g black out curtains, free minibar fridges and a good selection of complimentary snacks and drinks available downstairs, next to the relaxed seating area. It all felt very generous. The receptionists were very helpful and special recognition to Merly at breakfast for being so friendly and attentive and making everything run smoothly. Really good breakfast, all fresh and great selection. Good quiet location, with cafes and metro nearby. Recommended.

title: Very good stay
text: I came to Paris with my husband . The hotel is really nice !! Especially Tej at breakfast was really helpful. The room was small but adequate. The free mini bar was a plus so is the afternoon snack bar. I definitely recommend this hotel . W will for sure come back next time w come to Paris .

title: Excellent hotel in Paris
text: The room is small but it has everything one family needs. Breakfast was nice and staff particularly Merry  making sure all guests are getting all desired food. Hotel is situated in nice location with closely metro and bus stops.

title: Great Stay
text: This hotel was very nice, and a great value for the money! Our room was clean and comfortable, the snack area was well stocked and with plenty of options. But what we loved the most was our breakfasts, mostly because of the dining room staff led by Tej. He was very present and tried to get to know every guest and their preferences. He made our mornings fun and is a real asset to this hotel. The desk staff were very helpful and always greeted us with a smile! Highly recommend this hotel!

title: Great Stay
text:
This is a very charming hotel! The location coupled with the whimsical design make this a rare find. I will also add that the staff is lovely - so bubbly and outgoing! 

(EXCEPT for one receptionist who was rather unfriendly and always seemed annoyed)

The breakfast is substantial, The 24/7 beverages and snacks were always a great treat when coming in from a long day.

I'd definitely stay here again - the price, the quiet, the comfort of the beds and cheeriness of the place made this a lovely find!

title: Ok hotel, great personnel in the dining room
text:
The hotel was ok, smaller rooms and hard beds but clean and nice central location.
Tej, the server in the dining room was fantastic. Efficient and super fun. He kept all the guest entertained by making them guess where he was originally from. Great guy!

title: Wonderful chic hotel
text: We stayed here for only 3 days but it’s staff and service are very good, specially Tej, at the breakfast area, was very personable and very engaging. I’ll give him 5 star for his service and engaging personality.

title: A good holiday
text: We have an holiday for 8 days in this hotel. The rooms arent slow but clean.  The service is very good expecially in the breakfast with the maitre Tej.  The free minibar is beatiful. I donato have a cupboard

title: What a wonderful short holiday
text: We had a wonderful stay here when we were in Paris for a short holiday, The staff is so kibd and accommodating..i specifically to mention Tejpal Singh very warm and welcoming each morning at breakfast.. excellent accesible for everything…

title: Excellent Location
text:
My student group visited the hotel for 3 nights.  The location was perfect.  It was near everything, including a nearby grocery, shopping areas, nearby Metro station Rome, and just a nice area to practically go everywhere.

Shout out to Merly, who provided excellent service during our daily breakfast.

Other cool things to consider about this hotel:
1)  The hotel offered a good breakfast.
2) In-room non-alcoholic minibar included
3)  Snacks, drinks, and coffee are complimentary

title: Really nice Hotel
text: We visited this hotel for 4 nights and for our city trip it was a perfekt choice. A few minutes walk to the metro station Rome and other stations were close by. Breakfast buffet was always great, fresh coffee, scrambled eggs and the best of all, my boyfriend got a chance to taste gluten-free stuff.  Very much thanks to Merly for taking good care of him and Tej for being the charming guy he is :) Rooms are a bit small but it is really worth visting this hotel with all those nice people.

title: Great Hotel to Experience a Great City!
text:
Adored visiting the hotel with my sister! The rooms were very clean and the hotel provided free drinks in the mini-bar which was great. Breakfast was simple but still nice, with really friendly staff such as Merly and Taj. Reception is present at all hours and are very helpful with great english.

The hotel is a reasonable distance from all sites, with several metro stations and bus stops nearby. With the frequency of the metro most main tourist sites were roughly 25 minutes away. I found the area around the hotel to be quite safe, with various food options nearby, and in particular a pharmacy and mini-supermarket down the steet.

Considering the post-Covid boom it was hard enough to find hotels that were available at a reasonable price, but I personally would definately reccomend this hotel!

title: Astoria Astotel paris
text:
An amazing hotel absolutely fantastic staff. So clean and Tej couldn't do enough for us. Thanks very much for making our trip a dream. It is lovely and friendly super helpful great location 

   thank you Tej

title: Hotel Astotel Astoria - excellent experience
text: The hotel is clean and welcoming. The staff is very friendly, especially Tej. The breakfast is simple but everything is fresh and tasty. The location is excellent since it’s very close to the metro station. I highly recommend it! If you want to visit Paris, consider this hotel.

title: Professional, Understanding and exceptional Customer Service
text:
Hotel Astoria Paris, are so professional and supportive! Océane has provided us with exceptional customer service that gained my respect so much that I have decided I will stay at this hotel everytime I visit Paris.

I was staying at Hotel Astoria in Barcelona, and booked an extension in Hotel Astoria in Paris by mistake. 

The booking was non-refundable, by Océane went out of her way to help us get a refund from our agent that couldn't have happened if she didn't help and it wasen't even her duty.

Thank you Océane, thank you for your professionalisim and understansing, you just gained your hotel a super loyal customer.

You don't find this type of customer service anywhere.. this is true hospitality!

1000 stars for this.

title: Great service!
text:
I can't say enough about the quality of service at this hotel. In particular, I wanted to thank Tej for his amazing service. He was there to greet us for breakfast and his warm and friendly nature made us feel at home.

The room itself was very clean and comfortable, with premium fixtures. Some free beverages were provided in the room, which was appreciated. Breakfast in the morning was excellent, much better than anything an American hotel would provide.

The location of this hotel is also exceptional, as it's on a safe and quiet street with plenty of dining options nearby.

Although our stay was a short one, this hotel left a great impression upon upon us.

Thanks!

title: Glutenfree friendly
text:
Nice hotel and breakfast good! Also gluten-free bread available every morning. Service was excellent by the staff, especially Merly was super friendly and helpful.

The room’s floor was bit dirty. Excellent location next to multiple metro and bus lines. Super for few days visit in Paris

title: A nice convenient hotel
text:
It is a nice small hotel. Great location as it is located a walking distance from 3 different metro stations. There are a number of supermarkets, pharmacies and cafes in the neighbourhood. 

Very clean but small rooms like most 3 star hotels in Paris. Nice basic breakfast but can add options for vegans.

title: July visit
text: The hotel was perfect for our family of four.  The rooms were clean and newly remodeled.  Breakfast was amazing and Taj was  wonderful host.  Rooms included free drinks and the snack station was a hit with the kids!  Will plan on coming back

title: Very comfortable location
text:
Very comfortable location, in each room in a frigo bar free soft drink, the same in the hall, After 2pm until midnight.
Consierge are very kind and patient, a special thanks to Tej for his kindness and availability to satisfy every request during breakfast.
I will come back .

title: Great, comfortable hotel in great location
text: We really enjoyed staying 10 days at this hotel during our stay in Paris. The Staff was friendly and very helpful with any questions we had. Our French was not so good, so we were happy they spoke English to us. The rooms very comfortable with cold AC. The breakfast was a perfect way to start the day and it was not expensive. The neighborhood was nice and close to metro stations and different bus stops. The boulangerie down the street was delicious. I would stay here again if I ever get to come back.

title: Great hotel, even better service!
text: The hotel stay was great and the hotel was not noise at all. The reception at the breakfast was wonderful with fresh bread and meat daily. Tej (our server) was very helpful and energetic everyday. As the “most handsome guy in Paris,” he was certainly one of the most nice and helpful people there! He is friendly, cleans very well, and caters to your needs.

title: A very nice place for family vacation!
text: Very good location, closer to metro stations and bus stops.  Loved the hotel. A very nice place to stay.  Very impressive breakfast.  Their coffee is always good.   Friendly, helpful staff, especially Merly and Tej!  Keep up the good work.  Will visit again.

title: My family and I enjoyed our visit very much. Employees were always nice and willing to help.
text:
Service in general was very good, breakfast service was excellent.
Room is small, location requires transportation.
All employees are always willing to serve. Especially Tej, at breakfast he was always willing to get us what we needed and asked for.

title: An amazing place!
text: The service here was most excellent and the rooms were super nice! The staff provided a lot of free assets to the hotel, which was really nice, especially if you forgot something. Speaking of staff, Tej was a really great member and even gave us free coffee cake if we could guess what nationality he is from, and that kept the spirits alive and something small but significant  to look forward to when we got back from our travels. He was a really nice guy! Definitely enjoyed my stay here. :)

title: great service
text: the service was great, the breakfast was delicious, and the server tej was very welcoming! it is within walking distance of many things, and many beautiful cafes and streets around. if you are into photography, the aesthetic of this area is beautiful.

title: Great experience
text: Location of Hotel Astoria is perfect. So close to metro stations and best restaurants in town. Free snacks in lobby is very good touch. Very attentive and helpful staff. Good breakfast with a variety of cheese and breads

title: We will be back soon
text:
It was nice to go back to our favorite hotel in Paris. Location is superb, rooms are nice and clean, breakfast is good as well. 
Nearest train station is 5 minutes away. 
Staff are super nice especially Merly and Tej at the restaurant. 
The rooms with terrace are extra special when the weather is nice and you can hang out. 
First time we stayed here as a couple and now that we have 2 kids in tow, this hotel never failed us.

title: Wonderful stay at Hotel Astoria Astotel
text: Super friendly staff always willing to give us directions to the many places we went during our stay, room was perfect for a family of 4 - plenty of space for all of us, clean accommodations, great location. We would definitely stay here again

title: Nice hotel and staff
text:
Hotel review - 
We love their proximity to great attractions and places. Love also the afternoon tea where you can get in all their hotels. Need it to rest and restart the day especially with kids! But the best part is the Hotel staff! Super helpful, friendly, especially Tej and kuya William. Definitely will stay in this hotel whenever we will be in Paris in the future!f

text: We love their proximity to great attractions and places. Love also the afternoon tea where you can get in all their hotels. Need it to rest and restart the day especially with kids! But the best part is the Hotel staff! Super helpful, friendly, and will really care for you! Definitely will stay in this hotel whenever we will be in Paris in the future!

title: Hotel Astoria Review
text: Had a great time at this hotel everything was super clean and Tej was great the room was nice and the location is optimum for Parisian travel the breakfast was also really good so If you are considering this hotel choose it!

title: NICE HOTEL IN PARIS. GREAT LOCATION
text:
Stayed from May 29 to june 4 2022. Conveniently Located near Rome and Liege Metro stations.Good  Dining places nearby. Great breakfast.. Special shout out to  friendly staff Tej and Merly who make you feel so welcome. 

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

title: Great time in Paris
text:
Great time in Paris we started in this hotel.   Staff helpful (thanks to Tej and Merly in breakfast area) and all reception guys. 
Very clean and comfy rooms , free bar with drinks and free open bar with drinks and  snacks downstairs. Location just 2 min away from Rome metro station 3 min from Liege station. I would definitely comeback when return to Paris.

title: Holiday to Paris
text: This hotel is a great choice! It’s in a really handy location by the metro stop Rome which takes you into central Paris and beyond. Front desk extremely helpful and the breakfast staff are wonderful & full of personality. Very clean and presented well. Complimentary tea, coffee and cakes etc on arrival back to the hotel from a day out which is a lovely touch. In addition, a complimentary mini bar in the hotel room which is free on arrival including water, orange juice, sparkling water and pepsi. Reasonably priced for Paris and near to lots of nice restaurants close to Place de Clichy and Saint Georges area.

title: Perfect stay
text: We had 5 wonderful days in Paris. The hotel was nice. The rooms were quiet, clean and we could check in very early. The breakfast was nice with very friendly staff.  The location of the hotel was quit in the Center. Thanks for everything

title: Great Hotel in a perfect location! Loved it.
text: I loved my stay, the staff are friendly and caring. The breakfast ladies do whatever they can to satisfy you. The room was perfect size for us and the bathroom was gorgeous and clean, very important! The location is perfect, we walk to everywhere we went in Paris. Just brilliant! Thank you so much for making our stay so lovely and nice. Grateful _/\_

title: Charming and lovely hotel
text: A charming and lovely hotel with a vibrant vibe. Easily accessible as has close access to multiple metro stations. A lot of restaurants and supermarket in close proximity. Courteous staff and a special mention to Tej who is always ready to help.

title: Good hotel with excellent hospitality
text: Charming hotel on quiet Rue Moscou. A little ways away from the Seine and small(ish) rooms were only minor downsides. However, it was well organized, clean, with complementary drinks and snacks and the gracious hosts more than made up for any inconveniences. Breakfast was delicious and Tej's hospitality superb (merci beaucoup Tej). Thank you all for making me and my family's stay so enjoyable.

title: A Welcoming Service and Comfortable hotel!
text: Both my husband and I felt very welcome from arrival until departure during our stay at the hotel. The service was excellent and  all the staff were very friendly and ready to make our stay a great experience. I have Coeliac disease and need a gluten free diet. The staff  who prepared the breakfast were amazing especially Merly. Everyday she made sure I had gluten free bread and crackers and whatever I needed with a smile. In general the breakfast was very good and plentiful with a varied choice for a continental breakfast or a  cooked breakfast.    It's only a 3 mins walk from the Metro which then gives access to anywhere in the beautiful city of Paris. We would certainly stay again and recommend it to friends and family.

title: Amazing Service and Staff
text: Had the pleasure of staying at this hotel for a Summer Vacation and was not disappointed. All staff was friendly and welcoming, especially Tej, who was very kind and talked to us throughout breakfast. The rooms were cozy and clean and had everything we would need for our stay. I would definitely recommend this  hotel for any trip.

title: Quaint Hotel in Paris
text: This hotel is located slightly North of Central Paris but within Metro & Bus lines. I love the quaint and charming look of this property. Room was slightly small but normal for Europe. Hotel and room were nicely kept and clean. I chose to include breakfast which I rather enjoyed. Selection of eggs, cold cuts, bread, yogurts, fruits, cereal, coffee, and juices. I wanted to point out one of the breakfast servers, Merly, for her friendly and warm service each morning. She smiled and seem to appreciate our attempts at speaking the native tongue. On our next to last day we also met Tej who provided an eagerness and enthusiasm to serve. Merci.

title: A delightful, charming and comfortable hotel
text: This is a very friendly comfortable hotel. The staff are delightful and everything is designed to make guests feel welcomed. Breakfasts are good value and excellent and the free snacks in the afternoon and evening are a brilliant idea. The hotel is in a good location with good bars and restaurants nearby and a metro station and bus stops round the corner.

title: Great service at breakfast
text: Tej was super helpful and attentive. The breakfast was delicious more than I expected, especially for the price. The room was very organized and they had everything we would need for our stay. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Fantastic stay!
text: Everyone was very polite and eager to help with directions, sightseeing tours and information about shows. The breakfast staff went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. The rooms were neat and clean and the daily cleaning service was a great perk!

title: Charming place with great service
text: We arrived here just last night.  The place is spotless and very inviting.  Charming really!  And very welcoming.  Tej served us espresso, even if breakfast was finished.  All in all I would highly recommended this establishment to any newcomers in the city!

title: Friendly and comfortable
text:
Conveniently located in central Paris within walking distance of so many restaurants and must-see sites.

The staff is welcoming, helpful and friendly. It's nice to start the day at breakfast being greeted by TEJ.

I liked it so much that I got friends to book a room for themselves when they came to town for the weekend.

title: Sightseeing
text: Best 3 star hotel we have stayed at for 20 years. Clean, quiet, friendly staff, breakfast with lots of variety and humorus staff. The Metro station was just around the corner and very comfortable to have it so close to the hotel.

title: Lovely hotel and good value.
text:
Really lovely hotel with friendly staff in lovely area of Paris. Very clean and quiet.

Nice little restaurants nearby and very close to Metro stations. It feels like the area of Paris where Parisians go out, not just tourists. Would definitely go back.

title: Amazing service and great privileges
text:
We had a very pleasant stay here. We made great use of the free minibar and soft drinks, as well as visiting other hotels around the area. 

The customer service was on point! We look forward to coming back.

title: Vacation
text:
Tej.. Most cooperative guy met in my trip.. Loving & funny too..
Amazing rooms, good size.. especially for a family of 3 members..
Hotel has good amenities, enjoyed my stay thoroughly..
Staff also nice..

title: Hotel Astoria
text: We enjoyed the stay at Hotel Astoria during our weekend getaway to Paris. The room was tidy, staff was super helpful and friendly, good quality breakfast and complementary drinks in the minibar. I definately recommend Hotel Astoria!

title: Great location and lovely garden
text: This is a lovely hotel with very accommodating and welcoming staff.  The garden is an oasis in the city and the location is very good. Our room, which was generously upgraded without a request, was very comfortable, spacious, and beautifully appointed.

The beds are comfortable and the staff was really helpful (our Uber booked car to the airport didnt show up at 6am and the staff really came through by getting us a taxi) 

The only negative was that the bathrooms weren't as private, we had two rooms and one of them didn't have a door to the bathroom (the toilet which was separate had a door).  The other room had a door to the shower but had translucent glass. 

Nonetheless given all other positives, think it deserves top rating

title: An oasis in the city centre
text:
Fabulous hotel for a wonderful stay in Paris. There is alot to like about the hotel
1. The service is wonderful, nothing is any trouble and all staff we interacted with were helpful and very welcoming
2. The garden is an oasis to relax in. While the hotel doesn’t have a bar there is a supermarket literally across the road and the hotel are happy for you to bring in wine to the garden - they will even provide glasses, wine buckets etc
3. From 2pm daily they have snacks and refreshments on offer which is a lovely touch
4. Although the rooms are small - it’s Paris rooms are small everywhere - they are very comfortable and well appointed

The breakfast is not very exciting but there is equally nothing wrong with it and enjoying it in the garden certainly improves it. It is a residential area so I wouldn’t recommend it for someone wanting to be amidst the hustle but for us it was perfect - will definitely return

title: We made the perfect choice!
text:
I had a conference at the Palais des Congrès de Paris.  And because my wife had never been to Paris (?!), I arranged to bring her along with me.

I have always rather disliked staying in conference hotels, particularly when it's a huge conference.  After the work and the networking, meals, and drinks are done, I prefer to escape to a quieter, prettier, smaller, non chain-based hotel.

My wife actually found this hotel for us.  And it was just the perfect choice.  (Our room was also comparable in price to the conference hotel.)

The Hotel Regent's Garden is a five-minute walk to the Palais.  It is on a quiet side street, just off Avenue des Ternes.  (It's also a five-minute walk to the Arc.)  It has a stunningly lovely garden, where we ate our breakfast - which was included - on most days.  Every member of the staff was lovely and gracious and exceedingly helpful and attentive to...well, everything.  (Shouts out to Sofia and Arnaud, who we got to know by name.  And apologies to the others who were all so very nice and helpful.)

I tend to write reviews here only when I am exceedingly pleased and believe the place deserves the support and my little bit of effort.  There are way too many reviews and comments everywhere on the Web, everybody is a critic, and there are too, too many seemingly "entitled" folks who can be so negative and nitpicky and nasty.

If you have read this far, then, I will just tell you that the Hotel Regent's Garden is a gem.  It is a can't miss.  If you are interested or want to stay in the neighborhood of Monceau, I believe you will love it.

We would go back.  In a heartbeat.

text: Hotel Regent’s Garden is one of those exceptional hotels that I hesitate to share too widely because I would like it to stay the way it is. The hotel is situated in a 19th Century hotel particulier in the 17th arrondissement, with a paved courtyard in front and a beautiful garden behind. The rooms (I must have stayed in almost all) are elegant, well furnished and very luxurious. Downstairs is a well appointed breakfast room, which doubles as an “open bar” (non-alcoholic) in afternoons, and a very pleasant sitting room/library looking out onto the garden. And when the weather is pleasant, sitting in the garden — at 10 minutes’ walk from Étoile — is magical.
