I recently stayed at Hotel Regent's Garden and it was the perfect location for a quite business trip. The breakfast and snack bar were much appreciated as a pick-me-up between meetings. The garden was a retreat to decompress and tend to emails.

The staff are wonderful! They were patient with me during checkout. I left a few items in my room and they kindly sent them to the States for me. 

I couldn't recommend this hotel enough. Wonderful!

Other than that, this was definitely one of the top hotels I have ever stayed at!

title: BEST HOTEL IN PARIS
text: My friend and I stayed there over New Years after our AirBnB was cancelled, and let me just say that I am SOOOOO GLAD WE FOUND THIS PLACE!!!!!!!! The staff are BEYOND INCREDIBLE!!!!!!!! Every single person that we interacted with was so incredibly nice!!! When we first got there, the hostess at the front desk said “Welcome home!” and then we got chocolate (always a plus!)!! I speak French but my friend did not, but it was not a worry because everyone was fluent in English!!!! I cannot stress how incredibly nice everyone was; the customer service alone was enough for me to know that I’ll never stay at any other hotel in Paris again, and I’ve told all of my friends and family about it as well!!!! The rooms were very well sized, the bathrooms were large, super clean & modern, and the shower was also amazing. The beds were SOOO COMFORTABLE and the decor was really really cute!!!! They even have free snacks every single day, a list of bars to get free drinks at because you are staying with them, and even free sauna visit!!!! Also, the location is INCREDIBLE; less than a 10 minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe!!!! As 2 young female travelers, we felt completely safe and comfortable in the area. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!!!! YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!!!!!!

title: First time hosteler highly recommends
text: It’s literally a hotel. First hostel and Will forever look for a generator in the cities I stay. I had 1 problem and 1 problem only: the online booking allows you to book day of even after checkout time has passed- so make DOUBLE SURE your dates are correct. The website will automatically cancel your reservation and charge you for that day before you can edit your reservation. Once we arrived everything was better than we could’ve imagined. The workers were very very helpful and did not charge us extra for our mistake. Very clean, i felt very safe and the workers were helpful asf. Privacy dividers by your head so you don’t wake up staring at someone. Storage under bed (bring a lock!!!!!)  they have a reading light, USB plugs, and French outlets built into the bed frame. Shower and bathroom separate. We stored our luggage in the extra luggage room for a day after checkout for $8. Highly recommend.

title: A good stay, but watch out for the prices of extras!
text:
I stayed in the Generator Hostel in Paris for one night. I arrived between 23:00 and 00:00, so having a 24-hour reception desk was great as it enabled me to check-in. It's in a good location; it's easy to reach from Paris Nord. I (25 year old male) walked over and felt safe along the way.

The room was clean and the bed comfortable. I stayed in a 10-person dorm (~34 euros) and everyone was friendly. Our room had a sink and bathroom. One thing that was frustrating is while the toilet in the our dorm was in a room behind a door, the sink was not. It was opposite the coat rack in a little nook as you walked into the dorm. That meant anyone coming back from a late night caused a bit of noise brushing teeth and using the tap.

Staff were very friendly and helpful. I felt pretty confident that I could always get some help or even drop down for a chat.

The atmosphere was great - lots of people around chatting, playing pool, having a drink.

The security of the premises was ok. Having staff always on reception helped. However there's nothing really stopping a random person walking in, using the lift and tailgating into a room. That's pretty classic with hostels, but I mention this because if you want to use the locker in your room you need to bring a padlock. Alternatively you can buy one there, but I think this is a bit cheeky of Generator because obviously people staying in a hostel want security for themselves and their items - it's an essential. Charging extra for an essential is, to me, a big no no. Why not offer customers a padlock if they pay a small deposit?

My main issue with the stay was the cost of all the extras. I personally would not recommend breakfast, and I would also find another bar if you wanted a drink. I paid 9 euros for a beer; the average cost of a beer in Paris is 6.76 euros (2021 data). From memory, breakfast cost about 8.50 euros. For this you can get muesli, bread rolls, jam, ham, cheese, tomatoes, cucumber, juice and tea/coffee. It's very simple for 8.50 euros. A croissant was an extra 1.50 euros and cooked breakfast another 2-3+. That wasn't clear when I booked breakfast so I felt a bit ripped off. Charging extra for croissants is a bit ridiculous.

Overall a pleasant stay, and definitely a good option for travellers. Just mind out for the extra costs!

title: Un vrai plaisir
text: La Maison Favart is a lovely place to stay. Our room was beautiful and overlooked the Comic Opéra. The staff were all friendly and helpful. The small pool and sauna were a welcome bonus. The location is great, but as it's set back from the main boulevards, it's very peaceful.

title: Perfect night in the center of Paris
text: I have spent only 1 night in this fantastic hotel in the heart of Paris. I highly recommend this hotel if you are visiting Paris for short or longer stay. Don't forget to visit the Spa and ask the Concirge for tips on what to do around and where to eat.

title: Beautiful boutique hotel!
text:
This hotel was everything me and my best friend were looking for! It is very chic and so Paris! It’s so clean and decorated beautifully.  Our room wasn’t huge but it was perfect for just us.  

Has AC.  Cleaned twice per day which was amazing.  We did not get the included breakfast but around happy hour we did go down for free lemon cake and espresso. 

The staff was so friendly and always willing to help out and make suggestions. When I return to Paris I will absolutely be staying here again and recommending to all my friends!

This was in a quiet area with a close walk to everything.  Also easy to catch a cab a block away.

title: Wonderful stay
text:
We have just returned from 5 wonderful nights in Paris. We found the hotel to be boutique, warm and welcoming. The staff are a real credit to the hotel. 
Our room (Rm 51) was graded deluxe but was compact compared to others in the hotel. It did however have a great view of the comic opera and was well appointed. We particularly enjoyed having a mini fridge and coffee maker and access to fresh milk and pods/tea bags in the breakfast room (plus free cake!). As the floor space in the room is compromised by the main stairwell, we did find the shower room particularly small so perhaps ask for another room if space is an issue. 
We really enjoyed using the hotel spa, in particular the water massage bed (what fun!). It’s bookable in advance so we always had the space to ourselves. 
A good spread was laid out each morning for breakfast but we chose to eat out at a  nearby bakery/cafe each morning. Do make use of the recommendations of the hotel concierges, we had a particularly wonderful cocktail on the rooftop of the cheval blanc hotel, thanks to Freddie.
We can also recommend the rooftop of the Galerie Lafayette for a fabulous view of Paris and the Astair restaurant in the nearby Colonnades.

title: Beautifully Perfect in Paris
text:
I really do feel like Hotel Favart is like my Parisian home, I have been staying at this wonderful hotel for almost 40 years I love the romance, history and location of
 La Maison Favart, and overlooking Opera Comique is magnificent. The staff are so wonderful and very helpful and especially Boris he is a gem. Thank you to everyone for making my stay just perfect. I so look forward to returning again and again. Your fabulous!

title: The Heart of Paris
text: The Staff are friendly and very helpful, room was lovely and we would certainly stop at this Hotel again. Overall service was fabulous. Positioned within easy access to to the Metro it is a perfect base to explore Paris.

title: Very comfortable family stay
text: The room was great although it was on the ground floor next to the breakfast hall. The staff were very helpful. It's a small cosy hotel. The rooms are beautiful and clean and the location is pretty good as well. Would definitely recommend a stay there.

title: Wonderful boutique hotel with amazing service
text:
We were spending four nights in Paris and wanted to avoid staying in an impersonal hotel or chain.  We happened upon La Maison Favart and boy are we glad we did.  This is a small boutique hotel that delivers large.  The staff were - to a person - helpful and cheery.  The hotel itself is charming, located on a small side street in the heart of Paris.  The hotel feels uniquely French in the best ways - the decor, the furnishings, the rooms.  We had a lovely stay here.  A few things of note:

- The rooms were large by Paris standards, especially the suite.  Ask for a room overlooking the charming square directly outside the front door of the hotel, which overlooks a theater and often features locals dancing.  Really.
- We didn't have the breakfast, but it looked lovely and robust.  The complimentary coffee was delicious and a great way to start the day.  
- The staff was all great, but a special shout out to Boris the concierge.  He was amazing.  We had a rather particular medical need during our stay for our daughter and he went out of his way to find us what we needed.  He also had great recommendations, helped arrange for cars to/from activities, and was a gem of a help.  Thank you Boris!

Just a wonderful place to spend time while in Paris.  We'll be back!

title: Great value for Paris
text: Excellent staff very friendly and welcoming, standard room was good with excellent shower. Buffet breakfast with good choice for a boutique hotel, would definitely stay again if visiting Paris. Located 5 minutes walk from opera house with Metro close by.

title: Fantastic hotel
text: A very beautiful and extremely clean hotel, with the most helpful and kind staff. The receptionist had a high level of professionalism, addressing our needs and making us feel at home. The service we received was outstanding in whatever we needed.  We had such a pleasant and memorable stay!

title: We had a great time in La Maison Favart!
text:
Everything was excellent, starting with the room itself and ending with the human and service attitude of the local employees. Special thanks to Freddie, who was amazing and excellent and served us in the best possible way!

The room is a bit small, but not in a different way than is common in small hotels in Paris. The breakfast is very good (but it would have been more correct to take care of refilling all the things in the meal throughout the morning).

title: Excellent boutique hotel
text:
I cannot say enough good things about our recent stay at La Maison Favart. Every member of the staff was wonderful. We stayed in La Petite Maison, which I highly recommend for families of 4. We had plenty of space. Wifi was spotty in that room, but we had been advised that might be the case and the hotel had a mobile hotspot for us to use. That worked flawlessly. 
The staff hurried to ready our room when we arrived very early in the morning after an overnight flight where we got no sleep. They offered us breakfast while we waited. They were eager to help out with any issue, including reservations and recommendations, help to use the metro, etc. 
Carina, Boris, and every single member of the hotel staff was welcoming, helpful and friendly. We would return again in a heartbeat.

title: Cosy and clean hotel in the city centre
text: Cosy, clean and perfectly located hotel in the centre of Paris. The room was comfortable and clean. The pool is small but perfect for a quick swim after a warm day walking around Paris. The staff was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Would recommend it.

title: Wonderful stay in Paris
text: We were only at the hotel o e evening but it was lovely. The staff was great, we had a wonderful breakfast and the honour bar made it very easy to get a nice glass of wine when we wanted one !we would definitely stay again. My brother has 3 children and stayed in the petite Maison which was incredible.

title: Great location and super friendly staff
text:
This was our first stay at the La Maison Favart during our five nights Paris trip. The location was awesome and you could walk to everywhere. The rooms were beautiful and comfortable, and the staff was super friendly and couldn't do enough to help us (Thanks Nirou for the excellent service).  There is small pool and sauna in the basement and it was refreshing. 
The breakfast was more than adequate and offered scrambled eggs, various meats, lots of fresh pastries and coffee among other juices.
I highly recommend this hotel and we look forward to staying there again on our next trip to Paris

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text: We loved staying at La Maison Favart during our trip to Paris! The location was awesome, the rooms were beautiful and comfortable (ours even had a large balcony), and the staff was super friendly and helpful -- the concierge, Freddy, got us in to eat at some of the best restaurants in the city. Highly recommend!

title: Lovely boutique hotel
text:
This was our fourth stay at the hotel, the first since the pandemic hit. It was as wonderful as always. The location is great and fairly central  and we could walk everywhere. The rooms are very clean and have all the amenities you could want. There is also the benefit of a swimming pool in the basement. All the staff are helpful and welcoming and we hope to have a fifth visit soon!

We can also highly recommend Le Saotico which is a few short steps away. The food is delicious. The best you’ll find in Paris!

title: Paris boutique chic!
text: We had a couple getaway/staycation weekend, and decided to head to Paris, and luckily chose exactly the right hotel for the duty. At first we were placed into the inner yard facing room - according to my wishes, not hotel's decision - but after we decided it would be actually nice to see the view, the hotel staff let us have the top floor room facing the theatre carré, and... yep! Nice! The breakfast is a little sparing, but nutritious, and should you have missed something, their afternoon tea/coffee with in-house baked cake is, I must emphasize, The Treat, really.

title: Excellent accommodations
text: We had a great 2 night experience.  The staff could not be any more pleasant or helpful.  Rooms were beautifully updated, quiet and comfortable.  Conveniently located close to shopping and the Opera house.  Very nice and vibrant neighborhood.  Would totally recommend staying here.

title: Charming Hotel, strongly recommended
text:
Super nice hotel, cozy, clean and super friendly staff. fabulous location, great rooms, super clean and the little swimming pool is so cool. 
I oved my 3 nights stay at the hotel, and it is great for families, I would recommend this beautiful charme hotel.

title: Good location for a short stay
text: Small, cute boutique hotel, well located near the Opera Garnier and les Grands Magasins (major shopping areas). The staff were really friendly, couldn't do enough to help us, and it has a plunge pool and sauna in the basement which is a great find in Paris. The fitness room is very basic - no hand weights, the room was on the small side and the air con wasn't up to much, so we wouldn't recommend staying there in the height of summer.

title: A very satisfied client
text: We were delighted with our time at La Maison Favart - excellent service, excellent amenities, excellent location.  The room was tastefully decorated and modern - with the mattress being especially comfy.  It worked on several levels for us; we were very happy indeed.

title: Best Boutique Hotel in Paris
text: We stayed in this fabulous hotel for 7 nights. We were delighted by the comfort, cleanliness and the overwhelming friendly staff. Nothing was a problem from the first day we arrived. We would like to congratulate Carina De Lemos the General Manager for her friendliness and dedication for leading such an amazing and professional team. You’d be sorry to miss this Parisian experience. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: When I go back to Paris, this will be my go to, it’s a lovely hotel where the staff can’t do enough for you.  We stayed two night’s and I have to say they were very comfortable too.  it’s just far enough away as to not be noisy but a short walk away to lovely restaurants, cafe’s and bars.  I really enjoyed my stay here.  Thank you so much for your hospitality it was fantastic……. We will be back!

title: Character and that personal touch
text: My family stayed here on our last night in Paris and it was perfect. I appreciate the boutique experience (over the cookie cutter chain). Tons of character and style + flawless execution of hospitality and services. Freddy, the concierge, was a star. Breakfast buffet was excellent. I highly recommend this property.

title: La joie de vivre - La Maison Favart
text:
La Maison Favart is my new “home away from home”

This was my first solo trip in many years, after the end of a very long relationship of 13 years in 2020 - I was very anxious about traveling alone to an exhibition in Paris, a Gallery that was showing my work. 

I spent months researching where to go - considering similar hotels in areas such as Le Marais and Montmartre - having traveled to Paris a few years back I had an understanding of the city. 

The position was beyond my expectations - waking up to the Comique Opera House practicing their aira’s every morning was beyond enchanting - there is something magical about the square below and sitting in the afternoons and watching the sun drop over the streets of Paris is a memory I will forever cherish. 

Each day I would begin in the beautiful dining room and lounge with a coffee and croissant while catching up on the latest news, before setting out on my adventures set by the extraordinary kind and helpful team at La Maison Favart, who’s concierge staff would come and chat me through my day they had planned, call me a taxi or hand me my tickets and send me on my way. 

This personal level of detail I have not seen before in either the George V Hotel in Paris, The Four Seasons in Florence or the Gritti Palce in Florence and well Soho House generally don’t even remember you stay there - let alone your name. 

This level of service is beyond excellent - the kindness of the staff and comfort of the hotel made my trip truly exceptional. 

With regards to the interiors - whimsical and “enchanteur” - there is something spectacular about staying in a Home that was once the birth place of Opera in Paris. You can feel the history and all the good vibes that has gone through these walls over the moments of time. 

A word about location. On this trip - I walked Paris. Every amazing attraction you are able to walk to. I believe no other arrondissement, this will be possible from. I felt so safe on my own in this area as well. 

Beginning with wondering out your front door to the Comique Opera itself, you have a five minute walk to the best high street shopping in Paris, including, Printemps and The Gallary Lafayette, where an evening sunset trip to the rooftops is essential, followed by a show at Palais Garnier. 

A walk to Le Marais and Montmartre where my favorite’s, the magical places you stumble across to simply stop and have a coffee or a glass of Bordeaux and just breath and watch life dance by. 

A walk to the Champs-Élysées, Eiffel Tower, West Bank and Latin 1/4, so, so easy, do not forget to go on the pilgrimage to the legendary book shop Shakespeare & Co. and my most favorite gallery Musée d'Orsay and of course stop by the Louvre on your way. 

I really loved the Louis Vuitton Gallery designed by the infamous Frank Gehry and one of my absolute highlights suggested and arranged by the La Maison team was Cézanne and the immersive experience and without doubt a highlight of my life, The Monet Gardens - all I can say is take a day there - no less! These experiences took my breath away, in the physical sense. 

When I think of this trip I get goose bumps - I get emotional in the best kind for way. This was transformative to my soul and my life moving forward. 

I count down the days to my return to my beautiful red room overlooking the magical square - living in the moments while sipping French Champaign and enjoying in real time la joie de vivre! 

I can’t wait to return to Vincent and the team at La Maison Favart - may my return be soon and swift and hopefully my two week stay will be a month next time.

They say that traveling turns you into a story teller - what they don’t say is those stories are not always good. 

I not only have good stories from my travels to Paris - I have Grand stories… and a happy heart and soul and I count my blessing for every moment I was lucky enough to stay in my home away from home - La Maison Favart. 

Until next time, or until we meet again. I shall be counting down the days until then.

Ps - something should be left to discover - don’t forget a trip to their pool. 

All my love 
Ingrid

title: Delightful
text:
This is my fifth stay here (with a hiatus for Covid). It’s delightful to see the same staff members have been retained for many years and I think it reflects well on the hotel.

This is central for Paris but, because it faces the courtyard of the opera comique, extremely quiet. Breakfast is fine - continental in style. 
Walking distance to all the main sights. The beds are comfortable and rooms are lovingly decorated but compact - as is the norm for Paris.  

Recommended  !

title: Service
text:
The front desk is very kind and helpful. I wasn't able to travel due to private reasons but the hotel was so kind to assist me completely in finding a solution and made sure my future stay is arranged.
Looking forward to stay at this beautiful hotel later this year!

title: Perfection in the center of Paris!
text:
We stayed at La Maison Favart (total of 5 nights spread across two stays) and couldn’t be more appreciative of the rooms, breakfast, coffee, the amazing location right across from the Opera Comique and most of all the people there! 

The Concierge was also super helpful with recommendations and pick ups/drop offs. 5 stars for this gem and we will certainly stay here again the next time we visit Paris!

title: This is a True Gem!
text: My husband and I generally stay at the major chains even when traveling in Europe however, this time we chose to stay at this amazing little boutique hotel. It was wonderful! Staff couldn’t have been nicer and the room, though very small, had a charming decor and well appointed bathroom. We chose a deluxe room which had a nice view of the plaza below. The breakfast  was more than adequate and offered scrambled eggs, various meats, lots of pastries and very good coffee among other things. I highly recommend this hotel and we look forward to staying there again on our next trip to Paris.

title: Quiet but central location.
text: Perfect central location! We stayed here for the French Open (Roland Garros) but wanted to be closer to the center of the city to explore before / after tennis. The rooms were well decorated, decent breakfast included, staff helpful and friendly.

title: Wonderful hotel
text: The service was wonderful and the room was very nice and clean. Perfect boutique experience in Paris! Received an excellent dinner recommendation from the concierge our first night, and they got the room ready early upon our early arrival.

title: Excellent visit to Paris
text:
Lovely hotel, great location and the most kind and helpful staff. Breakfast excellent also.
We stayed for 4 nights and enjoyed the whole time at the hotel. We didn’t try the meals from room service but thought the idea of an honesty bar a great idea

title: Charming, Marie Antoinette feel luxury boutique hotel, perfect for a cute Parisian break!
text:
I had the most wonderful stay at La Maison Favart, it really felt so special and like my own little home for the time I was there, even though there were a good amount of other guests! The service is just so friendly and welcoming, stepping into La Maison Favart feels like a luxury living room where you can relax with a slice of cake and something from the honesty bar after rushing around! It's location is great as well, everything is pretty much in walking distance.
My room was so comfortable and such thoughtful attention to detail - I had the best nights sleep! I felt like I was living a Parisian fairy tale!

title: Top hotel in Paris
text: Staff were very friendly, special commendation to the concierge staff. Pity our room wasn’t ready when we checked in despite requesting (and paying for) early check in but helped enormously when given access to the well-being area where we could shower and freshen up after long flight from AU. Room was excellent, looked fresh, was very clean and all required amenities. Highly recommend this hotel and will be our go-to hotel next time.

title: Great location, clean comfortable room
text: We had a wonderful time at La Maison Favart Hotel. The hotel has a great location, with a Metro station very close. Our room was clean and comfortable. The breakfast buffet was very good, although some freshly prepared choices would have made it exceptional. The staff helped make out stay truly great. I want to personally thank Boris for going to the Post himself to send off our postcards, but everyone on this staff went out of their way to accommodate our needs. Thank you for an amazing 5 days in Paris.

title: La Maison Favart is Enchanting!
text:
ENCHANTING ATMOSPHERE  Private, charming, and immaculately maintained. This is a boutique hotel at its best. Incredible attention to detail in the aesthetic and service- service is attentive but not invasive. Favart offers many wonderful touches to discover, including breakfast, the spa caves and the delightful "Honesty Bar."

IDEAL LOCATION! Across from Opera Comique and near the grand Opera, Quiet charming street but all the amenities are found within a couple of minutes walk. La Maison Favart is also a comfortable walk to destinations such as the Louvre, Champs Elysees, etc. You can also plan slightly longer walks 20-30 minutes to arrive in areas such as St. Germain des Pres (left bank), the trendy Marais district, etc. 

My daughter and I felt that Favart set the perfect stage for a successful mother/daughter trip to Paris. Bravo and Merci Beaucoup to the lovely staff!

title: A real gem in the heart of Paris!
text:
We stayed at the Favart Hotel for 5 days and I wish I could have stayed for longer than that. The Hotel has the best of both worlds, it is located in a very quite street but close to all the stores (7min walk to Galleries Lafayette, 1 min walk to cafes and restaurants and 12 min walk to the Louvre). The rooms were nice and tasteful and the service was superb. All the staff members were amazing but we really appreciated Vincent and Freddy’s attention with all the questions, recommendations and insights about the city ( They definitely gave the extra mile).

We highly recommend this hotel and we definitely will come back again.

PS. The chocolates in the pillows were fantastic.

title: The sweetest, happiest, friendliest boutique hotel in Paris.
text:
This hotel is decadent from the time you check in and until you depart. The ambience and lengths Vincent and the team went to during our stay to ensure we had the best Parisian experience ever was incredible. The rooms are clean and stylishly furnished with classic accents and really comfortable beds. 
Loved, loved it. Would highly recommend.

title: Amazing hotel, with even better staff.  I must praise , Concierge Boris is great
text: We were there two families with children , so rooms beautifully clean, quiet , excellent breakfast in a very romaticke atmosphere. Everything close to the hotel so for me and my family exelentni hotel, we will definitely be back there.

title: Wonderful 7 Days
text: La Maison Favart has been my best hotel experience in Paris by far. The entire staff is very welcoming and super helpful. The hotel is centrally located, you can walk anywhere in central Paris easily. The hotel is very, very clean, comfortable, stylish and well appointed.  The bathroom and the shower were very nice and the overhead shower especially nice. The hotel is located on a quiet street which is nice. Breakfast and coffee were good, and perfect for starting the day. The honesty bar is a nice amenity. The part about the hotel is the staff. They are very, very helpful.

title: Amazing stay
text: La Maison Favart was an amazing boutique hotel, very accommodating. All the staff were incredibly kind and helpful, and made our first stay in Paris one of a kind. They helped us secure tickets to the ballet La Bayadere on short notice, and accommodated us when we came early to the hotel. Thank you for a wonderful stay and when we come back to Paris we hope to stay at the same hotel!

title: Regular Visitor
text: Expect exceptional service and great amenities! The rooms are very comfortable and the hotel is also well located in the 2nd arrondissement, walking distance from many of the city's most iconic attractions.

title: Vacances en Paris
text: We spent 5 nights at the Maison Favart. The hotel is ideally situated close to many attractions in a lovely neighborhood of the 2ème arrondissement on a quiet street. The staff were very friendly and helpful. We had a family room on the 1st floor, the room was beautifully decorated and well equipped. Temperature control in the room worked well but we couldn’t set the heat below 17C which made it slightly too warm at night. The spa was a lot of fun! Very relaxing. Everything was super clean. The concierge was very helpful with setting up a day trip to Giverny and assisting with airport transfer. I would highly recommend the Maison Favart to any other travelers. The hotel seems perfect for both families and couples on a romantic weekend in Pairs.

title: Great location
text:
This hotel has a fantastic location within walking distance of Opera Garnier, the Louvre and it is close to Sacré Coeur and rue Sainte Anne's many delicious Japanese restaurants and Bubble Tea shops. However, this area is also home to many famous traditional French brasseries. At La Maison Favart, you won't need the metro to go explore Paris.
Along with the cute wall ornaments, I was welcomed with pink balloons, flowers, and a delicious macaron on my bed. Exactly what I was craving on my visit to Paris! My highlight was the free massage bed in the fitness area. It’s a waterbed that will soothe your sore muscles from sightseeing with a 20-minutes massage program. There also is a small pool and sauna next to the fitness room. Since there is no space to lie down in the wellness area, you should quickly head back up to your charmingly decorated room afterward. The rooms all have names that fit the life of the artistic, iconic couple who has inspired the hotel's story, Mr. and Mrs. Favart. He was a playwright and she a dancer and actress. Hence the historic hotel next to the Opéra Comique is in a perfect location. On the breakfast buffet, you could find bread, croissants, pain au chocolat, meats, cheeses, and juices. During the day, you could enjoy free tea/coffee in the equally lovely lobby or breakfast room and there was free cake as well.

title: Quintessential Parisian hotel
text:
Located on a quiet side road only 2-3 minutes walk from a bustling street with a huge variety of bars cafe's and restaurants offering everything from the finest French cuisine to American dinners. 

The hotel is approximately 20 - 30 minutes walk from the main tourist attractions like the Louvre / Champs Elysée's, which on gorgeous spring days like we had was no effort, however in the winter months I would recommending buying a multi trip Metro ticket from the nearest station Richelieu–Drouot which again is only a 3-4 minute walk away from the hotel. 

We opted to have breakfast in the hotel which when we go back we won't do because there are so many gorgeous places to eat so close by why limit yourself to one? That said the food the hotel provided was lovely.

The staff are incredibly helpful, friendly and accommodating 

The rooms are very clean, bed was comfortable and shower was amazing! I personally felt the room size was a bit small but that's what you get in big cities, so I can't say that I was disappointed in any way. 

I would highly recommend this hotel and will definitely go back next time we visit.

title: Paris gem!
text: La Madison Favart was superb.  My wife and I decided to celebrate our 35th Wedding anniversary in Paris and selected this boutique hotel.  We LOVED this hotel.  Quiet, charming, well located and charming.  The entire staff also made us feel so welcomed and comfortable.  Was like staying in a charming home with a wonderful set of hosts.  Friendly, helpful and very nice people.  Our thanks to them for making our stay so special..  We’ll definitely be back!

title: My Favorite Place in Paris
text: This is my second time staying here and it was just as amazing as the first. We were a family of four traveling. The location was perfect for walking or jumping on the Metro. Centrally located, but off the main streets to provide peace and quiet. The rooms are very well decorated, comfortable and clean. The staff is very attentive with attention to detail to ensure you have a fantastic stay. The spa area was a nice retreat after a long day of sightseeing and my kids especially enjoyed the pool. I really love everything about this hotel!

title: Great Service
text:
La Maison Favart was very clean with small but well appointed rooms. The concierge staff was amazing and very helpful. They offered to go above and beyond when it came to helping us with train tickets. They get five stars. 

The only issue we really had was that the wifi did not work very well. Not a huge deal but we were trying to research our dinner options, etc.  

Breakfast had nice offerings - the dining room definitely could be crowded at times. 

Location was nice as well - easy to get to good restaurants and a nice walk to the museums we wanted to see. 

We would definitely recommend.

title: Exploring Paris in March
text: La Maison Favart is a very cute Hotel with lovely rooms. The location in the second district is perfect for sightseeing and to explore the city. All the stuff is very kind and courteous. Initially we booked our trip for March 2020 because of Covid 19 we had to postpone it a few times and ended up in March 2022. The communication regarding this was very easy and the postponement without any extra charge. We had a rate with an included breakfast but you can also book it for 24 € per day and person. The breakfast was OK but not worth the money. All in one a perfect trip to Paris. We are looking forward to our next stay at La Maison Favart.

title: AMAZING!
text: Incredible hotel with great character and great location. The staff were so friendly and couldn't do enough for us. The spa area is beautiful and spotless clean. Hotel room was fabulous and the breakfast was very tasty with plenty of options to choose from. Lots of gorgeous touches around the hotel set a wonderful atmosphere. We can't wait to go back.

title: great place
text:
all good: location, service, staff, breakfast, room and cleaning.
I recommend the deluxe room over the regular that can be small (but still nice).
come early for breakfast or wait for a few minutes.
the lobby is great.
you can get (and pay) refreshments all the time in the breakfast area.

title: Perfect
text: We chose this hotel to prepare for our wedding and to stay in that process. It was the best decision we made. The help and interest of the employees was very good. It is both a quiet and a good location in Paris. There is a magnificent square in front of the hotel and it was a great pleasure to see that square every day.

title: Beautiful hotel, friendly staff
text: We had a wonderful time at the hotel. The room was incredible, the staff was so helpful and had so many great reccomendations. It was also a great location very easy to walk to many attractions and lots of good restaurants around!  Would highly reccomend

title: Amazing Hotel and Perfect Location!
text: We loved the hotel, the staff was really nice and polite, the room was very functional with everything we needed, the bed was comfortable and it was great to have a Nespresso machine for our early mornings! The location was fantastic, just one block away from a metro station with 2 lines that easily connect to many other lines across Paris making it very convenient and quick to visit all the major attractions and well as get to the train stations. We would definitely recommend and come back if ever visit Paris again!

title: You have to try this hotel if your in Paris
text: What a beautiful hotel. Rarely does something exceed expectations, but fabulous decor, great facilities and the most welcoming and helpful team really took hosting to the level. The location is amazing too with bars and restaurants on hand and a 20 minute walk from everything you'll want to see. We also slept like babies in quiet surroundings and a lovely bed. Very clean and very smart. We're super impressed and already planning our return.

title: Beautiful Hotel & Lovely Stay
text: The staff is very friendly and helpful, we felt right at home. The hotel is very beautiful, especially our room was a dream with a beautiful  view of the Opera House. I highly recommend getting breakfast at the hotel – you will get a chance  to try typical French food  stuff (croissants, cheeses) in beautiful environment. But breakfast in bed is something really special. Also: the city center is quite easy to reach – great location indeed.

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: This hotel is clean and decorated so well.  The staff are amazing.  Always willing to hep and answer questions.  The hotel is in a great location within walking distance of most everything. The breakfast is wonderful.  A variety of pastries and yogurt and I love the honor bar in the evening.  Would highly recommend staying here.

title: A PARISIAN DREAM.
text:
What a lovely experience !We had a pleasant stay  
in La Maison Favart. Everything met all our expectations. It’s a beautiful hotel in the center of Paris. The staff was super friendly and helpful. We felt super welcomed by everyone. We stayed in a beautifully decorated double room on the 2nd floor with an amazing view of the Opera Comique. A big big plus is the access to the swimming pool, sauna and gym. The next morning, we had a room service for breakfast. It was so delicious. Every detail was perfect. It was like a Parisian dream. Thank you ❤️

title: Quintessentialy Paris, the best of it!
text: Everything was wonderful! Staff, location, architecture, design, rooms, spa, breakfast - to the the very last detail. We felt like being in our very own "Hotel particulier" and we are happy to come back.

title: Long weekend in Paris supporting half marathon runners
text:
Hotel was a small focused hotel with good support from all the staff. Breakfast was lovely as was the cakes etc during the day!
Good location near Metro.
Bedroom very comfortable, only issue was lack of English speaking tv channels, fed up with the news channel!!

title: A beautiful parisian home in the 2nd arrondissement
text: A beautiful hotel in nice surroundings, a familiar and welcoming athmosphere with outstanding service. Very helpfull staff, room facilities are up to date, and the small spa is relaxing and good supplied. We also love the genuin parisian vibes and the nice breakfast.

title: A perfect place for couples
text:
How we missed this hotel the last years. Feels like coming home to family, warm, personal and laid-back. 
Not to forget the honesty bar and the pool. 
Quiet but central in underestimatrd 2.arr  
We cannot wait to come back.
Rooms are spacious enough and very clean. 
Many excellent restaurants within 5min walk.

title: Wonderful
text: This hotel has the best location, superb staff, beautiful decor and very well appointed rooms. Everything is within walking distance and there's a Metro stop at the end of the street. Would highly recommend and we hope to return here again sometime soon.

title: We will be back.
text:
Super experience that met all our expectations (high!) 

Excellent staff team, friendly and helpful without overdoing it.

Very nice and cozy small spa. 

Clean and quiet room on 4th floor. 

Breakfast good as well. 

Concierge helpful with booking restaurant for us.

title: A short break in Paris
text: This hotel is lovely. It is elegant, small and great service. We ‘won’ this trip in a raffle and it was a great prize. However, it included a basis room which was situated at the front of the hotel. It was tiny with only one single functioning wardrobe as the other had the coffee machine and safe in it. It was also hugely noises at night when the hotels services - laundry and food was collected. Both nights we were awoken at 1pm for 45 mins and again at 3 for 30 minutes. This was a shame as it meant poor sleep. I would use this hotel again but would definitely not have a room on the front ‘with a view’.

title: My Favourite Boutique Hotel in Paris
text: My partner and I have just returned from our third stay at Maison Favart - we simply adore the hotel.  We were made to feel enormously welcome by everyone in this very special place where you feel at home in beautiful surroundings and really feel embraced in the heart of Paris.

title: Lovely hotel and friendly staff
text: We had a lovely 2 night stay at La Maison Favart. The hotel was cosy, well decorated, clean and all the staff were polite & welcoming. I needed to leave some things at reception for someone to pick up while I was out and the staff were very accommodating, in particular the concierge (I believe he was called Vincent) who was so helpful and friendly. We stayed in a double room on the 3rd floor with a lovely view of the National Theater of the Opera Comique. The bathroom was a little small so a bit of a squeeze for 2 people to be in there at the same time but wasn't a big problem for us at all. Comfortable beds, black out curtains and located on a quiet street so we slept very well! Good selection of food for breakfast, hot food was limited to scrambled eggs, bacon, sausages and was brought out in small batches from the kitchen so a couple of minutes wait if the breakfast room was busy but at least the food was fresh and hot! The breakfast room was very quiet, so could have had a little music to make it less awkward with other guests in there. We had forgotten to bring our swimwear so unfortunately didn't get a chance to use the pool or sauna but they had good measures in place for Covid reasons. 15 minutes walk to the Louvre and River and 25 minutes walk from Sacre Coeur. Plenty of cafe bistros nearby. Overall we had a lovely stay and would definitely come back!

title: Perfect little hotel in Paris
text: We were pleasantly surprised by this hotel. Our room was beautifully decorated, very clean, with a good size bathroom. A big plus is the swimming pool / gym / sauna in the basement. Breakfast is very nice too! Concierge was very helpful too.

title: Excellent stay at Maison Favart’s « petite maison »
text: We had a very pleasant stay at Maison Favart. We spent 4 nights in their « petite maison », a wonderful duplex with 2 bedrooms, 2,5 bathrooms, a private dining and a salon with fold-out bed. We loved the space, the wonderful decoration, the silence and the fact that we were able to have our breakfast in our own dining room. The staff was very, very friendly and always ready to help. Location was excellent. The welness was good, though we found the relaxation pool a bit chilly but that is just a matter of preference. The breakfast was nice and tasteful; perhaps not as abundant as in other hotels but certainly not bad.

title: Amazing Hotel and great location
text: Great experience on an amazing hotel. Really High service, the rooms are nice, however bathrooms are a little small, but besides that really worth a visit. Dont forget to visit the small SPA, which is perfect after spending the day visiting all the great sights of the city.

title: Everything was great!
text: We can’t fault the hotel at all, great friendly staff, beautifully decorated and very clean. Great breakfast and nice snack and drink options in the evening. We won this in an auction and at the time didn’t have kids, because of covid we postponed the holiday many many times and in the end went with our two year old twins. The hotel is more for couples however they accommodated our need for two cots in the room and they were so wonderful with the children even when they were being menaces at breakfast. I personally would rather go here as a couple so you can really enjoy the beautiful setting, spa and peace of the place but it can work for families too because the staff are so excellent. Thank you!

title: 5 stars!
text: La Maison Favart  is a wonderful small boutique hotel in 2eme. The friendly and helpful staff coupled with the quiet confortable rooms made my stay in Paris absolutely perfect.  I highly recommend and plan on returning for my next stay in Paris.

title: Home away from home
text:
I have stayed at La Maison Favart on 2  occasions.The first time was in the Classic bedroom, a small but very cozy, quiet and well equipped room. Second time was in the Deluxe bedroom (an upgrade generously provided by the team) - this room is more spacious, nicely decorated, well equipped and had a gorgeous view of the Opéra Comique. 
The staff is extremely helpful, kind and want to make you feel at home. The lobby always has complementary coffee/tea and cake/pastries available for the guests. The spa is cozy, quiet and has a pool, sauna as well as massage bed which is extremely relaxing. The small gym is also nice and quiet. The location is perfect - a lot was within walking distance of the hotel. I would definitely recommend! 

Thank you again to Freddy, Macicilia, Marwan, Vincent, Boris and the rest of the team for the stay. Au plaisir de vous revoir !

title: Great weekend stay.
text:
Great location and lovely room. Super shooter and amenities. The staff, especially Vincent could not do enough for us. Nothing is too much trouble. 
Easy walking distance to all the places you want to see. Provided you like walking, which we do. 

Highly recommend.

title: Nice and cozy
text: We stayed 4 nights and got a very warm welcome by the hotel staff upon our arrival. The lobby is nicely decorated and fresh flowers are always on display. The room  was was quite small but clean with a nice bathroom and a great shower. The location of the hotel is excellent, centrally but on s very quiey street. We did not have breakfast at the hotel but enjoyed a complementary coffee in the morning before exporing Paris and the honesty bar in the afternoon is a nice touch. The concièrge booked restaurants for us and all staff is very attentive. All in all a great stay.

title: Perfect stay in Paris
text: La Maison Favart is absolutely great in every way! Very friendly and attentive staff, beautifully decorated rooms, a nice spa and very centrally located. The metro station is very close, and many sights are within walking distance.

title: Raquel Gerlani
text:
I had the best experience at La Maison Favart. I felt like home. The location was perfect. I was only 8 min of the Galery Lafayette and right in front of Opera Comique.
The view from my role was mesmerized.
The staff are the sweetest and ready to help you. 
Perfect for family, couples and/or lonely traveler.

title: Extraordinary service at its best
text:
It is our first time writing a review but Hotel Favart and its team deserve praise. 
We arrived at 7am at the hotel and we were treated with utmost hospitality.
The hotel team fulfilled all our wishes and made our stay in Paris remarkable.
Usually, we enjoy experiencing different hotels but in Paris we know where to stay any time we go there again.
Best wishes,
Michaela & Markus

title: A quaint hotel with a perfect location.
text:
I am just home from a long weekend stay here. It’s a lovely hotel within a short distance from many lovely sights. Breakfast was delicious. 
The staff were courteous and helpful. Our rooms were small but spotless. I definitely would return here.

title: Wow… look no further great location feels like home away from home
text: We just came back from a 5 days Paris girls trip and this hotel is a gem. I would describe as cozy, charming and the sense of home away from home. The location was also a key factor on our decision as it’s literally 2 min from the metro Passy (where you can go anywhere from here) and 5-7 min from the Eiffel Tower which honestly nothing else should be required. After a long day walking on the beautiful streets of Paris we would go back, shower, relax and then grab a bottle of champagne and go to the Eiffel Tower as you can sit down at the stairs, listening to live music overlooking at the tower. This is our first time here and we will definitely go back with our families to the same hotel. The breakfast was amazing with simple things that we all love: great assortment of cheese, plain and chocolate croissants, yogurt, eggs, orange juice, amazing coffee, I miss that so much. The staff are nice and always smiling and willing to help. The shower was great and so the beds. Also, they are 2-3 min from a nice mall which has a supermarket (Metropix) underground so we were able to save on food right there. Right at the corner of the hotel there is a great and affordable place to eat super recommend (their salmon is to die for and only paid EUR 19). We could also see the Eiffel Tower from our room. Merci Passy Eiffel e a bientot.

title: Perfect Location near Eiffel Tower
text:
Decided to stay at this location after reading many reviews. I highly recommend it. I found the staff to be very nice and my room was very clean and quiet. We stayed in a superior room which had a queen bed. 
The Eiffel Tower is a 15 minute walk down hill from the hotel. We never ate the continental breakfast at 14 euro per person because there is a outstanding pastry shop 3 doors down called Desgranges. I did get coffee every morning and brought it back to the room. To the left of Desgranges at the corner is a nice bar where you can sit, have a drink and watch the people stroll by. To the right and up the hill about 10 minutes is Aero Passy Restaurant which has a really good omelette. This hotel is also near the Metro and local shopping. It is a local neighborhood so don't expect large crowds or name brand stores here.

title: Just what we needed in Paris!
text:
Passy Eiffel Hotel was as cute as I'd hoped for! I was staying with a friend and we got a room with twin beds. I was delighted to get a room where we  could step out of our window into our own private little balcony with two chairs and a view of the top of the Eiffel Tower! 

Room included a small fridge. The staff was friendly and spoke English. It was a 10 min walk to the Eiffel Tower! Very safe area with a bakery right next door. AC worked great!

Only downside was the very tiny elevator. It worked fine! And the hotel wasn't ever busy enough that we had to wait for it, but it could only take two people or a single person and their luggage at a time. However, it was in fine working order. 

Definitely recommend!

For breakfast they served the BEST CROISSANTS  in all Paris, good quality cheeses, hams and other goodies. The staff was friendly, kind and helpfull, always made us feel welcome and taken care off.

title: not a 3 star hotel
text: After reading so many positive reviews about this hotel I decided to book for my 2 nights stay in Paris. I was really excited because I had read this hotel had a wonderful view on the Eiffel Tower and was very close to the centre. When I got there I was asked to pay straight away without even seeing the room, which in true fairness was ok to me considering I had booked with the option pay at the property. The room was clean but very small and what they call view of the tower is in reality a very small portion of the tower you can only if you really push your head out of the window. Minibar was empty and hair dryer did not work. This is the first place I have visited that did not even have a toilet brush in the toilet. But the true problem was when we came back after having visited the city at night and realised that the heater was not working. I called the reception and was told that " no its not possible the heater is working ". I explained them that it was not, but they told me they did not have any maintenance person ( odd, all hotels I have been always have somebody ). I went downstairs and was told to take a picture of the instructions of the heater.. The receptionist insisted saying that there was a remote control but in reality the heater has only a fix panel and i had been trying to switch it on for the past hour without success. I went back to the reception and explained to the man that there was no remote control and i could not sleep at night without the heater. His answer was "what do you want me to do ? " and "there is nothing I can do ". I said that he had to find a solution and he said he was going to get me an heater so he disappeared and come back after about 10 minutes saying that there was no heater because they maybe gave it to another room ( sign that maybe heater was not working in other rooms either). I was quite frustrated at this point because I wanted to go to sleep and this person had shown no interest to find a solution. The receptionist finally decided to come have a look in the room, he confirmed the heater was not working but said " the room is warm ". as if he had the right to decide for me. When me and my partner said that we were not happy about this as the room was quite expensive for one night, he quickly opened the door and left saying again there was nothing he could do for us, He never came back as a result we had a very unpleasant night and the room was not very warm at all. The following morning I explained what happened and again the lady listened to me with total disinterest saying that there was central heater and in reality it was warm, In all years I have visited hotels I have never had such a bad experience. They could have shown some more interest by giving us a duvet cover ( the room only had sheets on the bed) or refunding part of the money for the night that went so bad. This place has so many good reviews, but I want to warn everybody please stay away this is a terrible place and there are many other better and less expensive hotels around

title: Terribly disappointing and rude check out receptionist
text:
The room was small however adequate for our needs. It was a pretty mundane stay until the end  check out where the check out receptionist Ana was so unhelpful and rude it really left a bad taste in our mouths after a great trip to Paris. First we asked her for an itemised bill. No the printer was broken. Okay fine please could you email it to us. Followed by a look which suggested we had asked her for her first born child followed by a weary sign. The we asked her to book us a taxi  to the train station- pretty simple request you would have thought. She started off immediately by making excuses that it was difficult to get a taxi as it was raining. Funnily enough it did not seem difficult for a couple who were also waiting for a taxi in the reception area, who left after 5 mins. 

After 20 mins of waiting we asked Ana to call the cab company again. While speaking to us about this she started to serve another customer who had walked in, not at all caring that we were still waiting for her to call again. While Ana was supposedly on the phone to the taxi company we were attempting to get an Uber driver - there was some problem connecting on the app. Ana kept telling us to 'just book an Uber' despite us letting her know we could not get connected. She seemed totally disinterested in doing her job and actively being obstructive. She could not tell us what the taxi company had said to her despite her holding a phone apparently talking to them. What a poor representation of the hotel.

title: Eiffel views, easy metro access, charming & clean.
text: Charming, clean hotel, good location with a metro stop 4 minutes away to get to other arrondissements. Excellent customer service- Christine was a delight and very helpful in printing our negative Covid tests, airline forms, etc. Our rooms (33 and 34) had views of the Eiffel and it was stunning to watch the lights at night. The courtyard is the perfect place to eat croissants from the Boulangerie a few doors down. Rooms weren’t too small, had desk and extra chair. Plus a full bathtub in the bathroom. Things to note- the elevator is snug, the hair dryers are vintage and not very powerful if you need that kind of thing, and there are no small towels for wash cloths, I have read this is common. We just grabbed loofas a few blocks down at Monoprix. None of this negatively effected our stay, we would stay here again!

description: Centrally located, our beautiful establishment in Haussmann-style embodies the perfect combination of original Parisian charm and modernity, thanks to its recent renovation in 2012. Its outstanding location allows guests to explore Paris on foot. Sacre Coeur, Montmartre, the Opera and major department Stores are withing a 10-minute walk from the hotel; the nearby st Georges (line 12) Metro station provides direct access to Champs Elysees in under 15 minutes. Upon arrival, you will be delighted by our charming reception area, as well as by the efficient and attentive welcome of our team. Our 84 rooms, to which our staff devotes special attention, have been tastefully redesigned to provide you with comfort and modernity. Enjoy free WiFi in the room and in public areas. Take your hearty breakfast in buffet style in an unusual setting, as you discover the original vaulted cellar, a beautiful and airy structure. Needless to say, you may also order your a-la-carte breakfast to be served directly in your room. Thus, the warm and modern furnishings of the hotel , its outstanding central location and our caring staff are the perfect ingredients for a successful business or leisure trip!

title: Super :)
text:
Recently stayed here and we absolutely loved our stay.

The location is excellent - just moments away from Moulin Rouge and Sacré Cœur. 

The nearest metro was not even a minutes walk away, and we utilised this daily to get to other parts of Paris, although a lot of tourist spots are well within walking distance.

Complimentary minibar was a godsend - after walking in the scorching heat all day we came back to nice chilled water and soft drinks and a spotlessly tidy room. 

The room was decently sized for Paris. The bathroom was nice too with a shower and bath.

Air conditioning and free wifi were great. We had a flatscreen TV although we didn’t use it. 

Little street noise although you could hear the metro underneath but that wasn’t a problem. 

Breakfast buffet was great too and set us up for the day and was 10€ a day although definitely worth it. 

All in all location was great, hotel was lovely, and staff were polite and helpful. Would definitely return!

text:
Travelling alone with my son, I wanted to be well placed to get around Paris but also have the little things taken care of when it comes to accommodation. 
I couldn’t have asked for more with this hotel. Super friendly staff right from check in, who were more than happy to supply us with recommendations, directions and point us to the complimentary snacks (big win). 
Room was a decent size for Paris. Basic in design and function but it doesn’t really matter when you’re using it as a base to explore. 
The Metro station is just at the bottom of the street and is on a well connected line. Free minibar was a godsend after long, very hot days exploring. Will definitely recommend this hotel to others and be staying here again in the future.

title: Superb Hotel and Stay!
text:
Just returned from a 4 night stay at the Lorette and we had an amazing stay from start to finish.Having looked around at hundreds of hotels in Paris, we decided on the Lorette and we were certainly not disappointed. All of the staff were so friendly and helpful and helped us with any questions we had with a smile and patience. 
They helped me arrange some surprises for my friends birthday while we were there, and arranged for a birthday cake and champagne to be brought up with our room service breakfast. The lovely staff who brought  up our breakfast even sang Happy Birthday to my friend. They even put up the banners I'd brought with me and decorated the room as a surprise.
In your room you have a little fridge which is stocked with water, orange juice, iced tea and coke, all complimentary, and these were replenished every day if you had used them. Every day in the lobby they had unlimited tea, coffee, chocolate and a fridge with soft drinks , water, pepsi, iced tea. They had jars of little sweets,  cakes and  cookies, as well as a special cake everyday such as a lemon cake or Swiss roll. All of this was complimentary. Lovely idea and very much appreciated.
The room we had was lovely, spotlessly clean, very comfy beds and a nice bathroom with bath and overhead shower, with a glass shower door. Plenty of hot water and good lighting. Good air conditioning too. There was a flat screen TV but  we didn't watch it at all. There was a safe in the room and a hairdryer too. There were double usb charging points at the side of the bed.
Very little street noise as it was all double glazed. Curtains were black out ones too, so you got a great nights sleep.
Breakfast was situated on the lower floor in a beautiful cavern style room. There was plenty of choice everyday with cereal, fresh fruit, yogurts, pastries, cakes , cheeses and hams, and a hot selection of scrambled eggs , bacon and sausages. Selection of hot drinks and fruit juices too. Everything you needed to set you up for the day.
The situation of the hotel could not have been better. A 2 minute walk down the street brought you to saint Georges metro , which took you all over the city and beyond. There is a bus stop outside the hotel as well. The immediate area is lovely and very pretty. Café's and restaurants are all just minutes away. A 10 minute walk up a slight hill, brings you the the Moulin Rouge and a further few minutes you are in the Montmartre area, full of lovely shops and cafes, bars and restaurants. It was a 20 -25 minute walk to the Sacre Coeur from the hotel and about a 15 minute walk to the Galleries' Lafayette and Opera Garnier, where you can catch the Hop on Hop off bus.
I would definitely recommend booking your attraction tickets and times in advance, as the queues were horrendous for the likes of the Eiffel Tower, The Arch de Triumph and The Louvre. 
We had an amazing time in Paris and our stay at The hotel Lorette just made it perfect. Thank you so much to Victoria, Emelia, Soumia and all the staff for being so wonderful and making our first trip to Paris so perfect, thank you. A perfect hotel in a Beautiful city. Highly recommended.

title: Great week in fun neighborhood in Paris
text:
Highly recommended for a fun, affordable stay in Paris. My sister and I shared a room at this lovely, comfortable hotel for a week in May 2022. We had a “twin superior” room, which was spacious and clean. We had a lovely view out the window.

The staff was friendly, and spoke excellent English, which was incredibly helpful. We had our room serviced every day, and the staff did a great job. Drinks and snacks were available at no additional cost every day. They called us cabs whenever we needed them.

We had breakfast at the hotel two days, and it was very good and convenient. Good coffee, breads and fruit. 

The location was great. A nice neighborhood with easy access to metro, and a short walk to other lines. Lots of great restaurants and cafes close by. 

Lots of spacing and masking with staff and other guests.

title: I loved this hotel - good location - good price
text:
I am giving this review with an eye towards what I would want to see/know about a hotel. I love the Lorette. It is quaint and authentic. There are wood steps going between floors (as well as elevators) and the steps slant – just so authentic and so ‘real’ over what you would find at a chain. The hotel is clean. The lobby and snack areas are clean. 

I liked the snack area. You can always grab a glass of water, soda, coffee, tea. There are always little cookies and crackers available. Then, later in the day, cake, croissant, chips and such. A nice little addition. 

The breakfast area was also quaint like a little cave with the stone ceilings and such. Was always clean and I have to say, they had a really nice selection of foods, hot, cold and traditional. The hot chocolate from the coffee machine is to die for. 

I had the twin superior room and it was a good size. Again, clean and well-tended daily. The mini fridge was stocked with water, juice and Pepsi. You could easily get more if needed. I could open the window in my room and look out – which was amazing – just such a Parisian experience. Desk space was nice, WIFI was good. The bathroom was clean, with shower and tub, decent water pressure and everything I needed. 

The location, well that was also amazing. Literally, a 2 minute walk to Metro and so close to other things. I learned if you go right down the street, there was a little grocery (front desk directed me there). They have a large selection but what I found was go in through front door and out the back and you on Rue de Martyrs which is FANTASTIC. All the food shops and specialties. 

Also, hotel is so walkable to other places. You can get to parts of Montmartre very easily for shopping and restaurants. Really, the location is so good. As you can tell, I really did enjoy this hotel and I felt it was a good value as well. I would absolutely recommend it and would stay there again if a heartbeat. I miss it.

title: Perfect place to stay in Paris!
text: Beautiful hotel in a great location with easy access to metro and buses. We arrived at the hotel by bus from Gare du Nord and it was such an easy journey. The hotel is close to Montmartre but away from the hustle and bustle of the busier parts. There are plenty of cafes, shops and restaurants nearby, and St Georges metro station is just two minutes away.  Although we didn’t have a great view from our room (some rooms do), we really appreciated the very quiet location. The room itself was spotlessly clean, and we really appreciated the ( free) minbar of soft drinks, which was replenished every day. Another bonus was the availability of complimentary hot and cold drinks and snacks in the afternoon and evening in the lobby - we were also told that this was at our disposal  in other Astotel hotels in Paris too. We had breakfast in the lovely cellar room, where there was an excellent choice of hot and cold food, including plenty of  fresh fruit. Staff in the hotel are fantastic - they are friendly and helpful at all times and they seem to have a genuine concern for their guests’ well-being. We felt very much at home in this lovely hotel, and we will definitely stay here again on future visits to Paris. Thank you to all the staff ( especially Xavier and and a lovely lady who dealt with our checkout on 8th Nov. - sorry, we didn’t catch your name!)  who do such an excellent job. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

I definitely recommend this hotel. :D

title: Great little hotel in a convenient and active neighborhood
text:
Arrival

The hotel is half a block down a pedestrian alley so expect the taxi to drop you off a short distance from the front door. There was one person behind the front desk and no other attendants that I could see. 

Check In
Was smooth and friendly. We got into our room earlier than expected which was welcome. Front desk people were very friendly and helpful on our stay.

Lift/Elevator
It's small even by European standards. It also has a weight limit of 180kg. We went one at a time with one bag each.

Stairs
There is a circular stairway from the basement to the top floor. It's easy to navigate and helps with the aesthetic. Only problem is that it stops at a very very narrow landing between each floor. If you have bags it's better to go a floor higher and carry the bag down. Be careful not to fall when the lift opens.

Room
There were two of us in a small room. We had a narrow view of the street but nothing special. The room was extremely small. There was hardly any room to put one suitcase much less two. And the bathroom was tiny. The room and bathroom were smaller than any of the cruise ship cabins I've stayed in. 

Breakfast
The free buffet started at 630a. It was usually empty but there are plenty of tables. Food included fresh croissants, fruit cups, coffee machine, fruit juice, ham/salami/cheese, etc. Everything was fresh and tasty. It was a nice place to start the morning.

Neighborhood
We felt like we lived in Paris. There were restaurants and shops all around -- shops for people who lived there not for tourists. Bus and Metro stops were also convenient. We mostly ate in the neighborhood and didn't feel at all crowded by the hoards of tourists at all the tourist spots.

Tour Eiffel
We chose this place because it was a five minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. That was definitely worth it. But we also loved the neighborhood.

Language
Everyone in the hotel spoke English and probably many other languages.

Noise
The walls are thin.

Conclusion
Low cost, convenient place in a friendly neighborhood with great staff.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel
