title: A great little hotel in a good location.
text: This is my second time staying with this hotel this year. Both times now I've had a great experience with them. The hotel is clean and modern, rooms are a good size (rooms in Paris are often small) , staff are brilliant, especially if you don't speak great French. The staff were accommodating, friendly and always happy to help. The hotel is a short distance from the metro, and very close to plenty of great restaurants, cafés and bakeries. Also, minutes from the Eiffel Tower.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Nice Hotel
text: My family and I stayed here for a few days. Our stay was very pleasant and the location was great. The staff is very friendly and the complex is very clean. Close to restaurants, boutiques and a few minutes from the Eiffel Tower. Great place to stay
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Love the place!
text: Out little family will definitely come back and stay here again! The location is perfect and the place is cozy and nice. We recommend the hotel and we are planning to come back with other family members!
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Jiri
text: this place is in nice, quiet  environment, 5 min walk from Eifel tower, rooms are a bit small, but clean and comfortable, staff is very helpful and polite, speaking good English, price a bit higher, but we are in Paris
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Great location!
text: This hotel was just a short walk away from the Eiffel Tower and the Seine! The hotel itself was very clean, and both of the staff members I interacted with were very helpful. Just be aware that the elevator is very small, so you may need to take multiple trips if you have more than one suitcase with you. I would definitely stay again!
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Great value
text: Great location 10 mins walk to Eifel tower. 5 mins walk to metro, safe neighborhood, very friendly staff, very clean and comfortable. i purchased breakfast in advance. Breakfast could be better but it was ok. I will definitely come back next time.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Nice hotel, good location, small rooms
text: The hotel is very nice and the location is perfect. Also the staff is very nice and friendly and the breakfast is good. But the rooms are very very small. The hotel is also not cheap. So a nice hotel for one night for one person.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Good location, good for a short stay, small rooms but friendly staff and pleasant
text:
Good location to walk to metro and Eiffel
Tower, rooms were small, but pleasant and clean and staff were good and friendly and helpful. Would only want to stay for a short time as very small and no bath.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Friendly and helpful staff
text: Lovely hotel, friendly staff, very clean rooms. Hotel staff was very accommodating, helped me to book bus ticket to my next destination as well as helped with booking the shuttle back to the airport. Room was comfortable and warm. WiFi was good too.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Great location, excellent staff!
text: The staff is very attentive to anything you may need. The proximity to not only the Eiffel Tower but also to bus and metro lines was great. Lots of bistros, cafes and patisseries/brasseries in the area. Very pleasant. Area felt safe. We walked everywhere at all times of day and night with no problems. Our only complaint if we have one would be the size of the room. It could not have been more than 11ft by 11ft. We could open a smaller suitcase on the baggage stand but then the bathroom door would not open completely. Even if you were willing to put your open suitcase on the floor you could not. The distance between the bed and the walls on either side was inadequate for that. Now, all the rooms may not be that small. We were on the first floor, room #3 with immediate proximity to the lobby and we had a small table and chairs on the shared patio with another room. We did not use it though because we were there in November. Not having to use the elevator to come and go was another plus for that room and it was very quiet.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Alexander Martchenko
text: We already stayed at the hotel 6 or 7 times, all was excellent, service, meal, bed, toilets, room, breakfast (they even provided us with breakfast at 6:15 am as we were harrying for airport), so we were fully satisfied
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: MTN
text:
I love the hotel. It is small, so don't expect huge room for the price you pay. The hotel's room in Paris are small. I had been stay in a smaller room before in Paris. The staff are very friendly & helpful. The location has many good restaurant surrounding the hotel. I like cafe constant & de Mar. There is a store selling very good pate and cheese close by hotel. Few block to Eiffel Tower and many other sightseeing . There is cafe in the corner and middle of all the road that is close to Eiffel Tower is a great place for people watching, but the waiters can be very aggressive to get the customer. 

Con: The room is small, but very functional. The bathroom is small and shower is small, but it is ok for us, but if a big guy then it can be a problem. The temperature is control by the hotel people (main setting), you can not control in the roomm
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Nice cosy hotel in a great location
text: Hotel is in the great location near public transports, nice restaurants and market. As we had only 1 night in Paris and we wanted to do boat trip at night so we decided to stay near Eiffle tower and the pier for boat trip which is about 10 minutes safe and pleasant walk at night from and back to the hotel. I stayed in a different hotel on the same street before. But it was much better experience this time. As we paid mostly for the location, the rooms of the hotels in the area will not be spacious but cosy. However, the hotel made us feel value for money with their high standard room decors and furnitures, cleanliness, comfortable even sofar bed, safe box with universal socket on the safe box door (Sadly, we spotted that when we're about to leave.) and electric kettle (apparently NOT all the hotels in the area with the same number of stars have it available, tea/ coffee in bed is the must!). In addition to that, the choice of 2 single or double bed in a triple room (the 3rd bed was a sofa bed) was handy and that was why we choose this hotel as we are 3 friends who prefered to have our own separate bed in 1 room. Staffs were welcoming, friendly and well English spoken. He had a Paris map with the hotel location and attractions ready for us without asking. We left out 1 star for any room of improvement and the milk that were missing from our tea and coffee making tray.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Comfortable and Convenient
text: While my single room was quite small, it ticked all the boxes.  Everything was clean and comfortable.  The staff was friendly and accommodating.  Metro was very close so I could get around the city very easily.  The area was safe and had all the conveniences that I needed.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Intimate Hotel in the central Paris
text: This small but cozy and intimate hotel n Paris was perfect for our 4-night stay. We arrived at 11am and our room was ready even though check-in was at 2pm. Very accommodating and friendly staff.  The room was small but very  comfortable. It’s a fabulous location on a very lovely Quiet Parisienne Street close to the Eiffel Tower and walking distance to a lot of tourist attractions, metro stops, museums and restaurants. Ihigly recommend this place for singles or couples.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Couples holiday review
text: Location and room were excellent but our room key worked for a different room when we accidentally went to the wrong room, while people were in there so we were a bit paranoid someone else could come into our room in the night and we put a do not disturb sign on the door throughout the day but our room was entered and stuff was moved around after we asked it not to be
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Beautiful hotel room in the heart of the 7th arrondissement right near the Eiffel Tower
text: Modern, comfortable room on a charming street. Hotel staff very welcoming and helpful. Quick walk to the Eiffel Tower, many restaurants and metro stations. Big plus for me was the dark curtains that completely blocked out the sun in the morning!
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Well Located - Small Room
text: Staff very friendly & helpful. Got us into our room early since we had arrived after a red eye from the US. Great location. Breakfast was good. We had a room on the ground floor that was small but very clean. The street was nice & quiet
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Great location!
text: I arrived late at night as a long layover in Paris. The staff was friendly, the bed was comfortable and the location was fantastic. I was able to see the Eiffel Tower before going back to the airport.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Paris
text: The staff is wonderful!  One of our traveling companions left behind her binder with tickets in it and the manager chased us down to return it to her. Location is great. Rooms are smaller than usual for Europe. Location was good for walking around Eiffel Tower area.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Good location, nice hotel
text: We had a cute little room in this typical Parisian hotel.  We had a nice courtyard, unfortunately it rained almost the entire time we were there.  But the room was nice and clean.  The breakfast was good, and the staff was really great.
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: One night at Paix Tour Eiffel
text: Very very good location next to the Tour Eiffel and next to a lot of bars and restaurants, you can go walking around to experience Paris inside. I stayed on night at one's of the little rooms of the Hotel, everything was clean. Only point wildfire didn't work that day
Hotel: Hotel de la Paix Tour Eiffel

title: Responsive hotel, be patient
text:
I was nervous about booking this reservation due to previous reviews stating there is no response from the hotel. I called and emailed several times without a response, however, I finally got through on a call (just be patient and try different times of the day).  The receptionist (may have been Joy, she also responded to my email) was So excited for us to visit and confirmed our reservation. 

I will update this review after our stay. Just a reminder you are in good hands; just be patient. 

Hopefully, this helps when you’re reviewing places to stay! Can’t wait to post photos on social! 

Tina R and Kristin V

title: Extremely Central to Paris Sites
text:
We stayed two nights at the Hotel. Checking in was easy, in fact we got there at 10:30 a.m. expecting our room was not ready, but we 
we were  able to go to our room.  The room was large enough, and had a nice patio with a great view from the 9th floor.
The elevators were working well, and we had very little waiting time. The staff in all areas were very friendly and willing to help. 
Our breakfast was included in the price, and it was very well set up, and delicious. The location was amazingly central to so many things,
many choices of restaurants very close to the hotel. We went to the bar on the top floor, but though you could see the Eiffel Tower all lit up, it was not an inviting atmosphere. They wanted you buying drinks and not just coming for a picture. They only really rude staff that we encountered.
Overall our experience was so positive. We were told that the top floor bar was closing the day after we were there, so hopefully the new and improved version will be a more comfortable environment (the 80’s dance club is what the recent one reminded me of).
My rating was based on the hotel only.

title: Cannot get a hold of anyone at the hotel prior to trip (from another country)
text: I tried emailing the hotel multiple times to make some pre-arrival hotel arrangements but no one emailed me back.  I tried calling the hotel multiple times long-distance over the phone as well, and it was either no one pick up, dropped call, or someone picked and hung right away.  I even tried calling through the reservation department and the rep tried to get a hold of the hotel 4 times over the phone and couldn't get anyone to pick up.  t is impossible to contact the hotel if you are not physically there.

title: Location, location, location!
text:
Lovely hotel and central location...very close to Eiffel Tower...some rooms with ET views...rooms were nice and spacious which is not something common in Paris

Mostly for us it was the wonderful resturant/bar staff who were very happy to help with any questions, directions etc...we grew to love Mr Dillon (our bartender) a fellow with such fun energy and very attentive...Miss Olga (hostess) was completely charming and what a beauty, inside and out...a shout out to the sweet Razvitha (bar back)...Good Luck in your studies girl!

All in all we enjoyed our time in Paris and stay at the Pullman🥰

title: Great location and fun visit..
text:
Visiting Paris for 3 days and found the location to be perfect with a view of the Eiffel Tower and lovely restaurant with yummy breakfast included.

Dylan was our favorite bartender. We had a nice drink each evening at his bar and Olga the hostess was lovely too!

Hotel was a short walk to the champ de Mars train for a quick trip to Versailles also short walk to Eiffel tower or cruise boats along river Seine.

Easy to get a cab out front and lovely Boulanger down the street.

Would stay again!

title: Great Place to Stay
text: Our stay was really good,the View of the Eiffel Tower was perfect. The bed was soft and the pillows were great. The staff was really nice , polite and helpful . The restaurant had an awesome food , a delicious breakfast and a Profiteroles to die for !!! Great location, I Would recommend for anyone to stay.

title: Location Location Location
text: The view of the Eiffel Tower is spectacular!! (If you request the room with a view). It is expensive but so worth the stay. Front desk service was great. The workers were friendly and very helpful. Overall I would say it was a great experience!

title: The hotel will hold you refund for a long time
text:
Please be aware that this hotel will not refund you for a LONG time once you cancel the reservation. I booked a semi-flexible rate room for December which allows me to get full refund 7 day prior to check in. They charged the entire amount of the stay (over $1,000) on the credit card right away. I cancelled it on August 28th, and still have not yet seen the refund yet after 10 days.

I called the hotel 3 times already. The receptionists were nice but they always said the manager was busy and asked me to send an email to the hotel. I told them I already sent the email to inquire about the refund a few times but received no reply. The receptionist said she will try to "escalate" it and told me to "call often". She said she receives many calls asking for refund. It sounds like many have waited for refund for a long time -- weeks and even months!

I hope the hotel will eventually provide refund. Please be aware of this when you are planning to book this hotel.

title: Inefficient check-in, not a four star
text:
Guest relations at check-in seem completely out of their depth. I had to wait 20-25 mins for a check-in (despite completing pre check-in online - this is supposed to make the process simpler). During this 25 min wait, I noticed three desks of guest relations managed to process just one customer each. This is truly incredible 

To make matters worse, at 1pm the room wasn’t ready since the check-in is at 3pm - perfectly understandable. When I came back at 2.45pm, apart from having to wait yet again at the counters, they tell me the room won’t be ready for atleast an hour longer

I am also posting a picture of the “lounge” I’ve been seated at 

This has been a unique and unprecedentedly terrible experience

I traveled in Sep’22 and booked one of their suites

title: Amazing hotel
text:
This was my second time to Pullman Eiffel Tower. 
Great Location. This hotel is very close to the Eiffel Tower and underground. We were welcomed by Alberto who is the life of the hotel. He is very friendly and welcoming. The Management Cocktail is a great idea. You get to be close to the iconic tower and enjoy the views

title: Not family friendly
text: We are at this hotel now and checking out tomorrow. Check in experience was poor, we were given a room after a long travel only go find out that there was another family still there as we opened the door - the person who checked in was nice (not that it mattered) and gave us another room claiming it’s a floor higher !  The goodness stopped right there! Rooms are super small, tiny bathroom and not family friendly. The staff are rude including the concierge guys (unless you are super rich and engage one of their exclusive travel service), they charge 5 euros for even delivering an empty plate and napkin, to top it all they gave us a drink coupon which we can never use as the roof top is busy - we even requested them time just for a picture as our 9 year old was keen but well we were refused ! So that’s that, we will never be back at this hotel. The only benefit is that it’s super close to Eiffel towel but everything goes downhill after that -

title: Amazing hotel, staff and location
text: First the location is a stone’s throw to the Eiffel Tower. Second, every single team member of their staff was amazing, friendly, attentive and wonderful. Third, their breakfast buffet was out of this world - they literally thought of everything.  We also dined at their restaurant one night and the food was amazing.  After we went up to their rooftop bar where they thoughtfully have seating arranged to see the tower so it was wonderful to see the sunset on the city.  I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Great service by Reservations Staff
text: I consulted the staff at Reservations desk (Mr Vuk) and he provided great service by answering our questions on the rooms, the type of bathrooms (which has accessible features) and holiday events.  He was very patient and provided us with much information to show this is indeed a world class hotel.  Thank you!

title: Don’t book a triple classic room, they don’t exist
text:
The hotel has a great location if you want to be near the Eiffel Tower.  It is a few minutes walk from Bir-Hakeim Metro station and a five minute walk fro the Champ de Mars and the Tower itself.  The hotel is smart and mostly clean.  We did have a bad experience checking in.. after a 10 minute wait, where only one of the 3 check-in desks was staffed, we were told that the room we had booked (via American Express Travel) which was a triple classic, does not exist and that rooms are just for two people.   I still don’t know whether that is an Amex issue or a hotel one, but I can’t believe we are the first to have this issue so the hotel should sort this with its booking agents.  The hotel was full so on the first night we were put in a classic room with an extra single rollaway bed.  Once the single bed was in there was no room to move.  On the second day they said they would move us to a larger room, which they did but failed to move our bags as promised which led to a worrying few minutes while we located them.  Then the new room was not really any bigger than the first but with a slightly better layout which meant at least that we didn’t need to climb over the furniture to get to the bathroom (and paying £300+ per night for the privilege).   The rollaway bed was poor quality, with two of the slats falling out the first time anyone sat in it.  We fixed it ourselves temporarily and didn’t want to waste any more of our time sorting it out. 
So taking away the annoyance and mis-selling of the room fiasco, the hotel is nice enough.  Breakfast was good with lots of options - and there is an egg/ omelette station, which no-one told us about, we just noticed people getting omelettes on the second day we were there. And it could take a long time to be served/offered coffee.   
The room we were moved to had a balcony…but no balcony furniture and a very dusty/cobwebby front panel.  Had a walk in shower which was nice, though hard to avoid flooding the room unless you use the overhead shower.
There was a pop-up bar on the 10th floor which was nice though the staff were a bit snooty.   And don’t even try to go in just for a look as you’ll be turned away very firmly.
Unless you really want to be near the Eiffel Tower I don’t know that I would not particularly recommend the hotel.   It is comfortable enough but the staff weren’t overly helpful/friendly and it doesn’t have much character.

title: Romantic 5 Stars!!!!! 10 Stars for us!!!!
text:
If you want to visit the Eiffel Tower and see her in all her majestic beauty- stay here at The Pullman Tour Eiffel!!

This was our 2nd stay, our sons’s 3rd!!!
The rooms have balconies that literally allow you to have the Iron Lady right in front of you with all her magic and beauty!!!!

The rooms are large, romantic as well as practical with bathrobes, rain shower, sitting area, comfortable king size bed, coffee makers andddddddddd the Eiffel Tower!

Their restaurant serves a wonderful breakfast brunch with fresh eggs and vegetables supplied from their own garden!

We can’t say enough about this 5 Star Hotel, and although it’s $$$ it’s worth the memories you’ll make!

Merci Pullman Tour Eiffel!!!! ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

title: Exceptional Location, Good Prices For Paris, Great Service from Staff
text:
My wife and I recently stayed here for 7 nights to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary. It was our first time visiting Paris and What a wonderful place it was. You really couldn't get a better place to stay if you wanted to be close to the Eiffel Tower and in walking distance to cafes, shops etc.  The staff were friendly, attentive and went out of their way to ensure our comfort. I can't express enough how grateful we were to be put in room 613 ( i think probably one of the best rooms for the Eiffel Tower View (not to low or high so you get the perfect view off the balcony)
Also I requested the full works to make the room romantic to surprise my wife, and they didn't disappoint as they dressed up the room with heart shaped helium balloons, rose pedals everywhere, a boutique of about 50 long stem red roses, chocolate, and champagne on ice with glasses, and a nice card, it was all so special and very memorable.

The room was comfortable, bed was great, hot water was adequate, towels and robes were good, bath products good.

Could you hear people from the other rooms, yes but this isn't uncommon for hotels in Paris from what I read in my research prior to coming here.  I read in some other reviews that this hotel didn't clean the rooms often, this isn't true, all you need to do is be proactive ask the front desk for whatever you need and they will arrange it for you.
I also read on the reviews that there were hours long wait times to check in to this hotel, again this also wasn't true, I was able to walk in no problem, speak to staff right away, have my luggage stored, left for the day, came back checked in, and the room was ready with no problems.
We went to the restaurant (the lobster roll is amazing), Top floor sky bar, and had room service though out our stay and all were good with no issues.
If you go to this place and show respect for the staff, be kind and appreciative, it's wonderful how you will be treated.
Thanks to all the staff for your kindness, hard work and ensuring my wife and I had an enjoyable stay to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary.

title: Great views, great service, friendly staff
text: Our stay was B&B for 4 nights ,  Great location, huge choice of delicious food  at breakfast. Fantastic service,  from the maitre D and.breakfast team particularly Christopher. In the evening the bar on the 10th floor was open from 6pm. Incredible views and again excellent service. Bar food was very good and cocktails too. Overall a lovely experience, recommend this hotel and would go again. Staff are excellent, well trained and attentive. Hotel due to its location is busy. We had a memorable city break.

title: Really nice
text: Me and my boyfriend came here for a weekend. It was a lovely hotel with an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower. We had a spacious bed. Lovely bathroom. We had nice freebies. A lovely balcony and bathrobes to use. It was lovely for two nights. The food in the restaurant  was also yummy.

title: Excellent
text:
This was a great, seven night, centrally located hotel experience for us. We were given adjoining rooms
 Particularly noteworthy were the helpful staff—Victor at the Concierge Desk and Céline in the Dining Room.
The Breakfast Buffet was absolutely outstanding. It was fresh and had a lot of variety.
The bar and balcony on the top floor bar provided unbelievable views of the Tower especially when the lights sparkled on the hour. 
Staff were very helpful

Now we mistakenly ate at one of those tourist traps close to the Tower where I first encountered the new trick being played on tourists—marking up the bill—“for service.” When I challenged the server—“I understood service was always included”—a new, correctly totalled  bill was produced.
This happened again at another restaurant-Le Beaujolais—a lovely spot a little further away from the hotel where the waiter simply wrote the word “Tip” at the bottom of the bill and suggested if I was happy with the service I could add something on. (I didn’t.) Then speaking with the French folks at the next table, they showed us their bill which didn’t have the word “Tip” written on it. Even they knew that tourists were sort of being targeted, perhaps by Servers who had been severely financially setback by COVID .
On another occasion the waiter asked me straight out—would I like to add something on for service.

All in all, this was a great hotel experience in an area which was very busy. I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Well located but service and food in restaurant vary greatly from day to day
text:
Ideally located, the hotel is clean and staff friendly and helpful. The breakfast however is either a full buffet… which is quite expensive or a take to your room coffee and croissant. 

The Frame restaurant is uneven in quality. One day the lobster roll is good the next, you wonder if it is actually lobster???

The saving grace is the well-stocked bar and the very efficient and friendly bartender.

title: Incredible
text: Had the best stay here. Check in was quick and easy, the staff were super friendly and the room we stayed in was fantastic. We had a balcony room with view of the Eiffel Tower and it is exactly like the photos!! The room was cosy and the bed was so comfy. Short walk from so many restaurants and the Eiffel Tower. We will be staying here again!

title: Not like the pictures
text:
We booked a one bedroom suite at the Pullman Eiffel Tower for a week in June. We chose this room based on the pictures provided on website. When we arrived, we were given a handicap accessible room instead, not a suite. There was no separation between the living area and the bedroom. There was no dining area such as the one pictured on the photographs of the suite. There were two bathrooms: one half bathroom featured a toilet and tiny sink; the other bathroom featured a large handicap accessible shower and sink but NO toilet.  Very inconvenient to say the least. My guess is that this suite had previously been two single rooms converted into a larger, handicap accessible room - without the conveniences of a suite. The carpet in the bedroom had a large stain. Overall, I was very disappointed in the room. 

The hotel has a great all you can eat breakfast buffet at a charge. We took advantage of this buffet before heading out to explore the city.

title: 0% SERVICE. 100% ATTITUDE. DONT BE FOOLED BY THE SOCIA MEDIA HYPE - WORST HOTEL IN PARIS
text: Terrible customer service. Rude and disrespectful restaurant staff. The hotel provided us with a room that had a broken sink, broken glass on balcony, rust and hole in the roof above the and calcified rain-shower. Housekeeping have a habit of taking all linen and towels out of the room and not replacing, we had to make our own bed. The only thing this hotel has going for it is the view. Breakfast items are cold, even the hot ones on the buffet. The hotel is always over occupancy and understaffed. We stayed with this hotel for over a week and the hotel failed to address our complaint correctly in person. We wrote a full three page complaint letter and provided imagery and explanations for everything wrong with our room. The hotel did not care and still charged us over $3000 AUD for the 5 nights in a room that was missing items, amenities that were not replaced, a room service phone that did not make calls, wifi internet that does not connect or is stable and room service that takes up to 2 hours to deliver a bottle of water, because housekeeping did not stock the fridge daily. We gave the hotel a second chance and stayed with them on our last night in Paris, they promised to resolve everything that was wrong by way of a credit with ACCOR or discount across the entire accommodation, however when we returned they provided us with a worse room, 2 deflated balloons and 8 fake rose petals on the bed. Hardly an apology or compensation. The language barrier in this hotel is severely misrepresented by the property and the hotel staff say yes but do not follow through with lots of empty promises. We will not stay here again and highly advise against this property. We will be uploading imagery to support this review within the next 5-7 days pending the hotels response to our complaint email and letters that have since checking in continued to go unanswered and resolved.

title: Fantastic location
text:
Had a lovely 1 night stay in this hotel. As tourists we were delighted with location could not be closer to the tower. 
We asked for adjoining rooms as we had our kids with us and that’s exactly what we got. Super comfy beds and a gorgeous powerful rainfall shower. Slipper and bath robes supplied and a gorgeous toiletry range. Only negative was the service in both bars, really could have been friendlier but we still had a super time. Check in and out what fast and they were happy to store our bags on our final day until our evening flight. Would recommend

title: Service not worth a 5 star
text:
Checked in at 3pm and went for a nap immediately due to travels.  Within 15 mins housekeeping entered our room 3 times with only 1 knock. 
3 separate entry into our room without our authority.  
This is not acceptable knowing guest have just checked in. 
We complained to reception 5 hours ago and still no feeedback or even apologizes.

Disappointed

title: Nice place to stay overall.
text: Be prepared for a little bit of a wait in the afternoon during check in. Rooms are clean and modern and the restaurant in the lobby is really good. Rooftop bar has an absolutely amazing view of the Eifel tower as do the balcony rooms. Only real negatives where I had to call for towels twice and got charged $5 to rent an ice bucket. Something you get for free at most hotels.

title: Late 20’s couple staying for 4 nights
text: Visited with my husband for a 4 night stay in Paris. Hotel around 1hr from the airport (€60 in an Uber). Check in process was poor, long queues, lengthy process, no information given about the hotel/facilities at check in. We’d booked a kingsize room with an Eiffel Tower view. Room was spacious, bed was comfy, great view from the balcony. There was a strong small of sewage coming from our bathroom but that settled after a couple of days. Housekeeping daily generally was good, however frequently room was left with no towels. Myself along with other guests went to reception daily to request towels for the room. AC was great, room really cool overnight. Customer service was OK. Visited the restaurant one night for dinner, service was so poor from the outside we left and went somewhere nearby. Overall, great view from the hotel (Eiffel tower rooms), some work on service required. Good location.

title: Bad service and experience July 2022
text:
The view was awesome and the bed, it was our honeymoon but we had a very bad experience. When things goes wrong, we saw the bad side of the inner beauty.

We were given a room that had a bad smell, wet carpet and spoilt ac. Front desk was reluctant to change room for us and kept sending people up to the room to check. I had to go up and down 3 times. 

On the last time, went down with luggage and was told to wait for supervisor. He was super friendly to the customer in front of us. When it came to our turn, he just left and we called him back. He went “you want a change of room and I will find another available room”. Seriously, I was given a very bad room and expecting us to stay to it? Not polite and different attitude from the previous customer. He went in and got another lady to come serve us, avoiding us totally. 

Then we were told we will have a change of room to a higher floor the next day. Nothing was done. Bad service when things goes WRONG! 

I understand that the hotel is popular and fully booked. 1. The room was bad  and I had to FIGHT for a room change. 2. Double standard in service. 3. For a 4 star hotel, this type of service is unacceptable.

title: Mr Brandyn
text: My girlfriend and I become engaged this day and Karim made the night very special as well as the rest of the staff. Good food great area delicious drinks best mojito I’ve ever had definitely go back again.

title: All around great experience!
text: This hotel is perfect if you want the Parisian experience. Our room overlooked the Eiffel Tower so we had a great view at all times. The hotel is located in the perfect area and everything is close by. I recommend having breakfast in your balcony (room service) if your room is overlooking the Eiffel Tower because that was such a lovely way to wake up. It was all very romantic, the room was clean, the bed was comfortable, the food was good and the service was great. Absolutely recommend.

title: Best rooftop bar in the world
text: Brilliant rooftop bar with the best views of the Eiffel Tower. Brilliant  location, great friendly service, lovely food and drinks - absolutely perfect. Would recommend to anyone staying in Paris. 10 out of 10

title: WARNING! YOUR CREDIT CARD IS NOT SAFE HERE
text:
I stayed at the Pullman for 1 night and paid my bill in full. However, nearly 2 months after my stay my Visa card was suddenly charged again for €600.00. 

I contacted the hotel immediately and they confirmed that my room had been paid for weeks ago. I was given an email address to contact and I sent a copy of my receipt from my original stay as proof of payment. No response. I contacted the hotel again 2 weeks later and I was given a different email address to contact. Again, no response. I know my emails are being read because I get the read receipts but nobody at the Pullman Hotel had the decency or courtesy to bother replying to me.

What would have happened had I not noticed the additional charge? They would have gotten away with theft. I have since emailed several times and still I have not received so much as a reply. I have now contacted my card company who will take up to a month to investigate this. 

Either way, I have had to waste my own time trying to get this resolved. Not cool at all!I think it's a shameful scammy way for a hotel to behave. You have been warned, use a disposable card number of paying by card here as they may try and scam you a few weeks after your stay! Or better yet, GO TO A HOTEL THAT TRY DOESN'T STEAL YOUR MONEY.

title: The Worst Customer Service!
text:
We stayed here as a part of Viking River cruise Pre Extension. I had texted hotel 2 months prior and requested early check in, they never responded! We checked in at 10:00 AM and told our room would not be available till after 4:00. We did our thing and checked in at 4:15. We were given two twins… I said no. The woman at the desk said we requested it, I said no. She said Viking then requested it, I said that’s impossible because there is a preference for stateroom on river cruise for bed configuration and we requested beds together. She said nothing she could do, but I could call Viking. Our room was two single beds in a very smallroom on the first floor, with a view of AC units and the carpet was stained, 2 outlets were broken and the bathroom was tiny! I called Viking to inform them, they got on the phone with the hotel and were told they had no rooms to change us! Later that evening I went to desk to inform them that 2 outlets were not working… a lady came to the same desk and stated she had requested 2 twins but was given a king! I couldn’t believe it! The same woman that told me there were no rooms, told this woman right away she could change the rooms! Our room was horrible! Viking River cruise offers a pre & post extension at this hotel and there must be over 30 customers at the moment and most got a queen/king beds and some with a balcony and Eiffel Tower view! We all paid the same amount of money for the extension! I’m upset, this hotel took advantage of us and Viking! 
The next day I asked for a bucket of ice, they said it costs 5 Euros! I refused and then was informed they had an ice machine on odd floors. I asked for a bucket and again they said that would cost money! I went to ice machine and they had large cups available! 
When we checked in there was no information given to us about WiFi and how to use our card to operate elevator! When we return from our outings there is no friendly “hello”… this hotel is just awful on customer service! Very rude! 
The breakfast buffet was good. Would I recommend this hotel if it was not part of a tour? No! Too busy, and customer service sucks! By the way they never fixed the broken two outlets!

title: Perfect
text:
Stayed at Pullman for 3 nights.
The room was very modern, clean and spacious. The beds were large and comfy, and the pillows were amazing. Slept like a baby!

The bacony had an amazing view of the Eiffel tower, where my boyfriend proposed to me,  with the Eiffeltower in the backround. Super romantic, and absolutely perfect! 

If you have gluten allergy the breakfast  may not have very much to offer. I had cheese, fruits and yoghurt everyday- not too exiting but everything tasted very good. My boyfriend, who does not have any allergies enjoyed it very much!
Roomservice was very good, did not try the restaurant for dinners.

Location vise the hotel is far away from places such as: Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe , Musée du Louvre and Quartier latin. With 50+ minuts walking time. We did not mind as we like to walk alot.

All in all we loved our stay, and would be happy to return!

title: Amazing view of the Eiffel towel
text: This hotel is definitely underrated for the Eiffel Tower view! Other hotels charge double for the view, so I was skeptical about how the actual room would be but it was great! We were gone all day but at night watching the Eiffel towel from our balcony after dinner was perfect. Would definitely recommend!

title: Enjoyed Our Stay
text: Clean, great breakfast, easy walk to the tower and several gardens. Nice little grocery stores are close by too in case you need something. Our room faced their vegetable garden, and although we couldn't see the tower, it was nice and quiet. I'd stay there again.

title: Nice hotel, convenietly located
text: We really enjoyed staying at this hotel - two adults and one eight year-old boy. The room was bright, clean, and spacious and the rollout bed for my son was comfortable. The bathroom was very large for a hotel room, and there was a large closet, a mini fridge, and a safe. Rooms were quiet - we were on the 2nd floor on the end and never heard any noise from other rooms. The breakfast was terrific - a huge selection of fresh food and drink choices. Staff were all very friendly. There was always a taxi outside waiting when we needed to grab one. And the location was very convenient for anyone looking to hit up the typical tourist attractions. A short walk to the Eiffel Tower and many restaurants and a market, but also only a couple of blocks to the RER C train to Versailles or Musee d'Orsay, and the #6 Metro line to the Arc de Triomphe/Champs-Elysee. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Awesome
text: The hotel is wonderful, the view of the tower is beautiful, the hotel is in a great location and the breakfast is the best.  Highlight for the friendly and excellent receptionist Patrick, great service!

title: 10/10 Hotel!
text: We visited for my mum’s 50th birthday, and the Pullman made it such a memorable experience. The staff are so attentive and welcoming, and the room - what a view! Our room was amazing we could not fault it at all. Thank you especially, to Patrick, who went above and beyond to make it special for my mums birthday, he was amazing! Will definitely be visiting again and would recommend it to anyone visiting Paris!

title: Celebration trip - this is a must!!
text:
Visited Paris for a special celebration… The hotel added to that with surprise touches in my room and a view to die for… amazing sun sets and the best Eiffel Tower view ever….  Room was perfect, service was some of the best we have ever received .. will definitely be returning…. 
Amazing location for all sight seeing …

title: Too noisy and crowded
text:
Very crowded and noisy!! 

The hotel had a disco party 3 floors up, with the music blaring until 2 am. Even with ear plugs in, we could here the pounding noise. 

It is also too crowded - too crowded in the lobby, too crowded to enjoy the buffet breakfast, and they were so busy, that we had to wait for an hour after check-in time to get into our room when we arrived. 

The hotel is simply too crowded and too noisy - it is not welcoming at all and we will never stay again!

title: Great hotel great view
text: Since we only stay for one night, we’ve decided to splurge a little and stay at this amazing hotel with a great view from the balcony, Eiffel Tower. Room size is great, very comfortable bed, but really hard pillow. But overall it was great. We’ll be back for sure.

title: Great location, Helpful staff
text:
Five star level of welcome and service.
Excellent location with great value, close to everything.  The view of the Eiffel ToweL is fabolous. Ideal  for a romantic getaway. Very nice event inside the hôtel.. 
Well located, surrounded by restaurants, clean, air conditioning, plugs, nice, really recommend it, in a nice area near the Eiffel tower, in the heart of Paris

title: Wonderful stay
text:
I stayed 2 nights at the Pullman Paris Eiffel Tower hotel. The hotel has an premium location near the Eiffel Tower and the Seine river. The view is amazing.
I also enjoyed excellent service from the front desk, room services as well as at the restaurant. Decoration is refined and pleasant.

title: Terrible service
text: Stayed 6 nights in the penthouse suite. The phones and refrigerator were unserviceable. Took four days and four reminders to fix the refrigerator and one day to fix the phone. Even a simple request to set up the sofa bed took two hours. The nice view of the Eiffel Tower from the penthouse suite was the only positive experience worth mentioning. The hotel has zero interest in service recovery and this hotel should be avoided if you dislike bad service.

title: Great location and great staff
text: We stayed here as a group, for business. The hotel is close to the Eiffel Tower and other attractions. The lifts could do with a bit of maintenance, The staff were generally friendly and helpful, but one (Louise) deserves special mention - she looked after us two evenings in the restaurant and was charming, knowledgeable and all-round delightful!

title: Restuarant
text: Carla was Outstanding,  Carla was very Professional   Great Attitude,  Helpful understanding of my special request.  She is Asset to your company.   I was very satisfied  with all of her Help .this added to great day.

title: Outstanding 5*
text: My husband and I booked this hotel as a surprise for our daughters 18th birthday and it was absolutely outstanding. The view from our room was truly unbelievable, the hotel itself immaculate and the team made our daughter feel like royalty. I cant fault this hotel and would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for 5* service

title: Wow what a view of the Eiffel from our room!
text:
The room of our dreams was one we never expected to get!
We booked a 3 day extension after our Viking River cruise. They picked this hotel. We had no idea where it was or what kind of room we'd get. Imagine our surprise when we opened the door to our balcony room and saw the view of the Eiffel Tower! See how happy my wife is in the attached photo. 

The room itself was fine, a moderate size, comfy bed, nice large bathroom. One weird thing about the bathroom was the walk-in shower...half a glass wall and no door meant taking extra care not to flood the room. Not unique, as we saw the same setup in another hotel, too. Who thought this was a good idea? Not a deal breaker.

Hotel has an excellent buffet breakfast which was included in our deal with Viking. Not sure if everyone gets this for free or not. But even if you have to pay, go for it! Fresh pastries, made to order omelettes, fresh squeezed O-J, and French Toast, pancakes, cold cuts and more. Best yogurt I've ever eaten!  It's all you can eat to fill up for a day of sightseeing.

Viking has an excellent concierge in the lobby if you need post cruise help and recommendations for restaurants, etc. The hotel concierge was also helpful in getting us reservations for a dinner cruise on the Seine and getting us taxis around town.

Hotel location is excellent. Easy walk to the Eiffel Tower and several cafes.Hotel is set back some distance from the busy main drag which helps keep it quiet for sleeping. That said, Paris is one busy city! People are out and about at all hours here, almost like NY City.

Bottom line: Consider staying here for the view of a lifetime. It doesn't get more romantic than this!

title: Best service
text: 5 stars for Alberto.  His attitude and great customer service made the stay one hard to forget.  He went above and beyond to make sure we were happy and our needs were met.  Best location in town with the best view to the Eiffel Tower.

title: Kimberly Durbeej
text:
We stayed here for 6 days and it was absolutely amazing the entire time. It was in the center of all we wanted to do. Excellent! 

I wanted to give a major shoutout to Akil our bartender at FRAME. Every single drink he made us was so so so good. The presentation was absolutely phenomenal.  Thank you!

title: Thank you Alberto!
text: Alberto from the lobby was such a pleasure to meet!! He made a stressful process easier, and he felt like family by the time we left. He went above and beyond to meet our needs, and was a consistent presence of positivity and friendliness.

title: Three and a half ...
text:
This is a large, fairly modern hotel with some comfort but little or no character. It has 430 rooms, meaning there are over 800 guests when it’s full, as it pretty much was when we were there, due to the French Open tennis being on and many players and their teams (and fans) staying at the hotel. We stayed for four nights and have mixed feelings.
People rave about ‘the location’ and ‘the view’ – but really neither are that good or important. I booked a ‘superior’ room with tower view – you look at the view for maybe ten minutes a day but sleep for several hours, and anyway the view is just outside the main door. The location is good for the Eiffel Tower, but not much else.
Our room was comfortable and clean and quiet – these are important things – and the shower was very good. The room was not large and had very, very little space for putting clothes – if (as we were) you’re a couple on a longish trip with big cases, you’ll not find much space to hang or put clothes. In retrospect, I’d book a bigger room with no view, but then we weren’t on honeymoon or stuff.
Plus side: very good staff, from check-in to check-out and specially at breakfast. The variety at breakfast is good. Sleep quality good too.
Negative side: there are three lifts and often it’s not enough for a place this size. Breakfast was always a tad chaotic – so many people around – and on two mornings the cooked food simply wasn’t hot enough, you’d expect better. Staff were sometimes struggling to provide enough plates / bowls / cutlery. The restaurant (Frame) overcharges and underperforms – avoid.
My wife and I love Paris and we stayed here because it was (relatively) close to Roland Garros. As an Accor Diamond member, I wouldn’t stay here again (I had to ask for the welcome drink) mainly because places like Scribe offer so much more.
Stay here if you’re obsessed with the Eiffel Tower. Otherwise, look around a bit. There’s so much more to Paris than this.

title: Excellent stay
text:
I booked a deluxe Room with an Eiffel Tower view. Our room was on the 10th floor with a direct view of the tower. The room was small but not by Paris standards. The beds are comfortable. They changed the sheets every day, which is something you don't see often these days in hotels. The staff are all so friendly.  Jeff and Chloe were especially helpful and engaging. We happened to stay while they were hosting the Rolland Garros. While there were many athletes staying at the hotel, we were not treated any differently by the staff. Breakfast was excellent. They offer a huge variety of hot food, fruit, yogurt,  croissants,  juices, anything you want.
The Eiffel Tower is a 3 minute walk away. There are cafés just around the corner if you want something close, but they cater to the Eiffel Tower tourists, so the food is acceptable but priced as higher quality cuisine. There is a small patisserie around the corner in the opossite direction of the cafés.  It caters to the neighborhood locals. It was inviting and cheap and had many delicious treats, bread, coffee and pizza.
If you want a direct view of the Tower, as for a room on a higher floor. Rooms with balconies offer Tower views, but you have to go out onto the balcony to see the Tower, with the exception of what looked to be 4 rooms with direct balcony Tower views on the 11th floor.
You can not go wrong with a stay at the Pullman Eiffel Tower.

title: Great location and views!!
text:
We stayed at the Pullman as part of a Collette tour of London and Paris. We spent 4 nights at the Pullman. We were overjoyed at our view of the Eiffel Tower from our room. The room was much smaller than our room in London but it had everything we needed. They have wonderful bath products. Full size shampoo, body wash, conditioner and hand soap. Oh! And body lotion. Smelled so good. 
The breakfast buffet was good. Many options. Coffee was delicious and there was a pot in the room with tea also. 
The hotel is in an amazing location. Steps from the Eiffel tower. There are many cafes and restaurants near by. They all have the same menus. A little more for tourists. But still good, not great. I would recommend venturing out and seeking better options. But for people who do not want to leave the area there are plenty of options at your feet. 
There is a look out level on floor 10 that has amazing views of the Eiffel Tower so make sure you go explore and find it. 
I would definitely recommend the Pullman.

title: Only good for the view.
text:
Very poor. Not worth the price. Sadly - Not even worth the view. Firstly the staff - I expect far more from a supposedly upmarket hotel, but they seemed disinterested, disingenuous and bored. Arrived too early for check in but wanted to find parking and leave our bags. The manager was greeting people and showing them to a receptionist for check in. The manager looked us up and down and decided we did not look important enough and assisted the guests next to us - ok trying to think the best it could be an honest mistake, we waiting again. Next a bunch of pilots walked in about 15 minutes after us and were immediately seen too and taken to a desk. Now I am pissed off - when no one but us were left waiting the manager then greeted us as if ‘oh I didn’t see you there..’. We tried to do the paper work as much as we could and asked for the wash rooms. We booked dinner for that evening and asked where we were dining and were told upstairs. Much later we were back to check in and people queued to be seen by a receptionist no manager in sight which was better so we were not discriminated against. They said they have no record of us booking dinner - so booked it again but this time the guy said we had booked down stairs. After taking our bags and checking in, the first glance the room was lovely, large and had a Superb view, we went back to explore the city. Coming back in we asked the manager to clarify where we are dining this evening and he showed us to the restaurant and again had no record of our reservation so we booked in for the 3rd time with a blond lady in a boob tube. (Very classy for a 4 star hotel, of course!) We came back just 2 hours later after changing and spoke to the SAME navel displaying women who said we did not have a reservation!! My husband tried to say we booked with you 2 hours ago and she dismissed him,Obviously getting frustrated we explained this is now the 4th time of trying to book dinner when she held her hands up and said ‘fine we will seat you but there definitely was no booking!’. So disappointed to be treated like this we quietly took our seats still trying to make the best of the situation. Menu was different - expected French food you know being in the capital of France and all but got a weird mix and mostly seafood. The bread was stale as could be and the courses mediocre at best. Ordered a cocktail and large beer from the bar and the first cocktail was delicious (the best part of the meal) the second cocktail came in a glass with a fresh crack and chip at the top - I pointed this out to the waiter and they apologised and poured my cocktail into another glass! Normally if was water or wine or something you could see through this would not have bothered me in The slightest - however being a thick pineapple based cocktail there was no way to see if the glass chip was in my drink or not. Seriously fed up with this hotel now we left went to a bar down the street. Came back to sleep and because of the not great experience in the restaurant decided to eat in the room at an additional cost but enjoying the best bit about the hotel - the view. Again breakfast was just ok - bread, croissants and pastries again not appearing to be the freshest. Why?! You are in Paris for fluffs sake! 
The view is fantastic, but not worth the faults with this hotel or the staff. The room would have been fantastic if it was cleaner - stains on the shower, the floor and the back splash behind the sink and door were really off putting! 
The Pullman paris was our first stop while travelling through France it was the most expensive, and by far the WORST hotel we stayed at during our travels.

title: Amazing hotel, perfect location, incredible staff!
text:
My wife and I stayed here five days and we were very impressed with this hotel, its location and staff. I booked a room looking out towards the Eiffel tower and it was amazing. The room was large, well appointed and the bed was comfortable. We could lay in bed and watch the tower sparkle at night! The bathroom was very nice with a ceiling rain shower and full amenities, bathrobes and slippers. 

The location was perfect and you could walk to the Eiffel tower within five minutes. We used the hotel as our base of operations and took in many of the sights, sounds, and restaurants around the city. It's location was perfect for us, and one night after dinner we walked home from the Latin Quarter along the Seine. 

I travel quite a bit in Europe with my band and I have to admit this is probably the best breakfast buffet I've encountered, a large variety of really good food, and once again really helpful and attentive staff working in the breakfast room. Check out my photos. We did not get a chance to eat at the restaurant other than breakfast, but the food and menu looked delicious, and we did have drinks at the bar.

However the most important part of the hotel for me was the friendliness, welcoming and helpful staff. When we showed up to the hotel we were greeted by front desk staff Othmane and Hictor, they checked us in promptly and answered all our questions making us feel instantly a home. My French is not very good and it was nice that they spoke fluent English. We stayed for several days and had many questions and Jeff Board who had lived in California was very helpful throughout our visit. They were all so thoughtful and helpful that we felt like family. When checking out Alberto was very gracious, hoping we would return for a visit. For me this is what made our stay so rewarding, and we look forward to visiting again soon. Not only did we have a wonderful time visiting Paris in the spring, but I felt like I made friends here. To everyone that we encountered or helped us at the Pullman Paris Eiffel thank you for making our trip a fantastic success! Merci beaucoup!!! Vous êstes tous rock!

title: Excellent value for money
text: I stay generally at Molitor and wanted a changem the room was very spacious and the staff super friendly - this was big highlight! Needless to say location is perfect for sightseeing but also dining out. Highly recommended.

title: Beautiful romantic getaway
text: Wonderful service, super helpful and friendly! Great accommodations, it’s a small thing, but hotel hairdryers are usually so useless and theirs was really powerful! Breakfast was amazing and last but not least, that Eiffel Tower view was incredible.

title: Best hotel in Paris
text: I stayed at this hotel for 4 nights  and I must say, my partner and I had an amazing time. We had the best view from our room of the Eiffel tower. We ordered champagne from room service and just sat on the balcony listening to the sounds of the streets and watching the tower glow every hour. The room was big enough for the two of us and OmG that bed was like a pillow from heaven😁 No lie. Service was great. Housekeeping came to make up our room everyday even though we are not early birds and got up pretty late. The bar downstairs was good but I have to say the rooftop bar took the cake. Calm. Comfortable environment. Elegant. Good snacks and lovely drinks. We will be returning. We are looking to go back at the end of July. That’s how much we enjoyed everything about the Pullman. Thank you for such an experience. I definitely give 5 stars. I would give 10 if i could.  If u do get a chance to experience this hotel, go big and get the balcony room. YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT.

title: Brilliant location and fantastic service.
text:
A fantastic hotel, with very comfortable beds, very clean room, the breakfast was very good and well laden with options, the bacon was excellent I might add. The location with its view of the Eiffel tower was brilliant.
But the best thing about the Pullman, is the professionalism and highly qualified staff who were very helpful and exceptionally efficient. I will definitely be back at this hotel.

title: Poor Experience - Would not recommend hotel
text: We booked this hotel to cap off a 10 day trip to France. We were excited for the hotel based on the amazing reviews. Our experience was that of a 2 star hotel. The room reeked of cigarettes. It was heavily perfumed to try to cover up the smell, but after a few hours, the perfume faded and the room smelled absolutely horrible. We had trouble turning the lights on in our room, and so the manager followed us to the hotel. I asked the manager about the smell, and he insisted that there was no smoking allowed so it couldn’t possibly smell like cigarettes. It was very hard for me to feel comfortable and relaxed. The room and amenities are also lot what you would expect in a 4 star hotel. Our room was more like a remodeled Best Western. Like others have said, we booked a deluxe king room with an Eiffel Tower view. We were put on the third floor and could only see the Eiffel Tower if we leaned over our balcony and looked to the right. The hotel was also insanely crowded. We had to wait over 15 minutes multiple times for an elevator. Overall, this was by far the worst hotel of our trip (worst in Europe that I’ve stayed at), and I do not recommend this hotel to others, especially for the price.

title: Stunning view
text:
Firstly, i choose this hotel because of THE VIEW!
Choosing the room type Deluxe Room with a balcony facing the Eiffel tower is never go wrong. This is priceless!
Yes, it's a bit pricey than Classic Room but it's worthy enough.
The room was spacious, the bed was comfortable, everything is great!

title: Brilliant Location
text:
Check in took little longer than we expected - so we got to explore around the area whilst we waited.
The front desk team were helpful and friendly.
The hotel is situated in the best location -  we booked a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower - the views did not dissapoint - highly recommend the room with a view of the Eiffel Tower - it feels really magical seeing the Eiffel Tower when you wake up and before going to bed.
The rooms, were spacious and clean - great water pressure.
The breakfast buffet was lovely, great variety everyday - highlight was eating breakfast whilst looking at the Eiffel Tower.
The team working during breakfast were always helpful, always checked up on us and made sure we got everything we requested.
Please make a reservation for their bar / restaurant upstairs as everynight we were there it was fully booked.
We needed PCR tests before leaving France and the hotel has a dedicated nurse that assists with this - this was a huge relief as we did not have to look around to get the tests done.
The location is briliant - walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, beautiful neighbourhood, lovely cafes and because the hotel is so close to the Eiffel Tower, one can take a quick walk early in the morning, before it gets really busy.

title: Delightful stay!
text:
We visited during the Easter break and in short our stay was splendid! The hotel is greatly situated with the Eiffel tower being just a couple of minutes walk. Front rooms give you breathtaking views of the Eiffel Tower. Front desk staff was very polite and helpful. 

The room was very good and clean. We were given a balcony room at the back of the property, it was pretty spacious and fully equipped. While we did not get Eiffel tower views, we still got very nice views of Tour Montparnasse. It has to be said that the property is dated and it shows when go out in the balcony, but the interiors are very well maintained/renovated. 

Breakfast was very good, offering a wide selections of products, typically quite tasty and fresh. Breakfast is served at the restaurant/bar area. We did try the restaurant, it was quite good, even though we would have preferred a richer menu - choices were a bit limited. It is also a bit overpriced, but this should be expected given the hotel location. 

The only downside was the speed of room service, as the hotel was full. Still, we highly recommend the hotel and we will probably visit again.

title: Average Hotel - Avoid the Bar in the Main Floor
text: Front desk staff are very polite and helpful.  Rooms are clean comfortable but small.  Breakfast buffet is very good, lots of options and food is high quality.  Went to the bar in the first floor the first night of our stay.  Took at least 20 minutes to get waited on and another 20-30 minutes to get drinks brought to our table.  All while three bartenders were behind the bar and multiple waiters running around looking busy.  The second night was worse.  Maybe four other customers in the bar and over 40 minutes to place and order and another 30 to get drinks.  Went to the bar twice to check on our order and got blank stares from the staff.  Go out if the hotel  to get your drinks and avoid the aggravation.   It’s not worth it.

title: Great Hotel
text: Excellent staff.  Very accommodating.  The packed us a meal because we had to leave early for a tour before the breakfast buffet opened.  View of the Eifel Tower from the balcony.  Nice décor, very clean.  Great location.  Metro Station only 2 blocks away.  Good buffet breakfast.  Would definitely stay here again.

title: Astotel George
text: Very good located in the center of Paris. Cosy rooms, comfy beds and friendly staff. Plenty of beautyful cafes, bars and restaurantes around. Louvre, Seine, Eiffel Tower everything within 30-60 min walking distance.

title: Great Location
text:
Our reserved room with a fantastic view of the Eiffel Tower was the reason for our stay.
The elevators are extremely slow. 
We couldn’t order room service or communicate with front desk, was told that hotel was having issues with system.
Our pre paid champagne bottle was only delivered on our last day after a few requests to front desk.
We helped our selves with luggage.
Breakfast was very good. Bartenders were fantastic.

title: Amazing location, average hotel
text:
I’ve stayed here a few times on business and it’s totally fine when you aren’t paying and you just need a place to sleep. 

It’s literally under the Eiffel Tower so in terms of location, it’s hard to beat, especially if you get a room with a view of the tower - you have to pay a fair amount for the Eiffel view; you don’t get a better room, literally just the view. If you don’t pay the premium, the view is pretty crap, looking out at another building and an ugly courtyard.

When I reserved I asked specifically for a room that was not near the lifts as the first time I stayed I was by the lifts and it was noisy. That being said I was put in the room literally right next to the lift. I was told there were no other rooms and I should request to move the next morning. I was woken up 3 times in the night by sounds in the lift shaft right behind my head. That night I had also ordered room service and my food arrived cold - they did refund me so that’s fine but I did go to bed hungry. 

The next day when I asked to change it seemed to be such a chore, it was so busy and I effectively had to checkout, wait until there were available rooms and then checkin again…begrudgingly I did this and after a lot of faff and discussion I actually got a room quickly but it was an old room and I think a disabled access room. The shower was old and tired and the room basic and a a bit run down. It was quiet however so I kept it since I was only there that final night. 

I think this place is fine for business if you just need a place to sleep but I would not choose to stay here in my personal time. I don’t think the premium for the rooms with a view are worth it when you can walk outside and see the tower and be right under it in less than a minute. Food is average and so are the rooms but you really cannot beat the location. Staff are decent, I cannot fault them really.

title: DREAM COME TRUE

title: Eifel View, nothing else
text: Checked in today and immediately realised that the only reason one should stay in this Hotel is the Eifel  View ( if you book one of those rooms). The rooms are small, with an extra bed in the room there’s is no place to walk. Rooms are very very basic, very congested for a couple with 1 child (Think Ibis rooms). There won’t be much explanation of facilities, WI-FI  or breakfast areas at check in ,you are given the keys and that’s it and then you are on your own.  If you are looking for a vacation feel, for this price look elsewhere, unless you want to see the tower from the balcony everyday. Not recommended for families with children.

title: City break in Paris
text: Excellent hotel, great location for getting around as it is very close to the metro and also lots to do close by. Would definitely recommend booking a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower. Staff were very friendly and helpful going out of their way to make it an enjoyable stay.

title: Great location, perfect staff, really couldn't be better!
text: We were in Paris as a 3-day pre-trip to a Viking river cruise..... and I was a little leary of the photo that Viking offered showing this Hotel.  But it evidently has been renovated since the Viking photo - and was almost perfect!  Not too "American-ized", typical French.   Lobby manager, concierege, bellmen, etc could not have been nicer or more helpful.  Great, huge breakfast offered in the restaurant.  I could sit at a table at breakfast and see the Eiffel tower!    Only issue was that the heat was still ON, and could not be changed until the AC could be turned on!  It was very hot in the room.  They suggested we open our window!, which was fun ------ and a great help!  Now, in US we could have NEVER done that , I don't even think hotels have windows that open?, do they?  This 4th floor window was a life-saver!    Can't wait to go back to Paris and stay here again.

title: Pullman Tour Eiffel Hotel

Thanks to Alberto and the lovely staff, we had a fantastic stay and will definitely come back!

text:
The hotel is one of many in the immediate vicinity of Gare de Lyon but truly is unique in its offerings.  The rooms are expectedly small and typical of all CitizenM hotels but everything else is different. The lighting and blinds are seamlessly controlled by the ipad next to the bed making it a cinch to turn it in. The bathroom is small but perfectly designed. A pet peeve in almost all hotels is the near impossibility of figuring out which to turn on hot or cold and the overhead shower vs the hand shower with most of them resulting in your getting scalded or wet when you least expect it.  Not so here. A simple knob illustrated with a temperature range tells you which way to go while another knob is a mere up or down depending on which shower you want to use. Even luxury hotels generally don't get this right. 

The check-in is a piece of cake with no need for any staff, who are of course ready to assist. 

Lastly, the mattress was super comfortable, worthy of a 5-star deluxe hotel.

title: Inexpensive stay in Paris with some Perks
text: When we arrived at the Hotel Citizenm, we were met by Merci,  She was a bubbly person who tried hard to make us happy.  Unfortunately, the first room we were given was the size of a shoebox.  If you have any ounce of claustrophobia , these rooms are not for you.  We expressed our issue with the room size and they placed us in another room that was a tad bit bigger but the air conditioning was not working.  Due to the unprecedented heatwave, that would not work as you cannot open any windows in the hotel.  So they gave us a handicapped room which was much bigger that all the other rooms.  This was great, However the air conditioning still did not work well.  The breakfast was mediocre.  On the flip side, the location is excellent.  It is right next to the metro and some decent restaurants.  The staff tries every way to make you stay enjoyable.  There is always someone at the check in area.  The price was fantastic for the location in Paris .  Would I stay there again. NO, but there were some good things about the hotel.

title: Citizen M, a chic boutique-feeling hotel by the Seine
text: The rooms are compact but so stylish and comfortable (you can even customize the color of your shower, from the colors of a rainbow). The lobby is so chic and stylish (lots of books, different furniture and lots of unique decor items) but the STARS of the hotel are its staff -- young, smart, incredibly and unbelievably warm, friendly and spontaneous. Everybody was helpful and cheerful, but nobody less than 'Mercy', a super-incredible ambassador. The hotel is a 5-8 minute walk across a bridge over the Seine from the very central Austerlitz Metro (plus train and bus stations). A little long if you have lots of heavy luggage, but otherwise a rather easy commute. The hotel also offers a welcome drink at its level 16 lounge -- what an incredible view, especially with a setting sun over the Seine and Eiffel Tower. Overall, this is a smart, stylish, hip hotel (hard to tell from its block-like architecture and office surroundings) filled with kindly and helpful staff.

title: Convenient location, good price, and quality accomodation
text: At $156/night as a solo traveler, I couldn't find any place less expensive for a hotel of this level with the short lead time between booking and arriving. Arrived at Gare du Nord then took RER to Gare de Lyon and literally walked 10 minutes to the hotel (you don't even have to go outside, and if I knew my route better, it would be only 5 minutes). There are lots of connections, bus, metro and RER available from the area. Like all CitizenM I've stayed at, the staff is fun, happy, helpful and very competent. Also, like all CitizenM hotels the room are squeaky clean, cool, and include a fridge. I've never liked hotel chains, but CitizenM is different. Yes, they are clone copies in terms of the rooms, but the views, art, people tell you that you're in a new locale. My room had a view west of the Seine that included the Pantheon, Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame. Breakfasts are buffet and phenomenal but you can also order just a coffee and croissant at a price competitive or cheaper than what you'd get outside.

title: Hi-tech and comfortable!
text:
When they say compact, they really mean it. It's a good size for two average-sized people-- Any more than that, you'll probably need to get a second room (Protip: Parents, get one room per parent and split the kids between the rooms!).

My favorite thing about this hotel was the fact that the room was completely controlled through the room's iPad and everything was super easy to understand (yes, mine was in English).

The staff is INCREDIBLE and super kind-- Don't listen to what people say about French stereotypes, these folks are genuinely nice and go out of their way to help you out with whatever you need.

We stayed for 3 nights and had friends who stayed at various other locations for the same duration, and this was hands-down the best hotel anyone had ever visited. They have a cocktail bar open at night too for when you adults want to sneak away and grab a nightcap.

The location is right next to the Gare de Lyon station, meaning that if you want to go to Disneyland, you just take a quick 2-minute walk down to the station, purchase your tickets to the station next to Disney (yes, you can opt for an English menu), and hop on the train! It's so simple, I can't even explain the amount of stress I DIDN'T feel during this trip.

There are plenty of restaurants, bakeries, bars, and pharmacies nearby too for any and all of your needs. There's also a breakfast buffet option if you're looking for that, but as stated earlier, the number of bakeries surrounding this joint is *chefs kiss*, so you may not even need it. If you do decide to go to canteen area, you definitely can purchase items separately, so you never feel like you're missing out (thank God, because I don't know what I'd do without my morning double cappuccino, lol). Don't miss out on staying at this super hip hotel!

title: Mediocre at best
text:
So many opportunities to make this something better.
Check-in experience was impersonal and rushed, staff are clearly overworked. No one explained anything about the hotel to me, just a member of staff shouting to me where the lifts are located across a sea of people checking in. The check-in area is messy and doesn't give a good first impression of the hotel.

Rooms are ok. Room amenities are basic or aren't available. 
No coffee/tea/water in the room, no explanation as to how you can get a drink to your room. No toiletries, hand and body wash bottles were empty.
Ventilation in the room was unresponsive to me making changes on the ipad, room was overly warm.
They urgently need new pillows. If you like sleeping with a bag of rocks in a sack, this is the place for you! I don't want to sleep in a bed that feels like it's been slept in by a million people (even if it has). 

The whole experience is built around the use of the CitizenM app and the ipad in the room, sold as convenience, but it's a gimmick and makes the whole stay impersonal and cheap.

Location is ok - not the nicest part of Paris, but you can easily get around the city from here.

"Affordable luxury"....affordable yes, but I didn't find anything luxurious about the hotel or my stay.

title: The 17th is a great place to stay, away from tourist crowds
text:
Despite its small size, the room was comfortable and it was quiet (the window opened onto a rear courtyard).   The bed was excellent.  In-room coffee/tea service was much appreciated.  It was rather muggy outside, and the air conditioning was effective (and not toooo cold.)  The cleaning staff was helpful and cooperative.   

And we loved the location, in a middle-class residential zone with plenty of authentic small cafes and restaurants around.  (We are sooo over the tourist scene in European cities......we prized the authenticity here.)

title: Lovely hotel!
text: I found this hotel on trip advisor for an upcoming stay in Paris.  Very clean.  Great location in the 17th arrondissement, within walking distance to many of the main tourist attractions.  The surrounding neighborhood was very cute.  There was a lift to get bags to the room.  Comfy bed and pillows.  Very small, but to be expected for Paris.  Bathroom, again was small but functional and clean.  Front desk staff  were helpful in holding my bags until the room was ready, getting me the wifi password, and securing a taxi the next morning to get me to my next location.  If you don't mind the small space, I would highly recommend!

title: Paris

title: Great hotel.
text: I had a great stay in this hotel, it’s in a quieter part of Paris but still very convenient to get anywhere with metro or tram. The metro station is practically at your doorstep. The hotel faces a private road so it was very peaceful and quiet if you are a light sleeper. Service was excellent. Check in and out was efficient and warm. We arrived before check in time but room was given to us without even us asking. Rooms size is small but that’s normal Parisian size and it’s nicely decorated and have whatever you need. I would definitely come back on my next trip to Paris.

text: Old dark carpet black walls on very small rooms toilet in one small area then you walk to another shower area to wash your hand. No car access to hotel due to construction so you bring your luggage from 2 street over on the sidewalk.
