Nice , airconditioned , but rooms small , close to Metro lines , easy to get around , great restaurant right at the front door Champotes , the best meal we had in Paris , there 6 days . Wouold be back again for sure 
the hotel front staff very nice , spoke english and did help us alot

title: Excellent!
text: I had an amazing time. The staff was super friendly and helpful. And the hotel is right beside the metro which is very easy to get to. Lots of other shops and restaurants around the area, and isn’t far from the city of Paris. I had a lovely stay with good service and the rooms was always cleaned and the bed was always made when I got back.

title: Enjoyed our stay in Paris
text: The staff were very friendly, warm and welcoming. They spoke great English. We stayed in the second floor executive room. It was in a section of the hotel that requires walk up so you need to be able to carry your own suitcases up stsirs. It was super quiet with an incredibly comfortable bed. The room was well appointed and modern. No dresser or much space for hanging clothes but that was minor to us. The bathroom and shower were great. The hotel location was great - right across from a line 3 metro station. The area has lovely street life with restaurants and cafes. It was about a 20 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe. We would definitely stay again.

title: Great Stay!
text: We loved staying here! The rooms were fantastic, clean and the hotel was close to some great restaurants. The showers were unbelievable, which was great after long days throughout Paris. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Would happily stay again!
text: The room size was very small, a lot smaller than expected and than is shown in the pictures. It was tricky for the two of us to get ready together in that space and was a shock initially, but now that we know what to expect, we would happily stay there again. The staff are lovely, always friendly, available and ready to help. The hotel reception area is nice, everything including the room and bathroom was clean and tidy -the bathroom was small was great! It was well designed and the shower was good. The location was fantastic! Very close to several metro stations to take you all over Paris and a short walk from several cafes, restaurants, boulangeries and even a pharmacy just a stones throw away. This was great value for money and we would definitely stay here again!

title: Good comfortable hotel

title: Boutique Hotel in the heart of Paris
text: I stayed at the Hotel Armoni for business, but it is in a great location for pleasure as well.  It is a little boutique hotel tucked away in a pedestrianized side street.    The room was compact but well-appointed.    The hotel is located at the edge of the upscale neighborhoods of Neuilly and Levallois-Perret.    It is an easy 20 minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe (Metro station Charles De Gaulle - Etoille), although there are closer Metro stops if you are more familiar with the Metro.    There are plenty of excellent restaurants and cafes nearby.    The staff was incredibly helpful, including booking an early morning taxi to the airport.   Note that, as of June 2022, the road in front of the hotel was under construction, so expect taxis to struggle a bit to get close.

title: Hotel review

title: Ok but not special
text:
The family room was smaller that the normal one. The veranda was a small tube where from you could only see the walls of the buildings.

On the other hand everything worked as promised. Not special but everything was fine.

It was far from the center and took two changes with public transport to get to the airport.

title: Lovely little hotel in Paris
text:
Enjoyed our stay at Hotel Armoni, great location for the Congress centre which i was attending but also ideal for a bit of sight seeing too. Hotel staff very friendly and helpful.
Room a bit on the small side and not a lot of space to hang clothes etc but that is the only negative thing about it. Fabulous takeaway coffee/ pastry shop a minute from the hotel ideal when you dont have time for a sit down breakfast. All in all, great value for money.

title: Good location, great value for money!
text: Good location if you are arriving by car (car park on the périphérique nearby) or by public transport. Easy walk to the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Elysées. The hotel is off the main road so it's quiet. Rooms are small (but we expected that in this location) but nicely decorated and equipped with tea & coffee making facilities and free water. Breakfast buffet is simple but it does the job. Good value for money for a family taking 2 interconnected rooms.

title: Nice little place
text: Fine service,charming place,perfect for a stay,good to reach by metro,surrounding fine good restaurant close to the hotel,price exellent for Paris.Thank you for staying at this place and all the help you bring to your customers

title: Such a great neighbourhood just skip reception
text:
I really like hotel, but staff are really unfriendly. U need to get rid of them to enjoy your trip.

It's not 4 star!
I don't know how gave them 4star rank and how, but if it's a good 3star.

Positive:
Location, access , nice neighbourhood, good coffeeshops and restaurants around.
Hotel rooms are lovely and cosy. 

Negative:
Staff. Be prepare!
We wanted to have fun so tried to get rid of them otherwise be ready for the rudeness of night shift reception.

title: Everything was great
text: The hotel looks very new and modern. Very clean rooms. Room good size and very stylishly furnished. Super friendly and helpful staff. Good location and metro 2 minutes away. I would 100% recommend the hotel.

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text: Lovely little hotel, super clean and stylish. The rooms are a bit small but the beds and pillows are super comfortable. The location is lovely and quiet - just a short walk from the Arc de Triomphe and the underground station is about a 3 min walk from the hotel. I would definitely recommend and stay again next time I’m in Paris.

title: Comfortable, quiet, convenient, what’s not to like.
text: With the metro 50 meters from the door, you can easily travel in to visit all Paris has to offer, then escape  the hurly burly back to the quiet calm of the hotel. Rooms are compact and a little short on storage space but very comfortable with excellent power showers. The staff were very helpful and supportive when I sustained a medical emergency. I was very grateful for their reassuring intervention.

title: A nice hotel i Paris
text: The Hotel Armoni is a really nice hotel in the northwestern part of Paris (17th). The staff is very helpful and friendly and makes you feel welcome. The interior design of the hotel is really nice - modernistic with a touch of Art Deco - very cool. An the rooms are quiet - no street noise. All in all a very recommendable hotel!

title: Amazing Experience!
text: Hotel Armoni is a cozy, artistic warm place! Beautiful Earth colors with attention to the little details, make it a special case. Friendly staff, sweet-small rooms with great and comfortable beds. Very clean place in a great location near to Arc of Triumph.

title: Business Trip
text: Lovely hotel and walking distance to the centre for sightseeing after hours. slightly hidden on a side street the hotel was easy to locate and quiet. Friendly staff who were always willing to help. I would 100% use again if returning to Paris

title: Very good
text:
We came to a uncleaned room, but they apoligized and gave us a new room. They Got us a taxi and called us in the morning to make sure, we could get to the airport. 
Very Nice with 24/7 reception. The hotel is very quiet in the night and has a great location 80 meters from metro/bus, which leads straight to centrum

title: Its a nice Hotel and near the Center of Paris
text: Everything was very nice, just our room was smaller than i exaptet. But its fine. it was everything clean and the personal was nice :)  I'm sur i will visit paris and the Hotel again. i recommend u thia hotel !

title: very very good - recommended
text:
I can pretty much repeat what I wrote in November 2019, before the pandemic hit.

Have stayed there several times now. This time I stayed from mid-December to early January. It's a well-run place in the 17th arrond. The neighborhood has all kinds of nice restaurants (in fact, right next to the hotel is what must be one of the best fish places in Paris, Abydoise.)    

Every time I travelled as a solo traveller since I was there mostly for work. 

The rooms are very well designed and equipped (large safety box, large-screen tv with many many English-language programs including cnn and bbc but also German language programs, eurosport, etc.). The wifi is stable and reasonably fast. 

The brekkie is also good and reasonably priced (ten euro). I like to work over brekkie and a couple of double espresso and that works like a charm since wifi in the brekkie room is also stable. Stayed there often for a couple of hours working away.

Staff is consistently friendly and attentive. 

While located in the 17 arrond the hotel is easily reachable via metro. (Try to avoid taxis from Gare l'Est if you can.) . 

In sum, I recommend Armoni. With confidence.

title: Great hotel for a city trip to Paris
text: Clean and modern rooms. Great bed. Friendly staff. Directly at the Porte de Champerret Metro Station. Many nice restaurants in walking distance. My preferred place to stay when visiting Paris. I will be back.

title: Brilliant hotel deal for Paris
text: Small, clean, cosy and well connected hotel. Really kind receptionist. Small but well structured room with all needed facilities. Transport was really easy to find (bus, metro, and taxis). Would definitely recommend it for young couples.

title: Business trip: great location
text:
Room is very clean, modern look. Good bed, good pillows, curtains keep light out. No traffic noise.
Bathroom is small. Little place to put your utilities.
Good breakfast, lots of choice for a French hotel.

title: Amazing
text:
Sabine was amazing ! most of all of the hotel personnel was great - but she went out of her way to help us and I’m so thankful ! 
If I ever went back to Paris I would stay there again ! It was close to everything !

title: A great experience.
text: I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone staying in Paris. The staff were so friendly and helpful. Rooms were so clean and were serviced every day.The metro station and bus stops are right beside the hotel. Very central indeed.  I will certainly be back in The Hotel Armôni.

title: Armoni Hotel Staying
text:
The hotel was amazing, the location is excellent and close to the centre. There are many restaurants next to the hotel.
The room was clean  and comfortable and the stuff is helpful.
I would recommend it for other couples as well.

title: Beautiful property - great service
text: I really enjoyed my stay at Hotel Armoni. It’s in a great, quiet location. And it’s near the metro. The rooms are clean and modern and smell wonderful. I’d definitely stay here again. The room was very nice size given that European rooms are on the smaller size. I was traveling solo so it was perfect. Bathroom was lovely and I enjoyed the L’Occitane amenities. The only thing missing is a kettle for hot water/tea/coffee. This is something that is really needed. Otherwise, a great stay!

title: Great Hotel
text: Great little hotel - really stylish and clean, in a handy location just opposite a metro station. The rooms are a small but not cramped and they are clean and comfortable. The staff were friendly and helpful, with good English. The Arc d'Triomphe is a lovely 20 mins stroll away. Will absolutely be back and would definitely recommend this hotel!

title: Always Good!
text: Every time i travel to Paris i choose Hotel Armoni. Perfect for a business trip or a weekend to visit the city. Very good rooms, always clean and very comfortable. Near metro and some restaurants. I will return for sure.

title: Not bad at all
text: We didn't speak French, so at times trying to understand what they are saying. They were helpful though. At times the heavy set female was getting smart because we didn't understand. The rooms are small. But if it's for tourism and just a place to sleep it will work.

title: Five stars
text: Stayed there a couple of times now and have to say am pleased. Every time I travelled as a solo traveller I had a large bed. The beds are comfy. The rooms are very well designed and equipped (large safety box, large-screen tv with many many English-language programs including cnn and bbc but also German language programs). The wifi is stable and reasonably fast. And people are friendly and attentive. While located in the 17 arrond the hotel is easily reachable  via metro. (Try to avoid taxis from Gare l'Est if you can.)  There is some excellent food places in the neighborhood such as Italian restaurant La Rosa and the l'Atelier Gourmand bakeshop on Rue Guilaume Tell. Plus the Maroccan place around the corner and the place next door look quite inviting. In sum, recommended.

title: Good location for my Business trip, too expensive
text: I was willing to pay a high price just because it happened to be close to my location of work. The premises are extremely clean and in order but due to the restricted space and lack of balcony (ground floor) i would not pay the same price again.

title: My stay in Hotel Armoni
text: Very small room. No balcony no air condition no source of air except in the bathroom good location good room service friendly staff . Satisfactory bathroom. We should be informed that there is no balcony and no air-conditioning

title: Great service. Poor lighting.
text: The hotel is across from a major metro and bus station which makes it easily accessible. The personnel is friendly and helpful. My only issue with the hotel is the lighting. The hallway is dark, the lights in the bathroom stay low. I felt uncomfortable with the lights.

title: Quaint boutique hotel in the 17th.
text:
Ultra modern rooms and amenities. Quiet rooms but without elavators for a 3 RD floor walk up.
If you don’t have heavy luggage, it’s really quite decent.
Perhaps a kettle could have been included in the room, but then again you’re in Paris.

title: Great location and facilities
text: Clean, excellent breakfast, friendly staff. Room was spacious, very clean, there is a metro and bus station 1-min walk away so you can discover all Paris easily from the hotel. and also there are restaurants, pharmacy and shops nearby

title: Nice surprise stay
text: We were surprised with this trip and had overall a fantastic time. This hotel added to the magic of it as well. They added a nice special touch in our room for our first trip to Paris. The bed was comfortable, the staff was fantastic, and the location was great!

title: Val from Sydney
text: Great location - close to metro, shops, supermarkets, cafes and restaurants.  I was in Paris for a conference at the Congress Centre and it was only a 10 minutes walk each way.  Staff were extremely helpful, especially with my lack of French! Only negative was no ability to make tea or coffee in the room.

title: Perfect location at a very good price
text:
The location is perfect, very near to two Metro stops (and the other is also an RER-C stop), restaurants are right outside and there is a Carrefour about two blocks away.
But once you're inside your room, you wouldn't be aware already that the hustle and bustle is just a few steps away - it is that quiet!
Sabine was very helpful in booking my ticket for Versailles and getting information for my daughter (who can go to Versailles for free). That is service beyond compare!
The room is relatively small, but if it's only for sleeping, it serves its purpose well.
A couple of negative observations:
1. We got a room with a bath - to soak in after roaming around Paris the whole day. We booked a double occupancy room. But we were given only a single bath salt on our first day, none on the second, and one on the third :-(
2. While there is a minibar including a mini fridge, there are no coffee-making facilities. There is an "honesty bar" and the hotel serves breakfast, but I do want to enjoy a cup of coffee upon waking up and before dressing up for the day...

title: Nice hotel
text: We stayed in the family room for two nights. The rooms and the bathrooms were clean! The lady that was working when we checked in was very nice, friendly and accommodating! Glad she was there when we checked in! The hotel is super close to the Metro and worked well for us. If you’re looking for a clean affordable hotel close to the Metro, this is the place!

title: Hotel Armoni
text: Excellent hotel just out of the city centre but right next to a metro station or a pleasant 10 minute walk if you prefer. The hotel is modern and well maintained. It is very clean and the staff are excellent, in particular the lady on reception was most helpful and informative. There is no hot breakfast but the meats, cheeses, yoghurt, cereals, croissants, bread etc were enough and perfectly acceptable. I would stay here again no problem.

title: Hotel Armon
text:
its a very good place i would recommend this place to any one who wants to visit Paris, they have got the best services in every thing 

Its a clean place, well decorated the food is excellent, the staff are welcoming and have got good communication skills

title: Good location, nice hotel, reasonable price
text:
The hotel is nice and clean and in a great location with a metro station right next to it. The rooms are small but that's expected in metropolitan Paris. Staff were friendly, especially the India guy whose name I can't recall. The price was great. 

Now the negatives.

1. The breakfast spread has no hot items. For 10 EUR pp this is a bare minimum expectation.
2. We once Requested dinner plates and cutlery from Reception for a takeaway service we ordered. While I understand that its no obligation of the hotel when we are not dining at their restaurant, these are the small things that make the experience sweeter. In this case the receptionist pretty curtly said, she can only give us 2 plates and not 4. Strange! These plates never arrived BTW. Next day we spoke to the Indian guy about it and he apologised profusely and promptly corrected this error.
3. Paris was sweltering when we visited. The AC in the room was not adequate.

I would recommend this hotel for great location, good atmosphere and value for money.

title: Nice hotel
text:
Great value for money, comfortable stay and helpful staff. Very clean, would stay again. 
Rooms - I have read a lot of people say the rooms are small but we stayed in the double and the size was ok for two people.

title: Great Place
text: Good location (literally 20 steps from metro) Clean, Cosy and cool (air con) Daily room clean and great facilities for the money...especially in VERY expensive Paris. I spelt really well as no noise from road or other guests

title: Pleasant stay - good service
text: Well located hotel for us. Clean and well presented room (if a little on the small side for 2 people) with aircon. Nice toiletries in the bathroom. Lift to floors. We had room only. Concierge staff very attentive. We asked for a corkscrew and the concierge provided wine glasses and serviettes too which was a nice addition. We asked for an ironing board and iron which they shared... my only negative point is that the ironing board could do with a thicker cover on it as they frame was marking my clothes.

title: Great Hotel
text:
From the start of the booking experience, the level of response from the hotel management has been second to none! I have never experienced this before. They were so keen on making sure you had your requirements met as closely as possible. Although the rooms are small, they are incredibly well fitted out. Although this is rated as a 3 star. I have stayed in 5 star hotels nowhere near as good as this one. 
The reception staff were extremely helpful in helping with queries with regards to travel queries and very cheerful and polite in spite of the long hours they no doubt work. I would definitely recommend this hotel! The location too is perfect. Close to food outlets and to the Metro and is a very pleasant and friendly area. Thank you Hotel Armoni!

title: Good value for money...
text:
Quick weekend trip to Paris and I needed a hotel in this area...this place had good reviews on TA so tried it. Not disappointed at all...right next to Metro, walking distance to some major attractions, good-sized room which was clean and comfortable.
Staff were friendly throughout, with manager Sabine contacting me a few days before to introduce herself and offer recommendations etc.
I travel to Paris frequently, and have stayed in 2* through 5* hotels...this is one of the better ones in terms of value and overall experience.

title: Flies in the room
text: Central location, but the place is full of flies, sheets were not changed, bed was fixed but that's it, toilet not cleaned, the place looks nice but they need to clean it, you're close to the subway and bus station and good restaurants. If you like to room with flies stay here. I'll never stay there again.

title: Hot stuff
text:
With the soaring temperatures this week it was great to be able to return to our beautifully furnished room where we could also easily control the Aircon.

Very comfortable and clean room and the staff were lovely too.

title: Loved our stay
text: This Hotel was perfect for our stay in Paris. All the staff were lovely and very helpful, the location was perfect and the rooms were comfortable and nice and clean. We would definitely recommend this hotel for anyone thinking about visiting Paris

title: New and nice hotel
text:
Rooms are clean and nicely decorated. Althought, small ....
Shower is great. Wifi is good. 
So - price for quality is high!

No lobby; however, great service. 
Location is very convienint for many purposes.

title: Elegant and classy
text:
Elegant and classy small hotel. Very clean, friendly staff. Especially Xavier and Sidney. Comfy bed and quiet room.
No coffee or kettle in the room- the only downside. Otherwise very happy with my stay here.

title: Great boutique hotel.
text:
Very happy with the my weekend stay at this hotel. I arrived a few hours before my check in as I booked an early train by mistake.  The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming and offered us a room straightaway, 
The rooms are very small but kept clean and are very modern looking, Opposite the hotel is the metro and bus station, where we jumped on the 92 bus taking us to 'Champs-Elysees' in ten minutes. Overall a very pleasant stay.

title: Boutique hotel
text:
Stayed for a business trip. It's no frills but clean and well kept. 

There was an issue with the TV which I couldn't turn off but it was sorted by a member of staff within 1 hour. 

The room smelled a little damp but this was due to the fact that the shower was a sliding door rather than a standalone unit. 

They take 100 Euro deposit on arrival and it is returned within 3 days. Best to bring cash unless you want it added to your card.

title: City double room
text:
The room was clean and bedding & linen was changed every day
The shower towels are small and not the best quality (thin)
The rooms are very small no room to put your suit case except on the floor
Air conditioning was turned off when outside temperature was low but room was still hot had to open windows but could hear traffic 
Slept with now covers

title: Spotless hotel
text: Stayed for 3 nights with family . First class service received from staff. Hotel was spotlessly clean and towels changed daily. Room quite small but we didn’t spend much time in it due to fabulous city.

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice place, very clean, very close to metro station & arc de Triomphe. I would book here again. We stayed 4 nights & found the room size adequate. Didn’t try the hotel breakfast, many other options nearby. Shower was especially good.

title: PERFECT
text: Perfect location for Beauvais Airport just 10 minutes walk from the bus stop (Porte Maillot) In our opinion good anyway, not far from the center, easily connected by bus or metro. Clean and very nice room. For sure we will be back soon, thank you!

title: Great stay
text:
Stayed here for the Paris Marathon weekend, easy walk to Champs Elysee 
Modern hotel, lovely welcoming staff, breakfast looked good- did not eat here. 
Room dark and bathroom small but lovely, modern and comfortable, great shower and lovely toiletries 
Restaurants very close by, Metro across the road 
Would highly recommend and would stay here again

title: small boutique hotel in the city
text:
Armoni Hotel is a very cleanclean boutique hotel in the city, perfect for couples or business travelers. Good service, simple procedures, nice art.
Its not cheap but due to triple glazed windows it is exceptionally quiet.

title: Perfect Stay
text: The rooms are pretty and very clean, they are well equipped. The staff was courteous. Located in a dead end street, the street noise is not disturbing in the night. In the morning a good breakfast buffet is offered.

title: Amazingly unexpected
text:
The hotel is perfectly located, close to transport and to some of the most important places in Paris. The room size is enough for sleeping and it is well equipped (technology). Bed was really comfy and the soap and shampoo for showers was high quality too.

If you are using Ryanair for traveling is perfect because it is close to the shuttle bus. 

Is more than great for the price you pay

title: Unexpected gem in Paris
text:
I booked the hotel for a 3 night stay whilst attending a congress in Villepinte. I was impressed by the Tripadvisor comments and was more than satisfied when I arrived and found that the hotel was in a small "no through road" ( cul de sac ). The bedroom was very well appointed as was the bathroom and we could not hear any traffic noise.
The breakfast was more than adequate and the hotel gave the appearance of having been refurbished recently. There are plenty of good restaurants nearby.
The staff were helpful and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. I would recommend this hotel.

title: Great Location and Lovely Hotel.
text: My boyfriend chose this hotel as a birthday present. We went to Paris and stayed for 4 days (3 nights). Prior to the holiday we contacted the hotel to enquire about transport and other different bits of information, they responded quickly and were more than happy to help, providing us with plenty of information to help us. The hotel looks lovely and the rooms are small but perfect. The hotel is located nearby a metro station so it is very easy to get around the city. All staff were pleasant and happy to help with any queries. Also purchased DisneyLand tickets through the hotel. Couldnt recommend the hotel more.

title: Aida Romania
text:
Beautiful hotel, in a very nice area, near to metro and other public transportation.
Very near you can find nice and good restaurants.
Very clean, the staff is very polite and helpful.
Really enjoyed my stay there.
100% recommended.

title: Very good hotel
text: Nice and clean room. The staff is friendly and discreet.  Lovely breakfast, we Will komt again. Good location in paris, close to the metro,tram,bus. Many restaurants in the Areas. Not to far from tour Eiffel, Arc de triomphe.

title: High interior design at excellent price
text:
great quality breakfast, very nice nterior design, excellent staff, good location, good price 
Excellent location for business trip and romantic escapes. 
Rooms are not very big but they have all that is needed. 
Bathrooms are of excellent quality and clean like the rest of the room

title: Luxury in the heart of the city
text: We were very impressed with the intercontinental La grande. The location is excellent being right beside the opera. Walking distance to pretty much everything in the city. If you have the opportunity you should splurge for the club floor benefits. Champagne in the afternoon and a great breakfast in the morning. The rooms are quite large and the bed linen is to die for. Great amenities all around. Concierge service is also well represented. We had dinner at Café de La Paix one night and were impressed with the decor. Overall for a luxury hotel in Paris, the price is quite reasonable and I can highly recommend it.
description: The InterContinental Paris Le Grand, opened during the reign of Napoleon III, is located in the very heart of the city: across the street from the Opéra Garnier, close to some of the best-known Parisian attractions, world-famous department stores and the wonderful Place Vendôme. The hotel contains 470 rooms, all richly decorated in the colours of the Opéra, and a warmly illuminated haven of peace and serenity in the bustle of Parisian life: la Verrière.

title: Beautiful
text:
Visited for my birthday and everything was just beautiful, the staff on reception were friendly and welcoming, our room had a stylish charm to it and had everything we needed.
This hotel is right beside the Opera house and the Roissy bus to and from the airport (CDG) stops 2 minutes from the hotel, very convenient. 
Breakfast was excellent and we had a lovely dinner in the restaurant one evening and a more informal meal in the bar another day. Everything was very good.

Everywhere in Paris is easily accessible from this location. We did a city sightseeing tour, visited the Louvre, Montmartre and went to a Paris SG football, all very enjoyable.

One small negative was one day I sat for maybe 30 minutes in a  quiet area in the back of the lobby and a security guard passed me a number of times and then rudely demanded by room number and I think I was only left alone because I answered him quickly. I was appropriately dressed, sitting quietly and this seemed over the top. 

Overall everything was lovely and we would be delighted to return some time.

title: Great old fashioned quality service
text: All I can say is we found good old fashioned five star service in this hotel. This is service that we haven’t been seeing in top rated hotels around the world. It is great that the inter continental Le Grand preserves this level of quality in everything, staff hospitality, room cleanliness, assistance, food service, etc. Their level of quality is un- matched.

title: Best location and platform to visit Paris
text: Our family of 4 plus a friend enjoyed the great location of hotel very much. Service was excellent, except at the start it was challenging to get few minor things sorted out (bath towels were missing from one room). Breakfast was perfect and we also enjoyed dinner in the hotel brasserie (menu and service were very good).

title: Beautiful, but not sure I would return.
text:
To start, I am an Intercontinental Ambassador and a Diamond member with IHG. I have been a loyal chap for a decade. I was very excited to spend my annual one weekend-night free certificate here. Mind you, the first night was well over $800 but included lounge access.

I entered, but honestly the doormen, there seemed to be several were a little stark. One smiled and said bonjour, the others stood there with not even an attempt to smile. Well anyway, at check-in I was delighted that my room was ready early. Leo was very kind and welcoming. However, no mention of the lounge when given my key. I inquired about access etc, and Leo told me lounge access was not included in my room. Luckily I had saved my confirmation and showed it to him, he then had to ask someone else about it. I really felt as if they were doing me a favor by allowing me entrance to the lounge that I had paid for. I am not sure what Ambassador-Diamond benefits I received, I wasn't asked if I wanted points, a drink, etc. and I am not sure that I received a room upgrade. I am assuming so because my room was great with a view of the Eiffel Tower from not one but two small balconies. 

The lounge is great, there are a lot of snacks and beverages available, the setting is lovely, and it is a quiet and lovely place to sit and relax. 

The hotel is beautiful and in a perfect location, but I just felt out of place for some reason, almost like an intruder, and did not quite belong.

title: Excellent experience
text:
The location of the hotel is nice. It’s very close to louvre museum and Opera House. It’s a beautiful grand hotel. The hospitality of the staff is unmatched. The staff is very friendly. 
The breakfast buffet has a large spread. 
The local transportation is easy to get that includes taxis, metro or buses. Our stay was very nice.

title: Five stars in the heart of Paris
text:
We loved our stay the Intercontinental Paris Le Grand.  From our wonderful check in with Kareem (an absolute pro - I hope Intercontinental knows what an asset he is) to our room and club access, we loved our stay.  The hotel is beautiful  and made more lovely by its rich history.  

Our room was a fine size for two people and the walk in closet really helped keep luggage out of the way.  The club is gorgeous. The breakfast is not over the top but fresh and very adequate.  Giles, Henry and Axel in the club were very helpful and attentive.  

The location is also excellent.  I would not hesitate to stay or recommend this hotel to anyone going to Paris.

title: Nice Room , Good Location that's about it. Book Ibis instead.
text:
It was a few weeks ago now since I visited the hotel. The hotel is still unfortunately etched in my memory. We’ll start with the good points, it’s a clean hotel, great location, and the room was nice. 

Now for the not so good side. 

We’ll start on arrival and check in, the room wasn’t ready although it was past check-in time. Still, I decided to wait about a bit as surely it doesn’t take that long to clean a room! An hour past and my patience was starting to wear thin. I went back up to the check-in desk and was greeted with total nonchalance. I was informed my room would be ready in another hour, maybe an hour and a half. At that point, it was no more mr nice guy, he rarely comes out as it is. Put me in France, and give me this attitude at a supposed 5 star hotel where I’m paying top summer, inflation, rip-off prices. Think again. The GM was summoned. Told him that we were already 1.5 hrs past the stated check-in time and he was about to see me get a whole lot worse. 

I advised that one would expect, at the minimum, an apology perhaps for not having the room ready, an offer of perhaps a tea or coffee, or glass of champagne whilst we waited. Nothing. Absolutely nothing, at which point he asked if I wanted a drink. My response. No! I may have wanted a drink 1.5 hrs ago, but now I’d like my bloody room! He ran off to personally check the room was up-to standard and came back down to inform me it was. Now why I was supposed to wait around another maybe  1.5 hours for this I’ll never know. When we got to the room it was very pleasant. 

The concierge on the desk were useless throughout our trip, even before our trip when we asked them to book some restaurants for us. Their excuse. They forgot – and now the restaurant is fully booked. So you can’t go. They recommended another place, it was terrible. See my review for Chez Monsieur. 

After one particularly hot day, we got back to the hotel mid-late afternoon and wanted a cold drink at the bar. Approached the bar and was told we’re shut. We’ll open at six, maybe seven pm. What? A five star hotel in the middle of Paris in the middle of summer and your bar is closed at 4pm on Wednesday afternoon??? Explain that one to me again! Obviously no staff around to get a drink so left. Final straw placed on said camels back. 

On the whole, go spend your money somewhere else. This hotel, whilst pleasant offers the service of an Ibis, and you can pick that up a hell of a lot cheaper than this place!

Upon arrival we were welcomed by the friendly professional cortege and reception staff who fully explained the hotel layout how to access our room, when and where breakfast was being served.

We had been upgraded needless to  say the  large bright room was amazing! all that you would need. It was spotless  throughout with more than ample supply of teas coffees and hot chocolate and lovely comfy bed .  Great nights sleep with no noise or banging doors with well insulated windows and doors made for perfect rest.                                                                 
   
 Having multi size  compatible  phone charger integrated in the electric clock was a really clever idea  if we had already known this we would not have needed to purchase two international adapters.

The bathroom was a great size ,plenty of towels and toiletries with both shower and  a bath with slippers and robes provided .

Well feed ready for a days sight seeing in Paris there is a beautiful perfume shop just down from the hotel which has a perfume museum worth a visit. Upon returning in the evening the room daily cleaned and refreshments restocked and fresh towels etc. .

We ate twice in the hotel restaurants  food excellent and very reasonably priced, 
 service fantastic, so attentive and courteous and before dinner selection of nuts olives and warm rolls lovely touch, a big thanks to Sebastian our waiter,the desserts so beautiful especially the apple and cinnamon tart .  

The ambience of this hotel is stunning and level of service exemplary and friendly, that oozes class from top to bottom, the hard working staff from front of house ,to cleaning staff always courteous and helpful complement perfectly their colleagues  in the restaurants and the great food by their chiefs.

Many wonderful memories in a truly beautiful hotel, La Grand have set very high standards and in modernising over the Covid lockdowns was innovate putting their mark as a Parisian leader in the hospitality business and this complements perfectly the service they friendly provide.  

Excellent location for accessing shops and museums located in a bustling area  that overlooks the Opera House acts as a great landmark, well recommend this hotel for a stay.

We needed to bring in large reusable pump bottles of shampoo and body soap. That’s okay, but there was not even a shelf to place them on!!

text:
We booked this hotel for the 2nd part of our Paris vacation as a treat & to celebrate couple of milestones. I was in touch with the hotel prior to my stay so that i could organise a surprise and I was assured that would be taken care of complimentary. We checked in slightly early with the intention of leaving our luggage and then coming back in late afternoon to do the ‘actual check in’ of the room but thankfully our room was already ready. We were not recognised for our IHG loyalty at checkin which was really surprising considered this is an Intercontinental and my husband is Platinum and myself Gold and neither were we offered points or drinks (husband checked account later and saw he was given the welcome points but would have been nice to
be given the option). We were hardly given any information at checkin and had to
probe for general queries such as breakfast and was given short and curt replies.. it was a very uncomfortable exchange to say the least.
Room was beautiful as was the hotel however there were few minor issues with the room (stains on the bathtub, shower head leaking from the sides) which wasnt a problem with us and hence we did not mention to the hotel plus as i felt extremely thankful for the early checkin and the ‘supposed surprise’ they were organising for my husband. 
As we left the hotel for the day, i discreetly mentioned to the front desk about the surprise i had organised with their colleague but i was told ‘well u came early, it will be there when u come back as normal check in is not now’ and the lady (another receptionist) seemed almost annoyed and judgemental - might i add that i wanted to pay for the ‘surprise’ but was told it will be complimentary as a ‘welcome amenity’ on the email exchange i had prior. 
We came back to the hotel around 6pm and there’s still nothing. I called the front desk again and the gentleman was far kinder and understanding and he said he would look into it. A knock came to our door almost an hour later where someone brought a bottle of champagne and 2 glasses and left. Husband was in room so no surprise and just the whole thing felt pointless having to continuously ask the front desk 3 times by now. There was no note along with it and at this point i wished i had arranged and paid for this surprise at the crowne plaza we had stayed for the first part of the trip as their service was outstanding. Champagne was not touched til our last night in the hotel where we opened it for the sake of opening it and hardly drank.
Check in went far more smoothly and the receptionist was alot more polite with the Intercontinental standards.
Might i add that the concierge staff we encountered were all amazing, they work so hard and tirelessly and so do the housekeeping team.
All in all, a beautiful hotel in an amazing location but inconsistent service levels across the staff.

The same night we lost power in the middle of the night and when it came back on the HVAC screen flashed on for a long enough period that it woke us up. One final note:  we had a rabbit stuffed animal in the room that disappeared one day. It was white and we assume that it got caught up in a change of sheets. Nonetheless it sums our our experience-disappointing. The hotel is nice and I suspect not everyone there had our issues since people were not lined up complaining. I think they compensated us appropriately but I would much rather have had everything just work and not spend so much of the limited time we had there dealing with these issues.

title: A fantastic Intercontinental in the heart of Paris.
text:
We returned to the hotel for the 3rd time now, after the major renovations, this time also for a 2-night weekend.

We checked in at 3PM.
Check in was quick, efficient and courteous.
The hotel was kind enough to make sure we got the same room as we did the previous time - Executive Suite 3126.

You could see the stunning results of the renovation the minute you walk in the corridors. Everything look absolutely stunning and you could almost feel the smell of the new materials.

Our room was fantastic and we could hardly recognize it from our last visit, as it was fully renovated and now feels much more modern, but still with a classic Parisian touch.
The room featured 2 beds, a TV and (brand new) sofa, a desk and chair, an armchair and a large coffee table.
There were 2 large cupboards, an empty minibar, a safe and 2 windows facing the opera house.
The windows were renovated as well, and now include 2 sets of windows to eliminate completely any possibility of noise coming from the square next to the opera house. However, this also meant we couldn't get out to the small French balconies of the room.

The bathroom was also completely renovated and included a window facing the opera house, a toilet (with a bidet hose), a sink, a bath tub and a separate shower (with a rather weak water pressure).
The bathroom amenities were from Algoterm and were very nice.

Our welcome gifts included a champagne, some fruits, macaroons, a box of cookies, water and a note from the management.

Breakfast at Café de la Paix was fantastic and included a full breakfast buffet and made to order eggs and hot drinks (I've written a separate review about it).

The new Club lounge is located on the first floor and is absolutely stunning. The renovation process included a brand new lounge, which is perfectly located (although it has no view).
First of all, the lounge feels airy, very large, comfortable, inviting and very modern.
It is open from 7AM until 9PM and features several food offerings as well as all day long drinks:
7:00-11:00 - breakfast.
14:30-17:00 - tea time with numerous macaroons, pastries, sandwiches, cheese and fish.
17:00 onwards - a stunning evening buffet with exquisite selections of foie gras, shrimps, escargot, fresh oysters(!!!), breads, sweets and drinks.
This is BY FAR the best lounge experience we've ever had in Europe and the hotel has certainly raised the bar when it comes to the quality (and quantity) of the food offerings in the lounge. Bravo!!!
The staff at the lounge (and Gilles in particular, as always) - were outstanding.

We were really sad to leave the hotel and finally checked out at 6PM.

A big thank you goes to the hotel's wonderful GM, Mr. Laure, for his incredible hospitality. Merci beaucoup!

Bottom line - this is a spectacular hotel, with a fantastic Club Lounge and team, located in the best area of Paris, and it is now even more gorgeous than before, having completed a major renovation.

This should be your only hotel while visiting Paris, period.

title: Superb concierge: a great asset for the hotel especially during COVID-19 with frequent flight cancellations and PCR test
text:
(Updated review on this newly renovated Paris Le Grand Hotel.)

LOCATION: 45 minutes to 1 hour and 15 minutes’ drive from CDG Airport, depending on the traffic. The taxi price from the airport is fixed. Since the hotel is located on the right bank of the Seine, the price is EUR 53 all inclusive. 

HOTEL: We stayed here twice in early December 2021. The first time was for 5 nights and the second time for 3 nights. 

The first 5 nights we stayed at a Capucines room on a higher floor. This room was extra quiet due to the additional thick, reinforce glass, 15 cm in front of the traditional French glass windows. The room was clean with comfortable mattress, pillows and duvet. Bathroom has a bathtub with a separate shower cubicle. The shower water pressure was very good here. There were two heaters in the bathroom, one for the towel rail, the other one was under the sink. The heated towel rail was easy to turn on and off, the heater under the sink is another matter entirely. You would have to be a child or a very skinny adult to be able to get under the sink and regulate this heater. 

The last 3 nights, we stayed at a Scribe room on a higher floor. This room has ordinary French glass windows, but since it was located on a higher floor and Rue Scribe was a quiet road, we did have a good night rest here without being disturbed by the noises from the outside. The mattress, the pillows and the duvet were also very good. This room also had a bathtub and a shower cubicle. The shower head here was of an older model and the shower water pressure was not as good as the one at the Capucines room. There was a separate toilet at the entrance, without a hand sink, which we found a bit unhygienic. Otherwise, there was a heated towel rail and another heater under the sink, the same types as the ones in the previous room. 

The housekeepers were all very courteous and fast. 

The Lounge had now been renovated and moved down to the 1st floor by the lifts. It was definitely nicer and brighter than the last one. The food served here however was a total let-down compared to before. The same could be said about the breakfast at the Café de la Paix. The food served here was very basic and bland. Most of the breakfast staff seemed to be very inexperienced. On two separate mornings, we had to tell them to change a coffee cup on our table because it was not properly cleaned. Now and again, they would drop knives or forks on the floor even though the café was rarely busy during early breakfast hours. The breakfast hostesses were also very inexperienced. They often have problem seating and advising guests arriving for breakfast. Once, we were told if we chose to sit away from other customers, due to our social distancing practises, we might not be served coffee or tea because our table was 4 metres away from the nearest waiter station. It turned out she was wrong of course. 

We specifically chose this hotel because we had very good experience with their concierges a few years back. We knew if there was a time for an exceptional concierge, it would be during this COVID-19 pandemic. The concierges here were very helpful and knowledgeable. They would go to great lengths to understand different countries’ arrival requirements for PCR test, paperwork and quarantine hotels. We were especially impressed by one of their concierges, Ms. Léa. She arranged for our PCR tests to be carried out from our hotel room. She also tirelessly made sure all our paperwork was in order and printed them out on time, well before our flights. (The PCR test results were available within the same day. It cost EUR 150 per person. Please make sure to triple-check the laboratory test results for spelling mistakes, names, date of births, passport numbers, test date, signature and stamp chop. We found several mistakes on our laboratory test reports. Without the help from Ms. Léa, it would have been a huge headache to have them rectified on time before our flight back home.)

Lastly, front desk staff would check your pass sanitaire, vaccination record, when you checked into the hotel. All the staff were very good at wearing masks and wore them properly, including the bell staff who were often outside carrying heavy luggage. Surprisingly, not many hotel guests here were using mask at the public spaces of the hotel, such as inside the lifts and on the corridors.

title: First Time Since Remodel
text: This was our first visit in several years so it was the first time since the remodel was finished.  We checked in at the front desk but will not do that again as Gilles advised us to come directly to the lounge.  We received a small shoebox of a room with a great view of the Opera.  I don't look out the window too many times so I prefer a room upgrade rather than a view upgrade due to my IHG status.   I called and stated my case and was told that someone would bring the keys for a new room.  I have pictures of both rooms and will post.  The second room was a suite with separate living room.  There was no tub as in the first room (the only thing better about the first room).   Our view was of the Rue Scribe and the neighbors across the street who must get some interesting views as well?  The a/c worked well, but we mainly used the room to sleep, bathe, and relax after our days in Paris.  We spent much time in the lounge.  We had breakfast both mornings in the lounge unlike our last visit when we ate in the restaurant a few times.  Not as much is available in the lounge, but it is more peaceful and relaxing.  I had omelets both mornings plus bacon and other meats, lots of flaky pastry, and more.  I had 3-4 expressos in one large cup plus about 2 bottles of flat water.  During the afternoon and evenings when we were there, we had wine (maybe a glass of champagne) and some snacks.  Unlike before, there is no dinner in the lounge and the afternoon snacks and desserts are much less than before.   Gilles and team though were as welcoming as always and treated us like royalty.  Armand (as one of the guy's name in La Cage) was a great evening assistant.  The early (morning and early afternoon) staff was great but not as personable since they were new to us and also very busy taking care of everyone's needs.  I always try to include lounge access (now on 1st floor-2nd in US/Canada) as they've turned the old lounge into several high priced suites!  We were on the same floor as the old lounge after our upgrade so I saw the entrances to such.  In conclusion, we plan to be back next June before our Amsterdam cruise.  We used an Ambassador weekend certificate on this stay and have also reserved similar for June.  It is always better when Gilles is there so we let him know our dates when we checked out (in the lounge not at the front desk).  Merci encore pour tous!

title: Lacking air-conditioning
text:
My husband (who has Spire status) & I stayed for 4 nights at this hotel.  We have always had wonderful experiences at InterContinentals-Sydney, Prague, Bordeaux, etc. and expected the same at this hotel.  Our room on the 5th floor was lovely but the last night the air-conditioning wasn't working.  I called guest relations around 5pm and a technician was sent to the room.  He looked at thermostat and said he'd return.  When he didn't return after a couple of hours, I called again.  When he returned, he stated nothing could be done that night and it was too late to move us to another room.  I called guest relations and asked the young lady who answered to send a fan.  She agreed but said it might take some time.  By then, it was 10pm.  We had an early flight so opened the windows  to try to let air into room & get a few hours of sleep.  It was impossible.  Sirens throughout the night and the room was still hot.  When I called guest relations the next morning, the gentleman said I should have continued calling throughout the night requesting the fan "we are here all night, you should have called again and again".  Why should a guest have to make a request several times?  The first day I had to call twice to get a luggage rack.  The second day I made 3 requests for a top sheet or light blanket which was never acknowledged.  I didn't have faith I'd receive a fan no matter how many times I called.

It's a beautiful hotel but for the price we expected a comfortable rest each night.  

And this is a small thing but there was never a smile or greeting from the doorman or from most of the staff.

title: Beautiful hotel in perfect lovation
text:
This is a breathtakingly beautiful hotel in a perfect location. 

The staff are friendly, polite and helpful. 

When we arrived our room was not ready, but we were given vouchers for champagne and a meal in the restaurant, which was wonderful.

It was for my 50th birthday celebrations and we were given champagne, fruit, biscuits and water in our room, which was a lovely gesture and made my day. 

The reason I gave 4 stars was in relation to my stay.. I had requested an opera view room with a balcony as this was for my 50th birthday, but unfortunately I did not get it.

It didn’t spoil our stay, and I understand that these things are not always available but if it had been possible it would have made my stay perfect. 

The room we were given was beautiful, but felt as if it might have been prepared in a rush.. the mini bars were empty and despite having a fabulous coffee machine there were no cups. We rang down to ask for cups and eventually some arrived, but then the used ones were taken away but not replaced for the following day.

Just tiny things, that could have been better but overall it was a wonderful hotel and I hope I get the opportunity to stay again.

title: Four nights of disappointment
text:
On the plus side:
The location of the hotel, the appearance of publicly available rooms.

Unfortunately, there are more minuses than pluses:
Let's start by contacting the hotel before arriving, I received three messages regarding the payment of the first night, because for some reason they could not use the card indicated during the booking, but they did not care what time we would arrive, whether the stay was for an important occasion, room preferences etc., nothing...
We booked a Delux Room with Opera view, arrived around 1 pm, the room was not ready, the reception was not able to give an approximate time of room availability, but tired of the journey, we waited until 3 pm, the reception was still not able to inform us how much time it still needed, so we left the city not wanting to waste any more time, around 4:15 pm the phone rang that the room was ready, after returning to the hotel it turned out that we did not receive a higher category room as a Spire Ambassador, the intervention at the reception did not give anything - no Junior Suite available on that day ...
A guaranteed upgrade does not work there, in addition, it is difficult to understand why a half-empty hotel cannot be planned so that the room is waiting for the guest?
Breakfast is the worst experience in an Intercontinental hotel in the world, long waiting, low quality of products or no such products, after the second unsuccessful attempt to order ordinary breakfast cereals for our son, we found it would be easier to buy it ourselves and from the third day we carried our own so that our child would eat anything else. cold pancakes, the size of the buffet aroused amusement not only for us, most of the guests reacted with disbelief, unfortunately what was coming from the kitchen was of little quality, the level similar to Holiday Inn Express or worse.
Beautiful refurbished building lacking organization, procedures and standards for a good 5 star hotel. Staff are polite but do nothing to change anything to improve if things go wrong very disappointing wedding anniversary stay.

On the occasion of our wedding anniversary, the hotel did not even leave a greeting card, it is just that the guests here are not important what we felt.

title: Pristine
text: Have stayed here a few times on business and for leisure, as it's an ideal location to be able to walk the city.  The renovations are ongoing but excellently managed, so had no impact at all during our weekend stay.  The newly refurbished rooms are beautifully decorated with fresh, calming decor and an amazing comfy bed and well fitted-out bathroom. It's the standard of housekeeping that sets this hotel apart.  Being a stickler for cleanliness it's often a weakness even in 5 star hotels, but not here, where everything was beautifully presented and absolutely immaculate - well done to the housekeeping team! The breakfast offering in Cafe de la Paix is excellent, especially the fresh egg station, our only slight disappointment was with the service which felt a little distracted and offhand.  I  had to ask for a cruet for the table then a few minutes later get up to find one myself. The waiter then saw I'd helped myself and said 'ah you got one', well yes, but an apology for forgetting would have been good.  And when serving tea in the lounge, please know that English tea is served with cold milk, not warm! Excellent spa treatments, and overall a superb stay.

title: Lovely hotel, good location
text:
This is a great hotel - not exactly city centre but we knew that when we booked. 
Metro station about a 10 min walk and tram stop about 5 min walk. 
The hotel itself was fairly basic but perfectly good for our needs as a family of 4 - 2 adults and 16 and 12 yr old kids. The hotel had set the children up 2 single beds which was very much appreciated as a girl and a boy! 
The hotel was spotlessly clean and the beds were very comfortable which was great after a long day walking all over Paris. 
Hairdryer, tea/coffee etc was all provided with tea etc and towels replenished daily. 
We had a slight problem in the bathroom in that the shower tray didn’t hold the water very well and so by the time we’d all had showers in the morning the bathroom looked flooded! The bathroom was a good size though which meant it was easily dealt with without anyone slipping! 
We only had breakfast at the hotel one morning and it was fine - croissants, breads, cold meats, yogurts, fruits and plenty of juices, teas and coffees. At €12 each though we found it cheaper to buy a selection of the same type of stuff in a local bakery and find a seat to eat elsewhere. 
The hotel staff were all friendly and though we could speak some french, most staff we encountered spoke a little English as well. 
We would definitely stay again, hopefully soon…

title: Excellent value and great service.
text:
I stayed here for 4 nights during my first visit to Paris, and overall I am very satisfied with the hotel. Staff were very friendly and are happy to help English speaking customers. The hotel has many services you wouldn’t expect for the price point. I would recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a quiet stay in Paris at a great price point. 

I booked a standard room, which was a bit smaller than it looks in the pictures, so I would highly advise booking one of the larger rooms as this one didn’t have much space for bags or to get ready with two people. Bed was fairly comfortable, and the washroom was nice. My room overlooked a nice quiet terrace, and while the view was nothing exciting it was much more calming then overlooking the busy city. This window provided am natural light for the space. Rooms were cleaned daily, and seemed to get done regardless of what time I was there/out exploring the city. The room does have a small fridge, however it didn’t get too cold so I wouldn’t plan to keep perishables in it. 

The location of the hotel is in the 15th arrondissement of Paris, so it is near the southern side of the city’s core. From here you can access multiple bus routes, and train lines, which makes the city very accessible (you can get nearly anywhere in under 30 minutes using transit), additionally there are Scooters and Bikes nearby to get around easier. The location itself isn’t too exciting, but it is clean and safe. There is plenty of basic amenities nearby such as Cafe’s, bakeries, restaurants, multiple grocery stores, etc.

title: Friendly traditional hotel in quiet local area
text:
The hotel is in a traditional French area, with few tourists but which is easily accessible by bus or 15 minute walk from the metro. There is a really good range of restaurants, bakeries and a local park, and we were lucky to be there at the weekend when there is a big antique book fair which was of great interest to my son with whom I travelled. There were free coffee and pastries available in the hotel lobby which was a really nice touch, and also a kettle in the room which was a real bonus as I didn't have to pack my own! And a very useful fridge.  The room was very clean and unlike many hotel rooms it was very well lit. The only downside was that it was small (as are many Paris hotel rooms) but also a very awkward shape, with a diagonal wall cutting off a large corner near the window making moving around somewhat tricky for two people. The windowless bathroom was tiny, with a good shower and lovely hot water although in a minute shower cubicle. 
We were at the back of the hotel overlooking the yard and other buildings but although there was no view it was very quiet at night. We didn't have breakfast as it was not included, but it looked very nice in the room information book. All in all we were very pleased with the hotel and the area and would definitely stay there again.

title: Short family Visit to Paris
text:
The start of our family summer holiday in France began in Paris as our children wanted to see the sites. Like most people with families, trying to find a hotel that is close to amenities, a room that is big enough and in a safe area etc, particularly in a city you are not familiar with, can be a minefield.

After weeks of looking we settled on Hotel Home Moderne. 

And we are so glad we did. 

Their communications were brilliant, sending emails beforehand asking if we needed anything for our arrival, or advice. I had a few questions and the response was almost immediate and really helpful, and enabled us to plan our short stay that bit better. They also sent an email during our stay asking again if all was ok with the stay and if we needed anything further whilst staying in Paris. By far the best communication I have had from a hotel. 
 
The family (our children are 6 & 7) room we had was a great size, lots of room and the sofa/pull out beds for the children (2 Single beds) were really comfortable. The main bed was large and comfortable ensuring a great nights sleep.

Located on several tranist routes, bus and tram you are only about 20 min from Place Joffre and one of the busses passes directly in front of the hotel and is less than a minute from the hotel and with children travelling free adults 2 Euro it makes for a great way to travel and to see some other parts of Paris. 

We arrived a little early but this caused no problems, the staff were great, welcoming and speaing great English. They seemed genuinely interested in our stay and plans and offered sound advice on places to visit and things to do.

Returning after a full day and night, the night staff were just as interested in our stay and plans as those during the day, again the staff spoke brilliant English.

This is a great Hotel with comfortable rooms, great amenaties and staff. 

A great place to stay and I'm sure we will revist.

title: Beautiful Parisien Hotel
text:
Excellent Hotel, my husband and I stayed for 4 nights. Close to many restaurants and supermarkets. 
On arrival we were welcomed and check in was quick and simple. Staff at reception spoke English and were very helpful. Our room was on the 7th floor, there is an elevator and we had the view with the courtyard. Tea and coffee are in the bedroom. Television has some English channels. Room was cleaned daily. Buffet breakfast in mornings, choice of cereals, eggs, toast, pastries, cheeses, yoghurts etc. 
The Eiffel Tower is 40 minute walk away (I am 25 weeks pregnant so not a fast walker) but I do recommend taking the Metro which is easy to get to from hotel, less than 10 minute walk. 
The Metro is 1.80€ for single or you can buy multiple tickets for cheaper.
I advise anyone - to purchase skip the queue tickets before travelling to Paris like we did into places to avoid waiting a long time in queues. Take Hop on/off buses to see the wonderful sights. Use the Metro (be sure to have a metro map).
We paid 55€ for taxi from CDG airport to hotel but on return journey we took metro from Porte de Vanves to Montparnasse then Montparnasse to Denfert Rochereau then from Denfert got RERB train to CDG airport for 10.30€ each. So simple just remember to use the metro map.
Thank you to the Hotel staff for the advice, recommendations and for the service. We would love to come back sometime.

text: My boyfriend and I flew to Paris for 4 nights on New Year’s Day and we chose Hotel Home Moderne for our stay. I literally cannot fault the hotel in any way. It is very modern and extremely clean. The staff were all very welcoming and were always on the reception desk if you needed anything. We had bed & breakfast which had plenty of choice in the mornings and was in a lovely little breakfast room. The rooms were small but I preferred that to bigger rooms as they were so nice and cosy and it was really nice to come back into after being out in the cold all day! There is also a fridge in the room which was also good as we could keep our drinks cold. The bathroom was a good size and the shower was powerful. There was also a TV with some English channels on as well! The location of the hotel is brilliant. It’s about 20-30 minutes away on transport form all the major landmarks and we went to Disneyland on one of the days and it only took us around an hour. There’s also lots of restaurants, bars and shops in walking distance so we had plenty of choice for our dinners in the evening. They were a lot cheaper than restaurants in the centre of Paris as well. We were also presented with a little gift on arrival which was so lovely. We made our own way too and from the airport as well by transport and it only took around an hour. I would recommend this hotel to anyone travelling to Paris, I will definitely return!

title: Depends what you’re looking for
text:
This hotel was nicely decorated and very clean. Staff were helpful and one even drew us a map to get us to the metro. 
It’s in a good location, far enough out of the central area that it is nice and quiet but close enough that you can walk to the Eiffel Tower etc. It’s about. 45 minute stroll to the tower and fairly simple and flat. There are supermarkets nearby as well as greengrocers etc. 
However, the room, like many things in Paris, was very small. We had to shimmy sideways between the sink and shower cubicle to get to the toilet, I’m a slightly larger lady but my partner is average build for a man and he had to do the same. This also means there isn’t really any storage space for suitcases unless you can fit them in the wardrobe space. The wardrobe space is probably the best space in there, could do with a few more hangers but lots of shelves for storing clothes. 
There is a hairdryer which is a kind of old fashioned wall mounted one so not the best so if you have a lot of thick hair it may be better to take your own. 
The hotel will provide and iron and board at your request. 
The only issue we had was that the holder for the shower head was too loose (obviously wear and tear) so it was only the water pressure that held it on, on first use it was standing straight up when the water went on which meant it was to straight to fall off so I didn’t notice the problem, I adjusted it down to a suitable angle but once I turned the water off it fell from the holder and bashed me right on the head. It wasn’t going to be a quick fix but did advise the hotel of the issue. 
Overall it’s a decent hotel to stay in. Ideal for short trips and to see the sights.

text: If you want to experience tranquility within Paris then Hotel Home Moderne is the place to be. We booked a bedroom for a family of 3 and whola the room is so big - the toilet itself is so spacious it's like a room of its own. There is complimentary water on your first day, safety lock and fast internet connection. The toiletries and coffee/tea bar are replenished daily. We didn't have breakfast but the surrounding neighbourhood have cafe's and restaurants with different varieties available for your needs. Supermarket and Pharmacy are also located nearby but take note in France they close very early so you must buy before 7 PM. The dining area has indoor and outdoor and its perfect to have your hot cup of coffee. The lift is very spacious and fast. The hotel staff can speak English and very friendly. There is a free croissant and french pastries everyday. The lobby is a bit small but comfortable enough.  They can print you for your tickets and bookings. Only thing I would say - there is a bit of walk to the nearest Metro station. Overall my experience at this hotel is both remarkable and memorable. It was a nice touch of French cultural experience.

We have been all over the world and staying in some amazing properties. We were taking our 15 year old to France for the first time.  He too has been all over the world and stayed in amazing places. Luxury is must for him - he is quite spoiled.

I am not sure I will ever be fortunate enough to stay in a Palais Royal Suite again for a 6 night stay. We have been to Paris many many times and have have never had a view like that. A fifteen year old stands on the balcony as the Tour Du France goes by. I will pine for it next time. It is not cheap but in my estimation its a great value. We have friend  who was staying at famous hotel on Place Vendome in a room similar to ours & it must have been 3 or 4 times as much. 

The service was exceptional. Ryan (fabulous)  the concierge sorted 8 or so restaurant reservations before we arrived. Ice for drinks was delivered immediately and never ever required a second call. My wife was ill and when the room service waiter came with toast he said that the she needed tea and quickly returned with pot w/o a charge.  It was quite charming. 

The breakfast was great with a big selection my only complaint is the croissants should have been better. Dinner was fine we only ate there once on the night we arrived. 

The location cant be beat - I like to stay in the thick of things and we typically stay in the 1st or 2nd in Paris. But this was the best location in my experience. Having the Metro next to the hotel is brilliant. I like to rent a Vespa and there is scooter parking is across the street. 

It clean, comfortable the bathroom was great.  The staff is friendly and out going very helpful. 

Full disclosure: When we arrived they put us in room on the 5th floor (might have been 4) the ceiling was low I could touch it with flat feet and the windows were small. they moved us right away but had nothing else been available and I was paying what I paid for that room I probably would have checked out asap - leaving a very different review. 

I am not sure I could go back if I could not have that view. It was a magical experience and one that cannot be replicated. Still I would not hesitate to stay here again. On a low floor. It met with our 15 year olds approval. As I said they ruined Paris it can never be the same again.

The hotel itself is beautifully maintained- it is an old French building, so of course rooms are smaller than American standards, but ours had wonderful French doors that opened up to the square below and was just what we needed. Staff in the hotel are the best, super friendly and helpful with anything and everything. Bar staff in particular is 10/10- made excellent cocktails and were so fun to hang out with. They gave us a big list of the best cocktail bars in Paris when we asked for recommendations. Weekend brunch in L’Officine is not to be missed- it is even better than it looks in the pictures. All in all we were very comfortable and well fed in this hotel. It’s a great price for this level of service in Paris. Normally I like to try lots of different hotels in cities when I visit, but it’s going to be real hard to book anywhere else after our experience!

title: Beautiful property in the heart of it all
text: This property is perfect for those visiting Paris for the first time or 7th time (like us).. yes, it can be crowded- you are directly across from the Louvre after all, but you have direct access to the Metro directly behind hotel; 1 min walk to Louvre, 5min to Opera House and close to all the cherished sites that visitors love to see.  Do yourself a favor and upgrade to the Palais suite- ours was on the 1st floor- it was amazing! Stunning views of the Louvre, we kept the French doors open and felt like we had the best lounge in Paris! Poured our own cocktails while watching the crowds-and enjoying the dramatic French buildings- (1st floor has 14ft high ceilings for dramatic effect)- note- not all suites are the same- our friends had the same category (room 138) which had a bathtub and huge shower, our room (158) had a good size shower but no bathtub- although we had a large walk through closet- it’s Europe- nothing is cookie cutter here- part of the charm!! Both suites did have huge and comfortable king beds- firm the way we like them… Hotel restaurant looked great but we did not eat there- too many options around the city!!!! We did have cocktails in the lounge which were good but service is slow- prepare to relax and enjoy… the suites exceeded our expectations and although the hotel advertises housekeeping only on the 4th day of your stay- we had twice daily service- so a wonderful surprise!!

description:
Hotel Rose Bourbon is an excellent choice for travelers visiting Paris, offering many helpful amenities designed to enhance your stay.
Rooms at Hotel Rose Bourbon offer air conditioning and a refrigerator providing exceptional comfort and convenience, and guests can go online with free wifi.
Breakfast will also help to make your stay even more special.
Nearby landmarks such as Parc des Princes (1.7 mi) and Champs-Elysees (2.0 mi) make Hotel Rose Bourbon a great place to stay when visiting Paris.
Paris has plenty of seafood restaurants. So when you’re here, be sure to check out popular spots like Le Jules Verne, Le Grand Colbert, and Pedra Alta, which are serving up some great dishes.
Best of all, Hotel Rose Bourbon makes it easy to experience many great Paris attractions like Arc de Triomphe, Panthéon, and Les Jardins du Trocadero, which are some popular monuments and statues.
Enjoy your stay in Paris!

title: Okay, but over priced for what you get. Not great customer service
text:
This was an okay hotel, with a few issues.

A quaint residential location which I loved, out of the touristy areas, but close enough to the action. The staff was okay, they ran out of water during the heatwave and my shower was clogged more than once. Also note these rooms are Uber small and very thin walled. You can hear guests in the adjacent rooms. And when I say small, I had no space to put my suitcase so it lived on the bed which was not ideal for comfort. I don’t mind sa arriving extra space but the rooms could have been designed to have a place for luggage. Both my duffle and carry one had to stay on the bed as they wouldn’t fit on the desk, chair or floor. I was most disappointed that the shower drain didn’t work and I had to point it out twice to the staff, I stayed for 5 nights and was more than ready to move out!

title: An exceptional stay!
text:
I did a TON of research on where to stay in Paris and really wanted a place with a balcony, which brought my search to Hotel Rose Bourbon—and I’m so glad it did! Nestled in a more quiet neighborhood in the 15th arrondissement, Hotel Rose Bourbon was an incredible place to stay for 3 nights in Paris. We booked online directly through the hotel for the balcony room and got breakfast included (total for 3 nights: €528). Honestly, we didn’t spend much time on the balcony because we were so busy exploring and it was still pretty chilly in early April, but the room itself was spacious and cutely decorated. 

Two highlights of our stay were getting to store our luggage as soon as we arrived in Paris (jet lagged at 7 AM of course), but we were able to check in a few hours early because our room was ready which was greatly appreciated! The second highlight was the amazing breakfast spread that was available each morning! Since our room included the option of having breakfast delivered to our room, we had an amazing breakfast in bed two days in a row that had everything we could have wanted—scrambled eggs, croissants and pastries, jams, cheeses, sausages and other meats, orange juice, coffees, etc. It is clear that everything is made fresh each morning—you can smell the amazing breakfast aromas around 6:30 am—and it was absolutely delightful. 

Another thing I appreciated was the size of the bathroom—very large and spacious for a Paris hotel—and the shower had steaming hot water almost instantly which is a huge plus (nothing I hate more than a cold shower!) The service was super friendly and gave great recommendations for dinner, and the location is also super close (1 block) from the metro which makes it easily accessible to anywhere you’d need to go in Paris. Overall, our stay at Hotel Rose Bourbon was incredible and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Paris.
