title: Good hotel at a great location.
text:
This hotel is located in a quiet residential area, in the 15th Arr. It is close to the 8 and 10 Metro lines  which provide easy access to other areas in the city. Felix Faure (Metro Stop for 8 line)  is about a 3 minute walk and Charles Michels (Metro Stop for 10 line) is about a 5-7 minute walk.
There is a FranPrix (supermarket) right near the hotel, and atleast one bank and one pharmacy in the vicinity. There is a nice, small park right next to the hotel. 
It is about 20 minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower.   
My room was on the first floor. It was clean, quiet and comfortable. The staff was friendly and helpful. 
I had to leave for Orly airport around 4.30am and the front-desk helped me with getting a taxi. You can talk to the front-desk and request for booking a taxi in advance.  It takes about 20-30 minutes to Orly airport by taxi. 
If you are coming from CDG airport, then you can take the RER B from the airport to the Metro stop Saint Michael NotrDame and change to Metro 10 to Charles Michels stop, from where it is a 5-7 min walk to the hotel. It is a very easy commute. 
There is breakfast provided at the hotel. If you would like croissants and coffee, or explore other breakfast/brunch options, there are many cafes and restaurants in the area.  
Overall, for a first time in the city, this was a great place to stay!

title: Good location but extremely noisy room
text:
I stayed at the Hotel Bourbon last month. I know this area of Paris very well, and compared to the other hotels in the area, Hotel Bourbon provided a refreshing change in its design. The rooms are pretty stylish, and the decoration is evidently well thought of. 
However, it becomes quickly apparent that everything is done rather amateurishly. Firstly, the rooms are very small, which one would argue that they disclose the sqm2 on the website from the moment you book, so this should not in theory be a surprise. But the room is so poorly designed that it is impossible for instance to open fully the cabinet where the mini fridge is located, as the distance between the door and the bed is too small for it to open. The same can be said in their larger rooms, where the front door couldn’t fully open either in order to let our large suitcases in. What a joke! There is also no room to store luggage and its content, especially if you are travelling as a couple. 
The biggest issue though was the noise: indeed I was able to hear next door’s conversation in details (to the point where I could have participated in the conversation from my room), and they were not even being particularly loud, just talking at a normal volume. Additionally, every time someone on your floor open their door, the entire floor can hear it shut loudly because of the automated system, which I can assure you becomes unbearable past midnight. I was not able to sleep during my 2 night stay, and when I complained about the noise to the receptionist, she laughed and said that she was a light sleeper as well. 
Lastly, the breakfast choice is not large, everything is already displayed and nothing is cooked or prepared for you (including hot beverages - you have to serve yourself from the coffee machine in the buffet). Food was okay. 
Next time I stay in the 15th, I will stay in a less pretentious hotel but with decent amenities, or simply in a different district but high end hotel.

We arrived at mid-day and as expected our room wasn’t ready. This was fine as we left our bags with reception and went out exploring. The nearest metro is just a few minutes walk away at Place de Clichy. If you look on the website the rooms look stunning ... they’ve done a good job of that website by the way! There is another toilet in the basement area which serves the spa area and you can use this if you felt uncomfortable with the glass door in the bedroom/bathroom. 
Location is excellent. You can walk up to Pigalle in 5-10 minutes where you’ll find the Moulin Rouge and plenty of saucy shops if that’s your thing! From there you can walk up to Montmartre and The Sacre Coeur but it is a gentle climb all the way and I’d estimate it would take 20-25 minutes to walk there from the Hotel. There are plenty of bars and restaurants near the hotel too. Would I stay there again? Yes I think we would.

title: Exceptional Customer Service
text:
Having read many reviews about hotel rooms in Paris being small and not good enough, we decided to book the Trocadero room with a private jacuzzi at this hotel - thankfully.

We arrived early just before 11am, and before anything else, the lovely receptionist offered us a complimentary drink. She then stored our luggage away as check in was only at 3pm.

We arrived back at the hotel at around 4pm, and the same receptionist offered us another drink, before taking us on a tour of the hotel. She explained the reason behind the hotel's design, and the different rooms the hotel offer before showing us our room and how to use everything. Our luggage had been delivered to the room already.

The room was beautiful, it was a small-average sized room but a decent size for Paris, it had a comfy bed with a variety of pillows (different sizes, some soft, some firm), a big TV, and a minibar with complimentary water and orange juice (replenished daily). Our room had a private jacuzzi in the bathroom and it is worth the extra € to upgrade.

The location of the hotel is very good - there are plenty of restaurants on the hotel's road, and nearby. We ate a few times at an authentic Italian restaurant named Caratello nearby (10 min walk), but we there's plenty of restaurants to choose from that are a minute or so away. There is also a supermarket next door to the hotel - very convenient.

The staff were very kind and helpful, and really added to the product. They were kind enough to print off our Disney tickets for us, with no extra charge, and the hotel kindly stored our luggage on the day of check out, as we had an evening flight.

All in all, it's a luxury hotel in the heart of Paris that is worth paying for to guarantee an excellent place to stay. 10/10 would stay again.

title: The Secret is Out: It was Magical!
text:
Wow! My husband and I stayed at this wonderful boutique style hotel for 5 days. What an amazing staff who spoke perfect English and were very helpful for all of our needs. As a gay couple we often can be made uncomfortable when checking into hotels but not at this wonderful hotel. It was clear this hotel was made for couples who want to enjoy a romantic stay while in the most romantic city in Europe. The staff gave us a wonderful tour of the facility upon checkin and they never blinked an eyelash when talking about making sure our romantic needs were met. It was absolutely the best bathroom options in a Paris hotel in this price range. We opted for the jacuzzi hot tub room which still allowed us to soak and shower together using the beautiful big rain shower head. I highly recommend this jacuzzi style bathroom because after our long days walking and exploring Paris, it was excellent to use the hot waters inside the privacy of our own room to relax. Most hotel bathrooms in Paris are small and tight, not here. You will feel like it’s a whole other room it’s so big. 

We also loved that the hotel was perfectly positioned to use both bus and metro trains to get around Paris. We chose to use the excellent Paris buses to get around and they were way better than the underground trains. 

Plenty of wonderful cafes and restaurants are in the neighborhoods surrounding Hotel Design Secret de Paris. You’re blocks from some of the busiest streets of Paris and also some of the quietest residential areas. My husband and I personally didn’t care for the touristy Moulin Rouge area close-by mainly because we were constantly accosted by women who offered us massages and entries to gentlemen clubs, clearly not our cup of tea. But we always felt perfectly safe!

Don't know why exactly but maybe it is because this was my first trip to Paris and I didn't really have a clue as to which part to stay in.

Well, I was certainly very happy that I found this place. Lets start one by one.. 

This small hotel is in the 9th Arrondissement. Walking distance from the Opera, Moulin Rouge, The Galleries Lafayette and even the Sacred Coeur. From the moment, I arrived I felt welcome. The hostess (I think it is Camila) was superbly friendly and a true professional. The check in process was quick and easy and she showed me my room. This was one of the Eiffel Tower variety. Each room here is themed like a particular monument in Paris. My bottle of Champagne was waiting for me chilled as ordered. The jacuzzi was excellent and I spend a lot of time in it. It is so soothing and relaxing with those coloured therapeutic lights as well.

Breakfast was served till a comfortable 11 am and was very nice. The croissants, cheese and eggs were great, as was the coffee. They also provide you coffee that you can have anytime in take away cups. 

So the hotel itself is on Rue De Parma and Rue De Clichy intersection. Just walk down Rue De Clichy towards Place De Clichy and within a three minute walk you are right in the middle of the action. The two closest metro stations are Liege and Pl. de Le Clichy. Both of these Metro stations are easily within 5 mins walk in different directions. From here, you can visit all the main places in Paris without any problem. If you intend to use the Metro more often, I advise, buy a booklet of 10 tickets. You save money. If Metro is not your thing, Uber works great in Paris. I used it a few times as well. But pretty much used a mix of Metro and Uber.

About 7-10 minutes walk from the hotel is the Galleries Lafayette, one of Paris' most upscale shopping places. If you want brands, this is the place for you. 

The staff at the reception is very helpful. Ask them for anything you need. Be it a phone charger, or shopping advice, or simply where to go and what to do. They are very helpful. I walked from my hotel to the Cathedral de Sacred Coeur and it took me about 25 minutes to reach. 

This is a great hotel to visit whether alone or as a couple. Very romantic, peaceful and friendly. Plenty of great restaurants to eat at nearby. I will certainly be back. Last but not least - very economical place to stay at according to Parisian standards, but that without compromising quality.

text:
I booked this hotel as a surprise for me and my now fiancé. The small boutique hotel makes it feel so classy and special, and the different style rooms are amazing.

We had the 'artist' room, it was bright, airy, clean and modern, with some lovely features like the switchable mood lighting. The jacuzzi bath was amazing, perfect after a long day wondering Paris, and in my case proposing to my partner - she said yes by the way!

The staff were helpful and informative, they catered for our every need. We opted for the breakfast in the room on our stay, the choice was amazing and the food perfect and very tasty! Breakfast wasn't cheap but as to be expected for a hotel in a city such as Paris. 

Location wise it was perfect, taxi was only €8 Euro from the train station - we travelled from London via Eurostar. There were plenty of cafes and places to eat near the hotel but we ventured towards the Eiffel Tower which was only €1.90 each and 15 minutes on the metro (underground). 

Overall the trip and hotel were a success, the hotel just made it for us though. We 100% would recommend and would stay again but in a different themed room. 

Only slight gripe was that the jacuzzi bath was very noisy and the room next door decided they wanted there's on at 1am in the morning, meaning all we could hear was the rumble on the bath and and the water pipes feeding their bath seemed to run through our walls. All in all though that's just me being picky and the hotel was outstanding as were the helpful staff.

title: Not for the claustrophobic, or those above a certain height
text:
This has to be the tiniest hotel room I have ever stayed in. We booked a traditional double room with balcony, priced at over $600/night, and I estimate that the room was about 100 square feet. There was approximately two feet of space between the bed and the wall on one side, less than two feet between the foot of the bed and the miniature desk in the room, and maybe slightly more between the other side of the bed and the bathroom. The balcony is barely big enough to accommodate two folding chairs facing each other with a tiny table in between. The bathroom is tiny as well. The elevator can barely fit two people with luggage.

This hotel proves the saying that "you get what you pay for" because other properties in the area were priced twice as high as this one. If I had known how small this room was going to be though, I would have booked elsewhere.

On the positive side, the staff is excellent and very helpful and the location is perfect. You can walk to all the major museums and tourist attractions and there is a metro stop on the corner for those who don't want to walk. All in all though, I would not stay here again.

title: A Parisian Jewel!
text:
My husband and I chose Hôtel Britannique on a recommendation from our daughter who visited several years ago and raved about this amazing discovery nestled in the City Center of Paris. Our dream was to share our third trip to Paris with our 14-year-old granddaughter and introduce her to all we love about this amazing city. This hotel was perfect for our stay because the location is in walking distance of all the sights Paris is famous for, the Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Pont Neuf, the Seine, Eiffel Tower (a bit of a walk), many shops, restaurants and cafés, and an extremely safe-feeling neighborhood. It is a very short walk to the Châtelet Métro and taxi stand. It was all there at our doorstep!
Upon arrival, we were overwhelmed by the graciousness and efficiency of the staff, who received us warmly. Jessica, Nicole and all the staff were very skilled and fluent in English and multiple other languages. They guided us through every aspect of our stay, answered all our questions and took away all the stress of traveling. Jessica, especially, took a very thoughtful and special interest in our comfort, even checking on us after our return home to the US! Communication is superb; emails get a quick response to answer all concerns about traveling in these uncertain times. We cannot praise this team highly enough.
A highlight of our stay was a wine and cheese tasting party in the warm, cozy sitting room served by the fun-loving staff. Henry was eager to entertain us by playing the guitar and serenading us with romantic French songs. It was a lovely way to get acquainted with guests from USA and other countries, as well as to learn more about fine cheese sourced from one of the best fromageries, La Fermette.
Our Twin Room Superior accommodated two adults and one teenager comfortably. It did not have a street view but faced a quiet courtyard. The room and very modern bathroom were larger than any Parisian hotel we have stayed in on prior visits. The room was exactly as seen on the website, very beautiful and immaculately cleaned daily. We slept very well on the comfortable king bed. There was a convertible armchair that pulled out to a very roomy bed for our granddaughter. Every detail is perfection: fluffy robes, slippers, nice towels, right down to the well cared for geraniums in the window boxes for a very Parisian feeling. The breakfast each day, served by Diana and Karima, was delicious and a wonderful value, that included cheeses, meats, scrambled eggs, bacon, yogurt, fruit and of course bread, croissants, and the best cappuccino machine ever. Occasionally, a homemade cake makes an appearance. Another loving touch.
Don’t hesitate to experience your glorious days in Paris at this jewel of a hotel with its fabulous location and magnificent staff.

title: Absolutely delightful hotel in a perfect location -  Hôtel Britannique
text:
There are so many hotels to choose from in Paris after considerable searching we settled on Hôtel Britannique, and we are so delighted to have made the right choice. The hotel feels very cosy with a most welcoming ambience. The hotel has historic links with the British, and this is reflected in the modest and tasteful decor which reflects British charm presented with unmistakable Parisian flair.
Hotels rooms in Paris can be quite compact, and Hôtel Britannique is no exception but leans towards the more generous end of the spectrum, but the space has been utilised exceptionally well and where this hotel stands head and shoulders above most others is the wonderful bathroom - a very high standard for Paris. Everything was tidy and in good order, including the 3 passenger lift. There is an amazing 19th C staircase in original condition which is an exhibition in itself. The staff were very pleasant and attentive throughout our stay and could not be faulted. 
So you take a perfect, charming British themed hotel with romantic Parisien charm and wonderful staff , then nestle it neatly adjacent to Place du Châtelet  and the Seine and within walking distance of Notre-Dame, Hôtel de Ville, the Louvre, Place de la Concorde and Champs Elysées, Rue de Rivoli etc etc. Excellent cafes, Boulangerie, restaurants, shops and Metro/ RER et voila - L’Hôtel Britannique !.  I cannot recommend this hotel enough, which will be without question our go to Parisien hotel from now on. The combination of very high standard and location would be extremely difficult to match at the same price point.

Our sincere thanks to all the staff at Hôtel Britannique for making our stay so perfect. We will see you again soon.

title: Loved our Stay!!
text:
Hotel Britannique is in a fabulous location.  Close to so many things with Metro stops within a 2 minute walk.  The hotel was very clean and the staff was super friendly and helpful.  We paid 10 Euros each for the breakfast which was tasty with warm eggs and bacon daily plus fruits, cheese and a selection of delicious pastries plus bread and toaster if you wanted to make your own toast.  Lots of juices to choose from too.  We had a courtyard room (#25) which didn't have much of a view (but we weren't in the room much).  We did not hear any street noise.  The walls are a little on the thin side and at times we could hear other guests but it didn't both us or stop us from having a good sleep.  The king sized bed was comfy with 4 pillows.  The bathroom was a decent size with a large shelf to store all our toiletries and there was a walk in shower with lots of hot water (good pressure) and cozy large towels for afterwards.  Face clothes are not provided but when I asked they did supply me with a version of a wash cloth.  It reminded me of a  synthetic paper towel.  There were 3 English channels on the TV and a mini fridge which we used to store our own bottled water and a handful of groceries we bought.  We used the safe to store our extra cash and passports.  

My only complaint would be the closet.  Although there was lots of shelves to unpack clothes, the hanging section was very frustrating.  The closet was not deep enough so the hangers had to rest on an angle.  They had those annoying type where the hook is permanent and you remove the base of the hanger.  Every time I went to put something back inside I'd knock the previous one down.  

Overall, the hotel was wonderful.  We would happily stay again.

All 39 of the hotel's rooms have a private ensuite bathroom, international television, high-speed wi-fi access, a courtesy tray, a minibar, a bathrobe, luxury welcome products....The reception is also there to generously welcome you 24/7 and to make sure that your Parisian stay is a success.

title: Absolute TOP hotel
text:
What a service, what a room, what a hotel. 
An absolute recommendation. 
The staff wil help you with any question. 
I really can't think of any downsides.
we really enjoyed our stay from the first to the last minute

text:
Fab trip, The staff are lovely & so eager to ensure we had a fab stay. (from transport to/ from the hotel, to restaurants & shopping)..

The took looked after bags as we arrived early, then the bags were waiting in our room when we got back that evening. The room was spotless every day. Shower had decent water pressure and the water was always hot. 

This hotel is located between the Louvre and Notre Dame, with restaurants nearby and even a supermarket less than 5 mins walk away.

title: Everything you could want
text:
We came to Paris to spend some time with friends to celebrate Lunar New Year and saw the great reviews this hotel had.

We loved the super convenient location and the moment we walked in we’re amazed by the classic aesthetic and cleanliness.

The staff were really welcoming and accommodating allowing us to store our bags while we went for lunch and wait for check in time. When we returned we were given our keys and they had already been kind enough to put our bags in the room.

The room itself is a great size, very clean and has all you need with mini bar, safe, toiletries and plenty of multi-national charging plugs and USB.
The bed was huge and one of the most comfortable I’ve slept on in any hotel. Show had great water pressure and temperature.

We had breakfast for one morning which we enjoyed and had a good amount of healthy choices.

If you don’t have what you need in your room there is a great selection of choices from reception which you can order and have brought to your room.

Overall I’d highly recommend this hotel for a comfortable stay and plenty of things to do within a short walk. We will be staying here again upon our return to Paris.

text: We had a wonderful stay at the hotel. The service was really good, our room was upgraded from a standard room to a room with an balcony. Just positive things to say about the stay. Great location, easy to get around  Paris from the hotel.

title: Cozy, Comfortable and Clean
text: A very nice, cozy and clean hotel in the smack center of Paris.  Location is amazing, the bed us VERY comfortable.  The hotel rivals with mainstream hotels as it relates to comfort and cleanness, however brings an old world charm and a personal touch.   The location is perfect, near the 1 minute from Chatelet and the 2 minutes from Samaritaine department store, restaurants, shops, metro, the river, etc.  GREAT VALUE for the money.  As with any hotel, book in advance.  WIFI is good, Airconditioned!

title: Perfect hotel!
text: We just loved this hotel! Perfectly situated in the heart of cafes, restaurants and metro whilst still quiet at night. The Louvre is a short walk away. Hotel was really clean & cosy and staff were so friendly & helpful. We will definitely return to this beautiful hotel.

title: Clean but overpriced
text: I found it well overpriced, not impressed with anything but its clean, staff is nice and that’s about it, they wouldn’t let us check in earlier than 3pm but that’s not a big deal, I wouldn’t pay more than $99 to $130 a night for this hotel, this price range is very decent for this hotel,  if you’re paying more than this range do yourself a favor and find something better.

title: Perfect location between North and East train stations
text: This hotel is almost exactly halfway between Gare d' Est and Gare d' Nord (excuse spelling).  There is a food store three doors down.  The breakfast buffet was delicious and very filling.   The staff was very helpful answering some local travel questions.  T was able to reserve a room at a very large discount.  Not sure how long these will last as travelers emerge from COVID-19 lock-downs.

title: Convenient location near Gare Du Nord to the Gare de l'Est train stations
text: Excellent location 5 minute walk from both Gare Du Nord to the Gare de l'Est train stations! The front office staff was incredibly helpful and friendly. We enjoyed the extensive breakfast selection including scrambled eggs, bacon, crepes, breads, yogurt, fruit, meats, cheeses, pastries, croissants, and fresh juices! They even surprised us with a glass of complimentary champagne and room upgrade for our 1 year wedding anniversary. We really enjoyed this hotel and highly recommend it!

title: Beautiful hotel
text: This was a really good hotel for the money. Yet the balcony rooms are very noisy. I know that can't be helped. But what can be helped, is the staff not helping us with directions to the closest subway. I politely asked the way to the subway and the young man folded it back up and said he couldn't help. I know I could have used an app, but I figured a local would be able to help.

title: Bad area!
text:
Checked out after 2 hours. The area felt dirty & threatening. Not the Paris we were hoping for in this side of town. Recommended not to walk around after 10pm. 
The hotel is very basic, not symbolic of a 4 star hotel unfortunately. 
Very close & walking distance to Eurostar but that is the only benefit.

title: Fantastic!
text: We stayed here for a couple of nights in August. It was brilliant. Clean, quiet and a great breakfast. We really liked the location as it felt less touristy than other areas of Paris but so close to Gare Du Nord. Perfect when travelling by Eurostar! The food in the local restaurants was also great. We walked miles and fell in love with Paris and Hotel Mademoiselle. We would certainly return. The only improvement would be a little more information at check in. We weren't  told about the spa or the times for breakfast. Otherwise the staff were very helpful and friendly. See you again!

title: Service and quality is very high at Hotel Mademoiselle
text:
If you are looking for service you will find it here in hotel Mademoiselle, the staff is very friendly and happy to make your stay comfortable. The quality of this hotel is very good, clean rooms, nice decorated breakfast room, very nice SPA and fitness room. The breakfast is very tasty with fresh bread, fresh orange juice, (scrambled) eggs, yoghurts and fresh fruit. I like mademoiselle because it's not a big commercial hotel but a nice  small (looks like a boutique) hotel.
The hotel is very good located near Gare du Nord and Gare du l'est, even close to the Metrostation Possionere.

title: Weekend in Paris
text:
Hotel is located very close to Gare du Nord, which was perfect as we were travelling on Eurostar.
When we arrived at the hotel we were provided with a warm welcome from a very professional reception.
The room was very big and the bed was very comfortable.
I can't remember, but I don't think it had a fridge which would have been nice.
The breakfast was amazing and the breakfast staff were very attentive and dealt with all our requests immediately.
Lovely hotel, great staff and a great location.

title: What a gem!
text:
So happy with this booking.
The staff were so friendly and helpful. The location is perfect and the rooms were very clean. Breakfast was great. Would stay here again and highly recommend it to friends and family!

title: Fabulous All Around!
text:
My mom and I booked 7 nights at the Hotel Mademoiselle Nov. 2021 and we had an amazing experience from the very beginning.  We arrived well before check due to our flight and while the room was not ready yet we were offered bottles of water and a comfortable place to lounge while we waited.  We only had a short wait and then were off to our room.  

We had a room with a lovely view of the interior courtyard; it was spacious for Paris with a nice bed, closet, and desk area. There were also 2 large sets of windows that opened.  The bathroom was very well appointed the shower/tub was larger than i expected and had a full size window that opens for air flow. 

All the staff that we encountered were very nice. They could answer all of our questions knowledgably and quickly. They printed our boarding passes for us and had a taxi waiting to take us the airport in the middle of the night.

The breakfast that was offered was well worth it and made for a relaxing was to start each day of exploring!   

Overall it was a great stay and we are in the process of booking the Hotel Mademoiselle again for Nov. 2022!

title: Homely hotel
text: Nice, cosy hotel. Rooms even on the street side were very quiëtisme, all decorated very Nicole and very good  breakfast. Staff very friendly and helpfull. Will come back ,next time we are in Paris. A little gem in the french Capital. Love the little matches

title: Perfect stay, perfect hotel
text: Every thing was good. Specially the freeparking! Good breakfast, beautifull atmosphere, very friendly staff, happy with the airco, perfect room. Close to metro Poisonniere. Nice possibility to use your breakfast at the patio

title: Clean rooms and excellent service
text: The rooms were lovely and clean and well equipped. Breakfast very good. Service was brilliant. They couldn’t do enough to help. Central location and very close to the Eurostar station. I highly recommend this hotel. Only one issue we had was with the air conditioning and they sorted it immediately ( it was probably our fault anyway!)

title: A little chique out of the way hotel
text: The hotel was very good. We all really enjoyed ourselves once we got the hitch sorted out with the right bedroom. .. and were offered a couple of glasses of champagne free for the hassle. I would have preferred if this information had been passed on rather than ‘haggle’ with reception at our departure!

title: A great boutique base for Paris
text: Close to Gare de Nord, very handy when arriving on Eurostar, but walk the other way down the quiet street and you’ll find good restaurants, a metro station and an easy walk down Rue La Fayette straight into the centre. We stayed for 9 nights in very hot weather. The hotel was our oasis, the courtyard was always cool and the air con worked well inside. Rooms higher up have more light and views (on the front) but courtyard is quieter. We preferred front but it’s personal choice. The breakfast is varied, fresh and tasty. But most of all the staff are excellent, very friendly and accommodating, from reception to housekeeping, all top notch!

title: Friendly hotel in a great location
text: Hotel Mademoiselle is in a great spot, close to the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est and within walking distance of many Parisian attractions. The room was pleasant, clean and comfortable, and the staff went out of their way to be helpful.

title: a good stay  in Paris
text:
Near Gare du Nord an exellent stay for a weekend /week 
trip. Nice hotel, good service. clean, and a good breakfast.
Staff is very helpful and location is in centre of Paris . Metro at short distance of the hotel.

title: Great value and service
text: I went back and forth on whether to reserve Hotel Mademoiselle or a fancier boutique hotel for 3x the price. I am so glad I decided on Hotel Mademoiselle -- we had a suite for us and our two teenaged kids, and although the rooms were small, they were extremely comfortable. The beds and bedding were very comfortable, and the bathroom had an amazing rainfall shower and fluffy towels. There was an espresso machine in the room. The breakfast buffet available in the hotel was very good with lots of selection,  and kids (under 18) eat free. The staff was very helpful, and the location near Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est is quite convenient. We enjoyed getting to know the nearby neighborhoods as well. Great value.

title: Great Location and service
text: We had a lovely stay at the Hotel Mademoiselle. If arriving on Eurostar the location couldn't be better and we also needed to travel to the Stade de France for a concert so the hotel was ideal. The room was clean and comfortable and the staff on reception were very helpful with recommendations of places to visit and travel info. We didn't make use of the spa as we had a lot to fit in!

title: Enjoyable stay
text:
The hotel is fantastically located a short walk from the train station. Was an excellent base for sightseeing in Paris. Our room on the top floor was comfortable and very clean. The staff are all lovely and friendly. Breakfast was plentiful and very good. The only complaint was that I had booked four months ago and requested a private one hour use of the spa. We were extremely disappointed to discover on arrival that our slot had been allocated to other guests instead. We never got to see or use the facilities. The reception staff very kindly tried to accommodate us with an alternative however this was not convenient as was on the morning of our departure. We did enjoy a glass each of complimentary champagne in the bar. 
All in all a very enjoyable stay and would book again.

title: Convenient location, relaxing stay, excellent customer service
text:
Location is key located between gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est  (only 5 mn walk)
Room very confortable, with air conditionning. The room was actually cool on arrival. 
Front desk reception staff members very nice and welcoming, always  happy to help. 
Breakfast full of fresh products- very tasty. 
Interieur design is very beautiful and original

title: Wonderful experience
text: We had an overall great experience staying at the hotel. Probably the best bed of all hotels we were staying, with high, wide and hard mattress and just the right size and softness of pillows that allow for restful nigh after long sightseeing days. Breakfast is wonderful with lots of options for everyone and even little patio sitting area for smokers. Hydro massage bed in the spa that is free for guests to use from 10-noon is awesome, relaxing experience. Hotel is very conveniently located to Gare du Nord and Eurostar and everyone in the hotel is friendly, courteous, and eager to help. Overall, a fantastic stay!

title: Extraordinary team
text: Hotel Mademoiselle has it all: a brilliant location (especially when one arrives by Eurostar), quiet and beautifully appointed rooms, delightful breakfast. But most importantly it has what many other hotels lack: staff who are not only unfailingly helpful and courteous, but who work seamlessly as a team. We arrived late in the evening and discovered to our disappointment that due to a misunderstanding the room did not have the facilities we believed to have requested. The concierge was unable to offer a solution immediately due to the hotel being fully booked, but assured us that the day staff would be able to help. When we came down the next morning we were prepared to explain the issue again, but upon mentioning our room number only found to our amazement that the day staff were fully informed. This happened repeatedly throughout our stay -  handovers between staff only meant that a different person was at the desk, not that the thread of the conversation was broken. Huge congratulations to such an extraordinary team - and to the management who clearly see value in not only carefully choosing  the staff, but more importantly in investing in training. We will definitely come back.

title: Charming hotel in an excellent location
text:
A really charming hotel in an excellent location for the Metro, Gare du Nord and other transport links. 
We stayed for 3 nights/4 days whilst visiting for RG tennis. As our timeframe was somewhat tight and we also wanted to visit some Paris attractions the reception staff assisted us daily with travel route planners, to save us getting lost and loosing valuable time! 
The breakfasts were delicious, and always served with a smile.
Beautifully presented the bedrooms and dining areas are first class. 
I would highly recommend this little gem if you are travelling to Paris, which was in a peaceful setting for a great nights sleep. 
I hope to return again very soon. Thank you for your wonderful service, we really enjoyed our stay.

title: Perfect for city break
text:
Perfect hotel for a city break. It is situated close to Gare du Nord (or de L’Est) so is easy to walk from the Eurostar and to jump on the metro. 

The best part is the staff, the reception staff were so friendly, very helpful and attentive. We came in late a few evenings and they asked us how our French was coming (gave us a much need lesson) and gave us some complimentary water! 

The breakfast has a good range of choice, it is not gourmet but ideal to start the day and rare to find a hotel in Paris with breakfast. 

The rooms are spacious and the showers are really good. Could do with a lick of paint here and there but all good generally. 

The spa is also free for a few hours in the morning for guests and is really relaxing for half an hour or so before you go out to explore.

title: Cute Boutique Hotel
text: This hotel was super cute and on a quaint little street not far from the action but still a quiet enough area. Everything was super walkable, or accessible by train (the Guard de Nord is extremely close). Lots of great food and drink options within a 5-10 minute walk as well. The staff was super friendly, a nice breakfast spread each morning and an adorable courtyard to sit and drink your coffee or have an evening cocktail. Great vibes all around, would recommend this hotel to others visiting Paris.

title: Perfect location, great staff,
text: 5 mins walk from Gare du Nord, I half expected a compromise in quality for the location but we were delighted with the quality of the hotel in general and the warmth of welcome from the staff in particular. There are plenty of restaurants nearby (Mamagoto 2 doors away is excellent too) and metro at Gare do Nord or Poisonniere are easy walks. The private session in the spa at the hotel was included in our rate and was a highlight. Sauna, steam, and hydro bed massage- ideal after a hard days sightseeing. Comfy bed, quiet, good shower, overall we highly recommend this friendly and hospitable hotel to anyone.

title: Great choice in central Paris
text: Great location, very close by the station Gare du Nord, and several metro stations nearby. Clean rooms, great breakfest, but what makes this hotel is the very friendly staff. Always willing to help to make our stay so pleasant as possible.. We had a great stay and will certainly come back!

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
We stayed in the Hotel for two nights over the Easter Break. The room was small but very clean. The breakfast was above average. 
We most liked the very friendly employees working on the reception. They adressed all questions and helped us to make our stay in Paris unforgetable.

title: Great hotel
text:
Just came back from a quick trip to Paris taking my daughter for the first time.
Can't fault the hotel, very close to Gare Du Nord so super easy from Eurostar. Very friendly staff and nice clean modern room. 
Would happily recommend.

title: Overdue Trip to Gay Pariee
text:
First time in Paris, had a wonderful time ....
Hotel was excellent, helpful staff, location was great,rooms and breakfast was fabulous.
Enjoyed my stay...🇫🇷
Moulin Rouge show was one of the highlights aswell as The Sacre Coer.

title: Another Fantastic Weekend
text: This hotel is in a great location, only a 5 minute walk from Gare Du Nord Station. Good for getting around the city and the staff are excellent. Rooms very comfortable and a very good breakfast. This was our second visit and we will certainly be back.

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Perfect spotless Hotel  in a local location near metro and bus links.

Huge beautiful breakfast.

Extremely welcoming and nice staff.

Room Perfect and relaxing.

100 %    could NOT fault it in anyway..

Totally safe surroundings..

Lots of great local restaurants catering for both locals and visitors..

title: Beautiful hotel.  Would have been perfect but very limited internet services was problematic.
text: We stayed here for 6 nights. Location is perfect next to the train station for the day trips we took outside the city.  The rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable.  The staff was super helpful.  The breakfast was great.  The spotty internet service was a big problem.  We were unable to get reliable internet.

title: Peace and tranquillity
text: This is a lovely hotel, perfectly placed in a quiet side street, only minutes from Gare du nord station and all its connections. Beautifully clean, very friendly and helpful staff, with a fantastic spa in the basement to relax and unwind in. Breakfast was delicious, plentiful and well presented.

title: Perfect for those coming to Paris by Eurostar
text: Excellent service and clean room. The serving staff at breakfast were so helpful and the breakfast buffet selection was great. Nothing was too much trouble and we left our luggage on the last day. We will definitely be staying again on our return.

title: Little Gem!
text: This hidden gem was the perfect spot for us. Breakfast buffet was the best, fresh croissants and baguettes plus fresh fruit everyday. My husband and I stayed for 6 days, walking distance to train station and metro, by Gard de Noord. Rooms are exceptionally large compare to European standards, great shower, they do have lifts which is great. They also have spa and sauna rooms. Customer service was phenomenal, everyone spoke English and are very helpful. I would have given this a 5 star rating except their internet was crappy.

title: Perfect
text:
This hotel was booked as part of a treat for my husband and I  from our children. 
 What a lovely surprise it was to be in such a superb place. Hotel Mademoiselle is in a good position close to the Gard du Nord station, due to mobility problems we took a taxi but I'm sure it is easily reached on foot. The hotel is welcoming, clean and has a lovely atmosphere.  A lift is available to the bedrooms.  Our room looked out onto the street and the traditional buildings opposite with their iron railed windows which I loved. The bed was large and comfortable and the bathroom  had a very efficient shower.    There is a bar available on the ground floor and a pretty area to enjoy the breakfast which was  plentiful with lots of choice .   The very best of this Hotel is the staff. They are pleasant, always available and good humoured in all our dealings with them.  A very special shout out to Antoine who calmed my panic when I thought I'd lost our tickets to an event and went to great lengths to try and sort the problem out for me.  I found them later and he was amused but showed no frustration about the amount of his time I'd taken up!   Antoine is a star.  We would like to thank him and in fact all the staff for making our stay such a pleasant one.   We would definitely recommend Hotel Mademoiselle and would return again once travel health regulations allow it.

title: Fun, chic and comfy
text: Helpful staff, nice, well decorated rooms and a great spa. Super breakfast in a beautiful courtyard setting.   There were lots of healthy  choices available everyday such as cereals, yogurts, all kinds of breads and fruits as well as the traditional goodies such as eggs, bacon, meats.  Also a wine and champagne bar. Definitely recommended!

title: Incredible staff
text: We had a wonderful stay here last week. It’s perfectly positioned walking distance from both Gare Nord & Gare L’Est. The rooms are a good size for Paris. Breakfast offered  a superb selection and the best bit was the INCREDIBLE staff who simply couldn’t have done more to make our stay any more perfect. The private spa is a lovely touch too

title: Highly recommend staying here
text: This was our first trip to Paris (from  Ireland) and we stayed at Hotel Mademoiselle. The hotel is a short walk from the Gard Du Nord train station, it is located in a small quiet street. The rooms are small but really well presented and so clean, faultless really. The breakfast is plentiful and always well replenished.  Breakfast runs until 10.30am and even when we arrived to eat at 10.15 the wonderful lady in the breakfast room was attentive and continued to bring fresh juices, bread, cheese, meats, smoked salmon, pastries etc… so a big shout to the staff in the breakfast room.  The reception desk staff were so helpful and polite throughout our 5 day stay. If we return to Paris we will definitely stay again and will be recommending the hotel to friends, family etc who are planning a Paris trip.  Thank you to all the staff at the hotel for your wonderful services, from cleaning our room to supplying breakfast and for helpful directions and smiles from the front desk staff.  Also worth noting the hotel is surrounded by many supermarkets that are reasonably priced.

title: Cozy Boutique Hotel
text: Excellent hotel close to Gare du Nord (12 minutes walk). Super friendly staff. Very clean and nicely decorated. Quiet street. Good breakfast includes eggs.  Only negative is WIFI  weak. Manager said they reduced bandwidth due to Covid so I expect this will get sorted as business picks back up. Will stay here again next time I’m in Paris.

title: Lovely stay
text:
Lovely stay. A warm welcome at check-in. Beautiful and cozy rooms, nice and quit location. Close to public transport and nice restaurants. Only negative was the beds, they were a bit to hard for our taste. Coffee and tea available at the room. Easy check-in, good communication in english
We would love to come back

title: Extremely warm welcome
text:
I have found myself stranded in Paris due to missed train (blocked roads). Coming to hotel Mademoiselle and being welcomed by Assane was a real relief! Such kindness and warmth is rare, he is a real asset to the establishment!
Excellent stay, highly recommended

title: perfect loacation
text: we stayed here a few years back & returnded as it left such a geat memory for us . Amazing stay made special by the staff here It may be a bit too central for some but we love that and the vibrancy that comes with it .

title: 100 % Satisfied service, location, cleanliness...............
text: Everything in this hotel is superb, value for money, cleanliness.  The staff could not be more helpful.  Everybody was excellent but a special thank you to Garmial at breakfast for his good humour and excellent service.

title: Beautiful, spacious hotel hidden in the centre of Paris
text: I booked a single room but was presented with a spacious room with Juliet balcony and beautiful decorative details. The hotel is quiet which is a miracle considering it's right in the centre of the city. You practically fall out of Gare du Nord and into the hotel. It has a big atrium where you can have breakfast, the breakfast itself was a dream for someone who loves croissants and pain au chocolat. On top of that the room was well AC'd and don't even get me started on the good water pressure I got in the shower. It's the perfect place for a trip to Paris.

title: Great hotel
text: Great little hotel. Walking dinstance from Gare du Nord and the lovely street in the 9th arrondissement. Small but very clean rooms with good beds. Very friendly and professional staff. We had a great stay.

title: Nice, comfortable hotel near Gare du Nord
text:
Stylish and warm boutique hotel just 5 minute walk away from Gare du Nord and Gare de L'Est. 

Rooms were nice and we had a nice view on the Parisian style buildings on the other side of the street. 

from the hotel you can easily walk to the Le Marais neighbourhood and Canal St. Martin which are both very nice areas. 

Breakfast was not very special and it took a long time before we got served. But I guess this is due to Corona and that in normal times there is a buffet where you can help yourself.

I did not use the spa so cannot comment on that.

Will be back!

title: Stunning hotel
text:
I spent three nights in this well located hotel 
The team was warm and really helpful. Also, sanitizer and masks are available for customers. 
The room was of decent size for a hotel downtown.
Top notch quality matress! 
I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Small, well appointed and very convenient
text: Within walking distance of the Gare du Nord, in a road appropriately called the 'street of small hotels'! The hotel frontage is very small - so is the rest of it - tall and narrow, built around a small courtyard. Rooms are small but well equipped, and the breakfast buffet is - by French standards at least - quite reasonable (scrambled eggs, bacon and sausage). Very helpful staff at Reception.

title: Perfect stay
text: Great place to visit Paris, clean romantic rooms, amazing staff, good breakfastbuffet! Love this place, 5stars! This hotel is close to Gare du Nord train and Metro on walking distance. A lot of restaurants surrounding the hotel even a great market with oysters and wines. A supermarket next to the hotel.

title: Long weekend in Paris
text:
This is the second time we stayed in this hotel and we were again very satisfied.
Location and Service are very good.
From the Gare de l´Est you can easily walk to the hotel 
As last time we had a room to the inner court that was very calm.

title: Exceptionally nice
text: Nothing to complain. Very nice staff, small but very pleasant rooms with a very good breakfast. Is in short walking distance to the gare de l'est and gare du nord, in a nice little street. I would love to stay there again

title: 36 hours in Paris
text:
We only had one night in Paris, and needed to hit the sights prior to our check in time, and the reception staff at the hotel were very friendly and allowed us to store our case until we came back to the hotel later that evening. We also had use of the comfortable lounge after our check out time and prior to our departure on the Eurostar the following evening.

A very nice, stylish hotel, conveniently situated, we would definitely stay again if we came back to Paris.

title: Don’t judge a book by its cover
text: This was my first visit to France let alone Paris and I definitely picked the right hotel. Within easy walking distance from Gare du Nord we found the hotel in a back street location which left a bit to be desired. The frontage looks a little run down which concerned me, but as soon as you walk through the front door, you’re in a clean, well presented reception area with an extremely well presented, polite, efficient, humorous, English speaking receptionist. I understand that not all reception staff speak as good English as the young man we encountered. All the staff we encountered were exceptionally polite and couldn’t do enough to make our stay enjoyable. In fact, I’d go as far to say that they were more than happy to go out of their way for their guests. Our room, (307) was small but large enough. It was clean and tidy and well stocked with everything required for our stay. The bathroom, though very small was also clean but could do with a little TLC, especially in the shower area. The only other area we used was the breakfast room which doubled up as the bar in the evening, but this, as you would expect, was also clean and well presented. I’ll definitely go back there again one day.

title: lovely hotel with the best staff too
text: Conveniently situated right next to Gare Du Nord, near the first day lunch place'Brasserie Flodere', and easy to get elsewhere. Just lovely helpful staff which makes all the difference - nothing too much trouble and super friendly. Also great breakfast

title: Absolute gem! Pretty much faultless
text:
We stayed for 3 nights, room was large enough with a really big, comfortable double bed. Bathroom and shower (not walk-in) was sizeable. The staff, all of them are excellent, nothing is too much. The two restaurant recommendations nearby were both superb. 
You are located around 10 mins (slow walk) from Gare du Nord, so perfect for Eurostar or airport (with RER connection). There is a food market less than a minute's walk away. 
The breakfast is wide ranging, lots of choice, don't think they have evening restaurant option but they will put out a lovely meats / cheese / salmon platter on request, delicious!
After a good days sight seeing, their small bar area is a cosy place to have a couple of drinks before retiring for the evening.
They advertise a spa but we did not use, so cannot comment.
We'll defintely return to this hotel!

title: Great hotel and well located
text:
Had a short stay at this hotel.
Its clean and comfortable... located close to Gard de Nord and Gard de Est, beaning getting the Metro is convenient... 

Access to the gym was disappointing as they whole gym was booked for classes.  Also no weights machines.

Breakfast options were good, and athe staff were very polite.

title: Relaxation & Heaven All-in-1
text:
I have rarely come across a boutique hotel as friendly and caring at the same time. They take away all of your cares and worries in the world and help to make your stay with them better than you ever imagined. 

The staff is not a staff, they are a family.

title: Great Service
text:
A lovely hotel, great location for our visit, superb service throughout especially upon check in and check out, very good value for money, clean throughout and good wifi.
I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Good value for money
text:
We will be back when we need a hotel in Paris for a short business trip. Business partner was convinced as well. Next time we will try the breakfast, so can't comment on that. 
Clean room, bathroom maybe a little too small.

title: It's the little things that matter
text:
We typically stay at Homeaway/AitBnB type places, but we thought we'd give a hotel a try during our second Paris trip. We are so glad we did. The staff was beyond accommodating. Typically, I get names and I neglected to do so. Every interaction we had with staff was really pleasant/entertaining. 

We checked in the morning of 1/1/2020. Our room wasn't ready and the front desk person offered to store our luggage until our room was ready. Within minutes, he found us a room, without our asking, which was an upgrade, at no additional charge. He had a dry sense of humor that my wife and I found entertaining and thought he was very personable. As we waiting for the elevator, we heard a crash noise from inside the elevator shaft and the elevator stopped.. Afraid someone may have fallen, we alerted a staff person passing by. He immediately ran up the stairs and quickly found a housekeeping person had dropped some glass in the elevator. He cleared the issue best as he could then made it a point to escort us to our room and answer any questions we had. 

Later that evening, we had occasion to visit the bar/lounge area. The young man working there was beyond nice and had an pleasantly amused air about him, which was very personable. Did we luck out and just happen to run into a few staff personnel who happened to be great? I don't think so. I sense a real effort is being made there. We really enjoyed our brief stay and most likely will stay there again when next in Paris.

title: Convenient for Gare du Nord, pleasant, helpful
text:
Great for being able to walk with luggage to and from Eurostar at Gare du Nord. 
Extremely helpful staff. Able to leave bags and collect for departure later than time of vacating the room. 
Excellent breakfast for France. 
Very comfortable bed.
Next to the local market for the arondisment. Which is worth a visit. 
Perhaps a little aspirationally priced but this is Paris for you.

title: Excellent
text:
We were looking for a boutique hotel close to Gare Du Nord for a trip from Charles de Gaulle we found Hotel Mademoiselle with TripAdvisors help, so glad we did. 
Excellent location, walking distance from train and underground. Front staff, excellent and rooms clean and sparkling!
Excellent!
Highly recommend!

title: Great little find
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights and chose it as it close to the Eurostar terminal but on a quiet street feels like a world away from it.

Location was great (lovely locals food market less than a minute away).
Hotel was clean and funky with a cute little bar.
Room was clean and I was lucky enough to be upgraded to a larger room for my stay.
Staff were really friendly and accommodating.

Basically there wasn't a single thing I could fault!

Would definitely go back

title: JonRAussie
text:
Welcoming and comfortable and a little unusual. (Why the red plastic elk head in both rooms we stayed in?) Contrast huge between this and 5 star we were in first-cold, huge, bulky furniture...This hotel is human scale.Tables at breakfast (nice breakfast) close enough to encourage interaction if you wish. A miscellany of languages. All staff-room cleaners, meal staff, desk staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome,whilst pleasantly amused at our French language efforts. Central location, reasonable walk to Metro, close to bus...
Easy address to remember Rue des Petites Hotels. Kinda cute. Would stay again.

title: Amazing Boutique!
text:
Location is great, walkable distance to Gare Du Nord! It is quite far to reach any of the big attractions, me and partner just rode the scooters that are everywhere to get the eiffel tower and Louvre.
We had spa access, and had it ourselves although small was very nice. One thing to say is that that steam room had a slightly sewer odour and didnt produce much steam. 
Breakfast is okay, maybe more options needed for those with any intolerances. 
The staff were amazing and so friendly, and happy to help! 
Rooms were so clean and beautifully decorated. 
Would stay again !

title: Very pleasant stay
text: Very nice and helpfull statts, from checkin, cleaning the room and chek out experience. Clean beds, sheets...good location also, walking distance to Gare du Nord and Gare de l'st ...  totally recomended

title: Very nice hotel !
text: Cosy hotel, well situated in a nice area. The staff is very kind and available. The hotel is very well decorated, rooms are clean. Great beds. The breakfast is also very good, with a lot of choice in fresh products.

title: Short but lovely stay
text: This was a last-minute reservation, as my husband and I got stuck in Paris when the big strike happened this month. The people at the hotel were really lovely - very helpful as we tried to navigate how to get to the airport without the RER. The room was also bigger than expected and super comfortable. We would happily stay here again.

title: An excellent boutique hotel
text: This is a very good hotel.  Located within an easy walking distance from Gare du Nord or Gare de l'Est, you will encounter no visiting anywhere within the city or traveling to and from other parts of Europe.  Rooms are clean and tastefully decorated.  They serve an excellent breakfast.

title: Great little boutique, perfectly priced and located
text: Just next to Gare du Nord, the pricing of this hotel really worked. The location in 10th was perfect, the rooms were quiet and nice, the breakfast was good and the staff were very friendly and helpful.

title: 1 night in Paris...awesome
text:
Pro's:
- location! 7min walk to Gare Du Nord, lots of restaurants nearby as well as a small supermarket.
- 20min walk to Galleries LaFayette
- lovely, clean and well decorated
- decent size rooms
- breakfast buffet was good - bread, eggs, pastries, cereals, yoghurt, fruit etc etc
- Staff: very friendly and helpful front office staff
- Rooms had robes and all amenities required for a short trip, even 2 small bottles  of water were provided aswell as a kettle and teabags etc.

Cons:
- pillows were a little too high for me and we requested a thinner pillow but reception said they didnt have any
- can be a little noisy for rooms on the roadside, as for quieter rooms.

Overall, highly recommended and we would definitely stay here again.

title: Great hotel in a perfect location
text:
A very comfortable hotel located 4 minutes' walk from both the North and East train stations, and very close to some great restaurants and buzzing nightlife. My room was very quiet and had everything I needed, including a very large and comfortable bed. Everything also worked properly and was easy to use - not something to be taken for granted these days. Having a window that opened in the bathroom was a very rare treat indeed.

The things that stood out for me were the friendliness of all the staff I met and the quality of the breakfast buffet. 

The staff were very friendly indeed and in a pleasant uncomplicated way, not "gushy" or over-personal. I was still addressed as "Mr. xxx" and not as some old school buddy.

The breakfast buffet was really excellent with plenty of choice. You don't see freshly-squeezed orange juice or yoghurt in glass pots in many hotels. I've had better hot food, and better scrambled eggs in particular, but this is not England.

My room was around Euro 350 for two nights, including breakfast. For the size and quality of the room and the excellence of the breakfasts I think it was very good value for money. The free tea, coffee and mineral water in the room made it even more so. You may get a free bottle of mineral water as a welcome gift in some other hotels but here I got 4 over the two days (being in a double room). Little things in themselves but they make a big difference.

I'll certainly be back!

title: Great hotel and staff
text:
Great location of you are taking the Eurostar early in the morning.

The place has a great vibe and chilled atmosphere and the staff are just as good.

I got eh buffet breakfast the next day and was please at the variety and service.

title: A boutique hotel that ticks all the boxes!!
text:
A lovely hotel tucked 5 minutes away from Gare Du Nord. The staff were professional, helpful and very polite. Though our room was quite small it was very well presented, modern and clean and we had no complainant. We had a joint massage in the on site  spa and if you get the opportunity you should make the most of it, it was a wonderfully relaxing well spent hour.
A lovely hotel.

title: All best!
text:
Many thanks for this great experience and stay at Hotel Mademoiselle.

We can recommend the stay, some highlights
- check-in & check-out procedure
- services
- breakfast
- cosy room
- Spa area

See you again. 
S&S

title: great location and exceptional staff
text: This is a lovely hotel in a great location. Very close to Gare du Nord, was able to take RER  and walk to hotel. Walked to Montmartre for dinner.  Walked to Palais Garnier. Good metro access.  The staff is exceptional: very polite, professional, and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable.

title: Cosy
text: Really enjoyed our stay - the staff were all really friendly and helpful both on the front desk and at breakfast etc. The Room was not big but very comfortable and the beds were excellent. The location is excellent for Eurostar and big bus or metro. Breakfast was also very good.

title: Hotel name should be changed to Cecil Hotel Paris
text:
Arrived at hotel and walked into acceptable lobby.
Checking in was told there was no room cleaning, even we were staying several days. You can get new towels, also toilet paper, by coming down to the lobby. Then when we got to our room, what a shock, nothing like the pictures they have on there web site. The place really needed an update, old everything, no pictures on the walls. No closet to hang your clothes. No place to put your suitcase accept at the bottom of your bed. Bathroom dirty, towels so thin you could see through them. We had a beautiful view of the above ground tram railway. Not worth the money. By the way, I loved Paris and will come back but won’t make this mistake again.

title: Overall very good
text:
We booked the hotel only for one night after coming from Disneyland as we had a day before heading back. Really convenient location and we booked the room with the eiffel tower view a bit pricey but I guess it's worth it also we had the family room so was very spacious and had a microwave , fridge,dish washer, pots,and pans almost like a home away from home. The metro is literally at the door step and there is a direct train to Arc de triumph and the eiffel tower is walking distance.  Now the metro being so cloase also has its disadvantages. You will hear the metro passing by and also feel the vibration. Its was not a game changer for me however was a lottle annoying at the beginning but grew on us a few hours later. Plenty of food options with McDonald's literally the next building.

The staff are extremely friendly and very accommodating. Now for the possible improvements. The breakfast is over priced especially because its a very small selection. Unless Breakfast is included don't pay for it. The rooms are  very clean but can be a little modern. Just beig picky  here they can have a few more TV channels in English. But overall a good hotel with well placed in terms of location and also access to food options. Good view of the eifel tower if you chose the right room that is.

title: Highly recommend!
text:
Stayed 4 nights at a one bedroom apartment, kids  slept on the sofa bed, no issue at all. Apartment was clean had a full kitchen even though small but it worked out good for us.

Our room had the Eiffel tower view on the 6th floor, you can see the lights at night. So beautiful. Even though it was in front of the metro line, we weren't too bothered about the noise as some reviews mentioned. 

On sunday morning there was a local market, we spent some time there buying artisan croissants..very delicious.

Also there is McDonald's right besode the hotel, and Monprix supermarket across the street, very convenient for families. We also had breakfast at a local cafe across the road, I forgot the name but I recommend the green cafe as it was cheaper than the other ones, and the breakfast set was good, omelets, croissants, baguette, jam, OJ and coffee/tea for €11.

Will definitely stay again if I visit Paris 🙂

title: Great Rooms-Needs to turn up AC
text: This hotel was perfect for two couples. The configuration of the rooms is such that both couples will have privacy, although one of the couples will be sleeping on a sofa bed. The mini kitchen in the apartment has everything you could possibly need, and the bathrooms are configured so that the toilet is in a separate room from the sink and shower, also allowing for a bit more privacy if more than one couple is sharing an apartment. There is complimentary water and coffee available in the lobby. The only reasons I am giving this hotel an average rating is due to room cleanliness/repair issues (there was blood spattered all over a curtain in the room, and one of the bathroom doors would not close properly due to the fact that it had obviously been bashed in at some point) and the fact that they have the air conditioning turned off. You can turn it on and hear it functioning, but there is no cool air being circulated. Depending on what time of year you are visiting, Paris is much too hot to not have at least some functioning air conditioning, even the lobby was a bit stifling.

title: bad service
text:
the location is very good you have everything next to the hotel ! walk distance to the Eiffel Tower to make a jogging in the morning.
next to Champs Elysees by walk

when I check in at 22:00 the receptionist was not nice he didn't say hello directly give me to sign the form and tell me how much I need to paid!
As director of the reception where I live, it was not a good reception (and it has nothing to do if I check in at 12:00 or 10:00 p.m.) and I was really very disappointed! He did not explain to me for breakfast (despite that it was not included in my reservation but if I wanted to take it?) and that there is a coffee machine for hotel guests, if there is one passwords for wifi ect.....all i need to have
Even during my stay of 1 week the receptionists were not so helpful with me when I asked for a service (so I no longer wanted to ask what it was) and really know it's a shame!
Even for my check out I asked to put my suitcases in the Baggage room, they made me happy that I put it!!!!
in the bathroom the soap was already used everything was old 
badly hanging curtain, dirty curtains ect....
i will never come back to this Apart Hotel

title: Great Stay! First Trip to Paris
text:
This hotel was recommended by our Travel Advisor for our first trip to Paris and did not disappoint.  The location is  wonderful and it is a very easy walk up to the Eiffel Tower.  The front desk staff was very helpful and kind with suggestions and directions especially Valentina!  

The rooms are a great size and having the apartment style set up is wonderful.  We had an amazing view from our rooms and could not have asked for more to make our little home away from home feel great while we were there!

title: Great apartment, convenient location
text: This was a "big birthday" trip for 3 senior friends.  We stayed 7 nights and found the hotel very safe and convenient.  Our apartment (312) had a view of the Eiffel Tower and was a good layout with K bdr and a split pull-out sofa in living area, plus table/4 chairs, mini-kitchen and split bath.  It was small, but larger than we expected given typical European hotel room sizes.  We didn't eat at the hotel; bought pastries/yogurt/berries/cheeses/wine nearby.  The metro was just across the street, so perfect for convenience; some noise but didn't bother us at night.  Many cafes, small shops, plus a yummy bakery nearby.  The staff was very helpful, especially Valentina who did our check-in and continued to help us throughout with metro assistance, suggestions, etc always with a smile.

title: Fab location , decent stay .
text:
Daily cleaning not available , clear own garbage , breakfast is a bit overpriced , reception staff is very helpful . 
We stayed for 3 nights - it was decent , supermarket next door , MC Donalds , sushi , next door , diagonally opp restaurant awesome food , very good location …… we walked to Eiffel Tower 15/20 mins max .

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text: We were at the hotel for 5 nights and it was a great location to be at! With 2 kids, there was enough room and it was a spacious apartment. Loved going to the nearby cafes, walked to Eiffel Tower in the evening, and strolled around at the bakeries, everything was within walking distance and I highly recommend the place! It was very clean and safe!

title: 2 night stay with view
text: Unfortunately not the best of stays at Citadines and quite upset. We arrived at the hotel around 11am to check our bags in and pay the full amount, we then returned at 4pm to check into our room. We were told to take a seat and waited nearly half an hour without being told anything except 'someone is checking it', but it was very obvious the room was not cleaned as the women can down with a cloth and spray to tell them its okay! We received free breakfast the next morning as an apology what helped but I preferred if they were more honest about the room not being ready.  When we got to our room we impressed by the view, but unfortunately that quickly changed when we realized we were right next to a metro station. This was quite loud every night and extremely disappointing for the price we payed. It was my partners birthday which she made them aware, the hotel didn't say anything about this, I understand it isn't mandatory but it does go a long way to show respect. When we checked into our next hotel they were much more friendly and expressed their interest in the birthday. The staffs English wasn't so strong, I am in belief this is not a hotel I'd suggest to a foreign tourist, this seems like a much more local hotel with the guests. On checkout the women on reception was not made aware of our complimentary breakfast but in the end took our word on it. We got back home to realize we left two items on the bed. We emailed the hotel and didn't receive a reply, so I called them for them to say no we haven't got the item, when it was left on the bed quite obviously left, so the cleaner must of binned it and failed to admit it was there. They said they couldn't check properly till Wednesday, which didn't make any sense as they must of already been in the room for the next guests? There seems to be many problems with communication in the hotels staff, after checking into our second hotel it made us upset to not spend the two nights at this place instead. If you are on a budget and want something close to the Eiffel tower then maybe this is an option but unfortunately I cannot see myself staying here again.

title: Awful!! Avoid!
text:
After paying in full at check in I was told the room
would be ready “in 20 minutes”. Rather than standing in a cramped reception we went across the road for a coffee (husband and 2 small
Kids). On our return we were given our keys.. go to our 1 bed apartment to find dirty towels on floor of bathroom and a suitcase and food wrappers in bedroom !!! We go back to reception and complete chaos. No one knew what was going on or who was in our room. 4 ladies in reception making many phone calls and looking intently at computers and refusing to give me any information, apologies or assurances. My 2 children extremely tired and becoming increasingly upset. After 2 hours from (from start of check in) manager finally appears and confirms no hotel room available for us. I had to frantically Google a new hotel room and make own arrangements to ensure I had somewhere to sleep.

title: Another great stay!
text: This place has become our home in Paris. We know the area very well as we lived around for some time, and staying here allows us to reconnect with our old area. The front desk staff is amazing, and the property is very well kept. We had another Eiffel Tower view studio, and waking up to that spectacular view was amazing. The studio was very spacious and had all the basics. The hotel is well connected by Metro and Bus and you can get anywhere very quick. Overall a recommended place to stay.

title: Amazing front desk people
text:
I want to start by saying , it’s this was one of the best vacations ever for me and my little one and the hospitality of the hotel staff just made it so much better!  We arrived in Paris extremely early and they were so accommodating, on top of that the ladies and gentlemen who work the front desk are so pleasant and nice! There is one girl that stood out , i didn’t get her name but she has black hair , she made my daughter feel so special and she even volunteered to be our photographer when she saw me struggling to get a good picture! I will definitely return to Paris and this will be where  I stay. 

Other major points for the hotel - it’s not really a hotel but apartments like which have more room.

Also location is a blessing, there are so many shops ,McDonald, pharmacies and super markets right around. 

The residence is also a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. Can’t beat that .

title: One of my Best Stays Ever
text: What a fantastic stay, and great value for money from a very caring and professional team. Amazing views from a good-sized room, bright and spacious with full amenities like a small studio with kitchenette, TV, wifi, safe etc... was a real delight. The hotel is super well situated in the midst of town, with convenient shopping, great restaurants and the metro, surprisingly quiet, right at your door. A traveller's dream!!! Bravo and thank you everyone.

title: Amazing hotel!
text: Wow, wow, wow, just come back from a weekend trip to Paris, I LOVED this hotel, the bed was so comfy, the room was super clean, we had so many amenities like a kitchen area, tv, wifi, safe etc. We had the best room in the hotel by far, it was absolutely perfect, my highlight was watching the Eiffel Tower lights from lying in bed! I can’t thank the staff enough for giving us that room, the staff were so polite and helpful, such an amazing hotel!

title: UK review
text: Had a Eiffel tower balcony view room and the view did not disappoint was absolutely amazing and so nice to see everyone from the room or balcony. Staff at reception were nice and was no problem in checking out 1 hour later for free. Very clean hotel.

title: Amazing views
text:
Truly enjoyed my 3 night stay here. Modern, spacious, clean room with amazing views of the Eiffel Tower, which was the main reason why I booked this hotel.
Great location, near  3 subway lines , bakery, supermarket, restaurants.
Would gladly book again.

title: It doesn't worth the price
text:
I paid for a room with a view of the Tower Eiffel, (as I saw in the picture of the room) but neither from the bed or the table, I could see that, I needed to go to the balcony to see it. The option of breakfast was terrible and expensive. The fire alarm rang in the corridor for nothing. I stayed in another hotel days before that was much better and much cheaper.
I don't recommend it to anyone. it doesn't worth the price.

title: Dont stay here esp if it's your first time in Paris
text: We arrived early after travel difficulties, and were not surprised to find our room wasnt available early. We were exhausted and had an evening appointment, so getting in at least on time and having time to clean up and rest was important. After 4 hours wait, knowing we were available, and well after our room was supposed to be free it still wasnt ready, they simply coldly said "no, its not ready yet, try again in a half hour." No apology for running late, nothing. When we finally got in later it was not the twin bedroom we reserved, and the bedside lights didnt even work, infact one was falling off of the wall. The bed was very uncomfortable. There were no USB chargers, and for one person to read in bed all the lights had to be left on. The curtain was hanging with several hooks off also. Aside from this the simple efficiency apartment was adequate, and had a view of te Eiffel Tower as promised. The promised available breakfast however, one of the reasons we had stayed here, was not available "we just have a bag" they shrugged. This a year and a half into COVID, when many hotels have been able to offer lovely COVID safe breakfast options. They should have updated their site to indicate that this was not available, so as not to deceive customers. The doors to the hotel are always locked, often front desk was unmanned, and when it was, with one exception in 4 days, no one ever even bothered to look up in greeting, while guests were entering or leaving, even though they were never with another guest. Other than one evening desk worker (a young man), everyone was cold and indifferent, and one middle aged man even actively refused to help answer questions myself and another guest had one evening. He just waived us off rudely and went back to eating in the back. Before you say-"Well, this in France, that is how people are", in every SINGLE shop, restuarant, tour, museum, everyone was friendly, and said "bonjour, bon soir", etc, everyone except our own hotel. Unless you just want an uncomfortable bed in a convenient area, and dont care about non-functioning things in a room and no promised breakfast available, and a cold, detatched, uncaring staff, I recommend staying elsewhere. They really made my daughters graduation trip less enjoyable. There are many other places to stay.

title: Avoid - Unaccommodating - probably reflects their service
text:
My interactions with this hotel was far from favorable. If you want to stay somewhere hospitable, avoid this place at all costs. I called ahead and asked for my reservation to be moved by a day because of flight delays that put me back a day. After the hotel attendant confirmed that there WAS room and he’d “do all that he can to help” but because I booked through Booking.com, I’d have to go through them. Which is okay! He tried guilt-tripping me talking about Booking.com’s commission fees -which has nothing to do with me.
