And so I asked Booking.com and they said they’d be happy to ask the hotel considering that me arriving in the country a day late was out of my control. The same hotel person denied my request, even after taking my money and confirming they have room.
Go elsewhere. There’s plenty of other options!

title: Excellent amenities, stone throw from Eiffel Tower
text:
Came here during the 8pm curfew, the ample restaurants, supermarkets and bakeries around meant take-out and food delivery is no problem at all.

5 minutes walk to the Parc du Champ De Mars where the  Eiffel Tower is.

title: Excellent stay in Paris
text: We stayed at the Citadines Tour Eiffel during a 5-day visit to Paris. Chose this hotel because we used to live and work in this area so being in a familiar place was a must for us. Directly across the Metro station, you can get to any place in Paris in less than 40 minutes. The service was excellent and the studio was very cozy. But what we love the most was the view from our terrace. The stunning view of the Eiffel Tower reminded us the beauty of the city. We will stay here again whenever we visit Paris.

title: Good location, average service and no free housekeeping
text:
Check in at the hotel was relatively smooth. The deluxe room was spacious, clean and air-conditioned and offered an amazing view of the Eiffel tower. 

The location is unbeatable- close to the metro and plenty of cafes and bistros. On the second night the flush of the toilet did not work, so when I advised reception, she was very curt and abrupt and said I had to wait 30 minutes before anyone could come solve my problems. I asked for an alternate room, but not a possibility. Please keep in mind this was already almost 9.30pm at night and I was ready to unwind after a very long day of walking in the Paris heat. A kind staff member showed up 30 minutes later and did a quick fix.

The kitchenette offers basic kitchen utensils, but bring your own coffee/tea. Additionally, I had to rewash some of the mugs and plates as they were a bit dirty and were chipped. 

The biggest downside for me: There is NO housekeeping offered unless you want to fork out an exorbitant daily fee. If Citadines wants to use the name "hotel", then they really should be offering housekeeping and especially, in times of COVID, the least they could do was take out the garbage. I would recommend guests bring their own sanitizing solutions.

title: Spectacular view on tour Eiffel
text:
Citadines Grenelle is the ideal hotel to stay with a breathtaking view of Eiffel Tower.
The studio is spacious , spotlessly clean and it is equipped with a full kitchen .  Located near supermarkets and shops with easy access to public transport.
A bit thank you to Mr Rabat for his outstanding hospitality.

title: very good hotel
text:
I visited this hotel  in 4 times, whenever visited this hotel , I was very satisfied with very kind employee / very good location / nice price
I am really recommend to visit this hotel to other person
of course, if i will have business in Paris, I will also visit this hotel again.
very nice hotel !!

title: Great stay, perfect location
text:
We had a 2 night stopover here on our drive through France as the kids were desperate to see Paris. We chose the Citadines Tour Eiffel because of its central location and secure underground parking (we had bikes on the back of the car.) Parking was €30/night. The apartment was compact but had everything we needed and was spotlessly clean with a good shower. Double bed was very comfortable with a decent mattress. Sofa bed mercifully split into 2 so the kids didn’t spend all night fighting over who had rolled across the halfway line. 

Management are clearly taking COVID precautions very seriously - single use pens to fill in the check in form, screens at reception, obligatory mask wearing in public areas, used key cards quarantined on check out and hand sanitiser freely available - so it felt like a safe place to stay. The reception staff were friendly and helpful (from a safe distance!)

I’d recommend for anyone wanting a centrally located apartment for a short stay in Paris. Easy walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and river and right next to La Motte Picquet Grenelle metro station with 3 metro lines. Monoprix supermarket directly opposite and plenty of places to eat and drink nearby (or a few stops on line 10 to the Latin Quarter for dinner.)

title: Citadines Tour Eiffel
text: Check in process is a strange one, you have to sign up to something? But cannot check in without doing so?! Wifi works great, excellent room! Stunning view if you have an Eiffel Tower view room. Helpful staff, and Free Hot chocolate/coffee machine in lobby to help yourself at any time. Walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, and amazing little restaurant across the road with amazing staff. Will definitely return and definitely recommend.

title: Wonderful View
text: wonderful stay wit a great view of Eiffel tower, and there is a supermarket very near, and dont forget the market. very good location with many restaurant. And there is walking distance to Eiffel tower .

title: Good location, bad customer service
text:
The location of this hotel is easy accessible to literally everywhere. Public transportation is just nearby and walking distance to the Eiffel tower. 

However, customer service at the hotel is extremely bad and feel unwelcome! There was an instance where I was standing in front of the two staff wanted to ask something, but they pretended inwwdnt there whilst continue to proceed with their conversation. It was totally unacceptable to me personally. No hospitality at all! Will never return to this hotel in the future!

title: superb stay at citadines tour eiffel
text: Très bonne qualité de l'appartement. Personnel très sympathique. Emplacement idéal à Paris. Une machine à café dans le hall. We had a great time and enjoyed the whole City. ideal is that the next Metro Station is right in front of the Hotel.

title: Citadines Tour Eiffel Paris
text: Stayed one week. Very good location near metro stop, lots of restaurants and short walk to the Eiffel Tower. Friendly and helpful staff. Stayed in a very spacious studio with an excellent kitchen area.

title: Eiffel Tower? Yes Please!
text: I wanted a hotel in a good location on my recent visit.  Not only was it in the best location, 4 blocks from the Eiffel tower, but it was clean and the staff was the friendliest!  I'm a travel agent, so I'm picky, but I will definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Very friendly staff Mr. "RABAH"
text:
Very friendly staff Mr. "RABAH"
Thanks to this I was able to check in very smoothly and accurately.
I also liked the first impression of Paris that came back every time. This is all thanks to Mr. RABAH.

- 위치가 좋아요. 바로 앞에 4개의 호선이 있는 메트로역이 있어서 어디로든 갈 수 있어요! 
- 근처 빵집이나, 레스토랑이 많고 늦게까지도 치안이 괜찮은거 같아요. 
- 근처에 까르푸, 모노프릭스 등 마트가 근접해있어요, (모노프릭스가 크고 종류가 더 많아요)
- 7층에 머물렀는데 에펠탑이 보이는 뷰라 너무 좋았습니다. 
- 어메니티는 부족하니 챙겨오셔야 해요. 
- 전자레인지, 오븐, 세탁기, 금고, 식기세척기, 냉장고, 다리미, 필요한 모든게 있어요. 
- 총 7박했는데 중간에 청소 한번 해주셨어요.
- 필요한 수건이나 쓰레기는 2층인가 가서 가져올수도 버릴 수도 있었습니다. 
- 세면대 물이 잘 안내려가더라구요
- 바로 앞에 메트로가 있어서 소음이 있긴한데 창문 닫으면 괜찮아요.

title: a great hotel to stay in paris
text: a great extraordinary location,a very energetic commercial area, you have a lot of nice restaurants and famous shopping stores also monoprix hypermarket is cross the corner, very comfy & clean studios fully equipped

title: Great location
text: Stayed at this hotel with my boyfriend on the next stop of our trip. Hotel was clean, staff was friendly and helpful. Room was a nice size and clean.   The only reason I didn’t give it 5 stars is the AC didn’t really get cold.  We were hot at night sleeping. Other than that I have nothing bad to say about this hotel.

title: Citadines Apart Hotel
text: Good value far a good sleep, near to centre just 1.1km to eifel.. its a short trip but i can sleep well in this hotel apart.. near the hotel you can find coffee shop and mini market.. danke well .. !!!

title: Staff are rude & breakfast is terrible
text:
The staff here are so rude. We were waiting to talk to someone at reception & the person who was on duty was on a personal call, saw us waiting and didn’t get off their call to help us. We gave up and walked away. 
On another occasion while staying here, we wanted to put things in the safe at the front desk. The person on duty sighed and said first of all that there was a safe in our room.  We explained that online reviews from people on TripAdvisor  said they had things stolen from the safe in their rooms. We were told by the receptionist this never happened!!
The breakfast at the hotel is terrible - don’t waste your money. It was poorly set out, the person duty in the breakfast room didn’t explain how things worked or where things were. We arrived 30 minutes after it was supposed to be open and it things were still being set up. The selection offered wasn’t good for what you’re charged.

title: Good accommodation in very convenient location
text: We have stayed here several times and like it because of the convenience for the Metro (three lines) and the ambience of the neighbourhood. Because we like to make our own meals on some nights in Paris it is also convenient for a very good Monoprix supermarket across the street and even more so on Sundays and Wednesdays when there is a market under the elevated Metro line. There is the most amazing choice of any kind of food you wish – meat, poultry, fish, vegetables, fruits, cheese, bread and patisserie and some non-food items as well. Unfortunately, the kitchenettes in the Citadines are sorely deficient if you  wish to do some serious cooking. Nevertheless, we buy a few extra items and prepare fabulous feasts on about half the evenings we are there and there is a boulangerie across the street where I can get our breakfast baguette for one Euro. Service at the desk is friendly and helpful and the studio apartments are rather small but just okay for two people.

title: Wonderful stay!
text: My daughter and I had a wonderful week in this hotel! It’s very clean, staff is polite and helpful and the location is super convenient.  Directly across from a metro station, lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance.   We had a view of the Eiffel Tower in the distance.  Lovely evening walks to the Eiffel Tower was an added bonus!

title: Underwhelmed.  Apartment more than a hotel.
text:
Family of four from US visiting Paris for first time. Location picked by travel agent. We would not choose to stay here again if opportunity arises. 

Room:  this location is more of an apartment than hotel especially thinking about some of the services you may expect in a hotel (housekeeping, room service).  We had a spacious room with a bdrm with a king bed and a sofa sleeper in another room that folded out to 2 twin beds so it can sleep 4 comfortably.  On arrival, the room was clean but there is no housekeeping and you have to get your own towels and supplies.  If we wanted to stay in apartment, we would have used airbnb. 

I have seen reviews about view of eiffel tower. well - we didnt have one. The location is near the Eiffel (15 min walk). Having the metro station across the street is convenient but if you have young children (stroller age) , you probably wont be using the metro much. Having a McDonalds and a grocery store (monoprix) nearby was useful. there are many places to eat as others have written in their reviews. 

Customer service: adequate 
Cleanliness: there was a definite odor to the hallways that was not pleasant (1st floor)
Breakfast: we did not participate 
Noise:  the disadvantage of being near a metro is the train rumbling by. But the main noise complaint was hearing all the flushing of the upper floors in our room. That was annoying. 

Supplies: the kitchen was supplied with fridge, dishwasher, utensils/bowls. We didnt use these much during our 4 days there.

title: Stunning views of the Eiffel Tower
text: For our last night in Paris we booked Citadines for the Eiffel Tower views and were not disappointed. We were on the top floor (7) and had a little balcony, and could see the whole Eiffel Tower. Stunning. A bonus to have basic kitchen facilities, but don't expect a particularly warm welcome from the reception staff!

title: Excellent location
text: The hotel  is located opposite to a metro station, which is very near to the Eiffel tower. Number of restaurants (Indian/ French), bars and pubs are available around the hotel. There is a McDonald's in the ground floor. Therefore whatever your taste you will be able to find.

title: citadines tour eiffel
text: best location.plenty of restaurants to choose only minuites away.unfortunately the best outdoor seating is taken up by smokers a lot of the time.easy 10 min stroll to the amazing Eiffel tower and the cruise boats along the seine river.train station across the road.we had aroom with a view of the Eiffel tower,a must.supermarket and café clothing across the road in the monoprix

title: I wouldn't stay here again
text:
I am a Citadines lover and stay in their hotels around the world. The Tour Eiffel location however, was not up to par. 

The front desk staff were very rude every time we encountered them, especially at check in. 

I would consider the location good but not great. We aren't big on public transportation, instead more about walking and the hotel was not great for walking. The bakery across the street with some of the best madeleines i've ever eaten made up for the hotel itself. The walk to the Eiffel tower was around 10-15 minutes and it was pleasant enough. There are some decent enough restaurants nearby.

The room was loud, very loud. We heard everything and everyone into the wee hours of the morning. The bed was uncomfortable. Not my favourite place to stay, sadly

title: Great Locations and room view
text: We booked the room with the Eiffel Tower view which is very nice. The room is huge with a fair-sized kitchen and adequate kitchenware. The supermarket downstairs has many choice of food for selection. It is great for budgeted travelers to prepare meal on their own. Perfect Location, just right outside the metro exit and a walking distance to Eiffel Tower. Travelers may need to pay attention that the hotel does not provide cleansing service but it was totally fine for us since we only stayed for two nights. The room is very clean and you can get new towels if needed. Everything is satisfactory to me.

title: Great value
text: Great value. Comfortable. Air conditioner typical European. The front desk staff can be quirky at times but meet your needs. We didn’t have an Eiffel Tower “view” room, but could still see the top half of the tower which was perfect for the lights at night.

title: Great long weekend in Paris
text: Great location to stay to visit Paris, close to Eiffel Tower across the road from a metro station and plenty of cafes and bars close by. Comfortable accommodation with all amenities and friendly staff.

title: most definitely not a 4 star hotel
text: the room is clean, but quite standard.  good bed.  wonderful staff.  great location next to metro subway station.  and good choices and variety of restaurants.  the biggest downside was that the air conditioning was very weak - in public areas and inside room as well.  the hotel itself as well as the room is not even in the same league as other 4 star hotels such as hyatt regency, le meridien or novotel in paris.  even 3 star mercure hotels (as I have stayed at several in france) has better amenities and atmosphere than this citadines.  am not sure how the hotel classified itself as 4 star when it’s actually 3 star.

title: Excellent Location with a Wonderful View
text: The room was nice and standard, but what stood out was the perfect view of the Eiffel Tower from our room. The location was awesome: everything was in walking distance and it was across the street from the train station. There was also free continental breakfast every morning. Overall, I would definitely stay here again.

title: EXCELLENT STAFF AND LOCATION
text: Excellent staff and location. In front of the Metro station. Availability of coffee 24 hours. Clean view of the tower on the 7th floor. Correct and varied breakfast. Good function of the air conditioning.

title: Exceeded Expectation
text: Hotel's location is excellent. There is a grocery store in one corner, several restaurants within blocks, metro right in front and an open market diagonally across. Places of interests are very accessible. The hotel is very clean and rooms are adequate and comfortable. Coffee and tea provided at the lobby is a plus.

title: a normal room with a nice eiffel tower view
text: A normal room with a nice eiffel tower view. The view was nice but one of my rooms smelt damp. the location of the hotel was great. There was a big mart near the hotel. I could see the white eiffel in my room.

title: June, 2019
text: Excellent location in the City of Paris.  We had a view of the Eiffel Tower from our apartment room.  An excellent small hotel close to fabulous French restaurants and a Farmers market across the street.  A great place from which to enjoy Paris.

title: Excellent hotel!
text: Great experience at this hotel!  It is clean, room is spacious, staff is friendly and helpful and wonderful location.  Visiting Paris for my daughter’s first international travel.  This has been a great location for ease with metro across the street and lots of shops and restaurants near by.

title: It was a very satisfactory place.
text:
Location : Nearby attractions such as the Eiffel Tower
Traffic : There are 3 subway lines, 80 bus stop, and many taxis.
Safety : There is no safety problem at the high street.
Shopping : Mongju Pharmacy, Korea Mart, Decatron are nearby.
 A clean house, friendly staff ...
All satisfied!

title: Good sight and transport
text:
We stayed 3days(26 ~ 29 May)
We consider effel view and covenience to go to tour sight.
This hotel coonnect to 3 metro lines.

We always saw effel in our room day and night.

We satisfied stay this hotel and recommend.

title: Perfect for our trip!
text: Great room, great location.  We had a 1 bedroom and were upgraded to Eiffel tower view which was amazing!  We were able to watch the light show from the room.  The room was large enough that we didn't feel cramped at all.  Bathroom was nice, as was the kitchen.  I was also surprised to find a washer drier, as everything i had read is they were not available.  So that was a pleasant surprise!  Also location was perfect, a nice walk to the Eiffel tower, shops and restaurants.  This is more of a local area then a tourist area, which i loved.   Would stay here again for sure!  Thanks for a great visit!

title: Comfortable hotel in the center of Paris
text: Very comfortable and cozy hotel near Effel Tower. If you want to have a good rest with sigtseeing, I wold reccomend you this hotel. There are cozy rooms with small kitchen full of equipment, good bathroom, clean towels and bed linen. It is very easy to go to different famous places from the hotel

title: WORTH THE MONEY
text: The reception is very friendly and nice. Room is surprisingly better alot than our expectation! Its clean, spacious and comfortable! Will come back again if visit paris. Very good location as well (McD, Monoprix and alot more is jus less than 30second walk)

title: That view, that room, very good option
text:
Reception: Maybe the week part of this apart hotel, the reception is ok but not as good and kind as some 4-5 stars hotels.
*You can get free choco or coffee all days anythime next to the reception :)

The location: Very good just in front of Grenelle metro station, is a studio so we just went to the monoprix shop in the corner to buy our food, perfect

The Room: Believe me, just pay the extra for the Eiffel view room, wooh, we were in the studio three days, to sleep every night seeing how the eiffel tower lights turned on and off in the early morning was great! what a way to go to sleep.

Will I come back? Very good option for Paris near the Eiffel tower, is not thattt close, but is near. The best is the view and the modern services of a studio

Suggestion:
If you plan to stay several days in Paris and close to the metro and everything like that, I will suggest this option seriously, you can save a lot with meals and is fun. Cool rememberings here :)
* high floor and eiffel view is a must.

title: Citadines Tour Eiffel
text: I would highly recommend the Citadines Tour Eiffel.  The location is perfect with the Metro right at the door, grocery store across the street, lots of restaurants in the close vicinity and a 20 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower.  The rooms are spacious (we stayed in a studio), clean and well equipped.  We had other reviews that complained about street noise but our room was facing onto Grenelle (with a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower) and we had our windows open the whole time and did not find it noisy.  It is a lovely hotel in a great location.

title: Best place to stay in Paris - my favorite!
text: This is the best place to stay in Paris! My family and I stay at this hotel every year and we absolutely love it! The staff is incredible! They are so warm and welcoming and kind! The rooms are terrific! They have everything you can possibly need! We travel as a big family with young children and the staff takes tremendous care of us! The views are gorgeous and everything about this place is absolutely magical!

title: Best place to stay in Paris
text: Everything was just perfect. I stayed at the Room with a view tô Eiffel tower and it was amazing sleeping every night contemplating its beauty. Location was perfect: right in front train station, bus stop, several coffee shops, restaurants, super market, etc. Everything I needed I could have in walking distance, including Eiffel tower walking. The room was confortable, kitchen well equiped and a very Nice, clean and spacious bathroom. I would definetely stay again in this hotel When back in Paris. Highly recommend!

title: Great Location
text: The location is very strategic. Near by shopping complex and just beside train station. Every Wednesday and Sunday morning, there is a morning market which sells fresh fruits, vegetables and seafood. There are also a lot of shops nearby.

title: Tired Apartment
text: While the location was good, the apartment was very tired and dated and smelt bad - in fact the smell permeated our suitcases and clothing and lasted our entire trip away. While the bed was comfortable the furniture in the lounge/dining room wasn't.

title: Great location but the hotel is tired
text: Be aware when booking this hotel that it is fully self-service - right down to changing your own towels. Location is very near the Eiffel Tower and Metro which can make it noisy in some rooms. Overall I was not impressed - the hotel is tired, it smells a bit, the beds aren't very comfy and staff surly.

title: Great accommodation in Paris!
text: Great hotel experience. Close location with metro line and very close to Eiffel Tower. Several shops around and supermarket directly across the street. Good service and comfortable room and large size.

title: Recent stay at Citadines Tour Eiffel Paris
text: Had recent stay at Citadines Tour Eiffel during our trip to ParisHad a great experience, very close to all tourist sites , great areaVery safe for families . Great restaurants, grocery stores , convenient stores

title: Nice staff, everything else desperately needs a major renovation.
text:
工作人員雖然服務周到，但酒店本身的裝潢以及一切設施都在廉價汽車賓館（還要是過時的廉價汽車賓館）的檔次。入住的人都應該是 1）沖著巴黎鐵塔景觀（只在最高的 6/F 和 7/F）和， 2）酒店的便利性而來的吧? 

訂房的時候，我提早 18 日前 email confirm 並註明我的額外要求。雖然所分派房間可能受到多個因素影響，但我最後成功獲分配到頂層風景最好的一間轉角房間，擁有 L 型露台，一間可在不同角度，日與夜都能夠完美地擁抱巴黎鐵塔的房間!!!!!

切記，大前提是要在合適的時間提出合理的要求!!! 若你於 1 星期前提出，而該房間有其他旅客的話，酒店可能無法配合。若你兩個月之前提出，酒店亦沒有可能空著那房間等你。不過，你可以自訂酒店一日起每個月都聯絡一下酒店，這樣人家也可以有充分的時間為你預備。

得到酒店方面的配合，讓我就算只待在房內都能夠拍照拍到最後一刻才捨得出發去已預約的餐廳吃飯，酒店的員工當然功不可沒。在巴黎，比這間酒店更用心，更願意去服務旅客的酒店工作人員並不常見。

地點方面也是一流，3 條地鐵線，另加幾條巴士線（因為怕被打荷包，我很多時候避而不乘地鐵出市中心 1 、2 區而選搭巴士，搭巴士去老佛爺也安全方便）。酒店旁邊就是佔地兩層的中型超市，斜對面馬路更會在星期三、六有中大型市集（約有 40 多個排檔和地攤。另外 15 區因為不像其他區般擁有特色景點，所以地鋪租金相較其他區段低，這卻造就了一個食肆林立的美食創業區域，十分值得饕客探索。

酒店的設施雖要更新嗎? 陳舊到不能，絕對需要。需要更有效率的升降機維修公司嗎? 我住的 5 天當中其中 1 部升降機都封著，正在維修，絕對需要更換另一間維修公司。房內設備需要大更新嗎? 房內所有東西都像是 90 年代一般平價汽車旅館的陳設，沒設計沒風格，絕對需要大更新。

員工出色，但酒店的硬件也需要接軌才會讓客人回頭。以相同的價格，除非酒店大換妝吧，否則我想我並不會再回來。

(我選擇不貼照片，因為我不想其他人只看了我的照片便跑去訂房，完全忽略了這間旅店的重大缺點。)

title: comforts of home
text:
Spent 3 nights here with my 3 Daughters. Loved the location right next to the metro! Rabah was most pleasant upon check-in. Spacious apartment with a view of the Eiffel Tower. Beds were comfortable and had everything we needed to fix breakfasts in the morning. Coffee machine in the lobby was pretty good and satisfied our wants. Nice market close by. 
Even though you are a bit “out of town”, the metro makes it super easy to get where you want to be. Loved it and would stay here again!

title: Location with  Tour Eiffel View & Apartment Facility!!
text: If you are not looking for 5 star hotel service but a good apartment hotel, this is the place!Right in front of the apartment, you could enjoy Open-air Marche`and easy Gourmet shops.Metro station is also in front of apartment door!

title: Citadines disappoints!
text: Had read great reviews about this Hotel/Apts,  yes, it is a good location, near the Metro and the Eiffel Tower, and good neighborhood.  But, the purpose of hotel when you are traveling is a starting point and ending point to your day on vacation where you can recoup and refresh yourself for the night or the next day.  This property is very "dated" and could use some "refreshing",  the carpets are worn and the walls and door ways could use new paint and touchups.  We were there for 6 days, there are two "tiny" elevators, one was out of service our entire stay, it's an 8 story hotel, so you either wait in queue to go into the elevator or use the stairway! Lastly,  i have never stayed in a hotel, where i had to go out and buy cleaning products to clean the smell of urine from the bathroom, but i had to, our's smelled so bad it was unbearable.  When i talked to the girl at the desk about the issue, she was indifferent, as if i shouldn't have really been complaining.   My family and i will one day return to Paris, but NEVER back to this  property.  The Citadines greatly disappoints!!

title: Great location with direct access to Metro
text: Had to request room change rooms due to clogged shower drain but front desk staff (Melody) very helpful put us in great room with balcony and Eiffel Tower view. Excellent location in great area with metro station in front of hotel.

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text: This hotel has a great location, comfortable beds, quiet, insulated windows, view of Eiffel Tower, full kitchen, lots of space to put things & a little sitting area. Extras were free coffee any time of day, umbrellas, dishwashing soap, a clothesline in tub.

title: Pleasant and convenient stay
text:
The hotel was clean. Room was spacious and comfortable. Breakfast was good as well. The staff was helpful and accommodating. 

There's a metro station right outside the hotel which made it easy to get around.

title: Just what we needed-excellent location
text: This was the perfect spot for our vacation. I went with my kids.  There's a train station across the street, a Monoprix next door, which seems to have everything we forgot and groceries and a McDonald's downstairs and sushi next door as well. There were plenty of cafe's along the walk to the Eiffel tower and food is amazing around there.  It was a very short walk to the Eiffel Tower. I didn't time it, but my kids did just fine with no complaints to get there. We had a view of the Eiffel Tower and it was a nice surprise because I wasn't expecting it.  I understand that only certain rooms in the hotel have that view and I inquired ahead of time and they said they couldn't accommodate.  I LOVED the fact that on Sunday there was a farmer's market that popped up in front of the hotel. Delicious food and fruit! Since you have a little kitchen and a little refrigerator, take advantage!  I read all the reviews for this hotel before choosing it and I'm glad I did. You have to go into the reservation KNOWING that it's not like  regular hotel. You're not going to have daily cleaning unless you pay for it, it's like an extended stay. You're not gonna have a pool. But we were fine with all that because the price was reasonable in comparison to the other hotels in Paris.... and because we knew what it was, they exceeded our expectations. The rooms are spacious. The pullout couch was really neat because it pulled out into two small beds, not a double like they normally are.  My boys enjoyed having their own beds.   I liked the free coffee downstairs as well and also the fact that we could do laundry for a very small fee. I traveled with the kids by myself, so I needed to travel light.  We only brought a few clothes and did laundry before we headed out to Disneyland Paris. The staff is very friendly and very helpful when I needed to find something for us to eat so late at night on the day of our arrival.  Thank you for a great stay!

title: Perfect Lodging and Location
text: I must admit I was a little apprehensive about an apar-hotel,as well as the location. Well, if I ever have the opportunity to visit Paris again, this is will be my choice. The reception staff were amazingly helpful and all spoke fluent English. Josephina and Djenny could not have been more friendly. It was immaculate and just what we, 2 women traveling without our husbands,needed. It was directly across the street from the Metro. So traveling throughout Paris was easy and safe. Several good restaurants and bakeries were within our block. As well as 2 grocers,Monoprix and Franprix. And of course you would guess from the name , an easy stroll to the beautiful Eiffel Tower.

title: Spacious rooms but some train noise.
text:
Loved the size of the room and we only had a studio however you can get alot of background rumble noise from trains. We had a room well back aswell. Room 204. I'll try and attach 3 photos. Would I stay again? Yes maybe for 1 - 2 nights because it is walking distance to the Eiffel tower. More nights and the train noise could get to you. We stayed 4 nights and it started to bother us. No problem if you are a deep sleeper or want to experience what it is like for millions of people who live near train lines like you see in the romantic movies. It's got very good 3.5 star furnishings, and if the price is kept down then it is... OK.  We liked how it is bigger than a standard hotel room. The studio had a decent kitchenette aswell which was a real plus. So, it's a very good average place and if you are a good sleeper then it's OK but not good if you are a light sleeper.
Only a minority of rooms will have some Eiffel tower views. Top floors etc however they will also face the train line below.

title: Great location
text: Very nice apartment, well organised and fantastic location. The only thing I didn't liked that we didn't receive rooms cleaning next day which was very important for me with two little kids. The rest every thing was great.

title: Great location
text: Website over represents the rooms on pictures. Amazing location, very friendly staff, very average rooms. They charged nearly $450 for a room with a view of an Eiffel tower, however the amenities inside the room were very BLAH to say the least. When we arrived with our two kids at nearly 10pm, the beds for them were not made. Very cheap bedding, pillows, blankets etc. The rooms are at best 3+ star amenity , at a lot heftier price.

title: Very nice and save area
text:
I found this small Hotel by accident while searching in google. It was a lucky pick.
Small room, but who cares.Enough for us.Silent neighbourhood.Bus stop to /from Gare du Nord 2 min.away. Underground station Argentine nearby. Nice simple breakfast with everything you need. The best of all was the cleaness of the room.
Lot's of restaurants minutes away.

title: Nice hotel at Paris.
text:
Nice French hotel, good location quiet and comfortable  clean room with enough space  staff was very friendly and professional. Coffee  tea water,icetea  and cookies available all the day for free.The breakfast at the terrace was amazing  we had a nice stay.

Co

title: Nice, boutique hotel
text: This is a very nice hotel.  Staff were helpful and friendly and service was all-round excellent.  We would stay here again if we have the opportunity.  The location is excellent, near cafes and shopping. The only quibble:  Lack of a safe in the room.

title: Great
text: Lovely hospitality. Really appreciated the attention and dedication of the staff. Hotel is in a great shape and perfect location. Would recommend without any doubts. I will definitely return whenever I am back to Paris. Hats off with this establishment.

title: Lovely Stay
text:
I really enjoyed my stay at Le 46. 
Very friendly staff, warm and very homey decor with spacious rooms compared to the small spaces you usually find in Paris. 
Great location, close to Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysées.

title: Group Work Trip from Lebanon
text:
Amazing service and super helpful staff! We were a group of 10 people, and we were all satisfied by the service, and generosity!
We were holding some meetings at the hotel and they perfectly catered for every meetings we had, by moving tables/ chairs in the breakfast room to organize it well. 
We would definitely stay at this hotel next time we're in Paris

title: Clean and Comfortable
text: Just a three night stay but found the rooms spacious and nicely appointed.  Not a fan of the shower arrangement and noise from adjacent rooms wear a source of irritation a couple times.  But would definitely stay there again.  Staff was friendly, attentive and spoke English well.

title: Really good hotel
text: The hotel is really nice, the rooms are quite big for Paris. Very well located, close to the metro, Arc de Triomphe, Not much traffic around who is really appreciated. We didn’t test the breakfast, but from what we heard, it is good.

title: Little gem near Porte Maillot
text: I had a pleasant stay at this hotel, the room was as described (the bathroom really small, but that was ok and expected, and it still came  with a heated towel rack), the bed seemed even bigger than described and was very comfy, they had a good choice for breakfast to cater for all tastes, and the staff was really helpful and friendly. The room had airconditioning, and there was an elevator so you didn't need to carry the luggage up. I can definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Very good hotel with very good service and room
text: I stayed here one night. Very nice reception with a very kind old lady. Very good room, one of the best rooms I've had in Paris for this price. Nice service too in the morning, and plenty of nice restaurants nearby. A place to come back to.

title: Very nice boutique hotel
text:
We stayed at Villa Brunel for a few days in July 2019.
Very well located in the 17e arrondissement near l’Arc de Triomphe- walking distance to metro, restaurant, stores, pharmacies,cafés, bistros, bakeries,...
Very nice hotel. Friendly and helpful staff. Clean and efficient room.
We will definitely go back to this hotel!

title: Saved our trip
text:
My boyfriend and I were stuck when our AirBnB turned out to be a dirty hovel on the Saturday night we arrived and were worried we'd be stuck. After a quick panicked Google, we found Villa Brunel and managed to book immediately for our two night trip, and were surprised at how affordable it was given the location and last minute booking (£166 for a long weekend in Central Paris)
 
The hotel itself was pure luxury from what we came from and we found it to be so clean and comfortable. The staff knew who we were the second we arrived and were so friendly and polite - Even the late night security when we came in a little worse for wear! We booked a double room which was small, but enough space for two for a weekend and the en-suite was clean and modern with a rain-fall shower head and detachable head as well. The standard hotel amenities were also provided, with others being available at the front desk - Including plug adapters.
 
It's set in a very quiet and beautiful location with some amazing restaurants nearby - Try Il Grano for delicious pasta and it's literally 3 minutes from the hotel! Plus, it was a 12 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysees which is ideal. 
 
This place is great for those wanting to be close to the action but want a peaceful nights sleep after a safe walk home, can't recommend enough! Thanks for saving our first weekend away as a couple :)

title: Great location, solid hotel for Business Travel
text:
I stayed at this hotel for business travel.     The staff were great, and bilingual.  Checking in was prompt, my room was ready.  Needed a cab to the airport the next day, the cab showed up right on time.    This hotel is a good balance between value and location.  The location can't be beat.  Short walk to Arc De Triomphe.   The breakfast is fine for me.  It is not a grand buffet, but note that this is a small hotel.   There was cheese, meat, cereal, cake, bacon, eggs etc.    

Suggestion to management, my room did not have an in room safe, I would be nice to lock up a few things in room instead of at the desk.

I would stay here again.

title: Good hotel and staff near Congress
text: We used this hotel for our conference and it was a great location to everything we were looking to do. It was a short walk over to the convention location and right down the street from both the RER C and Metro 1 which made sight seeing easy. The room was nice and the staff was consistently helpful and friendly throughout the entire stay.

title: Friendly people at reception
text: People at reception ( are very friendly and also provide valuable info about restaurants around and sight seeing in Paris, both in english and german. Hotel is very nice, cozy, and clean. it is also very good located for CDG airport bus and also metro. Nearby, there are number of specialized restaurants. Stayed at the corner Premium room overlooking two streets and it is the right size for a couple. Room was clean. At breakfast we missed the warm food e.g. eggs, bacon, etc. they were not available! and nobody was around in the breakfast room to ask. In any case we enjoyed to stay in Villa Brunel. Friendliness of the lady (also german speaking) and gentleman at the reception desk was compensating any missing elements of our stay!

title: Great Find Great Value
text:
A smart hotel outside and inside.
Room was a bit small but we were on the 6th floor (roof).
En suite still a good size with a bath.
Very comfortable and clean.
Adaptor available free of charge.
No fridge or mini bar but drinks can be bought from reception and are very reasonably priced.
Breakfast is 15 euros extra. 
Great location, we could see the Eiffel tower from our room.
Short walk to the Arch de Triumph.
Surrounding area is expensive to eat out or drink but walking around through the side streets you will find slightly cheaper options.
Staff were very friendly and helpful.
A great location, excellent value.
Would stay again and recommend.

title: Races
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights as we were going to the races. The hotel is very clean, cozy and in a great location to get the metro or bus.
The staff we encountered were generally very friendly but not so much on the day of the races. We had breakfast at the hotel which we thought was a bit pricey but we had a long day ahead of us and breakfast at the hotel was convenient. We were told breakfast was served until 11am but when we arrived at 8.30 there was no hot food available and was told by a lady it was finished, no offer to bring out anymore even though breakfast was served until 11am. There was still cereal, ham, cheese and other items available.
On our way out the weather was atrocious, heavy rain. We asked the gentleman at reception if there maybe an umbrella left that we could use, he just replied No without even checking. We asked him if he knew of any shops close to get an umbrella? He sent my husband in the totally wrong direction!
Other than that the staff were helpful.
We would stay again.

title: Great value in Paris.
text:
Villa Brunel is a very nice hotel in a good location. Le Bus Direct from CDG airport drops you a short and very easy walk away, and it’s an easy stroll down to the Arc de Triomphe and on to the Eiffel Tower. I hadn’t stayed in this part of Paris before and I really enjoyed it. Though definitely not a 5 star hotel, I’ve given it five stars here because irs such great value and delivers far above its cost.
My room was clean, very comfortable and quiet with a lovely window overlooking the street below.
The standout was the helpfulness of the reception staff. The lady on duty the afternoon I arrived was very welcoming and extremely helpful. She made me feel comfortable and relaxed after a very long and stressful journey, and as a solo traveller this was very much appreciated.
I highly recommend this hotel. Booking well in advance makes it extremely good value, too!

title: Clean rooms, nice staff, bad Wi-Fi, mediocre breakfast
text:
The room (15) looked nice but it was a bit small. It was really clean though, so that is good.
The wifi was really bad. I switched to my mobile network because it was so rubbish.
The staff was nice, it was a warm welcome.
The breakfast was very French, I have to say. In Germany you have a lot of choice during breakfast, but here is is very limited.
Room 15 is above the kitchen I think. I was woken up at 6 by the smell of bread. There are worse smells to wake up from, but I rather sleep a little longer though.

title: Excellent stay! Good condition :)
text:
Very cozy and well equiped room. Very comfortable bed. 
Great location, close to bus station and subway station. 
I think it's safe neighberhood. 
And also very helpfull and friendly Staff. 

Wifi sometimes breaks. Could be better.

title: Quaint Parisian Hotel Close to Arc
text:
Very pleasant 3 night stay at Villa Brunel. Ideally located to the conference center if you are traveling on business and want to avoid the Hyatt or the Meridian approach to lodging. Reasonable pricing for Paris and comfortable double bed in the single sized room. Please remember Paris is incredibly expensive and a 14 square meter room for under $200/night is a great deal. The rooms and entire hotel are updated with nice bedding, flat screen TVs and WiFi. Bathroom with showers are nice but tight space. 

There is great eating within walking distance including an amazing Lebanese place and a Wine Bar across the street. 

We loved our stay and will be back!

title: Delightful hotel with courteous staff
text: We paid a little extra for to stay at the Villa Brunel and it was definitely worth it. Recently renovated, it has been very tastefully decorated throughout- our room was spacious as well as beautiful. The staff are all courteous and friendly and the breakfast consisted of quality ingredients including fresh fruit salad, a good selection of continental meats and cheeses and viennoiserie. We wished our stay had been longer than 2 nights and will definitely return!

title: Lovely hotel in a great location
text:
This is a lovely small hotel. Our room was tastefully decorated with plenty of space, and was very clean. There was no street noise at night. The staff were friendly and helpful.
It is very close to the bus station for Beauvais airport, and also a short walk to the Arc de Triomphe. There were a number of metro stations close by, and plenty of restaurants. All in all, I would highly recommend this hotel, and would stay again.

title: City Conference Trip
text:
Booked 6 months out but still hard to find something central in Paris that was reasonable. Taxi from airport direct. Not far from Palais De Congress (less than 10mins).
Small manned desk as reception. Obviously an ornate old building which has been converted. Nice roof cornice plasterwork and quirky spiral stair case. Room slightly odd shape but large bathroom and shower. All clean and tidy. Noisy outside with revving motorbikes even on 4th floor. Was later back home one night and had to be buzzed in.
Good location for conference and was able to get to all the tourist sites.

title: Great location
text: Perfect neighbourhood to see the heart of Paris.. 10 minute walk Arc de Triumphe and cthe Champs-Élysées... metro station very close good restaurants near the hotel.. neighbourhood is very safe and quiet.. staff are very accommodating and helpful... would consider returning for another trip

title: you get what you pay
text:
Room was actually very small and the roof need 1:30 meter to touch the floor. couldn't take a shower actually. make sure you do not take the last floor room ( 6th floor)

team is great and very helpful. cheap taking into consideration his great and quite location.

title: Great Staff
text: Spacious and comfortable room, Great location within easy walking distance to arc de triumph.  Great area.  The staff was very helpful in making restaurant reservations and directing us to local sights.   We would stay there again

title: Good experience
text: We stayed at this hotel for 5 days 6 nights and it was wonderful. When we arrived the front desk person was very friendly and insightful. Although we have been to Paris before, he gave us a map of the city with the hotel information on it just in case we ever got lost. Be warned !!!! The elevator can fit no more than 3 people in it and that’s not including bags. Our room was on the third floor. The room was very spacious and the bathroom was nice and clean as well. There are complimentary slippers and candy in the room. The best part about the hotel was the location. It was central to Paris and the metro was 5 minutes away. There were many nights we came home too late for the restaurant to be open but thank god there is a McDonald’s 5 minutes away that’s open till 2am.

title: Standar room/great shower/clean
text: We stayed over weekend and the room was ideal for that type of stay. Standard comfortable double bed, powerful shower and clean room. Location was 10min walk to arc de triumph and the nearest metro station just 5min away. The staff was friendly and accommodating. We didn’t order breakfast which was €15 each.

title: Away from hustle and bustle yet central
text:
Villa Brunel is located in a quiter, residential area of Paris but in the same time only 10-15 minutes walk to the Arc de Triomphe. Room and bathroom were exceptionally clean and staff very helpful and polite. 

We used metro station Argentine on line 1 as the closest one which was about 5 min walk. 

Would stay at Villa Brunel again.

title: Great location, clean & friendly
text: Staff spoke great English, room was small but brilliantly clean and the facilities were great. We didn't choose to have breakfast there as so many amazing bakeries close by. Close to some awesome restaurants too. Metro is 7 minute walk and easy to get to anywhere in Paris. 24 hour reception. Can highly recommend!

title: Large room, safe location, good price
text:
We were very pleased with the hotel! The rooms were large for European standards and just right for an American family of 4 with young children. There was a flat screen tv, a beautiful balcony with fresh flowers, and two comfortable beds. Check in and check out was a breeze with very friendly people at the desk. The only problems we had were: no safe in the room. That's unfortunate, especially when traveling abroad and having important documents. The shower was very shallow and water wasn't draining quickly so it fills up and makes a mess. Worst of all, the tiny lift (elevator) got caught between floors which had us momentarily freaking out. We pressed the call button, talked to someone (elevator company?) who said-what's the address? Ok, we'll connect you to reception. Unfortunately it just rang and rang and reception didn't answer. Fortunately, the elevator moved back to a floor after about 5 minutes and we got out and took the stairs from then on. 
The hotel was clean and new looking and the area seemed very safe. A wonderful patisserie was up the street next to the metro with the best food! 
We would stay here again and just make sure we always take the stairs!

title: Perfect location
text: Nice hotel, good rooms and beds. Easy to find and to travel to by public transport. In the area there are boulangeries, cafés and other cozy restaurants where you can eat. I recommend this hotel for a city trip to Paris.

title: Typical Parisian Hotel
text:
The only thing going for this hotel is it's location. Walking distance from the Arc De Triomphe and Champs Elysees is the only thing going for it.  Otherwise it has the typical tiny rooms that you would associate with typical Parisian hotels and small stairwell and no lift meaning if you are carrying heavy bags you have to haul them up the stairs yourself.  Breakfast was included but limited in its options.

Overall the stay was pleasant but in another country and another city I would expect a much better property and a much better room for the cost that I paid. However if I went back to Paris I wouldn't mind staying here again.

title: Great value for a 5 star boutique hotel in Paris
text: Finding anything affordable in Paris is difficult at best, much less anything under $100 per night, but the Villa Brunel delivered at every turn.  Great locations, nicely appointed, immaculate rooms, wonderful staff - most multi-lingual, and amazing service at a great price.  We were so happy with our stay, that we were able to add 2 nights during our visit.  You cannot go wrong here.  Merci Beaucoup!

title: Beautiful hotel, brilliant location, no iron
text: We had a wonderful stay here, the location was very central and we were able to walk to the major attractions. The staff were very friendly and we were made to feel welcome. The main setback was the fact there was no iron in the room and the cost charged by the hotel to have things ironed was extortionate.

title: Great location (close to two metro stations of separate lines), very nice people, good prices
text: The hotel is very close (10 minutes walk) to Porte Maillot / Palace de Congres. It is very very cosy and located in a rather quitet area, at a join of two small lanes. Everything is clean. No problem with internet. Very nice people.

title: Great little hotel in a good area
text: We were impressed with Villa Brunel. The area is interesting not too touristy, close to a metro and safe.  The hotel itself is pleasant, clean and quiet. We would definitely stay again. Breakfast was adequate and everything we needed.

title: A fantastic stay!!
text: We stayed here for 4 nights and had an amazing stay, upon arriving the staff were very friendly, the room was very clean and very modern. We had breakfast included which was very nice, had a good selection of food. It is very close to the arc de triomph (about 5 minutes walk) it is also close to the metro, it's in a very good location to enable you to access the rest of Paris.

title: Small boutique hotel nearby Convention Center
text: Small boutique hotel nearby the Convention Center (Palais des Congrès) in Paris. Just a 5 minutes walk.  No need to use metro or bus ( security reason!). Clean and friendly service. Breakfast included: "extended European", not American, but more than sufficient. Rooms ( #25) are normal for European standards and clean. Modern stylish bathroom. Friendly concierge. Safe neighborhood. High class and low budged restaurants within walking distance. A good walk to the Arc de Triomphe and the Tour Eiffel if you don't attend the lectures in the convention center. Price/quality wise a wise decision to stay there.

title: Great location but toilet was too small!
text: Hotel is in a central location very near to Arc de Triomph. Room was pretty spacious too, however, the toilet was too small! I'm an average sized Asian woman, and the shower space was so small that I hit my elbow on faucet while showering. I also had to sit sideway on the WC because it was built directly in front of a wall which left no space for the legs at all. Given that the room is spacious, I would rather they give some space to the toilet for more comfort in using toilet facilities.

title: Three night stay in very hot weather
text: Upgraded (without asking) to large, comfortable room with a sofa etc. Very comfortable, clean, bright room. Hotel is convenient but in a pleasant, quiet area. Staff helpful and friendly. Aircon effective and much appreciated.

title: Modern hotel in central location
text: Not a big hotel, but modern interior and very clean room and bath. Comfortable bed. Friendly staff. Breakfast room is small, but sufficient and Continental breakfast good. The location at the Porte Maillot is very close to RER Line C and the Airport Bus. Very convenient.

title: Perfect hotel
text: Clean, pretty rooms. Quiet, sophisticated neighborhood. Walking distance to good food and the Arch de Triomph. Extremely kind and helpful staff. Delicious breakfast.  A perfect choice for my family! Air conditioning was a must for me, and we were able to get the room nice and cool. Shampoo and other toiletries were provided.

title: Very Nice Employees, Comfortable Beds, Good Location
text:
Our first trip to Paris began nicely when we were pleasantly greeted at the front desk by Renaud. He gave us excellent advice on finding restaurants in the neighborhood and on navigating the public transportation system. His command of the English language was much better than my French!

We booked two rooms and they were both clean and comfortable. Our sons had a room with two comfortable beds and my wife and I had a double. The rooms and bathrooms were slightly small by American standards, but more than ample for two people. We're accustomed to lots of drawer space, which we didn't have here, but the closet was big and had a shelf with plenty of room. For a 3-night stay, we didn't have to unpack much.

Breakfast at the hotel was worth the price. It was filling and tasty with fruit, cold cuts, cheeses, breads and hot foods. The coffee, tea, and juices were delicious, too. Our breakfast table also had a view of the street outside where we could see neighborhood residents walking to work and school.

One of the most wonderful aspects of this hotel is the view of the neighborhood. My wife and I enjoyed looking out the windows at the French architecture and watching the people pass by on the street. The light-blocking curtains helped when we slept in! We would definitely stay here again.

title: Nice and cozy hotel in a good location
text: First of all it is near Porte Maillot where we can find a bus to / from Beauvais airport. Second, hotel is located in a nice neighborhood with small restaurants, cafes, Arc de Triomphe nearbly and metro stop too. Breakfast was really good - high quality products, very delicious. Moreover, we liked bathroom accessories - smelled perfectly. View from the room - nice. Sleep quality was good, so this hotel gets 10 out of 10.

title: Loved it!
text: We loved this hotel!Its location is the best, just 10min walk from the Arch and on a side road therefore there is no noise and it has cute little places around it. We arrived and got upgraded without asking and the room was great! Renaud, the concierge, was absolutely lovely and super helpful. He recommended us a restaurant and a cocktail bar minutes away from the hotel that were the best we had in Paris and even allowed us an hour extra for check out. He made our stay even better and could not praise him enough for his amazing attitude, exactly what you want and need from concierge. We loved our stay and we would definitely go back!

title: Nice
text:
Very nice hotel. All the staff is very friendly and helpful and all speak excellent english. Room I was in was small but with a nice view. It has a small but beautiful and clean bathroom. Breakfast was great. It lacked in variety though. The food was very good but the same salami and cheeses every day. Some variety would be welcomed especially if you stay more that fee days. 
Recommended.

title: Very very good
text:
We stayed here for three nights over the Easter break. We Had a standard double room which was very clean, bathroom had huge double shower and this was hot and powerful, both were a good size. The staff were exceptionally helpful and knowledgeable and were able to answer any questions that we had regarding local transport, landmarks, shops, restaurants etc.

The location was brilliant close to Argentine Metro and Buses.. We flew into CDG airport caught RER B to Chatelat.. Then caught yellow Line Metro 1 to the Argentine Metro station .. Everywhere was well signposted... Arc de triomphe.. Very close.. 

Overall brilliant experience and I would recommend this hotel to family and friends....

title: Nice stay, friendly staff
text: I stayed here for a business trip. Even though I was in a conference all day it was close to the arc de triomphe and it was easy for me to get to see the city after the day. The front of house staff were very friendly and willing to help. The breakfast wasn't a great breakfast. Room was a good size & had all the essentials.

title: Well located but...
text: The hotel is well located, it's about 800m far from Arc the triumph. Wonderful breakfast and room. There is Wi-Fi available from everywhere in the hotel. We had some problems, the shower didn't heat water in one day, the manager increased extra fee for my child (even when we informed his age, previously by email and they confirmed the prices). All other things were perfect!!!!

title: A definite thumbs up
text:
Myself and my boyfriend chose to stay here for my 30th birthday in Paris. I always use tripadvisor to look at hotels first and this one had great reviews. 
We stayed for 3 nights. We flew in to CDG airport. Took train B to Chalet. And then line 1 to Argentine. The journey was about 40mins. 

The hotel is a 5 minute walk from Argentine metro stop too. I couldn't quite believe how well located it was until we went for a walk around that first evening we got there and stumbled across the Arc de triomphe 10 mins from the hotel. 
We were welcomed nicely and the lady on the desk marked on the map some good bars as we wanted to go out that evening. 

The lift is very small. And was a squeeze with just the two of us and our bags. But being on the 6th floor at the very top I didn't fancy the stairs. The room was small but had everything you needed. But all rooms in Paris are small from what I gathered from reading other hotel reviews on tripadvisor before we came. 

The bed was comfortable. The bathroom was very nice and had a shower aswell as a bath too. You can tell it has been refurbished as the room was fresh and well maintained. Being on the top floor our ceiling was slanted due to the roof so just had to be careful not to bang our heads. There was hardly any noise at night from inside the hotel from other customers and you couldn't hear any noise from outside. We had black out blinds and curtains so had a great nights sleep. 

Breakfast is available but we ate out so can't comment on that. Rooms were cleaned everyday and towels replaced too. The room was lovely and warm and so was the bathroom due to the heated towel rack which gave out a lot of heat. 

The hotel as I have said is very central and you can walk to the Champs de llyses. The metro and trains get you all over Paris. We went as far out to Disneyland on train A. The neighbourhood is safe and full of pleasant locals. Not full of tourists and noise which was good when you come back after a long day sight seeing. There was also a Carrefour supermarket a 3min walk away in the local square up the road. 

Overall Paris was a beautiful city and if I were to come again I would definitely stay here and have recommended it to my friends too. 

Also take public transport as it is reliable, cheap and really easy to navigate. We got a €10 one way ticket the evening we got there to get to the hotel. Then got a weekly pass which starts mon-sun for €27 (I think) even though we were only in Paris til Wednesday it works out cheaper as you can use it on the train, metros and buses. 

Thank you Villa Brunel for a lovely stay.

title: Great stay at Villa Brunel
text:
Just come back from a 3 night stay in the Villa Brunel, I chose this based on others reviews of the decent rooms and close proximity to the travel links. Ideal for just that, very close to Arc de Triumph and the Champs-Elysee, and close to 2 tube stations. 
Not much in the way of atmosphere or restaurants around the hotel - if you want somewhere near good food and drink I'd suggest the Latin Quarter.
Rooms are comfortable - but as with most places in Paris fairly small and basic.

Overall a great choice.

title: Very Good Balance Price/Quality
text:
My expectations when I booked this hotel due to location vs price were low. Once I arrived to the small building, the person who checked me in was not friendly at all, which reinforced my expectation, (I realized later that the other staff members in different shifts were very different). When I opened the room, the impression started to change; although room is small, it looked, clean, nice and cozy. The bathroom was very nice, and the distribution good. Beds are comfortable, and the place is quiet. 

The hotel is located 5 min away walking from a subway station (Argentine) and it takes about 10 min to walk to the Arch of Triumph. There are small restaurants and coulple of nice places to get sandwiches and pastries one block away. There is another  station not too far (Porte Maillot) which has more restaurants around

To improve the internet quality. I was on 5th floor but the signal was unstable and speed is low

In general, positive experience. Good choice when I come back to Paris

title: Good
text: Everything was good exept for the point that the room does not have a mirror. Friendly stuff good breakfast and perfect location if you travelling from Beavuais and you take an airport buss from port maillot 5 min walk

title: Nice little hotel in a nice area
text:
This hotel only has about 30 rooms - very charming and in a quaint, quiet area of Paris. Lots of restaurants around, quick walk to Arc de Triomphe and about 2.5km to the Eiffel Tower (for runners and joggers, this is very doable and safe). 

The staff (which is generally just one or two people) are very friendly and helpful. My only gripe with this hotel is that they lock the main door often, including when someone is not at the front desk. I came back from meetings one day around 5, in a rainstorm, and stood outside for a few minutes pressing the buzzer to no avail. I tried calling the hotel but it went to an automated attendant. Eventually the woman came back to the desk and saw me standing outside and unlocked the door. I can honestly say it was the first time I've ever been locked outside a hotel. 

Other than that issue, I enjoyed this place. It's the type of place I'd come back to with my wife if we ever visit Paris.

title: Nice and quiet !
text: Stayed 2 nights in november, nice and "little" hotel, nice and clean rooms + badroom, plenty of space. Deskmanager very polite and helpfull. Breakfast good too. Only 5 minutes walk to Arc de Triomphe, 2 minutes walk to nearest metrostation. Situated very central of the city : talk the metro and travel to the other side of Paris in only 10 minutes !!! Would book this hotel again for sure !

title: Well priced hotel for such a good locations
text: Stayed here for one night whilst on business trip. Hotel was in a good location, 5 minutes from Agentine metro and 50euro cab from airport Charles de Gaulle. Reception desk was professional and very welcoming and helpful. Had a superior room on 3rd floor ok size and very clean. Not too much noise from the street, stayed in other hotels in Paris where I struggled to sleep due to noise, but this place seemed fine. Good wifi connection. Only negative is the desk and chair in the room is small. Chair is more like a bench. Not great for sitting to do lots of work. Typical continental breakfast menu. Would recommend and stay again.

title: Nice location - close to Arc de Triumph
text: Older building, quaint hotel.  Floors are thin and you can definitely hear footsteps from rooms above you.  They serve breakfast, but I did not partake.  Teeny, tiny elevator can only fit one person with luggage.

title: Diane Daly
text: Lovely hotel, clean and comfortable, ideal location, ten minute walk from hotel to the 'arc de triumph'  where we picked up the 'Big Bus Tour' friendly welcoming staff.  Stayed here for three nights from 3rd September.  Wouldn't hesitate to book again.

title: Beautiful Hotel in Paris
text:
My fiancé and I stayed here for 5 nights in July. It was located in a beautiful, quiet area of Paris. We were able to check in early with no hassle, and found our room to be lovely. Our room faced Rue Brunel and was noisy during the day, but absolutely quiet at night. The room was clean and well equipped with fast wifi, air conditioning, and plenty of storage space.

Villa Brunel is located in a quaint neighbourhood with tons of beautiful cafes and restaurants nearby. There is a metro station 5 minutes away and the Arc de Triomphe was a 10 minute walk away.

I loved our time at Villa Brunel and I would recommend it! I can't wait to visit again!

title: Truly superb!!
text:
I booked months in advance and got a superb rate of about 65 euros a night. Upon check in I believe I was upgraded because I had an amazingly large bath with shower. The glass walled shower was big enough for three people and the bathroom itself was equally spacious.Bath amenities were high quality as were the towels. Air conditioning worked perfectly and although I don't believe there were English TV channels, it wasn't a problem. Location as many reviewers have pointed out is perfect. A few minutes on foot to the Air France Palais de Congres CDG Airport bus and the Champs. Ave. Ternes itself has many wonderful restaurants. Parc Monceau with its Nissim Camado Museum and Cernushi Asia Collection are a wonderful walk. Pick up a lunch and eat it in the park as many Parisians do.
Breakfast was 15 euros. Somne people say it is expensive. Yes you can pay half that for a coffee, juice and one pastry. I prefer to enjoy a leisurely breakfast with ham, cheese, as many croissants as I want with refillable coffee in a cheery cheery breakfast room with my paper. Trust me, have the breakfast. You will be happy you did.
Finally, the staffmembers. Professional, perfectly groomed, wonderful English and I have to say friends who left messages for me all commented on the excellent manners and response of the people who took their messages. My experience is the same. They made a small hotel experience seem like a 5 star luxury hotel. So all in all highly recommended.

title: A really good choice
text: We've been staying at this hotel for 8 days, the staff has been extremely nice and has given us everything that we needed. Great central position, 5 minutes from 2 metro stations and the Arc of triomphe. The rooms are small but comfy. I gave it a 4/5 due to the fact that breakfast (that may be included) usually finished half/40 minutes before the established time. Apart from it, really clean and nice.

title: Very good
text: Very nice hotel. Clean and pretty rooms. Very good location when you travel from the airport paris beauvais, because the shuttle service is a short walk from the hotel. There is also the metro with which you get straight to the center. Plus a tasty breakfast. I recomend it :-)

title: Very pleasent
text: The hotel is in a great location full of restaurants and places to relax the staff were also very pleasant and the room was lovely the only thing I found inconvenient was that there wasn't a fridge in the room or a safe to keep things like passports

title: 7 out of 10
text:
Pros:  Clean, great staff (all spoke English really well and gave great advice on transportation, museums, food), great location. Nice bathrooms.

Cons: no AC, beds were very small, no screens on windows, cost was US$160 in June.  Not able to use printer; only French speaking TV.  I wouldn't go there from July-September - just too hot.  Also, no screens on the windows, so if you want to sleep with the window open (because it is so hot), you might get bats and will get insects in your room.  We were on the 6th floor and had a few mosquitos/other bugs.

title: Fair
text: Basic hotel in a nice section of Paris.  Overall there may be better choices but hotels in Paris vary a great deal and this hotel is consistent.  I have stayed at Ville Brunel 4 times since it is close to where I work when in Paris. Each time it is the same.

title: Small hotel - good for a short stay
text: My husband and I had the cheapest category of room which was quite small - particularly because of the slanting roof - but adequate for a short stay. It was clean and pleasant, even with a bath, not just a shower. The breakfast was good with plenty of choice.

title: Amazing Location
text: The hotel was in a great location.  Right in the middle of everything. Room was decent size, beds were ok but they only provide one pillow and not a decent one. If they provide better pillows it would be a great hotel. Staff was helpful.  Breakfast was ok - coffee, pastries, etc nothing crazy but just the normal quick/free breakfast.

title: Adequate European style hotel
text: Few amenities, no restaurant, expensive continental breakfast in corner of lobby. We got what we paid for. Location good for our needs. Visiting family near hotel. Would only recommend as clean convenient location on a budget but if you want more, spend more. We had "Executive" room which sizewise was adequate. However, there was no chest or dresser to store folded items, only closet. Lighting was extremely poor and the toilet was located on one side of the room & the shower/wash basin was on the other making for trips to wc during evening hours disrupting to other party...light on left, light off left, step step, light on right wash wash, light off right, step step, well we're both awake now. On the good side, there was a friendly staff. Photo is street view from room.

title: 2 day business Stay Great location
text:
My Boss recommended this hotel to me so I know it should be in my budget.
I had a room on the sixth floor with a great view.
Everything was clean and the wi-fi excellent.
My room rate did not include breakfast which at 140 euros was for me a little expensive 
however this is Paris...
Staff were very friendly and breakfast was more or less what you expect in these mid range hotels in paris - sone baguettes would have been nice. 
The buffet area was however a little cramped when it was busy
As usual no fresh milk - one day hotels in paris will realise how much better this tastes 
price permitting I will stay here again

title: Excellent
text:
Excellent hotel.
The price was very decent, and the rooms very cleaned and well-appointed, with a large bathroom by parisian standards. Everything has been recently redone, and the hotel was conveniently located close to the Palais des Congres.
Quiet, with no external or internal noises. 
Breakfast was standard

title: Clean room, nice staff
text:
Plus side: nice staff, clean room, good location
Things that could be better or need improvement: a minibar would have been useful, the room and the bathroom were a bit small; also we could hear the people walking on the floor upstairs and the room next to us, so the walls were very thin

title: Excellent
text: Finding a nice and reasonable price hotel is always difficult, but this one ticks a lot of boxes. The room was big (by Paris standard), the bathroom brand new, people at the reception extremely helpful. it is just a short walk from Arc de Triomphe.

title: Last minute booking
text: We booked this last minute on a discount travel site after our original reservation at another hotel was cancelled. What a pleasant surprise! This hotel was less expensive and a lot nicer. The english-speaking front desk staff was friendly and upgraded us to a corner executive room, which is very spacious. The room seemed clean and was quite comfortable and modern. There is a small elevator so you don't have to carry your luggage up the stairs. The location is great! Just a short walk to the metro station and Arc de Triomphe. We took the RER train directly from the airport. We were only here for one night between flights, but it was a pleasant stay. Would stay here again.

title: Great location & stay
text:
Location: 5-10 mins walk from Arc de Triomphe/Champ Eleysés and right across the road from metro station 
- Bus from Beauvais is right across the road also 

Room: Small but comfortable, pillows a bit small is the only complaint 

Staff: 24hr reception with English speaking staff

title: Nice location, great room, good price
text:
We stayed during summer and booked an executive room. The price was reasonable and the room was great. Nice location of the hotel (quiet but close to Arc De Triumph). I would stay again. 

Location: quiet location near arc de triumph, there are a few locals around and more local eateries near the hotel. Also it is easy getting here from Gare Du Nord - you just need to catch a bus. 

Room: We booked the executive room and it was great, the room was massive and we could even see the very top of the Eiffel Tower! The room and bathroom were very clean. 

Service: Service was okay, it wasn't spectacular. But this is the only hotel I've stayed in Paris so the service may be on par with other boutique hotels.

Overall, I would stay again.

title: A gem
text:
I am an elderly experienced world traveler, picky but not overly so, who does much research on accommodations before I travel, and am therefore usually pleased with where I end up. Clean, quiet, comfortable, convenient, friendly are my criteria, but I am a big fan of “olde worlde charme”.
This is a boutique hotel and overall I HIGHLY recommend it.
The Location was perfect, in a safe neighborhood, in the posh 17th, very quiet peaceful area with no street noise, near to the Porte Malliot or the Argentine Metro stops on the best (#1) east-west main line.  You can walk from the Argentine metro stop all the way downhill to the Rond Point of the Champs Elysses.  Very nice way to star the day.
Staff, universally English speaking, were OK, but especially the lady at the desk, she was much more friendly and very helpful with all my questions. As I am often a solo traveler, I like to chat with the desk personnel at these boutique hotels to have some local contact and sociability.
Cleanliness was perfect in my room, bathroom, and public areas.  The maid service was fine.
The Bathroom size was large
The Breakfast buffet, not included, was very ordinary, and not well served, you would be better off going up to the Place Maillot and eating at the Congress (pricier but so worth it !!)
The Restaurants in the area are terrific, ask the lady at the front desk for suggestions.  My favorite is the Auberge Dab.
The Lobby was OK and the front desk open all hours.
There was an elevator to my room.
The Room was big enough and more like a 4 star hotel. The bed was comfortable, there was a TV which I never watched.  The room was quiet - NO barking dogs, no loud late strollers in the street, no trash collectors in the early am.
The View from my room was of the street.  Very interesting to look into the adjacent apartments at night.
The all important WIFI worked OK in the room but I usually do that in the lobby as it is always better there.
The Value for the money was acceptable

title: An Excellent time
text: We had an excellent time in Paris and the room was just what we wanted. Renée on reception was very helpful and always made us feel welcome.  The hotel was close to the metro and therefore it was very easy to get around Paris

title: Recomend
text: Excellent location 2.5 km to Eiffel Tower, 500 m to Arc de Triomphe. Room are small but clean. The hosts are very nice and the breakfast is typical french. In a few words excellent location, nice hosts and tasty breakfast

title: Good value hotel which is nice and clean with friendly staff
text: Nice clean hotel in Paris 19 with comfy beds. Good value for money in Paris and very close to Metro line 7 that is only 15 mins from central Paris. Staff are friendly and the breakfast is good value with plenty of choice. There are a few bars and restaurants nearby.

text:

Very friendly and helpful staff throughout the hotel and we had a smooth check-in and check-out. We arrived at the hotel at lunchtime and decided to have lunch and on another evening we had dinner and the food at both lunch and dinner was very good and at a very good price for Paris.

The room was a standard Campanile room as such and we have stayed in Campanile hotels in various places in France and the hotel is a good base to explore Paris.

There are plenty of supermarkets, bakeries and eateries nearby and we would be happy to stay there again if visiting Paris.

title: Campanile
text: I have visited Paris many times and stayed in quite a few different hotels. The Camponile Hotel is relatively cheap for somewhere in the centre of Paris. The room was very small, no mini bar, no deposit box, an intermittently hot and cold shower, just enough sugar and milk to make one cup of tea or coffee in a paper cup. On the plus side, it felt very clean, and I did get 5 very peaceful nights sleep. Breakfast was ok, probably just about worth the eleven euros I paid. I think I upset the waitress by not eating off a tray at my table, and she let me know she was disappointed by banging a tray down next me at the table, which I felt unnecessarily. The other staff are great to talk to, they speak a few languages and are most helpful. Cedry was particularly helpful, with a great welcome and warm ness. The 19th area ofParis is not considered too pleasant, I am not sure why that is because it felt quite peaceful and safe being there. There are plenty of local shops and places to eat and drink. The local butcher cooks the most amazing chicken and the Boulangery had the most amazing cakes. It’s 5 minutes from Crimée Metro and access to the whole of Paris is easy from there. Quick tip. A transport pass from the machine for 5 zones and 5 days is 65 euros. You can purchase the same thing from a kiosk for less than half that. Overall I felt I had value for money, just don’t expect too much much from this budget hotel.
