I have a bad back & chose this hotel as description stated elevator + good for people with mobility issues, but when the elevator broken, they took no steps to make-up for thi. I  asked for help at reception: woman working there told me to buzz-off - tough-luck about the elevator.  FYI she couldn't speak French, surprising at a bg Paris hostel.  The younger staff (I met in the bar) were nicer (and they speak French). There's a free breakfast which was 'average'.  Rooms interesting: Pod-beds wth plugs. Wifi works. It's in the seedier part of Paris, but I didn't feel unsafe.  If they hired new staff, and fixed their elevator, it'd be a better place.

title: I had a family crisis and the staff were unbelievably arrogant
text:
NEVER STAY HERE. A few months ago  I was staying a few days in Paris.  I stayed in the Hostel St. Christopher, and while I was there, my Dad almost died.  I got a facebook message while I was in my bed at night, in a room full of people.  I jumped up and as I needed to call a hospital and my family members, I went to the reception. I told the guy(s) two of them on-duty what happened. 

They shrugged at me, and told me all the common areas were closed.  I didn't want to sit in the stairway, so I asked if I they could please sit on the couch and talk on the phone.  I was clearly upset.  The guy working was Spanish and had light brown hair, a white t-shirt and  a pot-belly: He seemed to be very comfortable there, like he was a senior employee or a boss.  He was extremely rude. 

 He was talking to a friend, and that was apparently the most important thing to him.  He said everything was closed and he want back to talking with his friend.

So I sat outside, and I called my home-country, and talked to hospital staff, while standing outside in the cold.  In winter.

The rooms are ok, the bathrooms are dirty, the breakfast isn't anything special.  But what I'll remember about this hostel is how I was treated, and I wouldn't even recommend it to someone I didn't like.

title: Little walk, but great
text: This hostel is a little further out than it’s sister hotel at Gare du Nord but is still very easy to get to via crimeé station. The bunks are very sturdy so movement through the night doesn’t make noise. The beds are comfy. Each bed comes with a light and multiple plug in spots AND USB spots. And each bed space has large metal cages to store your bags which can be locked with a padlock. The staff are incredibly helpful.  Book direct and get the free continental breakfast - it’s basic but also free! Would definitely return.

title: AMAZING!
text:
I spent there 3 nights this weekend. Hostel is really clean, staff is really nice and helpful, and rooms are bright, fresh and big. 
Downstairs there is a nice bar and restaurant and every night something is happening so u are never alone 🙂 
Location is also really nice 20+mins to the city center with metro, really simple. 
Recommend!! 
🙂

title: Great value for money, party hostel (but not noisy for your sleep)
text: The location is great, breakfast for 5 euros and very good. The restrooms could be cleaned with some more frequency, but still were very good with warm water. The atmosphere is great with a very nice bar with good prices. There is no kitchen to cook your own food. Super recommend this hostel :)

title: Good hostel, modern and complete but light and noise problem
text: I stayed a night in St Christopher's Inn Canal Paris and had a rather mixed experience. On the one side, the amenities are great, new and clean. The right services are proposed and the staff useful. My only issue is that the surroundings of the hotel are noisy at night and the isolation not good enough to absorb such noise. Also, the room had very big windows on a whole wall, great during the day, but without blind, that makes the night too bright to have a good sleep.

title: Legend status
text: A bartender named Yves gave some of the best customer service I have received anywhere- he is a gentleman and his service was great (friendly, fun and he honestly made my stay that little bit better)! This man deserves a raise!

title: Bartenders are AMAZING
text: Yves is my favourite bartender ever, like10/10 recommend, he’s amazing, give him a rise and a promotion because he’s WORTH IT. So nice, what a darling. The best ever. Literally give him a raise, do it

title: Very good
text: A big nice friendly hostel! The rooms were big and had lockers. It’s close to gare de nord which is good. The staff is very friendly and the bar and restaurant was also good. Had a very pleasant stay!

title: This is my 10th visit in 10 Years
text:
I go Paris once a year. I been coming here every year and stay here its the best Hostel in Paris. Please book through there wed side you get Free breakfast. Please bring your own Locker and Towel. I stay on the 4th floor. 4 bed only. Wonderful staff and friendly.
I be back next year. Thank you everyone.

title: Basic stay
text:
Stayed here one night. Comfy bed and clean bedding. Although I did wake up to a wasp in my bunk! Not sure who was visiting me or the wasp?
There was a bad smell in the hallway to the room, most of the time, had to hold my breathe.

Bar downstairs is really good and comes alive in the evening with hostel visitors and locals. Good vibes and great food.
Staff are friendly and the lockers downstairs super helpful to leave stuff after check-out time.

All round an okay stay, just a bit of a clean needed to make it better.

title: Impressed
text: A great hostel located next to a canal. Rooms and toilets were clean. I liked that there were curtains on the beds in the dorm rooms, gave lots of privacy! Great restaurant here with outstanding food, along with a nice bar. The only downfall to this place is that it isn’t located in the centre it’s around 4 miles from the Eiffel tower and the rooms smell a bit of dirty socks (also read this on some other reviews). But overall - great place, would recommend.

title: Nice hostel but shame about the noise
text:
Hostel was pretty to easy to find and close to a metro station. The staff are friendly and helpful. I also like that you get free breakfast if book direct; although the breakfast wasn't very interesting. I liked that they had activity nights so on the first night there was free pasta and the second night was a film night with free popcorn - great way to meet people. Unfortunately the other 2 nights the activities never happened despite being advertised. 

The dorm room and bathroom were both fine; comfy bed, privacy curtain, charging point per bed and locker for belongings.

My only real issue with the place is the noise of the traffic from the road outside and the noise from the bar downstairs. Because there's no aircon the window needed to be open and there was constant sirens, horns honking, drunk people talking loudly outside - it made it difficult to get a decent nights sleep.

title: Safe stay
text: It was quite easy to arrive to this hostel from the airport using subway transportation. The directions given by the hostel are clear and concise. Upon arrival, the hostel upgraded us from a dorm to a private room, which was so kind of them. The canal is beautiful and has great bars and some boat rides available. Staff is multilingual, which is always appreciated. There is a sports bar below the hostel with local beer that tastes great. Recommend this hostel!

title: Good standard hostel
text: Stayed here just one night in a 12 bed mixed dorm, room was very spacious and curtains provided good privacy but watch your head in the bunks as they are a little low! Nearest metro was about 8mins walk with a small supermarket nearby. All staff seemed busy and breakfast was basic but quality. Only issue, mens bathroom was on opposite end of my room down a long corridor. Its a big hostel. The receptionists were polite and approachable. There was an American girl who I found to be quite pleasant! Good hostel

title: Safe place and friendly staff
text: We booked for 2 nights in 6 beds women floor,it was safe and clean,wifi good,the bfast was just basic.friendly staff,,just bring big locks for the safety box under your bed,need to deposit money for your towel.the lake was dirty,if you Don’t have problem with  dorm place with too many backpackers youngsters.then it’s best place for you.but it’s far from all tourist attractions.

title: A tireless and dedicated hostel
text: Paris is no easy city for any tourist, and this hostel was a great homebase.  The incredible staff helped with every imaginable request or question, going far above and beyond the call of duty.  Large as the hostel may be, it runs like clockwork.  It's clean, it vibrant, and there's always something going on.  It's basically been my nightlife during my stay in Paris, and I was completely happy with that.  Also, when Agoda screwed up my reservation to a criminal degree (charged me $321 for 5 nights in a private room, then paid the hotel half to book me in a 8-person dorm), the hotel's own staff went to war for me against Agoda.  They spent hours on the phone with Agoda's truly evil customer service staff, and allowed me to use their landline while I waited more hours on hold as well.  Essentially, they helped me through the booking nightmare of a lifetime (never use Agoda under ANY circumstances!)  I can't recommend the place enough, but book it directly via the hostel itself.

title: Very nice hostel
text: I had a very good experience visiting this hostel. It had a beautiful placement right by the canal. The banks were filled with people at night, so the life in the area was amazing. The common area was also very lively and a great place to make friends. The only problem would be, that it was far from the center (which gave me the opportunity to explore some non-touristy spots, which was really nice), and you have to take a metro to get there. Plus, the neighbourhood didn’t necessarily seem like the safest area to walk around alone at night...

title: Pretty Good
text: This hostel was good. The showers were alittle annoying, you have to push a button for water every some odd seconds, water was hot though, but everything else was great, from the food to the curtains on the beds. The staff was pretty nice. I did not use the laundry though.

title: Mixed feelings
text: We stayed here for 6 days during a heat wave in Paris, so the rooms were hot. They didn’t have any fans which made the circulation of air unbearable at times. The rooms are big and the curtains are nice, except they trap the heat. The showers could use a shelf for your items, but it’s only a slight inconvenience. The free breakfast is limited, but free, which is a plus. It’s only free if you book through their website though. I was given a key card that barely worked and when I complained she told me it was the lock on the door, but my friend had no issues with hers. I was disappointed they didn’t listen to me and just give me a working card. At some point it just stopped working all together and was then finally given a replacement. They have a strict one person per bed policy, which is great, until one of your bunkees brings home a boy and security barges in and flips on the light at 3am to kick him out. Overall, I enjoyed the location, the size of the room and the cleanliness. But I probably wouldn’t stay here again.

title: Amazing Place at affordable price
text: As the caption mentions, its an amazing hostel at an affordable price range just 400 mts from the metro station and situated just besides the canal which makes it accessible for a breezy evening stroll. We had taken a private room which had a sharing bathroom but nonetheless never had any problem. The staff was very helpful, forthcoming and suggested us places to visit . Though a bit far from the city center e.g Eiffel tower is around 35-40 minutes by metro but metro connectivity is very good. The place is quite safe and we never had any problem or encounters with pickpockets as heard.

title: Nice, spacious rooms
text: When I checked in at 230, the sheets had not been changed, but when I came back around 630 it had been fixed. Good easy access, storage for belongings under the bed, 2 outlets per bed. Showers due have a timer on them, but it is not too bad. It is a bit far from the city centre, but close to several metro locations. There was a sink in the room which was nice. I was able to check out at 630am with no problems. The room its self was large and spacious even in a dorm with 10 beds.

title: Awesome!
text: Okay, so this was the last Hostel Experience ive had during my Euro Trip and I must say it was the best.  The place is extremely clean, staff are friendly, and the environment is modern.  The bar/food areas are exceptional, storage units in the room are appropriate, the beds were pretty comfortable, and the privacy curtain gave it extra Flavor.  Wrist Bands were provided at check in to receive discounts on food and drinks.  The Location is very convenient to public trans and eateries.  My only complaint is that the room can get pretty warm.  Once you open the window, you should be fine.  Also, the lift is a little slow so taking the stairs is sometimes the best bet.  Other than that, i would definitely recommend thia Place!!

title: Dirty bed sheets and irresponsible reception
text: I checked in at 4.30pm and found my bed sheets & pillows dirty with black spots on them. I told the reception guy 3 times and every time he says someone will change them right now. It took them 1.5hrs to change my bed sheets! Horrible...and reception reply is "cleaning staff has other things to do!" .

title: Amazing stay for NYE in Paris
text: I spent New Years Eve in this hostal with 9 friends and it was the best decision that we made. The ST Christopher Inn is a hostal young adults that want to have a good time. our room was for 8 people and we had our own space with a curtain. The Hostal has a bar on the first floor that everynight we would go to and have a great time with a discount on drinks and food for staying in the St Christopher Inn. They threw a New Years Eve Party that we stayed in until 4 am.

title: Great time for solo backpackers or groups
text: Clean and comfy beds, and the washrooms and showers were very tidy. Shemayan and the other staff were awesome, and great free social events to get everybody mingling. Definitely coming back next time I’m in Paris.

title: Good location, don't forget a locker!
text:
Good choice to save some money. But don't forget to carry a secure locker so that you can put your bags protected, otherwise you will have to rent or buy one.
Bathrooms are clean, and outside the view is very nice and quiet to walk.

title: Great location
text: Great location next to the canal with a balcony overlooking the water. The canal is a hub of activity during holidays in the summer - boats, yachts, people hanging out  at the bank, picnicking. The hostel is clean and huge.

title: An INTRUDER Entered My Room
text:
(1) LOCATION: next to canal.  3 blocks fr Metro.
(2) BUNK PRIVACY: curtains, lamp, socket.
(3) BATHROOMS cleaned > once a day.

(-) Dorm bedroom doors DONT LOCK automatically.  You must manually lock the door.  I'm in a 12 man dorm.  How many ppl will manually lock the door?  I told front desk about it.  They said that's the way it is.

Sure enough the next day a guy comes into my 5th F dorm room & lies down on the sofa.  After 30 min I asked him what he was doing.  He said waiting for a friend.  I told him to wait downstairs.  He accused me of lacking the hostel "spirit" & began eating chips & cookies belonging to others.  I packed all of my stuff & went downstairs to tell staff.

(-) All of the electrical sockets are LOOSE.  If you have to use a converter AND your charging unit, they will fall off.  The electrical sockets are loose from overuse.  Additionally they are located a meter high.  I have to build a tower to support my charger.

Mgmt never apologized about the intruder, even after they sent me an email asking about my stay.  St Christopher's is getting too big for its breeches.

title: Best hostel in Paris for sure
text:
It’s amazing what they do this guys. They really have a great hostel overall. 

Located a little bit up north in the city, has an amazing view to the canal, a very good restaurant and a superb staff. They really make you feel at home. Specially a girl from Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 and a guy from Argentina 🇦🇷. On the welcome drink (that btw is a great idea for integrating new guests) they really make us enjoy the day (and during the stay they also did it). 

It’s a lil bit huge in my opinion, but anyway it’s great. Well equipped the rooms with storage for your bags. And the burgers are the resl deal st the resto. 

Basically has an amazing vibe. Congrats

title: March 2019 visit
text: The check in was ok.  You have to pay a deposit for your key card, that will be returned once you hand your key card back in.  The rooms were big, with a table and chair in the centre. In the morning I had my own breakfast, and just needed some hot water to add to my porridge, which they provided along with cutlery, but I was put in a separate room, I do understand why, but I did not like the way you are separated from others.  This place is close to the metro.  I have stayed at St Christopher's Inn Village - London Bridge in London, and this one was better.

title: Spring Vacation
text: Excellent staff! Friendly, helpful and welcoming. Great security, have lots of cameras and security at front door. every 7pm is free drinks to meet and greet with people. tours in the mornings around paris. comfy beds with privacy curtains. excellent food as well!!

title: Spring Break in Paris
text: SAM + GUARAB are AWEWOME!!! Super nice bartenders, very friendly! So glad we stayed here, very nice customer service, bice people and great music, food and drinks. Definitely recommend! I love! 🙏💛😇🥂🍻

title: Noisy but Nice
text:
I stayed for 4 nights in a twin private room February 2019.   The hostel is clean, well organized and has helpful staff.  At times, especially during peak hours, there was a long line up to speak to a receptionist so perhaps adding more staff would be helpful.  The breakfast was very good.  I would suggest a few more options for Gluten Free items for those with sensitivities to wheat as I could not eat any of the bread or cereals offered.   The mattresses and bedding were comfortable and the room, although small, was well laid out.  I participated in a "free" walking tour and it was excellent.  It wasn't free however, as the guide expects to be tipped at the end so be prepared to spend about 10 Euros for the 2 hour tour.  

The hostel has a good lounge area and the bar is always hopping with people day and night which is great to meet people.  It would be nice to have a sink and some dish-ware available in the lounge to wash cups, get tap water etc.  

My major complaint was the noise.  The hostel is located on a busy street and you can hear the traffic and sirens day and night.  There are also people in the hallways constantly talking on cell phones and you hear room doors open and slam shut.  I could also hear the people in the room above me which sounded like they were bowling.  I would stay there again, but would ask for a quieter floor and room location.

title: V good inn
text: Well situated with nice surroundings, the staff are friendly and helpful, the rooms are ok but make sure to let the windows open as much as you can to move the air because 6 persons sleeping in one room with the shoes and everything can be a pit smelly, the bathrooms are clean and tidy

title: St Christopher's Canal Hostel (very Economical)
text: Hostel was amazing, clean and nice place to stay. Canal was good with a nice view but was smelly and litter was in the canal. People sat there at night to have drinks but left the bottles. I think canal should be cleaned regularly.

title: Great hostel stay
text: I loved the room and the ablutions at this place, it has a lively clean ambience. The common area is fabulous and I loved that I could watch the football games. Lifts all worked perfectly. I felt safe there and it is very well located, close to everything you need. The breakfasts were super and the one dinner we had there was very goo and reasonably priced

title: Great spot to see Paris from.
text:
Everything goes very smooth at this hostel. They have a really good system and tons of perks: downstairs bar, weekend nightclub underground, lounge area, curtains for each bed, and much, much more. 

Make sure to book through their website for free breakfast.

Special shoutout to the reception staff; Lautaro, Myllon, Hayden, and Thom!! They helped me every time I needed assistance or wanted a recommendation.

title: Nice by hostel standards.
text: I stayed here for one night between cities and it was fairly nice. I had brought a lock from home, however the lock I brought was not long enough for the cages in the room. So I had to buy one from reception, so be aware of that. The rooms were clean, and it was nice having a sink in the room although the toilet and showers are in the common areas. Though the aforementioned toilets and showers did have a men's and a women's (i.e. Not co-ed). There is a great map of Paris in the reception/common area, and there's a fair amount of seating space in the common area/bar. There was also a balcony, but I didn't explore as it was December! There are also pay lockers in the basement to store your luggage before or after your stay, which I wasn't too impressed with, most hostels have a free luggage room. That's one of my very few cons.

title: Review update
text:
I stayed here in 2016 for the first time, back again for the NWE2018/2019. 4 nights is the period I stayed this time. So far, everything was almost very good except some details:
1. The access from and back to the room is still complicated 
2. Elevator take too long
3. Staff less friendly than back in 2016 

Great breakfast with a good value for money, intimacy in the room guaranteed, I still recommend it.

title: Really Great Stay
text: Came here for Christmas 2018 with my cousin. Our private room was all that we needed, good value and clean. The staff at the front desk and bar downstairs were super friendly and chatty. It was really nice to see they were putting on a Christmas meal which a lot of people attended (we didn't unfortunately). Only requests would be for the bar to close less early (it was full then suddenly everyone was kicked out!) and the showers to be a bit less annoying (having to push it every 30s was a pain but I understand the need to conserve water). Definitely would recommend, location was really great too, very atmospheric on the canal and literally a two minute walk from the metro.

title: Great position, nice vibe & very friendly staff!
text:
My experience was very decent. The Hostel is located on a canal, close to the city Centre. The accommodation is adequate & comfortable. The food served at the restaurant downstairs is good! Try the burger special!

Lastly, the staff & management are extremely helpful, very friendly & speak a multitude of languages!

title: Perfect Hostel for Affordable Stays
text: Accommodation is perfect if you looking for an in and out clean spot to stay in! Also a good bar and restaurant downstairs if you tired from the day exploring! We stayed in a room for 8 people and it actually was perfect!

title: Loyalty
text: St. Christopher’s Canal Paris ticks all of the boxes for a hostel: safety/security, affordability, location and friendly staff. The hostel shares a lobby with Belushi’s (a rather rowdy watering hole). However, a keycard is needed to access the hostel wing, as well as each room. There are private curtains on all beds to provide privacy, and the storage lockers underneath the beds are convenient. The price is good because it is not in the city centre. However, there are two metro stops within walking distance. Lastly, the staff (especially Ana) is multilingual, attentive and genuinely helpful. The front desk sells padlocks (for your storage locker), outlet adapters and toiletries. Continental breakfast and pints of ‘Frog’s Bollocks’ are an affordable 4€ at Belushi’s if you flash your room card!

title: Stay
text: I stayed at this place for 2 nights. I would recommend this for stay if you are solo or backpack travellers. If you book directly you'll get free breakfast. It's Very Nice overall and View is also quite good.

title: Nice stay
text:
We stayed 5 nights. 
Room very small, you can not  move around the room .Clean. Very good location , close to metro. Breakfast was ok. Reception staff was helful. If i go back ,i will not stay to this hotel.

title: Clean, cute hotel in PERFECT location!
text: I stayed at this lovely hotel for 4 nights with my boyfriend during a recent trip to Paris. The hotel itself is very cute and is perfectly located - getting around was super easy as there were so many travel options nearby. The room was very clean and cosy and both my partner and I agreed that we slept very comfortably. The breakfast selection was great and the food tasted very fresh every morning. The hotel staff were incredibly friendly and spoke great english, they always made the extra effort to help us with any inquiries we had. We would definitely stay at this hotel again - it's great for the price!

title: Small rooms unpleassent staff
text: The check in was a chaleenge as the guy at the reception kept on talking to me in french though it was obvious that i did not understand what i did not undestand him. No tea or cofee making facility and no parking and the taxi had to double park to drop us blocking trafic. Rooms are tiny and value for money was very bad

title: Clean rooms, pleasant people.
text: This small hotel located near the Pernety Metro station in Montparnasse was ideal for our five-day stay.  Rooms were small--of course--but the bed was very comfortable and everything worked. The staff speak English and were always helpful. Breakfast is available in the hotel, but we brought our baked goods in from the patisserie next door.  The streets nearby have numerous small restaurants, bakeries, bars, and fruit and vegetable shops, and seemed very safe for an evening stroll.

title: Nice room close to the centre
text: Nice room for 3 people at the top floor, good for travelling and short stay, we stayed only from evening to the morning, it was comfortable, there was some little details that could be improved in the equipment, but it didn't bother us to mention. Everyday cleaning, tea and coffee supply. Nice location, close to the center and on the subway, easy to reach, bakery at the corner, vegetable and fruit shop across the street and supermarket very close as well. We enjoyed our 4 day stay.

title: Cute hotel in good area.
text: We chose this hotel as it was close to Monparnasse Railway Station.  It was still quite a walk, but doable.  It was also very close to Pernety Station.  The staff were very helpful and the rooms clean.  Hotel is in a good spot close to lots of shops and restaurants, in quite a quaint little district.  Would stay again if in Paris.

title: Very nice hotel
text: Good hotel for the price. Near the pernety metro station in few steps. Very quit neiberhood, many place for fast food and reasturants, also many grocerry stores. The rooms in hotel are small but clean. Evry day cleaning. Breakfast is buffet tipical french. Stuff is very frendly. Higlly recommanded for  few day stay in Paris.

title: BEWARE ! DECEPTIVE AND DISHONEST PRACTICES!
text:
We confirmed a reservation for this hotel on August 21st for vacation to celebrate a family event during the week of Oct 22-Oct 28, six nights. Booked directly with hotel and received our confirmation direct thru email. Having traveled in this area of Paris on many occasions we liked the location of the hotel having been in Montparnasse as recent as July 2018.
Much to our surprise and dismay we received an email from le 55 Montparnasse Hotel on October 15 ( exactly one week from our stay) that read YOUR BOOKING HAS BEEN CANCELLED , with no explanation other than WE LOOK FORWARD TO YOUR NEXT STAY WITH US, ( really?) Imagine receiving that email one week from when your flight arrives! In over 40 years of traveling I have never experienced this type of behavior and action from any hotel.
Calling the Hotel immediately , we were informed there was a problem with your credit card. If you want to re book we don't have any rooms available until Thursday. Of course, there is no problem with my credit card as I use it daily, I even called Chase , they informed us no attempt was ever made from France to charge your card.
So, maybe an error in key punching ? In the business world, if this occurs, the standard procedure is to contact the Customer inform them and ask if they would like to use another form of payment. Of course none of these actions ever transpired.Only the cancelled your booking email.
When calling back to speak to a Manager we were told to email us and we will get back to you, we emailed twice, still waiting for a response.........
We called back four additional times to speak to a Manager, only to have the front desk hang up the phone on us.
So why was our booking cancelled, we still do not know why ???
So BEWARE , IF YOU HAVE A RESERVED CONFIRMATION WITH THIS HOTEL, ONE WEEK PRIOR TO ARRIVING YOU MAY RECEIVE THE CANCELLED YOUR BOOKING EMAIL!  Make sure you have a back up plan!
We then had to search for another hotel , we found another 3 star hotel in Montparnasse but paid 3X the price , needing the room with such short notice.
Extremely shady practices with horrible Customer Service and two weeks later have still not heard from a Manager or anyone from this Hotel
BEWARE !!!!! My advice would be select a similar 3 Star Hotel there are many in the area.

title: very basic
text:
We stayed for one night in a triple room, coming from Montparnasse station. The walk to hotel was not easy with luggage, otherwise the location is great, just few meters away from a metro station which takes you directly right in the middle of the tourist area.
The room was quite big, but it the cleaning was not the best. We found some hairs in the bath tube, which is always a bad sign. The carpet was dirty, as well. The air conditioning didn't work properly, neither the extractor fan in the bathroom. We could clearly hear voices from adjacent rooms until late in the night.
Breakfast was poor and basic, served in a cramped room. If one maybe needs just some water instead of juice or coffee, he won't find it. 
People at reception desk were helpful, they helped with ordering in the evening a taxi to the airport, which appeared promptly at the designated time in the morning.

title: It is what it is
text: We had a lovely 3 night stay here, the staff were friendly and helped us with everything we needed, the patisserie next door is amazing for breakfast (she does like you to have a try at speaking French to her though, she's quite grumpy when people just talk to her in English, so no matter how bad your French make sure you have a go!) Yes, the rooms are small - it's Paris. The bathroom had a full size bath with a shower over which had plenty of hot water and decent pressure.  The bed was comfortable and the air conditioning worked fine.  No it's not a deluxe penthouse with views over the Eiffel tower but the price reflects that, it is a 3 star hotel and provided us with everything we needed for a really nice few days away. Oh and the metro is only a few steps from the hotel so super convenient.

title: Make sure to book the top floor terrace room!
text:
Had a super nice stay at the 55 Montparnasse. We booked the top floor terrace room (I think they had the only one) and it was great. It was a huge room especially since we were changing hotels from an IBIS hotel. The room had two twin beds (we put them together), awesome A/C (needed for August), kettle, safe, living area and two views. One window overlooking the cute pedestrian street below and the terrace overlooking the rooftops of Paris. The bathroom was big with a tub and nice amenities. Even had a towel warmer if in case you need to do hand laundry and needed it to dry overnight. The best thing about the room was the terrace. It had a little table and chairs and my wife and I spent ALOT of time out there. There is a Monoprix about 7 minute walk away but a closer Franprix a 5 minute walk. Since it was August lots of places were closed but the bakery right below was open so went there every day for breakfast to take back to the terrace. The left bank is a bit more sleepier than the right bank but the main street in front of the hotel is quite lively and the Pernety metro station is a 3 minute walk away. We saw some of the other rooms that we passed on our way to ours and the regular rooms are typically Parisian small so if we came back we would only book the terrace room. A huge thumbs up to "Helder" the hotel receptionist who helped us communicate with the airline when British Airways cancelled our transatlantic flight 24 hours prior to flying. Merci Beaucoup Helder. Vous etes tres tres sympa and we really appreciate all of your help with our BA problem!
overall we had a great stay at the 55 Montparnasse. Book the terrace room, you will be pleasantly surprised!

title: bad hotel , do not go there
text:
very rude front desk  not helpful at all.  they seem to be pleased to annoy tourists.
Dirty rooms.  very old fashioned bathroom.  the pictures on their site is not at all what you get.  pretty nice small lobby but rooms have not been renovated .  dirty carpets, dirty windows, moreover vey noisy with no AC
do not go there

title: Lovely Location
text: We were a family of 3 adults visiting Paris for 3 days in June 2018.  We were very happy with our room as it was small (1 queen & 1 rollaway bed) but clean and comfortable.  The air-con worked well which was a bonus and the room was quiet during our stay.  The location is the best part of staying at this hotel.  It is literally steps away from the Pernety Metro station and has many cafes, fruit shops, restaurants and supermarkets as well as a self-service coin laundry down the road.  You really do feel immersed in the Parisian culture here as it's out of the "touristy" part of town.  It takes about 15mins by train to the centre of Paris but navigating the metro is all part of the Paris experience - we loved it.  I would be happy to stay at this hotel again and would recommend it to anyone travelling to the magical city of Paris.

title: A gem: quiet, great location, super-friendly
text: My family and I loved our stay here - we’d come back in an instant. Perfect location - a dozen steps from the metro, and from a street full of cafes and restaurants - but quiet enough for even very light sleepers. The rooms are clean and modern, and the staff are unfailingly friendly, kind and helpful. A real gem.

title: Good hotel close to Metro
text:
Our room was compact but comfortable. 
The Metro station was 200m.away, and there was lots of food options close. 
Do not believe Google Maps if you are looking for supermarkets in the area. 
We found it sent us on a lot of circular wild goose chases for some reason.

title: excellent position. clean very small room
text: The hotel is located in a very nice area, just 3 minutes from the metro station Pernety. The street is lovely (Raymond Losserand), with many little shops, caffees and small restaurants. In general, the hotel space is small, starting with the lobby, the elevator and going to the rooms. The room I was given was really really small, but for a place to sleep for 1 (ONE) person was enough. Not appropriate for more than one person, as you can observe in the pictures. Everything was very clean. The bathroom was small (again, sorry for repeating myself), but comfortable and clean. The noise can be a problem if you are a light sleeper, and better to stay in the rooms facing the lateral alley. For me it was not a problem, as I had to wake up very early anyway. The staff is very kind and helpful. Air conditioning was working well. I didn't try the breakfast, so no opinion about that. All in all, for a short trip, travelling single and given the excellent location and the cleanliness, I would stay there again. For a long stay, unless there are bigger rooms available, not sure :)

title: Friendly staff but noisy, thin walls
text:
The staff were very welcoming and the hotel was quaint and in a nice neighbourhood. However, I couldn't sleep in the mornings because the walls were thin - I heard people in the rooms next door, doors closing, people talking in the hallway and people cleaning the rooms next doors which made it impossible to sleep until things quieted down around 11am.

I also put the "do not disturb" sign outside the door and the cleaners still knocked on the door very loudly while I was trying to sleep mid-morning.

I also found blood stains on my duvet - it seemed clean and washed but the cleaners should check for stains before they make the beds.

title: very bad experience, this is not a 3 star hotel, Noisy, totally unwelcoming
text:
this is not a 3 star hotel.  only 3 rooms have been renovated so far.  pictures do not correspond to what you get.  beware of the cleaning ladies, dirty floor, dirty bathroom. very Noisy you hear the cars when the windows are closed. vibrating floor when the tram runs ....  Very rude  day time manager by name of Deira when we asked for a .the reason why they had such a rating  air conditionning was not working
was too hot had to open the window overnight, awful....
Do not go there;  there are plenty of other hotels around which offer a much better service

title: Well-located 3-star hotel in Montparnasse right next to Pernety Metro station
text: We stayed for 3 nights during the UK bank holiday weekend, and had no trouble finding the hotel via Google Maps near the metro station. There are dozens of cafes, bistros, creperies, brasseries, and bars in the Montparnasse area, so you have easy walking access to them and of course are very close to central Paris by Metro. The rooms are clean and surprisingly big compared to what we expected for Paris. There is a lovely boulangerie right downstairs with amazing fresh pastries and baguettes that we visited every morning and did our best with minimal French to order from the kind and patient staff. Very satisfied with out stay, they cleaned the room each day and changed towels, so that's just what we needed, a convenience and comfortable base of operations for sight-seeing.

title: My money was stolen
text:
I stayed for 7 days. On the fifth day I went out for breakfast and when I returned 150 pounds and 100 dollars had disappeared from my bag. The money was in a bag, under clothes, and inside a drawer. When I got back to the hotel, the bag was over the clothes and the money was gone.

I spoke to the receptionist who was very rude to me. He called the girl who had cleaned our room to ask her about the money. I do not know if it was her or if it was someone else, after all the key to the room is at the reception desk and anyone could have got it and got in there. After that the only response I received from the receptionist was "I do not like this". And no one else said anything. 

To make matters worse, on the last day, I was at the front desk when a young man came in and attacked the receptionist. The two began to beat each other and another girl working at the hotel had to separate the two. 

It was a very bad experience!

title: A Gem of a find in central Paris
text:
We had a one night stay in this delightful hotel. It was too short a visit and we must go back. It could not have been more convenient, less than 1 minute walk to the nearest metro station, Pernety. The hotel is on the corner of a quiet street but set in a bustling location packed with Parisian charm, bars and brasseries with oudoor seating, fresh produce market stalls, cafes and restaurants. 
The staff of the hotel were friendly and welcoming. The room we had was comfortable and clean with a large and very comfortable bed. We really appreciated the tea and coffee making facilties on arrival. We had a wonderful night's sleep as there was no late night street noise.
The view from our room was of the street below and we were able do our people watching from there. The rooms on the other side of the hotel had views overlooking the charming and quiet lane behind the hotel.
Breakfast was a self serve buffet in the bright and airy breakfast room. There was a good range of foods including cereals, yoghurts, pastries, hot foods (eggs sausages and bacon!) and as much, fruit juice, tea and coffee as we wanted.
Altogether a fantastic hotel at a very reasonable price. Loved everything about it!

title: Broke my ankle on the handicap ramp of this hotel
text: So this hotel, was mediocre and then I broke my ankle coming down their tiny handicap ramp, which is about 1 foot wide, while leaving the hotel. Let me explain that this ramp had a free edge and no rail. Anyone, and I am in good shape, can easily lose their footing on this ramp and fall off. I was coming down with my suitcase to check out when this happened. The girl at the front desk came to see if I was ok but did not bother to write a report of any kind. I couldn’t go to the hospital in France because my flight was leaving in two hours and our taxi was outside. I had no choice but to fly back to Miami with a broken ankle. Needless to say this has been painful,stressful, and very inconvienent. The hotel didn’t even bother to reply to my two emails. When we checked in, our beds weren’t set up at 2 twin beds and were instead one “double bed”. When we told the guy at the front desk about the beds, he was annoyed and angry and told me, “why are you telling me so late”,as is I had control over their mistake. No one told us we had free breakfast until we checked out which would’ve been great to know bc we stayed there for 9 days!  I’m including the picture of the the taxes that I paid when I checkled out showing the dates we were there. I am also including a photo from trip advisor that I assume they posted because these photos seem to all be taken by the same person. This is a picture of the elevator before they put in the ramp because as surprising as it sounds this hotel was even less handicap accessible than it is now. I put an arrow where the ramp is now. And finally I’m uploading my urgent care paperwork that says I have a fracture, and later found out that I have a ruptured ligament as well. So thanks for nothing 55 Montparnasse. You should look up the meaning of hospitality. Don’t give these people you’re hard earned money.

title: Absolutely fantastic
text:
What a great find! It's literally across the road from Pertenety station, so great links to the metro lines. The pastry shop next door is truly amazing and the grocery shop opposite is great too. 

Sorry I digress, back to the hotel. The staff were helpful and patient they knew English and even were paying to reach us a little bit of French too. The room itself had the basics  strong Wi-Fi, double bed which was very comfortable and the amenities were there too. The room temp was ok too but we also had access to an AC unit so we knew we could always use that. 

The room size itself wasn't large but as a base to drop off your bags and sleep it met our requirements. Would recommend this hotel for anybody who wants to travel into Paris on the cheap.

title: Big room in a tiny hotel
text:
We booked a superior room in this hotel for only one night as we went to Paris for a concert. 
The room was very spacious, as well as the bathroom, which is not always the case. We also had a very big bed, probably a queen size. Also, the room was quite clean. Last but not least, the room was very quiet, which is usually pretty hard to get in Paris. 
The staff was very friendly. 
Basically, this is a nice hotel but maybe refresh can be done.

title: Nice couple of days
text: Nice hotel, room and bathroom were very clean, all amenities you could ask for. Parking is very secure and cheap at €15 for 24 hours however it’s a 5 min walk on an adjacent street. Lobby is standard and left luggage is literally just leave your bag in reception where everyone sits.

title: Something Special
text: At first glance, I was not pleased as I could smell cigarettes smoke in my room when I arrived.  It turned out it was coming from the street level or through the HVAC vents.  Management evicts people when they smoke in the hotel and so that made me happy.  The room was small but great beds and lights and window to the street.  Breakfast was included and was terrific with a lot of different foods to choose from.  Breakfast room was very pretty and modern and cozy.  Perfect for the metro Penerty.  In fact, you can take the metro right to the airport with a one major change.  Save yourself money as the cab cost 60-85E depending upon which cabbie you get.  A few restaurants on the main street near the hotel, but nothing great.

title: Good value for the money.
text:
Nice and relatively clean hotel, near by a metro station and at a walking distance from Gare de Montparnasse. 
Room are clean and cosy. Friendly front desk staff. 
On my stay, the only negative thing worth to mention is that, accidently, the clean staff disposed a plastic cup that contained a dental corrective prosthesis and although the front desk staff said they'd email me to clarify the situation, I never heard from them.

title: Good value for Paris
text: Whilst not an intimate & romantic hotel it is 50m away from the nearest metro station & a 10-15 min walk from Gare de Montparnasse with plenty of cafés & bars etc within spitting distance. Most importantly perhaps for a city, it was pretty quiet & we had a good nights' sleep (unusual for us in a major city). The receptionist was great also making a room available within 10 mins of our very early arrival.

title: Basic hotel for short stay
text:
A basic hotel which is located just beside pernety metro station & bus stop. Most of the attractions can be easily accessed by metro. Rooms are smaller but clean and well maintained. Check in time is at 1400hrs but they allowed us to check in at 1300hrs. Good Ac,hot water system,l worked nicely. We had a problem with the reservation, hotel authority adjusted that after mails and did not over charge. There are bakeries,fruit shops,groceries,  take away restaurant around the hotel. Neighbourhood around the hotel is very nice.The young lady receptionist was very helpful & cooperative. She gave us some useful tips and direction to various places.We did not have bathtub stopper, after informing they fix it.

Advice :

A mini bar can be added in the room.
Room service personnels need some training.When we were at the room a lady suddenly unlock the door and get inside which was irritating. One time use slippers and dental kit may be added too.
They can readjust their check in time at 1200hrs.

title: A nice out of a way Hotel
text: Le 55 Montparnasse Hotel Paris: This Hotel is a out the way not in the Centre of Paris. But it is a very nice clean and safe hotel. It is just across the street from the metro station which is easy access to any place in Paris. The rooms are spacious and comfortable in the bathroom is very modern. During your stay in Paris the weather was very hot, but the air conditioning kelp our room nice and cool. The hotel staff is very friendly and very helpful. There are plenty of restaurants around including cafe’s and bakery and fresh fruit and vegetable markets. They have a good Continental breakfast buffet for 13 € which our friend had the breakfast and enjoyed . Instead paying 13€ for a family of three  Went next door and bought  fresh croissants and fruit across the street. For those who need laundry service. There is a nice self-service laundry mat down the street. We enjoyed staying here and probably will stay here again as it was well worth the stay .

title: Perfect location for a Paris break
text: With a Metro station right outside (literally 5 mins / 1.5euro to Eiffel Tower) and surrounded by quaint french shops & cafes. A sunday bric a brac market close by. easy to get too off the ring road however you WILL NEED satnav as it is in the middle of a Parisian Maze of tiny one way streets. This is the Paris you will want to see and whats more because its technically out of the main 7 zones the price comes right down...a true bargain. Will definatley use again.

title: Basic hotel with minimum services
text: Small room, no refrigerator, no place to put your clothes, pictures on the site make everything look much bigger than reality, basic breakfast, friendly staff, parking is 1000 meter from hotel, near metro, cheap, old bathroom, everything is SMALL. Good Airco

title: Good Stay
text: Hotel was good. Bed was comfy. Modern inside and quiet at night. The area is great lots of shops, fruit stalls, cafes etc. Would recommend. Only downside is the lack of plug sockets in the room although not a big deal.

title: Not recommended!
text:
We stayed here for 3 and was disappointed over all. Very small room, small bathroom and not very clean. The breakfast is a total joke as they don't even have water. We asked for no cleaning and had the DND sign on the door, but still they entered in the room.  
Parking is 500m from the hotel, but OK if you don't need to use the car during your stay. Location is noisy in the morning, but is ok if you need to use the metro.

title: Nice little hotel
text: We stayed in Paris for 3 nights and chose this hotel off of the internet. It was a good value. Our room was clean and the bathroom was nice. The location was great, with the metro across the street. Lots of restaurants nearby. I would happily use it again.

title: Cita hotel , Coles to Paris Metro station
text: I have been stay for a night in this hotel after long business weeks in Europe. Hotel itself is 3 star, close to metro station. Room are OK, with standard facilities and supplies. Staff are welcome with any information need especially for short visit in Paris. Breakfast are poor option in general , serve in small hotel resto and not open for lunch of dinner. However, you can found lot of Restaurant near by.

title: Nice stay , near to metro station, value for money
text:
Good to stay only if you are choosing metro as your travel option in Paris.
We stayed in a terrace room.Some may feel rooms are a bit smaller.Passages are congested .The hotel is one metro stop away from Montparnasse stop. Wont get much options for dinner nearby.

title: Stay for only a couple days,  and only at a discount
text: Basic hotel,  not luxury by any means,  you will get a reasonably clean room (by paris standards) and depending on room an undisturbed sleep.  Breakfast is very average and the night staff although probably normal for paris come off as very rude. Please and thank you would go a long way when checking in your customers.  The lady managing the day shift is nice and helpful.  Overall would not stay a second time,  but if the price is right this hotel had a place for a temporary stay in Paris (not more than 2 nights)

title: ok for a night
text: room small, but beds comfortable. bathroom spacious , clean and plenty of hot water. Facilities not great-no safe, 1 plastic coffee cup; no coffee, just tea and 1 tiny bar of soap. tv ok. Noise from other guests not an issue for us(were we lucky?). Good location. Plenty of bars and restaurants with a range of choice and quality.Air -con very noisy, Breakfast was in a light, pleasant, smallish room. Juice and coffee from machines . Reasonable choice and quality pastries and the bacon was good but not the scrambled eggs.

title: Excellent
text: This was a wonderful hotel. It is small and friendly. Yes the check in is small and the lounge is not big but the welcome was excellent.  English is spoken and they were happy to do everything and more. The rooms were great. They had a kettle bath/shower and were large for Paris. They had air con,which was very effective and also had tv and a great view out of both windows. To get there come off at brancion and turn left right and left under the big flyover. It took 5 minutes from the peripherique. The parking garage costs 15 euros a night but is spacious and secure and is literally 2 minutes from the hotel with easy access to the main routes out o to the motorways.  The metro is 55 steps from the hotel. You turn left right and it is there its two stops to montparnasse station and from there about 7 to the eiffel tower. It took about 20 mins from getting on the tube at pernety to getting off at the eiffel. It was about 20 minutes also from Monmatre. The "bar" was non existent though. It is a cooling cupboard that was never opened.  However this was good as there is a bar next to the station. Not " au metro" the one opposite this was full of locals and really friendly and again spoke English. Great to sit outside and watch the world go by. There are patisseries and boulangeries right outside the door so fruit bread croissants and the like are there to buy to eat on the go. The triple rooms were genuine double bed and single bed. Not a couch but a proper bed. Really delighted and really happy with the experience. It is not 5 stars a d you won't get all the trimmings and posh service but for what you pay for it is superb and well worth the money. fantastic.

title: Perfect small hotel right on the metro
text:
Our top floor room (With lift - no worries) was lovely - small but with everything you might need, and the bathroom was perfect too, with bath/shower that worked just perfectly.
The bed was great and all was quiet too. The 24 hour access was useful too (we arrived very late but had prepaid so no issues at all).
Yes the rooms are small by the standards of other cities, but remember that after Tokyo, Paris has the smallest per capita living space in the world, so bear this in mind.
Oe small tip _ skip the breakfast buffet and go down the road to the meilleur Ovrier de France (best worker in France) rated bakers for amazing croissants - if jet lagged like me, go before 6 am and get a 25% discount on the shop prices and extra freshness too!

title: Convenient location, friendly staff, great space
text: A few friends and I stayed here for two nights while visiting the city and were very pleased. Super close to the metro and conveniently located near restaurants and cafes, it was very easy for us to get what we needed and get around. The room was clean and spacious for a European hotel and you could stand up in the shower (not always possible). The air conditioning was reliable and refreshing after 90 degree days of sightseeing. Two thumbs up!

title: Functional hotel .. its a glorified B & B
text: Had a party staying here .. nice area but hotel was so basic ... rooms small .. shower was really tiny .. and I mean really tiny .. breakfast was also on the limited side .. it was perhaps standard parisian food but for the costs involved I was less than impressed given it has 3 stars ..

title: I spent one night here the 5th of june.
text:
Good location, hotel and room ok but what a surprise to find the door close at my arrival (5th of june), the receptionist explained me that it's because he was alone and not behind the desk so it's  why I had to ring the bell and wait.
ok fair enough, but what was, in my opinion, unprofessional is that the receptionist after opening the door for me left me alone at the desk to get himself a coffee!!!! 
Did you hear about the "concept" customers first????
Another thing from the bedroom you can hear absolutely everything single noise from the corridor,stairs, lift.
Very annoying  during the night. when you try to sleep
Last thing the receptionist for the check out this morning (6th of june) was not really friendly!
I don't know if I would recommend this hotel especially because of the noise maybe ask for a bedroom at the bottom of the corridor far away from the stairs and lift.

title: Clean, friendly place
text:
We booked this hotel because it was just a few blocks from gare montparnasse. There's a metro station right across the street so it's incredibly convenient. We ended up walking everywhere and even so it was still convenient. 

The room was clean, neat and comfortable albeit smallish (but it's paris, so it's expected). Staff were super friendly and helpful. The only downside I felt was the thinness of the walls. Either that or I had really noisy neighbors. I felt I could hear everything. I'm a light sleeper so it was not the ideal. My husband, however, didn't seem to mind. A good set of earplugs and I might've been fine.

title: Book the Terrace room if you can!
text:
We recently stayed here in the terrace room on the 4th floor for 2 nights and I am very pleased with what a great value it was! While normally I would argue against spending a little extra for a hotel amenity like a balcony that you're likely not going to use while visiting a city such as Paris, I would say it is absolutely worth it in this case. The view overlooks a cute little residential street and is certainly quintessential Paris! We enjoyed coffee one morning out on the terrace and then a bottle of wine later that evening!

The room and bathroom were very clean and the bed was comfortable. My only complaint would be the intermittent wifi, but that is not a huge deal breaker for me, since I visited Paris to explore the city, not sit on wifi all day. The staff was also very friendly and helpful with navigating the nearby area as well as using the very close metro station, Pernety.

title: Great Staff & Location - You'll Really Be In Paris
text: We were here for six nights and our review is very similar to those recently posted.  The room was indeed small. I think we could have paid more for larger, but we were here to sleep - not lounge.  The wifi worked quite well at all times.  We opened our window at night and enjoyed the fresh air and occasional sounds of the evening outside.  Were treated to baking smells several mornings. (My wife says I imagined this).  The Metro was just a short block walk, giving access to anyplace in town or around.  The neighborhood was active at night, but not rowdy in any way.  Our bed was comfortable.  The shower was fine.  The staff was First Class in every way.  Friendly, helpful and courteous.  We would very definitely stay here again our next visit to Paris.  The price is very right for what you get.

title: Excellent location & very helpful staff
text:
Small room and small hotel but excellent value for money. Pernety, Plaisance and Gaite stations all within walking distance. Excellent location for all amenities, shops restaurants bakeries and much more just around the corner from the hotel.

Hotel - has a lift, good wifi, stayed in room 103, small but perfect, comfy double bed, bathroom with bath, detachable shower, toilet, basin, hairdryer and shampoo and soap. Only negative is no extractor fan in bathroom. Room has limited floor space but mirror, table, chair, tv, cupboard and fan. Heaters work and window opens. Didn't use temp control or AC.

Staff- spoke to 3 staff members during our 1 day 1 night stay and very helpful with directions, recommendation for restaurant (L'essential, must eat there!) and bar (au metro 14, it was ok), and they helped a lot with making reservations for a club, calling for us, speaking to the club in french, taking messages etc. Just so helpful and friendly!!

title: Okay!
text:
Pro: good value for money. Location excellent. 1 min walk to Pernety metro station. Lovely boulangerie next door and 3 min walk to Monoprix supermarket. Clean room. Hairdryer comes as standard.

Con: no lockable safe. Small room (didn't bother us as we were only there for one night)

Overall would recommend this hotel to friends. For the same price you could stay at an Ibis budget hotel hotel or other such chain but there wouldn't be as much character as 55 montparnasse. Definitely got old Parisien feel here.

title: Great Little Hotel
text:
We stayed in room 312 which from the map seemed to be one of the biggest on the floor. 

The room was clean and spacious however at night we could hear the lift moving. Our bed was uncomfortable too. However in Paris you just want somewhere to sleep and that's what it provided.  

We didn't eat the breakfast here as literally next door to the hotel on the main road was a lovely bakery. 

The staff was excallant. It was customer service at its best. They spoke great English and helped us with anything we needed. 

The hotel is ideally close to the Metro and there are a few bars around Pernety and cheap places to eat. 
Pernety isn't busy like the centre of the city it's a nice place to relax after yiur visits. 
I would stay here again. It's a cheap hotel with a great service and overall everything is kept well clean.

title: Lovely, convenient hotel
text: Ideally situated very close to a metro station in an area with plenty of bars and restaurants, yet it wasn't noisy. The hotel was quite small but very well presented. Our twin room was well appointed and we weren't falling over one another. The staff on reception were all excellent. They had good English and always called us by name. They were extremely helpful with advice on places to visit and airport transfers. We didn't try the breakfast as there was a superb bakery right next door which was all we wanted. The only reason I wouldn't give 5 stars is because we had a first floor room adjacent to the lift (which was an ideal location for us) and it was a little bit noisy at times. Certainly not noisy enough to stop us using this hotel again though.

title: Great location good price.
text: Stayed only for one night but room was clean and recently renovated. Best location near the montparnass train station and next to metro station. Food market close to the hotel if you like to avoid expensive restaurants. Would certainly recommend it and stay again. For those sensitive with noises (not me) have in mind that you know when metro passes under.

title: Great stay! Great price, room & location.
text: I recently stayed here with my boyfriend. It was very reasonably priced and right opposite the tube station which was great and only took about 35mins from Gare du Nord. I would recommend this hotel. Lovely clean room and really friendly and helpful staff. All spoke great English which helped. I would stay here again, transport links were great and such good value for money. The hotel is also surrounded by nice little cafes and restaurants. Loved this place.

title: Reasonably priced average hotel
text:
I stayed in the hotel along with my uncle for couple of days trip in December 2015.
The positive:
- It is right in city and close to underground tube station and whole of Paris is accessible
- The rooms were very clean and nice.
- The internet was fast and connectivity was good.
- Front desk provides very good assistance and are very polite.

The Negative:
- The car park is not in the same building as the hotel, it is about 1 Km away. (It was disadvantage for us: After driving 5 hrs, I was getting key card for the car parking location my stationary car was hit by French guy and he told me that it was  my mistake. And in city like Paris police will come only if you have broken bones or if you are close to dying other wise you have to talk to a person who doesn't speak English. At that stage the front desk guy at the hotel was of no help because he was worried about Hotel security :( ).
-The check out time was 1100 hrs and we wanted to leave the car until 1400hrs and the cost for 24 hr was 15€ so we have to pay an extra 15€ for the parking.
-The rooms are very noisey in the morning as one side of the hotel is facing a street that is very very loud early in the morning.

conclusion
All in all it is good place to stay in city of Paris with reasonable price. But it is better to arrange your own parking since the Parking at the hotel is 1KM away in any case and it will cheaper as well.

-Faraz

title: Location, Location And Location
text:
The hotel has the Great Location , just a minute walk from the Metro station of Pernity. Although the rooms are smaller, its neat and clean. The breakfast are is also small but they have great breakfast .
Well, when you are in Paris you just need a small place to sleep and take a shower and closest to the train station, you dont want any fancy hotels, then this is your hotel. 
You walk around the hotel ,you have plenty of cafes and restaurants.All i can speak about this hotel is the Great LOCATION.

title: Perfect location, excellent customer service.
text: Hotel is about 3 mins walk from metro station Pernety, it's easy to get to all the tourist attractions. Each and every staff member was very polite , kind and happy to help, delivering excellent customer service. Room was clean and tidy.

title: Great location, fabulous staff.
text: I booked this hotel through a travel agent in Adelaide.  I wanted something big enough so that taxis could find it easily but small enough not to be too tourist obvious. This hotel fitted the bill exactly.  Although my room was definitely on the small side, it was big enough for one and was spotlessly clean. The best thing about my stay was the fabulous staff.  Nothing was too much trouble and all with a warm and friendly attitude. Montparnasse is a fabulous spot with plenty of eateries.  On the weekends it comes alive with street stalls and people, people everywhere.

title: Short holiday fron Thursday to Monday
text: On arrival the receptionist gave us a warm welcome speaking very good English. These people were always ready to see to our needs. The room was spic and span. Although the breakfast room is small a variety of food and fruit was offered including scrambled eggs, bacon different types of bread, plus cereals, yoghurt, fresh friut and croissants. This hotel is across the road from the metro offering easy excess to all the interesting sites in Paris.

title: Very pleasant stay
text: The staff was fantastic and really helped us out with directions and even wrote out the metro links we needed. They were really helpful with getting us our reservations for the Eurostar to London. We wouldn't have had such an easy time of it ourselves. Was very clean and the breakfast was enough to start the day. The room could have been a bit  larger, my husband is 6 ft. and said he felt cramped and the bathroom was tiny. But it was located nicely for us right by the metro and had a good variety of shops and dining choices. Love that the windows have flower boxes and you can get fresh air.

title: Handy location for families
text: When travelling with a 7 and 10 year old in a foreign country two of my main concerns are - how easy is it going to be to feed them and get them around? Although we drove into Paris, we didn't want to be driving around the city and it's hard to find hotels that have any parking, let alone at a reasonable rate. 55 does both - the cost of their parking is 15 euros a day which isn't too bad. The hotel is located a mere 2 minute walk from a Metro station (Pernety) in the Montparnasse area which means most of the city's attractions are only one line change away, which is so handy. Then there are the food options - unlimited, just on your doorstep - cafes, bakeries, restaurants, bars and grocery shops all within a five minute walk. The rooms have firm mattresses and lovely linen including a choice of pillows. I don't think the hotel has interconnecting rooms so if my boys were any younger there's no way I would have contemplated doing this, but we had rooms next to each other which I could just handle. They had a renovated bathroom which was awesome - massive shower with one of the largest show roses I've ever seen and all modern amenities. Ours was older but still serviceable. Breakfast at the hotel is a fabulous deal - just 11 euros a head for help yourself juices, cereal, pastries, yogurt, baguettes, ham, cheese, eggs, fruit, tea and coffee. All the staff are very friendly. This hotel is a fantastic all rounder - loved it.

title: Family of 4 stay
text: We are a family of 4 with 2 kids 8 and 10. As other reviewers have described great location, fantastic neighbourhood, Metro was very convenient. Approx. half an hour max to all the sites, Eiffel Tower, louvre, sacre le couer etc. The staff were fantastic especially the lady who gave us hints everyday on where to go. We had 2 rooms and the beds are North American queens. We were very happy, great price and location. A couple of tips. For those light sleepers the walls are thin as you can hear other rooms and try to get a room away from the elevators as you can hear the rumbling. Finally we used Uber throughout the trip, it was a flat 50 euro from the airport (no tip required) compared to 60-80 euro for a taxi. We were picked up in a bmw 5 series, offered bottles of water from our driver who was in a suit. You can't get ripped off with uber as u get a GPS map of the ride. There is also a grocery store around the corner that opens at least until 11pm for water, beer and wine.

title: Family visit to Paris
text: Perfectly located hotel in lovely area.  Rooms were clean and quiet, ours were on the top floor.  Windows opened (we love fresh air) and there was also air con.  There were 2 adults and 3 kids so we had rooms next door.  Staff were friendly and helpful.  Location was fantastic, very close to Metro station with bakery, butchers, supermarket and fruit shops very close by.  Nice cafes and restaurants nearby too.  Would recommend highly.

title: Comfortable in a non-touristy neighborhood
text: We had a nice, clean, comfortable room in this very small, convenient hotel located off the main tourist track. About a block from the train station or less with many boulangeries/patisseries and restaurants scattered around. We had breakfast across the street - le petit dejeunier - which was delicious. A/C worked great and was quiet. It was nice to be able to watch so many Parisians going about their regular business - picking up a baguette on the way home from work etc. Everyone was very friendly and nice. We could walk a couple blocks away to where big hotels were with a big increase in the price of things and big decline in quality. Great neighborhood.

title: Great hotel in a fantastic neighborhood
text:
One of my favorite hotels in Paris!  Stayed for two weeks with family. We booked two rooms which were located across from each other on the third floor.  Hotel is perfectly located two minutes away from Pernety metro (great line into the "touristy" part of Paris) but out of the fray of the hordes of tourists.  We felt like we were coming "home" each day to our Paris retreat.  

Many places to eat within five to ten minutes on foot from the hotel.  We tried the boulangerie on the corner, the cafe across the street, the Lebanese cafe down the street and an italian restaurant a few blocks away.  Additionally, the hotel is situated next to a pharmacy and five minutes on foot between both a Monoprix and Franprix (grocery/drug stores).

Hotel staff was wonderful and we looked forward to seeing them in the morning before we set out for a daily adventure and again in the evenings.  The cleaning staff was also friendly and my room was always cleaned each day.  

Rooms are (in my opinion) a bit larger than average for Paris and well appointed/functional.  Fans were provided which I found to be a very nice touch.  The A/C and heat worked well--- and we needed both during our stay!  My room had a modern bath- new sink, toilet and walk in shower...VERY NICE!  My cousins' room was more traditional, yet clean, and quite a bit larger in size.  

Breakfast was good and we decided to take advantage of the buffet each day instead of going out to find someone less expensive.  Breakfast always included: eggs, yogurts, ham, pasteries/bread, cereals, fruits, juices.  Le 55 has a coffee machine so guests can have what they like in the morning- cafe au lait, cappuccino, hot chocolate,  hot water (tea/instant coffee).  The breakfast staff were delightful and accommodating.

Don't be turned off from first impressions--- this hotel is a GEM!  The staff, the rooms,  the wifi, the location make Le 55 Montparnasse a Parisian treasure!  Warning: if you are expecting an "American-style" hotel- go elsewhere.  If you want a real Parisian hotel experience with friendly staff, clean and comfortable rooms (great beds!), wonderful location, stay at Le 55.  You won't be disappointed.

title: Booking cancelled without any advice
text: I arrived at 20.15 and my booking was cancelled at 19.09 by email and my room desappered! I had to find another room around spending a lot of money! The guy at the reception didn't give me any explanation, only an useless "sorry"! This is completly unaccetable!! It's a shame!!!

title: Great hotel in family neighborhood
text:
We had 3 rooms at 55 Montparnasse. We booked through Orbitz, and there was some trouble with getting the room with 2 twin beds, but the hotel adjusted and took care of it. The rooms are small, as you expect in Europe, but the superior room had a much larger bathroom. All the rooms were quite clean and the beds were comfortable - wonderful value for the price. The neighborhood is more of a typical Paris neighborhood - with a lovely patisserie downstairs, local markets and restaurants all within just a few blocks. A metro station is just across the street, which meant it took us just 20-25 min to get wherever we wanted. 
The day before we left, we found out about the planned taxi strike for the next day. The woman at the front desk was incredibly helpful in getting us a car to take us to the airport (just before the strike started). 
There's an Italian restaurant just down the street that is good and Les Artistes is a 10 minute walk and a definite find with excellent food and friendly staff.

title: Very friendly staff, good location
text:
Good location in a fairly quiet neighbourhood, right next to a metro that takes you directly to Champs Elycee. Found a good restaurant nearby, recommended by hotel staff.
Very friendly and helpful staff. Made us feel welcome and helped us a lot, especially when my son got ill.
The hotel is tiny, in an attractive way, cozy. Our room was not big nor fancy but clean and lacked nothing essential. One can say the same about the beds. Got the job done. 
Pretty good bargain for a three star hotel in Paris, I would say. 
Free wifi worked well!
Definitely on my list the next time a look for a hotel in Paris.

title: Nice place, terrific location!
text:
Could not believe how close this was to Metro station Pernety! So convenient. The staff were pleasant. The breakfast was included in the cost of our room on a promotion they were running and was simple, but adequate and tasty enough. Included free Wi-Fi which was essential for our needs. Lift was also smallish but big enough for both of us and our cases so no complaints.

The room and bathroom are very small but don't expect much bigger in Paris.

Staff offered to help us book tours/tickets as needed but we'd already organised that prior to arrival, so wasn't required.

Overall, very pleased with the stay. Would recommend this place to anyone. (Oh, and, do yourself a favour and visit the patisserie right next door on the corner- the strawberry tart in particular is exquisite!).

title: Lovely hotel
text: Such a lovely hotel, staff were so friendly and helpful and nothing was too much trouble, when we first arrived our key to our room didn't work properly so the hotel staff actually got a technician out to sort out the problem, while we were waiting for our key the hotel staff were more than happy to use their master key to let us in our room as much as we wanted.  We even forgot our plug converters and when we asked the staff if there was a shop close by that sold them, they went into a cupboard and leant us one of their own! It was the perfect location for my boyfriend and I, although it's so close to a main road we heard no noise through the night and slept really well. We paid extra for the parking which I think was worth the extra, it's basically a garage that can only be accessed with an electronic key, it was really easy to find too as it's just round the corner to the hotel. Getting about in Paris was easy once you got the hang of it, the metro was literally on the doorstep of the hotel, the staff of the hotel were very helpful when we had questions about how to use the metro. There were nice restaurants near by and two supermarkets which were easy enough to find. If I was to go back to paris this would be where I would stay. The only negative I can think if is that we were on the 4th floor and the way the room was shaped meant that the roof was lower on one side of the room. Which wasn't a problem until we wanted to use the shower, we had to stand at a funny angle to stand up straight so we wouldn't hit our heads. The rooms were nice and clean with the essentials. If I was to go to paris again I would come back to this hotel again.

title: Great if you're on a budget (booked through venere)
text: The location of this hotel is great, it is a minute walk right from the Pernety station on the 13 metro line. The bed is nice and big and very comfortable. However, I was not happy about the woman who worked at the front desk. I am very confused by why she would go into the hospitality business as she was very cold and seemed to always have an issue when speaking to us, as if we were bothering her. Our bathroom smelled like cigarettes which was gross. They didn't replenish the toiletries each night, and I would suggest anybody staying here bring their own as they did not provide lotion or conditioner, and the shampoo was a combination with body wash so it was not effective.

title: Lovely Hotel
text:
Just across from the metro . Staff were very kind and helpful that was everyone .
Breakfast was good . Room was clean and a good size for the three of us . Would definitely stay again. Easy access into paris . Plenty of places to eat . Two supermarkets nearby .

title: Nice hotel
text:

The only thing I didn't like very much is that the waitress don't do very good the cleaning of the rooms and the elevator have some spider webs, despite of that is a good hotel with a great, it has a subway station like 30 meters distance form the the hotel

title: Easy access everywhere
text:
