title: Nice Hotel
text: We stayed here for our 20th wedding anniversary, when it was still the Kyriad Montparnasse.  (My review says "April 2014" since that is as far back as tripadvisor allows, though we stayed here much earlier than that.) It is a small hotel located in the 14th (I think).  Great location, right across from the Pernety metro station.  Our room was small (but I was expecting as much) and anyway, I wasn't in Paris to sleep! It was clean, comfortable, and I remember the staff being very helpful.  The hotel had a restaurant but we didn't use it since I remember that there were quite a few restaurants and shops in the surrounding areas.  I especially remember a very nice bakery with delicious beignets down the street.  An affordable, no frills option to staying in the city center.  I'd rather spend my precious Euros on the seeing the sites and eating the food in Paris anyway!  I would definitely stay here again, but I would ask for the room with the terrace (I can't remember the room number, though.)

title: Excellent Place
text: This hotel has an excellent localization, right in front of Pernety Station. The room is clean and quiet. I would definitely recommend. The only think that it doesn't have is breakfast included, but there is an amazing bakery on the side of it.

title: Wonderful Hotel with Excellent service
text: The location of this hotel is excellent. It is very close to Pernety metro station, and within walking distances of many shops and restaurants. The staffs at the front desk are very friendly and helpful. The room we had was very clean and comfortable. The breakfast was quite reasonable. Happy with the hotel and would like to stay there again in the future.

title: Ooo La La
text:
Booked via Eurostar (Holiday Package)

Travelled to Paris for 3 days in August, look around for ages trying to find a hotel in a good location, then Le 55 Montparnasse came up, 30 seconds from the Metro.

Small hotel, but we were out all day from early till late, the room has everything you need though, Shower, Bath, Double Bed, TV etc, so for a room to crash in this was perfect, very comfortable and quiet, we upgrading the room for a small fee, highely recommended.

You are approximately 10 minutes on the Metro from The Eiffel Tower, and if you plan in advance what lines you need, you are very close to most attractions.

The hotel is out of the touristy parts of Paris and you get a feel of how the Parisian live, shops and cafes are situated near the Metro Station.

Receptionist spoke fluent English, you will have to pay TAX when you leave (bear that in mind)

Would stay in again if travelled to Paris, very impressed and happy.

Perfect for people on a budget and want to be situated away from the noisy and busy streets of Paris, but close enough to travel to everything.

title: Great Hotel, great value for money!!!!
text: Me and my boyfriend enjoyed our stay during November for 3 nights. Great value for money. Would recommend to anyone. Clean and modern hotel and rooms and the beds are really comfy. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Do not have any bad points to make. Location is in a nice safe neighbourhood and within reasonable distance from all the main tourist attractions in Paris, especially being situated right next to the metro station. The area has plenty of lovely bakeries, supermarkets, bars and restaurants all within walking distance. We both really enjoyed our stay at this hotel and it definitely lived up to expectations. If ever in Paris we would stay here again. Thank you.

title: Good hotel
text:
we stayed here for 2 nights. right next to metro. good bakery downstairs for breakfast and snacks. other food options at walking distances. good neighborhood. far from FCO airport but accessible via metro. 

hotel was nice. friendly staff.

title: Wonderful location
text: We had a lovely stay at the hotel and it’s very convenient to all you may want to do in the 7th. The staff were extremely polite and engaging and always willing to assist at a moments notice. title: Amazing Hotel (and Staff) close to Eiffel Tower
text:
This was our second stay at the Hotel de Londres Eiffel and we will only stay here when we visit Paris.

Lets start with the hotel - it is quaint and decorated so nicely.  Rooms are small as you would expect but they make great use of the space (and besides, you aren't there to stay in the hotel anyway!)  Many (all?) of the rooms have Air Conditioning so we were perfectly comfortable during the July, 2022 heat wave.  There is a small lobby area for waiting for cabs or to speak with the concierge.

Which brings us to the staff - there is no better! They are there 24/7 and always available to assist.  They are all fluent in English as well.  They know the area very well and will share their expertise if asked.  We spent a fair amount of time just having conversations with them and other guests while we were waiting to head out.  It makes the place just that much better.

And the location is ideal  in the heart of the district of Gros Caillou.  It is just a few minutes to walk to the Eiffel Tower and very close to several bus lines and the Metro.  There is a laundromat across the street and a small grocery store and the *best* bakery right around the corner.  There is also a variety of options for dining within a few blocks - fine dining to pizza - and we didn't have a bad meal. In fact, we had several excellent meals.

We truly love the Hotel de Londres Eiffel and the staff - it is a family and the kind you love and boast about.  <3 

Special shout out to Terry for getting the most difficult dinner reservations set up for us!!

title: Highly Recommend Hotel de Londres Eiffel!!!
text: My daughter and I just returned from a Rick Steves Best of Paris tour, and we stayed at the Hotel de Londres Eiffel for six nights with the tour and for an extra night before the tour started. We loved the hotel and staff, and it truly became a home away from home. The location is ideal (Eiffel Tower is around the corner, and the metro is nearby) and every person there was wonderful -- the 24/7 front desk staff helped us every step of the way, from storing our bags until our room was ready, restaurant recommendations, cars to and from the airport, printing tour tickets and boarding passes, directions to various places and providing umbrellas on a rainy day! The daily breakfast buffet got us off to a good start, and the ladies serving were attentive and kind. Our room, while small, was comfortable, quiet (courtyard side), cool (yes, there was air-conditioning!), well-stocked (mini frig, toiletries, TV, coffee/tea service, safe, and hair dryer), and had a fairly large bathroom. And it was cleaned and restocked every day! Finally, the lobby was cozy and inviting -- it became our first landing spot after touring each day thanks to its comfy chairs, water and snacks, stocked bookshelves, and board games -- and the wifi is strong throughout the hotel. We were sad to leave our Paris "home" and will definitely stay here again on any future visit!

text:
We stayed at Hotel Londres as part of a Rick Steves' Best of Paris tour. We stayed two days before and two days after the tour. At first there were no rooms available for one of those days, but the staff kept in touch with us before our trip, promising us a room if one became available. Thankfully that happened! It was our first time in Paris and we felt so welcomed by the staff. To say the least, the hotel is perfect. It is beautifully decorated and maintained. Our room was very comfortable and clean. Although we loved opening the windows to hear the city outside, we also appreciated how quiet it was when the windows were closed and the AC was on. The hotel is close to many major sites (Les Invalides, Tour Eiffel, Champ de Mars, the Quais on the Seine, etc.), and to public transportation, great restaurants, lovely market streets, boulangers and wine shops, even a laundromat right across the street! The buffet breakfast is superb--croissants, fruit, yogurt, breads, sliced meats, excellent coffee. My husband wanted to inhale the jam.  
We can't say enough about the friendly, knowledgeable and helpful staff, including Adrian and Arnaud. Merci a tous! If and when we are lucky enough to return to Paris we will surely stay here again!

title: Highly recommended
text:
Highly recommended.  

This family owned and operated boutique hotel deserves all the praise in its TripAdvisor reviews.  

Safe and clean facilities with excellent management and staff.  Arnaud & Adrien will ensure your stay is comfortable and memorable.   They’re excellent hoteliers.   

We stayed three nights at this property in late April prior to a three week tour of France as well as three nights after the conclusion of the tour in late May.  Zero regrets selecting this hotel.   Will return for another stay after a future tour of Europe.  

The hotel is conveniently located in the 7th arrondissement and within blocks of the Eiffel Tower.   Great neighborhood that is full of many close by cafes and restaurants, wine and cheese shops, fresh produce stores, groceries, pharmacies, dry cleaners and laundromats, etc.   Take a stroll down Rue St Domique and to nearby Rue Cler and you’ll see.  Hotel is close to buses, subway and taxis to take you wherever you want to explore.  

Before you travel, strongly recommend reading Rick Steves travel guide for Paris (his tours actually stay at this hotel).  

Suggest making reservations far in advance to the Eiffel Tower and suggest similar reservations for guided tours (early am weekdays are less crowded) of major attractions including world class museums such as the Louvre and Musee D’Orsay.   Also recommend making reservations for a Paris bike tour and 2CV tour after dark.  

Suggest spending a little more money and reserving one of the higher level rooms to view the illuminated Eiffel Tower at night.   At the top of the hour the lights twinkle for five minutes.   For a reasonable price, you can have a bottle of champagne delivered to your room to enjoy the after hours view of the Eiffel Tower.  Simply magic.  

Dean and Sarah 
Charlotte NC

text: I was on a Rick Steves Tour and apparently the company has had a 20 year relationship with this hotel and I can see why.  Although I was on a tour, I was traveling alone. On the second full day of the tour, I broke my Ankle, going down the metro on the way back from Montmartre.  Arno at the desk immediately called a doctor and Laurent, the hotel manager, gingerly walked me over to his office, waited and translated.  One of the staff went over to the pharmacy across the street and got a wheel chair.  They served me breakfast because I could not walk to the buffet to get what I wanted.  The day after the accident occurred, I sat in my room despondent not knowing what I was going to do.  Laurent called on the phone and told me I needed to get out of the room and get lunch.  He wheeled me over to a near-by bistro where I had a lovely lunch that truly revived my spirits.  Earlier in the day, I had tried to go to a pet store on the rue de Grenelle in my wheelchair and even with help I couldn't make it.  After lunch, Laurent came to get me and announced, "we are going to the pet store!"  I was delighted.  I wanted to bring French cat food back for all my friend's cats!!!  It made my day and made the trip!!! I did go to the American Hospital in Paris where they fitted me with a cast.  Back in the states, I had to have surgery as the ankle would not have healed properly on its own.  There are no words to express my gratitude to all these caring, kind and sensitive people.  They really came through when I needed their help.  They will always be in my heart.

In short, I absolutely loved this hotel and have no reservations about recommending it to my friends and family.  Thank you to the staff who made our stay a special one!

title: A Gem Of A Hotel 5*
text:
Being a wheelchair bound disabled person with other disabilitie's I have not travelled or stayed in any establishment since way before the pandemic. I was very nervous about booking any hotel.Well I need not have worried at all.This hotel should be classed as a 5* in my personal opinion.

From a seamless check in & having our room ready for us two hours ahead of the scheduled check in time of 3pm this was greatly received.

Our adapted room was absolutely perfect stunning in fact with a beautiful wetroom with a shower seat & grab rail's & an extra bonus was the rainwater style shower head along with a normal hosed shower.So two shower's in one was an added bonus.The beautiful accessible low level sink & raised toilet was again simply stunning.This wetroom was of showroom quality even the flooring was stunning & dried ever so quickly.

The only couple of niggle's was the mattress was to soft but that was not the hotel's fault as it can not meet everybody's needs & disabilitie's.

The second negative was our room was next to the cleaner's storeroom/cupboard & they were quite loud talking & laughing amongst themselves very early in the morning when they arrived for their shift.That did disturb my sleep on both mornings of our stay but again this was a minor disturbance.

The room also benefited from a huge window with doors either side & a secondary glassed window with artificial greenery that you could see out of both windows but nobody could see in to the room.This was a fantastic addition to the room along with an electric  shutter it really was an amazing asset to the beautiful room with subject to detail.

The manager was gracious & said if there was anything you need just to let her know.Honestly there was nothing we needed as everything was pristine.The linens were also bright white & looked brand new.

To top of the excellence of The Hotel George was the free soft drink mini bar in your room replenished daily this was much needed & greatly received.Along with snacks & more soft drinks available in the lobby area from 2pm-2am.Where else would you get such extra's plus if you are out & pass any other Asotel you can pop in & show your room card & you can enjoy their drinks & snacks on route to sightseeing or stop off on your way back to The Hotel George.

I really wanted to keep this hidden gem a secret from you all for selfish reasons but I can not do that as it needs to be praised for being so outstanding.

Thank you to all the staff for making our stay so welcoming.

So please do not hesitate in booking this outstanding hotel.

The Hotel George will always be our go to hotel when we are in Paris.

title: Fantastic Find - Friendly Quiet Convenient Hotel
text:
The Hotel George - Astotel exceeded our expectations in every possible way!  We loved it!  We are a family of four, with a 16yr old and 13 yr old.  We stayed in the "Family Room" setup which is really two rooms with a small foyer area.  One room had a double bed for us and the second room had two twin beds for the kids.  Each room had it's own bathroom and air conditioning which was really nice.  The setup allowed us all to have plenty of elbow room and our own space to recharge.

We have to mention the staff by name because they were so good at customer service at every interaction we had with them.  We really want their management/owner to know them by name and recognize their efforts. Kalden - she was incredibly friendly and helpful overall.  Anything we asked and needed help with she went above and beyond to try and help us.  Antione - again he was super helpful and very friendly at all times.  Sofiane - he was the first person who helped us late at night when we checked in.  He was great at getting us a little oriented with the area and tried really hard to help us settle in and he succeeded!  Sam - again another super friendly and helpful staff member.  Whoever is in charge of hiring staff is doing a great job at this hotel.

The amenities were great as well.  This is not a high end luxury hotel but it is very nice overall.  They have a small lounge area with free snacks and drinks at all times.  Every morning they have a delicious breakfast spread in a large room with multiple tables and a super great coffee maker.  This was SO nice because it was so convenient for us to just get fueled for the days activities without having to seek out breakfast.

So the location of the hotel is also quite nice.  The area is a bit off the beaten path and quiet overall.  It is super convenient from the Gard du Nord and steps away from the St Georges #12 Metro station.  We took the #12 Metro line to many of the attractions we wanted to see.  It is also really close to the Pigalle Metro station.  Also nearby there is groceries, pharmacies, restaurants, laundromats, and more.

Just a note - the Pigalle area is a real mix of red light style shops and normal shops.  So it is not really family friendly there.

You really will enjoy this hotel if you decide to stay.  If and when we get to Paris, we will be staying here again!

title: Love this hotel!
text:
Stayed at the George for a full week and it was awesome!  The decor is quirky and unusual so the hotel has a really engaging feel.  The bedrooms have everything you need (including mini fridges with free soft drinks which are replenished daily and kettles plus sachets of coffee/tea bags).  You can collect free snacks each day (after 2pm) from the "Free Bar" area in reception (and also more soft drinks are available there too, also free).  The bed was super-comfortable and I loved the pillows - they were actually like clouds!  The aircon was great!

The staff were all great, but especially Kalden at reception ... she was lovely ... super-friendly and helpful.  

Location-wise, the George is brilliant - it's no distance from the metro station at all (Saint-Georges is closest, but also Pigalle and Blanche are nearby).  However, we walked pretty much everywhere .... Sacre Coeur, Galeries Lafayette, Louvre, Latin Quarter, Notre Dame, Eiffel Tower, Place Diana ....and the Moulin Rouge is a gentle stroll away too.  That said, the immediate area is great because it has lots of bistros on the doorstep (the cafe on the corner downhill opposite does great 'frites' and wine ... that became our 'local'), plus a range of small supermarkets and boulangeries.  

Something we found really helpful was that as Astotel guests, we could visit other Astotels in Paris for (free) snack (and toilet) stops ... this was super-useful.  There's a map that comes with your key and we made it a priority to go to other Astotels during our trip ... the George was still our favourite though!

So overall - would we stay here again?  Yes, definitely.  This hotel had everything - lovely staff, great rooms, quirky decor and superb location.  Loved everything about it!

title: Absolutely outstanding stay, location, staff and with amenities galore. Read this!!
text:
This hotel falls into the “you think it’s too good to be true, but it’s exactly true and amazing” category. I have been to Paris dozens of times and stayed in hotels and Airbnb’s. My fiancé had never been. I’ve always loved the 9th&10th arrondissement so knew where I wanted to be. At the time of booking a lot was affordable but from now on I’ll only stay at Astotel hotels. Here’s what happens …
They own 17 hotels around Paris. When you stay at one you get to go into any of the other locations anytime and enjoy at all of them … FREE beverages, snacks which include pastries and cakes at some, bathrooms, Wi-Fi, couches and location help. Unreal! It’s like a personal network there to make your own trip better. And better yet they have the coolest interior decor that is unique to each hotel so you want to go looking just to see how pretty they are. 
The room we had at The George was great. Perfectly comfortable good sized bed (Queen by US standards), good size bathroom (European bathrooms are notoriously tight and small), walls were thick enough we could head a baby screaming at one point but no conversation through the walls. Prime location to metro. Absolutely safe. Don’t feel being close to Pigalle (old red light district and where Moulin Rouge is) is a reason to worry. Be smart obviously but that goes without saying. 
Staff were so cheerful and pleasant and offered to book things for us if we wanted but didn’t jam them at us either. Maps, guides and umbrellas all offered complimentarily in abundance. Amazing value for money especially when you’re out for the day and just need a breather somewhere or some Wi-Fi or a snack or a toilet and you can pop into any location. 
Couldn’t recommend enough. We live in the US and travel A LOT, this chain and location will be our go to from now on.

title: Lovely little hotel in a great location with brilliant staff!
text:
We got back yesterday from a 2 night stay here as a couple with a 14 year old daughter (it was technically her Christmas present!) 

Location wise it is excellent - the tube station at Saint Georges is literally a 2 minute walk away. This gives you access to Concorde and it's really easy to zip around the City on the Metro wherever you need to get to. 

When we arrived we took the train from CDG airport to Gare du Nord then walked from there to the hotel. 

Getting there seemed to take longer than the 20 minutes it was supposed to but a large suitcase (no comment!!) and getting distracted definitely played a part! On the way back we got a taxi in rush hour that took about an hour and was 65 Euros. 

The area of the hotel felt very safe and there's everything you need nearby. A cute little shop around the corner is owned by an extremely friendly shopkeeper and after 22:00 it is about a 5 minute walk to a small supermarket slightly further away. 

There are plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby if needed.

Regarding the hotel the whole place is exceptionally clean. The vibe is colourful, fun and relaxed but without being tacky. The staff are excellent and always happy to chat if you want to but also utterly professional too. 

As we were only staying a couple of nights we shared one room which was very clean, comfortable and had an excellent bathroom. The powerful shower had a large fixed head as well as a separate "detachable" one.

Of particular note in the room is the complimentary drinks in the small fridge. There is water, Tropicana juice in bottles, Pepsi and sparkling water. These are included and restocked on a daily basis. There is also a coffee machine and we also had a small outdoor area with a table and a couple of chairs too. However it was very cold so they didn't get much use!

The hotel itself was relatively quiet which is great as I normally prefer a quieter option as a base rather than the constant buzz of city life! 

There is also an "open bar" with a coffee machine and all sorts of pods near the main reception which is complimentary. In addition there is a kettle for making tea too. After 13:00 there is also a selection of snacks like biscuits, muffins, bags of crisps etc. that are complimentary to go with the caffeine fix too! 

Another benefit of this hotel is as it is part of the Astotel chain if you are near another one when you are out and about you can pop in to use the toilet facilities but also grab a coffee and some snacks. Whilst shopping with the ladies we were near the Bradford Hotel (at least I think it was called that) so showed our card at reception and had some excellent cakes and coffee before powering on! 

Breakfast was excellent, an even better coffee machine, fresh pastries, fruit, cereals, yoghurt, eggs, bread and sausages all available. I've probably forgotten a few things too but I generally filled my face with pastries and caffeine.....!! 

Checkout was at noon and you can safely leave any cases at reception as well.

I can't really think of much else to add (fair play if you haven't dozed off reading this yet!) but to summarise I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again due to the location, comfort but above those the friendliness and professionalism of the staff. Highly recommended!

title: Wonderful hotel with super friendly staff!
text: We stayed at this hotel as a family of 4 for 9 nights and we absolutely enjoyed our stay. The family room we stayed in was very spacious and private, so we could rest really well. We also stayed in the double room and twin room for the last couple of nights and those rooms were very nice too. All of the staff were very helpful and friendly, and they went out of their way to help us. Their breakfast was fabulous with a lot of hot bar items (not just eggs and meats) every morning (i.e., total opposite of typical free breakfast in American chain hotels). The free drink minibar (non-alcohol) in each room was a nice touch. Also, they offer all day snacks in the lobby so that you can rest and munch on some sweets after a long day of sightseeing around. Because of this, we hardly needed to buy any water on our own. There were some Metro stations very close by (Réaumur – Sébastopol and Strasbourg-Saint-Denis) too, so it was very easy to get around in Paris. We Highly recommend this hotel!

title: Great little hotel!
text: I stayed in a standard twin room with my teenage daughter for three nights. We both loved it and the location was great for sightseeing. The Louvre, Pompidou Centre, shopping around Le Marais were within 15 minutes’ walk and it was easy to get to the Eiffel Tower, Montmartre etc. on public transport. Some lovely bars and restaurants close by too. The room was clean, much more spacious than I expected and full of interesting little quirks related to the hotel’s music/film theme. The beds were super comfortable and the shower was excellent and always hot. The fridge and daily top-ups of soft drinks were much appreciated after a busy day, and the breakfast was delicious, varied and plentiful. All the staff were very friendly and helpful, and made us feel welcome and at ease. Our room was at the front of the hotel and I was worried traffic noise from what is quite a busy road would disturb me but the windows were very well sound proofed and I wasn’t woken once. I would definitely stay at 123 Le Sebastopol again and would recommend it my friends.

Very convenient location (very central),

title: Lovely Hotel
text:
One of the best hotels we've stayed at. The attention to details in the rooms are amazing, like there was a suitcase as the sink and a drum as the bedside table. You are made to feel welcome as soon as you enter the hotel and are shown around everywhere. There are complimentary toiletries in the room so shampoo/shower gel in one, conditioner, body lotion, cotton buds, cotton pads and a shower cap. Then the usual handsoap. There is also a very powerful hair dryer and offers of additional toiletries such as razors so no need to bring your own.

This was our first trip abroad after the pandemic so we were a bit wary of going and how everything would feel. We stayed in 4 different hotels during our trip and I would say this hotel we felt the most safe at. The cleanliness of the place is outstanding, all the staff had masks on at all times especially those serving food. There is hand sansister near the breakfast areas for you to use. Even though guests don't have to wear masks, we did just out of respect for the staff.

The free soft drinks mini bar in the room is a lovely addition and really saves money having to go to the supermarket for drinks etc. This is restocked daily and if you are there when they restock it they will offer you more.

The breakfast is well stocked and the free snacks from 2pm - 2am at any of the Astotel hotels is really useful especially as Paris is quite busy and it is difficult to find a public toilet. It's a great escape to see how near you are to one of them and just go inside for a 20 minute break.

We never used the cinema but it looked good and would be perfect if you want a break for the afternoon or have kids with you and want to give them a bit of downtime. There are a selection of free films in your room of about 40 ish in different languages and subtitles which we made use of one night.

It is in the middle of two different metro stations so perfect for getting around Paris. There are also some good cafes and restaurants nearby. It is about a 20 minute walk away from the Louvre, when we checked out we left our bags there for a few hours and the baggage was well managed, everything is labelled and you get a ticket in order to get your luggage back which is locked away so all feels very safe which you don't always get in hotels.

Even though it's on a main road it is relatively quiet at night. All I would say is we stayed end of April to beginning of May and the room was quite hot at night, we could open the window during the day but didn't like leaving it open at night and they don't switch the AC on in the room until summer. That's the only criticism which is not really a criticism I would have, to just switch it on earlier.

title: Trip to Paris
text: The hotel is in a good location, 10 minute walk away from the train station/tube that takes you straight to the Disney park, fashion shops and supermarkets nearby too with restaurants for nice food and drinks. Staff were very friendly and helpful, decent sized room for 2 people, comfy bed and nice shower.

title: Great location
text: Excellent hotel and location.  Very near the metro (5 minute walk) and great neighborhood with restaurants and walking around. Staff was super friendly and very welcoming everyday  we came and went from hotel. Unexpected perk was the snacks and beverages  every afternoon. Great to refresh in the afternoon after a morning of sight seeing before going out again in the evening.

title: Near to Gare Salazar - very comfortable hotel
text: The room was clean and the bed was comfortable!  The check in was quick and easy!  A great location in the center / not far away from all of the major sites! Many of the attractions was a straight walk down one street or with only one turn!  The serve a nice breakfast and have a bar (I didn't visit) in the hotel!

title: Great location and high quality
text: Spacious rooms, updated bathroom - everything very nice and clean and with a great location - and at a good price. Very friendly staff and nice atmosphere. Very nice breakfast and complimentary mini bar in the room. Highly recommended. Went there on business but would definately come back with my family as well.

title: Nifty Hotel in central Paris
text: Hotel Augustin is a safe bet for those looking for a clean, personal, friendly 3 star Hotel with bags of personality. Staff are welcoming and friendly. The rooms are spotless with cheerful decor and air conditioning. Ours had a little balcony where we could sit and sip a coffee watching life below and gaze over the rooftops of neighbouring streets. (Kids would be at risk on the balcony and there are notices warning that adult supervision is essential). The windows are double glazed which cuts out any street noise at night allowing a peaceful nights sleep. Beds are very comfortable. Breakfast is a buffet with plenty on offer including a small hot section and decent coffee... very cheerful breakfast staff give an upbeat start to your day. Free non-alcoholic drinks replenished each day in the mini bar and a free coffee/soft drink and cake bar near reception are very welcome for hot Paris summer days. Handy for St Augustin metro station and a bus (43) straight from/to Gare du Nord this Hotel is in a less touristy part of Paris that is safe and clean. Very appealing place to stay in Paris.

title: Paris
text: Wonderful place to stay, near from downtown and  excellent service from de personal who works in this hotel. I will return to stay here. I love the view, the hotel room and decoration. Definitely this is the place where you love to stay

title: good stay
text:
excellent position if you want to visit paris, you can walk, use tube, uber, taxi etc

clean and not so tiny rooms, friendly and english speaking staff

didnt use breakfast, its located near saint augustin square (tube)

title: Very beautiful hotel. Modern/Retro vibe mix.
text: Very beautiful hotel with very pleasant staff. The room was very comfortable and very clean and the breakfast was amazing. They also had 24/7 snacks and drink for free. I've never been to another hotel that offers that and I've been to a lot. Highly recommend.

title: Great hotel in a great location!
text: We absolutely loved our stay here! The staff were all friendly! Breakfast was delicious, and the room was very spacious and clean! The location was great, close to multiple metro stations and bus stops!

title: Wonderful stay
text: Rooms were clean, comfortable, and nicely decorated. Staff was great. Good location near shops, restaurants, train station. Walk to the sights/museums was doable. We all enjoyed the afternoon snacks and drinks. Breakfast and coffee was very good.

title: Highly recommend
text: Really enjoyed staying here! Such a safe and welcoming environmet. Really made our stay in Paris extra special. Particularly Claudia who went out of her way to make our stay enjoyable. Highly recommend

title: Perfect
text:
We loved this hotel. The location was great . Our room ( Superior room with little balcony) was lovely, cleaned every day and free mini bar ( soft drinks) was restocked every day and bed was comfy.
Free snacks in the afternoon were a bonus and the range on offer , sweet and savory, was unexpected.
We would definitely stay here again.

title: Helpful staff and comfortable accommodations
text: Staff was helpful in giving directions, calling taxis, and even helping me try to place a call to an Italian number. Breakfast was ample, and rooms were clean and bright. Proximity to metro station was helpful in allowing us to get around the city more easily.

title: Perfect stay
text: Stayed for 3 nights at this lovely hotel and couldn't have asked for more!. Rooms were spacious and clean with a quirky decor. All staff were friendly and pleasant. Breakfast and snacks were plentiful. Location was great with restaurants, bars and a metro station all close by. Would definitely stay again. Thank you all for a lovely stay.

title: Good hotel to stay in in Paris
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Nice personal touches such as daily refill of non-alcoholic drinks in the mini-fridge. Clean and great location. Transportation easily accessible. Good choice of restaurants around although many were closed due to the August holidays.

title: Wonderful and welcoming
text: Loved, loved, loved this hotel. Not only were the rooms bright and cheerful, so was the staff! Desk clerks always welcoming and Ariel, in charge of breakfast room, was a ray of sunshine greeting us with a boisterous “Hi Lady!”every  morning of our 5 day stay! (Breakfast was amazing and nice variety).  Great location near bus and metro. Laundromat nearby and close to restaurants. Would definitely return here!

title: Nicest stay in Paris with clean rooms and friendly staff.
text:
We stayed here as a family of 4 and had two rooms which were small (but big for Paris), but very clean and modern and colorful designed.

The hotel is in a quite neighborhood but in walking distance to the Boulevard Haussmann (where all the big shops are) and easily reachable by public transport.

The breakfast buffet in the morning is good and rich in variety. In the afternoon you get little snacks and soft drinks for free which we very much liked and used.
The staff is very friendly and helpful and especially the guy named Ariel made your day every morning with his big smile.

We would easily come back and stay here again!

title: Wonderful staff, breakfast and mini-fridge
text:
We stayed at Hotel Augustin from July 5-10 and loved our stay.  Our favorite parts were the kind hotel staff,  breakfast, balcony and stocked mini fridge.  

Breakfast was only €5 for unlimited pastries, eggs, juices, fruit, cereal, coffee, etc.  Everything was also top quality.  There’s also a mini-fridge in each room with unlimited beverages that gets refilled daily.  One evening, we had a balcony “picnic” with baguette, brei and wine. 

The staff is incredibly helpful and fast to respond.  After we left, we realized we left an AirPod behind.  They immediately contacted us and sent it out the next day. I’m grateful that they were so helpful.  

This was our 4th time to Paris and we HIGHLY recommend Hotel Augustin.

title: Lovely modern hotel in the heart of the city
text:
We are Americans who never travelled to Paris and I was looking for something close to the sights-- Eiffel Tower, Louvre, etc and access to a Metro station. St. Augustin was lovely and checked all the boxes. Prior to arriving I emailed the hotel and they promptly answered all of my questions. At check in, the young lady at the hotel (I remember her name but don't want to post on the internet) was just lovely and welcoming and warm. The room itself was small, but that is to be expected in Paris. It was very clean, modern and well maintained. The black out curtains and sound proof windows are essential in Paris during the summer and the AC blew cold. 

We have a small child and they even added a roll away bed in advance since she was on my reservation. They have a wonderful daily breakfast where everyone can find something-- it has hot eggs, sausage, vegetables, cheese/meat plates, bread, cereal, and an amazing drink machine that makes terrific cappuccinos. The afternoon reception from 2 PM has snacks and soda/juice until 2 AM which is nice to help accommodate breaks during travel. We actually went to two other astotels, one of which was rated #1 on tripadvisor for their receptions/bathrooms as we explored Paris and were welcomed with smiles.

The St. Augstin location is a beautiful clean neighborhood with an easy to access Metro. Compared to some of the other neighborhoods in Paris (and I am not an expert), this location seemed to be rather nice-- it felt very Parisian and well maintained. Lots of restaurant options and a Monoprix across the way if you need to buy essentials. 

Loved it!

title: Wonderful place!!!
text:
Fabulous stay! Just left Hotel Augustin today after 5 wonderful days. I’d read the reviews prior to booking and they are solid and on the spot! 
Location for us was perfect, we took the metro everywhere and had no problem accessing multiple stations all very close.
The breakfast was well worth the additional 6 EU per person per day! Eggs, veggies, bread, juices, sausage, quite varied and tasty. The afternoon/evening goodies we tried, helped to tide us over, but we were out most of the day, so really didn’t take advantage of the perk.
Our room was regularly stocked with water, juice and soft drinks. Room had a great view of the cathedral St. Augustin. We enjoyed opening the windows and hearing the city, but once closed, the room was so quiet!
Every staff member was superb! Very accommodating and friendly! I should have gotten their names!
Absolutely loved this place, will either return or try one of their other hotels just for the fun of it!

title: AMAZING STAY, EXCELLENT LOCATION!
text: The hotel did not fail our expectations!! It is located in a very nice neighborhood with restaurants and cafes and the metro station is really close. The room was cute and really comfortable and had a minibar with refreshments, all for free. They were also serving free snacks and soft drinks all afternoon for their guests. The staff was the kindest and they helped us with all our requests. The breakfast was not included in the price but with only 10EUR we ate a delicious breakfast. Totally recommend it without a second thought!

title: Excellent experience at Hotel Augustin

Two twin beds pushed together offer a bit more surface area than a standard EU double bed, and the beds were comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful. It was so nice to have the free mini bar with water, juice, and soda in your room every day, and the free breakfast and tea time with snacks was great.

title: Does not disappoint!

title: Excellent!

Will definitely be returning 👍🏼

title: Perfect Place after Long Paris Days

We (2) thoroughly enjoyed this hotel. Disclaimer - the room that we had was TINY. We had a double (two twin beds pushed together) with not much space to walk around the edge - especially with two suit cases.
HOWEVER - We did not go to Paris to spend lots of time in a hotel. Beds were comfortable, shower was nice and decor was very cheery. They provide snacks and soft drinks during the afternoon and that was a great amenity after a long day when it was still not time for dinner. There was plenty of seating in the snack area, which was a great addition to the room. They also provide free mini bar non-alcoholic drinks.
The staff was great! They were cheerful and went out of their way to help us and other guests. Anything from locating a 24 hour pharmacy, figuring out how best to get to the airport on a holiday to ordering a pizza delivery. I highly recommend this hotel!

title: Awesome place for our family
text: Family of 4 (parents + 2 teenage girls) and our first time staying at this hotel. Our usual was booked, but we are very happy to have found this place and will stay here next time. All staff was super friendly and helpful. Our rooms were two rooms joined by a little entry way (rooms 208 & 209). It was nice to have double of everything (especially bathrooms and fridges). The rooms are small, but it didn't matter because we don't come to Paris to stay in our hotel room. Beds were comfortable. Loved the duvet setup. Love the stocked fridge with free drinks and afternoon/evening snacks. I didn't have the breakfast, but my husband did and he loved it. Also, they have a decent sized elevator which is a bonus. Very clean bathrooms that looked recently renovated. Plenty of warm water. Two thumbs way up for this hotel!

Natalia
