title: Best budget hotel for a Paris Trip!
text:
I stayed in Hotel Augustin with my Girlfriend for two nights in the period between Christmas and New Years. I was absolutely delighted with the Room, the Service and the Location. We paid about €404 for the two nights in a standard room, so €202 a night. For such a busy peak period as the holidays this was not a surprised and seemed fair for the quality of the service.

1. The Room
The room was located in the corner of the sixth floor. The room was perfectly clean. The bed itself was a comfortable double bed. There were two (yes two) balconies. One had a gorgeous view of the Cathedrale Saint Augustin. The bathroom was a little claustrophobic but the shower was very nice. The room came with a complimentary mini fridge (yes free) with Water, Juice and Diet and Regular Pepsi, which was restocked both days. This was a fantastic resource as it saved us buying bottles of water as we explored the city.

2. The Service
The staff were extremely friendly! Nothing but smiles and a welcoming disposition. I cannot compliment them enough as we never felt awkward to approach if we needed anything. They all spoke excellent English too which made us feel all the more welcome. The room came with breakfast included with the room and was a simple buffet. Nothing fancy, but you never went hungry, it was perfect for fueling up for a day of touristy stuff. They do not have a restaurant or bar like other hotels, but the do leave out free snacks in the breakfast area around lunchtime if you are getting peckish. Just Croissants and Pastries and bits like that. No complaints from me as we sought finer dining out in the city. If you are travelling in Covid times, I would highly recommend this hotel. There were signs posted in English and French explaining exactly what to do if you caught symptoms (thankfully we did not), but we felt good knowing what was required of us should the worst happen. Other hotels were not so clear as we found out later. Service was 5 out of 5 for sure, just make sure you prepare a plan for dinner during your stay. I'm sure if you asked the staff would give excellent recommendations.

3. The Location
As I mentioned, we were right next to the Cathedral Saint Augustin. We never once had to take any public transport while in Paris. The hotel is located very near the Champs-Élysées and the Arc de Triumph. We walk quite slowly, but never had to walk more than 60 minutes to see any of the tourist attractions we wanted to see. We visited the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower, the Arc, and went on a Seine boat tour to see sights like Notre Dame, all accessible by foot. There are countless restaurants and cafes in the area as well so you'll have no trouble finding somewhere to eat.

All in all, as you can tell by this absolute essay of a review, I really appreciated the hotel. Cannot recommend enough for anyone looking to get right into the center of the action. 5 out of 5.

title: Great Location Service & Rate!
text:
We were so pleasantly surprised at how convenient the location was.  We were able to walk everywhere; the Champs Elysées, thé Eiffel Tower, Moulin Rouge, as well as , Avenue de Montaigne.. etc. 
The staff was super friendly and accommodating. The room, although, a little small, it was perfect for us, as we spent most of the day sightseeing.. the bed/pillows were comfortable and clean.. the bathroom was spotless.. the hotel breakfast was delicious and had everything we wanted. 
We would definitely go back!!

title: Highly recommended!
text:
-Excellent location, 10 minutes walking distance from 3 metro stations! 15 minutes walk to champs elysée, opera and many more attractions.

-Friendly and helpful staff 

-Clean rooms, Safety measures taken 

-Delicious breakfast

title: Beyond words
text: It is hard to find the words to express how wonderful my stay was at the Augustin. Great staff, cool design, cosy room, access to enjoy tea time in the other hotels of the group.... I wish I could give a 100 stars.

title: Perfect base for paris business trip
text:
Wonderful staff, perfect location, care for guests, space to work from and cozy room with little balcony. I will come again and I recommend it to all of you.
It made my journey wonderful, thank you so much!

title: Tres agréable!
text:
A hotel with pleasant, friendly staff - a good size room and bathroom - well located for walking and seeing the sights within Central Paris, and part of a handy little scheme whereby afternoon drinks and snacks can be obtained in any of the Group's hotels around Paris.

Breakfast was one of the best selections we've come across in a Parisian hotel (even those at a higher grade), with a multitude of cold and some hot options. Complimentary soft drinks AND a kettle with Tea/Coffee were also available within your room, which is often unheard of.

We booked a Superior Room and requested a corner - in part because it looked so good on the photos. And it DID live up to expectations. Place Saint Augustin (very close by) has its imposing Church and Neoclassical Cercle National des armées - both impressive structures and right on the doorstep. Equally, there is lots to explore within easy reach, and the hotel team will be only too pleased to assist and direct you.

Merci beaucoup!

title: Lovely!
text: A lovely hotel in a lovely location. Our room was spacious, the bed was comfortable, there was a choice of pillows.  It was spotlessly clean and quiet. There is a kettle with tea and coffee, a free minibar with water, juice and cola that was refilled daily. The whole place is clean, and observes the hygiene rules.  In the morning ( from 7 until 10, at weekends till 11) the hotels  offers a very nice breakfast with cold and hot options, juices, pastry. One can also enjoy daily free snack from late afternoon till late in the evening, Actually the same snacks can be enjoyed in a  all the hotels of the same chain - Astotel. The map with these hotels is given at check in. The hotel staff is very friendly and helpful. There are lots of restaurants and shops around and a few metro and bus stops from where you can easily and quickly get wherever you want. It does not take long though to go on foot to the famous spots - Opera , the Louvre, the Arc de Triumph - about 20  minutes all, to Cite and Saint Germain - maybe 10-15 minutes longer.

title: Mother and daughter take on Paris
text: Our stay at Hotel Augustin was great. We were greeted by the enthusiastic Fabio who provided some stellar recommendations on where to visit during our stay in Paris. I recommend others who are considering staying at this hotel to book the breakfast as well. They had a great variety everyday. Honorable mention: Ariel was awesome. He played a variety of music downstairs to get you in the mood for your daily voyage. All in all 10/10. I will totally return to this hotel on my next trip to Paris. Thanks for the superb customer service!

title: Quiet, spacious and comfortable room
text: Hotel ideally situated for our needs. We were happy to discover Hotel Augustin and spend one night there last week. Very pleasant staff. The room was spacious which is not the norm in Paris and it was very clean. Good breakfast. The offer of crisps, peanuts, fruit and drinks downstairs and the free use of the minibar in the room is  nice and welcome.

title: Amazing hotel
text: The hotel was very cosy, and excellently located  within walking distance from the Opera and Lafayette Galleries. The room was spacious and very stylishly decorated. This hotel is best value for money, will definitely come back!

title: Weekend trip to Paris
text:
10/10
From the check-in to the check-out a pleasant stay at the hotel. Easy and fast check-in. Very friendly people and some nice extras like the free mini-bar in the room. Looking forward to the next trip to paris and stay in the hotel Augustin.

title: Amazing attention to detail
text: Amazing hotel, really loved staying here. The staff went out their way to help us but leaving balloons on the bed for the special occasion stay. Able to leave baggage if checking out early in the day. Rooms nice and quiet and lovely shower.

title: The second time we’ve stayed  at the Astotel chain
text:
Love the concept of the hotels . Clean, comfy, quirky 
The minibar and help your self area is a very kind and  welcome USP
Nice breakfast 
Very friendly staff 
Great location , fantastic restaurants nearby 
We will be back

title: One of the best
text: We've visited a lot of hotels in our lives and this one was one of the best for sure. The staff was so polite and friendly. The room was tide and there was variety of foods and drinks for breakfast. The location of hotel is perfect as you are nearby to every attraction in town.

title: Good location, good place, good price
text: The hotel is well located, in a quiet area but really near from many tourist atraccions. Subway is really close, so the location is really convenient. The rooms are clean and confortable, and the staff are really nice and helpfull. It will be my first choice when I come back to Paris.

title: friendly staff, good location
text: good location close too all sights etc although the street itself is nice and quiet, decent breakfast provided, staff are very friendly. Plenty of restaurants close by. Rooms are pretty basic and small but that's normally the case with a city centre hotel.

title: Excellent value hotel in a great location
text: We spent two nights at Hotel Augustin in October 2021. The hotel is in a great location, being within walking distance of a wide range of locations/sights around Paris, and with excellent transport links (metro, bus). The room was bright, relatively spacious and quiet. Breakfast offered a good choice of cold and hot food (although the coffee was pretty forgettable!) and the free soft drinks are a welcome bonus. The staff are excellent - very accommodating and welcoming. This was our first stay here, and I'd happily stay again.

title: Great. Customer oriented.  Good location.  Small rooms.
text: The hotel staff was super friendly and helpful.  The location was very convenient to many locations including short walks to the Champs Elysees, Gare St. Lazare, and many metro stations.  The available snacks from 2pm onward was tremendous and super appreciated.  Rooms were clean.  Fantastic showers!  Only complaint is that the rooms were very small.  Got two rooms, one of which we upped to a deluxe and it was not a big size difference at all - with that said it is Paris, so rooms are never big at this price range.  As long as your eyes are open on rooms size, I would very much recommend.

title: One of the best hotels I've been to in Europe
text:
It was just perfect! The staff is super nice and helpful. The rooms are very clean and the breakfast is exactly what one needs in the morning. They fill the complimentary minibar every day and they have a nice collection of tea bags.
 I will definitely come back!

title: Fabulous and unforgetable
text: We have spent 10 days at Hotel Augustin in Paris, so this is a review of a couple of travellers that is based not only on just one impression. Firstly, the staff is fantastic. They are always kind, gentle and ready to help no matter what. We have requested help so many times and they were always fabulous. The room was a surprise for the better, it looks much bigger live than on the website. Clean, with a view, very nice bad and a big screen to enjoy it. Also, is super well located and you can go by walking anywhere in the most prestigious area in Paris. In summary, we can not be more happy and satisfied with them. Thank you Fabio and Simone for all! We loved it.

title: One of my best hotel experiences.
text:
Excellent hotel on a great location. Staff is so nice and helpful. Interior is stylish and cleanliness is on point. Free drinks are available in the mini bar, which is quite thoughtful. Breakfast is very good too. 
I would definitely visit again.

title: Clean, comfortable beds, great shower, close to metro
text:
A great hotel for a stay in Paris! We spent two nights here and can't complain. The hotel is situated about a 3-5 minute walk away from "Saint-Augustin"-Metro-station, there's lots of busses stopping around the hotel and yet it's quite quiet in the rooms. We had a room facing the church and hence the road and it was still quiet enough except for the ambulances/fire trucks which are obviously louder. 

The bathroom in our room seemed to have been recently renovated, everything was modern, great water pressure, warm water throughout, everything was very clean. Spacious enough rooms for hotels in the city. Hooks to hang up your things, a safe, everything you'd need available. One downside: our door was bent - it locked, but light came through thorughout the night. 

There's a free minibar with soda, orange juice and water that is refilled every day. Such a thoughtful thing for a city hotel! One can also get free snacks (croissants, cookies, ...) and drinks (water, juices, coffee, tea) from 2pm on in the lobby. 

Breakfast is a selection of cold cuts, cheeses, croissants, different breads/toast, a small salad bar and also warm dishes like scrambled egg/omelette, bacon, quiche, sausages. Big selection for the price. 

Staff was very helpful and friendly and spoke good English, but also accomodated me practicing my French.

title: Very good
text: Everything was perfect, best place in paris, i came back again next vacation, i love the room ,location, staff they are very nice i never been in a hotel so wonderful i already miss it so much, so thank you.

title: Excellent hotel situated near Champs Elysees
text:
Great hotel, very polite and helpful stuff, very clean, superb location close to metro, shops and restaurants. Loved the doctor also the free mini bar is a great addition.  Free Snacks and drinks available most of the day in the restaurant 👍 nice touch!  Very good breakfast.
Will definitely recommend and come back again!

title: A great place to come back to - this was our 2nd time
text:
This is the 2nd time we stayed at this hotel, and this time with your one year old daughter.

Given the good experiences we had 3 years ago as a couple, we wanted to stay here again. Prior to our stay we wanted to make sure there would be a baby crib available, and we could have the option of having a room with a balcony, so we could sit outside in the evenings with our daughter inside sleeping.

The contact prior to our stay was super friendly, and all our wishes were no problem at all, and we had once again a great stay. Even with our little one, it was no problem at all, and everybody seemed to really enjoy our little daughter roaming around the breakfast room in the mornings :)

title: astotel
text: good! very nice, small rooms, very well breakfast, very nice personal, comfortable bed, there is free drinks in the rooms, the television doesn´t work correctly, very central in general, with the metro very near, i didn´t see a supermarket near, in general very well.

title: Excellent location and wonderful & welcoming staff.
text: So nice to come back to Astotel St. Augustin after 18 months.  The team are so friendly and welcoming and even had my toilet back waiting for me in my room which I left behind 18 months ago.  It is a really charming hotel in an excellent location and I have never elsewhere in Paris experienced such excellent sutomer service and attention to detail.  Looking forward to my next visit!

title: Great value
text:
#1 Stephanie at the reception desk was very helpful & accommodating
#2 Good size clean rooms 
#3 Very good breakfast buffet with lots of options
#4 Great location
Overall- you get so much more for your money when you stay here

title: Amazing Hoten and excellent place to stay
text: ideal location to start your tour(s), Busses, Metro in the near, great cafes in all streets in area, Supermarket in two minutes, and personal in hotel friendly competent, Rooms with climate, clean and free Minibar, TOP

title: Very nice stay at Astotel Augustin
text:
Well located  new hotel, rooms are quite confortable and big enough considering Paris standard.
Staff is very nice and breakfast is good.
A very good point is the free drinks from the minibar and coffee, tea and snacks also included and served along the afternoons.

title: Great place to stay!
text: The location of this hotel is great, very central in paris. We also really enjoyed the free minibar and free drinks and snacks in the lobby. The staff was very friendly. The room we had was a decent size and had a nice balcony. The room was a bit dirty, that was the only downside. But still I will give it 5/5 stars.

title: EXCELLENT HOTEL
text: Very Clean. Extremely polite staff! comfortable rooms. Daily cleaning in the room. Extremely close to the center. Very good breakfast. I will definitely stay back on this on my next visit to Paris!!!!

title: Wonderful Stay and great service!
text: From the moment we saw the pics online, we knew this was the hotel for us. A great value and love the free drinks and snacks. Nice size room and very clean with a great Juliet balcony. Room cleaned every day and front desk staff was fantastic. Can't wait to come back here.

title: A hidden gem in the heart of Paris
text: I recently stayed at this hotel and I was pleasantly surprised.....the staff were extremely welcoming and hospitable, my room was spacious, clean and modern and the breakfast provided plenty of options.  I was absolutely blown away by my entire experience.  This hotel will now be my regular go to for all trips to Paris - business and leisure.

title: Wonderful stay at Hotel Mareuil
text: I have stayed at this hotel several times, it is a modern boutique hotel in a great location.  The Hotel Mareuil is a 4 star hotel with all the amenities you would expect, I have stayed at many similar standard hotels In Paris all very good, however, for me, it is the staff that set the Mareuil apart, they are wonderful, friendly, helpful and accommodating. The rooms are modern and comfortable. This was my first visit to the hotel since the pandemic, the rooms were pared back, no mini bar nor lotions etc to facilitate ease of cleaning and sanitising although everything was available at reception on request.  The hotel was immaculate, I felt absolutely safe and have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to others.  I will be returning on my next visit to Paris.

title: Excellent hotel
text: Good central location and not noisy at all. The hotel is very clean and well appointed. Friendly and professional staff. We didn't get a chance to use the gym or hammam. A good breakfast with fresh juices.

title: Wonderful stay and great location!
text: I loved everything about my stay at Hotel Le Mareuil! The location is fantastic-in the heart of the Marais, close to tons of great restaurants, but on a quiet street (so no traffic or other noise to keep you up after a long day of Paris fun). The staff were fantastic, attentive and helpful, and their English was far better than my French. Beautiful room with plenty of space, and the bed was very comfortable. Lovely breakfast room to start your day, too. I'd stay here again in a heartbeat, and highly recommend.

title: Excellent Hotel and Location
text:
We were very pleased with our stay. The staff is very friendly, the location is perfect since it's close to a train station, 
grocery stores, wonderful restaurants,  bakeries and an ATM. The hotels facilities are wonderful as well. Very clean and bright. The breakfast was perfect as well. We would certainly stay again.

title: Staying in Hotel
text: Excellent for staying in Paris and enjoying French food, museums, architecture and culture. The staff is very friendly, the breakfast is excellent. I would recommend this hotel to all my friends and, regarding myself, would want to visit Paris and stay at Le Mareuil.

title: Nice hotel and staff
text: We really enjoyed our 3 night stay. The staff was very nice and the room comfortable with everything needed. The breakfast offered a wide selection and the connection to public transportation is very good. We would stay here again without question and can highly recommend this place.

title: Lovely stay in a lovely hotel
text: Thank you Arnaud and team for a great experience. From check-in to check-out, the process was smooth, staff was friendly, rooms were modern, clean, comfortable and fully-equipped. Breakfast was great and included a wide-enough spread to appeal to different palates. I also enjoyed the hammam and like that use of the facility is based on a reserved time slot to allow for privacy. Lastly, I forgot my shoes in my room after checkout and really appreciate Arnaud for retrieving them after I left and ensuring they made it back to me.

title: great hotel with amazing staff
text: the hotel is really great, nice location, walking distance to most of what you want to visit, great breakfast, wide variety of food, the staff is absolutely brilliant, the bathroom would deserve a bit of maintenance (a bit worn off) but no issue with cleanliness

title: Perfect hotel for a city trip
text: The hotel is not the cheapest, but very comfortable. The bed was perfect and its very quiet in the night. Everything was very clean and the location is near restaurants, bars and the metro. The breakfast is very tasty.

title: Holiday in Paris
text:
The Hotel LE MAREUIL is in center of the city, near an important station of the metro.
The road is very silent.
The breakfast is good, but all self service
The rooms are very clean, but - at least the our - too small.
The staff is very gentle.
It is a very good choice if you want to visit Paris and stay not too time in hotel.
Recommended (8,5 / 10)

title: Great location, service and overall a very pleasant Paris stay
text: Well located - steps from Republique and Oberkampf stations in a safe neighbourhood  plus a wonderful staff who also spoke English! Special kudos to Razak! Other notable things include - adequate breakfast spread and great housekeeping/cleaning. One thing for improvement might be the wifi - which wasn't very reliable and slow. But overall a great stay for vacations - can recommend this.

title: Very Pleased
text: Quiet hotel with nice staff and rooms, although small as you would expect in Paris. Good breakfast with more than expected options and great self-serve cafe machine was welcome surprise. Very close to Republic square for easy access to multiple metro lines.

title: Excellent stay at Le Mareuil
text: Very nice hotel, in a quiet street, with great amenities. The rooms are spacious and well equiped, the breakfast was delicious and the staff very kind and helpful ! I had an excellent stay, will come back and strongly recommend.

title: Perfect stay!
text: The room was clean, washroom was large with a lovely rain faucet, and the bed was so comfortable that I fell asleep as soon as my head hit the pillow. Location was pretty central/near metro. Would definitely recommend.

title: Helpful staff
text: Staff of front desk extremely helpful. Location of hotel is convenient. A few supermarket nearby. However, the area is not of the best neigbourhood, with a quite a few streetsleeperse and hoarders nearby.

title: D&D Totolici
text:
Everything was great except for the size of the room.
Staff very frendly and helpful 
Room and beding very clean.
Breakfast with  wide selection of food everithing fresh and well cooked. 
Overall a pleasant stay

title: Wonderful Hotel and Staff
text: This hotel is fabulous, our room was spacious and filled with top notch linens and toiletries.  The location allows you to access many close museums and neighborhoods of interest.  The breakfast room and the food were lovely.  The all day coffee machine was a  real treat.  The staff was warm, helpful and able to assist with all our questions.  We would stay here again!

title: Excellent service, pleasant hotel
text: The staff at this clean and stylish hotel was uniformly helpful, very competent and friendly. No matter what my request was, they handled it with great professionalism. Of the 13 hotels I stayed at during my vacation, the staff at this hotel was by far the best. Bravo to them and the management!

title: Very nice visit at Hotel Le Mareuil
text: Stayed for 3 nights in a quadruple room. Enjoyed very much the rooms, staff and breakfast. 5 min from the metro and bus stations. Good breakfast with a variety of foods. Clean rooms and comfortable beds.

title: The best stay!
text: We spent a great week at Le Mareuil. Our family room was perfect (two connecting rooms with a common foyer), very quiet (except for some early morning construction from the hotel next door - not Le Mareuil's fault) and spotlessly clean. The breakfast every morning is truly amazing - everything you can think of and more. Loved the 24 hour coffee. Hotel is in an amazing location, close to the Mareuil and doesn't feel overrun with tourists. Hard to imagine finding fault with this place!

title: lovely stay during heat wave
text:
The staff was very friendly and helpful.
The (upgraded) room was smaller than expected but the bed was perfect and the airconditioning was able to cope with the heat wave.
Great breakfast.
A real shower instead of bath with shower curtain would be much better.
Good location.

title: Excellent hotel!
text: Amazing staff, beautiful & clean facilities, and perfect location! Great for solo travelers, couples on a romantic holiday, or families. They were able to accommodate some extras to make our stay especially comfortable & romantic. All staff speak perfect English as well.

title: Paris sojourn
text: Hotel Le Mareuil is a fantastic gem of a hotel.  Absolutely my favorite in Paris.  We stayed in the charming 6th floor 'garret' room which was beautiful.  The people at the hotel were incredibly friendly and helpful - always a smile and asking what they could do for us.  We particularly loved Carole.  The breakfast had everything you could hope for - always fresh.

title: Five Star Hotel
text: This property is located near the Republique Square. The staff are very accommodating and friendly. This is why I rate the hotel at five stars. My daughter and I were treated as guests in this small boutique hotel. Carol was so nice and helpful from giving directions upon arrival to any sites we wanted to see. The Breakfast was exceptional from food to decor and again the staff were wonderful! The rooms are so clean and have everything that a five star hotel would provide and more!! We would recommend this hotel to our friends and family! As this is how you are treated here!! Thank you for an excellent experience in Paris!! Merci  😘

title: The staffs are very friendly. I like our connecting room.
text: The location is great. It's close to two difference metro. There are many good restaurants including Korean, Thai, Chinese, Vietnamese food. There are one bakery is very closed to the hotel. I like the hotel located on a inside street, so it is quieter. The staff were extraordinarily friendly.

title: Four day stay
text:
Hotel is well located close to main Metro station and nice neighborhood.
Inside is updated and clean.
Staff are very nice. They do speak English which helps.
Breakfast is good. Free coffee Machine to use daily.

title: Boutique hotel with 5-star service
text: This was my first time staying at Le Mareuil but I would definitely stay here again.  Easy walk (3 min.) to 2 main Metro stations.  Breakfast was fabulous each morning and our last morning we were leaving at 6:30am and they even brought it out early (amazing!!) and had bags ready for us so we could take croissants, etc. to go for our long train journey.  How thoughtful!  That is exactly how we were treated the whole time, they helped us with everything and were so nice and accomodating.   The rates are very reasonable as well.  I would highly recommend this hotel!

title: 5-star oasis in bustling city
text:
Hotel Le Mareuil is one of the best boutique hotels I’ve ever stayed at! The staff went above and beyond to ensure the maximum experience here — from check in, service, and even recommendations. The steam room (hammom) really was an exceptional amenity after a long, tiring day of walking and shopping the streets of Paris. As for location, I LOVED it! Situated between 2 train stations, this superb hotel made it extremely convenient to travel to anywhere. I love that it is located on a smaller, tertiary street where few cars drove through. This I believe made it a quiet stay where I was easily able to get a good nights rest. Additionally, there were amazing restaurants right across (Picotte and HiBao) and a few steps away from Boulangerie Utopie. 

You can tell they take pride in the experience to guests. I was delighted by the little details this hotel offered, like the high quality Dammann tea and Haribo snacks provided. 

Staff is on site 24/7 to provide the additional feeling of support and comfort. Highly recommend and I wouldn’t hesitate to book again the next time I visit! Quick tip — book directly with them and ask for a discount (this is equivalent to the tax refund about 10-12%) instead of booking through a third party. Thank you so much for this experience!!

title: Lovely hotel, lovely staff.
text: The rooms are smoke free. Ours was small but very adequate with a nice bathroom with shower, and not noisy even though we were right downtown. We were able to check in a bit early and store our luggage for leaving a bit late, and there was always coffee and citrus water for us downstairs in the lobby. Breakfast was great, with yogourt, croissants, and cheese, and several sorts of eggs available on request.

title: very nice and quiet hotel with attentive staff
text:
Nice, clean and quiet hotel, everthing in good order and condition. The whole staff is extremly attentive and friendly - which is not an evidence nowadays! Metro stations with different lines close to hotel.
We stayed in the classic double room offering all amenities, however, never seen such a small closet for clothes (which was not a big issue in summer...). Would definitely stay again there!

title: Clean, quiet hotel with helpful staff
text: The hotel has easy access to two Metro stops, was on a quiet street, near a larger boulevard, and was clean and quiet. The staff was very helpful, communicated well and everything was clean. Thank you for the nice stay!

title: best place to stay
text: very friendly staff, everything clean, perfect position in Paris (Marais/Republique) to go out..., small but nice hammam room, quiet house, good breakfast, nice rooms, vers often with upgrades - THANK YOU!

title: Paris with family
text: Three days in Paris with family and the hotel was very nice and the people in the reception was very helpful and positive. The rooms were nice and the breakfast was Hood. It is god when they can and want to speak English.

title: Amazing hotel and staff
text: We were visiting Le Mareuil in June 2022. Such a friendly and helpful staff and lovely rooms. Breakfast was not too much and not too little. Not far from the metro and easy to navigate. We would definetely recommend Le Mareuil to others visiting Paris.

title: small but perfect
text:
good location,
very clean room,
super kind,
same breakfast every day but so delicious,
small spa but with complete privacy access,
free coffee at the lobby whenever you want with the perfect coffee machine.

title: Excellent stay
text: We had an excellent stay in a superior twin room. The location of the hotel was perfect, quiet and safe. The hotel staff were super friendly and welcoming and provided us with some excellent dining recommendations.

title: Great hotel in Paris
text: The hotel is clean, modern and in a great location. The location is what really makes it wonderful because it’s near two metro stations and it’s so easy to get everywhere in the city from the hotel. Rooms are very small, but they have everything you need. Most staff are helpful. Breakfast is good with a good selection.

title: Prefect in everyways
text: Location is perfect, very close by metro.  In a very nice area , and we feel safe coming back at night. Room is perfect with nice decoration, we have a nice view fr the room too. There are many good restaurants within walking distance . Staffs are excellent and helpful. Special thanks to the manager Arnaud, he always know the best restaurant for any type of food. So we can avoid over charge tourist restaurant.  If you are foodie, definitely a plus .  And it's very reasonable price. We really enjoyed our stay 💓  I will recommend to anyone if you are in Paris🗼

title: Very nice. Far from sightseeing
text:
Avery nice boutique hotel, but not with walking distance to sights. The complimentary breakfast was excellent and varied with meats, eggs, crepes, sausages, breads, juices, coffee, tea.
The room, although small, had excellent amenities- a fridge, rainfall shower, lighting, a large window. The hotel was very clean and secure. We felt safe there. The price was reasonable. My friend left her tablet there. We realized this very soon after leaving for our flight home and contacted the hotel. As of June 28, we have not heard from them.

title: Not great - hotel concierge was the least helpful of all hotels I worked with over the course of my trip.
text: Would not recommend - some of the staff was nice but the poor treatment stood out the most. My friends and I were almost kicked out for having a sick friend stay with us for a few hours. Pretty scary experience being yelled out by the hotel lobbiest

title: Excellent stay
text: Very friendly staff, good breakfast with a lot of choice, quiet and clean room. Not too far from the train station so we could walk to the hotel. Also subway station close to the hotel.  We had a great stay and would love to come back !

title: Excellent experience
text:
Second time in this hotel.

Very good location, near metro and near river..away from crowd..clean hotel, nice small rooms, good breakfast with variety of food, free coffee and tea 24/7.

Will come back again for sure.

title: Perfect hotel
text: Hotel is located very close to 2 metro stations. Very clean and tidy with excellent breakfast. Staff is very helpful and kind. You can have a break from your daily activities with coffee machine and water always available in a hotel loby free of charge.

title: The place to stay
text:
Very charming hotel that seems to be recentlyu renovated. It is in a good location in to profit from Oberkampf/Republique districtì and to connect with the rest of the city.
Go there and you'll feel really ata home

title: very good location and cozy hotel
text: surprisingly peaceful and yet, right around the corner there is all you would expect from a city. Paris does not have one city center, per se, but rather several main areas around the city, and this part is great. The hotel is very close to both "republique" and "oberkamp" metro stations, so getting around is both easy and fast. The foyer of the hotel is modern and clean.  Breakfast is as expected , with plenty of options along with newly baked baguettes. There is free croissants, multiple teas and coffees available at the foyer at all times, of course with fresh milk for the café au lait, and we enjoyed plenty of it.

title: Nice place
text:
We stayed for two nights.
The staff is very friendly and serviceminded. Nice room og great breakfast.
The location is good. Close to Place de la Republique with lots of cosy bistros and cafees in the neighbourhood.

title: Great Place to Stay
text: From the minute we walked in to the minute we left, the staff was always ready to help. The lobby, the room, and the breakfast were very good, but the staff is what made our stay enjoyable. We plan to visit Paris again and when we do, Hotel Le Mareuil is where we will stay.

title: Four Reasons to Stay at Le Mareuil
text:
I would like to give four reasons why you should definitely stay at Le Mareuil when you are visiting Paris. My wife and I spent a few days there:
1) The staff is absolutely fantastic. They went way beyond the call of duty to make our stay pleasant. I also noticed that they gave same amazing treatment to everyone else.

2) Metro stations are located at a very close walking distance from the hotel. We were able to access all of the sites we wanted to see with ease.

3) You can walk to great restaurants, stores, bakeries, etc.

4) Quiet neighborhood and hotel in the midst a very busy area.
 
I would definitely stay there when I return to Paris.

title: Great customer service!
text: We really enjoyed the hotel and their customer service. The location is great to grab a bite or the metro. It’s very quite and safe, we will definitely recommend and will comeback the next time we are in Europe.

title: Great stay in Paris!
text: We loved this hotel.  I went with my daughter and we got 2 twin beds which were located on the 5th floor.  The beds were made separately but placed together.  It was a small room but well-appointed. The pillows and beds were very comfortable.  A door between the bathroom and hall blocked out any noise from the hallway.  Close to 2 subway stations which allowed quick and easy access to all of Paris.  Close to 2 bakeries and many cafes.  Highly recommend.

title: Great gem of a hotel
text: Excellent location near 2 subway stops, nice safe calm area around. The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful. They recommended some excellent restaurants nearby including les Onze Coups that were really wonderful. The room was clean, modern and comfortable. Breakfast was also great (eggs, crepes, fresh fruit, cheese, coffee. We would stay here again and well recommended.

title: Beautiful hotel in great area
text: We loved staying here; it was all so comfortable and we loved eating at Mon Coco down the street. Razak went above and beyond and was so kind and accommodating to us - he made us feel very welcome. Carole was very helpful with printing documents for us and helping us get around the city as well!!

title: Excellent option in a great location
text: Hotel staff are excellent, friendly, helpful and very responsive to requests. Complimentary coffee with take away cups is very thoughtful. Large elevator, very little noise from street or from other rooms. Very close to 2 metros, including Republique which has several lines/interchanges. And the value compared to similar hotels in the area can't be beat. Will definitely stay here again.

title: Comfortable, reliable, conveniently located with professional service.
text:
We stayed for a week, and enjoyed the quiet, well appointed room in this small hotel off République. 

While inhabited mainly by small senior tour groups from the UK and US, they were easy to avoid before or after any of their all-inclusive gatherings, such as the breakfast self-service buffet or afternoon complimentary bar service. 

The linens and furniture were fresh and firm, the air conditioning Grade A for awesome, bathroom roomy and sparkling, the blackout curtains and double-paned insulated windows made for terrific sleeping. 

The front desk was always cheerful and helpful. Razak was a familiar and friendly face and went out of the way to make us feel at home, and secured us transport even during the madness of the futbol riots and "surprise to non-catholics!" catholic holiday closures.

Alas, one evening after dinner we arrived at 20:00 and the door was locked. A rude man who was not the usual night clerk answered the night bell with an accusative tone. He was our only great disappointment. He argued with the fact we were locked out, which was absurd, saying "it is open" aggressively and repeatedly through the speaker. It was not open. After telling us "NO" several times, he finally appeared in person at the door and mocked us, sneering, "it is open" as the actual night clerk (who had obviously run off to use the restroom for a moment) rushed up from the back and offered the only apology. We never saw the tall thin rude man who acted very unpleasantly again.  He would be the only reason we would not book again.

The coffee is not good, but this is common, and it is a little hike to find un vrai petit-déjeuner Parisien & café. Head down towards the Marais and there are a few lovely spots. Boulangerie Utopie just steps down the block, unfortunately is commodity and bland, the croissants poor. 

If you want close, inventive, delicious food. Picotte just across the street is an impressive one.

title: Really nice two night stay
text: We had a lovely two night stay at  Hôtel le Mareuil, with a warm greeting from receptionists, a very nice room that was well designed and an excellent shower. We really enjoyed the breakfast too. Good quality coffee was also available all day which was a nice touch. I really cant fault the  Hôtel le Mareuil. Thanks

title: Absolutely not a 4 star rating
text: Nice hotel in a good neighbourhood. Our room was only very small for this rating. A wardrobe of 50 cm width is also very tiny. One day they forgot the cleaning, that has never happened in my whole life. It was clean and okay and the price-quality rate is also good for a expensive city as Paris. Also because the included breakfast was very good.

title: Love this hotel!
text:
Absolutely love this hotel.  When I booked it, I didn’t realize it was around the corner from another hotel we stayed at before.  

Keep in mind, no hotel is ever ‘centrally’ located in Paris, bc Paris is so big, but it was centrally located to all the things WE wanted to do.  And with traffic, although places are a mile or two miles away, it’s always a 20-25 minute drive.  The Ritz hotel where we had afternoon tea was about 3-miles away and Champs Elysees where there is luxury/designer shopping is about 3-miles away as well. All about a $10-$15 uber ride.  

About the hotel itself, let’s start with the staff which were VERY friendly.  They were helpful with everything from providing us with an iron, booking us a taxi for the airport, giving us the best pharmacy to take our covid test before returning home.  They were very attentive and helpful. 

The hotel has everything you need and more.  Breakfast was included in our stay (I think it’s $18 otherwise), and quite delicious.  They have everything from bacon and eggs, your typical American breakfast, to pastries and even fancier with smoked salmon, which is what I stuck to. 

They have a small gym consisting of three cardio machines (spinning bike like the Peloton, elliptical and treadmill), along with some very light misc. weights.  I was happy with this as I just needed to get some cardio in.  Please note you need to make a reservation with the front desk to use the gym, which is always locked.  I think I was the only one that worked out, so this was not an issue.  

The room is very luxe and décor very modern.  I would say it’s a bit on the smaller side compared to other hotels I have stayed at in previous visits, BUT bc it’s in a good & safe location, and the hotel is nice and clean with modern decor, I would definitely come back again. Now when I say the room is small, we could barely house our two carryon bags.  But like I said, everything else about the hotel was great so it still gets 5-stars from me. 

This will likely be our home the next time we visit.

title: Great place to stay in Paris
text: Never stayed in the area of Republique. The hotel was close to the Metro and tourist friendly restaurants. Our rooms were clean and comfortable. The one thing that we noticed was the area was very quiet during the wee hours of the morning. The staff were friendly and spoke English. They arranged for the four of us and our luggage for a comfortable car service to Charles DeGaulle airport.

title: Perfect Week
text: Can’t say enough about this perfect place to stay.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  The breakfast in the morning was a perfect way to start your day.  Fantastic value.  The location was near several Metro stops which was so convenient to get around the city.

title: excellent charming boutique hotel !
text: this little hotel is situated in a narrow street just away from the buzz to guaranty you a good sleep. the staff couldn't possibly be more friendly, especially towards children. the serve a more than decent breakfast, a spotlessly clean environment and a location just off place de la republic, in between the city centre and montmartre. if you're not afraid of a good walk around town, this is your hotel !

title: Cosy little place close to République
text: Very helpful and pressional receptionists. Rooms are not large but clean and nicely furnished. I appreciated the free coffee area and spa. Very close to public métro stations Oberkampf and République. Fairly priced.

title: "The Little Hotel That Could"
text: My wife and I just spent five nights at Le Mareuil and we echo all the raves about the staff.  I could name names but to me, what comes across in an exceptional way is a "can-do, "happy-to-do-it" hotel culture that is shared by literally the entire staff -- from the basics like arranging for taxis promptly and reliably at any hour, to dinner tips, to small requests for extra Pellegrino in our room (supplied at no extra cost!).  Everything else was just great, too:  a location near la Republique loaded with good, reasonable dining options; excellent, generous breakfast; small but quite comfortable and very clean, updated rooms.  We've been to Paris several times and Le Mareuil enhanced our stay like no other hotel we've experienced.

title: Comfortable well located and newly updated - customary small room
text: European rooms are typically smaller than American rooms but room 11 was bigger than average and made good use of the space. The entire hotel seemed to have been recently renovated from top to bottom including a large (by European standards)  modern elevator. Wi-Fi was reliable but slow. Our room was functional but a bit quirky. The toilet was in a closet as you entered the main doorway and the room was on the left. The tub and sink were in the windows end of the room overlooking the street but heavy curtains could be drawn to close off the window and the bedroom. All the fixtures were very modern and worked well. Good water pressure in the rain shower. The breakfast buffet was generous and extensive and service was extensive. Most of the staff spoke good English. Ample closet space contained a save and fridge. The small desk had a power outlet and 2 USB ports to charge phones.

title: A refuge after a long day on foot.
text: A small boutique style hotel, well and nicely kept.  Size of the room was ok, bathroom modern and nicely appointed.  Very comfortable bed…slept like a baby.  The staff sets this hotel apart.  Extremely helpful and friendly.  They will sit you down upon arrival and go over location and maps.  They will make whatever arrangements you need, and all speak english very well.  The breakfast is excellent; a wide variety to choose from, and the hours of operation are longer than most.  It’s an excellent value that will set you up for the day, and it’s doubtful that one could match the cost unless satisfied with a simple continental breakfast.  Internet connection is good, which is very helpful as reception out on the streets of Paris is not at all good.  The location is excellent, and an easy walk to the Marias. Also a less than 10 minute walk to the Place de Republique Metro Station, which is a hub in which about 6 lines meet.  Thus it’s easy to get just about anywhere in the City.  (A word of caution…take care where you put your wallet and phone in the Metro…NOT in your back pocket…pickpockets are very good as I can attest). And to round it all out, the restaurant across the street is really good..Le Popette, and a reservation is necessary.

title: Excellent service
text: Small boutique hotel with outstanding service. Great location close to place de la République and to public transportation. Small room but very clean and functional. Excellent breakfast buffet included.

title: Great hotel even better service
text: We have been 8 days. The hotel is clean (spotless), we stayed in the handicapped room, it was spacious enough to move around, the bathroom equipped with all the necessary equipment, the was clean and tidy every morning. The breakfast was good too. Coffee or tea or water are self-service during 24 hours. I strongly recommend the hotel Le Mareuil.

title: Wonderful experience!
text: Our first trip to Paris and the hotel was perfect for us. The staff was friendly and helpful. The room was small but clean and met our needs in every way. The breakfast was excellent! It was a great surprise to have the Metro stops so close. Also the restaurant across the street, Picotte, is excellent!

title: May 2022 stay
text: Lovely hotel with very comfortable beds. I slept well every night evening with jet lag. Hotel staff were all very friendly and helpful. We liked the morning breakfast spread as well. Would recommend to friends and family traveling to Paris!

title: Highly recommend
text: We really loved Hotel Le Mareuil. Lovely staff and the location was great - very vibrant and central to a few different interesting neighborhoods and the Metro, so it was super easy to get around to everywhere we wanted to visit in the city. The included breakfast was very good and was an easy start to the day. The room itself was as advertised on the website. We were given one of the “larger” rooms with a Queen bed which was still quite small by North American standards, but was fine for us. We were not in our room much anyway, as I suspect would be the case for most visitors to Paris.

title: splendid
text: Very good hotel in a calm street in the heart of the city. Very nice welcome by the reception and lovely to relax in the hamman. Breakfast was very good. We enjoyed our staying very well in Paris. Good job!

title: Delightful stay
text: Lovely hotel, warm welcome when we arrived, good location close to Place de la Republique with convenient Metro stations, very comfortable and well-equipped room, lavish buffet breakfast, overall good value for money.

title: The best place in Paris
text: We were surprised with the level of services we received at Le Mareuil! Everything was above and beyond our best expectations, from quiet & neat rooms to wonderful atmosphere and extreme cleanliness of the rooms! Even teabags were of the premium quality, not to mention access to sauna and super attentive staff! Special thanks to Razak, he is the best of the best!

title: Wonderful hotel in quiet location
text:
My wife and I stayed at Hotel Le Mareuil for our 10th wedding anniversary over a long weekend. The staff were very friendly and capable an we found that location was excellent. The hotel is located in a quiet back street close to the Place de la Republique and it is well located for Central Paris.

The room was well furnished and clean and the fittings new. Breakfast was superb.

title: Great hospitality
text: The Hotel Mareuil was in an excellent location, and the room spacious and well equipped.  The staff were really helpful, and Were happy to make a phonemail for me (because I don't speak much French). And I loved the small touches - bottles of water each day, along with a small bag of haribo sweets, and the excellent coffee machine in the lobby.

title: Great Hotel in Lively District
text:
Great location, lively area with easy access to Metro & local facilities.

Staff we incredibly friendly and helpful and rooms were modern, clean and pleasant.

Overall a brilliant stay, would definitely comeback.

title: Fabulous Stay
text:
I couldn't fault anything with our stay.

Breakfast was delicious, staff were very attentive and rooms very clean.

Free coffee was Offred a day round too, which was an added bonus.  

I would defiantly stay here again.

title: Paris in the spring
text: Lovely 4 night stay at Le Mareuil.  Everyone was very efficient, friendly and helpful.  Breakfast was excellent.  Rooms well appointed, though compact, with limited hanging/storage.  Didn't try the gym or steam room.  Overall a great stay in a well located, quiet and well run hotel.  Many thanks

title: Super helpful and nice staff
text: The hotel is well located and the rooms are very comfortable. But, the best thing was the staff. They were all so helpful and nice. My wife lost her wallet and they were very helpful in forwarding a replacement credit card to our next destination. They really went out of their way to ensure we had a good experience in Paris.

title: Such a gem!
text: This hotel is a true gem!  From the stylish interior, cheeky front desk man, the coolest wine & coffee machines, nice size rooms and the only decent pillows in France I found after 4 other stays! The rooms have a nice character, lovely decor and excellent bath/shower.  Wonderful stay

title: Good value
text: To find hotel in Paris completely remodeled its not an easy task.  So that’s a main reason I was attractive to this hotel.  Its the best value for the level of hotel you get. But when things gets busy it’s seams like some stuff needs to have more training.
description: Bienvenue sur le site officiel du Victoria Palace, un boutique-hôtel 4 étoiles situé entre Le Bon Marché Rive Gauche et la Gare Montparnasse. Bénéficiez des meilleurs tarifs en réservant directement. Totalement rénové en 2020, le Victoria Palace Hôtel vous ouvre les portes de ses 92 chambres dans un esprit intimiste et raffiné. Et plus loin, poussez la porte de la terrasse où vous découvrirez notre écrin de fraicheur secret. Un hôtel parisien éco-responsable et chaleureux où la nature a repris ses droits. : Entendez-vous les murmures des vers du poète James Joyce ? Ils résonnent au Victoria Palace comme une douce brise se déposant sur la majestueuse façade datant de 1913. Situé rive gauche à Paris dans une petite rue calme du 6ème arrondissement, le Victoria Palace Hôtel a en effet accueilli de nombreuses personnalités qui ont façonné l’âme de ce lieu.

title: Absolutely WOW!
text: I just have one word for this hotel - 'Outstanding'. We stayed here for 5 days, Aug 15-20th, and we were in love with how simple, efficiwnt, elegant and caring is this property and all the staff. The front office staff was so so respectful and courteous, all speak in English, understand you, attend to you and offer solutions with a smile. The rooms were clean and very comfortable with a large television even in Classic room. The bathrooms are well appointed, well stocked (no small miniature bottles for body cleanser, cream, shampoo and conditioner but full size filled bottles). The beds were so comfortable and we had good and peaceful sleep. The room size is very decent, even classic rooms. The Housekeeping was so meticulous that they didnt leave a stain back. The hotel is so well located, we walked to St Germaine, Latin quarters, Montparsnne, Luxembourg gardens, Saint Chappel and even the Louvre (30 min or so). Just had a fantastic time here. Strongly recommend this beautiful property.

title: Recent stay September 2022
text:
Our family of 4 recently stayed here September 8-14, 2022.  It is a recently renovated hotel with large rooms by European standards.  For the most part our stay was enjoyable. 

The hotel is quiet but it is a bit of a walk to anything of interest. (1/2-1 mile). 

There is a lot of staff but most seem to be inexperienced and "in training".  Only a few seem to know how to get the job done and they do not communicate well with each other.

The breakfast is mediocre.  Croissants were worse than I could buy at Trader Joe's

title: Paris stay
text:
Wonderful 1 night stay in Paris after a biking tour in France. We wanted a hotel near Gare Montparnasse and near restaurants in 6-7th. The hotel was recommended by friends and Trip advisor and we wanted a room large enough for 3 . We booked a family room which has 1 king room attached to another double room by a hall way - spacious but private. 
The hotel was fully renovated in 2020 with modern but tasteful touches. 
It was a short 10 min walk to a quiet location off a busy road Rue de Rennes .Check in was efficient and cordial.
Rooms were clean and spacious for Paris. Air con was quiet but efficient in the August heat. Rooms 217-218 faced a quiet courtyard - no road noise or other inter room noise. Bathrooms spacious and modern with  wonderful showers and heated towel racks .
Beds were comfortable but firm.
Loved the in room safe, Fridge, Nespresso machine and water.
The hotel is easy 15-20 min walk to Luxembourg garden and restaurants in the 6th or 7th  e with many outdoor cafes  too nearby including Les Deux Magots
We did not opt for the 18 euro buffet breakfast but rather enjoyed a walk to outdoor cafe le Trait d’union for a lovely coffee and pain au chocolate for 3 Euros.
Check out was  efficient and many compliments and thanks to Clement for booking a taxi to CDG airport ! 
We would definitely stay at Victoria Palace again .

title: Pleasant Stay
text:
Nice decor. We stayed at a Junior Suite which is good enough for a queen bed and a folder full size sofa bed but it seems smaller than the website photo. Bath towels and bed linens are soft and comfortable. 
Room is nicely decorated, modern. 

The hotel is situated at a side street so quiet but no parking facility onsite though you can stop your car for a while in front of the hotel. There is a convenient store right next to it where you can get snacks, water and freshly-squeezed orange juice at reasonable price. The hotel is about 12-15 minute walk to Le Bon Marche.

My only complaint is the breakfast. The dining area is not fully ventilated and crowded as compared to the number of guests. Food choice is very very limited, very few fresh fruits, no freshly-made omelette and bakery is average (forget about the croissant).

All in all would  recommend this hotel 100% !

title: Wonderful boutique hotel!
text:
This is a wonderful boutique hotel. The decor is beautiful and the staff were so friendly - I have two boys aged 4 and 6 years and we felt very welcomed. We travelled as a family of six in total. My in-laws had a classic room which was petite but well appointed, we had the family suite, which was two interconnecting rooms with a private corridor and there was so much space. Huge beds, very comfortable, clean. There is no milk provided for the tea but you can call to reception and they will bring it. 
Breakfast was wonderful. At first the selection looks small as it's laid out in a little area off the main room, but there was actually more than enough there and it was all delicious and regularly refreshed. The area is also very convenient. It was one straight metro journey down from Gare du Nord to Saint Placide and then a 3 minute walk. There are also plenty of little cafe's & restaurants in the area, so you don't need to walk far for dinner. I wouldn't hesitate to stay again.

title: Wonderful Hotel! Won’t stay anywhere else in Paris
text:
Beautifully appointed, clean and wonderful staff! We stayed as a family with 2 children. The kids had their own room right next to our room. There was another door that closed off our two rooms, and so we felt comfortable having them in their own room. This also allowed us to sleep and to have the extra space.

Overall, I would only book this hotel on our next trip to Paris. The location was also super convenient to metro and also close to many sights. We loved walking back to hotel after dinner!

Thank you so much for a wonderful stay at Victoria Palace!!

title: Superb establishment, even finer staff.
text:
Each guest arrives with their own expectations of a certain degree of hospitality, a certain degree of quality, and a certain degree of accommodation. On our recent stay at Victoria Palace Hotel our expectations were exceeded in all categories.

First, the easy part. We booked a wheelchair accessible room which overlooked the interior courtyard. The room was spacious by any citified hotel standard and the bathroom enormous. Rainfall shower and stone tile siding adorned the bathroom with large 6 foot hinged windows in both the bedroom and the bath. The lobby and bar exquisitely detailed and charming.

Upon first arriving, my wife and I were uncertain of location relative to everything worth seeing but it all proved walkable. The Louvre, the Eiffel Tower, the Musee D'Orsay, Notre Dame, the Luxembourg Gardens (particularly close), the Latin Quarter, all proved convenient as we were willing to put a mile or so under our soles.

Victoire and Melodie, staff members extraordinaire recommended Georgette and Le Relais de L'entrecote restaurants all within convenient walking distance. Both were well populated by Parisians and not only tourists.

What stands out by far was the hotel's staff. I use a wheelchair and the accommodation to any necessities was prompt and considerate. When the bed was too low Melodie ordered bed risers. While the entrance lacks a fixed ramp staff members came with the portable ramp promptly on every occasion. Drinks ordered always arrived promptly with a smile. Most wonderfully, the staff had an authenticity about them that rang true beyond mere professionalism.

As for other accessibility features, the roll in shower was superb. The elevator tight but accommodating of a power wheelchair. Access to the patio and all areas of the lobby and bar were excellent. The area was safe at all hours from morning till midnight.

Finally, the staff, particularly Cynthia and her colleague Mallery who covered while Cynthia assisted us on our check out proved extraordinary. When the accessible transport failed to arrive to deliver us to a fast train Cynthia scrambled for no less than 45 minutes on the phone to overcome our need for French translation and as an advocate for our needs. Better still, her efforts succeeded.

The hotel possesses a charm consistent with its boutique status that distinguishes it from any chain and the particular efforts of staff (Melodie and Cynthia specifically) made this stay extraordinary. What the hotel may lack in comparison to a five star hotel is overcome by the intimacy and charm of the renovated facility and the remarkable individuals serving its guests.

title: Excellent hotel, great experience
text:
We had a large-ish family group of 8 people, staying for a week, in 4 rooms, so we got a broad experience to evaluate the hotel. Overall it was fantastic. The one flaw (details below) was frustrating but manageable and with everything else so great, this is a confident 5 stars for me. Details...

--Rooms are in excellent shape and kept very clean
--Beds and pillows were comfortable
--Rooms vary in size but all at least decent-sized, especially for central Paris
--Bathrooms are very nice* (one exception, noted below) and well-featured
--Common areas are elegant and well-maintained inside, including a nice little bar
--Outside patio area (it is an interior courtyard) is pleasant, though be aware people sometimes smoke there
--Breakfasts are a buffet, smallish but good quality
--The pool table is a nice touch, though the cues needs a little TLC
--Staff were unfailingly helpful and friendly, great customer service
--Location is reasonable distance to many sights in central Paris, plus a Metro stop nearby to get elsewhere

The one flaw is something I've experienced in a couple other places in Europe, though it should not happen at a higher end hotel of this sort. Our room had a combo bath/shower, with a swinging glass panel. But the panel, when I was standing in the shower, came up to about my chin in height, and went back less than half the length of the tub. The result is that anytime my wife or I took a shower, we had a large lake of water on the bathroom floor by the end of the shower. Why places don't have more complete shower enclosures is beyond me - seems like a cheap-out at a place that was otherwise anything but that. Something I hope they improve on in the future.

Other than that one thing - which can be managed with some artful placement of extra towels on the floor - we loved this hotel and I highly recommend it.

title: Fake reviews?
text: My experience at this hotel was extremely mediocre. I had a deluxe room booked and it fell short of 4 star in so many ways. The beds where two beds pushed together with a big plastic zipper which was left open between the two and a single sheet to cover it up. I complained to the manager who assured me it would be taken care of and yet each night the bed was exactly the same. The first night there was a water bottle and then each subsequent night no water to be found (even though water is supposed to be provided by the hotel), what I found even more insane is the maid put the welcome water sign back on the empty bottle with less than a cm left in it as if to say 'here is the water you get today'.  In the bathroom there is nowhere to hang a towel or bathrobe in bathroom and one day I came back to the room to find the seat ripped off the toilet and hanging to the side. Shower impossible to put a bath mat down because door opens out, so water gets all over. I tried to use the moisturiser and all this weird gunk came out in pellets on my hands. When I asked the manager he said the cream must have 'Turned" he then promised to send up a new one. Next day I try the cream, no one had replaced it.  I had do not disturb on my door and yet each morning got woken up by sound knocking on my door by the maid who apparently can't read the sign? When I tried to call reception to get water brought up or have the big zipper between beds closed there is no answer. I tried multiple times ended up having to get out of my pyjamas and go down to lobby to get help. The night watchman was extremely rude. This morning as I checked out I spoke to a very friendly gentleman who was extremely understanding about my grievances, he assured me they would discuss my stay and offer me a reimbursement of some kind. I later received a letter offering me 30Euro discount per night on my stay. Seeing that I missed two entire nights of sleep because of the sharp zipper in the middle of the bed and missed the opportunity to sleep it off in the morning by all the insisting door knocking, I came for meetings and was exhausted during the day from my uncomfortable stay. I find this wholly unsatisfactory. This has been my least favourite stay in Paris because the hotel falls short of all its expectations. I chose it for the reviews and now I am wondering are they really real? Because surely I am not the only person who experimented such a terrible time in this hotel. See pictures attached.

title: Comfortable and accommodating
text:
It is a very nice hotel. With one exception,  staff were very friendly, helpful and accommodating. They paid a great deal of attention to cleanliness. Our superior double rooms were quite comfortable with lots of closet capacity.

The bathrooms, while contemporary, weren't as well-thought-through. One member of our party had mobility problems, and the shower floor was slippery, with no grab bars. There were only a couple of hooks for towels, with no convenient place to hang a hand towel. Also the bathroom lights were all down lighting, which gives poor light for shaving, cosmetics, etc.

Having said this, it was overall a very comfortable place to stay.

title: Beautiful and Chic
text:
I had a wonderful visit to the Victoria Palace over the last few days.  I reached out in advance to request my Deluxe Room be one high up with a balcony.  Nicholas was wonderful at working with me and able to secure me a FABULOUS room with a dream balcony.  The location is great, and the decor is super chic.  I do wish they had a kitchen as room service would have been very convenient my first night.  That being said, I grabbed a pizza locally and asked for a bottle of wine to be sent up which was handled beautifully by the staff.  Bed was slightly firm for those who need softer.  

Only thing they need to work on is after hours access.  I was out late last night, and, when I returned, it took 10 minutes to get someone to the door to let me in as they lock the interior sliding front doors.  Unclear why they wouldn’t just allow your key to give you access.  I buzzed the person to let me in constantly and ultimately only gained access by banging on the window….  It was slightly worrisome, fearing I would be left in the street until morning.

That aside, I would still highly recommend the hotel, and I will definitely consider it again during my next return to the City of Light.

title: Comfortable and Convenient
text: We spent 6 nights in this charming little hotel which is within walking distance of Paris Garnier, La Fayette and many other attractions. The staff were friendly and courteous. We were lucky enough to be upgraded to a spacious superior room after 2 nights. The hotel was clean and well-kept. Breakfast consisted of fruit salad, cereals, croissants, eggs and a variety of breads, ham and salami. (Breakfast is optional but we liked the convenience, being a husband and wife of mature age.) There are many cafes, a supermarket and other shops within 30 seconds walk from the hotel. A good place to stay.

title: Cool Neighborhood Location in Paris just minutes by Metro to all of sites.
text: Fantastic location near metro and cafe/restaurants.  Rooms were comfortable and reception was very friendly.  Free coffee in the lobby was also a nice plus.  Located in a cool neighborhood with lots of places to hangout after a long day seeing the sites.

title: Perfect base for exploring Paris
text:
Lovely hotel that has been newly refurbished and nicely decorated. Location is perfect for exploring Paris and it’s very good value for money.

Deducted 1 star because our room was really dark without much natural light. And it could have been a little cleaner! But for the money, you can’t really complain.

title: Decent hotel in the middle of Paris
text:
We stayed here for three nights recently. Hotel seems to have been renovated recently and both the lobby and the room we got was in great shape. Staff is effective and check-in took about two minutes.  

We got a room on the ground floor. The room was quite big (considering it's Paris), and the bathroom looked great. AC worked great. Bed was good, pillows were great.

Although we were behind two doors, and a corner, we could still hear people coming into the hotel late at night, and was woken up a few times by that, especially in the morning when breakfast started  Wasn't too big deal, we slept through that in the end. 

Only thing that we wish were done differently was the soaps and toilet paper - we ran out of toilet paper after two days and nobody refilled it. The soap provided by the hotel is a 3-in-1 soap, which wasn't the greatest. 

For the price, this is a good hotel. The hotel is a little bit too far away from the Champs Elysees and Eiffel Tower for my liking, especially during the sommer months when the metro is full to the brink and hot as an oven. 

All in all, we enjoyed our stay!

title: Great staff.
text: The hotel is located in a good area,with lots of restaurants near by. The staff was kind and  friendly, and helped us with everything we required during our stay. They also gave us an upgrade for 1 of our nights which was really sweet. The double room was a little small in size though.

title: An aggressive receptionist and an imaginary guest
text: Was supposed to stay for 7 nights but cancelled after one. Dirty laundry sacs in the very narrow corridors which was there the next morning too. Our bathroom was full of black hair everywhere and really could do with a good cleaning. The staff at checkin was really nice and friendly but the next morning we were aggressively greeted  by a male receptionist who accused us for having a third person in our 2 person room (??) then he claimed we hadn’t paid for the whole stay and that we should pay him for one night extra ( we were just at the beginning of our stay) also he insisted to be paid city tax for the imaginary guest. All this was loudly, aggressively and in front of the other guests at the breakfast buffet. ( The whole stay was prepaid and the city tax settled upon arrival - which his colleagues could confirm ). At least have some decency and check with the colleagues first before you accuse your guests of anything and behaving aggressively towards a guest isn’t cool - it’s just stupid and unprofessional.

title: Cancelled my booking with no notice
text:
A first for me—the Hotel Axel Opera cancelled my week-long booking with no notice, even though it was already fully paid. Even when I dropped my bags off to be held until check-in, no one said anything. I didn't find out I had no room until late at night when I returned. I was left desperately calling nearby hotels to find any free room.

The clerk on the night shift seemed as shocked as I was. He was apologetic, but the whole experience was awful. This type of grift by hotels shouldn't even be legal. 

The sensible next question is did the hotel then refund the charge? No! They decided they get to keep the full payment. Why? Because I had the option to return to the hotel two days into my stay and have the room the remainder of my time in town. Unbelievable.
