title: Lovely hotel in Paris
text: Newly renovated and very close to all my train stations. The rooms are super comfy and feels very homie. Special thanks to the general manager who took very care of us. Definitely recommend it without hesitation!!!

title: Clean but missing some key items
text:
Rooms are clean, location over canal is interesting, bed is comfortable, it is a straight ride on Metro 7 to the center, staff is professional and helpful.

However, for an American traveller there are a lot of misses.  No early check in--guests are required to wait until 3 pm to check in (there was a line of exhausted overseas travellers who had arrived in Paris hours earlier).  No hairdryer in the room.  No refrigerator.  No bath amenities other than shampoo.  Rudimentary "closet" and "dresser."  No bottled water in room.  So far as I know, no guest laundry on site.  Long line for breakfast.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Paris over Bastille week
text:
Family of 3, we really enjoyed this hotel. We'd a family room over looking the canal. Others have mentionned the lively area but its not as if they roll on until the wee hours, except the night before Bastille day where the fire brigade stations party until the morning near enough. We've been to Paris many times but must have missed this tradition.

Continental breakfast every morning, and as others have mentionned the hot breakfast wasn't always on, which must be down to local circumstances. 

Clean, good sized, air conditioned room, something we were very glad of in 36º heat on some days.

Staff were always friendly and helped us with some queries.

Car parking at the hotel itself is expensive, try the Interparking at Rue Riquet and only 4 minutes walk away. 

There are alot of restaurants in the local area for dinner, we ordered pizza one night and had sushi from the place directly across from the hotel, the Bento boxes were great. La Villette basin is part of the Quai de la Seine whereby those areas are turned into a 'beach' vibe, with boats, kida areas and large open air seating to eat and drink, in this case provided by two of the bistros across and just a 100 yards from the hotel.

Travel into Paris is fastest by Metro, Riquet station line 7, although Crimee´is an alternative. Allow 20-30 min goin in as after you are just inside the Peripherique in the 19th eme.

i would recommend the hotel and happily go back again.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Fabulous hotel - terrible taxi system
text: Our stay at this hotel was absolutely amazing until our last day. The night before our flight we booked a taxi to the airport for the following morning for 5 people (we didn’t mind if it was 2 small taxis or one big taxi we just needed to get to the airport) the reception said that was no problem, taxi is booked so don’t worry about it. The next morning we waited for our taxi for 20 minutes and still nothing. When I asked reception staff they said the taxi was never booked that we were In a queue. This could have been fine if it was communicated the night before but it wasn’t. Bottom line - don’t trust the reception staff to order taxis they were very unhelpful the next day. They said they would order us taxis on the spot but it was too late we had to find other arrangements. On another note, bar staff were extremely friendly 10/10 service and our inclusive breakfast was brilliant! I would recommend this hotel aside from the taxi scenario.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Good hotel on the banks of a lively canal.
text: The wife and I stayed at this hotel in a canal view room for several days while visiting Paris in the summer of 2022. The hotel is located in a lively section of Paris, kind of in between the metropolitan area and the beginning of the suburbs it seems. There are lots of nearby shops and places to eat and at night the canal comes alive with groups and couples strolling along the canal or just sitting at the table edge enjoying a picnic dinner. The hotel had a well stocked buffet breakfast which includes hot items, and the facilities and rooms are clean and neat. It is located within walking distance of several metro lines but before you decide to ride those, do your research into keeping yourself safe! Cordial multilingual staff.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great location and nice hotel
text:
Staff were accommodating where I was merging business and personal bookings.
Room was large with a view onto the canal- loved the setting of the hotel with great atmosphere in the evenings along the canal with boule and bars/ restaurants.

Breakfast was good, though sometimes not everything available at all times as example some of the hot items were missing on one day, and late starting on another day when I had an early start.

Would recommend the hotel overall.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great hotel with disabled access
text: I travelled with a wheelchair. The hotel was fully accessible. no steps into the building, room fully accessible with wet room and large room to accommodate the wheel chair. The staff were very helpful.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Excellent hotel in a great location in Paris
text:
Excellent stay in an area of Paris I’ve not stayed before. Location is wonderful as you can walk round the various canal basins where there are lots of bars/restaurants.
There is a couple of Metro stations within 15 minutes walk although you can enjoy a 45 minute walk to Notre Dame.
Staff at the hotel very friendly and welcoming and derive excellent.
Rooms as you would expect in a Holiday Inn Express and the breakfast was very good.
Would recommend this hotel to anyone travelling to Paris.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Paris weekend
text:
Just returned after staying at this hurdle over the weekend. The hotel is on a great location by the side of the canal with plenty of bards and restaurants if you want to venture out. 

The rooms are cosy and functional and very clean. 

Breakfast was plentiful with a surprisingly large variety considering its a holiday inn express 

All in all it was it’s a really good hotel. 

Customer service, I think you only get a feel of how how good customer service is if there’s a problem, and we had a problem with our booking. 

As it turned out the problem was the result of central booking not the hotel however Chloe on reception and the manager Albane sorted through the issue, keeping us informed and resolved the issue allowing us to enjoy the weekend. 

Absolutely stellar customer service at a time when the hotel was fully booked, hopefully the company can recognise Chloe and Albane, I can certainly highly recommend this hotel
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Excellent location and good value
text:
Myself, wife and 14 year old daughter stayed at this hotel for 4 nights recently and found it to be really good value for money and the location was ideal and only a short walk to the nearest metro and a few decent restaurants. 

Check-in was quick and our room was spotlessly clean with comfy beds, which provided a good nights sleep after longs days of sightseeing and walking. The pillows were very soft which I liked but my wife did ask for a more firmer pillow, but the hotel couldn’t provide this. A slight downside along with a lack of drawer space, but for the short time we stayed we coped and the walking did mean my wife soon forgot about having a firm pillow. 

The staff were courteous and polite and spoke good English to compensate for our not so good French, which was most welcome. 

Breakfast was typical continental and was tasty and plentiful. 

Overall we had a really good visit to Paris and the hotel played a big part in this so we would definitely stay here again and happily recommend it to others.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great Location, relaxed atmosphere, staff very helpful.
text:
This hotel is budget, but in a great location at the side of the canal. If you walk down the canal it takes you to the heart of the city. Walk the other way for parks a recreation. One road parallel to entrance to the hotel had a large supermarket. Lots of choice for cafes and bars in the area. The canal area was very popular with the locals and boules matches were common.
It has good transport links close by.
Stayed for 4 nights, room overlooking canal towards city center. The room was not big but the bed was comfortable. On the first floor is a deck area sometimes used by people using the meeting rooms, it was great to sit looking over the canal with a drink and a snack.
Breakfast did not have the biggest choice but was adequate. 
The staff were very helpful and the hotel cleaners worked constantly to keep it clean. 
We walked from the Gare Du Nord which took about 20 minutes.
Recommend a coffee in the top floor resturant at pretemps, (who sponsor the free city map available in reception) but its not cheap.
When we were returning home the hotel stored our cases for us, while we had an extra day site seeing.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Budget friendly and comfortable
text:
Its budget friendly and a decent location with easy public transport access to other locations. We stayed a few nights as a family with a 5yr old and 15yr old. There was a park just 50yards away which my 5yr old loved.

 Our room was overlooking the canal, we took walks along the canal bank in the evenings and morning. Food was good but not a wide range of "healthy options" to choose.

 The beds were very comfy, bathroom was spacious enough for me to help shower my lo without getting myself or the floor wet.

As english visitors, the staff were very polite and courteous which was probably the only people during our stay whom we found to be courteous,  so thank you IHG.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great hotel: approved!
text:
This hotel is well located near the canal. There's nice bars and restaurants just around the corner. It is super clean and the insonorisation is good, nothing to say.
The breakfast leave a bit to be desired.
They offer to store your luggage for a few days if needed, which is a nice touch.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great to be back!
text:
Our third stay here, whenever we cross (beneath) the Channel from the UK. Great welcome, safe and comfortable. The unseasonably hot September weather meant the aircon was struggling to keep us cool, and the windows don't open wide (for safety) so not as comfy as usual. They are getting the aircon fixed though.
Free breakfast with an excellent cold and hot selection, drinks, cereals etc. The bar was closed as the barman had Covid but we still got our Platinum Elite amenity drink.
This place will be even better as things get more back to normal.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: DO NOT TRUST THIS HOTEL
text: Do not trust this Hotel with your reservation.  In good faith, we booked and part paid in advance for a stay from 3 January 2021. Despite numerous communications with this Hotel they refuse to refund our pre-paid reservation even though we remain locked in our Country with closed borders in Australia as of mid November and expected to continue closed borders until early next year.  I am a top tier Spire Elite Member and even having top tier IHG status neither this Hotel or IHG Head Office will help.  Do not trust this Hotel with your reservation.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Good staff
text: It is an upscale hotel, much appreciated the welcome and the quick check in, the staff gave me excellent advice for my trips to Paris, nice room with good equipment, nice television, good bedding, I did not have the time to enjoy the activities of the hotel because I was on a business trip, the check out was also very good
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: 1 night in Paris
text:
Good , clean & comfortable  hotel in a great waterside setting , pleasant helpful staff , 5 minute walk from the Metro & quite a few Bistros & bars within the vicinity . 

We only stayed for 1 night in January but would quite happily return .
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Nice stay
text: Lovely stay here, it was roughly a 10min walk away from surrounding stations. The hotel has a nice view of the river, if you are lucky to get a room with that view. Stayed here for a few nights with a friend and it was a comfy nights stay. Breakfast was nice, the usual bits and pieces that can keep you full for a while. Staff seemed friendly and were always pleasant when you spoke to them. I would probably find a hotel a little closer to the centre when returning to Paris.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Nice hotel
text: Clean and modern hotel in a nice area - a lot of hip restaurants/bars on the marina and nice large park on the other side of canal. Easy ride to the city center (subway lines 5 and 7 in short walking distance). A number of supermarkets around as well. Antoine at front desk was very friendly and helpful. Got upgraded to the top floor balcony room as a Platinum member which was a nice gesture. Breakfast is included (with optional a la carte orders for extra charge). The only concern is that they don't have coffee machines - only brewed coffee is available on breakfast.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: What you would expect
text:
We stayed for 3 nights as a family of 3. Check in was quick and the staff were polite and helpful.
The room was clean and was had the usual facilities, the website mentions a safe, but there was none in our room.
We opted out of housekeeping in order to boost our points, but as we only used the room to shower and sleep it never needed it.
Room was on floor 5 facing out onto the canal so apart from the odd police siren we heard no noise at all.
Breakfast was as we thought, croissants, bread, pain au chocolate, cheeses, meats and fruit. A great way to start the day. No evening meal option, but we ate in the city Centre.
The centre of Paris was only 15mins away by Metro, we found it easier to use Stallingrad Station which was a short walk away along the canal. At night there were groups of people at bars, playing boules etc but not once did we feel scared or intimidated, as they kept themselves to themselves.
All in all a nice place to stay and at very reasonable prices. Would stay here again.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Lovely stay
text: Easy to get to, saddled between metro lines 5 and 7. Nice location next to hotel. Good breakfast, usual high standard of service and cleanliness you'd expect from Holiday Inn. No restaurant on site but plenty around local area.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Good at this time of year..
text: The hotel was good. Excellent reception, happy to check us in early which was welcome after a delayed flight and efficient check out with luggage storage. Room was a good size for three of us and clean. Breakfast was ok. My concerns were (bizarrely) the cows which were too hard and there were no alternatives and the noise. I am sensitive to noise but I was surprised, on the third floor,  to be able to hear dogs barking and shouting on the street during the night and every person who came down the corridor whichever time of night. More insulation would have been good all round. Be aware of the area around as I was uncomfortable being out as a family after dusk; I can't say why but lighting from the metro could definitely have been better.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Very Good Stay
text: I enjoyed my stay here in a large and well maintained room. The hotel is set in a reasonable neighbourhood with local restuarants and bars quite close. The hotel only does breakfast which does get busy but the staff appeared to cope. The service was good as well.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Not a great business hotel or long-term stay hotel
text:
The hotel is clean and functional, which is a definite positive. It's located in the 19th arrondissement, which is a slightly rougher and more lively area of Paris, which makes it not so comfortable wandering around late at night if you are so inclined. There are metro stations moderately close by, which is generally convenient. The staff are generally courteous. The breakfast was perfectly acceptable.

The hotel has several bars in the same building as it, which, should you be cursed with a room close to them, means that there will be a significant amount of noise in the evenings - especially after midnight or 1am, and on weekends, well up to 4am. Should you have trouble sleeping, requesting a room change may be in order.

The hotel has few amenities and the rooms feel confining. It lacks a truly comfortable lounge area, and what seating area there is in the lounge is unceremoniously plunged into darkness after 11 or so, regardless of whether you wish to sit and read or work.

I never really ended up feeling comfortable in this hotel, and never enjoyed my stay, which was long - lengthened all the more by the lack of ever feeling at home there.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great Eco hotel!
text: This is our 3rd stay. Our 1st visit was when it was fairly new in 2008 and we loved it. The rooms are a great size, clean and tidy, staff are multi lingual and breakfast is great value. The canal de la Vilette is a great view with quant little bars close by for a coffee, beer or a meal.  The subway is a 5 minute walk (Riquet Station line 7) that will take you straight to the Louvres Museum. Due to the train strikes this visit we walked to the hotel from Paris Norde train station which is a nice 20 minute walk. (Google maps will help you, keep in mind, the walk is through probably the most multi cultural districts of Paris which we love!) On a side note, there is no room service meals however a supermarket is a 10 minute walk. We highly recommend Holiday Inn Express, it gives you a good taste of Paris.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Highly recommend
text: I had a great stay at the Holiday Inn Express in La Villette - the room was clean, room service everyday was impeccable, and the breakfast had a wide variety of delicious choices. The front desk staff were super friendly and more than willing to offer suggestions of things to do around town, and advise on how to navigate Paris vis-a-vis the Metro strikes. I highly recommend this hotel, and would definitely book another stay on my next visit to Paris.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Wonderful stay
text: We had a wonderful stay at this property. Location was great. Staff was professional, helpful and friendly. Highly recommend this place. The rooms are very quiet and clean.. I definitely would recommend.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Disappointment
text: A shameful service ... Small and uncomfortable rooms, it is not familiar ... if you plan to come with family and children, this is not the right hotel ... We requested a room for 3 people and the additional bed was not even arranged ... it has no fridge and very little room ... horrible room service ... and reception service was very disappointing ...
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Gluten free breakfast is a bit hit or miss
text:
the hotel is great,the location is beautiful with the canal lit up at night, fairly close to Metro stations and the venue at Halles de La Villette. The rooms are clean and the staff are friendly. 

My only issue really was that I emailled ahead to see if Gluten free breakfasts were available and was told that yes they were and to let the reception staff know on check in. I did this and the reception staff said, "just let the breakfast staff know when you arrive for breakfast. The first 3 days we were given 4 tiny gluten free rolls... and offered nothing to go with them. we were advised not to use the ham/ cheese, yogurts (sealed!) or fruit on the buffet, but were instead directed to use the jams...from large open jars... right next to the bread baskets which were stacked over the jars which had shared spoons in... so the contamination risk was exceptionally high!! 
on our last day however, a different staff member supplied us with the bread rolls, cake, muffin and biscuits as well as other things to have with it all. we wished we'd had this our whole stay.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: What a Lovely Hotel
text: A really nice place to stay in Paris, a little outside the centre but with two metro stations very nearby distance is not a problem.The staff were extra helpful and polite, the rooms excellent and the area very amicable.I would really recommend this place if you are visiting Paris, it has everything you could possibly need for a great stay.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Vacationing in Europe’s Finest – My Swiss Experience
text: Recently, I discovered the magic of Europe with Veena World’s package tour covering Lucerne, Interlaken, and Zurich. While it was my childhood dream to visit Switzerland, I was anxious as it was my first European experience. However, Veena World and its efficient staff ensured that all my worries were taken care of! The high point of my Swiss trip was riding the red train to the top of Jungfraujoch. I am glad that I took the advice of my friends who had very positive reviews of Veena Patil since they helped me make the right choice. I plan to discover the remaining wonders of Europe with them in the coming years!
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: HORRIBLE
text:
Spent a few researching hotels for my visit to Paris and this hotel seemed reasonable in price. PLEASE DONT COME HERE! 
Location is a 7 min walk from metro but the area is horrible.. smells like urine all around here. Hotel hosts are useful, waited hours  for check in and every employee seemed to chit chat like there was no one waiting to be checked in. Bar service is horrible they wait for you to just sit there for a long time without being advised that it is always closed. Definitely DO NOT RECOMMEND! Please spend your money elsewhere. Made me so disappointed about Paris.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Amazing stay!
text:
I had an amazing stay in Paris and this hotel made a great contribution to it. The location of the hotel is very good, close to the subway station. The services of the hotel are very good for what we needed. Breakfast was with good quality products (even if not very diversified), large room (for Paris) and very clean, bathroom ok.
The area where the hotel is located is a safe one, you are not afraid to go out at night.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Good Location
text:
I booked the Holiday Inn for several reason, price, breakfast, location, and trust in the brand. When reviewing hotels online this location was on the river and close to the subway. With this being my first visit to Paris I had to rely on the reviews and photo of others here on the TripAdvisor site to choose this location.
We arrived in Paris early since we were on overnight flights. We went straight to our hotel, they held our bags for us while we explored the city. 
The room was ready just as we arrived back at 3pm. We booked a room with a full size bed and a sofa bed. The room size was nice and spacious. It is one of the larger rooms available at this hotel compared to rooms with only a bed.
We had a view of the river and the boats. The room was directly above one of the restaurants that is located along the bottom floor. You could hear the noice from them but we were so exhausted from traveling it did not bother us. Just after we arrived we needed assistance with a few issues in the room. There was no extra bedding and for some reason the phone system did not work. We called and they came up immediately.
The breakfast they offer is perfect to fill your belly before going to exploring the city. My favorite item they offered was toast and nutella. There is a bar next to the check-in desk but that was not utilized by many guest. The area was more used for guest to have meetings.
The Area:
The hotel location was next to a youth hostel and an American Bar. Making this  area a fan for the younger age crowd. We found places to eat every evening within a few blocks of the hotel. One night we had Pho and another night we had McDonald's. There is plenty of options. The hotel is about 3 to 4 blocks from a metro station that will bring you to the heart of paris. 
If we go back, I would stay at this location again.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Once again, a very comfortable stay!
text: I have stayed at the Holiday Inn Express Canal de la Villette about five times over the past decade, and each time it has been a very pleasant experience.  The staff are always welcoming and super helpful, the rooms comfortable (although some are a bit small), and the breakfast quite varied and delicious.  The location on the canal is quite pretty, especially in the autumn when the leaves are changing color, and the working-class neighborhood has an interesting ethnic mix-- Jewish, Muslim, African, Asian, Middle Eastern, as well as French.  On Avenue de Flandre, a couple of blocks from the hotel, there are pharmacies, supermarkets, and chain stores, to acquire most anything you may have forgotten to pack, and on Saturday mornings there is a flea market in the avenue's median.  There are a number of cafes and restaurants along or near the canal, serving many different cuisines (French, Italian, Spanish, Asian, Fusion, etc.), as well as some delicious traditional patisseries on Rue de Crimee and other nearby streets. The Holiday Inn Express Canal de la Villette is a reasonably priced jewel in an otherwise very expensive city.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Very Poor Staff Attitudes.
text:
Look at my other reviews - I do not award one star lightly.  In this case, it is fully deserved. 

This used to be a good hotel.  However, this time, accompanied by my wife, we tried to resolve a room challenge and were met with the most unbelievably aggressive attitude from one Duty Manager in particular.  He came looking for a fight.

In general,  the staff is unwilling/unable to work with guests to look for compromise and reach a mutually beneficial solution.  This results in a 'do not care' attitude.

I visited this hotel when it first opened and complimented the staff on their attitudes - noting that it is hard to find such positive attitudes in Paris hotels.  I asked that they keep these good attitudes and hive level of customer care.  This has not happened.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Would stay here again
text:
The hotel is located on the banks of a canal and is near two metro stations (Crimée and Laumière , which is only a few stops away from Gare du Nord). We were able to get to all the major tourist attractions within half an hour using the metro. 

The surrounding area isn’t very touristy but we found it safe and there are a few good restaurants nearby - i recommend the the Italian restaurant, Simonetta, on the other side of the canal.

We found the hotel staff to be very helpful. 

Our room was a decent size and our beds were really comfortable. We had a good night’s sleep every night.

The breakfast buffet has a decent range of food (mainly continental) and drinks, although the cereals tasted awful and at times they ran out essential items such as English breakfast tea bags. 

Would stay here again.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: A Parisian suburb easily accessible by metro
text: We stayed during the beginning and end of our trip in June. The hotel is along a canal near 2 metro lines which is very convenient for visiting central Paris. We found the neighborhood very livable with grocery stores, laundromats, and affordable restaurants all within walking distance. During the weekends the canal is bustling with activities and locals hanging out, which we thoroughly enjoyed watching from our window and balcony. The rooms are spacious by Parisian standards, and although the air-conditioning may not be cool enough in full occupancy, the windows can be opened and the area is rather quiet at night. Breakfast was typically Holiday Inn Express, and staff were accommodating in allowing us to check-out 2 hours later due to our evening flight. We would return based on the price paid, room size, and location of the hotel.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Cosy nice rooms!!!!!
text: It is a fantastic place to stay. The rooms provided were clean and well equipped,nice view to canal  with everything we need. The ambience at the hotel always attracts the tourists .Wonderful spread of food menu in restaurant and the services provided were fast.Complimentary breakfast was really delicious. We really enjoyed our stay and would like to thank each n everyone who tended to us during our visit.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Very nice, clean hotel in a great location
text: The hotel is great and located next to the canal. Rooms are clean and very comfortable, especially the bed and linen. The bathrooms are excellent and well maintained. The only issue I have is that the hotel does not offer laundry/dry cleaning service which is very common in all hotels I have stayed at.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: On a canal
text: Reading reviews and being a holiday inn member I thought this place looks good a little off the central area but close enough to public transportation. We got in around 10am check in person was super nice stated cant check in until 3pm but we could store our bags. That was great we checked out Paris since like others mentioned 2 train station close by. Came back at 4pm as it was raining to check in first lady super nice asked if I want a drink or extra points. Then she gave me a little basket for being a member I pulled 1,000 extra points still havent received them.  She then asked another lady to get our bags I gave her the slips we got for checking our bags. At first she could find them then asked for colors mine were easy purple and red backpacks  but my spouse 2 grey roll backs they tryed to give him other people bags twice he said there not his. I dont understand why give slips with numbers if this isn't  used. Finally after 3 attempts he got his bags. We got to our room nice and big for European  standards. I like our view of the canal even with the rain wished we could sit out there. The hotel even had a nice little surprise  for my spouse birthday.  What was odd no safe which was scary thank goodness we were only here one night. We got showered,  unpacked, reorganized a bit changed from our wet clothes and head back out for the night. When we got back around midnight we noticed  an issue on our sheets. I went straight down to the front desk the young man name started with an L super friendly and new to this place apologized  and got us new sheets. Never had an incident like this happen. We slept well bed super comfortable. Anyways next morning woke up had breakfest. I did like this breakfest with the deli meats and cheeses  but it was hard to get a table. We were sat and then someone took our table. We found another but its odd they seat you and people just sit themselves. Also the hot food was extra from what was written which was odd and things did not get replaced right away or they ran out of things at 9am. At checkout I mentioned what happened when we got back to our room they got the manager  who seemed to say I dont know how that happened I was in the room checking on things.  Check out was fine overall just left a bad taste in my mouth that I felt the manger was blaming us for our sheets. Either way liked I stated really wanted to love this place  but cant say I stay here again a bit off from attractions.  Also at night when you walk back you will smell urine all around this area. Good  for one night great price. Lovely looking canal most staff super friendly. Just things to be cautious  of.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great hotel great location
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights. Rooms are a good size. Nice balcony with great views of the canal. You are approx 2-3 minutes walk from supermarkets restaurants and bars. Area feels very safe. Walked around in evening and no issues. Lots of locals out and about sat on the canals. Little pop up bars and restaurants on the canal. Really great location.

You are about a 3 minute walk from riquet metro station. Then it's about 15 minute ride to the Louvre. 

Breakfast was average but nothing special. Reception staff very friendly and helpful. Can't recommend this place enough. Oh and one last thing beds are super comfy.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Fantastic hotel, views, location.
text:
This hotel was fantastic.
The staff are friendly, happy, and make you feel very welcome.
The public transport links are close by with the metro at riquet (line 7) or stalingrad (line 5) easy to access.
There is a local supermarket 2 minutes from the hotel.
Lots of bars, restaurants and also an outdoor activity area along the canal for children.
Including boats, peddleo, kayaks to hire.

Travelling in and around paris are difficult to understand at first but become alot easier after a few short trips.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Do NOT Stay Here
text: Do not stay here on a Friday or Saturday night. The ground floor shares space with Belushi's Bar/Nightclub. They play very loud music until 4am. When we complained to management, we were told to call the police. Not a realistic option, since we don't speak French. With so many hotels to choose from in Paris, don't waste your money on a place you can't get a decent night's sleep.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Love the canal location
text:
We have stayed at this hotel two summers in a row.  While we had an exemplary stay last summer, this summer there was some unevenness in our stay.

Pros:  
Love the canal location and liveliness in the summer
The price offers good value
There are 2 metro lines, a 5 and 10 minute walk away
Rooms are spacious for Paris standards and beds are very comfortable 
Several good dining options nearby

Cons:
AC has undergone some remodeling and was a bit uneven
Too many people with inconsistent information at front desk
Faint paint smell in room and residue on hallway carpet
Loose carpet thresholds in hallway
Bustling breakfast scene and some items slow to be replaced
Charge for cooked items (only ordered once as omelet was horrible)
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: STRICTLY NO TO THIS HOTEL PLEASE
text: Please do not book this hotel. This is full of frauds and cheaters. I visited Paris to with my family to celebrate my son's birthday. We checked in at 1530 and returned after evening cruise to hotel around 2330. To our surprise our entire cash (600 Euros + 500 Swiss Francs) and 8 days family swiss pass was stolen from our room. We immediately contacted the hotel staff however no action was taken till 0330am when finally I had to call the cops from my own phone. Hotel staff did not take any action saying Lobby manager was not available. There were no CCTV cameras and no help at all was provided. Staff was too rude no support in difficult situation. At the time of checkout (3 days later) I was handed over an excel sheet (attached as a proof) showing room access logs since technician was also not available (enough time to make changes in). On this such a serious complaint Hotel staff sending rude response which I am shocked to see. I booked this hotel to welcome my Son into Teen age but the experience was shocking and instead of Happy memories we were terribly Traumatized and still regret why we selected this hotel to stay. Leave aside help or even empathy with the guest who was robbed inside their property and spoiling the occasion, The RUDE behavior and no help from hotel staff was insult to injury.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: A Good place to stay
text: This hotel is in a quieter part of Paris, the views along the canal are nice and you can stroll there too. Breakfast is "ok" but no more than "ok", rooms nice, clean and tiday, everything works. Reception people really helpful. Stay here if you want a bit more peace. It is near the Metro station Crimee
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Everything You'd Expect From HIE
text:
I'm a big fan of Holiday Inn Express. Always clean,  well organised and good value for money. This one is no different so I'll miss out "room was clean, staff friendly and professional" etc as that seems to be minimum standards for HIE

Location is great. 15 mins on Metro from Gare du  Nord and Gare de l'est.  30 minutes can get you to any of the major attractions.  Not exactly central but acceptable "commute" in my opinion.

We stayed during Paris Plage so loads going on around the hotel with open air bars on both sides of the canal.

A few previous reviews raised concerns over the safety of the location.  We didn't feel concerned or threatened in any way even when walking back from the Metro near midnight.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: A very good stay for the price
text: We stayed in Holiday inn express during our 3 day visit at end of May in Paris. This was our first trip to Paris and we felt the hotel location was absolutely good (with nearby metro). Our room was river facing one and we had a excellent time waking up every morning with an awesome view. Complimentary breakfast was really awesome. One of the memorable thing for us is that chef in the hotel went above and beyond to prepare us a vegetarian pizza which was not available by default in the hotel and it turned out to be one of the best pizza we had tasted. We forgot to get his name. But we do hope hotel management convey our accolades to the chef (young lad). Most of the staff were welcome and some of them we felt were impolite. This is hardly an issue as we felt that this is something which we did give a pass because of the other excellent things the hotel has to offer. Overall a nice place for Indians to stay as there are lot of Indian restaurants near by as well. Cheers and thanks to the hotel management for their hospitality.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Wheelchair accessibility
text:
Stayed here for three days. Lovely hotel. Lovely location. Only minutes away from Gare du nord train station, served by Eurostar. The staff are very friendly and very helpful. 

I’m in a wheelchair. The room had a wet room shower. The toilet is the same height as my wheelchair, so very helpful. I was given a shower seat which hooks on to the grab rail. The seat was very solid, but no arm rests, and height was much lower than my wheelchair.

Wheelchair accessibility was fantastic. The only slight drawback, was the fact that the toilet only had one fixed grab rail. It would’ve been fantastic to have two drop down grab rails. If the toilet had a back rest, that would’ve been fantastic too. I managed to use the facilities, nevertheless, but the added features would’ve been really fabulous.

Overall, the hotel was very clean. The breakfast was very good. The hotel is within easy reach of restaurants, bars, and cafes. 

An excellent stay, all in all...

Thank you,
Lee from Gravesend Kent England.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great hotel
text:
Very nice hotel, but like most Holiday Inn Expresses, this was very clean, reasonably priced and in a location that was easily accessible to central Paris.

Located on the canal, the hotel is in a very nice district with several places to eat and drink nearby.

In the summer the canal has several activities including motor boats that can be hired.

Two metro stations are within walking distance:Riquet (5 mins walk) and Laumière (10mins).

We visited in the summer and it may be worthwhile trying to avoid the metro and perhaps use buses (you will need to do some research) instead -
I saw on T/A a previous guest recommends the buses.

Breakfast is a buffet of usual continental fare, plus there was bacon, sausages and scrambled eggs.

Overall a lovely stay and we would stay here again the next time we are in Paris.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Paris In The Sunshine
text:
I last visited Paris 10 years ago and mainly did the tourist bus. I swore then i would go back and one day and explore Paris properly....by foot.

First choice i made was this hotel, what an amazing hotel. It delivered everything it promised and more.

We were given a room on the 5th floor facing the canal, how pretty, the best view in the hotel. I had asked for good working air conditioning, as this can be hit and miss in Europe in my experience. This hotel had great air conditioning. 

The beds.....so comfortable, we slept soundly every night and woke up just in time to catch breakfast.

The breakfast was delicious, scrambled eggs done to perfection, delicious sausages and bacon, fresn baguettes, yoghurts, fruit, cereals, a cold selection of meats and toast. Really everything was catered for.

The hotel and rooms were spotlessly clean and cleaned thoroughly every day. I really do not have a bad word to say about this hotel.

The metro is really close and we used this for most of our 3 day stay but unfortunately twice we were nearly pickpocketed. First two men tried to pickpocket my husband at Gare Du Nord station unsuccessfully. And then when i was going up the stairs at Palais Royal a group of 4 young girls of about 14 years old got quite close to me. Even though my bag was zipped up i felt a slight tug and caught one of them with their hand in my bag. Both attempts were unsuccessful but to be honest this would put me off using the metro in Paris again. From then onwards we used Uber which was really easy and cheap. So bear this in mind if you ever visit Paris, ive never known crime quite like this in any other city ive visited. So thats a real shame.

However that said me and my husband had a grest time in Paris, with a very comfortable stay at this hotel. I was so pleased with my choice and if i ever return i will most definitely come back to this hotel.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Weekend in Paris
text:
Perfect location, great lively canal side hotel. Very reasonable price for bed and breakfast. Highly recommend
Nice staff and good breakfast- parking was reasonable too.
I will definitely go back soon.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Good hotel - great location
text:
Hotel was easy to reach by car - and its (paid) parking below an appreciated plus. Reception was speedy and friendly as was the rest of personnel. Our room had enough space for the three of us. Batchroom looked like new - and was very clean. Room overlooked the canal.  The area around the hotel is really nice and alive. Various restaurants & bars within short walking distance.   Metro stations nearby but we used bus to get around in order to see  "Paris streetview" (also bus stop short walk only) . Breakfast was sufficient and fine. Personnel elevator to handle occasional guests elevator breakdown. 
Hotel has controlled access  to room floor.  No safe in room (but apparently items can be brought to reception desk for safe keeping) .  We used " don't disturb " sign instead .
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: First visit to Paris
text:
Quite a way out from the city centre; this makes it cheaper, but if you can get your head around the metro system, there are trains running almost constantly and Riquet station is a two minutes walk away. Right by side of canal so a nice view if on that side of hotel. Room was nice and clean and breakfast was okay except for the eggs!
The local area seems a bit run down in places and the rancid smell of pee is too prevalent around some of the streets. However, sitting by the canal in the evening is pleasant and the people are friendly. I would use this hotel again.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Loved the area
text: The hotel was lovely it is situation at the beginning of the canal. There were many restaurant in the area. Food is delicious and at a reasonable price. Excellent for summer visits. We took the subway which is down the block and was able to get to every site and department store.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Good Hotel
text: Good facilities, close to underground to get into Paris. Restaurants and shops close by. Friendly, helpful staff. Room a decent size. Located on the canal, nice walks along the waterway.  All in all good value for money.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Hidden canal gem in central Paris
text:
What a stunning HI Express, right on the canal in the heart of Paris. Immediately outside is a gravelled area where the locals pay Petanque (there were 4 games going into the late evening), there are two atmospheric Bistros opposite and on the hotel itself a super fish restaurant, La Criee. The prices are great for eating locally too.  There are two metro lines within 5 minutes from the hotel.

Breakfast was really great, with a fantastic array of cereals, fruits, cheeses, yoghurts and other snacks.

The hotel itself was fresh and clean and rooms really great (well the one I had was), when you have the canal view.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Lovely location
text:
This is one hotel which you will love only for its location. It is bang next to the canal and from the room windows or from the open deck, you can find many sailboats. Try to choose a lower floor room, which will give you an early morning feel that you are lying on the water level of the canal.
There is not much else to write about the room or the bathroom, both of which are small. There were not enough power sockets in the room and I had to charge the batteries from the bathroom. Having toiletries of "standard" brand was an added change.
Breakfast was complementary, good, but became a bore within our 4 nights stay. It would be nice if the cook learns to make scrambled eggs which are less watery.

In a nutshell. the family just loved it and would be happy to stay there again :-)
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: An Amazing Experience with Veena World
text: I recently planned my Himachal Pradesh holidays with the help of Veena World tour packages and I must say that it helped us a lot in our entire trip. I heard some great reviews of Veena World through a friend of mine and was willing to give it a try. Since it was our annual family trip, I decided to keep things simple. With their customization options, we were able to filter results according to our preferences. And since they had different tour packages available, it was extremely easy to choose the package that was not only affordable, but delightful as well.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: good location, nice area.
text:
We stayed here from May 25th to June 1st, 2019.  The area where the hotel is located is a nice canal with close proximity to both the Riquet and Stalingrad metro lines.  In travelling the world, one thing we appreciate are rooms with safes in it.  For some reason this is an amenity that's left out in the rooms of this hotel. We also ran into a situation that needed us to call Canada to deal with (pickpocketed on the metro).  There was no in room instructions on how to make a long distance call, and when we went to the front desk, no one there seemed to know at the time how to make a call to Canada.  Very frustrating. I wound up contacting who I needed to via facebook messenger.  

The included breakfast was ok..  Once they offered apple turnovers but once that one batch was gone... they were gone.  If you're travelling to Paris for tourism and pleasure, you won't be spending much time in the room.  There's lots of restuarants, brasseries and other amenities within walking distance.  The Riquet metro line takes you directly to the Louvre museum.  

I've stayed at a few Holiday Inn expresses in North American and the UK, and given the fact this was Paris, I just found it average overall.  Location was great for seeing Paris and access to the Metro and transit. But the lack of an in room safe was really off putting to me, which led to me carrying stuff around with me around Paris I normally wouldn't have.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Thelma C
text: Nice hotel! Happy I didn’t listen to the negative reviews. Super easy to catch metro to major attractions. Additionally have to give Elvis and Faudele major applause, they went way above and beyond with assistance.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Great View & Location
text:
Upon checking in the hotel, I notice the view of the place where in along the Seine River. The hotel is amazing that they have a good location and lobby. 

We don’t have problems upon checking in. We were assisted nicely by the lady at the front desk. 

We got the view at the seine river which is magnificent to see the sunrise and sunset. 

The bed are comfortable and pillows are good though they are small to normal sizes in other Holiday Inn. 

They serve good breakfast and appreciate the people working there nice and very helpful. 

Location wise is near to everywhere and it’s few minutes walk to the nearest 
metro. 

It’s a good place to stay and very accessible to all the groceries, restaurants nearby, laundry and others that you may need.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Much better than the rating I've given it
text:
I have stayed at this hotel 4 or 5 times now and have always thought it to be a hidden gem. The rooms are large by Paris standards and well priced and it's on the side of the Saint-Martin Canal at the Bassin de la Villette.

The hotel is well maintained and offers a really good breakfast with quality items and a wide variety of choice. Staff are generally friendly and efficient and speak many languages - English being the main one after French.

Usually, I would give the hotel a 5-star rating, but it's much less as I feel their professionalism left a lot to be desired on my last visit.

After checking out I asked for a taxi only to be told that they were on strike. This was the first I knew of this as no signs had been posted in the elevators or foyer. When I asked the woman at the desk what we could do she said to take the Metro. This to a person with 2 suitcases of around 25 kgs each and a handicapped wife who can't walk too far. 

After I pressed her for a solution she said she'd see what her manager had to say and went into the office behind the desk. The manager had such high concern for our situation that he didn't even bother to come out to us. When the clerk returned she said she would try and get a taxi and used the computer to make a booking. I asked how long the taxi might be and she said she didn't know. All through our conversation, she showed little if any empathy for our plight.

Thank goodness for phone apps as I was able to get a car from Kapten which got us to the airport in good time for our plane.

As I said this is a good hotel. But I have given it a poor rating because of the low level of professionalism and customer service when it was needed most. Also, because I received an email with a half-apology from the manager saying that staff would be counseled, but that there were signs in the lift - there were not. And that another client had got a taxi earlier after waiting 45 minutes and it took 2 hours to the airport. What relevance this has to our situation escapes me, but I find it passing strange that the manager knows how long a cab took to get to the airport. I actually believe he's not telling the truth, but who cares?

A professional manager would have arranged for signs to be in elevators, all foyers, and the breakfast room. They would also arrange some form of bookable transport to be available. They would talk with their customers and not hide in their office.

So stay at this great hotel by all means, but be mindful that when you may need it most their customer service might evaporate.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: A bit far from attractions but a good hotel
text:
This was my first trip to France so it was surprising that there was no AC in the hotel, just a FAN!  I don't know if this is a French custom (the LOUVRE didn't have AC!) but heading to the hotel, the Uber driver didn't use AC either, just the windows were open. Luckily it's Spring with cool nights and the windows were able to open.
Second complaint is that at breakfast, even at 9:30am (they close at 10) was pretty full.  Since I was by myself, they wouldn't seat me as they only had tables for four.  The ones for two were all used. So they suggested I get my food and take it to the bar across the way.
Other than that, this is a fairly nice hotel. The room was clean and a decent size.  The bed was comfortable and desk was functional. It's located in a safe area, even the police station is minutes walk away!
Hommie was great!  Even though she's at the front desk, she was willing to help out at the bar when no one was there!
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Nice Hotel, good service
text: This hotel is located in a beautiful surroundings, while walking through the neighborhood could prove the Parisian live. People playing jeu d bules, sitting at the cafe on the corner. We get there too early, that was not problem at all as we could leave our luggage behind. Metro station Riquet is just 5 min walking, traveling through Paris with public transport is quite easy. Metro app really helps! Personnel in this hotel is very very friendly, if there is something wrong they get it done right away. Breakfast is really good, many choices. Minor detail is the size of the breakfast room, a little bit small for so many guests. Even though the personnel do all their best to help you out getting a proper place. Rooms are also fine, a little bit warm but it was really cold outside so we could just open the window and it was ok. A lot of restaurants around.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: A good base for visiting Paris and the surrounding area
text: Easy to get to if you don't use the Parishuttle. A very nice quiet location on the river next to a very interesting mechanical bridge with nice views. You can watch the brilliant game of 'Bouls' well in to the evening which they used to play in the city on the banks of the Seine. Very handy for the Metro in to the city (of which only 5% of the stations have escalators). There are grocery shops for daily supplies and romantic inexpensive corner restaurants/bars to get the flavour of Parisians. The hotel rooms are modern and clean but NO SAFE so you will have to drag your belongings around with you or leave then in reception. Coffee and Tea making facilities are good. Hanging area for clothes but no drawers, otherwise ok.The staff are brilliant, polite and communicative with lots of advice if needed. (Good maps too!) .Breakfast is a hot buffet and just what you need to start the days touring. Tour operators will pickup from this hotel too! All in all a very good base for visiting Paris and the surrounding area. Holiday in is always good quality, value for money and has continuity.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Very Good Hotel for Location
text: Don't be afraid to stay a bit further from all of your Paris tourist spots.  This hotel is nicely located on the canal.  It has a very nice walking path and few a great little restaurants, coffee shops and even a brewery next door.  It is a quick and easy 5 minute walk to the metro to get you to all of our traveling spots.  Hotel was clean, breakfast was very nice, staff was very nice and spoke English.  We did have an air-condition water leak in our room, but luckily that was the last day and we chose not to shift rooms, as they did offer.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: The hotel was super
text:
The hotel was super tidy and looked very modern and nice. 
Our room was comfortable and surprisingly big. We loved the double door in the bathroom which either closes the complete bathroom or just the area of the toilet. The shower doors are a bit unusual to use but are working.
The breakfast was good too! So we were very happy and had very nice days here.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: One of the most perfect ..
text: I was pleasantly surprised by this property.  The location is almost prefect. It next to the seine .. you actually get the view from your hotel window. There is a place to walk on the edge. The hotel is between two train stations. The breakfast is quite good, Internet and rooms are spacious. The front office were quite helpful. I would stay here again and again ..
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: it is always good to sleep near a sizable body of water.
text: The bigger lobby is a welcome sight if you had enough of the minimal lobby of the cheaper paris hotels. The reception staff are multilingual and would help you in their capacity. the hotel is just a few floors, serviced by elevators, so luggage isn't a problem. The room is small but enough, we got the one facing the canal de seine, it is a better view than if you got the opposite rooms. the breakfast served was the same for 3 days so i kinda regretted availing it. Canal de seine is nice to walk along anytime of the day, there are a lot of homeless hanging around but i didn't see anyone bothering other people. it seems that the area is on a multicultural area as there are a lot of middle easterns, africans, asians aside from the old parisians. they brought along their cuisines as well in their respective restaurants. So you can have anything you want there right outside.  you can also rent electric boats in the canal. This hotel is nice if you get past the homeless people hanging around town.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Surprise
text: The location of this hotel was a surprise. A few stops on the metro from the Gare du Nord. Local amenities a short distance from hotel. Situated right by the canal. Pleasant walkway along both sides of the canal. There is also an interesting pont levis next to the building. Room was pleasant. Breakfast plentiful. Staff accomodating and couteous.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: nice but noisey
text: The hotel is new, the staff are nice and the area is good.  easy access to 3 metro stations can be a bit dark at night.  lots of nice bars.  However the noise,   my room was like a disco to 2am on the first night.  also, they were decorating my floor, this was not mentioned when I booked.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Very Good
text: Nice location by small Canal. Hotel nice and clean. Great staff. Peaceful area with good restaurants. Didn't do metro. Only in town 2 days. Caught cabs. Cab into central area 10 to 15 minutes. Great breakfast. Bacon type sausage and eggs were tasty. Plenty of good places to eat with short walk. Highly recommend
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Excellent Location
text:
Everything you wouid expect from a Holiday Inn Express -  kettle , coffee , breakfast , clean, efficient, good beds and good hot showers - but what sets this apart is the location right on the Quai De La Seine, overlooking the canal. 

Our room on the 6 th floor had this great view from the large balcony  and we enjoyed watching the runners , cyclists and dog walkers going about their business in this eclectic , safe and bustling neighborhood . Good little French cafes across the road , close to the Metro, and a good walking  trail along the canal towards the  city center.

Wouid recommend !
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Perfect location, great stay
text:
Stayed 2 nights with husband and son. Arrived at Gard du Nord and walked to the hotel from the station, a 30 minute walk. Arrived at 11.30 to drop bags off, but they had a room available so we were able to check in immediately, really impressed. 
Room was as per the photos on the website. Had been made up for 2, so only 2 towels & cups, collected additional when we returned in the evening. The view was of the canal. Everything was clean, except for the carpet which was pretty grubby. Room had hairdryer, kettle and small selection of tea & coffee.
Breakfast was good, with a selection of cereals, fruit, breads, cold meats, cheese & pastries, sausages, bacon and scrambled eggs, juices and a good selection of hot drinks.
There are several metro stations nearby, a few supermarkets and restaurants. Rue de Meaux nearby has a variety of restaurants and bars. The walk along the canal into Paris is very picturesque. 
I didn't have much interaction with the staff, but all I encountered were polite. I would stay again.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Lovely Staff
text:
I stayed here very recently with my husband for a short break during Valentine's. Location was really good and good parking space. Staff at front desk were great at their customer service skills and as the brand is quite relaxed so we could feel that while interacting with the team members. Special thanks to Marc for helping us order our food, Paul was very friendly and the lady that did the checkout for us was very polite and professional(sorry didn't get her name). Sadly I didn't get a chance to meet Perrick but he was very helpful during booking process. 
All the best and keep doing the great job 😊😊
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: First trip to Paris... I’ll be back!
text:
Beautiful hotel! Great neighborhood, close to the Metro. Quaint restaurants and right on the canal.. so lots of Parisians hanging out doing what they do - relaxing, etc.... 
The restaurant was good, but there were many neighboring restaurants for the authentic French meal....
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Recommended
text:
Classic Holiday İnn standarts are also available here.Staff is very kind and hepfull
Breakfast is very good.My room was overlooking the canal.l liked the hotel very much.Strongly recommended to stay for any reason.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Some nice. Some not so nice.
text:
Location- loved it. Off the beaten path for first time Paris visitors but nice to walk around in a more residential area. Lots of little restaurants and bars and very close to subway line.
Room- I wish we had asked to be moved on first day of our 7 day trip. Had a top floor room. Size was nice with one large bed and a sofabed. Two major problems- Worst stained carpet I've seen and odors (two totally different types). When we walked in room and saw stains on carpet I thought they had just shampooed since it was very discolored in most places. I never thought a Holiday Inn would put someone in a room with that carpeting. Also since it was raining out I thought maybe the previous guest or housekeeper tracked water in from the balcony. We unpacked and went out for the day. The next morning it was evident that this was just a terribly stained carpet. If this room was acceptable to them then the others were probably the same I thought.
The room also had either a VERY strong cleaning smell or on the last 2-3 days was a terrible sewer smell from the bathroom. We had to keep bathroom door shut so we could tolerate it in the bedroom. Neighbors had the same odor issue.
The restaurant breakfast was decent. No changes throughout our 7 days but didn't bother us too much.
Front desk nice enough. Never said hello or any acknowledgment when we walked by the desk a few times a day. It would have been nice.
Will we return? Probably not. I expect better quality of the room.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: Nice hotel, helpful staff
text: My family of 3 stayed here and although the room was slightly on the small side for 3 of us, it was adequate in size, very clean  and is well laid out with good storage areas/desk and a good sized clean, new bathroom with good shower. Breakfast buffet was great ....everything very fresh with lots of selection and friendly attentive staff keeping everything stocked and tidy. The dining room was very pleasant.  All staff we encountered were helpful and friendly.  The hotel is near metro stations which can get you into the centre fairly quickly.  We enjoyed our stay here very much and would return.  Great value for the price.
Hotel: Holiday Inn Express Paris - Canal de la Villette, an IHG Hotel

title: A great stay, and incredible staff!
text:
Me and my fiancé had the best time! The location is close to many restaurants and a short walk to the metro station. You can get anywhere in the city from there. 

And an extra shout out to Sebastian who works the front desk, he and Weelam made our stay very special, we will absolutely stay here again!
Hotel: Courtyard by Marriott Paris Gare de Lyon
description: Tucked within an eclectic neighborhood and offering breathtaking views of some of the city's most legendary landmarks, the 4-star Courtyard Paris Gare de Lyon sets the tone for a remarkable hotel experience. Whether you're in France for business or on a family vacation, you'll find everything you need here to pursue your passions. title: Great Stay!
text:

The hotel is quite the distance from the typical tourist attractions in Paris. But it is easy to catch the train there (RATP) or and Uber. But the train is cheaper and doesn't get stuck in much traffic. 

I would definitely stay here again!

We asked to get the room cleaned again on arrival as there were food crumbs everywhere and obviously hadn’t been vacuumed between stays and lots of hairs on the towels which is unpleasant.

That said its a comfortable place and secure and whilst the restaurant area could be made more inviting (its a bit harsh with white furniture and bright lighting) the restaurant manager Erwan was exceptional. 

The service provided by Erwan and team is really elevated above the rest of the hotel. Amazing cocktails and the fantastic service made the place really come alive, with hotel residents spending time there in the evenings.

Worth considering for a short stay in Paris, not the most central but fairly easy to get around from here.

title: Wonderful View, Large Room ...in Paris
text:
Huge room for Paris standards, status recognized and given late check out and...what a view.  wowza, its rare to have tall views in Paris and not be in like Montparnasse or Defense (both no no).  Friendly staff, great redemption of my points in peak summer 2022.   I would ding this for just one thing:  if you're AC/heat sensitive like me - a very hot sleeper - it was a humid 85 degree day the night I stayed and at night...the AC didnt do its job to my loving.  I was there for one night so it was whatever and everything worked the way I needed it to for my late train the next day with late check out, but the windows are massive so they prob take in a lot of heat from sun so...not sure how they'd handle the heat waves.  Considering its a minor timing thing I wont deduct but it did affect my sleep that day ...only bc I came from a hotel with an amazing AC.  the beautiful windows and largeness of room sort of worked against it in this respect.  

Location - it clearly says Gare De Lyon.  So you're in a bit of a business/busy zone so Ubers can be hard to come by or long waits, but the super friendly maitr'de - amazing guy who flagged me taxis both times I needed them fast.  

Enjoyed my stay and was worth my redemption.  Prob great for fams bc of huge rooms.

I contacted them and they told me they gave my money back, but I had a problem with my credit card (it got cloned so I had to cancel it). Now, about the hotel. It's well located, you can have a walk to the Marais and there are boulangeries and cafés nearby. The staff is nice, the breakfast is good and the rooms are clean and spacy.

title: Comfortable stay close to train station
text: We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights, and enjoyed our stay. Our room wasn't ready when we arrived due to a maintenance problem, so they brought us to the bar for a free drink and a small bowl of peanuts, which was a nice touch. We had a king room with a sofa bed for our teenage son. It was very tight in the room with the sofa bed out, but we made it work. The bathroom was very nice and updated, and they were generous with the toiletries provided. The A/C worked well. There were several electrical outlets in the room as well. There was an electric kettle with tea bags, and bottled water with a small refrigerator. There was also an ice machine available one floor up from us. The hotel felt safe because you had to scan your room key to get up to the floors. It was across the street from the train station, but you could barely hear the trains. Starbucks was attached to the building, and there were many restaurants, a small grocery store, and other bakeries very close by. My biggest complaint is that it is not close to any of the big tourist attractions. It was convenient for the train, but really nothing else. We had booked another hotel in a better location, but found out they might not have air conditioning. We switched to the Courtyard at the last minute, so we didn't have a lot of choices. We paid with Chase points, but I also think we had to spend too many points for our stay.

title: Good location, reasonable rate, poor experience overall
text:
The "front desk" is a counter at the junction of two hallways leading from the entry and the elevators and gets very congested. The desk clerk was initially very nice and we requested a quiet room away from elevators. When we reached the room to find it facing the elevator foyer and with a door to an adjoining room I went back to request relocation, with which she was obviously displeased.

Upon arrival in the second room there were no bath towels. When housekeeping came to deliver them, instead of graciously handing them to us at the door she came in to verify that we were indeed missing towels. She seemed more law enforcement than customer service (I say this as former Marriott professional staff).

The bathroom was separated from the remainder of the room by a frosted glass partition with a 1" gap and no fan for privacy. The heavy glass door would not stay open, requiring us to use a wedged washcloth as a door stop. The synthetic shower floor was very slippery when wet and no non-skid mat was provided.

There was plenty of floor space but very little room for your belongings. The closet is 12" wide, consumed mostly by the ironing board. A couple of coat hooks between the door and mirror would be an easy and very helpful addition. The luggage stand holds one carryon bag with the single, very shallow drawer below not capable of  accommodating much more than the provided Bible and Book of Mormon. At most it is useful for wallet, keys, glasses and phone.

The only chair is a hard plastic bucket with less than a half inch of padding. It is extremely uncomfortable even for a few minutes and coming in contact mid-back it is quite painful if you are not extremely well-padded yourself. The beds were comfortable (although the comforter was very noisy and the crinkling can be bothersome to a light sleeper).

The cabinet above the coffee center has a sharp corner at eye level that I narrowly missed reaching for the light switch. The coffee area leaves no room to maneuver and the coffee is instant. The fridge wasn't cold enough to even slightly chill a beverage or keep a yogurt from going bad.

The proximity to the Gare de Lyon train station and a metro station is convenient.  Rooms on the river side are quiet and the hotel is away from tourist areas and resulting crowds. The room was clean.

I understand that Courtyard is on the lower end of the Marriott brand line-up, however this property did not meet my expectations for anything associated with the Marriott name.

title: Lovely hotel
text:
I recently stayed at the Courtyard by Marriott at Paris Gare De Lyon for a city break with my partner and it was beautiful.

The hotel was clean, perfect and appeared as if it was new. The staff were very accommodating upon check in and if there is any issues they will happily rectify if. We had an issue with the lighting in our room and within five minutes of ringing reception an engineer arrived and rectified the problem. Any questions you have for staff they were very accommodating with good English and understandable. 

I paid approximately £700 for three nights however breakfast was not included and it was an extra £25 each morning for breakfast. I believe that breakfast could have been included considering the price I paid. If you are travelling to Paris to visit the sites, then I would not recommend this hotel. This hotel is perfect if your on a business trip, with the location directly next to the train station however it is a good hour walk to Notre Dam and a good hour and a half walk to the Eiffel Tower. There is the option of a river bus which is £30 for a day ticket and it stops at various locations along the river which is easier and this is about a 15 minute walk from the hotel on the River Seine.

A taxi is approximately £25 from the Eiffel Tower to the hotel and you can pay by card just tell them the train station and off they go.

Upon our arrival at around 0100 after a long day of travel we arrived at the hotel to check in and the outside doors were locked with no staff around to let us in to the hotel. No. One. title: 2 Gorgeous Views 1 Ungregarious Employee
text:
First off, I'm a Bonvoy Titanium member, which means I've stayed at many Marriott properties before and for the most part, have been pleased with their service. But not this one. First of all, there was a long line (20 minutes) to even check in. The poor trainee was left by himself. He was nice enough, but come on, this is rush hour for checking in here (5 pm). 

The rooms are spectacular: clean, modern, newly renovated, and the view to die for. At first, I got the Sacré-Cœur side, which offered a panoramic view of the city along with the clock tower at Gare de Lyon. It lit up at night like the city of lights would.

I wanted to experience the Eiffel Tower/Seine River side, so I asked to be transferred to a different room the next night on the other side. Big mistake! First of all, there was a used earplug from the previous guest laying on the night stand that I had to throw away. I understood why they had it because you can hear the subway every three minutes! 

Not only that, at 10:30 p.m., the people next door started playing club music while I was in bed trying to go to sleep. I called the front desk and they said they would send someone out right away. 20 minutes later, I called back because they hadn't kept their word. That's when they finally sent Sean over and he knocked on MY door even though it was fairly obvious where the noise was coming from! 

I was surprised because now the people next door would know I ratted them out. He asked in a loud voice, "Are the people next door the ones making noise?" to which I responded softly, "Yes." He then banged on the door next door and told them to keep it down. They did for a while, but the talking resumed. 

I was so fed up, I packed my bags and went down and asked to be moved back to my room from the night before. Guess who was staffing the front desk? Sean! When I confronted him about knocking on my door, he was very defensive and said, "They did not hear me knocking on your door or know it was you who called us." How could they not? He then passive-aggressively took another 20 minutes to process my request of moving me back to my old room.

I know the noisy guests was not their fault, but the way the staff handled it was extremely poor. I expect better from a "four-star" hotel, and certainly for a loyal guest like myself.
