text: They upgraded us we had a fantastic view and the meal was delicious. The personal was super professional and friendly. Worth the price I will for sure comeback there at my next visit in Paris . My family and I were super happy! Thank you so much windy and suthita for everything!
Hotel: Courtyard by Marriott Paris Gare de Lyon
description: Tucked within an eclectic neighborhood and offering breathtaking views of some of the city's most legendary landmarks, the 4-star Courtyard Paris Gare de Lyon sets the tone for a remarkable hotel experience. Whether you're in France for business or on a family vacation, you'll find everything you need here to pursue your passions. Settle in to contemporary, comfortable rooms with deluxe bedding, ergonomic work areas, high-speed Wi-Fi and oversized TVs with streaming capabilities - not to mention awe-inspiring views of the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, Sacré-Coeur and La Defense. Start or end your day in Paris with a meal at Kitchen & Bar @Gare de Lyon, our French bistro, or challenge yourself to a workout in the hotel fitness center. If you're in Paris for business, you can explore our flexible meeting rooms, which accommodate up to 100 seated guests. Our close proximity to the train and Metro stations makes it easy for you to discover the city, too. Your 4-star getaway awaits at Courtyard Paris Gare de Lyon.

title: Room with a view
text: Stayed here for an night on our way to south of France. I must say our room had gorgeous French decor with a marvelous balcony with views of both the arc and Eiffel Tower also including sacer coeur! Location is not bad either right next door to champ elysee.

title: nice short saty...........
text: stayed there for 4 days but was expecting much from the hotel was not given a room with an Eiffel tower view after so many requests but it's okay......hotel staff was a bit rude and did not help much ....but it was ok won't be giving it a 5 star though...

title: Falling stars for old dirty hotel
text:
Not worth the price paid. Dirty bathroom, uninsonorised rooms. Some people woke us up at 2 in the morning next to our room with communicating doors with holes so we could hear all they said. Bathroom from the 80's.
Broken lamps, switches not cleaned for centuries.
Many hairs on the floor.
Very dissappointed.

title: Wonderful Visit to Celebrate 40th Birthday
text: We stayed 6 nights to celebrate my son’s 40th birthday. It was his first visit to Paris. Our stay was wonderful, absolutely wonderful. The room was beautiful and well maintained, the staff were very gracious and the food was outstanding. We were easy walking distance to the major tourists areas and the views of the Arc de Triomphe and Eiffel Tour were spectacular. We will definitely visit again with our family.  Thank you for a memorable stay!

title: Duplex suite with views
text: Stayed at the Hotel Raphael for 4 days inAugust. The hotel is in a great location walking distance to many shops, sites and restaurants. We were a large group with 8 rooms booked. The rooms varied in decor but all fairly spacious by European standards. Beds are very comfortable. We opted for the Duplex suite with Terrace. The room is beautiful, but the terrace is the highlight. Being a large group, having the option to sit and enjoy a drink on the terrace was fantastic. It is very large and fits many people, with beautiful views of the lit up Eiffel Tower at night. The restaurant rooftop is also lovely, but drinks can be pricey so if you enjoy the rooftop view, I recommend looking into the rooms with a terrace. The rooms are limited in number and there is only one Duplex so good to plan early. Service at the hotel was good and everyone very pleasant. There is only one person taking care of check in and check out so be prepared for a possible wait. I would stay again at the Raphael and definitely try and book the Duplex if available.

title: Beautiful hotel
text: I had a wonderful experience at the hotel Raphael. Our room was clean and luxurious, with beautiful furniture and pristine sheets. The concierge was extremely polite and on our last night, we were upgraded to a beautiful premium room that was the stuff of dreams. I would definitely stay here again next time I am in Paris.

title: Brilliant
text: We Loved our room, the creaking lift and most of all the fantastic Concierge Team. Hotel location was brilliant and the rooftop bar absolutely spectacular. We found it great that the hotel is still in the same family after almost 100 years. Thank you

title: terrible experience
text: For info: I made 2 reservation before my arrival to hotel Rapahel: from 18 july, 2022 to 21 july 2022 (3 nights) , and from 21 july, 2022 to 23 july 200 (2 nights)I did 2 reservations because when I made the first reservation it was non refundable, and I couldn’t change it but wanted to extend our stay in Paris so I proceeded with the second reservationDay 1: room Number 111,We enter the room, and we are unable to lock the door from inside, I requested front desk to send someone to repair it. . When I entered the bathroom there was no shampoo so I requested shampoo and they said that they use a body gel and shampoo all in one….Bathroom, no shampooing, and soap, I asked for they told me the shampoo and the body gel are the same (first time in my life I heard this in a 5 star hotel). The light in the bathroom was also not working, so requested this to be repaired.After our numerous issues, the Receptionist at front desk promised to change the room! Day 2:They asked me to prepare our luggage to move to a better room, We moved to room 612,  day 3 we moved to room 307  To apologize for all these issues, they had put a champagne bottle and a note  from the Manager Mr. Fabrice Afuta. Although he shined by his absence since he is in lengthy  24/7 days meetings. However, there was an apology in the note.. least we could ask for…we never saw him and he is always busy in meeting 24 hours a day in the letter he apologies (amazing manager always busy)

title: Average  Hotel
text: Nice location. Rooms were lovely but many things didn’t work. Sink didn’t drain, burnt out lights in room, no coffee in room, mini fridge not stocked. We asked for it to be fixed.  It never was. Front desk staff had attitude.

title: Outstanding Hotel
text:
This hotel was one of the highlights of our brief stay in Paris, and we would most definitely plan to stay here again on a return trip.

The Room
We stayed in a Signature Suite, which had a bedroom and separate sitting room. The room was huge, comfortable, and beautifully appointed. The hotel itself was tasteful and peaceful. We truly looked forward to returning there each day.

The Service
Staff were helpful, generous, discrete, and it felt like every time we left the room we would return to see that it had been tidied (multiple times a day).

Location
A Metro stop is immediately outside the door (Line 6), with another a few minutes away at the Arc de Triomphe. For most of the places you’ll want to visit, it will require a ride on the Metro. The locations walkable are the Arc and the Champs-Élysées.

Critique
Only two things come to mind, and neither of them were close to being bothers such that it would mean we wouldn’t return. The first, air conditioning: we were in Paris during the summer heatwave (up to 105F one day), and we were sure to book a room that was air conditioned. When we arrived we learned that consisted of a portable A/C unit that was vented out the window, requiring the window be left open. We maneuvered the drapes to cover much of the open window, but leaving the window open in that level of heat did make a difference. It wasn’t what I thought would be the case when I saw the room listed as air-conditioned. We were comfortable nonetheless. The second: the shower temperature was erratic. Over the course of a five-minute shower the temperature would vary wildly. It would never get so cold or so hot that it was unbearable, but it was quite noticeable.

Summary
The critiques are minimal in comparison to the overwhelming quality of the hotel. We loved it, and we’d happily return.

title: Third visit.
text: We stayed for the third time in the hotel. Normally we stay in a junior suite, but  being late with the reservation we could only opt for a superior room. The room was a good size…however it could need an update. The hotel has a gorgeous historic charm but it is about time to introduce  modern comfort. The roof top terrace and the hotel bar are a real asset.  The breakfast is too average for the hotel category.  Service was excellent and staff is very attentive.

title: Magnifique.
text: Beautiful stay ay hotel raphael. Superb staff and attention to you. Delightful room and fantastic breakfast. Very wonderful property. Will return. Staff is fantastic!!! We enjoyed location and found the stay to be quite restful. Room was very quiet and location was perfect.

title: Wonderful Hotel, fantastic location, superior staff
text: Our stay at Hotel Raphael was all we wanted our Paris visit to be.   The wonderful rooftop gave us views of the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower.   The rooms were large and historic and the staff was incredibly helpful and polite.  A must stay for anyone coming to Paris.

title: Outstanding Service in Excellent Location
text: We enjoyed an excellent four-day visit at the Hotel Raphael with a spacious, quiet suite, very comfortable bed, and the most outstanding service from hotel staff. From check-in until our departure the hotel associates were attentive and kind. The views from the rooftop bar are stunning and a great place to relax after a day of touring. Waitstaff was terrific at the rooftop bar and at the daily breakfast service. The concierge was supurb as well. Bonus, a short walk away is the incredible Alan Geaam Restaurant. We look forward to a return visit!

title: Classic hotel in need of new bathroom and more smiles at the front desk.
text: Beautiful old hotel.  Large rooms.  Excellent service.  The bathrooms need to be modernized which they said they planned to do.  The folks at the front desk need to learn how to smile at their guests.  More dour looking front desk folks I have never seen.

title: Great Hotel in Great Location
text: Great hotel.  We loved the location, it was hot the week we were in Paris and the area was perfect.  The street the hotel is on is a pretty street with some shade and plenty of the things you need to enjoy your stay very close.  We walked to some great restaraunt that the wonderful concierge team recommended, the Arche de Triomohe is right there as well as shopping.  It’s in a beautiful neighborhood and we enjoyed a few early morning walks away from the more touristy parts.  The roof top terrace was amazing!  We had wonderful food and drinks our first evening.  They said only appetizers but the portions were very generous and we did instead of dinner.  We had two rooms- the suites are definitely worth the additional money.  Next time I would just get two suites as there was a appreciable difference between the Room and suite we were in.  But we were so happy we had picked this hotel.  The only thing that we didn’t like was the breakfast.  We didn’t do the breakfast included option - but the way our schedule worked and having 2 different room it was too hard to coordinate breakfast outside the hotel.  Based on the bill at checkout I think we paid  42 euros per person to have coffee and what I would consider mediocre pastries.  The breakfast is a buffet with just coffee, juice, the same 4 or 5 types of pastries and scrambled eggs.  No changes day to day.  You can order omelets and there is a chopped fruit bowl and cereal.  On the upside the staff was great and the coffee was good, it was quick and easy.  Just too expensive for what it was and way too repetitive.  Even having one pastry that varied day to day would have been great.  I always wanted a “good” breakfast and it was not even average and irritated me to pay so much day after day.  Frankly I would have been happier just paying for a cup of coffee and eating a protein bar, but didn’t feel like getting into whether that was possible with the staff so paid the full price and had toast.  There were coffee machines in the room.  We did room service once and it was good and prompt.  The kids did it more and it was always good quality and service.  Overall very very happy with the hotel!

title: Paradise in Paris
text: We stayed here for 4 nights. The location is excellent and walkable to everything.  The staff was very pleasant and the breakfast each morning was a perfect way to start the day.   Most will be tempted to eat on the main roads but don’t forget about Kleber Ave.  Really good options close by.  The rooftop terrace is a MUST do. The views are breathtaking.

title: A tad short of perfection
text: Where to start with a hotel that displays a Turner - yes a real one or at least a darn good copy - in its lobby. I love ancien regime hotels. The Raphael is certainly that. It feels a little like staying with a wealthy elderly uncle set in his ways. It sits on Avenue Kleber accessible to the chic 16ème arrondissement, the Champs-Elysees and the Louvre beyond, the river and the Trocadero. The Raphael is what you might call a 'grande dame'. Or in its case un grand oncle. The overwhelming majority of the staff are men - in grey suits. They're wonderfully helpful and professional but I think a sprinkling of young women front of house would give the place a lift. The rooftop restaurant and bar especially in summer - is a treat. Sip a kir royale and gaze at the Arc de Triomphe, the Eiffel tower and Sacré Coeur on the heights. Breakfast I thought was dull. Rooms are comfy. Ours was a bit tired. Bath was tricky to negotiate if you're on the wrong side of 70. Terrific shower. They give you one 500ml bottle of water on arrival but do not replenish that which is, as the French say, a trifle mésquin. It's family owned. Where's the younger generation?

title: Beautiful Parisian Hotel
text: Beautiful hotel that takes you back to a glamorous period in Paris. The staff could not have been more attentive and friendly. When we arrived there was a WW II era major film being filmed in the Hotel lobby .. so cool. Spacious Deluxe room with a separate large bath was great!

title: Enjoyable Stay in the City of Lights
text: We greatly enjoyed our stay at the. Hotel Raphael.  We felt very welcome.  Excellent location and lovely historic property with an amazing rooftop bar and priceless views.  Staff was very helpful, friendly and accommodating.  Large rooms and delicious daily breakfast in a lovely setting.  Steps from the Arc de Triomphe, Champs Elysees, Trocadero and so much more. Would highly recommend.

title: Memorable stay at Hotel Raphael
text: The Hotel Raphael was simply wonderful!!! The rooms were beautiful, the breakfast cafe was gorgeous, the location cannot be beat with a view of the Eiffel Tower and the Arc De Triomphe from the amazing garden top roof and finally, the wonderful staff!! I hope to come back soon.

title: Great Experience. Book today!!
text: The staff at Hotel Raphael was exceptional. The experience was great all around!!! They were very accommodating. We had ice cream two nights late and called room service. The young gentleman that brought us the ice cream was the sweetest guy!! He engaged in conversation and always asked how our day went. We felt like the hotel really tried to see that our staff was terrific.  I will be back.

title: Wonderful!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The rooms were spacious and well stacked. The staff was extremely professional and helpful. The rooftop was a real treat and offered a beautiful view of the city. Great location. We would highly recommend it.

title: Amazing Hotel and stay.
text: Everything and everyone at your hotel was amazing.  Our stay was wonderful and I am looking forward to coming back soon.  Thank you for everything. Your staff was always helpful and willing to do anything to make our stay enjoyable.

title: 3 DAY BREAK
text: We were treated to a stay in this fabulous Hotel by our friends for a joint birthday celebration; it was glorious! The staff(Alexander who showed us our room) the front desk and breakfast staff were incredibly attentive remembering how we all liked our coffee Etc. The roof top bar is a must with staggering views of the city at night although drinks choice were limited. A great base to explore Paris a 2mins walk to Arch De Triumph.

title: Lovely hotel - great bathrooms!
text:
Nice hotel and we stayed in the one of the rooms with the balcony view of the Eiffel Tower.  Please note the view is of the top part of the tower only! 

The bathroom was huge - best part of the room.  

The complimentary macarons were a nice touch.

We were a little surprised to notice on leaving the room that one of the lights was not on the wall straight and therefore showing the wiring underneath (wouldn’t have expected that in such an expensive hotel).  

The staff were helpful.  

We didn’t opt for breakfast given the price as we thought €42 was a bit steep so couldn’t comment on that.

title: Weekend trip to Paris
text: The hotel was absolutely fantastic! The hotel staff could not be any more helpful and warm in character if they tried. We stayed in the amazing duplex suite with near 360 degree views of the paris skyline. The Eifell Tower view from the room's private terrace was incredible, as well as the Arc De Triomphe being very close and beautiful. The location of the hotel was perfect, almost every attraction was within walking distance, my partner and I didn't require a taxi or the metro once on our stay.

title: Raphael: hostel experience at a price of a five-star hotel
text:
Pros:
* Rooms and corridors are truly beautiful

Cons:
* Beds impossible to sleep on, with cheap horrible pillows (had to buy in a shop)
* The noise never stops from neighbors: drunk guests shouting, throwing things at walls and banging on doors in the middle of night (shocked to see it anywhere, esp a 5-star hotel)
* Management are terribly unhelpful and rude.
* Promised a room with balcony, then when we arrived, gave us a room without the balcony: no apologies, said that their manager had no right to promise us a balcony for a De Luxe suite
* Breakfast for £42 is a croissant with butter from carrefour and disgusting coffee
* They put some fake orders on my account for over a hundred euros on my account, had a quarrel at departure.
* No apologies for a ruined trip. Saying arrogantly, it's not their fault.

It's actually impressive how disgusting they managed to make our stay at what was supposed to be a luxurious experience. I hope the manager of the hotel gets fired asap. This beautiful building does not deserve such people...

If you want a hostel experience at a price of a 5-star hotel -- look no further. Raphael is your best choice!

title: A class is Paris hotel
text: After a Covid quarantine, we needed to save the remainder of our vacation. A close friend in Paris recommended the Raphael. This is the perfect Parisian hotel that is well maintained with an exceptional staff. This is a place you will fall in love with.

title: Charming Hotel
text:
My husband and I stayed for 5 nights this March. The hotel service was impeccable. We were welcomed with complimentary macaroons in the room and everyone was very friendly. The concierge helped us with dinner reservation, tickets for tours and any information we could possibly need. 
The breakfast is not a buffet, but was more then enough, a la carte, several things to choose from and excellent quality.
The decoration is very Paris, a lot of antiques and a charming carved wood elevator. 
The location is very central.
Overall we would stay here again and would highly recommend it.

title: The most beautiful hotel in the perfect location!
text: I loved our stay at this hotel and will be returning for our next trip. It is in the perfect location, central to everything. The service and amenities were excellent. Each room is unique and authentic. The hotel is clean and wonderful.

title: Beautiful hotel, great service, and spectacular view
text: As soon as we entered the hotel, the friendly and professional staff were there to help accommodate our checkin. The hotel and the rooms are beautiful. Housekeeping tended to our rooms with great care. The beds are very comfortable. The drinks in the bar are a little pricey but the setting is very nice. The staff helped us reserve a large car (4 people) for transportation to the airport and other locations throughout our trip. The best part - walking out onto the terrace and seeing the spectacular view of the Eiffel Tower. We were able to watch it sparkle several nights right from the rooftop. On the other side is a view of the Arc. Very pretty.

title: A WONDERFUL AND CLASSY HOTEL WITH PROFESSIONAL, HELPFUL AND FRIENDLY STAFF
text: We stayed at the hotel during the New Year’s and enjoyed it tremendously. It was festive, elegant and relaxing. The hotel is in a perfect location, rooms lovely and the staff professional and willing to please. The hotel has an old charm but with all the modern amenities. My only comment on possible improvements would be to update the internet connections as we couldn’t log into our computers due to security issues. Otherwise, a lovely stay. Thank you to all the staff for making it special! 🙏😊

title: Timeless luxury with incredible service
text: We stayed in a two bedroom for 4 nights. It was like stepping back in time.  The beds were incredibly comfortable the rooms were large with big closets-room for the large steamer trunks of old. If you like and are accustomed to the more modern decor of the Four Seasons or Peninsula, recognize this is not it. The bathrooms have tub showers that don’t really keep the water in. Needed to just use the hand shower in one or water would have been in the entire bathroom. But they were a nice size with separate rooms for toilet which is always nice when traveling. Service really was incredible. Concierge can help with everything and does so with pleasure. Very good English by almost everyone. Included breakfast is a treat. We had room service once and it was very quick and delicious. While the rooftop was closed we were able to go up at night and see the lights of the Eiffel Tower. Very special. Fitness center is lacking. Very small. Treadmill, elliptical, rowing machine, recumbent and regular bike. Treadmill was broken and elliptical sounded like it was on its last legs. Nice locker room and showers available also a sauna I didn’t use. While they delivered water and macarons and some chocolate on arrival it would have been nice to get some water with the turn down service.  Location is great. Easy metro or walking to everything. All in all really a special trip and we would stay again in a heartbeat.

title: Beautiful small luxury hotel in the heart of paris.
text: Beautiful hotel with fantastic service and perfect location. Delicious breakfast, great rooftop views, beautiful rooms. It was exactly what we were looking for. We stayed for 6 nights and had a great time. Highly recommended and would definitely stay there in the future too.

title: Living like Louis XIV in Paris
text:
We really enjoyed our stay in this beautiful  *****-star hotel. Everything was perfect from start to finish. On entering the hotel we were greeted by a friendly man who escorted us to the reception and gave us some information about the Hotel. He also offered to take our bags out of the car while we checked in. At the reception, too, we were warmly welcomed.

The room itself was beautifully decorated, with an eye for authenticity and detail. The furniture was amazing and spotless. In the room on arrival, there were Macarons and a bottle of water. We stayed in an Eiffel Tower Deluxe Junior Suite and therefore had a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower. The bed was big and very comfortable. 

In the evening, it is also lovely to spend some time in the cosy "English Bar" of the hotel. Here, the staff will serve you the best cocktails or champagne with a warm and welcoming smile.

title: Beautiful Hotel; Excellent service
text: We spent several nights at the Hotel Raphael after Christmas, traveling with a family of four.  Our adjoining rooms were beautiful, spacious and well appointed.  Bath towels were plush and felt new.  All of the hotel staff was both professional and friendly.  Room service was quick and delicious.  A very special thank you to the concierge team who was able to secure several hard-to-get reservations for us for the days and times desired.  It was a truly a luxury experience at The Hotel Raphael!

title: Winter Wonderland
text: First of all, the hotel was beautifully decorated for Christmas.  Truly a winter wonderland impression!  We stayed in Room 104, a junior suite, which we didn't want to leave!  Very large room consisting of sitting area, semi-separate bed area with an equally large bathroom, small balcony and more closet space than we could possibly use (unless staying for a month!)  Hotel is decorated in a beautiful, classic style which is hard to find these days.  I want to especially mention Concierge Lionel and his team who helped us everyday and who we frequently telephoned before we arrived.  No request was too much trouble.  It was a joy to be greeted so warmly each morning by the staff in the breakfast room.  I would highly recommend this hotel for location, value and service.  My husband and I are hoping to return for Christmas 2022.

title: Excellent service
text: Excellent service, great location, friendly and professional staff, great in room dining experience. stayed in a junior suite which was quite spacious. Only negative is the rooms are a bit tired and need some upgrade. This is a lovely hotel that is good value but with the potential to be great one

title: A perfect welcome to Paris.
text: From the front desk experience to the concierge to the housekeeping staff, I can not give enough praise.  This was, indeed, the perfect welcome to Paris.  The have a great breakfast selection, a cozy bar with a fantastic negroni, and old-fashioned.

title: Our favourite hotel in Paris
text:
The coziest hotel in Paris with the kindest and most helpful staff. The old french style make it feels luxury and at the same time very cozy. We also love the location.
Been here two times now, during summer and during winter. The restaurant upstairs is a must in the spring/summer to watch the beautiful view over the Eiffel Tower.  In the winter we love to sit in the bar downstairs to drink thè :)

title: Paris at its best!
text: Phenomenal hotel and location, walking distance to everything, a very cozy bar on the ground floor and a rooftop with views all over Paris that are second to none. Staff and service extremely professional and make you feel at home. Hotel Raphael will be our go to hotel in Paris going forward - can highly recommend!

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Raphael doesn't have an impressive entrance and a beautiful check-in counter but it is a classic and sophisticated hotel. Breakfast was delicious and the staff very friendly. Room was spacious but I believe the bathroom could be updated.

title: Paris, city of love.
text: Hotel Raphael is an excellent choice for a hotel. The location is perfect, right at the Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elyesse. The hotel is small but luxurious. We visited in November so unfortunately the terrace isn’t open but the views are still amazing. Especially at night. This was our second time visiting. I will say the first time they had Christmas decorations up when this time they did not. We visited the same two weeks which was a surprise :(. They also did not give the hand creams during turn down which was a bit upsetting but none the less our experience was a 10/10. Their breakfast is superb as is there bar and restaurant. We stayed in a supreme room in 2019 and a deluxe room in 2021. Both rooms are beautiful and much better than the classic room. I highly recommend booking a supreme or deluxe room. The doormen and very kind and helpful as our the rest of the staff. We rented scooters and vespas which are conveniently  outside the hotel for east travel. I would definitely come back to this hotel but this in the spring so we can enjoy the terrace.

title: Very Good Palace Hotel in Paris
text: I choose this hotel for my Birthday trip. It is truly a PALACE hotel. The interior decoration is of a REAL PALACE. The staff is wonderful, the breakfast is very good and is served in an elegant room. The elevator is fast and in good condition. The room, bed, heater all worked fine. The floor cricks a little like in old buildings (understandable). I had 1 issue with the room and it was the water system: You have to open the water for a long long time until the Hot water comes out and you can do a shower.  The location is great, and very close to the Arc-de-triumph, Eiffel tower and Trocadero square.

title: really good hotel
text:
some people can find this hotel as an Old fashion one, but i completely disagree. this is an example of what a luxurious hotel should be: not too big, excellent service, superp facilities...

our junior suite with view to the eiffel tower was a comfortable atractive place, ococó style, big in size, well furnished, a lot of storage space, a huge bath room  with anything needed, a good minibar, an excellent bed and pillows, coffee maker and kettle, large tv, good towels  and bathrobes, good wifi... and an impresive view of eiffel tower from my bed. there was a large terrace but weather was unfortunately cold, so we could not enjoy it.

dogs are accepted for 20 euros a day, which is very reasonable for usual rates in top class hotels.

i did not use the restaurant.

their valet parking was professioonal as all the staff, always ready to help.

some aspect of the maintainace could improve, however i understand that it is not easy to maintain as always new this hotel, which is more a museum than a hotel.

all in all, an excellent value for money in  paris.

i would return.

title: Delightful!
text: A true gem in Paris!  I don't know how I hadn't been here before! I came for a business trip and added a weekend for fun.  Great location between Trocadero and Etoile.  An elegant hotel with the class of a top hotel but the warmth of a familiar one.  They were responsive to all requests and attentive to the details.  The bar and restaurant are on the high end but not unusual for a hotel of this quality.  There are plenty of choices around the hotel if you want something more  mid-range.  In summary, if you want to try Paris at her finest luxury without the stiffness of others, give Hotel Raphael a try.   I hope to be a frequent visitor!

title: Business trip to Paris
text: Great hotel with great service. All employers make their best for you all the time. Roomservice in 7/5!! Breakfast is very good. High quality hotel in the heart of Paris. I'm sure that everyone who will stay in Raphael will enjoy they stay in Paris

title: Impeccable
text:
Impeccable across the board: fantastic location-literally a stones throw from the Arc de Triomphe, attentive staff, you felt so well taken care of, everything was superior.
Will 100% be back soon next time we are staying in Paris!
À tantôt!

title: Excellent
text: Really just a very luxurious experience, wonderful service, wonderful and friendly staff, beautiful hotel and room. The only thing I would say that could be better is the breakfast which was perhaps not great value for money.

title: Old hotel in need of renovation and cleaning
text:
I stayed for a week. The room is great, spacious, even huge, roof top beautiful. Great breakfast too. But there are many carpets and even fabric on the wall, the one in the wardrobe then smells a lot. I got a horrible allergy, especially when I turned on the air conditioner.

On the third day, barely breathing, I went down at night and asked a nice man if there was an alternative, he wrote down my name and asked me to look for them in the morning to see if they could do a better cleaning or if there was a room with less smell .

The gentleman told me it was "hotel style". That all rooms were the same. I saw another friend in a room that at least had no fabric on the wall like mine. NOTHING WAS MADE.

I complained again the next day with another attendant. They were to return me. As I had a lot to work with, I slept for four long days with the windows wide open to breathe as well as take. For the past two days I have moved to the hotel across the street, the Peninsula.

Carpeting requires care, cleaning. And listening to the customer would make all the difference. Also, in my room in particular (106), the upholstery in the close-up and even the one on the floor and chair looked very old and full of mites. I felt very disrespected.

title: Wonderful Paris Weekend
text: We had a terrific stay at Hotel Raphael. It has a wonderful old Paris style and has a rich history. The location is terrific as well. Everyone we met who worked there was as nice as could be and spoke good English. The concierge was able to arrange our EU vaccine passports in advance which saved us the trouble of getting tests for every other country we visited. They also got us reservations where ever we asked and knew about all the museums and sights. And don't miss the rooftop bar!

title: Wonderful hotel with ultimate view from roof terrace at superb location
text: What a wonderful hotel to view and visit Christo's wrapped Arc de Triomphe. The roof terrace is amazing and offers 360 degrees views including Arc de Triomphe (very close) and Tour Eiffel. And if you have any doubts about the location - it's right next to the famous The Peninsula hotel (which costs four times as much but has a significantly worse view from its terrace). To the Arc de Triomphe it's less than 5 minutes walk. We were really amazed and took the opportunity to visit the Arc de Triomphe many times last weekend. Thanks a lot to the whole Raphael team, we had a great time.

title: Great place to be
text: It is a beautiful place with a great views from the roof. Everybody greeted us and smiled to make our day better.  I would have given it 5 stars but unfortunately not the whole staff is that great.  Being chased by the barman up on the roof because we are taking pictures was very insulting.

title: Highly recommended
text:
Superb view of the Eiffel Tower, and excellent atmosphere!
The staff is perfect, and the cocktails very good.
We were staying right next to the Peninsula, and enjoyed the more cozy atmosphere of the Raphael's terrace

title: The most wonderful stay!
text: We truly enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Raphael.  It was so very memorable.  Everyone was friendly, helpful, and interested in making our stay enjoyable: the two attentive staff members(both named Alexandre) as well as Pascal, who facilitated our airport transfers, and Aude, who was always so friendly at the reception desk.  I also want to  thank Jacque Francois, who was so kind as to find a way to freeze our butter purchases, so I could bring them back to the States.  The suite was large, elegant, and refined, furnished with many antiques  We enjoyed two bathrooms, a large sitting room, and all the extras anyone could ask for. Balcony windows opened on to each of four small pediments where one could see and enjoy the streets of Paris. Words cannot due justice to the beauty of watching the Effiel Tower light up from the rooftop Terrace. This five star hotel is one of the best!  The staff is always at your disposal and make the stay at this luxury  hotel an indelible memory of Paris!

title: Team Raphael took care of us
text:
We were a large group composed of Americans from a wide range of states and Europeans from several countries. Camille Allenic managed our group and set up all the logistics from parking to rooms to dinners. She went above and beyond to help us out as we had a lot of moving parts doing a Tour de France cycling trip.  Her help and professionalism made a world of difference. Once there, all the people we interacted with from conciergerie team to reception were impeccable. Joel Cochin especially was attentive and we so enjoyed seeing him at our breakfasts and dinners that it was like he was a part of our group. Everything was beautifully laid out and no request seemed too much. The Raphael team carries themselves with a perfect blend of professionalism and pride yet also interacting with genuine warmth. The hotel has grandeur and a presence but also feels inviting. We found it very easy to walk to shops, cafes, attractions, take the metro if we wished, all while in town to catch the last stage of the Tour de France. BRAVO team Raphaël and chapeau Camille and Joel. 
Iona Wynter Parks

title: Fantastic stay in a memorable place with all wishes fulfilled !!
text:
We stayed in the hotel as a couple in July 2021 in the Eiffel Tower Terrace suite and enjoyed every minute. 

Great room, splendid house, memorable view, excellent service, perfect location and everything you can ask for in a 5 star hotel. 

Outstanding communication ahead with the front desk for arranging special requests and they delivered in every category.

Highly recommended and we cannot wait to be back soon!!

title: Wonderful Hotel in Paris
text: I just came back from another wonderful stay at the Hotel Raphael.  I have stayed there many times, and was so glad to make this my first visit once travel restrictions were lifted.  The hotel is different than all other high-end hotels in Paris.  The style and architecture exude Belle-Epoque Paris, yet it also has a quite intimate feel.  The service, and especially the concierge, is wonderful, always at the ready to help.  The location is excellent -- right by the Etoile with lots of connections by metro to the rest of Paris.  The rooms are incredibly spacious  (the largest hotel rooms I've ever stayed in) and very quiet.  The beds are very comfortable.  To top it all off, the hotel has a magnificient roof-top bar with excellent views of the the Arche di Triomphe and the Tour Eiffel.

title: Wonderful stay - an hidden GEM
text:
We stayed 2 nights in the Eiffel tower suite and had a wonderfull stay.
We have been in most 5 stars in Paris but the Raphael exceeded our expectations. Usually we prefer more modern decoration but this time we tried a genuine "french" experience and it was really a pleasure.  From the quality of the room to the kindness of the staff everything is perfect.
The location is perfect and the rooftop is one of the best hidden gem in Paris.
Price wise, this is by far the best 5 stars you can find in Paris

title: Perfect Spot
text: My wife and I planned a spur of the moment 40th wedding anniversary trip to Paris.  We chose this hotel as it was centrally located.  It was everything that had been written.  The room (deluxe suite) was comfortable, well appointed and well maintained.  The staff was attentive, helpful and accommodating to any need.  The rooftop view at twilight was spectacular.  They provided recommendations to pharmacies that gave COVID tests (be aware that not all pharmacies know the rules to re-enter the US).  On the negative side, their restaurant only served cold food as it is not fully opened since COVID.  I am sure that this will change over time.  I would definitely return again.

title: Unforgettable hotel Raphael
text: it is the most Parisian of all hotels, French luxury, know-how and perfect service. They have the most beautiful roof top in Paris, Le Raphael is the  perfect place to live the Parisian experience for a week end !

title: Covid Cancelled Trip and they didn't even offer vouchers for our stay!!!
text: We booked this hotel before COVID had swept the world. Our trip was planned for March 2020 and was completely canceled due to having to quarantine 14 days and just to be safe - after all, it was the beginning of the pandemic and we were planning to travel with children. We did not ask for a refund, just a voucher to stay in the future because we plan to visit Paris as soon as it is safe. They denied us ANYTHING and had ZERO customer service and again we asked for a voucher - not a refund. I understand they are a smaller hotel but expected WAY more from a 5-star property/ it was also for my birthday. BEWARE - DO NOT BOOK THIS DURING THE PANDEMIC, YOU WILL COMPLETELY LOSE YOUR MONEY IF YOU DON'T GO.

title: We LOVE the Raphael Hotel
text: Staff very friendly and helpful, breakfast wonderful! Highly recommend! Very centrally located, making getting around very simple. Walking and using the subway. Beautiful bar/lounge that was quite popular at night I

title: NYE
text:
We booked this hotel due to its location and rooftop terrace to watch the fireworks.  I’ve stayed in Paris many times before and the customer service is hit or miss.

First thing is I have to say the customer service at this hotel was top notch.  The doormen and concierge were always so kind and helpful.  When asked questions, the concierge was responsive and helped us book reservations right away. 

The front desk staff was also very welcoming.

However, when we got to our room, we were surprised that there were so many cracks and chipped paint in areas.  There was also mold in our bathroom.  We reported our disappointment in the room and we were loved to another room the next day.  They were apologetic and gave some free goodies and also comped our NY day brunch (130€/pp).  The wait staff though did not speak English well. 

The new room was in much better shape.  The rooms overall were spacious.  It is a more traditional and older feel but very clean and comfortable. 

The location is excellent as the train stop is nearby.  But during this time the trains weren’t working due to the strike.  

For NYE on the roof top, you can see both the Eiffel and the Arc du Triumphe.  We enjoyed the amazing fireworks show.

Overall, I would recommend this hotel if you would like to enjoy the rooftop terrace and like a more spacious room in Paris. The service was also excellent.

title: 2 star room in a famous 5 star Parisian hotel
text:
I booked my room via booking.com. I arrived late in the evening after a long busy day traveling and business dinner, the check in was smooth. The lobby and room looked elegant at first glance. There was delicious welcome cakes waiting in the room too.
I got room 015. 
The big horrible surprised hit me in the morning when entered bathroom which was a worn down bathroom with cracked tiles, rusted faucets, fittings and shower head and worst enough black mould at the corner of bath tub and with a discolored dusty hairdryer hangin there (there was a new one in the room) but look this one was horrible!!?
The worst and most unbeleivable part came, I saw a smal half an inch cockroach walking on the wall right below towel rack!! If I had seen this last night I could not sleep there at any costs. The wall paints in the room was peeling near the floor in some areas near entrance. I checked out in the morning, receptionist promise he will send someone to take care of cockroach.
Later booking.com refused to publish my review, which is based on my personal experience in room they booked me in, against the fact I am a member since 15 years; sorry booking.com I never book through you.
I do not think all their rooms are like that but I know cockroaches can go anywhere, specialy the little ones!!!?

title: Nice hotel with big rooms near Champs Elysees
text: This old hotel is said to be historic building. The rooms are large, almost twice the size in Paris. The furniture is old, bed is comfortable, clean bathrooms. The staff at front desk, and restaurant are very courteous. Location is good, 3 minutes to Etoile and to many good restaurants. Its roof top has a great view of Eiffle tower and Arc de Triomp.

title: an excellent hotel!
text: Excellent service from the concierge to the check in, a good sized room with a very comfortable bed, a good bathroom with a knockout shower, and the lovely Bar Anglais. My wife and I had a great stay and we very much intend to return.

title: Old Hotel with Big Rooms
text: Hotel Raphael was an older hotel but very well kept.  The rooms were big and we had a king bed.  The bathroom had a separate toilet room and there was a tub/shower combo.  The concierge was nice but they only recommended upscale places to eat and we were looking for more casual places.  We just wanted a bakery type/ quick breakfast before we went on our tour and they really couldn't come up with any suggestions. Overall, it was a nice clean hotel, but a bit pricey and stuffy.

title: Avoid this hotel ....
text:
We stayed here a few days ago. Property is clean, staff reasonable helpful and location is convenient. 

However ... the breakfast is a  significant rip off unless it is included in your stay. We were charged 72 Euro for breakfast for two.    The pricing in the menu is confusing and part of the problem ... Example:  

Omelette 12
Sausage 4
Tomato, spinach, cheese, mushrooms 3

What this means is that you will pay 24 for an omelette that includes 4 ingredients.  9 for coffee and tea ... downhill from there. 

In addition, it is virtually impossible to control the water temperature for a shower. The water literally goes from freezing cold to scalding hot. 

Avoid this hotel if you plan to take a shower or eat breakfast at the hotel.

title: Fantastic Hotel
text:
Spent a week there in mid-august with my girlfriend in the Eiffel Tower Suite. Great hotel. The room was fabulous, the view from the terrace looking out over the Eiffel Tower was sublime, and the service and the hotel staff was on-point. 

I'd definitely stay here again. A great hotel.

title: BEST VIEW
text: I was there for a drink on the rooftop terrace and it was an incredible experience. The service was excellent and the atmosphere is very nice and intimate. The rooftop has probably the best view in all of Paris, you can see very well the Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel Tower and the Sacre Coeur. Amazing location close to the Champs Élysées. Highly recommend

title: SCAM, Avoid at all costs
text:
What a massive disappointment. I booked this room to share with my Father solely due to the fact that there was a possibility to have 1 king bed AND 1 twin bed. I would have never stayed at this hotel if this option was not advertised. Tripadvisor does not allow screenshots to be posted for travel photos but in the confirmation from the hotel it CLEARLY states in english that 1 king bed AND 1 twin bed are being offered. 

When we got up to the room there was only 1 king bed (2 twin beds pushed together). I informed the employee of the mistake that we did not purchase this room and needed the room with 1 king bed and 1 twin bed. He told me that this was not an option anywhere in the hotel and that there “is confusion”. In the confirmation and terms of purchase it says word for word, “1 king bed and 1 twin bed.” This is a mistake on behalf of the hotel, NOT my understanding of the terms of my purchase. He offered NO apology, NO compensation in any form, and NO solution other than separating the king bed into two twin beds. I am not happy with this proposal because I paid 340 euros for 1 king bed and 1 twin bed. He should offer something to make up for the false advertising on behalf of the hotel. 

What a complete waste of 340 euros for such horrible service. A real disappointment for our trip to Paris.

title: 3 star not 5
text: I was extremely disappointed on arrival . Firstly I found the reception most unwelcoming and somewhat grumpy . Our food was very over priced and dreadful , albeit my sons burger was was raw inside and my chicken was so over cooked . The room was so in need of redecorating with paint peeling and very dirty brown carpets ! Not a single piece of art on the wall. The rooms really reminded me of my Grandmothers nursing home . Whilst I adore traditional Hotels this is so dated and scruffy in areas not to mention the very rough sheets I had to sleep in and hard pillows . I also discovered that instead of a mattress protector they had used a bath towel !  Service slow and not friendly and over all I was very disappointed . Reallt this is a 3 star hotel as it stands in my opinion . Do not let the grand yet soulless reception area image fool you !

title: Eiffel Tower Suite - Lovely Property, a Few Minor Fixes Would Make It Perfect
text:
I had a short overnight layover with my 10-year-old son at CDG. While I had originally planned to stay at an airport hotel, as I was entering the itinerary into my calendar, I realized the layover would be on July 14 - so of course we couldn’t miss the fireworks over the Eiffel Tower! I chose the Eiffel Tower Suite specially to ensure a view. 

We arrived after a very adventurous trip in from the airport as various RER and metro stations we needed we closed for construction and due to protests we could not get a taxi/Uber so had a decent walk (with a large police presence due to the protests). We were happy to be greeted by friendly employees who confirmed we had the Eiffel Tower Suite and we were quickly on our way upstairs. 

The suite is lovely. After our long journey, we were delighted to find chilled champagne, juices, and macarons. The view was fantastic! The suite was spacious and lovely with a very comfortable bed. The balcony was HUGE. We ordered room service, which was excellent, and then watched the fireworks (the view here is to the side of the Eiffel Tower so the fireworks are primarily to the right of the Tower not behind it - we knew this in advance and it made no difference to us but I mention it for those who may be picky about their firework viewing!). My son especially loved this hotel and is begging to return. 

So, with all this excellence, why only 4 stars? A few minor points:
- there was something banging in the bathroom over the toilet, perhaps a loose part of the vent. It was loud enough to hear in the bedroom while we were trying to go to sleep so certainly would have been heard by housekeeping or anyone else entering the room.
- the balcony needed to be swept. 
- there was not a working deadbolt on the room. As a female traveler, this is a basic expectation. 
- the concierge was rude. As we were leaving, we stopped to request directions (we had asked the front desk and they directed us to the concierge). The concierge was on the phone so we waited. When he finished, he greeted us and I politely began asking him for directions. The phone then rang and without a word, he turned away from me as I was talking and answered the phone. I thought perhaps he was going to put the call on hold, but he just kept talking to the caller as if I wasn’t there. We finally just walked away without our directions and asked someone on the street. 

At a lesser hotel, a rude concierge and some maintenance issues might be cause for a lower rating, but with the exception of the concierge, all the employees here were wonderful and the suite was absolutely lovely. We were very satisfied but there is room for improvement.

title: Second-time visitor and delighted once again
text:
I just can’t imagine staying anywhere else in Paris. The location is amazing...5 minute walk to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs Elysees; a 10 minute walk to Trocadéro for the best view of the Eiffel Tower.
The property is simply spectacular and the staff is the best of anywhere we have ever stayed; absolutely top notch!
The rooms/suites are some of the most beautiful in the world...elegant and luxurious.

title: Fabulous location and stunning roof top terrace bar!
text:
Great location and Parisienne experience. Deluxe rooms are very generously sized with the most comfortable beds ever and very peaceful. The most unbelievably spectacular views from the roof top terrace but expect prices to match the view!!!!
Don’t buy the Perrier water 33cl at €18!!
Tip: Book room only as the buffet breakfast is not worth the expense, find yourself a cafe while out and about.
Would definitely stay there again!

title: Perfect hotel in the center of Paris
text:
Perfect hotel! The location is the best one, very nice rooms, the only bad side that room 15 is facing to the lift and because the lift is made from the glass everyone could see our room. Very nice breakfast, but normally for 42€ per person the omelettes are included ( I am talking about Hermitage and Metropole in Monte Carlo where the price of breakfast is 44€ and 43€ and there omelettes and other dishes of eggs are included ) in this hotel they are not. We really loved the design of the hotel.
Next time will consider to stay again here.

title: A loyal guest returns
text:
Where do I begin? service, comfort, cleanliness, uniqueness?

First, this is an older traditional hotel with an interesting history similar to its neighbor, the Peninsula (ask the concierge). My wife and I have been coming here for years to view the 14th of July celebrations from the hotel's rooftop terrace and bar. It is an ideal place to view the 1045 AM fly-over of the jets as the ouverture to the parade and the perfect place to view the spectacular fireworks around the Eiffel Tower on the night of the 14th.

The parade itself is best viewed on television. The French wisely note that this is best, most informative and most comfortable way to view the parade.

The hotel offers breakfast. 
In contrast to some of the other comments, we found the food great and the service to be competent, professional and friendly. Pancakes? no problem. Eggs over easy? no problem. Ask (in English) and you shall receive - quickly and with a smile. On the two days when we ate breakfast there there were three staff members present each time constantly checking the tables if something was needed. If the buffet was running low - just ask and it was refilled. I found breakfast enjoyable - a wee bit expensive - but all hotel breakfasts are. 

Service at the registration area was superb. I was allowed to check-out later. The secret to enjoying luxury French hotels is to be polite and friendly - just like you wish the other person to be -  and all you desire wil come true - if it is possible. A good tip will also assist the process. Don't be stingy in a setting like this. The concierge made a dinner reservation for us at Le Flo ( but that's another story) and arranged taxi service. The doormen were very quick to assist and e-v-e-r-y-o-n-e spoke English.

Our room was 503 and it was very roomy and had a balcony - yes the room has old furniture but it fits perfectly. The modern touch was the electrical outlet box next to the bed with plugs for electrical devices and for various plug designs. The bathroom was a step back into Nouveau Art history with lovely tiles and delightful. Very modern shower with "rain-forest" shower head.

Ah, the location: two blocks to the Arc de Triumph and from there you are on the Champs...Metro station is across the street and taxis are quickly available. 

In summary: expensive, old school,  but very worth the money. Staff is competent and friendly at all levels and the rooftop terrace is well worth the journey. We have been there at least five time and plan on returning. 
 Attached pics show rooftop views on July 14th.

title: great service during the stay, but the response after the stay is disappointing!
text:
It was a great service during the stay, but the response after the stay is disappointing!
When I checked out, I was overcharged for the mini bar charge.
The receptionist explained me that I can refund to my credit card later.
However, despite over three weeks, the refund procedure has not been taken.
I asked the hotel but there was no reply.
The card company also inquired to the hotel, but there was no reply.
In order to increase repeaters, I think that it is necessary to respond firmly to such queries.
The service during the stay was great, so I wanted to stay again next time, but I am very disappointed.
滞在中は非常に素晴らしいサービスで、素敵な旅となりました。
非常に感謝しています！
ただ、滞在後の対応が残念すぎます。
チェックアウトの際、利用していないはずのミニバーの請求がなされたので、確認したところ、クレジットカードに後日払戻ししてくれるとのことだったのですが、3週間経っても手続きがとられていません。
私自身からも、カード会社からもホテルへ問い合わせてもらいましたが、何の返事も無いです。
リピーターの確保にはこのような事に対する対応をしっかりとるよう、従業員を教育することが必要では無いでしょうか。
次回も是非利用したいと思っていたのに、このまま何の返事も無いのかと残念です。

title: Great location for a conference traveller
text: This place is perfect for people attending an event at the nearby Paris Convention Centre - close enough to walk to the Centre, but also far enough away to feel as if you're actually staying in Paris and not some impersonal out-of-town hotel. The other main plus is that the staff were really helpful: check in and check out were really efficient (and all in good english) and they were happy to go the extra mile and provide me with a receipt after I lost the first one.

Each soundproofed guest room has a telephone and a private bathroom with a bath or shower. All of the rooms have a colourful décor and are serviced by a lift. A buffet breakfast is served every morning in the breakfast room at Chouette Hotel. Free Wi-Fi access is available in public areas of the Chouette Hotel. Guests can read the newspapers provided in the lounge area. Convention Metro Station is 400 m away, providing direct access to the Montparnasse and Montmartre districts. The Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre is a 15-minute walk away. 15th arr. is a great choice for travellers interested in romance, sightseeing andmonuments. This is our guests' favourite part of Paris, according to independent reviews.

title: Business trip
text:
Location: close to metro and a few minutes away from Arc de Triomph. Alot of construction nearby though. 

Cleanliness: very clean. Specially for Paris. Thank you for providing a water supply hose in the toilets, we do struggle with that in many countries. Towels were provided. Rooms didn't smell snuffy (alot of hotels do smell weird in paris).

Value: I cannot comment as it was paid by the company. 

Service: very helpful staff, they speak both english and french. Nobody got angry at english-speakers.

Rooms: coffee machine provided, towels, a big comfortable bed, clean bathroom. It is small but I guess it's normal for big cities, also, the windows were big with a beautiful view so it gave the room some space.

Food: excellent breakfast (yes, I've tried other hotels in Paris they did not have the same quality for breakfast).

title: Amazing hospitality
text: Our trip to Paris was to be  a special one as I was planning a surprise proposal for my now fiance. Initially it was very important for our suite to have an Eifel Tower view, and I realized when I booked the reservation that it was not guaranteed. Several months before our trip, I called and spoke to a very friendly staff member who explained that there are only two suites of this kind and one had the view while the other did not. The staff member explained that they could not guarantee, but that she would make a note of it on our reservation for check-in time. The day of our check-in, we arrived significantly earlier than check-in time, nonetheless, staff was willing to help and see what they could do about the view. Isabel made it happen! Not only did we get the room with the view, but we were also able to check in early. While we waited for our room to be ready, we hung out in the regency lounge where Renata introduced herself, greeted us, brought us our room keys, and informed us that our luggage was already on its way to our room. WOW!!!! talk about five star treatment. The entire stay staff was checking in on us assuring our needs were met, and we have no complaints during our stay. I must also mention that before our trip, I had coordinated with the concierge team for a surprise in the room for the morning of the proposal. Following the proposal, we returned to the room and the surprise was exactly what I had asked for. It was magnificently put together. My fiancé and I are beyond grateful for every staff member that made this a very special stay. Renata and her team made this a magical trip and we are beyond grateful. Thank you very much for this amazing service and hospitality.

title: Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile
text:

title: Hyatt experience in Paris
text:
The Hyatt Regency Etoile is a large corporate hotel - don't expect quaint Paris charm here.  However, the staff go a long way to make this feel a more personal experience - a friendly welcome at Reception, and chatty staff in the lobby bar.

The rooms have been fairly recently refurbished, so it was clean and fresh.  There was a great view from floor 20 overlooking Paris, out to the Sacre Coeur in the distance.

Breakfast offered a good range of items and of decent quality.

Wifi worked reliably.

There are a range of restaurants and supermarkets in the neighbourhood, and the property is close to numerous Metro lines.  The Arc de Triomphe is a relatively short walk away.

I had a problem with one of the lights in my room in the late evening, and was very impressed that the Concierge had a maintenance staff member with me within about five minutes to sort it out.

title: Excellent hotel with an excellent view of Paris!
text:
My family of 5 recently stayed at the Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile on a vacation for 4 days.  We were very impressed with the room and view we got.  Our "family suite" was an interconnected room, so we got a decent amount of space and 2 washrooms.  The view was phenomenal and we could see the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, etc... all from our room.  It was great to be able to see it all lit up at night.

The hotel also very well anticipated our needs and without asking, had set up the extra couch as an additional bed since we have 3 children.

Paris in summer was hot and after walking around all day in the heat, it was amazing to be able to relax in a nice clean, AC room.  

The only drawback was the location was a little further from the main areas that we would have liked, but it was close enough to the Metro station and was never a real issue as the Metro system in Paris is excellent.

title: Family Trip
text: Our family was in Paris for a few days on vacation, and we stayed in this hotel mostly because we could get two adjoining rooms at a reasonable price.  The hotel itself is great and everything you'd expect from a  Hyatt.  Clean, updated, good staff and service.  The only thing to say is that it's a bit outside the main tourist area of Paris, so it you are wanting to get that cozy Paris hotel experience this is not the place.  However it you want a modern hotel with all the amenities and shopping a food nearby and about a 15 minute train ride to the hear to Paris, then this is the place.
