This hotel was a comfortable stay close to the metro. We had everything we needed for the amount of time we stayed in the room as we were out most of the day. The staff were welcoming and helpful. 
I would recommend this hotel!

title: Paris three day visit from UK
text: Great position, only short walk from Gare du Nord station. Metro station  just outside hotel, very handy for exploring Paris. Very courteous staff, good comfortable room with air conditioning. Very good continental breakfast. Will visit again.

title: Прекрасный отдых
text: The location is very good, close to the metro and public transport, they also have underground parking.  Bright and clean rooms, nice staff, tasty breakfast, a big plus is that they accept pets.  We rested very well, I recommend this hotel.

title: A tale of 2 halves…..read on!
text:
A tale of 2 halves…..

I had previously contacted the hotel to request rooms close together (teen kids travelling with us but I need them close to me in a strange city!).

On arrival (4pm) only 1 of 3 rooms was ready. We waited and we’re shown to the first room. Clean, nicely updated. 

We were then Told room 2 was ready. On another floor - not a problem as a room for adults. Again nicely presented.

Third room - there was ‘a problem’. Heart sank immediately. This was half hour after check in.

‘No more updated rooms available’. 

‘This room is  ok, but it hasn’t been updated’

This is not what you want to hear from hotel reception staff after a long day travelling.

This room was 2 floors away from our children!!

After a lot of talking (being told ‘I’m sorry, I understand but there is nothing I can do),
time and some mum anxiety tears, we eventually spoke to the manager who  (somewhat miraculously) found us a room right Next door to our children! A Christmas miracle…..?

Anyway, the rest of the stay was pleasant and the rooms were comfortable & clean……

Nb…room service only seemed to
Happen late pm (around 4)……..which seemed
Crazy to us as people return to hotel around that time after a day sightseeing to have a
Clean up before going out for dinner?

title: Okay
text: I suppose you get what you pay for. Not the best service. The complimentary coffee was finished and we had to buy coffee in the cafeteria for 4€ instead, not even real coffee, just one of those machines where you press a button for cappuccino. We hadn’t ordered any room service but the personnel had gotten a room number wrong and walked in on us more or less naked. Otherwise quite fresh rooms. Good cleaning. Nice bed.

title: Clean, basic and conveniently close to Gare du Nord
text: We only used the room facilities - no breakfast, etc - and booked with a deal from Eurostar. It's a very basic room but suited our needs to be close to the station, easy to get around Paris from. Clean, and was freshly changed during our 2 night stay. An easy bolt-hole.

title: Lovely hotel
text:
We have enjoyed our stay in this hotel. Very clean rooms, good breakfast and located in an area with lots of bars and restaurants.
Will certainly come back to this hotel when visiting Paris next time.

title: Amazing
text: I had an amazing experience. I was travelling with my small daughter. Easy to find. Walking distance from Gare du Nord. Staff was courteous, welcoming and helpful. They gave promptly all the information about the local area and the public transport. They gave us a local map, a Paris map and all the answers before we ask for anything. The room was clean. We could leave our luggage before the check in time and after the check out.

title: Absolute gem in Paris
text:
The hotel is very easy to find as it's not far from Louis Blanc metro. The garden room is gorgeous. The breakfast is a buffet feast with everything you could want from juices, hot drinks, cold meats, cheeses, breads, pastries, yogurts and cereals. The rooms were a good size with tea and coffee making facilities. 
The only issue we had was the rooms were not ready at check in. But given the positives and late checkout it's not a big deal.

We had a fantastic stay and can't wait to return.

title: Do not book! Will waste your time and money
text:
11pm. Landed, missed the last train so took the bus. 

2am arrived at prepaid hotel 

There had been a water leak. The night manager said he would find us another room in a different hotel.

2:30 to 3:30 he calls hotels. Then asks us to look for rooms.

I found a room, €600 for the night. I handed the phone to the night manager. Spoke, hung up. “Sorry, too expensive, Manager would not allow that”.

4am. He has found a room. Books us a taxi, Asks us to pay and we will be reimbursed

Travel 30 mins across Paris to Hotel Paris Vaugirard. The night manager was pleasant, offered us a drink and had the keys on the counter ready 

10am, wake up, breakfast, check out.
One of the receptionists asks another if we need to pay. Clueless but we did not have to pay

12:30. Check in at Hotel Paris Louis Blanc, hand over the taxi receipts totalling €65.

At checkout I was told the compensation and taxi’s could not be resolved but I could leave my contact details and they will be in touch.

No one contacted me.
Emailed them 1 week later and was offered the money for the taxis. I provided bank details and asked about further compensation.

The response, “on your next stay we will give you complimentary breakfast and a discount”

I responded to thay email saying the compensation was insulting and asked for some monetary value.

It has been 2 weeks, no response and we have not received the money for the taxis.

title: Happy
text:
When I checked into the room, I noticed that there was an unpleasant smell in the room. I went to reception and described my problem. The staff (sorry can't remember his name) was very helpful and friendly and offered me another room without much hesitation. 
I am really happy and super satisfied with the service and flexibility.

SIMPLY THANK YOU

title: Great spot for Gare du Nord, metro with local cafes
text:
Staff were v friendly and helpful.  Bed comfortable and good size.  Bathroom was good, water pressure not great but would not put us off coming back.

Did not have breakfast but cafe area looked nice.

Small balcony gave was a nice bonus on 5th floor

title: Perfect stay for a weekend in Paris
text: The hotel is very clean, modern and nice. It’s situated in less then 100 meters from the metro station where you can go to the city center in a very few minutes. Definitely recommend for a 2-3 days vacation in Paris. Lot of restaurants in the areas

title: Great stay at Louis Blanc A10 Paris
text:
Good:
- near to Gare Nord
- very near to Metro
- lovely little garden
- nice and clean room and bathroom
- perfect bed (not too soft)

 Not good:
- very loud at night
- no alternative Milk (soja or almond) at the breakfast

title: Lovely hotel & stay
text: Had a great  stay here thankyou. Booked as a Eurostar package.  Lovely helpful receptionist Hana. Room was bright, very clean and serviced daily by friendly housekeeping.  Comfy large bed. Nice garden to sit out in. Great location 10 minute walk from Gar du Nord and across road from Metro for easy access to Paris city centre.  Lovely pizzeria and delicious bakery opposite.  Supermarket  and couple of restaurant/bars close by. Close to Canal St Martin for more restaurant/bars.

title: Family holiday
text:
i would like to make a complaint about the reception. i've come here to stay on holiday with my family, and i have noticed that the receptionists are extremely rude. they are not friendly with my kids at all, they have no respect and they leave the building unattended without any staff. The room that we are in is extremely small for 4 people staying here, and this has caused inconvenience for me and my family. we do not feel welcome at all. Sometimes when we leave the room and the cleaners come and clean, we come back and there are things  missing from our personal belongings, not to mention the cleaners not  cleaning the room properly. The receptionists complain about my kids making noise, yet they allow customers to bring their pets to the hotel, so i don't see what the problem is. i have never felt soo experienced such violation during a stay at a hotel, taking into consideration that this is my first time here, and they are treating us like this. They seem to not have any training skills on how to satisfy their customers and how to treat  them with respect, and this has risen concer to me, because it seems like they don't know how to do their job right. 

HPLB HOTEL, PARIS LOUIS BLANC , 232 RUE DUFAUBOURG SAINT MARTIN LOUISBLANC.

- please guys do not waste your money to come here unless you want to be treated like rubbish.

title: A great Paris base
text: After reading positive reviews we settled on this hotel for our budget two night stay in Paris. We booked it as part of a Eurostar package. There were so many things we liked about the hotel - just 10min walk from Gare du Nord, clean facilities, nice hot shower, friendly and attentive staff and lovely courtyard garden to enjoy the decent breakfast. I've stayed at expensive business orientated hotels that in substance did not offer much more. Will definitely stay there again if the deal is right.

title: Nice hotel at low price
text: We have a very nice stay at this hotel. Everything was nice and clean, good beds, good shower, great service. Breakfast was good. Hotel is well situated just a few metres from the Metro Station. I would definitely recommend.

title: Great visit
text:
We had a great stay at this hotel. Everything was nice and clean, good beds, good shower, great service and the garden is an extra plus! 
Location is perfect; near Gare du Nord and a subwaystation across the street. We didn’t book breakfast, but there’s a small bakery across the street with delicious food. There’s also a supermarket around the corner.

Only small negative thing is there was no fridge in the room. We bought some drinks, but couldn’t keep them cool.

title: Great hotel at a low price
text:
Traveled with my ten year old son. 
We were lucky enough to have a room with a king-size bed (room 218) 
The room was clean and quite spacious for a Paris hotel room. 

The bath was not full size, not that this was an issue. The shower was clean, powerful and they supplied bodywash/shampoo.

We arrived quite late and there was a lovely Asian man who assisted us with our needs, he again assisted us with our requests on the second night. Very friendly and helpful, definitely sells the hotel when the staff are nice.

The staff at this hotel were all very friendly and pleasent, other hotels in Paris this has not been a luxury.

I'd definitely stay here again.
The metro is literally outside the door with the pink line taking you right into the action. 

You are also within walking distance to the large station of gare deu Nord

It's worth noting that I was unaware when I booked with Agoda that breakfast was included, we missed breakfast on day one but had it on day two. The breakfast was decent enough, my kid was happy with the options, they had a very cute courtyard you could eat in too. 

I would definitely recommend.

title: Great Stay
text: Hotel is well situated just a few metres from the Metro Station. Room was cleaned every day. Breakfast was good and was restocked on a regular basis. Staff were friendly and helpful, Only slight drawback is that the metro line by the hotel is not on the same line as the Gare du Nord. There is a bus service that takes about 5 minutes.   Overall well recommended.

title: Clean, simple hotel room
text: Easygoing, super clean and nice hotel. Perfect, value for your money. Close to Metro access. Daily room clean up and fresh towels, friendly helpful staff. Nice breakfast restaurants and bakery around the corner.

title: Simple and basic
text: We got this hotel in a package from Eurostar, after looking at trip advisor pictures and reviews we were happy to stay here as looked very pleasant. The hotel lobby and reception was lovely and made us look forward to seeing our room. Our room was incredibly basic, very small and the bed was the smallest double bed I’ve ever seen. The room was just missing basic commodities like a mirror in the bedroom, a bin in the room and plugs next to the bed. Simple things but also things you do expect from a hotel. We also got back to our room at about 5/5:30 to get ready to go out again, the chamber maid was in the corridor and when we went into our room the room hadn’t even been cleaned yet , you’d think this would be done whilst you’re out and about! Although despite these we did have a comfortable stay and the location was right next to a metro line taking you straight into the centre. As well, we were able to leave our bags with the hotel before and after checking in and out which was very helpful! I would recommend to people needing a simple room to stay in for their time in Paris

title: Pay more stay elsewhere
text: The room was just big enough to get in to. There was mold on the bathroom walls and if you use the toilet you had to sit with your knees against the opposing wall. The fellow in reception tried to make the most of it; hee was very helpful but it didn’t change the room. We abandoned the room first thing in the morning and stayed in the heart of Paris at hotel de La Paix Eiffel in Rm #4. Had a patio and a roomier room. Walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. The Louis Blanc was quite far from the heart of Paris.

title: Lovely place
text:
Everything good! The room is clean and the hotel is in a strategic place. The metro station is on the other side of the street, the line is the n° 7 well connected to the most relevant places (Louvre, Opéra, Champs Elysees).
The hotel staff was very nice!

title: Perfekt
text:
Everything was perfekt.
The location was good near by the Metro. Perfekt to go and visiting everything in the city. The employer was very friendly at the rezeption. 
The only negativ point the room was a little small

title: Good for city break
text: First the bad - which really more minor inconveniences - before the good. The standard double room is quite small and although online it said a hairdryer and safe were in the rooms we had to ask for a hairdryer from reception and the safe was there too. I’m vegan but there was no non-dairy milk at breakfast. They also don’t have an environmental policy of not changing towels unless requested. Toiletries are basic. However, the room was modern and quiet, with a comfortable bed and tea/coffee making facilities. WiFi is free and strong. The shower was good and breakfast was fine. The hotel is short (10-minute) walk from Gare I’d Nord and there is a metro station just across the road. Ideal for a short city break. I would come back.

title: Good value
text: A very good budget hotel near Canal Saint-Martin. Location is excellent. Louis Blanc metro station is around the corner. Train stations Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est are within walking distance. The hotel is clean, modern and in good condition. The staff is friendly (mostly) and you can get along in English. The bed was good. In the bathroom there was a small bathtub, which was ok, but caution is advised when getting out of it. The street traffic noise can be disturbing, at least in the corner room. The breakfast is plain but it is quite all right. The thing we always wonder, is the lack of hangers and wall hooks. Two wall hooks in the bathroom, none in the hotel room and only 3 coat hangers. That is nothing less than scrubby for us two staying for 4 nights.

title: Travel to Paris with friends
text:
We stayed at the Louis Blanc hotel, on the site it looked good, with a very good breakfast, so we decided to book our rooms (3) in this hotel. I looked for a hotel with breakfast included. We were with a group of 7 persons and I booked 3 rooms with breakfast. Some days later a friend booked also (because they wanted to come with us) a room and breakfast.
When we checked in, there was no breakfast included and had we to pay 12 euro per person each day for breakfast. The information on booking.com is not good or they changed it after we booked. We were very disappointed.
Beside that the hotel was good, clean and very good located.

title: Okay for the price
text: The location of the hotel isn‘t the best but the metro station is very close. The rooms are very small and the service by the receptionists could be better (e. g. be more friendly, give informations such as plan for the metro or map of the city). The cards for entering the rooms weren‘t prepared and we first were sent to the wrong room. So to sum up, it‘s a price

title: Great stay
text: We needed a hotel for 2 nights in Paris after traveling through Loire Valley. The room was very clean, bed was comfortable and was quiet. The staff were friendly and helpful. We were also able to park our rental car in their garage for 20 euros a night. I was told I should let them know in advance for this but they fortunately had availability when we were there. The second night we stumbled on street parking overnight very near the hotel which is free from 8pm to 9am. This worked since we were leaving early the next day. There is also a fruit market and several pastry shops a few doors down. I would stay here again.

title: Very nice and affordable
text:
Nicely located close to Paris-Nord station, Louis Blance metro station accross the street. Some nice restaurants nearby, also a good supermarket around the corner.
Modern room, well sound-proofed.
Bathroom also modern, but quite small.
Nice breakfast, but it felt the breakfast room was understaffed. The staff barely managed to keep up, but did a good job and service was friendly.

title: Decent hotel, what you'd expect for the price but less impressive than the photos
text:
Decent hotel with decent facilities. Underground parking garage is a huge plus, breakfast is good and the staff is pretty friendly. Room was slightly disappointing; not as modern as the photos would suggest. Stains on the carpet, otherwise clean. Fresh towels every day and an elevator, which was nice. 
Location is great: right beside underground station Louis Blanc with easy access to the city centre. Unfortunately no safe in the room, but it's nice to be able to leave your luggage at the desk for a final day in the city before the journey home.
Oh, and check out time of twelve o'clock was great!

title: Feels like new. Fresh and modern.
text:
It was conveniently close to Gare du Nord and right opposite a metro station.
The rooms have been redone in 2021, and they're amazing. The quality of the bedding is impressive, no noice at night. We had two very restful nights.
The staff was super friendly, even my requests via email where positively and rapidly answered.

title: Nice and central 🏨
text: This is a very good hotel for a stay in Paris. The rooms are extremely clean and the service is very good as well. Also, you can reach everything by foot from here and there are nice cafés and bakeries in the area.

title: Enjoyed our stay
text: We stayed here for two nights, we had a really good time. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the bathroom looks like it was just renovated. Most importantly everything in our room was clean. Only downside was thin doors so you could hear the halls and another room was smoking which you could smell in our room.

title: Good and convenient
text:
I really liked this hotel! It was clean and very conveniently located next to a metro stop. There are lots of cheap and delicious restaurants all around. The people at the front desk were nice.

My only complaint is that they did not care about the “do not disturb” sign. Completely disregarded it for several days. It’s worth noting that we stayed for 10 days and had the sign up for most days except a few. They came in regardless. Also, there was no money safe. 

Overall a good experience. I recommend it if you don’t mind the “do not disturb” thing.

title: Just GREAT!
text: Budget friendly? Check! Location? Check! Nice little room? Check! Friendly, accommodating and lovely attendants/workers? Triple check!!! I would definitely come back! If you’re not picky, this is perfect for you!

title: Amazing!
text: The hotel staff were all very nice and helpful. It was a nice and clean hotel with nice rooms and a very good location near a metro and bus stop. The breakfast was good, quite a lot of choice and I loved the apple juice :) I will return here, especially in summer because they have a very cute garden.

title: Very comfy and perfect location!
text: We stayed at the HPLB for a few days arriving from the US, and really enjoyed our stray. The metro station "Louis Blanc" is right around the corner, and the Gare de l'Est is a mere 5-10min away walking. There are a few commerces around, including a Franprix, a pharmacy and a bakery with delicious puff pastry!

title: Amazing experience
text: We had an amazing experience! The woman at the receptioniste helped us very well with all the questions and our luggages. The rooms are very clean and nothing bad to say about it. The location is terrific, metro is 40 metres from the hotel. We had a good stay! :)

title: Weekend in Paris
text: Very well located hotel, clean and quiet. Shops, restaurants and metro station just few steps away from the hotel. Great breakfast with croissants! :) Staff is kind and can speak English. Fully recommended.

title: Great Stay
text:
A great stay..clean room, confortable bed and very good location near of everithing.
Towels changed everiday, bed was very confortable,the area was a bit noisy.
Great option for a 3 days trip
Lots of economic options to eat nearby

title: Great trip to Paris!
text: We were so happy with our choice to stay at Louis Blanc and really feel like it was great value for money. We read some mixed reviews so had our fingers crossed that it would be decent. We got a late flight so we arrived after 11pm. They request that you let them know if you will arrive after 11pm so we did this via their chat service and there was absolutely no issue with it and the gentleman who checked us in (Roger I think?) was really friendly and lovely. We were completely accommodated with our request for a quiet room, we were facing the garden and on the top floor so had no issues sleeping at all, we actually slept really well. There was maybe a couple of sirens throughout the day and as you'd expect in a busy city like Paris a wee bit of outside noise but this seemed to mostly stop mid evening time. The room was not massive but was a decent size and the bed was huge and really comfy which was amazing. The big bed meant there wasn't loads of room for furniture so there was just a small hanging space with a couple of hangers and shelf for your clothes but this was totally fine for us.  There was also a desk with a chair, kettle and tea. The room and bed felt really clean and the room was cleaned every day with new towels provided and bed made. The bathroom was modern and clean with soap provided. The bathroom was on the small side and our knees were close to the wall when sitting on the toilet but I think most Paris hotels just have to make the most of their limited space, so although a little more bathroom space would have been nice it caused us no issue. The reception provided us with a hairdryer on request, they looked after our luggage after we checked out and put our food in their fridge when we requested. We didn't get the breakfast so couldn't comment on that. The subway station is also right outside so it was easy to explore paris by jumping on and off the metro with a day ticket. It is not the most central but still pretty central and at most maybe half an hour by metro to any sights, most sights are closer and some are in walking distance. We didn't explore the area much but there were bakers and small market shops next door and across the street and I can't say we ever felt unsafe there. We also found it easy to get to the hotel from Orly airport, we took a short trip on the Orlyval train and then a train from Antony station to Gare du Nord which is maybe a 10mim walk to the hotel but there were also lots of other transport you could take. Overall, clean hotel with a good bed in a decent location and with accommodating staff and amenities so thats all we needed. We were impressed with the hotel and really enjoyed out trip, thanks!

title: Trip to paris
text:
Nice hotel
Very friendly team, good hospitality, 
Nice is the late checkout at 12.00
Fine breakfast buffet 
Good  central location near highligts
Next metro stop en good restaurants
Near canal du Martin .
When  you walk ruw lafayette your  neAr the opera

title: DO NOT STAY HERE
text:
Horrendous Cleanliness, 
Sh*t on the Sheets 
And we were asked to change it ourselves 
People smoking in the corridors 
The Breakfast is Vile , Do Not Purchase

We were Offered Breakfast , as an apology, 
But we want. A refund as that was crap, and not worth the money, we expressed this and still no refund

title: A very pleasant stay
text: We had a very lovely stay at this hotel. The staff was helpful and we found the room clean, tidy and cosy, albeit slightly small. We also thoroughly enjoyed the breakfast and the location was great with a city-bound metro line just accross the street.

title: Perfect for a Paris trip
text: A great hotel only 10 minutes walk from gare du Nord. There's a metro station right outside the door of the hotel. The hotel looked like new and the staff were incredibly helpful. The room was cleaned every day and had an amazingly comfortable bed

title: Small, clean and noisy, not necessarily three things you want in a hotel…
text:
This is an adequate hotel, with many positives, however the negatives almost equal them. 

On the plus side, you could not get closer to a metro unless you were inside one! On line 7 that takes you quickly to many of the main Paris tourist attractions. It’s also about 10-15 mins walk from Gare Du Nord, so there’s that as well. When we stayed, the hotel and room was exceptionally clean, almost without fault. The bathroom was modern and well appointed. The bed was comfy, and the air con worked perfectly (which was good, as you would not have wanted to open the window, see below!). There are many great restaurants around the local area, in fact the Sicilian around the corner (1 min walk) was great for a first night pizza! There’s also a little convenience store, well stocked, less than 2 mins from the front door of the hotel.  

We did pay for breakfast on the morning we were leaving, as we were in a rush, and wanted something conviennent without leaving the building. It was fine, bottomless, standard continental fair, but at 12EUR ahead, a shade expensive. 

Now things take a turn, if you are a light sleeper, I would not recommend. I’m not, nor is my partner, but even even our deep slumber was interrupted by the noise outside (our room was over looking Rue du Faubourg Saint Martin, and thus also La Fayette, as we were on the fifth floor). If it is an uninterrupted night’s sleep you’re after (and isn’t that the point of a hotel) keep searching. The room is also on the very small size, and I mean small! The cupboard for your clothes was not even the depth of my shoulders, slightly awkward for hanging anything up, and after two adults and weekend bags where safely inside, there wasn’t much room for anything else! 

The vast majority of the staff were really lovely! But there is always an exception that proves the rule, and that was the young(ish) man that welcomed us. In my passable french, I explained I had a reservation, my french wasn’t very good, and did he speak English. He pretended not to (despite me hearing him talk it but a second ago to someone who was checking in ahead of us). He insisted speaking french, very very fast, something tricky for a novice speaker to comprehend. Yes, this might pass as a comedy in some alternative scenario, but not with tired strangers, who want to check in, who have at least made an attempt to speak French. With an eye roll, he mumbled and scorned at my lack of french, and proceeded to speak at me in (very good) English, very very fast, and even in my native tongue, it was hard to understand him! Clearly we were inconveniencing him and he had better things to do than his job! In contrast to ALL of the other staff who could not have been nicer, he was rude. 

In summary, adequate, ok for 1 or 2 nights, very good transport links, very clean, comfortable but small, but I wouldn’t want to stay again, mainly for the noise and disturbed sleep.

title: Perfect stay in Hotel Paris Louis Blanc
text:
We had a perfect stay in this modern hotel. Included a parking place for the car! 
People were friendly and careful.
the room was clean and very good with the light in it. also the possibility to open the window was very good. Near by also al lot of restaurants were you could have diner.

title: Clean, renewed, across metrostation, friendly, lively neighborhood
text:
This is a great hotel for your visit of Paris. 10 meters from the metrostation and 750 meters from Gare du Nord.
Completely renewed, new carpets, bed and bathrooms.
With a nice garden.
Neighborhood with all types of restaurants.
Friendly staff.
Breakfast a bit plain, but well.

title: Good family stay
text: I thought it might be helpful to add a review with some detail as different previous reviews had left me a bit uncertain before traveling. We stayed here for three nights for a long weekend family sightseeing. This hotel is not a luxury hotel and it seems like some people have been disappointed by this but I don’t know what they expected for the price! The hotel is really clean, well looked after and feels safe and well run. The reception desk is manned all the time. The reception service is a bit basic and very variable (which probably accounts for the varying reviews). The first night we were greeted by a fairly grumpy person who seemed to resent anyone unable to speak good French and was not particularly welcoming. However the next night we were served by a really helpful older guy who couldn’t do enough and on our last day were helped by a charming young woman who even bothered to call us after we had left the hotel because we had left something behind. Everything in the room worked, including the air conditioning which some travellers have complained about. The wifi is very reliable, but it’s just as well as there is only French TV. (Really not a big deal but the hotel documents suggest that they have English language channels). We were really comfortable here. We didn’t try the breakfast as there is a gorgeous boulangerie opposite (Grand Tre) and a wonderful pizza restaurant (Amore Mio) within a minute’s walk for good evening meals. As described by others, the metro station (Louis Blanc) is over the road. Great spot, we would definitely stay again.

title: Nice hotel
text:
I would recommend this hotel after just returning from a great stay here. I booked the trip for myself and my daughter through Eurostar as part of a 4 night city break. The hotel is ideally situated, about a 10/15 minute walk or short taxi ride from Gare du Nord (8 euros in a taxi, make sure you use the taxi rank at the station as there are lots of unofficial taxis touting for business). The Louis Blanc metro station is right near the hotel and the metro is very easy to use.
Our room was quite small but adequate with a built in wardrobe. The room itself and the bathroom were modern and very clean. The room was cleaned daily and fresh towels provided. The beds were very comfortable. Breakfast was continental and good value. Staff were pleasant and helpful. Overall we had a lovely stay.

title: Arnaque!!!
text: This hotel is a scam. Refuses to refund even when cancellation is 5 days prior to trip. Booking.com seems complicit in this arnaque. Go somewhere else!! Is also overpriced for what it offers. I have contested charge with my credit card and will continue to kvetch until I receive a refund.

title: City break
text: Highly recommended,  very quiet, clean and very friendly staff, good area with loads of shops, restaurants,  close to tube station easy access to all points of interest, definitely we'll come again. Nice terrace

title: A little disappointed.
text: We booked adjoining rooms since we are a family of 5 but one of the rooms air conditioning didn’t work and they were unable to fix it. We were offered another room on the same floor but not adjoining which is the reason we booked with this hotel. We were given a fan to blow air into the other room but it was a small desk fan that was in effective. We made the best of it since we were there to see Paris and not the hotel but it did make for some restless sleeping.

title: Exceeded expectations
text: Room was very modern, clean, and the adequate size. The location is amazing and the area is very calm with many facilities like supermarkets, bakeries and a metro stop one minute from the hotel. The receptionists were very polite.

title: Best price  to value ratio.
text: Hotel room  was really comfortable and it  had air conditioning. The staff was really helpful. Since  the  location is practically  just  around the corner of the metro station you can reach any place in  Paris within 30 minutes. I will definitely stay there whenever I am in Paris.

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice hotel and the bed was comfortable. The hote was very clean.  The staff was friendly. Good location. The was quiet. Near tot the canal, train, metro and bus stop.  Very great location for visiting Paris.

title: Great location
text: If you're travelling to Paris by car this is a great location. You can leave the car in the underground car park and travel around Paris by metro. The Louis Blanc metro stop is just opposite the hotel and only takes 30 mins to get to the Eiffel Tower (1,90 euros). There are lots of places around the hotel to pick up food which you can eat at the hotel in either the breakfast room or the cute little garden. There's also a really nice Italian restaurant just opposite which I recommend. You can leave your bags at reception free of charge if you arrive early or want to leave late. The staff are very friendly and helpful and the beds are really comfortable. I would definitely stay here again in the future. I was a bit concerned about it being next to a police station but we slept very well and weren't disturbed by any noise from the street at all.

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice room, good beds, friendly staff, perfect location, clean and quiet room. Near to the metro. Near to the canal, cosy place to have a drink. Supermarket nearby. Nice Price. The gare du Nord is nearby when you travel by train.

title: Reccomender
text:
Me and my girlfriend stayed here from 25 until the 28th of july and it was great ,

The room was a bit small but we were mostly visiting the eiffeltower and the other places so it wasn't a deal breaker.

The rooms were very clean and they got cleaned every day , the people at the reception were very helpfull and nice so if you want to go here i really recommend it!!

title: Nothing special, just ok.
text:
We were most satisfied about its location, the Louis Blanc metro line (7) is right across the hotel and takes you directly to a number of popular tourist spots.

The hotel itself is just ok;

Negatives; small rooms (no lounge chairs in our room as you see on most of their pictures though...), outdated bathroom, noisy area (24/7), poor breakfast, terrible matress, incredible loud housekeeping in the morning and worst of all, their airconditioning is a hoax, as it doesn't function.

Positives; location to metro station, coffee and tea facilities in the room, nice courtyard, plenty of cheap spots to eat or takeaway (pizza, thai, chinese, kebab, ...) nearby.

title: Not great, wouldn’t recommend
text:
On arrival the man at reception was rude and told us he was ‘too tired to speak English’ and told us to speak in French and then started serving another customer. Very unwelcoming. When we tried to speak French he started to laugh at us. 
Was also promised a garden room over email which we did not receive. 
Asked for an extra pillow for my back and was told by the man at reception that he was too busy whilst watching tv in the reception area. As soon as I mentioned Trip Advisor, he couldn’t have gotten up quicker to get it for me. 
Room was ok, minus a few stains on the bedsheets, had to go down to reception to get more and change the sheets myself. 
Overall, very disappointing stay, don’t know if there’s a possibility of getting money back but I doubt it. 
Really wouldn’t recommend, there are some other 3 star hotels in the area that are probably better. 
Particularly because it was a holiday to celebrate my birthday.

title: Anniversary break for two
text:
Close to the Gard de Nord and well placed for walking to see all the sights. The room was clean and tidy, we were lucky to be at the rear of the hotel. The staff were helpful and pleasant, particularly Hanna. Ready to provide restaurant recommendations and help with the metro lines. 
We stayed 3 nights and will definitely return, it’s what you pay for with a lovely courtyard and a reasonable choice of continental breakfast.

title: Cheap but Cheerful
text: 8 of us stayed over a long weekend, The rooms were clean & tidy and what you would expect for the money. I would suggest you ask for a bedroom on the rear elevation to avoid being woken up by street noise & police sirens. The breakfast was fine albeit the option of hot food would be welcome but not expected on the Continent

title: Rude Staff
text: We were here on holiday from Australia for a few days. The staff were very rude to us and annoyed at us for speaking English, even though we apologised as we did not speak French, they also did not advise us of extra charges for breakfast and the city tax, so at the end of our stay we were slumped with a $150 bill on top of the room cost which we had already paid online. Overall poor service but the room wasn't too bad, however it was all a very unwelcoming experience. We were also there during major public transport strikes, however I have not let the rating reflect this. If i were you I'd stay somewhere that is more welcoming to tourists.

title: Perfection in Paris!
text:
I cannot fault our stay at Hotel Duquesne Eiffel. Our trip felt so special and the hotel had such a huge part to play in this. 

The staff could not do enough for us and were so friendly, helpful and attentive both prior, during and after our stay. A huge shout out to Drichelle who is an incredible asset to the hotel - thank you for looking after us and recommending the lovely restaurant down the road ‘La Terasse’. 

The room was perfect. We stayed in a premium Eiffel Tower view room and it felt like something out of a movie - romantic, cosy and just perfect! We did not want to leave! 

Thank you Hotel Duquesne Eiffel for the best stay in Paris we have ever had - we will certainly be returning!

title: Small but bright and charming hotel with friendly service
text: We were immediately struck by the bright and inviting lobby decorations, complete with Rick Steves Paris guides - a nice touch.  Though it's on a main street, the area was quiet and lacking in they typical Paris summertime touristy chaos.  Metro and busses are close.  Our room was small but comfortable, and, if you stretched, you had a partial view of the Eiffel Tower.  Air conditioning worked very well, which was a good deal in July.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  They booked a taxi to the airport and made a restaurant reservation with no issues.  They also gave clear and helpful responses to any questions we had.  Breakfast left a bit to be desired as the selections were somewhat limited and the scrambled eggs were runny.  Serviceable overall.  Breakfast room staff was helpful and responsive.  Overall, a very pleasant experience.

title: Worst hotel of trip - left a lot to be desired
text:
The bad news started when we walked arrived at check-in time and noticed a lot of not so happy looking people sitting around the lobby along with lots of luggage. Not so surprisingly, we were told that our 4 rooms would be ready in an hour and we should come back later. The reception clerk  indicated that the hotel would hold our luggage and gave us 8 numbered clam checks. We arrived back more than an hour later and only 3 of our rooms were ready and she provided no indication when the last one would be ready. We handed over our claim checks, but didn’t look at the numbers   or check which luggage we were taking She only pointed to a collection of luggage on the other side of the lobby some of which was ours. So much for secure luggage holding.
Although the hotel had our credit card information when the reservation was made, the hotel makes you pay for your room as you check in (I’ve never encountered this before). You also are asked to decide whether you want breakfast for your stay, which you also have to pay upfront. Given the mediocre quality of the breakfast compared to the prior nights’ hotel, we would not have gone the second and third day had we not prepaid.
We’ve been to Paris a number of times and realize that rooms run small, but this was ridiculous. To get out of bed to use the toilet, I had to turn and walk sideways.
The worst however was service from the front desk. We had passed a restaurant the night before and asked to dine outside, but was told it was fully booked. The host said he could seat us inside, and then pointed to an inside table furthest from the street. We said we’ll come back another time. The next day we asked hotel reception to book an outside table for 8 at that restaurant that evening. She phoned while we waited, and us that the person she spoke to had to get back to her. Later, she told us the reservation outside had been made. I asked her if she was sure the reservation was for outside and she indicated that is why they had to call back. We got to the restaurant and mentioned our reservation for outside and gave both our name and the hotel name. The host then proceeded to usher us to the same back corner table that he wanted to seat us in the night before. I repeated that we had made an outside reservation but he didn’t respond. He offered no explanation or acknowledge whether he saw the reservation, but would not seat us outside.
We relayed this episode to the man on duty at the hotel reception, and he became defensive of the restaurant. He explained that restaurants often overbook. We understand that overbooking is sometimes done to handle situations when people don’t show up, but we were at the restaurant when the restaurant opened and no one was yet seated.  We questioned whether the restaurant might not like Americans, and he dismissed that possibility. In any event, he was totally unsympathetic to the fact that our reservation was not honored and perhaps irritated that we complained about the restaurant.
Prior to going to our rooms for the evening, I asked the same clerk to arrange for two taxis to take us to Versailles the next morning and he agreed. The next morning on the way to breakfast, I saw the same guy and a woman behind the reception desk and asked whether our taxis were all set. They indicated they were set. Later when we ready to leave, I asked the same woman where we should wait for our taxis and she said outside. When the taxis did not arrive, I came back to reception and let her know they were not there. She then told me the taxis in fact had not been confirmed. I then asked her to contact a taxi company and she indicated it was impossible as it was the busy time of the day. Since she would not even try to get us taxis (which she had previously said were confirmed) we were left to our own to find our way to Versailles with timed reservations during a busy time of the day. Given the circumstances, I was left to wonder whether reception purposely sabotaged the taxi ride because I took offence at the restaurant not honoring the reservation the night before. I’m glad we were not relying on the taxi to get us to the airport. 
I’ve traveled extensively both for business and pleasure, but never encountered a situation like this.

title: Perfect Parisian Hotel!
text:
We arrived a bit early to check in, so we killed time at a cafe for an hour.  Clara was very helpful at checking us in. The halls, and elevators, and rooms are small, but it's Europe.  
   There's a great breakfast on the lower level that's in a quaint room which cost 13 euros apiece when we took advantage of it. But it's really good!
   The rooms are small, but very nice and clean. The shower has great temperature and water pressure, BUT the shower only has a splash guard so that awesome water pressure can splash all over if you're not careful.  The toiletries were just a shower gel bottle in the shower, a bottle of lotion, and a bottle of hand soap.  So anything more you'd need, you'd have to bring. 
  I loved having a small fridge in the room, and I think there was a safe in the closet that needed some kind of key, but we didn't look into it.  The TV is a flat screen against the wall and has many French and English channels. There is no iron or ironing board, and even though I saw one downstairs where I ate breakfast, we discovered that was for use for the whole hotel and we had to bring our clothes downstairs to iron it. So I had wrinkled clothes that day.
  But other than that, everything was amazing!! All the major tourist attractions are within walking distance. La Bon Marche', Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, all within walking distance. It's a long walk, but I love it. Also really close is that huge gold domed building which is Hotel National des Invalides, which is must better than it sounds where you can see Napoleon's tomb and other great things.
   But this hotel is GREAT, the staff (ALL the staff!) is SO nice! This was the perfect introduction to Paris for me! Also, if you want to sit outside with a glass of wine from next door, the wifi works there as well! I would LOVE LOVE LOVE to stay here again!

title: Quiet comfortable
text: It was our first visit at this hotel,  chosen fit is closeness to my mother in law.  Well worth it.  Comfortable rooms for everyone.  Very quiet despite being on busy street. Couldn't hear anything inside which I  love ❤️.  Sheets are terrific, be a little unyielding for me but loved it overall.  Interesting to have 3 packets of shoe shine sponges in the amenities!  Very inviting outdoor seating which seems a familiar landing place for many.

title: Cute little hotel!
text: Gorgeous little boutique hotel in the 7th. The staff was excellent, the room was clean and comfortable. The rooms are soundproof and quiet. The view was amazing! It was walkable to the Eiffel Tower and in a nice area. We would stay here again.

title: Simply wonderful!
text: We took a long weekend (Thursday thru Sunday night) jaunt to Paris for our anniversary. We reserved a room a few months before and we were lucky to have the best room in this boutique hotel. Corner room with two French doors opening to a balcony with full view of Eiffel Tower. The staff could not have been more helpful. The breakfast (ours was included) was a buffet with a wide selection (Continental, English, American) and awesome coffee! Would stay again and highly recommend.

title: Value Hotel
text: Nice hotel in a good location. The proximity to the Eiffel Tower and other attractions make this a good hotel for a few nights. We were able to see and do everything we needed to do in our 3 days-2night stay. The hotel rooms were small but clean, this is normal in Europe. Overall good value for the money.

title: Perfect place to stay in Paris
text: This place was great. The room was very clean. The view was awesome. The morning breakfast was good. The staff friendly  and helpful when needed. The location within walking  distance to the eiffel tower and the ru Clare. I would recommend this hotel.

title: Great location in Paris!
text:
The location of this hotel is amazing! The staff were very friendly and stepped up after our reservation was lost during Covid and they had a complete staff change. They tried so hard to get us back in the hotel and make our stay enjoyable. A BIG THANKS to the staff!
We didn’t get the room we originally booked until the last night and it was great & had views of the Eiffel Tower. 
The one downside was the shower… had a small glass door that didn’t cover the whole shower so water got everywhere. Also, the shower was plastic and felt cheap. That is only downside and the views made up for it! I would stay here again.

title: Small, but very clean and very convenient
text: Spent three nights here recently. Like most buildings in the old world that are, in many cases, centuries old, it is small and compact. The being said our room was very clean and the staff was terrific. Oceana was particularly helpful as was Patrick. It is in a terrific neighborhood that is clean and safe with many food, drink and shopping options. An easy 15 minute walk to the base of the Eiffel Tower. Also, a very nice breakfast is offered each morning. If you want a big roomy modern hotel, stay out by the airport. If you want an inner city, old world, real Parisian experience, this is the place. Reasonably priced. Would not hesitate to stay here again.

title: Very good hotel and location
text: The staff at reception was friendly and helpful and were happy to store our bags when we arrived. Our room was small as is typical of a European hotel. Everything was up to date and clean. Very comfortable bed and nice bedding. Bathroom clean. Daily housekeeping service kept things very clean and fresh. Great location with easy access to Metro, many nearby cafes, and Rue Cler. A bit away from the most densely crowded tourist areas which is a positive. The first couple of nights we had trouble with the AC not working. A member of our group had many mosquitoes in his room and it seemed like a challenge for him to take care of this problem. We had a very positive experience and would stay here again.

title: Best hotel in Paris with Eiffel Tower view
text: The photos for this hotel do not do it justice. I have a front facing room with a view of the Eiffel Tower and it’s just spectacular for what it cost. You don’t need the Shangri La with this hotel. Very friendly staff with quick check in. I was supposed to be here with my husband but his passport didn’t have long enough (make sure you have at least 3 months if you’re coming from the UK) and they still sent up the champagne for our anniversary. Very clean and not as small as other reviewers have claimed. I 100% recommend this hotel, please don’t hesitate and treat yourself to a front facing room if you can.

title: Perfect hotel for couples! Close to the Eiffel Tower, shops and cafés!
text: J’adore the Hotel Duquesne Eiffel! My husband and I highly recommend it! We appreciated the assurance that our reservation would be held after our flight was delayed due to weather, and we would be checking in a day later. The staff was kind and friendly, and very helpful. We had the perfect room (room 51) with a balcony view of the Eiffel Tower. I couldn’t get enough of the view and looked out each day and night. Our location was perfect to walk to the Eiffel Tower, the Seine River, Champs-Élysées, the St. Germain District and Latin Quarter, as well as the Louvre! Thank you so much for everything and making our first trip to Paris memorable!!

title: Great views of the tower but after that, not much to rave about.
text:
If a view of the Eiffel Tower is what you’re after, then this is the perfect hotel for you. We booked a premium room and had a gorgeous view of the Eiffel Tower. The staff were so lovely and so helpful, the rooms were clean and it is only a 10 min walk to the Eiffel Tower. 
However, after that I would say there are nicer and cheaper hotels out there with better locations. The rooms were quite old, with chipped door frames and old, damaged furniture. It probably is in need of a total revamp. The walls were super thin… so much so that we could hear the people next door using the bathroom and their exact conversations with each other. I’m sure they could hear ours, too. The location is ok, but there wasn’t a lot to do around the area. Not many restaurants or bars. 
All in all… this is a 3 star hotel for a reason. We stayed in another hotel for our first two nights in Paris near the Arc de Triomphe and we much preferred it to Hotel Duquesne. I don’t think I’d stay here again.

title: Great place, excellent location!
text: The hotel is clean, the staff is super friendly, helpful and discrete. I forgot my passport and money at the counter and the lady put it in an envelope and handed it to the Uber driver I contacted to bring it to me at the airport. They also supported us with a health issue that will never be forgotten. The bed is very comfortable and the location is privileged. I would definitely stay there again.

title: Not value for money
text: Two rooms booked at the same time and at same price and one is at level 1 and the other is at level 4. Receptionist kept telling us that it is in the same category. Not worth the money and the hype. Window almost at street level with no privacy whatsoever. A superior room here is by far worse than most comfort rooms I have been in most cities, with dated and damaged furniture.

title: Unclean room, poor customer service, unapologetic
text:
1. Had to wait 40min for the room. I messaged the hotel in advance to ask if early check in was possible but didn’t receive a response so I showed up at the check in time (2pm) but only one of the two rooms I booked was ready. No apologies were made for the inconvenience.
2. Room was NOT clean. Long black hair on the toilet seat, small fine hairs in the bed sheets, and other hairs in the shower and bathroom floor. Black mold in the shower. This was during COVID times, and to not clean properly is very concerning. Did not feel comfortable for the remainder of my stay.
3. Service - no attempts were made to rectify the situation. I advised I did not want to be further inconvenienced by having to wait for access to my room by cleaning staff going in again (I was in a rush and was very tired from travelling). No solution was offered, just that they would let cleaning staff know. Again, no apologies were made.

title: DO NOT STAY HERE
text: We were COVERED in bug bites after spending a night in this hotel. Our wedding was the next day and we had to pay the photographer to edit the bites out of our photos. We reached out to the hotel, they admitted to a bug problem and that we should've been offered a bug socket repellent, but would not offer a refund of any kind. Their emails were accusatory, as though it was our fault we were bitten. Horrible customer service, and a clear bug problem in the room.

title: Beautiful location & view
text: Exceptionally clean, great location.  The room was small but very comfortable.  Spend the extra and get a balcony that looks out onto the Eiffel Tower!  The staff was very helpful and efficient.  We did not take the breakfast as there are Boulangies close by.  The view is phenomenal!

title: Great location and service!
text: The Hotel Duquesne Eiffel is an outstanding hotel for a trip to Paris!  The staff are very friendly, helpful, and informative.  They can email you directions on how to reach the hotel from the Metro, for example.  They all speak English.  The breakfast was quite filling and delicious.  The rooms are small, but they do have refrigerators and security lock boxes.  The location is wonderful as it is in a nice quiet neighborhood between the Eiffel Tower area and Les Invalides.  You have easy access to the Metro from the Ecole Militaire station.  If you like to run, this is a super starting point for a run through the heart of Paris.

title: Great hotel in great neighborhood!
text: We stayed here in our first traveling experience since the lockdown. The hotel is in a great location! The staff were amazing. They were friendly, knowledgeable, and efficient. Great breakfast to get the day started. We reserved one of the premium rooms with a view of the Eiffel Tower. An amazing stay at a great value.

title: Wonderful view
text: We were charmed by this hotel, warm welcome from the management, many English speaking customers, we made a lot of interesting encounters, we even made friends with some customers, the atmosphere is family friendly, beautiful view, beautiful room with a beautiful and charming decoration, we loved this charming hotel

title: Great location!
text: Perfect location for wandering the area around the Eiffel Tower which was an easy walk away.   Plenty of great restaurants in the area.   The room was clean though wasn’t particularly large but we weren’t looking for that either.   Friendly staff and a good value here!

title: Loved it!
text: My friend and I stayed here for six nights during December and absolutely loved it. It was really cute inside and the beds were super comfortable. The view was so gorgeous, we had a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower. The staff were extremely helpful, we were able to check in two hours earlier, which we were so thankful for as my friend was feeling very unwell that day. We were about a 15 minute walk away from the Eiffel tower, and a 5 minute walk from a big supermarket which was really handy. We both loved our stay there, we had breakfast at the downstairs buffet on the last day we were there, which was really enjoyable and had a selection of different breads and cakes, spreads, juices and drinks, fruit and yogurt.

title: Quaint hotel
text: I stayed here for 2 nights on a business trip. Good location for the Eiffel Tower and some nice restaurants. Small rooms but that is to be expected in Paris. The pillows were awful but the bed was comfy. Breakfast was in the basement. The room was like a cellar and nicely decorated. Unfortunately the cooked breakfast was cold but the coffee was great.They staff were very friendly.

title: Great place to stay
text: Very close to the Eiffel tower. Our receptionist was super helpful and spoke perfect English. Hotel rooms were small but very nice. This was a much better place to stay than our previous hotel and happy to have found it.

title: Fantastic Stay
text: I stayed here with my boyfriend for 3 nights in January 2020. The hotel is in a great location with tourist sights in walking distance and a taxi rank a couple of blocks away. The rooms were small which was expected, but they had everything you needed. They were clean and comfortable. The only issue we had was certain reception staff were quite rude and unhelpful. However, we didn’t let that ruin our trip and we had a great time at this hotel.

title: European Holiday
text: Admittedly this was my first visit to Paris so I haven’t stayed in other accommodation in Paris before however I have stayed in a lot of hotels and various other accommodation around the world, all moderately priced. I found our standard room at the Hotel Duquesne Eiffel to be extremely small. This may be normal for accommodation in Paris. The bed was very comfortable, the room and bathroom very clean and the staff were very helpful. The hotel is away from the tourist areas of Paris which is great because it’s quiet but it means a lot of commuting, in our case walking or taxis, to get to a lot of the tourist attractions. Unfortunately we were there during the transport strike.

title: Decent hotel fo rmoney
text: We stayed here for one night on a deal through booking.com for a standard room.  We came a day early so we thought we would give it a try.  The location is good, but without a doubt it was the smallest room and bed we have ever stayed in.  I could handle the small room size for a day or two, but definitely not the bed size.  It was quite uncomfortable for two people.  Otherwise, it was clean, and for the room we had, would have been fine for 1.  Would definitely recommend an upgrade to your room if you stay.  The property itself was fine.

title: Excellent location and cost-benefit
text:
I want with my girl to Paris 1st time and we wanted to be close to Eiffel tower. I m interested on a clean, safe place too. This hotel is walking distance from cafes, restaurants, metro, the river, Eiffel tower. . 
Staff is super-friendly and very accommodating. Cost was good. Quiet at night. clean, modern. No complains at all, i will definitely stay there again

title: Amazing views and location
text: The location of this hotel couldn't be beat. We had the top corner room which had a window literally opening up on the Eiffel Tower with a wraparound balcony to boot. Exceptionally comfortable bed, walking distance to the Tower and a great neighborhood. I found this hotel using the search "Eiffel Tower" and "Balcony" and this couldn't have been more on point to meet that criteria.  Also the breakfast was quite good and a good range of available foods.

title: Parisienne Charm to the Fullest
text: This charming hotel is located in a lovely neighborhood just on the fringe of tourists. Located a few blocks south of the Champs de Mar, you are away from the madness of the Eiffel Tour but remain in her sights. Clean and comfortable with all of the little touches. The breakfast offered in the cozy "wine cellar" atmosphere of the basement was fresh and plentiful. The front desk manager is French and I found her most helpful and friendly.

title: Great hotel, near rue Cler and other attractions
text: We spent 5 nights here in early November and had a great stay.  Room was a good size with a nice bathroom, very clean.  We were lucky enough to have a bit of a view of the Eiffel Tower - a real bonus.  The breakfast had everything you could want to start your day.  Great location, about 5 minutes to École Militaire metro, rue Cler, Invalides and about 15 from Eiffel Tower, very walkable to Montparnasse and St Germain districts as well.   Staff were very helpful and very friendly, especially Christina (hope I got name right!).   I would stay here again and would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Beautiful hotel near the Eiffel Tower
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Duquesne Eiffel in November and it was a wonderful hotel!  It is within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower, and there are a lot of restaurants in the area where you can get a delicious meal.  The staff was so friendly and helpful and the rooms, while small (but you're in Europe so they're usually all rather small), were clean and well kept.  Anytime we needed help with planning something, the front desk staff was more than willing to help us.  You're about a 10-15 minute walk to the metro or you could always grab a hop on/hop off tour bus right near the Eiffel Tower.  

The decor of the room was very pretty and classic.  I would highly suggest this hotel to anyone who is looking to stay in a great hotel in Paris that is close to a lot of different areas that you'll want to visit.   I would definitely stay here again.

title: Comfortable, great views from some rooms
text: Smallish but comfortable and pleasant hotel. I had a great corner room (ask for this) with a great view of the Eiffel Tower. Service good, continental breakfast fine, good location. Wifi fine. Plenty of restaurants and cafes in the area.

title: Good Place, Great Location
text:
My wife and I stayed here for 2 weeks. We had a great room with a view of the Eiffel Tower. Rooms were clean and a decent breakfast was served on-site. Staff is friendly, helpful, and they all speak multiple languages. 
About a 5 minute walk to Les Invalids
About a 15 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower
About a 5 minute walk to the two nearest metro stations

title: great stay near Eiffel Tower
text: Our stay at Hotel Duquesne Eiffel in Paris was most excellent.  It is a lovely boutique hotel located in the historic area of the 7th arrondissement.  We had an easy walk to the Eiffel Tower, Les Invalides and the metro stop at Ecole Militare. The breakfast area is nice and the food was really good. The room was decorated beautifully and was quite clean, even though it was small - we loved it. The concierge was helpful in arranging the hotel shuttle for me in advance.  Just a note about the hotel shuttle - - it is actually a private limousine service about the same price as a taxi.  It was nice to be met at my arrival by a driver holding a sign with my name, so I did not get lost in the airport, and the driver was a great tour guide on the ride to the hotel.

title: Great Location!
text: Lovely hotel within walking distance to the Eiffel Tower.  Rooms are quite small, but very clean but just fine for a weekend visit to Paris! There was a very good breakfast available each morning. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Lovely View
text:
A great hotel. 
Had a great view of the Eiffel tower.
Good location for the tower and nice places to eat near by.  
Staff were friendly and polite. 
Had cot bed set up requested and held luggage as well.
Good size room but probably needs a new carpet.

title: Amazing hotel
text: Great views, nice little bar next door for a drink before bed. A little off the beaten path. Clean and decent sized, with a friendly staff. If you are doing hop on hop off, it’s a 10-15 min walk to the nearest stop which is the Eiffel Tower.

title: AMAZING!
text: The location of this hotel is absolutely perfect. Check in was a breeze, rooms are a great size by Paris standards and we even had a view of the Eiffel Tower. Air conditioner wasn’t as cool as I would have hoped, but it was beautiful outside so we left the windows open when we slept. This hotel has the most amazing coffee shop right next door, so stop there to get your day started with a cappuccino! Would definitely stay here again!

title: A very pleasent week in Paris
text: This is a very nice welcoming hotel in a good location if you want to be in this part of the city. The rooms are well above three star standard but unfortunately my wife and I were billeted in a tiny room, okay for a couple of nights but not for six! A smart hotel might think in advance, is it a good idea to put an eighty-year old on the fifth floor but then that’s probably pretty routine in Paris. Will we go back? Definitely, but no higher than the third floor next time. We are not fond of lifts.

title: Great location
text: Having stayed here a few years ago and not wanting to try someplace unknown, we opted to stay here again for three nights. The weather was really hot, mid 90's. The room are all Air conditioned but were experiencing some overload and some of us changed rooms.  All in all it was great. We love the Rue Clare area of Paris and so much is within a short walk, even the Eiffel Tower

title: A great place to explore Paris from
text: We spent three lovely nights at this treasure of a hotel celebrating our wedding anniversary.  A short walk to the Metro was great. Many nice cafes nearby. The front desk was very kind and helpful.  For Paris our room was rather spacious and we were awestruck by the fantastic view of the Eiffel Tower especially the hourly light show. Thank you for what was clearly a terrific room upgrade!

title: Fantastic hotel
text: Stopped here for a one night stopover. Staff are very polite and helpful and afforded a warm welcome. Helpful with local knowledge and onward journey infornation. 15 minute stroll to the Eiffel Tower amd plenty of local bars/ restaurants and supermarkets close by.  Good size rooms by Oaris standards and all spotless and well appointed. If you want somewhere warm and freindly situated in a great location then book here.

title: Hidden Gem
text: Great small boutique hotel within 15 minutes walk of Eiffel tower and 20 minutes from river Siene. Staff are friendly and hotel immaculately clean, room was small but adequate and expected in Paris, good toiletries Tea and Coffee making facilities and English TV. Breakfast was buffet style and plentiful Eggs/cereal/pastries/toast/meat and cheese/juice/fresh fruit at €13, small breakfast nearby was €7-10 for just crossiant and juice and coffee. Great little bar next door selling beer at €3 instead of cafe's and bistro's near by at €10. Would certainly go back.

title: a great little place
text: this is located within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and only a block to the subway and several fine local restaurants! A really great location with great staff! Several rooms offer a really nice view of the Eiffe- All in all a l great bargain anyone  visiting Paris!

title: Wonderful stay at Duquesne Eiffel Hotel
text: My husband and I had a wonderful stay here for a total of 7 nights this month. It is situated in a perfect spot in Paris. A little quieter and within easy walking distance (my husband is a below knee amputee) to many shops and restaurants and the Metro station and only a few stops to Louvre, D’Orsay, Concorde etc. Also lovely walk to Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars. While the rooms are on the smaller side, they were air conditioned and the beds were comfortable, and the bathrooms good. We had AMAZING views of the Eiffel Tower. However, the best part of our stay was the wonderful staff, especially the front desk staff! All were great and very, very helpful and accommodating!!! Thank you!!! If we come back to Paris we would definitely stay here again!

title: Ideal Location
text: Wonderful hotel!  Great location close to many restaurants and a local market. Very walkable to the Eiffel Tower - the adjacent park was only two blocks away.  Our room was very clean, bed comfortable and bathroom spacious.  The hotel staff was very friendly.  We unexpectedly got a room with an Eiffel Tower view.  Would definitely recommend this hotel!

title: Extremely clean hotel, great location & great staff.
text: This hotel is the cleanest hotel I've ever stayed in, hands down -- second only to the Waldorf Astoria. It is in a terrific location, so close to the Eiffel tower with excellent views. Even rooms that may not indicate a tower view, have great views. This hotel is modern, with super attentive staff and terrific restaurants close by. We will stay there every time we are in Paris. The price is also fabulous.

title: Clean, great location
text: The rooms and the hotel are small, but clean. Breakfast is good with the basics. Front desk is accommodating. The location was the best part. Forget seeing the Eiffel Tower from the front chairs or your room. There are too many trees in the way. But grab a bottle of wine and walk three blocks to sit on the grass right in front of it. Also close to 24 hr market and cafes, rue de cler and the metro.

title: Great Smallish Hotel
text: We have been staying at this hotel for 3 nights. Excellent location in walking distance to many attraction, great cafes and restaurants. Very friendly and helpful front desk and housekeeping. I’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend for those not wanting a glitzy large hotel but something more personal and with French character. Some rooms have Eiffel views. Although in busy area, it is quiet inside.

title: Tiny room but well appointed
text: We just needed a room for one night after returning from Nice so we could fly out the next day. This hotel is in a nice part of the city, very close to Les Invalides. We got a double room, which was so small we couldn’t figure out where to put our two small suitcases so they weren’t blocking access to the bathroom. The bed was indeed a double, not a queen, but it was comfortable. The bathroom was clean and well designed and everything in the room was clean. Tiny closet with a mini fridge in it and some hangers and cubbyholes. The tea kettle leaked water so we weren’t able to take advantage of that amenity. The front desk staff were very nice and helpful but their English is perhaps not as good as other places we’ve stayed in France. I wouldn’t stay here more than one night.

title: Room With a View!
text:
We enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Duquesne Eiffel on our recent trip to Paris. The location is excellent - close to the Eiffel Tower, Invalides, Rue Cler, numerous restaurants and Ecole Militaire Subway station. The lobby is small, but the front desk staff was friendly and welcoming. Our room (#44) was a comfortable, cozy accommodation for our three adult family members. We loved being able to view the Eiffel Tower from the room! The bedding, air conditioning and maid service were all excellent. 

Only negatives were the toilette room was very plain, needed fresh paint and the toilet seat was askew! Breakfast was also a little disappointing. We only took advantage of the on-site breakfast once, as it was busy, crowded and not a great selection of offerings.

We had a wonderful trip to Paris, and that was partially due to the lovely Hotel Duquesne Eiffel!

title: Cozy european hotel. Very conveniently located.
text: Conveniently located in the 7th district. I chose this hotel for locations: closeness to places I had to visit during this trip and safe running loops. Hotels in Paris are generally quite expensive but this hotel was within my company's budget policy. For locations and convenience, this hotel is worth much more than I paid for. Very cozy European hotel. Room was a bit tiny but sufficiently accommodated everything I needed. Cafeteria is open for the breakfast. 13 euro for breakfast is really good price for what they have served. Only five to seven minutes walking distance from Eiffel tower. I will come back and would recommend my colleagues in my office.

title: Mixed feelings
text: I have mixed feelings for this motel ! First of all I have to say the staff are very nice , polite and helpful  . The location is great , no doubt ! But the hotel itself is very depressing ! We had a 3 bed room for a week ! We all felt so depressed and couldn’t wait to leave . The room was sooo little , we were not even able to open our luggage . 7 days the same exact breakfast .... ! No variety , very simple ! My daughter even didn’t bother to come to breakfast after the first day . people who were serving breakfast were very welcoming and kind. They had no hair conditioner ! The $300 something a night was a lot of money for that small prison.This was my fifth trip to Paris and I had stayed to different places . This one was the gloomiest hotel I have ever stayed . It reminded me of Alcatraz !! Overpriced .

title: Great Hotel
text:
We booked this hotel
As the final leg of our 45th anniversary trip to Paris. The staff was incredibly gracious and allowed us a room with a view  of “the Tower!”. We will never forget how special it was. Ever staff member was more than helpful arranging for tickets, dinner reservations (at a wonderful Michelin star) , directions, transportation etc. I cannot say enough. Thanks so much especially to Laura and Patrick for making our trip a wonderful memory. Room was quite large for Paris, exceptionally clean, beautiful decor!

title: Fantastic views of the Eiffel Tower from your balcony when you book rooms 51, 52 or 54!!!
text: Starting with Laura (at the front desk) who was probably the most helpful front desk person we have ever experienced, and continuing with our room(s) and the view of Paris with the Eiffel Tower our choice of this hotel was perfect! Make sure you are in your room after dark and before midnight to see the Eiffel Tower sparkle for 5 minutes every hour on the hour. The breakfast choices were amazing! If there were more stars to give they would have been given!

title: Great!
text: 3 of us really enjoyed this hotel. The location was great and walkable to attractions. We requested a view of the Eiffel as it was a special birthday for my mum, although the 3 beds do not have a direct view we got an amazing side look. We also booked a bit late for the hotel transfer but they managed to squeeze us on. Thank you!! Would recommend.

title: Small But Nice
text: Petit room on first floor , no views but window worked so we could let a nice breeze in daily. Staff lovely and location is perfect.  Tower, French Army  Museum..pletty of food in area. Metro has 2 stations with in 5 mins walk . Buses pass the front door . Nice and quite , very old school in design. Was one of the reasons we chose this hotel. Spent 6 days here in April. Every thing is handy. Good wi fi access .

title: Don’t recommend it
text: Upon arrival I was asked to pre-pay the room which I already found quite odd. Even more when I discover that I need to pay the city tax and the breakfast at checkout the morning after (which is very impractical). Room is small as always in Parisian hotels and the carpet really needs to be replaced. It looks old and dirty. Bathroom was ok but seriously why would anybody still have installed this kind of hairdryer in 2019??? We’re no longer in the 70s when only business men where travelling... anybody who’s anybody knows that this kind of hairdryer is a nightmare for a woman with longer hair... 🤦‍♀️ Breakfast was the worst part. At 8am cleaners everywhere even in the small elevator (had to squeeze in with mops etc). There was a old fruit salad, coffee was not particularly good and pastries did not seem very fresh. All of this for 200 euros for the night + 13 euros for breakfast.

title: Convenient, Clean, Well-Apportioned Hotel in Shadow of Eiffel Tower
text:
This hotel is located on a relatively quiet street in a fairly non-touristy district.  We enjoyed our 5-night stay.

You can see the Eiffel Tower when you walk out the front door, and there are several Metro lines in walking distance.  The room was pretty good sized for a European hotel room, and the staff was friendly and helpful.  The main nearby street, on which the Ecole Militaire Metro stop is located, has plenty of places to eat, as well as a 24-hour grocery store.  Rue Cler (a street with a variety of food & wine stores, plus restaurants) is within walking distance and is certainly worth checking out.  

If you are looking for a hotel that is near, but not directly amidst, the main museum attractions of the city, I would definitely recommend this one.

title: Comfortable and quiet stay in Paris
text: The hotel is located near the Eiffel Tower as its name implies. It is a short walk to several cafes, bakeries and is near at least two Metro stations which made it very easy to get around the city. The triple room our family of three had was comfortable and quiet, even with our room facing the somewhat busy street. As expected, the room was small. We bumped into each other a couple times walking around the bed, but we really didn’t mind. The room had everything we needed, was decorated nicely and was very clean. The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful with our small requests for an ironing board (which was communal), a “stronger” hairdryer and to reserve a private car on our way back home. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Wow
text: What an amazing view from our room. Although the rooms are quite small, it was okay as we were out for most of the day anyways.  the breakfast was incredible. The staff were so friendly and helpful. I would recommend you to book your stay here.

title: Good place
text: I liked the hotel, the staff was very friendly and knew moderate English. We had a small misunderstanding during checkout ( mostly related to the language barrier I think). The hotel offers airport shuttle, but you can take the metro for much cheaper if you have time. I liked how the hotel was near the Eiffel Tower ( you can see it from the room) 😀... I would stay there again.

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
I really enjoyed my stay at the hotel.  I found the staff very friendly and helpful with any questions or suggestions and the area is perfect.
