There are some great cafes and restaurants close by and as well as the Ecole Militaire metro which puts you within easy reach of several key locations and easy transfer points to others.

The rooms are clean, and comfortable and are standard size for Paris.  I had a street facing room which was well insulated and quiet, and I could see the Eiffel Tower when I stuck my head out a little.

Breakfast is a reasonable price and has a nice selection of pastries, eggs, cereals and of course meat and cheese.

I will definitely stay again, and recommend it highly.  Thanks to all!

title: Cute hidden Gem
text: We recently stayed here and the staff spoke great English, our room although small was perfect and had everything we needed, we could easily walk to nearby locations like the Eiffel Tower, and there were great cafes all around.

title: Not Great for Friends, Poor Value for Money - Rm 52
text:
My friend and I were very much looking forward to staying in what by all accounts should've been a lovely hotel. Unfortunately our expectations were not met.

Staff: We only had dealings with reception a couple of times, they were efficient and helpful although not effusively so.

Room: Unfortunately this was the main area of disappointment. We paid for one of the 'superior' rooms so our expectations were fairly high, reasonably so considering the more than 300 euro nightly rate for it! The size of room was, by any standard, tiny (the professional photos are unfortunately deceiving). We were travelling as two friends so while there were two separate beds there was no point to their being so as (by necessity due to the size of room) they were pushed right up together. There was only just room for one person to walk round the bed to the bathroom at one time, and even then it was a squeeze.

Night noise wasn't bad considering the central location however on both our nights we were disturbed by another patron screaming and cursing in the hallway in the small hours, of course not the hotel's fault but still a mar on short stay.

A small thing considering the number of cafes nearby but we were also disappointed by the tea and coffee making facilities, 2 sachets of coffee, a small selection of tea bags (one per type), no milk provided. So you will either have to enjoy your coffee black or bring in milk from elsewhere.

Another small issue was there were no instructions in the room as to how to call reception, the hairdryer in our bathroom didn't work and when we tried to call down to enquire we were unable to do so.

Bathroom: Clean but tiny, with the shower door open you were not able to exit the bathroom it was that small. In order to get in and out of the shower/bath you have to manoeuvre yourself out of a 1ft gap. There was a very concerning area in the bath that felt as if it could give way at any time. 

Location: Excellent! A ten minute or so walk from the Eiffel Tower with bus stops and the metro a short walk away. You also have a smaller supermarket and about 100 pharmacies in easy distance. Lots of great restaurants within the area too.

Summary: If you're travelling as a couple or solo and are looking for a cozy boutique hotel and being able to step out at any time to see the Eiffel Tower is worth the price tag, this might be a viable choice for you. 

For us, unfortunately, we felt the value for money was pretty dire.

title: Great stay
text:
Clean, quiet, friendly engaging staff. Rooms are a bit on the small side, but I guess that’s the norm for the area.
We called too late for them to arrange picking us up from the airport, but the return went perfectly. Would love to return and stay here again...

title: Stupendous View of the Eiffel Tower
text: Having been to Paris many times before, and usually staying on the Champs Ellyses or near the Opera, we decided that a small boutique hotel near the Eiffel Tower was what was called for to celebrate my December birthday. We found our room small but well-appointed, with a large balcony and a breathtaking view of the Eiffel Tower. Everyone at the front desk of the hotel was very helpful in suggesting restaurants and helping us secure transportation to and from the airport. For a modest fee we could have taken advantage of the hotel's breakfast room for our morning meal, but we chose to eat elsewhere.  Our room was serviced every day, and we had no complaints whatsoever with the housekeeping staff.  We would definitely recommend the Hotel Duquesne Eiffel and its convenient location to the Eiffel Tower, the Rodin Museum, and the Invalides, all within easy walking distance.  And there are many excellent restaurants nearby as well.  Ask for Room 54, which however they can't promise, if you want the perfect view of the Eiffel Tower.

title: New year in Paris
text: We stayed here for 2 nights to celebrate New Year in Paris. Excellent location for the Eiffel Tower where we were eating for new year and an easy walk to the park Champs Elysees etc. Stayed in the 5th floor with a great view and a small balcony. Room size is fine for Paris and had a couple of drinks in the bar which is small but relaxed. All of the staff here are fantastic and helpful with nothing too much trouble. Had breakfast one day and good selection of hot and cold with the convenience of just going downstairs. Would stay again and recommend.

title: Back again!!!
text: Just spent 9 nights at the Duquesne Hotel with my family and a friend of over 50 years.  I have been coming here for years and would not consider any other hotel while in Paris. I feel like I'm coming home.  The staff are incredibly helpful and go out of their way to make sure your stay is comfortable and memorable.  Laetitia, the hotel manager has a great personality with great people skills, the front desk, Marie, Badi, Alegra, Patrick all go out of their way to make your stay a 5 star experience.  I am looking forward to my next stay in the spring.

title: Great Location great price
text:
My wife and I stayed here mid November and were happy with our stay.

Although a little outside the entertainment areas, it was close enough to a metro station to hope on a train to wherever you wanted to go.  

We found the area safe and inclusive of what we needed, plenty of great restaurants and grocery stores to grab snacks and water.

The room was small but offered what we needed, the shower was also a little cramped but we made due.

The staff were nice and helpful for the most part, except for a little misunderstanding when booking a private transfer to the airport...but uber got us their instead.

The breakfast was a great way to start our long days of exploration and included cakes, cereal, teas and coffee and hot dishes - all buffet.

We didnt have much of a view from our room but wasnt a big deal as if you want to see the eiffel tower, just step outside the hotel's entrance. 

Would we stay here again? Totally!!! It is a great value in a great Paris neighbourhood.

title: Great Boutique Hotel with View
text:
We stayed 3 nights and loved this quaint hotel.
We had the triple room as our college daughter joined us. It was tight but worked well. Clean and updated. Gave you the Paris feel. Depending on room you have a great view of the Eiffel Tower. Check photos in this listing  for which rooms have best views. Staff was friendly and informative. We went for Christmas markets and Paris did not disappoint. Lobby was very festive for the Holidays. I would stay again.

title: Perfect
text: Excellent location with good cafes and a metro station nearby. Walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. We even walked to the Louvre in less than an hour. Great staff who were very helpful. Room was small but clean and tidy.

title: Great Little Place
text: I only stayed here one night. The staff were the most helpful I found in Paris. Very friendly. The room was a decent size. It is a small hotel. But very central. A 5 minute walk to the tower. Can walk to everywhere from here. Very central. Very quiet and comfortable. Best value for money. Room is good for 2 people. Any more would be little difficult. This is not a new modern property. It is very charming and well kept. The room also has a mobile phone which you can take with you with maps and everything. Was very helpful.

title: Great Stay, Friendly Staff
text: I had a very enjoyable one-night stay in this hotel.  From a super friendly check-in experience to a large room with a balcony over-looking the Eiffel Tower, the whole experience was a treat.  Well-appointed room and comfortable bed.  Even a bathtub for those who enjoy a soak.

title: Great stay!
text: We stayed here for the first three nights of our honeymoon and I cannot say enough good things. The staff was friendly and helpful (a great benefit since we unfortunately do not speak French), the breakfast was reasonably priced and good, and the room was clean and comfortable with a great view. The restaurant next door, L’Escapade Cafe, was also very convenient for dinner with great service. I would definitely recommend the hotel to friends and family!

title: very comfortable, very awesome staff
text: Very comfortable hotel, real good coffee and breakfast, reasonably priced. You are walking distance to so many things to see. Very good internet, lobby is a cool place to hang out and drink a beer or some wine before you set out to explore. I was here on Business, so I just had a day to see some sites.

title: Wonderful Boutique Hotel
text: Just stayed at the West End near the Champs Elysee in Paris - such a beautiful building and the room was perfect.  The hotel is spotlessly clean, the bed was really comfortable and a lovely bathroom with a bath.  Everything we could possibly need was in the room and for anything else the staff could not do enough to help.  Special mention to the lovely lady on reception - so friendly and welcoming - made our stay so  perfect.  Would definitely stay here again.

title: 40th birthday
text: Just come back from a 4 night stay here for my 40th brand was not disappointed. Stunning hotel, ideally situated and all the staff were fab especially Enrique who was on the desk at night, so friendly and helpful, was a joy seeing him when we got back to have a chat. Can’t wait to go back.

title: Beautiful boutique hotel
text: Cute and beautiful boutique hotel near champs, very close to arch de triumph and high end shopping district. The building is absolutely French antique architecture with rooms having standing balconies. The staff is very helpful. Breakfast is decent.

title: What a change in this hotel..
text: This used to be a very nice boutique hotel, with diligent and pleasant staff. It has become a pure commercial business, with very poor management and service, where all is important is ... your money. There are now much better option in Paris in terms of prices, and quality of service.

title: a long stay at the west end hotel
text:
my husband and I stayed at the west end hotel for 10 nights in July...I booked this hotel based on so many excellent reviews and location. Now, I will say that I am a very discerning traveler and my expectations were high. I did find the location to be excellent and the overall stay was pleasant. Housekeeping kept the room spotless and all staff interactions were friendly and helpful. however, there were a few misses for me. first, there was an issue with the shower...no hot water on our first day for a few hours and then after it was restored it never got really hot only lukewarm and would fluctuate wildly during the course of taking shower...hot, cold, hot cold...no bueno! 

also, hardly any shower pressure. secondly, the AC in the room cooled one particular spot (it just so happened to be where I was sleeping on the bed since it was literally right on top of me) very much...but the rest of the room always felt hot...especially the bathroom which was like a sauna at times..no vent... no way to cool it off, and with 90 degrees heat outside you wouldn't want to open the windows either. the TV had Netflix, which I really appreciated especially since I got sick on day two and was stuck in the room for a bunch of days afterwards. I will also add that there was a lady working front desk on my first day at the hotel who was coughing incessantly and violently... so much so that I asked her a few times if she was ok......I got sick two days later and never saw her again...my husband got sick as well. I remember thinking that in these Covid times, no hotel should allow a coughing employee to run the front desk. this experience really did throw wrench into our vacation. there also was only one pretty small closet to accommodate 10 days worth of clothing...it was very tight!!!

 I also thought breakfast could've used a bit of an upgrade, the croissants were stale some days and they ran out...marmalade containers on our table were opened when we got to the table one day, hard boiled eggs were offered in the beginning of our stay but then not on the last 4-5 days...it was a bit of a hodge podge situation.  our bed also wasn't the most comfortable. it was just ok. still, I encountered many lovely employees who were knowledgeable and helpful, the decor was pretty and their location is excellent, so, I will give them 4 stars.

title: Beautiful Hotel in Paris
text: Wonderful hotel in Paris, beautifully decorated lobby. Gorgeous, comfortable spacious room with large bathroom. Entire hotel was immaculately clean. We had a very nice  breakfast each morning. Very friendly and helpful staff. Location was on a quiet street but still close by to Champs, Eiffel Tower, Siene River, shopping and great restaurants.

title: A+ Hotel
text: My wife and I had a lovely week stay here. Breakfast is great, location is prime, room is so clean and comfortable, and staff is tremendous. Enrique is particularly fantastic. He helped us out a lot and provided us the kind of service you can only hope out of a hotel like this! We will be back!

title: West End Hotel - everything we hoped for and then some!
text: The West End Hotel is perfectly situated in Paris within short walking distance to so many attractions and the Paris Metro. The neighborhood (8th Arr.) is lively and busy but the hotel is on a quiet block. The architecture of the hotel is timeless. The lobby, common areas and rooms, while small, are spotless and wonderfully appointed. My girlfriend especially loved the special antique key to the room which made us feel as if we were in a time warp. Breakfast was excellent. Our favorites were the superb coffee and croissants. Best of all is the people who work there and their love and concern for their guests. They quickly learned how we took our coffee, patiently recognized our efforts to use our halting French by responding slowed, etc. Special shout out to Enrique and his crazy stories! Great place! Will be back!

title: Very well positioned
text:
+ Very close to champs elysees
+ Boutique hotel with a vintage beauty to it
+ balcony

-breakfast is free(but mostly pastry), if you want eggs or anything else they charge you 5€
-expensive minibar, 0.7 water= 10€

All in all a good experience, we would recommend this hotel.

title: Almost perfect
text:
Perfect location, walking distance to Trocadero and Eiffel Tower. 
Lovely staff, very attentive and helpful. One lady even gave us her wassap contact and gave us suggestions for bars, restaurants and directions. 
Clean and lovely room.
The drinks in the rooms refrigerator are not complimentary, you will be charged for everything, nobody told us this, hence my 4 star review. The eggs at breakfast are also not included on breakfast and will be charged. There is a close supermarket where you can buy water, beer, snacks, everything if you wish.

title: Superb Hotel - Wow, what a gem.
text: Wow, what a superb find!! Tucked away just off the Champs Elysees. Very elegant reception and superb bedroom, with a balcony. VERY friendly, professional and helpful staff. Superb facilities and spotlessly clean. Highly recommend this lovely hotel.

title: Brilliant and beautiful
text:
We stayed at Hotel West End for two nights in April. This is a gem of a hotel. The decor is stylish and brave, the hotel is immaculate and impeccably designed but retains its original charm. The balcony was perfect for a wonderful continental breakfast. Bed and bathroom both brilliant with everything you could need to hand. 

All of the staff were totally amazing, nothing was too much trouble from directions to brilliant Resterant suggestions and reservations. We will most definitely return to this beautiful hotel with exceptional staff.

The location was perfect for art galleries, designer shops, cafes and great restaurants and walks by the river.

I can not recommend this hotel enough, quite simply brilliant and beautiful.

title: Super friendly, comfortable and convenient
text:
This is one of the nicest and most friendly hotels I've stayed in anywhere in the world. The staff were all lovely, very patient with my terrible French especially the "meerkat" who works nights. It is also very comfortable, I like a big room and am often disappointed that it's not as big as claimed, but in this case it was a bit bigger than I expected, with the style intentionally retro but not too extreme.

The location is very convenient for many attractions (as you can see on the map) including a certain well-known observation tower and the road is relatively quiet for a city centre yet with some nice bistros within a few minutes' walk; if you can manage 5-10 minutes (!) then there really is lots of choice. It's easy for Uber to pick up and drop off here too.

It's worth bearing in mind this is not a big hotel, although they do have 24 hour reception and staff who seem well motivated and willing to do everything they can to make your stay comfortable. So small-ish and friendly with good sized rooms.

The breakfast room is the only exception - we ended up having in-room breakfast (little or no extra cost depending on options) to avoid the risk of not getting a table in time for our attraction bookings and onward travel on the last day. If it wasn't for the Covid situation our plans would be more flexible and I'd worry less; I'm sure it would be fine usually, and as we had a big room with a coffee table and a delicious continental breakfast served including cappuccino, it was a nice treat anyway. I've known hotels to overflow the breakfast room (e.g. to the lounge area) if needed so perhaps they do that, I didn't ask. In short, it's no big deal but good to know what to expect.

Anyway we had no issues at all with our stay, just a really comfortable and good sized room (with a Nespresso machine too for extra coffee!) and a genuine warm welcome from all the staff. Tip: they do speak good English, but a polite Bonjour Monsieur/Madame at the start of each interaction will help to bring out the best from some already very nice people.

title: If we could rate Higher than 5 we would
text: It's like a home away from home and you don't have to make the bed.  But seriously, this is a beautiful hotel with staff to match.  Ms. Fernandez is a master at her craft.  The front desk is ALWAYS kind and helpful.  The gentleman in charge of breakfast is fantastic and so kind.  I might be overusing kind but it fits this hotel staff.  Our room was outstanding with a patio view of the Eiffel tower.

title: Return visit to Fairmont Ajman
text: We have returned to this hotel. Family friendly.  Really good service throughout the day but specifically tonight in the Italian restaurant.  Fantastic service by Samir,  lovely waiter, great assest to Fairmont team.

title: Perfect short break
text: Beautiful hotel in a great location. Room was decorated beautifully with a small balcony which would be perfect in the summer. I had a small issue with the hairdryer that was fixed as soon as I asked so couldn’t fault the attentive & friendly staff. buffet breakfast has an amazing choice of food available, the breakfast room is small for the number of guests but we seemed to always arrive at a good time to get a seat. Very tastefully decorated for Christmas, we had an amazing stay. Some great locations just a short walk away

title: Unique option in Paris amazing value
text:
This hotel is perfect for the mid-range luxury budget who is willing to sacrifice some “resort” amenities for an amazing experience in the heart of one of Paris’ most desirable neighborhoods. 

This hotel is discreet but let me tell you that this is a plus in every imaginable way 

The rooms are massive by Parisian standards and the bathrooms are decadent. The staff are attentive and professional. If you are looking to do luxury on a budget or looking for something a bit different in the center of Paris then I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Exceeded expectations
text:
Stayed in suite. Asked for room with balcony and bathtub and they were able to give me both ! Very helpful staff. They always were able to help in everything you need. This is a lovely boutique hotel and worth ever penny from location to staff to breakfast all was top notch. 
Stay here and you will not be disappointed!

title: Wonderful stay with amazing service
text:
We will definitely be back to stay here.  Very Happy and friendly staff.  Always accommodating our requests. 
Best location!!!!! 
Was very helpful with making last minute reservations. 
Our room was extremely clean and shower had plenty of room to turn inside it. A big plus for me in France.  Lol

title: Perfect hotel in a terrific location!
text: We were fortunate to have a 3 day layover in Paris at the end of a 10 day stay in Croatia.  The West End Hotel was perfect!  Located just off the center of the Champs-Elysées it is in a perfect spot to see the highlights of the city.  Henrique is an amazing host!  He answered all of our questions and attended to our every need with grace and enthusiasm!  I would definitely recommend The West End Hotel for your stay in Paris.

title: So French
text:
Another boutique hotel with great reviews so I had high expectations from it.   Unfortunately I was terribly disappointed.   At first the front desk staff was sort of nice and for some reason,  suddenly they became obnoxious and stand-offish.   I think it was when I corrected the calculation of the black girl in the front desk but I was just being helpful!   I didn’t even make her feel stupid or anything.
But the rooms here are as expected, very very very small!   The bathroom?  I thought I was back in the cruise ship lol.  The elevator even tinier!  The breakfast food was ok.   The breakfast area was just big enough for our group!  Thank goodness we are all early risers so we all got tables.
The location was excellent (again it’s a stone’s throw to Champs Elysees Ave) and the hotel was very filled with French charm.
So why the low rating.   The daytime front desk became very aloof, I felt like I was walking on eggshells.   I didn’t feel comfortable being there.   Thank goodness we were always out and about.  But the night crew was nicer.
So travelers!  Try not to correct the front desk!  Do it after check out!

title: Lovely stay
text: Lovely hotel in a very convenient location. Rooms are comfortable, spaciousand very clean. Breakfast was better than expected. Staff was very polite and accommodating. If something needs to be improved is quality of food. We ordered dinner once and food was very average. Overall, lovely stay and recommended.

title: Beautiful hotel in excellent location
text: i booked junior suite which can accommodate for 3 person. the room is beautiful and comfy bed. The location is excellent. the only thing i wish, hotel have more choice of in house food especially for dinner. overall is beautiful experience in beautiful city in Autumn.

title: The perfect hotel for visiting Paris
text: We can’t recommend this hotel enough! The location is perfect, just a short walk to the Champs-Élysées or the Eiffel Tower. The rooms are fantastic. We have had the pleasure of staying at this hotel twice. The first in a beautiful room with a balcony and a view of the Eiffel Tower. The second we were lucky enough to experience a huge corner room with the most elegant Parisian interior design and 3 floor-to-ceiling windows. We can’t thank the exceptional staff enough for making our stays so wonderful. This will always be our first choice of hotel when visiting Paris!

title: Beautiful Hotel
text: Travelling as a couple we received Such a warm welcome when we first arrived!!! This hotel is in the perfect location for all the major tourist attractions. Our room (Junior Suite) was beautiful with French Boutique decor and also included 2 balconies. The added luxury of Hermes toiletries was wonderful. Would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Paris!

title: Ideal location for a short Paris break.
text: A lovely hotel in a central location, near to all the famous sights. The room was large, comfortable and very quiet. An added advantage of staying at this hotel was that breakfast was included, consisting of fruit, bread, croissants, juice etc. Staff were friendly and helpful. I have stayed in Paris several times, this was the best hotel by far.

title: Perfect Paris Paradise
text:
The West End Hotel exceeded my expectations!! From the time we arrived we felt like family! The front desk staff is
friendly, knowledgeable and incredibly helpful!!
We enjoyed breakfast each morning in
our room. We were able to sit outside on
the patio and dine.
The location is superb!!
So quiet and truly what you would imagine 
a French hotel to be!!
The only thing was the carpet needs to
be replaced and it looks like a remodel for
2020.

We will definitely stay here again!!

Thanks to morning Enrique & night 
Enrique you made my stay magical!!

The Christmas decorations that were put
up while we were there truly added to the
ambiance of the hotel.

We loved the neighborhood!! So many
amazing restaurants and shops!!

Thank you❤❤❤

title: Beautiful hotel with exceptional service!
text: We had the most beautiful stay at this hotel for five nights. We were a travelling party of three generations, my mother and my daughter. The staff were incredibly helpful, going above and beyond whenever we had a question or needed information. The hotel is perfectly position, we could walk to many famous tourist spots and had easy access to the hop on hop off bus. There were also a variety of food options catering to a wide variety of budgets within walking distance. Thank you to all of the staff for making our trip to Paris so memorable.

title: Outstanding staff, beautiful hotel.
text:
This hotel was absolute perfection. The room was beautiful, high end and with a view to of the Eiffel Tower. It’s a short walk to Champs-Élysées, the Eiffel Tower, Avenue Montaigne etc. Very central. Breakfast was yummy and the rooms were meticulously clean. 
The real treasure of this hotel, however, is it’s Outstanding Staff. Incredibly friendly and helpful, they go out of their way to make you feel absolutely welcome. Special mention to Enrique and the night attendant, but truly everyone was great. We will absolutely stay here again.

title: Great Experience
text:
The location was great.  Easy walking distance from Eiffel Tower, Champs Elysees, and Arc De Triomphe.  Longish walk to Louvre ... but a great walk on a pleasant day.

Staff was excellent, informative, and pleasant.

The accommodations were superb ... hotel gave us an upgrade ... which was kind and appreciated.

For us this turned out to be the perfect hotel for a great trip.

title: Nice hotel
text: The good thing about this hotel are ;  the hotel in the centre of Paris, the staff are nice. The room is good. 4 nights stay here fells like home. The breakfast is good but for 4 nights stay with same breakfast little bit boring, but it’s OK. We recommend this hotel.

title: Very Beautiful and Friendly Hotel
text:
If I am fortunate enough to visit Paris again, this is the only hotel I would consider. I have stayed at two other hotels in the city, but this was my favorite by far. The location is convenient to get around the rest of the city, the building and the rooms are beautiful and the best part is how kind and welcoming the staff are. Being in a foreign country can be intimidating for some people, but with the level of friendliness that the staff show to guests, it makes things so much nicer to have assistance from warm staff (I witnessed a lot of interaction between guests and staff since I spent a couple of afternoons in their lounge area working on assignments).

In particular, I would like to make special mention of the night staff employee named Henrique. He was so kind and extra helpful during our stay!

title: Beautiful Hotel!
text: Beautiful rooms, great location, good breakfast, great service!  Highly recommended!  200 characters are too much.  No point in just running on when I’ve said it all.  Loved it, would go back.  Excellent!!

title: Exceptional staff
text: This was our last night on a 7 week trip and we couldn’t have picked a better place to stay.  The hotel is wonderfully kept to a high standard and the staff were exceptional.  Our room comfortable, spacious and everything we need.   It was my wife’s birthday and the staff did everything they could to make it a special day for her, they even made me look good by giving some recommendation on where to take her.  The location of the hotel is great and the wifi strong and reliable.  The hotel is wonderful but the staff make it exceptional.  Next time back in Paris this is where we will stay.

title: Beautiful Parisian Modern Hotel
text: Very friendly & welcoming staff from the moment we arrived.  Beautifully decorated modern chic comfortable hotel room and bathroom.  The breakfast & coffee were always fresh,hot & delicious every morning. Having a computer and printer in the reception area was very helpful.  If we were ever to return to Paris I would definitely return to the West End Hotel.

title: Good hotel
text: More than happy with this hotel. Good rooms and service. Would return. Paris was lovely too and the location of hotel was good. Thank you! Hopefully I will return one day- Paris is beautiful and magical.

title: Amazing experience. Exceptional staff!
text: No words can express how wonderful this hotel was. I chose this hotel because of the reviews and the location and I’m very pleased to say all the reviews were not generous enough. We were in Paris for the first time celebrating my daughter’s 18th birthday and the hotel made this event extremely memorable with balloons, cake, champagne and more. It was perfect! This hotel is beautifully decorated with a true Paris feel, the room was exceedingly clean, and the location was ideal for restaurants, shopping and attractions. But the very best part of this hotel is the exceptionally professional staff, they were friendly, helpful, always a smile and went above and beyond to make our stay with them a memorable one. All hotels should aspire to be this wonderful. Five stars are not good enough! I highly recommend the Hotel West End for anyone traveling to Paris and be sure to ask for Henrique Rodrigues at reception to arrange your stay, he is remarkable!

title: Best-End Hotel
text: Stayed at the West End Hotel for 6 nights and we were thoroughly impressed. Impeccable customer service and friendly staff, clean rooms, great views and a fresh and delicious breakfast every morning. We felt very taken care of and the location was within walking distance of the Seine, Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe and more. Merci beaucoup!!

title: Nice Hotel, Good Location, But . . .
text:
Nice small French hotel in a convenient location within walking distance to the Eiffel Tower or the Arche de Triumphe but service was disappointing. Breakfast was OK at best (2 of 5 days there were no Hard Boiled Eggs BUT the chef would cook you an Omelet for an extra 5 Euro ???).  The desk staff was attentive but didn't get things done.  We had no Air Conditioning for 2 nights. Before 2nd night we were told it was fixed BUT not.  We had an early excursion planned for a day and they offered a small breakfast since it was before hours. When we came down, the person at the desk knew nothing about it (I saw it written in the book the day before). We were given one yogurt each but nothing else.  On the last day, we ordered a taxi the night before BUT when we came down, we were told the internet connection to the taxi company was not working (what about the phones?). We were told to walk down to the Boulevard by a larger hotel and get a cab there ??? 
Overall, poor service. Especially disappointed by lack of A/C. They did give us a bttle of wine which would have done the trick for one day but the 2nd night was inexcusable.  
We won't be going back.

title: Beautiful and Convenient
text: The West End Hotel is simply beautiful. The staff was very welcoming from the start and the room was beautiful. It is very convenient to shopping and restaurants. The Eiffel Tower is a 10-15 minute walk and there is so much to do in between. We really enjoyed the breakfast available each morning. It was a delicious start to our day. On our last morning, our driver arrived early and texted me in French. The concierge was super helpful. He spoke with the driver and translated for us. We checked out in a flash and were on our way. I don't think it would have gone as smoothly without the amazing staff.

title: Not worth the money
text: First, the best part of this hotel is the front desk staff and people who help with your bags.  Upon check in we were told we were upgraded.  When we got to our room, we found a room with stains on the floor, lighting that was wired very oddly (like we had desk lamps but couldnt turn them on without having the overhead light on), we had outlets which were loose to the wall and looked like you could see behind where they attached into the wall and we had a shower which just leaked all over the floor because the glass of the shower didnt come far enough over to protect things.  Wifi was horrible and although we could connect to it, it did not work where we could actually go to any websites on it.  Also, we had a long day one day and were very tired.  We ordered some food only to find out that they wouldnt let you eat the food in your room.  We had to basically negotiate with the front desk staff on another place to eat.  I found this ironic because they would bring breakfast to your room and have stains all over your room but, they wouldnt let you eat in your own room.  Breakfast was a basic continental breakfast and they up charge for things like bacon, which i think is just nitpicking at an already overpriced hotel.  For what was paid for the room, i wouldnt stay here again.  The staff was helpful though and i felt bad for the guy who brought us our bags as he has to walk the steps with everyones luggage.  I also want to say that if we were upgraded, i dont want to know what the original room may have been like.  I also remember hearing people complain about issues they were having to the front desk person and so i know it wasnt just me.  We honestly just wanted to get through paris and onto our next stop.

title: Weekend Break
text:
Well what an absolutely delightful find! So pleased my best friend booked this hotel as a surprise present for my 21st. The pro's and con's include:

+ Amazing customer service, so friendly, especially the evening warden and the gentleman on front desk in the day. Helped us have a room with a balcony as it was my birthday.
+ Incredible location, 1 minute walk from Avenue Montagne (with Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Balenciaga etc)
+Superior Room (Request for a balcony) we had a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower, as was able to request breakfast in our room on our balcony.
+Spacious room and bathroom in a safe and secure location

-Walls are rather thin as I could hear next doors conversation.
-No battled water complimentary in our room.

In all, would highly recommend. Have already sent to my family, and looking to come back!

title: Lovely stay in Paris!
text: We had a lovely experience at the West End Hotel! It’s in a great location and within walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and the Champs Elysees. The rooms were beautiful and you could see the tip of the Eiffel Tower  from ours. The staff was also so nice and helpful!! We also enjoyed the breakfast which was delicious and had lots of gluten free options for me. We would definitely return here when back in Paris!

title: A great hotel
text: This is a great hotel with very friendly staff and great service. Reception has staff that help you book trips and restaurant booking which we found great. Breakfast was lovely it was continental with a great choice and you could order hot at a extra cost. Rooms were good with ac you could turn up or down, the bathroom had plenty of hot water. They run a honesty bar which came handy when you fancied a drink without going out. Would we go back again yes we would.

title: A birthday/anniversary trip
text:
Location = great 
Beds = wonderful
Shower pressure = perfect 
The staff  = friendly , helpful , professional , and welcoming ! 
Did I miss something?  
This was not our first trip to Paris . We have stayed at many other locations in the city . This hotel far exceeded our expectations and provided an affordable luxury stay in the amazing magical city of Paris . I’m torn between recommending it (highly) or keeping it as a guarded treasured secret 
To the staff at The West End ... thanks for a perfect stay !

title: Great location and staff
text: This is a cute little boutique hotel located on a quiet side street. It is steps away from the Champ Elysèes, Eieffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, the Louvre and more. You couldn't have asked for a better location. If you like to walk and use public transportation, then this is a great place to be. The metro is close, but that seems to be the norm. The best thing about our stay is the staff. They are friendly, ready to give you advice and go out of their way to get to know you. They hotel offers a nice continental breakfast. There is no restaurant or workout facilities. You don't need that given it's so close to so many cafes, restaurants, etc. There is even a little grocery store around the corner on Rue Marbeouf as well as wine shops. If you are looking to stay fit, this area and most of Paris, is made for walking, running and cycling. Our room was very clean. The bathroom is a decent size. The only complaint is the tub wasn't draining quickly enough after our second day. I pulled up the stopper and it was ok. I didn't complain because it didn't cause me any issues, but is something the hotel may want to assess. It is an older and updated property so these are likely. My cousin and I stayed in the executive room and it was more than comfortable for two women sharing the space. This is Paris, not North America, and you should be realistic about your expectations. Things are scaled smaller here. The air conditioning worked really well and our stay was very comfortable.

title: First Impressions matter for a reason!
text: This was my first time visiting Paris, I was on my honeymoon with my wife and wanted as well as hoped the trip would go well.. Needless to say all expectations were surpassed as soon as we walked in the doors. The hotel, decorated in Parisian elegance, the receptionist Fabiana well we couldn't have been happier with her service and assistance throughout our stay. From making our reservations at fine restaurants to recommendations, supreme service. I hope she gets a raise! The hotel was clean and wonderful. You must include the breakfast they offer for your stay, top notch service. The room was comfortable and cleaned daily but I must say the winner was the water pressure that was fantastic. I enjoyed showering 3 times a day after our adventurous walks in the hot Parisian summer. Stay here and you will be so pleased.

title: Amazing staff and great location!
text: Me and my husband stayed here for our wedding Anniversary and we absolutely loved it! The location is great right next to Champs - Elysee and walking distance from the Eiffel Tower and Arc de triomphe! The staff were absolutely brilliant, really friendly and helpful! The room was a little small but we had a balcony with a view to the Eiffel Tower and had breakfast served in our room every morning. Would highly recommend and we will most definitely be staying here again!

title: Excellent Location, good breakfast
text: Location was perfect for sightseeing in Paris.  We traveled with 4 teenagers and they were able to walk to the Eiffel tower in the evening without any problem.  We either walked our grabbed an Uber everywhere.  Staff was friendly and very helpful.  Breakfast in the morning was perfect for us.  Would recommend.

title: Great stay!
text: Great location and amazing view of the Eiffel Tower from our balcony on the 5th floor! Was very convenient to buy our Paris Museum Pass from the front desk. Only negative was hearing noise from the street. While we were there a celebration occurred for a soccer win and we heard the noise all night.

title: Outstanding Service for Families
text:
Traveling to Paris with kids in tow is never an easy task - most difficult for me has been finding accommodations for 4. Hotel West End was the perfect choice! 

We booked a junior suite through the website that can sleep 4. They set it to have 1 large bed for 2, plus place a mattress on the sofa, plus bring in a pop-up bed. Overall that was much nicer than just a fold out sofa. If I did it again I would call the hotel directly to book though... online the reservation didn’t go through as for 4 and I had to pay an additional 100 EUR/nt upon arrival. 

The room was great for us (a shower and a bath in Paris!) and comfortable. Room service was sufficient when used. Breakfast was very nice (esp since included) but not outstanding. WiFi was a little spotty from our room. 

The particular standout was the service from the attentive staff. Everyone was extremely friendly! They really make the place feel like home and went above and beyond on any simple request or question. We were in Paris during the recent heatwave and the AC in the room wasn’t keeping up - one mention and the staff had it fixed immediately with follow ups to see how we were doing. They really were great hosts.

title: Awesome Stay
text: Great location, really pleasant and clean rooms( smelled nice didnt have to use my plug in I traveled with0, but the thing that makes this such a good place to stay are the staff. All of the people are incredibly helpful and generous with their time and advice. We stayed for 5nights. The room key was so cute

title: Location, Style, & An Amazing Staff!
text: My husband and I recently celebrated his 50th Birthday with a trip to Paris and our experience at West End Hotel absolutely made our vacation. The location is fantastic, so close to the Champs Elysees and the Seine, and the decor is a fabulous mix of modern and antique. We were thrilled with our room, the breakfast at the hotel, but mostly with the staff, all of whom were incredibly helpful and kind. Henrique in particular was so charming and hilarious, sharing tips and stories with us our first night when we stopped for a drink from the honesty bar (a nice touch). We were happy with all of the amenities, from Hermes toiletries to free room service for breakfast, they made us feel special. Our bed, pillows, and linens were so comfortable, and even in the heat wave our AC worked like a dream. The balcony was gorgeous and we loved the style, size, and feel of our room and the hotel itself. Love, love, love West End Hotel!!!

title: A hotel that makes you feel at home
text:
My wife and I spent a week in this hotel. In summary, it is the best travel experience that I've had in my life. It's closely located to Champs-Elysees, Avenue Montaigne, and la Seine. This conveniency allows me to walk or ride scooters everyday to explore the best of Paris. The complementary breakfast is tasty and can be served in-room as well. The room is clean, and I also like the vintage room key.

But what makes the hotel excel is their service. Every staff member I encountered, from front desk to break room, is super friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Henrique, who's humorous and welcoming (also speaks perfect English), we felt at home the whole time. You can always strike an engaging conversation with him thanks to his personable demeanor. This wonderful experience has made it the only choice for me to stay if I come back to Paris.

title: 5-star services and infrastructure
text:
Few things about west end hotel that makes us feel like home and love Paris (despite the horrible heat wave during our stay) 

1. 5-star customer service 
We are welcomed by a hand written note and a box of chocolate, which is very sweet and a nice start for our honeymoon trip. Staff here are really nice and helpful, they are able to provide good advice and help to your enquiry, they also give you warm welcome when you are back to the hotel. Special thanks to Henrique, he is a funny and warm guy who is also very helpful and friendly, talking to him makes us so happy and look forward to be back to the hotel. He also helped us to reserve a taxi to airport which arrives on time, very reliable and good experience. You could also have your breakfast at your room without any extra charge, just relax and enjoy your time! 

2. Infrastructure 
Very beautiful decor in the lobby and the view in the hotel is amazing. You may get a room with balcony, which is a traditional Parisian balcony and you can enjoy the beautiful view. You may even be able to see the Eiffel Tower from your room! Amenities are adequate, even hair conditioner is provided and they are branded Hermes. That makes you feel pampered.

Breakfast is great, location is also excellent with a few famous restaurants nearby. Overall it’s a very good experience and thank you the West End team for the excellent service.

title: Elegant Parisian Hotel
text: Hotel was an easy walk from the Champs-Elysées. Staff were very welcoming and friendly on our arrival. Our room was beautifully decorated and immaculately clean. The bed and bedding made for a relaxing sleep. Breakfast was scrumptious. Overall we had a very enjoyable stay and we would highly recommend it to anyone planning a stay in Paris. If you can request a fifth floor room with a balcony and view of the Eiffel Tower.

title: Beautiful Luxury Hotel
text: I only have good things to say about this hotel.  I travel a lot for work and stay in beautiful hotels, and this hotel is awesome and ranks with the best!  First the staff was so helpful and friendly to me and my friend.  We were there for a girls weekend and they made us feel so special. Loved the amenities in the room...Hermès!  Room was large for European standards and CLEAN!!  Bed linens crisp and fell sleep upon hitting the pillow.  We had a balcony and had breakfast delivered every morning.  It was in a very centrally located area so everything was walkable.  Safe neighborhood for sure.  This is the Hotel to stay at, seriously look no further. I cannot say anything negative.  LOVED OUR STAY!

title: Amazing Stay, Service, Location and Experience at West End!
text:
Just stay here!!

I always like to stay in smaller boutique hotels and West End definitely met those expectations. My mom and I stayed here for a week. A week prior I had emailed the hotel for a balcony room - we stayed in a standard room - and we were fortunate enough to get one. It was a wonderful addition to breakfast in the mornings. The location is very safe and close to two metro stops (5-7 min). The room we had was a standard room - it was clean and comfortable and spacious enough for two people. If I had more budget I would probably stayed in a bigger room since those looked more nice and decorated but this was perfect. If you have the budget do it. 

The staff was always super fantastic and super welcoming and fun to talk to.  The only con I could think of and it its very personal is changing the carpet it looked a little outdated but other than that no flaw. 

 The hotel is on the higher end but you have to remember you are in Paris and the location of this hotel is expensive. It is worth it. Breakfast is included but if you want eggs or fresh juice it is $5 euros more. Overall the price is worth it. Oh and the toiletries are so nice - Hermes - a nice touch. 

I would definitely stay here again.

title: "Perfect"
text: Excellent location, impeccable cleanliness, towels and high quality bedding. Typical French breakfast. The reception staff speak Portuguese and are extremely friendly and receptive. Great benefit x cost ratio. Anyway, a perfect hotel to spend a week in Paris.

title: Lovely place near Avenue des Champs-Élysées
text:
Me and my sister stayed  this lovely hotel 4 nights for our spring vacation and we had very nice time. First, our flight was early morning and arrived the hotel around 10am, but the front staff were so nice and just one our later we could checked in our room. During the waiting time, we could have breakfast at the cafe on Avenue des Champs-Élysées. 
Next, our hotel booking site sent a survey for the first impression and I wrote I need more towels. From next day, we were specially arranged more towels in our room. We were very impressed the service.
Location, breakfast, room size, staffs etc, they are just right for us and we definitely will here back on next travel.

title: Beautiful Parisian hotel
text: Had a wonderful experience at this perfectly located and beautifully decorated hotel. Small and personal, the staff knew us by name and attended to our needs perfectly. Rooms were spacious (especially by European standards!) and were clean and comfortable. Breakfast was delicious as well! Would highly recommend a stay here.

title: Impeccable
text:
Me and my wife actually stayed here back in August 2016. Coming from Croatia, Montenegro, Germany then Iceland, Paris was the last leg of our second honeymoon. We were very excited as it was both our first time in the city, but at the same time we were a bit tired from all the traveling from the past few weeks. 

The lady at the reception was very warm in welcoming us. A few days back, we convinced our friend to stay at West End too, but he ended up with a double booking at the same hotel. The said lady at the reception was kind enough to go through all the calls with expedia and booking.com (if I’m not mistaken) to sort everything out. I forgot her name, but I’ll attach a photo on this review. 

The bellman Arnande (I hope I got his name right) was also very courteous and was very accommodating even if he had to bring all our luggages up alone, he did it with a smile. He also assisted us every morning for breakfast, after asking on the first morning for coffee for me and hot cocoa for my wife, he made sure on the succeeding mornings that we had our coffee and hot cocoa ready for breakfast. 

Upon reaching our room, there was a very heart warming note on the table, a note from the staff welcoming us on our honeymoon. This came along with a small box of Laduree chocolate which I immediately consumed. 😆

The room was what I imagined a Parisian room would be. Then I looked out the window and was very pleased to see that we had a little view of the Eiffel Tower. We loved our room! Everything was impressively clean. 

Before our trip a lot of people told us that Parisians were snooty and snobs. Our experience at West End Hotel (and our whole stay in Paris as well) proved the opposite. Everyone we encountered were very warm, accommodating and very friendly, even all the Uber drivers we rode with.

Will definitely stay here again when we visit Paris again!

title: Great Customer Service
text:
Even before we arrived the desk staff made us feel welcomed. I had emailed them several times, and always received a prompt response. Upon arrival they welcomed us by name, and had upgraded our room after discovering we were in Paris to celebrate our anniversary. 

Our room was decorated beautifully, it had a view of the Eiffel Tower, the hotel was in a great location for walking to that area, and it felt safe. Our complimentary breakfast was very good, and so was the meal we ordered via room service. When the flat iron I had brought from home wouldn't work they obtained one for me! 

It's a boutique hotel, so not everything is new and modern, but that's a part of its charm. We loved the elevator which is about the size of a phone booth! 

This was our first visit to Paris, and the staff at West End played a huge part in why we left with such wonderful memories. My husband was unprepared for such exceptional service. It's certainly not what he's used to here. Haha.

title: Very nice stay
text:
The West End Hotel is a lovely place to stay for many reasons. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The location is in an upscale area in very safe. The walk to the Eiffel Tower was about 10 minutes. And it was through a very high-end shopping area. The breakfasts were terrific. The room was very large and decorated nicely. There was complimentary wine fruit and water bottles in the room. Overall it was a terrific place to stay.
Peter
From Massachusetts.

title: Okay! Needs room for improvement
text: So this is my 2nd time staying at the West End Hotel and this may very well be my last time. I originally booked a Deluxe room but upon checking I didn’t like my room and I ask to switch to different room the next day which is was a Jr. Suite.  The Jr. Suite was very big but they were multiple chip walls that needed fresh paint, the entry door to the room and bathroom door on the inside on the bottom left wood pieces were chip and broken off. I understand that hotels have ware and tears but I believe it’s very important to schedule time to improve and make necessary maintenance to rooms especially when your charging a lot of money for it. I work in hospitality and being a 2nd time returning guest I didn’t really felt “A genuine Welcome”  My welcome note for my Birthday I was refer to as “Mr.” instead of “Miss”. The young lady that checked me although very nice did not know I was a returning guest and had to be told that I was. Little things like this makes and break a hotel.  Hotel location is central to everything but the amenities such as room services is very limited and have not improve since my last stayed. Overall the staff are nice but the hiccup with my “Welcoming” was unacceptable and the rooms needs maintenance.

title: Fabulous Hotel in Perfect Location
text: I spent 6 glorious nights at the West End in early May.  It's in a safe, chic neighborhood between two Metro stops (FDR & Alma Marceau) & right around the corner from the famed Plaza Athanee.  I was warmly welcomed by Henri & Fabienne.  The lobby & breakfast room are beautifully decorated as was my room overlooking the Rue Chambiges.  I loved the high ceilings & the floor to ceiling doors overlooking the street - so Parisian.  Flower filled window boxes are on the wrought iron railings of each room.  The bed was firm which I like & the pillows were heaven.  It was so nice to be able to go back after a long day of sightseeing & have a hot bath in such lovely surroundings.  I thoroughly enjoyed breakfast each morning & Ibrahaim was always so kind & helpful.  I did a lot of research on Paris hotels before finally settling on the West End because 6 nights can be a long time if you're not happy with where you're staying.  I'm so glad I decided on the West End & know precisely where I'll stay on my next trip to Paris.

title: Best location in Paris with staff that feels like family!
text: This hotel is perfect in every way!  The location is the best!  It is right next to the most expensive hotel in all of Paris (that says a lot) The rooms are beautiful, beautifully maintained, and the staff felt like family right away!  When we go back to Paris, there is no other place I would stay!

title: Great staff and location
text: The West End hotel is nicely located between the Seine and the Champs Elysee.  There are 2 metro stops about 10 minutes away and it is in a quiet area with a couple of small restaurants a few minutes away.  The room was a decent size for a European hotel, and the bathroom was almost as big as the room and included a tub.  The room also had an honor bar/mini fridge and a hot water pot with coffee/tea.  Additionally, there was a small patio with 2 chairs and a table.  The breakfast included in the room fee had a good selection of cereal, fruit, yogurt, bread, pastries, meats, and cheeses.  The staff were terrific and extremely welcoming and helpful.  Several went out of their way to help us with out of the city trips (packing us a breakfast to go) and local running routes of specific distances.

title: Woderful stat at a great hotel
text: We were greeted with a big smile from the three people in the reseption. The rom was beautiful. I especially loved the bathroom with the big tub. The breakfast in the cute little diningroom was just perfect for us. Everytime we were going anywere we got the help we needed. We really felt we were wanted.

title: Not sure about all the glowing reviews... hotel was okay.
text:
We booked this hotel because of all the great reviews, and I was really hoping to love the place. First the pluses: check in was prompt. Room was spotless (very happy with how clean the room was during our entire stay). Room was small, but decent size for Paris. I appreciated the bath salts that was provided everyday. Really nice to have a soak after a day of sightseeing. The location is great - i love that it's only a short walk to the Seine and great view of the Eiffel Tower.

Now the not-so-great: 
The walls to the rooms are thin! The first morning, I was woken up from our neighbor's alarm clock. It sounded like it was right next to me. We were awaken many times at night during our stay. We can hear the drainage system next to our room. The window to the balcony (pretty and nice) doesn't close well and the street noise can be heard as well.

The breakfast area is small and cramped. They have small small cafe style tables, and it's just too tiny for 2 people to eat comfortably. The food was okay, and the server was friendly and helpful. But there was only 1 server for 7-8 tables. It was almost impossible for the 1 person to clean the tables, get coffees, and keep the serving table stocked. The waiter is great, but they really should have at least 2 people working during the peak breakfast time. They have a nice honor system wine selection at their salon. But their little nespresso machine is also honor system and charges 4 euros per cup. We've stayed in many hotels that have nice espresso machines free of charge for their guests, and this is the first place that charges. The nickel and diming doesn't feel good at all. Just charge the room a few more euros! 

It seems the hotel is trying to make itself into an upscale hotel, but in my view not successful in their attempt. The breakfast staff were friendly and helpful, but the front desk not so much.

title: affordable price with incredible service
text: west end hotel is a wonderful hotel for you to stay in paris with wonderful view and service. enjoy your breakfast with eiffle tower . also, accessible location is also outstanding than the other hotel.

title: Chic and intimate
text: Super hotel in typical french style.On my list to got back.   Lovely decor and well appointed rooms of a good size for a central Paris hotel.  The hotel is well located in a quiet side street with a few restaurants (Le relais d'entrecote for steak and chips and Chez Andre for typical french food) both super and for the Paris attractions and not far the high end stores for shopping.  Staff very helpful and could not do enough for you.    The metro is only 500 metres away, and the station just the other side of the river about 15 minutes walk if you want to catch the train out to Versilles.

title: Trip to Paris
text: We stayed at the hotel West End since the 8th till the 13th of March, so I am writing this review from the pane :). It's a very pleasant, cosy, stylish and convenient place. The location is great just 6-8  minutes to Champ Elysees. There are nice bistro and restaurants around, shops for any taste. But the biggest value of this hotel is the staff. We have been in many hotels, there were hotels much more luxurious but I think here they have great professionals and amazing people which is rear combination. Two guys at the front desk who have the same name Henrique (one on a day shift and the other is on the night shift) are incredible. They surrounded us with a family kind care and attention.  Always ready to help with anything, give a wonderful recommendation, print everything what we needed. Sorry I don't know the name of their colleague who also helped us quite a bit with printing our stuff and being ready to help with anything. Everyone whom we met at the hotel made everything to make our visit unforgettable and relaxing. Thank you very much!

title: Beautiful, Charming, Great Location.
text: I stayed here 3 nights my first visit to Paris. We arranged for their car service (extra fee) to pick us up from the airport. Our driver was warm and friendly, picking us up in a black Mercedes. The hotel is small but charming and beautifully decorated. Especially their lobby. You can pour yourself a drink or nightcap on the honor system. The staff is friendly and accommodating, helping us with our French, restaurant suggestions, directions...pretty much everything a visitor may need help with. The rooms are small but not claustrophobic especially because our room had a balcony with a view of the Eiffel Tower. It was lovely to open the french doors at night and sit on the balcony. They offer complimentary breakfast downstairs or they'll bring it to your room at no additional charge. Everything was fresh. It's located in a very nice area with plenty of restaurants within walking distance. There is also a little market around the corner where you can pickup snacks, drinks and french bread! It's across the street from the police department though we never heard any sirens and also around the corner is the hotel Carrie Bradshaw stayed with Alexander in Sex and The City. It's a pleasant one mile walk to the Eiffel Tower or the Arc de Triomphe and great shopping is nearby too. It's also a quick Uber drive to the Louvre. Even though it's located near tourist attractions, it isn't hyper busy in that area. It's a perfect location to squeeze in a lot in a few days and to get a stroll in and really absorb Paris. Prior to our arrival we had several questions  that were quickly answered by their friendly staff. I would definitely stay again and highly recommend.

title: Beautiful! We loved it! We enjoyed it! We are going Back!!! Soon!
text:
I looked for days and hours and read dozens of reviews here in TripAdvisor of reviews in Hotels in Paris. This lovely hotel had excellent reviews and the price was great so I 
 booked  it! It was a delighful wonderful surprise! The employees are very nice, helpful and corteous! The lovely lady who is the manager (originally from Mexico), and speaks several languages (spoke with my mom is Spanish) was wonderful!! She is an asset to that hotel. The room was gorgeous and the balconies are precious! The breakfast was outstanding! I was so happily suprise and yes all the reviews are just exactly what we experienced. Plus the location is amazing - between Arch of Triump and Eiffel Tower!! Great location! I cannot wait to go back with my family! 5 starts to a 5 stars class hotel! This hotel is a Gem!! Sincerely. G

title: The hotel staff and location were excellent
text:
1. The hotel service was excellent
2. The room was small but very nice and clean. You can see the Eiffel Tower from the balcony. Balcony table and chairs are an added plus.
3. Location was great. We could easily walk to the many of the top tourist sites.
4. The Hotel staff is excellent. The staff was both helpful and informative.
5.Based on hotel staff and hotel location we chose Hotel West End again.

title: Wonderful
text: Upgraded room free on arrival which had view of Eiffel Tower. Quiet room. Very clean. Breakfast was lovely. Ten minute walk to the tower and five minutes away from amazing shopping. Ideal location and would definitely recommend to friends and family

title: Review of Hotel West End
text:
The Hotel West End is an exquisitely appointed hotel in an excellent location. Our room was a complimentary upgrade and was stunning - beautiful architectural effects, beautiful powder blue and gold duchesse curtains, beautiful bar and stunning marble bathroom with Hermès toiletries.  Breakfast was lovely in another lovely setting.  Will absolutely stay at this beautiful hotel again. 

Madelaine

title: Vacation
text:
We love staying here !! Felt we were home , everyone is very nice and made us feel welcome , service great ! Clean , elegant , perfect location,excellent experience!!, we know now where to stay in Paris from now on . 
Thanks to all of your team West End hotel !!

title: Fantastic Boutique Hotel in Prime Location
text:
Staff are absolutely brilliant and friendly. The lady on reception even remembered us by face so by the second night she had our key waiting for us.

The breakfast is lovely and a wide choice for a continental. There are few seats but as we were travelling in off-peak season and the hotel only has about 40 odd rooms this was fine.

The sheets did have a little blood stain on the pillow and a rip in the duvet cover, but we didn't complain about this, otherwise i'm sure it would have been fixed.

It is in a prime location and took us 10 minutes to walk to the arc de triomphe, 20 minutes walk to eiffel tower and 5 to the champs elesee avenue. There is also a pharmacy, police station and great bakery nearby as well as the quaint, authentic french bistro chez andre.

I would not recommend ordering evening room service as this was just served in glass pots that no doubt had just been heated up. It came with fresh bread which was lovely but as you are in the centre of Paris this isn't necessary. We just ordered as we were so tired from all the walking we had done that day and had bad blisters! As the hotel has no real restaurant, we weren't expecting the room service to be amazing.

Would definitely recommend and would stay here again.

P.S The hermes toiletries were a great bonus!

title: Great stay!
text: We stayed 6 nights and loved it. The hotel is well situated, surrounded by good eateries and fabulous history. Notre Dame and the Pantheon both  only  a short distance from the hotel. Knowledgeable and friendly staff, with good English.  Hotel  -well -maintained.  Bright and attractive breakfast area. Would be happy to stay there  again.
description: L'hotel Abbatial Saint Germain est idéalement situé à l'extrémité du Boulevard Saint Germain, à proximité de la cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris, de l'île Saint Louis et du Panthéon. Sa situation en plein coeur du Quartier Latin lui confère un atout de choix pour la garantie d'un séjour inoubliable à Paris. title: Perfect location and a traditional Paris hotel
text:
With more than two dozen visits to Paris in various neighborhoods, we had a first-timer in our group and we wanted to show her quintessential Paris. Located where Saint-Germain-des-Pres and the Latin Quarter meet, it would be difficult to find a better place to enjoy historic Paris. 

As for the hotel itself, there have been fairly recent renovations and while the rooms are small, they are comfortable and provide a great place to rest after a day of walking the beautiful streets, beginning with Boulevard Saint Germain, right outside the front door. Don't bring a steamer trunk; it's a very small elevator in which three is literally a crowd. We used the spiral staircase going down, but waits were not excessive going up. Our fifth floor corner room featured small balconies out each window, complete with a small table and chairs. There's a breakfast room in the basement and it's popular with guests in the morning. The staff is friendly and helpful. We give this hotel good grades for housekeeping and ambiance. We've used it a couple of times and would gladly return.

title: GREAT location and clean with friendly staff. Very small but decently appointed rooms. VERY BAD ARRIVAL EXPERIENCE.
text:
Got a good deal so we booked. The Hotel is literally one block from Notre Dame and the Seine and was centrally located to other sightseeing locations so that kept down Uber fees. There’s a few good restaurants, an excellent bakery and a pharmacy very close to hotel (all less than a block away - or literally next door). 

Our arrival experience however, was a NIGHTMARE. I called hotel Friday evening of the 5th of April to advise them our flight was going to be late. Was told by young man “No Problem, we are open all night”. Arrived at 01:30 AM and after giving  our name, was told by same young man that “I gave your room away”. WTF. He stated that someone came in and without verifying their name, thought it was the man who called (me) and gave him our room. 

He did apologize, and after frantically clicking on computer, told us he could put us in same type room on 5th floor!  Unfortunately the elevator was broken! We had to haul 5 heavy pieces of luggage up 5 stories with my wife having had recent ACL surgery!!!!  After we got to 5th floor, sweating profusely (now around 2:00 AM) he called and said he found “bigger” room on the first floor and would come help with our bags. So at 2:00 AM we had to haul the same 5 bags BACK DOWN 5 flights of steps which was horrible and affected my wife’s ability to walk around the next day!!!!! 

The rest of the visit went well, although the “larger room” given us had a horrific “view” of an internal alley which stank of garbage with windows open and the smell of smoking. DO NOT ACCEPT ROOM 11 OR OTHER ROOMS WITH SAME FACING. 

The only plus was it was quieter with no street noise. Not sure how much “bigger” it really was in reality. 

The rooms are clean and relatively modern, but stuffy and hot. None of the air or ventilation controls worked so we had to open windows (garbage and smoking smell again). 

Had NO IDEA there was breakfast area in basement as this was not explained upon arrival so I’m not sure that I didn’t have to buy breakfast elsewhere like I did. Wish they would have said something. 

The other thing I don’t like is that they make you “surrender” your room key when you leave every time which seems quite unnecessary and weird but they demand it. Never had to do that elsewhere but they claim it’s for “security”. Again WTF. 

All in all and given the issues it’s a good hotel because it is clean and in a good location. They certainly “missed” upon our arrival and as long as you avoid room 11 and the like, you should be fine.

title: Loved Staying at Hotel Abbatial Saint Germain
text:
My husband and I stayed at Hotel Abbatial Saint Germain for nearly a week, and loved it.  It's in our favorite neighborhood in Paris, and is very centrally located.  It's within five minutes of walking to Notre Dame.  It's a pretty easy walk to The Louvre and other attractions.  There are many restaurants nearby.  Gladines next door, which specializes in Basque cuisine was a revelation.

There is a Metro stop very close to the hotel.  Also, it's pretty easy to hail a taxi on Boulevard Saint Germain.

We arrived fairly early at the this hotel, and, thankfully our room was ready.  We were staying in a deluxe room, so our room was spacious.  It was on the third floor and had a corner positioning.  We had spectacular views of the church across the street and of the Boulevard Saint Germain.  We had a tiny balcony that we could step onto, and both my husband and I loved the views.  Our room was on the third floor, which the fourth floor by North American standards, and while we were overlooking the street, we were not bothered by street noise.  

Our room and bathroom were clean.  The shower pressure was good, the quality of toiletries was good.  The bed was quite comfortable.  There was a safe in the room, which is always helpful.   There is an elevator, albeit a very small one, which is typical of old buildings in Paris, but it's a very dependable elevator.

Any issues encountered were very minor.  For instance, when we first got into the room, they had forgotten to leave towels, and housekeeping replenished them very quickly.  One day, they had not replenished toilet paper, and the front desk provided it very quickly.

We did not have breakfast at the hotel, as there are so many cafes nearby, and you can get spectacular breakfast there.  Overall, we loved staying at this hotel, and are looking forward to coming back for sure.

When in Paris - you don't want to spend much time in any hotel me thinks - so this place has got all the basics you need for a great trip. My room was clean with modern bathroom (shower was hot and had good pressure) / toilet area.
I get a bit claustraphobic - so didn't like the look of the tiny lift. Used it once but took the stairs for the rest of the time. That is the only downside from what I could see.

title: An 'accidental' stay that worked out
text: So we arrived to the apartment we rented in Paris after a rental car drop-off ordeal at around 11:30pm.  Unfortunately, the owner had not left the key (another story).  Luckily, this hotel was around the corner and open.  I wandered in and told the fellow at the desk our predicament. They were spacious, very clean and had good sized baths.  The beds were very comfortable and we slept soundly.  There is some street noise depending on where your window is, maybe we were too exhausted for it to matter, but we all managed to sleep well enough so we could face our predicament without being completely miserable.  The morning staff also were very helpful.  We did not know if we'd get into the apt the next day (owner had not been reachable the night before) and they said we could keep our luggage/bags there for as long as we needed.  They also were ready to hold a couple rooms for us if we could not get to the apt.  Other writers are correct, it's a great location - easy walk to Notre Dame and environs.  Many good things about this hotel - but esp the staff.

title: A SHINING GEM OF A HOTEL
text: Situated in the 4th Arrondissement, this delightful hotel is just two blocks from Notre Dame and within an easy walking distance of the Louvre, the Left Bank book and print stalls, the Musée de L’Orangerie where Monet’s water lilies will transport you to another time.  There are many restaurants in the St-Germain District and walking everywhere is safe if you are confident and stay vigilant, which is true for most of Paris.  Although a small hotel with the smallest, almost claustrophobic, elevator you will ever see, the rooms are clean and the towels fresh.  One precaution however— your shower floor may be slippery and with no grab bars!   The French do not use washcloths but instead use wash mits in their homes, which hotels don’t supply but which you can buy almost everywhere.  (Better to pack your washcloth when coming to France.) The Abbatial Hotel is very reasonably priced and includes a full breakfast.  In fact, the breakfast alone may be the best reason for staying here— simply sumptuous— along with a free copy of the International New York Times.  We will definitely stay here again.

title: Would definitely return
text:
After walking by this charming looking hotel on several previous trips to Paris, we finally stayed here one night before a cruise and two nights after. We stored our luggage here before check-in, in a locked room. The location is perfect for walking to so many places: the islands, the Marais (4th), Notre Dame, Saint Chappelle, the 5th & 6th, parks, etc. Restaurants abound, as do shops, along and around Boulevard Saint Germain. Our first night we stayed in a Deluxe Double corner room overlooking Blvd Saint Germain and we had 3 windows/balconies (room 35)! We had booked on hotels.com. The other 2 nights we stayed in a room overlooking the side street and had two large windows. All windows opened for fresh air. Rooms, including bathrooms, were newly (?) remodeled and very nice. I love that they have tubs as well as showers, and everything was sparkling clean. The beds were very comfortable, and although the room is smaller than U.S. hotel rooms (to be expected in Europe), we had 2 bedsides tables, a large wardrobe, desk, frig, electric pot and Nespresso coffee maker. Nice touches! Oh, and TV with English channels to catch the news. 

Reception staff (we talked to several) were friendly, helpful, and spoke very good English. Breakfast included hot and colds foods, espresso coffee, tea, and is attended by a very friendly staff person. 

We felt this was a very good value for a good hotel room, great location, good breakfast, and good staff. We will return the next time we need a hotel in Paris (we often stay in private rentals, but sometimes you prefer a hotel). Thank you to Hotel Abbatial for exceeding our expectations!
