title: Excellent Hotel
text:
This is a good friendly hotel which I’d highly recommend. It’s in an amazing location on a quiet street near the Odeon and Luxembourg gardens and in easy reach of Boulevards St Michel and St Germain.
The breakfast is good. The lift/elevator is tiny and very Parisian.
We’d originally booked in 2020. It was good to be here at last.
It’s 2 star, but deserves 3. You’ll find cheaper in other parts of Paris, but it’s great to be in the Latin Quarter

title: Wonderful hotel near Odeon and Luxembourg Gardens
text: I stayed in a single room in this lovely hotel. The room was small, as I expected, but it had everything I needed. The room was immaculately clean and the bed was super comfy. The hotel has a tiny elevator that fits two people or one with luggage! The location was ideal - quiet, but close to everything in the Latin Quarter. Being an avid walker, I also walked to the Eiffel Tower, the Marais and to Canal St. Martin from the hotel. Maybe the best part of my stay here was the staff. Each person was so kind and helpful. They even managed to patiently wait for me to try speaking French, and actually helped me with some words and pronunciation! I would enthusiastically recommend this hotel and I look forward to returning the next time I'm in Paris.

title: Very nice place to stay
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Grand Hotel des Balcons. The location within St Germaine is excellent if you want to explore Paris. Saint Germain is certainly not the cheapest quarter there is, but very nice to be at. The room in the hotel was not big, but sufficient and certainly well kept and clean. The hotel staff were great, competent, approachable and very friendly. The breakfast was the best we had while we were in France. The hotel is not cheap, but nothing is in Paris and given the price of hotels in Paris, this is very good value for money, plus great atmosphere and a lively quarter which is safe at the same time. Absolutely to be recommended.

title: Hi thread count sheets
text:
Positive – As a single person, the small room was just fine. A bed, a desk and chair, lamps, closet. Small bathroom with a pocket door. Small sink, adequate shower and toilet, space to hang towels – what more does one need? I opened my window a little at night and the cool breeze was wonderful – with high thread count sheets and comforter I slept like a baby. Breakfast was delicious! 
Negative – The elevator was NOT working! Clementine carried my small bag up for me, but she should not have to do this. This hotel is hard to find if you are walking and cannot get internet. And the map I was given at the desk is so small you cannot read the street names to find your way back to the hotel! Only by the Algerian man at the desk was I given the guidance to find the Odeon Theatre and go straight down the hill from there.

title: Great Location
text: Stayed here in April 2022 for 8 nights after a week in London at a very expensive hotel so our expectations were a little high.  The hotel is in a super location.  Walking distance to lots of really good restaurants, subway and many fun areas of the city.  It is very clean and the staff is very nice.  It is a pretty basic hotel.  I would say the room furnishings  are a little dated and the towels can use some fabric softer.  They were a little like sandpaper.  But for the price you cant beat it.    The elevator is extremely small.  One person and one suitcase is a tight squeeze.  Luckily we were only on the second floor.  Remember, in Paris they start counting at "0" floor.  Breakfast we ok.  We only did the hotel breakfast one day.  We so many bakeries near by we found it better to walk over to Eric Keyser every morning and get a fresh croissant/pastry and coffee.  I believe that is more of the real Paris experience.  Would stay here again now that i know what i am getting.  But if i was looking for a more luxury experience i would look for something else.  Also, just so you know, there is no air conditioning.  Coming from Central Florida where we keep our air on almost 365 days a year this was a little problematic.  Luckily it was not very hot while we were there but in the summer i would be a little concerned.

title: Hotel next to  Odeon
text:
The lift lived up to Paris lifts' temperamental reputation, and so was out of order when I stayed on the 4th floor, but to be fair they did give me a discount of Eur 60 per night for this. 

It's central, and the breakfast is good, but I think the staff are somewhat stretched to be honest. I asked for another duvet three times and I never got it. Could not be bothered to walk all the way down to the ground floor again to get one. For the price of EUR 240 per night, you would think they would provide a phone, an ironing board, and some tea and coffee. Not sure I'll go again.

title: Horrible stay avoid
text: this was the most  horrible experience so far in a hotel in Paris. The website photos are  fake. Mean staff. Room extremely small and smelly, uncomfortable bed, very old. the most horrible issue was the noise. you hear every single noise in nearby rooms. In the morning, the receptionist told me this is what I should expect, no sorry. It was difficult to talk to her from first day. she never smiles. in short, just avoid.

title: Unethical
text: Unethical. No refund despite the fact that Australians are not permitted to travel overseas during the pandemic. They made twice the amount on the room. I gave them plenty of time for another guest to book in & I know that - even at the time I cancelled - they were almost full so there would have had no problem filling it.

title: A quick stay
text: I stayed here for one night and was very pleased with the location, staff, and check-in/check-out experience.  The room itself was good, but did have a musty smell that seemed to be coming from the building itself.  The linens, bathroom, and surfaces were all spotless, so I had no concern about cleanliness.  For the cost, location, and service, i'll take a museum-like smell!

title: Great for a short stay
text:
We had single rooms. They are small, as others have said, but fine for a short stay. The rooms could do with an update, but they were clean and comfortable. We had rooms at the back so they were quiet too.
Staff were friendly and helpful. We decided to have the breakfasts as there was a good range of options - fresh fruit, yogurts, cereals, cold spread (cheese, pate, meats) as well as a hot option (eggs, sausage etc) as well as good bread & croissants/pain chocolat with wide choice of teas, coffee, juice.
Only issue was the rooms were quite hot and we couldnt figure out how we could turn the heating down, so had to open the windows - not a great solution given how important it is these days not to waste energy!

title: A real Paris experience + great location
text: Wonderful two nights stay at the hotel. It is in a great location and walkable to most sightseeing spots. The metro is also very close and easy to catch. The staff were very kind and the views of the street from the hotel balcony was very romantic. No water in the room, but that's ok, make sure to stock up. Thank you for the fantastic stay and I will be staying there again for sure!

title: Very pleasant hotel
text: I really enjoyed my stay. Ideally situated a short walk from Odeon metro. Louvre, Pompidou and Musee D'Orsay are all within reasonable walking distance with plenty to see along the way. The hotel itself is well maintained and clean. Front of house staff were pleasant too. Breakfasts are an additional €12. I tried one day but the choices were a bit limited it was hard to get value. This is a minor criticism - overall recommended.

title: Ian Malin review
text: My son and I were made to feel very welcome at a hotel and I have enjoyed visiting for over 30years. We had a very comfortable and pleasurable stay. The breakfasts were excellent and the staff friendly

title: Good value
text: Everything worked. Comfortable bed, lots of hot water, clean. Rooms are very small but adequate enough for a weekend in middle of Paris. Good value for a great location which is why we often stay here

title: Great location, decent rooms, lovely service
text:
Lovely service at the front desk, and I was offered early check-in. There's also a handy luggage room for storage pre-check-in/post-check-out. A tiny elevator is available - enough to fit one person and luggage.

Great location in Saint-Germain - I was able to walk almost everywhere, and even if not, the Odéon metro station is just a couple steps away. Rooms are slightly dated, but generally clean and functional. The carpets felt a bit manky underfoot, but weren't too bad. It would have been nice to have a bar fridge and a kettle on the room, but otherwise you have everything you'd expect. 

Breakfast is available, and the breakfast room looked cute, but I decided to venture out instead. 

Overall, good value given the location.

title: Okay rooms but great location
text: We stayed here on our first night in Paris. It was convenient to arrive early in the morning and be able to leave our bags for the day. The room itself was fine and we got a good nights sleep as the area was relatively quiet at night. The highlight is the location. With close proximity to Odeon, you are only a short metro away from everything. Also, close enough to enjoy a morning walk through Le Jardin du Lumexbourg.

title: A Gem and a Bargain
text: Another really tiny room in a great location. I’m thinking the French think hotels are for sleeping, not for hanging out. This one has an Art Deco entry, helpful staff at reception and a very welcoming atmosphere.

title: Review by two sisters
text: What a wonderful hotel . Superb location , truly amazing breakfast and comfortable clean rooms with plentiful of hot water .I would highly recommend it .my sister and I had a wonderful break which staying at this hotel played a large part in .

title: Great location, great breakfast
text: The room was the smallest we've ever had, but everything else was fine.  The reception was cordial, and we got into our room early.  The bed was comfortable, and the linens very nice. There was lots of hot water.  Breakfast was very good, with a wide variety of fruit, breads, eggs, cheeses, meats, juices, and pastries.  Good price for the location, a short walk from RER and metro.

title: Great Location
text: I enjoyed my stay at the Grand Hotel des Balcons. The front desk was extremely friendly and helpful. the breakfast was good with a nice variety to choose from. My only mistake was to reserve a single room. The room was fine for a shorter stay but 5 days was challenging. If I stay again I will reserve a larger room. The location was wonderful, quiet street with good local restaurants, accessible by metro.

title: Short stay in Saint-Germain-des-Prés.
text: Nice hotel, friendly welcome and very helpful staff! Quiet nights although it is located in the center of the city. Nearby most of the cultural highlights. Metro, bus an RER close. We diddn't have breakfast there, so we don't know about that. Super price to quality rate! Realy nothing to remark!

title: Well Located, Welcoming Space
text: This hotel is beautifully located on a quiet street in a bustling, historic and active part of the city. It features clean rooms, an exceptional breakfast buffet, and,most importantly, an extremely friendly and engaged staff who are eager to ensure that your time in Paris is both special and memorable.

title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location. You can walk to Louvre and Notre Dame from there.The hotel is very nice and they can speak several lenguages. The rooms are clean and the breakfast is good. The best for me was the location

title: Great place to stay!
text: We have visited this hotel many times and this time we were impressed with the new decor. It is a beautiful upgrade in the foyer. We had very good suggestions about the local restaurants from the reception desk. For 12 euros, the breakfast was amazing. A delightful, convenient place to stay!

title: Great Hotel with fantastic breakfast!
text: I enjoyed my stay in Grand Hotel des Balcons. I appreciated the warm welcome, the cosy and clean room, the little balcony and the fantastic breakfast in nice atmosphere. Already looking forward for my next stay!

title: Very conveniently located relative to St Germain
text:
Conveniently located, walking distance to St Germain Blvd, Opera.  Helpful staff.  Breakfast OK.  Room very small, bathroom miniscule and water from shower overflows to rest of bathroom floor.
All in all good considering price.

title: Nice small hotel in good location
text:
Let me start by saying I have been to Paris many times and have stayed in a variety of Airbnbs and hotels.  We opted for a hotel this time because the last few times we have stayed at pretty bad Airbnbs.  

This hotel had clean rooms.  They weren't anything special but they were nice enough.  The bathroom was normal size for Paris and the shower worked well.  As far as rooms in Paris go, it was A-OK!  It was expectantly small, but no complaints. 

The location is on a quiet street, but very near the city center.  You can walk to the major sites around the river easily.  We also love the Monoprix grocery store a few blocks away.

Additionally, the daytime staff were super helpful.  We had a lost luggage situation and they went above and beyond to help us!  Thank you!! 

There is one significant thing that could improve this hotel that would take barely any effort on the staff's part.  They have a lovely breakfast room, but they close it after breakfast.  Because the hotel rooms are so small, they should allow guests to use this space.  It would give people a place to relax, caught up on work, write postcards, etc....you get the idea.  It's such a wasted amenity!!  If they feel they'd lose too much money on free coffee/tea, then they could charge customers and actually make some money...  A common room like this would also allow guests to mingle.  This addition would take this property from nice to epic!!

Overall, if you want an inexpensive and clean room in a good location, you will be happy here.

title: Ok for a one night stay
text: We stayed here for one night at the end of our vacation and it was good for just one night. The hotel staff were friendly, but our room left a lot to be desired.  It appears that some of the rooms have been renovated, based on the pictures on trip advisor, but ours definitely had not been. The bathroom was in fine shape and I actually found the shower to be amazing, but the bedroom had very old furnishings and the carpet was pretty disgusting. Our hair dryer didn't work and there weren't any outlets by the bed which was really inconvenient. There also weren't any tea/coffee options inside the room.

title: Perfect - just what we were looking for
text:
Great location, near to the RER-B station for the airport transfer, Saint Germain and the Latin Quarter for bars and restaurants. I don't think we could have picked a better location in the city. Nice area, fewer tourists in my opinion, offering a more local feel. Still a short walk to Notre-Dame and Le Marais.

Room was typically tiny, as was the lift but that's been the way every time I've stayed here in Paris. Spotless, good shower. Great little balcony. A bit of noise from nearby bars but you're in a city, I expect it and quite enjoy it.

Effortless check in, luggage store was free. Reception area very nice.

We didn't have breakfast as there's plenty of choices in the area.

title: Great Location!
text: Great location close to attractions, public transit and restaurants.  Room was a bit small and dated; however, the property was very clean and an incredible value.  The front desk staff was very friendly.

title: Quaint and personable
text: Lovely quiet place close to much of what you would want to see in Paris. It's a great walking city and coming back for the evening was pleasing. The staff - especially the front desk lady - were very helpful and friendly. There are plenty of very good eating places nearby. I would stay here again.

title: Great location, great value for the price
text: We loved the location of the hotel. Form here you could pretty much start your walking trips to all important sights of Paris. Also, there were a lot of restaurants in just 2 minute walking distance where you could have your dinners. The hotel rooms were a bit dated, however they were very clean. he breakfast was better than I expected. They served nice breads and croissants, juices, scrambled eggs and bacon,  great coffee. It was always plenty to chose from, fresh and very delicious.

title: The Time of My Life
text:
My stay The Grand was perfect.  The room was quite pleasant and the entire staff was friendly and accommodating.  The offerings for breakfast each morning were superb...I ate in the charming 
breakfast room almost every morning.  I know I will return as I feel I have a home away from home
in Paris.

title: Best hotel
text: The location of the hotel is in the most beautiful and atmospere district.  Breakfast is fantastic and very reasonable price for the Paris!  Guys,  thank you for everything,  I will defenitely come back!!!

title: Always a pleasure
text: Grand Hôtel des Balcons is my go-to hotel in Paris. In the center of Saint-Germain, but on a quiet street. Congenial staff and excellent breakfast. I have mobility challenges, so Chambre 10, with a walk-in shower, is ideal. I hope I’ll be back again next year.

title: Grand Hôtel des Balcons; art nouveau on the Left Bank.
text: This is an older style Art  Nouveau  hotel in a very convenient location on the Left bank. It's a very short walk from the Luxembourg Gardens, Bd San Germain the Odéon Metro. Staff were welcoming and helpful. Bathrooms were clean and have been modernised  since my last visit and beds were comfortable. It has a small lift. There are many restaurants and cafés nearby and we walked from the hotel to Sainte-Chapelle, Pont Neuf and Notre Dame. Recommended. We had a fairly spacious family room for 4 and found it good value.

title: Review of Grand Hotel des Balcons
text: I enjoyed my stay at the Grand Hotel des Balcons. The room was clean with good cupboards for hanging cloths. The staff were friendly and helpful.  The location is excellent and there are lots of restaurants in the close vicinity and its easy to walk or take a bus or train to the museums.

title: Great location, quiet room
text: A great hotel that is very close to all sorts of Paris attractions. There are also many wonderful restaurants nearby, so you'll never feel out of the loop. Despite being in a busy area, the room was nice and quiet, which I really appreciated.

title: Paris by Luxembourg
text:
An excellent location, a good value hotel. Very small lift. Rooms are on the small side but that is a given in the price range for a large city.
The breakfast was top notch, great coffee and all you can eat.

title: Excellent option in a great location
text:
We chose this hotel based on a recommendation from someone who stays there often and we had a great stay. Our room was big (we booked the larger room w/ balcony) and we had plenty of space. It is on a quiet street but very close to metro stations and within walking distance of many major attractions in central Paris.

The staff was very polite and we had no issues. I would recommend this to someone who is looking for a good value hotel without too many fusses and frills in a central location in Paris.

title: Terrible Value for the Money
text: Bed mattress was hard, like plywood. The pillows were very uncomfortable. Don't stay here in the summer, no A/C and the little $10 fan we had was broken. Tried to get another and they replaced with another broken one. For the same money there are plenty of comfortable hotels in Paris that have A/C. Just to point out, 1,500 people died in France this summer due to extreme heat. Even a small window A/C unit could make a huge difference. The room is barely a step above a hostel, it is just a bed and a bath, nothing more special than that.

title: Very ordinary..
text:
Very small lift to share with 6 storey building.. if your on 5th floor like us, you will have to use the staircase , as lift is inadequate, for number of users. 

Not for elderly or small children. Location quite central
While trying to leave with heavy luggage, I had to wait 20 minutes for lift..

title: excellent rate quality/price
text: As clients for more than 40y several times/y we where disappointed by the quality of the breakfast service twice this week: shortage of bread...omelette...water for tea and coffee and even plates and bowls. That's the reason why i point the service as "average" rather than my usual "very good".

title: Robbed in the night
text: Be afraid...be very afraid of the Grand Hôtel Des Balcons. As the name suggests, the “balconies” of the hotel provided easy access for the robbers who came in the middle of the night, stealing a large chunk of Euros, our bank and credit cards and sunglasses etc. Very hot at the time, we stupidly left our window open after the shutters proved to be old and unlock-able. We woke at 7.30am to find my wife’s handbag gone. Frantically going down to reception, we asked to see lobby CCTV footage of us coming back the previous night, just to be sure my wife was wearing her bag. Hotel staff said we couldn’t look at footage until 2:30pm when the manager arrived. So not much urgency there! At 2:30pm CCTV footage showed my wife wearing her bag, thus confirming it had gone missing from the room. The manager was incredulous, dismissive and rude. The police at the local station, however, were not so incredulous and dismissive explaining this was a relatively common occurrence in Paris. Upon returning from filing the police report the manager did shift us up to a room higher than worry level as we were completely devastated that someone had sneaked into our room while we were sleeping. We were thankful that we hadn’t woken up because that could have only ended badly. So sure, it was our stupidity to open windows, but maybe the hotel should warn patrons of this possibility.

title: Very good
text: Ideal location . central but quiet, lots of restaurants and cafés and shops, near metro and tourist sites. Very comfortable bed though very little room. Good breakfast - quality and quantity. Competent and friendly staff.

title: First time in Paris
text: The bath tub did it for me, after getting very small shower stalls to shower in. They provided 2 separate rooms adjacent to each other for our family of 4. Each had a Tub. Very classy place, good friendly service with English speaking front desk. One of my favorites from the 11 different hotels we got.

title: Excellent small hotel in Paris
text: Excellent small hotel in central Paris, very clean, wonderful breakfast and with a most attentive staff. From the hotel, we can easily walk to the main museums, to the river Seine and to other tourist attractions in Paris.

title: Do not let the outside fool you
text: i recently visited and was kind of disappointed when i saw the facade of the hotel. but i was wrong to judge quickly. inside is clean and beautiful. the room i had was particularly spacious but the space was not wasted either. this hotel is the existing proof of the quote "dont judge a book by its cover". the nearby Luxembourg gardens was a plus as well. my only complaint was that the hotel blends in too well with its surroundings/neighbouring buildings although i know nothing can be done about that

title: good
text:
eveything is quite good.eveything is quite good.
it is just un luck to come on a crazy hot day. I  cant fall asleep at all that day.
but the service is good. Thanks to the umbralla.
Hope the interenet can be better.

title: Charmant
text:
Lovely hotel. Metro station Odéon 5 minutes walking from the hotel, good restaurants in the neighbourhood, friendly staff , it’s a pity there is no airconditioning but they solved it with a fan in the room on the hottest day of the year.
Good breakfast

title: I love this hotel!
text: This is the third time I have stayed at the Grand Hotel des Balcons over the past 25 years, and I will stay there again. The location is excellent; you can walk almost everywhere from there, a metro is close by, and the staff are always friendly and helpful.  They done renovations since the last time I stayed there, and the rooms are lovely, clean, and feel brand new. Although the rooms are not huge, they were really efficiently renovated and do not feel small, and they have all the amenities you need...and still maintain the charm of an old Paris hotel.

title: Great location- Would return
text:
We stayed here for two nights in July. The hotel is quaint and cozy. I liked our view, it was simply the building across the street, however, it is the enchanting wrought iron railings of the balconies that I had always pictured seeing In Paris. 

The hotel offers a breakfast at 12€ but we did my try it. There are many restaurants nearby. 

There is a hairdryer that was powerful. 

Many outlets nears the desk (not near the bed) 

Rooms are small but standard for Europe. 

The lift is tiny. We opted for the winding staircase (also small) 

The room and bathroom was very clean. Perhaps the cleanest of many of the hotels we stayed at in Europe. 

You will need to leave your key to your room at the front desk every time you leave. I did not think this was a hassle, I prefer it so that I did not have to carry the bigger key or fear losing it. 

There are stores nearby. 

The shower is open to the bathroom separated with a curtain. 

There is no A/C but they did provide a fan. 

Front desk staff were lovely. Arranged a taxi pickup for our trip back to the airport. 
City tax was very little. 

This was our first time visiting Paris. We took a taxi to the hotel as we had traveled 18 hours and felt that we perhaps did not have the right mindset to navigate metro with our luggage. I heard numerous times that the metro is easy and very close to the hotel, however, after the long travel we simply wanted an easy, worry free way to our hotel. From CDG it took us an hour with the traffic. You’ll get a real taste of the pace of the traffic and you remain all above ground to see the sites - we drive right by the Louvre and of course crossed the Seine. We walked many places from our hotel, despite it being very hot : Notre Dame is very close, Musée dOrsay, Seine (it’s nice to walk along this and cross the bridge), we walked to the Louvre and Tuileries as well. We opted for a bus tour the next day to hear some history and detail and get to the Arc de Triomphe, Trocadero & Eiffel Tower (reviews to come on these)

title: July Stay
text: Hotel Staff were very professional, friendly.  Breakfast was delicious! However a small refrigerator in the room would be nice, since there is no A/C. Unfortunately, while I was there staying on the 5th floor, the elevator went out.  I was there for three days and it was still out when I left.  To the Hotel Staff's credit, they offered the breakfast (normally 13 Euros) as a compliment.  I needed it, as going up and down the stairs required a lot of energy!

title: Excellent small hotel in a great location; problem with Trip Advisor
text:
Although this is a lovely small hotel (with small but comfortable rooms) in a great location, I suggest that people book directly with the hotel.
I booked through Trip Advisor (and then maybe through Expedia) and was forced to pay the full amount of my stay several weeks before I arrived.  When I got to the hotel, they told me that I was prepaid and showed the rate for my room.  This was substantially less than what I had prepaid.  In the future I will contact hotels directly to book rooms.

title: Week in Paris
text:
Very poor wifi, everything else are great! The connection is unstable and unfortunately you need to login again every time after unlocking your phone(
Location is great, very close to luxemburg park, a lot of bakeries and restaurants around the place.

title: Lovely stay!
text: Stayed here for the second time recently. Location is excellent. Don't be expecting super luxurious rooms. They are clean and functional however. Staff kind and helpful. Would stay again if the price was right!

title: Cultural week-end
text:
Very well located, close to metro station, lots of restaurants/bars, cinemas, museums... central yet very quiet!
The room was small but very clean and functional.
Just a few steps from Luxembourg gardens.

title: Quick stay
text: I only stayed one night. France has been having a heat wave currently so they did provide a fan but it was the most noisiest thing ever and I couldn't sleep with it on. The carpet was gross. The bathroom fan was very noisy, not what a bathroom fan should sound like. The toilet flusher plastic cover was falling apart. The room that I stayed in needed major updating. If I was going to stay longer than a night I would of requested to be moved.

title: Grand Hotel des Balcons
text: This was our eleventh annual trip to Paris, and we always stay at the Grand Hotel des Balcons...it is the perfect place for us to stay. The staff are, without fail, helpful and friendly. The rooms are immaculate, and very comfortable. The location is easily accessible, and very central for exploring the city. We shall be back!!

title: Wonderful time in Paris!
text: I chose this hotel based on its location, but I received so much more.  The breakfast buffet was extensive, and the staff was very helpful, calling taxis and printing out vouchers!  I’ll come back here!

title: Nice hotel!
text: I stayed at this hotel after a business week near Paris, just wanted a well-located hotel in St. Germain-des-Pres. This hotel is good value for the rate, taking its prime location into account. Rooms are as expected from such an hotel in the price range, clean, comfortable. It was a hot day in Paris, and air conditioning would have helped, but I'm not considering that in my evaluation. Excellent location, close to night life in the neighbourhood. The elevator is tiny, but I guess that's just the way these hotels are. Friendly staff, good breakfast. I would stay there again.

title: A Great Stay
text:
We came in to Paris from San Francisco and stayed one night on the way to Marseille. The staff was extremely helpful and kind. The bed was firm and comfortable.
This hotel is minutes from a 
very lively area and the famous Luxembourg Gardens. Yet, the street it is on was wonderfully quiet. I would stay here again for a longer stay next time I am in Paris!

title: Great for a short stay
text: Perfectly located hotel, ten minutes from the Metro and the centre of St. Germain.  Bedroom adequate for our needs as we were not there much and the bathroom was excellent.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Major drawback was noise from the street with lots of shouting and materials been thrown into lorries early in the morning.  Nights very hot so had had to have the windows open.  Accept this was hopefully temporary but it did spoil what should have been a good night's sleep for a birthday weekend.

title: a charming hotel in the best arrond. in Paris
text: This was my first stay at the hotel, but it will not be my last. Even though we struggled through record heat with no air conditioning (une vraie canicule), the the staff were kind and helpful at every turn. Stay here when you visit Paris and you won't be disappointed. If it happens to be during one of the three or four weeks of the year when Paris gets hot, take cool showers, relax, and enjoy this lovely, family-owned hotel.

title: Pleasant and reliable
text: Always a pleasure to stay in the Balcons  (which I do several times a year) - even in the recent hot weather.   It is consistently my favourite Paris hotel, and I expect it to remain so, as it suits my needs (and pocket) very well.

title: Nice room and nice hotel
text: Greeted warmly at check in. Nice sized room and bathroom. Liked the recently updated bathroom. Really appreciated the fan that was provided in room (no air con) on what was a very hot day (32 C) and evening! The hotel is located on a quiet street a little off the "beaten path."

title: June 2019 seven night stay at Grand Hotel des Balcons
text:
I had an excellent week at your hotel, one of my many visits over the years.    I shall return again next year.    You are situated in a superb position to explore Saint Germain, with bars, cafes, gardens, museums all close by. 
Every receptionist was extremely helpful.   Thank you.
Anne Bertoluzzi

title: Too warm and stuffy inside
text: Its a Beautiful hotel on a nice location. But it's sooo warm inside and there's no fresh air (while the outside temperature was fresh). My window was broken and clearly hadn't been open for a long time, causing a super high temperature and very bad air quality. this made me sleep terrible. The employees were friendly but were not able to help my situation stating all rooms were booked. I paid too much for this very bad night of sleep the free breakfast offered didn't cure my headache.

title: Great location on the Left Bank!
text:
My family and I recently stayed at this hotel which is near the Odeon Theater on the Left Bank.  It is close to the major museums and the heart of Paris.  The neighborhood has lots of great restaurants and eateries and you can easily connect via the metro to other areas in the city.  Our room was spacious, clean and quiet. The staff at the front desk very courteous and helpful.  Special thanks goes to Clementine, who spent 45 minutes helping me through a conundrum regarding train tickets.
Overall, I think this is a great option for a nice stay in Paris!

title: Beautiful small hotel in lovely area
text: I (grandma) was taking 3 teenage boys 14,15,17 to Paris as a special treat. I was looking for a nice hotel in a safe area with a family room and found this. It is fabulous- really clean spacious room with 4 beds, bathroom and separate toilet so couldn’t be better. The area is pretty with lovely restaurants and a nearby bakery with the most delicious croissants etc which the boys loved. Also Burger King/McDonald’s and other stuff for boys who are always hungry. WiFi worked well also important for boys. Near to metro and RER straight to airport. Would come again anytime. Don’t bother with taxi from airport just get train line B to Luxembourg stop and walk 5 mins. We didn’t have breakfast but it looked nice - we just wanted to be out and on our way.

title: Classic Hotel centrally located in St Germain close to transport
text: Great choice for a brief stay in Paris. This classic hotel is family run and truly felt like a home away from home yet smack in the middle of the vibrant hub of St Germain and close to major attractions

title: Nice place to stay
text: Nice hotel in a fantastic neighborhood. Friendly staff. Walking distance to great shopping, restaurants and more. Completely safe and relaxing time with my family. We didn’t want to leave Paris. The family room fit four people comfortably. Enjoy your stay here!

title: Perfect!
text: Lovely hotel, great location, excellent value! Our room was very comfortable, spotless, and had a great shower. The hotel is within easy walking distance to many shops, cafes, restaurants, and local sights. Highly recommend!

title: Clean, pleasant,would stay again
text: The hotel is located in a perfect spot for exploring this area of Paris near Notre Dame.  There Metro and RER stations close by.  We had two rooms- a double and a single.  The single had a little more floor space since the bed was smaller.  We found both rooms to be two warm but you can lower the powered shutter to the level of the balcony railing for security and then leave the windows open.  The double bed room had only a little bit of floor space.  There was small closet, a small folding stool in the closet, a safe, and a “wet room” shower / toilet combo with a shower curtain.  Some North Americans find the wet room a problem as North Americans don’t design bathrooms that way, but it is very common in Europe and is practical and economical.  The room was very clean, the bed was very comfortable and the room was quiet ( we were on the courtyard side).  As a courtesy to your fellow guest, please make an effort to close your room door quietly, especially in the hours when people may be sleeping as the doors tend to BANG shut.

title: Ideal, good value hotel for a short visit to Paris
text:
A good  location close to Bvd St Germain. Very helpful and friendly staff. Rooms are quite small but comfortable. An excellent breakfast for 12 euros.
Two small problems - there is no aircon and that might be a discomfort in hot weather; the wifi is a bit frustrating.

title: Central city stay
text: A small old fashioned Hotel, with excellent staff, good beds and showers, a few hundred meters from Notre Dame. Located in a quiet street with lots of food and drink places near by, good value in an expensive city.

title: Charming, central, and reasonably priced
text: I always enjoy my stay at Grand Hotel des Balcons. It's been my first choice of hostels in Paris for the last 20 years. The rooms are clean and comfortable, there is an excellent breakfast, and it is close to the Luxembourg gardens, the quartier latin, and the Seine with lots of restaurants close by. Make reservations early because they fill up quickly in the high season.

title: 31st May 2019
text: Yet another comfortable stay in this family owned hotel situated for easy access to the Left Bank. The staff are unfailingly helpful and friendly. The accommodation charge represents good value given its official rating. We are very likely to stay again.

title: Lovely hotel; great location; would return
text: This is a lovely hotel in the Latin Quarter - just a 2 block walk to the Luxembourg Metro station, about a 10 minute walk to the Louvre.  Amenities were everything we expected; great value for the price.  Staff were very helpful and pleasant; clean and comfortable room.   Very quiet location.

title: Perfect! The Parisian Dream!
text:
Absolutely perfect- beyond perfect! I cried when we left. We’ve been to Paris a few times and stayed in the area, and love it, but this was our first time with kids. We had ‘The Room’ that is used on the photos and it really really is like that. That view! 

The place had a great vibe, with staff and other guests being warm and welcoming. We loved the shared fridge and kitchen- perfect for our kids who will only eat cereal for breakfast! The location is perfect. Right next to a lovely play area for kids, Anvers metro station is outside and the Sunday street market that filled then boulevard was great! 

The room was lovely-  very nicely decorated and the kids loved the bunbeds. Loved sitting on our little balcony and enjoying that view.

I can’t even write how perfect our stay was. I’ve never seen Paris look so beautiful and we can’t wait to return.
description: Located in one the most popular district of Paris, few steps from Gare du Nord, surrounded by bars, concerts, pubs, coffee shops, and close to all the famous places; Le Moulin Rouge, Pigalle, Montmartre, the Regent is the ideal Hotel for travelers who want to live a authentic journey in the city. Traveling with your family, your friends, the Regent offers different types of room; private or shared bathroom, dormitories, mixed or single-sex. In the convivial and relaxing lounge, you will enjoy games, music and people from all around the world. Enjoy a continental breakfast in the shared kitchen and ask our friendly polyglot staff any tips or advices . On the 5th & 6th floor, you will get the most beautiful view of the rooftops of Paris ! If you are lucky enough to get the room!

title: Absolutely disgraceful - who is running this place?
text:
These people publish that they do not take prepayment, yet attempt to take it from your card of guarantee.  When they can't take your payment they then cancel your booking.

No idea why kind of business strategy this is, but good luck in the future.  You're going to need it!

DO NOT STAY IN ANY OVER THIER OVERPRICED PROPERTIES

title: A few days in Paris
text:
The staff were very helpful & extremely pleasant. The position is truly excellant, close to metro stations & a short walk to Gare du Nord. A vast range of bars & restaurents are just outside.
The room itself is very basic given that we paid the eurostar agent £200 per night. However the biggest single issue is the noise from other residents. It is an old building with no air con which means when its warm which it has been the past four nights you must keep the windows open.  Last night I tried calling out at 2330 to whoever with loud voices to quieten down, to little effect. The night before whoever was above was bouncing on the floor until after midnight. The night before that the noise went on until 0100/0200 am . 
We are now returning home utterly exhausted.

There were also only 2 electrical plugs in the dorm for all 4 people staying, so you could not charge your phone as there were not enough Power sockets:/

text:
Nice hostel in the very center of Montmartre. Right next to the underground and 10 minutes from the main train station. Nice hosts, and good services for a reasonable price. Unfortunately the room was not very clean.
The bathroom had only a tub and was full of hair.

text: Wow what a view from our room! Really friendly check-in, and got given a family room on the 6th floor. Kids were delighted with the bunk bed. Clean room, in excellent location. Breakfast could have been improved slightly with some ham and cheese for the rolls, but other than that a really great place to stay! Would recommend!

title: Excellent location and very comfortable!
text: We stayed for 3 nights in Le Regent Montmartre. The staff are extremely friendly and helpful. The lady who manages the breakfast is also very kind. Breakfast is cheaper if you book directly on Le Regent Montmartre website. Only downside was that they advertise pain au chocolat for the breakfast (in their website photos), but they are not included, only croissants. There is a kitchen to use a kettle or microwave and you can eat your own food in the kitchen or common area. The hotel itself is very nice, recently renovated and cosy. There is a lift or stairs to use to get to the rooms. We had a double standard room with a view of the street, even though there was no balcony it was very nice to have a Parisian view!! The room was very lovely, there was everything we needed. The only problem was the bathroom was not 100% clean, quite a few long black hairs all over the bathroom and little bit dirty. Overall, the stay was fantastic, you cannot beat this location (Sacre Coeur and Montmartre literally on the doorstep, Anvers metro station 1 step away, amazing coffee shops nearby and easy to walk from Gare L'est or take the metro). title: Crazy not to stay here
text:
Trying to find very cheap accommodation in Paris, 1 minute from a Metro, close to a major attraction and very clean/modernised is rare, but we found that with Le Regent.

I was tracing with my 2 boys (7&8) and a friend, so was tracking down a quadruple room. Le Regent appeared to have some good recent reviews and didn’t see the words “bed bugs” anywhere, which seemed a common theme with most cheap digs.

Hotel is easy to find and right besides Anvers Metro, No.2 line and at the base of the hill to the Sacre Couer. Staff were young and attentive and very friendly by Paris standards! Our room was on the 6th floor, accessibly by small lift (max 3 persons) or wide staircase. Once in the room, Wow!! A view to die for. While the balcony only fits one person, it’s was t a problem for us. The beds were firm, clean and room big enough for just sleeping and relaxing, we’re their for exploring Paris, not staying in the room. OK W/C and shower room, no issue with hot water and good pressure. 

I would have no hesitation in going back, it’s a hidden gem!

Only negatives I could find, and it’s minor. Yes, my feet did stick out from end if bed, but at 6’3” it’s something I’m very use to and still got a great night sleep. Fronting a main road, we heard 2-3 sirens during the night, but very little from the public so the double glazing did it’s job. Finally, as mentioned, expect a small lift, but it’s very common in Paris, just enjoy its quirky quality!

Thanks guys, had an amazing stay!

title: Modern and clean rooms, good Location for a short term stay
text:
We stayed in this hotel for 5 nights during a short trip to Paris.

Location:
The location of the hotel ist very good. A supermarket and various cafes and restaurants are nearby. The scare coeur and the moulin rouge are both around a 10 minute walk. Walking to the city center takes around 30 minutes. There is also a metro station nearby.

Rooms:
Our double room was very modern and quite clean. The rooms are very small though. The walls are quite thin and it’s possible to hear the other guests. Because our room faced the back, we could not hear any traffic. Many sockets in the rooms, also next to the beds.
One thing that is a bit annoying, is that there is pretty much no space to put clothes or other thing. Neither in the room nor the bathroom. No cupboards, nothing besides a couple of hooks.

Common areas:
The common areas are quite small. Especially the kitchen is too small for the size of the hotel. Cooking is possible but quite complicated. Only a few glasses and cups in the kitchen. The facilities definitely need to be stocked up. The living room is nicely decorated and they even put a Christmas tree up in December. But the atmosphere was quite cold. Some better music speakers and more couches would be nice. It was not a place many of the guests would spend their evening in.

Staff:
The staff was nice but didn’t stand out. One thing I did not like is that when we asked for another key card, they just gave it to us without even asking for any id. We could have just gotten a card for any room and stolen other peoples stuff.

I would recommend this hotel for abschort term stay with not too much luggage due to the modern rooms and the good location!

title: Good idea in theory, not so much in practice
text:
I picked this hotel for our four days in Paris based mostly on the photos of the place and its location at the foot of Montmartre (and an almost literal stone's throw from Anvers metro station). Somehow throughout the reservation process I missed that it's not a hotel, but more a hostel with some private rooms on offer - and both service and set-up are definitely skewed in that direction, despite the hotel-room price being on a par with the per-night prices in any big city.

As such, it was doubly disappointing to find we'd been given what seemed from the emergency floor plan to be the smallest private room going (about 9 m2, plus ensuite), as it offered little room beyond the bed, which itself seemed oddly short - I'm 180 cm tall and lying fully flat my toes were hanging off the end. The only other features of the room were bedside tables, a small table and chair with a TV on the wall above it and some coat hooks on the wall by the door. There was no storage at all: no drawers and no wardrobe or hanging space. The ensuite was comparatively spacious, but only had one small shelf above the toilet, and a short bath I couldn't fit into without bending my legs. Ventilation in both the bathroom and bedroom was quite poor.

The only breakfast offered on site is a 'Parisian breakfast' of croissant, bread, butter and jam, tea/coffee and orange juice. However, it wasn't included in our room price - you think it would be if you're staying in one of the private rooms, but no - so we didn't go for it, although the price (€6) seemed reasonable.

Service was in good English, if at times peppered with a somewhat stereotypically French attitude. When at one point there was no hot water for 12 hours and I asked what the situation was, my enquiry was met with a shrug and a "We know, we're trying to get it fixed". This, and the noise in the place - simply using carpet in the halls and stairwells would reduce it, but the walls between the rooms are paper-thin as well - meant that overall we weren't particularly satisfied with our stay.

On the plus side, the USB points by the bed are a boon, and it's clear they've gone to some effort with the design. And, as I said, the location is great.

title: Fantastic hotel - clean, friendly and stylish
text: I stayed 3 nights with my teenage twin daughters in August 2019 and we loved it. I booked a quadruple room (a double and a bunk) with an ensuite and it was very clean and stylish. The photos were completely honest. We were on the top floor (room 604) and we had a little balcony which had the most stunning view of the Sacre Coeur. Towels were provided and the room was cleaned every day. The staff were very friendly and relaxed; particularly Fernando who checked us in.  I do not know what the other rooms are like so can't comment on those.  The Sacre Coeur is literally a 10 minute walk away and it is a wonderful part of Paris. We had some lovely meals out and the Montmartre museum is well worth a visit. One word of warning about Paris in general..... I had my mobile phone stolen on the metro by a very crafty pickpocket and I also witnessed a Spanish lady have her whole bag stolen (including passports etc.) whilst she was sitting outside a café in Montmartre. This was a sad part of our trip as we had to spend a whole afternoon trying to find a police station to report the crime. Do look after your valuables (my phone was in a cross-body bag but the pickpocket managed to undo the zip without me noticing). This has not put me off visiting Paris but next time I would take a thief-proof bag and be extra cautious.  I would definitely stay at Le Regent again as I felt very safe there.

title: Parisian flair
text:
We booked a superior double room for one week (breakfast included because we booked on the official website) and we enjoyed our stay so much! The location is good, you can reach the Sacré-Coeur within 10 minutes. 
Our room had a beautiful design, it looked excactly like the picture in the website, we had a bathroom including some soap, shampoo and towels and the bed was very comfortable. The hostel in general is very clean the staff is always friendly and welcoming. 

The only negative things to mention are that there was no space in our room to leave our clothes (not even a shelve)- the room in general was small but because we had to live out of our suitcases it was just a little bit too tiny.
The kitchen is very small too and there is not enough equipment like bowls etc.  
I also would not recommend to buy  breakfast for 6€ each morning (it’s only a croissant, some baguette, one orange juice, one instant coffee drink and some marmalade- I know it’s typically Parisian but you could get it much cheaper at any supermarket!) 

But all together I really enjoyed my stay at the “Regent Montmartre” and I would recommend it to everyone that wants to visit Paris in a chic location without spending too much money!

The hotel is very, very close to Anvers metro station, but please never go to Barbès-Rochechouart metro station, especially if you are a girl. Me and my friends (all girls) went to that station (5 minutes walk from the hostel, because we want to pick line 4), and it is an extremly terrible area for girls to walk alone.
The only bad thing about this hotel is the breakfast lady, and the fact that the room can be very hot sometimes, but if you open the windows at night it colds the room very fast (and no mosquitos enter the room, which is a plus for me because I am allergic). I really recommend this hostel!

title: Fabulous Twin Room!
text:

The location was perfect! A metro stop (Anvers) is across the road and Sacre Coeur is only about 10 minutes walk. It’s very easy to get to all the sights from here.
My only criticism would be (and this is very minor) that the kitchen cloths and drying towels were a bit dirty and need changing more regularly.
Overall this hostel was a great place to stay and I would stay again if I was visiting Paris.

We arrived before check in and were welcome to leave our bags in a secure room, the same for check out, helping us to get the most out of our short visit.  Our private room was on the 6th floor with an amazing view of Sacre-Coeur.  We watched the colours change from day to evening and our kids loved hanging out on the balcony.

We thought the location was great, easy to get to from Gare Nord with either a bus or metro from door to door.  Some fantastic little bakeries and supermarkets within a short walk.  We made use of the kitchen and eating area, having breakfast and evening meals there, helping us keep to our budget.

Our beds were very comfortable and quiet and the room and bathroom freshly renovated with a lovely feel.  There were plenty of lighting options in the room which was great for my son and I who were awake hours before my husband and daughter (with jet lag).  For the price we paid, we were very happy with all the hotel/hostel had to offer.

First of all -  lack of space in the room - it was quite hard to move around when there are three of you and the room is so small. Also there is absolutely no space for your stuff - no hangers or shelves, we had to keep everything in our suitcases all the time. The lightning is very poor, more lamps are necessary, as well as more power sockets
description: Located in one the most popular district of Paris, few steps from Gare du Nord, surrounded by bars, concerts, pubs, coffee shops, and close to all the famous places; Le Moulin Rouge, Pigalle, Montmartre, the Regent is the ideal Hotel for travelers who want to live a authentic journey in the city. Traveling with your family, your friends, the Regent offers different types of room; private or shared bathroom, dormitories, mixed or single-sex. In the convivial and relaxing lounge, you will enjoy games, music and people from all around the world. Enjoy a continental breakfast in the shared kitchen and ask our friendly polyglot staff any tips or advices . On the 5th & 6th floor, you will get the most beautiful view of the rooftops of Paris ! If you are lucky enough to get the room!

title: Amazing
text: We stayed five nights in a private room with bathroom and balcony, it was brilliant. The room was spotless and made up each day The bathroom had a bath and shower and also opened onto the balcony, which was lovely to sit in and look out over Paris. I was very pleasantly shocked with how great the room was. The staff were so friendly and happy to help with heaps of local knowledge. Very well located and easy to find via metro with stops very close and on lines that cover all the must-dos. Unsure of what the shared rooms are like but can not recommend the private ensuite enough! Thanks so much for a great stay.

title: Fantastic
text: We stayed here for a 50th birthday weekend for 3 nights.From start to finish it was a special experience.The staff are so welcoming, nothing is too much trouble.Rooms are beautifully and unique.Breakfast was delicious with a great choice to cater for all tastes.Location is perfectly situated for all local amenities including Moulin Rouge.

title: Friendliest Hotel I have EVER stayed at
text:
Wow, what a wonderful four night stay we recently had. My wife and I along with our two children just returned home to Phoenix after spending four nights in Paris. There aren't enough words to describe just how wonderful the staff of the Hotel des Arts-Monmartre were to my family. They truly made us feel like we were part of their family. As my wife said, "this hotel is the FRIENDLIEST hotel we have EVER stayed at" and we have stayed at many hotels. Most of our contacts were with Philippe, the owner, who needs an Arizona Diamondbacks hat (what size? you might get a surprise) instead of the Red Sox hat :-), Amel who was so incredibly nice to us after our ordeal to get to the hotel, Allesandra, who was so friendly and had a smile every time, and  who  learned about, "see you later Alligator, in a while Crocodile,. Christophe, who always compared steps, sorry about walking more steps, but Paris is too beautiful of a city to not walk.

Now for the hotel. The rooms maybe a little smaller than what Americans are use to. Having been to Paris before I was quite aware. But, again, as my wife said, "the rooms are quite well thought out"
 and boy was our room such a nice room. Very comfortable, and remember, one doesn't go to Paris to spend all their time in a room. Bed was very comfortable as well as the pillow being nice and soft. The air conditioning worked extremely well, nice and cold, if one wants it to be. There are exercise equipment and a steam room in the basement, which we never used, we got more than enough exercise with all our walking. Our view of the Eiffel Tower couldn't be beat.

Our kids room, two beds was much larger and as an 18 and 20 year do, had more then enough room to spread out their stuff, and boy did they ever :-)

Every morning we were greeted with a warm smile from the staff. The maids ALWAYS smiled at us, a matter of fact, everyone always smiled and had a wonderful "Bonjour: greeting for us. Truly making us feel welcomed into not a hotel, but a home.

A nice touch was coming back after a long day when there would be cold soft drinks or water for us to have. Such a nice touch.

As for the area. What can one say about staying in Montmartre?  To me, the best area to stay in, especially if one likes to walk up and down hills. The Sacre de Cour is so close. The Metro is very close. So many restaurants, bakeries, chocolate shops and so much more is all around. I already miss the area

One more word of advice for when you decide to stay here and walk from Saint Lazare. Make certain to input the correct Hotel des Arts Montmartre. I told my son the name of the hotel  not knowing there is another with the same name in Saint Germaine. We walked there by mistake, and boy oh boy that was the worst hotel I have ever glimpsed at. It was truly a dump, but they did point us the correct way.

The journey was so well worth it. One day when my wife and I return, sans children, we will be staying there. It will be our Paris Hotel. 

One more thing, I was talking with an older woman who told me she and her husband had stayed at the Waldorf Astoria and the Hotel des Arts Montmartre was far better.

Again, thank you to EVERYONE who made us feel so welcomed. Philippe, truly you have created such a nice hotel, and the Art painted on the walls was beautiful. I loved hearing a truly joyful "bonjour" from the staff everytime we had contact with them.

title: C'est Magnifique
text: This hotel is full of charm and amenities. We stay at the Hotel des Arts-Montmatre for 3 nights and couldn't have picked a better spot for our first time in Paris. Upon entering, we were welcomed by the warm smile of Alexandra, who was happy to be of assistance. She was full of great recommendations and we had some of the best meals at restaurants she shared with us. The rooms are modern, clean, and full of fine touches. We loved having our first macarons in our room, and the L'Occitane products throughout were a touch of luxury. The hotel is surrounded by great restaurants, bars, bakeries, and shops, all within walking distance.  We couldn't have asked for a better stay, thank you Hotel des Arts family, we look forward to visiting again!

title: Faultless
text: Wonderful family run boutique hotel offering bed & breakfast. Friendly, helpful english-speaking staff, with beautiful rooms, conveniently located in Monmartre with an abundance of good restaurants nearby. Nicest hotel I've ever stayed in. Faultless.

title: Amazing hotel in Montmartre
text: From the moment we stepped through the door the staff could not do enough for us.  A warm friendly welcome with the offer of tea/coffee after our journey.  Everywhere spotlessly clean.  Great selection at breakfast.  Lots of help and guidance on places to visit, maps, tickets etc.  Excellent service always with a smile.  Would definitely return.

title: Excellent
text: Excellent. Truly excellent small friendly hotel, lovely rooms and staff truly a wonderful stay. Hotel obviously recently refurbished and done really well. Lovely area of Paris to stay good to wonder around to visit the cafes for coffee a beer of breakfast and a short walk to the moulin rouge.

title: Great hotel
text: Fabulous hotel great location , staff were so helpful and friendly. Restaurants and bars just a step away , we will be back  the rooms are superb and very upto date 24 hour reception .probably the best city hotel we have stayed in and I've stayed in many

title: Very good option with a splendid location.
text:
Fantastic friendly and serviceminded staff. Very nice and clean rooms in a relatively small but nice and newly renovated building which is typical Montmartre style placed in an very nice and lively section of Montmartre. Near all of Montmartres highlights.
Very, very good option and very good value for money.

title: The best 4* hotel in Paris and broader.
text: The personality is very helpful and makes our stay enjoyable, and the hotel is settled in a very nice place. We really had a wonderful time and love the friendly atmosphere. Thank you for everything! :*

title: Trip with my daughter
text: We had a really great time in Paris.  We arrived way ahead of check in time and they took our bags and gave us a map of the area and asked us to come back at 4.00 pm.  Awesome hotel, great location, amazing people. Exceptional service!

title: We’ll always have Paris!
text:
While we’ve been to Paris several times, never in Montmartre. In our search for accommodations, Hotel des Arts stood out as a unique little boutique hotel. And being there in person did not disappoint. Very interesting, well kept, friendly hotel with all the amenities we wanted. 

One thing to be aware of is that the room we chose, one of only two we believe with a great view of the Eiffel Tower, is VERY small. Having stayed in Paris before, I’ll tell you small hotel rooms are not unusual, in fact they’re more the norm - so unpack your belongings into every nook and cranny you can find, then sit back with a glass of wine and let the space grow on you. :)  One other item, the elevator only goes to the floor below this room, a spiral staircase between the 5th and 6th floor is your only way up to this top floor room. Totally worth it to us! But probably not for everyone.

The hotel itself is full of unique original artwork. We took advantage of the breakfast each morning which was excellent. They also have a self-serve bar open at night for an end-of-day refreshment. The staff were all very friendly and all had a much better command of the English language (some) than we had of French (none) - and we all managed to communicate just fine. 

Lastly, the location! Hotel des Arts is situated in the center of the most beautiful (our opinion) village in all of Paris! Lots to see and do right in Montmartre and a comfortable, leisurely 45-60 minute walk to anything you might want to see in the historic district along the Seine. We also took taxis often and they were easy to find with the closest taxi stand being a 5 minute walk down the hill to the Moulin Rouge.

We cannot say enough about this hotel, it was perfect for what we wanted to experience in the most beautiful city on Earth!

title: Great hotel for the money!
text: This is a delightful hotel located in a great area of Montmarte.  Clean, modern and fair priced accommodations.  Plus the staff were great - friendly, helpful and truly made for a welcome stay!  We couldn't have a found a better hotel in Paris and will definitely be back.

title: Nice hotel, well located and friendly personel
text: A nice hotel, well located in Montmartre and the personel is very friendly. Rooms are nice and clean, well provided, allthough the bathroom is a bit to small spaced. Montmarte is a very nice neighbourhood to spend a part of your time vissiting Paris.

title: Definitely would go back!
text: My wife and I recently spent a week in Paris and stayed at Hotel des Arts for 6 nights. The hotel staff are nice, helpful and attentive. Many reviews say that it is all about the little things. Free water and soft drinks in the lobby, water in your room when you get back from touring the city. Also, it was an incredibly hot week and the air conditioning was perfect. We had a room facing the courtyard which was great. You come from the hustling streets of Montmartre to peace and quiet. The location is great, just minutes to Sacre Coeur and Moulin Rouge. Tons of cafe’s and restaurants. Also, the bed was very comfortable, and the water pressure in the shower was amazing!

title: Beautifully French Stay with Friendly and Local Staff.
text: Gorgeous room and with great furnishings - smart use of space. The staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful, and check-in included a list of suggested eateries and a guide for a scenic stroll around Montmarte. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend to others!

title: Amazing
text: Lovely hotel in a great location. Room was clean and had everything we needed. Staff were extremely accommodating and helped us get the most out of our first visit to Paris. Couldn’t recommend it enough…we will definitely be back for another visit.

title: Lovely boutique hotel in a fabulous location
text: Wonderful friendly staff and clean rooms with lovely amenities including l'ocitane products. The free coffee / soft drinks / water were great to come back to after a long day out. We also loved doing the local walking tour they recommended/ provided a map for. The area was very vibrant and the location was excellent with a short walk to the metro. Would highly recommend!

title: Lovely hotel in an amazing location!
text:
The hotel itself is lovely, clean, stylish and welcoming with an amazing view from the balconies. You can see a lot of effort is put into the hotel, from the design to the toiletries provided. The location itself is perfect for exploring Montmartre and more and the staff are more than happy to share recommendations.
We called to drop off our luggage early and the staff (Allessandra in particular) was extremely helpful and friendly throughout our stay. Would definitely book again!

title: J’ adore Hotel Des Arts
text: Lovely! Wonderful ! Amazing! Just a few words to describe the Hotel des Arts.  Surrounded by many shops, restaurants and close to several Metro stations this hotel was ideally located for our stay in Paris.  Loved wandering the neighborhood of Montmarte.  Our hotel room had two single beds which were very comfy. Slept very well and we looked  forward to returning to our (air conditioned) room after a busy day of exploring.  The bathroom was stocked with hand soap , shampoo and body wash by L’Occitane.  The room was always kept spotless by the housekeeping staff.  The front/reception area had a kitchen/bar that was stocked with cold drinks like water and soda as well as a coffee maker (which I wished we had found sooner ).  The best feature of this hotel however was the staff.  The front desk staff always wished us well on our travels as we left for the day to explore and always greeted us with a welcome back when we returned in the evening.  They also were helpful in helping us navigate our route to Versailles and helped arrange our pick up back to the airport on our departure. By far the kindest hotel staff I have encountered.  Counting down the days already when we can come back to Paris and will no doubt stay here again.

title: Wonderful staff and very comfortable stay
text: This place is wonderful and the staff go above and beyond to help your stay in Paris be delightful. The beds were very comfortable, the water warm and our room was perfect temperature when we arrived. We had a nice view of the Sacre Coeur.  We were minutes from the Metro and many bus lines so it was very easy to get around by public transport. I can't wait to go back.

Very nice little hotel. Situated in beautiful Montmartre the location is really great. Our room was small, but clean and Cody. We liked the Rezeption area close to the little breakfast room. Free warm and cold drinks the whole day. Exceptionally friendly staff!
Good choice for a weekend in Paris.

title: Fabulous hotel
text:
This is a fabulous hotel.
The decor and location of the hotel are really cool.
The hotel team are just wonderful. They really made us welcome,
We were new to Montmartre, but will definitely be back to this hotel.

title: Nice situation but
text:
Located in the most bohemian district of Paris, Montmartre, we had a small room with little storage but a nice decoration but this decoration made the room seem even smaller,
during the night there were young people who made a lot of noise when they returned from their evening and this noise lasted too long and it prevented us from having a good night as we wanted

title: Little Gem in Mountmartre
text:
Fantastic guest experience from start to finish. Truly wish I was staying alittle longer but without doubt I will return. 
Every member of staff exuded a warm  professional calm confidence.
Such a fun quirky hotel with lots of little touches to make you smile from a welcome card in your room to refreshments and a bar made available. 
To Top this all off my room on the 6th floor ( small but perfect ) had a fabulous view of the Eiffel Tower. 
You would be foolish to book anywhere else for your stay in the Mountmartre district .... if indeed you are lucky enough to find this Gem of a hotel had availability.

title: Hotel stay in Paris
text: The woman who checked us in was delightful and informative about the area.  Enjoyed our morning breakfast plenty of choices and delicious.  All your employees were very helpful and the Hotel is very clean.

title: Welcoming, stylish and comfortable
text: My teenage daughter and I really enjoyed our stay in this lovely welcoming hotel perfectly situated near Sacre  Coeur. It is a lovely comfortable boutique hotel where the staff are friendly and helpful, the rooms well equipped and the air con very much appreciated. We will be back!

title: Wonderful staff, great location
text: The staff at Hotel des Arts were wonderful - very friendly and helpful for questions. The room was very comfortable and offered some great amenities. The location is superb. We highly enjoyed our stay!

title: Charming hotel
text: I stayed for 2 nights with my 12 year old daughter. The staff is very nice and helpful and the hotel (while small) is kept up to date, clean and with nice details like free soft drinks and L'Occitane soaps... The location is also excellent. Will come back whenever in Paris. We had a small room without a view but it was nice and peaceful and we both slept like babies.

title: Wonderful stay
text: Picked this Hotel due to its “foody ” location. It was as a fabulous choice, the positioning was perfect. It offered an air conditioned welcome, and warm greeting. Service from the small team, spectacular. Our room was clean, compact and cool, perfect for a short stay. An honesty bar in the lobby with complimentary cool drinks was welcomed in the heat. Would highly recommend.

title: Quite simply the perfect stay in Paris, Hôtel des Arts Monmatre
text: The staff are INCREDIBLE, nothing is too much trouble and they really make you feel 'at home'. The location of the hotel is perfect. The decor is stylish and the finishing touches in the room are perfect. It was 37 degrees outside during our stay but the AC in our room kept it lovely and cool. In my line of work I stay in LOTS of hotels all around the world, trust me when I say that this is one of the best!!

title: Beautiful, cozy, and kind
text: Our stay at Hotel des Arts - Montmartre was perfect except the fact that they can only take up to two people in a room while i wanted to have my kid stayed with us at the end of our trip.  All the staff members were so kind and informative.  Especially, Christophe was super nice to walk me through all the amenities there,  and he helped me so much to find restaurants and another hotel to move after staying here.  Restaurants and shops near the hotel were great, and the neighborhood is beautiful.  I would stay here again if i have a chance.

title: Wonderful Hotel, Lively Neigjborhood
text: A teriffic hotel in a wonderful neighborhood.  The deluxe double, with a 4th floor balcony overlooking the Montmarte neighborhood, was the nicest room we've had in our multiple visits to Paris.  The spacious room (for Paris), the helpful staff,and the beautiful, well-appointed hotel was a delight.  The neighboehood, filled with cafes, bakeries, markets and restaurants a stone's throw from Sacre Coeur was lively and authentic.  Would stay here again in a second.

title: Superb hotel and fabulous staff
text: I first stayed here 8 years ago and loved the hotel and now, coming back to visit with my youngest son, it is even better than I remembered.  It is by far the most welcoming hotel I have ever stayed in and I would never stay anywhere else in Paris.  The area is village-like and easily walkable (even with the hills..I'm not very fit so it is good for me!).  My son got up early every morning to use the gym and we throughly enjoyed our visit.  The rooms are beautifully decorated and there was a nice welcome gift of macarons and plenty of cold water bottles.  Good air conditioning and a great shower.  They could have done nothing better.  I look forward to visiting again.  Thank you  - such a friendly group of people running the hotel, without exception.

title: Street
text: You can get the underground train in short walking distance. Other sights are also close by. I was really not happy about the noises coming from the street and loud people staying in the hotel that was coming in and going out all night until early morning.

title: Charming and well-appointed hotel in a fabulous location
text: Beautiful hotel in a wonderful location! My husband and I have been to Paris several times before but had never stayed in Montmartre. This was a charming location with excellent views of the city. The hotel room was well- appointed with luxury shampoo, body wash, and lotion  (I’m a product snob, so this is saying something. Haha). The staff were all very friendly and a particular treat was the free espresso bar and soft drinks in the lobby. We will definitely stay here the next time we are in Paris!

title: Stop looking! You found the perfect hotel!
text: This place made my honeymoon magical! Hotel des Arts has the best location right in the heart of Monmartre!  2 blocks from the Blanche Metro stop means you can get everywhere in the city!  The staff here is amazing!  Extremely welcoming from the moment my wife and I walked in.  They readied our room with the Romance Package (which made my wife cry tears of happiness) and it was perfect!  Definitely take advantage of the breakfast in the morning!  They have something for everyone.  They were even able to get us a cab on our departure on a rainy Paris morning.  We know exactly where we're staying next time we go to Paris!

title: A great address in Paris
text: Beautiful family owned property in a great location in monmartre.  Booked a larger room on the 4 th floor.  Many unexpected high end touched like l’occitane products, luxury assortment of teas in room, plus water, coffee etc. all amenities you need. Bed super comfy, room spotless.  Free coffee and tea in lobby. Sweet hammam that I had no time to use. Excellent staff.  Location is fantastic for sightseeing and dinners out.  Small street uphill though so keep in mind if you have luggage. We took a taxi…worth it.   Good vibes from this hotel.

title: Perfect!
text:
Excellent hotel, loved it so much we have just booked to go back next March.
Great location, only a minute away from pubs and restaurants. 
The staff were so friendly and lovely. 
Hotel rooms gorgeous and luxury toiletries, comfy beds and air conditioned
They have some lovely touches too for example refreshments available and we're given a lovely bag and keyring on departure. 
Perfect!

title: Great hotel, excellent personal service
text:
A lovely trip and felt welcomed as an old friend from the very start to the very end despite this being our first stay

Excellent customer service in a boutique hotel that has personality as reflected by the excellent team for whom there was no problem that could not be solved

The room was comfortable and spotless and the air conditioning on the hottest weekend of the year was a life saver

It is difficult to not give 5 stars but if it were possible to give 6 then I would as the good humour and professionalism was perfect. Everyone there was focussed on ensuring that the stay was comfortable and memorable and without any disrespect to the others I have to give an extra special shout out for Allesandra and Amel as well as Christophe who shared some interesting local  stories as we enjoyed evening drinks

Breakfast is great value and unrushed and the location a great starting point to explore the city

If you want a great hotel where the team treat you as an individual then look no further

title: Best boutique hotel in the best area of Paris
text: Excellent Boutique hotel in the best area of Paris, Montmartre. Marvelous staff and in the center of this lovely district of Paris. I highly recommend this lovely hotel. Walking distance to marvelous restaurants and shops. Nice breakfast available and honor bar in the afternoon/evening. Rooms are impeccably clean and made daily with turn down at night.

title: Beautiful hotel, fantastic location and very friendly staff - highly recommend!
text:
I can't thank the team at Hotel des arts enough for all of their help and hospitality, both during and leading up to our stay.
I had booked the trip to Paris as a surprise for my boyfriend's 40th birthday - I paid extra for the romance package and we checked into our room to be greeted with a beautifully laid out room, rose petals and flowers, heart shaped balloons, champagne, macaroons and bathrobes and slippers. We had a lovely room and balcony and in a central, lively part of Montmartre where all the bars and restaurants are. We were walking distance from the Sacre Coeur and went there most mornings to eat our breakfast pastries! We also visited the Amelie cafe down the road! 
The staff were all so helpful and friendly, and they were very quick to answer all of my queries by email prior to our stay. They also sent lots of recommendations for sightseeing and eating / drinking ahead of our stay.
There is a little bar area downstairs open from 3pm to 11pm and it was a nice touch being able to have a little coffee or soft drink and a Madeleine cake there (for free!) after a long day on our feet and before heading out in an evening! There was also a nice selection of alcohol and an honesty bar for all guests.
My only minor criticism is that the room was slightly small so we didn't have loads of room for luggage and hanging / storing clothes, but I wouldn't have expected anything less for central Paris! The bed was very comfortable and I loved the decor too! 
Thank you again for our wonderful stay! Xx

title: Very pleasant stay
text: Excellent staff, very clean rooms, location worked very well. Would highly recommend this location and hotel.  Several great restaurants very close by.  Easy walk to Moulin Rouge or Sacre Coeur.  The owner (second generation) helped personally with our checkout.

title: Small Hotel with a great attitude.
