text:
We, a party of 3 friends, styed for 2 nights. Very bussy time, but the fantastic concierge Alessandra, did a great job, getting us tickets and dinner reservations, which looked sold out on the web.
Nice clean modern rooms, but still charming.

title: Wonderful
text: This hotel is in the heart of Montmartre, walking distance to everything there is to see and do in this charming neighborhood. What really makes the hotel stand out besides the perfect location and the well appointed extremely clean rooms is the staff. Everyone who works at the hotel is kind, gracious and goes out of their way to make the guests feel at home. I wish we could have stayed more than just one night.

title: A nice visit. We will come back.
text: This hotel really  gives you the family feeling . We will certanly come back 😃🇫🇷. The staff is super helpful. The breakfast nice. The room was small but peasefule , tidy och nice. Overall a super hotel in the region of Montmartre.

title: A fabulous choice
text:
The hotel is in a great location as Monmatre is a lovely place to wander around and eat dinner after a busy day sightseeing.

The hotel staff were really attentive, with a walking map to do a little walking tour of all the pretty streets of Monmatre upon arrival. As well as some complimentary drinks and macarons. 

Throughout our stay they also helped with directions to get the bus etc and restaurant recommendations. We tried Chez Pitou at the top of the street which was stunning! 

The rooms were clean and modern, comfortable bed and quality sheets.

title: Brilliant Base Camp!
text:
Wonderful stay 30th May until 3rd June. All staff are very friendly, nothing was too much trouble. In great part of Montmartre region close to Basilica Sacre Coeur, Place du Tertre and the Moulin Rouge. 
Withy plenty of good restaurants nearby as well as quaint bistros the area felt very safe and had a great vibe. 
The Hotel is Spotless and has a nice calm feel and family atmosphere. 
I wholeheartedly recommend this hotel.

title: The perfect stay in the perfect location
text: Loved everything about this place. Amazing service, great location (the heart of Montmartre, with metro at a walking distance) in a historic building with modern amenities. I’m already planning my next stay!

title: The best kept secret in Montmartre
text:
Overall, everything about the hotel was excellent! It was located within walking distance of all Montmartre has to offer. The friendly staff was always around to make us feel welcome as well as assist us in touring the city. The ambiance of the hotel and rooms were just perfect. We would definitely recommend Hotel des Arts to all and we hope to make another visit in the future. 
Kathy and Lauryn

title: Hidden gem in Montmartre
text: Centrally located hotel with spectacular views, surrounded with bars and delicious restaurants, with just a short walk from the cathedral. Beautifully decorated hotel with everything you need, but most importantly with amazingly friendly staff! We felt like home so we are definitely coming back!

title: Great hotel with perfect location
text: Great location and service. Close to metro and several restaurants. Charming hotel and our rooms was faced the calm backyard. A bit small rooms, but nice, modern and clean. So a bit small floor space for two large suitcases. Would stay here again.

title: Just the very best
text:
My wife and I stayed here for 3 nights on a trip that was two years overdue, twice deferred because of Covid.
At last we made it. 
We made one mistake, deciding to walk from Gard du Nord, trailing our suitcase! Not a good idea, whatever Google Maps tells you. In the end we hailed a taxi. Live and learn!
But what a brilliant hotel. Divine little room, more than adequate, and service that I defy any larger or more expensive hotel to better. Wonderful staff, attentive and friendly, nothing is too much trouble.
Free coffee and cold drinks on tap all day, and a small 'honesty' bar should you need it.
Set in the midst of Montmartre, it's beautifully located, and the hotel offers a print out walking tour, which we decided to do, and which showed us bits of the old City that we would otherwise have missed. 
The hotel and its staff did everything to make our short stay totally unforgettable. Later this year we celebrate our 50th wedding anniversary, and this will be a treasured memory. Thank you

title: Everything was perfect!
text:
We absolutely loved staying at the Hotel des Arts! The staff are exceptionally nice, well-trained, and very helpful with anything you need. The honor bar in the lobby area with light snacks and drinks was especially nice to "come home to" after a long day of sightseeing.

Our room was wonderful, the bed was very comfortable, and we thoroughly enjoyed staying in the heart of Montmartre. In spite of the central location (lots of restaurants, stores, grocery, etc within easy walking distance) the high quality windows kept our room very quiet in the evening. It's a bit of walk to the metro stations (situated about half way between two stations), but we had no problems at all with that. In fact, that made the area feel much more like a local neighborhood and quite safe. We never felt uneasy walking around, even after dark in the early evening.

This was our first trip to Paris, and we couldn't be happier with our choice of hotel. Staying at the Hotel des Arts was truly one of the best parts of our trip, and we can't wait to go back. We felt that the nightly rate ( in early May 2022) was very reasonable for the quality of the room, property, and exceptional customer service. If you like small family-run hotels with personal touches, situated a bit off the Paris touristy beaten-path, and don't want to pay outrageous hotel prices in the center of the city, this is the place for you. We highly recommend!

title: Amazing hotel will leave you with high standards
text: I only got the chance to stay at this hotel for three nights unfortunately and I wish I stayed longer but they were fully booked. This was the first place I stayed in Paris and it has left me with high standards. So much so that my next hotel is incomparable. The rooms are big and the bathrooms are lovely. They have quality shampoo and hand soap. I stayed on the first floor in Chopin and had a lovely view of the streets. It was quiet for a window room in my opinion. They had multiple USB ports to charge you phone, coffee tea and a kettle were in the room, room service I believe was twice a day and free coffee and nibbles from 3pm to 11pm. The location was in a great area close to many restaurants and bakeries and close to the abbesses metro station. The service was impeccable. I really wish I got to stay for my full time in Paris however I will be sure to book way in advance next time to ensure they have space. Highly recommend if you enjoy quality stays.

title: Wonderful little hotel!
text: I found this place after doing quite a bit of research on hotels in Paris. It was my first time in Paris so I wanted to find the perfect place at the right price. And I did. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, everyone was just lovely! The customer service was fantastic - Christophe in particular helped us pick some places to go out in the evening. The rooms were spotless and the perfect size. Not too small! Appreciated the air conditioning as well since it was just starting to get warm in Paris. The decorating in the rooms was also very chic. And the location! Montmarte is just absolutely the perfect place to stay in Paris. With the cobblestone roads and markets and cafes everywhere! Plus it’s close to the Metro, so easy to get around. I would most definitely stay here again! Merci !

title: I would happily return!
text:
Firstly; the staff were awesome. Thanks to Alessandra, Christophe & Co for being so lovely, and for making me feel so welcome. 

Secondly; the location is everything. Walking distance to 3 different Metro stations (Abbesses, Blanche & Place de Clichy, close to shops, cafes, bars & restaurants but located on a peaceful side street. 

Lastly; the style and amenities were on point. The aesthetic of the place was gorgeous. I loved the art, decor styling & also the small touches too - the Honesty Bar, the L’Occitane products, the goodnight note left on my pillow etc. 

A few things that could’ve made it a 5 not a 4 star review for me - better soundproofing between the rooms would make all of the difference. The walls were too thin. I heard way too much of what the other guests were up to. Also, an iron in the room and a room with natural light and not a window facing a wall would’ve been fab. The last two points were minor and did not stop me from enjoying my time at Hotel des Arts. I would happily return!

title: Perfect stay in a lovely hotel
text:
Perfect location, great and so super friendly staff, very very nice hotel, nice restaurants / bars - there is not a single thing you could complain about.
when I come back to Paris again, I would definitely stay here again.
It is perfect if you want to explore Paris as a couple

title: Best hotel in Montmartre
text: After all these years I’ve finally found a hotel in Paris I’d feel happy to recommend to friends and family. It was perfect in every way from the warm welcome (including an interesting self guided walking tour map), the beautifully decorated and appointed room with l’occitaine toiletries, to the very friendly goodbye.  I’m already planning my next visit. And for a very reasonable price. Thank you hotel des arts.

title: Frau
text: Christophe is the best receptionist ever, he literally saved my life . Good conversations and best stay ever. So much love for the City of love. The Girl who welcomed me on tuesday was also pretty nice (alessandra)! Very good reception!

title: Finally found the hotel I've been looking for
text: In all the many times I have visited Montmartre I have not come across a hotel like Hotel des Arts. Everything about it is perfect - the location, the rooms and the standard of cleanliness, the breakfasts and as well as that the amazing staff for whom nothing is too much trouble (including the offer of help with a police report). I cannot recommend this hotel enough. I have already booked my next stay in June.

title: Great location, even better staff.
text: Beautiful location. Lovely rooms. Exceptional staff. What more could you ask for from a trip to Montmarte? Everyone was extremely accommodating and had great recommendations. We will definitely be coming back here in the future! Merci!

title: Fab hotel in perfect spot
text: Loved everything about this hotel. Staff wonderful, location fantastic, room super clean and bed so comfy. Free hot and soft drinks and honesty bar meant cappuccinos, pale ale and champagne whenever we liked. Great having Bluetooth speaker too. We felt very taken care of here.

title: Welcoming Stay
text: We were offered tea/coffee on dropping our luggage early.  All the staff were friendly and welcoming.  The property is beautifully decorated and immaculate.  Our room was spacious for Paris and had everything we needed, including a bath,  Nice touch to have macarons in the room.  The bedside tables could have been a little larger. Used the honesty bar and the night porter looked after us.  Breakfast was plentiful and varied.  Really did feel like a home from home.  Would recommend.

title: This place dried my tears❣️
text:
This place dried my tears 🥰!!!

Originally I had planed to go to Thailand. A stop over was scheduled in Paris but due to problems with my Thaipass, Lufthansa didn’t allow me on my scheduled flight to Bangkok. I was devastated. It was already late so I looked on the internet for a place to stay and found this beautiful place in the center Montmartre. 
Wonderful, helpful and heart warming people, was just what I needed. They provided me with great tips for my dinner and I managed to somehow forget about the disaster and enjoy this beautiful city. The hotel itself is also lovely! It is designed by the owners - and let me tell you, for all I know, they could have a second and very successful career as interior designers. The rooms are small and cozy and the bed is fantastic. Everything is clean and functions well. You can feel the love and dedication the owners and their staff but into this incredible place. I will for sure be back! It is one of the most wonderful places I have been. Je l’aime ❣️

title: Highly Recommend
text:
This is a fabulous hotel in a great location. Super friendly staff and nothing was too much trouble, everything was clean and immaculate the bed was so comfortable and the room a decent size for Paris with a great bathroom.
Metro station was a 5 min walk but so much to to see-do-enjoy locally.
I’ll definitely be back.

title: Perfect visit
text: Proprietor Philippe and his team provide unmatched hospitality in an immaculate facility. The rooms are appointed with everything you may need, including a built-in universal power outlet that worked with my 3-prong 110-v U.S. laptop! Hôtel des arts is now my go-to residence when visiting Montmartre.

title: Lovely boutique hotel in Montmartre
text: This is a lovely hotel in a beautiful neighborhood with easy access to the rest of Paris. The staff is very friendly. The room we stayed in, while small, was very nicely and efficiently designed for the space. It was sunny, the bed was very comfortable, with good reading lights, and it was perfectly clean.

title: THE BEST SERVICE EVER!
text: This was such an amazing stay - we stayed for two nights and the staff were the kindest I have ever experienced in my travels. I 100% recommend staying here, it had such a good atmosphere and the facilities were amazing and clean. Thank you so much for a good stay!!

title: A treasure in Montmartre!
text: Hotel des Arts is a wonderful hotel, we really enjoyed our stay here for the 4 nights we were in Paris. The hotel is situated about 10 minutes walk from Sacre Coeur and very close to multiple metro stations. The hotel is beautiful and artfully decorated. The room was quiet and comfortable and the bathroom had a bath and shower (with great shower pressure!) The L'Occitane products in the bathroom were really nice. All of the staff at the hotel are exceptional, they go above and beyond to help you with any questions you have as well as any mistakes you made on your booking! I have been to Paris several times and this is without a doubt the best hotel I've stayed in. We will definitely be returning! Thank you so much for a lovely stay, a bientot!

title: Beautiful in montmartre
text:
This is one of the best hotels we have stayed in, everything is attention to detail and the staff are so friendly and helpful 
Located in a prime area,  and not too costly. 
The rooms are lovely, and we will definitely return, this was our second time staying here.

title: AMAZING
text:
My mom and I stayed here for three nights and it was an amazing experience. The staff were so nice, the hotel was so beautiful and typically French (outside and in), the location was *chef's kiss*. It´s smack in the middle of Montmartre so there's always ambience (never feeling unsafe) and restaurants that are open until late. The subway is a 5min walk and takes you all over Paris.

I can´t recommend this hotel enough!!!

title: Perfect!
text:
Wonderful location, super friendly staff, very nice facilities… so perfect!
We could had not chose a better place to stay this time in Paris. If you want to enjoy Monmartre neighborhood that’s the place to stay. Our stay was perfect!
The bed was so comfort! They use l’occitane products. Bathroom was Super cleaning. 
Love it! Love it!

title: Fabulous Hotel with great staff making us feel welcomed.
text:
Would absolutely recommend this hotel.

A fabulous little hotel in a great location of the city with lots of little lovely local shops and eateries in the area. The hotel was very clean, fresh and well maintained and there was a real feeling that the staff couldn't do enough for us, making us feel like welcomed guests throughout our stay.

On-site there were complimentary tea, coffee and juice available in the main breakfast bar and instant tea/coffee available in room along with a standard room safe. Whilst the rooms aren't huge, they are exactly as to be expected in a large city. 

There was a Marshall amplifier in room that you could connect via bluetooth to stream music from a compatible phone etc. The in-room TV wasn't great; just some standard digital channels but with only one channel that was in English. (France 24) and no option to chromecast - very minor point however!

Less than 10min walk from Sacré-Cœur and only around a 50min walk to the centre of the city and amenities.

title: Perfect stay in the 18th!
text: Superb hotel! Excellent accommodations and service. The staff is kind and welcoming and made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Rooms are beautiful and spacious with excellent views and the location can't be beat! Perfect part of Paris to stay in with many sights in walking distance and easy access to multiple metro stations. The team here made our stay wonderful and exceeded expectations. We can't wait to come back and stay again!

title: Our favourite
text:
We’ve always liked this hotel for its friendly staff and location near to the many cafes on Rue des Abbesses. On returning after a two year gap due to Covid, we were delighted to find now it’s even better. The refurbishment has been beautifully done and gives a fresh modern feel. The new reception and breakfast room layout provides somewhere to sit and have coffee if you don’t want to stay in your room. Our room was not large, as is normal for this area, but attractive, clean, comfortable and well equipped. The bathroom was new bright and roomy. The room was serviced daily to a high standard.
The staff are cheerful, welcoming and happy to help. We are already looking forward to our next stay.

title: Thanksss
text: The hotel is nice, clean and close to the metro to reach the most beautiful places in Paris. Really good self service breakfast. The guys at the reception are all very kind but a special thanks goes to Alessandra for her skills and her kindness. Always smiling. Thanks for everything and see you soon!

title: A caring team to make you feel at home!
text:
I was excited to find this hotel as the location could not be more perfect. It is walkable to the metro and ALL the key Montmartre tourist sites.  I expected to be satisfied but was pleased to be thrilled with the hotel, staff, amenities and service.  
STAFF:  Being a student of the french language, I sent an email in advance asking if the staff would be willing to speak french with me.  To a person, this request was honored and certain staff even helped correct my errors.  On my last day, I really came to appreciate the high level of service.  I had preordered a car service to take me to the airport.  The service never showed and the staff quickly arranged alternative transportation so I would not miss my flight.  During all of this, they efficiently helped other guests. AND, a very drunk homeless person wandered in singing loudly and creating a scene.  I was extremely impressed with the calm way in which the team dealt with this man.  They spoke quietly to him, gave him coffee and a snack while ushering him back outside.  Their skill at handling this situation eliminated a negative escalation and kept us all safe.  And, at the same time, they preserved this poor person's dignity to the extent possible.  How often do you get to see that in action?  The team worked together respectfully  to accomplish the goals of protecting the guests while understanding that this man is a human being.  Incredible!  All of these things make me a fan for life of this hotel!!!
ROOM:  Beautifully decorated room with a very comfortable bed and excellent linens.  The bathrooms are well appointed and the showers are incredible.  Nice L'Occitane products too!  Nice selection of in-room, complimentary coffee, tea and water.  Big screen TV.  Large window that can be opened for fresh air.  I woke up every morning to the delicious smells of breakfast being prepared. And even though my window was open all night, the room was very quiet making sleep easy.
BREAKFAST:  Loved the breakfast buffet which was well attended to and plentiful.  Very clean and delicious!
GYM:  I was thrilled to use the hotel gym.  It was kept meticulously clean.  Although small, the equipment was all state of the art, sophisticated and high quality.  Currently the gym is used by appointment only which I'm assuming is because of COVID to minimize the number of people in a small space.  I had no problem getting appointments.  
I encourage everyone to book their stays at Hotel des Arts.  You will not be sorry!!!  Thank you to the entire team for making my stay so wonderful.

title: A lovely hotel in a great location
text:
Well, what can I say. The hotel is situated in the most amazing street restaurant and bar area that has a great atmosphere. The hotel itself is finished to a high standard and the staff are extremely kind, they recommended places to eat and visit.

The room was very nice and they placed us in a room with the most amazing view over the elevated part of Paris. You also could see the Montmartre Sacré-Cœur over the tops of the other buildings.

Thank you for an amazing stay, and if we return to Paris we would be staying at your hotel again!!

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Stayed at this hotel Valentines weekend, location was excellent, staff really helpful, room/bathroom small but had everything you could need and very clean. Would definitely visit again and recommend 😊 Complimentary coffee and biscuits throughout the day too!

title: Best hotel in Paris!
text:
The hotel is perfect! 
Perfect location in a  vibrant neighborhood, the rooms are very convenient , quiet and well equipped and the staff is amazing! very friendly and welcoming. A metro station and buses stations are in close proximity to the hotel and the access to all parts of Paris is easy

title: Paris Vacation
text:
Wonderful boutique hotel in a great location near the Louvre. Staff is friendly and helpful, concierge did a fantastic job booking our meals and excursions. Our room included breakfast which offered plenty of great options from yogurt to pastries to omelets.
My wife and I highly recommend.

title: Wonderful stay! All of the reviews are true.
text:
Amazing customer service, the hotel is doing a fabulous job at keeping staff happy and it showed!!! The amazing service started from the time I reached out by email to book this hotel with Eve and Melanie. They could not be more helpful in answering my questions and replying very quickly. 

We booked a family/connecting rooms that consisted of a single door that opened to a small hallway where we had room 211-212. Very private and the kids loved having their own room. We could prop the door open so we could still hear them but had total privacy as well. I was nervous about the superior rooms being too small after reading some reviews, however they were bigger than expected and gorgeous! Our room had windows that looked on to the courtyard where I had fun seeing people take photo ops for their "emily in paris" imitation. Rooms were extremely clean, beds/linens/pillows were so comfortable we all had the best sleeps! 

The concierge were very helpful, standout being the service I received from Germain...he went above and beyond and was not bothered by my requests for dinner and indecisiveness. Restaurant recommendations were great, and he also booked us skip the line tickets for the Arc which was very helpful.  I also appreciated Suzanne the manager reaching out wanting my feedback directly and we would communicate by messenger. You could tell everyone cared about making your trip and stay the best it could possibly be. 

Breakfast was included in the rate, overall good choices but my only recommendation would be to add perhaps pancakes, fresh berries and bran cereal but really it was quiet, unrushed and great service in the restaurant. 

Location was amazing and although close to the Louvre we found the hotel situated in a quiet sanctuary away from the hustle and buzz of the crowds. I would not hesitate to stay here again and would recommend to anyone!

title: Really nice hotel close to the Louvre
text:
My wife and I came here to celebrate our 40th wedding anniversary. Our suite with balcony was very nice. 

Reception staff are really friendly and helpful and we were welcomed with a glass of champagne which was a nice touch

The bar staff make a fantastic Cosmopolitan

title: Romantic weekend feeling like a princess next to the palace!
text: Yes 5 stars to this gorgeous little hidden gem next to the palace and literally a view away from the Louvre.  We were fortunate to stay on the 5th floor in a suite with not one but two balconies with views of Sacre Cour, the palace and Louvre! Wonderful service by all from start to finish.  The included breakfast (which you can have in room as well) was incredible and so many choices! Very fresh and delicious.  Our bath was noteworthy large for France standards with a tub and separate shower.  Would highly recommend this hotel for a great location and excellent service and well earned Small Luxury Hotel.  Merci!

title: great staff, lovely hotel and excellent location
text: So charming and quaint....wonderful staff and intimate lobby with beautiful courtyard in back. (where emily in paris is filmed....so panoramic and stunning.)  My daughter and I loved being a stone's throw from the Louvre and the beautiful toulliere gardens and so many cafes and restaurants.

title: Perfect from start to finish
text: We would rate it 100 if we could. From the beginning of the stay to the end, the staff were attentive and professional. They couldn’t do enough to make our stay comfortable and special. The rooms were clean and comfortable, the toiletries wonderful and the hotel decor was very chic without being over the top - exactly what we were after.  The location unbeatable. The whole stay was an exercise in how the hospitality industry should be as standard.  Our thanks to the whole team for making it a memorable 10 year wedding anniversary

title: Gem of a hotel !
text:
A convenient gem of a hotel !
My teenage daughter and I stayed at this hotel for 8 nights at the end of July/beginning of August. You cannot beat the location in terms of convenience, safety, ease. The concierge staff is first rate. They were able to secure reservations at every spot we requested.  They arranged a private guide and transportation to Versailles that was wonderful. They also arranged shipping via DHL of flea market purchases back to the us. Truly the staff made our stay much easier for me !
Our room faced the Valois courtyard and was very quiet.  While small, it was clean and the bathroom was modern and efficient. Breakfast was included in our room rate and it was more than adequate. Friendly staff and delicious breakfast. I would defiantly stay there again. Palais royale is across the street and a beautiful stroll in the early am !

title: Home away from HOME
text:
My husband and I just got back from our nine night stay at the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal. I wanted to offer them my compliments on  our entire stay.  
We arrived on July 12th as our train from London was delayed and we were pressed for time and the road to your hotel was closed due to construction. Concierge member Irina and another one of her coworkers were the first smiles we saw as our cab  was parked by the Cafe Royal. She came down the street to help get our luggage out of the car, take it back to the hotel and check us in so we could get to a food tour in Le Marais. WOW!!!! So we were so impressed from checkin to check out by your entire staff.

Every time we came in from being out all day, we were greeted by smiles and a BONJOUR which felt like being home. The concierge team and especially Irina, are EXCEPTIONAL!  They are knowledgable and friendly and helpful. Every single reservation they made for us was PERFECT. Every change they did for me was also PERFECT. The bar area is beautiful and relaxing, the drinks are cool and refreshing. The dining area was comfortable and peaceful and the food was delicious. 

The front desk staff are friendly helpful and also delightful. One girl at the front desk even came out and spoke to the cab driver to make sure we got to where we needed to go. 

The room was small, BUT had everything we needed. The bed and pillows were comfortable and the balcony was what I wanted. I loved having room service in the room and the Nespresso coffee maker as well. When we ordered room service it came on time and efficiently. ALWAYS with a smile. 

I cant say enough wonderful things about this hotel. The location is perfect, the staff is professional and caring and the facilities we welcoming.

Thank you for all you ALL do for us as guests. We will be back.

title: Great place to stay after international flight!
text: We enjoyed our stay at this hotel!  After a long international flight, we were able to freshen up in their spa.  They also held our bags, so we could grab lunch before check-in.  We stayed in another Paris hotel later in our trip.  The rooms at The Grand Hotel du Palais Royal were large in comparison!  The rooms were also clean, quiet and conveniently located near the Louvre.  We would definitely stay here again!

title: Perfect location, clean, stylish, fabulous service.
text: We absolutely loved this hotel. The room design is efficient with beautiful decor, the customer service is excellent and there are thoughtful touches. The bathroom mirror is anti fog, there are small tables to enjoy the balcony and the toiletries provided are diptyque brand which smells amazing. Outlets are accessible and we even discovered champagne delivered to our room one day!

title: Lovely in every way
text: The staff are welcoming and helpful and efficient. The rooms are comfortable and the bathrooms are lovely. The restaurant is very good for both breakfast and cocktails. This hotel gets consistent high marks because they earn every star every day. Such a lovely experience in a terrific location steps from metro, Louvre, Tulleries, and Laduree!

title: Fantastic stay !
text: This hotel knows how to treat their customers , also their rooms are a good size for Paris and everything in the room was perfect . We had a room with a balcony and we were   surprised at the size of it .  The restaurant had a good breakfast with very good service . The location was great just a few minutes from the Louvre by foot . You can't go wrong with this hotel and we hope to return soon . Thank you Grand Hotel du Palais Royal .

title: Amazing customer service at a gorgeous hotel
text: The staff went above and beyond to make sure that our stay was as comfortable and amazing as possible. They constantly checked in with us to see if our needs were being met and to assist with any questions/concerns we had. The room was gorgeous and very comfortable. Breakfast was delicious every morning with great service. We would absolutely stay here again.

title: Great location, helpful staff, clean and comfortable rooms
text: This hotel is off a quiet street in a wonderful neighborhood, within a few minutes walk to so many great things to see and foods to eat. The hotel staff is attentive, the quality and cleanliness was very good, and everything was quite comfortable.

title: Great
text:
Great for everything, location, service, facilities, breakfast and others.
Will recommend if you are visitors for paris with schedules near the Louvre and shopping near Vandom and Samaritanne.
Hope to stay again for next visit

title: Excellent location, fabulous staff
text: The location is close to all and walking distance to the Louvre. Most of all what makes this hotel great is the staff. They are all so attentive to the needs of the guests. I stayed here with my teenage daughter and she did not want to leave the hotel even to go shopping. We will be staying here on our next visit and recommended it to my family and friends.

title: Excellent experience!
text: My wife and I traveled to Paris for our honeymoon, and we are very pleased with our decision to stay at the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal. From the moment we arrived at the hotel on Tuesday afternoon until the moment we departed on Saturday, the service we received was consistently first class and made us feel completely at home. Suzanne, the guest experience manager, checked in with us periodically to ensure that our stay was comfortable, and Alexandre and the concierge staff graciously assisted us with making restaurant reservations and booking sightseeing attractions like the Seine River cruise. We could not have asked for a better experience, and we will definitely be staying at the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal the next time we are in Paris!

title: A door to history
text:
It is the second time we have chosen to stay at the Palais Royal for a week-end in Paris.

The Palais Royal is a palais in its true sense: The reception is warm and attentive, the rooms are splendid and the ingredients for breakfast carefully selected. When sitting in the breakfast room with a view on the Place de Valois, you might even catch a look at the film set of 'Emily in Paris'!

title: Cute boutique hotel
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The hotel is in a great location in the 1st. The staff was incredibly warm and inviting. We stayed in an executive room, and though it was small, it was well appointed and extremely comfortable to sleep in. Highly recommend!

title: Very nice stay
text: Not much to find fault with here.  Yeah the rooms were a little small but the positives far outweigh the negatives.  The location was nice just a short walk from the Louvre and there are numerous places to eat within five minutes.  Breakfast at the hotel was very good and fast.  The staff at the front desk and concierge were both very helpful.  They provided us with some excellent recommendations for meals and gave good advice on how to get around.

title: Honeymoon Visit
text:
Our first visit to Paris as our Honeymoon and could not fault the staff or accommodation. 

The team were friendly and very helpful. 

On arrival we were offered either water or champagne at check in which was a nice touch. 

Location is great, central and nice district with great bars and brassiere near by with 10 minute walk.

title: 20th Wedding Anniversary
text: My wife and I stayed for our 20th wedding anniversary and were treated like royalty when we arrived.  The service during our stays was top notch and really helped make our trip a memorable one.  We highly recommend this hotel and would love to visit again.

title: A Perfect Jewel For The Self-Dependent Traveler
text: Our trip from the US to Paris had been years in the making as we came to see the Adam Lambert & Queen concert in Paris that had originally been scheduled for 2020 which, due to COVID, finally happened in 2022. The location of this hotel is ideal....the center of everything.  Our room was the amazing Suite Panoramique....at the top of the hotel with a terrace featuring perfect views Lourve, Eiffel Tower, Opera house and Sacré Coeur de Montmartre.  That about covers it!  The room itself is comfortable & functional but not opulent....which is perfect.  The air conditioning was not up to the temperatures during our visit...but it was 90+F most days.  Room service breakfast is amazing....French Toast to die for!!!.  Room service in general is marginal. The in-Room Dining systems/processes are problematic. Never call In-Room Dining...they dont answer.  Call the Reception and ask to be transferred...then it will keep ringing until they answer.  Lunch & Dinner menu is limited and focused "healthy" choices.  But sometimes, I would just love a turkey sandwich or something "normal".  Not here.  Staff is friendly.  But not trainied to "World Class" standards.  They are great until there is a problem...then they suddenly cant speak/understand English.  :)  But its all minor.  I am fairly independent.  I do not rely on the hotel to provide transportation or reservations.  I do that myself.  This is the way to be here...then you will be thrilled.  We will be back and we will stay here (but will plan our lunches and dinners elsewhere...hey, its Paris.  No issue there!).

title: Relaxing stay in a busy City
text: I stayed here with my wife for 2 nights and had a fantastic time. The staff are phenomenal; attentive, good knowledge and always smiling. Rooms were well done and well kitted out and a good size (for Paris).

title: Hidden jewel in the center of Paris!
text: Tucked away an unassuming side street in the center of Paris, Grand Hotel du Palais Royal is a hidden jewel perfect for tourists & business people alike.  Clean rooms, friendly staff, & fantastic food at Cafe 52.

title: Excellent location and service
text: The service is excellent as is the location. The wellness area is a luxury and sets this hotel apart. They have a large steam sauna with showers, robes, etc., which were easily accessible and which we used several times during our stay. Being right across the street from the Louvre is convenient. The only downsides are that the rooms are small for a five-star hotel (it is Paris, after all) and thus the beds are small (full). I would stay here again. Very happy with my stay here.

title: A Must Do in Paris
text: From the moment I arrived at this beautiful place, I was greeted with a happy expediency. The staff was extremely attentive offering a glass of champagne and offering to take pictures as I checked in. I received immediate help with my luggage and my room was ready prior to check in. I was offered a tour of the hotel and informed about the amenities. Each and every time I called the concierge, it was a success! Every question I had answered. The rooms were impeccably clean with beautiful views. There water and a bottle of wine upon arrival. The beds and pillows were so comfortable and dream inducing. I enjoyed restful sleep each time. Breakfast was lovely and the staff welcoming and efficient. I will definitely stay here again!

title: Customer Service was Incredible
text: We stayed at this hotel on the back end of a seven day trip.  We wished we would have stayed there the entire time.  It was an incredible location, the staff was bilingual and exceptional, and the room was large and had plenty of space.  We stayed on the 6th floor in one of the large rooms but it was well worth the additional money.  It was our 10th wedding anniversary and they had a bottle of champagne waiting on us in the room which was a nice touch.  The concierge was spot on and helped us  with just about everything include covid testing, car service, and restaurants.

title: Super location, great staff, tiny rooms
text: The location was unbeatable as was the service. Friendly staff, who were always available and smiling.  Having stayed at European hotels across the world, I know what to expect when it comes to size of the rooms but having booked a Deluxe Room. I must say I was disappointed with the postage stamp size room we got.  There wasn’t even space for the coffee machine which had to take up real estate on the dressing table. Tried bringing this up with the front desk but the hotel was full and probably nothing they could do anyways. Manage your expectations on room size and you will not be disappointed with the rest of your experience.

title: Lovely stay
text: Our room was beautiful and the bathroom and amenities were great. The staff was helpful and kind. The breakfast each day was delicious and fresh. We will return. The proximity to the metro and all of the main attractions was perfect for us.

title: Perfection
text: This is my absolute favorite hotel in Paris. Perfect location, helpful staff, great rooms, bar and breakfast. Everything is amazing here  - great for traveling alone, as a couple or group/family. Perfection overall!

title: Lovely building in a lovely location
text:
Room was small, but comfortable, with a big bathroom!
The "balcony" was in name only.
Free breakfast was a nice bonus.
Concierge was extremely helpful.
Location was just perfect, literally next door to the Louvre!!

title: Perfect hotel in perfect location
text: I cannot say enough about the helpful and friendly staff.  Every single need met and exceeded expectations.  The rooms are a little small but that is to be expected in Europe.  Even though they were small, they still met our every need and our stay was comfortable and amazing.

title: Very helpful and efficient
text:
We stayed at the hotel for 4 days and the service was excellent. All staff were very accommodating and helped with any enquiry we had, recommending some great restaurants (L’absinthe and Pain, Vin et Fromage). Jussi was very kind and extremely helpful. 

We used the pool, sauna and steam room. All a lovely addition to our relaxing stay. 

Would highly recommend!

title: Great hotel
text: Excellent value. Quick checkin, quiet area. Comfortable rooms. Many classic nearby eating places. Staff responsive and helpful. Pleasant view overlooking courtyard. Very comfortable beds and pillows. Highly recommend.

title: The Perfect Hotel
text: We recently spent 6 nights in a Junior Suite room with two balconies (Chambre 507).  This hotel is everything you could ask for in a hotel in Paris.  It has location, spacious rooms and bathrooms, and above all, the best service and most gracious employees.  We have stayed at three hotels and one VRBO in Paris, and this hotel competes with the best--Le Meurice, Peninsula, Westin Tuileries.  Actually, the service was superior to all but Le Meurice, which it equaled.  Upon check-in, we were upgraded to a Junior Suite with two balconies.  The concierges were so friendly and helpful.  Special compliments to Augustin, Thomas and Alexandre for all their help and warm courtesy.  I cannot imagine not staying here next time I am in Paris.  Well done to the Grand Hotel du Palais Royale!  Je t'aime!

title: Great stay and outstanding service
text:
Great location and truly terrific and friendly service by the entire staff. The Concierges were outstanding!
One comment is that we moved to a higher level of rooms but the room was smaller (particularly the bathroom), and more expensive. Only benefit: a minuscule balcony

title: Loved this hotel!   Highly recommend !
text: Just spent 5 nights at the hotel and loved it!  Fantastic location on a quiet and very pretty street. We booked a Jr Suite but were upgraded to a suite.   It was so comfortable and lovely.  Comfortable beds and pillows and a fantastic bathroom!   Shower fabulous which I always love.  Lobby of the hotel charming. Restaurant/ breakfast room very chic and you can also sit outside in the beautiful plaza.  Nice selection of foods and wonderful service.   Bar also nice to have a coffee or drink.  Staff just amazing,  kind and helpful.  Special shout out to their fantastic and helpful Concierge- Thomas.  Just fabulous and every suggestion he gave us was great.  I loved my stay and will definitely go back !

title: Wonderful boutique hotel close to the Louvre
text: A very nice hotel in a quiet plaza two blocks from the Louvre within walking distance of major attractions and great restaurant districts .  We stayed two nights on the 4th floor overlooking the courtyard.  The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful and the room clean and comfortable.

title: Truly Magical
text:
We traveled to Paris for our 32nd wedding anniversary. We had never been to Paris, and had envisioned Paris as a romantic, enchanting city. From the time we decided to book this hotel, we started working with the concierge team of Thomas, and Gerald,  who painstakingly researched and booked tours and skip the line sightseeing excursions for us. Every email to the team was met with timely responses, and great ideas. They also helped us to book a day trip to Brussels. We booked our transportation through the hotel as well, and the driver met us at airport baggage with a name placard. 
It was a very smooth process, and we arrived at the hotel quickly. We were met outside by concierge staff, who took our luggage and walked us into the hotel. 
We were offered champagne, a place to freshen up, and a tour of the hotel amenities. As we arrived early, our room was not yet ready. They held our luggage, and texted us when our room was available.
Thomas and Gerald went out of their way to assure that we had a great experience. Thomas gave us all of our excursion tickets along with a map of Paris and of the Metro. He explained everything to us and the best way to navigate Paris. He helped us with dinner reservations and listened to what we wanted.

The hotel itself is immaculate. The rooms are nicely appointed and there is turn down service. We received fresh towels twice daily. We had a balcony room which was beautiful, and the bathroom was spacious with a heated towel rack. 
There is plenty of staff, and never a line to wait on. 
Gerald helped us with daily information, and helped me learn French. He is so genuine, pleasant, and went beyond to make sure we had the best trip ever.
The breakfast offered by the hotel is delicious, and the wait staff is attentive and friendly.
I would definitely stay here again, and recommend this hotel highly. They are in the 1st arrondizment, close to the Louvre and the Seine, on the right bank.

title: Wonderful!
text:
Gerald was an amazing concierge and now a new friend! We loved everything about the hotel and will be back the next time we visit Paris.

Thank you for making our stay so comfortable and enjoyable. This hotel is THE BEST!

title: Looking forward to my return later this month.
text: Everything was excellent. Great service and care to make sure that everything is perfect. Could babble aimlessly just to achieve two hundred characters  bu I have always believed  that brevity is a virtue and blather is to be avoided.

title: Fabulous weekend stay
text: A Beautiful small hotel perfectly situated to explore all of Paris. The service was exceptional, and the concierge amazing at recommending restaurants, booking them and checking our stay was as it should be. A super friendly 5 star hotel, we will definitely go back.

title: short 3 night stay
text:
Stayed at this fantastic hotel for my wife's birthday. This hotel is located right next the the Louvre and the river, you really can't get better. Lots of cafe bars/restaurants on streets around the hotel. We had the hotel transfer which was brilliant, right to the door and back to the hotel. a warm welcome when we arrived and show the room by the reception staff (nice touch) we booked a room with a balcony (see picture) which was nice to have. Only small point was room/bathroom was small but I guess being in the heart of Paris and your not in it much during the day was acceptable but worth noting. breakfast was tasty, traditional continental style. 
Overall a great stay, wanted to stay longer and would recommend and stay here again.

title: Perfect choice for a Paris mini break
text: Fabulous hotel with super friendly and helpful staff on reception and concierge who were always ready to assist and make suggestions. Very comfortable and spacious room - although minor point, no mirror near a power socket in the bedroom. Great location from which to get to all the sights - perfect!

title: Late Honeymoon
text: We had a fantastic stay, the room was excellent, the staff were all very friendly and attentive. It’s location is perfect very close to the Louvre and lots of great restaurantsWould highly recommend this hotel.

title: Spectacular hotel and staff!
text: We loved our week-long stay at the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal. Everything exceeded our expectations. The location was perfect for heading out to sight see each day. The staff went above and beyond and we especially loved Gerard and Tomas, two of the Concierges. They helped us secure restaurant reservations, concert and museum tickets, and helped with travel tips among other things. They were a wealth of knowledge. We would gladly stay here again.

title: Home away from home in Paris
text: Lovely place a block down from Louvre, so quiet and still close to everything Paris has to offer. The most friendly staff catering to anything we needed. We are so happy to have a place to call home away from home when our travel takes us to Paris

title: Perfect room and location in Paris!
text:
We loved the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal! This is our second trip to Paris and we won't stay anywhere else on future visits! We love luxury boutique hotels (small to mid size) and prefer them over the big Palace type hotels. 

The staff is incredibly friendly.  Gerald (concierge) is so helpful, attentive, knowledgeable, and kind. It is clear that he loves his job and is amazing at it. Thank you so much, Gerald! The front desk staff and Jonas in the bar were incredibly kind as well. Every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful. 

The breakfast in the hotel restaurant is wonderful and thank you to Jonas and Armand who were so kind and attentive. A great way to start your day! 

The location is close to everything! We walked to the Louvre, the Seine, the Latin Quarter, the Marais, Notre Dame, to restaurants, the Opera House and shopping, etc. We took the Metro a few times and the stop is right by the hotel. Extremely convenient. 

We booked our room through our travel agent (Virtuoso affiliated) and received a room upgrade to a Junior Suite with balcony. The room was a nice size (especially by European standards), very clean, very quiet, and the bathroom was nice sized with wonderful water pressure and consistent heated water. 

If you are considering this hotel, book it! If you like luxury, boutique hotels with friendly and attentive service, you have found the perfect option!

title: Spectacular!!!  5-star amenities and service in an intimate and personal setting
text: What a glorious week we just spent at the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal!  When planning a trip, the hotel is usually my top concern (admitted hotel snob!).  As it was our first time in Paris (coming from US), I was overwhelmed by the many wonderful hotels to choose from.  But I kept coming back to this one.  Even before we arrived, I was in regular contact with the concierge department requesting recommendations and booking for excursions, meals, sights.  Specifically Gerald was amazing, always responding very promptly with many choices and recs.  From the moment we arrived, we were treated like longtime family.  We had arranged car transport through the hotel and were picked up in a Mercedes, making the drive after the long transatlantic flight much more comfortable.  Upon arrival, we were offered champagne and they held our bags as it was very early and the room not ready.  They had all of our documents ready and organized for all the things we had booked.  Upon returning later in the day, we were escorted to our room.  They had so graciously upgraded us from a Deluxe to an Executive room.  It was beautiful, with two floor length windows opening onto a double balcony overlooking a courtyard.  A bottle of chilled champagne was waiting as a gift to celebrate our 20th anniversary.  The courtyard may be recognizable if you're an Emily in Paris fan (which I had not seen prior to arrival and had no clue!).  Throughout our weeklong stay, the staff was just perfection.  They attended to all of our needs, greeted us by name each day and went out of their way to ensure we were beyond satisfied at every turn.  Gerard and the other concierge staff members attended to last minute change of minds with dinners and secured others at a moment's notice.  The hotel is decorated in a modern way with modern amenities while retaining the charm of the historic building and palace for which it is named.  The location is perfect, right across from the Louvre and a few short blocks from the Seine and Musee d'Orsay.   We absolutely cannot think of staying anywhere else when we return to Paris.

title: Great Boutique style hotel
text: Great location close to the Louvre.  Lots of shopping, bistros and restaurants close by.  Much to my surprise there was even a J Town area close by.  Hotel room is a bit small but clean and everything you need.  Nice soaking tub.  Only down sides was the renos to the restaurant but did not affect us as we did not eat in the hotel.  Everyone on staff was very friendly and helpful.  Would definitely return again.

title: Amazing property and amazing room
text: We were so happy with the accommodations at the Palais Royal.  The room was amazing and the views were spectacular.  The staff were all very helpful and friendly which admittedly is not a given in Paris.  They all also spoke english very well.  We only ordered room service once and the food was spectacular.  The concierge (Gerald) was ESPECIALLY great in helping us with everything and anything.  It was like having a personal assistant!  Thank you for a wonderful experience!

title: We love this hotel.
text: Me and my daughter have stayed in The Grand Hôtel Du Palais Royal twice now and we absolutely love it. The location is amazing (near the Louvre, the Rue de Rivoli, all the shops on the Rue St Honoré, the Metro, short walk over to the Tuileries Gardens or The Seine) and the staff are super helpful and assist in finding and booking restaurants, museums or printing out tickets. The breakfast room has an iconic Parisian courtyard view which is a brilliant start to the day.

title: Fantastic 3 nights at Grand Hotel du Palais Royal
text: Stayed 3 nights at The Grand Hotel du Palias Royal with my wife and son. The staff were fantastic and couldn't have done more. Alexandre and Gerald at the concierge desk we're brilliant in helping us find restaurants and book a visit to the Louvre. Location was just perfect, within walking distance of everything we wanted to see and our room was very comfortable and quiet. We'll definitely be back...

title: A place to go back to
text: The hotel is well organized and perfectly located for those who want to be right in the middle of the touristic attractions. Even though the rooms are not as big as we expected, their services made it nice and complete. We would like to specially thank GERALD, who was from the very beginning very helpful and kind (all the rest were as well… but Gerald is truly a bonus).

title: Paris Trip Stay
text:
Great location very walkable to all sites.  Gerard the concierge was terrific.  All staff very friendly and fluent in English.  Rooms small like all european rooms tend to be. 
 Hotel is very nice for the price.

title: Wonderful place to stay and enjoy Paris
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Grand Hotel du Palais Royal. The staff was so attentive and friendly, the rooms were spacious and meticulously kept, and we really felt at home. Also, there's a terrific happy hour and a wonderful breakfast. Special kudos to Gerald who went above and beyond to find an item that my daughter left behind in her room.

title: Greta Hotel
text: Very comfortable hotel, nice rooms (rather small but typical of most Paris hotels) with caring and attentive staff.  Terrific and very quiet location right in the centre of Paris but very close to the Metro.

title: We’ll be back!
text: The team members at the hotel were English fluent, service-oriented, helpful, solicitous, & fun! The concierges were the best I’ve experienced anywhere in the world! The hotel was lovely in a great section very convenient to the sights.  My room was well appointed, clean & had a wonderful view! We’re planning a trip back next year.

title: So lovely!!
text: We just returned from a wonderful stay at the Grand Hotel Du Palais Royal. The hotel is just beautiful and very clean. They have so many nice amenities, and the staff could not have been nicer or more helpful. The restaurant is beautiful and has a terrific breakfast and bar. We loved the staff at the restaurant and bar. Gerald, Thomas and the entire concierge staff make your trip so special. The location is perfect too as it’s both central, and yet quietly tucked away. We can’t wait to return!

title: Charming hotel, perfect location.
text: Beautiful charming hotel, fantastic location, warm, welcoming, and helpful staff, excellent food at Cafe 52.  The concierge service was so helpful both before and during our stay.  It was an excellent experience and I will certainly return.

title: Perfect Boutique 5 Star Hotel
text: A unique boutique hotel in a perfect location surrounded by Parisian architecture and traditional cafes/ bistros. Friendly accommodating staff and lovely clean modern rooms with comfortable beds No noisy traffic so a perfect nights sleep

title: Great hotel in the heart of Paris
text: Great cozy location and very friendly staff. I have been to Palais Royal multiple time over the years and always enjoyed this small hotel. Breakfast is good offering a decent selection of pastries and eggs. The staff really do try to make everyone feel welcome and helped out with all our questions and needs. It's located by the Louvre so fantastic for sightseeing by foot.

title: Don’t stay anywhere else!!!
text:
Having promised my wife for nearly 30 years and being lucky enough to visit a lot of the cities in Europe I finally got around to booking Paris and have to say the staff here are an absolute credit to France and have made our stay top notch. We had a bumpy start managing my expectations but have to say that from check in with Geralde and Suzanne (hopefully I have that right) they went the extra mile and then some to make sure that my wife and I had the perfect room, which I have to say they did a great job…currently sitting on the balcony writing this review with a glass of red in hand and it’s views to the sacré-coeur…They have been ever present with their customer service without being in sight.
Well done everyone and hopefully see you all very soon.
Vive La France 😘

title: very good stay
text: we loved the hotel, specially the location, the decor and the employees  : Andree, gerard, the breakfast team. Everybody very welcoming. We stayed at Suite Prestige, that fits very well for three people.

title: Excellent hotel + great staff
text: Excellent experience from start to finish. The hotel is beautiful and the rooms are lovely. Just the right size of rooms with high-end furnishings. The hotel is small enough to be relaxing yet large enough to have all of the right amenities. The location next to Palais Royal is wonderful and tucked away on a quiet street in the middle of a vibrant area. The best part of our experience was the staff. The front desk employees were welcoming and always happy to assist. The concierge Gerald is wonderful; he was able to get reservations for us at a favorite place within minutes after we had tried a few times without success. We relied on his great recommendations. All around a truly lovely stay and we have booked a return visit already.

title: Beatiful hotel with all luxuries in the epicenter of Paris. Perfect both for short and long stay.
text:
Fantastic location, large and very decorative and top level room with amazing bed. Breakfast was luxorious however the service could of been faster, You can order eggs in all forms.
Concierged are very helpful. Highly recommend the place.

title: Great location, great staff
text:
Great location, beautiful hotel. ALL staff amazing. over all experience great. 
I Highly recommend cocktails at there bar. Bartender is one of Paris best secrets. 
very central location walking distance from Le Louvres and many other interesting sides

title: Bad Experience
text: Not recommend. There are a lot of beautiful hotels in Paris. Why get ruined your life? Staff are gentle but iced: we had the sensation to be invisible. The quality is in the details, but here are missing the fundamentals. Paris is a wonderful place. Try elsewhere.

title: Grand Hotel du Palais Royal: the best hotel in Paris
text:
My wife and I stayed 5 nights in January 2022 to celebrate our first wedding anniversary. 

1) The Hotel staff service is unmatched. Gerald, Augustine, Thomas and the entire staff warmly welcomed us and swiftly answered all of our requests. They greeted us at our car, brought our bags to our room, and showed us where to find anywhere we asked about. The staff could not be more personal, hospitable and caring. 
2) The car service brought peace, style and luxury. The Hotel offered car service from the airport and back to the airport, which we recommend this service. 
3) The location is central. The Hotel is next to the Jardín du Palais Royal and the Louvre Museum. The Eiffel Tower is visible from your room balcony (we stayed in a superior room with a balcony). You’re walking distance to restaurants and shops. 

We cannot thank the Hotel and their staff enough for this experience. If you visit Paris, there is no other place to stay than the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal.

title: great location and wonderful staff!
text:
great location, wonderful staff and a perfect stay in the city of lights. 
Very central, close to Le Louvres, les Tuileries, and convenient for shopping 
we will go back for our next trip - highly recommended.

title: Excellent hotel on ideal location.
text:
The hotel is situated ideally next to the Louvre and walking distance from Musée d’Orsay, le Marais and Saint Germain de Près. 
Superb staff, excellent service and restaurant recommendations (from the concierge Gérald). 
Will be back when visiting Paris.

title: feeling good in Paris
text:
Great Hotel on a very good spot, next to the “ Emily in Paris office “.

A quiet area nicely in the heart of Paris. This hotel understands international service and demands,

Rooms are good, and conciërge Gerald helps you with the good restaurants en places to visit. 

You will be close to all the best streets and parcs. We did about 55 km walking in 4 days easy! 

Looking forward to the next visit !

title: Amazing
text: Great vacation in a super amazing Hotel .it was the best choice regarding cleanliness service and welcoming staff !I recommend it to all who need to spend vacation in Paris i give it a 5 star even more

title: Nothing but love for this hotel
text: We absolutely adored this hotel. I cannot think of a single complaint. The location is perfectly situated in the first arrondissement—easy walking distance to everything you want to see and do. The hotel itself is beautiful and had everything I needed or wanted. The bed was very comfortable and the breakfasts were fantastic and delivered right to my room with no extra charge. The service was remarkable. I asked the concierge where the nearest pharmacy was bc my electric adapter didn’t appear to be working—he ducked behind the counter and handed me one. Magic! He also managed to get us a last minute dinner reservation at the sweetest little cafe ever. The bartenders…..particularly Shubham…….make the best drinks in addition to being so funny, entertaining, very helpful. I hope to be back very soon!

title: Very nice 5 stars hotel
text:
Beautiful area, very quite, in the heart of Paris near Rivoli, tuileries, la Concorde and other places. A kind and nie welcome from the lobby, concierge taking care of the car and the luggages. Arrived to a nice, clean and well fitted room with a nice bath room compased by a bath. Room view into patio of the area and Montmartre basilic. 

We were passing here 2 nice and sweet nights, lobby permanently avalaible and professional.

Breakfasts have been nice and diversed. Quality was ok, fresh fruits and breads.

3 points to improve: Our suite was equiped by coffee machine and tea boiler, but no spuns, no tea, only 2 coffee dose, no sugar. This should be systematically checked in a 5 stars before customer arrival, no?

Washbassin taps marked by water leackage with calcium. Change it pls! A real 5 stars will have done it. 

1/2 champaign bottle Moet 70e when you buy 1/2 Krug for 30e at Nicolas 5mn walk from your hotel.... Pity.

I mentioned those points to hotel lobby team when leaving.

Very nice hotel, good place, very kind team customer oriented, but devil is in the details.

title: Grand Hotel du Palais Royal
text: Our stay at the Grand Hotel du Palais Royal was divine. It is situated just a couple of short blocks to the Louvre and the center of Paris. Our suite was beautiful, had the most comfortable bed, and the bathtub in the center of the bathroom was so nice. We had a lovely view from our balcony and cherished a beautiful bottle of champagne while looking at Sacre Coeur off in the distance. I cannot recommend this Virtuoso preferred property enough, and I am a travel agent that has experienced the finest of the finest. This is a must for your next trip to Paris.

title: Wonderful service and great location!
text:
My husband and I had a wonderful experience at this hotel. The staff was so friendly and helpful, and they really personalize their service. 
The hotel is in a perfect location, very central, and close to the metro and the Louvre! Our room was on the 5th floor, was very quiet and had a lovely balcony. 
My only complaint is that the bed wasn’t quite as comfortable as I would have expected from a five-star hotel. You could feel the bedsprings a little. 
But overall we really loved this hotel and would definitely stay again!

title: Vera Gattaz
text:
Our stay at the grand hotel du palais Royal was impeccable. Friendly staff, minimum details taken care of, the great location of the hotel and what there is near by. 
Amazing stay! I highly recommend and shall return

title: Understated luxury in an unparalleled location
text: Great hotel with excellent service in an unparalleled central location. The daily buffet breakfast was great. The bed was probably the most comfortable hotel bed in which I've EVER slept and the vibe was entirely elegant. The only very slight critiques I would offer are: 1) I was in the Palais Royale Suite and some of the furniture was stained and a bit more worn than advertised and the hot water in the shower a little limited (i.e. we had to take two showers in a row rather quickly to avoid running out of hot water); and 2) the hotel bar has no scene. But overall, I'd highly recommend this hotel - the staff especially were really lovely.

title: Best place to stay in Paris. All Around IMPECCABLE!!
text: If you are into boutique hotels rather than your big name so called “five star Hotels”,  Maison Souquet is THE best place to stay in Paris, hands down!! While being a few doors the corner from one of the busiest/loud intersections in Paris, the entrance is on a super quiet and quaint street. Check in, the service, the bar, the restaurant is absolutely IMPECCABLE. The entire staff is amazing, they will make you feel like home. This place will be my go to in Paris moving forward.

title: One night at The Maison Souquet
text:
we had a fabulous time at The Maison Souquet , couldn't rate it high enough - amazing decor and very friendly staff.  what a beautiful building , absolutely beautiful... 

thank you for giving us a fab night and will see you soon

Ewan and Gerri

title: The Best and most beautiful hotel in Paris!
text: I feel like staying at Maison Souquet was a dream! This hotel is everything you would want a hotel in Paris to be and more. Fantastic decorating, wonderful staff, never have I stayed at a more inviting hotel! Love, love love!!!

title: Intoxicating Opulence
text: First stop of our French honeymoon. My wife booked Maison Souqet for my love of dim lighting, elegant atmospheres and classic French design, and Maison Souqet didn't disappoint. There is a natural sensuality and easy sophistication to this hotel without ever tipping into the cliche or hip. The spirit of this former "gentleman's club" is alive and well, assisted by charming staff, 1st class cocktails, intoxicating interior design and an underground spa that HAS to be experienced.

title: Hotel with a character
text:
The hotel has a story behind it, we didn’t know anything about it before but super cool. This was our second time in Paris so we wanted to be in the living area of Paris instead.

Pro
-location, right on the street like 2 mins walk from Moulin Rouge, shops, restaurants etc
-although the room is small, there’s a good bed, good room (with a personal story behind every rooms), very neat and clean
- I was there during my birthday so they offered a champagne at the lounge but unfortunately we didn’t get to go cause we didn’t have time. 
-the staffs were very friendly, I’d like to say the most friendliest we ever seen in Paris lol
-there’s a private spa downstairs that you can book with the staffs, super cool. 

Con
-we found some stains big actually at the head panel of the bed which was quite strange

title: Perfect!
text: We stayed for three nights for my 60th birthday and stayed in room ‘Liane de Pougy II this is a very special boutique hotel and in a fabulous location. I need to mention all the staff, who were all fabulous. As the young lady who served us would say — perfect. And to also mention the bar staff who made us the best cocktails and served us, a few glasses of champagne. Best birthday ever xx.

title: Amazing stay, highly recommend, luxury, relaxing, the epitome of a Parisian adventure
text:
We stayed at Maison Souquet for three nights to celebrate my 40th, and it did not disappoint. The staff are the most welcoming, and look after their guests like you’re the only vip in the hotel. Highly recommend cocktails in the bar, a real artistry from the cocktail tenders! Book to use the swimming pool, a really lovely way to relax and take in the calm atmosphere. 

Great location to access nearby neighbourhoods for the modern restaurants and bars. It’s our second time to Paris, and staying at this hotel made it a completely new adventure and we were so sad to leave! Worth every euro and more!

title: The perfect place for a romantic stay in Paris
text: The hotel is a special place to stay, small and discreet, with very friendly and helpful staff.  We loved our room and the Spa downstairs is a unique experience.  We also loved the area, Blanche, easy to walk to many restaurants and local shops all around.  Would definitely recommend.

title: Amazing boutique property in Montemarte!
text: The whole experience at Maison Souquet is divine. The 20-room boutique hotel is decorated exactly as you'd want your Paris hotel to be - ornate furniture, decadent wallpaper, beautiful rugs and luxury toiletries (Hermes!). The staff is extremely attentive given the hotel is so small but that means they are on top of everything. Make sure to book a private session in their pool/steam room and grab a cocktail at their mixology bar. We had a lovely breakfast in the back room too. Would def stay again! Also, you're in the middle of Montemarte, so close to Moulin Rouge.

title: Exceeded expectations, would stay again, for longer
text: My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Maison Souquet. The vintage ambiance and decor were very nice but the level of service and personal attention from Pauline and the entire staff, exceeded our expectations and matched the elegance and history of the hotel. Thank you for a pleasant experience

title: Honeymoon Stay
text:
My wife and i visited last week for our belated Honeymoon. When we arrived we were greeted at reception and shown around the hotel and then taken to our Junior Suite on the 4th Floor. The room was very clean, well set out and the decor was amazing and the bathroom facilities were spot on for what we expect. The hotel is very beautifully dark and well decorated.
Room service was prompt, breakfast on time and very well presented and tasted great! Our bed was made and room tidied everyday.
We can not recommend this hotel enough and we would certainly stay here again if we travelled back to Paris! In fact, we will stay here again when we visit Paris again!!
The staff were always helpful, friendly, courteous and happy to help whenever we asked.
Our only criticism if it is one is the lack of USB charge points. We do understand though that these are modern points that may be difficult to fit in such an old building, early 1900's!

Well done Maison Souquet!!!!

title: Very Curious
text:
Yes, very curious on its face to be sure. I’m referring to both the 5* hotel itself and the content of the Trip Advisor rating and reviews. TA rates Maison Souquet number 6 of the more than 1,000 hotels in Paris. The hotel has an absolutely huge number of reviews, very unusual for such a small establishment, and almost none of the reviews are critical. This would be unusual if the hotel was a conventional 5*. But this property is unquestionably very idiosyncratic, and one would not expect it would have such universal appeal.

In any case, let’s move on to the details. Over the last 30 years, my wife and I have stayed at four different 5* hotels in Paris, including two of the larger, renowned establishments and two, including the Maison Souquet, luxurious boutique hotels of about 50 rooms. The short story in that the Maison Souquet falls short of expectations.

In the early 1900s, this property opened as a high-class bordello. Today it retains the extravagant House of Pleasure décor that make a stay an interesting and in fact fun experience from that perspective. 

Two red lights illuminate the entrance as one approaches the hotel. Once through the door, the dominant feature of the décor is burgundy velvet everywhere trimmed with gold and green. An aristocratic gentleman entering this House of Pleasure in 1905, the year of its founding, would have encountered everything as he would have expected. Our gentleman would be invited to relax in the small, plush front salon. After relaxing for a time, he would be escorted into the equally cozy sitting room to meet the ladies and perhaps select a companion for the evening. If he wished, she would lead our gentleman upstairs into her small, but luxuriously appointed boudoir. The lighting on this short journey would be discreetly and shall we say seductively subdued. Sometime later, upon descending, our gentleman could, if he was of a mind, relax in yet a third small, plush salon before departure. This was the legendary hedonistic Paris of the time.    

Today we are in the early 21st century, and our House of Pleasure has become a luxurious boutique hotel. The layout remains as described above. The décor works well if one is looking for a bit of a fantasy experience. But two key features of the facility as a hotel go significantly wrong. The lighting is not just discreet. It is dark. Very dark. For example, upon entering the elevator, one needs the flashlight of a smartphone to see enough to select the correct button for floor.  

Of greater impact is the size of the rooms. Our “junior suite,” no. 303, was a lady’s boudoir some 100 years ago. It is tiny. Amazingly tiny. Yes, Paris hotel rooms are small. But for 750 Euros, this was a bit of a shock. The bedroom couldn’t have been larger than about 10’ by 10’, and the “sitting room” area was no more than a hallway from the door to the bed chamber, very scantly furnished with a chaise lounge style sofa and a small stool against one wall, with no space left for even a coffee table. The bathroom with a tub and shower was adequate, no more; there was a separate toilet room that was just large enough for the purpose.  

On the plus side, we found the staff to be very accommodating. In fact, when we got out of our cab upon arrival, I forget my small carry-on in the car. I noticed just moments later that our passports, etc. had driven away! A young lady at the front desk sprinted out the door and down the street to catch the cab at the next light. This was far above and beyond to be sure.

Once shown to our room, we found that the switching for the lighting used relays with small buttons. We have seen this before in French hotels, and it is typically a clean, neat solution for three-way switching. But the relays for the main bedroom lighting and for the entrance hall/sitting room lighting sometimes worked and sometimes did not. A single relay system malfunctioning is one thing, but two for two? Soundproofing was poor, and we could hear muffled conversation in the next room off and on all night. Our early morning room service request for a pot of coffee for two brought us two cups of coffee and two small pitchers of coffee. Of course, the coffee in the pitchers was quite cold immediately, before the second cups were poured. Finally, before departure, I called the front desk for a bellman to pick up our luggage. The desk clerk chuckled at my request and responded, “We have no bellman. I am the bellman!” Understandable staffing for the small hotel, but the response was a bit off-putting. “We will be up momentarily” would have been the better answer. Picky? Of course. But 5* prices give some license for one to be picky. 

Now, about the rating and the reviews. As of today, Maison Souquet has a total of 1,115 Trip Advisor reviews. 1,058 reviews were Excellent, 44 Very Good, 9 Average, 2 Poor, and 2 Terrible. That is 95% Excellent and makes the hotel #6 of 1,882 hotels in Paris. The Four Seasons George V in Paris, widely acknowledged to be one of the finest hotels in the world, has only an 87% Excellent rating. We have stayed at the George V, we’ve enjoyed the George VI, and Maison Souquet is no George VI although the reviews would indicate otherwise. Very curious.

title: A small intimate palace
text: You will be dazzled by the decor signed Jacques Garcia , great decorator.  You will be charmed by the friendless of the staff . You will be extremely relaxed with the confort of the rooms and the private swimming pool. You will appreciate the delicious cocktails. IN SUMMARY A MUST for people of taste . William Beaux d Albenas

title: Good hotel
text: The hotel is very nice and the atmosphere is really different from any standard hotel. The spa is nicely maintained and very pleasant since it is private. Staff really try their best to help and accommodate any need.

title: A wonderful weekend in Paris
text: We booked a weekend break for my husbands birthday. We had a wonderful stay and will visit again. The hotel staff were fantastic and were so helpful . We have no hesitation in recommending the beautiful Maison Souquet. The private spa was fantastic and so peaceful

title: Wonderful Stay
text:
My partner and I visited this wonderful hotel in early June.  I don’t regularly write reviews but felt compelled to let others know how thoroughly we enjoyed our stay at Maison Souquet.  The hotel itself is “as advertised” with respect to its history of once being a house of pleasure.  The public sitting area and bar are perfectly themed with their red velvet furniture and hushed surroundings.  The rooms are similarly appointed and have nice amenities.  

The hotel staff was truly fantastic.  The front desk team was polite and friendly, and particularly helpful in assisting with a surprise celebration that was enthusiastically received. The bartenders perform their role with precision, flair and professionalism that will delight and make you anxious to visit again.  We had late nite cocktails every evening and they were the perfect nightcap to our days. 

All in all a terrific experience at Maison Souquet.  I would highly recommend this hotel to couples.

title: Definition of hospitality
text:
