They say “only those in the know will experience the luxury of Maison Souquet,” and they are absolutely correct. The hotel is both a serene oasis AND a chic cool bar and hangout. It becomes whatever you want it to be. 

When the door of Maison Souquet opens you are immediately enveloped in the intoxicating aroma of their very own branded candles (we bought one to relive our stay). 

After the quick and easy check-in, Pauline gave us a tour of the hotel and explained the origin of Maison Souquet and walked us through how each room was utilized during the Belle Époque. She guided us to our room and advised us how to reserve the Salon d’Eau, the private pool and steam room located below reception. 

Whether we wanted to shop for baby clothes, book a last minute hair appointment or reserve a vintage car for a driving tour of the city, Pauline investigated every opportunity and left no stone unturned to fulfill our needs. She is truly exemplary and also very friendly- so much so that we looked forward to returning to the hotel to show her our newly acquired treasures and tell her of our adventures. Everyone who works at Maison Souquet epitomizes the highest caliber of customer service. 

Our room, the Païva Suite, was so luxurious we found it difficult to leave and actually do some sightseeing. 

The bar comes alive at night and I suggest sitting at the bar so you can see the masters of mixology at work. 

We reserved the Salon d’Eau our final morning and I wish we had reserved it every day but then we might never have left the hotel. 

Before our arrival the hotel arranged a driver to pick us up from the airport. I highly recommend booking a driver through Maison Souquet and requesting Monsieur Aissa Rouache. We adored him so much we booked him for our entire trip- even after departing Maison Souquet. 

This boutique hotel will impress you so much with their sincere and genuine consideration of your wishes you will be determined to never stay at a large hotel ever again.

title: A little gem in the heart of the Pigalle
text: The hotel is a real treat. It is, in essence, a former house of pleasure and the owners have taken great care to keep many of its characteristics whilst ensuring a five star experience. The rooms are a little bijou but are beautifully decorated. Beware the corridors are dark, in keeping with the mood of the place. The facilities are excellent, particularly the pool area and the staff are wonderful. A really unusual place to stay that is highly recommended.

title: Extremely Small
text: Listen, I have to be honest here.  These rooms were so small we could not even open our luggage.  Shockingly small.  The staff were nice and the vibe was cool, which is why it has 3 stars.  but I read these reviews expecting much better.  For the price there are many better options.

title: Romantic staycation
text:
Hubby and I stayed here to celebrate our wedding anniversary. It's a unique hotel with an interesting history (go and find out yourself!). Small in size but well-appointed. The decoration feels luxurious, plush and very romantic...it's dimly lit throughout with lots of red velvet...the ambaince just screams romance.

Guests are entitled to 1h privatisation of the Salon d'Eau, which is simply genius. We loved our couple time in the pool and massages...it felt worlds away from the hustle & bustle outside.

Great location just off the main road from Moulin Rouge. There are plenty of restaurants in the vincinity, and we had a very nice walk around Montmartre after dinner.

Finished the evening with a cocktail at the famous bar, and it didn't disappoint. The cocktails were delicious. Service impeccable. Good selection of food at breakfast.

If I may just add a constructive comment, the bathroom is small and I find the shower not well designed - it's at the end of a small curved bathtub so it's hard to stand. There's no screen and the water gets splashed everywhere. Perhaps they should have just made a bathtub or a big Italian shower, instead of doing both.

This will be our destination of choice for all staycations in the future ;)

title: Small, stylish, and faultless service
text:
We were really impressed by this little hotel on several counts.

The small team who run the place were really attentive, kind and not intrusive. The breakfast was very good - eggs to order. The ‘salon d’eau’ is a perfect addition for a couple, especially as they book it out privately for you as part of your stay.

The rooms and bar are luxuriously decorated and the location couldn’t be better.

title: A sanctuary in the heart of Montmartre
text: A beautifully decorated hotel with an interesting history. This hotel is well located within Montmartre only steps away from cafe’s, restaurants, the Metro and Moulin Rouge. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The rooms, although a little small and quite dark, are beautifully furnished and keep in excellent condition. We enjoyed breakfast at the hotel daily, which was delicious and always served with a smile. A great perk of the hotel is the daily access to the Salon d’eau, a perfect place to unwind after a day of touring Paris. The only aspects that could use some attention, the double glazed windows cut out most noise, however; a small amount of noise still makes it in, so if you are a light sleeper this can be a problem. Also, the wifi is painfully slow and English options on the TV are limited to 2 news stations. These small issues are only that, small, and would not stop us from returning.

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text: Great hotel keeping the style of a former pleasure house including the outdoor red lights. Attentive and discrete service. Spa plus a massage is a must do. Our room was small but with rich fabrics and wallpaper giving it a boudoir feel. The hotel is in the Montmatre area of Paris, close to the Moulin Rouge and a short (uphill) walk to the Sacré-Cœur. Lots of nice bars and restaurants  close by. We ate at Les Canailles, recommended by the hotel, definatrly worth a visit. We thoroughly enjoyed our 3 night stay

title: Best Hotel Experience in a while
text: I was booked the Maison Souquet on "Booking.com" while searching for a hotel in the Montmartre area of Paris. I had no idea that it was going to be such a wonderful experience. After I booked the dates the staff reached out immediately to inquire if I needed car service from the airport and arranged it for me. The hotel is stunningly gorgeous and like no other "hotel" I've ever experienced. The rooms--all named after women who worked there when it was a brothel--are ornate but not garish and very comfortable. Breakfast came with my room and was served until 11am. It was not a Buffett like most places; rather, it was made to order and come with wonderful pastries. Perhaps the best thing about the hotel is the incredible staff. They are courteous, warm, and quite thoughtful. They always greeted me with a smile when I returned from an outing and inquired if I needed anything. They even gave me two complimentary glasses of champagne on my last evening there. I will definitely stay at the Maison Souquet when I return to Paris.

title: Wonderful weekend stay
text: We had a really lovely stay at Maison Souquet. The decor was beautiful the food was of the highest standard. The service of the staff was fantastic and even after our stay have only been too happy to help with questions. The room was lovely and perfect for our 3 night stay in Paris.

title: Perfect
text: Day 3 of 5 day stay (four nights). So far, impeccable service with 5 star accommodations. Rooms are well appointed, with nice turn down service. Front desk warm, friendly and provides reservations and insights found at a luxury hotel with warm attitude of an excellent boutique hotel which it is. Bartenders at the Bar are great as well.

title: Best Boutique Hotel in Paris with wonderful staff
text: Beautiful and very cool decor with no expense spared. Quietest rooms we’ve ever stayed in. Great location and the most helpful and friendly staff. It’s a wonderful place without fault. Will definitely be back…

title: Wonderful stay
text: Outstanding service. My wife, 2 year-old daughter, and I stayed there for one night. They were so welcoming to us all and nothing was too much effort. The salon d’eau was incredible. The room was beautiful. The whole hotel has a wonderful atmosphere. Cannot recommend highly enough. Thank you

title: Fantastic hotel, fabulous staff and amazing private spa pool
text: We just had the most wonderful stay at Maison Souquet for four nights. The staff are highly attentive and extremely friendly. Included with a room is an hour in the private ‘salon de Bain’ which is a beautifully appointed small pool and steam room. Having it to ourselves was a real treat - we used it 4 times! The hotel used to be a ‘house of pleasure’ and is decorated with sumptuous nineteenth century opulence. It’s a great place to chill before or after a day’s sight seeing. The breakfasts were just perfect - croissants, fruit, eggs, coffee. I highly recommend this lovely boutique hotel. Perfect for a romantic stay in Paris, and pretty much everything is in walking distance too. I’d definitely return!

title: Loved every minute of our stay here!
text: We stayed here for 2 nights and it was divine! The whole design of the place was immaculate and luxurious - such attention to detail. All of the staff were very warm and welcoming and so helpful, even before our stay with things like local restaurant recommendations. The private spa was a particular highlight, and the cocktails we had in the beautiful lounges were wonderful. We couldn't recommend this hotel highly enough and would certainly stay here again. We didn't want to leave!

title: Special hideaway in bustling Pigalle
text: Really authentic belle epoch Parisian hotel with exceptional service and fantastic ambience. Also extremely well located for the bohemian MonteMarte and exploring other parts of Paris. Incredible cocktails, a super pool and steam room for private booking and use, and incredibly clean. Beds could be a little softer though! Will be returning next time in the city.

title: Perfect for a Romantic stay
text:
This hotel did not disappoint.
From the start you are given a detailed tour explaining the history of this ex house of pleasure.
The moody lighting and furniture all add to the experience .
We received a complimentary upgrade to a junior suite which was beautiful .
Very comfortable bed and again furnished in keeping with the buildings history.
The hotel staff were amazing. My wife was unwell during our stay and they went out of their way to help.
The hotel is situated opposite The Moulin Rouge.So great for exploring the Mon Matre area with its small French restaurants.

title: A little gem
text: Such a special hotel, we stayed four nights and could not have been better looked after by the friendly caring staff, nothing was too much trouble. The history of le Maison Souquet is reflected today in lavish decor and unique interiors giving this special hotel an intimate and unique ambience. We will definitely be returning.

title: Extraordinary Boutique Hotel
text:
We stayed at this extraordinary boutique hotel for five nights and what a fantastic choice it was. The location is perfect, in an edgy part of modern Paris and surrounded by new-generation cocktail bars and constantly evolving on-trend dining.
The service was impeccable and highly personalised. We will definitely return.

title: Great hotel!
text: I had an amazing weekend at Maison Souquet. The room was small,  but beautiful. The staff is really friendly and very attentive, and the bar is amazing, some of the best cocktails I’ve ever had. I will definitely come back!

title: Amazing 💕
text: We absolutely LOVED our stay here! Luxurious, romantic, superfriendly and helpful staff, stunning interiour and an amazing bar. Be sure to have a cocktail before dinner🥂💕 Location is also perfect! 10/10 😍 Definetely coming back!

title: Fabulous hotel
text:
The hotel is very beautiful. The history is very impressive. 
Very close to the landmarks. Very clean place and the customer service is very professional. The stuff is very friendly. 
We were there for our honeymoon and it was the best choice to stay at Maison souquet. The next time in Paris we will definitively stay there again

title: Don't overthink this one - just book it!
text: This is more than a hotel - it's an experience! The atmosphere in the hotel, the room, the pool/steam room area, the breakfast, the incredible staff who treat you like royalty - just being in the hotel is as enjoyable as anything you will do in the city of Paris itself! For anyone trying to book a romantic getaway for their partner, as I did, as I said in the title - don't over think this, just do it and the hotel will give you an incredible memory with your partner for a lifetime. Can not recommend this hotel highly enough!

title: December trip to Paris
text: Excellent stay. Friendly staff and a unique decor. We loved our room and the hotel in general. We were able to book the spa just for ourselves which is something we were never offered before in any place. Highly recommend it if you want to be in a great location (9th, Place Blanche, Montmartre) and in a Belle Epoque vibe.

title: My home away from home...
text: I discovered Maison Souquet several years ago. I've always been in love with Paris, but Maison Souquet took my voyages to a different level. I fell in love with the photos and the history online, but it wasn't until I entered the hotel years ago that I was gripped from within. The atmosphere, the decor, the people...when I am there I am realizing my dreams and more importantly, my true authentic self. I have made long term friends that I hope to have for the rest of my life. And as a lover of the French language, but not yet fluent, they are patient and kind to me with my slow and "broken" French. I am beyond excited each time I go, and I am very sad to leave. Maison Souquet: Florian, Yoni, and Sylviane are masters at their craft and I look forward to speaking French fluently with them next year and helping them to grow their business in any way that I can. J'aime la Maison Souquet toujours.

title: Fun, historic hotel in a great location
text: Fun and interesting property in a great location. We received a complimentary upgrade to a junior suite, which was very nice. All of the staff were so helpful and accommodating. The decor is on point for the period and doesn't feel cheap or fake. Breakfast was very good and so was the bar. Would absolutely stay here again.

title: Amazing Staff & amazing hotel ❤️ Merci xx
text: Stayed here for two lovely nights and got back yesterday. The hotel is located very close to the Moulin Rouge and in an excellent location to some lovely bars and restaurants. The Sacre Couer is also very nearby. Upon entering the hotel, we were given a very warm welcome by the staff and one of the staff members gave us a lovely tour of the hotel and it’s past history as pleasure house. Such decadent, opulent decor in the main hotel which is carried through to the beautiful bedrooms which are named after each of the girls that worked there historically. We stayed in the Paiva suite which is decorated in rich colours with plush, velvet furnishings and very comfortable bed. Breakfast was amazing and you have the option of having it in your bedroom which is bliss if you want a lie in. This concept should be carried through in all 5* hotels! The Hermes toiletries were replenished daily and matched the calibre of the hotel. Merci to the staff who were fabulous and should you be thinking of booking a stay in Paris then do not hesitate to book this beautiful, boutique hotel ❤️💕

title: The Best Hotel for Couples in Paris
text:
We return to Maison Souquet every time we come to Paris because it is simply outstanding. This is an exceptionally unique hotel which caters to couples, so keep in mind this may not be the best destination for families or friends.  If you wish to impress your lover with a boutique Parisian experience, this hotel will not disappoint. 

Pros: the service is outstanding.  The careful attention to detail from management starts the moment you book your room.  The decor is one of a kind.  The red velvet salon and bar create a cozy yet sensual ambiance.  The rooms are small, but the decorations are elegant.  The Salon d’eau is the highlight of the hotel and features a private pool with steam room and massage.  

Cons: the bar is quite small and the hotel allows for outside guests. So, it can get quite crowded.  Because the menu is cocktail forward, a crowded bar means slow service because each drink takes time to make.  I would recommend somehow prioritizing hotel guests.  We had a small issue with our room not being ready and our shuttle not being at the airport on time, but management recognized the issues and made sure to compensate us with plenty of champagne ! 

Merci!

title: I wish we could have stayed longer
text: I wish we could have stayed longer. Just a few minutes' walk from the Moulin Rouge, this hotel has an excellent location. The receptionist's welcoming us was very friendly and polite. The decor of the hotel and our room where we stayed for 2 nights was very relaxing and high quality. The private spa is simply perfect. You should also definitely try the cocktail bar.

title: Romantic and beautiful hotel
text: Perfect hotel for couples. Had a romantic stay. They took care of our every need.  The rooms are perfect, quiet, dark and beautiful. The bar is very cool. We loved our private hour in the pool area and steam room as well. At the last minute they booked for us an incredible meal. Very much worth a stay, highly recommend!

title: The perfect stay, in every way. PLUS Teddy Bear return program
text:
All of my Covid-time reviews will start with Covid safety practices:
Covid vaccine checks at checkin and for bar guests. Very safe and conscientious.

There are not words to express the perfection and thoughtfulness of this gorgeous hotel. But, as we’re left with words, here are mine.

From the beginning of the pandemic, when I initially had to cancel our 2020 anniversary stay, the staff at Maison Souquet were kind and accommodating. Despite a non-refundable booking, they worked with me to ensure the credit remained and helped when it was finally time to book our 16-month-late stay.

We arrived excitedly and immediately left our bags at the front desk to charge through Paris and return our rental car.

When we returned, Florian patiently and thoroughly walked us through the history and amenities of the hotel; information and offerings intertwined. From the gorgeous greeting and entry room, to the deep burgundy velvet of the bar and breakfast room, the senses are immediately satisfied. Our room was a perfect haven and sanctuary, the staff somehow both attentive and discreet.

Throughout our stay, we returned to sink into the plush chairs and order one of the unique and delectable specialty cocktails (the Dita is exquisite - of course it is). I typically don’t enjoy bars; the intimacy of the space created and the clientele attracted by this exquisite space made us want to return here every evening… which we did.

Be sure to book directly with the hotel and take advantage of your hour in the private, decadent, delectable Salon D’eau. Photos do not do it justice.

This hotel knocked it out of the park before I discovered I had left something very important in the room.

You see, when I was 10, and took my first trip to New York, my mother (R.I.P.) bought me a teddy bear. Tedward is featured in some of my other reviews, and is an important part of my journeys as a nervous traveler. (Pro-tip - Tedward’s placement by housekeeping helps to determine tip amount.) I don’t fly without him. 

Imagine my distress arriving in Frankfurt after a four-hour train ride to discover I’d left Tedward in the room. Call it being an out-of-practice traveler. Call it any number of things. I immediately called; the hotel had located him. Now I had to decide - trust him to the post? Do something wild? The hotel supported any decision I made and… well, I did something drastic. We delayed our flight (surprisingly cost-effective, but that’s another story), and I took the bullet train to and from Frankfurt and Paris. Never, once, did the staff at the Maison suggest I was being absurd. No; instead, they accommodated everything, sending the picture (thank you, Tamara!) included with this review, and offering to mail him and subsequently holding on to him when I decided to stay.

To my great joy, the moment I opened the door to the Maison, Florian presented Tedward. With my remaining hour in Paris before my return train, what did I decide to do? Try to shop for souvenir? Enjoy one last delectable item? I could imagine nothing in the world more perfect than simply sitting in the bar and enjoying a drink.

Paris is an incredible city. It’s everything they say. But I would return for the Maison alone, and never leave.

title: Doesn’t get better than this for a romantic couples getaway
text: We had a wonderful short romantic weekend away last weekend and it really doesn’t get better than Maison Souquet. Tucked away just a couple of minutes walk from the hustle and bustle of Montmartre’s magical nightlife, we were able to whisk ourselves away from the crowds (and amazingly enough all the noise also of this bustling area) into this hidden gem of a boutique small luxury hotel. Make sure you book early enough to have a session in their “salle d’eau” which has a private stunning swimming pool and steam area. Thank you for a wonderful stay once again and for spoiling us with the suite this time  !

title: Second time around, still the best place to stay in Paris!
text:
I decided to stay at la Maison Souquet for the second time around and absolutely adored it. 
Every bit was enjoyable, the room’s decor, the cocktails at the bar and my favorite of it all : the private spa and massage to relax before a cozy night. 
The staff is always warm, welcoming and pays attention to details. I liked staying in the center of Paris and being able to walk around Montmartre close by. 
La Maison Souquet is a well-kept gem. Would definitely recommend again!

title: Did not disappoint!
text: My husband and I had an absolutely magnificent stay at Maison Souquet. The room, decor, the staff, the bar, everything was absolutely excellent. This stay was for our honeymoon and Maison Souquet did not disappoint. Cannot recommend highly enough.

title: Perfection
text: From the staff, to the decor, to the cocktails and Hermes toiletries. Beautiful, beautiful hotel. Already planning my next stay. Special mention to Florian and Ludwig who really went the extra mile to ensure we had a wonderful stay.

title: Amazing intimate and romantic destination
text: For those couples seeking a romantic destination in Paris and near the Moulin Rouge/Montmartre area will not be disappointed.  Maison provides services that most other boutique hotels do not provide.  Very unique hotel and experience, just be aware that the location is for adults only and no children.

title: The best couples hotel I have stayed in
text:
Every now and again you need an escape from the day to day, find yourself and your partner again...well for that occasion I can only recommend  Maison Souquet.

From the history  of the building, the loving restoration and keeping of an intimate and private yet classy atmosphere, married up with the whole team of staff who make you feel special and important from the moment you arrive, to your departure.

Their effortless attention to detail yet relaxed atmosphere is a dream combination.  Their ability to organise things for you and take care of everything was amazing.

Special place, special team...can't wait to come back.

title: A unique hotel
text:
Truly stunning design to this hotel. Relaxing in the bar or the salon d'eau (after privatising the spa) was an exceptional and memorable experience. 
The scale and luxurious design of the hotel, along with soft furnishing everywhere, creates a real sense of intimacy.  The welcoming and accommodating staff were excellent and the outstanding cocktails don't hurt. Comfortable and beautiful rooms as well.

title: Great Hotel for Couples
text:
Excellent two-night stay on my honeymoon. Beautiful and unique with excellent service. The cocktail bar and complimentary one hour visit to the private pool and steamroom are excellent perks.

It’s in a touristy area around the corner from the Moulin Rouge, but it is only a short walk from the views, dining and nightlife of Montmartre.

I would definitely recommend this hotel to an American couple visiting Paris.

title: The house of magic
text: One of the very best hidden places in Paris with everything from a historical vibe to a very friendly service. Also it is located close to a lot of nice restaurants and cultural experiences in Paris :)

title: Amazing
text: I booked to stay at the hotel as a surprise for my wife's 50th birthday in March 2020 but covid put a stop to that. The staff have been fantastic in understanding that we couldn't get to the hotel. We finally made it this August and what a treat! It is seductive and stunning in equal measure. The staff were attentive without being over bearing. A 3 day break to remember. We will be returning!

title: The Juiciest Luxury in Paris! Worth Every Euro!!
text:
Let me tell you that I’ve experienced many hotels in my day from regular to luxury. Often I’m impressed not by the name but by the experience. When I say that the staff at Maison Souquet blew me away, they provided outstanding service that astonished me to space and I’m still there wondering about how I’ve been missing out in life until now.

First, booking this experience as an English speaker living in the Midwest trying to make everything perfect for my husband’s birthday trip to Paris was EASY. Yes, you’re reading that right. EASY! Easier than booking a hotel in Chicago or anywhere in the U.S. Why you ask? Because their packages include everything you need before you even book. Once you book, someone reaches out to you personally and confirms your booking details (every single detail!), and then asks you to confirm your preference (e.g. rose petals and champagne? two massages or one? which room do you prefer after seeing the attached photos? what time do you want your private spa to be reserved? etc.). I was able to clearly and easily confirm every detail in just a couple of emails. Emails! (Thank you, Florian!)

Next, arrival was an experience in an of itself. Once we arrived, the concierge confirmed the details again with me to ensure that everything was perfect. IT WAS! (Thank you, Ludovic!) They didn’t miss any detail! He also ensured that he didn’t spoil the surprise and kept everything a secret. (Thank YOU!) He took our bags and showed us around the main floor of the hotel and shared its history (so juicy!). He showed us where we’d be having drinks (the bar is gorgeous) and breakfast (beautiful) if we choose to. Then he showed us to our room which they upgraded to a junior suite. Surprises on surprises here! The room was delicious. Before going to get our bags, he asked to speak with me outside of the room so my husband couldn’t hear any details. There, we went over the secret schedule for the day which was again perfect! We had massages, the private spa, and drinks & appetizers scheduled. After that, our bags were brought to us and I spilled the beans and shared the schedule with my husband. Who was absolutely surprised and excited!! 

Our concierge brought up the champagne and our stay began! 

Everything from the masseuse to the spa to the bar tender to the drinks and food was pure perfection. Their service was outstanding. We felt so comfortable and cared for during our entire stay. The staff was 10 steps ahead of us, professional and kind, and were experts in their craft. When we stepped out, they ensured we were all set and showed us out. When we arrived, they were the first to greet us back. They overdelivered. Every expectation was exceeded. It was as if we were the notes being guided by a gentle, warm, and skilled orchestra. Yes, just like that! Consistently in awe and enjoyment of our experience.

Consider the most luxurious hotel and resort you can think of and imagine them exceeding your expectations in the most juiciest way where you felt like you were the only guest they were caring for the entire time. Now take that feeling and compound that by you being in the most passionate city in the world with the one you love after anticipating time for just the two of you to reconnect and create new memories of a loving relationship together. What you feel now is close to what Maison Souquet allows for you. 

Maison Souquet is beyond them all. 

Book your stay now and thank yourself later for blowing your mind with the greatest life choice you made (outside of the love of your life and your children if you have them). You’re incredibly welcome. Have the juiciest time.

title: Weekend retreat
text:
What a wonderful experience made all the better by the incredible staff. 

It was a weekend to remember. The spa is also perfect for undoing the sins from the night before (best spent in the hotels incredible bar). Perfect for groups or couples!

title: Wonderful!!
text: I came to stay at the hotel with some friends for a weekend it was wonderful! The staff were so so helpful, the room was lovely and the steam room and pool were perfect for a Sunday morning relax. It is a great location and I would definitely stay here again

title: Absolutely incredible staff and service
text: We stayed at Maison Souquet this weekend and I cannot begin to describe how incredible the staff and the service was. The team helped us get COVID tests organized, tests and travel documents printed, they booked countless incredible experiences across the city for us. I needed an adapter to charge my phone and they sent up 3 different options within 2 minutes. Breakfast was beautiful. The spa was wonderful. But it really was the people who made our stay wonderful. Whoever hired this team - I hope you are reading this and know how valuable they all are to this business.

title: Perfect place for a romantic weekend
text: My wife and I celebrated a big birthday and found the ideal hotel in Paris. It is very well located (quiet street nearby the Moulin Rouge) to explore Montmartre and Paris on foot, great set-up with its own pool / hammam, and very friendly staff. Highly recommended!

title: SUPERBE
text: One of my best hotel experiences- every detail was perfect (staff, service, food, pool, rooms, etc etc). I highly recommend this place for any type of Parisian stay. The only thing missing is a in-house restaurant, but the area is well fitted with multiple choices of nice tables for all types of budgets.

title: Absolutely fantastic!
text: My friends and I had the pleasure of celebrating my birthday at the Maison Souquet... and it was beyond exceptional! The hotel is exquisite and truly unique. Even the pool looks as if it were made to be photographed! The team was so welcoming, and the entire experience was unforgettable. Now I just wish I could go back each weekend... Merci, Maison Souquet!

title: A dream-like experience
text: The location is already outstanding, just around the corner from a myriad of restaurants, bars and transport options. Once you cross the threshold you're transported to another time, where the velvet-cushioned furniture and the low lights bring the parisian spirit to bloom. The service and staff are outstanding, both during check-in and for amenities. The private hammam and pool provide a cocoon to be enjoyed in total calm, and the rooms are lavishly decorated. An extra note on the comfort of the mattress, bravo!

title: Nothing but Excellent !
text: One of the best hotel experience in Paris yet! I regularly come to Paris for work or pleasure and am often disappointed the quality of the rooms/common spaces and the quality of service. I was pleasantly surprised by La Maison Souquet’s excellent taste in decoration, personal touch and attention to detail in all corners of the house as well as the level of service which is no other than excellent! I will definitely come back very soon.

title: A Parisian gem
text: During our last stay in Paris,  we stayed at this wonderful boutique hotel for a weekend next to Montmartre.  The service and our room (Margot) were both exquisite, the decor overall is superb. The team was welcoming and helpful when needed, they assisted us perfectly. On our first night, we had a lovely dinner with delicious cocktails at the hotel bar, (order the Dita). The next day we enjoyed a walk in the neighbourhood (typical charming Paris) and came back for a session in the private spa followed by massages, which I honestly recommend to everyone staying at the hotel. Amazing in every aspect, we had a great time at La Maison Souquet and hope to return soon

title: Conveniently placed with wonderful staff
text:
Maison Souquet is a beautiful, boutique, establishment located just across from the Mouline Rouge, so super-convenient for accessing Paris both on foot and by metro. 

Given the situation, I was amazed by how well the staff looked after us and made us forget there was even a pandemic. Everything we requested was taken care of quickly and with a smile. I'd highly recommend reserving the private spa for an hour during your stay.

title: Weekend In Paris
text:
My partner and I spent the most wonderful few days at the Maison Souquet. The rooms are brilliant and the location is great fun. The bar is incredibly special as is the spa which we were given in private.

The staff upgraded our room and so attentive throughout.

Couldn't recommend higher! Especially for a romantic trip.

title: Valentine’s Weekend 2020
text:
My partner and I decided on a Valentine’s weekend in Paris and further, if we were doing it, we’d do it right. My partner chose this hotel based on reviews, not your run of the mill 5 star but something special. She was right.

Arrived early, room ready. Rose petals, champagne and a smile.
Throughout our stay Letitia looked after us, no matter what we asked.
Salon d’Eau was a treat. Wonderful treatment and some great time in complete privacy.
The decor of both the public areas and room was sumptuous, attention to detail was second to none (and we’ve both stayed in some pretty good locations).
The location was ideal for what we wanted, surrounded by the red light district but close to Metro and of course The Moulin Rouge.

Side recommend is a 2CV tour of Paris. Great fun and we felt like a tourist attraction ourselves haha.

I hope to be back.

title: Unique and lovely
text: Wonderful welcome and loved the history of the hotel. Staff were lovely and helpful. Highly recommend. Great place for cocktails in the evening. Good location very near the Moulin Rouge. A little haven of luxury.

title: The best boutique hotel in... the world
text: I spent several nights at the Maison Souquet. It's a genuine, full of soul, stylish and beautiful historic place. The staff was so helpful, professional and at our service. The private pool is always an unforgettable, peaceful experience for everyone. Last but not least, the hotel and its rooms are amazingly quiet, which is exceptional given the central location of this beautiful gem. Will definitely recommend to everyone, and come back for my next trip in Paris.

title: Intimate
text: A lovely little hotel that, because of small size and furnishings, is cozy and intimate. It's past history makes it interesting too! The staff were very welcoming and attentive. We had a deluxe room (the 'Appolonie') for 3 nights that was on the small side but fine for us. This room faces over the rear courtyard and is perfect for anyone wanting peace and quiet.

title: Unique Experience
text: Very romantic ambience.  An experience in and of itself as you feel like you enter a different world the second you step through the main doors.  Super cozy lounge great for relaxing and spending time with the one you love.  Great staff with 5 star service!

title: Perfect Valentine's Hotel
text: We were staying 2 nights, my girlfriend and me. The attention of the staff was unbeatable, specially thanks to Leticia and Alex. The room was super clean and the service was excellent. Even the air that you breathe there is sexy. Amazing hotel. Thank you! We will come back soon!

title: Thank you.
text:
We spent 3 nights in the Margot room and found the staff excellent and the private spa amazing!
Thank you to the team for making the stay so comfortable.
The hotel is well situated for great restaurants and metro.

title: Very Unique
text: I mean, come on! This place is beyond what you get anywhere else, the shear exquisiteness of the plush interiors. Rooms are small, so are all in Europe really. Pool option is sketchy since you have to book your time WAY in advance but hey, it was a very nice place to splurge money on just to say we have done it.

title: Lovely atmosphere
text:
The hotel is small and intimate, it is historically interesting. The staff is very nice and welcoming, It seems to be fairly newly renovated, the style is beautiful with lots of mirrors, paintings, red velvet. It is really "la belle époque". It is wonderful to be seated in one of the cosy salons, reading a book and just watching the decoration.
The spa is very beautiful.

title: Incredible Atmosphere, Even Better Service
text:
My wife and I were recently in Baden Baden Germany to see a Nick Cave concert and decided on an impromptu overnight trip to Paris given that Baden Baden is so sleepy. Having spent a week at the Maison Souquet during the Summer of 2018, there was little doubt where we'd stay. It did not disappoint the second time around, and they went waaay above and beyond, but more on that later.

Firstly, the decor: It's amazing! Everything is so opulent, but tasteful at the same time. It truly has the most beautiful interior design I have ever seen. Last year we stayed in a junior suite, and the extra space was nice for the longer trip, however, during last week's overnight trip we booked a standard room. The room was named "Rose" and they had spread fresh rose petals all over the bed. Also, the bathroom and closets are hidden behind these beautiful tapestry-covered doors. It's stunning. The lounge and bar areas are fantastic and the drinks are top notch.

But, the service: it's unparalleled. They tend to every need without being intrusive and are super helpful. We did a very dumb thing and left our passports in the room safe, and didn't realize it until we were on a train back to Germany. In a panic we called the front desk and Florian Depardieu, the Assistant Manager, not only rushed to FedEx to make sure and get the passports overnighted to us, but he paid out of pocket because my AmEx wasn't accepted at the FedEx location. (Don't worry, we paid him back). This is a level of customer service that you just do not get at hotels. It's a personal touch that the Maison Souquet offers that didn't just save our asses, but also ensured that we'll never stay at a different hotel in Paris again. And we plan to be there as often as possible now that we live in Europe!

So, thanks to Florian and the Maison Souquet. And to those potential guests reading this, please do yourself a favor and stay at this hotel, it's legitimately incredible!

title: Outstanding!
text:
Great location, beautiful environment and accommodating staff. We were very happy with our stay here. My wife and I had four nights here and it lived up to the hype. 

You are literally a block from the metro which gives you access to most places in Paris. It is a short walk to Montmarte and Sacre Coeur. Helpful recommendations and beautiful decor. 

Thank you for a great experience!

title: Memorable experience
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this unique hotel. We have visited Paris many times and wanted sthg different. We were in Paris for one night only and combined our stay with a quiet stroll around Montmartre and a visit to the Moulin Rouge. The hotel's location is fantastic and it is so easy to get to from the Eurostar. There are some lovely restaurants all within a 10 - 20min delightful walk. Such a nice change to get away from central Paris. The hotel is extremely atmospheric and well suited to the romantic ambience of Montmartre. The decor is outstanding and very opulent. We used the spa in the morning before checking out and literally melted away! It was such a treat. Have already recommended this hotel to friends. It is an experience in itself. Well done to the team running Maison Souquet!

title: Tiny, tired rooms
text: Booked this hotel because of the good reviews on various platforms but now I doubt these reviews are genuine at all. My wife was allocated a room which was supposed to be Superior (18sqm). In reality the room is tiny, maybe some 12sqm at most, it's literally a double bed and some 50cm of space surrounding it. It's also quite tired and looks nothing like the rooms they advertise on their website. Reception obviously keep saying this is the correct room and refuse to even show others. No cooperation whatsoever. So be aware of that and don't trust what you see on the photos.

title: A jewel of a hotel in the perfect location.
text: This hotel is a jewel.  The staff is without exception so warm and helpful.  The location is ideal - easy to walk to many great restaurants and several metro stations, yet on a quiet side street for peaceful sleeping.  Our cozy room was well designed with plenty of storage, lovely decor, and was kept sparkling clean.  The included breakfast was a decadent treat, and the ladies who served it bent over backwards to accommodate our every wish.  We will definitely stay here again our next trip to Paris.

title: Quiet Oasis in a bustling neighborhood.
text: We stayed at this lovely little hotel for six nights. While our room was “cozy,“ it was beautifully decorated and our bathroom was a great size with lots of counterspace and a tub and shower. We had delicious smelling toiletries and even a towel warmer. We did not opt for a room with a view, but since we were out early and back late it wasn’t an issue, and I’m glad I was able to spend that money elsewhere on our trip. We had breakfast a couple of times in our room but they have a beautiful garden atrium where we also took breakfast with the other guests. The staff was so friendly and helpful. Best part about this hotel is the location. We were steps off of the Boulevard St. Germain, a five minute walk to several metro stops and a 5 minute walk to the Louvre. We even walked home from the Eiffel tower which was an easy 30 minute walk. I would definitely come back and stay here at this hotel.

title: Perfect Parisian Homebase
text: For personalized service, in a great location, you can't beat the Pas de Calais.  I hate to share my "home away from home" in Paris, but it's fabulous and they deserve the 5 star rating.  We have stayed there ourselves, sent clients  there and brought guests there as well and everyone loves it.

title: Wonderful stay in Paris
text: Hotel was wonderful! Great ambiance. Staff was friendly and courteous. Room and bathroom were good size and well kept. Downstairs eating area was beautiful with plants and skylight. Very good breakfast.

title: Exceptional stay
text: This was a 40th wedding anniversary trip, Paris was our final stay before heading back to the USA. We absolutely loved the place, both day and night concierge/ reception were both fantastic. The evening concierge was fun and although I don’t remember his name he was both friendly and accommodating. He pointed us to all the correct destinations. The foyer was very pleasant, breakfast was typical for France with a wide selection of breads, juice and coffee. The bedrooms and bathroom were comfortable and relaxing and we were both glad we made the choice of this location. Thank you Hotel Pas De Calais, we really enjoyed our stay and hope to see you soon.

title: Awesome location and experience
text: Hotel is in perfect location with great shops and restaurants nearby. Breakfast includes everything you could want to be fueled for the day. The staff is all very kind and helpful. Would definitely return and recommend to all my friends.

title: Great location and service
text: Excellent Hotel, great location, very kind employees and nice breakfast.  Would improve shower’s water pressure. The size of the room is small but does not bother much as we spent most of the time out.

title: Great all around hotel
text: I recently stayed at this gem of a hotel while on a special getaway with my husband, our toddler, and a dear friend. We were able to book two adjoining rooms, each with their own private bathroom. The rooms were great size, air conditioned, clean, and well equipped with all the amenities. As for the staff, I do not think you can find a friendlier team - we were welcomed by attentive staff and served an amazing breakfast each morning by thoughtful ladies who made sure we were well fed! I cannot say enough about Hotel Pas de Calais - thank you for making our trip to Paris such a wonderful experience!

title: GREAT STAY! Thank you.
text:
The hotel is charming and very well situated just 20 min. Walk from Champs Élysées and the Eiffel Tower. 
There are an abundance of restaurants and caffe’s within a 5 min. Walk and many beautiful luxury boutiques as well. The hotel was gracious to provide a connecting room for or daughter. We also loved the beautiful continental breakfast which was more abundant than most in Europe.  All in all it was a lovely experience.

title: Wonderfull hotel in perfect location
text: Great hotel, at central location in St Germain de Pres, with all the action (restaurants, bars, metro) right around the corner. Hotel service was super and family rooms the best you can find in Paris. We had a wonderfull stay!

title: The perfect Parisian hotel.
text: This is a truly exceptional boutique hotel, one of the best in Paris. If there were more than 5 stars available, Hotel Pas de Calais would earn them all. Family owned and operated (and it shows), it’s beautifully situated just off Blvd St. Germain on the Left Bank, ideal for museum visits, shopping and sightseeing. The rooms were spotless and well appointed. Their delicious morning breakfast was such an enjoyable way to start each day.  The attentive, personable staff -- Vanessa, Kevin, Raphael, Jacques-Olivier and all the others -- attended to every detail while offering wonderful recommendations before and during our visit. Our family of three was made to feel completely at home at the Pas de Calais. We truly can’t recommend it highly enough, and hope to return for another stay soon.

title: Quaint hotel in a perfect location
text: We loved this charming hotel as our home base for 6 days. The staff is incredibly pleasant and helpful and the room was very clean and comfortable. You can't beat the location, it's perfection, We'll definitely be back.

title: Basic hotel in great location
text: The hotel is conveniently located near bistros,  metro and major sites, but it was not a luxury experience by any means. Our rooms on the 1st floor looked into an inner courtyard/apartment and we could hear the apartment dwellers' music through the bathroom windows. The rooms were dark, basic, sterile--looked nothing like the chic ones on the website. Not a sanctuary of relaxation after a long day of sight seeing. Bathrooms were large and there was plenty of closet space.  The air conditioning was excellent.

title: A perfect hotel in Paris
text: A perfect experience… my visit was so awesome I came back a month later for 2 weeks !  The entire staff is fantastic… they go out of there way to make your stay memorable. The owner Alex really makes the hotel feel like your staying with family. He’s so accommodating and so friendly !  It’s s gem ….

title: Very pleasing
text:
We had a Luxe room and were delighted with every aspect of it. Everything was sparkling clean and in perfect working order. Heavenly bed. Lots of natural light. Aircon was very effective even in the July heat. Reasonable sized room for Paris at 20 sqm. Check in was excellent. Most staff were outstandingly helpful. Would rather have had a buffet breakfast as a served breakfast does not enable you to select what you want. That said, we did ask for some items which were provided.

We thought the hotel was excellent in every way.

title: Wonderful stay at Pas de Calais
text: My 17 y/o daughter and I had a lovely 4 days staying at the Hotel Pas de Calais.  Our room was beautiful.  The staff was friendly and helpful, especially Vanessa who told me where to find a pharmacy to treat my daughters sunburn.  Breakfast was wonderful with strong coffee and more bread/pastries than we could possibly eat.  Location was convenient with two metro stops within a 5 minute walk and many sites within walking distance.  Would definitely stay again on another trip to Paris!

title: Fantastic service, friendly people, elegant hotel and great location. Cannot be beat in Paris
text: We have stayed at the Hotel Pas de Calais several times. It is always excellent but this time was even more excellent thanks to an excellent team on reception as well as at breakfast. Elegant, stylish and incredibly friendly and welcoming. It is also has the advantage of a great location - right in the middle of Saint Germain but out of the crazy busy parts, and close to the museums and beautiful shops. A wonderful hotel and I hope to stay many times more.

title: perfect for every every occasion
text: I visited this hotel with my husband and two adult daughters for our 60th birthdays . We all loved this family hotel - its in a great location, with friendly staff and we will definitely be back soon !

title: Excellent visit - highly recommend
text: We had an excellent stay at Hotel Pas de Calais in the 6th Arr from 6/25-6/28 in the family room - a perfect set up for our family.  The location was perfect for us.  Easy walk to the Louvre and the metro.  We arrived early on the 25th and they stored our luggage for us.  When we arrived back later in the afternoon our luggage was already in our rooms, which was a pleasant surprise.  All of the staff was very pleasant, rooms were great and comfortable.   They also arranged a taxi pickup for us on our departure day.  I would not hesitate to stay here again.

title: Elegant and relaxed boutique hotel in great location!
text: Beautiful and charming hotel. Wonderful location, friendly and knowledgeable staff. Great breakfast was such a nice way to start the day. If you need a room with elevator access, make sure to check at time of booking.

title: Fantastic!
text: Room was large, comfortable, and peaceful.  My wife and I travel to Paris often for work and really enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Pas de Calais because of its premier location to local nightlife, shopping and restaurants.  The hotel staff was top of the line.  Helpful in every way.  We will be coming back to stay in this amazing hotel.

title: Annual Work trip for a conference
text: This is one of the best hotels in Paris. The rooms are Spacious, very clean and absolutely Beautiful! The staff is very friendly and accommodating. It’s located in the perfect neighborhood close to shops , restaurants and with easy access to Metro and RER. I highly recommend this hotel. 5 stars all around

title: Excellent choice close to Invalides
text: Very nice and convenient hotel, very good rooms, friendly and helpful staff, very good breakfast. Hotel is in quiet alley in walking distance from Invalides and the universities. Evening bar, no lunch, but staff direct you to one of the many restaurants close by

title: Excellent 5 night stay for family of 5 Americans
text: Excellent 5 day stay at this hotel for American family of five.  Stay was above and beyond enjoyable.  The concierge team of Rafael, Jacque-Olivier and others were extremely attentive and helpful before and throughout our stay.  Assisted with scheduling pickup from airport upon arrival and pickup from hotel upon departure.  Bartender,  David was extremely polite, easy going and my children asked every night when we could go down and see David at the end of the evening.  All staff/employees speak excellent English and we had no issues communicating.  All three rooms we reserved were immaculate upon check-in.  Morning breakfast was excellent and hotel allowed us to order food delivered a couple times as sometimes that’s just easier traveling with three kids of varying ages.  Hotel was very quiet throughout the day and night as it’s located near a busy area but on a narrow side street.  Highly recommend staying at this hotel for families, couples or business travelers looking for a quiet, relaxed, resting environment.

title: Amazing hotel in the heart of Saint Germain
text: Best hotel in Paris.  Friendly staff and such a great location. I truly enjoy staying here everytime I’m in Paris. The proximity to all the best restaurants and easy access to transit make this the ideal choice.

title: Great Location in Left Bank
text:
Staff was wonderful, especially Jacques-Olivier and Rafael.  Room 59 - take elevator to 4th floor, then walk up a flight or stairs, cross the hallway and up some more stairs.  If you have mobility issues, ask for a room on a lower floor.    The room was nice size with a safe & fridge.  Queen bed & pillows were very comfortable.  Outlets and USB ports for charging.  Nice storage space.

I would have given a higher rating except for the service at breakfast.  Breakfast was not buffet but served.   The concept of having it served it great , except the lady serving did not seem to understand either French or English and it took a long time for her to bring it out.

title: Lovely spot to land in Paris
text: This was a perfect location in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Paris. Helpful staff at the desk and easy communication when making booking. The hotel was clean and one of the more spacious bathrooms I have ever had in Paris. Lovey breakfast as well. Would highly recommend staying here.

title: Great Boutique hotel in the perfect location
text: The location of this hotel is really the best. Almost everything that we wanted to do was within walking distance, and there was a taxi stand a 2 minute walk away. We did not need to leave the neighborhood for any of our meals or shopping. This neighborhood has everything you need, including great people watching. And this hotel is a gem. The rooms are small, but meticulously clean and comfortable. The hotel staff is very pleasant and Vanessa at the front desk was particularly helpful. This will definitely be our choice of hotel in Paris in the future.

title: The Saint Germain district is where you want to center your Parisian visit and this hotel is the perfect venue.
text: This hotel is owned and operated by the same family since 1922 and it shows. You will see that level of detail the moment you walk through the front door. Don't waste your time searching reviews. The Saint Germain district is where you want to center your Parisian visit and the Hotel Pas De Calais is the perfect venue. All future trips to Paris for my family must include this hotel.

title: Best hotel stay I’ve ever experienced in Paris!
text:
This is the absolutely best hotel stay I’ve ever experienced in Paris!
My family and I absolutely loved our stay at Hotel Pas de Calais. The staff is positively lovely and make you feel so very welcome from the minute you arrive. 
There are so many wonderful restaurants nearby but I highly recommend having breakfast at the hotel as it was the most peaceful and tasty way to begin a day of sightseeing in Paris.  I would be remiss if I also didn’t compliment the hotel on how nice it was to have a nightcap from the bar in the lobby area before heading upstairs to a very comfortable room. 
The hotel location is perfect.  We walked to all the sites from this hotel and took the metro several times.  We used the Saint Germain metro station which was 2 blocks away (3-5 min walk). Admittedly, I prefer to walk around Paris and I walked at least one-way to all the sites from this perfectly located hotel. 
My family of five enjoyed the family rooms which were two adjoining standard rooms.  I decided to book a suite for my wife and I for the last two nights of our stay and I was so impressed with how beautiful the suites are in this hotel.  
This was my third visit to Paris and first stay at Hotel Pas de Calais. I will be returning to this hotel for my next visit.  I cannot recommend a better place to make your home while you are in Paris. 
Many thanks to Vanessa and the whole team at Hotel Pas de Calais who were such great hosts for our family trip.  You all represent the epitome of hospitality. 

O. Hamid & family

title: Vacation with my son in Paris!
text: It was a true delight to stay at this boutique hotel.  There are so many things to praise including the proximity to great shops and restaurants, the caring and welcoming team at the front desk, and the great petit déjeuner.  But if anything stands out best to me, it really was the team and management.  I felt welcome and cared for at a time I needed to rest.  Thank you dear friends, and I hope someday to make you proud by being fluent in French.

title: Nasty Night Receptionist
text: Everything was wonderful except for the very rude night receptionist Olivie. I hope, if I ever stay in your hotel again, he will not be there. Ruined my last days in Paris. He should not be in a position to deal with hotel guests.

title: Very satisfied
text: I enjoyed my stay at Hotel Pas de Calais.Employees are so good ,room is comfortable and the hotel location is perfect .The pillows and the duvet are comfortable .The bathroom is good .I would definetely come again

title: Wonderful boutique hotel with ideal location in St. Germain!
text: We selected this property because of its outstanding location – the hotel is only steps away from the cafés of St. Germain-des-Pres, but located on a quiet side street.  The property itself is very charming with a beautiful central courtyard under a glass roof.  The staff is wonderful and very friendly, and made last minute reservations for us at a nearby restaurant that we loved (La Divina Comedia).  We were given a large room with king sized bed that had two closets, a very large bathroom and all the typical modern amenities.  The window overlooked a central light well so there was no view, but it was extremely quiet and cozy.  The only disappointment was that the website showed many beautifully decorated rooms, but ours was basic white on white.  However, the quietness and large size of the room made up for that.  The fantastic location in the 6th Arrondissement and the super friendly staff made our stay in Paris a wonderful experience.

title: Clean, Friendly & Convenient
text: Hotel was clean and well maintained. Staff was friendly and very helpful. Breakfast was outstanding! Room was small - but that is to be expected in Paris. Location was within walking distance to the Louvre, Musee Dorsay, Ile de la Cite and Luxembourg Gardens.

title: Absolutley fantastic hotel
text: The location is just perfect -- an easy walk to the Orsay, Rodin, or the Louvre.  The hotel is also surrounded by wonderful boutiques.  Souer, located just next door, has beautiful clothes and scarves.  The breakfast -- served in your room if you like -- was so French and so perfect.  It included fresh baked breads, butter, cheeses, and yogurt.  The room and bathroom were spotless and spacious.  Most importantly, the staff was so kind and helpful.  They recommended cafes.  They retrieved cabs.  This was a special trip for me and the Hotel Pas de Calais made it very memorable.  This is truly a special hotel in a special city.

title: Took good care of us
text: My daughter and I travelled to Paris in August 2021. My daughter has health issues and the hotel staff made this trip so easy and pleasant for us. I’m so appreciative and have recommended them to several people.

title: Wonderful Staff, Beautiful Boutique
text: The boutique hotel and the staff were amazing and very helpful.  The only area I feel could be improved upon is their breakfast offerings. There are so many cafes nearby that we were able to have a more varied breakfast outside of the hotel.

title: Will come back.
text:
Great, friendly, good service.  Room and bathroom recently refurbished.  Nice continental breakfast and alternative items available such as GF bread and soya milk.
Excellent location in St Germain. One of best roads.

title: First stay at Pas de Calais
text: This was our first stay. Your hotel is wonderful. Now our favorite. The greenery is very welcoming. The reception desk is so nice especially Raphael, Alex, and the young lady who has only been there a month. The service is outstanding. Very tranquil. Merci!!  Chambre 55

title: Wonderful service, accommodations, best neighborhood for visit with two teens
text: This hotel exceeded all of our expectations!  I would choose this hotel again.  Set in the most charming neighborhood on St. Germaine on a quiet street. Easy walks to restaurants and fashionable shops.  The Family Room accommodation was perfect for traveling with two teens with connecting two separate bedrooms and bathrooms.  Elegant lobby to read or have a quiet breakfast or drink.  The staff was the best during the booking process and our stay. They graciously helped us with requests and were charming to talk with.  Also made excellent recommendations for local restaurants.  Our trip was pleasurable and easy!

title: Great Hotel and Staff - shame our booking request wasn't respected
text:
We had booked 2 Superior rooms to be located close together. They nearly achieved this in that they were at least on the same floor, but one of the rooms  was out the back and overlooked a dark dingy central courtyard area with discarded pots etc., We checked with reception but they wouldnt move us to a better room.
This room had a rumbling sound that oscillated every minute and was most notable at night, so very little sleep enjoyed. The air-con didn't work and the door security locked didn't work either.
Having said this the Hotel the room and bathroom were spotlessly clean and the staff very friendly and helpful.
The Hotel is located down a quite side street with easy access to many Cafe's, Restaurants and Shops. We would certainly consider returning but only if we had a better room allocated.

Beyond exceptional service. All staff members were extremely accommodating. Good clean room with all the necessary amenities. Only issue was traffic noise from outside mainly during the night. Otherwise a wonderful visit.

title: As always very good
text:
I love your hotel , always stay there when in Paris. We my children and I feel it is our home , the hotel gives me the same room
every time which is so appreciated . And  the staff excellent . 
I hope I shall soon be able to visit again

title: Perfect Spot
text: Lovely hotel, very kind and helpful staff (especially considering we don’t speak French), delicious breakfast that includes all the French treats one would expect from a well serviced hotel, and excellent location. Will be returning in the spring!

title: Great small hotel in a great location
text: Excellent location, excellent service, a small and quite hotel very convenient excellent location.  The quite ambiance, close to every place you want to get to without the noise that often accompany such location is a real treat

title: The place !!!!
text:
Its a gem. Beautiful, quiet, near of everything.. 
you are going to fill you are at home. The breakfast is amazing. The people better more. Its my place in Paris
Valerie, Rafael special mention by them. Excellent stay

title: New Year's Weekend
text:
We stayed at this hotel over New Year's weekend.  The location was great.  It was a short walk to the Seine River and maybe 15 minutes to the Louvre Museum.  There was an abundance of brasseries in every direction, great shopping, and there were Christmas Market stalls still open.  
The staff at the hotel were very friendly and helpful.  The room was kind of small with about a queen sized bed, but everything worked well.  Maybe our only complaint was that the room was too warm and we had to open the window to let in cold air.
We would definitely stay here again.

title: I love this boutique hotel and always stay here!
text: We've stayed in this hotel 4 times now and will always come back to it. Can walk to almost anywhere you want, including Louvre, Tuilleries, Bon Marche, etc. Restaurants all there( as it's in the "haunts" of where the famous authors loved to meet, write and dine). It's on a one-way street so when Uber's come to get you it's an easy find. The staff is always welcoming and friendly (speak English too) and have helped us numerous times to get restaurant reservations or call cabs to get to the airport. Metro station/bus station just around the corner. Breakfasts are wonderful and not buffet (which I cannot tolerate buffets these days). Beds are comfy with fabulous sheets. It's just the perfect place for us!

title: Wonderful Boutique Hotel
text:
For us, the location was perfect.  Located on a side street with relatively little traffic, it is within a short 10-15 minute walking distance to the Louvre.  The area is also teeming with small boutique stores which is great for shopping or just window browsing.  

The room was clean and decent size (for Paris) with a shower.  Because we opted for a room away from the street, there was virtually no noise at night.  And, you can have breakfast delivered to your room, if you prefer to sleep a little later without feeling the need to rush to get to the breakfast room.

The staff was courteous and very helpful.  On one evening when it was raining, we had  the hotel request a taxi.  The concierge waited at the door for the cab and, when it  stopped a block from the hotel entrance, the concierge sprinted in the rain to request the cab to back up - even though we said we had no problem walking the block.  We were clearly impressed with the customer service.  

Without any hesitancy, I would certainly recommend Hotel Pas de Calais.

title: Wonderful boutique hotel in Paris
text: Have stayed here many times and always love it.  It is off the main drag which I love.  The hotel is small and quiet and the rooms are great.  The breakfast is the best and included!  Many rooms have tubs which is rare in Paris. The top floor suits are very large and roomy.  Everyone who works here is very nice and helpful and always patiently practice my French.

title: GREAT LOCATION _ FRIENDLY SERVICE
text: We stayed here in July 2021 right after Paris re-opened to American tourists. It is a family owned hotel in a great location in St. Germaine des Pres within walking distance of the most popular restaurants and shops. Breakfast everyday was hearty - no eggs, but lots of local cheeses and fruits and breads. Our room was comfortable, if a tad small. Bathroom was small. But location is great. Easy walk to metros.

title: Favorite Paris Hotel
text: have been staying at Hotel Pas de Calais for over 30 years. Hotel is in a Greal location, with friendly staff (hi Valerie) and lovely, comfortable renovated rooms. Will be back next time through Paris.

title: Very nice hotel in the centre of Paris
text: Rooms were very nice and clean and it was lovely to have breakfast in the room each day for no additional cost (other than the breakfast). Location was great, walking distance from many attractions, great restaurants and shopping. Will definitely come back!

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: The Hotel Pas de Calais is located in a truly central area of Saint-Germain-des-Pres.  The hotel staff is friendly and very helpful.  Don't be surprised when you board the elevator to your room--it's a classic Parisian tight fit.  The rooms are roomy and quiet--just what you need for a good stay.  Enjoy!

title: Wonderful
text: This is s small hotel in the left bank, nested between lovely boutiques in a quiet street.  The hotel is quaint, each room is unique, well appointed and cozy.  The bed is so comfortable and the sheets so soft.  They have a beautiful wall garden, perfect for an afternoon aperitif.  What make this place special is the staff.  They are kind and attuned to people’s needs.  We’ll definitely be back.

title: Lovely hotel with an amazingly friendly and helpful staff!
text: This is a great hotel in a nice location.  We enjoyed our stay and esepcially appreciated how helpful the staff was throughout our stay. They booked all of our dinners for us, they spoke wonderful English, and they provided a myriad of tips on things to go and places to see. The continental breakfast is nice since some of the cafes don't open that early so we appreciated being able to get coffee and a lovely breakfast before we starting exploring.

title: Wonderful stay at Hotel Pas de Calaid
text:
My husband and I stayed at Hotel Pas de Calais in September 2021 for the weekend and we loved the hotel.
The staff were all incredibly friendly and hospitable in particular Alex the owner of the hotel went out of his way to accomodate us. 
The position of the hotel could not be better right in the heart of St Germaine de Pres. Surrounded by all the best coffee shops and fashion stores. 
We stayed in the back section of the hotel and although there was no lift access the rooms were much larger and we were very comfortable.
Will certainly stay at hotel pas de Calais when I return to Paris.

title: Amazing!!!
text: It was a fantastic stay. The hotel staff was so friendly, and we had a wonderful time in Paris. From the hotel it is very nice and easy to walk to the Louvre, Eiffel  Tower, etc. and in every corner there is a beautiful coffee or restaurant. The rooms and perfectly clean and comfortable. For Paris, this is my favorite place to stay. Thank you so much :)

title: Lovely home-away-from-home in a perfect location
text: We loved our stay at the wonderful Hotel Pas de Calais! We booked the family suite, which worked perfectly for our family of four-- spacious adjoining rooms, Queen bed for mom and dad, and two twins for the kids. The interior design was really special and memorable. The hotel manager and the front desk staff are exceptionally attentive. They took great care of us, making reservations, changing reservations, and helping us with advice and directions-- they were so personable, kind, and helpful. The people who work here make this hotel  a home-away-from-home in the heart of Paris. The location is excellent. It is on a quaint, neighborhood street, but just a few blocks from well-known restaurants and tourist attractions, you can walk almost everywhere easily. We felt the rates this hotel charged were an extremely excellent value for the rooms, service, and overall experience.

title: Perfect hotel for Paris!
text: Perfect location, close to great shopping and the main attractions of Paris but pretty quiet at night. Great staff: Camilla was super nice and helpful, gave us great recommendations. Comfortable and clean room. Next time I’m in Paris, I’ll be staying here again!

title: Ideal small hotel on the left bank of Paris
text:
Stayed for 7 nights.
Excellent location near shops ,buses, and boulevard Saint Germaine in 6th arr.Room very comfortable 
and clean and quiet. Staff very helpful .
Delicious continental breakfast.No restaurant.

title: Great Stay
text: Had a great stay here. The staff was extremely welcoming and we loved the morning breakfasts each day. It is in a great location to shops, restaurants, and metros. Would stay here again! Highly recommend.

title: Excellent gem!
text: The location was perfect. The staff was amazing. I just came back from 6 nights there and couldn’t have been happier. Everyone was always ready to help and accommodate us the best they could. Nothing was ever too much. They always make sure that your stay is pleasant and stress free. I cant recommend a better place and will stay here again on my next trip to Paris.

title: Excellence in a very well located Hotel
text: A family owned hotel for over 100 years, service and quality are the themes here.  An impeccably clean and well maintained facility with beautiful recently refreshed rooms and public areas.  The staff and ownership are wonderful and extremely helpful.  Camila found us an excellent retuarnt in the neighbor hood and an amazing lady at the front desk arranged for our Covid tests required to fly home.  She is a lovely multi-lingual lady who has been with the hotel for 26 years which says something about the quality of the ownership.

title: Excellent Hotel!
text: Great hotel, clean and quiet. Very professional staff. Neighborhood is walking distance from the Louvre as well as many great shops and restaurants! The breakfast is very copious. The room was comfortable and very clean.

title: Charrning Left Bank Hotel
text: We have been staying here for more than 14 years.  Small and well placed right off the Boulevard Saint Germain.  Friendly and always helpful.  Close walking distance to so many things.  Close to the Louvre, the d'Orsay, the Rodin Museum, Les Invalides, and cafes such as Deux Magots, and the Left Bank locations for many of the luxury and less well known  brand boutiques.  Very accessible to a variety of interesting restaurants.

title: The Best Hotel In Paris!
text: I have been in many hotels in Paris and this one is simply outstanding. Beautiful, well located, amazing staff. The room is so Parisian, clean and so convenient. The stuff is helpful and always nice. Just the BEST hotel with great value for money. Merci! I highly recommend it for business or nice leisure stay.

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text:
We stayed here in January 2020, absolutely loved the hotel, the amenities, location and service. 

This is a gorgeous hotel, loved the entrance way and the living wall, this atrium was very relaxing and was a lovely place for breakfast and a nice glass of wine before heading to bed.

Our room was very comfortable with high end amenities. 

We highly recommend this hotel and if we ever return to Paris we wouldn't want to stay any where else.

title: Professional and friendly
text: Premium service and friendly professional reception and handling. The location is great as it suites within luxury shipping stores and Paris best cafes. The staff are so kind and the service is on the top of their priority and beyond our expectations m

title: You Must Stay Here!
text: This was my third stay at Hotel Pas de Calais and certainly won't be my last!  The hotel, the staff, the location, everything truly makes it my home away from home when in Paris. There's really nothing that the staff won't do to make sure that you truly have a wonderful experience in "their home"!

title: Loved this hotel!
text: Friendly Staff, Family Owned. Very close to metro, boutique shops and restaurants. Rooms were clean and cute. The entryway was gorgeous with the living wall installation. All around perfect boutique hotel!

title: Wife's birthday vacation.
text: We spent 9 days in Paris for my wife's birthday. This was one of our best trips ever. The staff at Hotel Pas de Calais only made it that much better. They even arranged to have fresh cut flowers delivered for my wife's birthday.

title: Friendly, comfy hotel
text: Having been so disappointed with the hotel we usually stay at in Paris, we decided it was time for a change, and were so pleased we did! The staff could not have been nicer or more helpful at Hotel Pas de Calais.  Our room was surprisingly spacious, quiet and very comfortable. The only things which was a bit annoying, and this is nitpicking, was the bath plug didn't work very well, the taps protruded into the bath area which made having a shower a little awkward and the grouting showed signs of age, but it was very clean. That said, I would definitely return and recommend this hotel.  I love the location, it's good values and the staff are just fabulous.

title: Comfortable stay
text: It was the second time we stayed at this hotel and felt it was consistently excellent in the service offered.  We arrived early and our room was almost ready, so we were offered a complimentary cup of Richard tea which was delicious.  It was taken up to our room after a very quick and easy check in.  There is a beautiful lounge area to relax in. Our room was very different to the last one, so it seems each room is decorated in a different style. This time it had a more Victorian rather than a modern look. The space is absolutely clean, with thick wonderful towels, gowns, slippers, decent hot water pressure and a selection of Clarins toiletries.  There are night lights for reading and the wifi was excellent.  House cleaning happens daily and complimentary bottled water is provided.  The hotel is situated in a safe and central part of Paris with many wonderful stores around, even better in January when there are sales on.  The staff are friendly, helpful and there is so much ease in the engagement with everyone.  I would definitely stay here again.  When we departed they kindly held onto our luggage even though we already checked out.  A really pleasant and comfortable experience.

title: Perfect Stay
text:
Really recommend this hotel. Location was perfect - easy walk to LOADS of bars and restaurants. Also can walk along to Notre Dame. Room was lovely and clean. Staff were great. 

Loved the location, the room and the staff!

title: Perfect place in central Paris 6eme
text: Hotel Pas de Calais is a darling, clean, perfectly appointed 4-star hotel right in the center of Paris on a quiet section of rue des Saints Pères across from the Sciences Politique school in the 6th arrondissment. The staff -- all of them both day, afternoon and night -- are welcoming, accommodating and helpful. The Café Complet breakfast is delicious (yogurt, basket of bread and breakfast pastries, cheese, butter and freshly squeezed orange juice). The rooms are nicely decorated and different from one another. And you're literally just around the corner from Brasserie Lipp, Café Flore and Café Deux Magots, St. Germain des Prés.

title: Quintessential St. Germain de Pres Hotel!
text:
Spent 3 nights at this Hotel in January, with my husband.  Room was on the 5th floor, which was interesting to get to, but absolutely lovely - with exposed beams in the ceiling and windows that opened onto the quiet courtyard.  Larger room than most Euro/Parisian hotels.  Big bathroom as well, in comparison.  We didn't have breakfast at the hotel, so I can't comment on that, but the lobby space is absolutely serene, comfortable and inviting.  Love the glass roof and the 'green wall'!
My only 'minor' issue was that the couple in the room next to us (or near us) were quite expressive in their love for one another...and we could hear all of that expression.  The walls are pretty thin...just beware!  Hey, it's Paris...but you might consider ear plugs if you're a light sleeper!

title: A safe place to choose in Paris
text:
Excellent location , walking distance to restaurants, shops , cafes , farmacies and supermarkets.
Nice modern rooms with a lot of light.
Small but very nice prepared breakfast .
Coffee, breads , croissants, butter, cheese , marmalade, yogurt ,fruit salad and orange juice.
A safe place to choose when in Paris.

title: Great staff, comfortable clean room and great location
text:
