Overall we enjoyed our stay and definitely will consider staying there again, The hotel staffs are very courteous and helpful. Our room was very comfortable and spacious. The breakfast buffet is very nice, it is also very nice that the hotel provides free snacks, coffee and juices after 1 pm. Location is very convenient, nearby restaurants, shops and a short walk to Eiffel tower. 
My only suggestion is the hotel needs a bit of updating.

title: Trip to Paris
text: Excellent service. Very clean room. The staff was friendly, kind and eager to help. Very short walk to Eiffel Tower and 35 min walk to Louvre an Arc de Triomphe. Great cafes only a 2 minute walk away on Rue de Cler. Will stay there again when we return to Paris.

title: Amazing Staff
text: Hotel was a little different than we expected based on pictures and reviews but overall we had a good experience. Staff was friendly and extremely helpful. They spoke English which was a huge help. Breakfast was delicious. We thought for sure we would go out for breakfast at some point but theirs was so good we opted to eat it every morning. Conveniently located to train station and Eiffel Tower.  We would definitely stay here again.

title: Great stay!
text: We had a great stay and the hotel is just what you are looking for in Paris. Would definitely stay here again in Paris. Views of the Eiffel Tower are unmatched especially for the value. The size of the room was surprisingly big for a European hotel.

title: Complicated
text: The hotel and its facilities are awesome. Just staff are kinda rude. My booking was complicated. I asked for a double bed but they insisted I requested two twin beds. I dont know how that happened but i also have proof that i requested and booked a double queen bed. Also told me “next time you should call the hotel to confirm” i have never done that my whole life but looks like they were insisting that it was my fault

title: A perfect perch in Paris
text: Friendly, clean, efficient   little hotel which takes care of things. Flexible and friendly staff good coffee machine in room.Well placed for Left Bank activities - near Seine, Les Invalides and St Germaine.

title: Review of recent stay at Relais Bosquet
text: I've stayed at this hotel previously and it does not fail to deliver.  Beautifully appointed rooms, some large by French standards. Lovely common area and breakfast.  Friendly, helpful, professional staff.  Fabulous location!  Highly recommend.

title: Recommended Hotel
text:
Excellent location, friendly staff and clean rooms. You can find the following shops and facilities very close to the hotel: Cafe trottoir, Monoprix, Carrefour, boulangerie, fromager, fruit and vegetable market,
Japanese restaurant, Amorino, Lebanese restaurant ... Tour Eiffel is at 15mn walking distance. I strongly recommend the hotel for families.

title: Perfect location
text: This boutique hotel is in District 7 in a residential area with some shops and cafes nearby.  It is a very nice area to walk around.  The room was clean with air conditioning and the staff was very helpful.  The rooms are small, but we did not spend much time in the room as we were out all day discovering this lovely city.  We would definitely stay here again.

title: Thoroughly enjoyed our time at Hotel Relais Bosquet
text: A lovely small hotel in a nice location near the Eiffel tower.  The staff was warm and welcoming, we had a spacious room, comfy bed, food and shops just steps away.  My two daughters particularly liked the free snacks available after lunch and i found i did as well, coming in sitting down and having a juice or water and maybe a slice of cake before going to the room made the entire experience feel more like home away from home than hotel.

title: Excellent
text:
Amazing view, amazing service! 
Very kind staff, always willing to help!
The position of the hotel is perfect! Close to the Eiffel Tower, walking distance from nice restaurants, supermarkets & metro.
Rooms where always clean…! In general it’s a nice hotel to stay at!
This was our 4th stay at this hotel and each time it gets better!!!

title: Great visit
text: Had a great time at the hotel.  Great location.  The staff was very helpful, even helped carry luggage to the room.  The room was adorable.  Just like a French hotel should be.  Next time in Paris will stay there.

title: Confortable stay
text: The best was the position, ideal for visiting Tour Eiffel and for the tours of sourroundings of Paris that depart from there. The room was tiny but whit a nice view of the top of the Tour Eiffel and a super comfortable bed. Maybe the only flaws were the cleanliness of the bathroom and the breakfast, not so excellent.

title: Perfect…location, comfort, hospitality!
text: We enjoyed our stay from the welcoming staff to the comfort and quiet of our room. We even had a peek-a-boo view of the Eiffel Tower. It has a great location close to the Metro and lots of restaurants.

title: Loved it
text: The location was great, and the staff were really friendly and helpful. The room was really quite large for a 3 star hotel in Paris. There’s plenty of cafes and a convenience store nearby. We’ll definitely stay again.

title: PLAN YOUR AWESOME STAY HERE!
text: From the comfort of the bed, shower, and room to the view from the balcony, this hotel is definitely worth your time and stay. The staff was attentive, and the location is amazingly close to food, drink, the Eiffel and other landmarks.

title: Great place and location
text: Was a pleasure staying at the Hotel Relais Bosquet Paris. We have stayed in the area before, but never at this hotel. Staff was friendly and helpful, room was large enough for the 3 of us (Me/Wife/Teenage Daughter). Even with the extra roll out bed, the room never felt crowded. Location was a great homemade to get to every part of the city via Metro/Taxi/Uber. The area is quite, but w/ Rue Cler a half a block away you have everything you need if you want to stay close to the hotel for Lunch/Dinner/shopping. Would definitely stay again.

title: Excellent sleep, excellent location
text: Great value.  Quiet Rue Cler neighbourhood.  So close (but not too close) to Metro station.  Nice easy walk to Eiffel Tower.  Nice choice of nearby restaurants and bakery.  Clean cozy nicely air-conditioned quiet rooms

title: Pleasant Stay
text: We had a short layover in Paris. This hotel is conveniently located for walking to shopping, dining and sites. The hotel was clean and the staff polite and helpful. A morning continental breakfast was available. The staff was helpful in navigating to the airport, helping to arrange transportation. Highly recommend staying here.

title: Excellent stay and staff
text: Stayed 3 nights with my husband and paid extra for the partial Eiffel Tower view which I thought was worth it. Our room was small but had a very powerful AC unit which saved us in the humidity. The staff are so sweet and attentive to every need. There are no outlets in the bathroom so using the hair dryer was challenging. Other than that, this hotel is clean, well maintained and in a good safe location. Highly recommend.

title: Great hotel close to the Tour Eiffel
text: A delightful hotel with great location close to the Tour Eiffel.  Room well appointed; a partial view of the tower.  Good breakfast with wide range of offerings.  Nice afternoon beverages and snacks to keep you going during the day!

title: Cool and cozy hotel !
text: Hotel Relais Bosquet made our stay in Paris pleasant and enjoyable. It's a cool and cozy place near the Eiffel Tower, shops, and restaurants. Very accommodating and helpful front desk staff. Snacks and drinks in the afternoon were available after a day's tour. Will surely stay here again!

title: Great hotel and staff and location
text: The hotel is very nice and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The front desk manager, Antoine, is very helpful and responsive if you need anything. There's a breakfast buffet and tasty snacks put out in the afternoon and evening. Plus, you're in an amazing location near the Eiffel Tower and lots of other sights and even being in such a great location it's not noisy at night.

title: Great Hotel!
text: Hotel was very accommodating and extremely kind. Location is great. Easy to get to the metro and plenty of restaurants/shops near by. The Effiel tower was very close! Room was nice and breakfast was fantastic!

title: Great Hotel and staff and location
text:
Great small hotel , well managed, friendly staff. clean great location .  
surrounding streets have good restaurants

fight for room with view..worth every penny

Sat on balcony drinking champagne late at night wtahcing the tower twinkle. that paris inn a room

title: Thank you for your kind and caring services
text:
The electronic devices were a bit old, refrigerator smelled bad and a washstand was kind of small to wash, but except for that It was an unforgettable memory i had at Relais Bosquet! 

Usually I would give 3 out 5 only for the condition of the room, but i give you 5 since the service I got there was so kind and caring. Thank you for your kind and caring services and i hope to see you again !

title: Long weekend get away
text: Stayed at this small, quaint boutique hotel for 4 nights in Aug 2022 with my significant other. Recommended by family who stayed here 14 years ago and had an equally nice stay.  Kind, helpful front desk staff, decent breakfast buffet (although the Boulangeries and cafes on nearby Rue Cler offer plenty of breakfast eats). Our superior room was spacious for 2 people, cleaned daily, well lit and air conditioned with recently renovated bathroom. Great location near Rue Cler in a quiet area of the city. A <5 minute walk to the metro, a <10 min walk from Champ de Mars making nightly strolls to see the Eiffel Tower possible. Will definitely return, we had a lovely trip and enjoyable stay.

title: Fantastic stay
text: Clean rooms,  Fabulous breakfast prepared by a kind waiter.  The front desk always helpful and friendly.   Location perfect.  I will certainly recommend to my friends and family that are interested in visiting Paris.

title: Nice stay
text: A little dated but very comfortable. No air con. The staff are friendly and helpful and speak English. A room with a view of the tower can booked. Very easy to walk to the tower. Lists of all day cafes etc right near the hotel. Also and e bike rental location just 20m away.

title: three  and half stars
text: Room rather shall but comfortable with two windows that opened to allow fresh air.Breakfast disapointing with lack of fresh fruit.Staff very helpful.Wonderful area near Tower Eiffel.Lots of restaurants and some good quality shopping.Lovely quiet streets surrounding Hotel.

title: amazing, would recommend to others
text: the rooms are spacious and adorable, the free snacks in the lobby were so nice and fun. the location is great, right by rue clef and the Eiffel Tower. the Eiffel Tower view room can’t be beat, recommending to my friends and family! If we ever come back to Paris we will definitely stay here!

title: Hotel Relais Bosquet
text: This is my second time staying at Hotel Relais Bosquet, and I will be staying here again for my next trip to Paris. Charming accomodations, very friendly and helpful staff, and complimentary snacks served in the afternoon! The location is conveniently located close to the Eiffel Tower and just a 2-min walk to public transportation.

title: Lovely stay
text: I enjoyed staying at Hotel relays Bosquet! The hotel is clean, quiet and in a safe central location. Only a 7 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower! The room was a nice size for Paris, with a roomy bathroom with a full tub/shower. I appreciated the room darkening window shades and the a/c worked well and kept the room cool. The breakfast was average, the cooked items were only ok, so I kept to the fresh croissants, breads, cheese and fruit which were nice. There are several cafes near by as well as patisseries and shops for cheese, groceries, wine etc. the front desk staff speak English and were helpful and friendly. The only issue was twice I ordered breakfast to be sent to my room for 10 am and both times I was woken at 8 with it being delivered, not a big deal but keep that in mind if you want to sleep in. The hotel has irons, boards available but you have to get them from the front desk, they are not already in the room. The hotel elevator is one of the larger ones that I have experienced in a Paris hotel, that was nice. On my day of check out I was leaving well before the breakfast was to be opened, the gentleman at the front desk offered to make me a coffee or cappichino  while I was waiting for my transport, which was very nice ! Overall a very enjoyable stay.

title: Great Hotel In Paris
text:
I stayed on recommendation from a friend. It is a great location, quite local and quite.Paid extra for the Eiffel view ( room).. You must do it especially as it was summer and sat on balcony watching is twinkle 

Organisation and staff were great allowed early book in or store bags and held bags as we weren't due to travel till early evening 

Cannot praise enough and will be back

This is not a cols international type hotel but small friendly clean place.

Local restaurants an bars good

title: Return Trip to Hotel Bosquet
text: Enjoyed a return trip to Hotel Bosquet.  Front desk was very helpful with advice on sight seeing and restaurants.  Room clean and thankfully with good air con.  Only slight disappointment was breakfast which didn’t live up to our previous visit.  However lots of local restaurants for a quick breakfast before heading out to explore.

title: AMAZING
text: We loved this property. Small but well designed with the kindest staff. I was on a quick trip with my daughter and we had such a great time and will be staying here again.  We had a beautiful view of the Eiffel tower.

title: Hotel Relais Bosquet, Paris - Excellent Hotel
text: Front desk staff are friendly, helpful and smart.  Housekeeping keeps things clean.  Breakfast is delicious.  Rooms are comfortable.  The handicapped room is very nice.  The location of the hotel is lovely in the 7th arrondissement, with cafes and the Eiffel Tower nearby.  Bus stops and metro are close.  Nothing negative to report.  I will stay at this hotel again when I am next in Paris.

title: Hotel stay
text: We had two rooms for two nights. The staff at the hotel was exceptional. Extremely accommodating and helpful. The hotel is in a fantastic location. Just a short walk to the Eiffel Tower and restaurants. We definitely will stay at this hotel if we visit Paris in the future.

title: Hotel Relais Bosquet is a hidden gem
text: We were again delighted with our stay at Relais Bosquet during our Paris vacation. The location cannot be beat!  The rooms are nicely appointed and meet our needs. The entire staff  was excellent - rooms tidied daily, concierge assistance by all at the reception desk was outstanding and I again need to mention the location.  Whether you wish to use the subway, Uber, taxi or rent bikes and scooters or walk the city this is the hotel for you.  Restaurants and a weekly farmers market are found down the block. Merci to all!

title: Long weekend in Paris to celebrate a milestone birthday (postponed from 2021).
text: As a family, we took two rooms, both of which were very comfortable.  The hotel was extremely central and convenient, surrounded by a fabulous array of restaurants and cafes.  The mini supermarkets were very well stocked with fresh produce and reasonably priced.

title: Great Location!
text: We loved staying at the Hotel Relais Bosquet during our  4 nights in Paris.  It is within a mile to most tourist sites and very close to the Eiffel Tower.  The breakfast is good.  The staff is very helpful and speaks English well. The rooms are comfortable with amazing black out shades.

title: Charming hotel in the perfect location
text: We received a warm welcome and friendly service throughout our stay. Location just off the Rue Cler couldn’t be better and provides plenty of bars, restaurants, shops and bakeries in walking distance. The free afternoon snacks and sweets available in the lobby were a lovely touch and our superior room was spacious and well-appointed. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Paris. Thanks for a great stay!

title: Great service and location
text: Charming hotel in a great location near the Eiffel Tower. Calm , quiet street with many good places to eat and shop nearby as well as a small grocery store. The hotel staff is very friendly, helpful and accommodating , The rooms are comfortable and are equipped with mostly everything you may need. We enjoyed our stay and would have no hesitation in recommending or staying at the hotel again in a future visit to Paris.

title: Terrific stay
text: Loved this property.   Close to Rue Cler.   Close to Eiffel Tower.  Great staff.  Close to a Metro stop.  AIR CONDITIONING!!!  Turns out Rick Steves was here for 3 weeks in 2021.   Breakfast spot on and close to several markets

title: Great stay.
text:
Stuff treated us more like a family than guests. Very helpful. 
Location is good, walking distance to Eiffel Tower and some nice restaurants and to Metro (école militarie) and to les Invalided. Grocery store less than 50 meters away.

title: Perfect Location (Rue Cler area), Great Room, and Friendly Staff!
text:
Clean, good-sized room with great air conditioning.  The staff was extremely helpful and the breakfast buffet was very good.  I will definitely stay here again.
I did upgrade my room to have a view of the Eiffel Tower, as I was there on Bastille Day, the 14th of July.  Perfect location for exploring Paris, close to Eiffel Tower, Les Invalides and transit.

title: We keep returning….
text: This is the third time we have stayed at this lovely little hotel in the past decade.  The rooms are comfortable, the multilingual staff very helpful, the location perfect.  There are just enough amenities (small elevator, air conditioning, cold water available in the lobby) to make things easy without losing any charm.  We also love being able to walk a few blocks to the Eiffel Tower, few blocks to the metro and plenty of wonderful restaurants.  It’s a great deal for an expensive city.

title: WONDERFUL!
text: This was such an incredible hotel. The location is nearly a 3-5 minute walk give or take to the Eiffel Tower, I felt comfortable, relaxed and slept better than ever here! Staff is extremely accommodating and kind!

title: Wonderful Hotel in the Ideal Location
text: My friends and I have stayed at Hotel Relais Bosquet several times in the past few years and this most recent trip did not disappoint. The staff was very helpful and courteous and the rooms are quiet and comfortable. This is my go-to place when I visit Paris. I love the neighborhood with Rue Cler being so close by, and the Ecole Militaire metro station is very convenient for getting around Paris. The restaurants in the area are also very good!

title: Hotel stay
text: Was a great stay, great location and the staff was great! I needed something at 12:30 at night and staff was there to help me out. I recommend this hotel highly and would stay again. Close to Eiffel Tower and other tourist attractions.

title: Wonderful!
text: Spectacular boutique hotel in the easy to get to/from 7th. The 8 train connects to just about everything (Louvre, Gare du Nord, etc.). Staff is welcoming and friendly. Many restaurants within short walk... as is Tour Eiffel! (Tiny ding: Breakfast is 13 euros/pp. Nearby patisserie and Franpix can save you big.) Look forward to returning!

title: Very comfortable, quiet, and the location is excellent!
text:
My mother and I were able to walk to many of the sights.  Rue Cler is 1 block away for restaurants, bakeries, cheese and chocolate shops, and small grocery stores.

The beds are very comfortable and the window had an excellent electronic metal room darkening shade on the outside.  This really helped adjust to the time zone.

title: Great hotel.  Even greater staff.
text: The staff at the hotel are so friendly and accommodating.  They really made our stay in Paris relaxing and enjoyable.  The rooms are nice.  Small to US standards but large for Europe.  They are both quiet and comfortable.

title: Great stay Hotel Relais
text: We had a great stay. The hotel staff was very friendly, helpful, and accommodating. Our room was a nice size with a king bed which was very comfortable. The location was fantastic. We were only a few blocks from the Eiffel Tower with lots of things within walking distance.

title: Great location
text: We enjoyed our stay. Nearby metro stop and Eiffel Tower within walking distance . Great neighborhood with lots of restaurants and shopping and sites nearby. The hotel was comfortable and air conditioned and the staff was courteous and helpful. I would stay again

title: Loved the Relais Bosquet
text: We loved everything about this hotel - the great location, the friendly staff, the delicious breakfast, the comfortable rooms, the afternoon snacks.  It was a perfect place to stay a quiet neighborhood with good food and close to the Eiffel tower!  We hope to return.

title: Good location, and quiet comfortable room
text:
Lovely quaint boutique hotel well located around many little shops, cafes and supermarkets. We had a superior double room which was a good size with ample room for our bags with a separate wc and wardrobe. Room was very clean, and bed very comfortable. It’s quiet, aircon works very well in summer and good shower too.  Only thing lacking was no hair conditioner in the bathroom. Also the staff on the front desk could look a little more interested in what they were doing. 
Overall our stay was very comfortable

title: Decent location and plenty adequate accommodations, but subpar in the finer details
text:
Stayed here June 2022 for vacation -- family wanted location near Eiffel Tower which this hotel offered. In hindsight, part of the charm of Paris is walking the streets, so it would have been worthwhile to stay at a nicer place further away. But overall adequate.

We stayed in room 22, which was older -- carpets were visibly stained (I'm not picky in general!), furnishings were on the old side. We had multiple rooms so I did see that some other rooms were in noticeably better condition -- still older but in much better condition with cleaner carpets. Room was pretty small and tight -- but to be expected given location. Toilet was completely separate on another side of the room, without a sink ... which in some ways was a plus (not having the toilet near the other stuff), but in some ways really off-putting (can't wash hands right away). Overall though bathroom was plenty clean, even for someone used to a higher level of accommodations. Beds and linens were comfortable. Towels were adequate. Rooms also had blackout shades which were CRUCIAL -- being able to sleep during the long days of summer after being jet lagged was huge.

Our flight was canceled initially and they were very nice to not charge me for the days we missed -- so they have some good people. But one desk person was not a pleasant man ... not mean or anything but for example they had a nespresso machine sitting in the lobby so I naturally asked "oh do you have coffee pods for coffee?" -- a reasonable question since they do provide free pods in the rooms. Instead of politely saying simply "oh I'm sorry, we don't," he launched into complaining about how "if we did that, I would have even more work to do, and how am I supposed to manage that?" He reacted similarly to other questions as well.

The other desk people were much more pleasant, but ... we specifically arranged for rides to the train station on checkout because we were a large party and timing was tight. We confirmed the details, but when the day rolled around ... they had forgotten to order the cars. We ended up scrambling and having to literally run to barely catch the train in the rain.

Lastly, they could spend a tiny bit of money on small details to make it a more luxurious experience. They had free drinks and snacks all day, but they it wasn't clear what was free or not, and it wasn't laid out in an inviting way. I LOVE free stuff but never felt compelled to try any of the free stuff. Anyway, overall it was a decent place.

title: A Comfortable Stay
text: The room size and cleanliness of the room were just fine, and we slept well.  Overall, the hotel is a little tired.  The public areas are small and not where one would relax outside the room.  The staff members were very pleasant, professional, and helpful.  We were satisfied with our stay in general.

title: Great boutique hotel with exceptional service
text: Truly enjoyed our stay at this hotel. The staff were so helpful and friendly and the room was large, well kept, and clean compared to other Paris stays. Location is great if you want to be near the Eiffel Tower and Champs de Elysees and premier shopping. neighborhood is quieter at night so if you want more nightlife, head towards the Marais in a short cab ride. Would stay here again for sure!

title: Perfect place!
text: We were in this wonderful place during our Paris trip. The hotel was clean and convenient and the employees were very kind and nice. Also, we could easily contact any landmarks we want to go. I'd like to visit this place again when I'm in Paris.

title: Another great stay at the Relais Bosquet
text: As always, i stay at this hotel.  I've never been dissappointed.  Service is great.  Accomodations are great.  Nothing ever goes wrong.  I love this hotel,  Front desk is always accomodating.  Breakfast is great.

title: My favorite place to stay in Paris
text: I've been coming to Paris for more than 29 years. Every year except during the pandemic. The staff are excellent and have been very helpful. My second home. This is a wonderful neighborhood with fresh fruits and vegetables, restaurants nearby as well as shopping.

title: Fantastic Stay and Wonderful Staff!
text: Who says the French aren’t friendly to tourists??? The staff at the Relais Bosquet went out of their way to proactively make sure our stay and visit to Paris was the best that it could be.  From making dinner reservations for our choice restaurants as well as recommending alternative restaurants that better suited our moods to making sure our rooms were comfortable, clean and quiet in the heart of the city, we would recommend this hotel to everyone.  It’s location to Rue Cler was super convenient and was the initial reason for choosing this Hotel. We will stay here again because of the staff!

title: Wonderful
text: Lovely hotel. Comfortable, good location!  Quiet rooms with very good black out shutters. Very helpful staff. Adequate breakfast with nice selection and helpful attendant. Elevator sounds scary but works. Would stay here again!

title: Unhelpful, incompetent, and rude
text:
To be fair, the location is great and the rooms are functional. We got a superior room, but the toilet was in a closet, apart from the shower and sink. Some staff are friendly and provided recommendations, others are not.

One specific example, I asked two days before to arrange taxis to a rail station. When we showed up that morning to meet the taxis, we found out that no one had called. We almost missed our train. Also, there was one gentleman who consistently provided excuses as to why he could not be of assistance. If you looking for a hotel with consistent, helpful support, then this hotel will not likely be a good choice.

title: Great Stay in Paris
text: We spent four nights at Hotel Relais Bosquet Paris and it was fabulous. The room was spacious and very clean. It was nice to be able to have breakfast in the lobby before venturing out for a day of sightseeing. And I cannot say enough about how wonderful the staff is! The location is excellent - about a three minute walk to many restaurants on Rue Cler. When we return to Paris we will definitely stay at Hotel Relais Bosquet.

title: Special Place Special People
text: The hotel is warm and inviting.  It is perfectly located. The Metro, city buses, and bato brides are shot walks.  The neighborhood is charming.  The  staff is knowledgeable and extremely helpful in all situations.  I am looking forward to returning.

title: Hotel Relais Bosquet Paris
text: This boutique hotel was amazing.  The room was, as expected, relatively small but very clean.  The staff was extremely helpful and cheerful! title: We love this hotel!
text: Stayed here with three of my friends on a girls trip and we all loved it. Love the neighborhood. The reception desk staff is very helpful. They arranged taxis 3 times for us. Great recommendations for places to eat and Rue Cler, one block away, offers nice cafes, boulangeries, fresh fruit, flowers, ice cream, etc. Breakfast is good with a good selection, coffee, tea,‘cappuccino, etc.  Rooms are a very nice size. Walkable to Eiffel Tower, Musee d’Orsay, Tuileries, etc.  I highly recommend staying here.

title: Great Location, Eiffel Tower View, Well Furnished
text: This is our third excellent stay at Hotel Relais Bosquet - it is down the street from Rue Cler, the rooms are nicely furnished and decorated, some with partial Eiffel Tower views, the brightly decorated breakfast room serves a reasonable light breakfast (in a newly decorated breakfast room) for those who find it convenient to break-fast at the hotel, the 24/7 staff are always very helpful and friendly (very valuable advice about the public transit strike schedule was given to me just yesterday!) and, therefore, the price is a good value.

title: A lovely boutique Hotel with a charming feel and a great location
text: My wife and I spent a few days here. The neighborhood is delightful with plenty to do right outside your door where you will find a charming mix of local life and active shopping and dining. It's close to a Metro station and bus lines making getting around the city really easy.  Employees are super friendly and helpful and speak English, the rooms are clean and well appointed. Loved it and will definitely stay here again. The 7th is a great home base for exploring Paris. This isn't a 5 star luxury chain hotel but who wants that in Paris.

title: Great boutique hotel in a wonderful location
text: We are so very happy we chose this hotel! We saw a recommendation by Rick Steves (with a code for free breakfast) and are so enjoying both the property and the location. And, we accidentally double-booked our room … which Christian at the front desk noticed and took care of it for us. Stay here if you’re coming to Paris!

title: Convenient to city center
text: Nicely situated close to city center attractions- just a short walk to Eiffel Tower. Small but neat and clean room with king bed and air conditioning. Breakfast is extra, as are amenities such as wine, macaroons, view of Eiffel Tower, etc. Friendly and helpful staff, very small elevator and pricier than many others for what is provided, but given the location I assume it’s to be expected.

title: Great Hotel in a Wonderful Neighborhood
text: My wife and I recently stayed here and loved this hotel. From the moment we made the reservation, the staff was quick to respond to questions and was very accommodating. The breakfast bar was delicious, and well stocked with an assortment of warm dishes, pastries and a yogurt buffet. The room was very nice and well kept/maintained. The best part is the location, you’re just a few minutes walk away from the Eiffel Tower, and right next door to all of the wonderful cafes and shops on Rue Cler. Overall, I would highly recommend this hotel!

title: Great
text: Thank you for your hospitality. Your hotel is very good. Best location. Super clean and comfortable bed. I would recommend this place. Everything is near the hotel. We enjoyed our stay at this place. Thank you!

title: family trip to Paris

The staff and building were great.The desk and dining room people were friendly,kind and helpful.Location was great. Easy access to Metro. Lots of good restaurants in area.
Would stay again. Rooms clean and well kept.

title: Perfect Paris charm
text: A lovely small hotel located in a perfect area of the city.  Staff was tremendous at accommodating our every need.  Can’t wait to return!  Little terraces that overlook the Eiffel Tower and to see that at night when it is lit up was spectacular. This little hotel is a gem.

title: j'taime Rue Cler

We have made the Relais Bosquet our Paris home for 20 years.  The staff are professional and
caring;  rooms are large for the neighborhood.  We love all the small restaurants within walking 
distance.  This will remain our favorite go to hotel!

title: Excellent Hotel
text: This hotel was great. The staff are friendly and give great recommendations for the area.  It is located is a safe neighborhood with lots of restaurants that you can walk to.   The metro station is within a block of the hotel. Definitely would stay here again!

title: Wonderful boutique hotel with top tier staff
text: Family of three just returned from our weeklong stay at the B Montmartre hotel. We had read a lot of reviews in advance when making our hotel selection and were confident this was a solid choice and indeed it was. The rooms are small, but well maintained and very clean. We were on the 3rd floor of the newer building in the courtyard so it was very quiet. If we return to Paris in the future, I think we would prefer the same room type and undoubtedly will stay at this hotel again. Housekeeping was efficient and did a great job, especially given we had a ton of luggage and shopping bags scattered throughout.  The Barmen, "Pranab" and "Hasim" (may have spelled incorrectly - sorry) were marvelous and took care of us when we were in the mood for wine. Also we brought pizza back from neighborhood place one night and some charcuterie on another night and were given utensils and welcomed to eat inside (it was quite hot outside during our visit). The French wine selections were well-picked and reasonably priced. We enjoyed several bottles. Also several wines by the glass and regional beers. The front desk staff was wonderful and very accommodating of our lack of French - we knew only basic salutations. We were always greeted upon departing for the day and returning from our adventures. Sergio helped us on our departure when our Uber did not show despite confirming both the driver and vehicle the evening before. This apparently happens with some frequency in Paris so I would advise you to use taxi's and avoid Uber.  We also used the busses and subways, which are closely and took us to the local landmarks and museums. Some good eats in the area are Mamma Primi (Italian), Lovebird (small plates/tapas), and, not too far away found the best sorbet at a Chocolatier "A La Mere de Famille".  Had the restaurant "Le Moncey" on the nearby corner as well. On all subsequent days, the proprietor of that restaurant would greet us or waive as we walked by on our way to hotel - very kind as were all of folks we encountered in the neighborhood. Also, there is a charming cat that strolls through the B Montmartre courtyard in the evenings - very friendly - laid on my feet while I petted him.

title: Lovely oasis in Montmartre
text: Quiet, restful, charming and modern oasis in the heart of Montmartre. Perfect for a more updated and modern hotel experience that still feels authentic to paris and the Montmartre neighborhood. Even the breakfast was good as far as hotel food goes, and the service at the front desk was some of the most friendly I’ve experienced. Rooms were cozy, quiet and clean, and the garden is a great touch.

title: Very nice hotel in great location, small rooms
text:
Very well-kept and modern hotel, in a very nice location in Montmarte, easy to get around via Metro as there is a stop right near by. Nice cafes near by as well. Unfortunately, the rooms are just extremely small, with barely enough room for two of us to get ready at the same time in the morning. There was barely enough space to have both suitcases out at the same time.

Customer service was phenomenal, Emmanuel fulfilled all of our requests nicely and the staff was extremely kind and helpful on arrival. Again, it was very clean and modern, just very small rooms.

title: Wonderful Experience
text:
While staying for a week in London with my wife, daughter and son-in-law, and two grandchildren, we decided to take a side trip to Paris for one night. We booked two rooms at the Montmartre Hotel. We could not have been more satisfied. The setting in the heart of Montmartre is ideal for eating and drinking in small outdoor cafes, walking to sites in the area such as the Basilica of Sacré Coeur, and is convenient for catching mass transit to other parts of the city. The hotel has very modern and clean rooms and a courtyard that is like a quiet oasis in the middle of a busy neighborhood.

But, the most impressive feature of the hotel is the staff! They went above and beyond our expectations in terms of assisting us with every aspect of our stay. They were friendly, knowledgeable, and professional; better than any concierge service we have ever encountered in a  hotel in previous European trips. I would highly recommend this hotel to any travelers to Paris.

title: If you want to be in the Montmartre area, I highly suggest staying at B Montmartre Hotel.
text: The room was very nice and just as expected from the pictures. The location was also great. The staff was perfect! They run the hotel like a family and want to make sure every guest has the best experience possible. If I'm in the area again this will be my first choice hotel.

title: Five days in Paris
text:
B-Montmartre is a very beautiful hotel, near to many restaurant in the Montmartre zone and close to   underground and markets. Our room was clean and modern, superior room big enough for three person,  the staff really kind and responsive.
We recommend this hotel, and we will book this hotel again for our next visit in Paris.

title: Overall Great Value
text:
We stayed here for 4 nights and had a great stay overall.  The room was spacious and hotel staff was nice.  The location was within 3 minutes walking to the metro and several bike/scooter pickup/drop off locations.  There are also many amazing restaurants and cafes within walking distance.

The only issue we had was with our sink.  They have this new technology sink where you press a button to turn it on and off.  During one night, the sink would turn on in the middle of the night and we'd have to wake up to turn it off.  We left to explore the next morning around 10am.  When we returned at 7pm, the sink would not turn on.  They were unable to fix it and had no available rooms so we had to do all our sink activities in the shower.

title: Absolute delight
text: This hotel and its staff are absolute gems. From Emmanuel, to Ruben and the beautiful ladies that handle the breakfast, I would love to say thank you and see you very soon. Not many places truly make you feel at home and this hotel does. Its in a prime location and a short stroll to all the attractions if you don't mind exploring on foot, which I highly recommend, allowing you to see so much more. I would recommend anyone to stay here.

title: Fabulous stay!
text: This is an absolutely wonderful hotel with the very best staff. The location is awesome too. We will definitely stay at this place for all return trips to Paris and will recommend it to friends and family.

title: Amazing Super Friendly Staff, Great Location
text: This hotel is a hidden gem at a great location with walking distance to many restaurants in the Montartre area.  It's very quiet, and with peaceful garden in the back, and the rooms were clean and modern, and the beds comfortable. The best thing was the staff though. They were absolutely amazing.

title: Amazing Location & Staff
text:
We had the best time in Paris and it was largely thanks to our hotel choice. The location was very good and we felt like it was not too crowded with tourists which let us feel like we are having an authentic experience with lots of things to do.
The staff were SUPER informative and kind, and helped us with any question we had.
Thanks a lot!

title: very good hotel

title: Wonderful place. Highly recommended!
text: Excellent location, nice and responsive staff, fancy rooms with nice interior. Highly recommend staying in a room with a balcony. Amazing view and the atmosphere is guaranteed. To recap it's the right choice to stay.

title: Excellent experience

title: A fun girly trip
text: Hotel was down a cute little street, staff were friendly - let us check in early. We was very happy with the room! Given extra bottles of water when asked. Was clean and chic - would stay at this location again.

title: Great Stay for Paris
text:

Everything was good from our excellent concierge Ahmand to the clean room.
We stayed 3 Nights and would like to say thanks to the friendly staff.
Next time we might take a room facing the garden and book with breakfast.
We will try to come back soon .

title: Excellent service. A great choice.
text: Very nice hotel with very attentive service. Very comfortable rooms although the one we stayed in was a little bit dark. Very comfortable beds and high quality linen. Excellent service and very convenient location.

title: Calm, clean & great service
text: We stayed 4 days. The bed is great, rooms are clean and quiet at night. The size of a room was quite small, but had all we needed. Delicious breakfast in a cozy garden. Close to Montmartre, we took bicycles to experience the whole Paris.

title: I didn't want to leave
text: This is a must stay if visiting Paris. room was very generous in size and fit out. The bathroom was large and really well equipped. Staff were number 1. And the bonus garden that I did not expect was the cream to top it off. Although it's right in the middle of the city, you'd swear you were in suburbia that's how quiet it was. This will be my go to hotel the next time I visit Paris.

title: Fantastic hotel in brilliant location
text: Hotel staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming and helpful. The hotel is located in a perfect place for getting in and out of the city and is very clean. It’s in very good proximity to excellent bars and restaurants; as well as the metro.

title: Good location and lovely hotel
text: Booked this hotel for a last minute trip to Paris for my mums 60th. The Hotel is lovely and a good location. Near lots of food places and the street beside it is nice and lively great atmosphere. Near the metro also and bus stand. Not far from there city centre which is also great. The hotel is nice and clean. Modern vibe to it and has a lovely garden to have tea and breakfast in. Staff are lovely and friendly!

title: Wonderful stay at B Montmartre Hotel
text: This is a wonderful hotel with the nicest staff. They helped us with everything. Arranging a second bed in the room, advice for close-by restaurants, suitcases. I just love this place. Good for business traveler and holiday makers alike.

title: Elegance and luxury at it’s best
text: I can’t say enough good things about this hotel! The accommodations were luxurious. The location was perfectly situated away from busy streets and conveniently located by the metro. The room size met our American standard (we had a suit). But what takes this hotel over the top is the staff! Emmanuel and Ruben were absolutely amazing! They gave us directions, recommendations and even added extra  mattress cover on the bed. I would recommend this hotel to everyone and anyone who asks,

title: Wonderful Hotel
text:
Our family of 5 had a wonderful stay here! Our rooms were clean and as spacious as an European hotel can be. The bathroom was also clean with great amenities-heated towel holder, heated floor, heated bidet, and waterfall shower head. Each day our rooms with cleaned and bottled water was left to put in our mini frig.
Everyone at the hotel was helpful, polite, friendly, and spoke perfect English and let me speak my limited French with patience. The front desk helped with getting taxis and dinner reservations, and all question we had. The breakfast each morning was a nice way to start the day with eggs, bacon, juice, coffee, meats and cheese, cereal, bread and croissants available. 
Our favorite part of the hotel is the beautiful courtyard, where we could eat breakfast, enjoy afternoon drink, or sit and read or play cards with our family. It was a welcomed oasis from the busy street of Paris that were feet away, but quiet as could be in the courtyard.
The hotel is steps away from restaurants, bakeries, supermarket, a short walk to the lively neighborhood of Montmarte. I do not hesitate to recommend this hotel and it's wonderful staff.

title: Our favorite in Paris
text: Always a pleasure to come to B Montmartre.  Welcoming friends and exceptional service.  The surrounding cafes and bars are great and sitting outside in the courtyard of the hotel is a relaxing experience.  We will be back and highly recommend this hotel in Paris.

text: Ideal hotel within Paris. Lovely, lush garden courtyard in which to eat breakfast or enjoy a drink in the evening. After a long day exploring busy Paris, it felt like a tropical escape to have that green outdoor space. Very clean rooms. The most comfortable of the beds we slept in in France. Nice showers. Very friendly staff. Tasteful decor. Nearby metro station.

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text: Just returned from a short stay at the B Montmartre. We booked last minute and despite multiple trips to Paris I was not familiar with Montmartre. Well we lucked out! What a lovely hotel! This is a small hotel with a beautiful courtyard filled with palms (in Paris!) and other foliage - what a respite from the noisiness of the city. Every room (and we had three different rooms) was modern, elegant, and extremely clean with crisp, high-end sheets. Breakfast was better than the five star hotel we stayed at in March! But what really stood out was how kind and helpful each person who works there is. They went out of their way to assist us and even checked that we got to our train on time once we left. This hotel is a small gem in a city full of great hotels (and not so great hotels!) The neighborhood is full of little restaurants and cafes and one gets much more of a feeling for how life in Paris is for the locales. Thank you B Montmartre!

title: Fabulous little hidden gem in Montmartre
text: We stayed for several nights in this hotel. Cozy and cute, it has a wonderful Paris vibe. The rooms are a little small, but the friendly staff and wonderful breakfast certainly make up for this. Enjoyed the restaurant recommendations from the staff.

title: Clean, quiet, lovely and GREAT staff!
text: Lovely accommodations in the heart of Paris - easy access to the Metro makes it great base to explore.  impeccable rooms, well maintained, but the best part is the amazing staff.  They really make the stay in Paris perfect.

title: Excellent Stay in Montmartre
text: The hotel was comfortable, good location for walking and metro and staff was friendly, exceedingly helpful (dinner reservations, taxi, recommendations). The tables in garden area and wine bar were perfect for after a full day of touring in busy Paris. So quiet. Comfortable bed very clean. I can’t remember all staff names but Patricia was outstanding

title: Wonderful hotel!
text: We loved our stay at B Montmarte and I was particularly impressed by the very friendly and helpful staff, and our lovely balcony room. I would thoroughly recommend this hotel in the bustling Clichy neighborhood of paris to fellow travelers

title: friendly staff, good location
text: the hotel staff is very friendly and helpful, there are many good restaurants nearby which is a plus. the hotel staff will help to book a table in the restaurants. Bath room is modern and comfortable as well. Overall very good experiences.

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: The Hotel is really nice. Stuff are all friendly. Tge rooms are nice and clean. They have a really nice terrasse with a fantastic garden. The breakfast was very good and they had lots of food. We are from Luxembourg and the owner is also from Luxembourg and very friendly. The metro station is very close to the Hotel.

title: Basa family stay
text: The location is perfect with a nice garden patio for a quiet retreat.  The room we stayed in is clean and loved your toilet.  Great breakfast.  Warm and courteous staff.  Special mention to Alicia, Hashim, Amar and Sergio.  We'll definitely stay again.  Thank you.

title: Excellent hotel with great staff
text: Located central. Quiet rooms with very comfy bed. The staff is kind and thoughtful. Beautiful courtyard garden. Love the fact that the keys are handed in when leaving the premises (no chance losing keys). Will definitely book here again when in Paris.

title: Wonderful hotel with friendly and helpful staff
text: We had a wonderful stay at the B Montmartre hotel. Our room was comfortable, clean, and had a really pretty view! We stayed in the room with the hamam on the top floor, and it felt luxurious! The staff was so kind and helpful, and they recognized us over the course of our stay. The hotel is conveniently located near the Place de Clichy metro stop, and we made great use of the metro to get around Paris. I highly recommend this hotel. The only downside is that they didn't tell us that there was an included breakfast, but I guess this was probably just an oversight.

title: Over achieved expectations!
text: I was very satisfied with our visit on b montmadre. The staff is very helpful and professional. Also the location is super! Rooms are not very big but clean, cosy and fresh! I would highly recommend this hotel

title: Great place to stay!
text:
My husband and I were here for four nights in May 2022.  Super nice and very helpful staff - they were very accommodating and professional assisting with tours, restaurants, etc.

The location is good, close to the Place de Clichy metro stop. There are restaurants, pharmacies, and small markets nearby. Everything is within easy walking distance. Be advised that the hotel is in a busy traffic area so there is road noise. Request a room on the back side of the hotel over the garden/patio and you should be fine.

The room was clean, well appointed and comfortable. There was a small fridge as well as a safe for valuables. The rooms and bathrooms are small in Paris as space is at a premium. There is an elevator. 

The breakfast layout was great. A comfortable cafe setting, beautiful buffet with lots of choices including fresh pastries and coffee made to order.  They serve drinks and small plates in the afternoon evening if you need something light.

Would definitely stay here again.

title: TOP OF OUR LIST!
text: After spending a month in Europe, B Montmarte was the PERFECT spot to stay in Paris!  The hotel itself is just the right size.  The beds are amazing (yes, we had slept in a lot of beds during the month) and the location is perfect!  Close to Sacre Ceour, Moulin Rouge and charming neighborhoods and the Metro as well! The garden is gorgeous and a nice quiet spot to end the day with a glass of wine or cocktail after a day of sightseeing.  And the breakfast was amazing as well!  All that said, the staff makes you feel so welcome and knows how to pamper you like royalty!  Big shout out to Hashim and Rubem who couldn't have been any more helpful and pleasant!  Don't miss this gem in Paris!  Thank you B Montmarte to the perfect end to our holiday!

title: Amazing experience!
text: Very nice everything! The hotel was exactly what I was expected! I recommend it for short or long visits in Paris! For sure I will be back soon and stay for a longer period! Thanks again for all the support!

title: Great little hotel
text:
Stayed here for a two night break and was very impressed. Everything was very clean. And the staff could not have been better. Very friendly and accommodating.
We would definitely return when in Paris again.

title: Great hidden gem boutique hotel
text: This is an outstanding boutique hotel.  The rooms are very lovely and spotlessly clean.  The beds are very comfortable.  There is a small courtyard on the ground floor and a restaurant where breakfast was served but we did not have time to use these.  The staff are outstanding and helpful.  I really recommend this hotel and will stay here next time we are in Paris.

title: Charming, Convenient Yet Off the Beaten Path
text: Clean, well appointed rooms, outstanding staff and excellent service. I will return to this hotel without a doubt! The neighborhood is more residential, a refreshing break from the usual touristy parts of Paris.

title: Very good service and very calm! Perfect location for trip to Paris!
text: Very good service! Nice rooms and very calm! Very nice garden with Palms and fliers.Close to Moulin Rouge and a couple of good restaurants e.g. Strobi and a wine bars. Little Italy at Place Clichy not to be recommended.

title: Excellent hotel - Great people
text:
All the staff were smiling and always willing to serve us. Breakfast is excellent. I traveled with my daughter
which on the second day the crepes were over and immediately the lady at the bar went to the kitchen and made it for her. Great location. The neighborhood was artistic and had many restaurants with cuisines from around the world, small bars and cafes but also very quiet.
best of all of course the excellent garden where we took our breakfast
perfect hotel but also great people
thank you very much b-monmartre team!!

title: B Montmartre Hotel - 5 nights
text: Small, very clean, quiet, confortable room No. 12 - shower, every day clean towels, hairdryer, TV, aircondition. The hotel provides excellent services and has a convenient location - subway, restaurants, sights, shopping.

title: Hidden Gem in Paris
text: Location, staff and interiors were amazing! Couldn't fault the hotel staff who were really welcoming and helpful throughout our stay.  Perfect base location for exploring Paris with the metro 2 mins away and a short walk to vibrant Pigalle and Montmartre. And the hotel garden is a hidden gem for a chilled drink amongst the busy Paris lifestyle.

title: A fantastically helpful and lovely stuff!
text: It’s a small but absolutely lovely hotel in a great location! Everything was just really excellently done, very clean, with lots of attention to guests. The stuff is super friendly and helpful! Loved the stay!

title: Fabulous
text:
Stayed for four nights on a City break to Paris. This is a gem of a boutique hotel. Rooms are cosy, immaculately clean, nicely decorated, bed linen and towels are crisp and white, in short beautiful. Slippers and bathrobes, mini bar, hairdryer, TV and safe. Beds are so comfortable and the hotel is quiet, we slept like babies. We didn't include breakfast in the stay, but paid €15 each on 2 mornings and there was something for everyone with a good selection and we enjoyed it. There's a small courtyard garden which is lovely to sit in for breakfast.
The staff here are exceptional. Warm, welcoming and friendly and highly efficient and professional. The front desk is 24hr and they go over and above to make your stay the best experience ever. Whether it's advice on places to eat, routes to tourist attractions, taxis or booking tickets for shows they are amazing!
Location of the hotel is ideal, not right in the middle of everything, but only a bus or metro away . No.30 bus around the corner (be sure to buy tickets at the Metro station prior to your journey) takes you most places, or catch the metro at Place de Clichy (2 min walk away)to almost anywhere. 10min walk to Moulin Rouge and nightlife. Lots of places to eat round about.
Love this hotel and would stay again in a heartbeat.

title: Great Hotel
text: a very nice hotel, perfect location with many restaurants around. Very nice inner courtyard, breakfast that leaves nothing to be desired. Comfortable bed, nice room, great bathroom, everything is clean and everyone is very friendly.

title: Great place, great location and great staff.
text: The title says it all. B Montmartre hotel was everything we had hoped for. The staff were very accommodating and helped us sort out the initial hiccup we had. The rooms were as advertised and beautiful. The breakfast buffet was wonderful. The staff really make the stay comfortable and relaxing

title: Decent Hotel
text: There are some things to like about this hotel. It's close to a store. Not far from the subway. Staff was welcoming and responsive. Our bed was comfortable. We had a rooftop room. The view made you feel less closed in than many Paris hotels. In a safe area. Nice garden area for warm days. They didn't have a good sitting set up in the room--hard chair with no back. Also be aware beside the Sacre Coure and other things in Montmartre other tourist things generally are 20 minutes to a half hour away. No warm eggs for breakfast--so most days we would go around the corner to a boulangerie. So though it is a nice hotel I prefer to stay closer to the Louvre.

title: Wonderful stay in Paris at a great hotel
text: We cannot say enough about how helpful and friendly the hotel staff is. They went out of their way to help us get tickets to Versailles when we were unable to do it online. We always got greeted with a smile each time we entered the lobby. They made a great time in Paris even better!

title: Very good

title: High quality comfortable hotel with friendly staff in the centre of Montmartre
text: High quality comfortable hotel with friendly staff in the centre of Montmartre. Rooms are excellent. We had the room on the top floor with balcony, and our friends had the room adjacent to the lush courtyard garden - both were perfect and the breakfast is excellent too.

title: C'est magnifique!!!
text: What a wonderful experience! First time in Paris, and this delightful hotel made it all even better - beautiful, comfortable, clean, great service (at a time when that can be understandably challenging). Wonderful location for walking and other transportation. And we always felt like we were in good hands. Thanks to the staff at the B Montmarte! I will recommend to everyone

title: Exceptional Hotel in perfect location

Lots of variety, delicious cheese, meats, fruits and of course a selection of several breads and croissants. We could not have asked for a more perfect stay.

title: Above expectations

title: Long weekend stay
text: The service was excellent, really friendly and helpful reception staff. The rooms were very comfortable with all amenities required. Location was central in close proximity to the metro. Overall could not recommend this hotel enough!

title: Absolutely Wonderful!

The staff was absolutely phenomenal, they were attentive, very professional, and went out of their way to make us feel special. The rooms are a bit small but they are very calming and relaxing. We could sleep the entire day! Loved the breakfast offering and general ambiance of this amazing hotel.

title: Excellent hotel

Excellent hotel at a great location. Very friendly staff, great service and very clean. 
The breakfast is fresh and also there very friendly staff. A modern hotel with a Parisian feeling. Also a very beautiful room with space and a big balcony. We are very happy to have chosen this hotel and will recommend this to our friends and family. Thank you for everything!

title: Nice boutique hotel with perfect location
text: Extremely friendly and helpful staff. Helped us with booking table for dinner which would have been much harder to do on a busy weekend without French skills. Room was very clean and bed confortable. Breakfast was also excellent!

title: Fantastic Hotel

title: Very nice!

title: Long weeks in Paris

title: A very pleasant stay in a friendly boutique hotel located in a great location
text:
Liked: The staff at the hotel are really friendly and we enjoyed relaxing in the quiet bar (which was not overpriced) leading to an oasis of a garden. Our double bedroom at the back of the hotel on the third floor was quiet, the ability to open windows and let in fresh air was a real bonus. The towels were fluffy and smelt really nice. Housekeeping was excellent. Very comfy beds.

The location - Place de Clichy metro stop 2 min walk and major sites easily accessible on the metro in 5-10 mins but it was Montmartre and its relaxed vibe that we enjoyed coming back to. Every evening meal was a treat and so many great restaurants to choose from, we went in April so just booked restaurants we stumbled upon and liked the look of.

Disliked · Even though the hotel is on a side street it is not quiet at the front - could not open the windows of the fourth floor bedroom at the front because of the noise throughout the night and then the bin collections/deliveries early morning. Would recommend a bedroom at the back of the hotel or ear plugs.

title: Montmartre
text: Second time we have been here, really nice hotel in a good location, just a minutes walk from the Place de Clichy metro station. Good breakfast and comfy bed. Staff are very pleasant and helpful. Some nice restaurants and bars close by as well.

title: Friendly staff who are so helpful, welcoming and very knowledgeable. Their recommendations made our trip!
text:
Firstly the location was brilliant, transportation around was so easy. 

Staff were exceptional, so friendly and welcoming. They really went above and beyond, their recommendations really made our trip memorable. Cannot thank them enough. 

Hotel was clean, and the bed was very comfortable. Lovely views from our window of street. 

Would highly recommend, and will be returning to this hotel if ever back in Paris.

title: Excellent hotel
text: Could not recommend this hotel more. Gorgeous hotel close to the Centre, staff went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable. All staff were so friendly and so helpful really made us feel so welcome. Walking distance to most places with Metro right beside. Fabulous clean rooms, Amazing hotel!

title: Excellent Hotel - to stay in !
text: Excellent location to stay in Paris, lively area with good access to local transport systems. Hotel was comfortable, clean and the staff on the front desk were very helpful and nothing was a problem. Highly recommend.

title: nice hotel which needs to maintain its standards...
text: This is the second time we stay at B Montmartre, but this time, it felt as if the hotel had changed management because the bed was uncomfortable, the bathroom door did not close, the safe box did not work, etc. It is a shame because it is clean, has nice staff and overall it is a nice hotel.

title: Our 2 year anniversary
text: We stayed in this hotel for our 2 year anniversary and it was amazing, the hotel was in a great location right in the heart of Paris. Breakfast was great and they were very accommodating, would definitely stay again!

title: Very friendly staff
text: Nice, quiet hotel near the Place de Clichy. Exceptionally friendly staff, especially when I got ill on the second night of our stay. Thank you very much. So we hope to return to Paris another time and will definitely stay here again!

title: perfect location, staff friendly, great breakfast
text: We stayed at Hotel Balmoral for 6 nights. It’s right around the corner from the Arc and in a quiet neighborhood with great bistros and a little market across the street. Room was very comfortable and the value of the room exceeded our expectations. Staff was extremely helpful with any request we had. The complementary breakfast spread was extremely good, exceed my expectations on that. I would stay there again!
description: Hotel Balmoral is located just 100 meters from Place de l'Etoile, and sits in a quiet road in the very heart of Paris. It provides a maximum of luxury and comfort, in a refined setting, emblematic of the French capital. text: We celebrated our 20 year anniversary here and was fortunate to stay 4 nights and on the 41 degree days, thankfully we had air conditioning. We were upgraded to the suite, a beautiful room, we had everything we needed and couldn’t fault the room.  The bed was so comfortable and king size. Loved the old fashion lift. The breakfasts each day was delicious, the man who looked after breakfast was very attentive and nothing was a problem for him, and the Nutella donuts were soooo good. The only thing wrong was there was no air conditioning in the breakfast room. I asked if it could be turned on but he said he’d open the front door.  The people behind the front desk were lovely and very helpful. We could even leave our suitcases there for the day before getting the train to London.  Highly recommend staying here as so close to metro and Arc de Triumph.

title: Fantastique!
text: Hotel Balmoral was amazing! We stayed for 2 nights as a short city break from the UK and we loved this hotel. Location is great, minutes away from arc de triomphe with lots of restaurants close by but it’s not crowded and on a lovely peaceful street away from all the crowds. Metro is also within easy reach just a few minutes walk away. We booked a superior room which was so clean and ample space for 2 people. Bathroom was huge with a lovely bath and shower. The bed was super comfy which was needed after a busy day exploring Paris. Breakfast at the hotel was lovely - pastries, fresh coffee, meats, cheeses, salmon, fresh bread and juice. There’s a cute little courtyard you can sit in too. Best of all about Hotel Balmoral was the staff - so friendly, helpful, smiley and made us feel so welcome. We will be back again and I can’t recommend this hotel enough. If you’re thinking of booking do it! You won’t be disappointed. Thank you Hotel Balmoral for making our stay in Paris wonderful!

text:
I’ve visited Paris many times but this was my first stay in Hotel Balmoral. It is now my home from home in Paris. I had a balcony suite with my teenage grandson and it was just perfect. title: Wonderful stay at the Hotel Balmorral
text:
We have just returned from a short family break in Paris and stayed at the  Hotel Balmoral on Rue du General Lanrezac. The hotel is in a fantastic location, very close to the Arc de Triomphe, Avenue des Champs-Élysées and the nearest metro station - Charles de Gaulle–Étoile is only a few minutes walk away.

The hotel deserves all the very positive reviews posted here on Tripadvisor. All of the staff we encountered were very welcoming and professional and went above and beyond to ensure we had a very enjoyable stay and positive impression of the hotel.

We reserved a Prestige  apartment which was very well appointed for our family of 5 and equipped with everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay. I particularly enjoyed the Cafés Richard espresso machine and delicious coffee.  

The hotel does not have a restaurant but there are plenty of great restaurants in the neighbourhood, so not a problem.  The hotel does provide breakfast with a wide variety to choose from including delicious French breads, pastries, crepes, scrambled eggs, sausages, cheeses, and juices. 

All in all a wonderful stay at the Hotel Balmoral. This is not an impersonal large international hotel chain. If you are looking for a unique French family run hotel which gives you a truly Parisian experience, great service and excellent location then I highly recommend the Hotel Balmoral. Looking forward to my next visit.

title: First in Its Class
text:
In late May I had another memorable stay in this hotel after a hiatus of two years, thanks to the pandemic. There was absolutely no deterioration in either the upkeep of the facilities or in the quality of service. Hotel Balmoral is an excellent choice for travelers who want to be close to major attractions and the metro but not to the noise that often accompanies them. It is also a superb home base for persons recovering from jet lag and all the stress that air travel brings these days.

In the end, what really makes this hotel is its  staff.  Anne Claire (sorry, I do not know her last name), who directs the reception area, is outstanding—- attentive to guests and their needs but not intrusive, knowledgeable about everything in the hotel, quick to recognize a problem (even if it’s a taxi cab) and even quicker to fix it. As someone who hired people for customer service, I would not only hire her in a heartbeat, I would give her a bonus! The same thing goes for the gentleman in charge of the breakfast room who also performs other functions later in the day. I do not know his name at all but he stands out for his kindness and his ability to help others. He and and Claire are quite a team and this is much more than a fou- star hotel!

text:
We stayed at the Hotel Balmoral, Paris last week. It’s a relatively small hotel with maybe 50 rooms over 6 floors, and was just perfect for us. 
The front of house staff were really pleasant, greeted us, took our cases as we were a little early to check in, and advised us of somewhere with a lovely view of the very close Arc de Triumph to have a drink. 
Our room was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed plus a welcoming half bottle of wine and some macarons. We slept well as the street was nice and quiet. 
We used the hotel’s electric bikes for a few hours one morning which were excellent and we covered 12 miles cycling around the city. 
Breakfasts were great and plenty of choice. Hot and cold buffet. 
The location suited us. Near the Arc de T, and really handy for a metro station. 
We’re looking forward to going back someday.

She ensured that my requests were met. This was a nice touch and not something I've experienced before having visited Paris on many occasions. 
The hotel room was comfortable and tastefully decorated...amazingly comfortable bed! Breakfast was included in the room rate and was very good as well. In terms of the location, the hotel is situated less than two minutes walk from the Arc De Triomphe - Fantastic. 
My friends and I had a wonderful stay and I must say that the staff at Hotel Balmoral went over and beyond for us. I would highly recommend staying here.
description: Hotel Balmoral is located just 100 meters from Place de l'Etoile, and sits in a quiet road in the very heart of Paris. It provides a maximum of luxury and comfort, in a refined setting, emblematic of the French capital. Its geographical situation is ideal, near monuments such as the Eiffel Tower, the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees. It is easy to get to airports, thanks to the proximity of the Air France coach terminal and the RER line to La Defense. At walking distance from the boutiques of Faubourg Saint-Honore, theaters and the Palais des Congres, it is the perfect spot for your stays in Paris. Family run hotel, our team is dedicated to your comfort, safety and pleasure. Welcome at Balmoral Paris !

title: 11 nights in April-May 2022
text: This is a well-located, expertly managed, always helpful, and friendly property. Our room was quiet, larger than many equivalent hotels we have stayed at in Paris, and was furnished and serviced to meet all of our needs. The breakfast buffet (included) was excellent and was always served with a smile. We would recommend the Balmoral unconditionally.

title: Beautiful and stylish hotel with an amazing staff
text: Spent six nights here in a Superior Double room.  The room was clean, bright and comfortable with room for storage and the bathroom was quite large.  Highly recommend their breakfast which had a good assortment and strong coffee. There is a bar and an outdoor courtyard for relaxing as well. Christian and Anne Clair along with their fellow managers were extremely helpful and always ready with a smile. They are the heart and soul of the hotel. Ask Anne Clair about champagne, she is an expert. The hotel could not be more convenient to the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees. A plethora of wonderful restaurants in walking distance. Stop searching and book here. You will not regret it.

Perfectly situated in the 17th, 2 minutes from the Arc de Triomphe.
The breakfast is so good with lots of French goodies!
The rooms are nicely renovated and very clean.
Thank you to everyone who works at the Balmoral for making our stay so nice!
Looking forward coming back soon, our favorite hotel in beautiful Paris.

title: Lovely hotel, really lovely staff in a fabulous city
text: We had a lovely time at the Hotel Balmoral. It's centrally located near the Arc de Triomphe, and Etoile Metro station. It was clean and very well appointed. We brought our two small children (6 and 4) who were made very welcome, as were we. The room (suite) was perfect for our needs. Lovely views from the small balcony, and the breakfast was varied, and tasty. Claire who was on reception most days (she works very hard) was very welcoming and warm, as were any of the other staff we met throughout. One gentleman waiter at breakfast kindly remembered our drinks / coffee preferences each morning. I would definitely recommend this place for families, or anyone really, wishing to visit Paris. Small things, and mostly the people, made it a memorable place to stay.

text: The hotel is very friendly and cosy, the employees are very supporting in each aspect. The breakfast is tasty, nice choice of sweet and sour delicates for everyone. The breakfast space is a nice place to spend time and chat in the morning. The coffee, croissants, pancakes and many other delicious proposals for breakfast make your day!!! Rooms are super clean and very cosy. The beds are very comfortable and big. We had a suite with a sleeping room and living room for our 2 kids where they slept. If we are back in Paris, this is our place to stay.
