title: Excellent location!
text: The room were very nice, and the bed was comfortable.  We would definitely stay here again.  Great area with walkable cafes and the Eifel   Tower is also in walking distance. The breakfast was reasonable and very good.

title: LOVED LOVED LOVED Cler Hotel
text: Lovely hotel on the most adorable street in Paris. The markets were wonderful to wake up to every morning - fresh fruits, meats, cheeses, chocolates, breads, pastries and restaurants...what a treat! We were 3 families that traveled from the US. The gentlemen who worked the desks were very helpful with organizing taxis (for a group of 7) on the days of our early adventures and helped with restaurant recommendations and even booking dinner plans for us. It was our first time in France - and EVERYTHING was simply wonderful. We absolutely LOVED staying at the hotel and the location was perfect!

title: Best Hotel in Paris!
text: Your hotel was absolutely delightful. For Americans arriving after a long, overnight flight, your reception was very accomodating, giving us an accurate time that our room would be ready, and offering to hold our luggage while we explored the Rue Cler neighborhood. Our room was spectacular! On the 6th floor (7th, for us Americans), the view was amazing! The Eiffel Tower dominated our view, and we spent many an evening watching the lights of the Tower, which never failed to dazzle. While small, the rest of the room was tastefully decorated, with all the amenities you could expect. The bed was very comfortable, and the bathroom was equally comfortable. The elevator made carrying our luggage up and down easy and quick. The breakfasts were delicious, with freshly scrambled eggs that were nice and fluffy. The coffee maching made our stay! We had all the options, and they all tasted great. Should we ever visit Paris again, the Cler Hotel will be my first choice!

title: Location, Location, Location!
text: The best part of staying at the Cler Hotel was staying on the Rue Cler, which is mostly filled with a long array of good, moderately priced bistros and their customers, plus a few stores for trinkets and even a supermarket. Almost no automotive traffic is allowed on the street.  It’s a 15-20 minute walk to the closest metro stations and a bit more to walk to the Eiffel Tower. Despite the busy street, the hotel itself was pretty quiet, even though we had a front view room on the same level as the front desk/concierge/breakfast area.  The room’s view of the street was limited due to the open awnings of all the businesses on the street.   There was a small quiet garden in the back of the hotel, which we enjoyed using almost every day in the early evening. The concierge was pretty good and very helpful  with taxis.  The room we had, however, was really rather small, about the size of very small hotel rooms in New York City’s Time Square, if you’ve ever been there.

title: Rue Cler and Cler Hotel FABULOUS!
text: We visited Paris and stayed in Rue Cler which was a fabulous neighborhood and location. So many local food choices and people were quite friendly. We stayed our entire stay at the Cler Hotel and so happy we did. Suqit (front desk mng) was beyond helpful for me - he truly went out of his way to assist me in buying train tickets to Nantes to drop off daughter at college, and giving many recommendations.. he was the best. The hotel was very clean, breakfast every morning was very good. The rooms are small, but honestly how much time do you spend if the room. AC was a bonus. Would highly recommend Cler hotel!!

title: You won't go wrong staying here.
text: A perfect location, super helpful staff, good air conditioning, nice bathrooms, clean, comfortable, affordable.  It's quiet and yet close to so many sites. We loved all the shops and restaurants nearby. A good value.

title: Disappointing
text: Sharp looking lobby in nice location  but for the money ($400+) a  tiny room (even by Paris standards). Would have expected complimentary bottled water (standard in most boutique hotels) and linens changed every day; not every 3 days  Disappointing.

title: A Jewel on Rue Cler
text: What a find! This recently remodeled hotel in the heart of Rue Cler has everything one needs for a delightful stay in Paris. Walk out its front door and restaurants, flower shops, confectionaries, etc. greet you. Located close to several metro stops, the hotel is also less than a ten minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. The rooms are efficiently compact and are air conditioned. While breakfast doesn't come with the room price, breakfast can be purchased on site and is served in a cozy room near the front desk...very convenient when you want to get an early start on a busy day.

title: Wonderful hotel
text: What a great find this hotel is.  This location and street is one of the coolest in Paris.  We loved just walking up and down the street as it had everything.  You can walk to the Eiffel Tower and numerous other sights.  Local restaurants were great.  The service was great and the room was very clean.  The rooms are small but worth it for the location.

title: Great location to stay
text: We loved staying at the Cler hotel. Our room was very clean and the staff were very welcoming. The hotel is located on a very nice street with many cafes, markets and nice restaurants. Would definitely recommend!

title: Great place in a quaint location
text: Such a quaint place with wonderful service…  we are here currently and I can’t say enough about this lovely little place!   It’s close to everything and has wonderful shops and cafes all along the cobble stone streets.   I would recommend this hotel 100%

title: Dangerous disrepair and no compensation
text: The glass shower door broke from the hinge on day 2, and stuck open, blocking the bathroom.  There was 1 other room available, with a view, and they refused to move us there.  They stated that we had to take the elevator down 3 levels to the basement to the bathroom with a shower that stated, do not use, under repair, and a toilet, if we wanted to shower or use the toilet.  They refused to give any kind of discount for this.  The breakfast was stale and the fruit was from a can, or at least 5 days old.  Skip this place altogether.  It is not worth the risk.  The location was nice.  The bed is comfortable, but the management and customer care, and service were horrendous to the point of being dangerous.

title: Best for foodies
text: We loved our stay in the hotel. The reception was warm and helpful. The room was small but very clean and functional. The little garden was a great place for a quick break. It has nice trees and plants to provide a cool shade. We mostly loved the street the hotel was on. The supermarket next to it has great selection of fresh fruits. The seafood market on the other side provides delicious pre-made seafood salad, mussels, and other dishes. You can buy small boxes of a few selections and bring them as picnic when you go to gardens or seine river banks. There are many restaurants, food stands, pubs, bakeries, chocolate shops, cheese and wine shops on the street. It’s so convenient. We also loved that it’s so close to the Eiffel Tower. We could easily go to the tower after the lights are on. Eiffel Tower looks magic with the lights on.

title: Family vacation in Paris - excellent location!
text: We recently visited Paris with our teenage daughter and stayed in the triple room at Cler Hotel.  The location was amazing!  The entry is directly on Rue Cler, right in the middle of all the cute shops and on a part of the street where cars are not permitted, but still only about 50 feet from Rue de Grenelle where you can pickup an Uber.  The three of us fit comfortably - there was a double bed for us and a single bed for our daughter.  We were in Paris during the July heatwave and the air conditioning worked like a charm.  The room was clean and the staff were very helpful.

title: Wonderful stay for our family of three.
text: Excellent hotel and location. We were in the triple and it was just right for two adults and a child.  Beds are comfy and clean. Everything is clean. Breakfast is better than other hotels. Staff is friendly and helpful. Delicious fruit and vegetable market right next to hotel.

title: Amazing Hotel!
text: We stayed at the Cler Hotel for four nights.  The hotel was wonderful! Modern rooms are perfect size and complete with a comfortable bed, rain shower, kettle, and great air conditioning. It was 40C during our stay in Paris, but the room remained a cool 21C the entire time. The hotel staff was friendly and spoke English. The breakfast was a great value and delicious. On top of the wonderful amenities and staff, this hotel is in a prime location. We had a variety of cafes to choose from each evening, all within a 5 minute walk. The hotel is also very close to the Eiffel Tower. Would absolutely stay here again on our next trip to Paris.

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Lovely hotel. Excellent location, walking distance to Eifel Tower. Also it is located on an area with tons of restaurants and shops. Metro station is very close as well. Super friendly and attentive staff. Rooms are small but very clean. Overall very nice hotel. We will stay there again if we ever comeback to Paris.

title: Perfect location in a delightful area
text: Hotel Cler is situated on a delightful pedestrian street full of little markets and cafes. It is within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and Les Invalides. Staff were so helpful, friendly, and happily spoke English.  The breakfast was outstanding (bacon!) and we were easily able to catch cabs from the corner.  Our room was tiny, but that was to be expected, and the bath was nicely updated.  Oh - there was an elevator and air conditioning, both of which were lacking in the countryside.  I'd gladly stay here again.

title: Excellent family experience
text: Excellent experience for our family of four, husband and I and two teenagers. The hotel is modern, clean, comfortable beds, lovely staff to acquaint you with the area and is a peaceful respite after busy touring days. The location is excellent, safe, on a charming street with everything you need: markets, shops, cafes, easy access to the metro, ATM, close to the Eiffel tower, and so many lovely restaurants I’ve lost count. The staff was friendly and helpful with city maps, transportation questions, etc. My family did not want to leave and fell in love with Paris in large part due to the great accommodations!

title: Lovely hotel in the perfect location!
text: We had a wonderful stay at the Cler Hotel last month! Perfect location on a beautiful cobblestone street filled with markets and cafes! We stayed in a triple room and even had a view of the top of the Eiffel Tower!! The hotel was very clean and quiet. Everyone there was very helpful and kind. We arrived early and they allowed us to store our luggage there until check in. We also enjoyed their yummy breakfast! I would highly recommend the Cler Hotel!

title: Loved Cler Hotel and This Area of Paris
text:
We decided to try this area of Paris for this trip after having listened to Rickey Steves mention the Cler area and decided to stay in the Cler Hotel. The location is excellent with numerous restaurants within walking distance. Breakfast at the hotel was quite good and the rooms very clean
The staff was very helpful throughout our stay from check in to departure and provided numerous suggestions for things to do in the area. The Eiffel Tower, Museum d' Orsay and Pullman Hotel (where we met our Palace of Versailles tour) all were in walking distance.
The sixth floor has one or two rooms with views of the Eiffel Tower. Although our room cost a bit more it was well worth it to watch the light display at the Eiffel Tower at night from our room. A delightful stay.

title: Thanks for the perfect first time in Paris, Hotel le Cler!
text: Perfect hotel for non-French speaking Americans! Staff were helpful, friendly, spoke good English and seemed to enjoy their jobs. Shout out to Shoujit in reception and Elsa in housekeeping! Answered all our questions, made us feel welcome. Beautiful location on a residential street- fresh fruit, bakery, cheese and chocolate all available right outside. And the flower store! Cafes and bustle by day, but sufficient noise-proofing for sleep at night.

title: Eiffel tower view from bed!
text: We got lucky and booked into room 605 with a view of the Eiffel tower, not only from the bed, but also the bathroom, lol.  I concur what others have said, quant boutique style hotel.  Extremely small elevator, fortunately glassed for the claustrophobic. Great location with a perfect slice of Paris out the front door.  The room is small, the bathroom is small (the shower is good size though) and the bed, while long, is very narrow. Smaller than a US queen. The staff is helpful, the rooms clean and the breakfast is delicious and a great start to your Paris day.

title: Cler Hotel in heart of Paris
text:
Hotel was very clean and staff were friendly. 
We were given only one key to the room. 
The lock would not work to open on the first try. We had to try it 5 or 6 times for it  to open. Only once during our 5 day stay we tried to take a shower and no hot water.

title: Great location, wonderful staff, clean room!
text: Fabulous hotel! The staff was always willing to answer our questions and make dinner as well we taxi reservations. The room was super clean (although a bit small) and the housekeeping staff did a wonderful job throughout our stay. We loved being on Rue Cler with the many cafes and shops. It was a great mix of a lively street while also being tucked away so it wasn’t as busy like some of the boulevards near the hotel.  I would highly recommend this wonderful hotel!

title: Nice little hotel in a great location!!
text: Very nice hotel in a great neighborhood!  Small rooms that are nicely appointed, very well laid out and super clean!! The breakfast is served in a lovely courtyard setting with a nice selection to choose from.  Very  friendly and helpful staff!!

title: Perfect stay for mother/daughter trip
text: Hotel Cler is a wonderful little hotel located on a beautiful, mostly pedestrian street with lots of markets and cafés.  The staff were all very accommodating and spoke English, though they, graciously, allowed us to practice our French before jumping in to save us with their English.  The rooms are small (it is Paris, afterall), but had everything we needed.  It was the perfect location for our mother-daughter stay in Paris.

title: Wonderful stay
text: Lovely place!  The room was small but spotless and superbly equipped. Excellent lighting and amenities. Great linens and wonderful water pressure in the shower. Fast internet. Breakfast buffet plentiful and varied. Staff delightful. Book it!  You won't be disappointed.

title: Location, Location, Location!
text:
We loved the Cler Hotel for its location near the Eiffel Tower and Seine River. It was a lot of fun being on Rue Cler with all its speciality stores: one selling beautiful fish, one selling chocolate, one selling bread and pastries, etc. We also enjoyed the many cafes right outside our front door. 

The room was tiny and the elevator even smaller but we managed. We would have preferred a slightly bigger space.

The staff were very nice and helpful, especially with providing metro directions. 

All in all, it was a wonderful 4 nights in the City of Light and we would recommend this lovely little hotel if you can manage with a small space.

title: Wonderful modern and clean boutique hotel on a cozy pedestrian street.
text:
Wonderful small modern boutique hotel located on a
cozy pedestrian street Rue Cler with many small shops, cafes and restaurants and with popular life during the day. Elevator and AC are available. We lived at the top of the courtyard and had a view of the rooftops and the Eiffel Tower. Very quiet in the room even though we had the windows open. In the morning we woke up to the song of the Blackbird. Very cozy! We supplemented our accommodation with breakfast which was good which we recommend. Close to walk to Champ de Mars and the Eiffel Tower about 10 min.

title: Great hotel, great location.
text: Hotel was clean and comfortable, staff was very friendly.  Good location in neighborhood with cafes and shops near the Eiffel Tower and not too far from Metro stop.  Only issue for older person is climbing into the bathtub.

title: Prime Paris Location and first-class accommodations and staff.
text:
Rue Cler is my favorite location, after many visits to Paris.  So happy I found freshly remodeled Cler Hotel.  Rooms good size, big showers, beds comfy and super clean.

We met several different staff members and all were fluent in English and so helpful.  Breakfast was best I've seen in Paris hotel.  Freshly scrambled eggs, sausage, cold meats and cheeses, many breads, juices and yogurt.

Now I am totally spoiled, and won't stay anywhere else in Paris!

title: Lovely Hotel - Great Location
text: Hotel location is in a great - lots of great cafes, fresh fruit and even a grocery store nearby.  Room was very nice, bathroom was roomy.  We were 3 and were a little tight, but that was to be expected in Europe. Glad there was an elevator, we were on the 5th floor.  Staff was very helpful.  We accidentally left a pair of sunglasses, they went over and beyond to ship them to us back home.

title: Very nice stay
text: Great location and clean room. Would use again. Nice breakfast with indoor or outdoor seating. 15 minutes walk to Eiffel Tower, River boat cruises or Metro station. Rue Cler has many eating choices. Includes small elevator to all floors.

title: Wonderful Stay!
text: This was our first trip to Paris. We had a wonderful stay at the Cler Hotel. The street is absolutely beautiful with lovely markets and shops. The hotel breakfast was delicious, and the rooms were clean and very nice. The staff was all so gracious and helpful–from accommodating us with taxi reservations, providing helpful guidance on touring and even mailing back a forgotten item to us in the United States! We will definitely be back! Thank you for a lovely vacation!

title: Perfect Locarion
text: Close to so many shops and restaurants. Love this location. Very clean. Helpful desk staff. Only issue is we couldn’t figure out how to shower as there was no shelf in the shower area to place soap and shampoo and razor. Had to place items on the floor of the shower.

title: 3 nights in Paris
text:
(Perspective from an early 40s couple) 

Well worth the money. Room accommodations were great given you are in Paris’ 7th neighborhood. Centrally located, The Cler Hotel is surrounded by all types of food located within a 1 minute walk of the Cler’s front door.

 Also, several of Paris’ main attractions are within a 30 minute walk. Taxis and public transit are easily accessible. 

The only draw back is the small (tiny) elevator. There is only 1 elevator for the entire place. We were there from 9-12 May and didn’t experience any difficulty taking the elevator to the forth floor. Additionally, the spiral staircase wasn’t really an issue going up or down. 

The staff was friendly and professional. Save money and buy the breakfast. For 12 Euro you won’t really beat it within walking distance. My wife and I will definitely stay at the Cler Hotel in the future.

title: Wow all in the view
text:
From e-mailing to check in very helpful with all my questions/ demands (hahaha)
Surprise trip for my wife’s birthday and booked the Effiel tower room with extras .
The room was exactly how I asked and her face when she saw the view was amazing. I would like to say a big thank you for helping make her birthday so special.
The room was small but then we only slept and showered there to much to see and do …

Again may thanks to all the people at the Cler Hotel next time in Paris we will definitely be back

title: Great hotel in a superb location
text:
My wife and I had a marvelous stay at the Cler Hotel. All of the staff we interacted with during our stay were helpful, friendly and professional.  In particular Idir went above and beyond in helping us.  

The location is ideally situated on the famed Rue Cler, near the Ecole Militaire metro station, an easy walk to the Champ de Mars, etc.  Needless to say, there are many fine eateries nearby. 

The rooms are small but comfortable. The rooms with a view of the Eiffel Tower are well worth the extra cost.  Breakfast is optional but is worth it if you wish to start the day with a nice breakfast buffet before heading out for the day’s activities. 

All in all, we may stay at the Cler Hotel for our next visit to Paris.  After all, a great hotel in a superb location with wonderful staff at a reasonable price for the 7th arrondissement is hard to find

title: Lovely Hotel
text:
7th time in Paris, and we have stayed somewhere different each time. Our first time at this hotel.  Loved it!  Great location, room was modern, nice and clean.  Bed was comfortable. We stayed in room 604, with a view of the Eiffel Tower.  The room was really small, but that's pretty normal for Europe.  It did have some good storage cubbies and so after traveling even for 10 days, we were able to get our belongings to fit in the room. The bathroom was a decent size with plenty of storage areas as well. The room also came with a mini-fridge, which for someone who has Celiac, it's nice to have to be able to have food items from grocery in the room. The hotel also has a nice elevator.  It is small, but does the job. It is glass, so you don't feel so enclosed or claustrophobic. Staying on the 6th floor, we did take advantage of it.
Again, the location is really great. Everyone at the front desk was really nice and helpful.  We would stay here again.

title: Perfect
text: This was our second stay at the Cler Hotel.  The staff was so very helpful and welcoming.  The room was very clean and well-appointed.  A step outside the hotel is the absolutely charming Rue Cler: a pedestrian only street lined with restaurants, shops of all kinds and the traffic of locals and tourists which comes alive in the morning and flows smoothly into night.  Located in the 7th arr. it's a brief walk to sites, transportation and everything a visitor to this grand city could want.

title: Would stay again!
text: We had a really lovely stay at cler hotel! It’s really nicely designed, clean and has all the facilities you need. The staff were helpful and facilitated an early check in as well as luggage storage on check out. The hotel is located on a beautiful street with lots of restaurants and cafes and is only a few mins away from the Eiffel Tower. I would definitely stay again next time I’m in Paris.

title: Wonderful Experience
text:
It was a pleasure staying at the Cler Hotel. Dealing with Sujit was a joy as he looked after our booking and accommodation so professionally. Great location. We found the rooms to be comfortable and finished to a high standard. Right outside the hotel , there was a street full of great cafes , restaurants and artisan food stores. 
We had a wonderful time. I would highly recommend staying at the Cler hotel.
I will be a regular visitor from now on.

title: The best of Paris
text: Located on a street where cars are prohibited and on a old fashioned open market it’s a beautiful Parisian experience. Staff is friendly and so very kind, rooms are updated and very clean, comfortable temperature even in winter. Full American breakfast available. Secure and quiet with a little courtyard. Perfect place to recuperate after hours on your feet as a tourist. Walk to the Seine, convenient to metro and everything. Tons of cafes nearby. Reasonable price. We miss it already. Located in an classic old European building, note that the elevator is small and carries only 2 at a time comfortably if attending to children and disabled elders in your party.

title: Fantastic
text:
Cler Hotel is located within walking distance to the Eiffel Tower.  We stayed in room 604 and had a great view of the tower.  Rooms 604/605 should have similar views and I would imagine the floors below in the same areas would have a view of the tower.  We slept with our window open each night and the area is so quiet and yet Rue Cler is such a bustling street with some shops and restaurants.  Fantastic hotel both in price, location and staff assistance.

Room- rooms are small but expected for a European hotel.  We put one of our two large suitcases under the bed and the other was left out.  The room is modern and the bed is super comfortable. Room tips: bring your own blow dryer theirs heats up and shuts down so you will only get about a minute at a time of use.  Also for only English speakers the tv has CNN and BBC but some channels you can try using the “tools” feature on the tv remote to change language to “VO” which will cancel voiceover back to English.  

Elevator- as other reviews indicate it is small.  Think narrow and about three people (if your thin) lined up size.  I fit two large suitcases and myself but had to suck in my tummy:)

Location- perfect! When you arrive the hotel door is small and you walk into just the elevator as the front desk is one floor up.  Across the road from you and next door is fruit stands and a grocery store.  The entire street has bakeries (for your daily croissant and baguette). 

Transportation- several blocks away is Ecole Militaire subway line M8 that can connect you to the rest of the city.  Subway is easy to use by downloading their RATP app.  In addition Uber and Free Now (their version of Uber) are easy to use and will get you to the rest of the city for about 8-11 euros.  

Coffee- the hotel has a breakfast for 12 euros a day but you have a ton of other options.  Starbucks is two blocks away, bakeries serve coffee, and of course all the restaurants serve breakfast.  

Clothes- their is about 1’ space to hang clothes and several cubbies to put clothes into. We were able to get most of our stuff in those areas and out of our suitcases.  They have an iron and ironing board in the basement but I never ended up using it since I hung the wrinkled clothes in the bathroom when I showered to steam them out.

title: Magnific!
text:
I write this opinion in english because i cannot write it in my language: catalan.

Magnificent hotel in the center of Paris, ideal for spending a weekend of walking through streets of the city and visit some of the emblematic places. New and clean, Stuff always present about you may need. In addition, it is on Rue Cler, which is an ideal space for parisian life.

title: Room 604 Hotel Cler review.
text: This hotel is a gem in the heart of Paris.  It is situated on Rue Cler, with bakeries, restaurants, markets, anything else you need just a few steps away. There is a metro station nearby for easy access to anywhere else in the city. This hotel is amazing. It’s modern and kept super clean. The staff are extremely helpful and rooms are reasonably priced. Do yourself a favor and book this hotel.  I stayed in room 604 come up with a view of the Eiffel tower. Pay extra and reserve this room.

title: Cler Hotel is a great place to stay in Paris
text: We stayed here for 6 nights on our first visit to Paris. The rooms were reasonably priced, and just what we needed for a couple of tourists. They also have a nice buffet Breakfast that made it easy to get going each morning as we explored Paris. The staff was very friendly and helpful. But, the absolute best thing about this hotel is the location. There was one Bus stop across the street, and two Metro stations less that 10 minutes walk. In addition, this hotel is at one end of Rue Cler, which has two blocks of stores, restaurants, wine shops, etc. There was even a friendly ATM machine just outside the front door. It is also a 15 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. We plan on staying here the next time we are in Paris.

title: Lovely little hotel
text: Stayed for one night and everything was great. Spotlessly clean room with a perfect view of the Eiffel Tower - small but had everything you’d need, and small is standard in Paris! The staff were all very friendly and helpful. The location is fantastic - Rue Cler has lots of little shops and cafés, and the hotel is within walking distance of most places, with the metro just a few minutes walk away. I would definitely stay here again and recommend Cler Hotel to friends and family.

title: Fantastic hotel
text: Hotel was clean and comfortable. The location was fantastic close to attractions, restaurants and metro. Loved the street Rue Cler.  All the staff were super friendly and helpful. Will for sure stay again if our travels take us back to Paris

title: Fantastic Hotel Cler
text: We have just returned from a four night stay at Hotel Cler. On arrival early we were allowed to check in early which was brilliant, as the rooms were both ready. The hotel is lovely, modern and has some quirky features! The reception area and dining area are a pleasant space, with access to a outside terrace/garden. Both rooms were on the 2nd floor which is lift accessible, both modern with modern shower rooms, clean and had views to Rue Cler at the front and a super comfortable bed. We couldn’t have been happier with the rooms. All the staff were polite, friendly, and always there to help when needed. Would highly recommend this Hotel if you’re staying in Paris!! Only a 5 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower too which is a bonus.

title: Everything we could hope for!
text: We stayed at Cler Hotel in October 2021. It was the most pleasant surprise. It is situated on a quaint cobble stone street in what seemed to be more of a local (as Paris gets) area. Our room had windows that opened to the street which we loved. If you are a light sleeper, I do not recommend it. The rooms are trendy but unassuming. Just what we needed. Rue Cler has everything you could need with great restaurants, markets and bakeries. The hotel is also located within walking distance to just about anything you might need or want to see! There is a pharmacy about a block away where we were able to easily get COVID tests for our return to the States. Idir was “the host with the most!” He was unbelievably helpful, going above and beyond to answer all of our questions. We definitely will return!!!

title: Fantastic boutique hotel on rue Cler - our stay could not have been any better.
text:
Nice boutique hotel in the 7th arrondissement on rue Cler.  We stayed 5 nights and took the option for breakfast included and this was a nice way to start our days.  Nice quality food, great coffee machine, Excellent service from a very friendly staff. Especial the welcoming Bonjour from Idir each day. 

Rue Cler is charming with some great cafes and market stores. 10 min walk to Eiffel.  We did lots of walking everywhere during our trip and found this to be a great location. Sorry to leave The Cler and Paris. We will be back for sure as soon as we can.

title: Excellent place to stay!!!
text:
The staff are all courteous and welcoming, walking distance to all landmarks and museums. Metro bus is a few steps away. Good restaurants and shops are all close by.
Thanks to Idir and Sunjit our front desk crew for all your help! Me and my wife are glad to pick your Hotel as we celebrate our 28th wedding anniversary…

title: Great place.
text: Hotel was small and quaint. Has an elevator and dinning place during breakfast. Clean and quiet. If you open your windows you can hear the outside noise of the street market. But when closed you don’t hear anything. Having the street market literally outside of your hotel is a blessing. You can walk to a bakery, souvenir shop, restaurants and many many more things.

title: Great Stay at Cler Hotel!
text: My wife and I stayed there for our first trip to Paris and we would both highly recommend this hotel. Very modest in amenities but great location and very friendly staff. Idir (front desk staff) was awesome giving us tips and  directions whenever needed.

title: Top notch stay!
text: The location is absolutely superb, near to the Museum we wanted to visit and on a pedestrianized street made it even better!  The service at the hotel was first rate, staff friendly, accommodating and very helpful. The room was very well appointed, with excellent facilities, clean, modern, light and with views across the roof tops to the top of the Eiffel Tower. The breakfast was excellent and good value for money. I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough, I only wish we could have stayed more than one night, I would definitely want to stay here again when visiting Paris.

title: Lovely hotel with a very nice location
text: I stayed at Cler Hotel for 4 nights with my daughter. I really appreciated that the staff was able to fulfill my requests. The hotel is clean, modern and is located in a very nice location. The area also felt very safe. I liked that there was a fridge in the room, and the beds were very comfortable. The staff was very nice and helpful. All in all we had a lovely time in Paris and the hotel was an important part of that.

title: Perfect
text: We had the BEST stay at Cler Hotel.  The location, the staff, and the hotel itself is a 10/10.  Our stay couldn't have been lovelier.  It was our first time at Cler Hotel, but it will not have been our last. :)

title: Efficient and practical stay
text: Clean hotel; good location; helpful staff (especially Sujit). The wash basins are too small though! We had thought that the rooms had Eiffel Tower view based on the website. But as it turned out there are only 2 rooms like that.

title: Loved it!! Will come again!
text: We came and stayed a week at the hotel. Loved the room, the staff, the location and the service at hotel Cler. Many restaurants just outside and a store. Every taxi driver knew where it was so taking a taxi was no problem. The staff was fantastic, helped us with everything we needed. Breakfast was amazing - recommend that.

title: Immaculate rooms, excellent service, complete hot breakfast and great location
text: We could not have been happier with our stay at Cler Hotel. We had excellent service from Elsa who provided the most complete and delicious breakfast service daily, and the receptionist Sujit and all the others who worked at the reception. Rue Cler was particularly quiet, and many restaurants in the area closed the last part of August when we visited, but we did like Le Roussillon next to the hotel and Le Recruetement, two lively Parisian bistros and bars when so many restaurants were closed for August vacations. Hotel rooms small, but only compared to American standards. Just right for Paris, and a great elevator! Thank you for a wonderful stay. The Donovans hope to come back and practice more French with you.  It was very nice that Sujit offered to hold our luggage between check out and our train departure.

title: Spectacular in every way!
text:
The Cler Hotel couldn’t be more perfectly situated or more welcoming. We were greeted by the wonderful manager, who spoke perfect English and made us feel so welcome. 
Our room was clean, comfortable and quiet with a lovely view out the garden window. 
Cler Hotel could not be more centrally located to explore Rue Cler, the Eiffel and has a Metro stop nearby. 
Merci beaucoup to the staff at Cler Hotel fir making our stay an enjoyable one.

title: Fantastic! Will stay again!
text: This was the perfect hotel for our two night stay in Paris! It was clean and quiet, the staff was incredibly friendly and helpful (absolutely adore Sujit and Elsa!), and it's really close to the Eiffel Tower and Metro 8 line. The breakfast was decent- maybe a little bit expensive for what it is- but it's nice enough (if you're in Paris- there is a lot of eating to be done anyhow!). I would absolutely stay at this hotel again!

title: Highly Recommended
text: Great location on rue Cler. Beautiful street and area right outside your door with shops, cafes, etc. Helpful and friendly staff. Room was comfortable and overlooked the busy and interesting street but was not loud. I would stay here again.

title: Perfect Location
text: Newly renovated chic little hotel in a perfect location.   Pedestrian street in the center of the Paris.   The service and the team there made us feel welcome!  Love the shower, the views- the bedding and the ambiance!

title: Cozy hotel in a pleasent premises area
text:
We spent 2 nights in this small but up-to-date hotel recently renovated. In a pedestrian area close with a general daily market and many interesting shops. It is also close to a couple of metro station (line 8). Walking distance from Tour Eiffel and Les Invalides.
We will choose this hotel again for our next trip to Paris.

title: Good but not exceptional
text:
Due to the Covid situation, they do not make the room or change the towels during your stay. This I did not like.
This information does not appear on the website when booking.
New hotel with small rooms. Located on a very lively street all day and night. Because there is a fruit market, noise is heard at dawn when the market is set up. The tiny elevator can only accommodate one person. Close to the metro exit and the Eiffel tower.

title: Great location
text: Lovely boutique hotel, set in cobbled streets full of cafes, cheese shops, restaurants, chocolate shops and bakery’s . Only a few streets from the Effie tower. The hotel is super clean and the staff couldn’t be any friendlier and helpful.

title: Great location and friendly staff
text: We stayed at the Cler Hotel for 3 nights during a long weekend trip to Paris. The hotel is right on charming Rue Cler which has plenty of bakeries and restaurants, and is less than a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. Rooms are on the smaller side, typical for Paris, but are clean and modern. The hotel staff is very friendly, warm and helpful with tips for traveling around Paris. Highly recommended.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Great stay, luxurious room, excellent location and staff.  Just a short walk from the Eiffel Tower, with views from the room, this is an excellent location for a special occasion or just to visit Paris.  Will be coming back!!

title: Perfect hotel
text: perfect hotel with a really nice location near the Tower. Staff is very friendly. Mearsures about covid-19 was perfect. Everything is really clean. A lot of restaurants in de street. Near the bus and metro. With 1 stopover from Gare du Nord untill the hotel, it was like maybe 20 minutes. Everything was perfect and I really like to come back!

title: Great stay and experience
text: One of the best places to stay at when visiting Paris. This was my third time in Paris and without a doubt the best experience hotel wise. The staff is nice and helpful. The rooms are cosy and overall give you a feeling of being welcome in the city.

title: CLERly the best
text:
I stayed at the Cler hotel for a week in the month of November 2019 for a business trip, it isn’t a business hotel but then I was ok to be not provided such a 'business hotel' feeling since this Hotel was acknowledged greatly for their hospitality which is more important to me as against.

I had my wife join me in the middle of the week so that I can use the later part of the trip for leisure visiting in and around Paris. I went for this hotel predominantly because of  the Eiffel tower view and another its proximity to some of the best places around.

Around the hotel:
I was overwhelmed when I laid my at the street for the first time - Rue Cler, where this hotel is based. It is a bright and colorful street to make your day, filled with flowers, fruits and eateries - one can savor street food as well as sit in/outside the Cafes. If at all you've read about tour guides who provide a peek into local flavors of Paris by foot / bicycle, Rue Cler happens to be one of the lanes they wouldn't miss. So, irrespective you're just inside or outside the Hotel - the feeling of living within the locals never fades away.

Entrance:
At the entrance, the lift is quite small for one person to fit along with 1 piece of luggage but it certainly isn’t a show stopper come to think of where one spends most of their time. At the reception, Idir greeted me with a warm welcome and kindly made a provision to park my luggage since I had shown up early. He then also took me through a map of nearby places around the Hotel where I could pay a short visit + he patiently answered all my questions so I can get by easily. Without further ado, I headed straight to witness the Iron Lady which was about 10 mins by walk. 

Checking in:
2 hrs later, rather prior to my check-in time, I got a call from the Hotel saying my room is now ready which was great, room size is comparatively smaller than you would expected for the price but I didn't mind given that I planned to spend most of time cherishing the Parisian culture, the additional money you spend here is saved up on your commute to tour around the location you get so I was happy to be at the mercy of a this hotel than business. I have stayed at many business hotels but the personal attention you get here is just great. Even when my wife checked in mid-week, she too had a pleasant experience. She took help from Idir & team to plan a one day solo trip to Belgium before we could start to explore the romantic city from Friday onwards.  The team at the Hotel have a lot of references so any help one needs on booking the taxi, shows, tours are provided right at the reception.

Room setup / View:
I had specifically booked Room. no 605, which has an Eiffel Tower view from the window. I could literally see the Eiffel lying down on my bed and adore the beauty for as long as it's lit, especially the hourly glitter. That breathtaking view is incredibly one of the best and has stayed ripe in my memories till now, I bet it would for a long time. The wardrobe can accommodate 1 person's luggage easily if you're staying for a week + they provide a table where you could fit in your laptop for work. Wifi worked like a charm through the day. 

Breakfast:
I even opted for their breakfast for a few days and it was delicious - it included croissants, cereals, meats, eggs, fresh juices,etc.  there isn't variety but everything served leaves your taste glands satisfied. Basic beverages were free of cost at the reception.

I would recommend this hotel to business, leisure and couple travelers without a doubt. The experience and the memories would be worthwhile a long. In the age of tech and luxuries, I was amazed with the kind of in-person hospitality offered to me in that week which I would cherish for a long time.

title: Very Accommodating During COVID and Will Definitely Book Again
text: We had a non-refundable stay scheduled in mid-May at the tail end of a 2 week trip.  I contacted the hotel to request the amount paid be applied as a credit when we reschedule the trip.  The hotel went a step further and refunded the amount for our stay.  This trip will be rescheduled and Cler Hotel will definitely be included.

title: Loved this hotel, great location, great service, stay here!
text:
My daughter & I recently stayed here for 3 nights in March 2020. We were absolutely satisfied with this hotel! First of all, this is a great location if this is the area you want to be in (near the Eiffel Tower). It is a lovely Boutique Hotel with the small elevator & winding steps up to the  Reception area. We had a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower which was amazing! I could lay in bed and watch the Eiffel tower sparkle at night! Sure the room is not that big but those who complain must not travel in Europe often because rooms are not that big. The shower was simply wonderful because of the overhead rain showerhead. Plus we even had a view of the Eiffel Tower from our bathroom! So we loved our room on the 6th floor. 
Secondly, the service at the front desk was fabulous, especially Idir & Florentin! They were very friendly, & helpful. They answered many questions that we asked, made recommendations & arranged a taxi for us to Versailles.  Lastly, the hotel is on Rue Cler which is a great street with restaurants, grocery stores,  a pastry shop, a souvenir shop and our favorite, Gelato Al Naturale, which we visited almost every night! We would recommend this hotel!

title: Amazing Stay!
text: The Cler Hotel was located on a popular street (Rue Cler) with many restaurants and shops. The location is great, just a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. We stayed in room 605, and we could see the Eiffel Tower from our bed and bathroom! So cool! The room was clean and the bathroom had a rain shower! The staff were all very friendly and helpful with answering any questions we had during our stay. There is an option to pay for breakfast, but we didn't because there are many cute restaurants on the street that serve breakfast! Would highly recommend this hotel! Great location, friendly staff, clean rooms!

title: Good location and clean, but not spectacular
text:
If all you care about is location and cleanliness, this place will do the job.  But other than that, we weren't so impressed.  We stayed in another hotel in Paris near the train station (Whistler) and it was a better hotel (not counting the location).

You can't beat the location on Rue Cler with lots of restaurants/shops just meters away and walkability to the Eiffel Tower.  There's a supermarket nearby, and the metro stop is not far either.  

As for the bad: tiny room with not much in the way of furniture besides the bed.  Hard to find a place to put things.  Tiny claustrophobic elevator and narrow stairs.  No freebies, they have drinks/snacks available in the kitchen but they are all overpriced.  One day they forgot (?) to restock our room with anything, we didn't have toilet paper, towels, soap - I had to go down and ask for it.  We didn't eat breakfast here - but given what we saw I assume it would be overpriced and not worth it given the plentiful options outside.

title: Great location, great view, great staff
text: Stayed at the Cler Hotel from Dec 28th through Jan 1st.  I want to thank all the staff, especially Florentin, who helped us secure transportation during the strikes this past December.   The view from our room of the Eiffel Tower was memorable plus.   The restaurants, the market and shops like the chocolate one on the street made it a great place to stay.   It’s about 10 mins walk from the Eiffel Tower.   Rooms are small, bathroom was still decent size.   The elevator fits two people only or one person with their bag.

title: Best hotel
text:
From the time I booked online until I checked out the staff at the Cler Hotel was amazing. My Husband and I took our senior citizens parents on a surprise trip to Paris after London Jan 1-4th we arrived via Eurostar and when I pulled up to the hotel I was scared and then when I seen the small elevator I was really scared. Traveling with senior citizens and walking up the stairs don’t mix. Walking up to the reception area was a no go and we had 8 total of luggage so we had to put one person in the elevator with one luggage at a time (the elevator is tiny) even the front desk gentleman came to help carry luggage up the stairs to speed up the process. 

However, our rooms were not ready as we arrived fairly early but the hotel had a big enough room for us to store our luggage as we waited for the rooms which I requested an early check in and they made it happen before 3.

The rooms are small but just enough space. I think it’s a European thing but for my Americans there are no wash cloths so remember to bring your own. The hotel room was clean (I’m OCD), each day the housekeeping would come clean and were so nice spoke little English but very nice. 

The only hiccup during our stay is when the elevator broke down and my 66 year old mother and 70 + year old father in law had to walk down the stairs from the 5th and 3rd floor. When we returned it still wasn’t working. We walked to get some lunch and Luckily just minutes as we returned the elevator was working again. 

The block of the hotel was the best. If I lived in Paris I would want to live on this block. I was a little disappointed that my street view room didn’t look at the Eiffel Tower (which I thought it did when I booked not the hotels fault mines) however the location is the best with the local stores fresh markets, post office, grocery stores, wine shops, and restaurant we couldn’t ask for a better hotel.

I would definitely recommend you are still near but away from all the attractions 10-14 walk to the Eiffel. We did go during the strikes so we took Ubers everywhere oh which will drop off at the corner of the hotel by the way. 

Check out my YouTube:

Renita great adventure 

LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE

title: Marvelous location, helpful staff.
text: Most everyting you would want in a small family-run hotel, it was centrally located to many major sites and attractions, including the Rue Cler neighborhood, and had a very helpful and attentive staff.
description: Hôtel Muguet takes its name from the French for lily-of-the-valley, a theme reflected in the hotel's yet refined decoration. Located between the Eiffel Tower and the Invalides, our hotel is very charming and parisian.

title: A great little hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Hotel Muguet. A small, family owned property, it is exceptionally well situated 1/2 block from the side of the Invalides, walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and Rodin Museum, close to the metro and numerous busses.

Rooms are on the small side - typical of Paris. But they are well appointed and modern. The bathroom was comfortable, modern, with good amenities. Windows are well insulated so that we did not hear any noise from the outside, even though our room faced the street. Some of our party had Eiffel Tower view, it was lovely.

The housekeeping team is meticulous, the place is very clean and they do a great job in the rooms as well as the public spaces. All the staff were friendly, attentive and helpful. I was feeling unwell day and they checked up on me a few times throughout the day and the next, offering to go to the pharmacy if needed.

The breakfast buffet was great including an orange juicing machine, freshly made scrambled eggs and the usual continental buffet with breads, pastries, fresh jam, honey, yogurt, etc... we didn't expect such a wonderful spread but it was a great way to start every day. 

They have a small courtyard which can be used to bring prepared meals, the hotel offered plates and utensils.

The price is right and we will be back to this hotel. If you are looking for a reasonably priced, not too fancy but comfortable location, this is the hotel for you!
description: Hôtel Muguet takes its name from the French for lily-of-the-valley, a theme reflected in the hotel's yet refined decoration. Located between the Eiffel Tower and the Invalides, our hotel is very charming and parisian.

title: Nice stay in Paris
text: We liked almost everything about this hotel. Great location within walking distance to Invalides Plaza and Eifel tower. There are many restaurants and Cafes in the area. Hotel is very clean, and very nice staff at the front desk. Our only comment is that rooms are too small (typical in Paris!!), also elevator is too small. One area that can be improved is adding fresh fruit to the breakfast with some other variety of Parisian pastries. We also think, plates are also too small, medium size is more practical.

title: Wonderful location
text:
We stayed at hotel Muguet for three nights for a quick visit to Paris. This was our second time in Paris, and second time to stay at hotel Muguet. The check in was quick and pleasant. The staff are friendly, and they will make you feel welcome. 
 
We love the location and the proximity to the Eiffel tour, the Seine, Les Invalides, and countless other attractions. We walked in large circle around Paris, eating and sightseeing, and averaging 20 km per day. We were always glad to back to rest at hotel Muguet. It's clean and has been nicely updated since the last time we came here. 

For breakfast you can eat in the hotel, or walk to the countless Cafes, within a few hundred meters. We chose to go to the bakery on Rue Cler, a five minute walk, and observe the morning hustle that Paris has to offer.

Transit from CDG to Hotel Muguet was also super easy and efficient. Just hop on the train and in less than an hour, you will be at the Ecole Militare station. From there it's a five minute walk to the hotel.

What else can I say. I am looking forward to staying here, when we come back to Paris again.

title: Perfect in every way
text:
Went to Paris for a week with 2 other couples.  This hotel was recommended by a friend and it didn’t disappoint. If you can, get a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower.  At night when the lights come on it was amazing.  We had rooms 41, 51, and 61.  Room 51 had a small balcony in it. The only thing bad about 6 floor, is the small elevator only goes up 5 floors.  I was on the 5 floor and walked up and down everyday.  Needed to work off all the calories from the delicious food and wine!
We were there a week, so dealt with lots of different staff.  Everyone was so nice and helpful.  When we arrived Carlos was there to greet us.  Such a nice man.  
The rooms had everything we needed.  Not small, like lots of other European hotels. They all even had air conditioning.  Beds were nice too.
The location of the hotel can’t be beat.  5 minute walk to two subways, 5 minutes to Rue Cler, and only about a 15  walk to Eiffel Tower. 
They had a nice buffet breakfast  if you wanted it.  Included eggs, meats, cheeses, granola, yogurt, etc.  we had it 5 of the 7 days there.  A lovely patio to eat too.  
If I ever get to go to Paris again ( a girl can dream) I would definitely stay there.

text:
This is our second visit to Hotel Miguet (last time was 6 years ago),  and as before we booked a superior room that as an aldove with a bed that our 19 year old daughter slept in. The room and bathroom are decent sized, and all was clean and relatively updated.  My only disappointment was of my own making, that we didn't book early enough to get one of the rooms with a view of the Eiffel Tower.  But that was my fault.

I have to totally disagree with the review by the person who placed the one star review below.  If you  don't book early enough to get a superior room that's on you.  We found the staff to be totally pleasant and professional.  If you treat people like crap you're going to get it back, and deserve it.

It is a bit quieter than, say, St. Germaine or the Latin Quarter, but there are plenty of decent restaurants and the Eiffel Tower is about a one mile easy walk.  Rue Le Cler is nice for breakfast, although we did find some of the restaurants a little touristy.  Metro is nearby and it's easy to get to other places.  Paris is a city to be walked in, anyhow, and the Louvre, Musee d'Orsay, Notre Dame, and St. Germaine were about 1.5 miles away, or one transfer on the Metro.

This is our go-to place for Paris, and will certalinly return.

text:
Loved the location of the Hotel Muguet in the 7th arrondissement.  It was on a quiet street.  Great for walking or near to two subway stations.  Nearby too so many different restaurants.  Hotel staff greeted us upon arrival and took care of all our needs.  Explained the nightly drop-off of the room key...nice security!  Elevator only went to the 5th floor and we had to walk to the 6th floor to our room.  No problem---great exercise!
We booked our room based one primary thing---the view of the Eiffel Tower!  And it did not disappoint!  Room had an unobstructed view of it and we could watch the nightly show from the comfort of our room!  Room was well appointed with a king sized bed.  The AC worked well and was quiet.  The shower was large and had great water pressure.
Breakfast each morning was delightful with fresh fruit and juice.  Varieties of meats, cheeses and spreads for the breads.  Could offer a variety of danishes in the morning, but no real complaints about the croissants served.
We would definitely recommend the Hotel Muguet to anyone seeking a quiet and friendly place to stay while in Paris!  Thank you for a wonderful experience!

text:
We stayed 2 nights in this really lovely hotel during a heatwave! We were met on day1 by a friendly and helpful Julien at reception.
Our Room 63, was accessed by lift to floor 5 and a short, very manageable flight of stairs to floor 6. The room had a sloping ceiling ( not ideal if over 175cm) and a lovely view (internal courtyard) of the dome of Les Invalides. 
Bathroom was small but spotless avd beautifully finished. Beds were extremely comfortable.
Aircon was a lifesaver, and worked really well. Wi-Fi was very good. 
We did not have breakfast at the hotel and because of the incredibly high temperatures during our stay, did not make of the external courtyard seating area. 
A lovely hotel, situated conveniently near the Eiffel Tower, and with pleat of restaurants and shopping within a couple of mins walk, I would definitely stay in Le Muguet again when visiting Paris.

The front desk attendant made calls for us to confirm an open pharmacy within walking distance, which was much appreciated.  I would recommend Hotel Muguet to anyone, and will definitely stay there again when visiting Paris!

title: Not a hotel, branded to make it seem that way
text: The Yooma Urban Lodge appears to be a hotel but is more of a glorified hostel. The guest rooms were smartly designed with USBs available, , but little walking room.  There were no amenities in the room besides a hair dryer, towels and toilet paper. The staff did not appear communicate well to each other or us. For example, we informed the front desk and payed to check out late and yet housekeeping knocked  on our door repeatedly and opened our door apparently to clean our room at the earlier check-out time. Furthermore, the hotel was not clean to hotel standards, and neither was our room . We stayed in a 4-person room. The top bunk was never cleaned. Also it is family friendly for younger kids - it is pac-man themed and for little children. The hallways are kind of like a maze. Finally, it’s very difficult to find and get in the hotel because the entrance is not at street level and the elevator to its main entrance is consistently broken. We were going to move at the beginning of our stay but the hotel refused to refund the other days.  I would not recommend this “urban lodge”, it is far to much money for what it is; even in Paris.

title: Nice & Comfortable
text: Yooma urban lodge is a modern hotel designed in a very urban way. It is 10 min walk from Eifel tower. Rooms are very clean, relatively small with tiny bathrooms and minimal decoration. This hotel is very family friendly and children would love it, especially the rooms with bunk beds. On the other hand, there is a play room for small children and babies. In case you are looking for atmosphere, view, or a romantic place, I don't recommend this hotel but is a good budget-friendly place for solo travelers or a family with children. Breakfast hall is big and breakfast is just OK. There is no mini-bar in the room as I remember and you can buy water and beverage from front desk.

title: Great place for a family
text:
We arrived via train into Gare du Nord, if you do the same you need to get the royal blue B line (Saint Remy les Chevreuse direction) and then swap onto the light green line (6) at Denfert Rochereau and go to Bir Hakeim station (Charles de Gaulle Toile direction), we found this to be the closest and easiest station for us.
The accommodation was ideal for us as a family, the children loved the bunk beds, the room was clean, the shower was lovely, nice view.
Our two young children absolutely loved the soft play room and as a couple we were able to relax in the evenings and play free pool (over 16's only, you need to give them a form of ID to get the equipment) with a beer.
Staff were helpful and I would definitely stay here again as we managed to visit all the big attractions by using the underground and it really is close to the Eiffel Tower.

title: Good alternative
text:
It`s a different kind of hotel, ideal for families with young kids. Provide all that is necesary for a good night sleep. Suficiently clean, very well ubicated (7 minutes walk to Eiffel Tower). Confortable beds, quiet and well designed rooms.

The only thing is the lack of service with some unusual requests. We had our room change do to a strange oddor. In the change, I forgot a pair of shoes. Inmediatly asked reception to look for them and they saiid will be done imediately. I trusted them and went out to enjoy. text:
A good hotel for a family of 5 whit great familiy rooms… 

We were welcomed by the nicest reception staff from start to finish. Even paid 30 Euro the day before check out, for a late check out, so that we didn't have to check out at 11am but at 2pm. And parking is cheap and safe and nearby.. 

The hotel is child-friendly and the rooms are good, creative and it is located right in the heart of Paris with 10 min walking distance to the Eiffel tower, Starbucks, Shopping center, Mac D, Laudree shop metro, Café etc. Right in the spirit of our children.

title: Budget Hotel for a big family with small ones.
text: A good place to stay for a big family. It’s a 17mins walk to the Eiffel and near the city center. We stayed in a room that has 4 bunk beds and 1 queen size bed and a pack ‘n play. The queen size bed and pillows are comfortable to sleep in after a tired long day, but I can’t say the same for the bunk beds mattress. The sheets are clean, the toilet is separated from the shower area. No other toiletries aside from toilet tissue. Its €3 for a toothpaste. Gods that we always bring our own shower gel, shampoo etc. The room is relatively small that we can’t all stand up all together at the same time. There’s no enough space if you have more than 3 luggage but you can always open up the luggage and place them under the bunk beds. The hotel has an AC, centralized and not so strong but hey, at least there’s an AC! The Hotel lobby/reception is located on the 3rd floor. The day we arrived the only elevator is broken so we had to climb up the stairs while our bags are still in the car and was told the parking reservation I made was less than 24hrs and they only have 20 slots for parking so they can’t provide me one. But the staff are so helpful, polite and patient with all my questions and suggested another parking nearby. The lobby has a carpeted floor all the way going to the rooms. It smells and looks unclean and could’ve use a good steam cleaning. It was written on the policy that room cleaning is only done upon check out or when requested while in the property but the following morning while we are outside someone entered our room without knocking, luckily my husband was there still sleeping and woke up. They do have a play area for the kids in the lobby, a billiard table and some arcades. They do have a restaurant where you can pay additional for breakfast or grab a quick bite.

title: Great base for seeing the sights in Paris
text: Had a great stay at Yooma. The room was clean, with quality bedding, pillows, mattresses and we all slept well. Despite it being a very hot spell in Paris the temperature in the room was perfect for sleeping.  The bathroom had quality fixtures and fittings and the shower was great. We had a family room, which was a bit tight for space but it wasn’t a problem for us.  The buffet breakfast was functional but decent value at 10 euros. On the whole the staff were friendly and helpful and spoke good English. Yooma is handily placed for the Eiffel Tower.

title: Excellent hotel to go with family.
text:
Very very very well located, very good value for money.

Excellent service and attention.

The family rooms really liked my children.

They have areas for children to play while you wait or check in, there are several nearby restaurants and a mall.

title: Superb hotel, hugely recommended!
text:
My daughter chose this hotel as it looked fun, and she was certainly right! Lots of free video and board games and a rumpus room for children to use. The room was very clean and very comfortable, towels were refreshed every day. Thick walls and doors so no internal noise disturbed us. A little noise from outside but it was during Bastille Day celebration weekend, so to be expected!

The reception staff were truly exceptional: when we arrived I was very, very hot and wheezing. The receptionist fetched me a glass of water without being asked and gave us water carriers and a spray, which my daughter found incredibly useful. Staff also ordered a taxi and were smiling and friendly at every point in our stay. the bar is very well stocked with soft drinks and more adult choices! Every staff member we met was incredibly polite and upbeat.

The location is very good, served by three Metro lines within ten minutes walk, great views of the Eiffel Tower and the Charles Michel area is a good local shopping point. 

A brilliant choice if you are a family.

title: Great for a Parisian Hotel!
text:
Most of the hotels in Paris don't cater much toward families.  This isn't because they want it that way, it is because of the age and layout of the buildings.  The Yooma Urban Lodge is a much newer building, and as a result it has more modern amenities.  The place was built for people to just relax and have fun.  The desk clerks were friendly and most spoke 2-3 languages.

The lobby has a small space to eat and many couches on which to relax.  There are arcade games, a pool table, and much more for families to enjoy.  The decorations are eclectic, themed with Pac-Man and other similar characters.  Don't let this be a turn off - it is done in a great way.

The rooms were nice because they actually had room for 4 people to comfortably sleep: two "pod" style bunk beds and a queen bed.  The rooms were clean and had decent storage.  As a result, there isn't much walking space in the room - most of it is used up for sleeping areas.

The hotel is a 10 minute walk to the Bar Hakeim metro station and about 15 minutes from Eiffel Tower.  This was a good base to explore Paris!

title: Very good stay

title: OK
