title: Excellent family friendly hotel
text:
We had a great stay at Yooma. The hotel is very clean and rooms cleaned daily and fresh towels left. The reception staff were very friendly and helpful. Children are well catered for - they all love the free arcade games which is in the bar area as you enter the hotel. Snacks and drinks are cheap for the area - 4 euro for a beer and 5 for a glass of wine. There is a monoprix supermarket about 5 minutes walk away and lots of other shops, restaurants and cafe bars in that area. It is about 10-15 walk to the Eiffel Tower. At first it was unclear how to access the hotel and we went up steps but there is actually a lift you can take that is outside to the left of the hotel near the car park. 
The rooms are small but expected for this location in Paris. In our room the toilet was separate to the shower room which was handy. All in all we had an excellent stay and would recommend.

title: Very good familyhotel
text:
We were 2 persons. It was a small room. It was lovely quiet. Everything functioned. The bath was fine. The breakfast was good and healthy.
In the reception the staff was very helpful and the staff in the breakfastroom was too.
The lounge was nice with af room for playing.We enjoied our stay.

title: Unhelpful staff and broken elevator.
text:
They have no luggage carts and the main elevator was broken and we had a lot of bags (travelling for a wedding) and the staff just said there’s another elevator around the corner. They didn’t show us or offer to help at all. And the elevator wasn’t just “around the corner”.  We spent 15 minutes finding it and lugging all our heavy luggage. 

Then our flights changed so we didn’t have to stay one of our booked nights and the staff was completely unempathetic and unhelpful and refused to give even a partial refund or even refund the city tax. 

Stay elsewhere.

title: Modern Basic Adequate Stay
text: The location is ideal for visiting the Eiffel Tower.  It's within walking distance to the Tower and the Seine is across the street, but you don't have a view of either.  You can see the Tower from a certain location just outside the hotel.  For just about everything else you want to do in Paris, you will need to take a train/uber.  Champs Elysees is about 15 minutes by train.  The Louvre is about 25 minutes away.  There are a few train stations in every direction, but they are about at least a 7-12 minute walk.  There are places to eat in the quiet neighborhood behind the hotel including 3 -4  terrific boulangeries.  You can visit the nearby mall for McDonalds or Chipotle.  If you walk to the two main streets a few blocks away on either side of the hotel you can find more establishments to eat.    The hotel caters to families with young kids.  There is a small arcade, a play room for the younger ones, and a Pac-Man theme design.  I was worried that I would hear loud kids running in the hallways, but once you are in the room, you don't hear much outside.  The hotel is only 2 floors of rooms, but you have to go upstairs from the street level to reach the lobby.  Hopefully the one elevator they have is working so you don't have to carry your luggage up the concrete steps.  I saw one family with a stroller and a person in a wheelchair having trouble getting the elevator to work.  It was working when we first arrived, but it broke for one day during our stay.  The rooms are very basic and small, but clean.  The beds are comfortable and the best thing is that the bathroom has a towel drying rack and enough spots to hang 4 towels.    I loved that I could come out of the shower and use a warm dry towel.  There is only 1 washer and 1 dryer for the entire place.  However, it was never used when I wanted to use the machines.  It costs a total of 8 Euros.  They take only coins.   The room doesn't have a frig, microwave, iron, or phone.  Therefore, we couldn't have cold drinks or warm up food and if you have an issue, you have to go down to the front desk.   The nearest grocery store is a small "liquor store" a couple blocks away.  The nearby Japanese restaurant, Okito, is okay for sushi, but stay away from everything else.  That was not Japanese food ( I have been to Japan).  The young staff were friendly and helpful.  Some knew more English than others.   It's close to Vaugirard Montparnasse Station if you wish to use the train to travel to the western part of France or the Palace of Versailles.  It is very far from Gare du Nord station if you plan to use the bullet train to travel between London, Belgium, Amsterdam.   For the price, it's a good place to stay for a first trip to Paris, but if I was to go back to Paris, I would probably stay somewhere more northeast.

title: My opinion
text:
Confort, and good location.
However,  one of the  reception staff was  a little ironic with my pronunciation in english and also impatient staff to demosntrate how to store bags in lockers.
But, with respect the structure and is location note 10

title: Yooma Urban Lodge
text: Hotel was a walking distance to the Eiffel Tower .  The only we did not like is the elevator going up to hotel and hotel reception are was broken during our 4 day stay. It is especially hard if you had luggage to carry it up .

title: Yooma child paradise
text:
As a grand mother of 5 under the age of 9 I was thrilled with the way they catered to young children. 
It surpassed my expectations!
My only complaint concerning a blocked drain was not addressed.otherwise a 5 for location and child friendly atmosphere.

title: Perfect hotel to stay in the city center
text: We had a very best weekend in Paris thanks to hotel Yooma, definitely come back again. Thanks to Hector and Rose at the reception that made our stays very welcome and pleasant. Hotel is clean and comfy, good breakfast.

title: No Communication
text: We are very much looking forward to visiting  this hotel this month.  However, communication is lacking.  I have emailed them 3 times because I had to cancel a room and rebook a different one.  I have never received any confirmation of the change.  I also tried calling the front desk and was told to email.  It is frustrating because I have no way to verify that the correct rooms are booked and that we won’t be charged for the cancelled room. I will update review after our stay.

title: Excellent location
text:
Excellent location (near Eiffel Tower and the train and metro station)
Helpful staff
Comfortable rooms (although basic)
Breakfast is ok but there is no variety
There are a lot of games (table and also electronic) - good for kids.
There are paid lockers

title: Great for the family
text: Excellent service and the staff is awesome, plus the location is perfect and the amenities for the family are cool, there's an option of getting breakfast with them wish is pretty good and fresh, train station is at the corner and Eifel tower like a 14 minute walk.

title: Perfect location for visiting The Eiffel Tower
text:
Fab hotel within walking distance of The Eiffel Tower and bus stops to take you further afield. Funky hotel with a retro arcade game vibe. Actual arcade games available and free to play!

Good size rooms with ensuite bathrooms (great shower!). My only niggle is the bath towels could be a bit bigger, they are kind of on the small size...

Reasonable breakfast available, but the selection could be better. It's more of a light continental selection: cheese (only 1 type), ham, 2 cereals (plain cornflakes and chocolate cornflakes), a few yogurts, toast (white & brown), baguettes (white & brown), mini (why note full size??) pastries (croissants, pain au chocolate & a sugar coated puff pastry), orange & apple juice and various hot beverages from a machine. The option of a hot breakfast would have been good eg fried, scrambled, poached eggs, sausages, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes etc...

title: Nice hotel
text:
All
Was good and rooms were clean and new.
One thing is about the breakfast and one lady that is so impolite and unprofessional which will change your view about the things.
They have to include some vegetables on the breakfast and maybe some freshly cooked eggs.
Also the gym is available but no weight machines or body building equipment, all are treadmills and bicycles.

title: Romantic trip
text: Great location, very close to the Eiffel Tower (10 min walk). Very clean and quiet. Very well communicated. Very close to a metro station (Bir-Hakeim) and numerous Parisian cafes. Great and helpful staff. I recommend this accomodation with a pure heart. I will definitely choose this place for a stay for the next trip to Paris.

title: Great location and great price
text:
This room was perfect for us (family of 5 with 3 kids aged 9,12,14). It wasn't far from the Eiffel tower (lovely to see it in passing every day and not just the once you go up it!).
Arcade games kept the kids happy while us parents unwound after the day, or in the morning before we set off for the day. Bar stayed open until 1am, games behind the bar could be borrowed with ID for free, pool table available (although needs a new cue tip and chalk!). Breakfast was grand - continental - bit too much bread and pastries for my liking, and could have done with being available until 11am as 10am is a bit early for cut off,  but lots of cafes nearby doing omelettes etc. So not stuck for choice.  Not far from the metro and once you figure out how to use it, it really is easy!  Would definitely stay here again.

title: Great place to stay
text: Very close from Eiffel Tower big rooms for 6 people. Our kids enjoyed the free game machines at the lobby. A place to repeat in next visit to Paris. The people at the lobby very helpful and friendly. Great place to stay.

title: Good location - but dirty!!
text:
As a family of 5 we chose this lodge because of its location and the fact, that each kid would have an own bed. We arrived and they first gave us a room, were they were still repairing sth. So we got a room with a nicer „view“. The room was small (like all rooms in Paris!!) but functional...
Problem is that it was DIRTY!
The floor and its frames were full of dust, I really desinfected everything I could...you could see dirt and fingerprints all over the „sliding doors“ of the Kids beds and all Cupboards and shelfs hadn‘t been cleaned for quites some time (not to mention light switches, door handels etc.). The toilett was also no properly cleaned. 
The white cloth I had cleaned everything with was grey/black afterwards.
The curtains were gross but worst was the fact to find hair on the mattress and I am pretty sure that the bed covers/cushions had mites...
For 250Eur/Night the LEAST one can expect is absolute cleanliness.

We decided not to have breakfast there (not after seeing how dirty it was also the Elevators or the Staircase was not clean at all).

Would not really chose that lodge again...despite the good location.

title: Location is good. The rest no so much.
text:
The good -
1) the location is decent. Just over 10 minutes walk to the Eiffel tower and just over 5 to the nearest metro station. This is the main reason who picked this hotel as there is quite a few amenities in the local vicinity such as a super market and restaurants and shops. It's basically on the river Seine. 
2) it was cheap for Paris. We paid approximately £130 a night for a 6 night stay. Although I would stress this is a pretty budget hotel. We were happy enough to pay this for the location. 
3) The beds are comfortable
4) the water pressure was good in the shower 

The bad - in no particular order
1) the room smelt a bit funky on arrival. Like BO. We left the window open in the room for large portions to try combat this
2) the window isn't child safe. It opens fully with a two storey drop below. Not ideal if this is meant to be a family oriented hotel. 
3) The bed sheets didn't get changed once during our 6 night stay. They also didn't hoover the floor once during our stay. We have two young children and the inevitable crumbs from snacks happen and the cleaners just left them on the floor after apparently cleaning the room. My son was sick in the room one night and a little bit got on the bed. They still didn't change the bed sheets, so we had to go and ask at reception for this to be done.
4) there are no phones in the room. You need to walk down each time you have a query. 
5) the staff seemed kind of rude and unhelpful. Any time you asked them something you got basic responses with little politeness. When checking in we got zero information about anything like check out times and this didn't seem to be available anywhere. We asked for ice for the room a few times and we felt as if we were asking for the world.
6) the room was very warm. The air conditioning didn't seem to do much
7) This is my main annoyance. Considering this hotel seems to be geared at families with the pacman decor and games in reception the hotel restaurant was absolutely not fit for purpose for our family. It is over priced and some vegetarian only nonsense. We arrived at about 9pm (due to plane delays) on our first night and wanted to just get the kids fed and into bed but because the restaurant was £54(nuts!) per person for a set vegetarian menu we had to end up going out and finding the nearest McDonalds after our long trip all because the restaurant was not fit for purpose. Who ever decided this was a great idea for a hotel aimed at families needs their head checked. It was a real annoyance on arrive. Having to have McDonald's at like 10pm was probably the reason my son was sick later that night. We then found out the reception can do pizzas later in our stay but no one mentioned this to us once. All things considered despite the good location and favourable pricing, I'd say this hotel was very budget and apart from an kind of affordable stay for a budget hotel in paris I  wouldn't consider staying here again with my family. I'd rather pay a bit extra for somewhere who can get the basics right and have a restaurant that I know will be suitable for my young children. Location isn't everything!

title: Lovely Hotel - Great Stff
text:
Location, Staff - Absolutely lovely. Spoke to Roze and Tatiana. Very helpful and helpful in every way. 
Lovely location. Delicious restaurants nearby, 5 minutes from Tube and RER. 
Great for kids, Free arcade games and board  games for all the family in the lobby, great fun had by all.
Restaurant on site is pointless but that isn't Yooma's fault as it is privately owned and very overpriced. especially when such delicious food available as Parisian cafes near by.
Car park not designed for big cars but no parking available elsewhere so do get parking booked if you are driving.

title: Perfect for a family!
text: This place is absolutely perfect for a large family with kids!  Our 4 loved the bunk beds, the game room and decor.  The location is ideal: just 10  min walk from the Eiffel Tower and several metro stops.  The rooms were clean and had everything we needed.  The staff was very friendly and helpful!  Definitely recommend!  Great value for Paris!!

title: Brilliant stay!
text: A real gem of a hotel, nothing too much for them and so many activities for everyone. Personally loved the free arcades and pool 24 h every day. Would definitely recommend. Fantastic hotel near the tower. Rooms stunning

title: Amazing hotel
text: The hotel was nice. There is many things to do, around and in the hotel. You have a good location 5-10 min away from the Eiffeltoren. And a shopping center behind the hotel. If you stand outside the hotel you can see the Eiffeltoren and the Seine. The room was clean and the beds were nice. We are going back for sure

title: Stay at Yooma Urban Lodge Dec 2021
text:
The rooms and hallway were to me extremely warm, but the rooms can be airconditioned colder (so I did for mine). 
We had a very small room with little opportunity to move around in it. It was ok for sleeping but not if you intend to spend more time in it (if for instance you need to part-time work); they could have given us the smallest rooms as we were one person staying in a room (I was with my son, and he wants privacy at his age, which I understand). Cleanliness was ok, I'm not that picky, except for the bedside table. I absolutely loved the presence of a sauna (no swimming pool). As we went sightseeing every day, additional fitness was not something we needed; if it is to you, there are a few treadmills and hometrainers. 
We took the optional breakfast, which was simple (buffet with limited choices) but ok. It is in the attached restaurant with which the hotel has some kind of agreement (same building, not same company).
They have some family games (board games), a few arcade games and a big TV wall in the lobby, and a form of pool biljarts. There's a toddler entertainment room as well with large pillows. 
The personnel was friendly and helpful.

title: Poor hotel
text:
Did not respond my email neither have done the refund. I called them twice and never had answer. 
Trying the contact several days before arriving to change the date, but never got a solution.
Lose my reservation money.
Not recommended

title: Great stay
text: Location is great. 15 min walk from the Eiffel Tower.  3 subway stations at 10 min walk but the area is relatively quiet, green and close to the Seine. Monoprix and brand new shopping center around the corner. Art design and a "gaming design" concepted throughout the building and a public area where parents and children can relax, play (video) games, board games, play pool, etc also make it an attractive place for children and parents to come back to after a long day of walking around town. Staff really friendly and helpful. Make sure to send them an email upfront if you want a parking spot.

title: Pleasant stay for perfect price in central Paris.
text: Room was very nice. Clean, spacious enough for the 4 of us. Checking in at 3 was not possible because the room wasn't ready, that was a bit dissapointing. Breakfast was fine. Fresh and simple, but satisfying. The arcade like entrance was a nice surprice! Pleasant stay, all together!

title: Great hotel / easy walk to Eiffel Tower
text:
Clean Hotel, Good neighborhood.  Kids loved the bunk beds.  Paid for Breakfast was good.  Really close to Eiffel tower.  They always had rental scooter and bike close too!!!

I would recommend this for families.  Loved the stay!

title: Staff lying in all possible ways to avoid having to deal with faulty room
text: "We are all trainees", "there is no night manager", "there is no duty manager", " we are fully booked" (x 5), "there is nothing we can do","here is a fan, it works very well", "I will come check it in 20 min", "I will call your room" (rooms have no phones). All quotes from replies from reception staff to my report of not working air conditioning in hot, stuffy room. Until after 45 min of insisting, one of them loitering behind the reception did offer 2 other rooms for me to check to move to. In this "fully booked hotel". Only your cash and their convenience seem to matter here. Before, check in took over 30 min, all pre-paid and without any complication. Not a 'terrible' score just because of their location.

title: Great family hotel
text:
We found this hotel on a hostel list of Paris, but it is much more time of a hotel than a hostel. The room was beautiful in its simple color concept, functional and cosy. The hotel has many special rooms which use is free of charge, just like a play room, extra showers/baby bath/microwave rooms and even a fitness room with a sauna. Towels included. The kids and I had a lot of fun down there! 
Also, the hotel is within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower, Paris Aquarium and a great Australian Café called O’Coffee, which was just perfect for us. Will come back!

title: Very pleasant stay
text: We had a very pleasant stay at Yooma, family with 3 kids. Good base to visit Paris with parking space. The rooms hheb everything you need for a city trip,  also special room for the baby, to warm milk and give him a wash.  The people at the reception and bar where very helpfull. The (veggie) restaurant at the hotel is delicious,  and I'm a meat eater !  We will be back...

title: Great hotel for price
text: Very reasonably priced hotel. The staff were very friendly. The room was small but very well designed, with beds you could slide to make a double or two singles, a flip-up table and plenty of USB charging points. It was clean and the beds were comfortable. We paid for the buffet breakfast both mornings and it was delicious.

title: Great location, terrible smell
text: Overall I cannot complain massively about Yooma. The hotel is a good price per night considering how close it is to the Eiffel Tower. The staff were extremely attentive and friendly helping with getting us to Disneyland as well as laying roses in my room prior to arrival which was a surprise for my other half. The room was mostly clean apart from some hairs found and the top shelf in need of a dust. It had everything we needed. The only bad thing I can really say that would put me off staying again is the smell. We had seen the reviews on here and almost cancelled and went elsewhere but decided to just brave it. It was awful. A sewer like smell that was constantly lingering it was really hard to not think about. It’s something that is clearly needing resolved as the reviews mentioning the smell have been going on for years. If you’re looking for a well priced average hotel focused on location and preferably have a nose clip, stay here!

title: Zero cleanliness
text:
Have just checked in to this hotel for 2x nights while in Paris. On arrival lobby and restaurant presents well. Checked in to our blue room to find many hairs - long, medium, very small all dark on every bed, on the doona, the sheets everywhere, dark stain, old wet stain with short hairs? and the room smelt strong of cat urine.

Went to reception to speak to the gentleman whom gave us a new key for a different room. This room now orange in colour but the same otherwise had a foul mouldy wet socks odour and the beds - all 4 had the exact same issue, dark hairs long and short on top and under the bed sheets.  By this stage we were very disgusted and physically unable to sleep at the hotel for obvious reasons.

Back to reception we proceeded where the gentleman claims he is unable to do any refunds as this has to be done by the manager Hector the following day. He could not tell us whether we would be able to receive a full refund if we walked away this stage or not. By this stage it’s 2330 and we are rather exhausted as had just arrived from London so agreed to let the gentlemen show us a third room.

This time we insisted the gentleman behind the counter escorted us to the third room to see for himself the standards of his hotel. This room was of a mustard yellow and that of a wheelchair accessible room with an off putting shower and no surprise more hair on the beds.

DO NOT STAY HERE!

title: Desperate need of a clean
text: The only good feature of the hotel is the location. The hotel is generally filthy, the lobby, walkways and the rooms. There was a terribly smell throughout the hotel and in our room. There were stains on the walls and the tv remove was covered in dirt and dust. The staff were generally un helpful and unpleasant. While the hotel looks great in the photos with the games in the lobby and bunk bends it is not worth the money.

title: Awful smell
text: Visited here for one night after a disney trip and a family of four. Entrance to hotel was quite grotty and rundown but was happier when I saw the lobby, it was bright comfortable and inviting. Check in was fine. Once we reached the first floor however, the smell hit us. It smelt like sewage, damp and stale sweat combined into the worst smell  imaginable. My daughter commented that the steel doors on the rooms reminded her of losing doors. When we opened the door to our room, the smell was even worse so we had to open window straight away and spray deodorant just to breathe easily. Room was adequate, teenager loved the USB ports and lights in the pod but was very cramped and not the cleanest.  Location was very good , other than that I wouldn't recommend.

title: Worst ever hotel in Paris
text:
1. The room was smelling awful all along our stay, probably something was wrong on the ventilation system with the toilet.
2. There was no fridge in the room so we couldn't have anything that needs a frige like a yogurt or a milk for the children.
3. The room was very dirty, you could see huge pieces of dust under our beds.
4. Very poor breakfast buffet, we paid 28€ per day to have just bread, croissants, milk, coffee and juces. We paid the breakfast for all the week of our stay at our arrival day and every morning the staff had to verify that we had paid for it to the reception. One morning we got in the breakfast room at 7:15 (it opens at 7:00) and they had on the buffet only bread they brought the croissants at 7:45 and you had to pay extra to get  eggs, bacons or an omelette.
5. Inside the bath all the walls were full of marks like they haven't ever cleaned them.
The only good thing is the small distance from Eiffel Tower and the connectivity with many usb ports.
I don't recommend this hotel even for one night

title: Roaches
text:
The cleaning of the hotel needs to improve, there was an smell in all the common areas and the rooms where not that clean and the shower door didn't close properly so the floor was completely wet. 
But the worst was to wake up to my wife screaming because a big roach in the bathroom, this is a huughe no no, only means that they have a serious cleaning problem and they need to addressed, the location of the hotel is the only thing that i can highlight, walking distance to Tour Eiffel and a nice shopping mall, other than that including service was very poor

title: Minimal hotel with some - and som +
text:
While visiting Paris a hotel with a good bed & bathroom is convenient enough. This is what YOOMA offers - the room is really as small as possible, your clothings, suitcase, jacket, shoes, etc. need to be very well placed in order to leave the tiny walking space open, so you will not struggle over stuff at night. The bed was just fine, though 1 of the 2 bed lights was broken. The bathroom seemed new and was fine, except that after taking a shower, the floor of the bathroom AND the tiny hallway was filled with 1cm water... 
The rest of the hotel was like this: 
-  the temperature in the hallways was 30 degrees Celsius, and had a nasty smell, so you had to close your nose and take a sprint to and from the elevator to your room. 
- breakfast was very poor
- we had a beer, which was warm and tasting like a cleaning solution (same taste as the fried egg at breakfast, probably same cleaning detergent)
- checking in took ages, unclear why

Location was fine, right at the Seine. Across the river were some nice bars and restaurants (close to Radio France building).

title: Bad experience - unclean and bad service
text:
Quality of the room was bad. Rooms are very small and lack comfort. You can’t even make a cup of coffee or tea in your room.
Worst thing is that our room was’t clean: 
- beds were not cleaned, still had hairs from previous guests in it.
- cups in the bathroom were filthy.
- shower was leaking.
After making a complaint in the morning, the beds had not been changed when we returned in the evening. Eventually, we were moved to a different room, which also wasn’t great as lights were not working and the wall above the bed was covered in dust.
Service was pretty bad and employees seemed hardly interested in our complaint. Would not recommend this place.

title: Interesting hotel
text:
We stayed for the Christmas eve and day in Yooma hotel. The setting is very interesting - we were 5 people in 1 room. One double bed and two bulk beds with doors that you can close behind you. So, basically, 6 beds. Of course, our kids took the bulks right away and were very happy about it.
The hotel itself is very clean and nice, the staff is very pleasant, we had a wonderful experience! The location is also great - it's walking distance from the Eiffel Tower.
The less I liked about this hotel is the breakfast. There was literally nothing to eat - just bread and butter and couple of croissants, tea, coffee. That's it! For this we had to pay 10 Euros per person!!! That was not nice at all.
The dining room was closed for lunch and dinner because of Christmas, so I can't say anything about it.
The hotel has a great gym, a sauna, a baby room, kids room, the lobby is filled with arcade games and all in all it's perfect for families and teenagers. It's possible to eat breakfast elsewhere - there is a mall nearby and also other restaurants.

title: Great family friendly accommodation
text: Our family of five, with teenagers stayed in the bunk room. It was modern, clean and neat, had most facilities we needed, USB chargers, separate shower and toilet, except a fridge. Laundry was handy, as was the location to the city and metro. Easy walk to the tower! The staff were very friendly and helpful, would definitely stay here again. A locker room downstairs for 2 euros/24hrs was also handy. For a cheap and great burger/pizza/kebab feed, try "O'best of" just a few minutes walk 😀

title: Christmas days
text: Nice room for 2 adults and 2 kids. That was the only nice thing i can say about the hotel. Poor breakfast and under staffing of personal. The 1 girl that was helping everybody was very nice and did the best she could. As i understood everybody else was joining a strike in Paris. So they had to close all extra's they normally offer like coffee bar etc. I would reccomend to pay somewhat more for a bigger hotel with decent breakfast and enough personel to help.

title: So comfotable!
text:
The rooms are small, like cabins on a boat. But they are so smartly equipped and constructed, as well as the bathroom, that you forget about it. The bed is very comfortable, the curtains very efficient. The whole hotel is nice, people very helpful.
Only the basic breakfast is a bit disappointing.

title: Yooma Urban lodge score
text:
Scale of 1 to 10
1.Location score is 9- just around 15min walk to Eiffel Tower & 5min to train station.
2.Hotel room score is 5- very small for a family of 5, which I booked for ,but bedmattress are good.
3.Housekeeping score is 3- room is not cleaned properly & the washbasin in the bathroom is clogged all through out our 2nights stay.
4. Receptionist score is 8- most of them are nice but some are having some unpleasant attitude.
The average score I can give 6 out of 10.

title: Family Holiday in Paris!
text: Had a wonderful time in Paris. And loved YOOMA! So close to everything we could walk to all the major sites. Great to sit in the lounge after a long day as tourists, have a drink and bar meal. Great restaurants with in a few minutes walk👍 Perfect for our family of 5.

title: Convenient hotel for families of groups of friend. Walking distance to Eiffel Tour.
text:
The positive: The hotel is interesting for family and friends, since the rooms have 4, 5 or 6 beds. This is quite "unique" in Paris. The rooms are nice, modern, stylish, clean and bed comfortable. It has a nice lobby where you can have a drink. There is a restaurant also where they serve the breakfast. The hotel is 15 min. walking to the Eiffel Tower and, in the opposite direction, 5 min. walking there is the Rue Linois, where you can find a lot of shops, cafés and restaurants. Metro station is also close.

Place for improvement: It is a modern part of the city, though; you will not find a lot of charm there. 
My experience with the management of the booking is that I had a problem with the cancelation of one room -the increased the price of the other room!- , but I put a claim and they admitted the mistake and solved very quickly the day after. 
A little negative detail -probably an stagier in the reception desk-  I phoned them to see if they could call a taxi for me with a fix price to the airport, they say yes, and then I went there to take my luggage, asked again for the taxi, and they said that it was not possible. I had to go to the Novotel hotel, just beside, and they did it without problems.
The place where you can leave your luggage  after doing the check-out is paying, 2€ per day or you can pay per hour also.
In summary: If you are a family or group of friends and you are interested in nice rooms with good 4, 5 or 6 beds, this is your place. I recommend it.
But if you come as a couple, or maybe only with one child, you will probably find other hotels in more charming places. Its up to you!

title: Stayed with family of 6
text:
Pros:
Affordable for large family 
8 minute walk to Metropolitan 
Close to Eiffel Tower
5 minute walk to Monoprix (grocery store)
Accommodated my family of 6 
Comfortable beds
Reliable WiFi 
Hector (front desk) very helpful and kind

Cons:
Bare bones hotel room...only soap provided and when asked for extra pillows (4 pillows) they only provided ONE.
3 of the 4 lights in the bunk beds did not work.
Common areas and hallways have a terrible smell.

title: Cool Place to stay in Paris!
text:
Great price for family of four & convenient location!  Easy walk to Eiffel Tower!
Would have appreciated Continental Breakfast, or just coffee & tea provided in rooms.
Bar in large lobby is a nice touch to relax & re-group!

title: didnt like it
text: Coming into the hotel I though it had real promise, the staff was friendly on arrival and the lobby area was nice and relaxed. The positive for me stopped there. Entering the room it was clean but it had a odor. Over 4 days staying there it didnt go away. I even tried a plug in freshener to no avail. I went to take a shower and noticed it was no wash clothes. I though maybe they just forgot so I went down to the lobby to ask for one (because there's no phones in the room) and they said they don't provide them. What hotel doesn't provide wash clothes! The shower also had a really bad smell due to the fact they had painted drywall and wood as part of the walls in the shower! The breakfast which you had to pay for only included pastries and coffee/juice, you had to pay extra for eggs and sausage. Overall I just didnt like the experience I had in this hotel. Simple things that hotels of this price range this hotel doesn't provide. The ONLY good thing about this hotel is its about 5 mins walk from the metro and 10 mins walk from Eiffel tower

title: Great hotel
text: Hotel was great! Location was perfect, walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. Walking distance to shopping, restaurants and sight seeing. The kids loved the bunkbeds! And, every staff member we interacted with was just awesome! Very impressed with this hotel.

Norma García

title: Unique & Modern
text: I really enjoyed my stay at Yooma.  I honestly have no complaints, but there are two things for people to be aware of:   1) The lights in the room are on timers to save energy, so be prepared to have the lights go out suddenly.  A quick push of a button brings them right back on, but it can be rather scary at first if you aren't expecting it, especially if you are in the shower when it happens!  2) The restaurant onsite is completely vegetarian at dinnertime. 3) The breakfast buffet does not include eggs, meat, etc. without an extra charge.  It is only breads, pastries, juice & coffee/tea.

title: Great hotel
text:
Great hotel, very clean and well presented. The rooms are very well organised and perfect for families. The only thing I would say which is negative are that the rooms are too hot (24degrees) and we were unable to turn the heating down. 
Great bathrooms and good water pressure. Would stay again.

title: Very Nice
text:
Hotel was nice for the price we paid for. Good location, walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and shopping center. 
We included breakfast however breakfast only includes bread and drinks (no fruit, eggs or meat).

title: Great for families, but watch out for clean glasses at the bar.
text: Very friendly check in, with great advice for a neaby restaurant (L'Abreuvoir). Room simple and rather small for 4 (you don't want to stay during daytime anyway), with the beds about the best we ever had in a hotel. Bath was clean, toilet separate - also great when traveling with 4 people. TV even had German channels. Breakfast very basic (Paris stile, just baguette, toast and croissants with jam and honey and cornflakes). Eggs cost extra, and 3 Euros extra for 3 slices of simple cheese is tough. However, with kids you don't want to go out to look for breakfast, though Beaugrenelle shopping mall is very close with Mc Donalds etc... Some youth-group made a lot of noise in the corridor at night, but we had earbuds so no problem.   Now to the downside: Our kids still are used to a glass of milk in the evening. In the dim light of the bar I saw that the glasses were wet, and was assured they came straight out of the dishwasher. Barkeeper had to ask manager for price, who decided it would cost EUR 4 per glass - I am talking about milk directly from the package. Most hotels offer milk for kids for free or charge EUR 1 or 2. Then in better light in the elevator I saw that the glasses were dirty - looked like lipstik. So back to the bar, where I was assured it was tomato juice from the dishwasher. Asked for clean glasses, a colleague of the waiter said in french he should refund, but that was no option, as I needed the milk for the kids. So finally glasses hand-rinsed and new milk. The best thing was the statement by that other waiter: "French kids don't drink milk!" really? So my suggestion: get a new dishwasher at the bar, and - as a family hotel - get milk on the menu at a reasonable price.

title: Good for school groups, a little rough around the edges and service prior to arrival could be improved
text:
We stayed as a school group. Service was good at check in and at every point during our stay. The location and atmosphere of the hotel were great, a 15 minute walk to the eiffel tower and 10 minutes to the metro. Leading up to check-in I found the service via email to be lacking (chasing for email responses and waiting weeks for replies). Once they did reply, they were accommodating with my requests. They only respond to emails in french - to be expected but worth noting. 

Personally, my room was a little rough around the edges, with some walls stained and the entrance to the room had a funny smell. The room was OK, not enough to complain about, but enough to notice. Bed was comfortable and clean. The bathroom was ok, the shower was hot and powerful but the jets from the ceiling sprayed in all directions, getting water everywhere! 

Overall I would stay here again as a group, but would consider looking elsewhere if I was booking as a couple.

title: Ideal solution for families but very poor service and maintenance!
text:
if you are travelling with a family of 5, YOOMA is one of the few hotel solutions (if not the only one) you can find in Paris. so a big plus for this.
However, big minuses:
- room maintenance and cleaning very very poor: 2/2 bed lamps of the queen bed not working ("we are waiting for new bulbs which will not come before next week"); safety box not working ("battery low, I am sorry" - but never fixed during our 3 days stay); door of the shower not closing properly - water all around the bathroom; floor and walls very dirty
- breakfast: very poor selection of things but, as a matter of fact, it's very cheap, so no complaint about that. However staff is not welcoming at all and at 9.50 of sunday morning all the buffet was already being removed and we were not accepted as they close at 10.
In essence, still A LONG WAY TO BECOME A FAMILY FRIENDLY destination.

title: A perfect base for families to explore Paris - but have breakfast somewhere else!
text:
It is so difficult to find hotels which offer rooms for a family with more than 2 children, so we were delighted to find the Yooma Urban Lodge which offers rooms that can sleep 2 adults and up to 4 children! My husband and I had a double bed, our 3 kids were thrilled to have their own bunk beds with sliding doors, their own lights, charging units etc. Fresh white bedding, a smart shower room & separate loo, and plenty of charging units and plugs, completed the room. The location is excellent, literally a 5-10 minute walk along the river to the Eiffel Tower. Close by is a large shopping centre, cafes etc. We paid extra to park in the Yooma carpark, which is off-road and secure, another plus. It is not French or “Parisian” in any way but, all in all, it was perfect for our needs as a comfortable base to explore Paris.
However..... I didn’t give it 5 stars because the hotel is really let down by the restaurant at breakfast time. The offering is limited to croissants and pains au chocolat, and bread. There was no fresh fruit or yoghurt, and the only cereals offered were cornflakes and coco pops. You can pay extra to have eggs or a slice of cheese or ham. Only 1 hot drinks machine was working so I had to queue for 15 minutes to get a coffee. And only 1 toaster available (1 slow one not an industrial hotel-style one, so it took ages to get a piece of toast!). There also seemed to be a shortage of places to sit for groups of more than 2 people, and strangely the larger central tables were all set out for lunch and “reserved” - but at breakfast time! 
I would definitely stay here again, and recommend it to others, but we’ll have breakfast at the cafe round the corner!

title: Great for families!
text: There were 6 of us in the group and the room with a queen bed and 2 bunk beds was sufficient. Each bed had their own light and USB & electrical outlets. Toilet was separate from the shower room which helped with the "rush hour traffic". Staff and facilities were great.  Typical continental breakfast: bread, jam, cereal, juice, hot drinks. Walking distance to metro stations, Eiffel Tower, food places and shopping. Perfect for families and big groups.

title: Stuck in elevator
text: My daughter and I were trapped in their tiny elevator for nearly an hour.  Their response was to offer us a few bottles of water and joking offer for us to ride in it again the next day.  Thru said that mechanical items break so I assume this was a common occurrence. Otherwise an average hotel with rooms for families of 5-6 with a horrible stench in the hallways.

title: Room for family of 5 very close to Eiffel Tower
text: Location is amazing for the price, a 15 min walk to the Eiffel Tower and you can see it from just outside the hotel, much to the kids delight.  This is a budget hotel and the room configuration worked well with the kids loving the bunk beds. Breakfast was rather disappointing & basic so we opted to find alternative locally which didn’t disappoint.  Staff are polite but service didn’t come with a smile.

title: Expensive, but great hotel. Rooms very small.
text: I loved this hotel! Superb location right in Champs Elysee. The hotel is very modern, nicely decorated, with a rooftop with a view of Effeil Tour! Staff is very friendly. Cafeteria 24 hours. Rooms are very comfortable, HOWEVER, very small! If you have a large suitcase, this hotel is not for you. If you have two small suitcases you will also have problems! The rooms are only 14mts. For that, I found the hotel quite expensive.

title: Greta stay ruined by incorrect double charge of room

The hotel was in an excellent location. Walking distance for shopping, Uber and taxi accessible. Excellent restaurants around the area. Monoprix in front where you can get essentials. Aside from the fiasco of the double hotel charge it could have been a very excellent stay.

Staff are friendly, approachable and helpful. Nothing was too much trouble. 
Quirky beds! They're large and comfortable but located such that you have to slide on and off them. Don't let that put you off! 
There are some great outside areas to enjoy a drink in the sunshine. We had breakfast on two mornings and it was very good.
Take your Uber app. It made getting around so easy.

Also, a nice enclosed patio when the weather is warm.

title: Wonderful experience! TICKS ALL BOXES!
text:
Where was I all this time! 

I  rate my recent 5 night stay at CitizenM as one of best   hotels  I have stayed in Paris! This place ticks most if not all the boxes anyone would be concerned about. 

1) location - main shopping belt, walking distance to most attractions. There are also many  dining options from affordable to luxurious, at your discretion.  
2) cost - very reasonable
3) Cleanliness - 100% in your room and all common area. I particularly love the wooden floor, knowing that it is clean and free from thick carpet dirt and mites.
4) bed and comfort- nice firm mattress and fluffy pillows. 
5) Bedroom size and layout - compact but it has everything including a spacious  walk in shower with High water pressure, a little chiller fridge, safe box, writing desk, and International Power sockets, under bed drawers etc! 
6) super chill vibes at  bar, dining , work space on L2/ open terrace.
7) cool ipad/ phone app for inroom controls/ requests etc.
8)  Friendly staff and superb support from lovely International Team of staff - Cheryl, Wonder,  Francesa, etc etc..sorry I can't remember many names! 

I strongly recommend everyone to give this a try!

title: Extremely high quality with an unbeatable location at a crazily good price!
text:
Loved the experience, not our first time with the brand. The location is unbeatable, 5 actual steps from the Champs Elysées, crazy for the price. Spotlessly clean and well maintained, there was even a cot already in the room when they said they didn’t provide them. Food was great and high quality at breakfast plus very reasonable and each and every member of staff could not have been more friendly, efficient and helpful. 
Only negative was that the bathroom got flooded with the shower being a wet room. It meant all day afterwards and night you got wet feet when using the loo. Otherwise we loved the fluffy towels, oversize bed, perfect blackout blind that really did blackout and fun room tech. Everything was easy, efficient and worked well to make for a really comfortable and easy stay. An extremely high quality experience that we can recommend without hesitation! There is also a lovely outdoor terrace which we didn’t use cause it was too cold but will be great in summer.

title: Lots of good reviews but we were disappointed
text:
A new building in a particularly appealing part of Paris. Close to the Metropolitain; lots of very good restaurants close by; rue du Commerce with plenty of shops is just around the corner. No parking at the hotel and no 5 minute parking in front either and we noted that cars parked in the street on a Monday were all papered with E35 parking tickets. There is a parking building about 7 minutes walk away. 
(Prepay for parking through Parclick or similar and get a lower rate than advised to me by the hotel. You also get unlimited entries and exits for the duration of your booking). Staff were all excellent, spoke English fluently and couldn't have been more helpful. Housekeeping is of a very high standard.

There is a swimming pool and a hammam at the first level souterrain which is a nice bonus. 

The very small lobby and bar has seating for less than 10 people. Perhaps because of that, we didn't see anyone using the bar during our 4 nights.

Everything about this hotel was small, except for the bathroom. We booked a "comfort" room at E190 per night but comfortable it was not. Using the term "comfort" to describe the room is seriously misleading. We carried two overhead-locker-size suitcases but there was no space to leave them out, even zipped up. The edge of the bed had gone soft on one side, perhaps from people using it as a seat. There was one small chair in the corner of the room that blocked off easy access to the very small wardrobe. Getting to the bathroom in the middle of the night was a matter of bouncing off obstructions en route.

The breakfast area is equally small and is therefore cramped. The offering at E17 includes cereals and hot dishes. We checked it out - the hot dishes may or may not appeal (they didn't to us) so we opted to eat at one of the nearby brasseries for somewhat less cost.

We have been staying at some of the brand-name hotels during our tour of la belle France and should have stuck with them. Rooms are larger and more comfortable, generally, and not priced as high as this hotel. We think this hotel is overpriced. Despite trying hard it is hampered by being cramped and small.

title: Wonderful hotel and experience!
text:
We stayed in the "family room," which was 2 adjoining rooms. Our room was clean, comfortable, modern and had all the necessities we needed. The rooms were amazingly quiet - even with the adjoining rooms, we never heard anyone in the other room, no TV sounds, etc. Each day we were left with 2 bottles of water, turn down service at night, and excellent cleaning service. The room has a good hair dryer and shampoo, soap, etc. The  hotel and rooms also have A/C, which was definitely needed in July.

The staff at Les Jardins de Madamoiselle were ALL over the top in their customer service. They were helpful as we planned our days, attentive to every need, very friendly, polite, and accommodating. We arrived very early and they worked to get us in our room that morning, offering us cold water and croissants and suggestions for things to do as we waited. Sophie and Alexandra were especially helpful and their English is perfect!

The hotel has a pool, which our kids enjoyed especially during the heat wave. It's clean and nice. There is also a nice steam room. We also spent time on the outside terrace which had comfortable sitting areas and lots of wonderful smells from all of the herbs growing there. It is beautiful! You can order service from the terrace and they will bring you whatever you need.

The hotel is very conveniently located - less than 30 minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower, less than a minute to the bus station, and 5 minutes to the metro station. There are tons of really good restaurants and shops and several grocery stores close by. It really is in a wonderful, safe location that is out of the crowds and noise but close to everywhere you want to go.

There is nothing I would change about this hotel or its staff. We had a perfect stay (6 nights) and would definitely stay there again. We hated to leave! I highly recommend Les Jardins de Mademoiselle!

title: Lovely little hotel conveniently located in the heart of Paris
text:
My mother and I visited Paris in July 2019 to see the sights, as one does. We stayed in Les Jardins de Madamoiselle for 3 nights, and were happily suprised by the quality of the accommodation and facilities. The swimming pool was just long enough for lengths, and the steam room was warm and comfortable. The gym left a little to be desired, but considering it was in the basement of a relatively small hotel it was still a nice facility to have.
The rooms themselves were modern, clean and comfortable, if a little small; the air con was efficient and quiet; the shower was powerful; and most rooms command a lovely view over either the street or interior garden. My mum was especially pleased to be able to see the Eiffel Tower from her suite on the top floor.
The hotel is situated near many lovely restaurants and cafés (more than enough for a different restaurant each day of a visit) and we found that the eiffel tower could be reached in half an hour of walking. The hotel is also very near the Commerce metro station on line 8.
All in all this hotel was fantastic. I would thoroughly recommend it to anyone travelling to Paris on holiday.

When I get back to Paris, I will definitely want to stay again!

title: Luxury Boutique Hotel in Residential Zone with Small Rooms & Service Challenges
text: Les Jardins de Mademoiselle is one year old, located in a quaint residential Parisienne neighborhood convenient to all of Paris via the Metro.  The lobby is small but modern and clean.  There is a small outside private garden to sit.  The breakfast room is a tiny "L" shape with barely enough room for the servers to work.  The receptionist, Anna (I believe) was welcoming and allowed us our room early.  Our room was small but modern and had a balcony.  Breakfast was very good and well beyond continental.  My only complaint occurred just before checkout.  Our flight was delayed so I wanted to change the time of my taxi pick-up from 7 am to later.  I tried calling the front desk for nearly 40 minutes with no one answering.  What would have happened if me or a guest suffered an emergency such as medical or if we were attacked?  I spoke to the receptionist who said that he had to go downstairs and set-up breakfast.  I told him that he should have a cell phone which he said he did but it did not work.  He told management.  This is a horrible breach of faith for a hotel that we paid nearly $220 per night.  Would I stay here again?  Probably not.  Would I recommend it to others?  Probably not.

title: Great Hotel and Location
text:
Had a wonderful stay at the hotel last week whilst exploring Paris. Hotel is very conveniently located in a delightful, safe, and accessible neighbourhood. Very short walk to Commerce Metro, making it simple to reach any part of the city (handy if you are arriving by Eurostar). Having said this, we felt it was a pleasant walk to (or at least back from) any of the major sights along the Seine, so opted to do this most days. It is also a direct walk to the Eiffel Tower.  We were always greeted by friendly and welcoming staff, who were keen to help and ensure our stay was comfortable. The room was small by American standards, but reasonable for a European city hotel. Our room (which overlooked the quiet courtyard) was always cleaned thoroughly and had everything we needed for a short stay. The pool was immaculate. We did not have breakfast as there are many delicious boulangeries/shops in the area. 
Overall, this is a great hotel if you want a clean and comfortable base for exploring Paris, which is located a convenient distance from the 'tourist-trap' areas. I hope this new hotel maintains these high standards, so we can use it as our 'go-to' hotel when visiting the city!

title: Enjoy the terrasse
text: A very clean and new hotel with outstanding staff.  Rooms are average size for Paris, so no surprise.  The shower is new and works very well.  We are not breakfast people, so we had espresso brought to the room each morning.  As others have written, the pool is brand-spanking new and very clean.  The steam bath is often not hot enough, something which could be easily remedied.  The hotel is on a quiet street within easy walking access to the Commerce metro.  If I was to give one recommendation, I would suggest that you purchase pates, roast chicken, foie gras and several salads from the Boucherie du Square on Rue du Commerce.  There is also a cheesemonger on the same street.  We purchased all that plus bread and wine (also on the same street) and had a wonderful picnic on the 4th-floor terrace of the hotel.  The staff provided us plates, wine glasses and utensils and even cleared everything away.   Frankly, this was one of our best meals in Paris.  There are also neighborhood bistros for coffee or beer/wine.  This locale is great if you want to get away from the hustle bustle of the more touristy areas yet still be within easy reach via subway.

Cons: Bath is not comftable. Difficult to step out from bath without sliping. Also the tap  is not suitable to the sink. So it's not easy to wash face. Vew from the room is nice but not as nice as promised. Breakfest isn't included.
description: Completely renovated and opened in June, 2018, Les Jardins de Mademoiselle is a real treasure of greenery right in the heart of Paris! Convenient to the business trips and leisure activities, alone or in family, the hotel offers rooms, reminiscent of nature at all times. It will seduce you with its gardens, terrace on the roofs of the city, heated pool, hammam and fitness. A real moment of rest in the City of Light

title: Excellent hotel, location and staff.
text: Came here on opening day. Fab hotel, brand new and clean. Excellent location and excellent staff. Highly recommend this hotel when staying in Paris. I stayed here for business and my room was quiet which is essential for me.

title: Helpful, sincere, friendly service.
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. From the night shift that helped us when we cant find any room in Paris until the bell desk that get our luggage and help us from the tiring night. The hotel is wonderful and clean. The room is cute and pretty. Don’t expect a big room, but still acceptable for a short stay. Thank you for all the friendliness. 🙏🙏🙏

title: Heavenly stay!
text:
Being picky and demanding in everything about my upcoming holidays, I made no exception when I was considering to stay in this hotel. I was talking to the reservations office about my room, to the concierge about the plan of my stay in Paris, to the front desk about a billion tiny things. When I stay at the hotel for the first time, I want everything to be checked and confirmed. And everyone at this hotel was friendly and ready to help me with my requests, and they have done everything to make me feel as a precious guest.
From the check-in to the check-out, everything was perfectly prepared according to my requests. The staff was amazing. And most important - their beds are just the best in the world. I can't even reckon when I was sleeping so well in my life - it's like you are sleeping on a cloud.
It looks likes I found my best hotel in Paris!

title: Nice Stay
text:
Let start with the positives: Our room was on the corner, second floor. Despite facing the road we never heard any noise from outside. The sound proofing is amazing. It had all of the necessities and the bath was a nice size. The breakfast was very nice, although it is in a soulless room in the basement. The location near the Opera was wonderful. The Opera metro has numerous lines.

Less than optimal: I'm not sure which room type we had (It was a group package.), but the room was tiny. There was one chair crammed in the corner, which made getting around the bed difficult. The real problem was there was no place to open our luggage! We had to put them on the bed, unpack, and then stack them in the narrow hallway near our bathroom. Fortunately, we did not spend much time in the room. There is so much to see in Paris!
Also, the service in the bar area was not great. The first evening we went in for a drink, no one ever came to serve us. There were workers there, but we were ignored and we were a group of eight! We finally just gave up and left. The next time we had to go to the bar and ask for someone to wait on us. 
The front desk was trying, but the one woman seemed very new. She immediately upon checkin charge our credit card for over $600 dollars as a deposit against "expenses"! The room was pre paid. After a small protest on our part, they changed it to $300. We did not use the concerige.

title: Excellent Hotel in the shopping heart of Paris
text:
The hotel is located next to the "opera Garnier", and very close to "grands magasins". the staff is welcoming, as per Sofitel standard.
The renovated rooms are very pleasant.
The room are filled with excellent bed, coffee machine

title: Excellent, Excellent, Excellent - Don't Look Any Further!
text: Magnificent hotel in one of the most desirable locations in the whole city.  Quintessential Paris architecture greets you as  you arrive, with best in class service from the staff.  Assistant Manager Stephanie is a gift who anticipated any need we had throughout our stay, and was so welcoming to our two boys.  The rest of the staff - the concierge staff, the front desk team and the bellman, to name some - were excellent at their jobs, attentive and friendly.  And the room!  Where to start?  The suite was beyond gorgeous, with not only every detail considered (absolutely spectacular linens, perfectly appointed bathrooms, beautiful bar area), but also gorgeously designed, painstakingly taking care to respect the building's heritage while expressing an elegant design point of view.  You really don't need to look any further - the Scribe is a true gem, and completely heightened our Paris experience.

title: First in 1st
text: This was the first time at Scribe and won’t be my last. Generally I book in smaller Botique hotels in the 1st arrondissement but no more. The service at Sofitel Scribe was above and beyond and super helpful. The location outstanding and hotel super classy in its design and lay out. Fab experience for work and play!

title: Never again.
text: An impossibly loud air conditioning engine installed outside our window meant you couldn’t sleep at all. Unfriendly and unhelpful receptionist who hangs up on you when unable to find a solution. Balmain shampoo container was empty. No help with luggage to your room. Long queue for check out on a Sunday morning. Never again.

title: Wonderful hotel in middle of downtown Paris. Staff was great beautiful lobby restaurant and bar area
text:
Wonderful hotel in middle of downtown Paris. Staff was great beautiful lobby restaurant and bar area  
Outside great place to people watch.  Close to Galleria Lafayette the Louvre and the Opera house.
Across street from Intercontinental with a wonderful beautiful lobby.

title: Renovation to a cost.
text:
First time in the Sofitel Scribe since it has been renovated and renamed. This hotel has the big advantage of an excellent location. 
Some plusses like the very good welcome at the reception and the more modern look , particularly the nicely decorated bedroom and beautiful TV, but unfortunately many downsides 
- rooms are not sufficiently protected from neighbour noise.  Mine had only a door with the adjacent room and I could hear all the conversation coming from there .
- rooms overlooking the courtyard are under constant rumbling from machinery. 
- the bathroom has been renovated to a cost . No partitioning between the shower and the rest of the bathroom with water going everywhere after each shower. Probably this is to not to have to clean the window every day. A   towel supporting bar strutting out of the wall next to the toilet bowl forbid any proper seating  as we have to seat across.  
- Bedroom badly lightened with only two lamps. 

Too much an impression of cost cutting for a luxury hotel.

title: You MUST Stay Here!!!
text: I cannot say enough good things about this hotel! This is our second time staying here and we will ALWAYS stay here when visiting Paris.  It's centrally located in a great part of the city near many tourist spots and the metro. The staff - everyone from the front desk, the concierge, the bar - everyone  is absolutely amazing - very professional, pleasant and very accommodating.  The people staying in the room above ours was loud and the staff didn't hesitate to give us another room just so we can get some sleep. The entire hotel was recently remodeled and our room was spacious and well-appointed. You will not regret choosing this hotel for your stay in Paris!

title: Paris charm in L'Opera
text: This was a last minute booking and so lucky to find a comfortable room in this lovely part of Paris. The room was small but well designed with lots of charm and delightful ambience. The hotel staff were very friendly and professional. We liked the intimate size and quiet atmosphere. Recommended!

title: Excellent experience
text:
Thank you for the great experience..
1- early check-in for free.
2- attentive front office staff.
3- House keeping clean the room at morning and at night they setup the beds( thanks to Momo & LIly ).
4- high security, at night front office always double check the guest information before reactivate the room card, in my case I leave my teenager's kids alone and I know its safe no one will get in the room by mistake.
5- breakfast buffet was Amazing thanks to

title: Le Scribe.. a hidden delight
text:
I travelled to Le Scribe with my grand daughter (10 yrs) and the hotel was cost, staff friendly.. In Paris😉). April ( substitute)  a charming young lady made my grand daughter’s trip. Warm, engaging and caring! 
Our room was quiet and all was great but could improve in the cleanliness of the room ( ie: replacing cups/tea etc..)

title: Thank you Julie!
text:
Thanks to Julie at the front desk, we were checked in smoothly. Other front desk attendent definitely needs more training. At the end of our trip, we were told that we cannot extend our stay, due to fully booked situation. Later that night, I checked reservation, many rooms became available. Hopefully the reservation system can be upgraded to reflect actual occupancy. We had to move to another hotel for one night.

Thank you again Julie for such a wonderful and friendly experience.

title: Beautiful ! Everything was beautiful !
text:
We stayed here for four days and we loved this hotel to the hilt . As much as we loved the city actually ! 
Location was perfect . Just behind Le Opera. And close by we had great cafés , all around the hotel we had great shopping with galleries Lafayette absolutely round the corner. 
The rooms were well appointed. Very comfortable and super luxurious. We didn’t have breakfast at the hotel though as we preferred the sidewalks . But the Bar was sufficient for a quick drink and snacks. They had their own Le scribe cafe which I thoroughly and highly recommend for the number of teas and coffee they serve. Yes they are well stocked. And it’s quite so good to have an eager conversation in privacy.
We were lucky to be there in Bastile Day and watch the parade on the road opp the Hotel. With hardly any restrictions we saw the parade up, close & personal.

title: Microscopic rooms for $600/night
text: Rooms the size of coffins. Air conditioning is non existent. Completely overpriced - paying $600/night for a weekday rate and can’t even go around the bed without turning sideways. Total rip off. Avoid this place at all costs. Tried to get a bigger room and was told they had nothing which I highly doubt

title: Chaos & bad customer service at its best
text:
I am not sure whether it is incompetence, bad will or ignorance, but am willing to assume it is just the latter. A shortage of staff is not the issue as there are many employees around who only fail to deliver customer-oriented services. I do not want to provide a full list as I do not have the time or feel the urgency to do so, but just 2 examples:

- The details: I don't mind encountering a half-used toilet paper roll in-room, but then a spare roll would be nice as this can otherwise cause awkward issues. Happened at least twice.

- If you approach the reception desk manned with 3 people, then the 3rd person fails to produce an air of being busy and therefore decides to disappear through the back door. The other 2 busily do something and might notice you after a while.

Overall seem to be geared more towards (non-returning) travel groups. Room preferences of regulars & diamond members are likewise regularly ignored (I can't bear the phrase "next time" any longer). But the upshot is that after requesting & receiving the bill / fast check-out and leaving the hotel they follow up with additional (random/undocumented) charges afterwards.

The price point would be ok, if they would deliver, but at this performance level, there are cheaper and better options around. In the current state: Avoid staying here!

title: There are better 5 star hotels in Paris
text: We arrived for 5 nights at this hotel.  The location is very good, walking distance from Vendome Square, Concord Square, and Gallery Lafayette. Breakfast was good, and so was room service.  But the room is very small, something is wrong with the bed that was uneven and uncomfortable to sleep.  And the concierge , not something you can get help from!  All the time with his head on his computer, you will stand in front of him for an hour he will not even raise his head to ask what you need.

title: Great Location, Beautiful Room
text: This hotel is in an outstanding location. Our room was superb, with lovely amenities , and a great view. I felt like I was in Paris, by the decor in my room. Our bed was very comfortable. The breakfast was delicious, and the service attentive. The lobby resembled some of the smaller lobbies, I associate with boutique hotels, and was less ornamental than I had anticipated . We had a wonderful visit, and this hotel helped to make it memorable.

title: Worse experience in Paris
text:
Rubbish service 
Not too bad location
Took 2 hours to check in at 4pm
Incorrigible front desk who can't do basic maths.
Deposit taken is at a nose bleeding 4.2k euros for a 3 night stay.
Will never return
Laid back attitude from staff who doesn't give a hoot about what travellers who are experiencing jet lag or discomfort.
Met a family who got robbed and the front desk couldn't care less.
A 4 star hotel in a 4 star environment with a 2 star staff.
Strongly recommend people not to bother

Astray not cleared by room service and left by previous traveller.

title: Good hotel but very very bad concierge I met ever!
text:
I will tell my experience about the hotel. I stayed 6 nights at the hotel. My room was in third floor, hotel provide free upgrade upn my arrival to premium  luxury room with nice view.The reception  manager & reception staff are professional and  so friendly.Hotel locations is  excellent, near by shopping area. Just 5 mins walking from Gallery Lafayette. Breakfast buffet was good. Staff at buffet very professional.

My big comments about the Concierge!!!!!!!!!!! I was so shocked about him. Very rude and dismissive.
