the I can rate the hotel conciergie  zero  out of 10.  Zero skills, zero responsibilities, he never follow up my inquires, he don't have any experience about his duties and responsibilities and how to welcome the guest as well. 

he’s attitude as well not acceptable at all. I asked him many inquiries, simply he’s not doing anything at all. Just settings next to his laptop and that's it. So what I didn't, I visited neighbourhood hotel and they help me allots, which to be honest it's not acceptable that I am staying in 5 stars hotel and their concerns without any benefits. 

So please, I would ask the hotel to take care about this position because it's very important for the hotel reputation.

title: Amazing hotel and stay
text:
We stayed here in early March celebrating our 8 year anniversary. It was honestly such a beautiful hotel. The team went out of their way to make us feel special. Our room was beautiful and they left us such generous amenities. 
The location is perfect. We will definitely be back. Thank you

title: A hotel like no other
text: A stay at the Scribe is always a unique experience.   The renovation is complete so that this historic hotel now is completely upgraded. The staff is first rate from the housekeeper to the management always attentive to the guests’ needs.   We always stay at the Scribe while in Paris and would never stay elsewhere.

title: Great location, beautiful hotel
text: Very nice hotel with some minor hiccups. This hotel is in a great location in downtown Paris. Very close to Galleries Lafayette and many shops and restaurants. Breakfast buffet was very good, service is quick. We had a king room on the third floor (may have been a superior room). Room was decent size, did not feel cramped and the air conditioning worked very, very well. Rooms were recently redone so everything still looks new. Bed is comfortable and bedding is high quality. The bathroom is where I have some minor issues. First of all, there were zero hooks or towel bars in the bathroom so there is NO place to hang a towel or robe while using the shower or bath. There is a card by the sink saying if I reused my towels for 5 days, I would save a tree - unfortunately, without any hooks or towel bars, it is hard to reuse a towel for one day let alone 5! Also, as is the trend, shower gel and shampoo and body lotion are in larger containers bolted to the walls. Housekeeping doesnt always check so we ran out of body lotion and the containers are bolted next to the faucets in the bath which made them very awkward to use while bathing. Finally, the bathtub/shower controls are not intuitive and hard to turn on without getting soaked by the rain shower faucet head. However, I would gladly stay here again. Ask for a room facing a courtyard to avoid street noise.

title: Beautiful and Comfortable
text: We stayed for 3 nights at this beautiful hotel. It is centrally located with easy access to all of Paris. The room was lovely, breakfasts were great, The  concierge staff were super helpful with restaurant recommendations, directions, taxis, etc.  My one complaint was that our room wasn't ready, despite the others in our group being done. The staff assured us our bags would be delivered to our room as soon as it was cleaned. That was fine, but when we came back to the hotel after the appointed time to get into our room, we had to wait again. Once upstairs, no bags. My husband had to go downstairs and bring them up himself. We were in a time crunch as we had plans and it made it extremely difficult. I am sure it was an anomaly but it did make it a little more stressful than necessary.

title: All but concierge
text:
Lovely hotel, comfortable, friendly staff, exceptional location, except for the gentleman concierge- he’s rude and dismissive.   
Breakfast was outstanding.  Many good restaurants in walking distance.   Decor feels like Paris !

title: Anniversary Celebration
text: We chose Le Scribe Opera to celebrate our 25th wedding anniversary. The staff were extremely welcoming and we were permitted an early check-in, a room upgrade and gifted champagne and macarons. We wish we could have stayed longer and would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending this chic hotel and indeed hope to return in the not too distant future. The location is perfect with so much on your doorstep and easy access to the metro for those sights a little further away. We are huge fans of Sofitel and have enjoyed many lovely experiences around the world at the group’s hotels.

title: Amazing hotel
text: Had the pleasure of using this hotel for business. The staff were nothing short of amazing. The location and proximity to all shops, bars, restaurants and sites was fantastic. Will come back again as a leisure guest for sure! Thanks so much!

title: OK Stay
text: We had an okay 3 night stay here.   We had a king room on the 3rd floor.   The room was very clean & nicely decorated.   The bed was very comfortable. The room itself was small.   There was not a lot of floor space to put our suitcases.    In the bathroom, there was a tub with a rain shower.   It was an odd setup.   If you turned on the shower, then got the soap from the dispenser in the wall & not want to get your hair wet, it was almost impossible.    The hotel also provided paper type tub mats which would rip or tear after 2 uses.    We definitely wanted to use the mats so as to not slip in the tub.  We'd had to call to get another after the cleaning staff took the torn one but forgot to replace it.    We had our breakfasts here.  It was a nice buffet with a lot of choices and very good coffee.  Breakfast room was in the lower level.    The staff were nice.    We went to the bar on 2 days.   Our server was friendly & good.   I'm not sure why but it was slow getting our order both times.    The hotel was close to the Opera House & the Galeries Lafayette department store which we walked to.

title: Good and bad
text:
First the good:
*The location is terrific. Easy to walk to many of the sites of Paris.Great shops, cafes, restaurants and people watching in the area.
*The staff was fantastic. Special shout out to the Concierge.  She was over the top helpful with a number of challenges during our stay . The wait staff and front desk could not have more pleasant, helpful and attentive.
*The food is excellent.  The salmon Carpaccio was the best
Now the negatives:
*The rooms are TINY.  Hardly room for two suitcases.  The interior rooms face air-conditioning units and a central area that seems to be under construction
*While Le Scribe is a side street, day and night there is a continuous line blocking the front door. The line is for that evening's performance of some grunge band or rapper that is occurring 1 1/2 blocks away.  
*Apparently No-smoking in the rooms is only a suggestion. In the hallways and seeping under our door was the constant smell of Tobacco and Marijuana.

title: Amazing service and great location
text: Staff are really friendly, helpful and very happy to accommodate. The room was ready earlier than expected and everything from check in, room service and checkout was perfect. The staff at breakfast were attentive, and concierge was always happy to help. The room had lovely modern decor, was clean and spacious with a Juliet balcony and a great view. Perfect location to get around and walking distance to most places. Will be visiting again, thank you

title: Excellent location
text: The hotel has well located - all the Paris top rated attractions are walkable and has good metro connectivity . At the same time it’s a located Ina crowded area and the hotel rooms are small. The reception staff is courteous but at the same time some staff members have problems in understanding English . If that happens please ask for the English speaking staff rather than get wrong answers and add to confusion . Good choices are available in breakfast buffet and the staff is prompt and caring . On one day during our stay ,  the gas in the kitchen was not working so the egg options were limited . However, on complaint to the reception it was addressed. Overall it was a pleasant stay.

title: Great service, comfort and location
text: We spent three nights at this hotel.  We received an upgrade (always a nice surprise).  The welcome was warm, the staff couldn’t have been more helpful.  The bar staff were good.  As others have said, thr breakfast room isn’t the most beautiful, but service was good, as was the location is excellent for restaurants, galleries, sight seeing, etc.   We hope to visit again.

title: Well-located beautiful clean property in the 1er, great location for a shopping trip
text: My sister and I came to celebrate her birthday and her first trip ever to France. The room was very clean, bright, well-maintained, with a lovely balcony with our twin bed premier room. Our housekeeping lady was amazing and never missed anything during our week-long stay, always made sure we had everything needed and came to service our room with a clockwork schedule and turndown service. The location is very central to everything we planned, my sister wanted to go shopping most of the trip and this hotel is a great easy walking distance to everything and a plethora of brand name stores right next door. The staff are pleasant and the bellman was très gentil, however I only wish they had recognized my sister’s birthday since that was our main focus for the trip. I had written it in the comments and the date when I made the reservation but there was no mention of a happy birthday for her at any time of the visit nor any nice small birthday surprises (not expected really but after our trip have seen others comment that they have). Maybe it is based on your tier status and I am starting out as a regular Accor member but it would’ve been the cherry on top for her to enjoy her birthday in paris

title: Very disappointed in our treatment
text: Due to flight change by American Airlines we arrived at the Sofitel Le Scribe Paris Opera after being awake for 36 hours. Needless to say we were exhausted. I asked the desk clerks - 4 of them on duty at 8 am on March 26, 2022. If they could please accommodate our situation by giving us early check-in. Not only did they display a total lack of empathy for our situation but they made no effort on our behalf. They told us check-in was at 3 pm. When I came up to the desk at 2:55 pm they refused to check us in until it was precisely 3pm. I almost laughed out loud. Are we to believe that all the rooms at the Sofitel Le Scribe Paris magically clean themselves at 3 pm simultaneously? By the way, the clerk checked us in way later than 3 pm due to a long line of very unhappy customers. Surely, a hotel this mired in their own rules does not deserve to call themselves 5 star. I am sure one or two rooms were ready before 3 pm. I have never been subjected to such a thing in any other hotel and I have stayed in many. The customer here is having to bend to the hotel’s convenience. We were booked at the Prince de Galles by Viking River Cruises who switched us to the Sofitel 5 days before our cruise. A very poor decision. The one saving grace at this hotel was Irina an excellent concierge. If you do not want to be treated as a valued customer stay at this hotel.

title: Elegant but cozy Parisian stay
text: Very elegant hotel with cozy Parisian atmosphere. Location is perfect in the center right next to shopping and dining opportunities. Stylish design of the rooms and the most kind and helpful staff. Breakfast selection has great variety and is always fresh every morning. What we liked a lot was the great number of amenities in the room and the view from the window.

title: Exceptional design, chic, art nouveau, with palace elegance
text: Room interior design in stunning, including bathroom, and also the LV Cafe, the main restaurant Cafe, refreshing, light, clean design, art deco art nouveau against the tall ceilings and palatial building. The Risotto at the lunch was incredible, and french fries may be the best in Paris - really. The view from my room was spacious and glorious with sun beaming in each morning, tall ceilings, and an apartment like feeling more than hotel. The location could not be better, near to everything really. The breakfast room is not as wonderful as other aspects of the hotel, with no natural light, no windows, and canteen-like feel. But would still stay here again, due to overall hotel room, location, and main public rooms!

title: A couple of days in Paris
text:
What an amazing boutique luxury hotel. The service upon arrival and throughout our stay was absolutely outstanding! Located a block from a very busy Galleries Lafayette and L'Opera is the perfect place to be in the city.
The rooms are very modern while maintaining the beautiful historical architecture! 
The lobby bar & lounge just off the lobby was a great place to unwind after a long day and catch up with some work. 
I love it and can't wait to stay here again!

title: Perfectly located
text:
LOCATION: Only a few minutes’ walk from a Paris Métro station. Many historical sites and shopping centres not far from the hotel.

HOTEL: Not very friendly front desk staff. Bell staff not especially helpful either. Bright, clean, spacious room for a Parisien hotel. Newly renovated only a few years ago. Excellent mattress, pillows and duvet. Good size bathroom with a bathtub, a separate shower cubicle with very good shower water pressure. Very modern bathroom design but impractical. Where are the hooks for the bathroom towels? Separate toilet on the entrance hall, with a  hand sink.

Exceptionally friendly breakfast staff. Tasty breakfast.

title: Lovely in every way!
text:
Great property - I’d stay here again in a heartbeat. I’m a Diamond Accor member, so very familiar with Sofitels. This is an excellent one. Great location near the metro, RER, and RoissyBus to CDG. Lots going on outside, but very well insulated rooms that were remarkably quiet and peaceful. Really helpful and kind staff. Our room (a standard junior suite) was beautifully decorated and comfortable.

I really can’t say enough good things about this place. We loved it, and will stay here again without hesitation next time we’re in Paris.

title: Beautiful hotel with fantastic staff
text: I loved the décor in my room and always appreciate a full bathroom. The bed was wonderful and I'm fussy when it comes to hotel beds. Full bathroom was beautiful, great amenities as well. Walking distance to Gallery Lafayette, Paris Opera and many other attractions.

title: Home away from home in Paris
text:
Travel is a privilege, especially in today's circumstances. I am blessed to have the opportunity to travel to France 4 times this year, and I am very grateful to return to my home away from home in Paris, Sofitel Le Scribe Paris Opera, my home away from home.

I have been coming here for many years. I return and return because of the staff who not only made me feel welcomed but at home. The staff is professional, courteous, attentive, and eager to assist. The hotel has undergone a major renovation in 2019, and the rooms are elegantly and chicly appointed with the utmost comfort, such as nice beddings, great sound proof, and of convenience with responsive staff to your every need. 

The quality of food at the main restaurant is wonderful. There are many great choices for breakfast. The staff of food and beverage is swift in delivering your orders with big smiles which demonstrated their pride. 

The location of the hotel is another reason why I always return. Centrally located, it offers easy access to metro, shops, and only minutes walking distance to Palais Garnier opera house and  Galerie Lafayette and more. 

It is worth of a visit to experience true Parisian spirit at Sofitel Le Scribe Paris Opera. I love my home away from home when in Paris!

title: Nice stay but drawn down of a low quality loyalty program.
text:
Well located hotel and nice staff. Newly renovated with nice style.

My total impression is, however, less good due to a low value of the loyalty program. This is not only this hotel not giving benefits, it is a general issue for other Sofitel and Fairmont hotels as well. Status of the perks according to my platinum membership status:

Early check in, not available
Room upgrade, not available but when I asked there was a possibility. This is appreciated. I have, however, stayed as a platinum member on many, many hotels, and only once the room upgrade was granted without I had to ask. It cannot only be the subject to availability that is the problem.
Welcome gift, not given. I do not know if the Corona situation is a bad excuse.
Late check out, not available
Free drink at the bar, given and it always is. This is a nice perk, but I think you get it from silver membership level, so no reason to be more loyal than that.

I have also tried to use the free night suite upgrade. The price I was given at a Fairmont hotel was the same as I could bould the suite on the internet. My free suite upgrades are soon to expire, but I do not want to waste time on using them as they do not have any noticeable value.

title: Great hotel but terrible sounds coming communicating rooms!
text:
Spent a nigth with my wife 6-7 Nov 2021 for our 10 year of mariage. 
Room 448 have a great looking. a fresh bottle of champagne was present at our arrival but without knowing if it was offerred or made on purpose we did not touched it !
Room service was superbe with quite some choice.
There are communicatiion doors betweem room 448 and 446 in the corridor were tv sound from the 446 were able to pass quite heavily in our room
There is also another communication door with the room 450 next to the bed and we were able to distinct sentences and words from the room 450. I was not expected this and it tooks me a while to fall asleep.
I would advise to do some stuff to block sounds from these rooms!
breakfast was excellent, really at the level expected. 
personnel were really great professionels !
I will anyway continue to go to Sofitel

title: Location and Quality
text:
Everything was incredible from the minute we walked into that hotel.  Our suite was absolutely gorgeous, the champagne was soothing after a day of travel, the food was incredible, definitely the best dinner I can ever remember.  After our first breakfast, the servers took pride in remembering what coffee we drank and what we wanted to eat based on some dietary restrictions.  The service from each and every member of your team was amazing throughout our entire stay. 

We have stayed in hotels all over the world and many of them have beautiful interiors and good food, but, it is the (Service) employees who can make the real difference. At the Scribe, your team made us feel like we were their family.  It is the people that make a hotel stay memorable.  They make the difference and make guests want to return.  You should be very proud of your team!!  They all deserve a pat on the back. This property was truly amazing from it's central location to Paris',  sites. the quality of it's rooms,  to it's consistently delicious food. We didn't want to leave! Pauline Courtois, the Director of Sales and Marketing , is an amazing member if the Accor properties to work with...a real polished leader in the industry.

title: Good location, thus the service may be better
text:
I am totally disappointed with the service quality of the hotel. title: Good stay
text: Very well located between Opera and Galeries Lafayette. Recently refurbished coridors and rooms, excellent bedding. Amenities somewhat limited, but champagne for welcome drink. Very good breakfast. Warmly recommended!

title: Great base for a visit to Paris
text:
I recently stayed here for four nights on a shopping and sightseeing/museum trip. The hotel is in a great location, near to Galleries Lafayette, the beautiful Opera building, and lots of shops and restaurants. There's also a Metro stop a few steps away and two small supermarkets for drinks and snacks. It's within walking distance of the Louvre. The hotel itself is lovely – I was in a 'luxury' room which was more spacious than a standard one and although there was only a courtyard view, I definitely appreciated the extra space. Everything was spotlessly clean. The bed was soooo comfortable, as Sofitel beds usually are. The bathroom was a good size and the toilet was separate, plus you get all the normal things you would expect in a 5 star hotel such as robes and slippers which I know some hotels have removed as an anti-covid measure. There was also a fridge drawer which came in handy for the Apricot Nectar given as a welcome gift! 

Staff were all helpful and friendly.  I had breakfast in my room a couple of times which was okay – there was no menu in the room so I just went off the menu on the hotel website. I think I got charged incorrectly (unless I had the world's most expensive hot chocolate) but didn't forcefully challenge as everything else had been great.

title: Perfect hotel in a perfect location
text: This hotel is beautiful.  The location made it possible to walk to many important sites. Our room was large by hotel standards with a most comfortable bed and extra closet and drawer space.  The bathroom included both tub and shower, plenty of counter space at the sink, and a private toilet area.  Staff kept the room very clean and always replaced the bottled waters.  Our stay included breakfast each day with a large variety of delicious foods, coffee and other beverages.  The waitstaff was helpful and friendly, and we were always greeted upon arrival by the most pleasant Maitre D.  Last, but so very important, the friendly Concierge in the main lobby was always at our disposal to arrange tours and answer any questions.  We especially appreciated the help we received from Clotilde, who spoke both French and English. We would not hesitate to stay there again if we are ever lucky enough to be back in Paris.

title: Five star is in the details
text:
This is a five start worthy hotel with a few issues that should be given attention. It might be covid but my suite was somewhat understated. No decoration, nor the announced magazines. Compared with the photographs on the web site not a space to lounge in. Luxury is in the details and perhaps a check is in order to straighten the crooked doorknobs and other faults that have been left after the redecorations.
Breakfast is great if somewhat chaotic. No menu was offered in an atmosphere of ‘you can ask anything you like’. That almost worked as French toast was not possible. 
Starting in the nice restaurant, breakfast was then served in the basement, in the kind of space that gives more of a three star feel. Buffet this time and a menu card. 

There seems to be some improvisation going on which needs to stay in the back office but shows in the interaction with guests. 
Having said this I would not mind coming back at all. I trust that this hotel is focussed on creating an even more perfect experience all the time and treasures the feedback guests give.

Added to that: perfect location, wonderful beds, well decorated, kind people.

title: Fabulous vacation to Paris in our favorite hotel!
text: My husband and I have stayed at the Sofitel Le Scribe several times, but this time was particularly special.  The service was extraordinary.  We were helped with everything from reservations to room upgrades by two incredibly competent and kind staff members--Pauline Basso-Bert – Guest Relation Director and Cassandra Murgia – Front Desk Supervisor.  They did everything in their power--including sending a fabulous bread basket to our room--to make our stay memorable and really special.  Our suite was spacious and very cool and comfortable despite the heat of July.  We were assisted with reservations by the concierge and received a warm greeting every time we returned to the hotel after a day of museums, shopping and simply enjoying Paris.  Thank you to this five star staff and this gorgeous hotel.  We are coming back ASAP!

title: A great hotel in central Paris
text: A top class hotel in central Paris. Good concierge, great in room breakfast and service with a smile. The room size was perfect for one person but would have been a bit of a squeeze for 2 with luggage. Nice toiletries.

title: Summer vacation in Paris
text: My wife & I went to Paris for our anniversary and this hotel was amazing.  Beautiful decor, clean room, great breakfast & very friendly/attentive staff.  Definitely made our first trip to Paris memorable.  Location was great, we walked to almost everywhere we went (museums, shopping & cafes).  We would come here again.

title: Great service and location
text: We are a family of 5 who have just spent one week in Paris at the beautiful Au Boeuf Couronné Hotel. It is an amazing hotel located next to the Metro. We were amazed by the hospitality and service by all the staff members from the cleaners to the front desk. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. We had booked a double room and a three-bedroom for our three teenagers. This was a great solution since the room has a double bed and an extra room with a bed and a small desk. Breakfast is delicious and the croissants are simply to die for. We would recommend this hotel to anyone and we sincerely hope to be back again in the near future.

title: I LOVE this hotel!
text:
I booked 3 nights at Au Boeuf Couronné online after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor & the hotel turned out to be even better than I ever expected. My daughter & I had an amazing experience - we LOVE this hotel! The room was beautiful, spacious, super clean, had unique furnishings, a huge shower with lots of hot water & great water pressure, super comfortable beds, tons of lighting options, a refridgerator, awesome air conditioning that we could control ourselves with the digital wall panel which we desperately needed b/c it reached 100 degrees that weekend in Paris.
The staff were so friendly, effecient, helpful, polite, accomodating - I can’t say enough good things about them. They gladly brought us a bottle of ice when we came in after a long hot 100 degree day.
The breakfast - oh my gosh! - the breakfast was AMAZING! The flakiest croissants, super creamy yogurt, fresh fruit & fruit juices, ham, cheese, salmon, cereal, dried fruits & nuts, bread, jams, Nutella, honey & more. Delicious coffee, too. We left the table stuffed every morning so we never needed a sit down lunch during the day. The outdoor covered patio for breakfast was a delight.
There is a beautiful restaurant downstairs but we never had time to sit down & eat there.
The metro is so close that the entrance almost reaches the edge of the hotel - about 15 yards away. 
I will definitely stay here the next time we go back to Paris. Don’t hesitate - book this hotel now & you’ll be glad you did!

title: Travel dreams of returning
text: I miss traveling so much during this current COVID pandemic that I have resorted to  visiting some of my favorite hotels and restaurants online.  Sad.  However I am compelled to mention that Au Boeuf Couronne Hotel and Restaurant where we stayed in June 2019 is at the top of my list.  The room was lovely, clean and modern.  The included breakfast was very nice and the terrace location was quite pleasant.  But primarily we were so impressed by the service!  The front desk staff and manager were not just efficient, but genuinely caring.  They went out of their way to inquire if we needed anything and to assist or advise us.  At one point I tripped and slightly turned my ankle, and they were fussing over me like mother hens.  On this occasion I was with my partner, but on other occasions I have traveled solo or with a female friend, so I am always on the lookout for places that feel safe for women travelers.  This place definitely fits that criteria.  Although it is not in the center or the tourist area, the Metro line just literally across the street was very convenient for traveling to all of our destinations.  I also have to mention the excellent attached restaurant, where we ate several times and were very impressed.  It is a beautiful space with high quality food and proper service.  Hotel au Boeuf Couronne, I miss you and I will be back!

title: Very good address in Paris 19th district
text: Au Boeuf Couronné is best known as a meat lovers' Paris favourite. But it is also a hotel and definitely a good option in an area of Paris lacking small-sized, comfortable and modern hotels. The location is very good, close to Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est, the Paris Philarmonic Orchestra house, the Grande Halle de La Villette and with a subway station literally next door. The lobby has nothing impressive but rooms are nicely decorated mixing leather and wood elements with dark colour tiles in the bathroom. Room size is OK by Paris standard. Preferably ask for rooms looking over Avenue Jean Jaurès that are quiet and offer a better view. Very professional, welcoming and service-oriented reception staff. Breakfast could be an area of improvement as the room is relatively small and options limited (e.g. no yogurt, fresh fruits, ...). However, Au Boeuf Couronné is a very good address in this area of Paris and I have no hesitation to recommend it.

title: Boutique experience
text: Almost every time I travel I book chain hotels (Hilton, Accor etc.) but during this trip I realized how much I am missing. Hotel Au Bœuf Couronné is a real experience! Check-in was smooth and receptionist welcomed me with a smile and some advises about the hotel and the neighborhood. The hotel is located in the old but refurbished building which gives a lot of charm to this place. Unfortunately the room was quite small but for my 2-night sightseeing stay it was very good. I loved the modern and thematic design of the room. Bathroom did not have the door so for a single traveler or couple it is fine but it might be tricky for friends / family – I would not necessarily want to see my friend taking shower naked. Breakfast selection was quite limited however all products were high quality – juice, cheese and pastry. I also liked good, strong coffee from the capsule machine. Overall for the price I paid for the room, given the design, location and the overall feeling of a boutique hotel I would definitely come back!

title: Pleasant Stay & Excellent Service
text:
Service is excellent all around. The manager is always around quickly addressing issues. A very friendly team that tries hard to please.

Rooms are modern,  spacious and have been decorated to a high standard. Despite my room being on a busy street overlooking Porte de Pantin metro station, there was no noise as they have triple sound proofing. Also they have wonderfully thick curtains with button snaps that keep the light out. 

The one problem is the  solid security doors that slam shut loudly and wake up anyone in the adjoining rooms. It's fine if you are getting up about 7:30 AM, but if you want to sleep in, that's another matter...:) Perhaps advising guests of this at check in and a sign reminding guests to hold the doors might help?

Also, note that the shower is see through and just off center from the bed so don't share the room with anyone you aren't intimate with.

WIFI free but very weak even at reception. 

Room very clean. I like the neighborhood too. It is not yet touristified. Lots of local color and many interesting Asian, Lebanese and French eateries nearby if you are not a carnivore intent on eating at the adjoining restaurant.  Steps from the Parc de la Vilette (currently hosting the King Tut exhibition) and a twenty minute walk to the Museum of Science and Industry.

I would happily stay here again.

title: A weekend with George
text:
I booked tickets to see George Ezra as a Christmas present for my better half. Having tried all his UK concerts I found that £260/ticket was a trifle expensive. So I settled on a weekend in Paris in Springtime. I originally booked a single night via a bookings site then increased this by way of a phone call to the hotel itself. I had a couple of conversations with the 2 ladies (Maria and Matilde) who worked in reception. Both of whom were extremely helpful and pleasant and spoke excellent English as did the manager. After an exhausting trip due to the French airline strike we arrived to be greeted with the good news that our room been upgraded to a superior. This was gratefully received and on entering the room found it to be spacious and luxurious. 

We were facing onto the main road but both noise and light were kept out during the night by way of a excellent double glazing and the efficient black out curtains. Nor were we disturbed by the nearby Metro which meant the centre of Paris was only a short distance. 

We didn’t have dinner in the hotel restaurant although the prices seemed reasonable for a capital city, but did enjoy breakfast in both days which was both continental and a version of an English breakfast. 

I don’t believe George will  play The Zenith again as he will have moved onto to larger stadiums, however we will certainly return to the Boeuf Couronné hotel and will inform our friends and family of this excellent establishment.

Although very beautiful, the only thing to be aware of was that the shower is completely glass and see-through. For a twin room, this was an interesting experience for friends/colleagues travelling together!

Otherwise, all perfect.

title: Comfortable Room, Smart Design
text:
A little out of the way and from the center of Paris, but it was worth the distance to have a nice and comfortable room to return and relax after a long day of shopping, walking, and sightseeing.  

Staff was friendly and allowed me to check in early after a long overnight flight— much appreciated. 

I loved the room design, which is true to the website pictures. For a small space I found the room to be very functional, smart, and aesthetically pleasing. In my room the shower was open and visible to the bed, so if you’re sharing just be aware.  Bed mattress was firm, but Iike that as it’s good for my back.  Duvet and pillows very soft and fluffy, made it hard to get out of bed in the morning. 

I tried the restaurant next door.  The prefix menu for 35 euros was a good value.  Food was very good ... not outstanding, but for the price can’t be beat.  Should give it a try.

The surrounding area reminds me of the burbs, but there are enough restaurants, stores, and supermarkets in the immediate area that you won’t feel isolated.  I can image in nicer weather with the Parc de la Villette next door the area will be bustling. 

If you don’t mind being outside the center of Paris and/or have no problem using the metro, I strongly recommend staying here.

title: Lovely hotel - ideal location!
text:
We stayed at Hôtel Restaurant Au Boeuf Couronné for 2 nights in November and couldn’t have asked for more. The rooms are modern and decorated to a boutique hotel standard, the beds were very comfy and although the room is not huge it is perfect for a city break. The staff were also very friendly and helpful with their advice.  

The location was ideal for us – just 4 stops from Gare du Nord on the Metro to Porte de Pantin which is practically right outside the hotel door. There are a few supermarkets nearby, and we found a great restaurant called Café Jean just down the road. Connections to Disneyland via the train/metro were easy and our only travel issue was twice when leaving early in the morning we had to walk to Ourq to buy tickets as the machines were out of service at Porte de Pantin but this only added an extra 10 mins to our journey. 

Our one downside to the hotel was breakfast was not worth the additional €15 and I wouldn’t recommend eating there in the morning because of this.

title: Good hotel, issues with temperature controls and shower
text:
This is a nice hotel within a 2 minute walk of Parc de Villette. Great if you are going to a concert etc. It has parking off site,which is charged for, and there are cafes etc nearby. 
The rooms are well decorated and clean and the bathroom a good size. We did have issues, because of its design, with the shower soaking everything in the bathroom and making the floor very dangerous. 
Also our room was like an oven with a broken air conditioning unit. We had to open our windows meaning we had little sleep as the hotel is on the main road so it was very noisy. On leaving we were told by reception that they control the temperature which they had set at 25 degrees!  We hadn’t approached them the night before as we got in very late from our concert and reception was deserted and we could find no one to help. 
All in all if you want somewhere close to the concert halls this is a ok choice.

title: Well connected, cool and quirky rooms
text:
We loved our stay at the Boeuf Couronné; we didn’t spend much time in the hotel itself as we wanted to explore as much of Paris as possible but pretty much everything was spot on. The staff were incredibly welcoming and lovely - I’ve seen a few previous negative comments about the manager which were (from what we could see) completely unfounded. The room itself was gorgeous, not too dissimilar in style to the Hoxton in London. Very fresh and modern with a great shower and a comfortable bed. The hotel is only about 15 minutes away by metro from Gare Du Nord so super convenient and I think reasonably priced. 

I have one gripe and that is the breakfast set up - breakfast is served in restaurant which is stunning. Continental breakfast is pretty standard, comprises of cereals, yoghurts, bread (there is nothing ‘standard’ about French bread), eggs with bacon are cooked at your request which was truly delicious. The staff at breakfast seemed inefficient and not as attentive as the staff on reception. It felt as if they simply weren’t prepared to serve anyone, even though there were only a few people down at breakfast at the same time as us. This could do with some tightening up to make the rating a five, but we still thoroughly enjoyed our visit and would stay again.

title: C'est Magnifique
text:
I really liked this hotel, a lot. I loved the style/design of the public areas and the room was small but perfectly functional, very clean and had a great shower. An excellent continental breakfast was included in the price too.

The staff were very friendly and attentive, nothing was too much trouble and the location is ideal for those who like to be away from the centre and explore other areas of the city. The path along the canal is close to the hotel and is a lovely walk and we walked to the Seine and Notre Dame from the hotel. The metro is just outside the hotel for those preferring public transport and the street (avenue jean jaures) is lined with all manner of restaurants. However, you will be very well served by eating at the hotel in which you are staying. We ate here one evening and the food was superb, as was the service. We will definitely stay here again and recommend to others.

title: Paris in the Snow
text: Prior to arriving we were in communication with the manager Carlo, his responses we quick and informative. As it turned out we arrived very early and they were able to accommodate us. Check in was quick and gracious. The rooms in Europe are generally smaller than in North America however a lot of thought and details went into the appointment of the amenities and features in our room. We were facing the street which provided a quaint view , due to the insulation and double pained glass the room was very quiet and the blackout window treatments were wonderful. For a small fee a breakfast can be added to the room charge and I would highly recommend the purchase. The selection of food and beverage was excellent. The steak house that the hotel is above is definitely not to be missed. Neither of us spoke French and our server did not speak English. We were able to communicate what we wanted and had delightful service and fantastic food, her wine suggestion was delicious. We would not hesitate to stay again at this delightful property and will be sure to revisit the restaurant.

title: A Birthday Weekend Getaway
text:
When you arrive at this hotel, it seems well presented and of a good standard. The member of staff at the front desk greeted us and was very helpful and attentive. Our room was clean and tidy. However, although the decor was fitting with the theme of the hotel, the design was favoured over the functionality. 

The Bedroom

The design of the room looked inviting, but as a large room it was left quite empty. As such, this made the room echo quite a lot which you could also hear from rooms either side. 
The bed was a double, which was smaller than we are used to but adequate. It was slightly too hard for us and we struggled to sleep well though the night though. However that’s our personal preference. 

The air conditioning worked well, so we were very comfortable in the room. 

For the storage, there was only a rail in a copper pipe design, which had approximately 6 hangers on it. There was no wardrobe or additional hooks to hang coats etc on the walls, so everything had to be either draped over the pipe or hung over the hangers twice. 

There were tea/coffee making facilities, a shelf/desk and lovely big windows letting lots of light in. Strangely, there was no bin inside the room, so we had to find a plastic bag to make do. 

The Bathroom 

The bathroom was very large which was clean and designed really well but It was another large room with not a lot in it, which echoed every sound!
As a wet room (no bath) it didn’t work as expected. After a shower, the room would be flooded and we would need to spend time sweeping water with the shower mat to the drain as the floor was unsafe to walk on. After leaving it for the day (thinking to might drain by then), it was still flooded. The functionality of the shower drainage was not fit for use which is a shame as shower itself was great! 

The Breakfast

I have more of a biased opinion of the breakfast due to our experience. My partner had booked through a third party website which had an technical issue. When he chose the option for bed and breakfast for two people, the website only created a booking for 2 people staying, but only one person having breakfast. 

The staff (another member of staff)on the front desk highlighted this to us as it was stated on the booking and started to reassure us that they were already aware and this was a technical issue from the website. However, they then expected us to still pay an additional €15.99 per day for the other person to have breakfast there. For me, this created a slight grievance. 
On the first morning, we decided to go to breakfast and talk to the staff about the options available for breakfast. When we asked if they catered for gluten intolerance (for me) the staff at reception said they didn’t and to only eat the things that were not gluten and when he asked the waitress (in French), she responded in a abrupt fashion of “no!”, stared at us, huffed and then walked away. The receptionist then told us we should have told them before we’d arrived, but there was no indication to do so. I don’t expect everyone to cater for this dietary requirement but I didn’t appreciate the response. I felt very unwelcome.

This upset me and left me feeling so embarrassed in front of other guests that I went straight back up to my room without eating. My partner scouted the breakfast on offer and told me the choices. As a continental breakfast it seemed adequate, but not worth the price they were charging. Therefore I went round the corner to the local shop and stocked up on what I needed. After that, my partner ate alone downstairs and I ate up in the room. Sadly, at a point where the hotel could have redeemed themselves, they simply made it worse.  

Based on our experience, I didn’t feel 100% comfortable at the hotel. Overall there were good points and bad points and some based on circumstance. 

I am sure there are many guests who felt they had an enjoyable stay, but sadly we didn’t feel the same.

title: Cracking little place
text:
6 months old hotel above a famous 150 year old restaurant. reception staff were very friendly, spoke great English, and were happy to talk about the hotel, its history and the local history. everything in the hotel is bespoke apparently so the design is quite unique. the rooms are small as per most of paris. my room faced the street and was really well soundproofed. yes, I heard a police siren at 2am, but you'd hear that from any rom in the city. air con worked although i couldn't switch it to cool (I like to cool the room down before switching the AC off, even in winter). shower had good pressure and i had two sets of towels even though i was travelling solo (hate it when you only get one a la all german hotels, for example). my only gripes are: the safe is only big enough to get you passport and phone in (not a lappy or iPad, for example), the bed was very firm - too firm for me, and you don't get a free bottle of water (there's a small bottle in the mini-bar which you are charged for). The wifi worked very well and is, I believe, free. 
Breakfast is continental, and due to its proximity to the restaurant that it's attached to, everything was fresh. OK, it's a little limited, but there is an A La Carte option if you like eggs, and whilst the coffee machine was a bit tricky to use, it made a decent espresso.
Would definitely stay again, but really would like a mattress topper to make it much more comfy.

title: Best kept secret hotel in Paris
text:
Au Boeuf Couronné is already famous for its belle epoque restaurant, the oldest steak house in Paris. It now has a fabulous hotel which is contemporary but with a nod to its beefy connection. The rooms have leather accessories and there’s even a leather studded entrance hall. I am amazed this place is classified 3 star, I’ve stayed in higher starred hotels that were nowhere near as good as this. The rooms are big, the bathrooms are fabulous, and the WiFi is speedy. It’s quiet and comfy and welcoming and less than a minutes’ walk to Port de Pantin metro (line 5) stop.

It’s a bit of a steal as it’s not expensive at all, though it looks like it ought to be. Location-wise, it’s terrific and it’s easy to get into the centre of Paris taking just 15 mins to Bastille from the Metro outside the front door. Its close to the Cité des Sciences, Zenith music venue, Philharmonie de Paris, La Villette and loads of other major monuments and sites. At just 5 minutes from Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est by metro - I'll definitely be staying here again.

Just unfortunate, it was rainy days and we were staying only for a couple of nights.
description: The Au Bœuf Couronné Hotel & Restaurant is located 15 minutes away from main international railway stations as Gare du Nord or Gare del l'Est, facing the "Parc de La Villette" (biggest green area in town) and its concert halls and exhibition centers. In our property you will find the perfect association between generous traditional french cuisine and modern hospitality comfort: you will be able to taste the most refined butcher cuts in a typical Parisian atmosphere, take advantage of many cultural events going on in the neighborhood and peacefully relax in one of our 42 rooms with up-to-the-time finishings. An underground station is just in front of the property and the Parisian ring road just 150 meters away, perfect balance between green environment and easiness of movements whenever you will have to join downtown, either for business or leisure. Take advantage of the 55 hectares of the park and have a promenade all along its canal then have a sit in our private terrasse and enjoy a glass from our wine selection staying connected with hi-speed internet, cocooned by the courtesy of our staff and its efficient and careful service.

title: nice little boutique hotel
text: we stayed there during  a 3 day trip in Paris and it was great.Loved the room decor especially though a bit on the smaller side.Staff were very helpful especially irfin and michael who helped with recommendations, helpful tips on our way to Disney and transportation.Also had dinner at the restaurant which was good.Great beef  and steak.would definitely recommend and return there.

Much better compared to most Parisian hotels, the room was large, comfortable, good quality bedding, minibar prices not excessive, bathroom well designed, separate toilet, lovely toiletries, tea/coffee in room, no noise from inside or outside hotel. Breakfast delicious with a lot of  choice, eggs cooked to order and typical French cheeses pate & saucisson. Restaurant very good too! Well done !

text:
Immaculate, well designed rooms.
The separate bedroom within our room for our son was great as it gave us extra space! 
Porte de Pantin station is just outside so you can be in the middle of Paris in 15mins. The car park over the road and lots of cafes just minutes away. Beautiful restaurant downstairs. Friendly staff. Recommend!

title: Amazing Staff!
text:
When I was in Paris last week, I attended an event in the large park across from the hotel. 

After looking for a taxi for nearly 40 minutes, tired and frustrated, I walked into the hotel to see if they could help me. The front desk staff was LOVELY .. they called me a taxi, offered me something to drink and made sure I could connect to the wi-fi if I wanted to while I was waiting. 

I just wanted to say THANK YOU, again. Honestly, I wasn’t sure how I would have been able to get back to my hotel without your help.

All I can say is, if that’s how they treat a random person walking in from the street..I can only imagine the exceptional service they give their guests.

title: Fab!
text:
Went on a Eurostar city break to this Hotel.  Was amazing! Beautiful roof terrace with great views.  Beds soft and comfy with quality linen.  Complimentary toiletries of high quality.  
Food in rooftop restaurant was very pricey and lukewarm which was a shame. Aside from this we loved this funky energy filled hotel.

title: original
text:
The service and products were great, the staff was very helpful and so caring ! and I think it's not easy regarding the context, 
We stayed fat the Mama Paris West for the PSG&ALL because the family is fan, so the idea was excellent for us ! we enjoyed all the program and the service with the very good food !

title: Far enough for quite streets yet fairly close to the city attractions
text:
I love the atmosphere, the wide street in front of the hotel followed by a park. The nearby Supermarket makes you feel like a local. 

The breakfast is big and lots of home made bread varieties. I did not mind paying Euro 19 for the breakfast. Sitting and facing the street is a joy with the ceiling to floor windows.

The rooftop atmosphere is also nice but did not spend much time there.

Nearby is the exposition where I can go for a coffee or a light breakfast at Paul. 

I used Uber mostly for transport because the cost I saved in hotel rooms. I walked to the Eiffel Tower and the Champs it is a little more than an hour walk but there are so much shops and things to see along the wall.

With kids you need laundry and with washing& drying machines in the hotel no stress for finding a laundromat. 

The only issue is that shower and toilet are separate, also once you step out of the shower, you are in the room.

title: Good Meal, average price
text:
We went to Mama Shelter at 11pm. Every place was closed but not Mama. The meal was nice. We ate Chicken with frites. Taste nice!! 
The price was a little expensive, just like Paris at all… not a surprised though. 
Thank you Eva !!

title: nice view and good atmosphere; food and drinks could be better…
text: Rooftop @mamashelterpariswest has a nice view and good atmosphere. However food and drinks could be better… We started with our drinks “Sangria La Rossa” and “Papi Chulo” 👎 with fries calamari (Very good 👍), then we had beef carpaccio, spaguettone al pomodoro and pizzas, all the 4 dishes had a lot of pepper and for sure they all could be better. For example, pizzas were so thin that they got all watery. For dessert we had ice cream 👍 (kids menu), prosecco gourmand  👍 and “riz au lait” 👎 (milk rice) not good at all, to the point that it was not charged to our bill. And jus to finish we chose the kid’s menu (1 MAIN COURSE + 1 DESERT + 1 DRINK + 1 MAMA DRAWING KIT = 19€) because of the drawing kit, however we didn’t receive it! the one on the 9th photo was a welcome kit (apparently different to the one on the menu), at least it is what the waitress said!

title: Super place
text: Excellent environment, fantastic food & sweets, super service from Marvin. Smiley and very pleasant!Strongly recommended. The food arrived in the right time. People working there where very polite, happy and helpful. Atmospheric environment, modern and clean

title: Don’t visit the restaurant if you don’t speak French
text:
Planned to meet friends at the rooftop bar. The friendly personnel at the hotel reception informed me that the bar was open and for drinks only no booking was needed. 

Luckily, I made a reconnaissance visit before the evening, only to find out the bar was closed that day. At the downstairs restaurant, I was told its terrace bar was open, free seating, no bookings accepted. When I later arrived with my friends, a few tables were free, but I was informed that they were booked. 

We were referred to the indoors bar. First, I was told all tables were booked, but when I said I stayed at the hotel and we also wanted to ear dinner later, I could get a table and was told a waiter would come soon. We never saw a waiter at our table. 

At the bar disk, a busy bartender completely ignored my order in English, although I stood right in front of him, and took orders from many French guests that arrived after me. When I told him that I had waited for a long time and wondered when he would take my order, he referred me in French to a colleague who was busy serving other guests. Frustrated we left the restaurant. 

Reading previous positive reviews, we were surprised to find this rude behaviour at the Mama Shelter.

title: Nice as usual !
text:
I particularly appreciate the service : nice and quiet people, really adjustable for our family.
The matress was as comfortable as at home, the same for the pillow.
The breakfast was as good as in 3 stars hotel : large choice to eat, sweet and salty and to drink.
Thank you !

title: Stunning hotel in Paris
text:
We stayed in this hotel for few days and we really enjoyed it. Room super clean with a really comfortable bed, drinks and breakfast amazing and the staff is incredibly kind and friendly. 
We definitely recommend this hotel to everyone especially for couples.

title: Mama shelter loves you, we love manager Sandra
text: We had a miscommunication about our reservation. It was till the next morning that we could speak about it with the manager. Sandra helped us in such a friendly and accurate way. Thank you Sandra and thank you mama Shelter. We had a wonderful stay! Sylvia van der Westen

title: Awesome design centric hotel
text:
Brilliant hotel with bags of personality and surprise design features around every corner. I wish the rooms were a little warmer but that’s the only minor issue I have. Otherwise the restaurants and bars are brilliant fun, the staff are probably the best and most fun in Paris, the food is amazing, the price of champagne is too low to stop drinking it ;) 

Absolutely love Mama!

title: Hipster hotel for younger fellows
text: Was there on a business trip, ssh i picked it as it was close to the trade centre. Reception needs improvement, very slow and not very quick in understanding simple logistics. Rooms was decent, functional bathroom, you could not hear a thing from the busy street. Breakfast was tasty and costs 18 Euro per person. Dinner was also fine but a little bit too expensive for what you get (54 Euros for a plate with meat and a coctail)

title: Fabulous food, beautiful venue and an easy hop into central Paris on the metro
text: Although this hotel has 'adult' options! (the sex package add on when booking online was a surprise!) Its actually a really great venue for a family. Staff were amazingly helpful, the rooms were quiet and clean. We also had a family room with 2 separate rooms for the beds - the living room has been turned into a bedroom for the kids - which is much better than the usual cot bed down the sides of the parent double bed.  The breakfast was also fabulous as was the lunch we had in the rooftop restaurant. We'll def stay here again.

title: Great modern hotel with very helpful team, functional & with great food & beverage outlets .
text:
I rarely write review on T/A – but I thought I would write one on my recent stay at the Mama Shelter West … I was there a couple of weeks ago .. the Hotel is brand new, opened late December, then closed 4 months later because of the Covid situation, and then reopened again 3 months later; not such an easy task to do when you are in the hotel business, I know…. It seems that - and despite all the turmoil experienced during all that time – they really got their act together! Great staff all around who generates a great atmosphere all throughout the hotel… Special thanks to Pauline and the 2 very helpful ladies at the reception who really went out of their way to help me in getting appointment, documents that were necessary to get myself back home…
The hotel might not in the best location but it is only a 15/ 20 minutes taxi ride from Montparnasse train station and to a walking distance to Rue de Vaugirard where you will find anything you need including nice small bistrots …But the hotel has also 2 F&B outlets that are worse the visits, before thinking to get out! – One is a roof top restaurant & bar, great for sundowners – (Eiffel tower on the horizon! & where they also serve a great breakfast (top notch crispy croissants and chocolatines); the other one on the ground floor, is rather vibrant venue where they propose great bistrot type food under the guidance of a 3 *** Michelin chef! I was there for 2 full days …Despite the hotel running at low occupancy (due to the covid situation) both restaurants at lunch and diner were packed with house guests but also with a lot of patrons from the outside! Highly recommended to book….though the front staff is pretty switched on as they will always propose to book for you. Finally, very comfortable rooms with all the latest modern facilities. Had a great time & will be back!

title: Really bad price/quality for brunch
text:
For 44 euros per person, you can go to really amazing places in Paris. This is sadly not one of them. The food IS good, but we had to stand in line for 10 minutes at each station to get the food. There were only 2 options for juice (orange and grapefruit), which is not diverse enough when you’re charging 44 euros...
While the staff are super friendly and welcoming, the service was slow, and no one came to clean the plates when we were done. Again, usually we wouldn’t mind too much, but in this case for the price we’re paying it’s not acceptable.
Finally the toilettes were really not clean at all. There were paper towels spread across the floor, and sanitary pads lying on top of the bin (so not regularly cleaned we assume).
We really love mama shelter usually, which is why this experience was so disappointing :(

title: Very chic & modern
text:
Very cool hotel, easy to find from the Metro. The rooms are chic and functional, had a huge walk in rain shower. Beds were comfy, no complaints.

Breakfast was nice, although a little inattentive - was not given an cutlery!

But super good experience.

title: Great hotel for event in Paris Expo
text:
Stayed for 4 nights as working at trade show at Paris Expo. Literally around corner.

New hotel. Fab helpful staff.

Great bedroom. Free wifi and films.

Plenty of choice for breakfast.

Good restaurant, funky vibe and dj!

title: Good clean hotel
text: Good clean hotel very well located for exhibitors at the nearby show center. A little disappointing that there isn’t a kettle or coffee in the room. One would expect this in such a hotel . Very comfortable beds.

title: Perfect experience
text: Love this hotel. Everything is nice, location, rooms, decoration, price, will definitely stay next time again. Breakfast was overwhelming, especially the granolas blew my mind. Nice personal with right attitude

title: Cannot Fault this Hotel
text:
I was in Paris for the Rock en Seine Music Festival however this hotel and it's location just topped off a brilliant 4 days.
First bonus for this hotel is it's location.  2 minute walk to the Subway and  right on your doorstep are all the cafes, bars and restaurants you can deal with.  Lively bustling area of Montmarte.  Moulin Rouge is round the corner a few minutes walk however my favourite area was en route towards the Sacre Coeur...street after street of lovely restaurants, bars and ice cream and craft shops.  Brilliant atmosphere throughout this part and all on your doorstep.  After a day sightseeing it was brilliant chilling in the evening here with the most difficult decision choosing what restaurant to eat in. 
Back to the actual hotel.  Cannot fault anything during our 3 night stay.  Rooms and bathrooms spotless.  Cleaning staff bang on and receptions taff very helpful.
Without doubt whenever I am returning to Paris I will be staying here.

title: DO NOT TRUST YOUR STAY WITH THIS OR ANY ACCOR HOTEL!
text:
The only reason this review gets any stars at all is for the sheer fact that the hotel was in a very accessible location to many bars, restaurants, and sites. The shared spaces for the hotel (lobby, restaurant, lounge) were relatively nice as well.

Here's where the zero star review would come in if it were possible:
For the price, our room was small and felt dirty. The carpet was visibly stained in quite a few areas and looked like it may not have been vacuumed thoroughly recently. The shower setup was lacking and it was impossible not to get water all over the bathroom floor when taking even a quick shower. One of the elevators consistently had issues taking either of our key cards to actually get it to move.

Much more concerning than the items I mentioned above, was the way one of the front desk staff handled a major problem that the hotel had created for us:

I thought my fiance had placed my passport in the hotel room safe, but the day before our flight out of Paris I noticed that it wasn't there. That's when we realized that we never got it back from the front desk clerk the night that we checked in. We immediately went down to the front desk, but when we asked the man working (on Monday June 27th 2022 between 11:30am-1pm) if he would please look around for it he seemed as though we were annoying him and that he could not be bothered to look. He specifically said, "we have no passports here". We urged him again to look and he opened one drawer, took a quick peek and assured us there was no passport. We felt the lack of respect from the front desk concierge when asked about the passport was completely unwarranted especially because at this time there was currently no one else at the desk to attend to.

Because he refused to help us, we had to spend the rest of our day going to multiple Paris police stations, then going to the US Embassy to get a replacement passport so I could fly to Dublin the next day and continue on our trip around the UK for the next few weeks.

This put an extreme damper on the end of our Paris trip and was unfortunate because we had to cancel our plans to spend our last day in Paris visiting the Palace of Versailles. Instead, we spent it running all over town, wasting the day, and spending 165 Euro’s on a replacement temporary passport + the cost of the Ubers to get to and from the police stations and Embassy. I will also have to incur the time/process of getting an actual replacement passport once back in the U.S.

Even more frustrating was that when we got back to the hotel late afternoon/early evening that day (Monday June 27th) the new front desk clerk recognized us immediately and said he had my passport at the front desk. It was in one of the drawers at the front desk…the same drawer that his colleague we asked earlier to check for the passport looked in half heartedly and said he didn’t have it.

I submitted a request to the hotel, Hôtel Mercure Paris Montmartre Sacré-Coeur Hotel, and hotel parent company, Accor, to tell them the issue and to ask them if they would at least cover the unnecessary replacement cost I incurred since it had been their fault my passport was "lost" in the first place. 

After I reached out respectfully to them twice and got nothing more than them questioning me why my passport was at the front desk and a "no" on helping cover my passport cost, I've been forced to leave this review due to their inaction. When again, the entire reason it was there was because their front desk employee forgot to give me my passport back upon checking in and then another refused to help us look for it.

After the way this situation was handled by one of the front desk staff as well as Marc Villeger, one of Accor's internal staff, I would urge you to not risk your stay with Hôtel Mercure Paris Montmartre Sacré-Coeur Hotel or any other Accor hotels and properties. It's unfortunate they would not admit their financial responsibility for their neglect.

title: Not as bad as others suggest.
text:
I am currently staying in the hotel and can offer no harsh criticism of it. 
The twin room on the 5th floor is spacious, clean and has 2 comfy beds. My only moan would be the pillows. Too soft for me but that’s a choice thing. 
There is a bathroom and separate toilet which is handy. The shower has great water pressure but the glass screen not big enough to prevent water egressing onto the floor. 
The room is equipped with TV, kettle with a variety of teas & coffees and a good sized safe. Small gripe is that there are no USB points for charging electronics. 
Staff that we interacted with were friendly & efficient. 
The room was cleaned and towels replenished every day of our 3 night stay. 
The hotel’s location is superb. Turn right from the hotel and you’re metres from the hustle & bustle of Place de Clichy with loads of shops, bars & restaurants and the Moulin Rouge area. 
Turn left, across the bridge and explore the Montmarte area which is absolutely fabulous. Quaint cafes, restaurants, bars and shops are all over this area on the rise to the Sacre Coeur Basilica. It’s an area you MUST explore.

title: Terrible for cleanliness
text:
After 10 wonderful days in France with my family, we decided to spend 2 nights in Paris on the way back home.

We wanted a hotel that would be easy to get to the A1 and close to Sacre Coeur so we booked Mecure in Montmatre Sacre Coeur. This was a mistake.

Their family room was booked so we got two double rooms, next to each other. However, the rooms were not up to the standards we expected.

1. There were pubic hairs and scalp hairs on the floors of the shower room and toilets of both rooms
2. There was urine on the floor in the toilet of both rooms
3. It was very clear that both toilets were not cleaned with a brush for a while
4. The beds were hard. If you like sleeping on the floor you would love their beds
5. Hair on the bed
6. The safe did not work in one of the rooms
7. The kettle didn’t work in one of the rooms
8. There was a crack on the floor in the shower
9. Blood on the wall
10. Stains on the carpet
11. Towels had a bad odour

In the toilet, there were pubic hairs and urine stains on the floor. There were also hairs on the floor in the shower room and more in the corners.

I called reception to tell them that the toilets and shower needed cleaning. The gentleman at reception said he cannot help me as there were no cleaners in the hotel at the time. He offered to change our room but that would mean as a family, we couldn’t stay in rooms next to each other. 

I was ready to leave this hotel, but they had taken full payment at check in and they had no manager on site on a Friday evening.

I was left with no choice but to clean it myself.  I asked for disinfectant wipes and gloves but I was offered a cleaning solution and towels to clean the toilet and floors. Yes, towels! Do the cleaners use the same towels they give to guests, to clean the toilets and floors? Although washed (or maybe not) the smell of the towels were horrible. 

In one of the shower rooms there was a red spot on the wall just where the towels were hung. I used a wet tissue to wipe it off and I’m certain this was blood.

The worse thing however, was the white smears of bodily fluid found on the underside of the throw on the bed and on the valance. 

I cannot recommend this hotel and most certainly not for families.

Glad we didn't include breakfast in our stay - can’t imagine the state of their kitchen. 

I have stayed in many Accor hotels before, when on holiday with my family and for business trips, but this one is by far the worse and I will never stay in another Mercure Hotel.

Moulin Rouge is closer to this hotel than Sacre Ceour. Perhaps it should be renamed “Mercure Montmarte Moulin Rouge”.

All pictures attached.

title: Go next door for better value
text:
The location is brilliant, but this hotel is very similar to the Ibis next door, only more expensive. Check in was lovely, but the room was tired and needed cleaning by someone who had no fear of corners!

20 years ago when I regularly stayed at the adjoining Ibis, I aspired to stay here. Wish I hadn’t bothered - I always chose the location because of good car parking, which is shared by both hotels. Save money - go next door for cheaper.

title: Would return
text:
Hotel is in an ideal location, rooms are really well sized for central Paris. Quick, easy transport links and lots of restaurants / bars / shops nearby. Metro to the Louvre etc takes about 15 minutes. 

Found all staff to be very friendly, welcoming and helpful. Anything we asked for throughout our stay was either promptly given or brought up to the room. Room was well equipped with all that was needed. Only issue was the A/C which although working was pretty weak. Had a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower as well. 

Breakfast was nice with plenty of options however the only let down was the ‘sweet’ area was riddled with wasps each day. 

Overall, highly recommend and would return

title: Not 4 star
text: Positives are location, good transport links, that is where it ends, the hotel was dirty, the bathroom and bedroom floor was dirty, there were two paper cups for tea and coffee in the room that weren’t replenished, when we asked for a cup and some milk at reception was told they didn’t have any.  The staff avoid eye contact with you and do not communicate with you.  This was for my 50th birthday and we had booked a superior room, goodness knows what a standard is like. No comments from the management, not even happy birthday which disappointed my daughter.  I received emails meant for someone else.  Paris did not disappoint it was as beautiful as I imagined but I would not stay here again or any other mercure for that matter. I think it was on the lower scale of 3 star.

title: A great stay in comfortable, quiet rooms with brilliant transport links
text:
The staff were friendly and our superior rooms (which seem to be the standard rooms) were large and very quiet with great black out curtains, fab air con and a useful little fridge.  

Travelling from the Gare du Nord by bus, the area seems initially a little "colourful" but we had no problems and the local shops and restaurants were great.  

Breakfast was plentiful with lots of choice, the outside seating area was slightly marred by the constant wasps buzzing around.  But we loved having a drink and watching the tiny birds in the garden.  The children enjoyed the table football.

 Within sight of the hotel, the Place de Clichy is brilliant for transport links to the whole city, bus and metro within a few mins walk and 30 mins on the bus to the Eiffel Tower.  25 mins walking uphill takes you to the Sacre Coeur, beautiful. 

We would definitely return to this hotel

title: Spacious rooms with a stunning view
text: From start to finish, our stay here was perfect. Our rooms were spacious and had the most stunning views over the city. The bed was really comfortable and was made every day by housekeeping who also refilled the fridge daily with a range of cold drinks. There was an excellent range of food available for breakfast. The hotel was only a few minutes from Moulin Rouge and the Metro.

title: Great weekend visit.
text:
Having read some other reviews we were slightly wary about this hotel but feel that the other reviewers must have been staying in another hotel, not this one.
We found the staff to be friendly, helpful and polite. The location is excellent, just round the corner from the Moulin Rouge, near a Metro, and plenty of shops, restaurants and bars.  The hotel reception is bright and airy and the terrace bar really nice.
Our room was quite spacious, clean, with air con and a safe. There was a good shower room and separate toilet. The bed and pillows were really comfy and the blackout curtains actually work.
Paris is expensive but we thought the price we paid for this hotel was reasonable. Would not hesitate to go back there.

title: Perfect stay in the most beautiful city
text:
Really shocked at reading some negative reviews about this hotel. We have just returned from a weekend in Paris and were blown away by the levels of service by the hotel staff - nothing was too much trouble. 

We travelled to Paris as a gift for my wife who turned 40 last month. Initially I emailed the hotel speaking to  the amazing Amandine Passicos about potentially doing something to help make my wife's stay special. When we arrived, we were delighted to find out that we had been given a voucher for welcome drinks in the bar, a Happy Birthday balloon, French chocolates and most importantly an upgrade to the Priveleged rooms with a stunning view of the Eiffel Tower. This started the weekend off perfectly for us. 

Regarding the hotel itself, the rooms were nice and big - free drinks which were replenished each day and large bed. The location of the hotel - albeit in an area that looked a little off - is absolutely perfect for a jaunt around the city with all major attractions being close by. Additionally it was within 10 minutes of Gare du Nord so getting too and from the Eurostar was straight forward by Uber. Breakfast was varied with plenty of choice and the bar food and drink were spot on also. 

All in all, we were delighted with our stay at the Mercure and would happily go again. Don't be swayed by the negative reviews and give this hotel a chance, it was perfect for us and we'd like to thank them for making our stay so special.

title: Do not stay here - HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
text: I do not recommend this hotel. Absolutely horrible customer service. If we weren’t part of an organized group I would be demanding my money back.  We have two rooms. First the lost my husbands luggage and delivered it to the wrong room. Then took over an hour to locate it and we were they ones who found it thanks to over hearing another guest say that they had someone else’s luggage. There was no empathy or concern. THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE. Then in the second room there are no towels or hand soap. After calling the front desk twice, we were told there are no towels tonight only tomorrow. I then went to the front desk only to be told the same thing. After demanding to be moved they miraculously found 3 hand towels and told me that was all they had. Again THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE. I will never stay at this hotel or a Mercure ever again. I will be writing a letter of complaint to both Accor Hotels and our tour operator.

title: Better than expected
text:
Don't be fooled by the location. This hotel is in an ideal location for getting around Paris, the Metro is about 100m and there is a bus stop at 50m. I would recommend walking up to the Sacre Couer up through the cobbled streets with all the pavement cafe's and shops, alternatively you can get the bus but you will miss quite a lot of the sites and history of Monmatre.
The hotel rooms are clean and plenty big enough. I would suggest you take advantage of the free safe in the room (DO NOT LEAVE ANY VALUEABLES IN THE ROOM).
The breakfast is very good with plenty of choice.

title: Wouldn’t visit again
text:
Mercure Paris Montmartre Sacre Coeur
Paris
Do not stay here! Bed bugs!
846635087
The stay in this hotel went from bad to worse. Decor is really nice but that was the only positive about it. The service on front desk is shocking Alain-Edward was the name of the guy on the desk and his attitude is the worst customer service we’ve ever had. Yelled at us, told us to go away (our room wasn’t ready at check in so we were made to sit and wait in the lobby with a child and repeatedly told by this man to go away when we asked for updates). 

The worst came when my 4 year old woke up with strange spots on first morning there then as the next few days went by myself and my brother did too. Upon returning home to England the spots got worse, become extremely agitated and sore. We had them checked by doctors which confirmed they were bed bug bites. My brother had to receive several antihistamines for his as they were borderline becoming infected! 

My bites were so uncomfortable and sore and my son’s causing him extreme discomfort I had to keep him off school and stay off work which meant loss of earnings as well as the cost of prescriptions to treat them. It has been weeks since our stay snd we are still suffering from the bites. 

I would advise people to stay away from this hotel. This hotel has a severe bed bug infestation from what our doctor observed from how badly we were bitten. 

The stay here cost us almost £600 for 3 nights and it is extremely disappointing to spend so much money on a place that is not worth it. This hotel really needs to re-think the staff that are representing the brand as it is clear from other reviews that service is a massive problem. 

We tried to file a formal complaint through the hotel company to be reimbursed but this is near impossible to do as the complaint route is not easy to go down which is clearly very convenient for the hotel. 

Worst experience in a hotel I’ve had. Ruined our whole time experiencing Paris. Will certainly not return!

title: Good old hotel in the Monrmartre area in Paris
text: Good old hotel in the Monrmartre area in Paris. The room is a little bit old and outdated. And unfortunately, as a Platinum Accor member, I wasn't offered for welcome drink nor upgrade room. I might need to avoid this hotel in the future.

title: Excellent stay
text: Stayed before, will likely stay again. Convenient to Montmartre and Place Clichy metro connecting two lines, so you can easily get almost anywhere in 30 minutes. Rooms clean and comfortable, nice to have window to open.

title: Poor response of reservation staff and non supporting behaviour to adjust booking during Covid-19 Pandemic
text:
My agent booked Hotel 4 Rooms for three night in July 2020 but due to Pandemic situation of Covid -19, we were unable to enter in France.
My agent requested for refund but they assured provide facility to change in date as per policy of Accor Group but now after of many email of my and my agent  and after so many call they didn't reply.
My booking amount is more than 200000.00 indian rupees but the reservation staff didn't reply.
