Another hotel of same group is adjusted my booking facility till December 2022.

The reservation executive spoiling the Brand Value of Accor Group Hotel.

title: Unpolite employees
text:
We (me and my wife) had a very bad experience with the lack of politeness of hotel's employees. 
If by one hand the waiter arrived screaming in the bar at the first floor, in the recepción they refused to accept and believe on me, even asking to talk to the manager. Its unacredible that instead of taking lessons learned and trying to improve the quality in the hotel, they have just ignored, and refused to accept the facts (from the customer perspective).
Absurdo.
Hope you guys do not have the same experience, as there are several and several other notes similar from other customers....a pity!

title: stellar customer service and view
text: Over the eight nights that I stayed at the Mercure, I experienced fabulous customer service, especially from Jean-Emanuel of the front desk staff.  On the third night of my stay, one night before I was supposed to fly back to the U.S., I tested positive for COVID.  Jean-Emanuel extended my stay with compassion and a friendly smile.  He

title: A good three-star hotel
text:
A good three-star hotel located next to Montmartre and Sacre Coeur. The rooms are OK but need some upgrades.

The breakfast room had space, and we didn't notice any rush, which is exceptional and very positive. However, the selection of food left some room for improvement. And many things were missing from the table, and we had to ask staff several times to fill them in.

The staff was friendly, and some of them were very helpful. However, some others didn't speak English, and it wasn't easy to get even the basic things done. The check-in was very chaotic.

I recommend this hotel based on the location; it has a reasonable walking distance to many essential places. But there's room for improvement in the overall quality compared to price.

title: If you are considering this hotel...
text: This is an excellent hotel. The room (superior double) was very nice and the bed was massive and very comfortable. The room was quiet and well sound proofed (we were on the 5th floor looking out onto the Rue Callaincourt). The room was air conditioned and with the window closed there was no street noise even the dreaded motorcycles/ scooters.  The room doors are designed not to slam - never heard a door slam (the curse of hotels) all the time we were there. The shower was excellent - powerful and hot. There was fridge in the room and a kettle so we could make Yorkshire tea (bring own tea bags of course).  The breakfast was brilliant; beans and egg and tomato and bacon and sausages in the hot buffet and tons of everything else including cold meats, fruit, croissants, pain au raisin etc etc. The location was excellent with lots of cafes bars and restaurants nearby. The Chinese restaurant in the road next to the hotel (Chez Feng - been there 32 years family owned) serves the best Chinese food I have ever tasted (ever ordered beef with black bean and been asked how you want the beef cooking?). We paid bugger all with a Eurostar deal and we were sorry to leave.

title: Very central
text: Great hotel,very clean and the staff were helpful and friendly. We came for a rugby weekend and couldn't ask for a better spot. Very close to the metro links to all of Paris. On the doorstep of great bars and restaurants.  Round the corner from montmartre and Moulin Rouge. Definitely stay there again.

title: Outstanding service from staff
text: This hotel was in a great location with easy access to Metro and sites. The room was clean. Food service for breakfast was extensive.  The  staff was most accommodating and helpful - especially Adam at the front desk.  I would book here again.

title: I want my held funds released…. Please … please contact me …
text:
£427.28 was taken on hold by the hotel in addition to the £335 charged to my account after check out
I am aware this is a massive hotel error. When I checked in I was told around 50 euro would be taken as a deposit and clearly 500 euro has been charged instead which is a large hotel error. 
This was on 3rd December. It is now 11th December. I have emailed the hotel 4 times to ask for confirmation of return and have received no response. When I last called I was told to stop calling as ‘they were busy and I just need to wait’
My account still has a hold on this amount which means I can’t spend it which is causing me enormous issues and stress especially considering the time of year 
Rang the mercure hotel complaints line no answer. Waited over an hour then gave up. The head office line no longer works. All I need is confirmation these pending funds have been released. But all I get is silence. So as it stands I’m £427 down for over a week. And I get zero response. 

Shame because the hotel is ok, spacious and in a great location. 

Hardly ever leave poor reviews, am not a fussy customer but I’ve genuinely never experienced such rudeness. And yes the staff are right. I did keep calling. But that’s because they have and are holding a large sum of money of mine which they shouldn’t be. So I have every right to call. 

The only reason I’m posting this is because the hotel seems actually to respond to reviews. So I’m hoping this might get a response. Real shame. Not a difficult customer just want the money that’s been taken back or some form of proof to show it’s actually been released. I’m sure if the staff at this hotel had had over £400 held on their account at Christmas time they would want it sorted too. Unfortunately all they want to tell me is they are busy and I need to wait. Completely unacceptable.

title: A great stay in a great neighbourhood
text: Being a stone's throw from a favourite dive bar of ours, we'd wanted to stay here for a while, and the opportunity arose at a decent price so we went for it. Having ALL Platinum status, our most basic of rooms was upgraded to a top floor view over Paris dominated by the Eiffel Tower - absolutely lovely. Room was recently renovated, spotlessly clean, decent size, and the upgrade included a Nespresso machine and a small free soft drinks minibar refilled daily. Checkin was a bit ropey - we were still made to wait for a room at 4pm, perhaps that's how we got the upgrade, which was worth it - and we got a free late checkout. Staff were all friendly, efficient and professional. Mercures can be a bit hit-and-miss, this one is a definite hit.

title: Nice budget hotel, great location
text: A basic chain hotel, but with very comfortable room and good breakfast. And a fantastic location for exploring Montmartre. There are loads of good cafes and restaurants nearby, and it's very handy for the metro. I'd stay there again

title: Lovely views and area of Paris
text: Awesome experience. Enjoyed our time. Very interesting venue and fabulous views. The shopping and restaurants were fantastic. The area is very bohemian and eclectic. We can’t wait to return! Overall, a very special place indeed. Be careful of the cobblestone walks!

title: Terrible customer service
text:
We booked to stay here for my 40th birthday. The hotel has cancelled our reservation due to Covid but refuses to refund my payment. As I have paid for train tickets to London and Eurostar to Paris I will now have to find another hotel but as this large hotel chain continues to hold my £400 I have limited funds so I we are really stuck. It is completely unfair and unreasonable of this hotel. They offer a credit note with a time limit of 18 months but the hotel is not even open to enable this voucher to be used! This means I will be forced to find funds for a further trip to Paris to enable me to use the voucher next year!

The hotel claims this is their cancellation policy but this is in the case of the customer cancellation, rather than the hotel choosing to close and thus being unable to fulfil the contract by providing the goods I have paid for!

This is appalling and such a big hotel chain should treat its customers better!

title: Great stay
text: We stayed here for 3 nights.  One mile from Gare du Nord so hopped off Eurostar and it only took 20 minutes to walk.  Right round the corner from Moulin Rouge and 10 minutes walk from Sacre Couer.  Was a fair trek to Eiffel Tower, we chose Lime electric scooters to get about and covered about 40 miles!!! Breakfast was lovely and the staff were polite and friendly.  The room was fine, clean and fresh every day.

title: Very disappointing, not good value for the price
text: I was given a room that was the furthest possible from the elevator, with the only pluses being that it was mostly quiet, and the mattress was fine, although rather firm. The room layout was very awkward, with almost no space to move around. Fine, that’s not unusual for big city hotels. But it was also one of the most hideous hotel rooms I’ve ever stayed in, and I’ve traveled to over 40 countries on nearly every continent. Too many competing shades of red, with dark, muddy gray-brown walls and headboard. The carpeting was dark and ugly, and also worn and stained. The tub / shower was difficult to climb into, was exceedingly slippery, and of course, did not have an adequate enclosure or curtain, so ended up with water all over the floor. The toilet smelled bad, and water started leaking from the base of the toilet onto the floor. That happened during my last night, so I felt it was too much trouble to ask to change rooms. Did I mention cheap, thin towels? And all of the surfaces were quite dusty, and the safe was broken. To add insult to injury, I was treated very rudely by a young woman at the front desk at checkout. THEN I saw an additional charge of $111 to my credit card, although the full price had already been charged the day I booked. I was never notified about a security deposit during booking or check-in. I certainly hope that charge is reversed, or I will take away another point from my rating! This does not feel at all like a 4-star hotel, certainly not worth a price 50% higher than the 3-star Ibis next door.

title: Brief stay
text:
Stayed here for two nights while working in St Ouen. Location is good for exploring on foot in the evening, but the metro is very crowded to travel from Place de Clichy in the mornings.
Room was fine, clean, as expected.
The hotel has very nice places to relax and the dining area is very pleasant. I had one breakfast. The buffet selection was vast and the quality was good. The only problem was some sloppy washing of coffee cups and over exuberant clearing of my table mid-breakfast.
Check in and out was very smooth and quick.

title: Fantastic stay, would recommend
text:
Lovely surprise on arrival to have an upgrade to the top floor rooms! These superior rooms have complimentary soft drinks in the fridge (replenished daily), bathrobes and nespresso coffee. The rooms are really large for Paris too. The hotel staff are very helpful and the breakfast fresh and delicious, everything replenished quickly. We even had a complimentary birthday cocktail in the bar.
The hotel is perfectly located for Montmartre and the nearby bus stop goes directly to the Louvre. Moulin Rouge (amazing show) was just around the corner, without being right on top of the colourful sex shops!

Only niggle was the taxi booked from the hotel reception which we were told would be €15 at the most for Gare de Nord, but didn't mention the additional €7 reservation fee.

Otherwise, fabulous would definitely recommend and return!

title: Wedding
text: I would like to thank JESSICA for her kindness, her great smile, for you great time that we spent with you thanks to Jessica, it meant a lot to us to be received so well.  We will come back this year thanks to you because you were very nice to us so what kind of people do you need in the reception because your friendliness and your smile gave us all the stress we had for a moment we could forget it thank you and see you soon Marc

title: Great location, decent hotel
text: We stayed here for 2 nights whilst visiting Paris for the rugby. The hotel is clean and comfy - and perfectly suited to this kind of stay or a business trip. It is walking distance from the Metro line 13 at Place de Clichy and only 10 mins walk from Rue des Abesses with all the restaurants and bars. Breakfast was good and the staff all keen to help. Just what was needed for this purpose, functional and with all the necessary facilities.

title: Bright Hotel well placed for site seeing
text: The breakfast was good quality and the local beer very enjoyable. The service was very Good  and the room clean and bright. The location was great for the local metro and Montmartre close enough to walk. Heed the warnings  when travelling around Paris to be aware of pickpockets.

title: Very good
text: We stayed there for two nights it was very busy a bit of a wait for breakfast.room was nice and had everything you needed . Toilet was very small and dark grey a bit overpowering.front desk staff were hit and miss most of them great but a couple of grumpy men.we would go back

title: Not used to being this busy
text: Whilst the room is clean, the hotel is distinctly average. Breakfast was not well organised. The staff were clearly overrun and getting frustrated by the constant complaints caused by lack of cutlery, plates, running out of various food. England rugby did not choose wisely for the cost.

title: Some staff rude
text: Still currently staying but felt I needed to write a review mid stay to try and get a response from hotel, check in was hard work couldn’t find our booking eventually Alfred (was nice and polite- could teach his colleague a thing or 2!) did and room is nice. Later our key to room stopped working and reception said we shouldn’t be in that room but a different one even though all our stuff was locked in there- eventually they agreed we were in that room and got our key card working. Menu says room service is available until 11pm tried ringing directly at 1040 no one answered phone so reception transferred me for the phone to be put down on me, told reception and they transferred me again to be told at 10.50 rudely closed! I tried explaining it says 11 on menu and the lady was just rude said NO. Not the service I’d expect, she obviously just could not be bothered- unfortunately this is leaving a bad feeling about the hotel and now I’m hungry.

title: Good Hotel but Beware!!!!
text: We just completed a stay at this hotel for one week.  All was well enough for what we paid, but the morning we checked out we found out that our car service had canceled our ride due to the ongoing transit strike.  We found out at the last minute and went to the front desk for help.  We understood that this was in no way the hotel’s fault, but they were quite unhelpful and dismissive of us.  One front desk worker simply said “It’s too complicated to get a taxi” and walked away. The other person behind the counter had some advice for us but this hotel is truly not equipped to help their guests especially while this strike is going on. ALSO, when we checked in using our Booking.com reservation, the female desk worker said we were not in the system and walked away.  Honestly, you’re better off paying 5 star prices and getting good service.  Although the rest of our stay was fine (the hotel has a nice design, great breakfast, basic but sufficient fitness center, and is definitely in a good location), we were ultimately disappointed with the service aspect of this  hotel and probably would not stay here again.

title: Great stay over a long weekend
text: Featuring a great location (many attractions within walking distance, Sacre Coeur about a 15 to 20 minutes walk, and quick access to the metro network via Place de Clichy), good bedrooms (firm mattress, good sound isolation from both outside noise as well as corridor/adjacent bedrooms), nice service with helpful concierges and a great breakfast selection (all the required goods for a continental breakfast, English breakfast and other sweet or fruity options), this was a good stay for a long weekend break.

title: Excellent location!
text: My daughter & I love this hotel. It’s about a 2 block walk along a busy thoroughfare with good lighting & crosswalks to Moulin Rouge, the metro, Starbucks, loads of restaurants, and pastry shops. From Charles de Gaulle airport it’s easy to take the train to Gare du Nord & catch your train via the tunnel - no worries about weather! The hotel itself is very nice, clean, and the staff were friendly. My favorite part was our walk through the Montmartre neighborhood from Sacre Couer back to the hotel. It’s a beautiful walk & I regret not visiting it prior to our last night.

title: Hotel close to Montmartre and Moulin Rouge
text:
Hotel is located in the popular tourist area of Montmartre beside Place de Clichy.

Good size comfortable room - larger than many I have stayed in Paris.

The entrance could easily be missed.  It is beside its sister Hotel Ibis.

Nice bar on 1st floor.  Good cocktails.

One thing to be aware of is that the location, though handy to many attractions, is beside some of the more libertine entertainment.

title: Eh
text:
After reading the reviews, I expected more. It wasn’t awful, just not great. Our room was big. Very roomy.. just a little damp feeling. Carpet felt a little old. Our room faces the Main Street and boy was it loud. All day. All night. We got there while the transit system was shut down due to a protest so I assume that’s what all the traffic noise was about. I think we stayed near a hospital because the amount of ambulance sirens that passed by each night was shocking. 
Breakfast was decent. The crew in the breakfast area were very pleasant. Very friendly. 
Front desk was decent.

title: Great hotel
text: We stayed at the Mercure for 3 days for a trip to Paris. We were upgraded to a Superior Room as it was my birthday, and had a fantastic view of the Eiffel Tower from the room. The bed was extremely comfortable- had a good nights sleep every night. Staff were very friendly and helpful. The hotel is a couple of minutes walk from the Moulin Rouge - and about a 45 minute walk from the Eiffel Tower, although there is a metro station very close by. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Pleasant 4-night hotel stay!
text: Very nice, clean, comfortable room with everything you'd need. Had a fantastic sleep in the cosy beds which had good mattresses, and a quiet hotel environment. Much appreciated the comfortable bed after an adventure-of-a-lifetime in Madagasar the week prior. Lovely tea, coffee, and herbal infusions available in hotel room to ease tension before shut-eye. Superb breakfasts available for a moderate fee.

title: Nice but needs to be better maintained
text:
A lovely hotel in a perfect location. 10min taxi ride from Gare du Nord, near a metro station which takes you to the Opera Garnier area in 2 stops, close to lots of nice bars and restaurants. The hotel at first looks very good, it has recently been renovated however, some classic and superior rooms look half renovated and half not. Meaning: all new furniture, modern look to it but the bathroom is old/outdated and therefore looks dirty. Bathroom doors with holes in it and not enough closet space. We changed rooms, were placed in another superior room and this one was perfect (how it should be). Completely renovated, also new bathroom and enough closet space. The breakfast was perfect as well, lots of choice (also when on a diet). They have a direct line with the taxi service so a taxi can be arranged by the hotel. One note on the beds: they felt like wooden planks. 
Outside on the terrace they have cute little iglo’s in which you can sit and have drinks. 
Overall an ok experience, I would recommend the hotel just make sure you have a good room. Personally I like the Mercure Opera Garnier better.

title: Close by Sacrecure
text:
Hotel ok, room renovated and generally in good shape, breakfast ok and fast service. 45minutes to CDG and easy to get a taxi. Libanese and Italian restaurant on the other side of the street.
Room price quite high.

title: Clean, coisy and friendly service
text: I booked in the hotel for 3 nights with my girlfriend. I choose the cheapest price for 4stars hotel. so I was afraid to end in a bad place, to my surprise. The room was very spacious for a place in the middle of paris, 2 min Walk from moulin rouge. Sperate toilet and sperate bathroom with a tube ( great with a bottle of champagne 😉👌 ) the room was very clean and stuff very friendly. I m definitely going back to this hotel for next visit.

title: Modern Hotel
text:
I really enjoyed staying at thus modern, clean hotel.

Rooms are small but very clean. Each room is equipped with a safe. Hotel is within walking distance to Moulin Rouge, and Sacre Coeur.  On the way to the church you do walk by the "artist" section with artists displaying their art, which I loved.

Staff is very welcoming and helpful. Breakfast is included and leans towards European cuisine.

title: Great hotel and base for Paris marathon 2019
text:
Stayed here for the 2nd time.

Checking in was smooth and the staff on the desk were very helpful.
We arrived Via taxi direct from CDG, a trauma; my wife left her bag containing passports, paperwork, purse in the taxi.
As soon as we knew this had happened the staff did everything to retrieve our belongings. 
I didn’t really have that much faith but low and behold the taxi guy came back about an hour and half later with the bag and all it’s contents. 
What a nice guy.
So thanks to the hotel staff and to this taxi driver / you’re honestly amazing.

Anyway rooms, as I’ve stayed on previous occasion I upgraded our room to a privileged  room on the top floor. Amazing views of Paris, nice size room and very comfortable.
Breakfast is a buffet type and had everything you need to fuel up and start the day.

Enjoyed this hotel.
Very reasonable price
Thanks 
Simon

title: Nice hotel
text: This hotel was nice. The location was within many restaurants and shops to get snacks. The breakfast buffet was great. I only had two complaints, and one of them was what most people complain about. The mattress. It was so hard. It was hard to sleep without getting a back ache. My second complaint is the shower. There was a small glass door but I still ended up getting water all over the floor. Also the tub is deep so it can be a problem getting in and out. I would recommend this hotel. I didn’t think the area was sketchy as some other people said but you should always be aware if your personal items and surroundings when traveling.

title: Disapointing, would not go back
text:
I stay in hotels 40 weeks a year and this was by far the most disappointing hotel that I have stayed in. 
The positives are that it is in a good location, with plenty of good restaurants near by and the rooms are quite and reasonably clean. 
The negatives, the bed was so hard and the most uncomfortable I have ever slept on, the bash/shower was so narrow that I had to stand side ways in it and when sitting on the toilet if you leaned forward you banged your head on the door. The bedrooms are a reasonable size so I don't understand why the have skimped on the bathrooms. 
My rate included breakfast which was not too bad on the first two mornings but on my last morning the bacon and egg servers were empty and were only refilled as I was leaving twenty minutes later. I wanted to have a cup of tea but the hot water machine was broken, I did eventually find one that worked after asking three members of staff. 
A business colleague of mine was also staying at the hotel and he agreed with everything that I have stated above. 
To conclude, when checking out I was not asked how my stay was and I put this down to the number of complaints that they must receive.
I will not be staying there again.

title: Good accommodation
text: Good accommodation with good sized room. Great position in the Montmatre. Plenty of restaurants/cafes in immediate area.  Breakfast all a person could need.  Quirky decor bur easy on the eye. Only drawback as far as I was concerned was steep sided bath making it personally difficult at 72 and tired legs to step into to access shower. Several instances of misinformation from reception staff regarding taxis and dry cleaning did detract. May have been language problems but insisted on cash for dry cleaning rather than add to accommodation account.

title: Very modern, clean and nice, but sketchy area
text:
I was impressed with how modern this hotel is. The room was a decent size for Europe. I liked how the toilet was in its own little closet from the sink/shower. The shower did tend to spray water all over the tile floor, though, because it only had an artsy glass wall that didn't do a good job of blocking water. It wasn't super noisy. The breakfast was GREAT! Their croissants tasted freshly homemade and were delicious. They had tons of food choices, and the breakfast area was large and nice. The ONLY negative to this hotel is that the area seems a little sketchy... even one of the nearby shop owners told us to keep our bags and things close to our body and to watch out. But... I think a lot of Paris is like that, not just this area.

It's a very short walk to the subway station. We also walked to Moulin Rouge, and there are a lot of great restaurants and shops within a block. I'd definitely stay here again.

title: Good alternative
text: Nice hotel, rooms and lobby are clean, good location, comfortable bed. Staff were not too friendly, sometimes distracted on the phone, chatting each other. Furthermore, we were refused to have a drink in the room next to the reception, even it was completely empty, we did not behave rude, disordered or noisy, then it does not make sense to have it as "available" if guests cannot use it. Dissapointing.

title: Paris 2019
text:
Mercure hotel 

We booked this hotel on the Eurostar website as a package with the train.  Having visited Paris regularly in the last 4 years we were pleasantly surprised by the room . The room was a very good size with a large firm bed, wet room, fridge and kettle. Looking out the window you get a view of the Sacre Coeur . Breakfast was fantastic  with both a continental selection and hot choice. Machines for tea and coffees.  Staff were very helpful and friendly.
The hotel is in walking distance of the Sacre Couer and Moulin Rouge and local shops and restaurants . Uber Taxi 🚕 to Champs Elyse was €9 in the day and the Eiffel Tower was €11 .  
We enjoyed a nice glass of wine in the bar and at €6.50 it was a very good price for Paris . 
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and will definitely look at stopping here again. 
Couldn’t understand the criticisms on Trip Advisor before we came as this hotel is fantastic compared to others in Paris in this price range .
Taxi from train station €9 to hotel

title: Great Location
text:
We were in a Privilege Room with an Eiffel Tower view. The location is close to the Moulin Rouge and not too far of a walk to Sacre-Coeur.  The staff were very helpful  and had an anniversary surprise set up in our room (Thank-you Kenza).
There is so much too see within a few kilometers.

title: Highly recommended
text:
Great location walking distance to the art district, sacre coeur. Had a fabulous view of the tour eiffel although a distance to walk, moulin rouge walking distance.
Staff friendly, breakfast fabulous all you could ask for

title: Awesome Service!
text: This hotel is perfectly located close to the Moulin Rouge, restaurants, the subway and the Open Tour hop-on bus stop. (Beware- its competitor, Big Bus, allows hopping off, but not hopping on at some of its Montmartre stops). There’s even an excellent small Chinese restaurant across a side street from the hotel. Although the hotel is not in central Paris, our very modern room even had a view of the Eiffel Tower. I especially cannot thank Bruna enough for making our Paris holiday so enjoyable. She and Melissa helped us find places, get tickets, arrange transportation, and made our stay very memorable. They both deserve the highest praise! Bruna even helped move us to a room closer to the elevator because my husband has trouble walking. She didn’t seem to have any days off during the whole week we were there, so if she isn’t the manager, she should be! I would highly recommend this hotel, and we hope to return in the future.

title: Close to the Moulin Rouge
text: The staff is attentive and the service very good. The room was perfectly well maintained. The hotel, located a stone's throw from the Moulin Rouge, offers a very pleasant place to stay and all the usual services.

title: Will choose another place on my next trip
text:
Stayed here for work. Staff is just not helpful. The go to response is “not possible” and “no”. One of the team members lied to me about the taxi service she called for me. Why??? The responses do not make sense, are rude and the service is just way below what anyone should expect for the price of this hotel. 

Just like other guests, I complained about the bed being too hard (I couldn’t sleep and really need the rest while working). No help. The bed is like sleeping on the floor. 

Also, the soap wasn’t refilled for 3 days but that was the least of my worries.

Very uncomfortable stay - won’t be returning.

title: HELP!!!!!
text:
We have stayed at hotel several times but this is definitely the last time. We are in the 2nd night of a 3 night stay and the experience has been awful.

The staff have been spectacularly unhelpful, rude and dismissive. At check-in, the staff member's default response was to say 'No', even before we had finished asking a question. This was particularly annoying when we were giving her our name to allow us to check-in and she did not allow us to finish before saying 'no'! Another staff member's response to our concern about the harm the bed was causing was to say "what do you want me to do about it?" Management obviously have no interest in recruiting quality staff with good customer care skills. Perhaps the current crop of employees are cheaper and less skilled?

Our first room had a defective bed mechanism and we were moved to another room (822) after much insisting.

The second room's bed was so hard that we asked for a mattress topper to provide extra padding but 2 nights later we are still waiting despite several requests. When I woke up this morning, I could not stand straight due to back-ache and advised the hotel of this but there was still no solution offered to help.

When we stayed previously, we would spend an additional several hundred dollars with breakfasts and in the bar (champagne cocktails and snacks). This time, the appalling customer service has meant that we will not be spending one extra euro at this hotel. Not one. If only all customers would do the same, perhaps management would get the message.

Another issue is that this is so obviously not a 4* hotel. There are paper cups in the rooms, plastic glasses, no tea and no furniture at the bed-sides. Please note that we did book the best quality room the hotel offers.  

So, au revoir Mercure Hotels. We will not be staying with you again.

A final message to the management, please do not respond to this message with empty platitudes and a promise to do better next time. Please do better this time during our current stay if you are really serious about customer service. Otherwise, save your time and your comments for those who may believe them. And, if you are really concerned about providing a good customer experience, start with hiring competent staff!

title: Wonderful way to celebrate our anniversary
text: We have just come back from a wonderful stay at the hotel. We loved it. Our room was spacious and comfortable with lots of little extras. We were given a room upgrade to help us celebrate and lots of little extra touches made us feel so special. We had a great view of the Eiffel Tower. The room itself was comfortable, quiet with a luxurious feel to it.  The hotel is very well located and a short walk from the Metro. The area itself has lots of charm and its easy to get to Sacre Cour. We can't wait to come back and visit such a wonderful hotel again.

title: Please avoid
text: We checked in last night and were given a room in the first floor. The room needs refurbishment. The WC is from the last century. Why are they using these rooms I don't know. Never going to stay in a Mercure again. We stayed at AC hotel by Marriott in Porte Maillot. It is far superior compared to this one. Never again here.

title: Mercure Paris Montmartre
text: The hotel is located close to the Moulin Rouge and about 10 minutes walk from the Sacre Coeur and hence there are lot of interesting places to visit and eat close to the hotel.   Room was large, clean and modern.  The only downside was that on Sunday the breakfast provisions were running a bit low, the tables were slow in being cleaned up.  One can eat outside, which is OK if you don't mind all the smokers.

title: Some good points, but some very bad
text:
The staff was friendly and helpful, but not as full of local knowledge as I would like given that they lack concierge service.  The location is great, being near the Pace de Clichy Metro and some bus lines as well as rue Lepic, where one can find a lot of nice restaurants.  The room us small, thought that is not unexpected, but the really brutal part was the bed and pillows. I ended my stay in Paris with a seriously bad back and I give the credit for this to the horrible bed, which also made sleep difficult.

On the plus side, we had a great view from the room and Steve, at reception, was especially nice and deserves a mention.  I know I'm jumping around here, but I also want to mention that the rooms are tired-looking, but clean and well kept up and the maid service was fine.  So all in all it's a nice enough hotel, but the bed and pillows were a serious problem.

title: Quirky decore
text: Although the hotel was interesting and very modern I did not like the location. The hotel itself was clean but The area where it was located was congested and dirty. Unfortunately the two nights we were there I could not sleep because the air conditioning was not working. So uncomfortable. The bar was nice with a great outdoor seating area. They need to work on their breakfast buffet.

title: Weekend break in Paris
text:
Booked online through Eurostar this hotel proved to be a great choice. 
The staff were friendly and extremely helpful. Everyone we met from the concierge to the room maid was happy and made our stay more enjoyable. 
Our room was very clean, spacious and more than adequate for my children and me. 
When we return to Paris this will be our automatic selection

title: Good Location
text: Overall the hotel was good.  We were there when it reached 42 degrees and the AC did not work as well, I guess that is a Europe thing. They did give us a portable fan, which helped Overall room was good, could use some updating. Service was excellent at the front desk and we constantly were able to get iced water, which helped in the heat

title: Very very nice place
text: Amazing views with amazing people. This is a must-visit spot. I found it a little pricey but it was great. My children loved the food and views. The place was quiet with polite visitors and staff. Definitely would visit here again.

title: Excellent staff
text: This hotel was Awesome! They met are accommodations as we are from Texas and felt it was hot in the bedroom. The gentleman kindly found us a fan and brought it to our room. We also did not have the adapter for electronics and asked to borrow and without hesitation the staff did. Great location walking distance close to sub, food and bars.

title: Fantastic stay at this lovely hotel
text:
Hi. My daughter and I recently had a very enjoyable stay at the Mercure Montmartre, as a treat to celebrate her 18th birthday. On arrival there, we were given a room upgrade and a little present for daughter's 18th. This was hugely appreciated, and got our trip off to a really great start. The staff are very polite, courteous and helpful. Thanks in particular to Jordan for the very warm welcome, and for making our stay extra special!
The room was lovely and very clean. I loved all the little extra touches, like the high quality toiletries and coffee machine (which could also simply heat the water for tea, if coffee isn't your thing). There was also a fridge with complimentary refreshments, and perfect for keeping fresh milk, for said tea! The safe also came in very handy.
Wifi was excellent and never cut out, unlike many other hotels I've stayed at.
Bed was comfortable, thus ensuring a good night's sleep. The hotel was also lovely and quiet inside.
We loved the breakfast and the choice was good too; there was always plenty of food, providing you with the perfect start to a day's sightseeing.
The location is good, and the closest metro station (Place de Clichy) is a couple minutes' walk away. The area is more Pigalle than Montmartre (the Moulin Rouge is round the corner!), and as such is a bit sleazy at night, with all the sex shops. My teenage daughter wasn't a fan, but this was her first time in Paris, and I am well enough acquainted with it to know that it's perfectly safe. And the seediness is easily avoided, if like my daughter you have no wish to embrace it :) 
There is also plenty of places to eat and drink locally, plus a Monoprix supermarket on the main Street near the Moulin Rouge/Blanche metro station. Paris really is incredibly expensive these days, so I found it helped to be able to pack the odd picnic with fresh ingredients from the supermarket, or even just buy treats and bottles of water for the room.
I hope this review helps, and if you have already booked or are thinking of booking, please don't be put off by the more negative reviews. The hotel itself is beautiful and I wouldn't hesitate to return.

title: Good Location
text: A good hotel located near by Sacre Coeur, comfortable and clean rooms. Nice decoration and facilities including co-working space. An odd point is you may find it crowded during the breakfast and the number of staff isn’t enough to support the number of people.

title: Great Weekend Break
text: Stayed for a long weekend  - breakfast was below average and some of the staff were not very helpful but overall enjoyed the stay and would recommend. I would book another Mercure hotel based in this stay.

title: 5 stars, BUT......
text:
We have stayed many times at this hotel over the past 2 decades and are always more than satisfied, BUT, this time there was a broken shower in our room and repeated requests, to front desk staff and the floor manager over four days had the result of nothing being done to rectify  the problem. A plumber did call on the room, but said he would return the next morning  as he was unable to repair the fault. HE DID NOT RETURN, and the fault remained so for the rest of our stay. Luckily as we are expert bricoleurs and the fault was not insurmountable,we were able to sort the problem with a small length of string.
  Otherwise the stay was more than pleasant, the staff were more than courteous and in the main, helpful. The general public areas are clean and tidy. The Bar is good with an outside terrace, but a little pricey.
  Breakfast is something to behold, fantastic. Hot cooked food, unlimited hot drinks, cold buffets and breads make for a very wholesome start to the day.
  Even with the niggles at the start of this review, I have no hesitation of recommending this hotel.

title: Trip to paris
text:
Great hotel smells lovely on arrival polite on reception warm welcome lovely reception area. Lovely room's and exterior and terrace and breakfast/dinning area. Reasonable price  great for kids couples family for everyone. Close to the local shops/bars/cafe restaurants easy access to public transport bus and train and taxi the bus 30 takes you straight to the Eiffel Tower lovely experience 2 euros bus trip. The shopping mall literally 5 min on the bus 80  defintely coming. Cinema 3 minute walk away local park.
Prefect location Great room tea coffee water..clean bedding daily...fresh water at reception..Great choice at breakfast nice pleasant staff. Good tv channels..nice shower n bath clean comforty room nice hotel nice bar area free use of the gym also comes towels and drinking water nice bonus 
Daily hotel tax charger 10 euros I stayed for 5 night with my son and sister great package deal from euro star return train from london to Paris prices included and breakfast for three people £700 a queen size bed and a sofa bed a seating area plus a dressing table nice size room Disney channel aswel

title: Very good choice
text:
If you want to rest in a good place , do not hesitate.
The place is beautifull in one of the best part of Paris, the team is very friendly
The breakfirst is an open buffet with a lot of choice, the room are big and quiet !
Thank you again

title: Great hotel and location!
text: We stayed here as part of a tour group in May.   It was a great location, right near Sacre Coeur, with lots of wonderful little restaurants, and convenient shops.   Super close to the Metro, so easy to get anywhere in Paris from here.   We liked it so much that we're returning to Paris in February, and we've booked this hotel again!  Very reasonable prices for modern, well kept rooms.

title: Delightful 3-day stay! Exceptional service.
text: We had a delightful 3-day stay in Paris at the beginning of our European trip. The service was friendly and inviting and the hotel was conveniently located to both the train and bus station. There were many wonderful restaurants within walking distance. Our room was well designed with a very comfortable bed. Our stay included a delicious breakfast buffet each morning with an array breads, fruits, meats, eggs, and amazing crepes. I highly recommend the Mercure for your visit to Paris.

title: Superb hotel , location and services
text:
My wife and I stayed here for a week 7 years ago, booked here again for 5 days this trip. The hotel continues to impress in every way! They have fully renovated since our last visit and the hotel is very clean, modern and well maintained. 
Rooms are great, spacious, seperate toilet area from bathroom which is a plus and great ammenities such as coffe/tea, safe, sitting area with table, mini fridge. We found the room and hotel extremely quiet the entire stay. Wifi worked perfectly throughout. 
Our booking included breakfast and the breakfast area is large, never crowded and well managed by staff. Selections are large, food quality is great and unlike other hotels we've used in Paris, the atmosphere here is casual and you can enjoy a peaceful breakfast here !! Well worth booking breakfast here with your room. !
Got to make mention of the staff here. Service is obviously their focus, always upbeat, engaging and helpful. Speaks volumes of good management and happy staff! 
The area this hotel is situated in is outstanding. Metro access a half block away, Moulin Rouge only three blocks.  Very close to Nord and Est train stations. There are lots of great eateries and pubs close by, area is extremely easy to navigate on foot, very safe and comfortable. No need to think you need to pay more and be close to places like the Louvre, Eiffel Tower. 10 minutes on Metro solves that and avoids crowded hotels. Hotel is close to Sacre Couer Basilica which is fantastic site and area in Montmartre. 
Highly recommend this outstanding hotel and will return for our next stay !!

title: Highly recommended
text: Very beautiful, clean and value for money. Staff very helpful and my experience was amazing. The breakfast spread is decent, good amount of fruits and cheese. Entire property is very aesthetically pleasing

title: Excellent hotel in Paris
text: Excellent hotel location, very clean and staff willing to help with everything!!Absolutely professional!!Beautiful rooms with stunning bathrooms!!!We recommend it for sure!!Everything in walking distance!!

title: definitely recommend
text: Clean and modern hotel in a great area. Walking distance to many of the attractions. Only negative is the Wifi wasn’t great if you plan to work out of the hotel. Staff was friendly and helpful as well. Definitely recommend and would love to stay again.

title: Great trip
text: The hotel staff were all very friendly and helpful and the hotel room was very comfortable. Our only complaint was the room doors. We didn't understand how to lock it upon leaving at first, but learned after our first time leaving the room. Others on our floor routinely let their doors slam behind them before going back to properly lock it using the key. It was a lot of noise early in the morning. A short note by the door in the room might be helpful.

title: Paris forever
text: Wonderful hotel. Best view to the Tourre Eiffel. Best experience. Super pool and spa so so beautiful. Super central. Very near to any attractions. Beautiful rooms. We will choose this hotel onceagain. Totally recommended

title: 2 days in Paris
text:
In Paris with the kids and had nothing planned. But no worries - the hotel had our back! Alejandro helped us with recommendations and everything we needed. 
Location was great, 15 mins from the Louvre on a narrow street with lots of great options for a quick bite. 
Loved it! Will definitely return next time we’re in town!

title: We really enjoyed staying at the Lyric
text: We highly recommend this hotel.  The staff members were extremely helpful and polite.  The cleaning service was excellent.  The location of the hotel is terrific.  We really liked the amenities of the hotel.

title: great stay in classy boutique hotel
text: we stayed here for 3 days and found the hotel to be clean, comfortable and well run. the check in process was smooth, staff were friendly and professional and we would be happy to stay again. it well located with great restaurants in the location and close to the metro transport links. Overall, we would recommend this hotel for a short trip to explore paris.

title: Excellent location and service
text:
Superb location: supermarket just around the corner, many Japanese and Korean restaurants in that area, Lourve, Lafayatte and many other landmarks are within 15 mins walk 
The hotel is new and clean, the bedding is so comfortable and we had good sleep every night. 
Another highlight is the excellent service of the staff, they are all friendly, helpful and efficient. 

Good job Lyric Hotel Paris. Highly recommended!

title: Great stay!
text: We had a wonderful stay here for our honeymoon. Location is great, very central and near the metro. Easy commute to the airport too. Staff were wonderful, friendly and helpful. Beds were comfortable and the showers were lovely too. Would definitely recommend for a long weekend in Paris

title: Horrible expérience
text:
I am really surprised to see all of these positives experiences. I went to the hotel for a work trip. They put me on the ground floor. The remote control was discusting (completely sticky with food stains on it). I went to drop it to the front desk to ask to clean it (he was surprised I needed it …). Then I went back to my room and see that the sink is leeking. The front desk comes to check and decides to change me from this room. Not one time, he said sorry about the situation…
I still get a ground floor room but in a « courtyard » which had no light and was more like the emergency courtyard with no charm at all and no light (despite great blue sky that day).
You could feel every few minutes the subway going underneath, the air conditioning couldn’t be turned higher in temperature than 19 degrees C (even when I put the temperature higher it always went back down). 
It really didn’t feel like a four star hotel… 

The only positive note was the breakfast.

title: Great hotel, very friendly and welcoming
text: Great hotel, very helpful staff, clean and stylish. Nice room, good breakfast and good location for business and paris in general.  Will definitely stay again in the future.  No bar, which was a shame, but plenty local bars and restaurants.  Didn't use the pool but looked very nice.

title: Great hotel highly recommend
text: This is a smart, clean and comfortable hotel in a great location. Staff are very welcoming, the rooms are beautiful and the breakfast super and there are nice touches like the Little Prince kits and Skinjay.  Nespresso made my husband very happy also. We also used the pool for a pre-breakfast swim which was good. It’s a great place to stay, I really recommend staying here. You might want to consider your own pillow, as they were very high, and a hairdryer, as our hairdryer was a fixed one that wasn’t very powerful, but really minor points. You won’t go wrong booking here.

title: This hotel saved our holiday and our sanity
text: This hotel was fantastic.  The location was brilliant for sightseeing & shopping, the rooms were exquisite and the breakfast was a knockout.  There are cafes, bars and shops all around the hotel and a metro within 400m.  The highlight however was the truly outstanding staff.  All our luggage was lost by our airline and the staff not only helped us try and find them, helped with advice, directed us where to shop and helped with our other arrangements, but they showed us so much care and support through the whole process. By the end of the week they felt like family.  I have never come across such sincere, helpful and kind people in an hotel before.  These guys saved our holiday and we are so grateful to them.  I will definitely stay here next time.

title: Paris Trip
text: We spent a couple of days in Paris for pleasure! I was worried picking a hotel in a city I didn’t know and we were so happy with our choice! We were greeted by a very accommodating gentleman that let us leave our bags while we explored the city before check in time. The hotel was beautiful, boutique style with a wonderful room. The bed was so comfortable and the washroom her modern and well stocked with towels and a robe. The breakfast buffet was wonderful with many choices. We didn’t get a chance to use the fitness room or the pool but I found out they are open. I live the location of the hotel. It was close to a train station and so many beautiful sites!

title: Excellent Stay
text: Stayed here for my girlfriends birthday, the hotel staff were extremely helpful in accommodating some special requests I made and making our stay very enjoyable. Modern, quiet and clean rooms. Pool and Spa facilities were also great!

title: Excellent hotel
text:
We stayed in the deluxe double room with balcony and the room was a very good size and tastefully decorated.
Bathroom also excellent.
Staff all very friendly and polite.
No complaints and would return.
Can’t comment on breakfast as we prefer to go out and do our own thing

title: Very fine hotel
text: I had a great stay at Lyric Hotel Paris. The room was spacious with much natural light. It was tastefully decorated and looked very fresh. The breakfast was tasteful with a good variety of food stuff.

title: FANTASTIC LITTLE HOTEL IN A GREAT LOCATION
text: Just back from a lovely stay here, made to feel very welcome, with great staff, great breakfast, staying in a lovely clean room. The hotel is located in a great area, close to the the action and metro but we loved the personal little touches that made it feel different to other hotels.

title: Best hotel to Stay in this area
text: very friendly staff, very clean, great and spacious rooms, amazing location - I have traveled on a business trip and this is my first time at this hotel, I’m planning to return for pleasure travel and stay in this amazing property

title: Beautiful hotel
text: Breakfasts were fantastic.  The staff was very friendly and kind.  service was excellent.  the pool was beautiful--it was a great place to relax after a day of sightseeing in Paris.  After a long journey it is the perfect place.

title: Excellent hotel

title: Wonderful staff
text:
I’ve just spent 5 days at this hotel and the staff were consistently excellent. 

The hotel is clean, conveniently located, modest but positively so. Breakfast was excellent. I would recommend it to anyone.

title: Very good place to stay
text: A nice hotel with very friendly staff. The rooms are very clean and there's a little spa with pool and sauna. Additionally the hotel is located so central that one can visit all the interesting places by foot.

title: Very nice Hotel!
text: We stayed 3 nights in the Hotel and we are very satisfied with our experience! Clean and large city (for this price) room, very friendly stuff and central located. We can only recommend and would choose this Hotel again for our next visit.

title: Great hotel
text:
Excellent place to stay, amazing spa, great breakfast and room, friendly and helpful staff and amazing location close to royal opera and in the centre of the japanaese quarter.
Air condition control in the night was a bit difficult, room was quite warm despite the low temperature setting but I am also a picky sleeper. Will definetly come again.

title: Heros during a rail strike!
text:
My best friend and I stayed at the Lyric for two days and nights, and it was simply sublime. The room was beautiful (and extremely clean), and every member of staff we met was friendly and knowledgable. 
They not only recommedned great places for us to eat, but also pulled out all the stops to get us a taxi when the city centre was brought to a standstill during a rail strike. 
I would 100% recommend staying at the Lyric and we're definitely going back!

title: Faultless.
text: Great location, lovely facilities, super helpful and friendly staff with enviable language skills.  We didn't have breakfast as there are so many great places to eat in Paris but we did use the pool and spa and they were clean and well maintained. We had a lovely stay and will return.

title: Fantastic stay!
text: Hotel is very well situated close to the main Paris attractiones (Opera Garnier, Luvr Museum, 1 hour walk from Eiffel Tower). Very delicious breakfasts, comfortable rooms and amazing swimming pool and finnish sauna!

title: Great spot!
text: Fantastic location, lovely rooms - nice and quiet and comfortable. Very nice team, offering impeccable service. Great little pool with steam room and sauna. Would recommend and hope to return! Thank you

title: Valentines getaway
text: Excellent hotel with very friendly staff, superb rooms, great breakfast, leisure facilities and location was great with beautiful restaurants all around it. Overall character, cleanliness, facilities & convenience was a great experience. We will be back! Keep up the good work 👍

title: Ideal Paris Hotel
text: Lovely clean rooms (big considering paris rooms are normally small). Staff were so friendly and helpful from check in to check out. Lovely quiet pool area and small fitness room. Complimentary mini fridge in the room. Such a good location only minutes away from the louvre! We really enjoyed our stay!

title: Lovely Hotel - great location - high standard
text: Great location - away from busy street - but very very central. Great rooms with lovely ambience - and room to fit a workspace - closet for your clothes - great bathroom with room for your toiletries AND delightful complimentary soaps and lotions  - comfort chair and big tv :-)

title: My new favorite hotel in Paris..
text:
home away from home. The rooms are clean always, spacious & comfortable. Prime location too. Carrefour is on the corner of the street.
Gallerie La Fayette is 5 mins away on foot. The area is surrounded by alot of services too.

title: Romantic weekend in Paris
text: The Lyric Hotel is perfectly situated between Gare Du Nord and the centre of Paris, offering a fantastic base to enjoy what the city has to offer for a weekend away. The staff were particularly friendly and helpful, and made us feel very welcome. The room was tastefully decorated and offered a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower. We would definitely stay again when we next come to Paris.

title: Great location, friendly and helpful staff, comfortable stay
text: We were very happy with our few days stay at the Lyric Hotel. The facilities were all excellent and above all the staff were extremely friendly and accommodating. We would happily stay again, thank you!

title: Wish I could have stayed longer!
text: Beautiful hotel, great location and such lovely helpful staff! Wish I’d had the chance to use the pool and sauna as they looked great. Highly recommended and would definitely stay again when I come back to Paris

title: Nice hotel in the middle of Paris
text: Me and a friend had a nice stay at Lyric Hotel Paris. The staff was very kind and helpful, the location is great (close to Opera Garnier), and the room was well designed and so is the rest of the hotel. Also a plus was the simming pool in the basement, with a sauna & steam cabine.

title: Highly recommend staying at Lyric Hotel!
text: My partner and I visited Paris and stayed at the Lyric Hotel and were so pleased with our start to finish experience. The hotel staff was more than helpful with accommodating our early check-in and more than happy to welcome us from the US. We loved the location and room as well. We'd stay again and recommend it to others without a doubt!

title: Really Nice and clean hotel in the centre of Paris.enjoyed our stay very much.
text:
Nice hotel, very clean, friendly staff.
Near centre of Paris 
Nice gym and Spa 
Breakfast was lovely 
Walking distance from a lot off the sightseeing
Lots of restaurants in the neaborhood 
Will stay there again  in the  future

title: Lovely Time at the Lyric
text: My time at the Lyric Hotel was absolutely amazing. The staff delivered the most excellent customer service. Everyone was helpful and accommodating. We arrived early and they accommodated an early check-in without any issue. The hotel is situated in the most perfect neighborhood that is central to many well known sites and retail shops. The hotel is very well maintained and decorated quite beautifully.  The pool and sauna are clean and very well kept. The room was spacious given that hotel rooms in France tend to be on the smaller size. The beds were very comfortable. The Covid safety measures (masking, designated pool appointments) made us feel safe. We had a great stay at the Lyric and plan to return again soon! Thanks for such a wonderful time!

title: Weekend Getaway Paris
text:
Great staff, beautiful and clean rooms. Spa area is a very convenient added value to the hotel compared to other hotels. 
Great place to make your base while discovering Paris. Well connected to public transport and close to many great attractions like the Opera.

title: Excellent
text: Great hotel at a good locaties. Rooms were nicely decorated. Beds were awsome. Very friendly and nice staff. Breakfast and welness facilities also outstanding. I would recomment this hotel to everyone!

title: Best place to stay
text: Loved staying at the Lyric hotel, though it was a short stay it was definitely a memorable one. Cleanliness of the hotel was amazing, staff incredibly pleasant and accommodating, rooms were chic and comfortable . Definitely a place I plan to when I come back to Paris.

title: Excellent stay
text:
Elegant and lovely hotel, great staff and beautiful facilities. perfect location & pet friendly. 
Value for money considering the quality of the furniture, and the view from the Junior Suite. Free upgrade made my day.

title: leee john
text: very good great hospitality, very helpful , always can get a room , always make space ,private pool , sauna , steam room , breakfast  , good cab service , surrounded by restaurants , department stores in great area of the opera.

title: Perfect choice
text: Very friendly staff, clean room & stylish hotel all in all a very good choice, many nice interior details. Good location with quick access to the Metro. Many nice Japanese restaurants directly next to the hotel. Perfect for business trips or couple holidays.

title: Top Hotel
text: Super nice Hotel in the area off the Opera and many stores. Balcony was perfect. Arco work good. Carona proof Hotel. The Breakfast was perfect, the waitress Anna did hear best, and she makes for you coffee ore thea on demand.

title: Amazing stay
text: From the check-in to check-out, everything was great. Fabulous location (close to French brasserie for long dinner but also the famous "japanese" rue Saint Anne with extensive list of ramen or sushi places. Highly professional staff and comfortable room. I didn't have the chance to try the pool unfortunately but would definitely do it when i come back.

title: It was really awesome! I was there with two kids .. it is in a safe environment and the staff are awesome.
text: It was really awesome! I was there with two kids .. it is in a safe environment and the staff was awesome. I would like recommend this hotel to everyone. The nearby the Opera and with the metro 10 to The Louvre

title: restaurant service
text: I want to express my gratitude to the employee Matilda for the quality service. We were very pleased with the service and would definitely return if possible. Also, thanks for the pleasant atmosphere, I managed to take a break from the working routine.

title: Absolutely no other place I would rather stay!
text: Have you stayed in a place and said to yourself, “There’s no way I will stay anywhere else!” We’ve found that hotel for you and for us!  What a great experience that we had!  From the start of check in, to the early morning of checkout, it was a tremendous stay! Yao was our check in agent and wow was she amazing. She has so much information of the Shangri-La and the palace that it was situated in!  We had to arrive to the hotel around noon and we expected our room not to be ready at that time so we thought we would lounge around or go walk around for the time being. Yao offered us some fine champagne and was able to lock in a last minute lunch reservation at the famous Shang Palace (a one star Michelin rated Asian inspired restaurant)! What a treat!  This was our second time in Paris and it was the best time thus far many thanks to Shangri-La.  The attention to detail that this hotel has and their staff is the best of the best. I felt like we were treated as if we were staying in the penthouse!!  We were greeted and acknowledge by every staff member that we passed, doors were opened for us and greeted with a warm smile. We needed to print out some documents for travel because of Covid and then we emailed concierge and they actually just slid it under our door minutes after emailing, what a great surprise, and what a great service! I would give the hotel and staff 20 stars if I could, well deserved!! PS, we had some macaroons (made in-house by the pastry chef) in our room when we arrived and I can tell you with confidence that they were better than Pierre Herme’s macaroons. They were so good we got some to go as gifts for our friends, thank you so much for arranging that Vandana!  Overall just an AMAZING hotel and more importantly, the staff!  Well deserved slow long hand claps

title: If you want to feel like royalty, stay here!!!
text: Truly one of the most luxurious, thoughtful experiences I've had. My husband and I stayed here for our babymoon and it truly felt like paradise. The staff goes above and beyond at every turn. The amenities are the finest!!! The best part is that you still feel comfortable and at home even though you are in a literal palace. Make sure to order the incredible in room breakfast and try ALL the restaurants. The food is some of the best in Paris. I had the best prenatal massage of my life. Make sure to take full advantage of the spa. Perfect after a long day of exploring Paris. The location is superb. Easy to walk or uber to everything you need to see. Please do yourself a favor and splurge on this amazing place. You won't regret it.

title: Above and Beyond Service and Food
text:
This was our second time staying here and the service did not disappoint once again. The staff goes above and beyond to make sure you have an amazing and relaxing stay. 

Also, the food is excellent! Each morning we went downstairs to enjoy a delicious breakfast overlooking the garden and Mohammed took great care of us! He exemplifies the top quality service you should expect while staying here. 

We look forward to coming back again

title: It’s mega!
text:
Exceptional! Just a great establishment, that is classic but not old-fashioned. Polished but not austere. Quintessentially French but very inviting.  

The level of service and professionalism restored my hope in the hospitality industry.

A huge thank you to the team at the Shangri-la for making my children’s first visit to Paris such a special one!

We will be back!

title: The Perfect 40th Celebration
text:
To summarise our stay at the Shangri-la in one word perfect! 

We travelled to Paris to celebrate my wife’s 40th birthday in style and after reading many reviews we decided the Shangri-la was our home away from home to mark the moment.

In preparation for our stay the concierge had helped arranged luxury transport to collect us, book a private boat on the Sienna at Sunset restaurants at all the best restaurants ( highly recommend Guy Savoy, Divellec, Les Ombres and of course the Shang Palace) and an express tour of the Louvre. It really started our trip off and took all the hassle out of it. Many thanks to Anthony too who after a large delay in the Louvre and our tour guide going AWOL for 30 minutes for arranging a refund.

The hotel is beautiful inside and out and our room was a terrace suite (Room 52) with a balcony overlooking the Eiffel Tower which having breakfast to the room in the morning being setup outside with that view was lovely.

I can see why Forbes ranked this one the best hotels I. World. The spa too was lovely and we ended our stay with the best relaxing massage after many miles shopping with Mrs K.

Thanks Shangri-la for the nice little touches too like cake, champagne and card upon arrival you made our stay perfect.

Eiffel in love with Paris thanks to the Shangri-la.

title: Didn’t want to leave
text: We’ve been incredibly lucky to stay in some of the best hotels in Paris and the Shangri la has been our absolute favourite. It was truly a 6 star experience in a joint effort from all the staff (Zhiwei who checked us in, Gabriel, Corentin ,Gianni,Valentine,Julian - amongst others) as well as the ladies from guest relations who made our special occasion even more memorable. Of course it was an expensive stay but the hotel definitely allows you to enjoy the experience with the delicious breakfast, luxurious Guerlain toiletries and unparalleled views of the Eiffel. It’s further from the shopping streets but was a fun new experience exploring a new neighbourhood of Paris as it has many cute streets and bistros nearby that are less ‘touristy’. We absolutely loved it and didn’t want to leave!

title: paid 2800 for two rooms and got an hour late check in
text: booked via amex platinum card. one of the perks is early check in by noon if possible. i had emailed the concierge and reception noting that we would be landing early and would appreciate an early check for one room. called the same am of arrival and was assured they would do their best. i would have expected at least an on time check in if early wasn't possible. my two adult sons reached the hotel by 1 pm. we did not arrive at the hotel til much later and neither one of the rooms were ready by 4pm. if i am paying by the hour, i should have been refunded. a round of cocktails was their answer.  the hotel itself is beautiful but far from the  the louvre and tuileries. the rooms were slightly dated, bathroom definitely dated. we have stayed at the meurice, the peninsula, the lancaster, and george v.  should have stuck to my gut instinct and paid the few dollars extra for one of those hotels.

title: Amazing stay at the Shangri La Paris
text: Great hotel with amazing staff and outstanding location.  My suite had a direct view of the Eiffel Tower and the decor was flawless.  The grounds are spectacular and highly manicured.   The hotel picked me up in a Rolls Royce from the airport and everything was five star caliber.

title: Incredible Stay at Shangri-La!
text:
We had the most magical stay in Paris at the Shangri-La as the last city stop on our honeymoon. The residence is absolutely gorgeous and conveniently located near the metro / walking distance to a lot of the best Paris has to offer. Everyone on the staff was courteous and accommodating. We felt truly spoiled with the attention to detail - everyone from the waiters at breakfast, to the concierge booking us multiple lunch/dinner reservations, to Lisa on the reservations team who gave us a wonderful tour, made it a memorable stay for us. We were also greeted with a lovely in-room welcome treat upon arrival (champagne, macarons, cake, chocolate, fruit).

Rooms are furnished beautifully and the beds are sumptuous.  Highly recommend the Eiffel view rooms. It was certainly a splurge but a special experience to have breakfast on our personal terrace in the mornings and a beautiful spot to watch the Eiffel lights at night. The landmark is so close that our friends almost thought we photoshopped it into our pictures. Thank you so much for a memorable stay and we will certainly be back to celebrate a future anniversary! - Steph&Craig

title: Simply the Best
text:
It's impossible to come up with any flaws with the Shangri-La Paris.  From the concierge help pre-trip arrival, to the property itself, this place exudes excellence.  
We were at the tail end of an over two week trip through Europe when we landed in Paris.  The time in Paris was the most stressful and we were the most exhausted.  It would have been easy to find any small faults at this point.  But we were blown away with everything.
The room was great.  We had a Terrace room with a nice balcony overlooking the city.  And a bonus that Lisa showed us when we checked in, we had a small window in the hallway right outside our door that overlooked the Eiffel Tower!
If there is one thing I could suggest...that the hotel provides local transportation where available.  Having a driver accessible for short trips to dinner or sights would be a nice bonus that most 5 star hotels seem to offer.

title: Great concierge service
text:
5 star hotels  aren’t just about fancy halls, soft pillows and comfortable mattresses, there’s so much more to that. It’s about true service and reading clientele  which you’ll find all at Shangri La. This was all reflected as i came by the concierge desk with  my daughter to ask for recommendations. I’m hard to please and happen to be an avid artist and museum goer. Concierge Anthony instantly pinpointed what I was looking for, one of the places on his list also came  from a friend  of mine who knows Paris inside out which gave me even more confidence in his advice. His authentic sense of graciousness and traditional welcoming are unique, through his recommendations we felt that he was passionate about Paris and was naturally extending his love  for the city through work onto clients. 

Another concierge Justine treated us with sincere care a sense and warmth. 

We had a drink and light dinner , service was attentive and classic French, it felt great after a busy day

Doorman was very friendly and graciously offered us a ride 

Looking forward to be back !

title: A Place in the center of Paris
text:
The Sangri-La Hotel Paris is a palace of luxury where one can escape the busy streets of Paris and relax in ultra luxury accommodations.

My wife and I came to the Sangri-La Hotel Paris to celebrate her birthday. The hotel is simply beautiful and the staff treat each guest like a VIP. 

We chose a garden view suite which was well appointed with amenities and enough room to enjoy our stay while getting a little work done. 

For my wife's birthday, the Guest Services team sent a bottle of champagne and a cake (no charge), it was a very nice gesture. 

You'll find the service impeccable here, as one would expect from an Ultra luxury resort. Every staff member was professional and helpful. 

We did have one small problem where a few special requests for my wife's birthday were forgotten by one of the front desk team members (dinner reservations and a photo op request), but overall the stay here was amazing.  I suggest connecting directly with the concierge or the guest services team instead of trusting requests to the front desk employees. I know this is a minor thing, but at these prices perfection is expected and should be delivered. 

Regardless of the one small problem, I highly recommend Sangri-La Hotel Paris, if one can afford it. Expensive but worth it. 

5 Stars.

title: Wonderful all round experience!
text:
The Shangri-La Paris is truly a gem of a hotel in Paris. From the breath taking architecture on the inside to probably the best view of the Eiffel Tower from a hotel in the entire city of paris! I am not kidding. The view is enough for you to justify the higher price of a luxury five star hotel! The next best thing and probably equal to the view is the exceptional and genuine service provided by the staff at this property. We could see that they were genuinely caring and went above and beyond to help us. 
Starting with our reservation. We arrived from the US on an early flight ( around 6:00am) and reached the hotel by 8:00am. I had informed the hotel ahead of time ( a few days prior) and they did mention that it would be difficult to arrange the room so early and noted that we could store our luggage and maybe use one of their health club facilities to freshen up. Both my wife and I were ok with this and had carried a change of clothes in our carry on. However imagine to our pleasant surprise! They had not only gotten our room ready, they also had a complimentary French breakfast laid out in the room since we were coming in after a long flight and guessed rightly that we would be tired and would likely prefer taking a quick breakfast and resting. 
The concierge service was excellent! They also helped with getting our health passes from a nearby pharmacy at no extra cost. 
Also, a special thanks to the house keeping staff who provided with a twice a day cleaning and turn down service and took extra care of our personal items as well. They were un-intrusive and worked around our schedule ( something the reservation desk arranged ahead of time after checking with us on what times we would be away so as to clean the room then). 
Overall, we spent a wonderful couple of days in the Shangri-La in Paris. We were left with a satisfied feeling at the end of the trip and will definitely be visiting the next time we come to Paris!

title: Family vacation
text: Best hotel in Paris. Maybe the world... Forbes wasn't kidding. Shangri LA has been so accommodating to me and my family. They made sure we had the best Christmas vacation as a family we could possibly ask for. They went above and beyond my expectations. title: A botanic luxury palace in the heart of the Ville Lumière
text: Shangri-La is definitely amongst the top hotels in Paris and to answer one of the most important questions for lovers: Yes it has some of the best room views in all Paris of the Enchanting Tour Eiffel. My experience there was indeed magical: The scent that you smell when you enter through the gates “protected” by huge Chinese vases is truly divine: if you close your eyes you could feel like being alone in a botanic garden in Tibet. The luxurious palace (which also hosts the apartments of Prince Bonaparte on the second floor with authentic crown mouldings and gilt work, Versailles-style parquet floors, period artwork and decor that seamlessly blends classic French late 18th century design with subtle Asian influences) is located 2 minutes walking distance from the worldwide famous Place du Trocadéro. I decided with short notice to have a romantic weekend trip to Paris with my girlfriend and we took a Superior Double Room for 1 night (1510€). The staff was extremely Elegant and careful with any of our needs. And surprise: We had an enchanting room close-up view of the top half of the tour that when golden sparkling for 5 minutes on the hour every hour after nightfall until 1:00 a.m. it was a pure instagrammable dream. A nice welcome food set with Château Mascard Haut-Médoc French Bordeaux red Wine and Shangri-La macaroons was waiting for us in the room as well as a delicious Jasmine tee was offered to us as a traditional welcome gift from the hotel. We did have the time to enjoy a dry Martini at the mahogany-styled “Botaniste” bar but not enough to experience the popular CHI spa. Next time! Because this 5-stars hotel deserves more days to enjoy it all!

title: Dreamiest Views in Paris
text:
My *forever* travel partner and I stayed here to close out a two week trip to Paris, where we hotel hopped throughout. This was the last hotel and we had high hopes. At this hotel, we stayed in the TERRACE EIFFEL VIEW ROOM and the view of the Eiffel Tower was breathtaking. Literally felt like you could touch it. Along with the view, what I really liked about this room was:

•	The bed. Was. HUGE!!! Imagine pushing two King beds together, that's how large it was. I swear you can lose your partner in that bed. 
•	The style. It felt the most “French” of all the hotels we stayed at, without feeling outdated or stuffy. 
•	Location. Location. Location. A stone’s throw away from the Eiffel Tower (I’m convinced you could literally throw a stone and hit it from the hotel room) and the Arc de Triomphe/ Champs- Elyssès 
•	Amenities. Bvlgari bath products are provided for guests; the robes were SO fuzzy and nice without being bulky or heavy, I genuinely considered asking to buy one; the pool felt very opulent and classic (white stone pillars/ plush towels/ mosaic tiled pool floor).
•	Can’t explain it, but we just felt..relaxed here. Just very calm and quiet despite being steps away from the din and discord of central Paris. 

On the flip side, 

•	The food here was not that good, and it was very expensive
•	A lot of rooms are “smoking rooms”, so the room we were initially given smelled so badly of smoke I got a headache within the first 5 minutes of our checking in, and called to request a room switch 
•	Check-In time is at or after the stated time of 3pm. Meaning, NO EARLY CHECK-INS. Our room wasn’t actually ready until almost 4pm!!
•	You tend to get ushered around when you have even very simple questions; i.e., “Oh, ask XX person” or “That’s a question for XXX” (at least, that was my experience, and may not be the norm).

Overall, I’d say this is definitely a good contender if you want a nice hotel with an AMAZING view of the Eiffel Tower, and I would recommend joining the GOLDEN CIRCLE CLUB (another free membership) to get points for future stays at one of their many locations.

title: Breathtaking view!
text: Excellent, high end hotel with breathtaking view, beautiful, very atmospheric interior, great location and very professional staff. A great choice for a luxury, unforgettable romantic trip for couple. I would highly recommend to anyone who is looking for something special and unique.
