title: Beyond expectations
text:
Where do I start . . I planned a day trip to Paris to propose to my partner. I booked a Terrace Eiffel view Room. 
From the moment I emailed the Reservation team to book, to the Guest Relations team organising a set up on the terrace for the propose, everyone was so supportive and helpful during what I call a stressful time for myself . . Got a welcome message with a bottle for wine and snacks. Had the terrace set up for sunset. Had a staff take our picture as souvenir after the proposal. The list goes on but they surly did make it personal and special for us . .

title: Luxurious and sumptuous stay in a old Roland Bonaparte mansion
text:
This was our 3rd short stay at the Shangri-la Paris this summer/autumn. We had a wonderful stay. Our room had a view upon the garden and the Eiffel Tower (side view). So, every morning/ evening we at least peaked out of our window once. The garden is wonderful to look at (at have dinner in on sunny evenings) and of course the Eiffel Tower is the star attraction. 
The room was as fancy as the 2 previous we had stayed at. They all somehow breathe the same luxurious and sumptuous atmosphere. We received a beautiful and above all very delicious heart-shaped red cake and a bottle of champagne to welcome us. The dinner we had at the Shang Palace was phenomenal and we were treated extremely well by Chef Samuel Lee. The wines the sommelier paired with the delicate dishes were excellent. Dining at the Shang Palace is absolutely a superb experience that made our stay even more memorable.
The second night we had dinner at La Bauhinia and enjoyed a delicious dinner with fantastic desserts by pastry chef Maxence Barbot. 
We ended our evening at the bar “Botaniste” for cocktails and bubbles. Wonderful memories and fantastic service by the bartender. He absolutely knows what he’s doing. A really great job! Awesome cocktails too. And a lovely atmosphere too with an elegant mix of an English gentlemen’s club with some colonial elements.
We are absolutely looking forward to our next stay in Paris and at Shangri-La. This is definitively our “pied-à-terre” in Paris.
The staff and the General Manager Mr. Julien Bardet really make our stays extra special and extraordinary.

title: Simply the Best!
text:
This is by far the best hotel we have ever stayed at in Paris and possibly the continent. The Shangri La Paris (“SRL”) had far exceeded our expectations. My husband and I have never stayed at a SLR before, but we were very aware of the brand and the 5-star reputation that they hold. They do not disappoint and treat all of their guests like royalty. 

We came to Paris with our 5-yr old daughter to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary. My husband, an avid hobby photographer, researched hotels that had the best views of the Eiffel Tower and found the SRL to be rated high for great views of the Eiffel Tower. We booked a terrace room with views of the Eiffel Tower and were notified by the guest relations team 10 days before our stay regarding our upcoming stay. We filled out their guest questionnaire and I’m so glad that we did. The SRL upgraded us to a 2-level suite with a terrace and  breathtaking views of the Eiffel Tower. The room was grand and gorgeous! They surprised us again when we arrived finding a beautiful bouquet of flowers, chilled Veuve Cliquot, macarons, madeleines, cakes and fruit awaiting for us in the room with a nice personal note from the Concierge Team. They even got my daughter a balloon, a panda stuff animal, her own slippers, coloring book and pencils. There was even a child robe next to the bath tub and taking a bath was probably her favorite activity during our stay there. They knew how to make every one of us feel special!

All their staff we encountered at the hotel was extremely friendly and helpful. It is there people who make this stay so memorable. The Concierge Team arranged for our pick up at Grand du Lyon and they even had a child seat installed in the car for us.  The Concierge Team were also able to book a last minute photoshoot the night before our actual shoot in our room terrace and around the Eiffel Tower. They tried to make restaurant reservations for the places we wanted to try, but unfortunately these places were first come, first serve only. We appreciated the effort. 

Their American and Chinese breakfasts were delicious, amazing and filling. We did not need to eat all day until dinner time. It came with a basket of various pastries along with your choice of eggs and breakfast meat, congee, dim sum, coffee, juice and toast. We booked a rate that included breakfast in our room and it awesome to have breakfast in our terrace. But be forewarned in the summer, it’s wasp season and they were going after our breakfast, but not us, thankfully.  We moved to having breakfast inside our room for the rest of the stay, which was just as lovely. 

It was extremely hard to leave the Shangri La Paris. We had a lovely stay that we will fondly remember forever.  We look forward to staying at this property again when we visit Paris. Thank you for leaving us quite the impression. My daughter no longer wants to live in Hawaii or Disney World thanks to the Shangri La Paris and my husband and I are ok with it.

title: None
text: Beautiful hotel and staff bring the Shangri-la experience to the very competitive  French hospitality market. The property has a quiet and elegant  luxury, with a modern cool provided by its chic and well groomed multilingual staff. The rooftop bar (available in the summer) was a unique experience.

title: Good for Eiffel view, not so good for other attractions
text: Beautiful lobby. Rooms are dated. Location ok only for Eiffel Tower. Other attractions 15 minute taxi ride away. We found ourselves in taxis when going to restaurants and attractions. They were not particularly available at this location without a wait.

title: ONE NIGHT STAND IN PARIS
text: First class! You delivered just as I expected. Thomas Fluery at reception was very helpful.  Taller brunette on the patio for dinner was beautiful. Didn't get a chance to use the pool as this was just a trial run, one-night stay between Morocco & USA, but I plan to return in February for a few operas.

title: 27th anniversary
text:
This was our 5th stay and as usual, it was perfection!!!!
We have stayed at most Palaces in Paris but this one is even more special!!!
The moment you enter the building, this beautiful, calm scent descends upon you!!
Service is top notch, from the Voituriers all the way to the housekeeping personel!!
Special thanks though go to Thomas, Jean-Baptiste and Souphine especially!!!
Can't wait to go there again for our 28th......................

title: If you can, stay here !!
text:
I can’t describe what a wonderful experience I had at the hotel.  I will definitely be back and will recommend it to anyone I can

Just got back from the most incredible 3 nights at the hotel on my own with my 3 daughters.  I felt so safe and well looked after.  Car pick up from the station was charming and swift, unexpected upgrade on arrival with the best view of the Eiffel Tower, generous room gifts.

I thought the breakfast was perfection and head waiter beyond efficient 

Concierge helped book our Covid tests and went above and beyond looking after us

Absolutely wonderful female life guard (with short hair) who couldn’t do enough and was encouraging my daughter to swim!  Another spa receptionist brought as jasmine tea by the pool which was thoroughly enjoyed

Cleaning room staff were all kind and outstanding!

What else can I say, this has to be the most perfect hotel mainly because of the staff, where nothing is too much trouble for them  - oh and the views aren’t bad either

Thank you so much !!!

title: "For he on honey-dew hath fed, And drunk the milk of Paradise."
text:
My experience at the Hotel Shagri-La was nothing short of extraordinary. Until this point, my only experience of Shagri-La was a lovely breakfast at their location in the Shard in London. This experience in Paris blew away not only that meal in London, but every other high-end hotel experience I've ever had. The anticipatory service, the gracious upgrade provided without request (a very nice touch), and the generous welcome gifts in the suite transported me from the City of Lights to Elysium itself. 

Not only shall I return to this palace of a hotel, I shall also seek out a Shangri-La in every city I visit from here on. Specific thanks to Mr. Thomas Fleury for his kind personal greeting and hand written note upon arrival, and to Anthony at the concierge desk, without whom I would not have had such a lovely dinner at Restaurant KEI. There were many others who contributed to the overall magic of the palace - you truly have assembled a talented and dedicated team. I look forward to seeing you all again.

title: Unmissable experience in a Parisian palace with view over the Eiffel Tower
text:
"Luxe, calme et volupté".
Spending a week-end at Shangri-La Paris is a dream come true.
Everything was perfect, except the playlist in the wonderful restaurant "La Bauhinia": please hire a different DJ and change the playlist to what it was 1-2 years ago.
The asian-inspired cuisine was divine; and the "Millefeuille with vanilla from Tahiti" was even more divine. :-)

title: Blessed by Ms. Vuattoux the Duty Manager
text: Thank you Alizee Vusttoux for service above and beyond great. I met my daughter in Paris at the end of her at the end of her 2 months of backing in Europe for her last 10 days. The Shangri-La hotel was the perfect end of a great trip for my daughter and me to make memories. When we checked in the view from our room was not what expected and Ms. Vuattoux saw that in my face and asked if I would like to see another room and we did and it was perfect. The hotel was one of the hotel’s I’ve ever stayed in with great service that matched the beauty on the hotel, it’s a must stay if you want to experience greatness. We thank all of the staff as well.

title: Amazing Hotel with Fantastic Views
text: We had an amazing trip to Paris. We were very lucky to receive an upgraded room at the Sangri-La and the view of the Eiffel Tower from our terrace was unbelievable. The service and kindness from everyone working at the hotel was fantastic. The reception and concierge were extremely helpful and informative and the dining and spa staff were kind and we received great service. The room was fantastic with lovely big windows and the beds were very comfortable. It was lovely and clean and we all loved the big shower. When I asked my children what the best part of their Paris trip was they said 'the hotel". The Louvre, Musee D'Orsay, Arc de Triumph, Sacre Coeur and of course the Eiffel Tower were nice, but as far as they were concerned the best part was the hotel! So that says it all.

title: Superb Service/Magical Views
text: I cannot tell you how pleased we were with our stay at the Shangri La in Paris.  We have stayed at many hotels in the city - Georges V, Crillion, etc. - but the staff at the Shangri La made the difference. From the superior arrangements made by Anthony and his concierge staff to the friendly welcome and excellent service of the valet and bellman to the friendly and efficient housekeeping staff to the delicious breakfast each day...We came for the view, but we were pleasantly surprised and delighted by the service.  The management of the hotel deserves an extra bonus.  We are thrilled with the Shangri La and will recommend it highly without reservation.

title: Disappointing: Unacceptable level of services: Services hardly worth 4 stars
text:
We spent 2 nights in the palace Shangri-La in Paris and what a disappointment ...
-First of all, before our stay we received a questionnaire regarding our preferences, in particular the choice of pillows and food allergies. But none of our answers were considered, especially the gluten allergy, which is serious!
-During the check-in, when we asked about reservations for the rooftop terrace, the receptionist told us that the rooftop was full and suggested that we call the concierge for our evening. 
A few minutes later, we contacted the concierge, who was surprised at our request for a reservation for a rooftop in the neighborhood as he still had a slot on the hotel’s rooftop.
Obviously, a communication problem within the team in a period with low activity ...
We are used to staying in 5-star hotels. However, at the Shangri-La, we were not contacted to ensure that we had settled in.
-The breakfast experience was disappointing as the staff did not recognize their guests. They explained the breakfast formula to us, even though they knew our room number and knew we had been there for 2 days.
The porridge-based amuse bouche was not given to us on the 2nd day while the other guests received it. Coffee arrived very late (after the dishes) and only after a reminder. 
Very limited options and non-synchronization of service: my husband received his stir-fried noodles very late. In addition, we had to ask the waitress for coffee and juice again and get the forgotten chopsticks for the noodles. Her response was borderline polite. 
All this, after a long period of lockdowns. 
This level of service is unsatisfactory and does not make us want to return.
Almost no choices in the buffet: mini-baguette, mini plain croissant, and chocolate croissant, 2 kinds of brioche, yogurt, and fruit salad. The price is disproportionate: 62 euros! Compared to the low diversity and quality of the breakfast.
The staff members were barely polite; the other servers didn't even greet us.
The worst part of the experience: the staff allowed some customers to get up for the buffet without a mask. This is dangerous and not authorized in France during this pandemic period.
-In the room, the thank you card had a mistake in my last name.
The bedroom was clean, but the copper bed ornaments had traces of dust and needed to be cleaned.
Despite coming in to make the bed, the room service left our dirty cups, which prevented us from having coffee in the room the next day. The empty bottle of sparkling water was not removed, and the water bottle by the bed was not changed either. The empty teapot following the welcome tea remained for the 2 days ... In short, room service unworthy of a 4 * hotel.
-Regarding the reception, the politeness of the staff was not consistent. 
By taxi, the doorman didn’t even open the doors of the taxi.
The last day, the staff didn’t ask us if we enjoyed the stay during the checkout. 
While we were waiting for our taxi on the hotel's steps, one of the cleaning ladies forced us to move, without apologizing, to vacuum the stairs on a Sunday at noon.

These are simple things, but this is a palace! You expect to have the highest luxury and the best possible services.
Disappointed, unexpected, unacceptable for this kind of hotel.
This palace offers a historic location, but the level of service is hardly worth 4 stars. A big disappointment.

title: The Krug Bar: Amazing experience with a view!
text: Hidden within this beautiful hotel is the Krug Bar, where you can get Krug Champagne by the bottle or glass and a selection of nibbles - we had Bellota ham and parmesan cubes plus the complementary mini onion tarts, which were great with the champagne. The terrace has a direct view of the Eiffel Tower - just spectacular! I was worried about the rain but they have large umbrellas outside. Great service and selection. Perfect for a memorable evening out whether you love in Paris or are just visiting. It is a popup that I think it is there until October and comes back after the winter.

title: One Week stay with Family at Shangri La Paris
text:
Family of 4 (2 kids -age 14 and age 3)
Excellent hotel for family stay of one week. Concierge team extremely helpful in finding impossible requests and making them possible. Location is great walking distance to Champs. Safe neighborhood, we walked with our 3 yr old child in stroller-no difficulties even at 11pm at night.
ROOM-insist on Terrace Suite with Eiffel tower view-kept kids busy multiple times. Terrace very safely built for 3 year old to maneuver without worry. 
Stand out services by entire Concierge TEAM: notable for solving difficult challenges-Wife wants veggie thai red curry; daughter wants veggie sushi and I just want a regular meal--Concierge found a place within 15mins and had us all booked up. Absolutely an amazing restaurant. Nearly every night we booked reservations for restaurants from Concierge team and were absolutely never disappointed.  I would like to sincerely thank the whole team, especially Anthony Schmitt, Julien Barral, Gianni Bierry, Marie Simon, Tony Le Goff and Corentin Prat for all their hard efforts to making sure our visit was memorable.
In regards to Pandemic safety--This hotel made our family feel very safe. Staff followed all rules to the strictest including any room service. For our return flights to   US, they arranged for our testing in nearby laboratory ( no cost) for our family to get PCR tests in a comfortable lab.
I have no reservations at all recommending this hotel for family travel safely in these times.

title: Safe and beautiful place to stay at the time of Pandemic!
text:
This is my second review about this hotel. After 15 months, not traveling, horror of the Pandemic, now we can go to France fully vaccinated! Still, it was amazing how this hotel met beyond the standards of the safety. We felt so comfortable staying in Shangri La Paris. Of course the hotel, amenities and  the view is breath taking. But the staff!!! So wonderful, professional,  nice and go above and beyond to make our stay so pleasant and without worries.
Even they organized a doctor to visit us at the hotel to take our Covid test on our way back to the United States. They make everything so easy! 
I highly recommend staying at the Shangri La Paris and to worry about anything, just enjoy and relax and have the best food here ( even in room dining is better than any Michelin star restaurant) !

title: Tasteful
text:
Loved it! Amazing suite, great services, polite staff. 
It might have been perfect, but the weather ruined the stay for us. That and we were in a hurry. However, I do love the Shangri-la chain, as a rule.

title: Shangri-la.....quite appropriate.
text:
Don't be fooled by the fact that the hotel is owned by an Asian company.  It's exterior and interior reflects it's Parisian setting.  But the wonderful attention to service that is reflected in so many in the Shangri la hotels based in Asia is also displayed here.  It is a beautiful mixture of east meets west.  

It's not too gaudy like many Parisian hotels with excessive floral prints in the rooms, gold fixtures, and huge chandeliers.  Yet the hotel and staff has a way of making guests feel like royalty staying in a palace.  Isn't that the experience when one travels to such a city?  The breakfast is wonderful (loved the chocolate crepes).  Rooms are spacious are and airy with large bathrooms.  The rooms hold 2 full size beds comfortably.  The hotel is a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower and the Seine cruise dock.  The courtyard is quaint and cute.  

Shangri la......fitting name.    It is a quiet oasis away from the urban noise and hustle and bustle of the city...while still being in the middle of it.

title: Parisian Delight
text: A new favorite in the City of Light - The Shangri-La Hotel Paris. A former resident of the grand-nephew of Napoleon Bonaparte , Prince Roland. The estate perfectly situated for dramatic evening views of the Eiffel Tower in the Terrace Suite , thanks to American Express FHR. While hotel appealed to the senses, the staff touched each guest with warmth and professionalism. The concierge team was tireless in their quest to make sure that every experience was perfect. A great experience and I ill be back for a longer stay

title: A very Parisian Birthday
text: This is a little late of a review however our experience was so beautiful we really wanted to thank the staff. We celebrated our daughters 2nd Birthday here and it was just the most perfect and posh Parisian Birthday. I cordinated a head of time all the surprises I had planned and the staff were immaculate at executing everything. From the flowers to the cake and macaroons to the balloons. Everything was perfect. What’s even sweeter is that EVERY staff member seemed to have been informed that our daughter was celebrating a Bday and were so sweet and kind and would always greet our little girl as A little Princess- oh the little Princess is here. How is the little Princess enjoying her Bday etc. it was SO endearing and sweet. They also went out of their way and had a beautifully embroidered shirt made with our daughters name on it made just for her. It’s so sweet. The staff and the manager are absolutely amazing and the best at hospitality. There’s nothing else that compares to it and we travel internationally extensively. I really want to thank you all for making my little girls Bday so special even though this might be very late. A thank You is always meant from the heart. PS this hotel offers complimentary umbrellas and foldable strollers. Bath toys. Bottle warmers. Kids robes and etc. I mean if your a family on a Parisian holiday I can’t recommend this hotel enough. They think of everything to make your stay as unforgettable as possible.

title: Amazing
text: The palace and staff were truly amazing and super accommodating. The palace concierge was always happy to help and would always solve any of your questions/problems. I asked once to replace my minibar water and I never asked again, everyday they put extra water for me. Very good at paying attention to detail.

title: Honeymoon Dream Come True
text: I am so grateful for the staff and the service Shangri-la offered to us. Staying here for my wife and I’s honeymoon was one the best experiences I ever encountered. From the start when you arrive you can appreciate the beauty of the hotel and it’s rich history. After checking in they offer us a tour of the hotel and the guide was perfectly knowledgable of the history behind it. Once we went into our beautiful room, we noticed a table set just for our special occasion, with champagne, fruit, desserts, and a most beautiful and thoughtful card welcoming and congratulating us. We had a wonderful time there and I would encourage anyone that is planning a honeymoon in Paris to spend it here in this wonderful hotel with great service and with great attention to detail. Thanks to all the staff for a great honeymoon and a wonderful experience.

title: Exceeded my expectations
text: My sister and I stayed here for 3 nights; i redeemed a couple of my golden circle points to stay here and I am so glad I did.  reservation were so helpful, they contacted me a couple of days prior to our arrival for details to make check-in easier. The hotel is elegant, the staff were great and accommodating. They had a table of goodies for our birthday treat which was an awesome surprise. I thought it was a perfect location as it is a short walk to the Eiffel Tower, nearby subway, you can walk along the Seine River and depending on whether you like to walk or not the Arc de Triomphe and other landmarks are also within walking distance. I would definitely stay here again

title: Exceptional!!!!
text:
Stayed for 3 nights, and can’t fully express how impressed I was with this location, customer service and heated indoor pool. Because the hotel does not offer many rooms, you never feel overwhelmed by other guests.  

If it’s raining in Paris, no worries, just stay indoors and enjoy the spa and pool, which are both magnificent and quiet. 

We had a room with a gorgeous view of the Eiffel Tower.  

I do believe I will stay here whenever I visit Paris.

title: When expectations are fulfilled
text:
We went for a Valentine’s Day weekend with my wife. We booked a Tour Eiffel view room with terrace, the astonishing views from which can be seen in the attached photos. 
When staying in chain hotels, the brand’s name makes you expect a certain level of service, but it is then up to the staff to deliver the expected.
This too was the case during our stay.
I would like to commend the hotel’s sales manager Ms. Olesya Slizevich.
As soon as we came up to the front desk for check in, Ms Slizevich approached us and from the beginning until checkout she was our go to person and made our stay even more memorable.
Olesya made the impossible- possible. She managed to get us into the DaVinci expo although we had not booked tickets in advance, she made sure that our culinary requirements (vegetarian) would be observed during the Valentines day dinner, making sure we get our own unique set menu, and on the last day she “was there” for us until we got into the cab.
Seriously, Olesya provided real prompt support of high quality with all our queries.
Room and amenities were great, housekeeping too was high quality!
I definitely recommend the Shangri-La in Paris, and a special hats off to Olesya for her professionalism and attentive service.
It is said that expectation is the root of all suffering. In this case the expectations were met, largely because of Ms Slizevich.

title: The perfect Parisian residence
text: Perfect location, stellar views and warm employees make it the best place to stay in unpretentious Parisian luxury. Great food and amazing service definitely provides the best environment to enjoy a true Parisian experience. It was simply fabulous.

title: had to cancel the reservation - due to unexceptable service
text:
i reserved a room (not a suite) for 2300 $ per day (two thousands and three hundreds $) - for a very special occasion.
my e-mails to the hotel  asking some normal requests were accepted but ignored (no answer).  i also e-mailed 2 senior managers of the hotel - and no answer.
only after full six days and 8 e-mails i got a standart response from reservation.
this is a very expensive palace hotel that pretend to give "world class service"
i am very disappointed and frustrated - and of course cancelled the reservation.

title: Shangri-La Hotel
text: 19th Century architecture, 100 rooms & suites large, beautifully furnished with period furnishings and modern facilities. They have views of the Effiel Tower, 3 restaurants, gym, SPA, pool, bars, shops, excellent staff. They recycle & green clean.

title: Wonderful Hotel.
text: We have just returned from a three night stay at Hotel Beige. It is a beautifully renovated small boutique hotel that retains all of its French charm. The decor is tasteful and immaculately kept and every area is spotlessly clean. A twisting wooden staircase leads up to the rooms (there is a small lift) from a bright and modern reception. We had a Superior Double room which although not large, was beautifully decorated with a great shower room. Doors opened onto a typical narrow, wrought iron, balcony with a table and two chairs. The location couldn’t be better. It is in a very cosmopolitan area with an array of bistros, cafes, bakeries and nice bars. A lot of Paris’ main attractions are walkable but Cadet Metro is literally a two minute walk away. Loved every minute of this hotel and of Paris.

title: One of the best hotels I’ve stayed in
text: This hotel is a hidden gem. To start it is great value for money. The rooms are modern, clean and spacious. The air-con was a godsend. It’s quiet, yet on a busy-ish road with lots of shops and cafes. Our room had a little balcony with a view of the Eiffel Tower! Reception were extremely helpful and friendly. They let us keep our luggage before check in (and delivered it to our room!) and after check out, so we could enjoy our last day in Paris without the suitcase. Unfortunately I didn’t catch the lady’s name who worked on reception, she was friendly and chatty and got us some refreshing water when we came to collect our bag. If I came to Paris again, I’d stay here.

title: A very successful holiday.
text: Fancy little hotel. We liked! Good Air C. Helpfull frontdesk. Clean and harmony. 5/5. Nice little cafes and reataurants near. Soundproof was good. The sounds could hardly be heard from the streets. The balcony was lovely.  Everything worked as it should. If we come to Paris again, we will choose this hotel.

title: Really great hotel
text: Nice clean rooms, great staff. Ive stayed in a lots of other hotels in the area and this is 100% the best value for money. I would recommend anyone in the area to stay here over others! Thanks Beige!!

title: Great hotel and Staff!
text: Stayed here for two nights this May and had an amazing time! The staff was very friendly and inviting. we were able to check in early (1:30 pm) and the receptionist even offered us some water to drink when we arrived. After check in he gave us 2 complimentary drink tickets for the restaurant next door! Room is super tiny but it was clean and that's the main feature for me. The toilet is extremely small but we were able to manage ok! I paid extra for the macarons and champagne and it was totally worth it! Hotel is pretty close to the nearest metro stations so its easy to get around! Lots of restaurants in close proximity made it easy to find a place to eat. The breakfast in the morning was ok. There was a small convenience store near by which is where we bought snacks and water.  There was a laundromat across the street which was also super beneficial!

title: Best weekend in Paris
text: We stayed at Hotel Beige for my 21st Birthday - the hotel and location were perfect. Our room was exceptionally clean, modern and had a balcony view with the Eiffel Tower. On my birthday the hotel arranged decorations and macaroons in the room which was a very sweet gesture, thank you! Claire was incredibly helpful, she booked our dinner reservations on two occasions, both of which were perfect - we would really recommend Caillebotte and Bien Eleve. Thank you to everyone at the hotel for making our stay so enjoyable, we can't wait to return next year!

title: Nice hotel in Paris
text:
Nice hotel. Renovated in 2021.  Small but nice room. Warm and elegant interior. Friendly and serviceminded staff. 
Only setback was the breakfast. Ok ”minus”. Served in an restaurant connected to the hotel. Check the meny and serving before you decide to have the breakfast there. 
In total we were very satisfied with our stay and can recommend the hotel,

title: So cute
text: I visited during the transportation strike last year. My original plans all got canceled so I ended up booking this hotel a couple hours before getting into the country. We took the Roissybus from CDG to the opera and from there it was about a 15 minute walk. We got a little lost trying to find the hotel but when we got there the woman at the front desk with black hair was so incredibly kind. She welcomed us and made us feel so comfortable. It’s a small hotel which I loved because it was super quiet and felt very safe. The room looked exactly like the pictures and had a huge bathroom which I wasn’t expecting for the price. It is in a really great central location with cafes and grocery stores nearby, it was really easy to get to everything

title: The Perfect Parisian Hotel
text:
My travel timing could have been better as I arrived just prior to the mandatory shut down of cafe and restaurants due to Covid-19, but this hotel was superb! Quaint, charming, and close to everything you might need. The staff were very helpful and spoke good English. 

I could have sat on the little balcony for hours and watched the world go by. The luxury bathroom toiletries were a nice touch.

title: Brilliant for valentines
text:
Here with my wife for valentines, they couldn’t be nicer here. Great location, a really lovely room (44), everything just works.
Lovely breakfast this morning, and little surprises/treats that we didn’t expect.
Be aware that a wheelchair would be difficult due to the age and design of the building, but personally we wouldn’t fault the hotel at all. Just lovely

title: Special weekend in Paris
text: Just returned from my second visit to the Plaza Opera. Always friendly 24hr reception. Close to so many amenities and walking distance to most of the major attractions. Rooms are clean and well maintained. Enjoyed my stay tremendously, especially the extra touch they added to make my husband's birthday trip to Paris even more special.

title: Happy
text: Great service, nice room, good location! The breakfast was ok whit fresh fruit. We relly enjoyed the location and walked from the hotel to Eiffel tower, Monte marte, Louvren, Concorde, Triumph and Moulin rouge. From our balcony we could se the Eiffel tower 😍

title: RATS RATS RATS!
text:
The hotel has RATS!
I really do not believe that I need to say more, but it requires 200 characters to submit the review, so I will just add that you can hear everything from the other rooms, the towels are old and often dirty. They

title: Not what I expected
text:
I chose this hotel from a list of manies and it wasn’t what I expected at all.
First of all the reception doesn’t speak Italian at all, and neither much of English. They are so strict about the ceck-in, we had it at 14:00 and at 13:45 they didn’t want to let us go in the room.
The room is not that bad, the bed is very comfortable, but you can hear whatever the people in the other rooms are saying, also the balcony is not private, you can reach the room beside you just bypassing a little plant.
In general the hotel is not bad, but not at all what I expected.

title: Very good location
text: Due to the public transport strikes we had to see all of Paris by foot so the location of this hotel was very convenient. It was an easy 20 minute walk to the Louvre and Montmarte. The hotel is surrounded by a variety of cafes and restaurants and has a self serve laundry right across the street.  The room and bathroom were small but very clean and the bathroom was well stocked.  The staff were also very helpful. We didn't eat breakfast here so can't comment and there is a lift which is super helpful after a long day of walking.

title: Our Xmas Holliday
text:
We were very impressed by all the staff, this made for a great experience. 
the location was good we were in walking distance of most of the sights that interested us. 
We would stay there again if we go to Paris again.

title: Pretty nice
text:
Dennis is wonderful, speaks good English and very helpful and kind. One night lady screaming for help outside. Staff didn't do anything about it. If your traveling France 112 is emergency number. Do not go into the suburbs as they are dangerous. Stay in Paris central. The rooms are very very small, beds were comfortable. Bathrooms were pretty nice and updated. Nice showers. The views are quaint in a Paris sort of way. Breakfast is spendy but it is everywhere in France. Coffee is very small. Starbucks are everywhere and still have large coffees. If you don't like stairs, these are very steep and winding. The elevator is barely enough room for two people to fit in. No room for a wheelchair. It wasn't perfect, but it has some staff there that really try to help make your stay enjoyable.
Note on taxis, from the hotel to the Eiffel tower, cost for regular taxi was average of 14.00 euroes. We had paid one guy 35.00 euros. He quoted us. The cheaper ones had a trip meter that rally as you go. They were cheaper. The hotel will call for good taxis.

title: Friendly hotel in great location
text:
Hotel Plaza is in a great location half way between Gare du Nord and Opera Garnier and around 15 minutes easy walk to either. 
Thank you to Julia on reception for the friendly welcome we got on arrival. 
We had a normal double room. The room is small but this is Paris! Very comfortable bed, good TV with BBC World News. The bathroom was great and recently refurbished. Very nice Yves Rocher shower products.
The Wifi was extremely fast. We did not have the buffet breakfast.
Overall the Plaza Opera is great value for money.

title: Perfect!
text: What a lovely place to stay in Paris. Stayed 4 nights, upgraded to a balcony room. Small but very comfortable beds and a modern, very clean ensuite. Super fast complimentary wifi. Excellent value for money! I would like to nominate Julia at reception for employee of the year! She was so friendly and helpful and genuinely concerned that we were having a great time. Spoke good english as well as 3 other languages. Perfect location as easy walk from Gaud de Nord international rail station. We ended up taking a taxi as it was raining when we arrived. Spoiled for food options in this area all within a minutes walk. Highly recommend Cafe M. Easy walk to Hard Rock Cafe where you can also catch the Open Top Tour hop on hop off bus, red line. Only 2 minor negatives, breakfast very basic continental and for $13 euro decided to eat elsewhere and finally traffic noise in our room #34, 3rd floor. Overall would recommend this hotel and would happily stay there again! Lovely boutique hotel.

title: Dissatisfied
text: The room was very small which was hard for a family of 3 with a teenage girl. On our first night I asked for extra towels and I was told by reception that it was only one towel per person per day! The room was dirty, there were bugs and I could here rats in the walls. Mould was in the bathroom. Our last night the room was apparently made up however all that was done were the beds were made. Our rubbish remained, no toilet paper, not enough towels or any toiletries. When I complained we were given a few mini chocolates! I would not recommend this hotel.

title: Nice hotel
text:
We stayed 3 nights and hade a really good stay. 
A women in the front desk was super friendly and helpfull. Love Paris and the hotell, good Walking distance around the city. I recomend this hotel. :) :)

title: Great location, friendly staff
text: Our stay at the Plaza Opera Hotel was great! We were on the top floor in a triple room. Our room and bathroom were spacious and clean; large bathtub with handheld shower.  The location was excellent as several metro stations and bus stops were within 5 minutes walking distance. Excellent places nearby to eat and shop; safe neighborhood; fresh croissants in the lobby every day. Everyone at the front desk spoke English, which was most appreciated, and they arranged for a shuttle to the airport (18 euros cash per person). We lucked out that our room was ready in the morning; we could settle in without an extra charge. Overall we had a wonderful stay!

title: Paris stopover
text: We spent 3 nights at Plaza Opera Hotel. I could not fault the front desk staff or the value for money. The room was a little on the small side but for what we paid it was hard to complain. Location is great with plenty of bars and restaurants close by.

title: Excellent Stay
text: Stayed 2 weeks - the previous reviews extremely accuarate - what made the stay was family feel of the hotel and the friendly and helpful staff. Great location for exploring Paris by the metro - highly recommend

title: Toussaint in Paris
text: Good location, fairly close to Metro Cadet, small but good room with decent facilities, decent breakfast with sweet and savoury options, helpful staff. Thin walls, no radiator in the room and we avoided using the AC ventilator. Small room but it's Paris, so it was good value for money. All good.

title: Short family stay
text: Stayed at the Plaza Opera for four nights in a triple room on the 4th floor. The view of the Eiffel Tower was a good surprise. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Breakfast was disappointing, very limited choice.

title: Cramped and basic facilities
text: the hotel was in a good location to the things we wanted to see but the accommodation was a let down.  The room was so cramped, I travelled with my sister, the beds were pushed together and there was not enough room to get around them let alone put suitcases.  Bathroom was so small that you had to get into the shower by climbing over the toilet.  The receptionist Julia was very helpful, friendly and couldn't do enough for you.

title: Loved it
text: Would definitely stay at this hotel again. We had a triple room, room 63 and loved it. This room felt more than big enough with a lovely large bathroom.  The hotel was very clean and the staff were very friendly and helpful- particularly Dennis. The only down size is that there is only a very small communal lounge. The area was great and we ate at Abbradavio’s Italian a couple of times. Missing the place already.

title: Gorgeous hotel in perfect location
text:
Plaza Opera was the perfect choice for our 2 day stopover in Paris. There are many local eatery options close by. It is conveniently located near Montmartre, several metro stations and Gare du Nord.
The owners were very welcoming on arrival, and extremely friendly, helpful and thoughtful during our short stay.
The rooms are small yet, charming and comfortable.
Will definitely stay there again.

title: First time in Paris
text:
For location, size of the room and price this hotel was great.
We arrived into Gare du Nord and it was a easy 29 minute walk downhill to the hotel.
Staff are very friendly and helpful and know at least five languages.
The neighbourhood is OK and we felt safe walking at night. It's a little noisy, like the rest of Paris, but once you close the windows you block out 99% of the noise.
Bed was comfy, linen was clean. Room wasn't too big, on par with an IBIS Hotel which suits us.
The lift is awesome and tiny. Two people and hand luggage is all it will take.
There are several metro stations close by plus convience stores, restaurants, bars and Boulangeries.

title: Great hotel
text: Hotel is very nice, good breakfast and perfectly located in Paris! The rooms are well cleaned and even if all around there are bars and bistros the rooms are very quiet and it is a great rest during the night. I really enjoyed the breakfast. Very good choice of healthy food!!! And delicious croissants!

title: Nothing special but just the location.  Paris always wants you to pay a lot for so little.
text:
This boutique hotel has one of the tiniest elevators I’ve seen in my world travels.  A big guy with a big suitcase would have a hard time to squeeze in.  The hotel room assigned to us in room 104 (1st floor) for a party of 2 is a bit small with hardly space to move around – in spite of our small luggage.   

The room (total of about 80 sq. ft including the bathroom) would be ideal for a solo traveler, a bit uncomfortable for 2 and a total nightmare for a party of 3 (even for 2 adults & a child) or more.  

The rooms use the good, old big manual keys so make sure they’re locked well as there’s no safety box inside.  There were ample power outlets but don’t forget to bring European adapters or extensions.

There is also a tiny balcony but all you see is a lousy side street and tenants from opposite buildings trying to peek through the sheer (there’s another thicker curtain though) drapes in the evening.

The positives: Good location for the budget traveler (as the Gare Du Nord train depot is just 3 quarters of a mile away & it would take you direct to Paris CDG airport & back for just E10.30 ($11.25) each way.  You could either walk to hotel or take bus # 43 from Gare du Nord & alight at Chateaudun-Lamartine stop & the hotel is just across.  

There’s also a nearby bus stop that services Sacre Coure (Sacred Heart Basilica) (bus #40 - get off at Orsel and walk a bit until you see a funicular (elevated tram) to get you up the church (same cost of a bus ride – Euro 1.90) instead of the lung-busting stairs.  If you’re in good shape, you could do the mostly uphill walk towards it from the hotel in less than an hour.  Don’t believe those # of minutes’ walk to the places of interest on the website, - they’re for intended for ultra-fit athletes. 

The small shower stall has good water pressure for both hot & cold with minimal outside seepage after a long shower. Towels are clean but not very fluffy.  Shampoo & shower gel on long tubes are provided as well as a thin circular soap. A hair dryer is provided but the single trash bin is also tiny.

The double bed is OK with clean sheets but they provided only 1 pillow for each guest.  There’s a small TV (24 inch).  No electric pot for coffee or tea inside the room --just 2 thin plastic cups. 

They use a 3rd-party to access WiFi so expect constant disconnects if using more than 2 devices.  After entering the assigned # or PIN, you can use any phantom e-mail address (to prevent spam) to finally log-on & have internet access.  It’s spotty at best, even at the 1/F.

If you’re checking-in at night, the guy at the reception will just check you in & no other information would be provided unlike the helpful & informative ladies during daytime.  So, if you’re an early bird, there’s actually an electric pot with instant coffee at the small reception area (or, for 1 Euro, you could buy a Nespresso capsule for the coffee machine. A small bottle of water cost 2 Euro – just ask the front desk).  It’s almost impossible to find a open café in the area between 5-7 AM.

The hotel also offers shuttle service to CDG airport for 18 Euro per person (cash only).  Taxi for 2 will set you back at about Euro 48.  There’s a lot of places to eat just less than a mile away (mostly going towards the Metro (Cadet Station) but take note that they open late (about 10 AM) & since this Paris, everything seems overpriced. Even their McDonald’s cost more than double as in the US.  So, just look for a Carrefour or even a Franprix to get your hot meals or sandwiches, wines & water to take back to your hotel room. 

But this is the big city of Paris in France, where they want you to pay more for everything so little, so it’s not very surprising at all. 

Overall, for about $130 a night (w/o breakfast), it’s OK but not great.  For the price, you’re essentially paying a premium for the good location & nothing else.

title: Thelma & Louise's fling
text: Stayed 3 days at this quaint centrally located hotel. Restaurants & supermarket all close by. Easy walking to tourist destinations or pickups. But best thing about this hotel was Julia at the front desk. A super efficient wonderful lady who went out of her way to care for us 2 mature ladies from Oz. She is a bonus to any hotel & made our visit so much more. A gift is coming her way from Australia.

title: Pleasant hotel stay, close to multiple train lines, helpful staff
text:
Plaza Opera Hotel in Paris is a cute little hotel with good clean facilities. The lift was relatively small but hey, it was Paris and you could fit 1 Person a standard check in luggage and a hand carry so not too bad overall.

The hotel roughly a 20 min walk with large luggages from Gare du Nord and closer for other metro lines but the fact that there was no fridge or kettle was made up by the excellent customer / concierge service we received... Julia you were so helpful and we appreciated your assistance very much

title: Honeymoon Stay
text: Went for our honeymoon, there was nothing special set up for the honeymoon nor was it acknowledged. We had breakfast included but it was very limited and the kitchen staff member looked like they were forced to be there, which made breakfast uncomfortable every time. The hotel was in a good location. The rooms were not sound proof as advertised.

title: Great Location
text: Stayed four nights and found the accommodation was close to the metro which made travelling to the sights easy for a first traveler to Paris. The Plaza Opera is also close to restaurants, pharmacies and a small supermarket if required. The hotel wi-fi made life easy keeping in touch and I was able to use the wi-fi to watch Netflix on my device.

title: Good value för Money
text: Central and safe location with lots of restaurants and cafes nearby. Walking distance to Madeleine Opera House and Concord Square. Courteous service, very reasonable continental breakfast, small room.

title: Nice hotel
text:
My husband and I first visit to Paris, wasn't sure where to stay ... Plaza opera was a nice clean tidy hotel... not far about 10min walk from the layfette district .. this is where there is the shopping mall and restaurants.

However there are lots of restaurants near the hotel.

30 min roughly taxi drive to Eiffel tower ...

The people at the front desk were welcoming and helpful every time you asked questions.

title: Great Location
text: The staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were pleasant, we had a balcony but didn't use it as we were always out and about. The breakfast involved cereal, bread, croissants, yogurt, cold meats and juice. It was nice ( No eggs and bacon) It was walking distance to Sacre Coeur and Moulin Rouge.  We felt it was an upmarket area and close to train stations.

title: Four  nights at Hôtel Plaza Opéra.
text: We spent four nights at this very comfortable hotel which was  conveniently situated close to the Rue ST.Lazare , where our son lives.The room was clean and adequately furnished with an excellent shower and clean towels supplied each day.A nourishing buffet breakfast was served each morning and the staff from the receotion to cleaners were all very friendly and helpful.Anyone wishing to go to church  on Sunday will find one within 5 minutes walking distance.There were many bars and restaurants nearby and a good shopping centre not too far away.

title: Too small terrible location
text: A twin share room was extremely small. The location was seedy and felt unsafe. The balcony is shared with other travellers. Cleanliness was ok but not amazing . The location was a massive downfall as it was riddled with crime and an unsafe vibe even for two 30 year old males, I felt uncomfortable

title: Lovely Hotel in Paris
text:
The staff was lovely and helpful.  Our French was weak, so we definitely  appreciated everyone's ability to speak English.   The location of Hotel Plaza Opera was perfect.  We were able to walk, take the metro or an Uber to tour all of Paris. 

Our room was comfortable.  The A/C worked well.  We had a balcony with a table and chairs where we sat in the evenings.  Our bathroom was great, especially appreciated the large shower!

title: Four excellent nights in Plaza Opera.
text:
We stayed four nights in Plaza Opera and we were very satisfied. We came by train from CDG airport and we walked into hotel from the trainstation Gare du Nord. It took about 15 min. The room was clean and cosy and we had also a balcony which was a pleasent surprise for us. The breakfast was traditionel and ok.
The service of the hotel staff was really kind. The location was great and there were several metro stations near the hotel. We highly recommend the hotel.

title: Budget excellence
text: The hotel was in a great position. The room was big enough for the two of us, was clean, functional and was serviced daily. The staff, particularly the reception staff, were very pleasant, helpful and friendly.

title: 4.5 out of 5
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here while in Paris. The breakfast was full and varied. The rooms were comfortable clean and well serviced. The staff were friendly and very helpful.  Though we had to check out on departure day but wait til evening to go to the airport the salon downstairs was delightful to wait in and room to store our luggage enabled us to see more of Montmartre before we left. Thank you for a delightful stay.

title: Fantastic stay!
text: Really enjoyed our stay in this hotel. Great location. Lovely balcony with tower views. Croissants and coffee downstairs a lovely touch! Receptionists very helpful. Julia was fantastic. Very patient and helped us out with directions. Could not do enough for us!! Housekeeping were extremely helpful and went out of their way for us! Would definitely stay again@

title: Lovely hotel in Paris
text: I really liked this hotel. It had clean rooms with great air conditioning. It was a little ways away from the major attractions but we used the metro to get around. The staff was very helpful guiding us on how to get to our destinations. It was only a few blocks to some of the metro stops.

title: 24 hour staff speaks great English in addition to French
text: We were greeted with a smile and a friendly Hello from Julia.  We were pleased that she spoke good English as we speak very little French.  Julia was very helpful throughout our stay and made us feel very welcomed.  This is a small hotel, but she remembered us and our room number.  There is a lift (elevator) just big enough for one person and their luggage or two people without luggage.  There are 5 floors and stairs from the lobby should you decide to use them.   Our clean room with air conditioning was small or standard size for Paris.  It came equipped with a small refrigerator and pot to make hot water for tea or instant coffee (provided), along with 2 cups.  The location was perfect for us as our friend lives just one block away, which happens to be where we found the best bakeries and fruit stand.  We were pleased with the location and room.  We would not hesitate to stay here again.  Hopefully we’ll get the chance to!

title: Great stay
text: We really enjoyed our time in Paris, and the Plaza Opera is in a great spot. The room was clean and roomy and the staff made us feel very welcome. Special mention to Dennis, who went out of his way to help us with directions and recommend restaurants. We all think he should be commended!

title: Lovely stay
text:
My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights in April for our honeymoon. The room was clean, small but normal for European standards in my opinion. The bathroom was also clean. We had a bath tub not a shower so if you'd like a shower, you may need to ask for that. We really loved the balcony we had as it was very Persian style and could see the Eiffel tower from our balcony. The hotel offered breakfast but we did not have it so I cannot comment on it. Staff was helpful and cleaned the room well everyday. The wifi was alright. Seemed to work better in the morning than evening. 

As for location, we really liked it as it did not feel it was a in a touristy part of the city. We walked every where and really enjoyed it. The Eiffel tower is about an hour walk so if you are not big on exploring by foot then there is a transit line that is close by as well. We took the train into Paris and it was about a 15 minute walk to/from the station to the hotel. To the Louvre, it was about a 30 minute walk. There are lots of cafes and restaurants around the area to eat as well. The Sacre-Coeur was a 15 minute walk. The location also seemed safe. We walked around at 11 pm at night and felt fine. There is someone at the front desk all the time which is a nice safety feature. You do have to return the key every time you leave and retrieve when you arrive. 

Would definitely stay at this location again.

title: Perfect Parisian Stay
text: It was a very short trip made all the easier staying here. Very informative front desk and the checkin process went off without a hitch. Rooms are small but the beds are comfortable and the air conditioning worked well. The bathrooms were clean and nicely appointed. Wifi was free but was very poor.

title: Our favorite hotel in Paris!
text: We love this hotel! The exterior facade, having undergone work last year, is beautiful to look at.  We spent 3 nights in room 54 and have spent several nights each year, for the past several years here. We had a lovely balcony with table and chairs and a view of the Tour Eiffel.  The lights at night whether sparkling on the hour or just lit were beautiful!  This hotel is in a wonderful location.  It's a 10 minutes bus ride from the Gare du Nord, a 45 minute walk to Notre Dame, a 10 minute walk to Galleries Lafayette and there are many restaurants in each direction.  All of the staff go out of their way to make your stay perfect.  Breakfast, when booked ahead, is very reasonable and a delicious way to start your day.  The breakfast hostess is very friendly, always smiling and brings a fresh basket of breads, croissants, and pain a chocolate to your table. The buffet tables are filled with many other foods. We even purchased our "carnet" of bus tickets from the front desk, making travel on public transportation very easy.  Maps of the city are provided and the staff will help with any reservations, answer questions etc. There is plenty of space for luggage, coats, carry on bags etc in the room. Coffee, tea making facilities and a small refrigerator are also in the room.  This is the only hotel we choose to stay at when in Paris.

title: Great hotel with fantastic staff
text: Great hotel with fantastic staff , especially Julia and Dennis. Rooms were spotless and the breakfast was delicious . Location was fantastic , would definitely recommend this hotel. We stayed in room 44 which had views of the Eiffel Tower, lots of lovely little Bistros close by. Thankyou Julia and staff for making our 20th wedding anniversary so special !

title: Gary & Patricia Percy
text:
Excellent location.
Extremely pleasant & very helpful staff.
Very small room (that's Paris).
Very clean room.
Comfortable Bed.
Provision of luggage storage was good a customer feature and appreciated.

title: Happy Paris Accomodations
text: A very friendly and helpful staff. In particular Dennis was excellent in assisting with our side trips and transportation confirmations. We look forward to staying at the establishment again in the near future.

title: Centrally located
text: A well located little hotel near Galleries Lafayette and Opera area. The closest metro station is Cadet. The room was clean and tastefully decorated. The staff spoke good English, were happy to answer any queries and provided assistance with directions. Would definitely recommend this hotel for solo travelers.

title: Very good hotel
text: It is very good located hotel. You ll be needed 15 minuted on foot to reach Opera, 15 minutes to Monmartre. Metro station Cadet is 5 minutes away. Breakfast is very good, little pricey. There is no hot meal for breakfast. Juice is excellent. Rooms are small, but everything is on place. In one word, lovely room. Staff is very nice. They ll help you to organise return transfer from hotel to the airport. It is 18 eur per persom which is best option to reach airport. To sumarize, it is very lovely hotel.

title: Lovely stay
text: Lovely hotel in superb location. Very clean and well maintained rooms. Our superior room with Eiffel Tower view from balcony was fantastic. Breakfast buffet had good choices. Julia on reception was so wonderful, with a genuine interest in us and our daily activities. Also advising us on nearby good restaurants, and even warning us about the yellow vest rallies and where to stay away from. She was so friendly and just lovely. Thank you Julia!!

title: Review
text:
The rooms and service were amazing! Julia was extremely helpful with ways to get around, places to eat etc 
And the balcony’s are great little set ups and views. The place is close to heaps of food and bars. 
Would recommend staying here to anyone

title: Parisian Gem!
text:
We absolutely LOVED our stay in March 2019, and we were genuinely sad to leave after our two night stay. We got engaged during our stay, so the hotel will always hold a special place in our hearts, and we will be back!
The location is fabulous, close to the Metro and a bus stop right outside that will take you to the Eiffel Tower. You can easily walk to Montmartre from the hotel too. Lots of places to eat in the neighbourhood, grab a quick glass of wine or stock up the grocery store close by. We felt very safe in this area of Paris!
The staff at this hotel are AMAZING, especially Julia! So friendly and knowledgeable, nothing was too much trouble for her, or any of the staff we interacted with. 
Our room (and the entire hotel!) was spotlessly clean. The bed was comfortable, cute chocolates and Eiffel Tower shaped candies on our bed, and we didn't here any of our neighbours in the adjacent rooms. The small fridge was great for chilling wine/beer/water. The view of the Eiffel Tower from our balcony was a plus, especially in an evening when it sparkles on the hour! We also had spectacular sunsets over the Parisian rooftops :-) 
Yes, the elevator is tiny, but they usually are in Paris.....we actually loved the novelty of it, not something we see everyday on North America.
Thank you Julia and Co for an awesome place to call home in Paris!

title: Lovely visit
text: Many thanks to Julia for being so kind and helpful in making my one-day stay in Paris a great one!  From checking in to checking out, to neighborhood directions and advice on where to visit, she was a big help

title: A great experience
text: The room was exactly what we needed. Small but comfortable and with a great view. We stayed for four nights and the room was cleaned daily. The location was also good.Everyone at the reception was kind and incredibly helpful. Would definitely come back.

title: Perfect for a short break
text:
Hotel is central, it is 15 minutes walk from Gare Du Nord station. There are plenty of eating and drinking options very close to the hotel.
Breakfast was OK, nothing hot available, but you won't go hungry! Staff very pleasant and friendly

title: Authentic Paris Stay
text: Felt like we were in Paris, right from the building façade, welcoming, through to the quaint lift and spiralling antique staircase. The view may not have included the Eiffel tower, but the streets below were full of live and sound. Good restaurants nearby, right across from the bus stop, not far from the Metro and walking distance to down town. Don't think we would have had the same experience in a large hotel chain which feel familiar and comfortable. Breakfast was good, staff were great.

title: Affordable luxury
text: We loved our Eiffel view room. It is affordable luxury in a great location! Staff are very helpful and pictures are true to room. Only downside was wifi didn’t work on 5th floor very well but otherwise loved it!

title: Good location, Friendly staff, Clean Hotel
text:
We enjoyed our hotel in Paris' 9th arrondesmont. The hotel is a typical, small and quaint Parisian hotel. The room was clean and the wifi worked well. The room was also very small, but did provide us with a safe and quiet place to sleep. We were in a room that accommodated 3 adults. There were 3 twin beds, a "big" (by Paris standards) bathroom and a small work table. Our big windows opened fully, so we were able to get some fresh air and enjoy the noises and bustle of the beautiful Paris streets.
Check-in and check-out went seamlessly and the staff was always very friendly, and the staff we encountered all spoke decent English.There are two smaller metro stops within 3 minute walk and the big Gare-du-Nord station about 10-15 minute walk. 
We would consider this hotel again when we come back to Paris.

title: exactly what we needed for the purpose of our journey
text: Near the North Railway Station and where we had the planned events. The location is also served by metro stations but is in line with Pont Neuf via Montmarte. The balcony was useful, but also a lounge where we received our guests.

title: Good Location
text: We loved the location of the hotel. It is just centre of the city, near the bus stops and subways. It also lasts max 10-20 minutes to walk to "must see" locations in Paris. The room size was ok, but not big as we expected. Room view was awesome, we loved the little balcony.

title: Good hotel for the price
text: Stayed there for two nights.  The staff was very nice and helpful.  I had a room for one person and it was comfortable and what I expected.  The only complain I have is that the people that occupied the rooms on my floor were very loud the second night.  They were partying all night, singing at 3 am.  Did not get any sleep that night.

title: Fantastic Staff who were very helpful and friendly
text: The staff are very helpful. Their English is excellent and they were very helpful. The Hotel is 12 minutes walk from Gare Du Nord. There is a Bus stop Literally outside the door and Bus Number 42 takes you directly to the Eiffel Tower. there is a metro stop 3 mins away. Our room had a view to the Eiffel Tower. It was a lovely sleep and even though the Hotel is on a Busy street it was quiet in the room.

title: Wonderful
text: We arrived and was greeted by a very helpful Julia. As our room wasn't ready, because we arrived early. It was no problem for them to store our luggage. All the staff were so friendly. Breakfast was delicious and plentiful. Our room was clean and the bathroom spacious. It is close to a laundry mat, restaurants and a supermarket. The Plaza Opera Hotel is one of our favourite places to stay now. If we ever get back to Paris we will differently stay here again.

title: Hotel Plaza Opera
text: the hotel rooms are small but charming. the staff were very helpful and pleasant to talk with, even booking us a river cruise on the Seine and providing other recommendations. hotel easily accessible to the major sites of paris, while also being in a quiet area. highly recommend for the price!

title: Good value hotel
text: Good location close to 2 metro stations and Rue des Martyrs. Compact size rooms. Basin clogged up and not fixed. Nice breakfast downstairs. Would stay again but get a larger room. Paris bed tax is on top of the room rate.

title: 5 Star!
text: After an awful experience at Disneyland Paris with another hotel chain we arrived in Central Paris at Hotel Plaza Opera and cannot fault a thing! A beautiful location amongst the traditional French street, close to the METRO, Opera bus stop for the bus tour and lovely restaurants and cafès! If you are visiting from outside of Europe just consider the room size upon booking, the traditional European rooms are very snug and cosy! The interiors were beautiful though so not worth complaining about. The staff were very accommodating and helpful. We were able to book our bus tour and get some local discounts via the hotel reception and book our shuttle (very offordable for €18 PP to the airport). They are quite tight on security, eg. Leaving luggage in the locked room available and making sure we handed our key in every time we left the building. We definitely felt very safe in this location. The staff were always on reception to answer any queries we had and guided us to the best tourist spots with a handy map. Will definitely be back! Thank you!!

title: Great Paris style hotel
text: This is a great Paris hotel but remember it is typical truely parisien size very snugg.  Julie and all the staff are outstanding and went out of their way to help us obtain transportation during the difficulties of "yellow shirts" event.  They also were checking that all the clients were going to be safe where they went.  Room was super clean, bigger bathroom updated and bed furniture looks new.  As special treat there is a basket of pain au chocolate at desk in afternoon. Fabulous bakery near lorette metro stop nearby and the restaurants down the street were 4/4 rating.  So is plaza staff.

title: Great Little Hotel
text: The is a small hotel full of French character. Lovely spiral staircase to all levels. There is a lift too.Very clean. Comfortable bed. Nice toiletries.Modern, clean and comfortable living room.Really friendly staff.

title: Friendly staff and good location but...
text: The location of the hotel was very good (close to Gare du Nord and metro station) and the staff was more than helpful and friendly. The room was small, but enough space to be expected from any Parisian hotel. However my problem was, the hotel was under renovation during our stay and we were not informed about this prior to our visit. We made the booking long before our arrival and I did get in touch the hotel management and staff about our room before our arrival. We were expecting to have a view but none for us, and also the renovation noise was not pleasing. Even though we were greated with chocolates on our bed (probably due to the inconvience), I was in Paris to celebrate my birthday and we were not off to a good start. Other than that, we did not have any problem and even though to our inconvience, overall I believe it is still a good place to stay.

title: Love the hotel.
text: The location was great! Really close to the metro and really nice area to walk. All the staff were very helpful in all the questions that we had. Breakfast was good and the rooms were always very clean.

title: Fresh croissants at reception desk - a welcome sight after a long flight!
text: Small, clean room with comfortable firm bed.  The hotel's a short walk to the subway and the Opera Garnier.  Excellent staff, particularly Julia, who was friendly, knowledgeable, and went out of her way to help us have a great visit.  Two blocks from the rue des Martyrs, a great little neighborhood shopping street that leads up to Montmartre.  We will definitely be staying here again.

title: Good location, average room
text: The location of this hotel was great. The first receptionist we had the day we got there was fantastic. Very friendly and helpful. The breakfast was terribly average. Would not recommend breakfast. Somewhat annoying the room did not have a safe and needed to be paid for at reception.

title: Fantastic  staff
text:
Firstly the staff were fantastic 
Fatima was amazing , nothing was any bother and a massive help.  Thanks fatima and Victoria. 
Hotel nice , great location . Nice food , pool small but a nice touch . Would book again

title: Great location and lovely room
text:
Room on first floor which was a good size with a small terrace which was a real bonus given how hot the weather was. Staff were attentive and chatty and really helpful with local knowledge. Excellent choice at breakfast with something for all tastes. 
5 minutes walk from two different metro stations on different lines, one of which goes direct to Gare du Nord and there are shops and restaurants a couple of minutes walk away. 
Hotel was more expensive than I would normally book but, in my opinion, was worth it he I would definitely stay again.

title: Great find in a pleasant suburb of Paris
text:
Had a one night stay here on a business trip to Paris. A very impressive chic hotel with decor to match. Very comfortable room (102) with street view. Hotel is spotless. For Paris the room size was a pleasant surprise, large double bed & plenty of room. Excellent shower that blows you away or wakes you up as needed! Very well appointed bedroom, with complimentary water, a chiller in wardrobe & allthe facilities you will need. Breakfast provided a very good range of continental offerings along with some hot food selections. Staff were very friendly, polite & helpful. The hotel has a small bar & a lrager area to relax in. It is an 'honesty' bar. One helps themselves & then complete a form as to what drinks are taken. This is then added to your bill. While I appreciate it is out of season for Paris room/breakfast £116.00 - bargain! 
Hotel area is surrounded by residential properties but restaurants and bars are all a couple of minutes walk. Definitely recommend Bistro 31 (3 mins away , see separate review)
Overall an excellent hotel and would definitely recommend as a hotel of choice for Paris as many attractions are a nearby via a good stroll or worst case Metro/Taxi.

title: Very nice boutique hotel
text: My husband and I had a 3 nights stay at the Hotel Felicien in France. The hotel is nicely tucked in a very beautiful residential area. Nice continental breakfast in the morning. Clean hotel. Some of the decorations were a bit loud but was fixed with a room change. The manager, Paula was absolutely amazing. Very helpful to get around France for a non-speaker and taught me a bit of french too.

title: Sexiest boutique penthouse in Paris
text: We stayed here for a birthday weekend treat during a 3 week stay in Paris and booked the 2 story penthouse with the private roof deck and jacuzzi. It’s a hidden oasis staycation. Private, romantic with a staff that tries to accommodate you in every way. It even had an indoor pool which we didn’t use because of our hot tub and also a spa. What a dream that went beyond expectations. Market, great restaurants walking distance around hotel, perfect take out as well for picnics on the terrace.

title: Very nice place
text:
Very nice and clean hotel. Our room was very nice and cosy. The view from the balcony was gorgeous. Staff  were always kind, friendly and helped us out with every request. Also they have a beautiful SPA.
I recommend this hotel

title: Me and my daughter new years eve trip
text: The staff were very helpful and friendly. It was very clean. Breakfast was traditional Parisian style. Small and intimate hotel. Always clean. Not in the hustle and bustle of main paris but only a 5 minute drive to the Eiffel Tower. Selection of room service food was disappointing, however Uber Eats is great! So it's a win win. Bar open 24 7 so cold drinks round the clock is a win win also. Local grocery shop around the corner for small snacks. Was sad to leave definitely recommend. Thanks for making my first time trip to Paris a nice experience.

title: Just for one night
text:
We decided to choose the Felicien hotel for its location however pictures on their website look better than reality. Room is small and we were at level 3 "ruby", all red!
You have to be ready with the color. Bathroom is not functional, very dark - you can't do a proper makeup. Room & bathroom were clean.
Staff at the reception is professional and nice.
I cannot say I had a bad experience, I think it is nice for one or 2 night but not a full stay in Paris.

title: Good hotel
text: Stayed here a couple of times. The staff is friendly and helpful. The hotel is clean and baths modern. Tubs are a bit deep for people with mobility problems (I sprained my ankle while in Paris). Breakfast is only ok. Better to just grab something at a nearby bakery. The location is good because it's close to 4 or 5 metro stops but it is a little out of the way for people that feel less comfortable taking public transit.

title: Fiche individuelle de police
text: Beware! Warning! This hotel makes you sign a form for « police » and no other hotel in Paris has ever made this request.  This hotel is in the 16th. Nice quiet neighborhood.   The first impression will ruin your stay. We actually called police and they had no idea what we are talking about

title: Spa
text: Me and my friend went for the SPA, it was really nice, clean, have all the utilities needed . And it was very comfortable. Also the stuff where very friendly. It wont be the last time We would go there

title: Top hotel in 16e!!!!
text: From the moment of arrival, we loved it! Matteo on the desk checked us in seamlessly! He advised us where to eat locally, and could not do enough for us! Later he informed me he was "in-training", which added to the experience, because he was an utmost professional throughout! He IS already a great asset to your chain! We also met Paloma, who is another great asset to you! Overall, a really lovely stay! Thank You!

title: Wonderful stay!
text: We booked a last minute trip to Paris when I was visiting my husband while he was working in Germany. We needed to change our hotel reservation by one night at the last minute and the staff was extremely accommodating, given the short notice on our part. We booked the “gourmet getaway” package and our room came with a bottle of wine, free breakfast and a voucher for a free meal in the city at a restaurant of our choice! They even decorated the bed with flower petals! Paloma was very helpful in getting us checked in and answered all of our questions. The breakfast buffet had a very nice spread and the overall atmosphere of the hotel is so fun and comfortable! 20 minute walk from the Eiffel Tower and very close to plenty of restaurants and cafes.

title: Very well situated hotel - some effort required
text: Located in a quiet street near a fashionable area close to the OECD, the hotel has had the attention of a bold decorator. Bright colours and thumping patterns make it visually memorable. The hotel is friendly enough but needs to master better  some of the basic skills such as calling taxis and ensuring that baths drain properly. Excellent location for a quiet stay. My experience may not be representative.

title: Nice location however too expensive for the services offered
text: Very expensive for what is offered. Nice location in terms of access to the city however not too easy to walk downtown.  Small room with bathroom split in two (WC, shower). When going to the WC you should go through the main bedroom to wash your hands.  No area to sit and relax apart from a very small bar.  The SPA (or small swimming pool) is actually charged extra at 30 EUR. Breakfast with limited opportunities for choice (had saucage but no bacon).

title: Great stay at the Hotel Felicien in Paris!
text: I highly recommend the Hotel Felicien in Paris!  Conveniently located within walking distance to both Roland Garros and also to the the Eiffel Tower area.  Contemporary, chic, and clean with terrific guest service!  Paloma was especially helpful at the front desk!  My 5 night stay there was absolutely wonderful!  I will definitely stay there again!

title: Paris 2019
text: Excellent and polite staff, good location of the hotel and very quiet area, comfortable room and bathroom and very good breakfast. The breakfast room is not so large, however there is possibility to have breakfast in its own room.

title: Good hotel
text:
We booked the room with the jacuzzi on the rooftop and we had by chance a lovely weather 
A private terrace just for us !!
The breakfast is just amazing, you can not even compare it with breakfasts in others hotels 
The staff is friendly and helpful 
We didn’t enjoyed the spa but it seems to be a intime and romantic place

title: Customer service
text: The breakfast is very expensive , it should be included with the room fair, the staff is surprised every time we ask for something missing from the room. the staff should be more welcoming and ask the guest if they need anything. in brief; the customer service is not at a global level

title: Very pacefull place
text: Lovely stuff . Mostly I liked the Spa .  It’s not very far from Eiffel Tower and other places you can visit. The breakfest is very tasty and you have a lot of choises . It was a very pacefull vacantion .

title: Great
text: Great place to visit. It is a place where technology is open for all. Technology has become a major role in our life. So, technical things are smartly developed in here. In this place we know the oldest technology things.

title: Please avoid
text:
Please do not book this hotel. Avoid at any cost unless you are being chased by Zombies in Paris. Rooms are old and tired. The swimming pool is shut for maintenance. Staff are very French, and provide little or no service. If you have to book this hotel due to friend or colleagues pressuring you, do not fall for the hot tub. The hot tub on the roof, its open to the elements and to most of the neighbourhood. The hotel rooms are very close to the other neighbours, you can see them cook in the evenings. 

There are no decent restaurants in the area. The breakfast is basic, looks good, taste bad. I know, its Paris but yes they found a way to source bad food in France.

title: Simply a Great Hotel!
text:
A beautiful boutique hotel in a quiet location off the main street. The hotel reception staff was very welcoming and professional and always very helpful with any of my requests.
