The rooms are very comfortable and the lobby/bar a nice area to have a business meeting or to simply relax.

I have decided to make that property my home away place when visiting Paris.

title: Just perfect
text:
It was the first time for us in Paris and the team from Felicien made their best to make our stay a wonderful memory 
They helped us with directions, restaurants and places to visit 
The hotel design is original and the bar concept is a good and original idea also!
Breakfast in the room it's perfect to start a new day in Paris..
Thank you for everything and see you soon all

title: Weekend trip
text: We had such a nice stay, the services were great. It’s very well located, u can get anywhere from there. The stuff were very helpful and made the stay even better. over all it was a great stay, I totally recomend it.

title: Good location, but doesn’t meet the expectations
text:
As a family of 2 adults and 1 child we have spent 1 night at Hotel Felicien.
Among the positive sides of our stay were fast check-in, room ready at noon, big room, big and comfortable bed. Location is great as well.
However, the hotel was quite difficult to find, and we were not allowed to the swimming pool because our child is less than 16. This kind of information should be written jn hotel description, because swimming pool was my priority while searching for the hotel. 
Also, we found blood stains on the blanket, and tobacco remainings on the lamp, so we guess that the room has not been properly cleaned after previous guests. 
It was good that there was a proper bath in the bathroom, we really liked it, but while showering all the water kept leaking to the floor because the silicone part of the glass curtain was worn out. So after the shower it was impossible to get into the bathroom. 
Generally speaking, we loved the hotel, but it is either not worth the money, or not worth the 4*.

title: Enjoyable
text: Really enjoyed my stay here. Lovely shower, comfy bed, (very small) swimming pool, great location, good price. But the best thing was the breakfast. I stay in Paris frequently and the breakfast is mostly terrible, but here it was great. Staff on the desk were very friendly and attentive too.

title: A little jewel in Paris
text: Hotel Felicien is a boutique hotel in the 16. district of Paris. It is a very nice part of the city, close to the Seine and Tour Eiffel, with nice restaurants, shops, elegant buildings. The hotel’s chic interior design is of Ted Lapidus’s with colors of black, white and red. Rooms are small but functional with high quality furniture, bathroom, bed, etc. Each floor has different color - each room is decorated with matching pieces of contemporary art. The most remarkable design is that of the restaurant. The hotel has a patio, bar and even a spa.

title: Appalling service and room requesting refund
text: What can only be described as an atrocious stay, the ceiling was leaking and mouldy this literally kept my partner up all night, broken glasses to drink with  and even tried to charge me double for the room when leaving early in the morning to go and find sleep somewhere else, the mould on the ceiling and around the shower was in excusable, no use of pool facilities due to maintenance, no television remote and very slow WiFi, bag drop not secure so anyone could have walked away with my bags. I would like a full refund and apology for trying to charge me double !

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice cosy hotel with stylish rooms and efficient staff. I was very happy with my stay a small supermarket is at the end of the street and breakfast was up to standard. Nothing to complain about and good value for money.

title: comfortable room but wifi is not so stable
text: Hotel was nice, staff was also nice, I personally liked it. but there are 2 things I gotta mention. 1. 2 small water bottles were provided only once. →I wish I could get the bottle every day at least. 2. Wifi is not so stable, sometimes even disconnected.

title: Terrible bathroom design, hygiene and bad service
text:
My husband and I went to spend a relaxing weekend in Paris and we chose this hotel predominantly because it had a spa and offered treatments.

The spa was under renovation which affected the treatments, and there was no pre-warning about this to customers prior to booking. The plunge pool, steam and sauna were supposed to be working, but when I went down there they were both clearly broken as the rams were cold. I wasted what was meant to be a relaxing morning frustrated back and forth trying to get it fixed with the staff.

No robes or slippers were provided; I had to ask twice to get these.The hotel offered no apology or compensation for any of this. 

The room was fine but the bathroom drove me mad!! It floods with water when you shower because of the terrible design. There was no ledge around the shower tray to stop the water nor was it a wet room design with a slanted floor to gather the water. In fact the floor was slanted a little the other way filling the bathroom with water. Meaning you have to get your feet soaking wet every time you went in. 

But the worst thing was that they had no shower screen or door, they had a shower curtain which is so unhygienic. The curtain was FULL of mould. It was SO GROSS.

And to top it off the extractor fan was useless and both the rain and hand shower leaked.

Photos attached. 

And as if all of that wasn’t enough - they charged us for the room twice.

It is a shame because the hotel is cute and in a great location with the potential to be great. Until they fix these essential issues in design, service and communication; it is not a 4 star hotel in my books and I would not recommend you stay there.

title: Quiet Neighborhood, Great Walks
text: Located two blocks from the Seine River and 3 blocks from le Pont (Bridge) de Grenelle and the Statue of Liberty neat la Maison de la Radio, it is a good and comfortable hotel in a very quiet location.  There are nearby supermarkets and a range of eateries from bistros to restaurants of good standing.  The rooms are small but intimate, the beds comfortable.  The toilet was separate from the bathroom and bedroom.  There are no screeens making it vulnerable for insects if the windows are left open.  Very enjoyable stay and would return easily for the facility and surroundings.

title: Beautiful rooms but lacking customer service
text:
An expensive but very elegant place. Girls at the desk were lovely but the evening gentleman was pretty rude and arrogant. Our coffee pot melted on the desk and shorted out power in our room and stunk. We didn’t even use it! Someone may have bumped it but it should shut down when it is boiled dry no matter what. Man at desk was annoyed to come up to reset power. Not our fault! And never replaced it. Wanted coffee in the morning from the machine as we were going out at 630 (breakfast started at 7). All he needed to do was place a carton of milk beside the machine and put the hose in the carton) but he refused. And breakfast was included (18€ each) but we left early to go to golf tourney and he wouldn’t budge. And we couldn’t make it in our room because they hadn’t replaced the pot. Not impressed. 
Pool didn’t work. For the $ paid, should have been treated better. 
But the king bed was a treat and very comfy.

title: an elegant hotel
text: Every part of this small hotel is very nicely decorated, with a character, that represents the French allure. Besides that the Lapidus family has a long tradition in elegance thru their famous line. My choice for this hotel was exactly for that reason. It is on a high budget,but on a good location.

title: Weekend at Paris
text: We spent a three days and two night in a very confortable&clean hotel.The breakfast wa good and huge. At the reception they spoke Franch but also English.We raccomed to take in consideration the Hotel Felicien.Mauro&VivianaPARIS C'EST FABOULOSE

title: Not for business travelers
text: Nice hotel on a good location for a fair price. However, they don't have enough planks and irons in the hotel. For a business traveler, you need to be able to have this in your room. For the rest this is a nice hotel to stay in and the staff is friendly, breakfast is simple but good.

title: VASTLY OVERRATED
text:
I booked this through a travel agent on line and the photos, descriptions etc... looked marvelous
However the stay there was less than fabulous by a long way. 
Firstly do not try to bring a car to this hotel as there is no parking on the street ( or virtually impossible to find)
The reception staff were inefficient, and not at all helpful. 
The whole hotel is pokey. There is no room for everything
We were on the 4th floor served by two lifts, one terribly slow and the other rather quaint. The room itself is accessed through two very heavy doors., I am not a total weakling but found them hard to open. The room itself was small, and strangely the toilet is between the two entrance doors and does not have a wash basin which means that you have to touch door handles etc...l before getting to the bathroom to wash your hands. 
The rooms are decorated in an eclectic style which was not to my taste, 
There is no room service as far as I can see,
#Then there is a 'bar' where there is no-one serving so it becomes a 'honour bar'
The coffee machine dispensed weak lukewarm coffer. Breakfast is taken in a small room with no service ( apart from a lady who removes dirty plates etc... The choice in the buffet is just OK and again to get any drinks one had to go to the 'bar' to help oneself.
OK everything was quite clean, however the outside of the hotel is littered with cigarette butts and is not swept ,
The place is not cheap.in fact very very overpriced.
I cannot recommend this at all.

title: Excellent value
text: Excellent value in a great location.  Unique concept hotel. Easy to navigate from. Staff was friendly and accommodating. Room was more than enough. Spacious bathroom with a wonderful shower. I would stay here again!

title: Clean helpful staff but expenisive
text:
I arrived at my hotel that I booked online. I booked this hotel online through a third party, I booked mainly because I wanted air conditioning and a bathtub. When I arrived the staff was friendly, upgraded us for free, however, the sirconditioning in our room didn’t work and would not be working until the next day. The staff moved us to another room because of the broken air condition however that room only had a shower. We asked for another room, however, that rooms airconditining didn’t work. So we asked the staff to please put us back into the room with just the shower. We found out later that the rainfall shower didn’t work and the handheld spraining sprayed all over the place

For our inconvenience the staff offered us free drinks, we took a bottle of water as it was not included in our room category we booked. We were down graded from our upgrade because of the broken air conditioner.

The staff was very friendly the bed was clean, the water was very hot
Room was clean, the breakfast was okay. But being upgraded to be down graded was disappointing, and also twice the fire alarm went off in the middle of the night waking us up out of a busy tiring day, once agin not the staffs fault. They were very helpful.

The hotel in located on a very quite street, within walking distance of the river, the Statue of Liberty, the small one, and wonderful views of the Eiffel Tower.

title: Communication
text:
Overall the hotel room was very small.  The upper shower head looked  corroded.   One of the front counter Clerks didn’t understand English that we could see.  He gave my husband the wrong information about the massage package.   I have to admit that the manager corrected the front counters mistake and didn’t charge us almost $250.00.

Breakfast was okay too cold in the eating area which make the food get cold fast.

title: Parisan Hotel Stay- First in Paris!
text: Lovely boutique hotel! The staff was pleasant & helpful. The room accommodations were satisfactory. We request a certain type of room and granted the request- Sky room! Bed was super comfortable & shower was fab! Hot water available.

title: Troubled after being (sort of) fleeced
text:
I arrived, checked in at 8 pm. At check in it seemed quite clear that everything was fine. My file/paperwork was right there, found within under 20 seconds, for processing me into a room. Put things in room and went out to have dinner.

Three hours later I came back to be told of that my reservation had been for the previous night (turned out my wife accidently booked wrong night) and that I might (MIGHT!) be charged for the room again but that the person in the evening couldn't do anything about it and seemed totally unsure about it, and that as a courtesy to make his life easier he changed my room.
In the morning, not only was I charged full fare pricing-- but charged for that upgraded room that I had not asked for.  
The morning I was hit with a full rate bill -- including about Euro 60 (US$80) to pay for the upgraded room that I didn't request.
All I needed was 'a bed' for the night ... within blocks were suitable ones at less than half the price. If Felicein's staff had been upfront (at 8 pm)  that I didn't actually have a reservation (having been booked for the previous night) and  how heavily they would hit me financially, I would have made the effort to change hotels.
Yes, upfront, our error but Felicien took advantage of it to fleece me.

title: Couldn't ask for a better hotel
text:
Having had this hotel and trip to Paris as a wedding Anniversary surprise I was a little apprehensive during the flight, but as soon as we arrived at reception any reservations I had soon disappeared, the staff at the hotel were very welcoming, helpful and professional.
I'm gluten intolerant and my husband had no time beforehand to alert staff so  he had packed my own rolls, however the staff at reception offered to buy in anything I needed, but the breakfasts catered to everyone's needs as far as I was concerned so I didn't need anything.
We had a pearl room on the 5th floor and it was lovely.
Spacious wardrobe space  with a mini fridge and safe and the decor was very tasteful and calming.
Bed was comfortable too.

Shower was lovely and hot, room clean. 
We did have a problem with sink draining as there seemed to be a problem with the operating system 
but was not really a problem so  we didn't think to let reception know as everything else was so lovely.

The hotel was quite near to the seine river, was only about 20 min walk to Eiffel Tower which we found better as every trip we wanted to go on we wanted to start off with a walk after a lovely breakfast, 
My husband had thought of booking something in the heart of Paris but had done his research very well as the description of the hotel and decor was exactly as described,
Everything was pleasing to the eye, very modern and very well designed
so he was glad to have booked here.
 
Hotel was lovely and quiet, all staff were very helpful and friendly and a credit to the hotel.
The spa was fab, we only had to ask for robes and they were delivered up to the room along with flip flops, we were lucky to have it all to ourselves so we used the sauna steam room and jacuzzi pool, which after a very busy day sightseeing was a welcome bit of relaxation.
Very happy that during a trip to such a wonderful city staying at the Felicien was the icing on the cake.
Thanks to all the staff and would loved to have stayed longer than 3 nights.

title: Comfortable hotel
text: I spent two nights in this hotel during a business trip for an event in Roland Garros. The hotel is well located to visit the southwest parts of Paris. To visit other precincts, suburban train lines (RER C, 'Javel' stop) and tube lines (Mirabeau, line 10), which are close to the hotel, will enable you to reach the very centre of Paris. The staff at the reception turned out to be very friendly and helpful.

title: Great funky hotel... something different plus indoor swimming pool
text:
Booked this hotel as it was something different that the usual chain hotels.
each floor has its own theme and rooms are different.

we had recently married and they spread petals over the room, a bit cheesy but nice touch.
the hotel has wife which is a must now.

we didnt have the breakfast there as there are lots of cafes and markets nearby.
location is a bit out of town, but gives you a chance to explore paris and there are lots of shops, takeaways and restaurant a walk away.

staff really friendly and they also kept our luggage after checking out as our flight was later in the day.

There is also a spa and an indoor swimming pool which is a great bonus.  it has waterfall and jets etc very nice.
luckily for us when we went to use it there was noone else there as it is quite small and intimate.  But you can book it for private session for a feww.

title: Nice, clean, perfect hotel in very good location in Paris
text:
Excellent location, very close to Sena left bank, near to Boulogne -Auteuil, Rolland Garros, and Grennel, Tour Eiffel over the Sena.
Very clean, newly renovated and equipped, SPA and Gym.
Good Metro and bus connections on some 200-300 m.  
Good restaurants, grocery shops nearby.

title: Very very nice
text: Really nice hotel with excellent staff and would recommend anyone thinking about it to definitely come here. Also Paula was very helpful with her customer service. Pool was also very nice and the room we stayed was very clean.

title: Comfortable But Small Room; Not Particularly Convenient Location
text: The hotel is near Pont Mirabeau in the 16th arrondisement. It is outside of tourist zone: no major sights within walking distance. I was here for meetings at the OECD, and that was a 25-minute walk away. Each floor has a color theme, and I was on the Ruby floor, and had a very red room (which I find cheapish looking). The room was small, but the shower was a comfortable size. There are reading lights by the bed, and back lighting behind the bed and in the bathroom that served as nice night lights. My sink was not draining well, but as soon as I told the front desk, it was promptly fixed. There is a refrigerator in the room, and 2-3 supermarkets within 5-minute walk. If you bring back a bottle of wine from outside, the friendly bartender would happily open it for you. Not many good restaurants within easy walking distance though. The closest metro is about 10-minute walk away.

title: Friendly & Cosy
text: A hotel enjoyable to stay while in Paris. Pleasant stay, with friendly staff and a nice breakfast. Close to major landmarks and tourist spots to visit. A city worth visiting with great sceneries, landmarks, restaurants etc.

title: Brilliant
text: Me and my boyfriend recently stayed here for a romantic city break and I can't recommend this hotel enough. The decor and interior was beautiful- very modern and stylish. There was also a plunge pool/jacuzzi with a steam room and sauna (we were the only two people in there which was an added bonus). I had requested a room high up with a balcony and we were given just that. The room size was good for European standards and the hotel was small but cosy (I find most hotels in Paris are more "boutique" style hotels which adds to the chic-ness!). The area was also good- a few restaurants nearby and the Eiffel Tower was about a 25 minute walk which was a pleasant, scenic route along the river Seine. The staff were friendly, helpful and lovely. The temperature of the plunge pool/jacuzzi was a little bit on the cold side, would have been even better if it was slightly warmer, although again, this may not bother the majority of people, but from a personal point this was literally the only ever so slight complaint I had. Thank you for a fabulous stay. I would definitely recommend this hotel and return again.

title: Not perfect but still 5* at the price we paid
text:
The hotel has exceptionally friendly staff which are the reason I give it five stars despite not being perfect on other ways. I hope the staff are paid a little more to reflect this. They helped us by printing station names so we could try the metro and also did eventually sort better firmer cushions for us- so they did everything they possibly could.

We were warned that French staff in hotels and restaurants would be rude (we are English)but literally none were rude - far from it. 

As for people marking down for the location - wow, really? Did you book blind or not do your own research beforehand? That’s your issue and reflects your ignorance ... nothing else - trip advisor should remove those. 

The hotel has comfy compact rooms. A bath would be nice but we had an awesome big raindrop shower. Yes some water leaked but nothing a towel couldn’t handle. 

The hotel has a good feel, a nice layout and top quality furniture and fixings - yes they are starting to show their age and water marks etc in shower so it’s due an update but for our price perfectly acceptable and still clean.

One big negative is that the swimming pool is tiny making it very awkward if just one couple is in there. Also not obvious how to change there if you can? Very awkward using lifts in bathrobes but we did see some couples brave it... if you’re confident there’s a swimming pool but if you’re not then really it’s unusable. This was a reason we chose the hotel so it was very disappointing.

Also the spa seemed to be closed a lot and on Saturday they’d obviously rented out the small bar/ lounge area to an event - so we couldn’t use it. It was really heaving with a fashion event? I suggest the hotel compares that income with the negative impact on the hotel customers.

The location: you get what you pay for- it’s quiet. Perfect for us because we don’t need lots of local bars cafes etc.  We also feel like we found more authentic restaurants full of locals due to this - tripadvisor still brings up plenty of walkable options. But for a livelier romantic get away going to bars every evening we recommend you look to another region of Paris - lots of guides online. Do not mark the hotel down because you’re too ignorant to research this yourself!

title: Nice but not 4 star
text:
Hotel was nice but not for 4 stars 
They have issues with de design or with the furniture because it was looking old and used .
The Hotel has a good position for city centrum  .  For 2 night was good tks

title: Not a good value for money
text: Holidays, the wifi in the hotel is very slow, they do not change the towels, this is a motel not a hotel, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, this is literally apartments converted to a hotel👎🏽

title: Decent rooms, friendly staff, lovely whirlpool
text:
Convenient to shopping and sightseeing. The room was a decent size by Parisian standards, but the sheets were dirty. 

Breakfast was a step up from other four-star properties. There was a wide selection, including fresh fruit.

There is a fantastic whirlpool and hammam in the basement. Unfortunately, these were often occupied by couples, so it was easy to feel that you one was intruding.

The staff were all cheerful.

I wouldn’t hesitate to go back, but competition is fierce in Paris. There are a lot of good choices. Although competitive, I’m not sure that the Félicien has the best value for money.

title: Good but be better
text:
Stayed in the hotel in early December 

If you like walking it's a great location - 5 minutes from the rive seine - on a map look for the statue de la liberte - from where you can get s boat down the river - we walked to all the main tourist points from the hotel and returned very tired - the hotel is set in a mainly residential area so at night there is only a couple of bars and restaurants - we were the only tourists which was evidenced by the waiters asking where we were from etc - but that made it special - it felt abroad ! And with the added benefit of drinks half price of the more tourist areas - I can't really comment on price as you need to keep it in perspective - we had a room, a sitting area and hot tub with access to the spa - I imagine 15 minutes closer to the centre this would be out of our price range

We didn't order breakfast which was a good result as was a lovely bakery on the corner where a coffee and croissant was €3 - great result 

Staff were lovely and their English was very good and far better than my French 

Bath robes were also great 

Negatives for me

The shower ! I'd read other reports about the room flooding as the shower is broken and won't stay in place - yep we also soaked everything 

The main one was I ordered flowers for my arrival for my wife - I was charged €60 for about 15 roses that were just left on the bed - looking very much like supermarket flowers - even had to put them in the glass from the room as no other way to put them in water - irony is there is a beautiful florist about 50m from the hotel and great bouquets for €20 

So yes a god hotel in a residential area but I wouldn't pay for flowers or breakfast

title: Very poor not worth price at all
text: Very poor hotel not with the price staff rude useless! Spa crap dirty rooms dirty! Noisy! Things to do nothing round there breakfast 18pound per person nothing there cleaning of room they obviously do t know how to use a hover! As I went out and something on he floor that I knew was there was still there after cleaning was meant to of been carried out hotel small bar dirty would not recommend this hotel at all to anybody would rather stayed in caravan.

title: Very disappointed
text:
I was very disappointed by this hotel at all levels: staff, service and cleanliness (the toilet hadn't been properly cleaned!). Neither the hammam nor the sauna were working. I told reception that the stay was terrible value for money upon checkout and was offered an hour of privatisation of the spa. I told them I wasn't interested in this as I wasn't planning on coming back and they didn't offer anything else.

I honestly would not recommend this hotel and will not go back. There are much better places to stay in Paris for that price.

title: Almost 5*'s
text:
Stayed at Hotel Felicien for a weekend work trip to Paris and brought my partner along with me. I thought this hotel would be perfect as it looked very different and quirky.

The location wasn't bad, luckily we like to walk and explore but there wasn't many restaurants in the area which is something us foodies struggled with. 

RESTAURANT RECOMMENDATION- L'Ogre - 5 minute walk from the hotel - steak restaurant and A LOT of wine choices. Friendly staff. Local restaurant. Book in advance they managed to squeeze us in on a Saturday night because we were so lost for food!

Breakfast at hotel - not much choice but still very good... fruit, yoghurts, meats, cheeses, pancakes, egg, bacon, baguette, pastries, cereals.

Rooms - try and request anything but the pearl room. Its very out dated...we asked to change and got moved to the Ruby floor which is LOVELY! Cute balcony which was nice, bathroom is elegant along with the room. Shower did leak but no problem that a towel can't sort out... Beds comfy so much space, can't really fault.

Spa was out of service so we had access to the Jacuzzi which was so relaxing at night after a long day of 25,000 steps around the city! 

Staff - I think this was the part that made this hotel stay PERFECT! The 2 reception staff we met (Lady from Romania and young Gentleman) - So friendly and helpful, gave recommendations, allowed longer stay in Jacuzzi, overall perfect... and they deserve a pay rise ;)

I would like to try and stay more in the centre of paris if I come again but this hotel was perfect for what we needed for a weekend stay!

title: Great Hotel!
text:
The Hotel is quite small and cosy, also has a SPA that was closed due to
maintenance, but it did not matter for us since we got access to the outdoor jacuzzi on the top floor.

The staff working is truely 5 star, they were always kind and helped out with every request with a smile. 

Our room on the fifth floor had a really nice bed, a small balcony and a Nice bathroom.

We will for sure stay here again when visiting Paris.

title: Fab Beds!!
text:
We have just stayed at the Hotel Felicien.
The hotel is tucked away off the Main Street but trust me this is a super benefit very quiet at night.

The room was smaller than we like however perfectly suitable for a short trip. ( We just slept and showered in it) The hotel is modern in style and has everything you need including a must for most travellers these days WiFi!
The location is fab, just a short walk to the main attractions and a pretty good shopping centre, and Javel station.
Have to point out the beds, they were just fantastic slept well in the comfy beds with crisp white bed linen changed everyday!!!
Would defo stay here again if we are doing Paris again!!!!

title: Disappointing
text: Would not recommend this hotel at all. Rated 4-star more like a 2 star. Too far away from main attractions. Not many nice restaurants and cafes in the area. Shower curtain which was mouldy and stank the entire bathroom out. Water from the shower leaked all over the bathroom floor.

title: Great hotel in a great area
text:
It’s been amazing. The staff is great. Clean an great Parisian atmosphere. 
The facility is new. Great restaurants in the area. Everything feels local and homey.
It’s not close to main attractions but it’s the exactly the point.

title: Second Stay and over the moon again!
text: This was our second stay at the hotel in as many years and we were completely over the moon with it. I contacted the hotel prior to arriving to see if they would be able to provide a surprise romantic gesture as I proposed to my better half that morning. They were quick to reply and filled the room with rose petals. They offered to have a bottle of champagne on ice in the room and even went out to look for a specific champagne at my request. The girls on reception were always helpful! The room was a good size and the hotel in a great location for walking to the Eiffel Tower! We tried to spa late at night and were upset we hadn’t tried it last time! A small pool, sauna and steam room! A truly welcome break after the days walking! We will be returning to Paris in the future and this is the only hotel we will ever stay at! Thanks again!!

title: False 4 star
text: The decoration, done by the son of the designer Ted Lapidus, is very attractive. However the standard functionalities of the hotel (bathroom too small, bad isolation of the shower, bad expresso at the breakfast) are mediocre. They do not justify a price of 240€ / night !!!

title: Amazing stay at the Felicien Hotel ❤️
text: Beautiful fresh and modern decoration by a french designer with various ambiances.The staff is smiley and knows really well the city. When arriving we had flowers on the bed 💕 We had breakfast in the room with good coffee and fresh juices ! good quality good price. Lovely hotel we recommand !

title: Great helpful staff
text: We had reservations for 5 days. My husband had a medical issue and we arrived in Paris a day later. Although we purchased a non refundable ticket, they refunded our night (we presented medical documentation) and although we arrived about an hour after breakfast the staff brought my husband a tray full of cheese, cold cuts and breads with a bottle of water free of charge. The staff was very helpful and showed genuine concern for my husband's health. The hotel is totally rennovated, very modern and designed by Lapidus, a French designer. It is located 15 minutes from the bateaux bus which function as a hop on hop off boat along the seine. A bit far from the center. A great find.

title: Hidden extras
text:
Hotel was nice and modern. Felt like we were a local because we weren't near the tourist hotels. We stayed on the black floor which was nice, rooms average, with lovely matresses, brilliant night sleep. 
Wellness centre was lovely, plunge pool nice when not busy, sauna/stream room would fit 3/4 people. 
Receptionist spoke goof english was helpful. Metro 5/10 walk. 

Had to put down a €50 deposit for the mini bar if we used it and breakfast was something ridicious like €20 pp. I think they charged us over €200 for 6 mornings. The breakfast was typical continental breakfast, was nice but way way over priced. Also there is a tourist tax of like €2/4 a day. 

Would I return? Possibly not no

title: Very good service and very friendly Employees
text:
It was wonderful. It is one of the design hotels I would like to recommend at any time.
The staff were friendly. The staff in general was very attentive.
The location was great. In 2-5 minutes to the RER or Metro. Great restaurants nearby.

Thanks for the nice time.

title: Unreasonable price & closed spa.
text:
We went to spend our honeymoon in Paris and stayed in this hotel noting that it is our honeymoon but they didn't care (unlike the hotel we stayed next gave us champagne). The room was painted black and very dark. The terrace chairs had no waterproof covers so were soaked through from rain on the first night making the terrace un-useable. Multiple times bath robes and towels were not provided and had to ring front desk several times to get some delivered (after an hour!). No sitting area and table so restricted to bed area. Spa facilities were closed which was the main reason for booking this particular hotel. No bath tub in the bathroom. Price was very expensive for what you get. 
On the positive note, the swimming pool is warm although it's small, good shower experiences and the cleanliness of the room is excellent.

title: Couples weekend away
text:
After proposing to my partner (with her thankfully saying yes) we flew to Paris. Having a not so great reputation with hotel bookings, I don't think she was holding out much hope.
The hotel was incredible. It was quirky and comfortable with the staff willing to bend over backwards to help. The room did not have a bath plug and they offer free breakfast for two for the inconvenience or a change of room. My partner was happy to escape the intensity of the RED room and our bags were moved. We would have been happy for a bath plug!
On check out day they provide a changing space if you want to change before your flight.
Staff could not have been more helpful.

title: Terrible service
text: This hotel is horrible. The receptionist did not speak English... What is not acceptable in a 4 star hotel in paris. After She was trying to explain that I needed to do a pre authorization of 100€ in case that i use the minibar. I was not expecting that because they don't say that when I book the room. After some minutes I was able to understand what she was saying and I paid. At 4pm she gave me the room and when I went there,  the toilet lid was broken. I called the receptionist and she change me the room but in that room was missing some items on the mini bar and towels, so I called again the receptionist saying that was missing some items on the mini bar and towels and the receptionist said it was okay because they didn't check the minibar before. In second day I went to the hotel at night and the housekeeping only put one bath towel and it was 2 people in the room. When I did check out I said again to receptionist (this time a different one) that was missing some items on the minibar and she said it was okay because she know it before because I call when I arrive. Now after 3 days they were supposed to give me back the money when I realised that they charged 12€ from my account when I didn't use nothing from the minibar. This hotel is so disorganised and the costumer service is terrible.

title: Average
text: I visit this place not long ago happy for me just for one night. I stay in many 4* and 5* hotel but this is for sure non of them  i just give this place 3* only for location and no more , for me it is just 3* hotel . When I arrive at 12 non to Hotel after long trip I find out check in is at 4 pm.... after wait for my room i find out in my bathroom wet bath rob with no even strap which was disgusting! New one have also no strap and look very old.. I chose this hotel mainly for rooftop pool. Later i find out that Pool on roof top is only for suit apartment not for everyone what I find out asking in reception, don't see any information before to inform about that , it was huge disappointing. Pool in "spa" was available for rest guest , without towels and bath sleepers . I get information check in pool is open till late evening , but later on i see information in the lift that pool is close for privet event.  In very morning next day wake me up some contraction work room next to my, nobody inform me about possible noise that early in the morning. For sure i will not stay there again.

title: Third time here but standards are slipping
text:
My son and I enjoy this hotel and have been here three times. It isn't the cheapest hotel and so the standards of what they provide have to be high. 

The hotel has many good points - the beds are the most comfortable beds I've slept on, the rooms are very clean, the breakfast is brilliant and the staff are always friendly. 

However, sadly may of their standards are slipping. The spa wasn't working properly and there was no apology for this - it is a very small pool, which we enjoy, but when it's key feature doesn't work, that's a shame. I was also given a very dirty towel for my room, with little apology. And the honesty bar continues to charge €6 for a cup of tea and the wine and beer prices are eye watering - laughable when you have to make it yourself. 

Final point - they allow the spa to be bought for private use by hotel customers for €140 per hour, which means that all the other guests are not allowed to use it during that time. As a paying guest, I think this is a poor policy as they hour may be the only time we can use 

We'll be back I'm sure, but the management needs to raise its game again.

title: Trip to Paris
text:
The staff was friendly, and professional, providing with tourist attractions information, very good. 
The room was very nice, all facilities in good order and clean. 
Decoration of the room was chic, retro style, wich I like it. 
The location of the hotel was good, very easy to go around the main tourist attractions .

title: Disappointed
text: We travelled from Nottingham to stay in this particular hotel. On booking they said they have a spa with facilities to use in house. Now. When we got there our room was dark and small. The lighting was awful. We decided to go down to the spa to see what was available. When we go to the 'pool' area which was about the size of a kitchen sink, all I can describe is what looked like a swingers party. We made a swift exit!! We looked at the treatments available... £140 for a massage!!! We decided to head out for the night instead. The hotel is close to the Eiffel Tower so this wasn't too bad. The second night we was going to try the spa again but noticed it had been closed between 6pm- 10pm for a 'private session'. Need I say anymore.

title: Bag stolen
text:
We stayed at this hotel in June 2017 and an expensive mens bag was stolen from our room. We believe we know when and how it was stolen by a staff member, and we have contacted the hotel multiple times regarding this but they have refused to directly contact us back regarding this. Very poor response. 

If you do stay here do not leave any valuables in your room.

title: Great concept and location!
text: Wonderful neighborhood and really enjoyed the staff. The hotel itself was beautiful. The suite we had was amazing with great views! Highly reccomend. The food service was a bit pricey for the amount of food and slow. The bar was also odd. Didn't like that there was a self-service cocktail station. I expected to have a drink made for me especially if I was paying €13. I also would have liked the bartender to be able to make different cocktails.

title: Good design, poor functionality
text: Looks great, virtually nothing works as expected for a modern hotel.  Light over the sink was so dim that it was very difficult to shave or put on makeup.  No hooks to hang clothes, towels, etc.  Front desk staff were pretty much clueless.  Pool was not much bigger than a hot tub. Best feature was the location.

title: Nice Vibe
text:
This hotel has a nice atmosphere, decor is very sultry. 

Staff friendly and speak English well which is helpful.

Hotel is a little far out but you can walk to the Eiffel Tower in less than 30 minutes so not too bad.

title: Clean and quaint rooms
text: Rooms were very clean and staff were incredibly nice. Front desk went above and beyond by reserving a taxi for us so that we wouldn’t be late for our flight early the next morning. Although the room was a little tight, it’s pretty common. Bathroom looked recently updated.

title: Amazing hotel
text:
Very nice atmosphere in the whole hotel. Kind staff that helps you with everything and even take the time to make a joke :)
When we arrived way too early the room wasn't ready yet, but it was no problem to leave our luggage. The check-in was smooth. The room itself was brand new, very clean and had everything we needed.
Would definitely recommend!

title: Excellent hotel
text: We had a lovely 5 day stay. Hotel staff were friendly & helpful. Room was perfect for our family. Air conditioning was excellent given very hot weather. Buffet breakfast beautiful. This area is a perfect base for site seeing with the bus just outside the hotel & shops/restaurants in the local area.

title: Solid Tourist Hotel Nice Neighborhood
text:
Overall I had a good stay at the hotel. The room was nice and clean, comfortable bed and good bathroom. Workout facility did the job. Nice neighborhood with lots of restaurants of varying cuisine away from the hustle and bustle of downtown but still close enough to it.

Only complaints are you have to ask the front desk to adjust the temperature in your room. As a US based chain I was disappointed they don't have universal power outlets in the rooms.

title: Very good and staff very friendly
text: Staff was very polite and welcoming! i was very impressed by the quality of services provided by the staff and the 2 gentlemen working at the reception during my stay but a rooms are a bit overpriced. Hotel was clean and room were clean.

title: Lovely staff, great location, but small rooms
text: We travelled as a couple for a 2-night weekend away.  This hotel has a great location, lovely staff and nicely renovated hotel.  The room was very small though - I had expected this from reading previous reviews, so had booked a "superior double room with relaxation space" but cannot imagine where the relaxation space was meant to be - the desk (though this was snug against the bed once sitting)? or the balcony (though not relaxing with the street noise and weather and nowhere to sit)?  I even wondered if we were in a classic suite (queried with front desk, nope).  4 stars are credit to the staff and the amazing location with lots of lovely restaurants, cafes, markets, metro and bus stations.  Hotel has great sauna and gym, we didnt try the breakfast (lots of boulangeries nearby) but it looked good.  We would stay again, but would have to be prepared to book a suite

title: three nights in Paris
text: Our "classic room" on the 6th floor was spacious & lovely--except we had no hot water in the tub/shower and the bed needs a new mattress. A/C worked fine, even with the heat wave. Breakfast was more than adequate, with excellent coffee.

title: Best Western Plus La Demeure
text: Hotel is nice and clean. Good breakfast. Hotel is located in quite area, close to metro station. Many bistros and shops around. Hotel room for family with 2 children could be a bit bigger for more comfort. I recommend this hotel.

title: A very nice hotel, a super friendly team
text:
I can only recommend this small but very friendly hotel.
The rooms are nice and very clean.  I enjoyed the continental breakfast very much.
Bars and restaurant, bus and metro station are in the neighborhood

title: Great hotel and amazing service
text: We stayed at this hotel for 6 nights, as a group of 4 in two seperate rooms. The staff did everything possible to accomodate all of our requests, called us taxi’s and gave helpful suggestions. Super friendly and couldn’t recommend staying here more.

title: Staff and location wonderful, rooms tiny
text: This is a very well located hotel, clean with attentive and polite staff. However, the rooms are too small. There was no cupboard, just a dusty curtain in front of a rail and almost no space to get around the bed (so not a space to relax in).

title: A comfortable stay in Paris!
text: The hotel is cozy, very clean, and has great amenities. The staff gives you a great customer service. Also, is located close to restaurants, coffee shops, etc. I loved staying there! I definitely recommend it!

title: Great Hotel with tremendous staff
text: My stay was short business trip but with many things I had to address. This was helped by the support I received from the tremendous Hotel staff, nothing was too much trouble. The Hotel itself is smart with a modern interior but still classy in its own right. I will stay here again if I return to Paris.

title: Good location
text: The hotel was conveniently located and the staff was very welcoming. Overall we had a great stay! The only point that could be improved was the room which temperature which was too warm. A/C could not switched on in May.

title: Great hotel in Paris
text: We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Service was great as was the room. Nice decor, good bed and nice view. Nice services like wellness and fitness available and well equipped. We will come back when we plan our next visit to Paris! Three nights was to short…

title: Quick Trip to Paris
text: Best Western did not disappoint us. We are BW members and we are happy to have chosen BW La Demeure for its excellent quality service and cleanliness.  Breakfast was great and the staff were superb from the front reception to the cleaners and the kitchen staff. Great job! Thank you for making our stay a memorable one!

title: Superb
text: Amazing staff. With some problems with our baggage at the airport we recieved a lot of help from the staff at the hotel. Desk agent Ismael mad a lot of phonecalls to help us to locate and to make sure that we would get our baggage back. The service was really suberb.

title: Welcoming, relaxing and friendly hotel
text: We (2 adults and 2 young children) stayed in a junior suite for two nights following a busy Disneyland holiday. Our suite was spacious with a large comfortable bed and generous pull out sofa. The rooms were spotless and very calming. Lots of lighting options, large soft towels, good coffee machine and complementary teddies for the children all lent to a great stay. The breakfast was excellent and the staff we met were all very friendly. The location of the hotel was perfect for us as we explored the Jardin des plantes and the latin quarter on foot, and the Eiffel tower was an easy metro journey away. We will not hesitate to book again. Thank you again for a wonderful stay.

title: Fantastic!
text: The hotel has a great location, ideal to reach several tourist places directly by walk and plenty of places to lunch or dinner; it's very well connected with public transport lines. Personnel is amazing and always willing to help. The room, despite a bit small, is always very clean and comfortable

title: Great hotel, great people
text: From communication before arrival to check out: this hotel offers charming, welcoming venue where quality is outstanding. Decorative and comfortable & cosy rooms. Professional fitness, sauna and in everything else going the extra mile to make guests feel at home.

title: Wonderful hotel!
text: I really enjoyed staying here. Friendly, helpful staff. Very clean and comfortable room. Internet had a super strong signal. It’s a little outside of the touristy areas, but just a couple blocks from Metro or still within walking distance to sites such as Notre Dame & Maubert market.

title: Pleasant and comfortable stay
text: We stayed at the hotel for a week. Excellent and friendly service at the front desk, all very helpful in providing directions and advice on where we could do our covid tests. The room was comfortable and clean, a little small but still OK size by Parisian standards. Bathroom is a little tight but shower and hot water worked really well which was very important for me.  Overall an very enjoyable stay.

title: some complaints, that rule out our return to this hotel
text:
When I was just arrived, I was obliged to leave a caution of 50 €, for "any service you can get and not pay". I was really offended by this request, and it is the first time I hear of this. It seems to me offensive for any customer of high -level hotels, especially in a room with no fridge!
Moreover, the role of the concierge seems to be unuseful, if he doesn't know  that the lift is not working and he doesn't advice customers living at the second floor

title: Best and most friendly hotel in Paris
text: Its my first time in Paris and I stayed at Best Western Plus La Demeure and staying at this hotel helped me enjoyed my stay in Paris even more. The hotel receptionist (specifically Leo) is very friendly and accommodating, making sure that have everything I need and that I feel really welcome. He is very hospitable and speaks english really well. The rooms are really clean and the design gives you a Parisian vibes. I got even surprise that you can book the sauna privately for yourself and have a good massage. I will definitely recommend staying at this place. The price is also reasonable and pretty cheap for the quality you can get. Thumbs up!

title: Great
text: We stayed for one night. It was very close to the metro, only a 6 minute walk. The staff was friendly and the room was great and specious with a lovely view. We will definitely come back here when in Paris

title: Average
text: Staff very helpful and room was clean with a comfy bed, but very small. The bathroom only had space to stand in one spot on the floor, very difficult to easily shower/dress. We didn't have breakfast but it looked good.

title: Nice hotel
text: We stayed in Junior Suite and no complaints. The room is clean and good enough for 4 people to stay. Staff are friendly . The hotel is centrally located and walking distance to the metro station . There are nearby good restaurants to dine . Will definitely use this hotel upon my return.

title: Average
text: Average hotel in Paris. The hotel is a renovated apartment building with tight halls. The junior suite did not have a fridge. Overall clean room. Location was good, calm area. A bit over priced compared to the standard. The parking was around 800m away.

title: Lose the piano!!!!
text:
Rooms were tiny. but that's probably to be expected in a city hotel at this price level.

What drove me NUTS though was the piano in the little lounge adjacent to reception.  Twice when I wanted to sit in the reception area - work and talk to friends/colleagues, someone was having fun with the piano.

In both instances, someone was practicing - both piano and singing and THEY were having a fabulous time.  That's fine - but I had no option but to listen to loud (and not very good) singing and playing - nowhere else to go - and again, it was LOUD!

I'm not sure that the balance of one or two people having fun while everyone else just has to listen is right and think they should put the piano somewhere more isolated, get rid of it - or have one with headphones so others can live/drink in peace.

title: Friendly staff, lovely hotel
text:
My daughter and I stayed in this lovely hotel and it was everything I’d hoped for. I was prepared for the room to be small, and it was, it being Paris, but it was thoughtfully designed and beautifully decorated, so that it wasn’t an inconvenience. 

The bed and pillows were so comfortable, I wished I could take them home with me, and the shower luxurious even while small. 

The staff was so friendly and helpful, particularly one young man, my favorite concierge, who’s name I wish I’d thought to get. He helped us find Covid tests at the last second when I was in a panic, asked how we’d faired when we returned, and wished us a safe trip. I arranged a taxi to the airport ahead of time for early morning and it arrived without a hitch. We also booked a tour through their website which was wonderful. 

The hotel is quiet and in a beautiful neighborhood within easy walking distance to public transportation, restaurants, and shops. 

We highly recommend this fine hotel.

title: Delightful breakfast, and a view of the Eiffel Tower in the distance from my room!
text: I particularly liked the push-button rain shower, which worked perfectly every  time.  The breakfast was always perfect.  I needed a bigger desk for work, and the staff were helpful in bringing a second table.  From this larger desk I had a long view of the Eiffel Tower!  (I was on the sixth floor - not every room would have that view, but I certainly enjoyed it.)

title: Great hotel
text:
Great hotel, staff is friendly and helpful. Nice location, close to several metro stations, lots of restaurants in the area. 
We wanted a room on a higher floor then the one provided. Sophie was amazing accommodating our request, and we ended up getting a room with a nice view.

title: Excellent. Friendly Service, kind atmosphere
text:
Frendly Service, Special thanks to Le Specjał thanks to Leo. Tasty breakfast. Kind atmosphere. Comfortable beed, nice design. Recently renovated.
No sink in the toalet, and cold Scrambled eggs on breakfast, that was the only inconvenience.

title: Amazing hotel
text: One of the best hotels me and my boyfriend have been to. Super clean and modern rooms for a great price. The staff at the front desk were all so nice!! Would definitely go here again next time we go to Paris :)

title: Hotel is Ok
text:
Very nice days in this Hotel. Short distances to the  Metro (3-4 min.) and Bus Station( near the Hotel). We prefered  to walk in Paris so we reached the seigtseinngs in aprox. 45 -55 min.
The room is clean. The beed is comfortable. The staff at the reception was always very helpfull and profesional. 
  Good locations to eat and drink something in the neighberhood.

title: Best Western La Demeure
text: Excellent restful stay after a long flight from the US.  The staff is courteous and welcoming, the breakfast is scrumptious, the room is very clean and comfortable.  I will definitely make it my Paris stay when I come back.

title: Lovely stay, friendly staff
text: We had a wonderful stay. We stayed one night. The kids in the room next to ours and friends of ours across the hall. Nice that we were placed next to each other. I told the lady at the front desk that it was my wife’s birthday and when we later arrived in our room there was a little bottle of champagne waiting for us with a card from the staff. Really nice. The hotel is perfectly situated. Clean room nicely decorated and wonderful bed.

title: Nothing to add
text:
Good location, near the Austerlitz station, and plenty of small restaurants.
Friendly staff, both at reception and breakfast. Quiet room, even on the first floor, boulevard side. Dog friendly. Value for money.

title: Amazing service, great location, and beautiful rooms and view
text: We had an amazing stay at Best Western Plus La Demeure. When we arrived we first got a room with at the third floor with a view to the garden. However when we asked the staff if it was possible to switch rooms, they were so nice and switched us immediatly to a room with city view on the fifth floor! Overall we had a very pleasent stay and the staff helped us with every little thing. Would definitly recommend and looking forward to get back as soon as possible!

title: Cosy
text: Nice, cosy, well situated. We booked two rooms for a family of four (two adults + 2 children), but the allotted rooms were in two different floors. The lift was out of order. The rooms were nice and clean but  really small, without wardrobes. The bath was also nice but small.

title: A good accommodation but the failure of lift ...
text: The superior twin room was a good accommodation per us and the people professional. But the last day there was a trouble with the lift. So we went up and down on the stairs even with the baggages. The room was located at the fourth and we are not young people ...

title: Lovely hotel in a quite district of Paris
text: Had a wonderful couple of days here. very peaceful and pleasant part of town and not too far from the center. The hotel staff are most helpful and courteous. The room was a little on the small side but not too small.

title: Excellent stay!
text: We really enjoyed our stay in your hotel. Your front desk service was very nice and good, the room was - although maybe somewhat small - excellent in cleanliness, finish, and facilities, and the location is conveniently close to metro stations. We would definitely come back to this place!

title: Excellent stay
text: I went on vacation with my boy-friend, the hotel is amazing and the staff is really lovely, definetely we’ll come back, I advise it to everybody, the rooms are comfortable and with a wonderful view of Paris

title: Visiting Paris
text:
A 2 day trip to Paris for me & my daughter so it was very important to have a good hotel in a nice location, close to the Metro and plenty of restaurants nearby!! What an amazing hotel - from a super friendly receptionist who stored our bags as room was not ready (we arrived in the morning!!) and also booked our batobus (water taxi) tickets online (cheaper than at the kiosk) to a fabulous room with amazing views of the Eiffel Tower and a gorgeous little balcony with lights on - so pretty!! The room was lovely, bed was so comfortable and the shower amazing!!! The towels were super thick and even slippers were provided - essential for relaxing in after walking round Paris all day!!! We didn’t use the Spa as we were too tired but the staff were so attentive in letting us know it was available should we wish to use it!! The breakfast was lovely - gorgeous pancakes, mini pastries, fresh fruit, good coffee and juices! Cooked breakfast looked nice too and the waitress was really nice too!!

To sum it up - lovely hotel with very friendly and helpful staff and a great breakfast - 100% recommend and we will definitely return!!! Thank you for a great overnight stay!!!

title: Amazing hotel!
text: Stayed here for Valentine's day all the facilities were lush I highly recommend this hotel if you are looking to completely relax. the Hotel staff were very welcoming anything we needed we were catered too. I was very lucky to have the top floor view and could see the Eiffel tower light show at night which was a bonus this was my first trip to Paris I would highly recommend! Thank you for our stay Le Demeure.

title: Excellent
text: Staff were very friendly and accommodating. Always asked how we were and were there 24/7 if we needed anything. Hotel itself had everything we needed and good location for cafes, restaurants and local shops. Very close to metro and easy to get around. Room itself was quiet small but I noticed alot of hotels in Paris were like that. Very modern and room cleaned everyday. Could not fault.

title: So cute and such nice staff
text: The hotel was so nice, the staff was so helpful and the shower was amazing! I went by car and used it a lot, the area was super nice for this as well. The staff was so easygoing, and didn't act difficult or rude when I wanted a late check out. Definitely going to stay here more often when I go to paris. Very pleasantly left to go back home

title: Convenient
text: This is a convenient and clean hotel, which was close to the venue of our meeting. The room was clean and and had all requirements. The room was a bit small though. Many restaurants nearby and a nice breakfast buffet.

title: A perfect stay!
text: I had just one night at the Best Western Plus La Demeure and everything was perfect! My room was very spacious and the breakfast very fresh and delicious with lots of options. It was my second time there and certainly not the last!

title: Excellent hotel
text:
My stay at Best Western Plus La Demeure has been amazing and super comfortable. The hotel has everything you need to feel at home (great gym, big rooms, comfy bathroom, etc...) 

I will definitely come back sooner than later.

title: Small but Cozy rooms in a great location
text: I had the pleasure of staying here for 2 nights, and I must say this went very well. The room I stayed in was very small, however did the trick. Sticking to that theme, the bathroom is also quite small, but still adequate. What really pushed it over the line was the shower, which was very nice especially considering I’m quite tall.

title: Cute hotel
text:
The staff is very nice but not accommodating. Rooms were cozy and clean at check in. My room had a great view of the city.
Housekeeping did not change my linens and my stay was 6 nights.
The elevator was out of service a few hours after I checked in and was not repaired until it was time for me to check out. My room was on the 6th floor and they did not offer to move me to a lower floor. 
Some of the people staying there left because they simply could not climb the stairs multiple times a day. I would’ve left also if I would’ve received a full refund.

title: Beautiful hotel room and lovely staff
text: Wonderful stay on nye. Great views. Lovely staff and very helpful. Clean room and lovely shower. Would be good if breakfast was included but great location and lots to do. Very close to the Louvre which is one quick bus ride away

title: Great hotel!
text: Location of the hotel is excellent, very close to all the main sites.  Good places to eat nearby. The neighborhood was safe to walk late at night. The staff was amazing all along and was very attentive.  Great rooms and views from the hotel to the Eiffel Tower.  Would definitely recommend to stay here and would also stay here again!

title: Very nice hotel and not far from Notre Dame
text: The hotel is on the edge of the Latin Quarter and within walking distance to Notre Dame. The junior suite worked well for 2 couples and was both roomy and nicely appointed. The reception room and sitting rooms in the lobby were very nice, too. We did the full breakfast which was so convenient. Loved everything about this place!

title: Beautiful hotel with very helpful staff
text:
This was our final hotel for our 3 week trip to Europe. We had a junior for the 4 of us and it was very spacious and comfortable. Front desk staff extremely helpful - got us a car for return trip to airport and made sure that all was confirmed.  Paris is a very large city and this location is close to Notre Dame, but not to any other sites. You can walk to the Dame and catch a hop on hop off for touring. Lots of subways - but there was a strike while we were there so not sure if they would have helped. 

Breakfast was plentiful and delicious. Would recommend this hotel.

title: Very good experience
text: We had a very pleasant stay at La Demeure. Refurbished and clean room, very friendly staff and large double bed. Our room was even upgraded to a superior one. Totally worth its price, can just recommend.

title: Excellent location
text: Excellent hotel: very clean, very well managed. Rooms are small but very comfortable. The breakfast in 2 forms covering the whole morning is an excellent idea! The location is central, with many restaurants, shops attractions within 15 mins walk. There are also larger rooms also appropriate for a small meeting work. The management is very friendly and helpful.

title: Wonderful first stop
text: We stayed here on our first few nights in Paris and found it a great location with super friendly staff and ultra comfy beds. From here we walked most days to a number of great spots in Paris and enjoyed the local food the quarter had to offer.

title: Nice place
text: Nice place and nice staff. Clean and well located. The room was really cute and the bathroom too. I would only change the fact that the gel they give has to be used as champoo too. Even this, I think is perfect.

title: two nights in Paris in November
text: Hotel is ideally located. You can go to Sorbonne university or Notre Dame etc. by foot. Breakfast is good, though it might be a little expensive (16€). The rooms are quite small but very tidy and clean. When you are tall, the bed length might be a challenge. You have to sleep diagonally.

title: A really good choice !
text: We really loved our staying in La Demeure hotel ! The location is very good, the metro station is close and there are a lot of shops around the hotel as well. There is also a Carrefour market and a Boulangerie a few steps away which is important if you don’t want to pay extra for the hotel breakfast and a lot of restaurants and brasseries if you want to stay close by -the Korean restaurant right next to the hotel was AMAZING-. The room was very clean and though it is a standard small Parisian space, everything is very well thought out so you will not feel limited at all. The stuff was very friendly and ready to help and even gave us a complimentary bottle of champagne for my husband’s birthday! I only wish there was a small fridge in our room but it was not that important. I would    stay again at this hotel and would also suggest it to anyone visiting Paris !

title: Great Paris Visit
text: This hotel is a wee bit expensive but was absolutely worth it. Terrific rooms - Ideally positioned and the service was second to none. Great sleep and fantastic breakfast. The journey to & from Paris attractions was very easy via the Metro stations nearby.

title: Great view from 5th floor rooms
text: The view from the 5th-floor rooms is fantastic. We have stayed in 504 and 505 previously and both can see the Eiffel Tower across the rooftops which is nice. Some rooms are very small, so if staying in a 'Classic' room then don't take too much with you! Lovely little breakfast room as well, with loads of restaurant choices all within a few minutes walk. You can also walk to Gare Austerlitz and the Natural History Museum and Gardens from here also.

title: attractive hotel, small and cosy.
text:
The rooms are very complete. Unfortunately our room was very small, but everything you need is there. Location is okay. the possibility for parking is a big advantage.
Price and quality are in balance.

title: Very Nice Stay!
text: We had a very nice stay at La Demeure. The two of us spent 7 nights at the hotel. I loved the decor of the room, it had everything we needed including a safe and a little desk with a mirror which we used as a vanity to get ready. Situated in a quiet part of town, but under 5 a minute walk to many train lines which made it easy to explore all parts of the city.

title: When in Paris .......
text:
For my family from the Philippines, it was a very nice stay at your Hotel. Especially Sophie and Cora they were very efficient and accommodating. They made our stay very special. The Hotel has it all. Thank you of course as well to all the other team members. 

We for sure will come back and we will tell our friends to visit you. 

🍀👍

title: Decent place, great professional staff
text:
The hotel is clean, beds are comfortable, staff is attentive, polite, professional and willing to help at all times. They also have a mini gym with very little equipment but enough to do some exercise. Next to it is a sauna that nobody uses.
The hotel is old so you can hear people going up and down the stairs so try to get a room on the top floor. Don't expect views though as there are none.

The breakfast is actually great, nice variety of hot and cold food. Fruit, yogurt, coffee and teas are available. 

Good little gem!

title: Bed bugs
text: We stayed for 2 nights. When we woke up we had lots of insect bites across our body. Nice hotel apart from that. Still waiting for complaint response after several weeks of submission. Not a great experience

title: Top location - hotel
text: The hotel was very standard in services. Sauna, rain shower and gym is a plus, but these facilities were small. The room was good, enough space for overnight. Service was very friendly. The location is excellent, a small 10-minute walk to different metro stations.

title: Excellent
text: We liked everything in this hotel. The room was very comfortable. We were surprised that we could even see the Eiffel Tower out of our window! The breakfast room seemed not very big, but we had everything we wanted and we needed for breakfast - it was very good! The sauna was working all day, which also impressed us very much. The staff was very polite, friendly and helpful. Also the lounge of the hotel was very beautiful and comfortable. We saw absolutely no disadvantages during our stay!

title: excellent hotel with comfy beds and nice personnel
text: Everything was excellent, especially our family room and so comfy beds. Breakfasts were very delicious too, not soooo big selection, but the very high quality and taste. We can only recommend this hotel :).

title: The most beautiful hotel
text:
I travelled with my teenage daughter and stayed for 4 nights in La Demeure. The hotel might just be the prettiest and most beautifully decorated we’ve ever been to! The hotel staff was very friendly, everything was clean and perfect. Two metro stops very near by just a few minutes from the hotel. 
Hoping to return one day to this lovely hotel!

title: Chicago Baby Takes on Paris
text: Our visit to Paris was very nice!  We took the Euro Star From London as we visited Family first before visiting Paris.  The Hotel, tiny when compared to American hotels, but very nice.  Coffee was great!

title: Perfect stay at the Plus La Demeure hotel
text: I visited Paris together with my daughter and had booked in another hotel for 3 nights. After 2 days with a very poor experience in the other hotel, we looked at options nearby and found this charming hotel just a 10 minutes walk from the other one. Paula in the reception was very helpful and gave us excellent service! We were upgraded to a very nice room, we felt really good taken care of and we are happy to recommend the hotel/room/breakfast/service to anyone. Thank you for a really nice stay.

title: Honeymoon stay
text:
We had two nights at the La Demeure at the end of our honeymoon, and it couldn't have been better. A wonderful hotel with great staff and clean, comfortable rooms (like most Paris hotels, they're not huge so we took the slightly larger option - turned out to be ideal). We were lucky to get a top floor room with a fine view of the Paris skyline. The breakfast buffet was extensive and high quality.

A good positioning in Paris with easy access to two Metro lines - we never had to make more than one change of line while moving all over Paris. 

Highly recommended!

title: Great
text:
Nice place , location is ok , quiet , closest metro is 600 meters, so not very close 
Basic rooms are very small but the beds comfortable beds superior room is very nice 
Good breakfast 
Great view 
But expensive

title: Jan
text: Very pleasant hotel (clean and quiet), friendly staff, rooms renewed recently, Eiffel tower in direct view from room window (5th floor), very good breakfast, metro stations of 2 metro lines going to the center of Paris within walking distance of approx. 5 minutes, travel time of metro train to Louver museum approx.15 minutes

title: Parking issues
text: We were not told that there was going to be a parking fee. Upon check in the Host welcomes us with a spot in the hotels parking area. Which was thought to be complementary.... surprise! It wasn’t! $$$$

title: A little heaven on earth
text:
I can’t stop thinking about my experience at this hotel, I’ve travelled a lot and this is by far my favourite experience. I can’t wait to return I just might turn this into a yearly tradition.

The restaurant has the most amazing food and presentation.

title: Perfect Boutique Hotel
text:
We stayed for 4 nights at this wonderful gem of a hotel. With only 28 rooms the hotel is intimate and the service is perfect - not too in your face but friendly and attentitive. We asked a lot of questions on places to visit, restaurants etc and they were quick to provide written recommendations and advice.  They even managed to book us at table at Restaurant de La Paix when we were told it was full! we had a basic room which was perfect, although a little small. When we return (which we will) we look forward to trying some of the other styles of room. 

Breakfast wasn't included in the room rate but this suited us as we wanted to explore Parisian cafes and patisseries. 

On our last day we visited the hotel spa for massages before our flight - one of the best massages we have had! the spa is small but has all you need and like the hotel, it's all brand new. 

Would definitely recommend this hotel and will be back! 

Thank you all for looking after us. 

Daniel and Dean

title: As if Paris were not enough…
text: We spent our one year anniversary in Paris. It would have been enough for a romantic experience, but we were so lucky to find this luxury boutique hotel in the heart of the beautiful 17th arrondissement. The 5 stars hotel is brand new and decorated with a lot of taste. It’s luxurious with a romantic feel without falling into the cliché. Our room was very creative, with a swing (what an experience!), together with much technology and comfort. We tried the Spa with a big pool, as well as the restaurant with modern French cuisine. The quality was really in line with the rest of the experience. This was a really good start for our second year together. We really want to thank the staffs for their friendliness and help to make our stay in Paris unique.

title: A fantastic experience at the Paris j'Adore Hotel & Spa
text:
I spent one night at the hotel with my wife for our anniversary. We were choosing carefully the hotel based on the pictures we saw online.
We arrived at the hotel and we had the most joyful time we could expect. 
The rooms are beautiful and very unique designed. The rooms are smart and everything could be greatly managed through the ipad located at the room.
The rooms are very clean. The hotel team were wonderful and helpful. 
The spa is beautiful, clean, well designed and comfortable. 
We will definitely return to this hotel. It is highly recommended.

title: Romantic Staycation
text: We live in Paris and were looking for just 1 evening away, without the kids...an evening for us. This hotel was perfect! And all the reviews I read before booking were outstanding so it was an easy choice. The hotel was easy to get to, well priced, and did not disappoint.

title: Simply FANTASTIC
text:
here are no words to describe this hotel.
The rooms are simply unique!
The staff are very professional, helpful and polite.
unfortunately we were only a few days but we will definitely be back!
Thanks thanks thanks !
Soon :)

title: Paris in October
text: Beautiful room, friendly/courteous staff, and a clean spa that made our trip to Paris a great one! Highly recommend to USA travelers who are looking for a centrally located hotel to see the sights throughout the city.

title: Perfect for a romantic trip to Paris!
text:
At the moment of writing this Tripadvisor has top notes for this hotel from everyone. And they are absolutely correct! If we could we would have given it even more. Are you coming to for a romantic trip to Paris with you significant other, this is the hotel for you! It’s romantic, it’s elegant. We were welcomed in such a polite and nice manner. They offered us their sitronade which was Devine! They even escorted us to the room to explain how it worked. I’ve never experienced that in any hotels before. Even other 5 stars’. 
We deposed our luggage and jackets before check in time and found it hanged up in the closet when checking in. 

The rooms are clean, like the photos ans smart controlled. We had a jacuzzi in our room and we could fill it with the perfect temperature from the bed! The curtains and lights are  controlled in the same manner. And the toilet is Japanese!!! I love that! Even the mirror had an area resistant to steam. It’s all in the little details! 

We had a duo massage during our stay and we were soft like a silken tofu afterwards. So relaxing! 

The only thing I missed during the stay was hair conditioner for the hair. Which is really just a small detail that didn’t bothered me since I had one with me. It’s really the only downside I could find! 

If you are wondering if the stay is worth the price: it is! Wish we could have stayed longer. But next time we will.

title: Best romantic hotel i Paris
text: WONDERFULL hotel stay. Very friendly staff. We had a  private dinner on the balcony. Michelin level food, very kind waitor. We got our breakfast at the balcony as well , with a glass of champagne. Everything is new. Spa and wonderfull rooms with jacuzzi.

title: Pleasant stay
text: This newly opened hotel is fantastic. During check-in we were told that we got an upgrade. We were welcomed with a drink on the house. The staff was very friendly. The room was clean and we enjoyed all the automations that’s controlled by an iPad. Overall a very pleasant experience. Love to come back!

title: Crazyness
text:
Generouse room, 2 jacuzzis, great minibar and a massiv soundsystem. State of the art room woth ipad remote control. Wonderfull quarter and friendly staff. 
The brekfast was fresh and healthY. And evErything was new. Cum again soon babe. XXX

title: Fantastic Paris gateway in 5 star boutique hotel/spa
text: A gem of a boutique hotel in Paris, perfect for a romantic getaway / spa away from the kids.  Everything is done with taste. Fantastic spa amenities. Obviously super clean and terrific staff as expected for a hotel of this category. This is a brand new hotel. Wish we could have stayed a few more days.

title: Brilliant hotel in the heart of Paris
text:
Wow…..amazing from start to finish! 

Easy, quick, friendly check in.  Room was immaculate with an amazing view of the city! Staff were tremendous throughout our stay.  Room cleaned daily. Central location with everything that you could possibly need. Quiet, safe and secure location.  Great wifi. 

Would highly recommend and will definitely be returning on our next visit to Paris!

title: Nice clean hotel with super friendly staff
text:
I’m giving this hotel 5 stars mostly because they have wonderful customer service (such a friendly and helpful staff) and the rooms are nice, clean and value for money.
I took a single room and it was big enough for one person. It was very clean, and since it was on the 7th floor it was also very quiet. It had a great air conditioning which one can control by themselves, and that was great for the hot summer days.
It didn’t have a fridge but I didn’t need one. And the hair dryer was barely producing air, but this seems to be common to many hotels in Paris. If you need a good hair dryer bring one from home.
