title: Perfect stay
text: Great location, a few minutes walk from the nearest Metro station and Montparnasse railway station. I stayed three nights here, it was perfect for a short break in Paris. The room was comfortable, clean and surprisingly quiet. As a solo female traveller, I had no concerns about safety. Would definitely recommend a stay at Hotel Mistral.

title: Clean and comfortable
text: The hotel is well located, the rooms comfortable and clean, and the staff were prompt and helpful. Breakfast was good with a nice selection of fruits, pastries, and the usual things. Some street noise but no more than to be expected.

title: Four nights in August at the Hotel Mistral
text: We planned to stay here in 2020 but COVID put and end to that so we rebooked in 2022.  The hotel is very clean, freshly decorated and comfortable.  Paris was very hot during our stay but our room was a quiet and cool sanctuary after a busy day.  IT is very well located close to Gaite Metro and Montparnasse Railway station.  Breakfast was good value and plentiful and the staff were helpful and friendly.  Our room was refreshed every day and clean and tidy.  All in all very good value for money and a great place to stay as a family.

title: Week in Paris
text: Every staff member we met was extremely helpful and polite at every opportunity - special thanks to Julie the receptionist and Mirella the cook. Room was clean with comfy beds and location had good transport links. Keep up the good work!

title: Very nice and convenient hotel in Paris
text: We stayed for 3 nights as a family with two teenagers, in two separate rooms. While the rooms are small, they are adequate and clean and the beds are comfortable. The staff is friendly and were accommodating when we wanted to change a double into a twin room.

title: Excellent hotel
text: The hotel is very well located in a quiet environment in Paris 14th, close to a Metro station. It is comfortable, children friendly, has an excellent breakfast and very professional staff giving in addition smart advices regarding touristic info (but not only). No negative point: only positive feelings. This is the perfect hotel!

title: Good hotel
text: The hotel is in a good location, clean and the staff is very friendly. Everything fine except for the door of the toilet. If you want to use it during the night you can not switch on the light without waking up your couple.

title: beware: no air conditioning
text:
I booked this place because it was advertised as having air conditioned rooms. However, the AC was non-functional in our room, and the staff told us that there was nothing they could do, as the hotel was fully booked.

Good customer service would have the hotel notify guests of such problems in advance and offer them a full refund. I wouldn't stay here again, and I wouldn't  recommend it to anyone else.

title: Hidden secret
text:
Amazing hotel in a great location with lovely rooms staff and best ever breakfast
I will definitely return and tell my friends about this great hotel. Amazing history also and great to have the paper in the morning

title: Artsy boutique hotel with great staff
text: Mistral is a cozy little and a very friendly boutique hotel with a great access to the metro lines. It's a small walk to Montparnasse Tower and some other attractions as well as lots of restaurants. The entire staff at the hotel is simply outstanding! Our stay all the way from check in till check out was fabulous. It's a bit pricey, but surely a great experience to stay here.

title: Family from London
text: Very good quiet hotel with friendly and helpful staff. Plenty of restaurants around to choose from. Good for couples, a little bit tricky if you have children as rooms are actually all doubles. Close to or have good transport connection to all places of interest

title: A Montparnasse Gem
text: A friend recommended Mistral. We are forever grateful. A perfect place to learn one of Paris's neighborhoods, convenient to train and Metro stops, and near countless cafes. Discovering Rue Daguerre and experiencing local places made it perfect.

title: Awesome service, good hotel and great location!
text:
Great hotel, was very good location and easy to find. Very close to Gare de Montparnasse, you can walk for 10 mins. 
The staff was very very good, very kind and we were welcomed very well. The breakfast was good too and the service was amazing. Good and clean rooms with good housekeeping. 
Just the curtains may not be enough to block the sun light early in the morning if you are someone like me who likes to sleep in darkness/less light.

title: Wonderful
text: Really enjoyed hotel . Friendly staff, very clean, quiet. Did not eat buffet but looked good. Close to everything by train. Plenty of restaurants, near historical cemetary, near Luxembourg gardens . Will stay again when we return. Great outdoor market nearby on other side of cemetary on saturdays and wednesdays.

title: Week end with Family
text: The stay in the hotel was very good, especially for kindness and availability of personnel . The hotel is situated in a very nice area where you can find a lot of services (Metro,Resturants,Markets). I think will come back again !

title: A great find in a good location.
text: Required a hotel near Gare de Montparnasse, this was a wonderful find and for those into literary trivial, Simone de Beauvoir and Jean Paul Sartre stayed there, coincidentally they are buried in the nearby cemetary..worth a walk over.

title: Convenient to Gare Montparnasse
text: Stayed here for a night before a departure from Gare Montparnasse. It’s very convenient— about a 7 minute walk. My room was clean but tiny— even by Paris standards. The bathroom was miniscule too. Charming decor with wallpapered hallways. On a very quiet side street. The walls were a bit thin, though, so heard a lot of muffled neighbor noise.

title: HEC Graduation Ceremony
text:
Visit to attend our son's graduation from the HEC MBA programme.
The Mistral Hotel is excellent both for service and in a very quiet location near to the Rue Daguerre market which is delightful. Also adjacent to the Rue Fermat which brings back fond memories for advanced mathematicians!

title: Happy Anniversary
text:
Spending our 38th anniversary in Paris.  SO glad we booked the Hotel Mistral. Warm reception, friendly staff, and a cozy and comfortable hotel.

The hotel is easily accessed from the CDG airport via RER B to Denfert Rochereau. It is a 10-15 min walk to the hotel. Walk up Rue Daguerre to get a feel for the neighborhood.

The metro system is accessed from the Gaite stop, appx. 2 blocks away.

Excellent location for transportation to anywhere. Excellent neighborhood for dining and markets.

title: Excellet weeklong stay
text: For Paris this is an inexpensive, congenial, clean, and very helpful hotel.  Rooms are small, as is typical in this type of hotel, but have needed amenities.  The hotel is a block's walk from a long restricted-traffic street of restaurants and food shops, and a five minutes walk from a Metro.  Called taxis arrive quickly, or they can be stopped nearby.  There is a full breakfast buffet that includes scrambled eggs made each morning, bacon, and sausages, fruit, cereals,  breads and pastries.  An excellent value for the money in Paris.  I will  again to stay at the Mistral when I, or my wife and I visit.

title: Very clean and great neighborhood
text:
The hotel was in a great neighborhood away from all the touristy places.  There were several very good places to eat nearby and a great grocery store.  

The breakfast had a good variety of foods for both kids and adults.  We loved the happy hour every night as well.  

The rooms were a bit small so you will have trouble fitting a large checked bag in the room.  However, the rooms were VERY clean.  The hotel itself was very clean.  I would highly recommend this hotel for families or anyone who wants to be away from the touristy areas.

title: Great hotel in Paris, Montparnasse
text: The front desk staff was very friendly, helpful and attentive to all our needs.  Rooms are European style (on the small side) but very clean and comfortable.  Set nicely in the Montparnasse area of the city, one block from the Gaite metro stop with easy access to every corner of Paris.  Breakfast is an extra charge but nicely done.

title: Excellent little gem
text: Small rooms but perfectly formed, very helpful staff, pretty courtyard, great bathrooms, clean with excellent beds and pillows and I am picky about cleanliness and beds! Overall a great stay. You need to be able to walk though as the nearest big station (Montparnasse) is about 15 mins away.

title: Very clean and charming hotel
text: A very charming hotel in a nice area around Montparnasse and Rue Daguerre. Very clean room and super friendly staff. No noise could be heard, sleeping was very nice. Bathroom was really big compared to similar hotels.

title: Excellent
text:
Very friendly staffs. 
Good location close to the metro Gaite and Montparnasse stations.
Although the room may not be spacious for two, it was enough to stay alone. 
Shower booth partition may need to be improved, because water easily overflows to the toilet floor during shower.

title: Cute hotel
text: Had a really good time, and the staff was super nice and helpful. Also allowed us to store our luggage.  The location was quite good, a bit of walking to metro stations but not too bad. Had a really nice welcoming to the place. Do wish the ground floor wasn't that next to the dining place as it can be a problem when you want to open the window

title: Best Value
text: Hotel Mistrals gets 5 stars for value, comfort, location and an outstanding staff.  On e person in our group had stayed there before and recommended it for our trip.  Price was reasonable enough to where I could have my own room and not share!

title: Slept well
text: after our airbnb trip was cancelled the day before we arrived, ik had to find something quickly to sleep in Paris. My priority was with parking the car and they had a own garage. Not verry large but the Volvo V50 could fit in. The Hotel is fine and the people are correct and welcoming. The windows of the room could be opened, something i appriciate. We slept well.

title: Tree days & a half in Paris
text: I found yhis hotel by chance, And I choose it again for my stay in Paris. Convinient for metro & bus stop very close; very big choise of restaurant brasseries bars cafes minimarkets around. I highly recommend it.

title: Excellent hotel
text: Really enjoyed, can recommend. Lovely location and friendly service, and easy walk into the center for the city, and many good restaurants close by. Also theaters, parks and museums. Would stay here again!

title: Helpful staff
text:
My sister, niece and I chose this hotel after seeing some bad reviews for our initial choice.  It is off the beaten path (in Montparnasse just a few blocks from the cimitiere) but if you're comfortable using the metro, then you'll enjoy a clean, comfortable hotel with helpful staff.
One of the biggest pluses was that one of the staff showed my niece an app for the metro that allowed us to 'Metro' to Hotel de Ville, to a Seine river cruise, to Musee l'Orangerie, the Arc de Triomphe and Tour Eiffel.
And their recommendation for a restaurant our last night was phenomenal.
The staff also let us use the small garden for an impromptu dinner one night and had a cab ready to take us to the train station fairly early on a Sunday morning.

title: Stay in Paris
text:
Perfect Location. Small but confortable room. Clean. 
I would kindly recommend this hotel to anyone that wants to have a nice stay in paris. very close to the train main long distance station
I will repeat

title: A charmant Hotel with very friendly staff
text: We meet us with family in the hotel and it was a very pleasant stay. A lot of good restaurant and bars are near the hotel and a metro station too. We were walking also to the Louvre and the Eifel Tower from the Hotel in about 40 Minutes.

title: Excellent stay in Paris
text: The hotel was very close to many metro and bus stations. Very clean rooms and the personnel was happy and eager to help. Definitely recommend it as it is close to all the famous landmarks of Paris and offers good value for money.

title: Excellent stay with friends
text: Very friendly and helpful staff, clean and cosy rooms, close to "Montparnasse Bienvenue" metro-station, quiet neighbourhood, close to beautiful cafés, great if you travel with friends and enjoy a good time in Paris.

title: Friendly small clean hotel with correct friendly personnel.
text: It is a friendly small hotel with correct friendly personnel, cleanliness is above the average French standards. Rooms are small, but then the price is for Paris also small. The Hotel is located is a very nie district, with lots of restaurants and nice small streets.

title: Excellent small hotel with warm welcome and lovely breakfast
text: We stayed two nights in this small hotel near Gare Montparnasse on a quiet side street.  Although we arrived at almost midnight we were greeted warmly and had a very comfortable stay in a lovely room on the fifth floor.  It was very clean and perfect for us, and I especially liked the generous breakfast in the lovely breakfast room that opened onto an interior garden.  We will certainly stay again, it is now a favorite!

title: Lovely small boutique hotel
text: Excellent quality/price ratio. Cute Hotel, newly redecorated, clean, friendly staff, quiet street yet close to lovely restaurants and 'Paris' we stayed two nights and chose the hotel because we planned to leave from gate Montparnasse, it is ideal for this. And I would recommend this hotel for all other reasons ;-)

title: wonderful stay
text:
this is a lovely boutique hotel.
Rooms was clean, nicely renovated and the air conditioning worked.
Staff was very nice and helpful. It's nice to be in Montparnasse and near the cemetery.
Good value. I recommend this hotel.

title: A gem
text: Great hotel with very helpful and friendly staff. Rooms are not large but very comfortable. Cute little garden off the eating area. Breakfast is good value. Close to Metro with good access to the city centre.

title: Great cost-benefit
text:
I stayed at Hotel Mistral with my family (2 young children, husband, parents and in-laws), we got 3 rooms, and they managed to put us all very close together, on the 3rd floor, which was great.
The rooms were small, but had enough space since we were out all day. The location was very good, with many restaurants and metro stations close by. There were also a few markets nearby, where we could buy fruit and other breakfast items.
When we arrived, there was a small plate with 4 delicious macarrons in each room, and a small complimentary bottle of water in the small fridge
At the lobby, there were always some very delicious complimentary croissants (best I've ever had), and the coffee machine was available 24/7, free of charge. I also found very convenient that they sold metro tickets at the front desk. And the women at the reception desk were very nice and helpful.
Overall, I would say the only negative point is the size of the rooms / bathrooms. But all the other postive points more than compensate that.

title: 2nd visit, great stay except for one little thing..
text:
I stayed in the hotel in 2011, before the renovations.  This time of course, it was much better especially the rooms. All the things that drew me back remain: a nice family-run atmosphere, friendly staff, great location and surroundings... and the price. 
I had booked 2 nights through the hotel at a decent rate for Paris.  When I inquired about staying on 3 more nights a couple of weeks later, I was told that there was, in fact, availability but the price  would rise 50%- which made it unaffordable for me.  When I asked management to get involved, the price to my chagrin, remained the same. 
So my advice to the hotel is.. if you want to make your guests feel happy and special, then keep the price the same.  Don’t offer it again at a higher rate, to the guest who just completed a stay and wants to return. This is not the stock market after all, where prices fluctuate all the time. 
Other than that, it was a perfect stay.

title: GOOD HOTEL IN MONTPARNASSE
text: Nice charming notel. Efficient and friendly staff willing to provide information about restaurants in the area or places to visit. The basic room is small but well equipped with a bright bathroom that includes a heated towel.

title: Home Away from Home
text:
The moment I walked in the lobby I knew this was a special place. Gwendolyn (thé desk clerk) was very friendly and welcoming. The courtyard was nice unfortunately I was unable to sit out there because the weather didn’t cooperate. I did frequently enjoy a cup of coffee in the breakfast/game room though. The room was perfect for our needs including a wonderful shower with heated towels. The room was large compared to previous rooms I’ve had in Paris. There was a safe and even a mini fridge. The bed was comfy and the room was quiet. 
There was an easy walk to the metro and I felt safe during all hours. It’s an easy commute to all the tourist spots on the metro. There were plenty of restaurants nearby and even a Starbucks a short walk away. 
I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Definitely a GREAT PLACE to stay
text: This place was awesome!  We just loved it.  It was a great location. The rooms were spacious and had a queen bed. The bathroom was a great size. The water pressure was great (I notice a lot of people put that in their responses). The breakfast was awesome and had many choices. Great location for restaurants. The bus and Metro is a block away. They sell metro tickets at the front desk. Everyone spoke English.  They also email you ahead of time and ask you a few questions. This is a MUST place to stay. Great price as well. The hotel is off a cute little alley.  We just loved it here and would definitely stay here again. This is a 5 star for us!!!

title: Very nice boutique hotel
text: The staff are very friendly and although the room was not huge it was bigger than I expected for Paris with a huge bed that was very comfortable.  Very quiet apart from people above us moving around all of the first night! Good selection of breakfast for €12 if you want it, the selection of bread was very nice. We also enjoyed a glass of wine in the evening in the little lounge. For what we paid we were very happy and easy to get around with Gaite Metro very close by, felt very safe walking back late at night

title: Perfect Hotel! ✨
text: Located just near Gare Montparnasse, the hotel is clean and provides you great hospitality. The staffs are super friendly, very helpful and make sure you have a great experience throughout your stay. They help me when I want to drop my bags before checkin and after checkout time. The breakfast is also great. I enjoy the fresh baked croissants. The hotel has a 24/7 coffee machine, which is super perfect. My overall experience was awesome. I recommend this hotel to everyone who wants to traveling in Paris. Would definitely stay here again in the future.

title: Small room, but otherwise nice
text: The room was very small.  It was hard to have any suitcases open (except on the bed) and still be able to move around the room.  Otherwise, the room was nice, and the bathroom was great.  The shower was very modern and actually had a door!  There was a nice lounge downstairs, but we never used it.  The only other issue was the shuttle to the airport.  After driving through Paris for about 20 minutes, we had to switch to a different shuttle, suitcases and all, right on the street.  It was inconvenient and uncomfortable.  I assume this was not normal practice.

title: My Paris Trip
text: It was my first time to stay at this hotel but my 100 times to visit France . Hotel is very good and more than I expected . Breakfast was good as well , location and staff are good and friendly and helpful

title: Nice hotel, good location
text:
Hotel staff is very nice and always ready to help. The hotel is close to the Montparnasse station and the bus stop for CDG airport.
Shower is good size and water pressure is great.
Most of all I loved hanging out on the courtyard and breakfast area with complementary great tea & coffee

title: Wonderful!
text: This is a cute hotel in an excellent location. Would absolutely recommend to anyone looking to stay in Montparnasse. Complete with complimentary croissants and a short distance away from some excellent crêperies, restaurants, and the train station, this is a great place to stay!

title: Great place
text: Great hospitality and customare care. Very good location with special mention for the vice director : i valued his high professionalism. Very very good breakfast. Room facilities very good and very clean

title: A cozy small scale hotel
text: A sympathetic staff makes you feel very welcome in this small scale hotel. A room with no nonsense decoration, but still with a nice atmosphere. Absolutely recommended for a short stay, also with children.

title: Lovely
text: Very enjoyable to be able to walk around the area to see sights and have good food nearby. The staff were super friendly and helpful. Hot drinks anytime was nice too. Remodeled in a very modern style very nice.

title: Incredible hotel
text: The staff could not have been more friendly or helpful. They really were lovely. The room was modern and spacious and so clean. We arrived early and were able to leave our bags before checking in. When we returned in the evening our bags had been taken up to our room and we were greeted by a plate of yummy macarons! The local area is lovely, authentic and tourist free (which was nice after a hectic day of sightseeing). We would go back in a heartbeat.

title: Nice room/friendly staff/great location
text: We stayed here for 4 nights on our first visit to Paris.  The staff was extremely helpful.  There were always croissants in the entry and happy hour in the evening.  The room was clean though small.  There wasn't a lot of room to open my suitcase.  They had adequate electrical outlets and mirrors near them.  Nice breakfast for 12 euros.  Location was just a few minutes walk to the metro and we actually walked from the Montparnasse train station when we arrived.

title: Cute and super friendly
text:
This hotel is in a great location if you want to explore Paris - we walked to all the major sites from here. It took 30 mins to an hour depending on where we wanted to go but we could have done it in 20 on the metro system if we had wanted.
The hotel itself is well designed and stylish. The rooms are small but perfectly formed and the showers are big with hot and fast water. There is a lovely courtyard tucked away to sit and relax between excursions!
The staff were so friendly and helpful we made time to stop and talk to them. They made great recommendations and took the time to check we had what we need and to make us feel at home.
Within 5 minutes walk of the hotel is Ru Daguerre which is a amazing street full of restaurants frequented by locals and around Edgar Quinet Metro Station which is awash with bars and cafes serving good food and with a great atmosphere.
We will be staying here again!

title: Smallish room but overall it was a good stay
text:
Good things.. Breakfast and location

Not so good.. Room was a bit small and was rather hot as air con was turned off in October

Hint.. On walking to the denfert station on the way to the RER train for the airport we cane across RUE DAGUERRE! wish we had realised this lovely street was just around the corner.  We would have visited a few times during our stay. Maybe the hotel could put a lost of local suggestions to visit in a book in the room.

title: Weekend in Paris
text: Hotel Mistral is pleasantly surprising. It is a boutique hotel with a pretty courtyard, which unfortunately we couldn't use due to the weather. All of the staff were friendly and polite. Breakfast was very tasty and a good range, we were compensated a free breakfast as a smoker set off the fire alarm during the night! Which I thought was very kind. The location is actually very good. It's a 10 minute walk to the RER B line, which links straight to Gare du Nord. It's also close to Gaite metro (4) Station which is convenient for getting into town. Really safe area with nice restaurants and close to the montrapasse tower - €20 for adults to enter. There is a farmers market on a Saturday near the hotel/tower - worth a visit!

title: Short stay in Paris theatre district
text: A nice hotel and friendly staff.  Like most European hotels, room on the small side but made up for it with good size, and comfortable, bed.  Nice modern room and bathroom.  It’s quite close to Gare Montparnasse train station (5-7 minutes by foot) which was a big plus

title: Good location
text:
Next to Gare Montparnasse, so you are very well located with trains and metro to basically anywhere. Walking distance from Les catacombes, Jardin du Luxembourg and St Sulpice church. Parallel to rue Cels, there´s a street called rue Daguerre with many restaurants, pubs, bakeries and mini-markets.
Clean, although very small room, good shower, amenities from Fragonard. Real hairdryer. There´s elevator in the building. Very friendly staff, they are awesome!

title: Fantastic hotel! Great staff and little extras
text:
Hotel was fantastic- Clean, staff was very knowledgeable and there were a lot of extra little things that made our stay fantastic... such as free coffee, filtered water and croissants 
Would definitely recommend to anyone

title: Home Away From Home
text: What a great hotel and at a terrific price for Paris!  Rooms are decent size, very clean, cheerful, and well appointed.  TV has CNN, BBC, and a few other channels for English speakers.  Breakfasts are very good using fresh foods from the market located two blocks away.  In the same area are a multitude of good restaurants. But best of all is the staff who are very professional and seek to help in any way possible.  And, you are very close to the Gaite Metro stop.

title: Lovely boutique hotel
text: My husband and I stayed here for five nights in September.  The hotel is historic and tastefully decorated.  Friendly, helpful staff.  Our room 304 overlooked the courtyard.  Breakfast was delicious, room was sparkling clean and the location is away from the crowds but only two blocks to the Gaite metro station.  Many delicious restaurants are within two miles or less (we walked and always felt safe). We will definitely stay here again.

title: Charming hotel near Montparnasse Station
text: Hotel Mistral is perfect for those using Montparnasse Station and it is also well served by several metro lines. We enjoyed our small but sparklingly clean and cosy room with its comfortable bed and excellent air conditioning system. Be sure to pay extra to have the breakfast included as it is well-stocked with good breads, cereals, fruit etc. You can even make your own boiled eggs! We also found the staff to be friendly and helpful.

title: Excellent choice near Gare Montparnasse
text:
Quiet rooms with trendy design in convenient location. Rooms and common spaces are immaculate.  Compact by U.S. standards but with all necessary amenities.
Excellent quality of breakfast for price and charming courtyard to enjoy it in.  Staff very helpful and friendly. What's not to like!

title: Lovely small hotel good location.
text:
We stayed during our anniversary. The staff left a lovely message and some macarons in the room, nice touch. Room was average size for Paris. Bed was comfortable, had a good nigt sleep. Bathroom was small and compact, but worked well. 
The staff are super friendly and helpful, I was really ill with flu and they would ask me each day how I was and offered to extend my check out.
Love the area, have not stayed in Montparnasse before so pleasantly surprised  by its many resturants, Saturday street market, easy access to shopping and relatively not to far to walk to St- Michel, can be done in under 20 to 25 minutes, transport  links are excellent the metro is a few minutes walk. The creperies live up to their name - best in all of Paris. 
Cemetry close by is worth a stroll, some famous residents!  Overall enjoyed this hotel and location.

Mark & Asta

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice hotel in fine area.  I would recommend it to others.  Not the biggest room, but fine and bathroom was well designed and big enough.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  Overall, a very good package.

title: Hidden Gem in Montparnasse
text: We stayed in Room 01 from Sept 6 to 12, 2019 . The room was just right for the three os. The beds were very comfortable and the bathroom was very c!ean. A word of caution though on the shower as you might flood the entire bathroom if you are not careful. Otherwise from start to finish we had a wonderful stay. Kudos to Rova, Carlos and Abdullah for their excellent service. Location was just ideal, too as it is just a short walk to the Metro Gaite station. We will definitely stay at Hotel Mistral again.

title: Our booking of 3 rooms from 6th to 8th Sept `19
text:
Excellent location and very helpful staff. 
The rooms (all doubles) and bathroom was much too small for two people, with minimum luggage.
We did not have the chargeable buffet breakfast.
The hotel arranged for an airport drop in a shared shuttle van.

title: Paris Hotel
text: Very good Hotel, close to Montparnasse Stn and Tower, Very helpful staff, the room we had was quite small (typical Paris), neat and clean. Easy walk to Boulevard du Montparnasse with all the excellent restaurants such as La Coupole. I would recommend this hotel for staying in this area of Paris

title: We recommand all to take a choice of staying at Hotel Mistral
text:
We really enjoyed staying at Hotel Mistral.  As all others already mentioned, the quality of break fast was just wonderful. The location is great. Hospitality provided by all staff was more than excellent. When we ask the reception for our Taxi arrangement, they were so responsible for it, even a few minutes before the arranged time, the responsible staff was making sure if the arranged taxi was coming to the right direction for sure. It was just amazing quality of hospitality at Internationally high level.  
Lovely garden and patio/terrace refreshed us for giving us relax moment at the final part of our journey. 
Such all experience surprised us this hotel having only 3 stars. From our perspective, it could be 4 stars, because it is so much better in comparing with other 3 stars hotels. We definitely recommend to all our friend, and for sure sometime in the future we ourselves will come back to the Hotel Mistral again.

title: Excellent
text:
Mr. Bompaix and staff were attentive ,kind and helpful
Delicious breakfast with quality products
Rooms quiet and very clean
Location excellent  near Montparnasse station .Will recommend to family and friends.

title: Great value for Paris
text:
Very good hotel. Nice, relatively quiet. Remember it's Paris, so their idea of a large room might still be your idea of tiny. Also, the walls are no match for loud noises. So loud people will trump the quietness every time. 
But this would be the nicest hotel experience i have had in Paris.  Very comfortable and quiet, relative to my above comments. The two desk staff guys were extremely welcoming, friendly and helpful. After contacting them ahead of time, my requested early check in was ready for me. Also, an early TGV meant I would miss their 7am breakfast. But when I went to leave before 6:30am, the breakfast buffet was all ready. Fantastic. 
Location: excellent for Montparnasse TGV and cafes/bars/restaurants. All 8-10min walk. Gaite metro stn 4 min walk. Edgar Quinet 8-10min walk.
Staff: excellent.
Room: clean, roomy and quiet (by Paris standards). Very comfortable bed. Great shower.
Elevator: yes, one small.
Highly recommend.

title: Great "boutique" hotel.  Excellent value.
text: My wife has stayed here several times.  First time for me.  Excellent, attentive without being intrusive, staff.  Very nice breakfast buffet.  Charming "old-school" hotel.  Location is great for easy access to Metro and major attractions without being at ground zero for all the craziness that can be Paris.  Would definitely stay again.

title: comfortable bed, good shower
text: the Hotel is clean, staff friendly, room modern and new but extremely small, difficult to move with two open suitcases, but the mattress and beddings are comfortable. We had to leave from Gare Montparnasse so the location was perfect for us.

title: Perfect home away from home in Paris
text: Loved my stay at this cute and comfortable hotel. Our room was perfect and clean, a great spot to call home while in Paris. Special thanks to Raphael, Remain, Marlene and Rova who made us feel welcome and made our stay exceptional. Highly recommended! Will definitely come back again.

title: Bright and Cozy
text: Perfect spot to rest your heads for a night or two.  Very bright rooms with all you need for a comfortable stay.  Our room faced the garden which provided lovely views and quiet evenings.  The staff were super helpful and extremely friendly.  Access to historic sites is great with quick access to the metro and Gare Montparnasse for exploring farther afield.  I would stay here again.

title: Paris City Break
text: I stayed here with my husband and daughter. Prior to my visit the hotel were able to answer questions and recommend parking nearby. The hotel is perfect for a short break, situation about 35 minute walk from Notre-Dame or a short walk to several metro stations. Staff were lovely and very helpful. The garden space is perfect to unwind after a day of sight seeing and the bar is well stocked.

title: Great choice
text: Absolutely great choice, very comfortable, near the metro, very nice staff, great beds and bathrooms, only point that could be improved is breakfast although it is good enough. Some real fresh fruit (mine was not fresh anymore) would be highly appreciated. But all in all a great stay.

title: Fantastic Staff
text: Our first stop in our 5-week vacation, a long day of travel, we were met by the wonderful staff at the hotel, they even sorted out our phone service. This was the type of service we experienced throughout two-day stay.

title: My right decision to choose Gustave hotel ! I love it
text: My first time in Paris and I choose beautiful hotel! Very good location, friendly and nice staff, clean rooms, safety and quiet area, tasty breakfast! Definitely come back and I will recommend this hotel to my family and friends. Thank you!

title: Amazing hotel, really friendly staff
text: This was for a family occasion. The staff were amazing, she was super helpful and any request was no trouble. The hotel is not far from the tower and right by the train station. Will 100% come back!!!!

title: Gustave hotel.
text: My experience was top 🔝 up, excellent. The staff was extremely friendly and kind, the room was beautiful and clean. I had the best experience. Close to everything I just walk everywhere. I love this place I can’t wait to come back to paris.

title: Family visit to Paris
text:
Stayed here as a family of 5 with adjoining rooms. The hotel is in a great location just about 15 minutes walk from the Eiffel Tower and 5 minutes from Dupliex metro which is around 30 minutes from Gare du Nord and the Eurostar. 
The hotel was clean and the staff incredibly attentive and friendly. Throughout all of our trips our youngest (6 years old) just kept asking “when are we going back to the hotel” because he loved it so much!
It felt like nothing was too much trouble, whether it was adding breakfast last minute for us or arranging taxi transfers to and from Disneyland for us, everything was organised with no fuss at all. 

We would definitely stay here again. It was just about perfect

title: A view of the Eiffel Tower
text:
I am very pleased with the Hotel Gustave. We had a gorgeous view of the Eiffel Tower from our rooms. The rooms were clean. The cleaning staff went above and beyond to keep the rooms sparkling. The staff was incredibly helpful, especially with helping my mom. They called the airport to help my mom get a wheelchair because we do not speak French. The staff spoke English and were able to communicate with Americans! I would definitely stay at the hotel again. It was worth every penny. 

The hotel is a 15 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. There isn't much surrounding the hotel but there is a train/subway a block away that makes commuting around Paris easy. The 6 train is 4 stops from the Arc de Triomphe and the shopping district. There are various train stations within walking distance that can take you to tourist spots (Pantheon is 11 stops away). Uber rides were between $8-$20 to tourist spots from the hotel. (Note: Uber was cheaper than taxis and the Uber drivers seemed to speak more English than the taxi drivers).

Definitely worth staying at the Hotel Gustave!

title: A short but sweet stay
text: We had a lovely stay at hotel Gustave, albeit short. The room was a really good size as was the bathroom, everything was clean and the location is nice and close to the Eiffel Tower and some nice cafes and restaurants. Most of all I was really impressed with the communication and service from the staff members particularly Alexis who I had the most contact with. Highly recommend this hotel if you are planning to visit Paris!

title: Great service!
text: Great service, very clean, lovely design - especially breakfast room.  Lovely comfortable stay in this hotel. Room was not the biggest for 3 people, but well appointed with large bathroom. Extremely friendly and helpful front desk at all times, especially Noa.

title: Great hotel ❤️
text:
The hotel is located very close to the tour.
Metro station is super close.
A lot of restaurants and bars around.
Breakfast was great!
Hotel is very clean and the hotel personnel is amazing. 
Way to go guys! It was a great experience staying in this hotel.

title: Wonderful hotel!
text: We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Gustave. The receptionist was very friendly and helpful - she helped with our luggage which we dropped off prior to check-in, gave us a great dinner recommendation, and arranged our taxi for us upon check-out. The room itself was great - nice modern design, very clean and had a view of the Eiffel Tower. Also we were so thankful the hotel had strong air conditioning as we stayed in August and it was extremely hot. Would definitely stay here again!

title: Hotel Gustave is a Wonderful Parisian Boutique Hotel!
text:
The room was very clean, neat and well appointed, nicely decorated, with windows that opened. We also had lovely little view of the Eiffel Tower.
The room had a steamer and a hair dryer which we didn't need to request.
The room was on the small side, but had enough amenities that made it very comfortable during our stay.
What really made the Gustave A+ were the hotel staff. They couldn't do enough for us to help improve the quality of our stay. Rachel & Noa and all of the front desk staff were our best friends and had all of the information we needed at their fingertips. Nothing was too much to ask of them. We would return to the Hotel Gustave the next time we come to Paris!

title: Best hotel experience for me in Paris so far!
text:
The team is super professional, helpful, and smiling… they are always available to provide the support needed. They would recommend restaurants, bars, things to do, etc… to any client that asks. 
They would even go the extra mile and look things up for them. 
The rooms are always very clean, and the staff that do the housekeeping are all extremely nice.

I was on medical leave and alone in Paris. I changed 3 hotels in less than a week before choosing to stay at Gustave for 1.5 months, although I could’ve stayed somewhere bigger.  Not for one second I would’ve thought of leaving this hotel if It wasn’t the end of my stay. 

Those amazing people became like a family to me and I will always choose to return to this hotel and tell all my friends and family to stay there too when in Paris.

title: Amazing experience!
text: We stayed in this hotel only for one night. But everything was amazing. Room is excellent and staffs are very friendly! If somebody does not decide a hotel in Paris, I will definitely recommend this hotel!

title: Beautiful Hotel
text: We stayed at Hotel Gustave during our time in Pais  and have to say the service was excellent. Any questions I had before the trip were answered quickly through email. The hotel is in a great location, close to the Eiffel Tower with many cafe bars close by. The rooms were lovely and as we were travelling with our 3 grand children we had adjoing rooms which was perfect.  Would highly recommend.

title: boutique hotel in Paris
text: The hotel is beautiful and the staff is outstanding. They are only service driven which is remarkable in itself. I had the opportunity to watch Rachel handle everything at once and it was done with such charm and efficiency I was truly astounded.  Near so much yet hidden away, Hotel Gustave is definitely a destination hotel in Paris.

title: Great boutique hotel and centrally located.
text:
This hotel is great overall. The room sizes are quite tight but surely manageable and think that you’re there just to sleep and shower because you spend all day walking around the beautiful city of Paris. It’s only a 2 minute walk to the Dupleix Metro station and a 10 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. It’s ideally and centrally located. The manager Alexis was great, attentive, very nice and personable. A new employee named Rachel welcomed my wife and I with a smile and she was very polite. The hotel is very clean and maintained well. It’s located on a quiet residential street and so you don’t hear any noise or traffic. My wife and I highly recommend this hotel to any prospective guest and visitor. You won’t be disappointed. 

Frank T. from Long Island, New York. Aug 2022.

title: Awesome hotel
text:
I booked with Hotel Gustave thru Expedia back in late 2019 for a March 2020 visit. Covid come along and everything shut down the week before our trip.  I had failed to click on the “refundable” rate option, yet Hotel Gustave granted me credit for as long as it took. With lots of fits and starts, we finally made it August 2022!  It was a great experience! My wife and I enjoy the “one of a kind” boutique hotels and we have stayed at many wonderful places but this was the best!  Everything was an absolute joy. 

LOCATION
Wonderful location on a quiet side street, within walking distance from the Eiffel Tower and with several very nice restaurants right by.  
ROOM
We were told our room had a view of a “sliver” of the Eiffel Tower.  Well, we saw the entire top ½!  It was a joy to see it all lit up each night!  The bathroom was nicely sized with instant hot water in the shower and sink!  The air conditioner worked great (and it was hot in Paris!). And as a person with back issues, the bed was excellent!  Firm and comfortable.  The room was clean and quiet.
STAFF
I cannot say enough about how incredible the staff was.  Each and every one of them. In particular I would like to mention Noa, Alexis, Rachel and Julien. As I mentioned above, this has been a long time in the works and I have had regular email communications for almost 2 years with them.  Incredible people.  Courteous, helpful, and patient.  We speak no French and they were awesome helping book tours, taxis and just talking to us each morning as we left and each evening as we returned.

title: Great hotel
text: A small hotel that is nicely decorated and clean.  It is within walking distance of the iconic Eiffel Tower.  It has a great deal of charm.  The staff was very friendly and helpful - they gave us ideas of places to go and ordered a taxi for us when needed.  Everyone spoke perfect English which was helpful for us monolingual Americans.  My room was upgraded for free to a larger one without even asking.

title: Visit to Paris - Eifeltower - Hotel Gustave
text:
Last week we went to Paris to see the Eifeltower and found a nice hotel nearby. The name is Hotel Gustave and we had a very nice stay there with our family (5) in one of the family rooms with 2 rooms , one frontdoor, simple but very effective for families. 
The hotel is nice and clean but what stands out is the extreme passion of the host to help you with whatever you want, ask it and they fix it , like call someone or advice a restaurant , help you park, OUTSTANDING!!
We love it and will for sure return next time we go to Paris again.

title: Nice Hotel near the Eiffel Tower
text: The amazing staff makes this nicely renovated hotel perfect. Located near the Eiffel Tower, restaurants in close proximity. We recommend this hotel. Rooms are clean and look and smell new.  Thank you Alexis, Rachael, Lara and the entire staff for a wonderful stay.

title: Our Paris trip.
text:
This hotel is amazing!   We’re a family of 4 so we got 2 connecting rooms.  

First, the service is great!  Everyone is so friendly and are willing to help you.  Noa, the hotel manager was great.  She helped  recommend places to eat and visit.  

The room itself was very comfortable.  Probably one of the best beds in the hotel.  Having 2 rooms also helped us have a little space as well.  

The location is perfect.  It’s down the street from tons of restaurants, laundry and the metro.  

I would highly recommend this hotel if you’re traveling with family.

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel walking distance from the Eiffel Tower
text: The exceptional concierge staff truly made our stay. Knowledgeable, courteous, and quick to respond. The hotel is walking distance to the metro which is easy to navigate. We had a wonderful time here and would highly recommend.

title: Amazing Location, comfort and staff
text: I stayed at the Hotel Gustave for 3 nights with my family, we were 5 (2 kids 3 adults). The rooms were very comfortable (to larger size for Paris Standard) and the staff was extremely accommodating and friendly. Helpful with the kids needs, they found and booked a transfer to Disneyland Paris on very short notice. Very good breakfast for a good price. Initially we did not include the breakfast to our booking but ended up having it 2 mornings of our 3 day stay. Highly recommend Hotel Gustave, super close to the Eiffel Tower, central to take a boat ride down the river and to walk (between 20 and 50 mins) to all main attractions and Museums.

title: Great Paris Hotel
text: The staff was very helpful and nice. For anything you needed, they were very attentive. The hotel was very clean and the A/C was VERY welcome this very hot summer. The location was decent: near the Metro and cafes. All in all, a great choice for a Paris stay.

title: A great stay
text:
Welcoming hotel with friendly staff. Convenient location and clean room. A great stay. 
Lovely shower and view of the Eiffel Tower from the bathroom window. Pretty courtyard with plenty of neighbouring bistros to chose from.

title: Summer 22
text: Excellent, helpful staff,  fantastic breakfast buffet. Nice clean room,  spacious shower and bathroom good air conditioning system which was important during the record hot summer.  Quiet neighborhood in walking distance to Champs de Mars, Eiffel Tower and Invalides.

title: Lifelong Dream fulfilled
text: A boutique hotel with everything you want. From the rooms to the staff, the breakfast & the location, everything was incredible. We booked the Gustave Room with views of the Eiffel Tower & couldn’t be happier. Please bear in mind, this is a boutique hotel so if you’re looking for a room that has 30sq m, then this is not for you. It is small & quaint & that’s what makes this place so special. Thank you Hasan, Noa, Charlotte, Lara & even Claudia who does the breakfast by herself. Can’t wait to see you guys again & we’ve already rebooked for next year.

title: Great place to stay.
text:
Hotel Gustave was a great place to stay for our family while visiting Paris. It was only a short walk to the Eiffel Tower and the metro. The rooms are the typical size for Paris; they were clean and had air conditioning which was great during this recent heat wave. They even squeezed in another bed so all 3 of us had a place to sleep. Breakfast was good; my teens liked it and we were able to fill up before we went to explore. 
I cannot say enough about the staff. They were Super friendly and all spoke English. They helped us navigate Paris and gave great advice on some sights I hadn’t thought of. They even suggested an app that made it easy to get around the city. Overall, great place to stay on our modest budget.

title: Wonderful well-organized small hotel with a very welcoming team
text: The hotel is really comfortable- it was our 4th small 4-star hotel in Paris in 6 weeks. We really liked the hotel because the feeling is relaxed but super professional, with a very kind and service-oriented team. They had noticed before we arrived that our two rooms were reserved for the same family and moved our rooms from two separate floors to allow us to be in two adjacent rooms, a very thoughtful extra touch. The space in the ground floor of the hotel is well-designed, with a lovely small patio, two little dining spaces and a lobby. All the areas are comfortable and you can work from them-they have USB and electrical outlets. The hotel offers cold lemon or Orange water and fresh melon or pastry in the lobby in the day. Their rooms are comfortable, the bath products are very nice, and they provide good quality thick cotton towels and bathrobes as well as  slippers. They also have really good showers, comfortable beds with 2 types of pillow for each person depending on preference. I also like that they have a steamer for each room - much more practical than an iron. The other hotels we stayed in were lovely but all would have felt a bit cramped staying 3 days and this one had lots of pleasant space on the ground floor to hang out. And again, the team was really friendly, professional and organized and they paid attention to details like the toiletries and bathrobes etc. The area is quiet and there are lots of little bakeries and restaurants nearby and you are near public transportation although we walked most places— it’s a nice walk on the Seine to Rodin Museum and Musee d’Orsay and you are next to the Eiffel Tower. For me, it was my favourite of the small hotels we stayed in, with more attention to detail and a lovely team at the reception. Thank you for making our stay in Paris so comfortable!

title: Great location and reception
text:
The location was a short walk from the Eiffle Tower and not packed with tourists, so double bonus. It helps if you want to occasionally uber as well. I noticed the tourist areas would take very long to get a car. 

The room was as advertised. It was clean with good service and a view of the tower as on their pictures. The bathroom and shower were great, too.

title: Great place to stay
text:
My wife and I spent some days in Paris as a vacation and we stayed at Hotel Gustave. Great room with the view of Eiffel Tower. The service from the hotel was excellent as they made us feel like at home. The room was extremely clean. I usually don’t write reviews but I was so impressed with the service that the least I can do is write a review. Location was perfect and safe.  Our last night in Paris before going back to the USA we were able to spent some time with Etienne and Lara and it was awesome. Beautiful people. Can’t wait to go back as it now we have friends when go back. 

Ed and Chany Almenara

title: Great Boutique hotel in Paris
text:
Excellent location, warm and friendly staff and lots to do around the hotel. 
Less than five minutes from the train station and 15 minutes to walk to Champs de Mars, the Seine river and Eiffel Tower
Good breakfast options and we had a nice stay in the 15th arrondissement.

title: Great Paris hotel!
text: Great hospitality throughout our stay. Always a welcome smile after a long day exploring all Paris has to offer. Rooms are well appointed and the beds were comfortable. Great breakfast buffet as well. We will visit again for sure next time in Paris.

title: Lovely hotel - great rooms for travelling with teenagers
text: Lovely hotel - the two rooms is perfect for travelling with teenagers and very nice breakfast option. Great recommendation for dinner at a local restaurant & nice easy walk to Eiffel Tower.  Nice staff and I would return again in the future..

title: Excellent boutique hotel
text: Hotel Gustave exceeded our expectations.  We were a group of 9 (5 adults & 4 children) and the hotel was able to accommodate all of us on one floor.  Proximity to the Eiffel Tower is a short walk 10-15, depending on pace.  The staff were overly helpful with booking (answering my many questions) and very welcoming upon our arrival.  The rooms were impeccably clean.  I would like to thank Hasan, Noa, Alexis and Lara for their hospitality.  Our entire group was VERY pleased with our stay and would return without hesitation.

title: Amazing trip
text: This place is special. Very close to Eiffel Tower Everyone and everything exceeded our expectations. Starting from booking till the breakfast the next day. Wish we could stay longer. Noa and Lara were always smiling and very helpful.

title: A very nice stay
text:
We stayed 5 days at Gustave Hotel - 3 couples and 3 kids. Everything went pretty well specially the very kind attention provided by the staff (Alexis, Lara and Noa). 

I highlight the cleaning, attention and the very well location of the hotel. An additional highlight for the breakfast that is affordable and despite it doesn’t have several options, it’s very well served and tasteful. 

We strong recommend and we will be back.

title: Paris visit
text:
I am super happy about the people over there
Their treatment was very comforting and very hospital.

I would like to thank Noa, Alexis and Charlett.

Noah’s receiving really made us feel comfortable.

-Alekya

title: Really nice!
text: Hotel feels cozy, clean and updated. Staff were way too nice and helpful. We enjoyed staying there. Close to attractions, restaurants, and station. Will definitely recommend and visit again. Couldn’t ask for more.

title: Stay at Hôtel Gustave
text: Our stay at Hôtel Gustave was fantastic.  We loved the charming hotel and wonderful staff.  They were extremely helpful and accommodating.  The hotel was conveniently located near the Eiffel Tower.  It was a great location.  We would happily stay there again!

title: Excellent service, comfortable but small rooms
text:
I stayed at Hotel Gustave for a total of 6 nights. The staff at the hotel were incredibly friendly and helpful. Even before the trip began, they were very communicative and provided recommendations on where I could eat before checking into the hotel. Both check in and check out were very pleasant. 

The room itself was very clean, and comfortable, however the hallways leading into the rooms were quite small, as was the restroom. I was traveling solo so it wasn’t a problem, but if I had another person in the room, I imagine things would have gotten tight.

title: BEST HOTEL IN PARIS!
text:
I booked this hotel for my 4th night in Paris and it was the best decision that I’d made on my Eurotrip. The staff, cleanliness, food, everything is just 10/10.
The Eiffel tower location & being budget-friendly is an add-on!
Would highly recommend this property to everyone who’s wishing to have a great time in Paris! 👍🏻

title: Amazing customer experience, friendly, clean and convenient
text:
I was a little hesitant when I booked as it looked like a small hotel and wasn’t sure what to expect. It was beyond amazing. The hotel is super clear, in a great location and the staff was extremely helpful, friendly and provide a great guest experience. We had to check out on the last day then went shopping, they were really kind to provide us with a room to shower after spending a day roaming around the city before we head to the airport.

I do highly recommend it and will stay again if I get the opportunity to stay in Paris again. 

Don’t think twice 

Thank you

title: Had a spectacular time!
text: The concierge staff is super kind and welcoming. They offer great tips for restaurants and always with a smile. Location is just 10m from eiffel tower and the rooms are absolutely adorable. Had a great stay, it'll probably be my go-to for future visits.

title: Alshammari
text:
We had a good stay with a family vibes  we felt home in the hotel it has a great location nearby Eiffel Tower , a small supermarket ,bakery and restaurants 
  Also very friendly staff they were helpful and very fast responding with any issue we required 
many thanks and 
regards from Kuwait ♥️

title: Wonderful stay at L'Hotel Gustave.
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at L'Hotel Gustave. Beautiful room, fantastic location (walking distance of the Eifel tower) and exceptionally friendly and helpful staff. Paris is amazing and this hotel is really special. Well worth a visit.

title: Excellent service
text:
3rd booking to hotel Gustave.
Reception is perfect, service at the top.
Rooms are comfortable. Bathrooms Italian shower.
We recommend this place, tower eiffel is very close.

Thanks for Gustave Hotel team. Special thank you to Alexis

Denis Le Havre France

title: Enjoyed my stay!
text: Nice hotel and quite larg rooms compared to most Paris hotels. Location is quite close (5-8min walk) to the Eiffel tower, but I would say the area was average. Do not get me wrong, not a bad neighborhood, just not the Paris city centre vibe. Enough restaurants, bars, bakkeries etc around. Clean hotel and rooms.  Rooms are quiet enough, no problem there. Staff? 10/10! Every member of the staff is friendly, helpfull and made me feel welcome. Whether asking for directions or a cold beer, they are happy to help. I had a large room and my last night I got an upgrade to a room with the best view. 👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽

title: the BEST personnel I've had in a hotel EVER
text: The hotel is absolutely lovely, nice rooms, great breakfast, rooms with a view, nice location... but I must highlight the attention we received. We arrived as a big group, which is normally not easy, and they made our stay smooth, helped with everything we needed, and always with a smile and good predisposition. All of them were so nice and generous, but especially Noa, who was always a great host and helped with every little problem or thing we needed during our whole stay. Definitely a MUST hotel in Paris!! I'll come back!!

title: Perfect solo trip
text: This hotel blew me out of the water. Alexis and staff… Above and beyond to make me feel welcome. I was a solo traveller and a bit nervous being in France however they were amazing with recommendations as well as taking my photo before leaving each day. I highly recommend this hotel! Rooms were well appointed. Comfy bed.

title: Excellent stay
text: I love everything of Hotel Gustave! The cleanness is at the top. The staff is super kind. The neighborhood is very convenient and safe. A lot of nice restaurants are nearby. Korean restaurants are surprisingly popular. The hotel is also close to metro 6, 8, 10.

title: Wonderful hotel
text: I had an excellent experience at Hotel Gustave. The staff were superb, and incredibly helpful. The room itself was great value, and the breakfast service was also worth purchasing - a great way to start each morning. Overall, I would strongly recommend Hotel Gustave.

title: !!!AMAZING!!!
text: Honestly, I can’t say enough about how much we LOVED our stay. The hotel was beautiful. Great location—about a 10 walk from the Eiffel Tower.  Amazing staff. They made us feel like family. Sooooo grateful to have found this treasure. If we ever make it to Paris again, we plan on staying here and will recommend it to everyone!!!!

title: Come here for the champions league final
text:
Me and a group of friends come here for the champions league final. Staff were all excellent and very welcoming. Especially noa who was also very helpful with where too go around the city.
Room was clean and nice, would definitely come back and visit in the future. Thank you for making our stay great 👍🏻

title: Trip for Champions League Final
text:
Thank you so much for helping make our weekend in Paris as enjoyable and seamless as it could be. Every hotel employee we interacted with—in particular Alexis, Etienne and Lara—was incredibly kind, gracious and eager to go above and beyond what we asked for. To note just a few examples, Lara efficiently arranged a mandatory covid test at a local pharmacy for our flight home, Alexis offered great sight-seeing recommendations for our first day and Etienne suggested a wonderful restaurant for our final night. We fully intend to stay at the Hotel Gustave the next time we’re in Paris. 

- Chris and Chris

title: Paul
text: Nice hotel in a great location. Hotel staff at reception were all extremely helpful and friendly and made the experience even better. Room was clean and nice. Comfy bed. I would recommend staying at this Hotel.

title: Book the hotel Gustav now! 10/10
text: We stayed here with our 7 year old son while visiting Paris for the Roland Garros Tennis tournament in May 2022. The location is excellent - in the dupleix area - and is within easy walking distance to some lovely bistros, bakeries and bars as well as the Eiffel Tour. Metro station (dupleix) and taxis easy to find too. Based on a quiet and pretty street, Rue Viala, the Gustav is a perfect choice for those wanting a little luxury paired with superb service from the staff who really couldn’t be more welcoming and can’t do enough to help. It’s a small cosy hotel as are the rooms on the small side but it makes up for that with the huge quality and all the extra touches they strive to make to ensure you feel relaxed and calm and well looked after. Breakfast has everything you need to start your Paris days well after a great nights sleep in the super comfy beds. Curtains block out loads of the light to aid a good nights sleep. Great shower pressure. Clean and fluffy towels. Everything very clean. Can’t think of anything I didn’t like really, 10/10 - would absolutely recommend and would definitely stay again.

title: Wonderful stay at Hotel GUSTAVE
text: Such a lovely special time in Paris staying at Hotel GUSTAVE.  Stylish interiors with wonderful friendly and helpful team who looked after us .. thank you Alex!  Nothing was too much trouble .. highly recommend this boutique hotel .. we walked everywhere in the spring and will surely return for more.

title: Very nice experience, from booking to check out
text:
The family and I are super happy after our visit to Paris.

The main purpose of the trip was to surprise our son on his 10-year birthday.

All the way from contacting the hotel prior to booking to check out was really a pleasure!
Super friendly and accommodating staff.

The location of the hotel are as you can imagine perfect with a short and pleasant  walking distance to the Eiffel tower, in a safe and nice neighborhood.

We will definitely choose this hotel on our next visit!

title: Fantastic location
text:
Nice hotel close to the Eiffel Tower.
The room was clean end full of accessories.
Delicious breakfast served in an environmentally friendly manne,  the courtesy of the staff was extraordinary.
I suggest this solution!!!

title: Fantastic view of the twinkling tower
text: Nice place to stay! Very helpful and pleasant staff. Loved the view of the Eiffel tower from the room!  We had to watch it twinkle at the top of the hour! Close to public transit and the Eiffel Tower..

title: Great customer service!
text: They were very accommodating from the first day! Took really good care of us. We had a toddler with us and they were very accommodating towards his needs as well. Staff was very friendly! Would definitely recommend your next stay there. ☺️☺️

title: Wonderful!
text: My husband and I really enjoyed our stay! The hotel staff were extremely hospitable and very helpful. The location was great too! Close to the Eiffel Tower of course but to numerous metro lines. The staff all spoke English which was also very helpful.

title: The Best Hotel in Paris
text:
We came to visit Paris for two days and the customer service experience we got from the hotel was exceptional.
Lara provided us everything we need till the date of our departure and make our stay very pleasant. 

If anyone is looking for a nice hotel around the city, Gustave hotel must be the first choice!

title: Best customer service!
text:
Since the moment we arrived we loved the decor and the attention of the staff. All of them were really nice and went beyond to make our stayed remarkable. The room with view to the Eiffel tower was amazing and also we stayed the first days in a classic room which was also really nice and spacious. They have great customer service, their location is so convenient to travel around the city. 
Would make Hotel Gustave my go to hotel when visiting the city.

title: Great hotel
text: This hotel was Clean, had a great view of the Eiffel Tower, and really nice and helpful hotel staff! I recommend staying here and it’s close to the Eiffel Tower, shops and restaurants. Also super close to public transit.

title: Beautiful hotel
text: We felt very well looked after for our whole stay.  The staff all spoke perfect English and were very helpful with recommendations.  The location is quiet and we felt very safe.  we could see the Eiffel Tower from our room.

title: Clean Hotel close to the Eiffel Tower with friendly personnel
text:
A very nice hotel with friendly and helpful personnel. 
The breakfast is great and the breakfast hours are long so that you have the possibility to sleep in. 
I Would recommend it to friends and family and might stay here again next time I’ll visit Paris.

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Hotel was beautiful and clean. It was in the perfect area. 10-15 minutes walking from the Eiffel Tower, 5 mins walking from a convenient subway station. Staff was very helpful and accommodating. The rooms are a little small but perfect for what we needed. Would 100% stay here again.

title: Cosy hotel near Eiffel tour
text: Clean. Cosy. Walking distance to metro and Eiffel Tower. Very friendly and helpful stuff. Would recommend and come back for sure. Room has everything what is needed, small iron, hair dryer, bathrobe, shampoos etc

title: Very nice place
text:
Very nice place to stay
Very helpful staff and the location was very central.
Sanitary room and the bed room were clean and in good condition.

We would definitely stay again next time we are again in Paris.

title: Amazing hotel!
text: Every staff that worked in this hotel was amazing. They made us feel welcome and well taken care of. Hotel location is great, Eiffel tower was min walk away and Metro is really close. Lots of cafes and restaurants around the area too. Just a great experience!

title: Fantastic stay
text: The hotel is very nice, well located and with super friendly stuff. Even before we arrived they helped us organizing everything. The rooms are nicely furnished and the badthroom was modern. We enjoyed our stay very much and can recommend the hotel!

title: Nice hotel
text:
Really close to Eiffel tower and near metro and cabs stations, clean room. I could see Eiffel tower from my room. The staff is really efficient and nice. Totally recommend.

Merci beaucoup pour votre accueil :)

Julien, Switzerland

title: Truly fabulous hotel
text: This lovely hotel has it all! It’s in a great location - so close to both the Eiffel Tower but also line 6 on the metro - but that is just the start. The staff are so warm, friendly, attentive without being intrusive and at the end of our stay they even gave our daughter a little gift to remember her stay in Paris by. A truly lovely gesture. Breakfast is fab - great choice, brilliant value and the breakfast room has the most fabulous decor (as does the rest of the hotel). Our bedroom was absolutely spotless and the shower was amazing. So often we’ve had hotel showers with very little power - not the case here! We absolutely loved staying at Hotel Gustave and will be highly recommending to anyone visiting Paris. Hope we can come back to visit again soon. Thank you so much for a fabulous stay.

title: We would definitely recommend
text:
Perfectly located walking distance to the Eifel Tower and 5 minutes away from the Metro. 
Excellent staff, they were very friendly and helpful. We got an upgrade to a room with a view ❤️ The room was absolutely clean and functional.

title: Perfect Place for a dream destination!
text: We couldn’t have asked for a better hotel. The location was perfect. Less than 5 minutes walk to multiple train stations and Less than 15 minutes walk to Eiffel Tower. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They gave us great advices from restaurants and places to visit, to cabs and shuttles to airport. The breakfast at the hotel is really delicious with a good variety and hotel’s coffee and tea is 10/10

title: Great hotel and personnel.
text: The cleaning should be controlled after done, forgotten details, for example the dirty coffee cups. Fill up water on coffee machine should be done, refills of coffee, etc… small rooms but comfortable and quite.

title: Great, great service
text: I had an amazing time in this hotel, the view is amazing, totallly clean and safe ; but the best part of everything is the team work the hotel have; they make you feel you are really at home. I totally recomended and share the pictures of my amazing time, thank you so much i will return soon 😃😃😃🙌🏻🙌🏻.

title: Terrific find!
text:
This is a gem of a hotel. Very quaint and
Parisian feeling. Close to the Eiffel, metro line
and the Seine. The staff was amazing- could not
have been more helpful and accommodating.
They offer a lovely breakfast at a good price.
The room was very comfortable and modern.
And as a bonus there is a fabulous bistro just
down the block- The Duplex- right across from
the metro so was the perfect late night stop
before going back to the hotel after a long day of
exploring. Highly recommend! We will be back.

title: Great location
text: This hotel is located on one of the most vivible areas of Paris, and their service was great, the room was charmingly decorated on a modern and simple way. It felt more like an apartment than a hotel.

title: Great place to stay
text: The Bel Ami is centrally located in the St Germain area.  We stayed in a one bedroom apartment room which was more than adequate.  The room has a living area with a kitchenette which is restocked daily.  There is plenty of space to relax after a day of exploring Paris.  The bedroom is separated from the living area and is very comfortable.  There is a good sized bathroom attached to the bedroom.  All of the concierge are extremely helpful and offer great suggestions for meals. The entire staff at the Bel Ami makes you feel comfortable and welcome.

title: Wonderful location
text:
Nice and clean, Excellent staff.
Very nice location to restaurant and Museum. 
Room service was fine and fast.
Nice breakfast and good service.
Bell man always smiling.
Nice air-conditioning and cozy room.

title: My favorite Paris Hotel
text: The Bel Ami is a fabulous hotel, and my absolute favorite in Paris the staff is attentive and supremely polite.  The rooms are well equipped with everything you might need.  I loved the breakfast buffet and the bar is a beautiful way to begin and end your days in Paris.  I was extremely impressed with the concierge who helped make my stay enjoyable.  Also, the location is fantastic - right in the heart of Saint Germaine.  It’s on a quiet side street and also just a block from the main streets and metro, so it’s easy to get everywhere. The hotel is modern with a very cool and elegant vibe.

title: Wonderful hotel in great location
text:
Just back from a 4 night stay at Hotel Bel Ami and we had a wonderful time. All the staff were so attentive and friendly; the room was great and so was the breakfast - something for everyone.
The hotel is ideally located off the Metro and we could easily walk to Le Louvre, Notre Dame, Musée d’Orsay and along the Rive Gauche.

title: The Most Splendid Boutique Hotel!
text: This is the second time in two years that my family and I spend our vacations at the Bel Ami. Of course, the hotel is ideally located in the heart of Saint Germain, an area known to be the heart of Paris’ intellectual life and a great dining and shopping area. But beyond the perfect location, the Bel Ami has a unique spirit and that spirit is its perfect and unique manager and staff. The welcome, the service, the impressive attention to details is simply not seen in other hotels. Our children of 6 and 5 received a magnificent attention (plushies and chocolates) and this went straight to our heart. In a word, staying at the Bel Ami is an absolutely unique experience. Not only do we recommend it but this is the hotel that will make your Paris stay unforgettable and filled with beautiful memories!

title: Perfect stay in Paris
text: What an amazing location, situated in St Germain - which is surrounded by lovely places to eat, shops and close by to some of the main site seeing attractions. The hotel was spotless and loved the classy and stylish interior. The room was perfect, comfortable bed and a very modern bathroom with a bath/shower. Classic breakfast selection with option of hot or cold food. We only stayed 1 night and managed to walk almost everywhere.

title: Great Hotel w/ Prime Location
text: Our stay at the hotel for 4 nights was great. We were welcomed by the staff with great reception, they held onto our bags and brought them up to the room when it was ready for check in (we were early). The concierge desk was helpful in making a dinner reservations, directions and shipping a parcel. The room maintenance team was great and friendly, as were the staff in the lobby bar. Overall a great hotel (with amazing staff) and great location to surrounding shops, museums, etc. will definitely be staying there on my next trip to Paris

title: The most perfect little boutique hotel
text:
We cannot be happier at this ideally located hotel. Our fourth floor room is spacious, squeaky clean and perfectly temperature controlled. The tub and shower comfortably fit two and have that designer feel. Beautifully decorated nice touches such as daily bottled water and chocolates add to that luxury hotel feel. The breakfast buffet is delectable, with more choices than one could possibly eat.
Most impressive is the gracious and hard-working staff, tending to our every need.
We are loving our time here at Bel Ami!

title: Great location and Great for kids.
text: The Hotel is ideally situated in St. Germaine, shopping is very close by as well as the Louve.  The staff was very welcoming and  warm to the children I had with me, 12 and 10 year old,  The morning breakfast buffet is amazing. Staff is very attentive and made us feel welcome and warm.

title: Elegant and friendly
text:
I stayed here again and I can only wait to come back.  The location is just incredible, the room was cozy for a couples summer escapade, it was a perfect match.  The real asset about this hotel is the staff!! From the moment you step in the friendliness and warmth makes you feel like at a friend’s house. Everybody is looking out for you, Reception, the bell boys and the breakfast staff.  Breakfast is delicious, it offers good quality and variety Kudos to Monalisa and Pedro!

Thank you for a beautiful stay and I am looking forward to come back

title: One of the best hotels in Paris
text: The Bel Ami hotel is located in one of the best location in Paris. The cleanes of the room and all the hotel facilities is outstanding. The staff is Kind and pleasant to help with everything. Without a doubt, next time in Paris we will choose your wonderful hotel.

title: Great hotel in the St Germain area
text: A lovely hotel conveniently located in the St. Germain area. I was able to explore the majority of sights walking from the hotel. Breakfast was perfect and the concierge team left an outstanding impression with their helpfulness.

title: Fabulous Paris Vacation
text: We’ve just returned from a fantastic stay at the Hotel Bel Ami.  The location is perfect - on a quiet street in St Germain des Près but mere steps to restaurants and shops.  The room was small but so well designed we had plenty of space for everything during our 12 day stay.  The air conditioning was so appreciated during a very warm spell in Paris.  The breakfast is plentiful with many choices all presented in an elegant buffet style.  The staff is so welcoming and helpful and really made our stay comfortable.  Highly recommend for your next visit to Paris.

title: Excellent Hotel in best location
text: Beautiful, clean, and friendly hotel. Perfect stay in perfect location, close to great restaurants, museums and gardens. The staff were so friendly, courteous  and attentive. Breakfast was fantastic too. Couldn’t recommend this hotel more.

title: Nice hotel in great location
text: This is a smaller, environmentally conscious hotel in a great location.  The breakfast is delicious and the staff was very good.  The bar served great drinks and food for easy dining.  The location was great and easy to walk to the sights or take the metro.

title:
THE BEST PLACE TO STAY IN PARIS!
EXCELLENT / OUTSTANDING  & SUPERB STAFF
text:

title: A Gem of a Hotel
text:
Bel Ami Hotel has everything going for it --style without stuffiness, a super Left Bank location and easy access to other parts of Paris.  The lobby is a fun place to read and relax and its  breakfast buffet is bountiful and delicious.  My room was lovely --well designed, very comfortable with excellent reading lights and a well appointed bathroom (e.g., deep soaking tub).

However, a beautiful hotel with indifferent or pretentious staff is not a great hotel. I  want to stay at a hotel with a staff that has customer service as a core value. And that is exactly what differentiates Bel Ami Hotel from others at a similar level --- its universally outstanding staff. I found each and every staff member with whom I engaged to be a consummate professional --- warm, welcoming, knowledgeable and totally focused on client service. 

I don't want to overlook staff whose names I'm not remembering. So I'll mention the following people as representative of the other equally terrific staff members: Ambre and Patrick, Front Desk; Christophe and Clement, Concierge; Abdul, Dining Room; Erik, Lobby Bar; Tamar, Room Supervisor, and the entire Housekeeping staff; and all of the lobby reception staff.

I would happily stay at the Bel Ami Hotel again and agin.

title: Beautiful wedding Anniversary

Beautiful experience and highly recommended :)
