title: An example of outstanding hospitality
text:
When you travel to Paris, would you like to stay in a great neighborhood, with an ultra comfortable room, delicious breakfast buffet, friendly front desk staff and concierges who will help you with your itinerary and make reservations for meals, museums, concerts and events? 

If so, the Hotel Bel-Ami is for you. My husband and I recently enjoyed an eight-night stay there in a one-bedroom apartment. It was super spacious with a bedroom (with TV), one huge full bathroom, a powder room, and a separate living room (with TV) and bar area. 

Ww were in Paris to celebrate our 40th anniversary, and the hotel welcomed us with a handwrittten note, full-sized bottle of champagne and treats. They also put a ribbon on the door and made us feel especially welcome. As an extra perk, the refrigerator held snacks and drinks (including some alcoholic nips). We were allowed to enjoy as many items as we wanted from the refrigerator for free. It was restocked each day with the same policy.

The concierges, Christophe and Clement, were helpful, making reservations for us before and after we arrived, and giving us little maps for our excursions in the neighborhood. They made excellent dinner suggestions and reservations within walking distance of the hotel -  Cinq-Mars and Le Colvert, two quaint, down home French bistros, with very good food. (Like chocolate mousse? Get it at Cinq-Mars). 

The hotel's neighborhood is a gem. Up the street you have the ultra touristy Les Deux Magots and Cafe Flore, to see and be seen at, as well as Église de Saint Germain des Prés, the oldest church in Paris. Also nearby is Brasserie Lipp where there is a convenient taxi stand. Win!

Across the street from the Bel-Ami is Le Relais de l'Entrecote, a restaurant that serves one dish - steak frites, if that's what you want (Not our thing how they make it, but very popular with others). There is also an AMAZING chocolate store, Le Chocolat Alain Ducasse, across the street. The helpful sales clerk will give you as many samples as you need to make a decision. They also give you packing covers to transport the chocolates back home, 1000% worth it. 

I could go on forever, how good our experience was at the Bel-Ami. Suffice it to say, next time in Paris, we'll be there!

title: Great  Location/Nice Hotel
text: To be honest not everything was perfect during my stay.  I understand that sometimes things happen that are unavoidable.  I appreciate that the hotel took responsibility for this and worked hard to find a solution that was fair.  The hotel itself was very nice.  The room was comfortable and the staff was very competent and friendly.

title: Wonderful
text: We probably never had better service in a hotel. It is  a modern gem in the heart of Saint Germain des Pres. I could not recommend this hotel more highly. The front desk people and the coincierge were especially helpfull. And of course it is located in one of the most charming urban areas in the world.

title: Pleasant stay
text: My group and I stayed there periodically over 2 weeks. We checked in and out a few times. The hotel has excellent service with courteous staff. The team at the concierge is very quick and efficient in addressing to your needs. The housekeeping is slightly inconsistent - some of us receive chocolates in the room but not all. Some of us get water at the end of the day but not all. One of my colleagues asked for a new bar of chocolate after finding out that the one he got had been eaten by the previous guest. The hotel responded with a bottle of champagne as apology plus a new bar of the chocolate of course. They also allowed us to shower using the shower room in the gym before we go to the airport for our night flight. The room I got shrank in size each time I check in. The last room was so small there was barely space to open my suitcase fully but luckily it was only for a night. It's relatively near to metro line 4 (5 mins walk). Overall, it's a pleasant stay.

title: A gem of a Hotel in the heart of Saint Germain des pres.
text:
Our family booked 2 rooms with breakfast included at the Bel Ami hotel.
It was the best decision we ever made. The staff was attentive and courteous, we had excellent service..
The beds in the room were comfortable for a good night sleep. Everything was top notch! 
When you hear Location, Location, Location.
This is THE HOTEL to be in.
It is surrounded by nice shops, restaurants, cafes.
Across is the famous “Entrecôte de Paris”,  then 2 mins walking distance you can sip a coffee or enjoy a glass of  wine at the renowned “Deux Magots” café. It is literally 10 mins walking distance to the Louvre museum. On your way there, you walk along the Seine river and cross a bridge to arrive to the Louvre. 
Then you have the delicious Italian Vesuvio restaurant on the other side, Brasserie Lipp, 
beautiful shops at rue des saints pères. 
It was a wonderful experience and we will no doubt come back to stay at the Bel Ami Hotel.

title: Don't pass this by!!!
text: Part 2 of our 2022 Family Girls Trip to Frankfurt & Paris was amazing thanks to the staff and the beautiful accommodations at the Bel Ami! We were located right in the heart of shopping at beautiful boutiques, amazing cafes and restaurants, walking distance to the Louvre and Seine River and great area to just people watch. Breakfast was incredible and served buffet style, 24/7 room service, concierge were very knowledgeable and attentive. Rooms were quaint, comfortable and extremely clean and they turned down your bed every night without requesting. Loved the contemporary look and the incredible staff. Will definitely go back!!!!

title: Not a 5 Star Hotel
text: We were very underwhelmed with our stay at Hotel Bel Ami. Our biggest issue is that the hotel is classified as a 5* hotel but it is at best an average 4* hotel with 5* prices.  The location of the hotel is great in the center of St. Germaine. However, the rooms are extremely small even by European standards and composed of mediocre materials and finishes throughout the hotel.  We booked through the Chase Hotel Collection which comes with perks like early check in, late check out and a room upgrade when available. I understand these perks are “when available” and it was a busy weekend but the fact that none of the three perks were accommodated when we only picked this hotel since it is part of the program was a let down. In the future, I would book a boutique 4* hotel over Hotel Bel Ami when given the option.

title: Great city centre hotel in Paris!
text:
My partner and I stayed at the Hotel Bel Ami on a weekend away in Paris, and had a very enjoyable stay. We stayed in the newly refurbished terrace suite which has a small outside terrace at the back, a wonderful four poster bed, the separate living space with sofa and an incredible marble shower room. There's also a sauna and gym in the hotel too - the sauna is great!!

The location is fantastic, right in the heart of Paris! Just 15 minutes walk from the Louvre and the Musee d'Orsay. The neighbourhood has some nice coffee shops, restaurants and wine bars too. It all felt very arty and also safe.

The staff at the hotel were wonderful and friendly - the loveliest staff I think we've ever had the pleasure to encounter during a hotel stay.

title: Best place to stay in Paris!
text: Hotel Bel Ami is the best place to stay in Paris! title: Excellente
text: The excellent service and friendly staff made our stay very enjoyable. The location is perfect for visiting all the touristic places and has amazing restaurants all around. We will return in the future for sure. Definitely recommend for a weekend away with loved ones!

title: Was Good… up until end
text: It was a pleasure upon check in. Hotel was nice. Decided to have breakfast here one morning. Breakfast is slim pickens (not much selection). Orange juice was good, but I must say that was it. Upon leaving they came out to us while getting our taxi and said you must check out. I’ve never ever checked out of a hotel and I’ve stayed at many 5 star hotels. I don’t consider this a 5 star hotel at all. Not only did they charge two for breakfast (when only one ate) they breakfast is 30.00 plus tax for what you get. Which is nothing. Staff is not friendly. When I contacted them about the breakfast issue they tried saying that I said I never ate breakfast, but that wasn’t the case. I never said that. But I did say only one ate, which is true. They still didn’t care. Would never stay here again based on their practices!

title: Perfect location and super friendly staff
text: Bel Ami is in a great location in Saint Germain, with an easy walk to Notre Dame, The Louvre and all of the great neighborhoods in Paris.  The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, the breakfast good and the rooms clean, spacious and modern.  It was a perfect spot for our family visit to Paris.

title: Our place next time if we get the privilege of coming back to Paris
text: We won't look for any other place to stay next time.  The Hotel Bel Ami has it all for a low key visit to the great city of Paris.   Our room was small but that's where the cons start and stop.  Front desk?  Great.  Concierge?  FROM BEFORE WE ARRIVED with our questions to when we arrived with their helpfulness?  Great.  Room amenities?  Great.  Location to transportation and sites and restaurants?  Great.  We paid up 20 bucks a night for breakfast just so that we wouldn't have to worry about it on a day to day basis.  And they had scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, cereal, baguettes, croissants, fruits, cheese and charcuterie daily.  The hotel staff is friendly.  They have a small fitness area if you want to use it along with a spa though we did not.  Our room, again while small, had a TV, safe, fridge and Nespresso machine.  They stocked us with bottled water daily.  You may have to request a iron and ironing board though.  Metropolitan is a short  3 or 4 minute walk.  Les Relais de le'Entrocote is right across the street (go, it's good).  Cafe De Fleur is 2 blocks away (don't go, it's overrated).  Last tip unrelated to this review, DO NOT fly Air France - 2 hours just to get through customs with no representatives to help us get to our gates more timely like United had and lost our luggage going home.  Hotel Bel Ami?  Yes, please.  Air France?  Never again.

title: Excellent hotel with amazing service and staff
text: We loved our stays at the Bel Ami hotel - amazing building, rooms, and especially staff: caring, competent and able to accommodate changes in our needs. And in the best part of Paris.  Definitely return and highly recommend!

title: Amazing hotel, even more amazing staff.
text: We stayed for 3 nights and really enjoyed the hotel.  The location is great to explore Paris and there are lots of great restaurants nearby.  The room was good sized.  The breakfast had a good variety of stuff.  The gym was very clean and had a variety of equipment.  The highlight for me was the staff.  They were amazing, very friendly and attentive.  I think this will be my “go-to” hotel in Paris.

title: Place to be for the Perfect Paris Trip!
text:
Kudos and hats off to the team at Bel Ami!  “They” made our stay with them truly memorable. 

The team assisted each other in all aspects that we observed.  They seemed to have remarkable cohesion as a group.

Any question, request or even whim was addressed with extreme courtesy and professionalism.  I know why a lot of their pictures line the wall by the elevator, they are All-Stars. 

Specifically some team members that were instrumental in making our stay great were Ibrahim, Christophe, and Pascal.  

The housekeeping and other staff behind the scene deserves a ton of credit too, as everything worked seamlessly and looked spectacularly well maintained. 

The bar was a great place to wait in between activities (husbands know what I mean, I.e., wardrobe changes) with a well crafted cocktail and the breakfast buffet was very well done too. 

My wife and I had stayed in Paris 7 times prior to this trip and this was by far the best location and hotel. 

As others have stated, for those with mobility walking to most of the prime spots is within range from this location.  We walked to Notre Dame, the Louvre, and back from the Madeleine area.  

The metro and famous Cafes were a block away.  It was also great hearing the bells of Saint-Germain-des-Prés through our window.  

All of the fun (restaurants, bars, people doing people things) of the Rue de Buci area is a 5 minute walk away and the Place Saint-Michel area is just about 5-10 minutes further. 

We had a fantastic time at the Chez Papa Jazz Bar down the street. The owner was extremely welcoming and the performers the night we went were top notch. 

Best meal even though during this trip we ate at a 2-Star and a 1-Star that we had also eaten at during previous trips, was at a very very small location (~ 8 tables) that Pascal reserved for us right above an Italian market. I think it was called Porto Vino. 

Will stay again.  Soon!

title: Made our dreams come true!
text: First of all the staff was wonderful, kind and helpful! Everyone at the hotel went out of out way to make our stay pleasant and comfortable. We always had people checking if we needed anything and everyone was gracious! I have stayed at many hotels and by far Hotel Bel Ami is the best hands down! The hotel is gorgeous and in a wonderful neighborhood. This was our first trip to Paris and we cant wait to go back and stay here again! Thank you for making a mother and daughter's dream come true.

title: Grandmother and Granddaughter
text: The hotel was amazing. The staff totally wonderful. Everyday the concierge desk would ask what I needed they made tour reservations, printed tickets, had subway tickets, made restaurant reservations, gave me directions on maps highlighted everything. The area the hotel was in was perfect St Germain was a cute little art/cafe with little shops and if you walked up the street you were on a main Blvd St Germain which lead to everything and lots of shop. Subway was 2 minutes away. The hotel was very quite and clean. Breakfast was a full brunch buffet and free if u book directly with hotel or Amex. The rooms are small but  very organized if u have traveled Europe before you will know all rooms are small in Europe we didn’t need any more room then we had. The area is perfect if you want to be in the center of Paris would highly recommend this hotel

title: Great thanks to all staff in the Bon Ami Hotel, Paris France for their warm hospitality and friendly service
text:
We are a senior couple in early 80 th and later 70 th. Our daughter arranged a family get together in Paris for Chinese New Year. We stayed in Bon Ami Hotel, Paris France from January 22 to 31, 2020. We experienced great service in this lovely hotel.
 
Unfortunately we both had health problems when we were in Bon Ami Hotel. The staffs in the concierge helped us to find the doctors and nurses who came to our room to see us 3 times. They helped us to arrange the wheelchair service at the airport when we departed for Vancouver, Canada on January 31 2020
We will not forget the day we needed seeing a doctor at 2:00am to make sure we were able to fly back to Canada. When the staffs of Elina and Roberto at the front desk learned of our problems they comforted us and arranged an ambulance to take  us to the hospital where the staff helped us such that we were able to fly back to Vancouver on time. Elina and Roberto not only arranged a taxi to take us to the airport and asked that the driver helped us to find the wheelchair office. Sorry I do not know the name of taxi driver. Please pass on our great thanks to him. 
 
Also many thanks to the restaurant in the Bon Ami Hotel
Due to the health problems, the restaurant made some special food at my request. I saw a “Jing” Tea Pot in the restaurant. I wish to buy one from the restaurant since it had my name on it (Jing). The manager of the restaurant found a new pot for me. 
 
We really had a good impression of Paris; it is not only a beautiful city full of the worlds outstanding historical attractions but also it is a very friendly city in our experience

title: Such a wonderful stay!
text: The staff was truly amazing!  We were there to celebrate my friend's birthday, and they wrapped the door to her room to welcome her!  Quality boutique hotel, comfortable rooms, wonderful service and in a perfect location.  Highly recommend!

title: Warm, friendly, and convenient to everything. Surrounded by art and culture.

Choice of eateries beside the hotel are every 40 feet or so from the front door. Batobus is three blocks away will take you to Eiffel Tower via the Seine.

title: Best Hotel

title: Best hotel in Paris.

We were there in the midst of the strikes and this did not impact the outstanding personalised service we received.  My girls even received a Xmas gift on arrival.  The quality of the food at breakfast was excellent.  Would definitely return to this hotel.

title: Our 3rd year coming to the Bel Ami
text: We came this year to celebrate our anniversary and NYE - it is a perfect location and a beautiful hotel where the staff are always happy and accommodating!  The Concierge helped with all of our reservations and transportation we could not be happier it was another great visit to Paris

title: Hotel in great location St. Germain des Pres
text:
Excellent location and good service.  Buffet breakfast very good. Small gym and spa good.
Restaurants and cafes nearby including the famous Cafe Flore.
walking distance to Blvd St. Germain des Pres and to Parc Luxembourg.

title: rooms are small

title: Vacation Stay

The hotel is lovely, and the staff is incredible!  We were catered to the moment we arrived, and we were always greeted and checked on as we entered/left the hotel each day.  The concierge would arrange tours/taxis/etc for us-even when we asked at the last minute.  I hope to visit Paris again one day, and I will definitely stay at the Hotel Bel Ami!

title: Christmas Time in Paris
text:
Someone suggested staying in the 6th and I found this Hotel online and stayed there based on location and reviews. I can’t say enough good things about it. The location was great. Lots of restaurants and shops around.
Staff were wonderful especially when the Transportation Strike started in France.

title: Favorite place to stay in Paris
text: This is our favorite place to stay in Paris. Great location, everything you need in walking distance. Lots of restaurants, shops and bars nearby. Lovely people. Great breakfast and a nice bar in the common area. Highly recommended!

title: Nice stay
text:
Nice and charming hotel. Staff really welcoming. The location of the hotel is perfect. 
For 2 people, we had a small room. We could barely walk and store 4 luggages.

The gym is well equipped but too tiny, can't workout at your ease, and too open with other spaces.

title: Perfect in every way!
text: The Bel Ami is perfectly located in Saint Germain. Right at the center of „rive gauche“ its the perfect starting point for exploring Paris. Concerning the hotel itself, everything is perfect. Staff, rooms, service, food.... Will come again.

title: Magic Paris
text:
It’s the second time we stay in this very charming hotel. We went the first time in 2013 and we had a beautiful permanence. During the years it has been renovated and now it’s more beautiful. 
It’s located in the heart of Saint Germain des Pres, few steps by the famous Café de Flore, the most beautiful area of Paris.
The staff is very kind and available to solve any possible problem. 
Breakfast is really good! 
There also is a little spa and gym and a nice lounge bar and library area where you can pass relaxing moments.
Thank you again and see you next time.
Angelo

title: Wonderfully Attentive Staff
text: Bel Ami really knows what hospitality means, especially for a property that is as busy as theirs. The lobby is beautifully decorated in what seems to be Art Deco or Hollywood Regency style. The staff is attentive and go out of their way to make you feel special. One night my friend and I stayed at the bars late, we asked if the kitchen was closed and it was...but the front desk manager opened the kitchen for us to order a few items to munch on late night. You don't usually get the attention to detail in major cities like you do at Bel Ami. Would highly recommend.

title: Excellence at its best
text:
The hotel staff are always courteous  and available in ensuring you have a most memorable stay. I have allergies to feathers and pets, once I communicated this to the hotel prior to arrival they guaranteed I would have a hypoallergenic room. 

Upon our arrival Sarah greeted us with a warm welcome and gave us a tour of the hotel services and grounds . She accompanied us to our room which was immaculate, spacious, modern , with all the amenities. The hotel staff also prepared a special presentation for our anniversary with complimentary champagne.  Wow

The cleanliness and layout of the room, entrance and bathroom is outstanding. As soon as you enter there is a hook for your wet jacket . Bathroom also has a hairdresser quality blow dryer and bench . 

Hotel is very well situated on quiet street close to all the highlights of Paris. Traveling by Metro is easy. 

If you need any recommendations or reservations Christophe the concierge is always available and ready to serve you. 
In all my travels in Europe this is the best quality and service hotel I can recommend to everyone. 

Merci de tous cœur  Hotel Bel Ami pour un séjour inoubliable ❣️

title: My new go to Paris hotel
text:
After years of experiencing some rather average hotels in Paris, it was great to discover the floride etoile. 

The stand outs for me were the helpful and friendly reception staff and the quietness of my courtyard facing room. In many Paris hotels the staff are very hesitant to speak English, not so at the floride etoile where the staff prioritise speaking English to their…..English speaking guests. How logical and helpful of them. Some hotels in the city can be in very noisy locations. From my courtyard facing room I could only hear the birds …..lovely! 

I was impressed to see the manageress of the hotel be across all aspects. It was obvious that she and her staff genuinely prioritise customer service.  

The room, whilst small, was perfectly ok for 2 people, I found it comfortable and perfectly clean. I appreciated having tea and coffee facilities in the room. 

I found the surrounding streets of Victor Hugo to be stylish and sophisticated, they are also very expensive if you are considering going to one to one of the nearby restaurants, but not excessively so.
Their was a very convenient supermarket next door to the hotel. 

The hotel is walking distance to the subway and a number of bus lines. For those that don’t mind a little walk the Eiffel Tower and The champs elysee are a 20-25 minute walk. Tip: make sure you go to the Place du Trocadéro and view the lights of the Eiffel Tower at night. It’s only a 10 minute walk from the hotel. 

Their are not a significant amount of bakeries to grab breakfast near the hotel so you may like to have breakfast in-house. Their was a patisserie near Victor Hugo subway but it opened quiet late in the morning if I remember correctly. 

The only negative of my stay was of the front desk failing to respond to an email I sent after I had checked out. This was in regards to a dangerous taxi driver who picked me up from the hotel and was a serious matter (no connection to the hotel). I am still yet to receive a reply. This was disappointing.

title: Living life
text: What an amazing hotel room 512 was perfect for family.  The room was perfectly presented clean and well positioned.  The hotel is a 5 minute walk from the Eiffel Tower.  It was a very quiet at night no noise.  The staff were extremely welcoming and very talented language skills.  The breakfast was a delight with the choices. Thank you for a lovely welcome.

title: From Vancouver
text:
This hotel is situated in a very popular location. It is steps away from metro, Eiffel, restaurants,…very convenient!
It’s clean and breakfast is pretty decent. Also, people at the reception are helpful. I recommend this hotel.

title: Just perfect!
text:
We had a two night stay in this lovely boutique style hotel which is in the most perfect location. The staff were the most friendliest people I have ever met in a hotel and very warm and welcoming. The room we were in was small for three people but it still worked for us and was not a problem. They have options to have bigger rooms though so if space is a concern for you then make sure you book a deluxe option. The room was also very clean and tidy. 
We added on breakfast last minute and it did not disappoint. Plenty of options and cheaper to have at the hotel than going out to most cafes! Overall, I am absolutely thrilled to have chosen this hotel over all the other options, and I will definitely stay here again in the future.

title: Quaint boutique hotel
text: Quaint little boutique hotel tucked away in the side streets but close enough to walk to the major attractions.  Staff friendly and accommodating. Rooms are tiny but that’s what you’ll get in the city centre.  Plenty of storage space for your clothes makes up for the lack of room size.  Breakfast was ok.  Did the job for our stay.

title: Excellent
text: Not really cheap, but very good value for money. Besides that, in a very nice quartier with good café's and also grocery shops. And don't forget to visit the balcon at the Place de Trocadero, with view on the Eiffel tower.

title: Good
text: Everything is ok except the breakfast, it was always the same, after 6 days it was very boring. However, the hotel is near the city center, metro station, the room was clean  and bright, the staff friendly

title: Long weekend in Paris
text:
The Hotel is ideally located for a short trip in Paris - you are central with easy access to Metro and walking distance to a lot of sites. Hotel staff is extremely friendly and helpful and the overall atmosphere is very nice!
However, we had a room on the first floor to the street and as this seems to be a gathering place in the night and early morning, this is very loud!! The windows are new but some additional sound iisolation would be great!

title: Perfect near Eiffel Tower
text: Loved having a short walk to Eiffel Tower, Arc d Triumphe, Champ Elysees. Also supermarket, bars, cafes, bus and metro all right there. Michael at frint desk was great and made this my Paris home- not just a hotel. My toom was spacious and comfortable very clean. Had fridge, great wifi and Tv.

title: Super excellent
text:
Best Stay in Paris Super nice staff Michel is so helpful and nice always ready to make your day easier! The room are bright and clean. Even late you are always welcome with a smile! This hotel is a gem at so many levels ! 
My new favorite address in Paris and the location is great.

title: Short break in Paris
text: Great location, easy walking distance to many attractions, hotel is comfortable and staff are very pleasant. We had a triple room as we were travelling with our older daughter and the room itself was large enough and catered well for our needs.

title: Lovely hotel, conveniently located
text: This hotel has all the necessary amenities for business or personal travel. I stayed here while visiting Paris for a conference and was able to easily walk to the Palais de Congres, the Eiffel Tower, or the Metro. Our room was on the smaller side, but it was clean and quiet, although it is possible to hear other guests in the hall if they're being loud. Staff was welcoming and friendly. I would stay here again.

title: Great stay
text: Everything was great. Nice hotel. Great staff. Very friendly and kind. Very good location Near the Eiffel Tower and 3 minute to metro station. Breakfast could be more varied. But  It really was a nice stay there;)

title: Franco P C
text: excellent service, very nice facilities and well adapted for wheelchair users.  A special highlight goes to the excellent reception staff, very humorous, communicative, polite and helpful. by Paris standards, it has spacious suites, which are clean and well decorated.

title: Hidden gem
text: Great location only a few minutes walk from the Metro.   Friendly & helpful staff. Nice buffet breakfast. This was our 3rd stay and won’t be our last. Recommend the executive room for a bit more space as standard rooms are quite small.

title: Nice, clean & very friendly in a very good neighbourhood
text:
Apparently well-renovated, not-too-big hotel in a convenient location. Very friendly concierge and relaxed, low-profile atmosphere. We´ll definitely consider to return here on our next trip to  Paris. 
The room was facing the (little) side street, a room to the rear of the building would probably be even better. ;-)

title: It was so great to be back!
text:
It felt so good to be back in Paris last week!  I am fortunate in that I travel there (comparatively) regularly - at least once a year but the pandemic stopped that - I am certainly not complaining, what has been happening over the past two years was too serious to get into a heap about holiday travel.  That said, it was a thrill to return to travel last week and an absolute joy to stay, once again at Floride Etoile Hotel.  

So let's start with the location - it's excellent, within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower, Champs Elysees and a stone's throw from the Metro.  The area itself is safe and quiet which I like after a busy day sightseeing.

Now to the hotel - simply put - I love staying there!  All of the staff are friendly and knowledgeable  - to me that's a sure sign that the place is well managed.  I have a dietary issue -  but this was handled with discretion - I just mentioned it when we were placing the booking.  The breakfast is superb and really sets up the tourist for a heavy day's sightseeing.  The rooms like many Parisian hotel rooms may be considered small but I will readily admit to having stayed in smaller rooms in other cities.  Full marks for cleanliness!  I would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Perfect Location
text: Couldn’t of found a better hotel! The rooms were perfect for us, they were quite small but were exceptionally clean, and perfect if you’re planning on just using the hotel as a base to sleep and shower. Staff were very friendly and accommodating. The location is amazing only 10 minutes from the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe, with plenty of restaurants and cafes within the area as well as a supermarket a couple of doors down. What more could you ask for?

title: First class treatment
text: From start to finish, every one of the staff at Floride Étoile were incredibly friendly and helpful. Breakfast was typical French: delicious and plentiful. And how could a hotel that large with completely full bookings be SO QUIET? I’ll definitely be staying here next time I come back to Paris.

title: Very good deal!
text:
Our overall experience was good. Near to Eiffel Tower, the hotel also has good connections with metropolitan transports. The staff is extremely kind and the cleaning quality was exceptional.
Honestly, I expected my room was bigger, but we were  3 persons, so I think maybe the hotel has better rooms for couples or singles.

PD: Si hablais español, preguntar por el señor Miguel que fue muy gentil y bueno con nosotros!

title: Perfect hotel , can’t wait to return.
text:
A perfectly located hotel, less than 10 min walk to Arc de Triumph and 10 mins on metro to Eiffel Tower. Lots of restaurants within 5 minute walk at Trocadero and Bossier, Carrefour supermarket next door to hotel. 

Hotel rooms were spotless and staff were amazing giving us really good advice in sightseeing and safety. We hope  to return to Paris very soon and look forward to staying here again.

title: My favorite hotel at my favorite region of Paris
text: I always prefer to stay at Floride Etoile. Because of the frankly, nice and kind personnel and of course the hotel's beautiful place! Each time is another nice memory for me. Thanks for all. Looking forward to my next accommodation.

title: Room a bit small but amazing staff service
text: Overall, was a really nice place to stay in a really good location, easy metro access and good walking distance to places. Firstly, the room was a bit small, not much space to walk around the bed and very difficult access to both wardrobes either side of the bed. However, secondly, the customer service from the staff was amazing. We had a particular problem with covid test results not coming through, so my partner and I went down to reception to ask for help with translation. The gentleman on the reception was particularly friendly, welcoming, understanding and we could see he tried his absolute best to help us sort the problem, going beyond just translation. He went as far as alerting his boss who was taking over from him in the morning (the morning of our flight and when we needed the problem sorted for) and she also went beyond just service for the hotel. She had set alarms for when to call the target company, and even after we had left for the airport she was calling and emailing and trying to sort the problem for us. Overall, definitely would stay here again, it was just a shame about the room size.

title: Cozy hotel in a perfect location
text: The hotel is very well located between the Arc de Triumph and Tour Eiffel. The room is small yet spotless and the bed is very comfortable. The staff are very friendly and welcoming. Overall a very positive experience.

title: One night at Paris
text: Excellent service as always. Excellent place, very well located near by Eiffel Tower and Triumph Arc, just walking distance, also the are metro station near there. Is located in a secure area with small restaurants and cafés to enjoy your visit.

title: Paris
text: My experience was great. The employees at the hotel was very accommodating but small space. Great for 2 people. The area was safe with lots of cafe around. There is an grocery store which was very convenient. Very close walking distance to the eiffel tower. Check them out.

title: Good location, very small room
text: We stayed whilst visiting friends in Paris. Location was ideal for us, close to our friends, bakeries nearby, and a short walk to both the Eiffel Tower and Paris Metro stations. The room was very small and basic, but generally clean and suitable for a weekend stay. Price was competitive for Paris, albeit still on the high side in terms of value compared to quality. An option to consider if in Paris and this location is convenient to your visit.

title: Great hotel!
text: Will strongly recommend this hotel. Location is great, near Trocadero, easy walk to most relevant Parisian places like the Eiffel Tower, the Arc of Triomphe, and Champs Elysee. I have stayed at this hotel at least 3 times! Rooms are tiny, as everything in Paris, but really clean and nice. Staff is great and helpful. There is a Carrefour supermarket close to the hotel that is a plus for quick groceries.

title: Great hotel
text:

Clerks are kind
Water is hot

And not that expensive
Thats the important part

But the room maybe seems to small for someone 
I was actually okay with it but someone could

title: Very very nice!
text: Thanks for your kindness!! The accommodation was very clean and cozy. Walk for nine minutes and you'll see the Eiffel Tower. I could see the Eiffel Tower every day. 15 minutes walk and you'll see the Champs-Elysees! The subway is a nearby and safe area.

title: Pleasant stay in Paris, nice location and great staf!
text: I have selected The hotel based in the location Trocadero from where we can walk easily to good tower sights, Restaurantes and etc. bedroom as cosy and small (ok Paris) but breakfast was fairly good and staff was always very helpful. We enjoyed the time and found this to be a very good cost-benefit!

title: Omar
text: Simply amazing , wonderful staff , great location , service , very welcoming , everything around you in 5 minutes walking , nice and tasty breakfast , we have celebrated our son 16th birthday And the hotel arranged for a fantastic cake . Well done and keep it up

title: excellent accommodation in an excellent location
text: The location is within easy reach of the main landmarks, staff is welcoming and very helpful, and the room is nice, has everything you need, a spacious bathroom, everything very clean. The only minus during my stay was the noisy neighbors but it is important that the hotel staff did all in their power to help. This means a lot to me.

title: Excellent convenient hotel for Paris sights
text: Excellent place to stay for visiting the Paris sights. 3 metro stations within a short walk. Lots of restaurants nearby. Staff at the hotel very helpful and friendly. Got an email before arriving to find out if I had any special requirements which was a lovely idea. Would recommend and would definitely stay again. Thanks

title: EXCELLENT AND GREAT LOCATION
text: The location is # 1, extraordinary and proffesional staff, room very clean, bed and pillow very  confortable and the breakfast is super, close to important historical atractions, you can walk to there, restaurant in the area excellent and near, we recomended if you look for confort, proximity and convinience for and great price in Paris

title: Good location for a good price
text: Very good located, nice and clean. The elevator is very slow though. The Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe are close, also a Metro/Subway station. Next door is a grocery store. Personnel is friendly and helpful.

title: Excellent location
text: We took an a 14-hour tour to Normandy, and had to be in Trocadero Square very early and dropped off very late at night, so this was perfect walking distance. It turned out that we could also walk to l' Arc de Triomphe and la Tour Eiffel, and metro stop was a 2 minute walk. Hotel was clean and professional and an excellent price.

title: Super location
text: We stayed in this modest hotel in October 2019. There was nothing over the top but it was clean and the staff was friendly and helpful. We slept with the windows open so I can’t say much about the street noise, but the few rooms next to us we could hear their coming and going very easily. It didn’t bother us, but might bother a light sleeper.  It was very close to metro, an easy walk to the Eiffel Tower and within walking distance to Champs-Elysees. Very close to a delicious Italian restaurant, Ozio. There is also a small grocery store a few doors down. The Big Bus hop on hop off tour pick up area was also very close. The room was small compared to American hotels but had all we needed. The in wall hair dryer wasn’t the best, they don’t supply wash clothes, which is common in Europe, but the did supply shampoo, shower gel & lotion.  They also gave us a map at check in which came in very handy!  Taxi cost €50 to the hotel from the airport. I would stay here again next time. The area was very safe feeling and in a super location.

title: Good choice for a short stay
text: Neat, clean, very friendly staff and right in the center. The room was a bit small though and the breakfast was with Limited choices. Otherwise, it was great. The hotel is about 15min walk from Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Élysées, yet in a very quiet area.

title: Nice hotel with clean and good sized rooms
text: we visited paris for a couple of days and we stayed at this hotel. the hotel itself is pretty clean, staff are friendly and the rooms are pretty updated and good sized. there are also a few restaurants and groceries around the area and the hotel is pretty close to the metro which made going around the city pretty easy for us.

title: Excellent choice
text: Very Nice hotel and the location is great. But most, Very very satisfied with the service provided, Nice personnel and treatment. Totally recommended, Definitely will book again when I return to Paris

title: Almost as theft
text:
They leave two bottles of water in your room that looks like complementary. But they charge you with 5 times the price in the end. 
Cleaning is done only when you ask for it. And it's annoying to remember and wait in line at the lobby to ask the room to be cleaned. The cleaning lady threw away my razor. So I bought another one. She threw away that one the next day. She also threw away my friend's toothpaste. The only positive comment I can leave would be that the location is good.

title: First trip to Paris
text: This was our first trip to Paris.  We had a wonderful visit thanks to the staff at Floride Etoile.  They gave us helpful advise on transportation, tours and sites to see.  They even arranged our travel to the train station for our trip to Switzerland.  Very friendly and welcoming.  The Hotel is within waking distance of the Eiffel tower and the Arc de Triomphe.  It has a grocery store just a few steps away and several restaurants and a pharmacy around the corner. We would definitely stay here again,

title: Clean, friendly and reasonable position and price
text: I stayed here on business working in La Défense area. I couldn’t find anything within budget in Défense and this hotel was a decent alternative. Room was fairly small but clean and functional. Couldn’t get an ironing board which is a bit poor. Shower has mixer taps which was hard to get temp right but decor throughout was very smart. There a few bars and restaurants within walking distance and the Arc is within easy walking distance. For travelling to Défense it was an easy walk to the station next to the Arc. I had a few great dinners at a good price locally too. Slightly off the beaten track so didn’t feel like a tourist trap. Staff at the hotel were very helpful and friendly and all in all I was happy with quality all round for the money.

title: 3.5/5 star stay
text:
We stayed at Floride Etoile Hotel for 6 nights mid September.

Positives: Check in was easy and quick and staff were lovely and very helpful. Our room was a double room, although small it was all we needed for our stay. The bed was really comfy and the pillows were soft too, the bathroom was spacious and the shower was good. Rooms were very clean and also cleaned every day and towels were changed too. There was little light shining through at night because the curtains were great and our room was on level 3, located towards the back of the hotel so we didn’t hear any noise from the street at night.

Negatives: The rooms were not sound proof at all. We could hear kids crying from other rooms, doors slamming shut at all hours of the night and also footsteps from the room above us, making it hard to sleep for a light sleeper. House keeping also start from 8am so we could hearing vacuuming early, making it impossible to sleep in if you wanted to. Wifi was ok, sometimes it was slow or would drop out, but majority of the time it was working well.

Location: The location of this hotel is perfect. You have so many subway stations around making it easy to access The Louvre, Notre Dame and Disneyland. It is located about a 20mins walk from the Eiffel Tower and Arc De Triomphe also. It is a 15mins walk to the Champs-élysées too, making it super convenient to access everything. So many restaurants and shops close by too, some are a little pricey but that’s just Paris!! 

Altogether we loved staying in Paris and we were very satisfied with our stay at this 3 star hotel.

title: Amazing hotel
text: Receptionist helpful and polite. Room was clean and beautiful. Everything was amazing, thank so much. When I back I'm sure I'll book Floride Etoile hotel again. Nearby Trocadero, restaurants and metro.

title: Four Night Stay
text:
Everything was great about the accommodation except for the bath tub. There was no overhead shower head. There was a hand held shower head. There was no shower curtain or screen. As as result it was hard not to spray water all over the bathroom floor and toilet.

Breakfast was excellent. There was cereal, cheeses, nuts, fruit, yogurt and lots of bread. Hard boiled eggs were available.

Avoid a room facing the street otherwise you might be woken by trash pick up.
The subway is just up the street.

title: Good value
text:
We stayed here in August 2019.  I had reserved an "executive" room, which was similar in size to an average hotel room in the USA.  This is not a luxury hotel but was clean, in a nice quiet location within the city and very well priced. Unfortunately for us, the closest metro line (6)  was undergoing servicing during our stay which limited it's usefulness, but we walked to Victor Hugo for the #2 metro line which was about a 5-7 minute walk from the hotel.  It is also located halfway from Arc D'Triumphe and Eiffel Tower.  Beds were comfortable and the air conditioning worked well, a blessing as we were in Paris during very hot (90+ Fahrenheit) weather.   

My only non-positive comment is that the sound-proofing was not good.  As a light sleeper, I was woken each morning by the sound of slamming doors and other noises.

title: This hotel has never disappointed me!
text: I took a 3 day holiday with my son this weekend and once again stayed at Floride Etoile.  I stayed here a number of times over the years.  It is a small hotel but it extends a big welcome.  Front staff are multi-lingual and it's easy for a guest to feel comfortable once through its doors.  Staff are very knowledgable and were up to date with all the current issues on metro disruptions.  Always greeted with a smile! beds are really comfortable so you can be sure of a good night's rest after a busy day (sightseeing or business).  Food allergies are catered to - just let them know in advance. Breakfasts are very generous and will set you up for the day.  It's central and really close to the metro.  A short walk from the Eiffel Tower.  Lovely safe district.  What's not to love!

title: Very good for overnight stay in Paris
text:
Good location
Clean hotel, room, bathroom
Missing fridge in the room, was super hot weekend and we miss fridge for our watter.
Very nice staff on reception, with good tips and we get good price for river cruise.

title: Excellent stayed
text: First visit for me and my little family to Paris, love the city..!.. The hotel was great, walking distance from Eiffel Tower.!!!!!.. Extremely friendly staff, room was exceptional clean (I’m an OCD with cleanliness) the Avenue was very quiet and there is many restaurant and markets close by.. loved it..!! So far the best place I have stayed in this trip.!

title: Hidden Gem
text: Great staff, especially helpful front desk staff.  Comfortable rooms and very close to great restaurants, the Eiffel tower, Arch. Appreciated the air conditioning. Rooms are very clean and updates have been made around the hotel. Wifi was good. Can’t think of a single complaint about the hotel itself. It’s not a luxury hotel, but it suited our needs perfectly for 4 nights in Paris.

title: Great little hotel
text: Great hotel, comfy beds. Try to book a twin room instead of double. it is way bigger and beds are set together.  Walking distance to Trocadero. There is a carrefour next to the hotel for snacks and beverages.

title: Lovely hotel and room staff are so helpful
text: The hotel was lovely and the room was small but clean and lovely. The staff were amazing we even left our bags there after check out and they watched them for us as we went around Paris for a few more hours. There are scooters you can rent with a app that's the way to travel around Paris.

title: Perfect Tdf situation !
text:
We came to Paris to look Tour de France. Hotel is very near Arc de Triomphe and Champs Elysees. Easy to go Metro and Tour Eiffel.
Good restaurants in Trocadero .Bus to Orly also went here.
Hotel Staff were helpfully and frendly!

title: Amazing hotel !!!
text: This hotel is excellent. Amazing customer service, the front desk staff are super friendly, helpful and kind. They assist my partner and I with everything and provided directions to locations. The rooms are clean and A.C. is amazing. They allowed us to be checked in early which is a plus. I will definitely recommend this hotel. It’s walk distance from the Eiffel Tower and is surrounded by good restaurants. I would definitely return to this hotel.

title: Great location and service
text: Very pleasant hotel in great location. Reception staff extremely helpful. Our ground floor twin room was perfect except for being a bit dark as window looked out on a courtyard corner. Loved the convenient and nice location.

title: Just excellent.
text:
The location of this hotel is perfect, easy walking distance to the famous shopping avenue. Plenty of restaurants & cafe's.
Hotel rooms are very nice bathrooms are clean and has a shower. Double beds are also very comfortable. Breakfast has lots of choices. Eat as much as you can! Just perfect to start your day.

title: Nice updates since we last stayed
text:
My daugther and I stayed May1-5. This was our second stay with this hotel. Since our firtst time in 2011, they have updated the rooms slightly and the best part is that now its a non-smoking hotel. Love that the rooms include a mini fridge and safe. Front desk staff were extremely helpful and courteous. 

One problem we did experience was that the air in our room did not work. I addressed this with the front desk and was told they would look into it, however it was never fixed. Thankfully we had a window to the street that opened so we were able to cool the room down that way.

Other than that, it was another nice experience.

title: Great
text: The property was well locted near attractions, restaurants and shops. It was clean. The downsides were that the shower oscillated between hot and cold a bit and there was no cooling AC. The room was also small which is typical in Paris. I would stay there again.

title: Excellent value for money.
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights costing £285 all together. Didn't opt for breakfast as we wanted to try the local cafes. Safe and air con was included.

The room was on the small side, however we was not bothered by this, as the bathroom was a good side with a large shower, all very clean on arrival and cleaned daily with all shampoos re-stocked so no need to bring any if travelling light.

Had a selection of English channels which was good for down time.

Great location, between the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower no more than 5 mins to the arc and 10 to the tower, and lots if cafes and restaurants near by.

Would highly recommend for short stays, longer stays the small rooms might be a problem.

Staff very friendly.

title: Brilliant for a short stay in Paris
text: Came for a long weekend and for a 3 star hotel it was perfect. You walk in and it was very clean the hotel and the room. Was a small room but was perfect for the two of us as we didn’t need a lot of space and we was barely in the room. The bed was unbelievably comfortable including pillows slept like a baby. Towels and bed was changed every day. You can hear noises from other rooms but not that it disturbed my stay at all cause I still was able to sleep at night there was no noise. Air conditioner and heating you control what temperature you want in the room. Obviously the location of the hotel was the best bit near everything and amazing restaurants that’s just a reason in itself to book this hotel.

title: Great location ! Safe, comfortable. Nice staff
text: Great place to stay for my first time Paris. Staff were nice/helpful, rooms were small (typical European) and clean. Room service was also delicious ! Close to a bank, grocery store, metro, Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. Only major negative was thin walls so could hear neighbors but my sound machine on my phone helped with that. Would stay again!

title: A nice experience
text:
The hotel met my expectations. Service was good, rooms were clean and I had everything I asked from the staff.

Location is also good, 4 minutes walk from Subway, 10 minutes walk from Champs Elysee e close to restaurants and cafés.

title: First time in Paris
text: First time visit to Paris.Very nice hotel in fairly quiet area off Ave.Klebber.Room nice though not much of a view,Safe,Mini Bar,big TV with some Enlish channels.Did not eat or drink in hotel but the bar and reataurant looked nice.Room cleaned every day and towels changed also.Great location.Five minute walk to the following;Trocadero/Eifell Tower,Arc de triomph,Champs Elyses,Metro stations(2 lines).Reception staff very good and spoke Enlish well(Thankfully as our French is non-existent.)

title: Best location in Paris
text: 15 minutes walk to Eiffel tower and 15 minutes walk to Arc de Triumph, 2 minutes from Metro station. We stayed in Twin room and apparently this room is much bigger than Double room. Clean room and very friendly staff. Facilities to leave your luggage  after check out. Great value for money.

title: Excellent location and good service
text: Clean and tidy. Excellent location near the metro station. Just walking distance to Tour Eiffel & Arc de Triomphe. Very good service and helped us a lot during our stay. The price is reasonable and not expensive. Would recommend to others.

title: Great Choice
text: Stayed here for 7 nights with a 3 month old. The staff were most accommodating, approachable, helpful and friendly. We arrived early in the morning with the baby and asked if we could get an early check-in, the desk was also busy checking guests out at this time. At first we were told noon but "let us see what we can do", it was amazing and I felt that they really hustled to get a room clean for us; they took our luggage to the room around 8 am. I  had to mention this exceptional service because it was truly appreciated after an overnight flight with a baby. The hotel itself is very clean with everything that we needed.It is  well situated, close to transport, walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, The Arc and Champs- Elysees. It is also close to many restaurants and grocery stores. Will definitely recommend staying here. We did not have breakfast so cannot comment, but had coffee and it was good. They also arranged an early morning taxi to the airport. The hotel itself is spotless and very well located but the entire from front desk personnel to the cleaning staff puts it over the top.

title: Nice clean little hotel
text: The hotel was simple and clean. Breakfast was sufficient, simple and tasty. The room was a bit small, there was no sitting area in the room, it was just the bed, tv and wardrobe. The staff was helpful when you approached them. I would suggest they have some welcome leaflet to help tourists to choose where and how to go. The hotel is in quiet area, between Trocadero and Arch de Triumph. Not so many restaurant choices around. You should surely try the close by Brasserie.

title: Brilliant stay!
text: My boyfriend and I stayed for 3 days at the beginning of January and the hotel was everything we needed. The room was modern but most importantly perfectly clean. The staff were extremely helpful and friendly. I would most definitely recommend this hotel for a trip to Paris as the location is also ideal, close to a metro station that will bring you wherever you want and a less than 10 minute walk to amazing views of the Eiffel Tower.

title: Wonderful Choice
text: We needed a room for only 2 nights. This hotel was very well located and reasonable. The reception was very professional and friendly. The location was very good and was close to the metro and many restaurants. The hotel also arranged an early morning shuttle to the  airport. The place was spotless. We'll stay there again. Thank you.

title: My go-to hotel for trips to Paris
text:
I started coming to Paris in the late 1990's and this has been my go-to hotel ever since.  Once again, it did not disappoint this weekend.  

Starting with the staff, every single one was very helpful and friendly.  Dietary needs were catered for, no problem. (The breakfast is very generous and the staff in the breakfast room were really friendly and professional).  It was a pleasure to come down to breakfast every day.  

It's a small hotel so you really get the feeling of personal service (without intrusion).  I have to commend Audrey for her professionalism and assistance.

From a hygiene viewpoint, the place is spotless so it was a pleasure to return to the hotel after the day's activities.

Overall, a great stay.  I am already looking forward to my next trip.  It may be a year ahead but I won't have to search for a hotel - I found it already!  

Thanks again to Hélene and her team!

title: 3 days escapade.
text: We've checked in last December 26-28 and room was clean and decent. Hotel staffs are friendly. We enjoyed our stay in this hotel aswell as we enjoy our quick escapade in Paris. We will definitely come back.

title: Nice hotel good location
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights as a couple, flew early in the morning so arrived at the hotel around 11am and they let us check in early as the room was ready (usual check in 3pm) so this allowed us to make the most of our first day which was nice. The room was small but what we booked so this was to our expectation an plenty big enough for a city trip. Comfy bed and nice shower, only down side is the walls must be very thin as we got woken up every morning by someone else’s alarm! However this isn’t much of an issue as we weren’t there to sleep in and got us up early to explore. 

The hotel location is very good and easy enough to get to from the train, would recommend the shuttle service from reception though as for two this only cost €36 to get back to the airport where as the train cost around €20 took a lot longer and can be very busy with luggage and plenty of pickpocketers around. 

On day of check out our flight wasn’t until 10pm so they locked our luggage away and allowed us to use the whole of the last day. 

Friendly service and great location, only down side is the thin walls and few small cosmetic things but nothing not expected, great value for money in Paris!

Would definitely book again.

title: Nice hotel
text: Excelent hotel, the staff is very nice. The hotel is near to the Eiffel Tower and the the triumphal arch. The breakfast is good. The underground is near to. You can walk to many places and is safe The places around the hotel are safe

title: Wonderful trip
text: Great hotel. With excellent location close to attractions and buses/metro. Staff very courteous and helpful. Comfortable and clean room. Delicious breakfast. It is located one block from main avenue Kléber. All in all 5 stars. I would stay there again.

title: Wonderful Stay!
text: Loved the hotel and the staff was very friendly. Great location,  The whole facility was very clean. The room was good sized and a very nice bathroom. Comfortable bed and the pillows were heavenly. Staff was very pleasant and helpful!

title: Weekend Break
text: Very clean, modern and fresh. Small rooms but perfect for weekend break. Great location, close to 3 metro stations and 10 mins walk from Trocadéro, and arc de triomphe/champs elysees. Helpful staff. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Location is key
text: Great hotel,  clean and comfortable. Didn't like the shower head, needs cleaning for better flow. Location is great,  close to everything. Friendly staff,  willing to help you. No complimentary water, so buy your own as bottles in the fridge are expensive.

title: Very nice and good value for money.
text: Nice clean and quiet hotel. Very good value for money,Nice bathroom, and good wifi (good enough to watch Netflix in the evening). If I should put my finger on anything, it would be a rather limited selection for breakfast, but good enough.

title: Great Hostel
text:
We loved staying at the People Hostel. Particularly the view in the evening to the Eiffel Tower and the proximity to most things.

I must say our long weekend in Paris would have been perfect if it hadn't been for the unfortunate event at Bir-Hakeim (Eiffel Tower) Metro station . It was about 10:30pm and we bought our tickets to enter the Metro station. We were stopped by some transport patrols who claimed one of our tickets was 'invalid' and demanded 60 Euro fine. This was very strange for us as we had just used the gates with no problem and bought the tickets at the ticket office. They would not accept an explanation of any kind, they were abusive, pushy and threatening. This caused my daughter an anxiety attack.  They kept incrementing the fee because we refused to pay it. 
We called the police and we were so disappointed that they didn't help. We ended up handing in the 60 Euros.
Both police and transport patrols were very friendly to each other. We felt robbed by the transport authorities. What a way to get money from tourist!
Be aware!

Other than that, we loved Paris.

title: Not my best experience
text:
The hotel is OK for what you pay for. The rooms are clean. Although, I had to book another hotel because I couldn’t stand it.  I was going to stay 3 nights and checked out the 2nd night, lost my money but needed to get out! 

It’s too many people (8 beds)  for just ONE bathroom and ONE shower, the air conditioner was poor and we were really hot, they have a thing that if you open the terrace door the air shuts down, but they should not have that since you need to air the room, it’s EIGHT PEOPLE inside. Although when it was close and the air was on, it was still really hot. 

I didn’t enjoy the curtains on the beds either, you feel in jail and it’s a weird vibe, claustrophobic.  

Everytime someone went to the bathroom the whole room will smell like sh**t for HOURS, the bathroom doesn’t have ventilation. I was in the bed right next to the bathroom and room door, and I couldn’t sleep the whole night between the smell, the hot air and the rude people that won’t respect and care that there’s other people sleeping there  (not fault of the hostel) 

Conclusion, better look for a hostel that has the bathroom outside or more than just one inside. 
Other advice, book a room with less people. 

I’ve stayed in many hostels before, first time I had to get out of there. 

The terrace is nice and the staff was really nice too.

title: Night bar is a great place to meet people
text:
Nico is very attentive to everyone that comes through the door, encouraging and helping them to join the crowd. I made really good travel companions just hours after arriving, and I'm very happy to have decided to book here because of a similar review I read. 
Beds are comfortable, storage place is adequate and there's more space over the bed with an electronic lock.
The roof is really pretty, but sadly it lacks its own bar (and it's closed during the night), so there is little reason to stay there.

title: Amazing
text: Had an amazing time at People Hostel. The rooms are spacy, very clean and have comfortable beds. The Location is perfect to get around Paris with two metro stations close by. There also many nice restaurants and bistros in the same street. But what made the stay there really remarkable is the social ascpect. The super friendly and opened minded staff does a great job bringing the travelers together so everybody can connect, exchange experiences and plan common activities. All that in multiple languages and always with smile. Simply great! Thanks!

title: Awesome
text:
My experience at The People Bercy was awesome! The crew was super kind and the room and all the facilities were super clean. I strongly recommend it!

Also, I had a problem with a refund and they solved very quickly

title: Well thought out hostel
text:
The staff are super friendly and the amenities are great! There are even safes above each bed. The only downside is that the toilet is in one room and the sink to wash your hands is in another room with the shower so if someone is showering you can't wash your hands. Luckly I had handsanitizer on me otherwise this would have been an issue
 The location is a bit of a treck to Paris attractions but super close to the bus station which is perfect.

title: Amazing!
text: We booked a 8 bed mixed dorm and somehow got upgraded to a family suite. Everything was perfect (clean, spacious, quiet, ...). Check-in was easy going and staff were very friendly. 10/10 would recommend.

title: Immaculate place, not very social for a solo traveller though.
text:
Very nice, clean, professional hostel. Beds were immaculate and very comfy. The bar in reception is nice. Good access to the metro and Paris central train station is 20 min walk. 

One criticism is that it is not particularly social, other hostels I have stayed in run events or social gatherings where you can meet other residents, which is not done here. E.g. the bar was empty at 9pm on Saturday night. But maybe it’s just not that kind of hostel.

title: SUPER amazing place for everyone!
text: Firstly, the team is so incredibly nice, accommodating, and helpful with everything. That combined with the actual room being clean and spacious made our stay absolutely amazing. If you come to Paris, stay at this hostel/hotel.

title: Great hostel
text: I stayed in a mixed dorm of 6 which was very clean and modern, the bunks have their own curtain, safe inside the bunk and light so they are very private and quiet. The rooms also have lockers which are really big. The location of the hostel was great - close to both Dugommier and Daumesnil metro stations and you can get to most of the main tourist sites within 30 minutes and to Versailles in an hour or so, and Gare de Lyon is within walking distance. There’s also lots of shops and a laundrette nearby. The communal areas are quite nice and again modern, although the roof does close at 10pm. Staff were friendly and helpful. My only complaint would be that there is no sink in the toilet meaning you have to use the sink in the shower which is annoying if someone is in the shower. Overall I would say that the hostel was great value for money and I would definitely consider it if returning to Paris again.

title: Excellent!
text: Excellent experience! The hostel is really lovely, positioned between the two metro stations, eassy to find. The staff is nice and helpfull. The rooms are quite big, and the private space is clean and comfortable.

title: Nice place
text: It was Friendly place and clean, just 30 minutes from the center in metro. There is kitchen, share areas, rooftop, and rest area, I really recommend  the place and if you go solo, you always will Meet others

title: Private room good
text: The room was small, but good. You dont need more space for a trip to Paris. You have an own bathroom, a comfortable kingsize bed and a beautiful shared balcony. The bar was always full at the evening. Nice place to stay. The only negative thing was that there is only french TV.

title: Someone else sleep on my bed.
text: I put very important note that I want lower bed which the hotel give me that perfectly, but there's someone else already take my place ( so I have to sleep on upper bed instead). Really disappointed. Not good for first night in Paris.

title: Really great hostel
text:
The room is clean, the bed is confortable.
The bathroom is private in each room and really clean
The rooftop is really nice, the music is cool
Thank you Alenxandre for the early morning coffee
The staff is really nice as well

title: The best hostel I have stayed in
text:
I would recommend this hostel to anybody! It is in a great location with central paris a few minutes away by metro, and it was easy to get to from the airport.

The staff are all so welcoming and friendly, the check in process was really easy, and I was able to leave my bag in a secure locker before my bed was ready and check in properly at midnight no problem.

The room and bathroom were very clean and the beds are comfortable with a decent sized safe and a larger cupboard for your stuff. Each bed is enclosed and has a curtain down one side so it feels very private when it needs to.

The bar/kitchen downstairs are great, and I felt really safe and had fun staying here as a solo traveller. 10/10.

title: The best way to start our holiday
text: My friend and I are travelling across Europe, and this place was our starting point. We were immediately welcomed by the friendly staff and made some great friends here. Will stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

title: Amazing!
text: Amazing hostel, nice and helpful staff, good breakfast, clean rooms, good location. Definitely recommend and would go again! The beds were wide and the lockers were big enough. Overall extremely nice hostel :) I lost my keycard but easily got a new one without extra charge

title: A Restful Stay
text: This place was quiet and very nice. It wasn’t difficult to find and even accommodated my early arrival. The room was clean. This was probably one of the best beds I’ve slept on in a hostel. I even tried to rebook for my trip back through Paris, but they were booked for those days. Would definitely recommend.

title: Great hostel for the price.
text: The staff were so friendly, helpful and welcoming. The rooms were clean and the curtains on the beds helped with privacy. It was a comfortable stay and would definitely recommend.  With the metro a short walk away it makes it a great location.

title: Amazing hostel!
text: I spent just a few days in Paris, but this hostel was a dream. Very accessible to public transport, safe, comfortable, clean, & the staff was lovely! It’s not in the middle of the hustle & bustle of Paris, but it’s very close by transit so you get all the joy experience without being overwhelmed. Would stay again!

title: Highly recommend!
text: The staff here are so welcoming and friendly, the service is great. Great value for money, I stayed in a private room and it was lovely, clean and felt more like a hotel- it had a great view also. Good location, only a short walk from two metro stations. I definitely recommend and would stay again!

title: Excellent budget stay with kids in a great location
text: This place worked well for us as a group of 1 adult and 2 kids, aged 14 and 8, staying for 4 nights. We had a room with 2 bunks, 1 double bed and a self-contained shower and toilet.  It was more than enough for us. The staff were very welcoming and the common facilities were good.  There was a building site next door while we were there (Feb 2022) but the noise was well managed, starting around 8am.

title: So welcoming!!!
text: It was my first time in such accomodation and it was a delightful experience. Very charming, cosy and ideally located near to 2 metro stations. Very clean amenities and welcoming employees. The bartender was really funny and easy going. Only one thing to say, bring a towel with you as they are rented. But for the price I paid it definitely deserved it's five stars!!!

title: One of the highlights of Paris!
text: We were a group of 8 people and we were all amazed with everything The People Hostel offered, from modern premises, nice and helpful staff, clean facilities, comfy bedrooms and beds and great location.

title: Awesome place for solo travels
text:
My time there was great! I met a lot of people everyday and Nico, the bartender, he is awesome at helping shy people to connect. Fully recommended place for solo travels.
It is a good point to have it as your base while visiting Paris. Right next to the metro.

title: Good option
text:
Very good place, clean, the staff is nice and helpful.
The location is exceptional, only a few steps away from the metro. The only thing to say is they need to change de pillows because they are a little bit hard.

title: amazing trip to Paris with Friends
text:
The People Hostel is really charming! Kind and funny staff. Comfortable rooms. 2 terraces, one on the bottom and another on the top floor, where you could see de Tour Eifell.
You can book you breakfast for 7 € or get your own food.
Great atmosphere to socialize as well.
Just 2 minutes walking from de subway!
Thanks a lot mates! you made our stay a pleasure! 
Hope to see you soon! to be honest I'm dying to see you soon! ;)

title: Affordable, clean, friendly
text:
I only needed one night to reset before taking a very long flight back home and this was the perfect place for that. 

Rooms were impeccably clean, tho sparsely furnished. My room had a balcony with a nice view of the streets below. I rented a bed in a 6-bunk dorm, which had its own toilet and shower. The toilet and shower are in separate rooms, but the sink is combined with the shower, which means to wash your hands afterwards you have to visit two rooms. Not too much of an inconvenience unless the shower is occupied. 

Bunks were a comfortable size (I'm 5' 8" or 172 cm) with privacy curtain, some USB outlets, a shelf and a small lockable compartment for small valuables that you can lock with your room card. There were bigger lockers in the room (you need your own lock or you can rent one or leave unlocked), a coat rack, and some stools. That was it for furniture. 

Because it was raining, I didn't get to enjoy the outside common areas but there was plenty of sitting areas on the first floor to work/eat. Also a small kitchen (not meant for many people at a time) and also a lovely bar/cafe to take a drink.

It's the perfect place to reset for a short stay. Very close to two Metro stations, a grocery store and eateries. Front desk staff were very helpful and friendly. Would stay here again!

Note: for my stay in November 2021, you're required to have a passe sanitaire to stay or recent negative COVID test to stay.

title: Great atmosphere, amazing & friendly staff, highly recommended!
text:
Every night going back to the hostel there were people socialising at the bar encouraged by staff which gave my whole stay a great vibe!
Clean, tidy rooms and amenities, super friendly staff and top location (metro stations closeby)
Highly recommended, will surely be back during my next time in Paris!
Nico (staff member) for president!

title: Very good hostel in a convenient location
text:
First of all the location of the hotel is impeccable. It is nearby a major transportation hub (Gare de Lyon) and 2 metro stations.
The bed was outstandingly comfortable. The rooftop has a view over Paris and especially the Eiffel Tower.
There's private bathrooms that were perfect in terms of water pressures and temperature.
I really recommend this place

title: Perfect!
text: It is super clean, people are really polite. So well located, next to the subway.  Private restroom, with a beautiful rooftop from where u can see all paris, also at night the tower. I will come back for sure!.

title: Lovely hostel, friendly staff, perfect facilities, excellent location, especially for coaches from Paris.
text:
This hostel was perfect - the staff were so friendly and positive, treated us like friends from day 1 and were so happy to help us when we had queries. The kitchen is great for cooking your own food with everything you need, and the common areas, both indoor and outdoor, were ideal. A lovely atmosphere - would definitely return! The beds were comfy and cosy, loved the reading light and curtain for privacy, and they had Aircon or a door to open for fresh air. The rooftop was a plus - with a lovely view over Parisian rooftops. 

The hostel is perfectly located near a supermarket, a metro station on line 6 and the Bercy bus station where we took a coach from. 

It was reassuring that they took Covid seriously and everyone was wearing masks in common areas with hand gel in most areas.

Only suggestion would be to provide hand soap for the bathroom, especially in covid times.

title: Great hostel
text: Rooms are very clean, the curtains around your bed add greatly to the privacy. THe staff is nice and very welcoming, reception is staffed 24/7 which was nice. The location is very conveniently near two metro stations, but the neighbourhood itself is also charming. The common area is large and the garden is cute. I'd definately come back here if I were in Paris again!

title: Excellent hostel and very helpfull staff!
text: Nice room and nice hostel overall. With a very helpfull staff ! I 've had some problems in the metro (be careful with your wallet, espacecially on ligne 4 !) and they helped me considerably when i came back at night to the hotel, broke...

title: Great hostel
text: Excellent !! Clean, well organised, quick check in and check out, easy to metro, cheap . We arrived in two families (8 people) and everything worked correctly. Recommended. Skid just for 1 night in Paris!

title: I made a new friend every day I was here. This
text:
I would come back here in a heartbeat! The vibes were so wonderful--everyone I met was friendly and helpful, and I made friends the moment I arrived. This was my first experience in a hostel and I couldn't have asked for a better one! The staff was enthusiastic and friendly--Alex in particular did everything he could to make sure my stay was pleasant and easy. He insisted on helping me with my luggage and trying to mail something home, and I really appreciated it.
The rooms were great--I slept soundly. I appreciated the curtains on the beds to give privacy, and they blocked out all light. The power outlet was easily accessible, as well as plenty of shelf space. There were also lockers for the luggage, but what didn't fit in it I felt comfortable leaving next to my bed. The water pressure from the shower felt like a back massage. The one thing I would recommend is some liquid hand soap or a hand towel in the bathroom. 
Very cute living area and lots of young people and families hanging out! Breakfast wasn't quite worth the price, at least as a vegetarian I would've had to stock up on croissants to get my money's worth, but it's convenient. Happy hour was fun!
All in all, I can't recommend The People Hostel enough. The staff and other guests made it a memorable and fun experience. I am so grateful for my time here!

title: Recommended hostel for young people
text: Recommended hostel for young people and families with evening entertainment and ideal for getting to know other fellow travelers. A lovable place for the young at heart, open-minded people from all over the world.

title: A MUST GO
text:
I still can't believe this place was real. The staff is welcoming, helpfull, the rooftop is amazing, the bar is cheap and they have delicious cocktails, rooms are clean, beds are comfy and the list goes on and on! 
Definitely a must go is you're travelling to Paris!

title: One night in Paris
text: Honestly very well located ( near 6 metro station) and a straight shot to the Eiffel Tower if that’s what you are interested in seeing. Not terribly far from the other airport. People were awesome and the place was clean

title: One day in Paris
text: Even staying for one one day and night in the People hostel I felt warmly welcomed. The staff is polite and attentive. It was warm and clean in the room. There are curtains on the bed that creates some privacy. After checking- out I was allowed to store my luggage in hostel for few more hours. That is really kind. I used this opportunity and went for a walk before leaving Paris. Thank you!

title: Amazing team and hostel
text: The rooms single or dormitory where amazing, clean, space enough. The work team was super sweet and dedicating time to share experience and explain things about the city. I really Recommend  this place !!

title: Good in general
text: I love the facilities and stuff and it is actually a nice place to stay. But my experience could have been better if I didn't find hair of the previous guest on my bed.
