That was pretty gross to me. Also, the fact that we need to do a bed ourselves upon arrival is okay, but quite annoying in fact. Besides, it might be a good idea to change the bedding into some other material, could be softer since the current material makes loud noise each time we turn from side to side and it's not very ideal.

title: Awesome
text: This place looks so new and cute, I've loved everything about it! The bed is pretty comfortable and the rooms are spacious, everything was clean and the staff is kind. The roof where you can see the Eiffel Tower is a gem. I highly reccomend it.

title: The best Hostel that I’ve ever been
text: Clean rooms with privacy curtains for each bed. A minute away from Dugommier metro station which is in the same metro line with Eiffel Tower .Lovely and welcoming staff. I really enjoyed staying there. I definitely recommend the place eyes closed!

title: lovely
text: Great,  friendly, very clean place to stay in Paris. Near a metro to get to the sites. Some local resterants nearby. Option of individuel rooms or dormatries. Many of the rooms have a small balcony with street views.  Recommand highly.

title: Brilliant for the price!
text:
Loved staying at the people's hostel!
It is VERY clean! Love the curtains that are attached to the bed. Blankets are nice and warm. Bathroom includes a hairdryer. The room looks brand new. There are even some hangers! Lockers are big enough.
Wish there would have been a big body mirror in the room :/ totally missing here!!
Breakfast was OK. Some juice, coffee, baguettes and crossaints. Staff is very friendly.
Towel rental is 4€+10€ (get 10€back after towel returned)
Is quite far outside the center and far from all the sights but definitely doable with the metro wich is near the hostel.
I'm a female solo traveller and was booked in a 6mixed dorm. Always felt safe and would recommend staying here!

title: Superb!!!
text: I booked for my son to stay at this hostel for 3 nights. He was very satisfied. The staff were friendly and accommodating. The room is clean and the bed is very comfortable according to my son. The Hostel itself is near metro station.

title: Pleasant and quiet, nice view
text:
I'm satisfied of my stay at this hostel that provides good service and wide, cosy, well-lit rooms (with services) for good prices. I had to arrange one extra night after my check-out had been done, which was easily arranged (10% off if reserving on the spot). The building has few spacious rooms for each of its 8 floors, connected by lift and stairs. The 8th floor hosts a rooftop with a nice view; the 12th arr. is about 30 minutes from Notre Dame but you can see the top of the Tour and typical Parisian streets. It is not a touristic area, but it's perfectly safe and you can enjoy of a glimpse of 'everyday' Paris, with a nice market just outside of the hostel. There are two métro connections, Daumesnil and Dugommier, and Gare de Lyon is just a couple stops away. Well equipped with supermarkets and bars. 
In just 5 minutes walking you can reach the Parisian 'high line' on a former railway track, walk all the way to Place the la Bastille, and get to the heart of Paris.

The hostel is clean and quiet, comfy beds have a curtain for more privacy and small side shelves. Unlike many hostels, luggages won't pack up the place, even in shared dorms. There are sockets enough, mind that the USB access won't necessarily work as a charge (happened to my camera, to my great dismay!).

There is a small kitchen at the ground floor, a small but cosy common area, books, and a bar. Average customers: 30-sths in mid-November. Great choice unless you want a place to party.

title: Good value for money in Paris
text:
Nice stay at the People Hostel. Kitchen has 2 microwaves and 2 ovens (no stove) and a large refrigerator with also a large freezer. For meals, it is perfect. I stayed in the female 8 bed dorm. It is very good that each bed has a curtain, so you do not wake up if someone turns on the light. I appreciated it very much and could sleep much better than in previous hostels. It is good that the hostel is located 10 minute walk from the station Bercy. Line 14 of the metro runs there and this line is automatic (no driver) so it is not affected by the metro. Also a stop of the line 1 (automatic too) called Reully Diderot is like 20 minute away on foot. There were bus stops close by so it was possible to go to all places I wanted despite the strike. There is a small monoprix market like 2 minute away from the hostel but my friend said that Monoprix is a very expensive market. I would try to look for other alternatives. But it has the basics. Only things that bothered me were:
- Locker by the bed is minimal in size, not even a purse can be locked there, just for some money, passport, etc.
- Architecture of the room did not make sense for me. There was a shower room and a toilet room, however, the toilet room really only had the toilet, no sink to wash your hands. The sink was in the shower room. Sadly no showers in the floors, so we had to share the toilet and shower in the room for 8. At least there was a toilet in the ground floor so I used it in case the toilet in the room was occupied.

title: Everyone is so friendly
text: This was my first stay at a hostel and it was a great experience. The staff were very friendly and in general their positive attitude made everyone else very friendly and helpful. Although most people are solo travellers, no one feels alone here! The hostel was very clean and the rooms were comfortable. Although there were metro strikes while i stayed, the hostel had bus stops and other metro options to choose from, all within walking distance.

title: Friendly place
text: The people's hostel is a great place for those who love the bar and new peoples. It was close to the metro station but very far from the Eiffel Tower and other tourist destinations. Overall it was clean but the bed was not clean, there were hairs on the bed when I checked-in, I didn't complain about it as I was there for 1 night. The doors are noisy when you close them. Beds are comfortable but the lockers are very small on the bedside that you cannot fit your laptop bag in them.

title: Excellence
text: Very nice, moderne androgynous comfortable place. Very kind stuff! Thank you!  Breakfast is very good , i recommended! Large  and space room,  comfortable bed ! Very satisfied  ! Good for the money !###########$#

title: The best first experience in a hostel i could imagine
text:
It was my first time in a hostel, because i had an early train to catch at Gare de Lyon. The location was very accessible and for 40€ it was a perfect stay. It was a completely new experience to indeed sleep as if i was in a cubicle. But i slept so well. Of course there is noise with other people coming in and leaving at different times, but it is part of the experience (so bring your earplugs). But i had a light that only shown on my bed so i wasn't disturbing anyone. I had a charging plug, a usb plug, a shelf with a safe and a mirror, all in my tiny area. It was incredible! And very clean! I was very tired so i didn't explore much further, but there was a bar and restaurant that had a lot of people interacting with each other, so a great place to be if you are travelling alone as well! 
The only thing i did not like was that i had to pay 4€ to rent a towel for one shower, every little thing you wanted had a high price added for something so simple.

title: Excellent Hostel
text: This was the first hostel I ever stayed at. It was amazing and set the bar high for all other hostels. Super clean. Loved the security curtain for each bed. There was a small confusion when I first checked in(they gave me the wrong bed number), but it was easily fixed.

title: Nice place for one night
text:
I stayed there for one night, before my flight next morning. Actually i liked the concept, it's a dormitory but in the same time you have your private space / hub. it's well isolated and well connected (USB, power plug, lighting, locker...) 
the mattress is extremely comfy, and the shower and toilets are private to the room only not the whole floor. 
The only problem was in the shower floor, it was similar to a swimming pool, with a problem in the water drainage. Hope this problem will be fixed

title: Excellent hostel
text: Had to book somewhere on the day of arrival and found this hostel. Excellent location very close to metro, clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again. Market in the same street. Restaurants close by but area is quiet so had a good night's sleep

title: Brand new hostel
text:
I stayed in a female dorm when it had been open only a few days and loved it. Yes, they were still finishing up the final touches in the kitchen, laundry and luggage room, but they worked with what they had avalible and I know once that is all complete it would be perfect (I'm sure by now it is all complete).  Being brand new it was super clean and the bed for a dorm was amazingly comfy with a great addition of a privacy curtain. Each bed had their own valuable locker, adjustable lighting and power outlets, a very well planned bunk. The staff were super friendly and very helpful. Gave me plenty of advice on where to get away from the busy tourist areas which I loved. 
Thanks for a great stay!  I'll be sure to recommend and stay again if in Paris.

title: Amazing place
text:
Rooms are amazing, beds awesome, the rooftop gives me chills. By the way, you wouldn’t stop by the bar.
Don’t hesitate to ask where the Chilian staff comes from...
And please, try to reach the 8th floor

title: Thé best journey
text: I had à great time in Paris here! Or was wonderful!!! Really enjoy y trip there! You have to go there if you want to visit Paris. The rooftop is amasing so you have to go thème. Prices are really cheap. It's time To go!!!

title: The best hostel in Paris
text: I spend a lot of time in Paris since 5 years and this hostel is the best I can try !! Everything is good. There is a really nice staff : kind, professional and funny. Je recommande plutôt deux fois qu’une !

title: Beautiful walking stay in Paris
text:
Finally arrived in Paris for our 30th anniversary (2 years late ;-)
Walked miles through shopping, museums, parks and cafes.  
Highlights included the Louvre, Eiffel Tower, walk around Notre-Dame and the Pantheon.  
Thoroughly enjoyed the cafés and restaurants.   
Can’t wait to get back!

title: Mrs
text: The hotel is well located right in the city centre which is very convenient. The breakfast are okay but it would be nice to have dinner as well. The room service and other services are generally very nice as well.

title: Excellent value in superb locatrion
text: Friendly staff, good value, fine location for visiting all the central sights. No need for Metro or taxis. Everywhere central is within walking distance. Room at front have wonderful views. Ours at the rear, on this occasion, had lots of light and was not enclosed in courtyard or similar.

title: Expectations are key
text: If you know that the hotel does not look like the photos, you will be less disappointed when you arrive. Spectacular location near the Louvre but appearance falls pretty short of expectations. The staff is welcoming, but the lounge is stale and warm. The “bar” is a cabinet in one corner that is manned only when you ask reception staff to come make a drink.  None of our group’s rooms looked anything like the website photos. The advertised “air conditioning” exists but functions only in certain guestrooms.   It’s a solid 5 that photographs like an 8. Just know that.

title: Wonderful accomodation
text:
We had a wonderful experience at the beautiful hotel.  From the moment we arrived the staff were warm and welcoming.  The buffet breakfast was delicious and set us up for a busy day ahead.  The bed was comfortable and a great relief after a day of exploring Paris. 

I would like to acknowledge Jean-luc, he was delightful and attentive and his smile and joyful nature made our stay even more special.  Our time at the hotel Brighton was everything we wanted and more.  I highly recommend a stay at the hotel Brighton.

title: Excellent stay again
text: This was our third stay at Hotel Brighton. Junior suite was perfect for a 3 person family and the views to the Louvre, Tuileries and Eiffel tower excellent. Service was very good. Hope to return soon.

title: Excellent boutique hotel
text:
Location location location 
A very charming , centric hotel which is walking distance to all the major attractions. It is located in a very safe neighborhood with plethora of restaurants and shops. Moreover, there is a metro stop right across the street. I’ll be staying there again on my next visit for sure.

title: Lovely Hotel but......
text: Hotel Brighton is a lovely well run establishment.  Having said that, we did not realize during July and August a carnival would be going on across the street.  Yes they have air-conditioning, but when the outside temperatures are over 90 it cannot keep up.  We payed extra for a generously sized room on the 5th floor and it was lovely, but we seldom got the temperature below 85.  During the morning we could open our windows but at night had to leave them closed due to the noise of the carnival which went on until after midnight.  Even with earplugs in, it could still be heard.  Fans in the rooms would at least give some air flow and mask the outside noise.

title: Disappointed about not being informed....
text: Very good hotel overall, but we were not told that our room (#10) was actually under the arcade that surrounds to hotel.  So there was no view at all of the Tuileries, just a very restricted view that did not even really include de Rue Rivoli itself.  People booking should be told they would be put into these rooms on the mezzanine floor since it effectively provides no view at all.  Not being told is just very poor business practice--and reinforced somewhat the feeling that the hotel is cutting corners just to make extra money from tourists.  Our room was #10.  Avoid.  Also, there seems to be some room above Room #10 that is being used for housekeeping that woke us up a few times--nothing particularly annoying but still, for 500 euros a night one shouldn't have to deal with this--or at least, once again, be told in advance....

title: Location, Staff excellent. Room needed refurbishment
text: Great location, fantastic staff, public areas lovely - but - room needed a refurbishment. Carpet stained, wet patch by bathroom door, rough tiling in bathroom, sink plug not working. For the money, not cheap!, details really matter.

title: Paris Fashion District Hotel
text: Outstanding.  Everything was as advertised.  Staff took care of our every needs.  Great location.  Felt very safe to walk around at night with no problems.  Room was just the right size for one person.  Breakfast was delightful and available on your own schedule.

title: Family trip
text: An absolutely magical, beautiful and warm hotel. Staff, facilities all superb! The room was spectacular, so much space, air conditioned and so very homely. Already booked for our second visit! Merci!!

title: Will definitely stay here again
text:
This hotel is in a great location, the service is great and the beds are comfortable. The lady with the beautiful body filled black hair (wish I remembered her name) at the front desk was wonderful! 
I suggest having breakfast included in your reservation.

title: Wonderful hotel in the perfect location
text: Excellent location near all of the best shopping and sightseeing in Paris!  Beautiful large room. We had a Junior Suite with courtyard view so there was really no view but the room itself was huge for Paris and decorated beautifully and very quiet.  Very comfortable beds and every amenity you need.  The breakfast was so delicious and many choices!  We felt so safe and the staff is so wonderful and friendly.  The concierge helped us with reservations and they were perfect.  Don’t expect to have afternoon/evening aperitifs in the lobby though. We tried and the hotel isn’t well equipped for that.  But we enjoyed our stay so much and can’t wait to return.  Don’t hesitate to stay here.  Next time we will book a room with a view...the views are insane!

title: Hotel Brighton, Paris
text: Our stay here was a delight due to the extraordinary front desk staff, the excellent location and the quality of the hotel itself.  We had a lovely corner room that gave us a view of Rue d'Alger, the Tuileries Garden and the Louvre.  The line 1 Metro was steps away and was so convenient for us to travel to all the sites we had planned.

title: Hotel Brighton -- perfect place to stay in Paris
text: Excellent and elegant hotel, perfect location on the Rue de Rivoli, spacious Junior Suite with all the amenities you could want, warm and welcoming staff met our every need. We will definitely stay here again.

title: Excellent hotel in the heart of Paris
text: The Hotel Brighton is an excellent hotel, located perfectly for exploring the city. Easy access to key attractions (e.g., Louvre, Tuelleries Gardens, Eiffel Tower), but also good if you want to visit areas such as the Marais, Ile Saint Louis or the Latin Quarter.

title: Very beautiful and peaceful hotel!
text:
I was a guest on June.Visiting for professional reasons.
The hotel is clean and beautiful.In a great location.Stuff very warm and polite.Breakfast good and the spa is one of the best.
Definitely i will visit again.

title: Location!   Get a room with a balcony and a view Of Paris and you will remember it forever.
text: The room with a balcony overlooking Paris is magical.   From the Louvre to the Eiffel Tower - best view imaginable    The hotel is a bit old and has issue (air conditioning, lights needing fixed) but staff was very helpful and accommodating!    I would stay there again.

title: first time to Paris
text: Excellent location near all of the popular attractions and shopping.  Highly recommend paying for a room or suite with a view.  Could see Louvre, Tuleries Garden and Eiffel Tower from room. We chose to include breakfast which was convenient each morning.

title: Family trip to Paris
text: The Brighton was absolutely the most perfect place to stay in Paris. The location was ideal, within walking distance to most major sights. The room was generously sized and well-appointed. The overall service was exceptional and the staff were most welcoming. We would highly recommend the hotel and plan to return on a future trip.

title: Excellent experience
text: This hotel was outstanding in every way. The room was lovely , well appointed and super clean. The staff were extremely helpful and the location couldn’t be  better. Breakfast was delicious, a large selection in an elegant setting. We will definitely stay here again on our next visit to Paris

title: Perfect stay
text: Second time staying at this lovely hotel and I cannot recommend it enough. Clean comfortable rooms, lovely breakfast, perfect location and staff for whom nothing is too much trouble. Will certainly be returning.

About a month ago, we stayed at the hotel, 4 families with 6 children. The location of the hotel is ideal, central, close to many sites. The rooms were large and clean, I would add a sofa to the suites, beyond the chairs that were in them to make it more comfortable.
The hotel staff was very courteous and professional, I would especially like to mention one of the receptionists, Frederique, who went above and beyond to help us with anything we asked for, with professionalism, pleasantness and courtesy.

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Great location facing the Tuileries gardens. Metro station across the street.
Beautiful rooms, decorated with beautiful furniture. The rooms are very comfortable. Very rich and tasty breakfast. The staff was very welcoming helpful and courteous

title: Beautiful hotel in a beautiful city
text:
We spend 6 nights in hotel brighton. After first 4 nights , we went for a weekend trip and had made booking for 2 more nights at another hotel in paris. But we were so happy and  impressed by brighton that we preferred to stay again at brighton.
 It is a beautiful clean hotel. The staff is wonderful, helpful and courteous. Staff is ready to help out always. They have a 24 hour front desk which is super. Breakfast was very good  and tasty. We stayed in the family room, which was very spacious and comfortable for a family of 4. The location is very central and close to tuileries gardens, musee d orsay metro to catch RER to travel to versailles. Louvre museum is few minutes walk. Lots of great cafes  and restaurants to eat. Very safe location , even walking back to the hotel at 10:30 pm felt safe. Angelina and laduree right round the corner.

title: Beautiful Brighton
text: Just got back from Paris last night. My friend and I stayed six nights at the Brighton. I suppose I should rave about other things but the staff comes first. What a wonderful team of staff. The owners should be very proud. I want to single out Sultana from the front desk who solved a messy problem for us. She was really helpful. We loved the room, the view and the location. Breakfast was amazing. If I could come once a year I would always stay at this great hotel.

title: Excellent Parisian Hotel with Superb Location
text: My wife and I selected Hotel Brighton because of its superb location.  It is adjacent to the Tuileries Gardens and within easy walking distance of the Louvre, restaurants and shopping.  The Tuileries Metro stop is across the street from the hotel, so all of Paris is within easy reach.  We were very pleased with the accommodations.  Our room was well-appointed and comfortable. The hotel staff was friendly, professional and always helpful.  We included breakfast with our room rate and were pleased with the selection and quality of food.  In summary, we were happy to have selected Hotel Brighton.

title: Great location, beautiful views. and very helpful staff!
text: The title says it all.  We have stayed here for many trips over many years!  It is truly like our pied de terre in Paris.  A very good value in a wonderful setting.  A special shout out to Sultana for her assistance with our trip.

title: Beautiful Hotel in a Great Location
text: I had an incredible stay at Hotel Brighton. The hotel is perfectly located right next to the Tuileries and the area is beautiful. The room was beautiful as well, clean and well equipped. The staff were super nice and helpful. I would highly recommend the hotel and would definitely come back!

title: Beautiful Hotel
text: What an incredible stay!  My husband and I stayed 3 nights in this fantastic location and beautiful room.  Our room was perfect.  We had a small balcony with a view over the Tullieres park from the Louvre to the Eiffel Tower.  The hotel was very clean, well taken care of and the staff incredible and super friendly and helpful.  The location to all things important to see in Paris was unbeatable. Also, don't miss the breakfast!

title: Unforgettable stay!!!
text:
Everything was amazing!! 
The hotel is located in a beautiful area!
But what really made our stay unforgettable was when Sultana upgraded our room to another one with a marvellous view! That made me and my daughter so so happy!!
Sultana, thanks for everything!!!

title: The Best view and service
text: Hotel Brighton welcomed us so warmly. We had the Louvre Suite which gave a breathtaking view of The Louvre, Jadrin Tuileries, the Eiffel Tower and so much more. The room was spacious and we loved having an espresso machine. Everyone at the hotel was friendly and helpful. Merci!!

title: Great stay for a great value!
text: Hotel Brighton is located on Rue de Rivoli, across from Tuileries Garden, which means you have quick access to the Tuileries Metro station, the Louvre to the east, Place de la Concorde to the west, Rue Saint Honore on the north, and Musee D'Orsay to the south. What better location is that! What I also found interesting was that there are a lot of hotels in the area, notably a popular five-star hotel that charges more than 1000 Euros a night, and yet Hotel Brighton has all the benefits of location, friendly staff, and comfortable rooms without the five-star prices. So many attraction are within walking distance, and close access to the metro is a big plus. Of note, Musee D'Orsay (only about a 10-15 minute walk across Tuileries Garden) has a RER train station which I used to go to Versailles. I decided to treat myself and get the deluxe room facing Tuileries garden, and I was placed on the top floor with a gorgeous view and balcony. In addition, the staff were very friendly and always offered assistance when needed. Breakfast was a bit steep in price, but that's the price you pay for convenience, especially since some of the mornings I was there, it was raining and I didn't feel like going out. Thank you to everyone at Hotel Brighton for making me feel welcome and safe in Paris.

title: Ideal hotel - great location, fantastic room, incredible views, friendly staff
text: We had a high floor and the view is incredible. Located close to a lot of the significant landmarks in central Paris. Shopping - depending on your situation it could be good or bad that one of the premium shopping locations is situated right behind the hotel.

title: My Favourite!
text: The view is just outstanding, and the staff are multi-lingual and very nice.  The room service breakfast looking out over the Jardins des Tuileries was especially memorable.  My favourite hotel in Paris.

title: Wonderful stay
text:
The overall stay was excellent. The hotel staff was very friendly. The hotel dining room is a bit small but the rooms and their views were as expected.
The location is superb as it is close to Place Vendome and Louvre Museum. I highly recommend the hotel. If I return to Paris I will stay there again.

title: Really Wonderful Hotel
text: We absolutely loved staying at the Hotel Brighton. We were treated with kindness by the staff who spoke very good English but were also very kind when I wanted to practice my French. The hotel is small but charming. We stayed in the Louvre suite and the view of Paris took our breath away. The bathroom is very large esp for Europe and our teenagers loved the speakers in the bathroom. The closet and storage space was very good as well. I will definitely stay here in the future. Thank you, Hotel Brighton, for making our stay a delight!

title: room with a view
text: We had a 2 night stay in the Brighton. We asked form a double bed room with a sleeping-couch for our son. That was perfect, we had a big room, big bathroom and the view was magnificent. You could see from the louvre over musée d'Orsay to the eifeltower.... The room could be updated and maybe they should have more tables in the breakfast room... Overall very good stay, we would book here again.

title: Good location
text:
Very good location. Amazing view. We actually had a good stay, but the hotel is not like they show in the pictures… I was a bit disappointed. The chairs at the dinnng room are not for a 4 stars hotel…

The staff at the restaurant very friendly.  

The coffe wayTOO expensive 8 €

title: Great location but tired
text: Great location and I’m sure the views are wonderful if you have a room overlooking the jardin des Tuileries.  I didn’t.  The hotel is in need of a refurb - my room was tatty and one of the lifts didn’t work for much of my stay.  The breakfast buffet was good but the coffee average and I didn’t realise until after I’d finished that I could have ordered a boiled egg instead of the scrambled egg that had been sitting there for sometime. Service was hit and miss. And it all lacks ambience not helped by a characterless front communal area.  It’s all a bit tired and not good value.

title: The most amazing views of Paris
text: My stay at the Bright was memorable. The room was spacious, extremely clean and very well equipped. The service was warm, friendly and helpful. The location is outstanding. BUT the VIEWS!!! There were the reason why I booked this hotel and they are incomparable! My room was facing the city, on Rue de Rivoli right directly onto Le Jardin des Tuileries, with unobstructed views of the Eifel tower, the Musée d'Orsay and the Louvre.

title: Wonderful views - room needs update
text:
Excellent and welcoming staff. Beautiful views of the Tuileries,  Eiffel Tower,  and Louvre. Room 511 needs an uplift, however. The room decor, carpet, chairs are outdated needs a lift. Some outlets did not work as well as some light switches. 
Excellent location.

title: Not 4*, more like a 3*
text:
The location is very good. Outdated inside especially the bathroom. We travelled a lot and I wouldn't give 4* to this hotel. Terrible soundproof, we heard every word of a phone conversation next door. 
The staff was very good and helpful. Breakfast was very good too.

title: Amazing Hotel
text: This hotel was absolutely amazing. The location is fantastic and the view from our balcony was stunning - we could see the Eiffel Tower, Gardens and Louvre. The room was spacious, everything was impeccably clean and very comfortable. We had breakfast included and it was really delicious. The hotel was also very kind to hold our bags on the day we left. We would HIGHLY recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Paris!

title: Wonderful
text: Extremely charming hotel perfectly located with excellent and welcoming staff. Beautifully decorated room which was very quiet and comfortable with view of the Tuileries. Lovely Paris experience with easy access to sites and shops.

title: Doing its very best
text: Like so much of Paris, the Hotel Brighton is doing its very best to get back to "normal". As ever, the staff are first class and the facilities well run and professional. We will be back - again! Thank you.

title: Great alternative to a 5-star
text: This is a great alternative to a 5-star. Superb  location, good service and attentive staff. Choose your room carefully, some are tiny and dark, others are spacious and luminous. Breakfast is very complete. Will come back!

title: Loved it
text: This is a beautiful hotel and located right across from the park Tuileries and very close to the louvre. We walked everywhere from here including the champs élysées to the arc de triomphe and to the Eiffel Tower. We didn’t have breakfast so cannot comment on it.

title: Perfect place for a short or long trip.The breakfast,the staff are just Perfect!
text: Perfect place for a short or long trip!Very friendly staff,amazing breakfast!Everybody has to try and stay there!Best location in Paris,very good restaurants,shops nearby.Its safety to go outside by night as well!Go to Hotel Brighton and enjoy the Luxury!

title: Excellent
text: We loved it from beginning to the end. Friendly personnel, close to everything we wanted. Very good breakfasts. Will come back and certainly recommend this hotel to people. The only desagremen was the noise of the picking of bins on the street

title: The View Alone is Worth It
text: The view from our junior suite was absolutely stunning.  This, coupled with the beautiful, spacious, comfortable room, made our stay very special.  We try to visit Paris every couple of years trying different hotels.  It’s going to be hard to beat this place.  We really hope we can stay here again.

title: Hotel Brighton
text: Brighton is a wonderful hotel, with a courteous and helpful staff. Its location is perfect for exploring Paris by foot. Our room was extremely comfortable and well appointed.  We will stay here again!!

title: Excellent hotel!
text: Great location, excellent value and wonderful staff.   We opted for one of the upgraded rooms which was very large, fantastic view and a relative bargain by Paris standards.  Hotel is top notch on all fronts

title: Mesmerizing
text: What a wonderful place to stay in Paris. We stayed in junior suite w a view and the view is grandieur. We have an expansive view of the Louvre, Jardin de Tuileries and Eiffel Tower. The staff was very nice and accommodating. There was a tall young gentleman that was so helpful in everywhich way. I forgot his name and I want to say thank you but didn’t get a chance. Can’t wait to come back here next time.

title: Very good hotel!
text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Brighton. The rooms are very comfortable and quiet, the people helpfull and professional and the location is perfect. I recommend this hotel and will come back there for my next trip in Paris.

title: Worth it!!!
text:
Service attention is impeccable from the bellman to the housekeeper, Impressive.
Drink are tasty and well executed, the bar staff is very attentive and surprisingly, I feel in love with this place because the attention to quality. Is true that is not cheapest place but it totally worth it!!!

title: Amazing Staff
text: We loved the location and our room was perfect. The main reason I'm writing a review is because I was extremely impressed by the kind and courteous staff. I didn't catch the manager's name but (in addition to being a fellow NYC marathon participant) he went above and beyond the call of duty in making sure we were comfortable. A very enjoyable stay and highly recommended!!

title: Fabulous boutique hotel
text: Hotel Brighton is located in the center of the 1st arrondissment and our room on the 3rd floor provided stunning views over the Tuilerie Gardens and over to the Louvre on one side and the Eiffel Tower to the other.  The room and bathroom were both generous in size by European standards and beautifully decorated.  The hospitality was warm and the breakfast room and offering perfect in every way.  An absolute gem of a find, we will be back for the next special occasion!

title: Fantastic time in Paris
text:
Our stay at Hotel Brighton was absolutely perfect in every way.  Fantastic location - we walked to many places which was very convenient; Top-notch staff - every single person working there was extremely friendly and helpful. They went out of their way for us and it was much appreciated since this was our first time in France; Historic charm but with a cool modern lobby and lovely rooms - everything was very clean and well maintained. 
Overall a great place that I highly recommend.

title: Parisian hospitality
text: Everyone from housekeeping to check in were pleasant and accommodating.    Room was large with balcony and large bathroom.  Close to all of Paris in any direction.  Plan on staying there again.  A gem of a hotel.

title: Perfect Parisian Small hotel
text: Beautifully appointed lobby, perfect location, extremely responsive staff. A lovely small hotel. The desk arranged for cars to pick us up and take us back to CDG airport. Walking distance to Everything! Would definitely stay again!

title: Excellent Hotel and Services
text:
Our one-week stay in Paris was fabulous.  Hotel Brighton staff was very helpful and friendly.  Breakfast excellent.  Museums and shopping within walking distance.
Highly recommended. Looking forward to a return visit.

title: Happy with our choice
text: This is one great hotel to stay in. The location is Excellent, the staff are amazingly helpful, the breakfast is highly recommended with fresh quality food and our room was spacious and comfortable overlooking the city of Paris. It will be on our list to come back to.

title: We had a lovely stay at Hotel Brighton
text: We had booked a room at La Tamise around the corner on Hotel.com, but when we arrived found the hotel closed for  refurbishment and saw a sign telling us that we were to go to Brighton around the corner. So we did and were very happy with our accommodation. The room was lovely and very comfortable…wonderful bedding, air conditioning in the room was great, and wonderful bathroom appointments. The staff was very friendly and courteous and went out of their way to greet us every time we came through and to make sure we were  being taken care of. The continental breakfast was lovely, with fresh squeezed orange juice, coffee and delicious pastries. We highly recommend the hotel to others and hope to return!

title: Perfect for Tour de France viewing
text: I am finally reviewing this hotel for those interested in a balcony viewing of the TdF. We stayed here for the Tour summer 2018. This hotel is in an excellent location for the end of the race and the final repeated loops. Also easy accessibility to many highlights of this beautiful city. Easy walk through the Tuileries gardens to the Louvre. View the Eiffel Tower in the distance from a Tuileries Garden View Room. The balcony is only about a foot deep so no chairs.  My husband and I stood comfortably sipping champagne while watching the cyclists wiz by us below. Hotel was clean and staff was helpful. Only down side is the amusement park right across the street adjacent to gardens. It got noisy, especially at night but the windows are sound proof and do block out the noise when you close them. Main purpose of our stay was the Tour so we were very pleased.

title: EXCELLENT
text: Very central to everything you want to see in Paris. Deliberately selected this hotel as walking distance to highlights and  lovely gardens across the road.  Services at hotel exceptional and  friendly staff. Surrounding services, cafes, restaurants for breakfast and dining were delicious.  French fare to tempt the tastebuds and we were not disappointed with selections on offer. Very happy memories of this hotel.

title: Excellent in all regards
text: Hotel Brighton is our choice for lodging when in Paris. An excellent location for touring and dining with most Paris attractions readily available via Metro, with a station across the street from the hotel. The rooms are very comfortable and well appointed. Great breakfast with great variety for all tastes. The staff at Hotel Brighton is the best we have experienced through our many travels - polite, friendly, professional, and always helpful. We truly enjoy Hotel Brighton!

title: Superb location
text: This is a lovely hotel situated in a fantastic location with extraordinary views from the rooms overlooking the Jardin des Tuileries, including the Tour Eiffel, Les Invalides, Musee D’Orsey and of course the Louvre.  Easy walking distance to all the central Parisian sites of interest.  Friendly staff, well appointed rooms and excellent breakfast.

title: A perfect choice !
text: A very stylish hotel, the perfect location for trips in Paris.  ALWAYS very friendly and helpfull at the reception, during the delicious breakfast and an enthusiastic room staff. They really strive for perfection.  And don't forget the view of the room on the Eiffel Tower and the rest of Paris is breathtaking.  We recommend Hotel Brighton and will return on our next visit to Paris.  No doubt !

title: An excellent choice for a stay in Paris
text: Great hotel and the Executive Suite is well worth the price for the view and the space. The breakfast was excellent. It was a great value for the money. The staff was excellent, most of all Rodrigo at the front desk, the manager of the breakfast area and George in the breakfast area. The location provides easy access to the Metro or to walk to most of the important areas.

title: Very nice!
text: Very nice boutique hotel across from the Tuileries Gardens and the Louvre. Friendly staff, clean and comfortable room for a good price.  The location of this hotel is the great for touring Paris. There are a lot of restaurants nearby and there are a lot of bikes and scooters for rent near the hotel as well. I think the hotel also has bikes if you need them.

title: Excellent  Hotel
text:
I stayed at the Hotel Brighton in a room overlooking Rue De Rivoli and the Tuileries Gardens. From the moment I arrived I felt welcome. Reception staff were courteous, friendly and informative. 

The room I booked and received was spacious enough for 1-2 people. Extremely clean with comfortable beds, linen,  and furnishings. It felt like living in my own Paris apartment. The bathroom was clean and freshly decorated. I was more than satisfied. I would definitely return again and again it my stay was so comfortable. The Decor was elegant and comfortable. 

The service I received was exceptional. Room service was quick and the staff went out of their way to accommodate my requests. 

The location is great with all the main attractions within a few miles. 

The only drawback was the food. I ordered the continental breakfast which was fine but the few times I ordered dinner it was only average. However since I was out most of the time it was not an issue. It did not in any way affect my stay. 

Wonderful hotel. Hope to return soon.

title: Parfait!
text:
Excellent location, prompt and courteous staff, lovely petite dejeuner.
Rooms are clean and comfy.
Beds are soft.
Petite coin in each room..
The ambiance is quiet - except don't leave your windows open at night, if you have
a room that overlooks the Rue de Rivoli. The traffic overnight will be noisy.

title: Wonderful small hotel
text: Perfect for two friends visiting Paris for six days. Not ultra fancy but oh so charming. Staff is friendly and so (no shower i room-tub w handheld head) was responded to within minutes and breakfast was just delicious. Most impressive was the sincere desire  very welcoming. Request for tub maton part of staff to insure my friend and i had everything we needed. What a pleasant experience...and of course the location was perfect.

title: Daughters 21st trip to paris with mother
text:
Myself and my daughter stayed at the brighton paris for 2 glorious nights in feb. 
From the time we arrived we were greeted with genuine friendly faces and excellent professionalism. 
Sylvie was the receptionist who greeted us when we arrived and she was friendly face. She gave us the great news the hotel was giving us an upgrade because it was my daughters birthday. With a views of the gardens and eiffel tower. So we were so trilled with this. 
When we arrived to the room it was bright , luxurious, excellent views. 
Breakfast was really good too with great selections to choose from, and good quality. 
We have to give Jean luke a mention too as he was always smiling and was excellent interacting with customers but but not over the top. Just right. 
The hotel manager gave us a completely drink for my daughters birthday also, which was a lovely gesture, that was very kind. 
Our flight was late in the evening so the hotel reception staff looked after our luggage for the day while we did more shopping. 
When we arrived back the staff gave us complimentary bottles of water as we looked tired after all that shopping.
I cant say enought good about this hotel and the staff. They all seem so happy in their work and all very suited to this industry. I have set the standards high now for next visit but it will have to be the brighton hotel paris for me for any future visits, as we just loved the place. Cant wait to come back.

title: Lovely Hotel for Visiting Paris
text: An excellent hotel to stay. Hotel employees are all so nice, friendly and helpful. The location of Hotel Brighton is very best for visiting Paris. The hotel food is terrific. The room and bathroom are so big. We will stay there again and again next times.

title: An excellent hotel expierence.
text: Hotel is in close proximity of all the major attractions and has wonderful views as soon as you step out the hotel door. I had a wonderful time in Paris and the staff and hotel played a key role in the experience.

title: Very comfortable hotel in great location
text: A very comfortable hotel in a great location, within walking distance of many of the most popular sites in Paris such as the Louvre, the Musée d’Orsay and the Orangerie. The staff are very friendly and helpful.

title: Great hotel in excellent location
text:
Terrific and helpful staff, comfortable rooms and really really good room service.

Just a stones throw from the Louvre and across the road from the Tuileries gardens, couldn’t be better located. Close to a metro station too!

title: Great value
text:
We stayed for a couple  of nights in July and were pleasantly surprised. Wonderful location close to the Arc de Tryomph, great staff and service, beautiful breakfast and we loved our rom, which was very clean and tastefully decorated.
Highly recommend!

title: An excellent property, very central.
text: Le Tsuba was such a pleasant surprise. Our stay was absolutely perfect. We were a group of 6 adults and 5 children and everything about the property was excellent. From the size and quality of the rooms, to the location of the hotel, to the friendliness of the staff. I have stayed in other hotels in Paris during this trip as well as in the past, and this property is now my favorite. I will definitely stay here again.

title: Great place
text: Great place to stay. Close to a lot of things, attractions, restaurants and metro. Very clean and tidy. Friendly staff. Breakfast included which was very good. Nice view from top floors. Service was nice.

title: Qin
text:
The staff are very friendly and very helpful, nothing to complain, very convenient location, I just enjoy everything here, will be back again when I visit Paris.
The only thing is that the night noises near the street, someone yelling during the midnight.

title: Amazing hotel and staff!
text: We celebrated our post wedding night in Le tsuba hotel. From the moment of check in until check out, the staff were amazing.  They prepared our bed with lovely red petals.   We loved the room - pristine clean and smells very new. Bathroom is modern. Location was great too since its near the sightseeing spots and lovely cafes around the area.

title: Comfortable stay in Paris
text: The hotel was very nice and clean and it was very central and close to the metro. The staff were very polite and friendly. The only comment I wanted to add, which might sound pedantic, is that although while booking, I wrote that my husband and I were on our honeymoon, we were not given any special treatment which is normally custom when a couple is on their honeymoon. We enjoyed our stay very much but we just felt a little uncared for.

title: Really nice boutique hotel
text: An excellent hotel in a good location. The staff is really friendly. The hotel has also a nice bath and sauna area. The bar is very quiet, but it is actually a nice place to sit in the evenings. The location is very central and easy to find places to eat and go anywhere in Paris.

title: Le Tsuba Hotel
text:
The hotel is exceptionally clean; the room we stayed in was very spacious and the air conditioning was perfect. 
The staff were professional. The housekeepers worked hard to keep the room stocked and clean. The TV didn't offer much choice in English but we were on holiday so spent our days sightseeing. We didn't sample the breakfast buffet. Not far from the Arc du Triomphe and it's metro & train services into Paris and all the major attractions. Safe & Quiet area. Very happy with our choice.

title: Great stay!
text: A beautiful hotel with great amenities and a yummy breakfast buffet.  The staff was very polite, helpful and very nice.    The hotel is walking distance to the Arc De Triomphe.  We Uber to most other places and the drivers found the hotel easily.

title: Overall incredible
text:
Very good hotel, excellent quality. We were happy with the energy of the hotel. 
This is our new place on Paris. Congratulations to the owner he did a excellent job.
Recommend it to everybody, please keep up this quality.

title: Absolutely wonderful stay!
text: Le Tsuba was amazing!  The room was clean, beautiful and well appointed.  Every single staff that I met during my stay was so kind and helpful.  Everything was perfect and exceeded my expectations in every way.  I was there for a week and wanted to stay longer.  I will definitely come back again.

title: Excellent hotel with superb staff
text: Excellent hotel very close to the Arc de Triomphe. My superior room had a hairdryer, robe and slippers, kettle and a fridge with complimentary water. The receptionist staff went above and beyond when we couldn’t get a taxi, and brought us beers even though the bar was shut. Highly recommend this place.

title: Absolutely Amazing
text:
We checked in the first night on a Friday and requested for a room on a higher floor. And although they did not have a room available for that night they did move us the following night. 

The room is beautiful, the beds are comfortable and very quiet. But, I think the most important thing is that the customer service is impeccable. Everyone at the reception and in the breakfast area is helpful, pleasant and courteous. Will recommend to family and friends

title: Comfort staying in Paris
text: Location, personnel, and breakfast was super. It is a clean hotel with cosy, although little bit small rooms. Everything worked well and we had good vacation. -I sincerely can recommend this hotel. We stayed five days and walked in the neighbourhood and used metro (stations near). Easy to come from the airport.

title: Splendid !
text:
All went perfectly well 
From the receptionist to the rets of the hotel team, all were dedicated for us.
We spent 2 wonderful days
Overall the hotel have a high standard, it’s very well located 
We need to change our room for bigger 
Unfortunately the hotel was fully booked 
But he receptionist were amazing and able to make the changes

title: Excellent location and service
text: Hotel is conveniently located a few blocks from 3 metro stations. Front staff were very helpful and courteous. Hotel was clean and room was larger than expected for Paris. Bed was comfortable and A/C was very cold. They even stock the fridge with free beverages!

title: Top
text: Nice location, very clean and great service. You are immediately at Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe. Very good restaurants in walking distance, shopping, drinks and relaxing is possible. I highly recommend this hotel

title: LOVED MY STAY!!
text: I had the best stay at this hotel. The staff were extremely friendly and helped with anything I needed. The location was perfect, only a 10min walk to the Arc de Triomphe and alot of yummy food spots all in walking distance. I could not recommend a better place to stay whilst in Paris.

title: Extremely Happy
text:
The hotel was welcoming, the room was nicely appointed, quiet and the bed was comfortable allowing me to sleep well. 
The staff was at our service; very kind and accommodating.  
They don't serve dinner on Sunday and Monday so beware you will need to find other food establishments.

title: Gem in Paris 17th
text: Loved my stay here. Will most certainly return. Faultless service,with friendly staff. Great ambiance, lovely outdoor patio with live green planted walls. Added bonus was sauna, steam room and gym. Walking distance to Arc de Triomphe.

title: Brilliant hotel in a great location in Paris
text: This is by far the best Paris hotel I stayed in. It’s very clean, the rooms are comfortable (including a small balcony), the staff is very friendly and super helpful. The breakfast has a nice diversity of options including eggs, cheeses, fresh fruit, cereal and several types of bread. Next to the dining area there is a lovely back garden you can sit in. The hotel is 5 minutes walk from Arc de Triomphe and there are nice cafes and restaurants nearby. I had a very pleasant stay and will definitely come back.

title: Superb Quality Small Hotel
text:
This is my 2nd time at Le Tsuba Hotel and once again I was not dissapointed.
The location is fantastic, just a short walk to The Arc Du Triumphe and The Metro.
The hotel is spotlessly clean with first class bedding & decor.
The staff are very friendly, proffessional and they cannot do enough to help you.

title: Absolutely astounding
text: I've been to a number of hotels across Europe and this one definitely was the most pleasurable experience my family and I ever had. The staff thought of everything. The room was bigger than we expected -- especially for a European hotel -- so our two kids did not have to use their sleeping bags as the rollout couch bed was sufficient in size. Also, the desk staff gave us tea while we waited for our room to be available. Also, seeing we had children, they gave us shampoos with "The Little Prince" (the children's character from France) on them, and even included a balloon, which my oldest daughter even played with while in the hotel. I cannot say enough good things about this hotel and the staff. When we come back to Paris, we will definitely seek out Le Tsuba for our stay.

title: Great location
text:
Nice, modern hotel, very clean with friendly staff.

Good bedding, towels etc.

Can't  give 5 stars as the rooms are small (as always in Paris) and the breakfast is just chaos, no cutlery set, staff flapping and very weak coffee

title: Best Cozy Hotel In Town!
text: We stayed at Le Tsuba for two nights in May 2022. The rooms were excellent, clean and well kept. The staff was very helpful and friendly.  I will recommend it to anyone who wants to stay close to city center and be close to subway stations. We had to change to another hotel after our two nights and even my kids felt the difference about the quality and the service.  We will definitely come back!

title: Business Trip
text:
Excellent hotel  in a great location tucked away off the beaten track. Staff were helpful and friendly and the rooms were clean.

The restaurant and bar has an outside space with a lovely terrace - a real hidden gem.

title: Excellent
text:
Friendly and very good mood of the personel, clean and fresh rooms 
Great suraroundings 
Very is access and nice neighborhood 
If the room service was more timetable extended, we would stay at "home" much more

title: A gem of a hotel in a great location - highly recommended.
text: Friendly and helpful staff. Relaxed and comfortable lounge and bar area. Lovely breakfast with plenty of choice. Room was clean, comfortable and well equipped, and so quiet that you wouldnt know that you are in the City. Great location, quiet area yet only 5 mins walk to the Arc de Triomphe and the Metro station there.

title: central and appealing
text:
🙂 By Paris standards, this is a very large and tasteful room with a well-appointed daylight bathroom. Perfect location with a short walk to the Arc de Triumph. Metro station easily accessible. Parking garage right around the corner.
😕 Breakfast very chaotic. What was there was delicious. Croissants are no longer available after 10 a.m.

title: Great experience.
text:
Five days with my familly in Paris was a real pleasure in your hotel. We love that it was 5 minute from Arc Triomph. The  room was clean and we had a great vacation because a great day start with a good sleep and nice breakfast.
I want to mention the nice parfum that it was in the hotel. You can feel it but just a little bit, not  too much not to less. Congratz. You have a great team. 
Thank you :)

title: Great Hotel!
text: I was recently in Paris for a week long business meeting and stayed at Le Tsuba Hotel.  The hotel was very clean, very organized and a great place to stay.  The staff was always helpful and nice, took care of all of my needs.  Both French and English was readily spoken, stores and pharmacy near by should you need anything. The breakfast bar was very nice too. Would definitely stay again! Bravo Le Tsuba!

title: Not what it once was! Terrible front end service.
text:
I’ve been to the Tsuba before and this is the reason why I’ve decided to book again for my trip to Paris. 
But this time I’m leaving with a massive disappointment and I will not visit the hotel again. 
Room was small with stains on the carpet so less clean than usual and not acceptable for a hotel which used to be impeccable. I’ve requested a room with bathtub at the time of booking and I didn’t get it. 
Then the Issue of communication between the employees. As all of them give you different advice depending on when you ask. 

On day on I was delayed due to the national incident with SNCF trains across France which led to trains being delayed up to 5 hours. The knock in effect is my next train is also delayed so Last night knowing that I was going to check out today I kindly asked to the gentleman that was in recepition if I could have left the room later than usual due my train being very late. The answer of the receptionist is “of course you can stay as long as you want”.  Great right? 
Then this morning i went out before my checkout time to do some commissions and I’ve asked again to another receptionist if I would like to stay longer like the receptionist told me the previous night. And the answer was, you can stay till 2 and if you want to stay longer you have to pay. So already a different version. 
Then after 5 minutes leaving the hotel , the Director of the Hotel ( Italian) he calls me on my personal phone telling me that the receptionist has made a mistake and the room it’s not available if I want to stay longer. 
3 people , 3 different answers. No solution has been offered. And this is terrible for a 4 stars hotel. 
Especially after 2 years of a pandemic and lockdown I really think that the hotel could have had cleaner rooms and make sure policies are clear between colleagues. Knowing the train situation the hotel has done nothing except add to the stress that thousands probably experienced on trips to Paris over the last few days. 
With this being said I will not come back to the Tsuba and I will surely not suggest to anyone to stay. I will be updating my positive review on booking.com and trip advisor to reflect a more balanced view of this hotel. It is not the same as it once was.

title: My favorite hotel!
text: The staff, the breakfast, the room, everything was amazing!!!! The breakfast buffet was so good. You can tell everything was made from quality ingredients. I had some small things I needed to get done and the staff was so friendly and accommodating. This has officially become my all time favorite hotel! If you’re visiting Paris, this hotel is the best place to stay at.

title: Clean efficient and functional- with an added touch
text:
superb location and excellent links. 
room was spotless and reception staff friendly and very helpful. internet login easy.
lounge facility was well provided for although a 'business room' with quiet facilities /conference would have been great.

title: Hideaway
text: This is an elegant hideaway in the center of Paris with a friendly and welcoming staff. The hotel is within walking distance of major sights and yet located on a side street without too much traffic. Grocery store, bakery, choice of restaurants all nearby. Very quiet at night.

title: Week Parijs
text: Breakfast was not always well organized. Not enough employees. Food was not added. Table not clean. Room was smaller than expected. Bed sheets and bed are good. Badroom was good. People are friendly and offer services where possible.

title: Excellent Hotel in Paris
text: The hotel is in a great location. Just a stone's throw away from the Arc de Triomphe. Easy access to many attractions from the hotel. The hotel rooms itself are very clean and sufficiently large and super comfortable for couples. Breakfast is great. All the staff are friendly and courteous. Someone is always there to help you with anything you need, even at night. The only minor inconvenience is that there isn't a restaurant in the hotel itself, but they have room service for dinner. There are also a multitude of restaurants just walking distance away. So it wasn't really a big deal. Overall, extremely satisfied with the stay!

title: Great hotel
text: The hotel and all the staff were wonderful. All the staff members were very accommodating and couldn’t think of anything we would have improved. The location of hotel is in a very nice neighborhood close to a great little market street.

title: Small Jewel in excellent Location
text: Outstanding, small & personal Boutique Hotel. Great location, excellent Rooms, comfy Bed, BEST Iron, I have ever experienced in ANY Hotel (not even Raffles, Peninsula, Mandarin Oriental, Four Seasons, have it ... I was VERY impressed!!). Complimentary Mini Bar is rather a joke, then I would charge & fill it up properly, but to put 2 bottles of Water + 1 little Orange Juice, is not a unique Selling Point - the contrary, it works against them. Breakfast was excellent, Staff at Reception was great, kind & well presented. Dir. Operations was attentive & overall I had a fantastic, short stay. Surely a Hotel to book again in the future. Thank you. CG

title: Fantastic stay
text:
We were here for 4 days and had a fantastic stay! Highly professional and friendly staff. Great hotel location, cleanliness and overall experience. 

Will definitely stay here again the next time we are in Paris. Thank you. 

October 2021....

title: Weekend for Christo
text: We really enjoyed our stay. The room with the balcony (room arc de triomphe) is really cool looking over the roofs towards Arc and Tour Eiffel. Staff is very friendly and helpful even with topics outside the hotel (we had some difficulties with public parking and are not french speaking). And the location is perfect, 5 minutes walk from Metro, Arc and Champs Elysee. We will definitely stay here again when we come back to Paris.

title: A great and luxurious place to stay in Paris
text: Great location & helpful friendly staff, centrally located off Avenue Champs Elysees and close to l'Arc de Triumphe. If you want to dine out there are many restaurants in the neighbourhood. The rooms are modern and clean.

title: I 100% recommend this hotel
text: The hotel is located less than 5mn walking distance from the Arc de Triomphe and the Avenue des Champs-Élysées. The room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. The staff are a delight and very helpful. It’s perfect for couples’ getaway.

title: Best hotel stay in Paris
text: Less than a 5 minute walk from the Arc. Incredibly clean and well kept. Quiet and calm decor. Super friendly and helpful staff. Hands-down the best stay I have had in Paris yet and I have been seven times.  This is the only hotel I would like to come back to again and again.

title: 2 night stay
text: beautiful lobby and 24 reception. room vie is nice I could see the top of effel tower. the bed is comfy. mice but very small balcony. clean and new. the room is very very small. the location is not bad. a supermarket and pharmacy and shops are near to the hotel.

title: Elegant yet friendly
text: Surprisingly lovely stay at Le Tsuba, I had not heard of this hotel and it was wonderful for my 5 day stay. Friendly staff, large, comfortable rooms, a very nice terrace lobby for breakfast or wine (when open, it wasn't with Covid for a bit). Stocked mini bars, super plush towels, and small fitness center were all good treats. Plus it smelled quite nice, and Nuxe products in the bath. I would stay again.

title: Friendly hotel
text:
the staff is pleasant and smiling , bathroom towels is good quality - breakfeast is good but classic
Not had the time to take advantage of all the services but the list is well.
It's with pleasure that we can come back there - 
thank you again

title: A perfect place to stay in Paris
text:
Amazing staff and very comfortable hotel. 
The service was ideal especially during a difficult period such as the quarantine in Paris. After spending 3 months I recommend this hotel with no hesitation.

title: Perfect for business travel: business by day and relax during the evening
text: I had the opportunity to stay at Tsuba Hotel in Paris for several days a week for a month and a half. Well decorated, warm and efficient staff, boutique hotel with clean, comfortable and calm rooms, a gym to keep in shape and a small hammam. Easy access to La Défense - 5 mins on RER from Charles de Gaulle -  and to metro lines. Nice neighbourhood to stroll during the evening and to enjoy nice restaurants. Very good Price-Quality relationship.

title: New Year's Holiday in Paris!
text:
I'm sorry it has taken me over 17 months to write this review...I apologize. Our stay at Le Tsuba Hotel was Fantastic! From the moment we arrived and were greeted by Manuel, The Concierge, I knew we made the right choice! 

Manuel personally greeted us, and escorted us to our room. Once in our beautiful room he began to give us a plan for our quick visit to Paris. Pointing out restaurants nearby, giving us suggestions for our Louvre adventure and showing us the closest Metro station. He cam with brochures and maps and had a plan for us...unsolicited!

We had been traveling all day from Amsterdam and were in the mood for wine and a baguette. So, down stairs I went, found Manuel and he escorted by two doors down to the wine shop. I don't know French so he took control with the ladies in the shop. He suggested a nice red for $14EU...then two more doors down was the bakery. Again...cutting in line..speaking directly to the baker, we got two fresh, hot baguettes and some of that fantastic French butter. Back to the Le Tsuba we walked. He gave me a couple of more suggestions on dinner locations...which we used the next night, Bistro de L'Arc.

The experience for three nights was superb. Hotel is clean, beautiful and the breakfast was divine!! We will return!!

Thank you Le Tsuba...and especially Manuel! 

Kevin, Morag and Elizabeth Rosa

title: Fantastic place to stay!
text: My husband and I stayed at Hotel Tsuba for 7 nights. We were always greeted with a smile. The staff went above and beyond to fulfill our needs. One gentleman in particular was such a helpful person. He worked during the night shift unfortunately can’t recall his name. The breakfast buffet was amazing, we had it brought up to the room one time. Cappuccino’s and bar/food staff were great. Our room was clean, nice and spacious compared to other hotels we saw online in Paris. We utilized the sauna and the little gym area often, it was perfect and again so clean! We would definitely come back and stay. Totally recommend it.

title: Upscale Hotel With  Excellent Service in the 17th Arrondissment
text:
I have been to Paris many times but decided to stay in the 17th for the first time, and I am so glad I did! This hotel is nestled on a small side street filled with shops, cafes, and is a few short minutes from the Arc de Triomphe. Great neighborhood with a butsling atmosphere, yet once I walked through the doors of Le Tsuba I was transmitted to a place of beauty and tranquility! Front desk staff is OUTSTANDING! They cannot do enough for you, from directions to providing a quality umbrella during the rain, pleasant, professional, and always smiling! The rooms are extremely clean, with quality bedding, complimentary toiletries, a nice flat screen tv, and a great roomy shower.There is also a great spa and sauna that you can reserve with the front desk, and beautiful robes and slippers in the room, a great mini bar, and kettle for tea and coffee  We were celebrating and were upgraded to a high floor with a beautiful view of Paris, and a complimentary bottle of bubbly- what a way to start our travels!!  The employees were so kind and the hotel looks brand new, they take pride in keeping it as such and it shows! I highly recommend, and its easy to get the metro to wherever you want to go in Paris. This was literally the best of all the hotels I have stayed at in Paris, and I cannot wait to return to this hidden GEM!! 

jusqu’à la prochaine fois paris

title: Seriously - ADORED!
text: Truly have nothing but praise for this boutique hotel, we had such a truly fantastic holiday here for a very short three nights, could have easily stayed the entire week (wish we had). The hotel is quite stylish, yet classy, the absolute best part was the location/zone, we walked everywhere every single day and found it very safe and convenient. Dont let me forget the breakfast with all the fresh cheeses! I adored every minute here!!

title: Lovely recharging spot in Paris
text: This was one of the loveliest places I have stayed in Paris -- the location is fantastic, the rooms are large and well appointed, and the staff is very friendly and accommodating.  This is my fourth trip to Paris for work and, even with all of the city's amazing attractions, I looked forward to being in my room or winding down with a cocktail at the end of the day.  It was a quiet little oasis with a very comfortable bed -- a great place to recharge before going back to work and exploring each day.

title: Top notch hotel
text: A great stay at Le Tsuba as always. I have been staying here for the past few years. I spent this past week at the hotel for work. Rooms are very comfortable and extremely clean. Nice size bathroom with  a great shower and towels. The front desk staff is professional, attentive and friendly.  Always a pleasure to return. Thank you.

title: Very comfortable stay
text:
We were spending nearly 2 weeks at the hotel.
The hotel location are very good . You have metro near by , supermarket, pharmacy, bank and lot of thing to do around the area. 

The breakfast buffet was nice. The staff many of them are very nice and helpful. 

As a long stay guest , the room cleaning is a bit complicated. They didn’t refill the soap , tea or cup. After 1 week I ask them to change my bedsheet and it’s took 2 days for them to finally do it. 

If you looking for hotel with good location. This one is good choice for you.

title: Excellent location, cute rooms, dissapointing customer service
text: Halfway thorough my second week-long stay at Le Tsuba, my niece and I brought pastries down to the lobby to eat them with coffee we intended to buy there.  The host came right up to us to let us know that we could only eat food purchased in the lobby bar or restaurant in the lobby.  I was disappointed since (1) they don't sell pastries and (2) we had no other civilized place to eat them and (3) I've spent 4,000 euros at this hotel in the past three months.  It's a nice place but they really shouldn't nickel and dime us.   Bottom line:  great location, very good rooms and breakfast buffet, below-average exercise room, friendly staff, unaccommodating polices.

title: Comfortable hotel for a week long trip to Paris
text: Cute hotel in a central part of Paris. It was easy to get to and from the Metro (when it was available) and get around the city. We didn't find a ton of cafes we liked within walking distance, but there are so many option in Paris so we weren't at a loss. The room was comfortable and had everything we needed. It was on the smaller side, but that was expected. The gym area was great and the amenities were excellent.

title: Great...
text: Hotel with a slight Asian touch. Very nice employees, great rooms, good breakfast (from my perspective not always easy in France) and great location. Arc de triomphe is just two blocks from the hotel.

title: Gorgeous hotel
text: We stayed here for 3 nights and absolutely loved it. The staff were great- so helpful and attentive. Breakfast was lovely. The location was great. Our room was spotlessly clean. I would highly recommend it.

title: Amazing !
text:
Each time I go to Paris because of work I go to TSUBA.
They provide na amazing customer service, breakfast, rooms. The stuff is very helpful and the location is perfect
I really recommend the hotel!!!

title: Highly recommendable
text: I had a wonderful stay at Le Tsuba. My room was clean, the bathroom was spacious and the overall interior design is just beautiful. I've never seen a more varied and appealing selection at a breakfast buffet and I could have sat there all morning and tried everything. Staff were very friendly, welcoming and helpful.

title: Excellent
text:
The hotel has a great location, the decoration overall is modern with good style, the room is clean and comfortable, bathroom is outstanding. It is great to go to the sauna at the end of busy day. Breakfast is perfect, just exactly what you need in the morning. Free still water is provided. 
Highly recommended.

title: Awesome Stay!
text: I had a wonderful stay recently at the Le Tsuba! Service was great, breakfast was great, rooms were great. I would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Paris. I felt very welcomed every time I walked through the doors and loved my stay.

title: Wonderful surprise from Le Tsuba
text: From the beginning of my stay, the staff has been very attentive and tries to accommodate all of my requests, especially Paulo at the reception. I also got upgraded to 1 of the 2 nicest rooms at the hotel, and was offered a late checkout. The room and amenities are very comprehensive and in top quality. Breakfast is served until noon and can be ordered to the room. The location of the hotel is very central and is within walking distance to metro stations, making my commutes very easy. Cannot recommend this hotel enough!

title: Elegant hotel
text:
Fantastic location and Very nice and helpful staff, the hotel is  Quiet and cosy with 
 Comfortable rooms.
I have not seen something need attention or correction just keep up the good work and good luck.

title: Charming
text: Hotel is only a few blocks from metro. Walking distance to several sites. Very close to a mini market and some restaurants.  Staff was very helpful with local recommendations and car service.  Hotel is very clean. Drinks at bar were good. Did not use room service or breakfast. Rooms are small but typical for Europe. Complimentary water bottles in room.

title: Great stay and super service
text: Great stay and super service. Location is close to restaurants and shops. The hotel staff was welcoming and helpful with all requests. Good breakfast with lots of selections and fresh brewed coffee. Nice bar and relaxation area. Music Thursday evening.

title: Fantastic staff, great location, quiet rooms
text:
The title says it all - a new, well located and quiet hotel with fantastic staff. Definitely recommended!

I greatly appreciated the assistance with dietary requirements.

I will happily stay again on my next trip to Paris.

title: A very pleasant hotel in very good location
text: We have spent 6 days in this hotel during a Medical convention that took place at the congress center, a nice 10 -15 minute walk from the hotel . The hotel is located at a quiet street close to Place del Etoile. The room was pleasant and well equipped. The service was excellent. The only drawback of our stay was that the room was very small. We could hardly move around it. A lot of ingenuity was needed to find a place  for our suitcases. I have ordered directly through the hotel and got a room that was defined de lux. My daughter that booked online  through booking.com, got a much larger room. So pay attention to what you order , the "de lux" is misleading. The breakfast offered a nice variety in pleasant sitting area with a very good service. The front desk was responsive, friendly and helpful

title: Everything perfect
text:
Thank you for the treatment received and the attention of the staff. The facilities were also very pleasing to me.
The hotel is very comfortable, quiet and pleasant. Although my stay was for professional reasons, I will consider it as a very valuable option for a holiday stay.

title: Quiet boutique hotel with all the amenities
text:
I travelled to Paris with friends for a long weekend visit and booked here because that's where my friends were staying.  The location was excellent, on a quiet side street but within walking distance to major attractions without feeling too "touristy".  

The service was professional and kind, the rooms and common areas of the hotel were very clean and the ammenities made the stay comfortable and enjoyable.  My room on the 6th floor also had a beautiful little balcony with a view of the Eiffel Tower. If I return to Paris I would definitely book here again.

title: Franchement j'aime cet hôtel
text: Excellent ambiance upon entering both lobby and one's room. Staff warm and supportive and breakfast environment delightful, especially with the wall of vegetation in court just outside breakfast area. Quiet hotel and very well located. Staff even in August very attentive to my desire to upgrade to Tour Eiffel "Prestige" room (Sasha?). No, these people tried to always be helpful, explaining even at midnight how to find a restaurant open. I will return to this hotel and actually am already looking forward to my next visit, maybe with my wife or son.

title: Perfect Stay in Paris
text:
This place is the must have, near to everything, sweet and perfect design.
People from the service are always helping, smart and discreet.
This is where we enjoy the most to stay in Paris.
On last thing, ask them to have a room on the top of the hotel, some rooms have views :)

title: Amazing hotel
text: The hotel was really amazing and very comfortable. They offered everything that we needed. The rooms are clean and very spacious. We recommend the hotel, and we are sure that we are going to come back. Thank you!

title: Excellent hotel for visiting Paris
text: The hotel is very beautiful and nice, the room was very comfortable and clean and the hotel has excellent service. The hotel location is perfect for traveling the city and also the airport shuttle has nearby stop. Ideal hotel for couples visiting Paris

title: Lovely hotel
text:
My wife and I checked in for 4 nights and had a wonderful time throughout the stays.
Deluxe double room is spacious. Comfortable bed, large toilet with bathtub, quiet and cold aircond, good soundproofing, JBL bluetooth speaker, close to arc de triomphe, convenient shop is 2-3 shops away, many restaurants in the area. 

Hotel was located between 3 metro station, Ternes station, Charles de Gaulle Etoile, and Argentine station. Each of them is 350m - 400m away from the hotel. 

However, there are a few things that required improvement.

1. The room cleaner never bother to replace a new set of toilet amenities which includes body shampoo, body lotion, tooth brush and vanity set where we normallyl will use up after morning shower. Not sure if this is hotel rules or room cleaner did not aware. So each night we must call room service for replacement of each 
items that mentioned above which is quite troublesome. 

2. Only one hanger available in the toilet. Nowhere to hang second towel. 

3. Slippery to get in and out from the bathtub. I fell down on the first night when get off from the bathtub but luckily no major injury. Given extra caution since then. Strongly suggest the hotel to install a handle on the wall above bathtub. Must mention also there's a glass screen blocking half of the bathtub (attached photo) . Falling in there can be fatal. 

Overall, very lovely hotel and appreciate the great service from the service staffs except the cleaner :'D

title: Excellent stay!
text: I will highly recommend this hotel. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel rooms were very comfortable and well equipped. The breakfast had a nice variety and was of high standard. It was a pleasant stay.

title: Loved it!
text: Le Tsuba is located within walking distance from the Eiffel Tower and the Arc of Triomphe. It's also less than a minute walk from the nearest Metro Station which takes you to pretty much anywhere you want to go. We loved the room and the staff was extremely friendly, hospitable, knowledgeable of the area, and always greeted you with a smile. Loved it and definitely will stay here again.

title: Excellent hotel
text:
Room is very very nice. Clean, great toilet, bed is very nice, light is ok, amenity is very good. 
Lobby and others is very clean, look good.
Staffs are very nice, good services.
