Location is very good. Nearby Airport bus stop, nearby Metro and RER, can walk to champs Elysees.

title: Great hotel in a great location!
text:
Rooms are clean and stylish, bathrooms are very nice.
The area is lovely, central, and there are metro stations nearby.
The staff are very accommodating & helpful, and the free buffet in the afternoon is a lovely touch. 
I will definitely be returning!

title: Great hotel, location, staff!
text: This renovated hotel has a great location. In the heart of the Latin Quarter, surrounded by lots of cafes,  restaurants and shops, safe neighbourhood, young happy atmosphere, walking distance to the main Paris attractions. Clean room, so nice and helpful, english speaking staff. They helped us with every our requies, like ordring taxi, restaurant reservations and explanation about the surrondings. The suite on the high floor has a lot of space, balcony and beutiful view on the neighborhood. The room was very clean and equiped with everything you need. The hotel offers free snack bar and drinks in the afternoon. We enjoyed a lot our stay and will be definatly back. Enjoy!

title: Great hotel
text: Clean room, helpful and polite people at the 24h reception and nice breakfast! The location is also great. Safe neighborhood with many cafes and restaurants around. 10 minutes walk from Notre Dame and 1 minute walk from the metro station. I will definitely stay there again!

title: Good hotel
text:
The hotel is clean, good breakfast, excellent location, friendly staff
You are in walking distance from Quartier Latin main objectives (Bd Saint Germain, Bd Saint Michel, Pantheon, Sorbonna) and the same for l'Ile de la Cite

title: Wonderful staff , and wonderful stay
text:
Very helpful staff at hotel, both  at reception and at breakfast every day.
Very friendly, lovely clean rooms great location in the city.
Nice walk to Notre Dame in the morning, good shops and bars nearby.

title: amazing staff, well locted , clean and trendy
text: We stayed a full week in this hotel, and it couldn't be a better experience. The staff is beyond kind and helpful, the room was comfortable, nice, and quite new and the location was great. I highly recommend it to everyone

title: Amazing hotel
text: Great location (near Jussieu and Cardinal Lemoine metro stations) in the Latin Quarter, about 10-15 minute walk to Notre Dame. Friendly and helpful staff. Rooms very clean and lovely shower and bathrooms. Great stay

title: Wonderful stay at a great hotel!
text: The staff at this hotel were very friendly and helpful! They were able to assist with a route to take the metro around the city and pre booking us a taxi for an early trip to the airport. Our room had a lovely balcony with a table and chairs. The shower has a huge rainfall shower head that is luxurious. The breakfast was continental style with pastries, coffee, fruit and yogurt. We were very surprised by how great the hotel was and would recommend it!

title: An absolute gem of a hotel in the heart of Paris
text: I cannot recommend this hotel any higher.  It's a small hotel only minutes walk from the river and Notre Dame.  The rooms are compact but spotlessly clean and modern.  We had three rooms booked and two of them had beautiful balconies giving views over the city.  Downstairs, in the same building, is a cafe/restaurant called Cosmo where it's happy hour almost all day.  The food is excellent and the staff couldn't be nicer. I will certainly be back.

title: Great stay in a great part of the city
text: Rooms were clean, bed was extremely comfortable. Room size was normal for hotel rooms in a big city (may be smaller than expected for those not having stayed in cities before, but it's perfectly acceptable).  staff was friendly and helpful. We absolutely would(will) stay again.

title: Excellent location and service!
text:
I stayed here for a grand total of 9 nights, extending my visit by 3 nights so that should tell you something.  

Pros:
-Great location with supermarkets very close by and tons of great restaurants all around.  You don't ever need to venture more than a quarter of a mile to have everything you need.  I had to work a chunk of the time so I could step out for a quick minute to get something.
-Good service.  Personally, I don't like being waited on constantly like at some hotels.  The front desk staff were very polite and helped me get everything I needed.  Whenever I emailed them before the trip, they responded promptly.  The only problem I ever had was my room key being demagnetized by my phone, and they fixed that quickly.
-Room is modern.  Don't be put off by the tiny reception area.  Each of the rooms I stayed in had a comfortable bed, TV, safe, tea kettle, and other conveniences.
-The shower has great pressure and sufficient hot water (I can't say the same about other places in Europe).

Cons (these are mostly out of the hotel's control):
-Hotel is located on a busy street (rue des ecoles).  I don't hear well, so this is not an issue for me, but all throughout the day and evening there is lots of noise coming from the street.  So if this bothers you, close your windows and turn on the AC/heater.  I couldn't hear the noise when the windows are closed, but again, my hearing isn't the greatest.
-Elevator can be a bit of a pain.  It's not exactly intuitive.  If you are on the ground floor, you have to press the down button to go up (if the elevator is on a higher floor).  Once, I had to wait five minutes before I could get on the elevator (I had bags so stairs wasn't practical).  And anything higher than floor 2, a working elevator is a must!
-The single room is really small even for a single traveler.  I started out with a single room and could barely move around the room.  Thankfully, I moved to the "Cubik" room for the other six nights, and it's much spacier with a fantastic view!

I would say that this a 4.5 rating that I rounded up to a 5.  I would 100% stay here again on my future trips to Paris!

title: Genny
text: Well centered, very good and genial staff went out of their way to guide us on what steps to take for what we wanted to see and refer us to the best around town. my family and I had a great time for the short visit to Paris and with the guidance of the hotel staff, we were able to see all we wanted.

title: Quaint and interesting
text:
Having heard so much about this hotel and having seen good reviews, I would have liked to mark it as 5 but it fell short of that. Similarly, I could have marked it as 3 but the friendliness of the staff, particularly at the reception desk, pulls the score up to 4.

First the pluses. The location is rather good, it is right on a five point crossing, the streets being Rue des Ecoles, Rue du Cardinal Lemoine, Rue des Fossess Saint Bernard and Rue Jussieu. We stayed in a fifth floor corner room, named Cubik. It has a neat little balcony which can be accessed both from the bedroom and the bathroom. The balcony is very narrow though it has two chairs and a table, which are tightly wedged in. The view from this room is superb, it seems to be right on the wide crossing, with an open sky above you and Paris skyline in the distance. I spent 8 nights in this Room 524, of which I spent a considerable time in the balcony. There are many bistros and restaurants in this locality which made dining out a pleasure. Two metro stations are close by, buses are easily available. Pantheon is an eight minute walk, so is Cluny Museum. La Seine is a six minute walk. Jardin Luxembourg is also within walking distance. The hotel is right in the heart of the University area, with full charm of old buildings. 

Rooms in Latin quarter are generally small and this was no exception but the room was pretty well appointed. Comfortable Queen bed, small table, closet space, big screen TV, no fridge. Was greeted with a bottle of champagne cooling in an ice bucket, which was a nice touch. The bathroom, once again small, had all the necessary amenities, a heavy shower and a telephone shower combined unit, but no bathtub. Good tiles that dry quickly and the step out window to the balcony were the good extras. This is an old building, quaint with a spiral carpeted wooden staircase as also a neat lift.

Breakfast was a hearty European or continental breakfast, with an assortment of croissants, French breads, pancake, cold cuts, juices, cereals, scrambled eggs, cheeses etc. There is a spanking coffee machine, spewing out Chocolate and Mochaccino, apart from the regular stuff.

For some of the negatives now. There is a drainage problem in this area and when you step outside you see the accumulated water as well as smell the stink. Unfortunately the bathroom also had some kind of sewage problem, with a faint nasty smell. You need to open the windows or keep the air conditioning on to get rid of the smell.

Overall maintenance could be better, nothing major...  but both the air conditioning unit and the bathroom sink had a bit of a dripping issue. The lift went out of order one day which meant a bit of a climb from our eyrie on the fifth floor. Cleaning is occasionally good, occasionally lacklustre. 

The breakfast room gets converted to a mini free snackery during the day which in itself is a nice touch. This mini snackery is largely a neglected part, as there is no cutlery, the coffee cups are removed, and the fare on offer are some as the leftovers from the morning. This room clearly needs attention. Another surprising thing is that while there were four bottles of water and soda given complementary on the first day, you have to buy the rest. However we were occasionally getting complimentary bottles as well. We were also getting two chocolates on the bed after the room has been cleaned, though not on all days! Because of lack of availability in high tourist season, the room was pretty expensive, too.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience in a lovely old building in Latin quarters in spite of minor hiccups.

title: Hotel in Paris
text: A beautiful little hotel, with kind staff. We were not completely satisfied with the breakfast and thought perhaps there was a little selection. We thought that the rooms should have a fridge. But we had a very nice time at the hotel.

title: Clean and modern
text: The rooms are clean and updated, with air conditioning.  The beds are pretty comfortable.  I would note that the elevator is very small, but it works.  The staff are friendly and helpful.  I would stay there again.

title: Small hotel great location and service!
text: We enjoyed our three night stay very much - even though the room was tiny. Had lots of light and we enjoyed the breakfast every day plus being able to sit in the lounge to wait for our taxi to the airport. Staff were very helpful. The hotel very close to both the St. Germain area, bridges over Ile St. Louis to the Marais. Lots of good bistros and restaurants right in the neighborhood! Also, we were there during a heat wave so it was nice to retreat into the air-conditioned space! We recommend!

title: Perfect stay
text:
Nice hotel very well located. Bed is super comfi. Breakfast was nice and located in a opened and very light room. Unusual to enjoy breakfast with daylight. 
Nice staff and very helpful. 
Nice decoration

title: Excellent
text: We stayed in Paris Art Hotel Quartier Latin for three nights; the room was quiet and clean; breakfast was good; the most enjoyable thing of this hotel is its location, halfway between l'ile de la cite and the Pantheon and very close to the underground station, an excellent location to sightsee Paris

title: Great and cozy hotel with super service and staff plus a good location
text: A very nice renovated small hotel. Great location, Great rooms (small but very clean and nice), good ac and the staff is extremely good and can help you with almost anything. Nice restaurants close by and a short walk to the Metro and Notre Dame. We give this hotel 5 stars for our stay and will stay there again next time we are in Paris

title: Terrific!
text: Superb hotel, hope to stay again! All staff were very friendly and accommodating. Rooms were very clean and well designed. It was also very helpful to have elevator access and air conditioning. And the location was amazing. Many delicious food options, blocks from the river, and easy access to bus, train, and bike transit.

title: Excellent Hotel with great staff!
text: Wonderful stay.  Rooms are bright and exceptionally clean, all fixtures high end and great quality.  Beds superb.  Right in the center of the Latin Quarter, short walk to the metro.  Staff was very helpful.  Will be back!

title: Lovely hotel!
text: My husband I stayed here during our honeymoon and enjoyed it! The rooms were updated and clean. The breakfast was good, especially the eggs. The location was pretty close to the bus station and metro, which we used extensively to travel to different sites.

title: Staff very helpful
text: The staff was very helpful.  Even though we did not speak French, it wasn't a problem - they were very patient.  Most of the staff spoke English very well.  They helped with transportation, answered our questions about restaurants, places to go, things to see, etc. and even made suggestions on the best way to do things.

title: Very good hotel
text: Staff were all excellent, very good beds for a comfortable sleep, good location and ok breakfast. A bit repetitive but food was good. Rooms are sound proof and blackout curtains work very well. The afternoon coffee and treats were much appreciated.

title: Excellent Service with Clean, Comfortable Room, modern amenities and a great view
text: While small by North American standards, my 6th floor room was just the right size for what I needed with a very comfortable bed; plush, clean sheets; a wonderful bathroom with a luxurious rainfall shower head; and a gorgeous view out over the rooftops of Paris. Everything in the room was in like-new condition and worked properly (provided USB-C outlets in the walls were particularly appreciated since I only had one European power adapter). I particularly appreciated the strong air conditioning since Paris was experiencing a heat wave when I visited that pushed temperatures to nearly 40 C outside, but things stayed cool inside, despite my room being on the top floor. The buffet breakfast was very convenient (this was a business trip). The staff were friendly and helpful and, when my cab back to the airport refused to provide me with a receipt, they volunteered to sort things out with the company and had the document I needed within the hour.

title: Excellent Stay
text: Overall, the staff was super friendly and helpful. As well, the hotel was clean and new. The hotel was in a great location very convenient to public transportation and also near dining and attractions.

title: Lilliputian Room 27
text: Clean hotel with friendly and helpful staff.  The room size was a shock.  I had to sidestep around the bed and sideways into the shower.  The decor was lower than expected. The bed was very comfortable. and the location was good.

title: Great place to stay
text: Great and friendly staff… clean rooms, lots of plugs/outlets.  Breakfast was good… the chocolate croissants were yummy. Access the the metro was close.  Balcony was a treat in the morning and evenings watching the people pass below.  I would recommend.

title: excellent location!
text: We had a wonderful four-night stay and will definitely return. The location was perfect for us, as there was so much to see and do within walking distance. Our previous stay in Paris was two weeks in the Marais but my husband and I found that we preferred the location of Paris Art Hotel in the Latin Quarter. Friendly and helpful staff, our room was perfect for us (newly-renovated, a plus!), and we were fortunate enough to have a room with a balcony that contained a table and two chairs. Highly recommend Paris Art Hotel.

title: Cosy hotel in the Latin district
text: I had a very good stay in this hotel - very comfortable bed and pillows, nicely decorated bathroom. Room was tiny but everything needed fitted in. Breakfast are tasty, the staff friendly and helpful. Location is great - you can reach e.g. Pantheon and Notre Dame on foot. I would certainly come back!

title: Great location, room and no complaints!
text: The hotel is well located in the French Quarter so you can walk, metro or get citi-bikes to go anywhere.  Bakeries, food shops, brasseries right out the door.  Steps from the Seine.  The rooms are clean and modern, with lots of plugs.  We had large room with a balcony and great view.  The staff was helpful and friendly.  Free afternoon drinks & snacks.

title: Great location, room and no complaints!
text: Convenient to walk everywhere, get metro or citi-bikes.  Safe with bakeries, cafes and brasseries close by.  Friendly and helpful staff.  Rooms were quiet, clean, and modern with lots of plugs.  We had a large room with balcony and great view!  Excellent for a 3*

title: Great small hotel in convenient Latin Quarter location
text: Very nice, clean, friendly, comfortable small hotel.  The rooms are small, as is common for Paris Hotels, but the bed was great, and the fittings and linens very nice.  The bathroom has a nice shower, and the room is efficiently laid out.  Buffet breakfast was quite good, with a nice selection.  There is no lobby to speak of, but the folks at the front desk are friendly and helpful.  Location is nice -- pretty quiet, but walking distance to many tourist attractions and very close to two major Metro lines.  Highly recommended.

title: Excellent and newly refurbished
text:
Excellent recently refurbished small hotel with very well designed 
rooms. Every small detail has been carefully considered. It is also in an ideal location in the Latin Quarter with 2 metro stations situated very close by. Very polite and helpful staff who speak English Strongly recommended. I will be going back!

title: Great location, clean and friendly
text: We had a great stay - the rooms and general hotel are very clean (almost brand new) and we were happy with the central location of the hotel. The only thing which to point out was that the breakfast included was maybe not worth the additional cost per night, but nonetheless was a good touch

title: Fabulous Hotel!
text: The Paris Art Hotel is my new favorite hotel in Paris. I travel there at least once each year en route to the Cannes Film Festival and this hotel is a gem. First, the hospitality was wonderful. Amine, Nuëmi, Benois, and others were very kind and helpful, and extended every courtesy to us. Second the location is perfect. It is located just a couple blocks from St. Germain metro stop, the Seine, and the Isle de Paris, our favorite part of Paris. Third, because of my wife's allergies, we particularly appreciated the hardwood floors. And finally, the hotel's rooms were as clean as any hotel we've visited. Bravo to the Paris Art Hotel team!

title: May 2022
text: Hotel is situated in a very good place, very close to the subway. The entire staff was very helpful, even giving us some good advice on what was best to visit, especially Tommaso. Personally, I really appreciate the small buffet that was served after 12.30, it was delicious. I’ll definitely came back.

title: This Hotel is Amazing! Deserves 10 stars
text: I cannot say enough things about how superb this hotel is in the Latin Quarter !! The hotel is so beautiful and has been updated because everything is new and updated ! The Hotel is spotless and our room was spotless every day ! I requested a balcony and Benoit honored the request along with being able to check in early after a 9 hour flight ! Benoit provided us with transportation options on how to get around the city as well as restaurant recommendations. It was also my daughter’s 30th birthday and Benoit helped assist one of my daughter’s friend with getting the most beautiful flower arrangement and champagne! The customer service this hotel and Benoit provided was AMAZING!! The location was perfect !! 10-15 min walk to Notre Dame and several great cafes and restaurants on the same street . Look no further if your looking for a great hotel in the Latin Quarter. The hotel and staff are SUPERB!!!

title: A Friendly Hotel in an Excellent Location
text: We've recently had a four night stay at the hotel, which we would definitely use again. The hotel is very close to the main Sorbonne University in a vibrant, but not noisy, area. There were a few plumbing issues with the wash hand basin, otherwise the room and hotel were perfect with even afternoon snacks provided free of charge. The location is within five minutes stroll of two metro stations plus it's an easy amble down to the le Seine and Notre Dame Cathedral. The staff were all friendly and made huge allowance for our appalling French by answering in English! All in all, an excellent choice.

title: Completely renovated hotel, highly recommend!
text:
This place is brand new with really modern and clean design. Every inch of the room is efficiently used so you have all the space, drawers, storage, surfaces you need within a smaller space (all hotel rooms are small in Paris, at least in this price range). Bed is super comfy, rainfall shower head in a brand new clean bathroom and tons of hot water, central air and heat. Also double pane window sills so no noise even though it’s on a big street. 
4 min walk from the metro. 24 hour staff downstairs that are very professional and friendly. 
Highly recommend, I would come back!

title: 10/10 would stay again
text:
I stayed here for 3 nights recently and had a lovely stay. The staff on the front desk were friendly and helpful. We were able to check in early which was much appreciated after a very early start to the day. Our room was spacious and clean, and we had a balcony as we had requested if possible. The bed was very big and comfortable - I had one of the best nights sleep I’ve had in months on our first night. We were on the 5th floor and could hear some noise from the busy street below but it was more of a buzz than noise as such which was easily masked with ear plugs if you are a light sleeper like myself. 

The location is excellent- within easy walking distance to the heart of the latin quarter, Notre Dame, river and parks. There are also two metro stations within 2 minutes walk of the hotel. 

We didn’t have breakfast so I cannot comment on that and we were not at the hotel at the time the daily free welcome buffet was put out but on one day we did pop into the room later on in the afternoon to see if anything was left and were able to help ourselves to some pastries and sweets. 

I would 100% recommend this hotel and would stay again.

title: Great stay
text: Had a great stay. Our room was quite small, but clean and had comfortable beds. We really enjoyed the little balcony.  The employees were friendly and helpful.  Breakfast was good,  the lady in charge of breakfast was also very friendly.

title: The pictures ot their page doesn’t correspond with reality
text: Very expensive for what it is. The picture on their page don’t belong The pictures ot their page doesn’t correspond with reality  to reality. Particularly the reception. It is well located and the personal was kind and helpful. The price is to high for the kind of hotel, even though we understand Paris is not cheap.

title: Dry nice and friendly
text: My booking got mixed up and we had to be moved to a different room each night but the team was very friendly and apologetic. They offered a very nice welcoming and a bottle of champagne as a goodwill gesture. We will definitely be back! Amin and Noémie have been fantastic!

title: Loved the place!
text:
I stayed at the hotel from 12-15 april with my mom and sister, and we loved the place. The staff was so kind, and gave the impression, that they were ready to help us, if we needed it. Thank you so much for that. The breakfast was fine, not bad at all. Bread, yoghurt, scrambled eggs, etc.
The rooms smelled sooo good, and they were very clean and comfortable. I will definitely stay here again, when i return to Paris - and i can also recommend it for anyone considering this place.

title: Modern and comfortable, attentive and helpful staff, don't recommend the breakfast
text:
Overall I was impressed with this hotel and felt it was a good choice. It started out rocky, when I entered the room it was cold and I couldn't alter the heating. When I called down to reception it turned out it was managed centrally; they did make the change so I could turn the heating up or down myself so the issue was resolved. However something to be aware of if you stay here. I also specifically looked for a hotel where the rooms had safes, the one in my room was not working. At first the reception staff wanted me to leave my things in the reception safe, but when I made it clear I was not happy with that they did pull out all the stops to resolve the issue by swapping the safe over with a working one. I did hugely appreciate that but I wish everything had been working when I arrived, it was extra stress. The bed was comfy, noise level was good, décor was up to date. The receptionist booked me a taxi and was happy to help with making reservations at restaurants. Internet speed in the rooms was good. The rooms were quite a good size, I moved to this hotel from another on the same road where the rooms were much smaller. 

The breakfast I found odd, I only ate there one day and then went to local cafes after that. I'd recommend just paying for breakfast when you get there for one day and seeing what you think. One thing that is a nice touch is that they have mini pizzas, juice and sweets out for guests after 12:30pm. 

More detail on the breakfast: tea bags aren't out you have to ask the server to get one from the kitchen, no English breakfast tea in the kitchen but there is in the rooms! Hot food was sausage rolls made with frankfurters, mustard mac and cheese, cold tater tots. Yogurt was plain, although there was jam to mix in. Juice, Toast and Pastries were fine what you would expect. No cereal at all, which I have never experienced on a continental breakfast before.

title: Quaint hotel, excellent stay
text: Comfortable, clean. Small rooms, but it's perfectly reasonable for Paris. Price is reasonable, stay was great, no complaints. You get good housekeeping every day. I didn't buy the breakfast but it smelled delicious in the morning. Staff are very nice. You will have a great time here.

title: Gem in Paris
text: This hotel has been newly renovated and is a rare find. The rooms decor is great, the shower and bathroom fantastic and the location is perfect. The staff were friendly and helpful and speak both French and English. It’s a 2 min walk to the metro and st Victor restaurant around the corner is a must. Highly recommend for singles, couples or a family.

title: Great hotel and location
text: Staff were very helpful, excellent English versus my poor French. Location is thriving and reasonable to get everywhere you'd expect but handy for Notre Dame and Louvre. So many excellent places to eat a stone throw away from 24x7 crepes to Brasseries and nice breakfast and snacks in the hotel.

title: Clean, good location, but....
text: I love the Latin Quartier and have stayed at several hotels on Rue des Ecoles.  We chose to try  Paris Art Hotel  which was clean and well maintained.  One of the better bathrooms of any hotel we've dtayed at in the area.  There really is no lobby area when you enter.  The hotel staff are ok although not particularly helpful.  There is clearly a shortage of staff as the front food door was locked for about 10 mins with a sign saying the staff person would be right back.  This was not late at night but n the early afternoon.  The breakfast room is fine, but food choice is nothing specail.  The best part ws th coffee options.   I would stay again but I still prefer a couple of other hotel options in the area which have more charm and more engaging hotel staff.

title: Clean, good location and great beds
text: We liked the location of the hotel as it is centrally located within walking distance to our interesting places. Very clean room and public places and a comfortable bed. We had a room with a view out to the street, and it was still not noisy.

title: Overall excellent experience
text: Amazing experience here. Staff was very friendly and room was incredibly comfortable and modern. Also very generous as every day at 12:30 they put out free snacks and coffee/juice in the dining room. The location is also excellent. Walking distance to many attractions, lots of dining and bar options nearby and only steps from a Metro station.

title: Good
text: I was travelling alone for 3 days where I was spending most of my time out of the room. It was a small room - but perfect for what I needed. Good facilities in the room, friendly staff, quiet, and free food and hot drinks during the day. Couldn’t ask for more really!

title: Nice little place in the center
text:
The place was very clean and nice, the staff was professional. 
The room was not too small, we had the place to open our luggage. The curtains really hide the sunlight in the morning.
We had a shower problem when we arrived to the room, they apologized and moved us to another room directly.

title: Perfect location and hotel
text: Paris Art Hotel Quartier Latin is a modern hotel but having the essence of Paris. It's well connected with metro station and the staff was very nice. Lots of restaurants in the surroundings. I will repeat if I travel to Paris again.

title: Friendly clean hotel with some nice little service touches
text: Very friendly service from all the staff, and some unusual touches like free small snacks in the breakfast room all day. The bed was really comfortable and the room was well-equipped. title: Everything perfect!

title: Very nice stay

title: Klein, aber fein! / Small, but nice!
text: The descriptions and reviews you can find here in Tripadvisor for the previous hotel (Royal Cardinal) have little to do with today's reality: the Art Hotel. All rooms are state-of-the-art renovated and tastefully furnished. The house only has a small reception, but the reception  staff was always extremely friendly and helpful. We had a spacious room on the 5th floor (junior suite Arabesque) with 22 square meters. However, some rooms are smaller. Internet connection excellent! Bathroom modern and perfectly furnished. The cleanliness and the daily room service was absolutely top level. A surprise for us was the breakfast room on the 1st floor and the breakfast itself. A rich breakfast buffet with everything your heart desires and with nice service! The hotel is on a very good location. Two metro stations nearby and a lot of small brasseries, bars and other restaurants close to the Hotel. A lot of the highlights of Paris can be explored from the Hotel by walking.

title: Perfect home base for a Paris Visit
text: The location is great and we were able to walk to the Louvre, tons of great shops and restaurants as well as the Eglise de Saint Germain des Pres. What made it more special was the actual history of the hotel coupled with the kind and smiling staff. The rooms are on the small side but so are most in Paris but they are clean and comfortable. Really happy with our stay.
description: The journey back to the Renaissance starts in the lift. The glass panel is a window through which you can admire a series of drawings taken from the various studies executed by Leonardo da Vinci. The hotel's 24 rooms are named after the leading figures of the Quattrocento. These include Botticelli, Raffaello, Michelangelo and Catherine de' Medici. The invitingly comfortable rooms are decorated in a style that takes in a great many references, such as a highly typical caqueteuse chair, or a dressing room with curved features, reminiscent of the wardrobes of the period. Almost half the rooms have balconies. Some look out over the hotel patio, a haven of peace and quiet, while others, overlooking the Rue des Saints-Peres, afford a glimpse of the Louvre nearby!

title: A lovely hotel in a great location!
text:
A really lovely hotel and we had a great 3 nights here. It is the perfect hotel and location for a city break.

Positives: Perfect location, central to so many things and a 2 minute walk to the Seine. Restaurants and bars are close by too! Hotel is small but beautiful and the rooms are the same, small but beautifully decorated. Lovey products in the bathroom, plus a robe and slippers. Our breakfast was included and this was really good- a small selection of cooked food, but all the meats, cheese, yogurts, croissants, pain au chocolate etc that you could want. And a really friendly server (but I can’t remember her name). The spa is AMAZING. Definitely book your 45 minute slot if it’s included. We took a bottle of champagne down and it was so nice to have a private spa experience!

Negatives: It was a special weekend (birthday and engagement) and my partner had ordered champagne to be waiting in the room. This wasn’t there on arrival and he had to go and ask for it. They set it up when we were in there which isn’t quite the same. We were in a superior balcony room as I love balconies and a view (even a courtyard as it states), but there is a reason there are no pictures of the balcony view on any site… there isn’t one at all, it just leads to a very enclosed courtyard. This means the room was quite dark too. I would recommend booking the street view if you want to see a little bit more from your window.

Overall we would definitely recommend this hotel!

title: A secret history
text:
What a lovely stay in Paris. The Hotel Da Vince is a wonderfully charming small hotel with a little bit of history of its own (the name is not random). The hotel and the rooms are on the smaller side, but that does not take away from the enjoyment of the space or the staff. You will have everything you need. title: Terrible service, horrific breakfast
text:
I don’t understand how this place has such a high rating. Perhaps it just got bad recently? To be fair, it’s a nice-looking place and in really good shape. Everything is clean and neatly refurbished. But the service is just awful. 
Check-in was cordial enough. No complaints. 
But we booked through a Staycation offer (based on an exaggerated savings) and they forgot to give us the bottle of champagne. Not a big deal, but off to a poor start. 
Then we get in the room and discover we can’t use the safe because the battery was dead. 
The standard room was incredibly minuscule. I realize Parisian hotels are small, but this room was insanely tiny. You can barely just walk around the bed. 
The biggest nightmare of our stay was the breakfast the next morning. In my entire life, I’ve never seen such an unorganized mess. When we showed up, not a single table was cleared. So we patiently waited for them to clear one off. When we finally got settled, our first surprise was the coffee machine was broken.  I honestly don’t understand why a hotel would rely so much on a machine like that without a single backup solution. I waited 25 minutes while they tried to fix it. I kept asking the staff, Why don’t you just pull out one of those manual machines like they have in the bedrooms? Or at least offer basic filtered coffee like most hotels do. Not everyone cares about an espresso. I would’ve been happy with just basic filter. That idea seemed beyond them. Finally, after the coffee machine was settled, I make my way over to the food. Everything of interest was empty. The pans for the eggs and bacon were totally empty. They said, we’ll get more. When they finally came back with the scrambled eggs, they were hot in some areas and ice-cold in others. By the way, this breakfast costs €18 per person. 
When we went to check out the next morning, I was hoping the clerk would ask how everything went. I would’ve politely and respectfully mentioned some of the issues. But he didn’t even ask. Didn’t seem to care.

title: Best location, elegant, clean and great rooms.
text:
We spent 5 nights at the lovely Hotel Da Vinci, and recommend it highly. It is a small, elegant hotel. Fabulous staff were welcoming and extremely helpful. The room was in the back, so there was no view but that did not matter to us. The room was small but not confining, with a beautiful and comfortable large king sized bed, dressed in white bedding with real down pillows and comforter. We loved the bathroom, and the shower is a dream, great pressure, a huge rainshower head and a large shower stall. There were two nice closets, and good lighting.
The spa in the basement is a real treat, very magical and beautiful, and great to swim or soak, with a fantastic overhead jet to massage neck or back. 
Best of all, the location is perfect, two blocks to the Seine, the Louvre is right across the river, and a short couple of blocks to the heart of Saint Germain. Easy walking location but not in an overrun tourist location.

title: So charming with best location!
text:
We stayed in this wonderful little hotel 3 nights in november! The service is excellent and the check-in is quick and effective.
The hotel is so charming and the historywhy it is called ’Da Vinci’ makes it even more interesting/ exciting.
The only negative thing about the hotel is the size of the room. You can barely put ONE suitcase in a suitable place and If you by accident have two it will be really difficult to move around in the Room.
There is only one small wardrobe. 
But the beds are great and it is very quiet during nighttime.
The Spa is a very nice experience, really relaxing. You can reserve this little Spa for up to 6 People. They have no gym, but we where not in Paris to work-out, so we didn’t miss that.When it comes to ’treatments’ the information that you need to  reserve this at least ”two hours ahead ” is not really true.This tas not possible; We tried to book this but it was totally fully booked at least one day ahead, so if you would like some massage make sure you book this well in advance!
The location of the hotel is excellent. It is in the middle of everything. It is close to Louvren, Musei d’Orsay and not far from other points of interest. You have a lot of great restaurants all around.
We did not have any breakfast in the hotel, so cannot say anything about that.
Anyway; I would absolutely come back and stay here again but this time I would definitely not bring 2 suitcases.... Otherwise I really recommend this charming hotel!!

title: Nice hotel but a couple things could have been better
text: We booked two rooms for this hotel — ‘Invention’ room and a superior room with a balcony. The check-in process at the hotel was a little bit unsatisfactory. We had just arrived in an Uber after coming to Paris on a 3 hour train ride from Geneva. The check-in process was slow — my main issue was that three other parties came in while I was in the middle of checking-in and the hostess immediately tended to their needs, interrupting getting us checked-in, while we just stood there, after several hours of traveling.  I was in need of using the washroom so did not appreciate that wait. They had complimentary water and bread available which was a nice perk. As previously mentioned, we had booked two rooms. The ‘nicer’ of the two rooms, which was also priced about €50/night higher than the invention room was OK but very small. The room advertised a balcony but there was absolutely no view. I was a little annoyed that this was a bit of a selling point when it was not a nice balcony. In fact we all found that the cheaper room was nicer, with a view out the window and a bit bigger. The hotel provided a complimentary bottle of champagne for each room which was very nice, and appreciated by the ladies in my party. Our rooms came with breakfast included. The breakfast was nice. Fruit, breads, egg, sausage. Nothing too over the top but it was good. The hotel has a very nice atmosphere. Definitely a boutique feeling. The location is very excellent and one of the reasons I chose the hotel. Close access to the Louvre, in particular. The staff was very friendly. They had complimentary umbrellas available for use which we did use as we experienced some rain on the trip.  They have a bar which they call an “honesty” bar meaning you can take what you’d like to take and you write down what you took and they bill it to the room invoice. I liked this service as it was always accessible. The ladies in my group did not understand the bar system at first and helped themselves to drinks without writing it down. I did make that right, however, by submitting a list of their drinks on the paper, to ensure we were billed. Overall a nice stay, aside from the slow check-in and the balcony room being small and with a bad view.  If anything, it’s my opinion that the hotel should really specify that the room has no view, even thought it has a balcony, and it should probably be the same price as the other rooms. Perhaps it would be advantageous to have the balcony if a cigarette smoker but as we don’t smoke it was not something nice to have. The WiFi connection was quite slow, and the worst connection out of the 4 hotels we stayed at in Europe this trip. I would probably stay at a different hotel on a future visit to Paris but there is a chance I might return. The staff at the hotel, including those working at the breakfast, were all very nice and friendly.

title: Beautiful bijou hotel on the left bank!
text: This was our third and wonderful stay at the Da Vinci hotel, and it was as good as always. It's a gorgeous bijou hotel in a townhouse on the left bank, each room decorated with Leonardo da Vinci replica paintings behind the bed. Aptly named because the Mona Lisa was once stolen and hidden in the attic before it became a hotel. It's in a brilliant location on the left bank, with views of The Louvre at the top of the street and the Boulevard St Germain down the other end, surrounded by lovely shops and restaurants in neighbouring streets. There's a welcoming cosy reception with open fire resembling a gentleman's living room or study, and a lovely little pool/spa in the basement with changing coloured lights in the water (you have to book time slot as it can only can take a couple at a time, and they have swimsuits if you forget your own). Breakfast is served opposite the reception in a quaint little parlour with white clothed tables for two and an honesty bar. We had rooms 303 and 301.The pretty standard rooms have rather small en-suite shower rooms, and overlook the quiet street with full sound insulation from double glazed french windows. Best for a single traveller or weekend couple, despite the two wardrobes and dressing table, there is no room for a big suitcase, but that is typical of Paris hotels. Luxury rooms are larger and face the inner courtyard with larger bathrooms and twin beds if required, some with small balcony. There is also a lift to all bedrooms. The staff couldn't be more helpful - from restaurant bookings or fixing light bulbs, they were so welcoming and always a friendly smile. Particular mention goes to Raffaela on front desk for all her suggestions and help each day. I stupidly left my valuables behind in the room safe, and she posted them straight away. Recommended for friendliness, style and location, a real gem.

title: Disappointing  & over priced
text:
My daughter took me away for 3 nights surprise stay 
She paid nearly £1500 which didn’t include breakfast. 
No tea or coffee facilities are in the room & you have to pay if you want a hot drink. Nothing is complementary 
The spa is a joke!  Literally a small pool in a room. The fountain not working. Only luke warm temperature   In the photos it looks big but it is so small.
If you request a massage this has to be done in a separate hotel room.  This is NOT a spa hotel,  they arrange for an outdoor therapist to come to the hotel. 
The room was very small with no where to put a second suitcase.  No room for bedside tables either.  Totally impractical.   We asked for a room with a street balcony which is very pretty but again little dolls house table & chairs. 
Reception & breakfast area tiny as well. No where to kick back & relax. 
The area is lovely & the staff where lovely   Such a shame the photographs online are deceiving.

The hotel's 24 rooms are named after the leading figures of the Quattrocento. These include Botticelli, Raffaello, Michelangelo and Catherine de' Medici. The invitingly comfortable rooms are decorated in a style that takes in a great many references, such as a highly typical caqueteuse chair, or a dressing room with curved features, reminiscent of the wardrobes of the period. Almost half the rooms have balconies. Some look out over the hotel patio, a haven of peace and quiet, while others, overlooking the Rue des Saints-Peres, afford a glimpse of the Louvre nearby!

title: 2 nights in Paris
text: Great location for walking to the sites, warm staff, great breakfast. The rooms were small, but that's what you get for a boutique hotel down the street from the seine river and a 4 minute walk to the heart of St Germain. The hotel also has a cool history... 1911 when the Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre, the thief and the painting spent the night in this location. Good thing she is back because we had an easy walk from the hotel to meet her.

text: We were here for 5 nights in August 2019, and it was absolutely charming. We were there for our 30th anniversary.  The rooms were updated, the bathrooms newly remodeled (or so it seemed), the rooms were quiet with high sleep quality, and the location is close to everything. The location was perfect, right between Notre Dame, the Louvre, and Musee D'Orsey. Breakfast was very good with a broad variety. And the staff was wonderful and helpful. I highly recommend the Hotel Da Vinci to anyone traveling to Paris who is looking for a charming, boutique clean, updated, and wonderful hotel.

title: Great stay in Paris
text:
small but nice rooms. Good hotel service for the room . in general the people in the hotel were very nice and friendly. Everything so far ok. We will come again if we are going to Paris. 
Breakfast quality was good.

title: Horrible experience - do not book!
text:
Hotel gave us the wrong room type (we booked superior they gave us classic). We had called to ask for an additional bed in the room for one night - which was confirmed and paid for upon arrival (where it was confirmed again!). Then, we left the hotel around 6pm - still no bed so I confirmed with the front desk who told us not to worry as the bed would be installed upon return. We came home at 1 am at night only to be informed that there was no third bed placed because the room was too small and that they gave us our money back for the extra bed. It’s 1 AM at that point - what were we supposed to do? The hotel literally did not give us any help whatsoever and the hotel manager is apparently unavailable if needed! One of us literally SLEPT ON THE FLOOR due to poor management!

Next morning went downstairs and was informed that there was a mixup because this extra bed is only available for a superior room - WHICH IS THE ROOM WE BOOKED!! Was then confirmed that we did not get a superior room and that the extra bed magically disappeared. HORRIBLE experience!

We wanted to get an obvious refund - and the hotel told us there was nothing they could do and to contact our booking operator. We - that same day - emailed them to ask them to formally confirm that our room was NOT a superior type and that we did NOT get the requested third bed. They are now reluctant to reply in any way whatsoever - which we already figured when leaving there , so we have a bunch of pictures and a recording where the reception clerk literally confirms all the above. I’m curious to see where this will go - and honestly happy to put my consumer policy into good use and put a lawyer on this. Hotel assistance is the absolute WORST we have EVER had. Good luck booking this hotel - especially getting something done if you have an issue, you are going to need it.

WOULD NOT RECOMMEND

title: Room
text: dirty room, bad smelling, bathroom dirty, shower had mold. the breakfast plates were dirty as well.  the advantage is very nice and helpful staff. unfortunately I won't visit this place anymore, waste of money.  a pity because on booking.com it looked like a lovely and clean room.

title: Too many glitches, sadly.
text:
Arrival: Night receptionist, Mussa, was courteous and efficient, although seemingly unaware that the wi-fi does NOT function in bedrooms, but only on the ground floor. (This poor availability is more appropriate to a hostel, rather than a 3* hotel ?)

The 2nd floor bedroom was relatively clean and tidy, but with some shortcomings. The hand towel was so frayed at the edges, and discoloured, it was clearly not of an appropriate standard. Both windows had greasy fingermarks, at eye level. And there was neither a  bathrobe nor slippers, which were pre-requested.

I raised these points at reception, next morning. 

Breakfast buffet: The regular provider was only around at the start of my stay. Her two replacements were not supervised, and it showed. No welcome or explanation to new diners; tables not cleared promptly after being vacated; and various items being unavailable due to depleted supply/stock, such as eggs, toasting bread and black tea. One even insisted on placing the toaster immediately beneath a basket container, clearly unaware of the potential fire risk.

On the first afternoon, after the room had been serviced, its two windows still had the greasy fingermarks. I reported this oversight to the receptionist, who personally came to the room, and cleaned the windows, herself  - which I thought was an excellent response. 

After that, I had no further complaints about the room, other than the permanent unavailability of wi-fi, and the television which was out of action for some 24 hours, awaiting repair.  On the topic of TV, not all of the listed English-language channels were available - such as CNN and the two business ones - but at least BBC 1 & 2 were functioning.

The two "student vacation" receptionists were courteous and helpful throughout my stay, so a big thank you is due to both !

Overall, a comfortable  and affordable hotel in a convenient and respectable area of Paris was let down by poor supervision, training and oversight. 

P.S. Why are there no dessert spoons provided in the breakfast room ?

title: Good hotel
text:
Good location hôtel. Clean service and breakfast team are great, as well as night shift receptionists.
The tourist experience could be better if the reception were aware of the neighborhood attractions, a tourist map and a metro map would be very much appreciated on arrival, but they had nothing.

title: Long weekend vaccination
text:
Great location, close to Metro and the Bus, close to market's and Bistro's, very friendly and helpful staff, Breakfast was very good.
We done several daytrips to different locations we didn't get lost once.

title: Lovely four night stay
text:
This was our first time visiting Paris. We feel very fortunate to have found this great hotel at such a reasonable price (100 euros per night including breakfast for two).

This is a small hotel. Our room was accessed via a tiny lift and half a flight of stairs which was fine (we just had cabin bags). The room was big enough for two people with bags. The bed was very comfortable, and the bathroom was very nice. There is a jug and cups to make tea, but no fridge. Our room had a view from the second floor, and the double glazed windows and air-conditioning meant there wasn't any problem with street noise. Even though the hotel appears to be on a main road it was surprisingly quiet at night.

The staff at the hotel were friendly and helpful. Breakfast is simple but very nice, and again the service at breakfast was friendly.

The hotel is located in a quiet neighbourhood very close to a subway. Close to subway is critical we discovered, as this is the best way to get around Paris.

We would happily return here if we visit again.

title: Excellent stay at this fine hotel
text: Happy repeat customer here. After staying a number of times over the last 8 years, I appreciate how consistent the maintenance and services provided by the management and other staff members at this hotel. Professional, courteous, friendly and efficient, I have only praise for this establishment. Enjoyed the breakfast, appreciated the most recent changes in the menu. The room is very comfortable and well designed for my needs. Very clean. Great location for transit (subway, buses & streetcar). The neighborhood is worth exploring. The area is great for walking. Easy access from and to the CDG airport. I would certainly highly recommend.

title: Long weekend stay in Paris
text:
Air conditioning, breakfast buffet. Big bed in a small room. Location between two subway stations of line 8, area not very touristy. Good shopping and a few restaurants, where many locals frequent.

Closet with doors would be ideal. Bathroom very small but in standard in Paris.

title: Not worth they price they ask for it

Room incredibly small
Dirty bathroom
failed wakeup call from the reception

title: Average stay
text:
Staff were really nice. The place was a little more dated decor wise than expected but this didnt impact my stay. 
Room was cleaned well. Breakfast was average. I preferred eating out. 
The noise levels from my neighbours bothered me and my sleep. Constant door slamming, babies crying. TV super loud so it wasnt sound proof. You can hear them talking and slamming cupboard doors early morning/late. Jolted me awake more than once so that wasnt relaxing. 
If you go out late you need to ring a bell to get back in. I had to wait a long time one night as reception was empty and kept ringing the bell. It was early hours. 
The lift stopped working on my last day so i had to carry luggage down 6 flights of stairs. 
Overall nice experience and if there were no other options i would go back. It does the job for a 3* budget when you stay/arrive. 
Personally, i would spend more next time to stay a bit more up market for a full comfortable stay as a solo traveller.

text:

title: A perfect stay
text: Everything was perfect, the location it’s great, we only had to walk 3 minutes to take the subway and arrived everywhere we wanted to go, the attention was good, the room comfy and warm. Definitely if I come back to Paris I’ll stay there again.

located in the beautiful areas of the capital, we recommend visiting Paris during the holiday season because very beautiful light decorations in the streets, we were a little bored by the demonstrations but the hotel staff put us in safety by advising us the tourist sites to visit,
good size room and good breakfast

title: Great hotel for a citytrip
text:
We spent 3 nights in this hotel and we are very enthousiastic. Friendly crew, clean rooms. Breakfast was great in a cost breakfast room.
Close to metrostation Bizot with nice restaurants in the direct neigbourhood.

I really recommend this hotel. First of all, the hygiene was so good. The room is cleaned every day. Personnel of the hotel was so helpful. They did what i wanted from them. So I again choose this hotel when I go back to Paris.

title: First Time in France
text: We are very happy to recommend the Hotel L'Interlude. Staff very friendly, rooms clean and well appointed. We found the help we received to locate points of interest around Paris was informative and the option of being so close to underground and bus services was a highlight

title: Amazing
text: The sympathy of all the staff is incredible. The hotel is situated near a metro station so it’s easy to move across Paris. They offer coffee all day and some suits to eat around. I really recommend this place to stay.

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Can’t recommend this hotel enough. The staff are so friendly and couldn’t do enough for us. The room was beautiful and very big. It was so clean and warm! The breakfasts are delicious and such a wide variety of choice. Thank you for a lovely stay. We will definitely be back.

title: Lovely hotel with brilliant staff
text: Just returned from a lovely long weekend stay at this hotel. The staff are lovely, friendly and very welcoming. The hotel is in a great location and although away from the city centre it is only 30min metro trip away - which flies by! There is also a metro stop a stones throw away! Breakfast was fresh and perfect ahead of a day of exploring. Would recommend this hotel for a great city break stay.

title: Reception
text:
The worst service was from Mary, she's the receptionist. Very impolite, doesn't help, makes bad faces on the phone talking to clients. Who can hire a person like this? I wrote a review in booking.
Benjamin is the only dedicated, kind, helpful person I've seen there. The man from the breakfast was ok.

title: Bed Bugs
text: My room was completely full of bed bugs, unfortunately, I noticed that during the day after my first night of sleep and I was able to kill 3-bed bugs that were super visible on my bed. I contacted the front desk during the night and the staff at that time tried to find the best solution possible, which consisted of a mattress on the floor (the hotel was fully booked and it was not possible to change rooms). During the morning I warned the front desk again and the answer that I got was: " I am sorry". All in all, it was the worse experience that I have ever lived in my travels, I would never recommend this place and will never go back. I also opened a formal complaint in the European Customers Services.

title: Margot
text: I needed a reasonably priced hotel for just one night in Paris, and this one fitted perfectly! Although the room was compact, it was beautifully clean, had a nice view across the street, and was conveniently located. If you are catching a bus from the Bercy bus station, then this hotel is well located. You can walk to the bus station, or it's a cheap taxi ride away. The staff were very polite and friendly, and helpful with any requirement. There is a choice of food options right on the doorstep, with nearby cafés, bakeries and supermarkets to choose from. I would go there again any time.

title: A Very nice hotel in a very nice location
text: Overall a very nice experience staying in this hotel. Our room was spacious for a family of 4 (amazing bathroom), clean, modern. The location was great with an amazing Thai place, nothing flash but great food and also some amazing bakeries in the neighborhood, supermarket and 2 mins walk from Michel Bizot metro station.

title: Teeny weeny rooms but good location
text:
I had heard Paris hotel were smaller in size compared to other European cities but nothing  preosree me for this shocker ...it is so so  so tiny that you have to put your suitcase on the bed each and every time you wanna open it.then there is zero space to put up stuff. Just a narrow ledge like cupboard   plus the lift stops at a level between floors so you will be climbing up stairs with the suitcases.
Food..no eggs at breakfast which was a surprise. 
Pros...very great location.next to the metro.bus stop.has lots of bakeries.eating places. Bathroom was obviously super small but has very good water supply and arrangements..has tea coffee maker .
Oh yes...the front desk staff is super helpful especially mohsin. 
Net net a functional hotel .perfect for 2 nights .if a longer stay is planned may get claustrophobic.

title: Nothing bad to say
text:
Rooms were were clean bed was comfy staff were very friendly!
Easy and cheap to get into cetral paris (only 20mins). 
They have baggage storage if you have a late flight out which is handy. 
There are loads of lovely restuarants and bakerys close by and free wifi.

title: Good small, business hotel
text:
The hotel room, on the 6th floor was small, with a lovely view across the roof tops. 
 Although the room was tiny, the open windows made up for the small space.  The room and the hotel was clean and quiet overall, a perfect location for business meetings in this area of Paris.  It is located conveniently a few short steps from the Metro.  Although the walls were rather thin, the neighbors were very understanding when I asked them to try to keep the noise down.

title: Lovely stay
text:
A lovely, traditional hotel in a very nice and quiet area. There are many bakeries, local shops and places to eat. There was a Sunday market which was nice to walk along. We went to two restaurants - Chez ma Belle Mere which is just across the road and Au Tramway - both had really lovely food. There is a park with a lake just up the road which is a peaceful place to walk. Perfect location for the Michel Bizot metro station - the hotel is about half an hour from the centre of Paris.

We had a small but comfortable room, on the top floor [there was a lift] with nice big window and view of the street. There was tea and coffee making facilities but no milk provided. Breakfast was great and just what we wanted - a lovely selection - pancakes were a added bonus! The reception staff were friendly and spoke good English.

A lovely hotel - we would definitely recommend.

title: good value for reasonable price
text: small rooms but very clean and with all needed. a little bit too far from the centre. friendly and efficient staff. I would recommend to ask for a room on the backyard, front can be noisy because of the market in the morning.

title: Good value nice hotel
text:
We booked two nights here for a visit to Paris. The location is pretty good as there are shops, restaurants and a circus and zoo nearby. However, the circus was not open during the week in November as it is out of season.
It is close to Metro stations so very convenient.
The staff are friendly and speak English.
The lift is tiny, barely enough room for two people with cases, and you do have to climb stairs anyway as the lift stops between floors, however this was not really an issue for us.
The room was small but modern and clean. The bathroom was also small but adequate and clean.
My only complaint would be that there were no milk pots in the room and the tea and coffee were not replenished, however this is a minor issue and reception were happy to provide these when requested.
Breakfast was a standard continental breakfast and was nice enough.
You do have to pay city tax of around 1.70euros per person per night.
Overall a very good value hotel when visiting Paris, I would definitely return.

title: Great stay
text: I love this hotel the staff are extremely friendly and nothing is too much trouble I’ve stayed here before and will stay again everything you need is on you door the bakery next door is amazing friendly and beautiful products the staff are great

title: Great stay! Authentic Parisian neighborhood
text:
We had an absolutely fantastic stay at the Linterlude hotel. The staff was super friendly, the hotel is quaint and located in the beautiful 12th arrondissement of Paris, away from all the tourists and hustle-bustle. The rooms were super clean, beds were very comfortable and everything was just about perfect. The complimentary breakfast is alright, although they don't serve eggs (which they really should).

Walk out at 7 in the morning and you'll smell freshly baked bread from a multitude of Boulangeries around, kids going to school, people jogging and bicycling. Take a 5 minute walk to the breathtakingly beautiful 'Lac Daumesnil' in the Park Bois De Vincennes (photos attached). This was most definitely the highlight of our stay here. We would go there every morning for a stroll and the 4km run around the lake was is beyond amazing. 

There is a Fanprix supermarket just around the corner from where we'd get most of our daily shopping done. The Daumesnil metro station is a 7 minute walk which connects you to all of the major metro stations. The Eiffel tower is about a 25 minute ride (Mir Hakiem station). There are popular eateries like McDonalds and Subway just around the corner as well. 

Highly recommended on your stay to Paris, especially if you want to stay away from the touristy bits and have an unadulterated Parisian experience!

title: Best location
text: Metro is 100mt from the hotel. So peaceful area. Rooms are so clean and staff is very polite. I really enjoy my trip. U can move easily to plaxe u wish to visit. I suggest this hotel to who want to visit tourist places in Paris

title: Outskirts of the city in nice neighbourhood
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights whilst attending a concert. It is outside of the main city but in a really nice area with good transport links - Metro station and Tram a few minutes each way from hotel. Plenty of places to eat locally too, Villa Romana we particularly liked for the pizza, wouldn't rate much else we had some over cooked mussels, so just stick to the pizza its good !
The hotel itself was a good price, nice and clean with all the basic facilities you need. Corridors and hallways very old fashioned and in keeping with the building but the rooms, reception and small breakfast area were more modern. Bedrooms were small and bathrooms massive, but as we were visiting a city it was really just a clean bed and shower for the night. Breakfast was adequate, nothing special but you could get a drink and a few options of bread, pastries, yogurts, cheese, hams, jams etc
I you fancy a nice park, Parc de Bercy is just across the main road, lovely to walk around and get away from city life for an hour or two.

title: Tiny room, not worth the price you pay
text: We booked 2 months in advance and were dismayed to get allocated an extremely tiny room on the 5th floor. I had stayed in that hotel a few years back, before the renovations so the room we stayed in  has had a basic make-over, the beds were firm and the bathroom was basic and tiny but pleasant and clean. But the problem of that room was the size: there is hardly enough room for one bed but there were two twin beds! No room even for a luggage stand and we had to put our cases on the bed to get anything from them with our back touching the wall. It should be a single room not a double. When I mentioned this to the lady at the desk, she just said that it was like that in Paris and all the hotels in the area were the same because space is a premium. I know this, I was born in Paris! But then the price should reflect this and it definitely does not. The correspondence I consequently had with the manager revealed an arrogant attitude and a total lack of elementary courtesy towards a client. I will not recommend this hotel to any of my friends and I personally will not be back.

title: Birthday Treat
text: This was booked for my husbands birthday. Room clean breakfast room on the small side but adequate. Staff very helpful. Metro station nearby for sight seeing. All in all a very pleasant few days. Viva la France

title: Good hotel
text: Modern and clean hotel with friendly hotel staff! Metro just seconds down the road to get into the center of paris. Also had A few bakeries and brasseries located along the street if you don’t want to go far for food! I would stay here again!

title: Good value with excellent transport links
text:
I stayed here September 2018 for a week with my partner.

Positives:

- good value

- a comfortable bed and clean room

- excellent transport links (Michel Bizot metro stop is just down the road)

- continental breakfast was a bit lacking in choice but did set us up for the day, also the lady who ran the area was very nice and attentive (e.g. remembered us and that we have coffee)

Negatives:

- the room was supposed to be available at 2PM (check in time) however we had to wait 40 minutes for it to be cleaned first

- the room key had to be handed in every time we left the hotel, I thought this rule was a bit strange

Overall I would definitely recommend the hotel, in particular it was nice to be in a quieter area of Paris but still be able to travel easily. From the hotel it took approx. an hour to get to Disneyland Paris and under an hour for attractions such as The Louvre and the Eiffel Tower.

title: Good Hotel for small money
text: The Hotel is located right next to a metro station, so travelling the city is made very easy.The staff was very nice ans helped finding everything we wanted to see.The breakfast was alright, nothing special but enough to start The Day.Our room was small but really really nice!!

title: So good!
text: Clean, good looking and efficient, the room is a little small but it’s good for a couple and for a trip to Paris, located 2 minutes from the Michel Bizot station and so easy to reach every place of the city. The staff is absolutely kind and helpful, the breakfast it’s delicious and full of choices! I’m surely choosing this hotel again if I’m coming back to Paris. See you soon and thank you for the hospitality.

title: Comfortable and clean
text:
The hotel room is small, but really clean and comfortable. The bed is fantastic😊 the hotel is near to the metro 8 , so u can reach the Eiffel tower in 20 minutes. And the Nation Rer to go to Disneyland is near too. 
It’s a good hotel for couples and families.
The staff was always gentle and all of them speak English😊

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Me and my family stayed for four nights in Interlude Hotel in Paris. The hotel is very nice, clean and there is a metro station just 50 yard away, the area is very safe and there are some nice cafes, restaurants, bakeries, shops, Pharmacies and Supermarkets. The staff are very friendly the rooms are good with very comfy beds. The breakfast was good but there’s nearby bakery you can get your breakfast in. We booked two bedrooms and they put us one next each other with the street view. If we go again we will stay in it again. We are highly recommended the hotel.

title: Minimal and basic service in this hotel
text: The hotel was clean,staff was welcoming. Breakfast was the same every morning which was boring if you are on holiday and very less choice. I had to go and bring milk every time when making tea or coffee in the room even ironing board. Would prefer to go somewhere else next time.

title: Good service
text: We stayed for 3 nights. The staff was very friendly and the service was good. Dinner was delicious. The hotel is in a very relaxed place of Paris..not in a very busy environment and not very loud soundings in the night. Thats what we need. Thank you very much.

title: Short Stay
text: Nice hotel in a non-touristy part of Paris with convenient Metro connection.  The room was clean and well maintained with a comfortable bed and quiet air conditioning.  Staff were friendly, and helpful.  The breakfast was very good - espresso coffee would have made it excellent.

title: Great little hotel for short breaks
text: Basic hotel with a  basic breakfast. But perfect for a short city break away. Wall are thin so not the quietest but all guests seemed respectful. Very friendly hotel staff as well. Also in a great location from the Michel Bizot Metro stop and great water pressure in the showers

title: Budget hotel, most amazing croissants for breakfast
text: Stayed in this hotel for 2 nights. Landed in Paris airport and as first time travellers to Paris, dared to take a metro requiring 2-3 changes to Michel Bizot. Hotel is walkable from there (assuming you have luggage that can be easily dragged). Our room was facing the main road and although very compact room size, it was extremely clean and comfortable. Since we aimed to mostly be touring the city, we did not mind the small room. The breakfast was not very elaborate but had basic stuff. The show stealer were the croissants that were almost always freshly baked. Since this was a relatively smaller hotel, the breakfast was prepared as and when people kept coming. On a particular day, the croissants were over and the hotel staff kindly obliged to bake a round of fresh ones for us. The softest and best croissants I've ever had. Can go back just for that. If you do not mind travelling slightly more to reach the main destinations of Paris, you could try this hotel out.

title: Wonderful Stay
text: Located one block from the Metro so easy to come and go. Excellent staff and friendly. Stayed for three nights and loved our beautiful little room with wonderful bath. Very comfortable. Would stay here again. Good breakfast.

title: Paris
text: I arrived late in the evening for my check-in and fortunately the bed was very confortable with very clean toilet and bath. The night staff was very helpful particularly when i needed to leave very early in the morning on my last day. The taxi he reserved for me and my daughter was very much on time.

title: Three night stay
text: A  great place for a short stay . Handy transport links for the city sights plenty of places to eat and drink. Take a walk in the lovely Bois De Vincennes,  maybe a row around the lake . Only a little gripe we had to ask for more  coffee  in the room as  it was not replaced after use. all in all a good place for a short stay.

title: Good!
text: A very nice place to stay in, the breakfast is good, the reception staff is polite and helpful. The metro station is 4 min walking from the hotel. The rooms are clean and reformed, the only point to improve is maybe to put the small fridge in the room but nothing else.

title: Rude, aggressive and abusive hotel manager, please do avoid this hotel!!!
text: We were on our second honeymoon in Paris last Sunday and stayed at this hotel with supposedly good reviews, We came back midnight on Monday from the Eiffel Tower after it rained heavily with muddy shoes. Hotel worker at front desk spoke little English so we used a toilet towel to clean our shoes as we didn’t want any mud to go on the carpets. The following day that wet dirty toilet towel was left on top of our white duvet with an angry letter from the manager demanding €10. We immediately spoke to the lady at the front desk who attempted to contact the manager who wasn’t available. We went outside for 5 minutes to the local convenience store and as we came back we found the female manager waiting for us looking visibly angry. As I attempted to explain what had happened she became angry, rude and passively aggressive at me and my wife stating that ‘we people in France don’t do this type of behaviour’, I didn’t know whether this was a racial/religious/nationalist attack on us, we are of Asian ethnicity. She would not entertain my explanation an told me multiple times to shut up. I apologise for gett8ng the towel dirty and agreed to pay a fee for the towel, she stated the small white toilet towel apparently costs €10 to purchase. I enquirer as to proof of this before I part with €10. She said she don’t have to show proof and she could’ve changed me €50 instead! I expla8ned to her where in the terms and conditions does it say she can start charging me for these things and of an inflated cost. When she realised she had nothing else to add to back her claims she rudely told me to shut up again, finish my stay that night and leave the next day. I was left gobsmacked, my wife visibly upset, that we had been rudely spoken to, abused, and wer both left mortified and fearing our own safety. I told the lady she had ruined our honeymoon, she said she didn’t care, told me to shut up, and leave the next morning. Her own receptionist looked startled as to the managers behvaiour. We had no option but to pay that excessive fee on our check out. We would like to say we are both working professionals with good jobs, we have stayed in Dubai for 10 nights in our first part of our honeymoon, and we have stayed in multiple hotels in the UK and across the world prior to getting married, and never have we experienced such shocking, poor, rude, aggressive customer service, let alone from the hotel manager! DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS HOTEL, AVOID AT ALL COST!!!

title: Nice little individual Hotel for a fair price
text: The hotel has good metro connection to the city center. Rooms are small but modern, stylish and clean. Service is exceptional, the breakfast/Kitchen team is quick and works flawless in the background. Speaking of breakfast: its not the big buffet you would expect on a pricey high standard hotel, but its good value for the money. Otherwise you could go to a bakery or cafe nearby. On our arrival the lift was not working, that was a bit of a bummer, because getting the luggage onto 4 floor after a 40 minute walk from quai de bercy was not so nice. But the lift was repaired next day, so no worries about that. Wifi was ok, but not the fastest. Biggest concern for us were other guests. An italian family with wild children can be enervating, when the come home loudly after eleven at night. But thats not the staffs problem, thats just a question of good behaviour. The staff was always very friendly a helpful. You can use a computer to print E-tickets in the lobby.

title: Could be excellent, but...
text:
Nice hotel, calm and very clean, modern rooms, silent elevator. Excellent service. 
Only the breakfast room is much too small, very narrow and noisy and the service unable to cope with the amount of guests. Displeasing start for the day.

title: City Break
text: Just two nights in Paris, but lovely stay at Hotel Interlude. Second time there - very convenient for us. Room is clean and comfortable. Staff are extremely happy and the breakfasts are superb. Will definitely book again

title: What a lovely 😊 hotel
text: This hotel is an lovely location and a great place to get into the centre of Paris.The hotel is spotless and the rooms although cosy came with all you need all the staff are lovely and greet you warmly with a smile 😊 plus are helpful with the map locations didn’t want to leave Paris or the hotel great full on weekend thank you

title: Nice room but bad room service
text: The room was really nice if you booked the room for 4. The rest of the rooms are small. Street had some food, and nice locals tho few knew english. We stayed 4 nights and didnt get roomservice once. Tried to get them to change bedsheets, but they couldn't so we slept in blankets.

title: excellent service
text: Very pleasant and comfortable stay at the lodge. the location, despite the location in comparison with the rest of the districts of Paris, is well located towards the metro stations Michel Bizot (300ft) and Porte Dorée (700ft), besides, there are a couple of supermarkets (Franprix and Monoprix) around, and some fruit shops and boulangeries at less than 500ft away. Clean rooms and the breakfast is well served.

title: Great location, great service!
text: This hotel is located in the 12th District which is not closed to the touristic attractions but is instead located in the middle of a nice suburban area. The subway is a few steps from the hotel main entrance and as a result, it gives you the opportunity to leave early in the morning and come back late after a whole day in the city. The farmer market on Sundays was a nice and unexpected surprise. Good hotel for business and vacations, as well as families and couples! Thank you L’interlude for a fantastic Parisian experience.

title: Very well !!! Optimal Hotel in Paris !!!
text: This was our second visit in Paris. The hotel is fantastic, especially for this price. The area is very nice, next to the Metro station Michel Bizot, Park Bois de Vincennes and super markets. Easy zone without suspicious  dark faces !!! Clean room with WIFI, TV with 60 international programs, free tea and coffe, nice new fornitures. Good breakfast, good hours. Very nice STAFF, Thanks !!!
