Next to hotel there are a lot of restaurants with all type meal and prices, under is a great roast meat and chicken place good price, up the corner there is Burger King and Mcdonalds too. A good place to stay.

title: Nice stay
text: Metro right next to it, 20-25 min ride into town center. Nice, small hotel. Rooms quite small but clean and breakfast is basic but everything you need. Price good for what you get and for an hotel in paris....

title: Great base for Paris p
text:
Me and my wife had a two night stay at the Hotel L’interlude Paris. The hotels very easy to get too on the metro with the Michel Bizot station on route 8 a short walk away.
We read other reviews and read that there was not a lot around we found the opposite, the restaurant opposite the hotel s well worth a visit and walking up the main road Avenue Doumesnil there are many places to eat and drink all in all we had a great stay the rooms are a bit cosy but the showers are very powerful and the rooms are immaculately clean. You are on the main road but you get the sense of Parisian life.

title: Comfortable hotel for short stays
text:
Cheap but nevertheless comfortable. Rooms are small and modern with all the facilities you would need. I liked the area: lac Daumesnil, promenade plantee and the jardin de Reuilly are great places for running/ walking. Next to the metro stop, access is easy into the city centre or even to Disneyland and plenty of interesting restaurants in the neighbourhood.
Staff at reception were friendly and helpful 24/7; looked after our luggage for the whole day after checking out and even let us check in early on our arrival.
Overall, good quality for your money although, like in all hotels, the breakfast is too expensive. Better to go to the local boulangerie and fill your boots.

title: Comfortable!
text:
Very friendly and clean hotel near two metro stations (Michel Bizot and Daumesnil). 
The room were we stayed was clear and big.Also the bathroom was fully equipped. I must say that the Staff were helpful and polite.

We stayed for 4 nights with breakfast included which by the way was delicious.

There are plenty of restaurants near the hotel and there is also a bakery next door which is excellent.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

title: Terrible
text:
Sitting in the lobby as I write this. It has been almost 45 minutes that we have been waiting. The check in was 2.30 PM. We arrived after a long flight, tired and waiting to hit the bed and take some rest. 

The receptionist informed that the room isn't ready. Inspite of the fact that we reached an hour after the actual check in time. 
Very very disappointed with the service. Such a let down. All the good reviews about this hotel don't seem to make sense to me now. Already regret having booked this property for three days, all the more because I am traveling with my parents and it is their first trip here. 

Hugely NOT RECOMMENDED! They've already spoiled the beginning of our trip! Such a spoiler.

title: Nice Hotel in Paris
text:
We went to Paris with some friends for a long weekend (4 nights) and found this small hotel very close to the Convention center we were attending. The room was a little smallish but did perfectly well for us as we did not spend a lot of time there. The bathroom was very clean and the personnel of the hotel was very friendly and helpful all the time. I

t's really well situated with a Metro station nearby and plenty of places around to eat (Italian Pizzeria, fastfood, Thai...) or take a drink at nights in the bar just in front.

Having a bakery just next to it is a perfect fit when you can taste local products everyday there! Also, there is a supermarket very close to it so you can buy supplies for the day when going for tourism. 

If I go back to Paris, I would definitely try this hotel again!

title: Great hotel, friendly staff
text:
The room was small but clean and had everything we needed. Shower was brilliant! The hotel is situated literally less than 100 meters from Michel Bizot Metro stop-you can be in central Paris is no time. 
On Sunday morning there is an extensive market on the street outside the hotel.
When we stayed, the hotel was quite and we slept well. 
The breakfast was Continental-coffee, fresh juice and croissants suited me perfectly. 
The hotel is a short was from a large beautiful park and also Paris Zoo (well worth a visit). 
We used the luggage store room free of charge, and the wifi was free too.
The staff were so friendly and accommodating (man with moustache whose name I didn't catch-thank you for being so helpful and welcoming!). I'd highly recommend this hotel as a safe bet and convenient place to stay.

title: I loved this hotel, but not better than Hotel Porte Doree.
text: Clean, Friendly and accommodating staff, nice rooms although small yet this seems to be the norm for Paris. The hotel is close to food and trains (Metro). Our room was to the rear of the hotel so our view was of roof tops, buildings and the beautiful sky.

title: Very confortable hotel
text:
The rooms are clean, quiet and comfortable. 
A lot of restaurants and shops in the neighborhood 
The hotel is at one minute from the underground station Michel bizot. 
However you cannot take away the keys of your room when you go out. You have to leave them to the staff. That's not very convenient.

title: Perfect little boutique hotel
text: We stayed here for 3 nights. Everything about this hotel was perfect. Great location, less than a 5 minute walk from the Metro and with lots of shops & restaurants nearby. The staff were very friendly & welcoming. The room was ideal, with daily cleaning and fresh towels. We asked for extra pillows on our second day and came back that evening to find they'd been provided. Will definitely come back for another stay.

title: comfy but loud
text: I went to this hotel recently and had a thourghly good time. Their is a usual amount of space for a capital city hotel. It cookes a nice continental breakfast which ranges from crossiants to yohgurts to crepes. It might cost a little bit more than eating out. It is based in a nice residential area which is around nice local restaurants. It is a few stops away from the centre in michael bizot. The main line is 8 on the metro which isnt a mager line but has a few stops linking to line 1.

title: Comfortable and accomodating
text:
My 13 year old son and I have just stayed here for 3 nights.  The rooms are the size you would expect for Paris.  They were clean and tidy.  The beds were comfortable.  We asked for an extra pillow each and reception sorted it straight away.  Very polite and friendly staff.  The breakfast, although quite expensive was nice enough and you could help yourself to as much as you like.  All a good standard.

The only negative is the noise from the road if you overlook Avenue Damuesnil.  It's noisy at all times of the day.

The location although away from the city centre, the metro is only a few minutes walk away.  The neighbourhood was nice and mainly with locals going about.

I would return.

title: Superb hotel - perfect location
text: I stayed here with my 16-year old daughter for a few days in August 2022. We were so impressed with this hotel. The rooms were lovely - clean and well-equipped. The hotel itself is small but perfectly formed! The staff are very helpful and friendly. The buffet breakfast is great. What else could you ask for? And the location, of course, is simply fantastic. So close to all the main tourist sites. Our room was on the first floor and so there was a little bit of road noise from about 6am; but considering how central we were we really couldn’t complain. Loved it. I will definitely be back with my other 2 daughters when they’re a bit older.

title: Lovely little hotel
text: This hotel is in a good location. The rooms were clean, updated and clean and had everything we needed during our stay in Paris. and staff was very friendly.  They had a nice breakfast and was located near other pubs and restaurants within walking distance.

title: Great hotel, excellent location, but walls are thin
text:
Love this hotel for a few reasons.
1) Location, location, location. Hotel is on a side street just 1 ~2 blocks from major streets. Very convenient to walk around, but still quiet once you leave the main streets. In addition, it is located within 5 mins walking distance to 3 different metro lines/stations. Printemps & Galerie Lafayette are within 5 mins walk.
2) Rooms are a decent size. I would say big for a Paris boutique hotel. The rooms we had were 2 twin beds pushed together to form a king size bed. It wasn't overly crowded. Don't expect US hotel room size, but was quite comfortable for 1~2 people/room. 
3) Hotel staff were very nice & welcoming, bathrooms were stocked with Nuxe bath products. Hotel decoration was simple but tasteful. (Travel Tip- request room #55. It has a lovely balcony with plants that faces out into the streets and give you a nice pleasant view of the neighborhood. )
The only negative aspect of the hotel are the walls seem thin. I can hear people in the hallways when they walk past and room service staff getting ready for the day. Its a small hotel so there wasn't a ton of people traffic, but if you are planning spending a lot of time in your room, then this might be a problem. 
Overall I would definitely stay at this hotel again. It was quite safe to walk around the area at night. This is in June when sun doesn't set until past 10 pm. There is a British style pub right next door to the hotel, so coming back at night, there were ample people & energy.

title: Lovely hotel!
text:
We finally made it to Paris after our trip being cancelled numerous times over the last 2 years due to Covid restrictions.
Marie's communication with us was fabulous the whole time. 
The hotel is perfectly located off the busy main roads, all the main tourists spots are within walking distance and the train to Disneyland Paris is just 5 minutes away. 
A great stay! Merci!

title: Great staff!
text: We stayed for 6 days. Good location and cossy hotel rooms. But the highlight is the hotel staff who helped with every little thing. Especially Didier the concierge who had great recommendations and helpful tips.

title: Lovely hotel
text:
Lovely hotel in a great location, very comfortable with a great breakfast, where the staff were particularly friendly and helpful. 
Clean and great facilities ranging from the toiletries, mini bar to lots of fluffy towels. 
The bed was very comfortable, I slept like a log! 
The seating areas are lovely with bright, stylish decor. 
We were very happy during our stay and would definitely return again.

title: Ideally located
text:
The hotel is on a relatively quiet side road in Paris but in a very good area within the Madeline area.  

Nice size rooms, mini bar, good shower and bath, plenty of hanging room for clothes and to put the travel bags away.  

Great buffet breakfast, a nice spa area and the whirlpool / jacuzzi/ steam room are free of charge during the day but can be reserved in the evening.  

We used the spa and it was a great way to relax before and or after an early dinner.

The staff were really friendly and helpful.  Especially the front of house / concierge.

Location was really good sight seeing things within 25mins walk or 1mile to 1.5km away some closer.

Lots of places to eat and drink nearby as well.

title: Charming little hotel in the heart of Paris
text: Stayed here for 2 nights with my daughter. My favourite hotel in Paris: great location, very stylish and clean rooms. Breakfast is to die for. Close to the Metro, shops, restaurants and other attractions. Highly recommended.

title: FeedBack
text:
Amazing location, staff was very friendly however food quality and service could be improved.I will recommended for short business stays or weekends away.

Prices are acceptable however wasn’t enough variety on food options for room service.

title: Quiet, nice and close to St Lazare station
text: Very conveniently located between La Madeleine and St Lazare, this small hotel offers everything you need - nicely furnished small rooms, lady receptionist very helpful and very quiet environment even if you’re close to Haussmann boulevard. I will definitely come back

title: Julia’s wedding
text: Cozy bouquet hotel with all the amenities of Paris. Just yards away from the chapel. Excellent position to get around the city!!! Safe and multiple things to do, places to eye within 2 blocks. The absolute best in service. Reasonably priced.

title: Amazing hotel
text:
From arrival to checking out, this hotel customer service was outstanding. The room size was nice, it was sparkling clean. 

I loved their customer service. I wished I had time to visit the spa. Breakfast had a wide choice of option to choose from.

title: Great Paris city break hotel
text:
We had 3 nights at La Mathurin with the family between Christmas and New Year. 
Only 20 minutes from the station by cab and a few minutes walk to the shops and the city centre.
Very high standards and a great team to help us with recommendations to eat and drink. Will come back very soon.

title: Boutique hotel with generous and comfortable rooms
text: Recently stayed 3 nights with my wife and toddler in a Deluxe room.  The room was generously sized, with a sitting area and a separate bedroom.  Being on the top floor, the skylight in the bathroom was a nice touch.  The room was well furnished and had all the amenities you'd expect in a modern top-end hotel.  The staff were friendly and helpful.  Great location, with easy access to metro, and walking distance to major attractions.  A very comfortable stay and would return again.

title: Charming boutique hotel, friendly hosts, quality breakfast spread
text:
2 nights stay during a Paris metro strike. Hotel hosts were in stark contrast to the city metro system. They were charming, friendly, helpful, personable, although with the usual Parisian reserve.

The room was of a reasonable size for 3pax, had comfortable bedlinen, luxurious towels, and comfortable bedroom slippers. I especially want to give kudos for this as I hate the cheap, flat and thin slippers provided by most hotel chains, although it's incompatible with idea of luxury that the chain is trying to impart. Decor was charming if you do not have a preference for modernistic styles.

The breakfast buffet spread included in my package was of a very good quality for a hotel breakfast. Enjoyed the coffee, hot choc and croissants.

Also in a very good location. Will visit again.

title: Definitely recommend!
text: Very clean and comfortable room, nice spa and high quality breakfast. The location is also very good, just few minutes from the metro or train. We spent here 3 nights and that was really good time, recommend.

title: Great hotel in the centre of Paris
text:
My wife and I stayed last week for four nights at this 4 star hotel close to the Grands Magasins. As my wife has difficulty walking we had requested a room with walk in shower and close to a lift. The room provided, 17, was ideal, Spacious and well furnished. The staff throughout our stay were always attentive and responsive to any needs we had such as requesting taxis. 
I would thoroughly recommend this hotel and would certainly stay there on any future visit to Paris.

title: A lovely, boutique-style, hotel
text:
We arrived early, and the check-in was easy enough.   When we came back to the hotel after getting some lunch, we went to the room and were happily surprised that they supplied a foldaway bed for my teenager.  The deluxe room was beautiful, with doors to separate our bedroom from where my son was sleeping.

All in all, the service was excellent.  If we had a problem, then it was quickly resolved.  The breakfast has a tasty variety, and it is a buffet, so don't expect waiter service, but you can't fault it.  And as we paid for breakfast, they delivered a continental one to our room for my son free of charge.  Now that's what I call service!
The spa was fun, and the plunge pool isn't extensively large.  It's worth chilling out in there for a bit then going into the Turkish steam room if you can stand it.

There are good restaurants close by, and the back streets have small bars worth giving a try. Don't go to the ones on the main roads as you will get ripped off.

I would happily stay here again.

title: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MOBEY
text: Booked this for my parents and myself, it does not look anything like in the pictures or even close, the room is tiny, this was suppose to be for 3 adults not 2 adults and 1 child, the bed is tiny not even enough for a child and absolutely ridiculously uncomfortable, stained all over the sheets, floor was sticky and the service is even worst or should I say no service at all, Paid over €200 for this? The management needs take some responsibility for sure, I wish I had more time to write the whole horrendous story but I am very tired and jet lagged so in short please please do not waste your money like I did

title: Small hotel, great upscale area & safe area, many restaurants, amazing decor, super clean great staff.
text: This is a 19 room hotel in a fabulous upscale area of Paris. It has an elevator and no steps into it which is great for people with knee problems.It is so modern but has Parisian accents which I loved. Bed was comforable, friendly staff, super clean, great breakfast that even had a choice of Gluten free breakfast cakes and about anything you could think of. There are lost of restaurants and outside cafes in a 3 block area plus even a pharmacy in walking distance for last minute things. We wanted a king size bed and comfortable chairs to relax in. We got the Red room on the top floor and it had 1 and 1/2 baths, shower, tub, small frig,coffee pot, double sliding doors to seperate the bedroom from sitting area and shelves in ther walk in closet. Great find by our travel agent.

title: Exceptional hotel experience
text: Excellent location and exceptional staff and facilities! Wonderful. Breakfast had great variety and was very good. We were able to walk to several major attractions and it was only a 5 minute walk to a major metro & train station.  Very convenient.

title: Return Guest. Needs Upgrade Facilities.
text: HUGE disappointment! Beds are beyond extremely HARD!! Beds destroyed our backs!! Toilet not flushing properly. Staff at breakfast, hid in kitchen, very, very poor service, every morning. Low Standard.

title: THIS IS MY PARIS HOTEL...
text:
THE STAFF. THE LOCATION. THE DECOR. THE ROOM. THE CUSTOMER SERVICE.  

Everything about my stay at Le Mathurin was absolutely MARVELOUS.  The staff was so absolutely warm and helpful.  Especially Aurelie, she was so kind.  The front desk staff have amazing concierge skills and helped me navigate my way around Paris during my first solo trip.  

I will return to this hotel over and over again.  Le Mathurin is MY place in Paris. 

xoxoxo

Meagan

title: Enjoyable business trip
text:
Spent two nights in the hotel.
Staff is vey kind and polite.
Room was full of books from all sorts which makes the place feel like home, very cosy.
I travel to Paris on a regular basis and will certainly go back again to that hotel.

title: Great location, shower place could add a door or bath curtain
text:
Great location, but shower place could add a door or bath curtain. 
Room is very comfortable and convenient. Breakfast food and service is super good.
The front desk service is standard. 
Spa place is very private although I only took a look.

title: Great hotel. Will definitely be back.
text:
I originally booked a room at another nearby hotel and they had overbooked so they sent me here. I absolutely fell in love with this hotel and will try to stay here again next time. The Turkish bath is such an added bonus, couldn’t resist. They sell bathing suits for 12 euros, not the best quality- but enough for what you’re looking for in terms of a nice dip. 

Will definitely be back.

title: OK hotel with some let downs
text:
Overall not too bad, but some serious let downs:

- bed was a bit hard
- brekfast lacked in variety and quality 
- air conditioning was not working in the room. Asked the reception to fix it, twice, and nothing was done

In this area of Paris, at similar prices, I would recommend Maison Albar instead.

title: Fantastic boutique hotel
text: Lovely boutique hotel - not large but we were very well looked after and had everything we wanted/needed. Lovely professional staff.  Spa was quiet so felt like our own personal spa.  Good for getting away from hustle & bustle of Paris but still in central location. Highly recommend!

title: Almost perfect!
text: This is a great location, central to all things Paris, shopping, monuments, history, most in walking distance. The rooms are par for the location, breakfast with great variety and the most helpful, friendly staff (except the night deskman), professional. I would stay again. I'm giving it a 4 due to bed/room sizes...otherwise awesome!

title: Great Hotel. Grat Location
text: Delightful hotel, with very professional and courteous staff. Breakfast was included and of excellent quality, with a very decent range of food. The room was quite small, and didn't include a chest drawers, but apeart from that the room was reat with a nice firm bed, good quality linen, along with a really good bathroom. I would recommend this hotel for a weekend in Paris, it is close enough to the main attraction to be an esy walk or Metro ride, but not so close that you fall over groups of tourists.

title: Hotel and Location okay, stuff could pay a bit more attention to the customers
text: Hotel and location were okay, but the hotel stuff should pay a bit more attention to the customers and give more personalized service to each customer (I stayed there for my birthday, no nice word upon arrival, no amenity in the room).

title: Fantastic stay
text: Great hotel with great attention to detail. It's close to the main shopping areas and some of the main attractions. Rooms are nice and clean. Obviously Parisian size but that is common. Excellent service!

title: Nice hotel, great location, a few negatives
text:
The hotel is in a great location, you can walk to St Lazard, Madeleine or St Augustin in less than 5 mins. It’s a nice area, I was walking around as a solo female until close to midnight and felt ok, it’s also tucked away from the busy parts.

Positives: room was spotless and had some nice amenities, staff were also friendly and helpful.
Room has pretty much everything you need. 
Excellent location. 
I would stay here again. 

Negatives: breakfast is way overpriced at €24 and I spent €30 for breakfast in a Michelin started restaurant with coffee!
The room is very small and not suitable for a couple who would be climbing over each other. 
It got very noisy. My room overlooked a building and was directly outside the lift. I heard everyone coming and going, the people in the room next door and even with the window closed on Saturday night it was very noisy outside. So much so I had to use earplugs (good thing I always travel with a pair). 
On Saturday I went out and left the DND sign on my door as I had left some work and my laptop out. It was definitely on ‘Do Not Disturb’ and yet I returned to find the maid had entered and cleaned anyway. 
I wasn’t asked at checkout whether I had a good stay either and this would’ve been something I would’ve raised if I had the time as it’s not acceptable for your room to be entered when you wish it not to.

title: Kool,Clean. A nice quiet place to rest your head after a long day
text: I recently had the pleasure of staying in this quiet boutique hotel. I booked the hotel because of a recommendation by a friend who had stayed there multiple time in the past for business. I must say, she didn't lead me in the wrong direction. I stayed there for 5 nights. The staff was very helpful and courteous. I booked a Superior double room. It was a nice size room for Paris. Very clean upon arrival and the staff did a great job cleaning very day while I was out. The hotel is located on a quiet street very close to shopping and transportation. I did not spend a lot of time at the hotel and did not use any of the amenities. Very comfortable bed and quiet sleep.

title: Sight-seeing hotel
text: Compact, smart, good breakfast.Lots of books within rooms and communal spaces - a nice touch.Mix of business travellers and tourist couples.Excellent location for major sight-seeing.Downsides: rooms very small, servicing could be variable, no kettle, coffee cups not always replaced, drinks expensive, not much storage in room, staff in spa not professional (laughed during massage and whispered to one another throughout)

title: Just ok
text:
The price is expensive compared to 4 stars expected i think. Our view was a building. The services was good and employees were very helpful. 
The SPA room wasn’t soundproof then we can’t speak loudly, we should pay attention when we were talking to avoid to bother.

title: Good hotel
text:
We spent 4 nights in the hotel. The staff was very kind, we arrived very early in the morning and they gave us our 2 rooms, thank you so much. 

We loved the rooms of the lobby and the wonderful furnitures and the flovers (every day new flovers). 

Our guest rooms seemed brand newly renovated, it looks wonderful, we really loved its engerieur. The bathroom was extremely large, the room was small, but compared to other Paris hotels it was definitelly larger. 

The sourrounding of the hotel is very nice, you can make walks to every directions, and you Will find great shops, restaurants everywhere. 

To be realistic, let's mention the negatives

1. they offer soundproof rooms, but I would say it is only party soundproof. You can hear the cars from the street, and you Will definitelly wake-up every day at 6.30 when the garbage truck comes. We also woke-up when the lady next door come back to her room at 1.30 in the night and walked in her room. 

2. the spa is extremely small. Not even the jacuzzi and the steam bath, but if there are more than 4 (!) people in the spa, you can't find any place to store your belongings.

3. There was a renovation in the hotel, and it was disturbing.

But alltogether we had good experiences in this hotel, thank you for that.

title: Fantastic boutique hotel
text:
I found this hotel while travelling for business and have stayed here 5 times. It is a brilliant boutique hotel in the heart of the Paris. It is very conveniently located 5 mins walk from St Lazare train station which means I can be off the Eurostar and checking in within 30 mins.

Rooms are beautifully arranged with all the modern conveniences including smart TV and Wifi but also have a touch of old elegance with ornate ceilings and interesting artwork. Only criticism is the rooms are a bit small but I really dont mind since they are done up so well.

Other reason I love this hotel is the breakfast which is a full buffet of most things from a light continental breakfast to  cooked items.

Hotel isnt cheap but is definitely worth the money whether travelling for business or pleasure.

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
I visited this hotel with my wife on a short city break. The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful, I will definitely go back to this hotel when I go back to Paris.
The location is great only a short walk to the city centre.

title: Very good for business meetings
text: There are several lounge space (nice Sofa and table) which can be used for business meetings for free. Not many people was used during my staying that hotel, so I didn’t need to make a reservation. And also, the staff were very friendly and very kind.

title: Genuine Parisian stay
text:
This place is an easy walk from the Opera bus station, meaning it’s easily accessible from CDG. We were 3 people staying in the Deluxe room. The living quarters were spacious and well configured. The bedding was memorably comfortable with the only fault being a creeky bathroom door. 
We’d arrived into Paris on a 6am flight so in reaching the hotel very early the management were most helpful in trying to facilitate an early check in. While waiting in the business lounge they provided us coffee and orange juice. 
The in-house cafe is very expensive but as with everywhere in Paris, a patisserie is never far away.
Across the road there is a park with a small children’s playground and next door there’s a bar that attracts a sensible crowd (we weren’t disturbed by any rowdy behavior). 
I would certainly recommend this hotel for a short term stay in Paris. 
The front desk were more than helpful in providing useful information on the metro and the surrounding area.

title: Great staff and hotel
text: Rooms are clean and chic. They are a bit small but that is expected of Europe. Great neighborhood and location. Very quiet after a long day of sightseeing in the hustle and bustle of Paris. Pharmacy and Pub next door for convenience

title: Pleasant and welcoming hotel
text: Very cosy and comfortable hotel, within walking distance of the metro and easy to visit the sights of Paris. Staff were very welcoming and helpful. The room was very comfortable and the spa was amazing. Only problem was that it was noisy outside of the hotel at night as there is a bar right next to the hotel, but apart from that was a lovely stay.

title: Great hotel
text: The hotel was in a great central location; could easily walk to some of the attractions as well as to and from Gare du Nord.  The staff were exceptionally friendly and the facilities were great.  We were here to celebrate my Mum's birthday and all were very accommodating!  Just gutted we missed out on the spa, as we forgot our swimwear!

title: Great stay, wonderful location
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Le Mathurin Hotel & Spa. It is a lovely boutique hotel located on a quite street within walking distance to wonderful shops, restaurants, and a very large Metro station. Check-in was a breeze and the front desk staff were always friendly and more than happy to help with any concerns we may have had. 

The rooms, although not large, were cozy, bright and pleasant with plenty of nice books accenting the room. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom (with a shower/tub combo) was very nice. We did not try the spa during our stay.

Overall, it was a great hotel for a few days in Paris! I would definitely stay at Le Mathurin in a return trip to Paris. I would recommend this hotel to any person visiting Paris.

title: Wonderful stay
text: Really lovely room. Loved the haram, could have spent all day there. The desk staff were also fabulous. Great location if you want the designer shops, easy to get to other , more hip, locations. We were here on our honeymoon and very much enjoyed our stay.

title: NIce small hotel in Paris
text: Nice property with sizeable and well furnished rooms. The breakfast service is a bit disappointing: nice produce, but below average service. Front desk personnel is kind and efficient. Location is fantastic, close to the Opera and much of the best Paris has to offer.

title: A very nice and cosy boutique hotel
text:
The hotel has a great location, in a quite street, at walking distance from very nice areas. The staff is efficient and welcoming. The rooms are not very big, but have a beautiful, cosy and pleasant decoration, and have plenty of art books inside. The bed is very comfortable and the bathroom is well equipped. The hotel has a spa, which we have not tried.  Breakfats is good, though the choice of bread could be improved.

In sum, a great boutique hotel for a great stay in Paris!

title: Not the best for families
text:
My wife and I and 3 children stayed at Le Mathurin for 4 nights.  It was our second stay. We stayed at the hotel for this trip because as a couple we were impressed with the hotel when my wife and I stayed there 4 years ago.

The hotel is in an excellent location. Five minutes walk from Gare Lazare and the department stores. It is walking distance to Opera. On a quiet side street.

We booked a family room and a double room. We arrived to discover that the family room is actually two adjacent double rooms each with their own door leading to a common halfway and door. The doors would not stay open and we had to request a door stop. But then you could not leave one of the doors open because it blocked access to the toilet in one room. The door stops were taken back without asking on the day before we left which was frustrating.

The double room was on a different floor and a separate part of the building. That room had a musty smell. We asked to move that room closer to the family room and the staff were able to make that happen - but we had to move to an even smaller single room.

The rooms are very small. No room for a suitcase to be laid out and no shelf space in the bathroom. A Nespresso machine is nice to use. The rooms are colourful but now look a little tired. The toilet is in a separate room about the size of a small wardrobe.

The staff were helpful.

Overall, not great value and I will look at other options next time.

title: Great location, Beautiful rooms!
text: Very rare for Paris that value is more than expected for a reasonable price ! Very good rooms, clean, looking new, very comfortable, not tiny! Location is the best for shopping, sightseeing, just exploring the city. Very close to metro too (4 min). Highly recommended!

title: Excellent Hotel
text: The hotel was very good. Everything was easy to reach on foot. The staff was very friendlyWould book the hotel again anytime. The rooms were clean and for England very nice and bigust around the corner there are bars as well as Restauratns. Shops are also within easy walking distance

title: Great location
text: LevMaturin is a Lovely hotel in a great area, across the street from a historic park. They have a  Nice and quiet spa. The staff are very Friendly and helpful staff. The bed was comfortable and there was a bathtub and shower combo

title: Good choice
text: Excellent location, clean, space is just a little small, friendly staff. Breakfast is good. Good for a family trip. Could be a bit cheaper for what we get. If a bit cheaper, I would definitely go back on my next trip.

title: Wonderful hotel
text: Had a fantastic time at Le Mathurin, wonderful hotel and staff! We were playing golf at Le National and all our transport was organised and superb. Great location, lovely rooms and we were lucky enough to stay in the rouge suite which was beautiful.

title: Wonderful place, great location.
text: Had a wonderful time attending an event in Paris with friends. The hotel was lovely, beautiful decorated and all the staff were superb. We were lucky enough to be in the red suite which was fantastic. Would highly recommend it!

title: Paris Golf Trip
text: This in my view was one of the best hotels I have stayed in. The staff was excellent, curtious, illing to help. This hotel is located very close to all amineties. Staff was always n hand when required, I would use tis hotel again and will encourage friends to stay there when ever they are in Paris.

title: Short Vacation
text: Great time with the family.  Will definitely recommend to all.  The staff was great.  Rooms were available at 8AM.  Totally unheard of. Locations was great. And a small store around the corner that sold every little thing we needed.

title: A perfect Parisian hotel
text: We absolutely adored our stay here. The staff was very kind. The rooms are spotless ! We actually took a small trip to Barcelona between stays. They allowed us to keep our large bags at the hotel, then already had the bags in our new room when we returned. I was so please with our experience. Very close to one of the Main Metros as well.

title: Long weekend mini break
text:
A fabulous gem in the heart of Paris and only 15 Euro from Gare du Nord by Taxi. Fabulously quiet yet really close to walk to the sights and relax - the Louvre 15 mins, the Seine 15 mins, Place de la Concorde 10 mins and loads of street cafes for that well earned glass of wine! 

The hotel was perfect - aircon, really comfy large bed and couldn’t fault it.

title: Fabulous boutique hotel, well located in central Paris (8th Arr)
text: I love this hotel, I've been here many times with work and came this time with my family. The rooms are small but beautifully done. Breakfast is good and there is a small bar (but no dinner). There is a great pub next door and lots of restaurants and cafes nearby.

title: Small but nice
text: Great location, fairly small rooms, but nice and tidy and friendly staff. Breakfast was ok - nothing special, but with what you could expect. Could be a bit better when it comes to business facilities, color printer etc.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Such a nice vibe to this place. Beautifully presented, great staff, super room with a cracking shower and  perfect breakfast. Had a lovely run from the hotel up to the Eiffel tower. Well done to all at the hotel.

title: Wonderful stay
text: Lovely hotel, comfortable rooms. Great location.  Able to walk to opera and most major sites. All rooms non smoking which is an added bonus. Checkout at noon gives plenty of time for last minute shopping near hotel.

title: Great situation
text: Spent a very pleasant weekend here.  Very nice hotel, ideally situated for visiting most tourist attractions with metro stations within 10 minutes walk.  The rooms were well equipped although our superior room was very compact. Pleasant bar and good choice for the buffet breakfast.  Unfortunately we didn’t have time to take advantage of the spa.  Staff were helpful and pleasant and everyone we encountered spoke English.

title: Wasn’t Great.
text: Wasn’t what we expected! Room was tiny, noisy building work going on. Breakfast was horrendous not a huge selection. Every thing was very pricey. When I asked for a later check out as our flights where late in the evening the hotel weren’t very accommodating!

title: pleasant stay
text: i had a very pleasant stay in the hotel. friendly service, nice and comfortable room and a good breakfast. also well located vis-a-vis gare du nord and metro lines etc. i would definitely recommend to a colleague or a friend

title: Weekend Trip
text: Nice hotel in a perfect area in the center of Paris. Good for shopping too.  The room very comfortable and the breakfast delicious. Reception helpful and polite. We would recommend this hotel and for sure come back again. Keep up the good work.

title: Lovely
text: We stayed here for 2 nights and we thought it was such a lovely hotel. The rooms were comfortable and clean. The staff were all really nice. The breakfast was delicious. And the hotel is close to where we wanted to be - we walked to the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower etc - all the tourist spots. We got the train from the airport to the hotel - we had to change train once and the Auber stop was a short walk to the hotel. We would love to return, and will definitely recommend to others.

title: Confortable, Quiet, Centric, Clean and excelelent pillows. What else,.?
text:
I needed a hotel where I can be next to the Opera-Madelaine area. This was my choice and I was very happy with my decision. 
Clean, centric, quiet and with excellent ccmmunication near by buss, airport CDG train, metro, and airport buss also to Orly and CDG as well. etc. If it is in your price budget, I do reccomend it.  The standard room is nos spaceous, but I do not travel with huge bagagge.  The bathroom offers separate toilet space sepatated by door, for more privacy.  The beds and pillows, excellent.  I will return for sure.

title: Muchas gracias por todo
text: The hotel was very cozy. The reception was excellent. I have no complints about the hotel. The breakfast was well prepared and delicious. Thank you for your atention and kindess. Everything was perfect. Merci beaucoup and see you soon!

title: Almost perfect
text: The hotel is in a great location, has wonderful staff, a lovely lobby and sitting area. The room was on the small side but very nice but the curtains were closed for a reason: the was into an ugly tiny void with what looked like aircon units. Breakfast was also good.

title: A relaxing trip away
text:
The room was lovely,  I chose a deluxe room which had a extremely comfy large bed. We would of liked cable tv but we didn’t spend a lot of time in. 
Metro very near, as well as some lovely restaurants and brassieres. We walked to all the major sights. We would definitely return to this hotel

title: Excellent hotel
text: Great and well maintained hotel in a lovely and convenient location, incredibly helpful and knowledgeable staff. Great spa area, overall wonderful for our honeymoon - will be staying here again next time we visit Paris.

title: Elegant and efficient
text: Le Mathurin offered all that we required - attentive and efficient staff, comfortable and well appointed bedrooms, lounges and dining rooms, quiet yet convenient location,  Deserving of its star rating.

title: Not a 4star standard
text:
Tiny hotel close to Madeline. Good point are that is clean and people worling are helpful. But if you think that you are going to overnight in a 4star hotel....well this can't be more far from reality. The standard of this hotel is for maximum 2 stars: room are tiny, dark, old and cheap closet and incredibile, no possibility of climate control. Is very cold amd to heat the room they bring me an electric oil heater. Very polite, but this is not the standard expected with this price and this star positioning. 
Overated.

title: Nice, comfortable little hotel
text:
I enjoyed my first visit to this hotel, it is small and well placed within Paris for the meetings I had to attend.

It is small, rooms and bed are comfortable, very clean, impeccable bathrooms and from my room I could not hear anything from outside. Everything worked well
 Including the wifi.

Staff was very friendly, the breakfast buffet was more than acceptable.

title: Bells and whistles but that's it.
text:
So we arrive to this hotel, the entrance seems nice, but the service was poor.

Location:
Is not bad, but no that good neither, is close to the metro station and that's it

Reception and service:
Weak, basic, we ask for ice, sorry sir we dont have it, we ask for shaving cream, sorry sir we dont have it, and is a 4 stars hotel ...

Rooms:
Ok rooms, and that's it

Will I come back?
Definetely not, this is suppose to be a 4 stars hotel, but honestly if you remove the Bells and whistles of the webpage or reception decor this is more like a 3 stars hotel at most.

title: To dream
text:
Everything spectacular 
Reception very kind 
Breakfast all the choices to prepare in the best way to visit the city all day
Room a little bit tiny but the view was magic 
Bathroom big and with full amenities 
Only negative point the lack of refill on complimentary water in the room and the fact the sauna broke down the same day of our arrival 
Position stellar close to St Lazaire metro 
Anyway this is a place to return for sure
Final 4.9/5

title: Won't stay here again
text:
The hotel is mediocre but has really bad management and staff 
If you ever get back to the hotel after 11pm you have to hope that the extremely rude night shift bold receptionist is not sleeping for him to open the door in addition if you talk to him doesn't even reply its people like him that gives the bad service image of paris 
I believe he doesn't care about anything and the management is stupid enough to keep him and ruin the hotel's image 
I believe that the least you expect from a hotel is smiling employees and not rude and sleepy employees

title: Very nice boutique hotel in city center
text: Had the opportunity to stay at this boutique hotel for 2 nights at the suggestion of a colleague. Arrived early from the USA but was allowed to check-in to my room (at 9:00 am) - great start. Staff was friendly, competent, engaging  and professional. First impressions of the foyer and adjoining rooms were great -  warm and inviting, with lots of seating areas and comfortable sofa chairs. Breakfast room can be accessed by a short flight of stairs leading to to an open area below from the foyer. Assigned room was small (normal for Paris) but well laid out with standard amenities, viz., safe, fridge, small work table, walk-in shower (rain shower with good volume of water), separate WC etc. I think this is fine for 1 person but may be a squeeze for a couple with more than one piece of luggage. Power outlets were sparse but reachable from the work table with a normal cord length. Room climate control was responsive and provided adequate cooling, given the warm temperature outside. Bed was very comfortable and sound-proofing adequate despite the room being located across from the elevator. It probably helped that there are only 4 rooms/floor (at least in the action that I stayed). Wifi was free and reliable. Breakfast was standard fare and probably a little expensive given the selection - but there are numerous alternate choices within walking distance.I should add that the hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of several city landmarks. I really liked this establishment and can recommend for business or leisure.

title: Nice 3* Hotel
text: Fantastic location just down from Rue Dominique. Rooms are small but modern. Had free breakfast which is great incl. croissants, bread, pastries, cheese, cold meats, cooked breakfast, yoghurt, fruit, juice, coffee. Eiffel Tower easily walkable. Bar du Central is 50m away and does good food/wine. Couldn’t have picked a better mid-price hotel in 7th Arr.

title: Perfect visit
text: Location, staff, value, view were all top notch. The staff were incredibly helpful, as our language skills were less than basic.  The information and assistance which they provided helped to make our visit to Paris unforgettable.

title: Nice and clean rooms.
text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel. We didn´t have the breakfast buffet, but the rooms was clean and had lovely calm colours. The bathroom had a bathtub, and the room always had a nice cold temperatur when we got back from the warm weather of the city.
The room was clean every day.
We had one incident where we asked one of the employees a question, but we felt like he just shush us away and got annoyed about our question. This was not a nice experience.
But when we asked another employee the same question, then he smiled at us and answered our question. So that made us feel more welcome.

title: Great location, clean budget hotel
text:
Location … amazing neighbourhood. Walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, Metro, Cafés, restaurants, groceries, various shops, a laundromat right across the street, and the neighbourhood felt safe. We loved the location. 

Rooms … our Premium room (which included an Eiffel Tower view) was not worth the upgrade. The room was dated with stained carpet but it was clean (and the cleaning staff were great). The bed was extremely hard but the linens were always clean. The Eiffel Tower ‘view’ from our room was that of you leaning over a narrow balcony and looking left. Otherwise looking right out the window your view was a building rooftop. Unless you lucked out and got one of the few rooms with an actual view of the Eiffel Tower… the best views were from the stairwell windows. The air conditioning did not work and the air circulation was poor. The bathroom was bright and clean, though the towels were very thin and really rough. The room did not have an iron but there was one at the front desk, which you have to pick/return. Note - there is only one iron for the entire hotel and no ironing board. The closet needed more hangers. There was an in room safe and small bar fridge which were great to have. We did ask for a different room but were told you get what you get - 

Breakfast .. there was a good variety of options for a standard continental breakfast. The staff working the breakfast area were fantastic. 

WiFi… yes they have it but it is extremely slow. 

Overall we wouldn’t stay at this hotel again. 

Welcome Pickups … a waste of money - use Uber instead. Prior to our hotel stay we were sent an email from the hotel referring a company called Welcome Pickups. They provide direct transportation to the hotel from the airport. We were picked up on time and dropped off directly at the hotel but the price was double that of Uber … and there are hidden extra fees that you’re not made aware of at the time of booking and are hit with when you’re picked up - we should have researched this better ! Definitely don’t recommend this service.

title: Les Jardins d'Eiffel
text: Excellent hotel, staff and location. Room and facilities were also terrific.  We couldn't have been happier with our choice.   Almost all staff were sufficiently fluent in English and were always helpful with anything we needed. Check-in and check-out was efficient.

title: WORST STAY OF MY LIFE.
text: First day we arrive they place us in a room with no AC. We ask maintenance to come check it. He laughed at us and told us it was because we had our screen door open (mind you it’s open because the AC doesn’t work. Room was hotter than outside 90 degrees F). We sleep the first night and try to make the best of it. For the second night we politely request a different room. The second room had AC that worked just fine. That night my wife and I attend Moulin Rouge. ended at about 1:30 AM. We get back to our hotel between 2:30-3:00 AM. However, our key to our room no longer works. So I go to the front desk and request a new key. The gentleman at the front desk informs me that he cannot make new keys and that I am stuck outside for the night. After waiting for about 2 hours I return and ask if he has reached the manager yet to make me a key. At about 4:30 the manager responds and finally a key is made. I go up to my room and it won’t work. I come back down and he remakes it again and finally it works. The next morning we return to our hotel from the Louvre and the hotel worker starts to shout at us in front of guests and called us drunk. We calmly explained that the key didn’t work. After being embarrassed and harassed we return to our room. The key won’t work again. We go downstairs to explain and she calls us drunk and rude again. I told her she was unprofessional and that none of the keys work. Finally, a key is made for us and the hotel admits they were making a key for the wrong room the entire time. Absolutely unacceptable behavior from “professionals”

title: Excellent!
text: Hotel is in a very good location, close to Eifel tower. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The rooms could be a little bigger, but it was not a problem for us. It was second time in this hotel and we surely will come back! Thanks a lot!

title: Rude front desk
text:
Overall the room was great, great location BUT the front desk guy that was working overnight on Sunday around 4am ish was extremely rude. My boyfriend and I went downstairs to check out and he demanded us to pay after we already explained to him
That we paid already and on top of that while I was waiting I accidentally bumped my luggage on one of the chairs in the lobby and the front desk guy basically yelled at me and made a nasty face and told me people were sleeping downstairs which made no sense to me because no one sleeps in the lobby. It looks like this guy was sleeping on the job and was angry because we were downstairs waiting so early. I hope this review helps with anyone thinking of staying.

title: Clean and nice  location
text: The rooms are clean and the people are friendly, the rooms could have been a little bigger there was not really space for our suitcase , parking is very ok too and it is close to the Seine, and tour eiffel , enough restaurants in the neighbourhood.

title: Great location! Clean and cozy!
text: Cozy and nice small hotel. Clean rooms, very good service level, staff helpfull and open for any requests. Breakfast could be more variable. Very good coffee😀 Close to Eiffel Tower and metro station.

title: Awesome experience
text: The hotel was a lovely hotel! Beautiful and charming. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The room with the Eiffel Tower view was amazing! The location was also great. You have so many restaurants and shops walking distance.

title: Wonderful view of the Eiffel Tower!
text: We really enjoyed our short stay at Les Jardins d'Eiffel. We had a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower. The staff was really friendly and the location is perfect. Would definitely recommend to stay at this hotel.

title: You nerver get disappointed
text: I have been staying at this hotel since 1991 for for business and leisure trips. The service is very genuine and you never get disappointed. Very good price for money. Nice rooms size more Parisian standard with charm, excellent breakfast with variety of choices included in the price. The location is good you can go shopping around the corner and you can easily reach sightseeing spots either by foot, metro or by taxi. For taxi in Paris please add G7 app to you cellular. Excellent service, faster ride when they can use the bus lines and better price compared to Uber!! Enjoy your stay!!

title: City Tour!
text:
We booked our trip last minute and we were pleasantly surprised with our hotel. Located 15 minutes from Eiffel Tower and within walking distance from most attractions in Paris. Hotel is located on a small side street, our room overlooked small courtyard; nice and quiet. Room is small, clean, bed and pillow were comfortable. What I am not used to and prefer not having is carpeting(which indeed was clean).
Reception was occupied with a friendly, helpful English speaking worker.  Another positive staying at this hotel is that there is underground parking on premises.  We enjoyed our stay and would come again.

title: Great location
text: Nicely located to the Rue Cler neighborhood,  Place de Concord and Bateaux Mouches.  Nice breakfast although there were several days when we couldn't take advantage of it since we had tours before the breakfast time.

title: Location, location, location
text: This hotel has it all going on. The view of the Eiffel Tower from our room was spectacular. Even more so at night during the light show. The courtyard and breakfast areas were spacious and beautiful. The hotel staff was friendly. Checkin and out were quick and efficient. Although the rooms are small, as expected, they are more than adequate, since all we do in sleep in them and shower daily. They are clean and met our needs. The balcony was bigger than our whole room and bathroom and that is where we spent time in the evenings. This was a premier room and not one of the standard ones, so be aware of this when you book. All upgraded rooms have a view of the Tower.

title: Excellent stay!
text: This hotel is close to everything! Just a 8 minute walk to the Eiffel Tower and 12 min walk to metro, also lots of cafe/restaurants to choose from! Staff was lovely, very kind and helpful, thank y’all!

title: A Week in Paris
text:
We chose this hotel when planning for a couple reasons.  1.  Location.  It was easy walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, the Seine, and a couple of the museums.  2.  It has a parking garage.  I have learned over years of traveling that I will always want a car at my disposal.  The secure garage was perfect.  3.  It was close to the Rue Cler and a couple of restaurants, not to mention bars, and a pharmacy (for Covid testing to return to the U.S.).

The staff was awesome.  They provided us with ice daily for our room (when we were not drinking wine), provided wine glasses and an opener when we were, and provided advice and wisdom when asked.  I was looking for a specific hard-to-get cognac and they spent three days helping me to find it.  The staff provided us with an iron when asked, but no ironing board (used the corner of the bed).  They provided laundry services outside of the hotel.  A laundromat was directly across the street from the hotel.

Our room was small.  We had a small balcony that looked over the center courtyard with a view of the Eiffel Tower.  Our TV was small (glad that was not our focus) and our bed was a double.  The room was efficient, just small.  The bathroom was the star of the room.

The daily price of the room was higher than others.  The cost of the parking garage was 24 Euro daily.  Breakfast was included in the price of our room.

Overall, a very nice stay, but pricey.

title: Short Visit to Paris
text: Very nice hotel...checkin went smooth...FDA was brusque but relatively friendly.  Breakfast very good...made sure we had it included in the rate...great location , 2 blocks to metro...room was ok, European rooms, so small....couple of cleaning issues, but it was ok....decent value for money.

title: Great location and comfortable!
text: The staff was very friendly and they were fluent in English.  The rooms are small (but standard for Europe), but clean and modern.  USB charging ports were available so conversion plugs weren’t necessary.  We did not do the breakfast included option.  The location of the hotel provided great access to the Eiffel Tower in one direction and the Louvre in the opposite.  I would happily stay here again.

title: May in Paris
text: We enjoyed our stay here very much.  This was my Second trip to Paris, both times I stayed in this neighborhood and really loved it. There are Great shops and Restaurants.  Lots to See but not too crowded.  Highly recommend staying here.

title: Great stay with a great view.
text:
Amazing views of the Eiffel Tower. We were able to have our window open at night and peacefully watch the light show on the tower with only very little blocking our view. Just the houses in front but that added to the charm. 
One of the oddest challenges we’ve had traveling in Europe is the amount of plugs in hotel rooms. This was so not an issue here as there were enough plugs that we never had an issue. And most importantly there were several Usb plugs in the room! 
Breakfast was yummy and worth the little extra. Had some of the best eggs from a hotel buffet ever. Coffee and hot water are fresh as the staff asks every table when they sit down.

title: Daughter's 21st Birthday
text: Amazing staff, helped arrange the birthday surprise for my daughter. All very polite and friendly, rooms clean and comfy. Missed just a kettle in the room for coffee. Breakfast is simple but enough for the start of the day.

title: Great location
text: Les Jardins d’Eiffel, near Rue Cler, has a perfect location for touring Paris. The staff was very knowledgeable and helpful. The rooms are small, by American standards, but clean. Beds, not so comfortable. Amenities that could be improved: brighter light (reading in bed difficult); shelf in shower (nowhere to set shampoo or soap except floor); convenient electric plugs (there were none in bathroom for curling iron, in fact no where near a mirror to curl my hair); stronger internet connection. Breakfast buffet choices were plentiful, but mostly pre-packaged. Croissants, magnifique!

title: 3 lovely days in Paris
text:
It was a very pleasant stay, breakfast was very good, the receptionists very helpful.
Location very good , close to the river and many bistrots.
The 2 connecting rooms we booked were no as expected and the amenities in the bathroom poor.

title: May Stay
text: The location was very close to the metro and walking distance to the Eiffel Tower so that was great. Only issue was small ant problem in our bathroom and mildly slow wifi. Great overall! Loved how we can store our bags there before and after check out. Everyone was friendly and the lounge area was nice.

title: Amazing Paris
text: Great location to take a walk to town, beautiful and clean hotel with garage. Great staff and nice breakfast. Room is everything you need! Clean, enough space, enough light and bed is comfortable. Thank you for everything!

title: Paris holiday
text:
Price / quality is not good.   The door of the room was several times blocked due to bad working card.
We need to take and pay 2 rooms for a couple and daugher.  No room with double bed and single bed was available.

title: Great location, poor service
text:
Location was great, minutes from restaurants, bars and the eiffel Tower and River. 30 min walk to Louvre
Close to metros, linking to RER and everywhere else you need. 
Room was BOILING. Asked them to help,  was informed they would turn our heating off, but didn't feel like they did, meant we barely slept all weekend
Safe didn't work, felt like an annoyance asking them to fix it
Our waitress at breakfast was rude! Had her twice, not helpful, got annoyed when I wasn't fluent in french. Just walked away from us! Dropped coffee on my white trainers....honestly not impressed. 
Hotel was clean and tidy, pretty modern too
Receptionists were always friendly enough

title: Excellent hotel near the Eiffel tower
text: Spent three nights here and had a great time. The room was nice, clean, well maintained, had a comfy bed and a very good shower. The breakfast buffet doesn't have a huge selection but was more than sufficient, and most importantly everything tasted great - but get there early if you want to get your hands on a beignet. (Yes, they're worth it.) The service from the staff was impeccable. Great location, 10 minutes walk from the tower and 5 minutes from the metro (La Tour-Maubourg).

title: Great location- missing basic amenities
text: It’s a small boutique hotel with great location. Missing main amenities like : bar, gym, even simple coffee maker in room. There is no room service so there is no way of getting food or drink in the hotel. Rooms are tiny and it was super hard to move around, even tho I was alone. Hotel was clean must say that. But if you looking to be close to main attraction this is great location. But besides location there is nothing great about it.

title: Amazing expericne
text: We had a great time in Paris and Jardins d'Eiffel for sure was the best choice for us. The location was perfect, the hotel was very clean, friendly, cozy and the breakfast was delicious. I recommend it 100%.

title: Great staff but tiny room
text: Great staff, very helpful and responsive and make you feel very welcome. But even by Paris standards our room was tiny, virtually claustrophobic! For this reason alone we will not stay with you again. Sorry.

title: Good hotel, nice location
text:
The hotel is generally fine, a big bonus is a private underground garage.
Unfortunately my room was a bit tiny and could not see the Eiffel tower as from the other room wing. The staff is friendly, the place is quite even if the borough is full of nice food places, cafes and shopping options

title: Nice Stay . . . Not so nice service
text: Overall nice hotel, night manager not helpful about internet not working. “What do you want me to do about it”?, was his comment when he was told it wasn’t working. The fan in the room would not turn on to circulate the air, it was cool enough to open the window but noise from the street below kept us from sleeping well.

title: Fantastic boutique hotel!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Jardins d'Eiffel! Rooms were clean and well appointed, service was friendly and the location was wonderful. Beds were very comfortable. My only complaint would be that the rooms were pretty small (as was the elevator!) with nowhere to unpack a suitcase. The walk to the Eiffel Tower took about 10 minutes at most, so the location was wonderful. We did not eat the hotel breakfast, but found a charming and delicious patisserie down the street where we ate every morning.

title: Rencontre á Paris
text: I was surprised to find this little sympathetic Good hotel in Paris. Good breakfast, silent at nights. Beds on a little bit of a small size. Good and comfortable stay just around the corner to Eiffel tour.

title: Lovely Stay
text: The hotel is in a great area for walking to the Eiffel tower and plenty of cafes and restaurants (some are a bit expensive but citys are expensive).  The room was ok, clean and warm, the bed was comfy and shower was good. The staff were very nice and our room was ready before check in (we arrived at 10am) whixh was amazing!  The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because of how busy breakfast was , the staff were stressed (understandably) and they did a great job considering they were run off their feet however if there was more staff it would have been a more relaxed experience.  The breakfast food was good and coffee was great.  Thanks for making our stay very pleasant 😊

title: Fine three star hotel
text:
This is a fine three star hotel. The rooms are clean and the bed was comfortable. The breakfast is 15 euro. The scrambled eggs were great, the croissants were not. Skip those and go to one of the bakeries around the corner. 

It’s a great walkable area and very close to the Eiffel Tower; I had a view from room 201. 

To be more eco friendly, they could have glass bottles instead of small plastic bottles of shampoo and body wash and if the towels are hanging up they don’t need to be changed.

title: Convenient located next to Eiffel Tower
text: For an 'executive double room' it was quite small, with instant coffee (not very executive!). Wifi was slow, but that goes for the whole of France. The room doors slam very hard into their locks. It makes for noisy nights. The front desk clerk claimed it had to do with fire regulations, but that is nonsens. You can both have noise-free doors and fire safety. Let a carpenter have a look at it, and I am sure he can create noise-free room doors. As for the breakfast, it was a bit poor. Cold eggs, portioned packaged cheese, bottled orange juice instead of freshly squeezed, and instant coffee. For a few euro's more, you can serve better quality and people will be willing to pay when they stay in a hotel like Jardins d'Eiffel. The parking under the hotel is great! Decoration is fine too. One last thing: get better pillows! The bed is great, but the weak little pillows are not so great. Make that more in balance. I slept well and enjoyed my stay. yes, I am critical, but that's part of my job as a mystery guest...

title: MEDIOCRE MOTEL
text: Worst experience with hotels ever. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, this is a mediocre motel. The only reason I chose this hotel was the room with Eiffel tower view. I saw that this hotel has this type of rooms with this view and before booking the room I have contacted them directly to be sure that I will book the room that I want. I spoke by e-mail with a hotel employee named Mathilde who assured me that I had the room I wanted reserved, a Premium room with direct from the bed Eiffel Tour view. I made the reservation a month and half before. Instead, I received a very very small room (size of a normal bathroom) with old furniture, uncomfortable bed, smell damp, old and dirty carpet, so was the curtain, old TV. The view was ridiculous, the tip of the Eiffel Tour outside of the room in a poor, unsafe and dangerous balcony. THE WORST PART: NO HEATING IN THE ROOM IN FEBRUARY IN PARIS! A maximum temperature of 8 degrees outside during the day. I had the pleasure of meeting Mathilde at the reception when I went to report all these problems. Although I read to her what she wrote in e-mails, she kept telling me that it was not true, that I have not reserved a Premium room with Eiffel tower. And regarding the heating that an engineer will come to repair the heat, which did not happen. There was no coffee machine in the room, no mini bar, just 1 still water. Small wardrobe with 3 hangers. Not good value, I have paid 430 EUROS for 2 nights. Breakfast poor, there was no diversity, some pastry and some cold eggs, I had to eat at restaurants every morning. All the employees of this hotel I came in contact with were rude, unwelcome and arrogant. THE WORST HOTEL I'VE EVER STAYED IN!

title: Excellent stay in Paris
text: The reception was very friendly when welcoming us to the hotel, the rooms were spotless and breakfast was great. The location of the hotel was excellent, a small walk from pretty much everything. The rooms were a bit small, but that’s Paris.

title: Poor place
text: poor room, uncomfortable bed and overpriced, small and dangerous balcony with poor view of the eiffel tower, totally a scam. Staff unhelpful with bags, the room had dirty pillows and the tiles in the balcony are super slippery and dangerous, the fence is old and dangerous too. The view in the announcement picture is totally different of what I got. Awful place

title: Great stay with awesome views
text: We stayed in the Premium room with views of the Eiffel tower from the balcony. The room although small was comfortable and clean. The staff were very friendly and helped answer all our questions and accommodated our special requests. Will definitely recommend this to all our friends and family.

title: Great place to stay
text:
Best place to stay if you are looking for a place with eiffel tower view and in budget! Amazing breakfast menu with hot coffee/tea! Amazing view from room, and has good connectivity! Most recommended than other costly hotels with small distant view of tower! This view is more amazing and beautiful than the pictures shown! 

Thanks Les jardins hotel for making our stay memorable

title: Good hotel with great location
text: Nice room with clean facilities, room size is standard for Paris , Hotel is near to metro, Eiffel Tower, restaurants, bars and minimarts. Breakfast is standard but get bored after two days due to same thing every morning.

title: Awesome hotel!
text:
Great location, the staff is nice and even the ones who don’t speak English make an effort, the room is lovely and you can see the Eiffel Tower from you window (room 502)!
The best option in Paris! Absolutely love it!

title: Excellent for a visit to Paris
text:
Very nice neighbourhood with restaurants, patisseries, shops, pharmacies,...
Hotel very well maintained and clean.
Very professional, friendly and helpful staff.
The view from my room was for the outside garden and... the Eiffel Tower! Fantastic for a romantic stay!
The breakfast was also good.
Very near the Metro.
I will stay again in future visits to paris and already recommended it to my friends and family!
See you soon!

title: Happy I chose this hotel
text: I wanted to stay in this area and am glad I chose this hotel. While it is close to many tourist attractions and transportation options, the location is very quiet. As others have said, the rooms are small but as a tourist I am not coming to spend time in my room. Breakfast was good, staff pleasant and helpful. Also, most of the other guests seemed to be French. As an American, I liked that. Definitely recommend.

title: Cozy hotel in the heart of the City of Lights
text: Ideally located nearby a few main touristic sightseeings in Paris and close to metro/bus stations. Lots of restaurants, coffee shops and shops around. Very calm area over the night. Good variety of choices for the breakfast in the morning and very pleasant staff. A bit pricey for the offering, but all-in-all acceptable.

title: GREAT LOCATION!
text: STOP SEARCHING just stay here! The LOCATION is perfect! walking distance to a lot of tourist spots, restaurants, pharmacy(for covid test €25) right next to a bus stop (69) and short distance to the METRO station(C). The hotel offers delicious breakfast, nice clean room (ask for room upgrade with eiffel tower view its worth it.) the staff are really friendly and helpful. We will definitely stay here again and would recommend it to our family and friends.

title: A 3star hotel that doesn’t allow you to choose the temperature of the AC
text: The hotel doesn’t allow you to choose the temperature of your own room, something I’ve never seen before. The room was hot and I wanted to turn on the AC, but it didn’t work. When I called the reception they said it’s because it’s fall and they have a central AC set to only allow heating. This is ridiculous, people like their rooms in different temperatures, if I’m paying I should be allowed to choose whatever is comfortable for me. Very upsetting. Also, it’s the smallest room I’ve ever been in my life.

title: Great location, great hotel
text:
This is a great hotel. We were in Paris for only 2 days and booked this place because it is close to Eiffel. Turned out the location offers a lot more. The area is a combination of residents and tourism. So one gets to experience what Parisian culture actually is. The surroundings are packed with cafes , bakeries and restaurants. There is a Carrefour around the corner, Eiffel is less than 10 mins away, train station from where you can get anywhere in Paris is a short walk. Lots of parks. Train can get to Louvre (20 mins) , Notre Dame / St. Michel fountain / Shakespeare & Co. ( 7 mins). 
Lots of boutiques , value stores, spas and pharmacies close by. So you can do loads no matter how much time you have. We could not have experienced Paris as much as we did if it wasn’t from this hotel. 
The hotel itself is sparkling clean. The housekeeping comes in everyday no matter how short your trip is. Rooms are small ( as in Europe) but well furnished and super comfy. Bathrooms are brand new and come with all supplies including hairdryer. Our room was on the first floor with a terrace view but we could still see Eiffel. 
Breakfast was also good. Included a combination of hot varieties and many breads. Fruit was awesome. I would highly recommend this place.

title: Perfect base from which to explore Paris!
text: Staff was very warm and friendly, spoke English, and always greeting us as we came and went. Location was perfect, lots of patisseries and other eateries around, laundromat across the way, and close to all the major attractions. Rooms were quiet, comfortable, but just a tad bit small (not much room to maneuver around). It was still fine with us since we weren't really in the room that much! Would definitely stay again.

title: Pleasant stay
text: The hotel is walking distance to the metro and the Eiffel Tower. The room is comfortable and clean. Breakfast was super. The staff are very helpful. We had a delayed suitcase and both the day and night receptionists knew about it and took extra care to let us know as soon as it arrived, which was great!

title: Top hotep
text: Super hotel,location and staff. Breakfast top, location also. You are closevto Eiffel tower, metro, restaurants. We had a room with Eiffel Tower view, it wascreally nice to wake up with Eiffel towe view

title: Great return visit
text:
Everyone at reception went out of their way to be friendly and help to resolve any questions during our stay.  Breakfast was great.
Appreciated the updated rooms since our last visit a few years ago.
Merci, until next time.
Ian

title: 100% recommended
text:
Extremely helpful and friendly staff, excellent location and very high standard of cleanliness in the room. Mattress was a bit on the softer side, but that's personal preference and we slept very well anyway. 
Breakfast had something for everyone and the staff there was super friendly too.
We booked a room with Eiffel Tower view and got exactly what we wanted and expected. 
We definitely will be back!

title: Great location, coffee can be beter
text: The hotel is just perfect, super close to everything, metro really close too. In front you have a great bakkery and nice restaurants. Breakfast was fine, maybe the coffee can better but dor the rest all great...people at the reception friendly and polite.

title: A Hidden Gem
text: This hotel is a gem hidden in plain sight. It is on rue Amélie - yes, I read the book, too! It is an easy car ride from CDG airport. The hotel put in touch with a wonderful car service. We were able to check in as soon as we arrived, which was wonderful after a trans-Atlantic flight. There are many restaurants, cafés, boulangeries, patiseries, (and even an Irish pub) nearby. If you come while the pass sanitaire is still in effect, the hotel staff will give you directions to the nearest pharmacy. The hotel staff was kind, helpful, and very professional. The breakfast was large and very tasty. This lovely hotel and it's staff is now at the top of my list for Paris hotels. Oh, did I mention that we had an incredible view of the Eiffel Tower? Oh, yes, we did. Do come and stay at the Hotel Jardins d'Eiffel. You will love it.

title: location  location location !!!
text:
Located near all, heart of Paris, next to Metro, walking distance from lots of major attractions.
Hotel was cozy warm and very pleasant and efficient.
VIEW OF THE EIFFEL TOWER FROM OUR ROOM WINDOW WAS SPECTACULAR! 
Took my 17 years old daughter for her dream vacation and that Lovely friendly hotel made it come true. Breakfast is great fresh and yami, loved the coffee and fresh  croissants….. it  will be our second home in Paris that’s for sure.

title: Great location
text: Hotel is very clean, breakfast is okay, everyone can find something to eat. Location is perfect and the service (especially during the breakfast) is amazing. Parking is a big advantage, though little scary to enter. The only thing i didn’t like is the size of the room. They are very very small. So, for the next time i’d choose bigger one. All in all, perfect hotel for 1-3 nights.

title: Totally satisfied
text: Staying at LJd'E was a throughly positive experience. The room was clean, comfortable and quiet with a great view of the Eiffel Tower. The breakfast was generous and of a high standard. The staff were all very helpful.

title: Dissatisfied
text: Small, old tired rooms.  For almost 1,000 US rooms are not worth it.  The breakfast was cold and boring.  Nothing Parisian but motel 6 food.  The service was lacking.  We had to come 4 times down to let them know key room was not working.  Even the housekeeper could not open door.  As per connecting room really?

title: Amazing views and location
text:
This was my favorite hotel ever. We had a beautiful room, and the view of the eiffel tower was magic.
I would definetly come back again.
It is very close to all the main attractions and there are plenty of shops around.

title: Small but nice!
text:
We stayed in a Premium Twin Room with balcony. The hotel was very nice! Room was VERY small, but probably to be expected in Europe. The balcony was larger than our room, haha. Not a big problem since we were out all day. Beds are very comfortable, and AC and shower were great. Breakfast included was also impressive. Veronique was very helpful and kind during booking and when I was emailing with questions!

Complaints: There was no table/chairs/anything on the balcony. We thought we would be able to have coffee/breakfast or wine out there. It was good for a cigarette if you smoke, though. And, there were ants in the bathroom. And one of the male nighttime concierges was kind of rude. 

Otherwise an amazing stay and great location!!!

title: Wonderful week
text:
We had a lovely time at Jardins d'Eiffel. It is located approx 10 minutes walk from the Eiffel tower. Walking distance to Invalides, Louvre, Arc of Triomphe. 
The closest Metro station is about 800m, nearest bus stop about 150m. 
We had a nice reception. The staff we encoutnered throughout our stay were helpful and friendly. I needed assistance on two occasions, and I was provided the help. 
We stayed at the hotel for a week. 
Our room (111) had a balcony and a view to the tower. Very happy with that.
