Breakfast had scrambled eggs, bacon, sausages. Ham and cheese. Yogurt. Fruit salad. Pastries, toast. Cereal and milk. Two types of juice. We were asked about our preference of drink (varieties of coffee or tea). It was nice that they have green tea as well.
Jardin d'Eiffel offers luggage hold. We checked out at noon, but had until 4pm in the city, so that was much appreciated.
Our bed was made evey day. I am used to changing the towels, if I were to leave them on the floor. I really don't mind havin the same towel for a few days. Here, it was changed every day. 
The price was as it was. I usually book about a year ahead. This time it was two weeks.
I would definetely stay there again.

title: Room with a view
text: Everything was very good, location, service etc. Booked a room and took also an extra option- the view to the Eiffel tower - which cost €40, much did i know and at the check out was a big surprise that it was applied for every day not just once. By extra options it was not explained and clear at all and that’s why im disappointed.

title: Small, clean, comfortable rooms, wonderful location, good value
text: I was surprised at how small our room was but it didn't matter in the end as we barely spent any time in it. We slept comfortably, the hotel was clean and quiet, the staff were warm, welcoming, efficient, professional. The location can not be beat.

title: My new favorite hotel in Paris
text: Incredible views of the Eiffel Tower! It was all my Parisian dreams come true. I’ve bookmarked this place to stay again anytime I find myself back in Paris. The staff was wonderful and happy to answer any and all questions I had.

title: Superb!
text: Wonderful staff, great AC , excellent location and parking on location was an absolute blessing!!!  Clean, modern rooms with sound proof windows and comfy beds. Nice breakfast spread and wine selection. Will def stay again.

title: lovely clean hotel
text: lovely continental breakfasts, clean lightroom, comfortable bed, and friendly staff.  Will always go back when in Paris.  Plus an underground car parking area, safe and reliable.  PLus quaint Parisian balconies

title: Unsafe
text: I stayed at the hotel for one night, left the room for a couple of hours and my laptop and charger got stolen on my bed in my room!!! The hotel staff was not friendly nor helpful. The asked me if I left my room open? ( off course I did not and impossible to leave it open which was checked later with the responsible ) if I left a window open? - no I did not - and even if so, I was on the 5th floor without balcony! I felt very unsafe during the following night; afraid that someone would enter my room and went to the police the day after to file a rapport ( where there luckily they were very helpful ) I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, unsafe a nightmare!

title: Great hotel
text: Small room but otherwise this hotel was excellent.  Great service and great location. Nice breakfast provided one avoids the apple in the fruit salad.  Plenty of nearby dining opportunities in the area and reasonably close to public transport.

title: "Fine" Place for a Short Stay
text:
This hotel is on a little side street that is so easy to miss! We stayed here for two nights and I would say it is just "fine". The best part of the hotel is of course the distance to the Eiffel Tower--but the Eiffel Tower view room does cost an extra 30 euros a day! It is also a short walk from Pont Alexander III, which is very close to Champs Elysees! In short, this hotel has lots of sights to see in a 2 mile radius which is easily walkable if you are looking to up your step count ;)

The staff was very friendly. We had an easy check in and check out. I personally didn't ask for any advice about sights to see but I did overhear them recommending some places to other hotel guests and they were very patient.

In terms of breakfast, they have a very simple spread (when we were there it was eggs, bacon, sausage, yogurt, fruits, and an array of different pastries). They also had tea and coffee out in the lobby for people. The staff in the breakfast room didn't speak a lot of English, but it wasn't hard to communicate with them!

The rooms are small, but that is normal in Europe, and the price is pretty steep, but overall, a nice and quite stay! The only thing I would note is the lack of hot water--there wasn't a boiler in the room and it's cold in the winter! But they have hot water, nay BOILING WATER, behind the receptionist desk so you just have to ask them to fill up your bottles every night!

title: Quick Paris trip
text: Beautiful hotel in a quiet sector of the 7th arrondissement (district) of Paris.  The hotel is rated as a 3 star and its prices are fairly affordable for this area of town.  The rooms are clean and their size more than acceptable for Paris.  Overall a very good 3-day stay.  Would probably return there if the price is competitive...

title: Location was perfect!
text: We recently stayed at this property during our first visit to Paris.  I booked this hotel based upon reviews on this site.  It is a cute, boutique hotel in a great neighborhood.  We had purchased the breakfast prior to our stay and it was very nice and convenient prior to setting out for the day and had a variety of hot and cold choices. There is a lot of places in the area to walk to (including Starbucks) and a great bakery right across the street.  Additionally there is several grocery stores right around the corner.  We did not pay the extra money for the Eiffel tower view, but instead had a great view of the street we overlooked and the bakery (again it was WOW!).  We had no problems with the staff and they helped out on several occasions for directions and calling for a cab. The Metro stop as well as several other sites are only a short walk away.  I would definitely recommend this hotel if you want to be close to some of the tourist sites, but also experience a real Paris neighborhood.

title: Location & rooms - good! Staff - not great!
text: The hotel location and the cleanliness was  very good. The rooms were small but considering the price we payed it was reasonable. The only sad the about this hotel was the staff. They seem to not want to help you with anything at all. We asked if we could book a taxi with them the night before since we had to go to the station to catch a train. They told us to come back in the morning and to let them know 10 mins before. We did as we were told and the lady who was there checked the computer for about a minute and said sorry, no taxis available. We had to get one of our friends help who lived there to track a number down to call for a taxi. There were no free taxis on the road either. But in about 5 mins another guest came and asked for a taxi and they happily arranged one for them. And the guests after. So watch out for double standards. Even at the breakfast the staff is not at all attentive. Forgot to bring my coffee one morning and the next morning I had to go after one staff member to ask for coffee. And they seemed very unhappy to be bringing you coffee or anything else you ask for. We have travelled a lot and have had amazing experiences at different hotels. Although this hotel seems to have a lot of potential sad to see how unhappy and lagged out the staff looks to the customers

title: Gorgeous View
text: My husband and I stayed three nights here while in Paris. We paid $150 a night and got a direct view of the Eiffel Tower from our window in room 401. I absolutely recommend asking for that room/ a view of the tower when you book. The room had a mini fridge/bar, heated towel rack in the bathroom and everything you need to be comfortable. The shower was great and had super hot water and two different shower heads. It was not a large room and it got a little stuffy with 2 huge suitcases. The AC is central control with no fan in the room, our room got warm fast. We opened the window to cool the room off at night but if we had come in the summer it may have been more of an issue. WiFi comes with the room and works enough to get some things done and send emails. It was not a fast network and streaming was tough but it gave us what we needed. It may work better closer to the lobby? Just a warning be elevator is TINY. My husband and I couldn’t both fit in there with our suitcases but it worked quickly and efficiently. You can pay to eat breakfast when you book. We did not and there is an excellent bakery right across the street. We ate breakfast in the hotel on our last day to save time and it was $15 a person. A little overpriced but it was good food and very convent. The front reception staff speaks multiple languages so we never had an issue checking in or out. They have parking that you can charge to your room each night ($24 per night?). We did not need parking and were only .2 miles away from the nearest metro station. The only issue we had was getting around Paris while the strike is occurring. Even when checking right before leaving the hotel we’d get to the station to find it was closed. The front staff is helpful in calling a taxi for you or you can get an uber. We enjoyed our time here and would come back in a heartbeat!

title: Late Birthday present.
text:
We deliberately went for this kind of hotel, as we had no intention of spending much time in the hotel other than sleeping and washing. 
The hotel served its purpose perfectly and a little more. It was clean with very friendly and helpful staff. The facilities although limited, were l looked after and clean and tidy. The room was spacious enough, and although there was no bar to speak of you can buy a bottle of wine cheaply, (well cheap for The rest of Paris). You are welcome to relax at a table and share your bottle. 

It was central enough to see everything we wanted to see and there were some fantastic cafes bars all around. I would definitely recommend staying if your going out and about.

title: Perfect Hotel… Couldn’t be any better
text: The location of the hotel is perfect, close to all attractions but away from the busy over crowded areas, each member of staff was helpful and friendly. The breakfast was great with lots of choice of fresh, tasty food (See the attached menu) we can’t wait to visit again. P.s the complimentary maroons are a great touch.

title: Excellent
text: Excellent location.  Walking distance to most of the attractions.  Quiet, reasonably priced.  The rooms are smaller than US standards, but clean and added to the cozy romantic feel.  The room even had a small balcony.  Rental bikes and scooters were nearby and cheep to reach the further sites.

title: NO air conditioning - NOT comfortable
text: We picked this hotel from others in the area because the TripAdvisor lists the hotel as having air conditioning. Turns out our room doesn't. While it's a great location, I would have NEVER stayed here in July.

title: Paris Vacation
text: My wife and enjoyed a three night visit at Hotel Saint Germain. Wonderful hotel that we will visit again in the future.  Very comfortable bed, small but well appointed room, terrific breakfast served each morning included in the room rate. The staff works hard and is very accommodating. The location is ideal for many Paris sites.

title: Great location
text: Our family of four booked 2 rooms and thought each room was rather small but charming.  One downside was that there was no refrigerator in the room but we were able to keep our items that needed to be cooled in their refrigerator which was very nice.  Breakfast was included.  The hotel is ,3 of a mile from Bon Marche which is one of our favorite places to shop in their market.  Julien was very helpful and personable.  It is within walking distance to great restaurants and attractions.

title: Wonderful boutique hotel
text: Small and charming hotel in great location, short walk to the Louvre, Latin Quarter. Rooms are very comfortable and with nice amenities. The staff is fabulous--professional, friendly, and helpful to the max.

title: Charming hotel in St Germain
text: Charming hotel very well situated in St Germain, close to Bon Marche on a calm and quiet street. Very friendly and helpful staff, no request was to small and always greeted with a warm smile. We will definitely return next time we come to Paris.

title: Absolutely Delightful
text: From the moment I booked my reservation, the staff of the hotel did everything possible to make me feel welcome and special. They emailed asking my preferences for bedding and anything I might need on arrival, and when I unexpectedly arrived in Paris earlier than anticipated and needed to get out of the pouring rain, they made my room available early so that I could unpack and get settled. They even loaned me an iPhone charger, which saved me from being stranded without communication! C’est bonne! The hotel itself is charming, adorably decorated and in an exceptional location for experiencing everything the neighborhood has to offer. I will make this my Parisian destination from now on. Really outstanding service, so clean and the staff and management know how to make one feel at home in a new city.

title: Awesome boutique hotel in a great area of the city
text: We had a great experience in this adorable little hotel. The location is fantastic - close to transportation and in a very nice area of Paris. We found it to be very affordable, perfectly clean, and staffed by very helpful and nice people. The beds were comfortable, the linens were very nice, and the breakfast was fantastic. With all of the places in Paris to stay, we would probably go right back here if we ever visited again. Highest recommendation.

title: Charming gem!
text:
The BEST time ever! I cannot say enough for the service and customer service in this charming botique hotel. I am totally enamoured! I cannot wait to go back. Michael  and Julianne at the front desk are a magnificent staple. Very knowledgeable and very helpful with a positive desposition. I'm so happy and satisfied with my stay that I am recommending this to everyone i know. 

Until we meet again Paris, Je te amo

title: Fantastic Location and Fabulous Service
text: We stayed here for 6 nights over Christmas 2021.  We loved everything about this charming hotel.  The staff were very helpful before we arrived; booking restaurant reservations for us and, changing them when part of our group had to cancel.  We felt like we were coming "home" after each days adventure.  We have been to Paris a dozen times over the years and this is one hotel we will definitely come back to.  An added plus is that  the Location is phenomenal.  Steps from the Metro and a few mintues walk to the Grand Epicerie at Bon Marchee, Brasserie Lipp and a the wonderful neighborhood Cafe Varenne.  The street also boasts 3 wine shops, 3 chocolate shops and two super markets.  We had everything we needed not to mention being a 10 minute walk from the Tuileries and the Louvre!

title: J’adore cet hôtel !!!
text: I was so happy to see that Hotel Saint Germain had reopened after the lockdowns and I booked right away. I was not disappointed. The hotel has been gorgeously refurbished and the service has maintained its high standard for excellence even with all the challenges posed by anti-covid protocols. In these difficult and stressful times, the staff remains friendly, knowledgeable, and incredibly helpful. I felt safe and cared for during my one-week stay. A special shout-out to Michaël, surely the finest concierge in Paris!

title: Top-Notch Staff & Hospitality in the Heart of Paris
text: This boutique hotel located right near Rue du Bac Station is beautiful decorated and compensates for petite rooms with a wonderfully attentive staff. When I arrived exhausted from travel, my bags were whisked out of my car, I was taken through a very brief check-in process and then taken to my room. In my room a bottle of wine with a lovely note was awaiting me along with a generous bottle of water, and the air conditioning had been started prior to my arrival to ensure the room was comfortable. The staff has been truly attentive throughout my stay, and I cannot say enough about these hard working professionals. The bathtub was a bit snug for my American waistline, but that’s more on me than on the bath. The staff has continued to make helpful recommendations, and breakfast is plentiful and delicious. I really recommend paying the upgrade fee to have breakfast included throughout your stay. With COVID, they are lovingly serving meals instead of a buffet. I am a disabled woman with invisible disability, and I appreciate that the hotel has a petite lift and sturdy railings on the stairwell to offer options depending on how worn out I am. I love the neighborhood which is full of shops and crafts people at the top of their crafts and is centrally located to everything. The staff and property are both 5 stars, but please be realistic about your expectations for room size if coming from America. This is like staying in the heart of Manhattan where space is a premium and most buildings are historic. You’ll have all you need, but the rooms are cozy and compact.

title: Excellent stay with world class service
text:
We stayed at the HSG from Sunday March 1st to Thursday March 5th. The rooms lean small but contain excellent finishing. The beds, furniture, and decor are all luxurious. The breakfast was small but the spread was classical. Yet the HSG doesn’t stand out in its accommodations—instead, it distinguishes itself by its world-class, 5-star service. We were in France as neither a matter of business or please, rather France was forced upon us by untimely travel restrictions in our home country. Stuck in Paris, we were working remotely and trying to explore in the evenings, getting out whenever we had the opportunity. While I worked, the staff was distant but present, ready to answer any questions or assist in any request. One night, Michael, the receptionist, secured for us a same day reservation at a supposedly exclusive restaurant. This was all superb, but there remains one incident which ensured my stay upon any future visit to Paris. 
The rooms lack fridges. This is neither here nor there as most people, with the exception of those with medical requirements, never use the mini fridge they are provided for storing their personal produce. Yet on this trip, it was relevant to me: I was returning home with a perishable gift. As such, I asked HSG how they recommend I proceed. Of course, they had a guest fridge and I was welcome to use it. So on the first day of my arrival, I put my gift in storage and settled in to our temporary abode. Only a few days later, the situation in France had deteriorated and we realized we had to leave the country. We packed our bags, took a cab to the airport, and waited for our flight to Greece. While waiting, it dawned on us that we had left our gift, our incredibly important gift, at the hotel. Panicking, we called the hotel. Michael answered the phone and, as he always does, asked you how could he help. With little hesitation, we explained everything. We explained about the gift, about our uncertain border situation, and about our need to leave the EU in a few days. After we were through, he immediately said it was no problem and to call him after the flight. Some hours later, we were back on the phone with Michael. Due to the nature of the gift we were certain we couldn’t ship it out of the EU. Within the EU, we were less certain. So, we planned an express delivery. Michael quickly shuffled us through all the bureaucracy, and in the late evening, we had a tracking number for our package. 
Michael was incredibly communicative and flexible throughout the entire ordeal, and we are absolutely certainly that if you have an issue at the Hotel  Saint-Germain, they will have your back, regardless of the inconveniences and roadblocks.

title: Another great stay
text: This was our second stay in two years and we were just as pleased as the first. Great location a couple blocks from the RER B and up the street from the metro line 4. Can be anywhere in central paris within 15 minutes. Near a street market, several supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants. Located in a real Parisian neighborhood. Staff is very customer service oriented and friendly. Rooms are small but clean. Very quiet. Will be back next year!

title: A Great Hotel
text: This hotel features a terrific location within easy access to the métro. The staff is cordial and helpful. Michael, the chief desk person, is a gem. He will do anything to keep his guests happy. I wish that he had more assistance as there are times when the desk is so busy that you cannot get to see him. The breakfast is basic, but high quality croissants and baguettes along with cereal and yogurt. I have stayed here twice and the rooms have been well kept with sufficient storage/closet space and decent sized bathroom. What can I say other than I am always blissed out at the Saint Germain.

title: The worst hotel in Paris
text:
The receptionist are rude and ironic !
Mark is the worst 
The breakfast is poor 
Rooms are claustrophobic!
The doors form de the shower almost fall in my wife 
The elevator works just for suitcases.
Definitely try another one .... Paris has much more to offer you

title: Absolutely lovely
text: I just enjoyed such a truly wonderful visit to this hotel! The room was adorable and comfortable, the location was superb, breakfast was ideal, and the most special part of the hotel was the genuine and caring employees. I cannot recommend enough.

title: Paris Mini Break
text:
My wife and I visited Paris this week and as we love the area of St Germain we decided on Hotel St Germain after looking at various reviews on TA.

The hotel was everything that we could have wanted - it’s in a fantastic location , the rooms were lovely and clean ,and the staff could not have been more friendly and helpful .

The hotel is surrounded by lovely bars and brasseries and I can’t fault this hotel .

Finally I have to mention Michael on the front desk who offered a wealth of good advice on where to go and what to do he was simply lovely .

I would highly recommend this hotel .

title: Hidden Gem!
text: We stayed at the Hotel Saint Germain for two nights. It’s a small cozy hotel in the heart of Paris. The staff were superbly friendly and accommodating. They assisted us with anything we needed. We had room #4 which was on the bottom floor, and had direct access to the patio which was perfect cause we are smokers. The room was clean and tidy and so warm! The bed was something else, you simply sink in it and sleep after a great day walking the streets of Paris. The location was the greatest bit about it, we got everywhere we needed by walking. We only sometimes took the bus to save time cause we were there for a short time. Highly recommended, would certainly stay here again!

title: A little gem in Paris 7eme
text: We just spent a lovely weekend in Paris staying at the hotel St Germain on rue du BAC. A small but lovely boutique hotel with great staff and an excellent breakfast in a vibrant part of Paris. Who could ask for more?

title: Paris
text: Amazing hotel with excellent friendly team. Very handy to the Metro, great room and great breakfast. Close enough to the attractions without been to far away. Lovely cafes just up the road. I would highly recommend this hotel and the team for a memorable stay in this fantastic city.

title: Perfect location for a perfect NYE trip!
text:
My partner and I stayed at this beautiful hotel for 2 nights over the NYE period. Straight away we were welcomed by Michael (who was fantastic throughout our stay. He helped recommend restaurants and helped us with bookings. He also was happy to take some photos of us as we were leaving to go home!). He is a credit to the hotel and we hope to see him next time we come. 

The hotel provides a French-style buffet breakfast with fresh juice, hot drinks, croissants, bread, cheese, fruits and yoghurts. We never had an issue getting seated straight away for breakfast before our busy days ahead. 

The hotel is within walking distance to metro stations (although they were on strike when we were here), bus stops or the attractions themselves i.e. Louvre and Eiffel tower. 

The only downfall we had on our trip was due to noise, not the hotel's fault though. The first night was NYE and there was a loud party (what sounded like above us, but we think was the building next door) which went on to the early hours. Normally we would have tried to join the party but after a long day of travelling and being awake nearly 24 hours all we wanted was to sleep! Early on both mornings we also heard what sounded like either chairs being moved or glasses being thrown into something? This was around 6am every morning which was quite annoying but again, don't think it was the hotel making the noise. 

Overall, a very pleasant stay on what was a very magical trip. Paris will forever hold a special place in my heart and staying at such a lovely hotel with fantastic staff was the cherry on top.

Thank you again and à Bientôt!

Nicol and Joe

title: Happy to recommend it!
text: This is a small hotel in a great location on Rue du Bac in walking distance of many of Paris’s greatest attractions such as the Musee d’Orsay, Louvre etc etc It’s an old property that’s been exceptionally well modernised and, while rooms are not particularly spacious as you’d expect in a building if it’s vintage in such a central location, excellent design makes them a pleasure to stay in. We stayed as a family of four - two parents and two teenage boys and we all loved the hotel. Continental breakfast is excellent with beautiful produce in plentiful supply and the whole hotel is spotlessly clean. What sets this hotel aside however is service - the exceptionally professional and helpful staff are a real class act. In summary Hotel Saint Germain is excellent and I’d recommend it!

title: Excellent Hotel
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hotel Saint Germain!  The location is very convenient -- it is a ten minute walk to many tourist attractions.  The area is lovely and there are several terrific cafes and restaurants within walking distance from the hotel.  What truly makes this hotel special, though, is the exceptionally friendly and considerate staff.  The concierge in particular is very helpful.  Michael, who was at the front desk for most of our stay, especially stood out.  We were in Paris during the transportation strike and he went out of his way to help us book taxis, and was always accommodating, thoughtful, and kind.  We will absolutely stay here again and recommend to friends!

title: Perfect Paris Location
text: This is a great, quaint hotel. The staff was extremely friendly, they had a nice breakfast and almost all of key Paris sites are within walking distance. Nice Bistro's are all around and there is a nice vibe with plenty of specialty shops nearby. The rooms are small as is the hotel, but somewhat typical for Paris. We loved our stay!

title: Boutique Hotel
text: Beautiful city centre hotel with quirky design and wonderfully friendly staff . Will definitely return again. Close to all tourist attractions and lovely restaurants. Room had lovely touches including shutters onto the street

title: Beautiful Experience, World Class Customer Service
text:
I visit try to visit Paris annually for my birthday. This trip was exceptional. It was first time staying at the Hotel Saint Germain. I will plan to come back. 

The hotel is just lovely. The service is world class. The breakfast each morning, served on quaint blue and white china, was icing on the cake. I just happen to love blue and white china :)  The staff were charming, attentive and so professional. I was even gifted a jar of honey from their own hives. It is exquisite - like an explosion of delicate flowers.I think about Paris each morning as I have my biscuit and honey. 

They helped to make my birthday very special - and unforgettable.  The room I shared with my granddaughter was very pretty - the bathroom beautiful and had a full shower/tub combo. The beds very comfortable with beautiful linens.. The location of the hotel can't be beat - just four block walk to the Louvre or Musee d'Orsay in one direction and about the same to Bon Marche in the other. But, no matter where we set out to visit each day, we were not far away. Many thanks for their service, attention to detail and warmth. I can't recommend this hotel enough.

title: Good night sleep
text:
I struggle to sleep. 
But there is something about this place. 
It’s just peaceful and calm in a certain way. 
Cleanliness and service is excellent. 
Next time I will may be ask for a pillow to bring home to.

title: Hotel Saint Germain  !! part 2:)
text: in my first review, i may not have expressed my appreciation for Juan's help at the front desk and i want to be clear that he, along with the other staff, the 'evening and night' desk personnel were kind, helpful and courteous. on our wednesday morning departure the 'night' person helped with getting us coffee, assured our taxi was on the way and offered us the fresh bread that had just been delivered.  an amazing staff from start to finish!

title: Wonderful stay in a great location
text:
I visit Paris frequently, but had not stayed at this hotel before. I knew I loved the area, and chose to stay here for a business trip recently. The welcome was very warm, and my room was well equipped, overlooking the rue du Bac. The staff was most helpful, my room well attended, and the room equipped with thick bath towels, nice sheets, and a comfortable bed. The breakfast was average, but the hot coffee and fresh juice was a nice way to start the day. 
The location is spect, near3 metro lines, and within easy walk of most attractions on both banks. Lots of food choices, both eat in and take out, as well as Le Grand Epicerie just a 5 minute walk. I especially enjoyed the gentleman, Juan, who attended the desk at the weekend. Overall, I can recommend this hotel as a perfect place to stay.

title: Charming Boutique Hotel
text:
We visited form Canada for a week during the off season (November 2019) and unfortunately we encountered a major issues on the first day of our stay, however, the hotel staff did absolutely everything they could to make it right. Michael and the hotel assistant manager (we didn’t get her name, but she was great!) worked hard to make sure we were happy guests :)  

The rest of our stay was perfect, the rooms were a good size for Europe and many of the hotel staff speak perfect English. 

The hotel has a super cute little lounge area that you can drink your own wine in, or order from the hotel. They were happy to provide us with wine glasses and an ice bucket.

The breakfast is yummy: pastries, cheese, great yogurt, fruit, coffee, tea, hard boiled eggs. Perfect for a quick start to the day.

The hotel has adorable decor, perfect for instagram pics. 

The beds are comfy and the house keeping was impeccable. Very very clean hotel.

25 min walk to Notre dame and saint chapelle. Many great restaurants, chocolate shops, perfume shops etc in the area. 
 
We will stay here again if we return to Paris.

title: Cozy and at the Center of it all!!
text: Visited in Nov 2019. This hotel was the perfect central point to all the major tourist sights, yet was on a street full of local shops, markets and restaurants! I felt like a true Parisienne! - the room was fantastic, comfortable and cozy, and one of the biggest I’ve stayed in in Europe. The shower was big and the cleaning staff left the room impeccable each day! - the breakfast was included in my stay and it was beyond perfect. Nothing better than a full belly to start the day exploring! - the staff was very friendly and accommodating, anything you need they would help to do/find. They spoke excellent English, which was a comfort being away from home. - I will stay here every time I return to Paris. Merci Juan and staff, a bientot!!!

title: Lovely
text: The staff were exceptionally lovely and near native English speakers (which I consider a luxury, even in Paris). I last minute booked here in the aftermath of an Airbnb experience and they were the perfect antidote. The rooms are small, but somehow still feel slightly luxurious and the breakfast was delicious.

title: Great hotel and location
text: Our 4th! visit in this ecxellent  boutique  hotel. The staff is so nice and helpful, especiallly Mr. Michel in the reception, also the woman (I forgot her name, sorry) that  served during the breakfast. The French breakfast- the best croissants in Paris. The classic room is small , but very comfortable, clean and nice. The location is wonderful !! We will be back for sure

title: Great Location!
text: The small boutique hotel's location was perfectly situated for us, in the 7th arrondisement. It's a busy, high end area with easy access to major sites via metro, only  a minute away, or bus, equally close. The hotel is a short walk to the Rodin Museum and an easy ride to other major sites, including among others, the Musee D'Orsay, Eiffel Tower, and Sacre-Coeur. There are many reasonably priced brasseries and other restaurants on rue de Bac, and lots of shopping, though much of it pricey. Our room was adequate but tiny, fairly common in Paris. The bathroom was spacious. A cold breakfast, with standard fare, was included in our package. Concierge service was excellent, efficient, and friendly.

title: Great value. Lovely location. Nice touches...
text: If you are tired of large American hotel chains, try one of the charming hotels in St. Germaine. This area is filled with local shops and restaurants. I stumbled onto this hotel and loved it. It's a great value. The room was lovely. I ordered a glass of wine to my room (crystal stem). Very nice. Incredible linens. I"m over 50 and need a comfortable bed. Bravo. The staff is professional and friendly. Yes, I'll be back.

title: The quintessential boutique hotel.
text:
We booked a Junior Suite for ten (10) nights as a "birthday" trip, and Hotel Saint Germain set the perfect tone for our trip.  The breakfast was just enough, the ambiance was relaxing, and we were greeted each morning by every staff member with a huge smile and a warm "Bonjour!".
The room was perfect.  It was beautifully decorated, quiet, and had an amazing shower.  
The staff warmed up to us quickly, and worked hard to make sure we had everything we wanted or needed.  Michael and Juan were tireless in their efforts to serve during the day, and the night staff were waiting at the door with smiles, even at 1 am.
Convenient location, warm reception, and clean rooms - all add up to the perfect stay in the City of Lights.

title: Nice, in a great location
text:
Nice hotel, with a great service, at walking distance from the D’orsay museum.
The French breakfast is really good, so you can leave the hotel ready to go, no need to look for a place to have breakfast.
Loved the small elevator.
The room was really small, but we knew that, so no surprises.

title: Charming botique hotel in great location
text: Can not think of a better location in Paris (short walk to Musee D'Orsay and near Metro stop)   The gentleman at the front desk was extremely nice and helpful making it a very welcoming place to stay.  This was a bit pricey.

title: Paris Charm and Conveniently Located
text:
Just finished a recent stay at this wonderfully charming hotel recommended by our agent n the United Staes. The staff especially, Juan, Michael, Pedro and the kitchen personnel could not have been more guest  friendly and went out of their way to make our 4 night stay with our friends most enjoyable. 

The location is centrally located to a significant number of must see sites in Paris and you can enjoy a leisurely stroll to most of them.

title: Lovely hotel
text:
We fell in love with Paris and this hotel started it all.

We had a room that looked out on to a charming little lane, the room was clean and tastefully decorated.  Location is perfect too.

The staff are charming and friendly and speak excellent English.  The breakfast staff aren't as fluent, but were happy to smile patiently while my son and I practised our fractured French.  Hubby is fluent, which helped.

We hope to be back soon, and stay at this hotel again, it's just lovely.

Claire

title: charming Paris hotel
text: Stayed here Aug 2019.  The rooms are small, but just what we needed for a quick stay in Paris.  The hotel is emaculate!  The beds were comfortable.  They have a nice breakfast in the morning which is included.  The hotel staff was very friendly and always willing to help us with any questions or directions we needed.  They are in walking distance to the train stations.   Even with luggage we were able to walk to the hotel.  The staff is fluent in English.  We walked to all the sites.  I would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Charming, Stylish, Close to Metro and Major Landmarks
text: Located on trendy Rue du Bac, this charming and stylish hotel is fabulously close to the metro, restaurants, supermarkets and an easy walk to many of the major Parisian landmarks. The rooms are secure, quiet, bright, elegant, very clean and comfortable with bathrooms that are equally immaculate - the daily room service staff take a genuine pride in ensuring this ambience endures. There is an elevator between floors, rooms have plenty of storage, adjustable airconditioning, in-room safe, hairdryer, wifi and daily filtered water is provided. The buffet continental breakfast is wonderfully French, well stocked and served in beautiful surroundings - it became a real highlight to the start of every day. The 24-hour front desk staff is amazing - friendly, professional, helpful and genuinely interested in making patrons feel welcome and relaxed. Hotel Saint Germain - highly recommended. Enjoy!

title: All the French Charm
text: I'll stay here every time I go to Paris.  Lovely little hotel with wonderful staff who helped us with everything we needed, great area with lots of shops and eating, close to walk to everything and metro station nearby.  Room was clean, larger than expected and had all the charm we were looking for.  We had a great time!

title: Hidden gem of a hotel
text: A nicely located hotel near wonderful shopping and a quick 30-min walk to all the major sights. Small qnd quaint with very attentive front desk personnel who are willing to assist at all hours and provide great recommendations.

title: family summer vacation
text: Our party of nine (ranging in age from 2 to 72) spent three nights at the Hotel Saint Germain during our family summer vacation.  It was great!  The staff was extremely helpful and communicated fluently in English.  Breakfast was fresh, delicious and exactly what we needed to get going every morning.  I would definitely stay there again.

title: Another fantastic stay at Hotel Saint Germain!
text: This little gem in rue du Bac did not disappoint for a second stay. Beautiful rooms, immaculate housekeeping, lovely friendly staff & of course their fabulous secret weapon Michael the Hotel Manager! Nothing is too much trouble for Michael, the genuine interest he has in his guests & their comfort is the epitome of professionalism. Rue du Bac is delightful, a stroll to Le Bon Marche, with delightful little shops & bistros to wile away the days in the loveliest way. Highly, highly recommended xx

title: C’est parfait!
text: An absolutely perfect little boutique hotel in a fabulous part of Paris. I just returned home from my second stay at this hotel. Both visits were fantastic. The rooms are comfortable and charming. The breakfast is excellent. They even had gluten-free bread for me! (Celiac travelers take note.) Every single member of the staff I encountered was friendly and helpful. I especially appreciated how patient they were with my horrible French. :-) Furthermore, the hotel’s commitment to using environmentally sustainable products is admirable. I live in France and can’t wait to return to the Hotel Saint Germain as often as I can!

title: Great service from the gentleman at reception
text:
We stayed in Hotel Saint Germain in mid-July and thorougly enjoyed our stay there.

The hotel is in a quiet street away from the busy main roads yet very close to the metro station and Boulevard St Germain.  We had two connecting rooms and this really made our life easier as our two teenager daughters enjoyed their privacy yet we stayed connected with them.

What impressed us most is the hospitality of the gentleman at reception.  From check in to giving us advice on our plan to see 14 Juillet parade and reserving a taxi for us to the airport, he was just super friendly and helpful.  Unfortunately we don't know his name (he wore glasses and always in a suit).  He's there every morning and was ready at any opportunity to help out the guests of the hotel.  He is one of the main reasons that has made us enjoy our stay at Hotel St Germain.

title: Lovely hotel
text: I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights during my stay in Paris. What I love about this hotel is the Parisian charm and decor of the rooms, the incredibly central location, and the fantastic service. This truly has a boutique hotel feeling. Everyone in the staff is so lovely, friendly and helpful. Specifically Michael who works at the front desk! He gave me such detailed advice on what to see, how to get there, and made me feel so at home during my stay. I happened to stay in 2 different rooms during my 3 night stay because I booked one night in a larger room through my credit card points. My first 2 nights were in the deluxe room (the first price point level) Its not ideal for 2 people if you have large luggage because it’s definitely a cozy European style room. We made it work, but best to get the superior room for 2 people if you want to be more comfortable with space. The rooms were super clean, the bath products were great, the breakfast was simple and delicious! Overall, I highly recommend this hotel for a quaint, authentic Parisian experience in the perfect location.

title: I miss it already
text: This is a fantastic little gem of a hotel in an ideal location. The rooms are comfortable and quirky and charming. What really makes the experience unforgettable are the concierge staff—Michael, Pedro and Juan—who go to great lengths to be helpful, to answer endless and even ridiculous questions, and to make their guests comfortable. I’m so happy to have stayed there.

title: Amazing experience with excellent customer service
text: This hidden gem boutique hotel is in a perfect location if you are looking for local Parisian experience. It’s the heart of shops and great restaurants. The hotel concierge Pedro and Michael provides excellent customer service - making recommendations and reservations for restaurants, booking car service and others. We will certainly go back to this hotel again!

title: Perfect Location
text: We stayed here on our honeymoon. It was my first time to Paris and the hotel was a nice distance to walk to the Eiffel Tower or to the Louvre. The neighborhood was great and the rooms were charming! I would stay here again!

title: Excellent quiet hotel near the Latin Quarter
text: This small hotel was in a delightful quiet location with small shops and locally frequented cafes nearby.  Within easy walking distance of all the major sites it is a delight to come home from a busy day to the quiet hotel with the helpful and friendly staff.  We opted for the "privilege room" which had a small living room along with the bedroom and bath.  Much bigger than I expected in the heart of Paris.

title: Amazing Quaint Gem of a Hotel
text:
The hotel is centerally located to so many of the sites of Paris. Area was safe and had many local shops and places to eat. Service was wonderful and very helpful at giving advise or making city reservations. Breakfast in the morning was delicious. Rooms were small but very clean and we felt like we were in Paris. Lots of sundries in the bathroom.
Shout out to Michael who was wonderful to us! Great value!
This is not a hotel to stay at if you are physically handicapped though.

title: Amazing Hotel to stay at!
text: Great hotel! Truly enjoyed the location and the staff! The hotel is located very closely to the metro and múltiple bus stops. It is about a 10 minute walk from the Seine River. There are multiple shops and restaurants around the area. It is close enough to be near multiple tourist spots but not to close to be overran  by tourists. The staff is excellent! Very helpful and accommodating. Gave us whatever we needed and helped us schedule a taxi for our drive to the airport. The room was a little small, but I could look past this because of how amazing everything else was.

title: Lovely Boutique Hotel in Great Location
text: Wonderful staff; within walking distance of all the major Paris neighborhoods.  Fantastic cafes and restaurants within  blocks of the hotel.  Rooms a bit small but beautifully decorated.  Very nice common room and bar and breakfast was fantastic -- everything you could possibly want.

title: Amazing Stay
text: Perfect location, perfect staff, nice sized rooms and bathroom, comfortable bed.  The staff is so friendly and professional and couldn't do enough to make you comfortable and welcome.  Highly recommend this hotel and will definitely make this our go to Paris hotel.

title: Third Time was Just as Wonderful!!
text: This is our 3rd time staying here. The staff and manager especially Michael is awesome and makes our stay each time full of the best places to visit in Paris as well as recommending places for dinner. The location couldn't be better!

title: Charming Hotel with Perfect Location
text: Our family of 4 just finished a 9 day stay at Hotel Saint Germain on Rue de Bac (there are several hotels in Paris with similar names), and truly had a lovely stay. The hotel is located perfectly within a 5-30 minute casual walk from any of the major attractions or destinations, in a nice, safe neighborhood where several embassies are located. There are numerous great cafe's and brasseries right around the property as well. As Americans who speak very little French, we had no difficulty whatsoever communicating with the staff, as every front desk person, as well as the manager, spoke perfect English, even on email communications prior to our stay. The breakfast provided each morning is also wonderful. Several of the staff members such as Michael, Juan, Pedro, Edoard & Laurent helped us make dinner reservations, plan activities including the best means of transportation to them, and recommended can't-miss places to go. Edoard even helped me locate a 24 hour pharmacy early on a Sunday morning to get medication for one of our family members, and Pedro personally went to a bakery to get me a pastry for the staff to surprise me the next morning at breakfast for my birthday!  Overall, it was a wonderful stay in a clean, European boutique hotel with a perfect location, wonderful staff, and reasonable pricepoint. We will definitely plan to stay at Hotel Saint Germain again, and recommend it to our friends.

title: Wonderful Location for our Anniversary Trip
text: Special thanks to Michael for recommending and booking a truly awesome dinner reservation for us and making wonderful suggestions for our activities shopping and more. Thanks to him we added the Saint Chapelle to our daily exploration and were rewarded with a breathtaking sight. He was so friendly and funny and helpful despite our pitiful attempts to speak French. His English was excellent too! The other staff members were also quite friendly and helpful. The location was perfect with cute shops, amazing wine store across the street and very walkable to all the main sights. The lobby is decorated with really neat reimagined movie posters and the view from the rooms are of cute Parisian rooftops. We will miss our home away from home at the Hotel Saint Germain. Au revoir!

title: Horribly rude to Americans
text:
We had high hopes for our stay at Hotel Saint Germain, but were greeted by the rudest manager / concierge we have ever met. His name is Michael.  We had just arrived from a long trip from the U.S. as well as a two hour cab ride and were chastised for going in search of the hotel lobby bathroom without first "introducing ourselves". He proceeded to say that "all Americans are rude" and act in a way that was completely unacceptable.  He was apoplectic because we needed to use the bathroom - and never ever apologized - just kept fighting us. It was a horrible way to start our 4 day stay. We have a choice of hotels to stay at in Paris and will never again stay here.  Further, the hotel is grossly understaffed at the front desk. You have to wait 10 minutes to get any help. And this is evident the rudeness of the one person who is there. If you are American, I highly suggest you don't stay here. Spend your dollars elsewhere - where you will not be treated with disdain, contempt and hostility.

Further, the rooms were small and there was little ventilation. If anyone goes to the bathroom, it emanates through the sleeping area. 

Location was great - but lots of hotels to stay at in the area.

title: Perfect spot for an anniversary trip!
text:
We spent a week at this gorgeous hotel in May for our anniversary.  Perfect location for a quintessential Paris experience. Boutique feel was exactly what we were looking for.  Parisian decor, window boxes, quaint rooms, pretty breakfast room with a perfect European breakfast spread, helpful staff pointing us in the right direction.  
The room and bathroom were small but we were expecting that in Paris. Next time I'd probably choose a room with shower only, as the bath was tiny and the shower over bath not that great, and it may have allowed slightly more room in the bathroom, but it was fine.  We wanted a street view which we loved, and the double-glazed windows cut out any noise.
The staff were fantastic.  Pedro, Michael and everyone else couldn't be more helpful and accommodating.  The location is so convenient - a metro station just a stone's throw away, but the Seine, the Louvre, Musee d'Orsay and so many other attractions just a short walk from the hotel.  And so many gorgeous pavement cafes to stop at for a St Germaine Spritz or whatever catches your fancy! 
During our search, there were certainly more modern and more groovy hotels in this price range, but the character of this hotel ticked the boxes for us. Highly recommend!

title: Great Location
text: We only stayed one night as we were passing through Paris, but this was a lovely boutique hotel.  My husband and I were traveling with our two children, 7 & 11 years old.  We booked connecting rooms.  The rooms were actually connected by a hallway which was unexpected but even better than the traditional room to room connection.  Staff was incredibly helpful and the area was beautiful.  I highly recommend.

title: FABULOUS location
text: A colleague and I booked this hotel for a work trip. We have traveled together before, so felt comfortable sharing a room. It was small, with two twin beds. But we were rarely there, and it was no smaller than other European hotel rooms I have stayed in. The bathroom was rather expansive for the size of the bedroom, and was modern. Our room was in a small courtyard, which added to the charm. The staff were wonderful and helpful. And the breakfast is perfect for what we needed - some coffee and pastries to get us on our way. But again, the location was the absolute highlight. Five minute walk to Musee Rodin in one direction, five minute walk to the shops and restaurants on Blvd St. Germain in the other direction. Great views of the Eiffel Tower five minutes in another direction. And really, you could stay right within two blocks of the hotel to eat and shop with abandon. The street is absolutely adorable.

title: Hotel St Germaine
text:
My wife and I just spent a week at the Hotel St Germaine in Paris.
Can’t say enough about how wonderfull our stay was. The room was perfect, small as expected, but beautifully appointed. Breakfast was casual, delicious fruits, crouissants, jams, eggs. Enough to start your day. 
Location is perfect. Away from the crowds, but close enough for all the sites and restaurants.
But the main reason for this review is the staff. Pedro, Juan, and Michael went beyond the call of duty, They were amazingly helpful, and treated us not as guests, but as family.
Guided us in the right direction, great dinner recommendations, and exuded a sense of comfort and hospitality. Our hat goes off to them. For first time Paris visitors, we were treated royally.
We highly recommend this small wonder on Rue de Boc. Can’t wait to return!

title: Amazing location, excellent stay
text: We stayed 2 nights here. Our room was #21 if I remember correctly, it faced the street, but with the windows closed we didn't hear any street noise at all. Our room was also super cute. It was small, but I felt it wasn't abnormally small compared to other Paris hotels we've stayed at. I loved the design of the rooms and lobby/common areas. Staff was super nice. The location was amazing - we walked everywhere. Would stay here again for sure.

title: Hotel Saint Germain is a very, very special small hotel
text: We were fortunate to find this hotel via Trip Advisor.  The location is wonderful, in the middle of a great neighborhood but the street where located is relatively quiet.  We received great restaurant recommendations and the staff there was fantastic. Michael is a hospitality rock star!  We were so happy to be staying at Saint Germain.

title: Four star? Not convinced ...
text: A very nice hotel in the heart of Paris and beautiful 7th Arrondissement, but I think there's room for improvement. I expect more from 4 Star hotels. Firstly, the location of the hotel is fantastic. Very central, super close to La Grande Epicerie (absolutely worth visiting) major tourist sites, the metro, shops etc. Hotel Saint Germain is also located on a pretty quiet street (although the cafe opposite is noisy in the early mornings... banging of beer kegs or something). Breakfast was great (highlight of stay) and our rooms and bathrooms were also fine - the beds are comfortable, linen of good quality and bathrooms modern - but I would expect a 4 Star hotel to generally have more of a 'wow factor' (thoughtful touches, more services etc). One major annoyance was not having a fridge in the room (even though there's room for one). I also found the staff not particularly friendly or helpful. So, overall, not sure I would return.

title: A lovely place to stay in Paris!
text: We stayed here while we explored Paris and it was the perfect base. The staff are lovely and helpful, it’s in a great area, the Metro and all the sights are nearby. The rooms are small but it’s Paris! They are nicely decorated and the beds were comfy. The breakfast each day was delicious. We loved our stay here.

title: Worst place to stay in
text: The worst hotel to visit. The place was nothing as shown in the photos. The rooms are so small that you can either keep your luggage or walk through. Nothing as promised not worth the money you’re paying. The bathroom included is so small that you can’t even have a shower properly without getting the water everywhere. Not recommended.

title: Really friendly staff and great location
text: We stayed here fir 5 nights and really enjoyed this hotel and the very accommodating and friendly staff. We had made a lot purchases while in Paris and were on our way to a hiking trip in Avignon by train . We asked if we would leave some bags at the hotel until we returned to the airport hotel 10 days later and they not only accommodated us but arranged fir a car to bring our bags to the Sheraton Airport before we flew out. There was free breakfast every morning and good restaurants nearby. They front desk arranged our reservations for dinner at restaurants we wanted to try. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Great location
text:
This is a wonderful boutique hotel with great service and just a short walk to the Louvre. 
Rooms are small as you would expect in an expensive part of Paris. And bring a converter and adapter for your phone as there is no USB port connection In the room. 
Wonderful continental breakfast.

title: Loved it!
text: We spent a week at the Hotel Saint Germain. It was wonderful! It was our third visit there and we hope to be back there this summer. The hotel in a fabulous neighborhood. The rooms are very pretty, clean and comfortable and the staff are absolutely wonderful and are always very professional.

title: What a wonderful small hotel!
text: Perfect location. Nice building beautifully maintained and operated. The crowning jewels of this hotel is the staff. Each and every employee was professional, yet extremely kind, and considerate. You'll notice that most of the good reviews mention the staff. I can't think of anything more to say without repeating myself.

title: A delightful boutique hotel in a great location
text: Super friendly and helpful staff.  Rooms were a bit small, but expected.  Bathrooms were really small.  There are eateries all around and a market across the street.  We tried three restaurants on the block and they were all great. Hotel is just 10 minute drive to most Paris sites in various directions.  They are a lso very walkable from the hotel, but add 30 minutes.

title: Great hotel
text: The staff are really helpful and friendly. The room was clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay again. Super location too with lots of choice of places to eat within walking distance. Well connected to the rest of Paris.

title: Exceeded expectations
text: We just spent a week at the Hotel Saint Germain. The hotel staff was extremely friendly, accommodating, and generous with their time. The location was perfect for touring all of the sites we wanted to see, and within a block or two of a variety of excellent bistros and cafes. Our room was pleasant with a very comfortable bed and excellent linens. My only complaint was that the shower stall was very small and might present a challenge to larger or taller people. My brother’s room had a tub/shower combination which provided ample space.

title: A wonderful small boutique hotel in a great location!
text: Spent a week at Hotel Saint Germain July 2018.  The rooms are small as are most in the city. The staff was excellent and very helpful. The perfect location for a first time visit to Paris. Perfectly situated near museums, Notre Dame and other must-see sights.  The daily complimentary breakfast is the perfect start of a busy day. The hotel is only steps away from the pedestrian way Rue De Buci! This lively avenue has fabulous restaurants and volumes of people watching from the sidewalk cafes. The perfect respite after a long day of touring.  The staff were very helpful especially for first time visitors to Paris.

title: Outstanding!
text:
Was here by myself for one night.  Everything from the greeting to the au revoir
was perfect....location outstanding, service exemplary, breakfast delicious and 
plentiful, rooms delightful and beyond expectation.  I was impressed and this hotel will become my Paris go-to!

title: Hotel canceled our reservations
text:
I booked rooms at the Hotel Left Bank for my family one year ago for my planned July 2022 trip, booking directly with the hotel.  When I  sent an email in mid-June 2022 to update my credit card on file, I was told that my reservations had been cancelled due “dysfunction by our hotel system”.  

The hotel offered two solutions: I could book 2 rooms for my family in their lower-ranked sister hotel or I could have two lesser rooms in their hotel.  At no point in the email did they offer some kind of discount for this error.  

They never responded to my questions about the unacceptable options.  I was forced to find another hotel.  No apologies and no response from a hotel booked a year in advance?

title: Excellent one week Stay, Just as Advertised
text:
We spent 7 nights in a Superior room the last week of October.  It was pretty much just as expected with no unpleasant surprises.  We were on the 3rd floor with windows facing into the interior courtyard(really more like a built in skylight)  We used the tiny elevator to go up to the room and always the stairs to come down.  We booked direct w/ the hotel and took the 5euro pp breakfast option.  It was a great value, given that just a cup of coffee anywhere outside could be 3 euros.  The breakfast options were adequate and didn't change much but certainly enough and the fresh baguette bread and pastries were always welcome. 
We got a peak into some of the standard rooms & they looked quite small.  We were glad to have the superior room if only for the extra space it provided for our clothes etc.  There isn't a proper closet in the room, just an antique wardrobe so that was not nearly enough for a week's worth of cool weather clothing for 2. 
My only other negative would be the lighting, which was poorly positioned, so I had to prop a mirror by the window in the mornings to try & do my makeup.

For our first stay in Paris, I couldn't have been happier with the location.  We used the metro every day and the Odeon station is literally less than a block away.  But we also walked for miles and we could easily reach the Right Bank, the Louvre, the D'Orsay, and all of St. Germain by foot.  Within 3-4 blocks of the hotel there are 3 movie theatres, several bakeries, 100's of restaurants, pharmacies, grocery stores, wine boutiques, etc.  We had some great meals, some so-so and a couple of take- aways when we were hungry in the late afternoon( when most kitchens are closed)
The hotel staff was friendly and helpful when needed and everything was very tidy & clean.

title: Only place we will stay in Paris
text:
Cannot say enough about Hotel Left Bank St. Germain - an old-world French hotel with a welcoming staff in a fabulous location. We spent 8 nights there on our honeymoon in November 2019 & found it absolutely charming.  The beautifully decorated 18th-century building still retains its original hand-hewn beams & woodwork. The bathrooms are thoroughly modern, with marble tub/showers, & the rooms are quiet, beautifully appointed & very comfortable. (We stayed here twice during our visit to France.)  We also received an unexpected upgrade to the luxurious top floor suite with incredible views of Notre Dame and the Eiffel Tower.  

Every member of the staff was wonderful - always friendly & helpful with advice on local restaurants, events & transit options. The location is perfect in the heart of the oldest part of Paris, its narrow streets full of beautiful architecture & interesting shops, sights & sounds.   It's a 5-minute walk to the Seine and 10-20 minutes to gardens, museums, etc.  Taxi stand around the corner & there is always Uber. 
 
Each morning, for only 5 euros, we enjoyed an in-house buffet of several cheeses (including Brie!), croissants & other pastries, baguettes, cold cuts, fresh fruit, yogurt, freshly-squeezed orange juice & delicious coffee.  The service was impeccable & the breakfast room lovely. Room service is also available.  

Staying at Hotel Left Bank St. Germain made our trip more fun (and romantic!).  Cannot imagine there is a better place to stay in Paris.

text: A big thank you to Chris at the front desk, he was very helpful during our entire stay at the hotel. Hotel is a short walk to many sites in Paris. In the evenings the hotel's entrance door is locked so if you get back late at night you press the door button for staff to open the door. I recommend this hotel if you're visiting Paris. Many good restaurants nearby.

text:

title: Great stay, value and personal attention with the front desk
text:
I stayed there for two days in the middle of October and it was a perfect stay. 

The hotel seems to be full so don’t count on checking in early, but they can hold your luggage and there are nice places to eat and see nearby. 

I was traveling alone and was “upgraded” to a deluxe room. It is on the lobby floor and I was skeptical that it would be loud, but I surprisingly didn’t hear much. I kept the window open so the air inside the room wasn’t so stuffy. I always sleep with a soft white noise sound and I never awoke to any loud sounds or people. 

The room was spacious with a king bed and a day bed. The bathroom had a separate shower and bath. The bed only had two pillows which I could foresee being a problem for other travelers but I bet it wouldn’t be a big deal to an extra pillow. It wasn’t a Westin bed, but it wasn’t uncomfortable either. 

The gentleman at the front desk (I am embarrassed that I don’t remember his name) during the day was always so helpful and pleasant. He helped me with so many little things since I speak terrible French. He also spent nearly 10 minutes trying to get the wifi to work on my phone. Really made me feel like I was the only one there. 

You can’t be the location and as long as the traditional decor doesn’t bother you I can’t imagine why this would be a great value for most people. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Location Location Location...and a Great Staff As Well
text:
My wife and I loved the Hotel Left Bank Saint Germain.  First and foremost the Hotel Left Bank is in an amazingly great location.  We were a 10 minute walk from the Seine and no  more than a 15 minute walk from the Louvre, Notre Dame and several other major tourist highlights.  The hotel is about a 5 minute walk to the Metro (subway) which means all of Paris is very accessible.  Take the time to figure out the difference between their Metro and the RER.  There are numerous shops, cafe's, bistro's, restaurants immediately outside the hotel.  There is an excellent boulangerie right across the street and a small and very nice supermarket about 5 minutes from the hotel.  The staff was friendly, accommodating and helpful. The front desk staff, namely Chris and Fanny could not have been nicer.  We bought croissants from the boulangerie (across the street) and intended to make coffee in our room to have with the croissants.  Fanny saw us bringing in the pastries and insisted on giving us coffee from their breakfast kitchen.  She had us sit down in their small sitting room just off the front lobby, which we did. Fanny and Chris just made the whole experience better for us. Our room was attractive, old style and clean.  The only reason I did not give the 5th star (above) was that the room does not have the amenities of newer hotels (which is to be expected in an old style hotel).  The very small safe is bolted to the bottom of a wooden cabinet deep in the back of the cabinet.  To use the safe you literally must get down on all fours, stick your head pretty much on the floor and into the cabinet and  use your cell phone for light to see inside the safe.  Not easy to do when your knees creak (my knees creak).  The safe was very small, so not all of our valuables fit into the safe.  The bathroom was very nice all marble and glass.  There are no shelves or cabinets so all toiletries must be stored on the sink itself.  We managed very well in that regard.  
This was our second visit to Paris.  On our first visit we stayed in a hotel that was quite distant from the major attractions.  The Hotel Left Bank is walking distance to so many Paris attractions.  It made all the difference in the world to us.  If you're into American history, take the time to walk into the restaurant next door, namely the Procope, the oldest Cafe-Restaurant in Paris.  You will find many artifacts and ancedotes having to do with Thomas Jefferson, Ben Franklin, French writers Voltaire, Diderot and others. Jefferson and Franklin developed the precursor to America's Bill of Rights right there in the Procope.

title: Best hotel we've stayed at in Paris to date
text:
Hotel Left Bank was our choice mainly because it's located in the heart of busy St. Germain.  A few steps literally from rue de Buci, Blvd. St. Germain, and Odeon.  Loads of shops and restaurants too.  We have stayed in other hotels in the area for years, but I have to say that this personally was my favorite hotel to date.  

Perhaps I'm biased because I was fortunate enough to book the hotel's top floor suite that's exactly as pictured on their website. Suite was really spacious thus extremely comfortable for stretching out.  Has two TV's so that both of us could enjoy our own programs.  And the entire suite was spotless and tidy. Only thing missing is the view of half of the Eiffel Tower that is located on the other side of the suite.  And because we visited in low season end of February/beginning of March we were able to score a fantastic rate especially with the inexpensive breakfast special included if one booked online via the hotel's booking engine.  

Also I highly recommend booking the hotel's private transfer. While we typically would take the official taxis to & from CDG we decided to book the private van arranged by the hotel for very reasonable rates truly.  Honestly the last time we visited Paris seven years ago we were scammed by an unscrupulous taxi driver at CDG.  Never before occurred until then with any taxi driver, this one caught us unaware that we didn't remember to take a photo of him and his license; he played the 'you shortchanged me' game upon our arrival to our hotel who could care less about our plight.  This time with the flat taxi fare being 55 euro to the left bank we paid 15 euro more for the private van (a new, clean Mercedes 6 seater with tons of space for our luggage).  Driver was there waiting for us at arrivals, we walked a few steps to his van, and were delivered promptly to our hotel without any stupid scams pulled.  Same thing to return to CDG we were actually booked with the same vehicle and driver except fare was 10 euro less.  Again I highly recommend this service-well worth it IMO!!

I booked the 5 euro breakfast special with the room via the hotel's booking engine.  Five euro for either a Continental (which also includes choice of eggs and/or ham-alot of other hotels charge an exorbitant price for these items as extras) or buffet breakfast with choice of jams, cheese, eggs, ham, yogurt, cereal, and pastries including baguette, freshly squeezed orange juice, and choice of coffee, tea, milk is an excellent deal.  The only small negative IMO is that the pastries were bite sized & the croissants were not the best quality considering it's Paris.

I can't say enough about how excellent all of the staff were.  From before we left home I'd emailed them about different questions which were promptly replied to.  Upon arrival we were greeted by Christophe who was quite helpful in lending us an adapter saving us the trouble of going out and buying one.  The other reception staff were all great too as were the housekeeping staff who kept the suite spotless every day.  Want to also commend them on allowing us to sleep late each morning.  Other hotels sometimes do not respect the 'Do not disturb' sign on the doorknob and would knock to proceed with their cleaning schedule.  But here the staff truly respected the guests' wishes to leave the room when they chose even past 1pm as we did everyday.  Thank you for that!!

So all in all, both my son and I loved this hotel & would recommend it to anyone seeking a moderate cost for a lovely, well staffed hotel in the heart of the 6th.  And do try to book the suite!

title: Perfect for Visitors- Paris Perfection

The Odeon metro stop is around the corner with access to the 4 and 10 line which will take you quickly to other areas. There is a Starbucks nearby for English speakers or early morning departures, a post office to mail stuff home if you bought too much, and a couple excellent pharmacies if you forgot things..You are also a short walk from great restaurants, bars, and high end shopping. The rooms are super charming and clean. Classic without being dated! The WiFi is great. The prices are very reasonable for what you get in the area. The staff and manager Fanni have always gone out of the way to assist with planning my visits, or answering any questions... If you want to feel like a local, with the benefits/amenities of a hotel then Left Bank is a perfect choice.

title: Loved it!
text: It’s been ten years since I last stayed here but I have such fond memories of it!  The rooms are wonderfully cozy and one (I want to say #505) has a view of Notre Dame.  It was covered floor-to-ceiling in a rosy red toile that I absolutely loved.  I kept the window open most of the time just to look out at the city.  The room has a bathtub which was great after long days and many hours spent walking.  The breakfast was always tasty and served in the room or the dining area, according to your preference.  One of the best attributes of the hotel is its neighborhood and its proximity to a major-thoroughfare metro station, about two blocks away.  You are in a quaint and (possibly) still not completely-tourist-overrun area of Paris here, between the best of St. Germain and the Latin Quarter just out your door.   Head only a few blocks to the Seine, the Pont des Arts, the Ile de la Cité, the Louvre, and so on.  I’ve visited Paris many, many times, and some of my happiest memories are the ones spent in this sweet and charming little hotel!

title: Location, Location,Location!
text: We chose this 3 star hotel by the reviews and because it had a cheap breakfast if booked directly with the hotel only €5 per person which was a continental buffet breakfast but plenty of choice fresh fruit, toast, Croissants and pastries, French breads and Cheeses, Cereals, Pancakes, Yoghurts and tea and coffee. We filled up and didnt need lunch. A cooked breakfast was available at a further charge. We had a room overlooking the street.It was very clean and the bed was comfy. The bathroom had a great rain shower over the bath with instant hot water. Toiletries provided too. Wi fi was was a bit patchy dropping in and out so we used our data. I slept well but my husband found some noises from other guests disturbed him but he is a light sleeper. The hotel had great air conditioning and we needed it as it was 34 deg when we were there. We visited The Seine which was just 5 mins walk and The Louvre 10 min walk. Notre Dame and Muse D'Orsay was 15 mins walk. Toullieres Gardens and place de La Concorde 20 mins walk and Arc de Triomphe about 30 mins walk. The Eiffel Tower was the furthest at approx 40 mins walk but it was an easy walk along the Champs Elysee. There are tour brochures in the hotel and we got a boat tour and a 3 course meal in the oldest cafe in Paris La Procope (which is next door to this hotel) for just €39 each it was well worth it. The Luxemburg Gardens were also nearby about 15 mins walk away and so beautiful. Lots of restaurants and cafes close by for dinner and Rue St Germaine de Pres is at the end of the road to do lots of shopping. Staff were friendly, polite and helpful and spoke perfect English. They kept our bags after check out for us and organised a taxi too. The Gare de Nord was approx 15-20 mins drive away and the taxi costs about €20.00. If you book your stay in August it is cheaper per night than in July. A great month to go. I hope you enjoy your stay at Hotel Left Bank as much as we did.

title: Amazing location - good value for the money
text:
We stayed here recently in two rooms. First, the location is great! We were right in St Germaine and near Latin Quarter. Lots of restaurants and shopping and just nice walking around. We could walk to many attractions (Notre Dame, Luxembourg Gardens, Louvre) and very short cab rides to others. 

The hotel staff was very helpful and had good suggestions. The rooms were nice and had ambiance. First night we stayed in two adjoining rooms which were adequate, on the small side but clean. For the last few days of our trip we moved to the suite on the 6th floor. The views from the room were fantastic - Eiffel Tower from one end and Notre Dame the other. I would struggle to call it a suite though. While it says it sleeps 4 people, when you do put 4 people in it you lose any use of the couch (that is one of the beds) and they bring in a cot which takes up the rest of that living room area. So in the end, it's a tight space for 4 people with no real useful seating area. If we went back, I would get the two adjoining rooms for four people as that gives you a little more room and you have two bathrooms.

Overall a good stay and a very good value for the price, especially given the location.

title: Charming hotel with a charming view
text: Stayed here for three nights with my mom and my partner while we toured a few European cities. We had a triple room on the top floor. It had the cutest little balcony with a picturesque view of Parisian side streets. The other window, which when opened was more of a faux balcony type of thing, had a view of residential buildings and a courtyard directly below. If you look above the neighboring building you can see the very tip top of the Eiffel Tower. It was nice to see it sparkling at night directly from our bed. The room came with a twin bed and a double/queen sized bed.  A very standard and slightly dated design but cute nonetheless. The room also had no air conditioning, so I’d imagine in the summer months it would get pretty hot. However, The room does come with small table fans for when needed, but Luckily for us we had cool weather and were able to leave the windows open. The fans added a nice comfort for a great sleep. Perfect location with a 15 min walk to the Eiffel Tower, where you have many options and can pick up tons of bus tours that will take you around the entire city to all must-see sights. I would definitely stay here again.
