title: Basic hotel, great location
text:
A friend and I met in Paris to spend a few days in the city, for pure enjoyment. My friend had booked this hotel already, I had my reservations after seeing the pictures and reviews. Luckily I was proven wrong! I loved the area, 20 minute walk from Eiffel tower,  but more importantly set in a residential area so I was able to experience Paris like a Parisian! There are lots of local shops around: bakeries, green grocers, cheese and charcuterie shops, butchers,  etc.
The hotel is very basic and the price isn't cheap for what it is, but in a big touristy city you would struggle to find anything similar for a cheaper price, unless you opt for air b&b I suppose.
We had a room on the 3rd floor, it was small and the sound insulation is not good, so make sure you pack your earplugs. Yet, the room had sufficient storage space and it was clean enough. We had a pillow each and there was an extra pillow which I have my friend. We asked for an extra pillow but they didn't have any, they would have taken one from another room but the hotel was full.
The breakfast was of fair value. For 8.30 euros you get decent coffee, juice (from concentrate), 2 choices of cereal, yoghurt, pre-packed cheeses, and freshly baked baguettes, croissants and pain au chocolat. If the hotel's breakfast would have included ham and fresh fruit, we would have probably had breakfast there everyday.
Some cafes in the vicinity would charge you a similar price for a "French breakfast": a coffee, juice, a croissant and tart. If you, like me, prefer a breakfast which include savoury items, you'd do better to go to a local "boulangerie" and get a nice savoury quiche or sandwich, and a coffee, and you'll spend around 7 euros, but it's unlikely you'll be able to sit down.
By far, the best part of our stay was Sophie, the star hostess! She speaks very good English and Spanish and she was very friendly and helpful, miles away from the Parisian stereotypes! 
This is not the best hotel I have stayed at but my experience was very good, and the location certainly made up for anything the hotel lacked.

title: Poor, no elevator in back tower
text: Hotel Is great located but not really good, we arrived late and got received by a bad dressed receptionist that didn't smelled well, he wasn't kind.  The hotel doesn't have elevator in the second tower of 4 floors and stairs were really tight...

title: A convenient bed and shower, not much else.
text:
The hotel is small, seems quaint, and has nice service. It's off the higher trafficked streets of paris, but still really close to the metro, and about a five minute walk to the Eiffel Tower. The walls are thin, the rooms/beds were quite small, and we heard out neighbor take a loud phone call every morning, which woke us up. But, there are a lot of restaurants nearby, and the fact that it was so close to the metro was a huge plus. We loved the small bakery/cafe down the block and went there almost every morning for breakfast. Service was really great, and the hotel was safe--it had a buzz-in system at night, which made us feel really safe.

Overall, not a terrible place to stay. I would recommend this hotel to a solo traveler, or a couple, traveling through Paris on a budget that wants the convenience of a hotel (instead of hostel) not far from the tourist highlights of the city.

title: Conveniently located
text: This hotel is a 20-minute walk from the Eiffle Tower, and is close to the Dupleix Metro, making it a short dash to any of the major tourist sites in Paris. Our room was tiny.  There was a cupboard to store items from your suitcase, a small desk with chair, and two small end tables.  Our room was tight for two people, but adequate for the budget minded staying in Paris. The TV has only local channels, and none are English speaking. The door is secure but the walls are thin. The window opens to the street and the area is active and noisy at commute times and weekend after hours. There is a nightclub near by that draws nightlife on weekends. The staff is hospitable and helpful. Our room was made up each day, and there were fresh towels, soap and shampoo provided.  our bed was comfortable. The shower is good but tight. Be careful that you understand your booking contract. Breakfasts was not included in our room price, and we were charged 8 euros each per meal. The offered fare was sweet rolls, croissants, cheese, dry cereal flakes, juice, coffee and tea.  In summary, it is a good place if you are not spending time in your room except to sleep and change clothes. Small for two people.

title: Small hotel in Paris, nothing special

title: mixed service
text: When I checked in on Tuesday 30 January the taxi driver would not let me pay by card and I was 5 euros short. the man at reception very kindly advanced me the money and I paid him later. He was charming and helpful. But the following day the person on duty who was apparently the manager was not helpful at all. Although she did not appear to be busy she refused to give advice about directions. The other staff were very good. The room was as expected, as I have stayed there before but it was smelly, as if someone had been smoking in the room. Otherwise the facilities were good for a budget hotel in an excellent location.

title: Good hotel of its type
text: This is a fairly basic hotel, but it does what it does very well.  Our room was small but perfectly adequate - and clean and comfortable.  The bathroom was also clean with a very good shower.  It is not a luxury hotel but does not purport to be one.  Quite a good location, excellent market nearby on Sundays and Wednesday.  In a quieter part of Paris but not too far out and not bad value.

title: Very nice budget hotel in a great location
text: We were very satisfied with the service the staff provided, location, and the hotel features. The room was clean and nicely furnished and the beds were comfortable. There was plenty of room for two. The WiFi worked fine. The location is great to walk to many attractions and places to eat.

title: Good location
text:
It's a small hotel, with small rooms, small elevator. The problem of this hotel is that don't have air conditioner, we was for 4 nights in july and the temperature out was more than 36 cecius  all day and when you come back in the room after a long day you need some fresh air or not????? 
Buuuuut location it's very good near Eiffel tower and metro station Dubleix.

title: Good and Cost Effective
text: The hotel itself is a bit out dated, however the accommodations are good enough. For the money the location is fantastic! Right by the metro and there are so many restaurants around as well as cafe's and bars.

title: Just great
text: I really liked this little hotel. It's a simple two star hotel, but the staff are really friendly, they speak English and the rooms are impeccably clean. As added value the Eiffel Tower is just a five minute walk away. You turn right and suddenly it appears in the horizon - can't beat the location. There are local shops, cafes and restaurants all around away from the tourist trap. I highly recommend it.

title: Fine for 2 nights
text: Fine for 2 nights, good metro links, with a metro (number 4 I think) at the top of the road. The actually hotel is really grotty and be prepared to walk up lots of stairs if you are on a higher floor!

title: Basic but comfortable
text: The hotel is located just walking distance from the Eiffel Tower, in a quiet street. The metro station and a large shopping street are just round the corner.  The hotel is probably more suitable for less demanding tourists. It is clean and nice, but do not expect anything fancy, the room was pretty modest (bed, chair, small table, wardrobe, TV set).  The double room was spacious, with a reasonably big bathroom (with a bathtub). The staff was polite and nice, provided us with an additional blanket on request. We didn’t have breakfast but the hotel does provide it. There’s not much to say about the hotel, its biggest advantage is the location for sure, it’s full of tourists and in a safe area, so you’ll feel safe even at night.  My only complaint would be about the Wi-Fi connection. Some days it was really slow and I could hardly connect to the internet.

title: Small but comfortable and clean
text: This hotel is very near to the Eiffel Tower. The area is very quite and safe. Just 20 minutes walking from the Hotel. The WIFI sometimes work and sometimes not work very good and I stayed in the second floor. The breakfast was the same food all the days but the croissant and the baguette was very good. The personal of the reception speak fluently English. This hotel have elevator but is very small "Petit". Near the hotel you can find a lot of restaurants, wine shops, bakery and supermarket.

title: Great position
text:
We have now stayed in this hotel 5 times and each visit is great the rooms are small but clean staff are supper helpful don't worry about the size of room you only sleep there it's in a great part of Paris .
There is a laundromat around the corner the best bakery 1 minute away and now a Aussie style coffee shop around the corner it's called o coffee shop .free wifi in hotel 
Really quiet street over all a great place 10 minutes from the Eiffel Tower

title: Basic, Average, Good Location
text: The hotel is located within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower. Although quite modest with small rooms, it is clean and comfortable. Okay for a night's stay. You can walk across to the Seine River as well. Within the close vicinity there are bakeries, restaurants and retail stores. Check-in could be more cheerful :)

title: Nice hotel.
text:
The staff was very helpful, and there was no problem with communication in English. The room was simple, but comfortable. The bathroom was larger than I expected, very clean and nice. The only thing I missed was larger desk or table for work. WiFi worked reliably, but with rather low speed.
The location of this hotel is a great asset. Easily accessible from metro (2-3minutes walk).

title: Basic hotel
text: This was a basic hotel and was a good 20 mins walk from Eiffel Tower and about 10 mins to metro. Location was ok but looking at about a 20/25 min metro ride to get to museums/points of interest other than Eiffel Tower. KEY POLICY found this a bit weird as they don't let you leave the hotel with your room key and ask you to put the key behind the front desk every time you leave and then ask for it back when you come back to the hotel seems strange and not as secure as just keeping the key on you. Balcony was nice. Good location if you are flying into Orly airport on a late flight as only 25 min uber ride (uberPOOL €25 uber €35).

title: Super basic but does the job
text: Basic, a TV and a bed. Bathroom was very clean which was a pleasant surprise. Rooms on higher floors are better, thus we didn't hear any street noise. A decent walk from the Eiffel tower. Metro stop is close. Nice walking area.

title: Great location
text: One of the highlight of this hotel is the location. It is near the public transport and Eiffel Tower. You can walk from the hotel to Eiffel about 15 minutes or even faster by metro. The pictures of room on website are totally different from reality. In real the room is quite new and small, private bathroom is included without breakfast in room price. The hotel is also near supermarket Franprix, bakery, school and restaurants. All in all, worth a stay right in centre of Paris at reasonable price.

title: accessible location
text:
The hotel is situated atleast 10-15 minutes walk from Eiffel tower. Around, you will small bakery, small coffee shops, small pubs, a self service laundry, a bio-carrefour, some atm, and pharmacy. Also it is close to the metro. 
The room my mom and I had was okay. We were on the 2nd floor. No A/C, but it was okay as it was a cold season... so we just had to open the windows. Hotel was clean. Wifi is fast. Hot and cold showers available- room heating available, bathroom amenities replenished.

The only thing I would like to recommend is to have atleast 2 bottled waters in the room. Coz in our case, we arrived almost midnight due to the delayed flight. And when we got to the hotel, there was no water in the room. I went down to reception only to find out they also don't have any water available in the hotel(that was the night reception informed me)-and no more shops were open. So we had to endure our thirst for the night.

title: Location, location, location!
text: Situated in the 19th, the hotel is near The Eiffel Tower in a vibrant, energetic neighborhood. Great local restaurants (especially the Ethiopian Lac Tana), as well as brasseries and cafes. Hotel staff were friendly and very helpful. The rooms are spacious by Paris standards and the add-on breakfast is good value. Will always keep it on my list!!

title: Nice location
text: Well located to local must see events or tourist traps like Eiffel tower in the heart of Paris .  For the hotel itself it's clean comfortable and quiet.  Breakfast is available if you want it and also WiFi.  It's a pretty good hotel at a reasonable price.

title: Great Value
text:
Location about 15 mins walk from Eiffel Tower. Quiet, safe and easy to find. 
Excellent value for money. Great for a base, no frills but comfortable.
Our flight was quite early in the morning so the hotel allowed us to store our bags their while we explored the city, which was very helpful. If I returned to the city I will use the hotel again. My only recommendation would be refreshments in the rooms.

title: Great Location
text: Booked this hotel so I was staying in the same hotel as a friend and wasn't sure about it but was pleasantly surprised, it's in a quiet area but only ten minutes from the eiffel tower and the rooms are good although not large are great for a night or two and are well furnished with a shower ensuite which is very modern.

title: Budget hotel.
text:
Stayed here in early June. Room was dated but clean and had all the basics. Hair dryer etc. Most of the staff where nice although when we asked where my daughter could park the car we was told to Google it!
Hotel is fine for a few days in a busy city. Close to metro, rer, and Eiffel tower only 10 Min walk away. Would probably stay there again.

title: OK for budget stay near Eiffel Tower
text: Reception not very helpful. No tea and coffee in the room. Very basic and outdated room. But was half the price of anything else that close to where we need to be. Metro station at end of road made getting about easy.

title: solo guest
text: A basic room ..quite small but clean .Shower only just big enough but was quite powerful . Did not sample breakfast as it was an extra cost .A plus point was the fact it was a short walk to the Metro and good amenities locally.

title: Good value
text: Our room was small but adequate on the back of the building away from the street.  No air conditioning but, visiting in the spring, open windows were fine.  The room had a private bath with shower.  Some members of our party had rooms on the street side of the building so there was some noise at night.  The hotel is well situated to local restaurants and bakeries.  About a 10 minute walk to the Eifel Tower and easy access to two Paris metro subway stations.  Would stay there again but only on the backside of the building.

title: The no no hotel
text: If you get a room on the street side, forget about opening the window.  It's to noisy and it faces the west sun.  We had a group of 10, they would not even let us sit in the dining area to visit or if you brought a snack in, to eat it there.  Any time we ask them for a small request it was NO.  The hotel was clean, only good thing I can say.

title: Very good full of nice people
text: Staff is lovely ... in particular there are 2 ladies there at the reception working Thursdays and Fridays at least that are simply amazing . We did not try breakfast so we do not know what is like. Room was very clean as well as the bathroom . Hotel is close to 2 subway stations and you can walk to Eiffel Tower, a 10/15 minutes walk walking slowly . A supermarket around the corner and some restaurants with very reasonable prices and good food . Amalfi is amazing if you fancy Italian food ... pizzas are incredible.

title: Comfy hotel close to Eiffel Tower
text: This is an older hotel but still very comfy and within walking distance of all the sights. The only negative part of our stay was on Saturday night--the locals who live in the apartments across the way partied all night.  They didn't stop until 4am, but this isn't the fault of the hotel.  The front desk staff was excellent.

title: Likely best value for money in Paris
text: Stayed one night on business; rate booked was extremely competitive. Room was clean, spacious and had a balcony. Bathroom: functional and equipped with what one needs for a one night stay on a business trip. What I appreciated most was the very quiet location. Never slept that well in a busy european capital. Receptionist very friendly and highly efficient. Free WLAN reliable and fast bandwith. Breakfast: quick and equally efficient. Good quality items on choice. To compare, I have been staying at hotels in Paris before (predominantly chain hotels around Porte Maillot), paid 4times more and did not get what I got here - first and foremost - a quiet good night's sleep. Will certainly return, over and above the fact that the area in which the Pacific is located is lively and gives a good handful of options to go out for a drink or a meal.

title: Great location, small room, no frills.
text: We stayed here for 4 nights while in town for the Paris Marathon. It's strength is definitely its location. It was about a 10min walk to the Eiffel tower. It's within 400m of metro stations on two train lines which was very handy. There are Patisseries on every corner in the neighbourhood which we found useful for breakfast and dessert. The hotel has a tiny lift, tiny corridors and the rooms had no frills. No kettle or tea/coffee making facilities which was tough for us. One small table and a chair.

title: Large rooms
text: Stayed here in March 2016. Rooms are large and hotel is quiet. Recommended to me by a friend who stayed here. VERY close to Eiffel Tower and subway is VERY close. Many cafes etc. nearby. Well priced. A GOOD deal!

title: Friendly Hotel, Great Location.
text:
Stayed here for one night when we travelled to Paris for the football. Had a twin room with my 20 year old son.
It was ok for one night but thats all, very small room and extra small single bed. Bathroom was ok, good shower but again small and no shower curtain so left the bathroom floor soaking....... sorry.
Great value for a one nighter and its in an excellent location. Quiet back street but shops,bars, restaurants and Metro all close by. Eiffel Tower is 10 minutes away.
Friendly and helpful staff. I would stay again for the football but would prefer somewhere a bit more substantial if I were to be with my wife.

title: Hygiene and Simple
text: The rooms are so simple. The table, bed, even the wardrobe are placed in a very logical system. Room cleans everyday and they do this very well. Hotel's location is very nice, it's close to Dupleix metro station and the Tour Eiffel! Thanks for smiling service and good location!

title: Review
text: Very basic room, nothing fancy at all about the hotel and seems dated.  however it is a good location, clean and the staff are friendly and helpful. Good wifi and good shower. Would recommend for a short stay

title: Cheap & functional
text: Small rooms with even small bathroom, but clean and in a good location. If you are looking to your budget this could be your place. The WiFi is good, something that you can't say in all the hotels!!!!

title: Value for money
text: I stayed here with my husband for 3 nights. The location is very convenient. There are a few metro stations nearby and it is walking distance to the Eiffel Tower. The room itself is very small, which is, however, not unusual for Paris. There are blankets on the bed instead of douvets (maybe you can request for douvets, I didnt investigate). The bathroom is decent, clean and looks quite new. The TV has only French channels :) There is no fridge, water kettle or safe in the room.

title: Nice affordable Friendly
text: I have to say I really enjoyed my self here. Great price, cheap, very very clean and a fantastic location. The staff were lovely, in particular the ladies at reception were always welcoming and informative .  I went with my partner and 3 friends, so there was 3 rooms in total. I was in all 3 rooms.  They were all held to a good standard,  there are some great shops around with one right around the corner called Franprix. It has everything you need and an nice quite area.  I would highly recommend and also stay there again.

title: Nice place in Paris.
text: This hotel is centrally located in Paris. Eiffel Tower is ten minutes away by foot. The place is close to many restaurants, shopping stores, and the Metro. I will recommend this place to friends and family. The place is clean and the price is resonable, and the staff is very helpful.

title: Better than I hoped
text:
- Excellent location near to the Eiffel tower,
- Shops, restaurants, cafe, bakery within 200 m, 
- Clean and cleanly kept rooms,
- Daily replaced towels,
- Polite receptionists,
- Relatively poor offer for breakfast ,
- Poor sound-proofing among the rooms,
- Well equipped bathroom,
- Fair price.

title: Good location and quite inexpensive as compared to other hotels in Paris
text:
++ location in a VERY centre, close to the Eiffel tower.
++ quite cheap for Paris and especially for this location
++ you can leave your belongings after check-out for some time at the desk
--  tiny space in the hotel itself and in the room, no balcony

title: Clean, Safe, Cheap--Reasonable location
text:
We spent 7 nights in this hotel.  We found it more than adequate, though the room was small.  The price was excellent.
Location--About a km walk from the Eiffel tower, about 300m from the Emile Zola station on the Metro 10.  Very quiet neighborhood across the street from two children's schools and next-door to a synagogue, (which got us a military guard during the recent terrorist scare).  The bad side of the location is that it looks like any other European large city, with very little character.  Restaurants are adequate but not great.
Sleep Quality--Excellent.  Very quiet.
WiFi--good  
Service--Front desk was very helpful and the cleaning staff very efficient.  I am knocking the rating down for the breakfast service staff, who were close to dreadful.
The hotel offers a "continental breakfast" for 8.30€ a head.  I've had better free continental breakfasts in cheap American motels.  Coffee and water is restocked--not so much the rest.  Get there early or there won't be any yoghurt left.  AND the tables are liable to be messy and unbussed.  If you are not on business, take the time to eat out at a local brasserie.  Breakfasts can be had for 9-13€ throughout the neighborhood.  Good breakfasts.

title: Budget place
text: In the average. Good for the price paid, nothing exceptional. Just I expected a bit more of the breakfast. Rooms are small and impersonal, but clean and tidy. Situations is good enough, it's not very close to anything, but close enough to the Tour Eiffel and, with the metro service, everything is at half an hour distance. Just one strange thing, there must be something important very close, because every morning we could see three military personnel with full gear and machineguns guarding outside.

title: The worst hotel in Paris
text: We've stayed there for 5 nights... What a mistake!!! Completely joke! We arrived at night .... Receptionist wasn't very friendly to start with... Our bed was broken, we asked to get changed to another room but they said that was not possible because the hotel was full... They said they would get back to us next day... Next morning I tried to get a shower and the water was cold, I phoned reception asking why the water was cold and she replied " well we had some problems so we won't have hot water for two days.. I asked her if that was a joke? And she said " no! What do you want me to do?" They change us to another room which wasn't much better to be honest but the manager made out that the room we changed to was "more expensive" and "a lot better" think trying to change our minds of the hotel so far. The room was NOT a lot better. The bathroom and shower was a cubical, like the one you get if we were outside, put into the room. The next day we came back from our sight seeing with no clean towels and no toilet roll so we had to back to the hotel and ask for clean towels and toilet roll so another disappointment to our trip to Paris. All the rooms have very basics amenities, it says they have international TV and yeah but you can't change the language so international in French which didn't really bother us but the hotel shouldn't advertise something is not true, we asked for a discount because 2 days in a room with the bed broken, no hot water the 3rd day, have to pack all out things because they were changing us to a room that was NOT ready... So we had to leave all our things in reception that to be honest was not ideal in the middle of your holidays... The new room had plates that were never washed before so I have to say I washed the plates because it would be embarrassing and disgusting for the new guest.. The discount was based in 10% of our total bill that if you put at the top the taxes that have to be paid daily in Paris.. Doesn't make much difference.. Receptionist had no idea that we've been told about getting a discount we were about to miss our flights because he could NOT solve the problem himself so he had to phone the manager at 5 o clock in the morning.. Total bill 430 euros for this joke! Location is 10 min away from the Eiffel tour but really isn't a safe place to be at all at any time of the day I would recommend to stay near Notre dame or Latin quarter far much better with cheaper places to eat!

title: A nice place, at nice location, for a nice price
text:
The location is very good, around the corner from a shopping street, very close to a bakery, and about 3 minute walk from the metro La Motte. 
The welcome at this hotel was friendly, and the rooms simple but clean and comfortable. The bathroom didn't have a standard layout, but was good enough. Nice shower. Elevator is small though for 2 people and suitcases, luckily we travelled light.
Considering that it is within walking distance from Tour Eiffel this hotel is very good value!

title: Superb!
text: My wife and I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights and all we can say is that we're really satisfied. Although, we didn't have a fridge in our room the service was terrific. Our room got cleaned everyday

title: ☼ Bonjour Paris ☼
text:
Overall this hotel is a perfect little place to stay on a room only or bed and breakfast basis. Granted, it is a little on the basic side, but a lot of people just look for things to complain about when discussing a simple hotel

The rooms are small and basic, but extremely clean and thoroughly modern, with new bathrooms, TV and excellent free wifi connection.

Located right next to an organic supermarket and one block away from a range of stores offering snacks and baked goods, plus lots of shopping.

2 minutes walk from fabulous bars and delicious restaurants and street food vendors, this hotel is located in Grenelle which is basically like staying in the Kensington or Mayfair area of London. 

10 minutes walk from the Eiffel Tower, down streets lined with typical Parisian amenities, this hotel is in a quaint and affluent area of Paris and makes for an enjoyable stay.

The only point about the room I would say, would be the lack of air conditioning in the hotel (and most buildings in Paris) < traveling in August when it was in the 30'C each day, some A/C would be good. Although this wasn't a problem as the windows opened fully, and our room on the top floor offered an ample breeze. In a quiet street, set back from the main street, leaving the window open all the time was not a problem; plus this hotel has military armed guards outside!

title: Paris Pacific hotel
text: Perfect base camp.Close to local shop, boulangeries, cafes, 5 min from Eiffel Tower...  Guarded by the military...  Very clean, helpful staff... at any time.  Metro station close by.  Very local feel.  Great!!!!

title: Very economic and pictures are not matching!!!!
text:
You just get the basic small rooms without any basic amenities which is standard in any other hotel rooms.
We stayed for 4 night and overall not happy about our stay in the hotel.
So i can will not recommend .
The pictures shows in website does not match the hotel!!!

title: Very average !
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights. 
I felt we paid too much for this hotel. The room was small and quite average looking. The staff was not very helpful ! Keep in mind that they don't speak much english. The elevator was SO tiny that we had to take our luggage one at a time. We didn't have the breakfast as we were told previously that if you pay more than 5 euros for breakfast in hotels, its a rip off. 
The only plus point about this hotel is that its close to the eiffel tower and metro stations. The area seemed to be quite safe.

title: it is ok but it doesnt look like the pictures
text: it was ok, but th eonly thing  if you dont wanna have breakfast over there, that it was not nice breakfast they dont even give you take water. actually we bought some fruit to eat at night and i ask for knife and a plate and they told me not.

title: Just okay.
text: The pictures look nothing like it. Not really that nice, incredibly small and blank rooms. The picture of the lobby isn't even close to what the lobby looks like. Pictures were just deceiving and I may have picked something else if I had known.

title: Good clean hotel near eiffel tower
text: Nice and rather cheap option for living when visiting Paris. Clean rooms, good and comparable cheap breakfast. Nothing special, but it's a budget place. No problem with late checking in. Everything was OK.

title: Small clean hotel in excellent location for very reasonable price
text: The hotel is located in quiet street. You can reach the main Paris destinations walking or using metro. The metro station is few minutes walk from the hotel. Personal was very pleasant , rooms are small ( usual for this city), simple and clean.

title: Paris
text: very nice and cozy hotel. perfect distance from the center in a quiet and nice neighborhood. only negative was that we did not have access to the kitchen. as a family with small children so we could not heat baby food. but in addition to it. so it was a perfect hoteL

title: Just what we needed
text: Great location for eiffel tower, rolland garros and close to nice restaurants and the metro. Room very clean and just what we needed, just needed a base as we were at the tennis most of the days, wifi wasn't great but i had 3G.

title: Stayed in May 2015
text: We'd a fabulous stay and it was good value. 15 minute walk from the eiFfel tower and 5 minute walk from metro station. Only critique is that the photos of the hotel are not an accurate representation of how it actually looks

title: Merci for a great weekend!
text: This was a very nice hotel. My friend and I stayed here for two nights in May. The staff were very helpful and the entire hotel was neat and clean. The location was about a 5 minute walk to a Metro stop and about 20 minutes from the Eiffel Tower. There are many cafes and bistros in the area that are reasonably priced. Merci beaucoup!

title: Excellent!
text:
I really had a pleasant stay. Clean and friendly service. Great value for money!
If you check a bit options around, there is no better choice. i will definitively recommended it to all my friends and family

title: Best budget option in Paris!
text:
Honestly. No complains. This reviewiers that pay 40 eur per night and still want the Ritz, I do not get them, honestly.  

If u do a quick check. It is absolutely the best value for money in the area. Yes, rooms are small. What do u expect for this price?

Again great great option! I will recommend it to all my friends!

title: Nice Stay for the Price...
text:
We had stayed at this hotel for 3 nights in October 2014.
This is an average hotel. But for the price we pay it is Ok.

Pros:
- Rooms are Clean
- Walking distance to the metro stations.
- Good Restaurants around this place.

Cons:
- The walls are very this. You can hear the voice from next rooms very clearly.
- Staff is helpful, but not much friendly.

title: Very nice
text: The room we stayed in was a reasonable size and always well heated, the bathroom was very nice and the staff spoke good English and were polite and friendly. The hotel itself was quite small but was right next to the Eiffel Tower so we didn't really mind. Essentially this hotel had all the basics covered and there were no complaints. For the price we paid, we were very happy with it.

title: TERRIBLE HOTEL
text:
We made a booking online and when we make our check in on 03/12/2014 we found a horrble room very stinky and someone were smoke in the room.
Me my boss had two different room according to our booking but both rooms were the same even with different price, we ask the reception guy for the smelling in the room that we cant sleep his answer was very strange " Open the window " 
the reception guy was very rude with us 
and when we asked to cancel because we cant stay for this room his answer was " do what you need to do there is no money" 
also we talk with the owner throw his phone as we were very tired and her answer was not good. 
after all the reception again scream on our face....

title: Mixed response
text: The hotel is located in a central place. I wrote a mail asking for the directions from the Gorde nord station and got no reply. For a first timer we were stressed to find the right station to alight. The rooms were neat and compact. When we arrived we payed and checked in, in a hurry as we were close to our Eiffel tower appointment. Unfortunately I misplaced my receipt. When we were about to check-out the receptionist said there's no entry of our payment in the system and made us to pay the amount again (after lot of conversation). Fortunately we got the money refunded in a couple of days after they found the error.

title: Au Pacific Hotel, Paris
text:
A very convenient hotel close to the Dupleix metro station and a mere ten minutes stroll to the Eiffel tower.
The staff are courteous, the rooms are rather small but an excellent budget accommodation.

title: my stay for 4nights/days
text: overall my stay went ok but some comments as follow---the double bed(I had to book double as no single was available)--the mattress carried a canal in the middle and during the night one tended to slope towards the middle into the channel tunnel--need new mattress urgently.The room was rather cold.Plus on checking my final invoice found I was charged for breakfast(I has prepaid)for Saturday am when I actually stayed out and had breakfast at my cousin???

title: A good hotel
text:
We have spent five nights in this hotel, two rooms.
Excellent value for money.
Room very clean; tasty breakfast sweet and savory. Friendly and helpful staff
Unfortunately we had a problem with a led-light behind the bed of my children's room. We and the hotel staff were unable to turn it of. So for one night we had to remove the card and turn off all the lights. So we had to leave the cell phone flashlight on for the children
The problem was solved the following day
Another note: the bar was closed soon
Still a great experience as always in All Accor Hotels
Hotel: Ibis Styles Paris Meteor Avenue de la Porte d'Italie
description: L'ibis Styles Meteor c'est La petite lumière aux Portes de Paris Un cocon qui offre une pause détente à tous ses clients. Un environnement et une équipe engagée qui vous feront vivre une expérience unique ! City lovers, en famille, sportifs, en déplacement... Il y en aura pour tous les goûts ! L'hôtel ibis Styles Paris Meteor Avenue d'Italie vous accueille dans ses 185 chambres avec climatisation, literie Sweet Bed et wifi/fibre offert. Vous séjournez en famille ? Demandez nos chambres familles avec kitchenette et nos Suites jusqu'à 5 personnes. L'hôtel ibis Styles Meteor vous propose un service de restauration sur place 'Deli Styles'; retrouvez du lundi au jeudi soir notre ardoise de plats savoureux. Avec la ligne du metro 7, à destination direct du Louvres, Opera, Le Panthéon, Chatelet... Rejoignez facilement la tour Eiffel avec la ligne 6, ainsi que les Champs Elysées. Paris s'ouvre à vous ! Depuis l'hôtel, à pieds, profitez en pour visiter le quartier Chinois, ou encore le parcours de Street Art de la Buttes aux cailles. Envie de couleurs, rejoignez la petite ceinture et la cité florale où vous sens seront remplis de bons parfums.

title: Great hotel and even greater staff!
text:
This hotel was included in a Paris vacation we punched through Gate 1 Travel. I was very impressed from the minute we walked in until the moment we left. The staff is incredible and will bend over backwards to help with anything. We had an issue with our return transfer to the airport, and the front desk guy was on the phone forever trying to get it straightened out for us. It obviously was not his job to do this, but he did it anyway. 

They were very helpful in assisting us in using the subway (metro), finding places to eat, and other tourist attractions in the area. The breakfast was great and had many options for food and drink.

The rooms were also great. Tons of USB plugs for all of our devices, and a surprisingly large bathroom, especially for a European hotel. I totally loved the place and will definitely return if ever back in Paris.

title: Earth 🌍 friendly economy lodging
text:
Most amenities in this hotel show commitment to better our planet.

There are no more plastic water bottles in the hotel, rather cold still water and sparkling water on tap in the lobby, where you can refill your container or grab a glass, for free.

Access to floors and rooms is with bamboo-made magnetic cards 💳, very stylish.

There are also 4 automatic coffee machines ☕️ where one can help oneself to cappuccinos, mochas, single and double espressos, americanos, etc.

Free breakfast included croissants 🥐 , chocolate croissants, cold meats, yogurt, fruits 🍎 , cheeses 🧀, cereal 🥣, eggs 🥚 you can boil at your own taste and more. From 6:30am to 8:00am is the best time to get it, after that, it gets busier until 10:00 am when it’s removed.

ROOM AMENITIES
There were eight European type-C 200V outlets across the room and 2 USB outlets by one side of the main bed.

When we arrived, the sofa beds 🛋 were already converted to beds and made; we thought of this as a very nice and smart gesture, considering that many hotels we’ve stayed at have sofa-beds with missing linens and we have to do the work.

The bathroom is a minimalist expression of a bathroom: Curtains or sliding door is missing from the shower so after showering 🚿 you’ll notice a bit of water that needs to be wiped off, just for your own safety. Toilet, shower and sink are all in the bathroom and there was no lock in the room we got.

Blame the jet-lag or not, the IKEA-type simple beds 🛏 were very comfy! It just would have been nice to have light sheets during one warm night, instead of just the thick covers.

There was no safe in the room and only one safe for the whole hotel, operated by the manager. Apparently they haven’t had an incident “ever” and we didn’t experience anything either, leaving valuables such as passports, electronics, home keys 🔑, etc.

AROUND THE HOTEL
Excellent location: 🚶🏻 Walking distance from about 20 different restaurants as well as the Port D’Italie Metro 🚇 and Bus 🚌 station, where you can easily and inexpensively find transport.Oh, and very close to Paris’ interior circuit Boulevard Périphérique Intérieur, in case of driving around.

Considering the €125 nightly rate for a room that can host 6 people that can be fed breakfast everyday, I’d say it’s a great deal.

title: Post COVID - Dirty room & unhygienic.
text:
Room 722 - upon check in there was a problem with the room rate and an unhelpful front of house manager who’s sole recommendation to resolve the issue was to tell me that she would refund the booking and I can  find an alternative hotel. Not very helpful when you’ve travelled from the UK and you’re standing in reception. But that’s another post. 
On arrival to the room it was dirty. Bed linen was stained, hairs present and black fluff all over it. The bathroom mirror was stained with previous toothpaste splashes. The toilet seat was stained and the bedside table was stained also with oil marks and handprints. Considering Ibis pledge extra sanitation post COVID this room wasn’t fit for purpose. 
Hotels are meant to take cleanliness seriously and clearly this hotel doesn’t check rooms before being allocated. 
Dirty rooms are unacceptable and a health hazard. 
Despite it only being 18:00 there wasn’t any management presence apart from the earlier representative that hardly instills one with confidence. 
I’ve been lucky to travel all over the world and I’ve never witnessed a room this dirty, let  alone post a pandemic. The ibis responsibility to health and hygiene is severely lacking.

title: A quiet stay
text:
Greatly located next to a lot of public transport stations (one minute to the bus station and two minutes to the metro and tram stations) but also next to some bistros and markets, IBIS Styles Meteor offered us a quiet stay for 4 nights in Paris.
Even though we arrived a few hours before check-in time, the young lady at the front desk was very open and took our backpacks and trollers back so we could go down to a bistro nearby to eat and to drink a cold beer.
At 14:00, the room was waiting for us clean and cool, only good for a short rest before taking the Trocadero and climbing the Eiffel Tower.
Breakfast is ok, except the option to boil your own eggs in a small dedicated kettle (at one point there was a queue to boil an egg ...).
The staff was exemplary, both at the reception, cleaners and at breakfast.
In the morning at 6 o'clock, upon departure, check-out was extremely easy (we left the card at the reception and the invoice then arrived by email).

title: Not what we were hoping for...
text:
As someone else mentioned, this is the 2nd day we've had housekeeping come into our room unannounced.  Today I asked her to leave, but she doesn't speak english, so she huffed and puffed and rolled her eyes because we stayed in the room.  Then she came back 10 minutes later and just entered AGAIN without knocking.  Unacceptable.
The construction outside is so loud we cannot keep our window open.
The motion sensor in the stairwell doesn't come on right away and has once shut back off while we were still on the stairs.  That's downright dangerous.
As someone else mentioned, we had 2 bottles of water on the desk when we arrived but no refills since.
Breakfast here is pointless.  It's disorganized, poorly stocked, dirty, and it's just basics like cheese and lunchmeat, yogurt, bread, and apples and croissants.  The juice machine was empty this morning also.
Most staff doesn't speak English.  Definitely not as well as you'd expect in a tourist city at a hotel.
Nice things: it is very close to public transport.  Hot drinks (coffee, tea, hot chocolate) available around the clock in lobby.  Lobby has a bar with VERY LIMITED selection (don't try to get decent food here though). WiFi is good.

title: Regret booking this hotel
text:
1. When we entered the hotel we were not greeted in a friendly manner we were told to show our ID given our room cards and that's it. No friendly welcome.
2. The room is very basic, not much storage room for clothes. Could not even watch TV due to every channel being in French and no way of translating it to english.
3. We asked one of the girls at reception for help with ordering food. She tried to help us and got very frustrated and began to have a bad attitude towards us and we felt very uncomfortable.
4. On the hotel page it states that there are staff who speak English French Spanish and Arabic, no english speaking staff 1 or 2 staff members spoke slight english making it very hard to communicate. People will be coming to stay here from all over the world you cannot have a hotel with just french speakers.
5. The morning after arrival, we went to get breakfast as this was included in our room stay. The breakfast was atrocious. It consisted of cold ham cheese a few fruits 2 choices of cereal and croissants. We asked for eggs we got boiled eggs which looked black and grey in the middle. No warm food at all which was the worst part about our stay at this hotel
6. We came back from shopping and we decided we wanted a few drinks. No staff behind the bar, we asked the hotel staff and she told us the barman would be here in 30 mins. We waited and a couple of staff behind the bar turned up and then they all left. A hotel Male staff informed a lady at the reception that we were waiting for drinks and they exchanged words in french and we were still ignored. We went back to our room and called the reception. Spoke to a man spoke in French then a lady told us to come downstairs and a colleague would make the drinks and we could hear laughing in the background which is highly unprofessional. Why couldn't we be told this when we were waiting downstairs for over a hour. 
7. The air conditioning was not working and staff at reception could not speak English for us to ask how to do it.
8. The house keeping staff could not speak english either. We asked for our room to be cleaned. We arrived back and the bed sheets or pillow cases had not been changed and the bed had just been spread, our cocktail glasses were still on the side, the rubbish in the bins and by the bins were still there. No cleaning done until the second day.

This hotel was a disappointment in nearly all areas. Staff do not care about guests and ate not very helpful at all. The only positive aspect of this hotel is that the bed is comfortable and there is free wifi throughout the hotel. Would not recommend this hotel as it is very basic and not a friendly atmosphere.

title: New hotel on the edge of Paris
text:
Pros:
- Brand-new hotel with large, modern rooms and stylish common areas
- Friendly and helpful staff
- Very affordable if booked early + free breakfast
- Just 4 minutes away from metro line 7

Cons:
- Located in a desolate neighborhood that is still under construction and utterly devoid of charm
- No cafes, restaurants or shops in the immediate vicinity
- Requires at least 30-minute metro ride into center of Paris (hotel is located on the fringes of the city)

If you’re looking to immerse yourself in the charm of Parisian life, this is not the place to be. However, if modern and very comfortable accommodations at a great price is your priority (and you don’t mind being further away from the heart of Paris), you will enjoy this modern hotel that is part of a reliable and recognized chain.
