There were bootle parts and socks under the bed (so not cleaned properly)
Light was falling out of holding
Medial Treatment dismooved from room (€20.)
Hotel: Ibis Styles Paris Meteor Avenue de la Porte d'Italie
description: L'ibis Styles Meteor c'est La petite lumière aux Portes de Paris Un cocon qui offre une pause détente à tous ses clients. Un environnement et une équipe engagée qui vous feront vivre une expérience unique ! City lovers, en famille, sportifs, en déplacement... Il y en aura pour tous les goûts ! L'hôtel ibis Styles Paris Meteor Avenue d'Italie vous accueille dans ses 185 chambres avec climatisation, literie Sweet Bed et wifi/fibre offert. Vous séjournez en famille ? Demandez nos chambres familles avec kitchenette et nos Suites jusqu'à 5 personnes. L'hôtel ibis Styles Meteor vous propose un service de restauration sur place 'Deli Styles'; retrouvez du lundi au jeudi soir notre ardoise de plats savoureux. Avec la ligne du metro 7, à destination direct du Louvres, Opera, Le Panthéon, Chatelet... Rejoignez facilement la tour Eiffel avec la ligne 6, ainsi que les Champs Elysées. Paris s'ouvre à vous ! Depuis l'hôtel, à pieds, profitez en pour visiter le quartier Chinois, ou encore le parcours de Street Art de la Buttes aux cailles. Envie de couleurs, rejoignez la petite ceinture et la cité florale où vous sens seront remplis de bons parfums.

title: The worst hotel experience I've ever had
text:
The absolute worst hotel experience I've ever had.  I arrived early after a long flight at around 11 am.  Even though I was early, I was told my room would be ready by noon.   It was not, then I was told that technically the reservation starts at 3 pm and to come back then. Returned at 3 pm and the room still isn't clean.  The room isn't ready until 4:45pm, and the receptionist seemed annoyed that I even asked about the room being ready for a third time after an over 5 hour wait.  I also overheard another man with his family yelling "menteurs!" (Liars) at another receptionist. So right away I'm thinking I'm not alone in having issues.

I wasnt told anything about how the hotel works like getting new towels throwing out trash, etc. Since there was no room service; in the middle of the night I had to go to the receptionist to ask for toilet paper.  

When I get into my room, oh boy...The entire room smells of mold and was absolutely crawling with spiders and insects.  Then there's the bed, it's like sleeping on cement. I woke up in pain almost every morning.  

I go into the coffee/breakfast room one night to grab coffee and there are flies everywhere and I'm told by staff they usually close the room at night and that "it's summer so there's lots of insects that come in". I'm sorry, but not in a properly managed hotel there aren't.

Finally was able to switch hotels to a wonderful boutique hotel near Montmartre that was the same price!

Avoid this place like the plague!

title: Awful
text: My mother had stayed here 4 years prior but it had gone down hill terribly. The room was not the type we had booked and they did nothing to rectify it. The room reeked of cigarette smoke despite it claiming to be a non smoking hotel. There were lame excuses for that. It was very dirty. The bathroom was the moldiest I've seen and the floor was so dirty that you had to wear shoes at all times. The aircon in the bedroom didn't work and nothing was done about it. While we were there we overheard several other groups with complaints with a similar theme. One group left after one night. It does not live up to the pictures!

title: Be aware of bed bugs
text:
I stayed at the hotel from August 3 to August 5th and it was the worst experience . The hotel room was run down and dusty. It did not at all look anything remotely similar to the pictures  I saw on Booking.com 

Now the worst part happened when I woke up in the morning and found bug bites all over my body, especially on the right side of my leg and my arm. 

After paying my dermatologist a visit, he has confirmed that those were indeed bites from bed bugs. I have since emailed them to demand for a full refund but have been ignored.

Lastly, the two night stay at that hotel in Paris was my last stop before I headed back to the U.S and the bug bites really left me so rattled (and itchy) I haven't been able to get anything done and All in all, it was a very disappointing and upsetting experience.

title: Lovely location with all you need. Having a kitchen is really handy.
text: Great sized room with all we needed to eat in and within walking distance to a lovely area to eat out. Clean and simple and very peaceful. Close to a my metro too so perfect for getting around, although we walked everywhere.  Next time I would book a balcony option.

title: The hotel double booked our room
text: The hotel double booked our room. Therefore, we went from a large family room to two smaller rooms next to the laundry room. Bad service in general as we had to call hotels.com to get assistance. Then they booked a much smaller car for us to the airport so our family had to split up again. Without car seats for children, although I had clearly asked for that. The receptionist said it wasn't possible but then when the second car came – it was a large car with multiple car seats. It was a very stressful experience and I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone. The room also had dirty floors and spiders. On the plus side, I appreciated the gesture from the hotel when the bought us small gifts to apologise. It didn't however, make up for the numerous mistakes and attitudes.

title: Comfortable, well located
text:
Serviced apartment, Simple but all amenities and plenty of room. Iron and board. TV with BBC. There is a laundry but need to pay for App to use. Wash powder incl. Check with reception who are all friendly and helpful. Beds comfortable, breakfast E13 but cafes and supermarket around corner.   Lovely Italian around corner in main Blvd.
2 mins. to Metro and 1 min to 69 bus which takes you to most sites. 
Be prepared for lots of stairs/steps on metro as lifts/escalators rare.

title: Rooms are only cleaned once per week...
text:
I enjoyed my stay but the air conditioning didn't work for most of the trip, at least not well. The floors had not been swept when we first arrived and the bathroom tiles were also very dirty. I also ruined a brand new pair of shorts and a shirt by sitting on the outside chairs on the balcony and getting them stained from how filthy they were. 
The coffee and water downstairs was convenient.
Front desk staff were pleasant.
Wish I would have known ahead of time that rooms were only cleaned once per week.

title: Convenient dated serviced apartments with weak air conditioning
text:
Stayed here for a couple consecutive nights on 2 separate pre-paid bookings, booked direct and it was merely a mediocre experience.

Found out the hard way, during the heatwave, that only certain hotels in Paris are air-conditioned, even within a same brand... The best part about the stay was that the property is air conditioned, although somewhat dated and needing some refurbishment...

Check-in was slightly bumpy, initially being offered a room with a broken A/C, before being upgraded to a Deluxe Studio, featuring a balcony, supposedly due to having status with ASR.

The studio itself is dated, and in need of either some deep cleaning and/or remodeling. The first studio had a weak A/C unit and the 2nd studio had a strong A/C. 

Water pressure in the shower was excellent, although the drain was a touch finnicky. Towels were on the thinner side.

The mattress was on the firmer side and provided a great nights rest. My studio ended up with 2 twins (instead of a double or queen), which was fine, which meant more space for my carry on!

The kitchen was extremely dated, although well-equipped, including a dishwasher, hood, crockery, fridge, and microwave. A kitchenette is a phenomenal way to get additional square footage, in an otherwise tight hotel room!

There was a complimentary espresso maker in the lobby along with a laundry room that can be operated by the WeWash app.

Breakfast was available for a fee. There are numerous bakeries and grocery stores within walking distance to get breakfast!

The Metro is also merely a few minutes away by foot!

title: Excellent for travelers from North America.
text:
We stayed in one bedroom with a teenager. Lots of space, large and comfortable bed and sofas, kitchenette with everything needed, air conditioner and hair dryer working .. . Other then awkward  European shower, nothing to nitpick.  Very clean. Coffee/tea available 24 hrs.  If you request courtyard room, it is very,  quiet. Full breakfast is available.
Hotel's front desk staff was most helpful and pleasant.

The location is  also excellent -  about 15 min  by bus  or Metro on the corner to  Louvre - Notre Dame areas ( or 30-40 min beatiful walk).  10 min walk to Picasso museum.
The area around is residential with lots of stores,  restaurants, cafes and patisseries  that locals use . The hotel is situated on a boulevard, with a playground and park.  I believe they have airport transfer, and  it's 5 metro stops from euro rail.

title: Clean and cozy hotel with very friendly staff.
text: Suitable room size, acceptable room facilities. Very friendly staff. Everything is acceptable. You can have a free coffee in the hotel lobby. Access to the subway is very easy. The hotel is located near Bastille Square. The supermarket is nearby. The street is quiet.

title: So much more than a hotel room. We were so satisfied with our choice.
text:
Our book club stayed for 5 nights in four rooms. Our rooms at the back all had  balconies, one large enough for all of us to gather for coffee and wine. The rooms were all different but all were comfortable and clean with lots of storage and big bathrooms with storage and shelves. The kitchenettes are well supplied. We shopped at the Casino market just across the Boulevard so we could have breakfast in the mornings. We made a meal one night.
This is a great location near several metro lines. We took RER B and metro to Richard Lenior stop from CDG. Easy and fast.
Coffee machine with many choices always available in the breakfast room.
We never requested our room to be cleaned. We were not messy. It was fine. Trash and recycling room located by elevators. 
The staff at the front desk were very efficient, friendly and helpful. We all felt they went out of their way to make our stay pleasant, including changing some double rooms with one bed to double with twin beds. Be sure to request what you prefer when you book.  
This is not a luxury hotel. It is basic but with great extras for a longer stay. 
Bastille Marais is a great location for walking and taking metro or bus. 
I recommend Citadines when you are staying for more than one night. They provide so much more than a room.

title: Citadine…never again.
text:
Very disappointing stay which has put me off the Citadine brand.
Staff were rude and unhelpful. Waisted hours at reception trying to get a baby cot even though I had called and emailed requesting this prior to our stay and it was confirmed by email. After 3 hours they finally dumped an unopened cot and uncovered baby mattress at our door with no sheets at midnight. 
My husband had to sleep on the floor as they gave us a room with two single beds instead of a double as requested. Staff were unapologetic and uncaring stating the issue was that they had given our room away so they could upgrade us to a room with a balcony. Shocking. 
Needless to say we will never consider a Citadine again.

title: 👍👍👍👍Well equipped apartment . Near to many metro . Nice staff . Near to supermarket . Please stay !! 👍👍👍
text:
Review from Singapore , stayed 17-19 mar 22

LocAtion.- near to many metro line . Near to supermarket . Near to commercial laundromat.
In one word.  Easily accessible 

Facilities - I love the room. Kitchen comes well equipped. Ironing board. Hotel has own laundry machine but need to download the app to activate . Super easy.  Toilet and shower room is separated I stay room 003. Awesome . Opposite  is laundry room .  Did not use other facilities 

Food and drinks - hotel have free coffee anytime of the day . Just go and get .  Breakfast wise I eat outside as I rather eat something local from outside cafe. 
Outside the hotel . Have Vietnam food, thai food. Macdonald… all just around 10 mins later walking away. 

I arrive on Thursday and there is a morning market outside . Good to walk 

Hotel staff- I am amazed by the lady ( slightly plump, long hair and wear glasses who help me store my luggage , she let me check in early at 2pm instead of 3. Even tell me wheee to go for food . 
I am amaze by her smile and friendly attitude . 

Second- the cleaner ( black short guy) help me with the laundry machine . He dun speak English . I dun speak French . But we somehow Managed to get the thing settle . 

Both personnel above ! Really makes my day! 
Please convey my thanks to them !!

title: Excellent apartment .
text: Excellent apartment in a perfect location. Ideal for the solo traveller who likes to self-cater. Wonderful market on Thursdays and Sundays almost on the doorstep. Close to supermarket which is well-stocked with a wide variety of food and wine.

title: Huge room, good location, poor service (plus, BEWARE! clearing fees not included in the price)
text: The hotel is located in a quiet neighborhood conveniently located close to Bastille. On the positive side, the room that we got (the standard one) was huge for the Paris standards. We had a small dining table, and a full-equipped kitchenette. This is very convenient, if you plan to stay several nights but do not want to dine out every day. The cons are the following ones. First, our room was old (particularly, the bathroom). On top of that, they do not clean it during your stay, unless you pay 17 euros extra per day. This is not good. We also found the service to be inefficient. We ordered new towels (yes, you need to call the reception to get new towels!), and a couple of times they forgot to bring them to us. Also, the day we arrived the room was not ready and, therefore, left our luggage in the hotel. The person in the front desk provided us with tags to identify our luggage and show us the way to the luggage room. That person ordered us to write down our name on the tags (three of them), cut them, and to put our luggage in the luggage room: first time I do this in my life, with absolutely ZERO help from the person in the front desk (which, by the way, seemed to have nothing else to do, as there were no other customers there). These small details make me doubt whether I will consider this hotel again in future trips to Paris.

title: Good choice
text: This apartment hotel is a good compromise if you plan to spend several days in Paris. I was there for a whole week in August 2020.  Prices were rock bottom due to the coronavirus emergency. I had a sort of studio on an upper floor, ample and quiet. The full kitchen is quite useful if you wish to cook your own dinner with a steak, salad, and cheese, complemented by a bottle of wine, or if you buy some specialty at the local traiteur.  Management schedules only one room service during the week, but you can buy extra room service at affordable prices. Personnel was very helpful.  The location is convenient to reach most sights on foot.

title: Perfect for a short city break
text:
Chose the Citadines as we wanted to have some kitchen facilities during our stay. Decided on this one as it is a little cheaper than some of the others around the city and the location is great for getting about. 

Booked directly on the Citadines website as it was cheaper than going through Booking.com, Trivago etc.

We had a Studio Deluxe room which had twin beds, a kitchenette (including kettle, toaster, fridge, induction hob and dishwasher) and a large balcony.  The room was comfortable and well-maintained. The only fault was the air-con which didn’t seem to be working, meaning the room was warm during the heat wave.

The location is great, in between 2 metro stops and within 5 minutes of 2 supermarkets. We mainly used the Casino supermarket which opens at 8.30 and has fresh bread, croissants etc. 

Staff are friendly and helpful. 

We’d definitely stay here again.

title: Repeat visit to a very good place
text: I have stayed at this residence a number of times. It is close to the Marais, which I love, had good metro and bus service, good good shopping and a wonderful street market twice a week. Though the general area is not filled with boutiques, etc, they are close enough. The general atmosphere is very pleasant and the property is well kept up.

title: Accommodation
text:
Close to trains but cheap, nasty and hard to find. Wouldn't recommend foreign families to stay here as we didn't feel very safe.

For what we paid for beakfast 14 euro per person we didn't get much and the when food ran out the lady didn't refill it so people went without despite paying the money.

title: Great Value
text:
Big and clean apartment, great location with a small but functional kitchen. Very confortable beds.
All the staff were very kind at the check in, check out and helped with all our needs.
Very good place to stay with the family

title: Clean and functional
text: The spacious and clean rooms in this apartment hotel come equipped with fridge, microwave, small cooktop, small dishwasher, a table with two chairs, a comfortable bed and functional bathroom. In short, all you need for convenient self-catering stays. Our son and family, with two small children, were staying there at the same time and opted for a suite, a wise move in that it allowed the children to go to bed in one room while their parents were still up in the living room. Perhaps because of the kitchen component, breakfast was an extra and didn't really look to be worth the price, especially since there were excellent boulangeries a short walk away.  The hotel has on-site laundromat facilities. Wi-fi was fine, but the two English stations deemed to be available on the television were non-functioning (the picture fragged constantly, and the sound was inaudible: French stations functioned normally). The hotel is well-located, close to the Marais and Bastille areas. The Metro is a short walk away.

title: This time it wasn't as usual
text:
Hello, in this stay I cannot say that I have encountered the service that I usually find in your facilities. At the Citadines Bastille Marais, I stayed for the sixth time, and I also used the Holborn facility twice. this time things were not positive:
The air conditioning system did not work, it only gave cold air, and the structure knew it before I arrived, having positioned an electric radiator in the room.
The firigerifer was broken, the part for the bottles was missing and it had a single broken shelf too.
The dishwasher was corroded in the basket, and I am attaching the photo to it, also it had some lighting difficulties.
The cleanliness was not at the level of the other times and overall it seemed to me that the structure did not have the level of maintenance that I had always found.
The refrigerator has been changed at our request, and the dishwasher has started working again, but the rest has obviously not changed; to make matters worse, the door opening cards have also become demagnetized, oddly both.

title: Fantastic excellent location
text:
A super place to stay the
staff are great And so helpful nothing is too much trouble for them. A wonderful place. Would highly recommend. Easy access to everything, transport restaurants.  Will return again

title: Excellent Option to visit Paris
text:
Great stay at Paris. Ideal for families. All you need at hand. Restaurants, Shops, Bars.
Friendly staff and big rooms. Nothing to complaint about. The kitchen is fully equiped and you will feel like at home.

title: Matching my expectations
text: Renting an apartment in Paris is a way to relax, especially during a strike!!!! The service was excellent. The apartment was confortable. It was very well located. Having access to a small and practical kitchen is a real asset. Many food stores are available. Overall, an excellent experience.

title: Great option, huge appartment size
text: We were 2 adults and our daughter and spent 5 days at this great location in trendy Marais-Bastille in a huge appartment (for Paris standards) with kitchen and a separate bedrooom. We will come back no doubt

title: Conforable well located aparthotel
text:
Facilities are clean, apartment properly equipped with all kitchen needs, towels, soap, etc.. receptio open 24h. Possibility to have breakfast.
Location is vey good. There is a subway station walking less than 5 min, quiet area close to La Bastille square.
Only but... window on room 314 didn't close perfectly.

title: Low toilet paper and mold
text:
My shower had a lot of black mold in it. When I arrived, I only had half a roll of toilet paper for an 8 night stay. I went and got more toilet paper but when housekeeping came to clean (which they only did once in an 8 night stay) they took away my extra roll. Which meant I had to and get toilet paper a second time from the front desk. Toilet paper is just the bare minimum I expect a hotel to have. 
The bed was two twin beds put together which if I was with a partnered would have bothered me to have the crack in the middle.

title: An Essential Hotel
text: This apartment hotel is located in a very special area of Paris..the staff are very welcoming and friendly, the rooms are clean and cozy... there is a great market twice a week almost out the front door on Thursday and Sunday mornings..an abundance of restaurants are in easy walking and the Opera Bastille offers an opera experience..when staying on the upper floors the Sacre-Coeur Basilica and the Eiffel Tower can be seen in the distance

title: More than what we expected
text: I booked this property after seeing it online. Good Choice! My husband and I found the property to be well located, depending on where you want to stay in Paris. The bachelor suite was spacious, clean and provided soap, shampoo etc. There is a 24 hour reception which is great. This is not a hotel, so don't expect housekeeping unless you want to pay additionally, which works. Staff were friendly, and efficient. I did think for the price point that breakfast should be included, which is good for starting your day.

title: Ok
text:
Our first time to Paris. When we checked in the clerk tried to make us pay (again) as he had no record of our payment (we had already paid the Flight Centre in Australia as part of our holiday package). Luckily another clerk stepped in and said it was all ok! 
The room was small but had a lovely view, however I was not thrilled about the hotel’s location. Room service was not included. However there was a laundry for €9 wash & dry. We thought it was ok overall but will choose a better location next time we visit Paris.

title: Great location, in need of refurbishment, very helpful staff
text: We have stayed here many times. The one bedroom deluxe apartments are spacious and reasonably well equipped. Kitchen facilities, not bad, although fridges are always missing a shelf or a basket. Wifi ok, but can require re logging in frequently. TV good, helpful as wifi does not seem to enable streaming.

title: Very Convenient
text:
A good apartment hotel near Bastille. Two metro stations nearby make access into the city and other areas easy. The hotel itself is made up of self catering units. The room had a two burner stovetop, microwave, dishwasher and fridge. Very clean. Plenty of cooking utensils and cutlery, but don’t expect even a teabag. You must provide everything. But a good supermarket is about a 4 minute walk. 
Downside - rock hard beds and a lot of noise if you get a street view. Ask for “garden view” if noise bothers you, and the laundry token is five euros for just a small wash, no dry.

title: excellent residence in a fantastic position
text: We were staying in a very nice top floor room overlooking Paris' roofs, with the Tour Eiffel and the Sacre Coeur shining at night at a distance. The room was large, comfortable, full of light, elegantly furnished with a small but fully furnished kitchen. The residence was very well organized and the staff eas kind and helpful. Underground, supermarkets, restaurants at walking distance. Highly recommended!

title: Great apartments next to Bastille !
text: Bright and comfortable apartment at the last floor. Quiet despite the proximity to Bastille. Clean and very convenient for families. Several restaurants, bars and shops nearby. Ideal for a stay in Paris !

title: Highly recommended - Happy with Location, Service and Room
text:
The hotel is between the metro stations Richard Lenoir and Bréguet Sabin (the latter is closer to the hotel), connecting directly to the Gare de l’Est and Gare de Lyon. And you are in the heart of Marais within a five minutes’ walk.  
Boulvard Richard Lenoir is quiet, but if you want to be sure to have a quiet night, ask for a room facing the rear. The bed was comfortable, though the matrass was too hard for me.
The kitchen equipment is OK, though I missed a dishrag and an oven (to be fair, there was a microwave). The crockery is limited, but for a quick meal, there is everything you need. 
The bathroom has a decent size (for Paris ;-) and was clean, there just a few stains in and around the bathtub.

title: Apart hotel experience in an excellent location
text: Very well located (access to 3 different metro stations, close to th e Bastille place). Modern facilities with spacious room and equipment up to the standards. Friendly front desk staff but not providing complete information on how an apart hotel works: During the 3 night stay we did not have contact with any housekeeping staff and obviously nobody came to check in our room if anything was needed, Too much traffic noise during the night.

title: Excellent Stay
text: The property was immaculate.  The room was good sized, and the kitchen was well supplied.  The breakfast was outstanding.  There was a wide variety of foods, and it was buffet style.  Coffee and tea were available 24 hours a day.  The staff spoke excellent English, and were very helpful.

title: Nothing special...
text:
Stayed here for 3 nights in Paris..

Good Points:
- Room was quite cheap in comparison to others
- Location is good with excellent links to Metro
- Area is safe to walk around
- Supermarket close by
- Bed was comfortable 

Bad Points: 
- Not the cleanest location 
- Furniture dated especially the kitchenette 

I suppose with this place I realised you get what you pay for. If you just want a cheap and cheerful weekend it would be fine.

title: Home from home in Paris
text: Great location for the Bastille Opera.   Just a leisurely walk from some of the most historic places in Paris - The River, the Islands, Notre Dame.   Great shops and restaurants are close by,   A big bonus is the availability of coffee/tea at any time close to reception.

title: very good
text: nice stay, excellente ubication. very confortable apartment. There is free coffee/tea available all day.  The staff was very kind and contributed to the wonderful stay we had. We strongly recommend to stay at Citadines.

title: Comme Ci Comme Ca
text:
This hotel was a recommendation from a co-worker, who happened to be visiting Paris at the same time (and also booked a stay here).  I had several questions before arriving (eg. laundry, luggage storage) and was able to get those answered via email prior to our stay.  The communications were great and at arrival, the front desk was genuine and friendly.  The rooms were not ready so we left the luggage in storage and returned around 3pm.  The check-in process was painful and such a long wait - we were required to sign forms for the police department and I felt it could have gone much smoother with passport in hand.  

The room was clean and spacious. There is no daily room service, but we were able to request a fresh set of towels or cleaning if need.  We purchased some sanitized wipes for the bathrooms, but clearly needed new bath linens and more bath tissue after 3 days, which were provided.  After room service, my cousin noticed her money was missing.  It was reported to the front desk, but nothing came of it.  There are safes in the hotel, but she didn't think anyone would go sorting through her bags and fish out 8 euro of coins and paper.

It was difficult to figure out how to unfold the sofa-bed on the first night, it would have been nice to have some instruction.  Overall, the beds were comfortable, the evenings were quiet, and we got a good night's rest.  The metro was less than a 2 minute walk away, and a variety of restaurants were about a 10 minute walk.  The location was good but there are better locations (provided you don't mind paying more).

title: Simply liars
text:
Appartment was NOTHING like what i saw in the picture and despite a chat session i had with a certain "Héène" that confirmed me that I would get what i saw in the picture: a room with a double bed and a sofa bed. I felt laughed at and frauded by the property that was not at all what was described to me by the customer service person
A big shout out and a big BRAVO to Tatiana: she handled the situation like a true pro boss unlike her 2 other colleagues who were looking at us without understanding our problem: I am a French native speaker and bilingual in English

title: Citadines, your best option in Paris
text: Very very nice hotel, excellent location, great staff, clean, spacious rooms, fully-equipped kitchen and nice and clean bathroom. I had a personal problem while staying at the hotel (my brother passed away) and had to cancel my stay while in Paris. The hotel staff responded more than kindly, were very considerate and reimbursed me for the cancelled nights. This made my ordeal so much bearable, I will never be able to thank them enough.

title: close to Metro and grocery store
text: We stayed for only a few nights; wish we could have stayed longer. The room overall was good. The beds were very comfortable. I could not sleep but it might have been due to jet lag. It also could have been a noisy fan that I could not figure out how to turn off. It was nice to have a kitchenette, a table and chairs, a sofa, and a separate bedroom with a door. One thing that was weird was that the toilet and the shower were in two separate rooms across the hall from each other. The shower was great! The metro was a short walk away which was very convenient. There was a nice continental breakfast in the lobby which included yummy bread, cheese, and salami. There is a grocery store a very short walk away as well as a few restaurants. Our room looked out over a courtyard but we kept the windows closed most of the time for privacy. The WiFi was good.

title: Best accomodation in Paris!
text:
We stayed for a week in an apartment in CItadines Bastille with our son. It was definetly a wonderful choice. 
This apart hotel is quite new and everything is impecable! We had a one bedroom apartment which had a double sofa bed in the living room. It had access to the terrace of the first floor. The kitchen is very well equipped and the bathroom is separated from the shower room, which is very convenient. The aaprtment was modern, very comfortable, it had wonderful heating and was spotless clean. 
an extra plus, there is coffee machine at the lobby with free hot beverages. It is lovely to come after the whole day walking in Paris and grab a coffee! 
Location is also perfect! Near Bastille and Le Marais and a few steps from the metro. Many bars and restaurants were at walking distance. 
Needless to say, it has elevator, which is not frequent if planning to rent an apartment in the area.
Citadines bastlle has become our home away from home when visiting Paris!

title: The best Citadines in Paris
text:
I love this Citadines, a wonderful warm welcome & all staff on the front desk so lovely & friendly every time I saw them.
Sorry I don't know all names but I remember Marina & Omar
Our room was at the front, facing into the street, with a balcony, loved it.
Walking distance to a lot of interesting places & the metro is also close by.
Loved the neighbourhood & the fabulous market.
Thank you everyone for making our stay so wonderful, this is definately where we will stay on our next trip to Paris

title: Safe, convenient, and family friendly!
text:
Love this apartment hotel! It is in a pretty safe neighborhood. About 5 min walk to the nearby metro, which takes us to all the touristy spots. It’s usually 15-25 mins to get to the key places to see in Paris. We stayed on the 7th floor, 2 twin beds, one full size pull out sofas for a family of 3 adults with plenty of space. Outside the window I can see Notre-Dame, Eiffel Tower, and Sacre Coeur. All are walkable but not recommended in the winter,  just take the metro lol. 

On Thursday and Sundays, the Bastille Market is right outside the hotel for delicious food to bring back and cook in the kitchenette. There’s are also a couple super makers super close, and a bakery we really like. 

If you walk down the street to the Bastille station, it’s a bunch busier street with lots of stores for food, restaurants, and shopping. 

Every night when we get back from touring Paris, we get a free cup of coffee/ hot chocolate / hot milk from the lobby before going back to our room. 

Another perk is there is a laundry area on the first floor, $9 Euro to wash and dry (detergent is included) and we brought our own bead fabric softener and dryer sheets though. 

Word of advice, booking through the hotels official site seems to be the most expensive option, I think I overpaid by at least $70 euros a night. I’m glad I did get this room, next time I might need to try booking though other sites.

title: Excellent accommodation in Paris
text: We usually stay in Airbnbs when traveling in Europe, but this time got a good deal on this apartment-hotel. After initially giving us a studio, the manager quickly correctly the issue and gave us our apartment as booked with a balcony. It has all the amenities and well located near 3 metro stations on 2 different lines. A groceries store is a block away and there are many restaurants in the nearby vicinity. Thursdays and Sundays a produce market is close to the hotel across the street. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Overall, very satisfied with this place. Will certainly stay here again if I ever come to Paris again.

title: Citadines Marais
text:
Well worth the cost.  Free coffee/tea.  Very warm welcome - staff so friendly and helpful., facilities spot on for price.  Booked direct, recommended.
Location excellent. Would definitely book again..  Check out the local supermarket Franprix for everything you could need (Waitrose quality). Thank you again for a lovely stay.

title: A very good stay and worth a return
text:
There are many things to recommend about this hotel. It is easy to get to via train and subway from CDG (one transfer at Gare Du Nord to Richard Lenoir). Secure access to the building, in room safe, well stocked kitchen with a cook top and microwave. I would highly recommend taking advantage of your kitchen and the Sunday market outside the hotel to live like a Parisian and make dinner from some of the wonderful produce and seafood available. If you like oysters pack your oyster knife. Many non-touristy local restaurants nearby as well. 
  We arrived in the morning after a trans-Atlantic flight. Our double bed room was not available - fair enough we were well before check in. But we were told if we would take two twins we could check in or pay for an upgrade. We declined and checked our bags. When we returned 15 minutes before check in we were told the same thing - no double rooms available but we could have a twin or upgrade for an additional 50 per night. We declined again and said we would wait in the lobby until our room was ready and guess what it suddenly was ready. Something to watch for when checking in. There is no need to book the hotel breakfast was there are two grocery stores nearby to pick up breakfast foods.

Even though it was November our room was incredibly hot and was uncomfortable without a window open. Not the most environmentally friendly situation.

title: A Very Special Apartment Hotel
text: We have stayed at this Citadines Apartment Hotel before and would not think about staying anywhere else in our future holidays in Paris.. the hotel is so centrally located and we especially appreciate the Bastille street market held on Thursday and Sunday for very fresh products within very easy walking distance and then the Bastille Opera House So close

title: Amazing accommodation in Paris
text:
We booked through Booking.com, we stayed there 7 nights and enjoy every moment at the place, very nice, helpful and friendly customer service, free coffee and tea all day. Free wi-fi.  Great location, close to the metro station and the Place Bastille. Nice neighborhood.
The apartment was very clean, spacious, comfortable and quiet. The kitchenette was fully equipped, everything works perfectly. We had supermarkets close by and plenty of restaurants. We had the opportunity to visit the Sunday markets across the road and really loved it.
Our family really enjoyed staying in this apartment. We really recommend Citadine Bastille Marais Paris.

title: Horrible never again!
text:
Great location close to Marais this is the good part of this place.

Horrible for meeting expectations of previous reviews.
 Paris has been experiencing warm weather for October. We were promised an air conditioned room. Apparently the manager and owner doesn't believe in meeting customer needs because the air had been shut off and we were told by the desk employees would not be turned back on. It was so hot in the rooms the windows had to be open.
The main boulevard out front is extremely noisy with traffic including motorcycles until 4am. Not only traffic noise there were people hanging out in front screaming, partying, fighting until 4:30am. Needless to say we got no sleep for 5 nights! Unacceptable! Will never stay again.

title: Live like a Parisan
text: This apartment/hotel is located in a neighborhood that is both convenient to the Metro, the Bastille Marche, local shops to pick up food and tourist sites. It's great for couples, friends or families who want a comfortable home away from home.

title: Comfortable aparthotel
text: This is a standard comfortable apartment hotel. I stayed there for one week and was fully satisfied. It is located in an interesting area, a few steps from Place Bastille and easy Metro (subway) access to all the key attractions of Paris. The kitchenette was fully equipped. There are several supermarkets and small bakeries nearby. It is certainly a good place to stay if you are in Paris for a longer time. Tea, coffee and hot chocolate is available in the lobby 24 hrs. I was making my own breakfast but the hotel also offers breakfast for a fee.

title: Happy Holiday
text:
I recently stayed in a studio apartment, I requested a balcony and was lucky enough to get one.  The room was a great size, it was clean, very comfortable and quiet.  The little separate kitchen was perfect with a good size fridge and microwave etc. 
A choice of a couple of little supermarkets close by plus plenty of restaurants to be found, the more you walk around the more you find!  Choice of train stations very close plus the 69 bus stops across the road and that took us to the Eiffel Tower, it was a great way to have a look at the city.
We visited the Sunday markets across the road and really enjoyed it, well worth a visit.
The front office staff were all very helpful and friendly and thankfully for me they spoke good English!
A nice hotel and good value for money.

title: Great accommodation for Paris
text: We stayed for 7 nights. I will always try in future to stay at a Citadines. The apartment concept combines advatagese of hotel with that of a air b&b. Friendly staff. Great to be able to make your own food. Free coffee. Free wifi. Laundromat and friendly staff. Very neat apartment. Great bed and duvet. Great view and location.

title: Location, good apartments.
text:
Very good location, walking distance from the marais, metro is 50 m away. Apartments are nice and well equipped. Several small supermarkets within 2 minutes walk allow to equip with groceries.
Cons: apartments are a bit old. Overall it is highly recommended.

title: Stay away!
text: There is one thing impossible to show with pictures: smell. My room smelled like a fish market. The cleaness at Citadines is very bad. Everything in the room has poor quality. The bed is unconfortable and the "double bed" in my room was two single beds joined together. If you are looking for something close to Marais and wish to pay less, there are lots of other hotels nearby. Otherwise, staying at Saint-Germain-des-Pres will certainly let you in a better neighbourhood and at great 3 star hotels, like the ones at Rue de L'Universitée. Not necessarily luxury, but clean and confortable hotels for the same price. I don't recommend this and would never stay there again.

title: Spacious studio apartment near Bastille
text: We stayed at a Citadines Aparthotel for the first time and were impressed. Our studio was spacious and plenty of natural light which was exactly as we requested. The small kitchen was ideal for our needs. We had an internal door which made our room quiet and peaceful. The staff were very helpful and welcoming. We did not have breakfast but you could get free tea/coffee all day long. There was 2 metro lines and bus (69) nearby to the hotel which made it easy for travelling around Paris. There were two supermarkets nearby and plenty of choice of cafes/restaurants within walking distance. There was a large market near to the hotel on Thurs morning (think also Sundays) which had lots of fruit/veg, cheese/meat/fish, clothing, accessories stalls etc. An excellent place to stay in Paris at a reasonable price and we would be happy to stay here again.

title: Good option for longer stay
text:
We stayed here for 18 nights and found the 1-bedroom apartment comfortable and quiet. At first I was skeptical because the hotel is on a busy street and the lobby is fairly plain. But we soon realized this location is a real neighborhood where people live and raise families. Metro stops are close and there is Bus 69 stop right across the street. This bus goes to the major landmarks in central Paris.  Two nearby groceries, plus the twice-weekly street market provide essentials. The kitchen had everything we needed, although we didn’t cook much. There are lots of restaurants within walking distance. 

We used the laundry facilities a few times. Only one dryer and two washers but ok for us. We used them in the mornings, as they were busier at night. 

The breakfast was really good and reasonably priced. Eggs and meat on the hot bar, boiled eggs, croissants, cheeses, cold meats, yoghurt, cereals, etc. Also a very good espresso/coffee machine. 

One difference between Citadines and a regular hotel is cleaning service is only once per week unless you pay extra. For two adults that’s fine. We made our own beds and emptied our trash ourselves. You can get extra soap, toilet paper, etc from the desk if you need it for no charge. 

Recommend this hotel for those staying longer.

title: Excellent place to stay in Paris
text:
Citadines Bastille Marais Paris is an excellent option to stay in Paris. Rooms have a complete kitchen with refrigerator, microwave oven, cooker, and very close to a market. It’s located very close to 2 metro lines making it easy to reach any where in Paris. And even walking from the hotel it’s easy to reach in a few minutes some postcards of the city as the Bastille monument and the place des Vosges. On sundays there’s a street market just in front of the hotel.
The staff was very friendly and helpful. Specially in one specific moment where I wanted to find an specific point in the city where my 6 yo daughter wanted to go. It was the boulangerie of a TV cartoon character (Marinete/ Ladybug) and Silvie was very friendly and discovered the real address to me! Thank you again silvie.
It was a very pleasant staying. I really recommend citadine Bastille Marais Paris.

title: Couldn’t ask for more!! Perfect for our needs!
text:
We stayed at Citadines Marais Bastille in August 2018 when there was a huge heat wave (37 degrees C) and it was perfect. Though the air con probably isn’t as good as other places it was definitely cool!

Value for money was brilliant (we paid £250 for 3 nights) in peak holiday time that is very good indeed.

The kitchen was brilliant - we had a studio apartment and were pleased to see he kitchen had a separate door that could be closed off. The kitchen has the essentials but no oven. There is a hob, plates, bowls, glasses etc and washing up liquid. 

The supermarket is opposite the hotel and it made our trip very reasonable - I cooked pasta dishes each night and saved us a fortune and bought bread for sandwiches in the day. 

The rooms are very quiet which is especially important to me because I am a light sleeper, the other excellent thing is there is a mini hall when you enter the room and another door which means you can’t hear anything from the corridor - super! 

Location wise it is central and breguet metro stop is down the road and the hotel is easy to spot from there. It has a connection to Gare du nord directly. You can also walk to chermin vert or bastille for other lines which they connect to most of them.

The neighbourhood is very safe and Parisian which we really liked - after walking round the Eiffel Tower area/ champs elysees I was so so glad we didn’t stay in those areas and stayed where we did as it was so much nicer.

Overall if you are on a budget and would like an aparthotel so you can cook to save money or even just to have your breakfast you honestly can’t ask for more - would absolutely definitely stay again!!!!

title: Great room & location
text:
We had a room with a kitchen that had a stovetop, fridge, and dishwasher. We were on the first floor and had a little patio area as well. The room was very clean and it was great to have an ironing board and iron and also laundry facilities. The bed was very comfortable and we were very happy to have air conditioning. 

It is in a great location. Explore the neighborhoods around the hotel as they are wonderful. There was also an outdoor market a few days during the week and on Saturday.

The staff were excellent!

Because we stayed less than 6 days we didn't have housekeeping which was fine. I would suggest leaving some cleaning products in the room.

We would stay here again.

title: Family of 4 Vacation 10 nights.
text:
We stayed at the Citadines Bastille Marais Paris for 10 nights in July 2018 for a family vacation. Two adults and two children ages 12 and 14. I would recommend it to families. It it not luxurious by any means and it is limited in its amenities, but it worked for us and the front desk staff were helpful and friendly. 

We had a one bedroom on the 3rd floor. The room was comfortable, albeit modest. The pull out couch was actually two separate twin mattresses which was perfect for our family. The beds and pillows comfortable. The kitchen area as well stocked with the appropriate cooking utensils and appliances including a mini dishwasher.  The room was clean and the Air Conditioning worked well for us! We were there in a middle of a blistering hot heat wave. Other reviewers said they couldn't control their AC but we could and it stayed cool. Our room was welcome cool relief at the end of a long hot day of sight seeing. We looked at Airbnb before booking here and most apartments did not have AC unless you wanted to pay considerably more. In our opinion, this hotel was a good value for that reason. And it was large enough for our family of 4 to be in one room. 

There is a supermarket directly across the street and a couple of convenience stores close by. Many many restaurants within close walking distance, and considerably less expensive in this neighborhood than the heart of the tourist areas. The Metro station is across the street and the main line #1 at Bastille is about a 10 minute walk and takes you directly to the main tourist areas. The area felt safe for us.    

As for the front desk, everyone was very friendly and there were absolutely no language issues. We attempted some basic French but everyone spoke English. One morning staff person (I think her name was Silvia) was particularly friendly and helpful with all of our needs. 

This is NOT a full service hotel. The breakfast was modest but certainly not overpriced. We utilized it some mornings but mostly ate breakfast in our room. People complaining about housekeeping should have understood this before booking. We had no issue putting our trash/recycling out, or asking for extra towels or toilet paper etc. We did our laundry 2x during our stay and that was very convenient to have on the premises. There is modest soap and shampoo in the room and a hairdryer on the wall. It is not "high powered", but typical for Europe. There is a safe in the room for passports and such. 

My biggest complaint was that the lobby was very tired. The furniture was even stained. Not a great first impression. The hallways are also tired and in some cases the carpet looked dirty.  From reading older posts it seems that a renovation of rooms may have happened in the past year or so. Our room did not look exactly like the photos on here but close enough. We did not have a balcony. 

Overall we were happy with our stay.

title: Clean rooms, quiet area, convenient
text:
Chose this Citadines over the centrally located ones for the larger rooms. It is close to metro stations or a 30min walk into the very centre of Paris.
The free coffee, tea and filtered water was a true bonus. A small cost to the hotel , yet it leaves everyone with a good impression. 
We used the kitchenette for breakfast and sometimes dinner. the dishwasher was the smallest I've ever used! The Casino supermarket across the road is a proper one with meat, fruit, vegetables and packaged goods. 
Double beds was comfortable and even the pillows were relatively soft. Sofa bed in the living room was a bit hard. Some parts of the apartment needed a bit of maintenance such as the bath mastic. Otherwise it was in reasonable shape. 

The road is quiet. Staff at the front desk were helpful. Overall, good value for money.

title: Great location
text: We stayed for a week, and our room, which included a living room and kitchenette, was quiet, clean and comfortable, with good air conditioning. The hotel is in a great location, within easy walking distance of at least four metro stations. Overall this hotel allowed us to have a fantastic time exploring Paris for the first time.

title: Beware of Thieves.
text:
I stayed at this hotel May 7-14. During my stay, I informed Staff that the safety box was not working, this was verified by a guest with me at the hotel. Feeling concerned about my safety on the streets, I hid my jewellery within luggage that only a very in-depth search would have located it. I then departed on the 14th onward to Spain. Upon my arrival in Spain, I realised the jewellery was missing. 
Upon contacting the hotel, they informed me that no jewellery had been ‘found ‘ further investigation proved that only myself & cleaning staff had entered the room. Key card access is only available to the rooms. But elevator can be accessed by anyone. It is my very strong belief that I was targeted and hotel staff along with others, allowed unknown persons to access the room. I have had correspondence with the hotel, and Citadines/ Ascot corporate offices, who have declined to accept responsibility for duty & care to their guests. This hotel is well known for repeated incidents regarding theft. One can only check with the relevant Police Department, and by other reviews here & other sites. I only chose this Citadines property as a colleague suggested it.
The hotel imply that my jewellery was stolen while traveling to Spain, which is totally incorrect as the bag in question was with me the whole time. I am a frequent traveler for business and fully aware to watch my belongings as they go thru airport security checks. 
The significant loss of my jewellery will never be compensated for, the loss of my diamond ring that was a gift from my late husband will never be replaced. If I can advise potential guests then my job is done. 
If you have suffered any issue with regard to theft at this Citadines/ Ascot or related properties  please let me know, a collective approach is far more effective. 
So my advice .... read the reviews and make your choice wisely. 
Avoid this Citadines and all other Citadines /Ascot properties.

title: Very smart choice
text: I like apartment hotel actually. It let you  feels at hotel. The small kitchen in the room is well maintained with full equipments. It includes microwave, small fridge , electronic stove, plates, glasses, cutleries even dish soap and sponge. Coffee machine at the lobby is free flow, my aunties love it. Staff are friendly and  you could keep luggage after check out and continue your city tour. Near by there's a popular local restaurant Cafe de I'Industrie , we had our dinner over there for 2 nights, it's really nice.  The metro ( Breguet - Sabirn) and supermarket are nearby just 3mins walk. It's really convenient and the area is not crowded with tourist. The most important thing is reasonable price, with 2 single beds and sofa bed for 4 people, I don't think I could find another better one in Paris.

title: Very nice hotel
text:
We had a great time and we really enjoyed our stay at Citadines Bastille. The room was big, comfortable and clean, we hade a nice balcony and the people on the desk were very nice and helpful.
A lovely place to stay and a great location.

title: Great apartment hotel in a Great location
text: We were very impressed with this apartment hotel, our apartment was great, on the sixth floor with great facilities, a balcony for evening drinks, light and airy, staff very helpful, reception area very welcoming, we have joined the citadines club and will definitely be back to this hotel and others in the group. We use Quest apartment hotels in New Zealand and Australia, we have used them often.

title: Loved it!
text: We have just returned from a 10 day stay in Paris and we loved our stay at this Aparthotel! We stayed in a 1 bedroom apartment and were lucky enough to be on the 6th floor, we had 2 gorgeous balconies with lovely views of Paris and everything we needed for our stay. We loved having the well stocked kitchenette, the beds and pillows were very comfortable, staff were friendly, it was close to supermarkets, 2 within 2 minute walk, lovely park across the road, metro station only a few minutes walk away and the most amazing markets twice a week also on your doorstep! Free water and tea and coffee from the breakfast room was available throughout the day and evening as was any left over pastries from breakfast. The breakfast buffet is extra but was extensive and well priced. The room was spotless and spacious and the pull out sofa for our 8 year old son was perfect. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars was only one elevator was working the entire length of our stay but to be fair they were upgrading and the laundry only has 2 washing machines, 1 of which wasn’t working. There were a couple of laundromats close by though so this wasn’t really a big deal. All in all we had no complaints, loved our stay here, would highly recommend and wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again if we are ever lucky enough to return!

title: Unexpected Pleasures
text:
I have now stayed in several Citadines hotels in France, and I generally find them quite nice. This hotel did not disappoint, and in fact had some exceptional features. First, for the price (c 160 euro per night in early april 2018) it was a bargain, located as it was right on the border of the Marais District, which is very hip. Second, some of the rooms have lovely views. I lucked out with an end Studio on the top floor that overlooked Paris rooftops and featured windows on three sides. In one window I saw Montparnasse Tower;in another I saw the Eiffel Tower; and in the third I saw Sacre-coeur. Some days I had trouble leaving the room because I just sat on the bed  with the windows open and gaped  at the beauty of Paris.
The studio was compact but not cramped, and the furnishings were modern and of a quality kind of like higher-end Ikea products . Kitchen well-stocked . Bathroom spacious and well laid out, oh I did need to call down for more towels a few times in 8 days. Rooms like mine on the Courtyard are very quiet, despite being on the major thoroughfare called Boulevard Richard Lenoir. The  Paris Metro and a number of buses  were within a 5-minute walk , so I could get anywhere in the city  very easily. 
The most outstanding feature, however, was the staff. They were so friendly and accommodating and very patient with my bad French. There was a woman named Karen I especially liked and a manager named Guillaume, both of whom should receive kudos. I stayed 8 days and pouted that I had to leave. We will be back.

title: Convenient,comfortable hotel with great staff.
text:
This hotel is lovely and quiet but you walk for about two minutes and the action of Paris is all around you.
It's vibrant and fun.
Nothing is too much for the staff here.
If I return to Paris(and I hope I do)I would definitely stay again.

title: Perfect location and a great place to stay
text:
The Citadines Marais is perfectly located just outside the city center across the street from the metro for easy access to anywhere you want or need to go.  We had four people and it perfectly accommodated us comfortably.  Having four people it was nice to have the toilet separate from the bathroom/shower area which is unusual for most other hotels.  It was a great base as we spent most days wandering the city.  There is a grocery a few minutes walk across the street and a huge outdoor market on Sundays and Thursdays just down the street.  Having the kitchenette was great as we were able to take advantage of both the grocery and market to buy fresh eggs, croissants cheese etc. to make our breakfast every morning and snacks for the end of the day.  

The area around Citadines is full of shops and cafes and very lively.  The room was well kept if not in need of a little updating.  Since we spent very few waking hours in the room it was not a big concern.  The area is safe and clean and quiet at night with a park directly across the street if you have little ones.  The staff were very friendly and although we did not pay for a breakfast we were able to get coffee and water everyday and any leftover pastries they had from breakfast.  We stayed for five nights and would stay again.

title: Good practical base for exploration
text: We have stayed at Citidines Munich before, so knew what to expect. The Citidines brand is standardised, but practical. Our room had a small separate kitchen so we could make our own breakfast or dinner if we chose. It's not tidied daily, or sheets/ towels changed daily either, so if you are messy, be warned! Location is great - close to Republique, restaurants, bars etc. And there is a street market a block or two further down twice a week. It's reasonably priced by Paris standards, close to the Metro and the staff are affable and multilingual. If you are looking for quaint Parisian charm, it's not your best bet. But good for convenience, location, getting around. Oh, and it has a useful guest laundry - do it yourself cheaply, not an expensive laundry service.

title: Stay at our own Peril
text: A serviced flat provided by my company for 3 months stay. Sometimes free is actually still paying too much. Blood stained pillows, dirty bathroom / room (even after the cleaner has been) and elevators that constantly are out of service with guests expected to drag suitcases and bags up and down 7 flights of stairs. Truly the worst place I have stayed out. Stay at your own peril.

title: Great location and a fantastic pace to stay!
text: This was our first time in Paris and we chose to stay here because we wanted a fridge and microwave in our room. We are so glad we made the choice to stay here. We loved the location and the neighborhood. There is a grocery store right across the street to stock our fridge. Also, we enjoyed many of the restaurants and cafes in the areas. There are 2 metro stops very close to the hotel, so getting to all of the tourist sites and landmarks was a piece of cake. We would suggest this hotel to anyone. We stayed for 7 days and we were very, very pleased the entire time.

title: really good
text: my experience in citadine bastille marias parris was very good. the location of the hotel is very good and is well connected by metro and other means of transpotation . i had taken a double bedroom apartment which was very spacious
